-- Luarmor: source-mode fallback from the LPH macro documentation.
-- Hot functions below use literal function arguments, as required by Luraph.
loadstring([[function LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(f) return f end;]])();

-- ===== executor compatibility layer (Delta, Arceus X, Xeno, Solara, Velocity, Potassium, Volt, Madium, ...) =====
-- Fills in functions that low-UNC executors lack, so missing ones degrade a feature instead of killing the script.
do
	local env = (type(getfenv) == "function" and getfenv()) or _G
	local genv = env
	pcall(function() if type(getgenv) == "function" then genv = getgenv() end end)
	local function get(name)
		local ok, value = pcall(function() return env[name] end)
		if ok and value ~= nil then return value end
		ok, value = pcall(function() return genv[name] end)
		if ok then return value end
		return nil
	end
	local function def(name, value)
		if value == nil then return end
		if get(name) == nil then pcall(function() env[name] = value end) end
		pcall(function() if rawget(genv, name) == nil then genv[name] = get(name) end end)
	end
	def("getgenv", function() return genv end)
	def("cloneref", function(object) return object end)
	def("newcclosure", function(fn) return fn end)
	def("checkcaller", function() return false end)
	def("gethui", function()
		local ok, gui = pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
		if ok and gui and pcall(function() local _ = gui:GetChildren() end) then return gui end
		local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
        if not player then return nil end
        return player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
	end)
	local function nested(lib, field) local t = get(lib); return type(t) == "table" and t[field] or nil end
	local req = get("request") or get("http_request") or nested("syn", "request") or nested("http", "request") or nested("fluxus", "request")
	def("request", req)
	def("http_request", req)
	-- in-memory files for executors without a file system
	local memory = {}
	def("isfile", function(path) return memory[path] ~= nil end)
	def("readfile", function(path) return memory[path] or "" end)
	def("writefile", function(path, data) memory[path] = tostring(data) end)
	def("appendfile", function(path, data) memory[path] = (memory[path] or "") .. tostring(data) end)
	def("delfile", function(path) memory[path] = nil end)
	def("isfolder", function() return true end)
	def("makefolder", function() end)
	def("listfiles", function() return {} end)
	def("setclipboard", get("toclipboard") or function() end)
	pcall(function() genv.__CrackHubRealSetFps = get("setfpscap") end)
	def("setfpscap", function() end)
	def("queue_on_teleport", nested("syn", "queue_on_teleport") or function() end)
	def("identifyexecutor", get("getexecutorname") or function() return "Unknown", "" end)
	def("getobjects", function(url)
		local ok, objects = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects(url) end)
		if ok and type(objects) == "table" and #objects > 0 then return objects end
		local id = tonumber(tostring(url):match("%d+"))
		local okI, model = pcall(function() return game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadLocalAsset("rbxassetid://" .. id) end)
		if okI and model then return {model} end
		return {}
	end)
	-- aliases only: same function under another executor's name (no fake stubs)
	def("getcustomasset", get("getsynasset") or nested("syn", "getsynasset"))
	def("hookmetamethod", nested("syn", "hookmetamethod"))
	def("hookfunction", get("replaceclosure") or get("detour_function") or nested("syn", "hookfunction"))
	def("getnamecallmethod", get("get_namecall_method"))
	def("getconnections", get("get_signal_cons") or nested("syn", "getconnections"))
	def("firetouchinterest", get("fire_touch_interest"))
	def("fireclickdetector", get("fire_click_detector"))
	def("fireproximityprompt", get("fire_proximity_prompt"))
	def("sethiddenproperty", get("set_hidden_property") or get("sethiddenprop"))
	def("gethiddenproperty", get("get_hidden_property") or get("gethiddenprop"))
	def("getthreadidentity", get("getidentity") or get("getthreadcontext"))
	def("setthreadidentity", get("setidentity") or get("setthreadcontext"))
	def("mousemoverel", get("mouse_moverel"))
	-- heavy assets (music, covers, animations) live on GitHub: downloaded once, then read from the CrackHub/assets folder
	pcall(function()
		genv.__CrackHubAssetBase = genv.__CrackHubAssetBase or "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hehejwkkkq1-art/crackhubasssest/main/"
		local SECOND_BASE = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hehejwkkkq1-art/Assserw2222/main/"
		local IN_SECOND = {["skin_data.json"] = true, ["custom_pictures.json"] = true, ["pictures.json"] = true, ["sound_data.json"] = true,
			["snapshot.json"] = true, ["items.json"] = true, ["pig_talk.txt"] = true}
		local function baseFor(name) return IN_SECOND[name:match("[^/]+$")] and SECOND_BASE or genv.__CrackHubAssetBase end
		-- Bounded callers, shared in-flight requests, validated cache, and optional resources.
local assetMemory, assetJobs, assetFailures, assetWarned = {}, {}, {}, {}
local activeDownloads = 0
local assetHttp = game:GetService("HttpService")
genv.__CrackHubStartupStats = {started = os.clock(), phase = "resources", building = true, lastYield = os.clock()}
local function validAsset(name, value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" or #value == 0 or value:match("^%s*404") then return false end
    if name:match("%.json$") then
        local ok, decoded = pcall(assetHttp.JSONDecode, assetHttp, value)
        return ok and type(decoded) == "table"
    end
    return true
end
local function rememberAsset(name, value, path)
    if not validAsset(name, value) then return false end
    assetMemory[name] = value
    assetFailures[name] = nil
    if path then
        pcall(function()
            local mf, isd, wf = get("makefolder"), get("isfolder"), get("writefile")
            if mf and isd and not isd("CrackHub") then mf("CrackHub") end
            if mf and isd and not isd("CrackHub/assets") then mf("CrackHub/assets") end
            if wf then wf(path, value) end
        end)
    end
    return true
end
genv.__CrackHubAsset = function(name)
    if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return nil end
    if assetMemory[name] then return assetMemory[name] end
    if assetFailures[name] and os.clock() - assetFailures[name] < 3 then return nil end
    local path = "CrackHub/assets/" .. name:gsub("/", "_")
    local okCache, cached = pcall(function()
        local isf, rf = get("isfile"), get("readfile")
        if isf and rf and isf(path) then return rf(path) end
    end)
    if okCache and rememberAsset(name, cached) then return cached end
    local deadline = os.clock() + 6
    local startup = genv.__CrackHubStartupStats
    if startup and startup.building then deadline = math.min(deadline, startup.started + 6) end
    if os.clock() >= deadline then return nil end
    local job = assetJobs[name]
    if not job then
        job = {done = false}
        assetJobs[name] = job
        task.spawn(function()
            while activeDownloads >= 3 and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait(0.05) end
            if os.clock() >= deadline then job.done = true; assetJobs[name] = nil; return end
            activeDownloads += 1
            local okWorker, workerError = pcall(function()
                local url = baseFor(name) .. name:match("[^/]+$")
                local req = get("request")
                if type(req) == "function" then
                    local okR, res = pcall(req, {Url = url, Method = "GET", Timeout = 5})
                    if okR and type(res) == "table" and tonumber(res.StatusCode) == 200 then
                        if rememberAsset(name, res.Body, path) then return end
                    end
                end
                if os.clock() < deadline then
                    local okGet, data = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url, true) end)
                    if okGet then rememberAsset(name, data, path) end
                end
            end)
            activeDownloads -= 1
            job.done = true
            assetJobs[name] = nil
            if not assetMemory[name] then assetFailures[name] = os.clock() end
            if not okWorker then warn("[CrackHub asset] " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(workerError)) end
        end)
    end
    while not job.done and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait(0.05) end
    if not assetMemory[name] and not assetWarned[name] then
        assetWarned[name] = true
        warn("[CrackHub asset] " .. name .. " unavailable; using the built-in fallback")
    end
    return assetMemory[name]
end
genv.__CrackHubJSONAsset = function(name)
    local raw = genv.__CrackHubAsset(name)
    if type(raw) ~= "string" then return {} end
    local ok, decoded = pcall(assetHttp.JSONDecode, assetHttp, raw)
    if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then return decoded end
    return {}
end
-- Overlap the three first-use catalog downloads with UI/module definition.
for _, name in ipairs({"skin_data.json", "custom_pictures.json", "pictures.json"}) do
    task.spawn(genv.__CrackHubAsset, name)
end

	end)
	local missing = {}

	for _, name in {"hookmetamethod", "getnamecallmethod", "getconnections", "getcustomasset", "request", "Drawing", "sethiddenproperty"} do if get(name) == nil then table.insert(missing, name) end end
	local okName, exec = pcall(get("identifyexecutor"))
	print("[CrackHub] executor: " .. tostring(okName and exec or "?") .. (#missing > 0 and (" | missing: " .. table.concat(missing, ", ")) or " | all features available"))
end


task.spawn(function()
local startupOK, startupError = xpcall(function()

local CrackHubEnvironment = _G
if type(getgenv) == "function" then
	local ok, env = pcall(getgenv)
	if ok and type(env) == "table" then CrackHubEnvironment = env end
end

CrackHubEnvironment.__CrackHubStartupStats.builder = coroutine.running()
-- Snapshot of the REAL MM2 inventory as soon as it loads (before any client-side skin changer runs),
-- so Player Info can value only items you actually own.
task.spawn(function()
	local key = "CrackHubRealInventory_" .. tostring(game.JobId)
	if type(CrackHubEnvironment[key]) == "table" then return end
	for _ = 1, 240 do
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			local modules = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Modules")
			local module = modules and modules:FindFirstChild("ProfileData")
			return module and require(module)
		end)
		if ok and type(data) == "table" and type(data.Weapons) == "table" and type(data.Weapons.Owned) == "table" and next(data.Weapons.Owned) then
			local snapshot = { Weapons = table.clone(data.Weapons.Owned) }
			if type(data.Pets) == "table" and type(data.Pets.Owned) == "table" then snapshot.Pets = table.clone(data.Pets.Owned) end
			CrackHubEnvironment[key] = snapshot
			return
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
end)

local AttachCrackHubGui; AttachCrackHubGui = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(gui)
	local candidates = {}
	local hiddenUI = gethui or CrackHubEnvironment.gethui
	if type(hiddenUI) == "function" then
		local ok, parent = pcall(hiddenUI)
		if ok and typeof(parent) == "Instance" then table.insert(candidates, parent) end
	end
	local ok, core = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end))
	if ok and core then table.insert(candidates, core) end
	local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
	local playerGui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if playerGui then table.insert(candidates, playerGui) end
	for _, parent in ipairs(candidates) do
		local attached = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() gui.Parent = parent end))
		if attached and gui.Parent == parent then return parent end
	end
	error("Failed to create the CrackHub window")
end)

local function CrackHubHttpGet(url)
	local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url, true) end)
	if ok and type(body) == "string" and #body > 0 then return body end
	local httpGet = httpget or CrackHubEnvironment.httpget
	if type(httpGet) == "function" then
		local received, text = pcall(httpGet, url)
		if received and type(text) == "string" and #text > 0 then return text end
	end
	local send = request or http_request or CrackHubEnvironment.request or CrackHubEnvironment.http_request
	if type(send) == "function" then
		local received, response = pcall(send, { Url = url, Method = "GET" })
		if received and type(response) == "table" then
			local status = tonumber(response.StatusCode)
			if status and status >= 200 and status < 300 and type(response.Body) == "string" then return response.Body end
		end
	end
	error("Failed to load data")
end

-- Shimmer: animated gradient that flows across logos and titles
local Shimmers = {}
local function Shimmer(target, kind)
	local g = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") or Instance.new("UIGradient")
	if kind == "text" then
		g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.Text),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, Theme.Text),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Theme.Accent),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, Theme.Accent),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, Theme.Text),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.Text),
		})
	else
		g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.Accent),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Theme.Accent),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.Accent),
		})
	end
	g.Rotation = kind == "text" and 0 or 45
	g.Enabled = true
	g.Parent = target
	Shimmers[g] = kind
	return g
end
do
	local acc = 0
	local shimmerRate = (game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled and not game:GetService("UserInputService").KeyboardEnabled) and 1 / 15 or 1 / 30
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
		acc += dt
		if acc < shimmerRate then return end
		acc = 0
		local x = (os.clock() * 0.45) % 2 - 1
		for g, kind in pairs(Shimmers) do
			if not g.Parent then
				Shimmers[g] = nil
			else
				g.Offset = Vector2.new(kind == "text" and x or x * 0.5, 0)
			end
		end
	end))
end

local ApplyIcon; ApplyIcon = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(img, icon)
	local asset = type(icon) == "string" and CRACKHUB_ICON_ASSETS[icon]
	if asset then
		img.Image = asset
		img.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero
		img.ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero
		return
	end
	local l = type(icon) == "string" and LUCIDE[icon]
	if l then
		img.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. l[1]
		img.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(l[2], l[3])
		img.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(48, 48)
	elseif icon then
		img.Image = icon
	end
end)

local Create; Create = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(class, props, children)
    local startup = CrackHubEnvironment.__CrackHubStartupStats
    if startup and startup.building and startup.builder == coroutine.running() then
        if os.clock() - startup.lastYield >= 0.008 then
            task.wait()
            startup.lastYield = os.clock()
        end
    end
	local inst = Instance.new(class)
	local parent
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do
		if k == "Parent" then parent = v else inst[k] = v end
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(children or {}) do
		child.Parent = inst
	end
	if class == "ScreenGui" then AttachCrackHubGui(inst) elseif parent then inst.Parent = parent end
	return inst
end)

local Tween; Tween = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(obj, props, time, style, dir)
	local t = TweenService:Create(
		obj,
		TweenInfo.new(time or 0.25, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		props
	)
	t:Play()
	return t
end)

local Corner; Corner = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(r)
	return Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 8) })
end)

		Color = color or Theme.Stroke,
		Thickness = thickness or 1,
		Transparency = transparency or 0,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
	})
end)

local function IconLine(parent, x, y, len, rot, color, thick)
	return Create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0.5, y),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, thick or 2),
		Rotation = rot,
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Parent = parent,
	}, { Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }) })
end


local function Icon(kind, parent, color, size)
	local h = Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size or 14, size or 14),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	local asset = CRACKHUB_ICON_ASSETS[kind == "chevron" and "chevron-down" or kind]
	if asset then
		Create("ImageLabel", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Image = asset, ImageColor3 = color, Parent = h})
		return h
	end
	if kind == "chevron" then
		IconLine(h, -2.3, -0.5, 7, 45, color)
		IconLine(h, 2.3, -0.5, 7, -45, color)
	elseif kind == "check" then
		IconLine(h, -2.6, 1.4, 5, 45, color)
		IconLine(h, 1.4, -0.4, 9, -52, color)
	elseif kind == "x" then
		IconLine(h, 0, 0, 10, 45, color)
		IconLine(h, 0, 0, 10, -45, color)
	elseif kind == "search" then
		Create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -1.5, 0.5, -1.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Parent = h,
		}, {
			Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }),
			Create("UIStroke", { Color = color, Thickness = 1.5 }),
		})
		IconLine(h, 3.6, 3.6, 4.5, 45, color, 1.5)
	end
	return h
end

local function IconColor(h, color, time)
	for _, d in ipairs(h:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Frame") and d.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then
			TweenService:Create(d, TweenInfo.new(time or 0.2), { BackgroundColor3 = color }):Play()
		elseif d:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			TweenService:Create(d, TweenInfo.new(time or 0.2), { ImageColor3 = color }):Play()
		elseif d:IsA("UIStroke") then
			TweenService:Create(d, TweenInfo.new(time or 0.2), { Color = color }):Play()
		end
	end
end

local function IconAlpha(h, alpha, time)
	for _, d in ipairs(h:GetChildren()) do
		if d:IsA("Frame") then
			TweenService:Create(d, TweenInfo.new(time or 0.2), { BackgroundTransparency = alpha }):Play()
		elseif d:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			TweenService:Create(d, TweenInfo.new(time or 0.2), { ImageTransparency = alpha }):Play()
		end
	end
end

	return Create("TextLabel", p)
end)

local order = 0

	order += 1

local function SafeCall(fn, ...)
	if typeof(fn) ~= "function" then return end
	local args = table.pack(...)
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, err = pcall(fn, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
		if not ok then
			warn("[CrackHub] Callback error: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end)
end

local function IsClick(input)
	return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

local function IsMove(input)
	return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

local function Ripple(frame)
	local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset()
	local rel = mouse - frame.AbsolutePosition
	local size = math.max(frame.AbsoluteSize.X, frame.AbsoluteSize.Y) * 2.2
	local circle = Create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(rel.X, rel.Y),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.7,
		ZIndex = 5,
		Parent = frame,
	}, { Corner(999) })
	Tween(circle, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.6)
	task.delay(0.6, function() circle:Destroy() end)
end

local function MakeDraggable(handle, target, conns)
	local dragging, startInput, startPos
	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if IsClick(input) then
			dragging = true
			startInput = input.Position
			startPos = target.Position
			local c
			c = input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
					c:Disconnect()
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and IsMove(input) then
			local d = input.Position - startInput
			target.Position=UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale,startPos.X.Offset+d.X,startPos.Y.Scale,startPos.Y.Offset+d.Y)
		end
	end))
end

local function OnDrag(button, conns, onUpdate, onEnd)
	local dragging=false
	local moveConnection,endConnection
	local function finish(notify)
		local wasDragging=dragging; dragging=false
		if moveConnection then moveConnection:Disconnect(); moveConnection=nil end
		if endConnection then endConnection:Disconnect(); endConnection=nil end
		if wasDragging and notify and onEnd then onEnd() end
	end
	local began=button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if not IsClick(input) then return end
		finish(false); dragging=true
		moveConnection=UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(value)
			if dragging and IsMove(value) then onUpdate(value.Position) end
		end)
		endConnection=UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(value)
			if IsClick(value) then finish(true) end
		end)
		onUpdate(input.Position)
	end)
	table.insert(conns,{Disconnect=function() finish(false); began:Disconnect() end})
end

local function Hover(button, frame, normal, hover)
	local st = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	if frame:GetAttribute("InGroup") then

		frame.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
		button.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Tween(frame, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.92 }, 0.2) end)
		button.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Tween(frame, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.2) end)
		return
	end
	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		Tween(frame, { BackgroundColor3 = hover or Theme.ElementHover }, 0.2)
		if st then Tween(st, { Color = Theme.Accent, Transparency = 0.55 }, 0.25) end
	end)
	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		Tween(frame, { BackgroundColor3 = normal or Theme.Element }, 0.2)
		if st then Tween(st, { Color = Theme.Stroke, Transparency = 0.35 }, 0.25) end
	end)
end

local function FirstChar(str)
	return str:match("^[%z\1-\127\194-\244][\128-\191]*") or "N"
end








local KeyShort = {
	LeftControl = "LCtrl", RightControl = "RCtrl", LeftShift = "LShift", RightShift = "RShift",
	LeftAlt = "LAlt", RightAlt = "RAlt", Return = "Enter", Backspace = "Bksp", Escape = "Esc",
	CapsLock = "Caps", Delete = "Del", Insert = "Ins", PageUp = "PgUp", PageDown = "PgDn",
	Backquote = "`", Minus = "-", Equals = "=", LeftBracket = "[", RightBracket = "]",
	Semicolon = ";", Quote = "'", Comma = ",", Period = ".", Slash = "/", BackSlash = "\\",
	Zero = "0", One = "1", Two = "2", Three = "3", Four = "4",
	Five = "5", Six = "6", Seven = "7", Eight = "8", Nine = "9",
}
local MouseShort = {
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1] = "MB1",
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2] = "MB2",
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3] = "MB3",
}

local function NormalizeBind(v)
	if type(v)=="table" then v=v.Key or v.Mouse end
	if typeof(v) ~= "EnumItem" then return nil end
	if v==Enum.KeyCode.Escape or v==Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return nil end
	if v.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode then return { Key = v } end
	if MouseShort[v] then return { Mouse = v } end
	return nil
end

local BindName; BindName = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(b)
	if not b then return "—" end
	if b.Mouse then return MouseShort[b.Mouse] or b.Mouse.Name end
	return KeyShort[b.Key.Name] or b.Key.Name
end)

local function BindMatches(b, input)
	if not b then return false end
	if b.Key then
		return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and input.KeyCode == b.Key
	end
	return input.UserInputType == b.Mouse
end



local BindCapture={Active=nil,LastInput=nil,EscapeUntil=0}
do
	local service=game:GetService("ContextActionService")
	local name="CrackHubCaptureEscape_"..HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local regularBound,coreBound=false,false
	local version=0
	local function unbind()
		if regularBound then pcall(function() service:UnbindAction(name) end); regularBound=false end
		if coreBound then pcall(function() service:UnbindCoreAction(name) end); coreBound=false end
	end
	function BindCapture:Blocked(input)
		return self.Active~=nil or (input==self.LastInput and os.clock()-(self.LastInputAt or 0)<0.3) or (input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape and os.clock()<self.EscapeUntil)
	end
	function BindCapture:Finish(owner,input)
		if not self.Active or self.Active.Owner~=owner then return end
		self.Active=nil; self.LastInput=input; self.LastInputAt=os.clock()
		version+=1
		local mine=version
		if input and input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			self.EscapeUntil=os.clock()+0.25
			task.delay(0.26,function() if version==mine and not self.Active then unbind() end end)
		else unbind() end
	end
	function BindCapture:Cancel(input)
		local active=self.Active
		if not active then return end
		self:Finish(active.Owner,input)
		active.Cancel(input)
	end
	local function escape(_,state,input)
		if not BindCapture.Active and os.clock()>=BindCapture.EscapeUntil then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
		if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin and BindCapture.Active then BindCapture:Cancel(input) end
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end
	function BindCapture:Begin(owner,cancel)
		self:Cancel()
		version+=1
		self.Active={Owner=owner,Cancel=cancel}
		self.LastInput=nil
		regularBound=pcall(function() service:BindActionAtPriority(name,escape,false,10000,Enum.KeyCode.Escape) end)
		coreBound=pcall(function() service:BindCoreActionAtPriority(name,escape,false,10000,Enum.KeyCode.Escape) end)
	end
	function BindCapture:Stop()
		self:Cancel(); version+=1
		self.LastInput=nil; self.EscapeUntil=0
		unbind()
	end
end

local function AddBindChip(parent, conns, x, initial, cfg)
	cfg = cfg or {}
	local bind = NormalizeBind(initial)
	local binding = false
	local captureConnection,savedBind
	local lastAction = 0

	local chip = Create("TextButton", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, x, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Text = "",
		FontFace = Fonts.Medium,
		TextSize = 11,
		TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
		ZIndex = 3,
		Parent = parent,
	}, {
		Corner(6),
		Padding(0, 8, 0, 8),
		Create("UISizeConstraint", { MinSize = Vector2.new(32, 22) }),
	})
	local st = Stroke(Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)
	st.Parent = chip

	local function refresh()
		chip.Text = binding and "Press..." or (BindName(bind) .. (CrackHub.BindModeSuffix and CrackHub.BindModeSuffix(chip) or ""))
		Tween(chip, { TextColor3 = binding and Theme.Accent or Theme.SubText }, 0.15)
		Tween(st, { Color = binding and Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke }, 0.15)
	end

	local obj = { Frame = chip }
	CrackHub.BindRegistry = CrackHub.BindRegistry or {}
	table.insert(CrackHub.BindRegistry, obj)
	function obj:Refresh() refresh() end
	chip.MouseButton2Click:Connect(function() if CrackHub.OpenBindMenu then CrackHub.OpenBindMenu(obj) end end)
	function obj:Get() return bind end
	function obj:Set(v, silent)
		if v==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then return end
		if BindCapture.Active and BindCapture.Active.Owner==obj then BindCapture:Cancel() end
		bind = NormalizeBind(v)
		refresh()
		if not silent and cfg.OnChange then SafeCall(cfg.OnChange, bind) end
	end

	chip.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if not binding then Tween(st, { Color = Theme.Accent, Transparency = 0.5 }, 0.15) end
	end)
	chip.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if not binding then Tween(st, { Color = Theme.Stroke, Transparency = 0.5 }, 0.15) end
	end)

	chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if binding or os.clock() - lastAction < 0.25 then return end
		savedBind=bind
		binding = true
		BindCapture:Begin(obj,function(input)
			local clear=input and input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape
			binding=false; lastAction=os.clock()
			if clear then bind=nil else bind=savedBind end
			if captureConnection then captureConnection:Disconnect(); captureConnection=nil end
			refresh()
			if clear and savedBind and cfg.OnChange then SafeCall(cfg.OnChange,nil) end
		end)
		refresh()
		local conn
		conn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
			if not binding then return end
			local t = input.UserInputType
			local finish, changed = false, false
			if t == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
					BindCapture:Cancel(input)
					return
				else
					if gp then return end
					if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
						bind = nil
					else
						bind = { Key = input.KeyCode }
					end
					finish, changed = true, true
				end
			elseif MouseShort[t] then
				if gp then
					finish = true
				elseif not cfg.KeyboardOnly then
					bind = { Mouse = t }
					finish, changed = true, true
				end
			end
			if finish then
				BindCapture:Finish(obj,input)
				binding = false
				lastAction = os.clock()
				conn:Disconnect()
				refresh()
				if changed and cfg.OnChange then SafeCall(cfg.OnChange, bind) end
			end
		end)
		captureConnection=conn
	end)
	table.insert(conns,{Disconnect=function()
		if BindCapture.Active and BindCapture.Active.Owner==obj then BindCapture:Cancel() end
		if captureConnection then captureConnection:Disconnect(); captureConnection=nil end
	end})

	if cfg.OnPress then
		table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
			if binding or not bind or BindCapture:Blocked(input) or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
			if gp and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
			if os.clock() - lastAction < 0.15 then return end
			if BindMatches(bind, input) then
				local mode = chip:GetAttribute("BindMode") or "Toggle"
				local owner = obj.Owner
				if owner and owner.Type == "Toggle" and mode == "Hold" then
					if not owner.Value then owner:Set(true) end
				elseif owner and owner.Type == "Toggle" and mode == "Always" then
					if not owner.Value then owner:Set(true) end
				else
					SafeCall(cfg.OnPress)
				end
			end
		end))
		table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if binding or not bind then return end
			local owner = obj.Owner
			if owner and owner.Type == "Toggle" and chip:GetAttribute("BindMode") == "Hold" and BindMatches(bind, input) then
				if owner.Value then owner:Set(false) end
			end
		end))
	end

	refresh()
	return obj
end


local function AttachTitleBind(f, titleLbl, window, yOffset, cfg)
	local chip = AddBindChip(f, window.Connections, 0, cfg.Initial, cfg)
	chip.Frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	local function place()
		chip.Frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14 + math.min(titleLbl.TextBounds.X, 220) + 10, yOffset)
	end
	titleLbl:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextBounds"):Connect(place)
	place()
	return chip
end



local function WantsBind(window, o)
	if o.Bind == false then return false end
	if o.Bind == nil and window.AutoBind == false then return false end
	return true
end

local function MakeBind(self, o, obj, f, titleLbl, yOffset, onPress)
	if not WantsBind(self.Window, o) then return end
	obj.BindChip = AttachTitleBind(f, titleLbl, self.Window, yOffset, {
		Initial = (o.Bind ~= true and o.Bind) or nil,
		OnChange = function(b)
			obj.BindValue = b
			SafeCall(o.BindChanged, b)
		end,
		OnPress = onPress,
	})
	obj.BindValue = obj.BindChip:Get()
	obj.BindChip.Owner = obj
end


local function Lower(s)
	local ok, res = pcall(function()
		local t = {}
		for _, c in utf8.codes(s) do
			if c >= 65 and c <= 90 then
				c += 32
			elseif c >= 0x410 and c <= 0x42F then
				c += 32
			elseif c == 0x401 then
				c = 0x451
			end
			t[#t + 1] = utf8.char(c)
		end
		return table.concat(t)
	end)
	return ok and res or string.lower(s)
end

function CrackHub:CreateWindow(opts)
	opts = opts or {}


	Mac = (opts.Style or "macOS") ~= "Neon"
	if Mac then
		for k, v in pairs(MacTheme) do Theme[k] = v end

		local SF = "rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json"
		Fonts.Regular = Font.new(SF, Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
		Fonts.Medium  = Font.new(SF, Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold)
		Fonts.Bold    = Font.new(SF, Enum.FontWeight.Bold)
	end

	if type(opts.Font) == "string" then
		local fam = "rbxasset://fonts/families/" .. opts.Font .. ".json"
		Fonts.Regular = Font.new(fam, Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
		Fonts.Medium  = Font.new(fam, opts.Font == "Ubuntu" and Enum.FontWeight.Medium or Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold)
		Fonts.Bold    = Font.new(fam, Enum.FontWeight.Bold)
	end

	local themeOpt = opts.Theme
	if type(themeOpt) == "string" then themeOpt = CrackHub.Themes[themeOpt] end
	if type(themeOpt) == "table" then
		for k, v in pairs(themeOpt) do Theme[k] = v end
	end


	if typeof(opts.CardColor) == "Color3" then Theme.Card = opts.CardColor end



	local cc = opts.ControlColor
	if cc then
		if typeof(cc) == "Color3" then
			Theme.Accent, Theme.Accent2 = cc, cc
			Theme.ToggleOn = cc
		elseif type(cc) == "table" then
			Theme.Accent  = cc[1] or cc.Accent or Theme.Accent
			Theme.Accent2 = cc[2] or cc.Accent2 or Theme.Accent
			Theme.ToggleOn = Theme.Accent
		end
	end

	local title = opts.Title or "CrackHub"
	local subtitle = opts.Subtitle or "UI Library"
	local size = opts.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(600, 420)
	local toggleKey = opts.ToggleKey or Enum.KeyCode.RightShift

	local Window = { Tabs = {}, Connections = {}, Visible = true, Minimized = false, Destroyed = false }
	Window.UIMode = "Rage Mode"
	local safeVisualTabs = {
		World = true, ["World 2"] = true, Weather = true, Sky = true, Effects = true, Trails = true, Character = true, Camera = true, Auras = true,
	}
	function Window:CanShowTab(tab)
		if self.UIMode == "Rage Mode" then return true end
		return tab.Group ~= nil and tab.Group.Name == "Visuals" and safeVisualTabs[tab.Name] == true
	end
	local introThread
	local conns = Window.Connections
	-- Drag-to-scroll: hold the left mouse button (or a finger) on a list and pull it, like on a phone.
	-- It starts only after a clear pull along the list, so sliders and buttons keep working.
	local DragScrollFrames = {}
	local function EnableDragScroll(sf)
		table.insert(DragScrollFrames, sf)
	end
	do
		local drag = nil -- { sf, start, canvas, active, horizontal }
		local function inside(sf, pos)
			if not sf.Parent or not sf.Visible then return false end
			local p, sz = sf.AbsolutePosition, sf.AbsoluteSize
			return pos.X >= p.X and pos.X <= p.X + sz.X and pos.Y >= p.Y and pos.Y <= p.Y + sz.Y
		end
		local function visibleOnScreen(sf)
			local o = sf
			while o and o:IsA("GuiObject") do
				if not o.Visible then return false end
				o = o.Parent
			end
			return true
		end
		table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			local t = input.UserInputType
			if t ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and t ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			local pos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
			-- the innermost (smallest) list under the pointer wins
			local best, bestArea = nil, math.huge
			for i = #DragScrollFrames, 1, -1 do
				local sf = DragScrollFrames[i]
				if not sf.Parent then
					table.remove(DragScrollFrames, i)
				elseif inside(sf, pos) and visibleOnScreen(sf) then
					local area = sf.AbsoluteSize.X * sf.AbsoluteSize.Y
					if area < bestArea then best, bestArea = sf, area end
				end
			end
			if best then
				drag = { sf = best, start = pos, canvas = best.CanvasPosition, active = false, touch = t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
					horizontal = best.ScrollingDirection == Enum.ScrollingDirection.X }
			end
		end))
		table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if not drag then return end
			local t = input.UserInputType
			if t ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and t ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			local pos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
			local d = pos - drag.start
			local along, across = drag.horizontal and d.X or d.Y, drag.horizontal and d.Y or d.X
			if not drag.active then
				if math.abs(along) < 8 or math.abs(along) < math.abs(across) * 1.4 then return end
				drag.active = true
				drag.start = pos
				drag.canvas = drag.sf.CanvasPosition
				-- a phone already scrolls a list natively: let Roblox do it, only the mouse needs help
				if drag.touch then drag = nil; return end
				return
			end
			local sf = drag.sf
			local maxX = math.max(0, sf.AbsoluteCanvasSize.X - sf.AbsoluteWindowSize.X)
			local maxY = math.max(0, sf.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - sf.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
			local sc = Window.ScaleObj and Window.ScaleObj.Scale or 1
			if sc < 0.05 then sc = 1 end
			if drag.horizontal then
				sf.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(math.clamp(drag.canvas.X - d.X / sc, 0, maxX), sf.CanvasPosition.Y)
			else
				sf.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(sf.CanvasPosition.X, math.clamp(drag.canvas.Y - d.Y / sc, 0, maxY))
			end
		end))
		table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			local t = input.UserInputType
			if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then drag = nil end
		end))
	end

	local Gui = Create("ScreenGui", {
		Name = "CrackHub",
		ResetOnSpawn = false,
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
		DisplayOrder = 100,
		Parent = nil,
	})
	Window.Gui = Gui

	local Root = Create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -size.Y.Offset / 2),
		Size = size,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = Gui,
	})
	local Scale = Create("UIScale", { Scale = 1, Parent = Root })
	Window.ScaleObj = Scale
	-- auto size: the menu always fits the screen (phones, tablets, small windows); PC at normal size stays 1
	do
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local function fit()
			if Window.Destroyed or Window.__No2DFx then return end
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not cam then return end
			local vp = cam.ViewportSize
			if vp.X < 50 or vp.Y < 50 then return end
			local w, h = size.X.Offset, size.Y.Offset
			local touch = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
			local s = math.min(vp.X * (touch and 0.94 or 0.9) / w, vp.Y * (touch and 0.86 or 0.9) / h, 1)
			s = math.clamp(s, 0.35, 1)
			Window.AutoScale = s
			if Window.ManualScale then s = Window.ManualScale end
			Scale.Scale = s
			Root.Position = UDim2.new(Root.Position.X.Scale, Root.Position.X.Offset, 0.5, -h * s / 2)
			if Window.SetRestingY then Window.SetRestingY(-h * s / 2) end
		end
		Window.FitToScreen = fit
		task.defer(fit)
		local function watch(cam) if cam then table.insert(Window.Connections, cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit)) end end
		watch(camera)
		table.insert(Window.Connections, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function() watch(workspace.CurrentCamera); fit() end))
	end
	Window.Root = Root
	Window.Cards = opts.Cards ~= false
	Window.AutoBind = opts.AutoBind ~= false
	Scale:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(function()
		if Window.Transitioning then return end
		local t = Window.ActiveTab
		if t and t._sync then t._sync() end
	end)


	if not Mac then
		for i = 1, 5 do
			Create("Frame", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),

	end

	local Main = Create("Frame", {

			Transparency = NumberSequence.new({

			}),
		}),
	})


	local function Orb(color, pos, sz)

		})
	end
	local Orb1 = Orb(Theme.Accent, UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.1), 420)
	local Orb2 = Orb(Theme.Accent2, UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.9), 360)
	local Orb3 = Orb(Theme.Accent, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), 260)

	local Topbar = Create("Frame", {

	local Logo = Create("Frame", {

	Logo:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient").Enabled = false

		BackgroundTransparency = 1,

	})

	local TitleLabel = Label({
		Text = title,

	local CloseBtn = TopButton("×", -12, Theme.Danger)
	local MinBtn = TopButton("–", -44)


	if Mac then
		CloseBtn.Visible, MinBtn.Visible = false, false
		local function HeadBtn(iconName, x, hover, cb)
			local b = Create("TextButton", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, x, 0, 14),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Text = "",
				Parent = Topbar,
			}, { Corner(14) })
			local ic = Create("ImageLabel", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,

	local function ApplyFilter()
		local tab = Window.ActiveTab
		if not tab or not tab._reg then return end
		local q = ""  -- results are shown in the global search list instead of hiding rows
		local reg = tab._reg
		for i = 1, #reg do
			local e = reg[i]
			local want = q == "" or string.find(e[2], q, 1, true) ~= nil
			if e[1].Visible ~= want then e[1].Visible = want end
		end
	end
	Search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(ApplyFilter)

	local spin, t, frames, fpsTimer, visualTimer = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	local backgroundConnection
	local UpdateBackground; UpdateBackground = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
		if Window.Destroyed or not Window.Visible or Window.Transitioning or not Root.Visible or Window.Minimized then return end
		t += dt
		frames += 1
		fpsTimer += dt
		visualTimer += dt

		if visualTimer >= 1 / 30 then
			local step = visualTimer
			visualTimer = 0
			do
				spin = (spin + step * 45) % 360
				StrokeGrad.Rotation = spin
				LogoGrad.Rotation = spin
				Orb1.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.85 + math.sin(t * 0.4) * 0.12, 0.1 + math.cos(t * 0.33) * 0.15)
				Orb2.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.15 + math.cos(t * 0.35) * 0.12, 0.9 + math.sin(t * 0.45) * 0.12)
				Orb3.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + math.sin(t * 0.25) * 0.25, 0.5 + math.cos(t * 0.3) * 0.2)
			end
			if FpsDot then FpsDot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 + math.sin(t * 4) * 0.25 end
		end
		if FpsLabel and fpsTimer >= 0.5 then
			local fps = math.floor(frames / fpsTimer + 0.5)
			frames, fpsTimer = 0, 0
			FpsLabel.Text = fps .. " FPS"
			FpsDot.BackgroundColor3 = fps >= 50 and Color3.fromRGB(70, 220, 140)
				or fps >= 30 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 70) or Theme.Danger
		end
	end)
	local function SetBackgroundActive(active)
		if active and not Window.Destroyed and not backgroundConnection then
			frames, fpsTimer, visualTimer = 0, 0, 0
			backgroundConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(UpdateBackground)
		elseif not active and backgroundConnection then
			backgroundConnection:Disconnect()
			backgroundConnection = nil
		end
	end

	local function Flash(frame)
		local glow = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.7,
			ZIndex = 10,
			Parent = frame,
		}, { Corner(8) })
		task.delay(0.15, function()
			local tw = Tween(glow, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 1.2)
			tw.Completed:Connect(function() glow:Destroy() end)
		end)
	end

	local function GoTo(tab, frame)
		if not Window:CanShowTab(tab) then return end
		if tab.Group and not tab.Group.Open then tab.Group:SetOpen(true) end
		tab:Select()
		Search.Text = ""
		Search:ReleaseFocus()
		CloseResults()
		if not frame then return end
		task.delay(0.08, function()
			if not frame.Parent then return end
			local page = tab.Holder
			local sc = math.max(Window.ScaleObj.Scale, 0.05)
			local y = (frame.AbsolutePosition.Y - page.AbsolutePosition.Y) / sc + page.CanvasPosition.Y - 14
			Tween(page, { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, y)) }, 0.35)
			task.delay(0.3, function() if frame.Parent then Flash(frame) end end)
		end)
	end

	local function TabPath(tab)
		return tab.Group and (tab.Group.Name .. "  ›  " .. tab.Name) or tab.Name
	end

		ApplyIcon(ic, iconName or "layers")
		Label({ Text = titleText, FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 13, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 3), Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 16), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 42, Parent = b })
		Label({ Text = pathText, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 19), Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 14), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 42, Parent = b })
		b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.85 }, 0.1) end)
		b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.1) end)
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onClick)
		if not firstResult then firstResult = onClick end
	end

	local function UpdateResults()
		CloseResults()
		local q = Lower(Search.Text):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
		if q == "" then return end
		local n = 0
		for _, tab in ipairs(Window.Tabs) do
			if n >= 40 then break end
			if not Window:CanShowTab(tab) then continue end
			local tabIcon = tab.IconName or (tab.Group and TAB_ICONS[tab.Group.Name])
			local tabHit = string.find(Lower(tab.Name), q, 1, true) or (tab.Group and string.find(Lower(tab.Group.Name), q, 1, true))
			if tabHit then
				n += 1
				ResultRow(n, tabIcon, tab.Name, tab.Group and tab.Group.Name or "Menu", function() GoTo(tab) end)
			end
			for _, g in ipairs(tab._groups or {}) do
				if n >= 40 then break end
				local card, gname = g[1], g[2]
				if gname ~= tab.Name and card.Parent and string.find(Lower(gname), q, 1, true) then
					n += 1
					ResultRow(n, GROUP_ICONS[gname] or tabIcon, gname, TabPath(tab), function() GoTo(tab, card) end)
				end
			end
				for _, r in ipairs(tab._reg or {}) do
					if n >= 40 then break end
					local fr, nm = r[1], r[2]
					if fr and fr.Parent and nm ~= "" and string.find(nm, q, 1, true) then
						n += 1
						ResultRow(n, tabIcon, fr:GetAttribute("CrackHubName") or nm, TabPath(tab), function() GoTo(tab, fr) end)
					end
				end
		end
		if n == 0 then
			Label({ Text = "Nothing found", TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), ZIndex = 41, Parent = Results })
		end
		local sc = math.max(Window.ScaleObj.Scale, 0.05)
		local top = (Search.AbsolutePosition.Y - Main.AbsolutePosition.Y) / sc + Search.AbsoluteSize.Y / sc + 6
		Results.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, top)
		Results.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(330, math.min(n == 0 and 42 or n * 38 + 12, 320))
		Results.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new()
		Results.Visible = true
	end
	Search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(UpdateResults)
	Search.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
		if enter and firstResult then firstResult(); return end
		task.delay(0.25, function()
			if not resultsHover and not Search:IsFocused() then CloseResults() end
		end)
	end)
	Search.Focused:Connect(function() if Search.Text ~= "" then UpdateResults() end end)

	local HL = { Btn = nil, Snap = true }

		HL.Btn = btn

			or btn.AbsolutePosition.Y < TabList.AbsolutePosition.Y
			or btn.AbsolutePosition.Y + btn.AbsoluteSize.Y > TabList.AbsolutePosition.Y + TabList.AbsoluteSize.Y

		local size = btn.AbsoluteSize / sc

		if size.X <= 1 or size.Y <= 1 then TabHighlight.Visible = false; HL.Snap = true; return end
		TabHighlight.Position = target
		HL.Snap = false
		local wantedSize = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X, size.Y)
		if TabHighlight.Size ~= wantedSize then TabHighlight.Size = wantedSize end
	end)))

	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local blurMode = opts.BlurMode or "Screen"
	local blurSize = math.clamp(opts.BlurSize or (opts.Blur and 14 or 0), 0, 56)
	local blurActive = false
	local BlurFx, DofFx, GlassPart
	local glassConnection, blurTween, blurCompletion

	if blurMode == "Screen" then
		BlurFx = Create("BlurEffect", { Enabled = false, Size = 0, Name = "CrackHubBlur", Parent = Lighting })
	else
		DofFx = Create("DepthOfFieldEffect", {
			Name = "CrackHubDOF",
			Enabled = false,
			FarIntensity = 0,
			NearIntensity = 0,
			FocusDistance = 0.5,
			InFocusRadius = 0.1,
			Parent = Lighting,
		})
		GlassPart = Create("Part", {
			Name = "CrackHubGlass",
			Anchored = true,
			CanCollide = false,
			CanQuery = false,
			CanTouch = false,
			Locked = true,
			CastShadow = false,
			Material = Enum.Material.Glass,
			Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			Transparency = 0.98,
			Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 0.001),
		})
	end


	local UpdateGlass; UpdateGlass = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam or not GlassPart then return end
		local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
		local pad = 8
		local tl = Main.AbsolutePosition + inset + Vector2.new(pad, pad)
		local br = Main.AbsolutePosition + Main.AbsoluteSize + inset - Vector2.new(pad, pad)
		if br.X <= tl.X or br.Y <= tl.Y then return end

		local okN, np = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return cam.NearPlaneZ end))
		local dist = (okN and math.abs(np) or 0.1) + 0.05
		DofFx.FocusDistance = dist + 0.5

		local cf = cam.CFrame
		local look = cf.LookVector
		local toWorld; toWorld = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(v)
			local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(v.X, v.Y)
			local d = ray.Direction
			return cf.Position + d * (dist / d:Dot(look))
		end)
		local a, b = toWorld(tl), toWorld(br)
		local diag = b - a
		GlassPart.Size = Vector3.new(
			math.max(math.abs(diag:Dot(cf.RightVector)), 0.001),
			math.max(math.abs(diag:Dot(cf.UpVector)), 0.001),
			0.001
		)
		GlassPart.CFrame = CFrame.new((a + b) / 2) * cf.Rotation
	end)

	local function StopBlur()
		blurActive = false
		if blurCompletion then blurCompletion:Disconnect(); blurCompletion=nil end
		if blurTween then blurTween:Cancel(); blurTween = nil end
		if glassConnection then glassConnection:Disconnect(); glassConnection = nil end
		if BlurFx then BlurFx.Enabled = false; BlurFx.Size = 0 end
		if DofFx then DofFx.Enabled = false; DofFx.NearIntensity = 0 end
		if GlassPart then GlassPart.Parent = nil end
	end

	local ApplyBlur
	Window.__StopBlur = function() StopBlur() end
	Window.__ApplyBlur = function(a, t) if ApplyBlur then ApplyBlur(a, t) end end
	function ApplyBlur(active, time)
		if active and Window.__No2DFx then StopBlur() return end
		-- phones: no menu blur (full-screen blur is one of the heaviest effects on mobile GPUs)
		if active and UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then StopBlur() return end


		if not active or blurSize <= 0 or Window.Destroyed then
			if not active and BlurFx and BlurFx.Enabled and not Window.Destroyed then
				if blurCompletion then blurCompletion:Disconnect(); blurCompletion=nil end
				if blurTween then blurTween:Cancel() end
				blurTween=Tween(BlurFx,{Size=0},time or 0.16)
				blurCompletion=blurTween.Completed:Connect(function(state)
					if state==Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and not Window.Visible then StopBlur() end
				end)
			else StopBlur() end
			return
		end
		if blurCompletion then blurCompletion:Disconnect(); blurCompletion=nil end
		blurActive = true
		if blurTween then blurTween:Cancel(); blurTween = nil end
		if blurMode == "Screen" then
			BlurFx.Enabled = true
			blurTween = Tween(BlurFx, { Size = blurSize }, time or 0.2)
		else
			DofFx.Enabled = true
			GlassPart.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
			UpdateGlass()
			blurTween = Tween(DofFx, { NearIntensity = math.clamp(blurSize / 30, 0, 1) }, time or 0.2)
			if not glassConnection then
				glassConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
					if not blurActive or Window.Destroyed or not Window.Visible or not Root.Visible then return end
					local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
					if GlassPart.Parent ~= camera then GlassPart.Parent = camera end
					UpdateGlass()
				end))
			end
		end
	end

	function Window:SetBlur(n)
		blurSize = math.clamp(n, 0, 56)
		if self.Visible and Root.Visible then ApplyBlur(true, 0.25) end
	end


	local glass = 0
	function Window:SetTransparency(v)
		glass = math.clamp(v, 0, 0.9)
		Tween(Main, { BackgroundTransparency = glass }, 0.2)
	end
	if opts.Transparency then
		Window:SetTransparency(opts.Transparency)
	elseif blurSize > 0 then
		Window:SetTransparency(0.18)
	end

	local HudArrow, HudKeyLabel

	function Window:SetToggleKey(key)
		toggleKey = key
		if MenuChip then MenuChip:Set(key, true) end
		if HudKeyLabel then HudKeyLabel.Text = BindName({ Key = key }) end
	end




	-- Smooth menu open/close.
	-- During the animation the window and preview panels go into temporary CanvasGroups
	-- and fade in/out. Window size is NOT animated: changing scale makes the
	-- CanvasGroup re-render the whole window every frame, which caused
	-- stutter. Everything is restored after the animation.
	local visibilityPosTween, visibilityFadeTween, visibilityCompletion
	local visibilityTween -- kept for compatibility with checks below
	local visibilityPending
	local restingPosition = Root.Position
	Window.SetRestingY = function(y) restingPosition = UDim2.new(restingPosition.X.Scale, restingPosition.X.Offset, 0.5, y) end
	if Window.FitToScreen then task.defer(Window.FitToScreen) end
	local HIDDEN_OFFSET = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18)
	local fadeHosts = {}
	local fading = false
	local FadeAlpha = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	FadeAlpha.Value = 0

	function Window:AddFadeHost(host)
		table.insert(fadeHosts, { Host = host })
	end
	Window:AddFadeHost(Root)

	local function ApplyAlpha(a)
		for _, h in ipairs(fadeHosts) do
			if h.Fader then
				h.Fader.GroupTransparency = a
				if h.Bg then h.Host.BackgroundTransparency = h.Bg + (1 - h.Bg) * a end
				for s, t in pairs(h.Strokes) do s.Transparency = t + (1 - t) * a end
			end
		end
	end
	FadeAlpha.Changed:Connect(function(a) if fading then ApplyAlpha(a) end end)

	local function BeginFade()
		if fading then return end
		fading = true
		for _, h in ipairs(fadeHosts) do
			local host = h.Host
			if host.Parent then
				local fader = h.FaderObj
				if not fader then
					fader = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
					fader.Name = "Fader"
					fader.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
					fader.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					fader.BorderSizePixel = 0
					local corner = host:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
					if corner then
						local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
						c.CornerRadius = corner.CornerRadius
						c.Parent = fader
					end
					h.FaderObj = fader
				end
				local children = {}
				for _, c in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do
					if c:IsA("GuiObject") then table.insert(children, c) end
				end
				h.Children = children
				h.Bg = host ~= Root and host.BackgroundTransparency < 1 and host.BackgroundTransparency or nil
				h.Strokes = {}
				if host ~= Root then
					for _, s in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do
						if s:IsA("UIStroke") then h.Strokes[s] = s.Transparency end
					end
				end
				fader.Parent = host
				for _, c in ipairs(children) do c.Parent = fader end
				h.Fader = fader
			end
		end
		ApplyAlpha(FadeAlpha.Value)
	end

	local function EndFade()
		if not fading then return end
		fading = false
		for _, h in ipairs(fadeHosts) do
			local fader = h.Fader
			if fader then
				for _, c in ipairs(fader:GetChildren()) do
					if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c.Parent = h.Host end
				end
				fader.Parent = nil
				fader.GroupTransparency = 0
				if h.Bg then h.Host.BackgroundTransparency = h.Bg end
				for s, t in pairs(h.Strokes) do s.Transparency = t end
				h.Fader, h.Children, h.Bg, h.Strokes = nil, nil, nil, nil
			end
		end
	end

	local function CancelVisibilityTween()
		if visibilityCompletion then visibilityCompletion:Disconnect(); visibilityCompletion = nil end
		if visibilityPosTween then visibilityPosTween:Cancel(); visibilityPosTween = nil end
		if visibilityFadeTween then visibilityFadeTween:Cancel(); visibilityFadeTween = nil end
		visibilityTween = nil
		visibilityPending = nil
	end

	function Window:SetVisible(state)
		if self.Destroyed then return end
		state = not not state
		if self.Visible == state and (visibilityTween or visibilityPending or Root.Visible == state) then return end
		if not self.Transitioning and Root.Visible then restingPosition = Root.Position end
		self.Visible = state
		CancelVisibilityTween()
		self.Transitioning = true
		if HudArrow then Tween(HudArrow, { Rotation = state and 180 or 0 }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint) end
		SetBackgroundActive(false)

		if state and not Root.Visible then
			Root.Position = restingPosition + HIDDEN_OFFSET
			FadeAlpha.Value = 1
		end
		-- Re-parenting the window into the CanvasGroup costs one heavy frame.
		-- Do it first, then start the tween on the NEXT rendered frame, so the
		-- hitch happens before the animation instead of eating its first frames.
		-- (When the window was hidden it is already inside the CanvasGroup: free.)
		BeginFade()
		if state then Root.Visible = true end

		local token = {}
		visibilityPending = token
		task.spawn(function()
			RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
			if visibilityPending ~= token or self.Destroyed then return end
			visibilityPending = nil
			if state then ApplyBlur(true, 0.4) else ApplyBlur(false, 0.22) end

			local posInfo = state
				and TweenInfo.new(0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
				or TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
			local fadeInfo = state
				and TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
				or TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

			visibilityPosTween = TweenService:Create(Root, posInfo, {
				Position = state and restingPosition or restingPosition + HIDDEN_OFFSET,
			})
			visibilityFadeTween = TweenService:Create(FadeAlpha, fadeInfo, { Value = state and 0 or 1 })
			visibilityTween = visibilityPosTween
			visibilityPosTween:Play()
			visibilityFadeTween:Play()

			visibilityCompletion = visibilityPosTween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
				if playbackState ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then return end
				if visibilityCompletion then visibilityCompletion:Disconnect(); visibilityCompletion = nil end
				if visibilityFadeTween then visibilityFadeTween:Cancel(); visibilityFadeTween = nil end
				visibilityTween, visibilityPosTween = nil, nil
				self.Transitioning = false
				FadeAlpha.Value = self.Visible and 0 or 1
				if not self.Visible then
					-- Stay inside the CanvasGroup while hidden: the next open then needs no
					-- re-parenting at all (that re-parenting was the FPS spike on toggle).
					Root.Visible = false
					Root.Position = restingPosition
					FadeAlpha.Value = 1
					StopBlur()
				else
					-- leave the CanvasGroup once the motion has fully settled
					RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
					if not self.Visible or self.Transitioning or self.Destroyed then return end
					EndFade()
					SetBackgroundActive(not self.Minimized)
					local tab = self.ActiveTab
					if tab and tab._sync then tab._sync() end
				end
			end)
		end)
	end

	function Window:Toggle()
		self:SetVisible(not self.Visible)
	end


	function Window:Hide()
		self:SetVisible(false)
	end

	function Window:Minimize()
		if self.Destroyed then return end
		self.Minimized = not self.Minimized
		SetBackgroundActive(self.Visible and Root.Visible and not self.Minimized)
		Tween(Root, {
			Size = self.Minimized and UDim2.new(size.X.Scale, size.X.Offset, 0, 50) or size,
		}, 0.4)
		MinBtn.Text = self.Minimized and "+" or "–"
	end

	local coreCleaned=false
	local function CleanupCore()
		if coreCleaned then return end
		coreCleaned=true
		BindCapture:Stop()
		Window.Destroyed=true; Window.Visible=false; Window.Transitioning=false
		if introThread and coroutine.status(introThread)~="dead" then pcall(task.cancel,introThread) end
		SetBackgroundActive(false); CancelVisibilityTween(); StopBlur()
		for _,c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end
		table.clear(conns)
		if BlurFx then BlurFx:Destroy() end
		if DofFx then DofFx:Destroy() end
		if GlassPart then GlassPart:Destroy() end
		if CrackHubEnvironment.CrackHubWindow==Window then CrackHubEnvironment.CrackHubWindow=nil end
	end
	Gui.Destroying:Connect(CleanupCore)
	CrackHubEnvironment.CrackHubWindow=Window

	function Window:Destroy(immediate)
		if self.Destroyed then return end
		CleanupCore()
		if immediate or not Root.Visible then Gui:Destroy(); return end
		Tween(Root,{Position=Root.Position+UDim2.fromOffset(0,12)},0.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		task.delay(0.17,function() Gui:Destroy() end)
	end

	function Window:Notify(o)
		return CrackHub:Notify(o)
	end

	CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Window:Destroy() end)
	MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Window:Hide() end)

	table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if not gp and not BindCapture:Blocked(input) and input.KeyCode == toggleKey then
			Window:Toggle()
		end
	end))


	-- Watermark with several styles. Drag to move, click the logo to open/close the menu,
	-- right-click it to pick a style (the choice is remembered).
	if opts.HUD ~= false then
		local STYLES = { "Default", "Plus", "Classic", "Neon", "Minimal", "Stats", "Profile", "Compact" }
		local sessionStart = os.clock()
		local STYLE_FILE = "CrackHub_Watermark.txt"
		local style = "Default"
		local HttpSvc = game:GetService("HttpService")
		local ITEM_DEFAULTS = {
			Default = { "fps", "ping", "key" },
			Plus = { "fps", "ping", "players", "time", "session", "key" },
		}
		local ALL_ITEMS = { "fps", "ping", "players", "time", "session", "key" }
		local ITEM_NAMES = { fps = "FPS", ping = "Ping", players = "Players", time = "Time", session = "Session", key = "Menu key" }
		local items = { Default = table.clone(ITEM_DEFAULTS.Default), Plus = table.clone(ITEM_DEFAULTS.Plus) }
		pcall(function()
			if isfile and readfile and isfile(STYLE_FILE) then
				local raw = readfile(STYLE_FILE)
				local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpSvc:JSONDecode(raw) end)
				local saved = ok and type(data) == "table" and data.Style or raw
				if saved == "Pill" then saved = "Default" end
				if table.find(STYLES, saved) then style = saved end
				if ok and type(data) == "table" and type(data.Items) == "table" then
					for k, list in pairs(data.Items) do
						if items[k] and type(list) == "table" then
							local clean = {}
							for _, id in ipairs(list) do
								if table.find(ALL_ITEMS, id) and not table.find(clean, id) then table.insert(clean, id) end
							end
							items[k] = clean
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		local function SaveWatermark()
			pcall(function()
				if writefile then writefile(STYLE_FILE, HttpSvc:JSONEncode({ Style = style, Items = items })) end
			end)
		end

		local Wm = Create("Frame", {
			Name = "Watermark",
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 10),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Active = true,
			Parent = Gui,
		})
		local itemPressed = false
		do
			local dragging, startInput, startPos = false, nil, nil
			Wm.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if not IsClick(input) then return end
				task.defer(function()
					if itemPressed then return end
					dragging, startInput, startPos = true, input.Position, Wm.Position
					local c
					c = input.Changed:Connect(function()
						if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false; c:Disconnect() end
					end)
				end)
			end)
			table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
				if dragging and IsMove(input) then
					local d = input.Position - startInput
					Wm.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
				end
			end))
		end

		local refs = {}
		local DIM = "#928aac"

		local function Logo(parent, size, order, plain)
			local b = Create("ImageButton", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Image = "rbxassetid://84919983720903",
				ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
				ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
				LayoutOrder = order or 1,
				Parent = parent,
			}, plain and {} or { Create("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(Theme.Accent, Theme.Accent), Rotation = 45 }) })
			b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Window:Toggle() end)
			return b
		end
		local function Text(parent, text, order, size, font, color)
			local plain = tostring(text):gsub("<[^>]+>", ""):lower()
			if plain:find("crack", 1, true) or plain:find("hub", 1, true) then
				local lbl = Label({
					Text = text, RichText = true, FontFace = font or Fonts.Medium, TextSize = size or 12, TextColor3 = color or Theme.Text,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = parent, Active = true,
				})
				lbl.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
					if not IsClick(input) then return end
					local start = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
					local c
					c = input.Changed:Connect(function()
						if input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.End then return end
						c:Disconnect()
						local now = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
						if (now - start).Magnitude < 8 and CrackHub.OpenWatermarkMenu then CrackHub.OpenWatermarkMenu(now) end
					end)
				end)
				return lbl
			end
			return Label({
				Text = text,
				RichText = true,
				FontFace = font or Fonts.Medium,
				TextSize = size or 12,
				TextColor3 = color or Theme.Text,
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				LayoutOrder = order,
				Parent = parent,
			})
		end
		local function Sep(parent, order)
			Create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 14),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Stroke,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				LayoutOrder = order,
				Parent = parent,
			})
		end
		local function IconImg(parent, name, color, order)
			local ic = Create("ImageLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				ImageColor3 = color,
				LayoutOrder = order,
				Parent = parent,
			})
			ApplyIcon(ic, name)
		end
		local function KeyChip(parent, order, light)

				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				BackgroundColor3 = light and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Theme.Element,

				Text = "",
				FontFace = Fonts.Bold,
				TextSize = 10,

				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				Parent = chip,
			})
		end
		local function Box(props, children)
			local p = {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 32),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
				Parent = Wm,
			}
			for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do p[k] = v end
			return Create("Frame", p, children)
		end
		local function Row(padL, padR, gap)
			return {
				Padding(0, padR or 12, 0, padL or 10),
				Create("UIListLayout", {
					FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
					VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
					Padding = UDim.new(0, gap or 8),
					SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				}),
			}
		end

		local Build
		local ITEM_REF = { fps = "Fps", ping = "Ping", players = "PlayersPlus", time = "Time", session = "SessionPlus" }
		local ITEM_LOOK = {
			-- colour = theme key, read when the watermark is built (not frozen at startup)
			fps = { "gauge", "Accent" }, ping = { "wifi", "Accent" }, players = { "users", "Accent" },
			time = { "clock", "Accent" }, session = { "timer", "Accent" }, key = { "keyboard", "SubText" },
		}
		local function BuildEditable(styleName)
			local list = items[styleName]
			local b = Box({}, { Corner(10), Stroke(Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.2), table.unpack(Row(10, 10, 4)) })
			Logo(b, 20, 1)
			local name = Text(b, title, 2, 14, Fonts.Bold)
			name.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 32)
			local segs = {}
			local function Order()
				for idx, seg in ipairs(segs) do seg.Frame.LayoutOrder = 10 + idx * 2 end
				for idx, seg in ipairs(segs) do seg.Sep.LayoutOrder = 10 + idx * 2 - 1 end
			end
			for _, id in ipairs(list) do
				local sep = Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 16), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Stroke, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = b })
				local seg = Create("TextButton", {
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26),
					AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
					BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					Text = "",
					Parent = b,
				}, { Corner(7) })
				local inner = Create("Frame", {
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26),
					AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Parent = seg,
				}, {
					Padding(0, 6, 0, 6),
					Create("UIListLayout", { FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
				})
				local look = ITEM_LOOK[id]
				IconImg(inner, look[1], Theme[look[2]] or Theme.Accent, 1)
				if id == "key" then
					KeyChip(inner, 2)
				else
					local l = Text(inner, "", 2, 13, Fonts.Bold)
					l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26)
					refs[ITEM_REF[id]] = l
				end
				local close = Create("TextButton", {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 3),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
					BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Danger,
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					Text = "",
					Visible = false,
					ZIndex = 5,
					Parent = seg,
				}, { Corner(7) })
				local xi = Create("ImageLabel", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ZIndex = 6, Parent = close })
				ApplyIcon(xi, "x")
				local entry = { Id = id, Frame = seg, Sep = sep }
				table.insert(segs, entry)

				local hovering, dragging = false, false
				seg.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
					hovering = true
					close.Visible = true
					Tween(seg, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.55 }, 0.12)
				end)
				seg.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
					hovering = false
					if not dragging then
						close.Visible = false
						Tween(seg, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.12)
					end
				end)
				close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					local at = table.find(list, id)
					if at then table.remove(list, at) end
					SaveWatermark()
					Build(style)
				end)
				-- drag an item left/right to reorder it
				seg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
					if not IsClick(input) then return end
					itemPressed = true
					local startX = input.Position.X
					local moveConn, endConn
					moveConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(m)
						if not IsMove(m) then return end
						if not dragging and math.abs(m.Position.X - startX) > 4 then
							dragging = true
							Tween(seg, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 }, 0.1)
						end
						if not dragging then return end
						local x = m.Position.X
						local me = table.find(segs, entry)
						local left, right = segs[me - 1], segs[me + 1]
						if left and x < left.Frame.AbsolutePosition.X + left.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X / 2 then
							segs[me], segs[me - 1] = left, entry
							Order()
						elseif right and x > right.Frame.AbsolutePosition.X + right.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X / 2 then
							segs[me], segs[me + 1] = right, entry
							Order()
						end
					end)
					endConn = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(e)
						if not IsClick(e) then return end
						moveConn:Disconnect(); endConn:Disconnect()
						task.defer(function() itemPressed = false end)
						if dragging then
							dragging = false
							table.clear(list)
							for _, sg in ipairs(segs) do table.insert(list, sg.Id) end
							SaveWatermark()
							if not hovering then
								close.Visible = false
								Tween(seg, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.12)
							else
								Tween(seg, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.55 }, 0.12)
							end
						end
					end)
				end)
			end
			Order()
		end
		builders.Default = function() BuildEditable("Default") end

		local fps, ping = 60, 0
		local Refresh; Refresh = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			local dim = refs.Dim or DIM
			local F; F = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(v, u) return v .. ' <font size="10" color="' .. dim .. '">' .. u .. '</font>' end)
			if refs.Fps then refs.Fps.Text = F(fps, "FPS") end
			if refs.Ping then refs.Ping.Text = F(ping, "MS") end
			if refs.FpsRaw then refs.FpsRaw.Text = tostring(fps) end
			if refs.PingRaw then refs.PingRaw.Text = ping .. " ms" end
			if refs.Time then refs.Time.Text = os.date("%H:%M") end
			local count = #Players:GetPlayers() .. "/" .. Players.MaxPlayers
			if refs.Players then refs.Players.Text = F(count, "players") end
			if refs.PlayersRaw then refs.PlayersRaw.Text = count end
			local up = math.floor(os.clock() - sessionStart)
			local upText = up >= 3600 and string.format("%d:%02d:%02d", up // 3600, up % 3600 // 60, up % 60) or string.format("%02d:%02d", up // 60, up % 60)
			if refs.Session then refs.Session.Text = upText end
			if refs.SessionPlus then refs.SessionPlus.Text = F(upText, "SESSION") end
			if refs.PlayersPlus then refs.PlayersPlus.Text = F(count, "PLAYERS") end
			if refs.Sub then refs.Sub.Text = "@" .. LocalPlayer.Name .. "  ·  " .. upText end
			if refs.Key then refs.Key.Text = BindName(toggleKey and { Key = toggleKey } or nil) end
		end)
		function Build(name)
			style = table.find(STYLES, name) and name or "Default"
			for _, c in ipairs(Wm:GetChildren()) do if c.Name ~= "CrackHubFit" then c:Destroy() end end
			table.clear(refs)
			itemPressed = false
			builders[style]()
			if style ~= "Neon" then
				for _, d in ipairs(Wm:GetDescendants()) do
					if d:IsA("ImageButton") and d.Image == "rbxassetid://84919983720903" then
						Shimmer(d, "icon")
					elseif d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Text == title then
						Shimmer(d, "text")
					end
				end
			end
			Refresh()
			SaveWatermark()
		end
		Build(style)

		-- right-click menu
		local Menu
		local function CloseMenu()
			if Menu then Menu:Destroy(); Menu = nil end
		end
		local function OpenMenu(at)
			CloseMenu()
			Menu = Create("Frame", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(at.X + 4, at.Y + 4),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 0),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.04,
				ZIndex = 50,
				Parent = Gui,
			}, { Corner(10), Stroke(Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.15), Padding(6, 6, 6, 6), List(2) })
			Label({
				Text = "Watermark style",
				FontFace = Fonts.Bold,
				TextSize = 11,
				TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
				ZIndex = 51,
				LayoutOrder = 0,
				Parent = Menu,
			})
			for i, name in ipairs(STYLES) do
				local active = name == style
				local b = Create("TextButton", {
					Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
					BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
					BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.82 or 1,
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					Text = "",
					ZIndex = 51,
					LayoutOrder = i,
					Parent = Menu,
				}, { Corner(6) })
				Label({
					Text = name,
					FontFace = active and Fonts.Bold or Fonts.Medium,
					TextSize = 12,
					TextColor3 = active and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText,
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),
					Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, 0),
					ZIndex = 52,
					Parent = b,
				})
				if active then
					local ic = Create("ImageLabel", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ImageColor3 = Theme.Accent, ZIndex = 52, Parent = b })
					ApplyIcon(ic, "circle-dot")
				end
				b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if name ~= style then Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 }, 0.12) end end)
				b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if name ~= style then Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.12) end end)
				b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					Build(name)
					CloseMenu()
				end)
			end
            local elements=Create("TextButton",{Name="Elements",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,28),Text="Elements · Music List",
                FontFace=Fonts.Medium,TextSize=12,TextColor3=Theme.Text,BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,BackgroundTransparency=.35,
                BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=51,LayoutOrder=#STYLES+1,Parent=Menu},{Corner(6)})
            elements.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if Window.OpenMusicWidgetSettings then Window.OpenMusicWidgetSettings(at)end
                CloseMenu()
            end)
            local keybindsItem=Create("TextButton",{Name="ElementsKeybinds",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,28),Text="Elements · Keybinds",
                FontFace=Fonts.Medium,TextSize=12,TextColor3=Theme.Text,BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,BackgroundTransparency=.35,
                BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=51,LayoutOrder=#STYLES+1,Parent=Menu},{Corner(6)})
            keybindsItem.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if Window.OpenKeybindsSettings then Window.OpenKeybindsSettings(at)end
                CloseMenu()
            end)
			local list = items[style]
			if list then
				local order = #STYLES + 1
				local function Small(text, color, cb)
					order += 1
					local b = Create("TextButton", {
						Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24),
						BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
						AutoButtonColor = false,
						Text = "",
						ZIndex = 51,
						LayoutOrder = order,
						Parent = Menu,
					}, { Corner(6) })
					Label({ Text = text, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = color, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -14, 1, 0), ZIndex = 52, Parent = b })
					b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 }, 0.12) end)
					b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.12) end)
					b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(cb)
				end
				order += 1
				Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Stroke, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 51, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = Menu })
				for _, id in ipairs(ALL_ITEMS) do
					if not table.find(list, id) then
						Small("+  " .. ITEM_NAMES[id], Theme.Text, function()
							table.insert(list, id)
							SaveWatermark()
							Build(style)
							CloseMenu()
						end)
					end
				end
				Small("Reset items", Theme.SubText, function()
					items[style] = table.clone(ITEM_DEFAULTS[style])
					SaveWatermark()
					Build(style)
					CloseMenu()
				end)
			end
		end
		CrackHub.OpenWatermarkMenu = function(at) task.defer(OpenMenu, at) end
		Wm.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
				OpenMenu(UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset())
			end
		end)
		table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if not Menu then return end
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then return end
			local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset()
			local p, sz = Menu.AbsolutePosition, Menu.AbsoluteSize
			if m.X < p.X or m.Y < p.Y or m.X > p.X + sz.X or m.Y > p.Y + sz.Y then
				task.defer(function()
					if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and Wm.Parent then
						local wp, ws = Wm.AbsolutePosition, Wm.AbsoluteSize
						if m.X >= wp.X and m.Y >= wp.Y and m.X <= wp.X + ws.X and m.Y <= wp.Y + ws.Y then return end
					end
					CloseMenu()
				end)
			end
		end))

		local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
		local frames, timer = 0, 0
		table.insert(conns, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
			frames += 1
			timer += dt
			if timer < 0.5 then return end
			fps = math.floor(frames / timer + 0.5)
			frames, timer = 0, 0
			local ok, p = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end))
			if not ok or type(p) ~= "number" then p = LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() * 1000 end
			ping = math.floor(p + 0.5)
			Refresh()
		end)))
	end


	if opts.MobileButton ~= false and UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
		local MobileBtn = Create("TextButton", {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Text = FirstChar(title):upper(),
			FontFace = Fonts.Bold,
			TextSize = 18,
			TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			Parent = Gui,
		}, { Corner(23), AccentGradient(45), Stroke(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 1.5, 0.6) })
		MakeDraggable(MobileBtn, MobileBtn, conns)
		MobileBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Window:Toggle() end)
	end






	function Window:CreateConfigTab(o)
		return CrackHub._BuildConfigTab(self, o or {})
	end

	-- every tab sticker uses the theme accent, so all tabs share one colour and follow theme changes
	local stickerColors = {}
	local function createTabSticker(parent, name, icon, size, inset)
		local color = stickerColors[name] or Theme.Accent
