		local badge = Create("Frame", {
			Name = "TabSticker",
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, inset, 0.5, 0),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
			BackgroundColor3 = color,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.79,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			LayoutOrder = 1,
			Parent = parent,
		}, { Corner(6), Stroke(color, 1, 0.72) })
		local glyph = Create("ImageLabel", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size - 7, size - 7),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ImageColor3 = color,
			Parent = badge,
		})
		ApplyIcon(glyph, icon or "layers")
		return badge
	end

	function Window:CreateTab(name, icon, group)
		local Tab = setmetatable({ Window = Window, Name = name, Active = false }, Container)

		icon = icon or TAB_ICONS[name]
		Tab.Group = group
		Tab.IconName = icon
		local Btn = Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Text = "",
			LayoutOrder = NextOrder(),
			Parent = group and group.Holder or TabList,
		}, { Corner(8) })
		Tab._btn = Btn
		local BtnStroke = Stroke(Theme.Stroke, 1, 1)
		BtnStroke.Parent = Btn

		local Indicator = Create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 0),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			Parent = Btn,
		}, { Corner(2), AccentGradient(90) })

		local textX = 35
		local sticker = createTabSticker(Btn, name, icon, 20, 8)

		local TabLabel = Label({
			Text = name,
			FontFace = Fonts.Medium,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(textX, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -textX - 8, 1, 0),
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			Parent = Btn,
		})
		if not group then table.insert(SideLabels, TabLabel) end
		local baseY = (Mac and group) and 44 or 0

		local Page = Create("ScrollingFrame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Accent,
			ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.75,
			ScrollBarThickness = 2,
			TopImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png",
			MidImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png",
			BottomImage = "rbxasset://textures/ui/Scroll/scroll-middle.png",
			CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
			AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
			ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
			Visible = false,
			Parent = Content,
		}, { List(8), Padding(Mac and 4 or 16, 16, 16, 16) })
		if baseY > 0 then
			Page.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, baseY)
			Page.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -baseY)
		end
		Tab.Holder = Page
		EnableDragScroll(Page)
		Tab._isTab = true
		Tab._reg = {}




		local PageLayout = Page:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
		local function SyncCanvas()
			local sc = Window.ScaleObj and Window.ScaleObj.Scale or 1
			if sc < 0.05 then sc = 1 end
			Page.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, PageLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y / sc + 32)
		end
		PageLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(SyncCanvas)
		Tab._sync = SyncCanvas
		SyncCanvas()

		if not Mac then
			local PageTitle = Label({
				Text = name,
				FontFace = Fonts.Bold,
				TextSize = 22,
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30),
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				LayoutOrder = NextOrder(),
				Parent = Page,
			})
			Create("UIGradient", {
				Color = ColorSequence.new(Theme.Text, Theme.Accent),
				Parent = PageTitle,
			})
		end

		function Tab:_SetActive(active)
			self.Active = active
			if active then
				Window.ActiveTab = Tab
				if Mac then
					local pageName = group and group.Name or name
					TitleLabel.Text = pageName
					SubLabel.Text = PAGE_DESC[pageName] or title
				end
				ApplyFilter()
				if Tab._sync then Tab._sync() end
				Page.Visible = true
				Page.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, baseY + 6)
				Tween(Page, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, baseY) }, 0.16)
			else
				Page.Visible = false
			end
			if group and group.Bar and Mac then
				group.Bar.Visible = active or (group.Current ~= Tab and group.Bar.Visible)
				if active then group.Current = Tab end
				if Tab._pill then
					Tween(Tab._pill, { BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.78 or 1 }, 0.2)
					Tween(Tab._pillLabel, { TextColor3 = active and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText }, 0.2)
				end
			end
			if active then
				MoveHighlight((Mac and group and group.Header) or Btn)
				Tween(Btn, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
			end
			Tween(TabLabel, { TextColor3 = active and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText }, 0.25)
			Tween(sticker, { BackgroundTransparency = active and 0.56 or 0.79 }, 0.2)
		end

		function Tab:Select()
			if not Window:CanShowTab(self) then return end
			for _, t in ipairs(Window.Tabs) do
				if t ~= Tab and t.Active then t:_SetActive(false) end
			end
			if not Tab.Active then Tab:_SetActive(true) end
			for _, g in ipairs(Window.TabGroups or {}) do
				if g._Paint then g._Paint() end
			end
		end

		Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Tab:Select() end)
		Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		Btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			if not Tab.Active then
				Tween(TabLabel, { TextColor3 = Theme.Text }, 0.2)
				Tween(Btn, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.93 }, 0.2)
			end
		end)
		Btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			Tween(Btn, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
			if not Tab.Active then Tween(TabLabel, { TextColor3 = Theme.SubText }, 0.2) end
		end)

		Btn.Visible = Window:CanShowTab(Tab)
		table.insert(Window.Tabs, Tab)
		if #Window.Tabs == 1 then Tab:Select() end
		return Tab
	end



	function Window:CreateTabGroup(name, icon)
		local Group = { Tabs = {}, Open = false, Name = name }
		local Bar
		if Mac then
			Bar = Create("ScrollingFrame", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 4),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 34),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				ScrollBarThickness = 0,
				ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X,
				CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
				AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				Visible = false,
				Parent = Content,
			}, {
				Corner(10),
				Padding(4, 4, 4, 4),
				Create("UIListLayout", {
					FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
					VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
					Padding = UDim.new(0, 4),
					SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				}),
			})
			Group.Bar = Bar
			EnableDragScroll(Bar)
		end
		icon = icon or TAB_ICONS[name]

		local Header = Create("TextButton", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			Text = "",
			LayoutOrder = NextOrder(),
			Parent = TabList,
		}, { Corner(8) })

		local textX = 35
		local sticker = createTabSticker(Header, name, icon, 20, 8)
		local Title = Label({
			Text = name,
			FontFace = Fonts.Medium,
			TextSize = 13,
			TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(textX, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -textX - 30, 1, 0),
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			Parent = Header,
		})
		local Chevron = Label({
			Text = "›",
			FontFace = Fonts.Bold,
			TextSize = 18,
			TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, -1),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
			Visible = not Mac,
			Parent = Header,
		})
		Group.Header = Header
		table.insert(SideLabels, Title)

		local Holder = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ClipsDescendants = true,
			Visible = false,
			LayoutOrder = NextOrder(),
			Parent = TabList,
		}, { List(4), Padding(0, 0, 0, 14) })
		Group.Holder = Holder

		-- more than GRID_AT sub-tabs: 2 compact columns instead of one long list
		local GRID_AT, CELL_H = 5, 30
		local function UseGrid() return #Group.Tabs > GRID_AT end
		local function OpenHeight()
			local count = 0
			for _, tab in ipairs(Group.Tabs) do
				if Window:CanShowTab(tab) then count += 1 end
			end
			if UseGrid() then
				return math.max(math.ceil(count / 2) * (CELL_H + 4) - 4, 0)
			end
			return math.max(count * 36 - 4, 0)
		end
		local gridOn = false
		local function CompactTab(t)
			local btn = t._btn
			local sticker = btn:FindFirstChild("TabSticker")
			if sticker then
				sticker.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
				sticker.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0.5, 0)
				local glyph = sticker:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel")
				if glyph then glyph.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(11, 11) end
			end
			for _, lbl in ipairs(btn:GetChildren()) do
				if lbl:IsA("TextLabel") then
					lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(25, 0)
					lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0)
					lbl.TextScaled = true
					local c = lbl:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint") or Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
					c.MaxTextSize, c.MinTextSize = 12, 8
					c.Parent = lbl
				end
			end
		end
		local function ApplyLayout()
			if gridOn or not UseGrid() then
				if gridOn then CompactTab(Group.Tabs[#Group.Tabs]) end
				return
			end
			gridOn = true
			local list = Holder:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
			if list then list:Destroy() end
			Create("UIGridLayout", {
				CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -2, 0, CELL_H),
				CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4),
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
				Parent = Holder,
			})
			for _, t in ipairs(Group.Tabs) do CompactTab(t) end
		end

		function Group:RefreshMode()
			local height = OpenHeight()
			Header.Visible = Window.UIMode == "Rage Mode" or height > 0
			Holder.Visible = Group.Open and height > 0
			Holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Group.Open and height or 0)
			if Bar then
				local active = Window.ActiveTab
				Bar.Visible = active ~= nil and active.Group == Group and Window:CanShowTab(active)
			end
		end

		local function HasActive()
			for _, t in ipairs(Group.Tabs) do
				if t.Active then return true end
			end
			return false
		end

		local function Paint()
			local hot = Group.Open or HasActive()
			Tween(Title, { TextColor3 = hot and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText }, 0.2)
			Tween(Chevron, { TextColor3 = hot and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText, Rotation = Group.Open and 90 or 0 }, 0.25)
			Tween(sticker, { BackgroundTransparency = hot and 0.56 or 0.79 }, 0.2)
		end

		function Group:SetOpen(open)
			if Mac or not Header.Visible then return end
			Group.Open = open and true or false
			for _, t in ipairs(Group.Tabs) do t._btn:SetAttribute("Hidden", not Group.Open) end
			if Group.Open then Holder.Visible = true end
			local tw = Tween(Holder, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Group.Open and OpenHeight() or 0) }, 0.3)
			if not Group.Open then
				tw.Completed:Connect(function()
					if not Group.Open then Holder.Visible = false end
				end)
			end
			Paint()
		end

		function Group:Toggle() Group:SetOpen(not Group.Open) end
		Group._Paint = Paint

		function Group:CreateTab(tabName, tabIcon)
			local t = Window:CreateTab(tabName, tabIcon, Group)
			table.insert(Group.Tabs, t)
			ApplyLayout()
			if Group.Open then Holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, OpenHeight()) end
			if Bar then
				local pill = Create("TextButton", {
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26),
					AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
					BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					AutoButtonColor = false,
					Text = "",
					LayoutOrder = #Group.Tabs,
					Parent = Bar,
				}, {
					Corner(7), Padding(0, 9, 0, 7),
					Create("UIListLayout", {
						FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
						SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
						VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
						Padding = UDim.new(0, 5),
					}),
				})
				createTabSticker(pill, tabName, t.IconName, 17, 0)
				local pl = Label({
					Text = tabName,
					FontFace = Fonts.Bold,
					TextSize = 12,
					TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26),
					AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
					LayoutOrder = 2,
					Parent = pill,
				})
				t._pill, t._pillLabel = pill, pl
				pill.Visible = Window:CanShowTab(t)
				pill.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if not t.Active then Tween(pl, { TextColor3 = Theme.Text }, 0.12) end end)
				pill.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if not t.Active then Tween(pl, { TextColor3 = Theme.SubText }, 0.12) end end)
				pill.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() t:Select() end)
				if t.Active then
					pill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.78
					pl.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
					Bar.Visible = true
					Group.Current = t
				end
			end
			t._btn:SetAttribute("Hidden", not Group.Open)
			if Window.UIMode == "Safe Mode" or Group.Open then Group:RefreshMode() end
			t._btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() task.defer(Paint) end)
			return t
		end

		Header.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if Mac then
				local current = Group.Current
				if current and Window:CanShowTab(current) then
					current:Select()
					return
				end
				for _, tab in ipairs(Group.Tabs) do
					if Window:CanShowTab(tab) then
						tab:Select()
						break
					end
				end
			else
				Group:Toggle()
			end
		end)
		Header.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			Tween(Header, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.93 }, 0.2)
			Tween(Title, { TextColor3 = Theme.Text }, 0.2)
		end)
		Header.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			Tween(Header, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
			Paint()
		end)

		Window.TabGroups = Window.TabGroups or {}
		table.insert(Window.TabGroups, Group)
		if Window.UIMode == "Safe Mode" then Group:RefreshMode() end
		return Group
	end


	do
		function Window:SetUIMode(mode)
			if mode == self.UIMode or (mode ~= "Safe Mode" and mode ~= "Rage Mode") then return end
			self.UIMode = mode
			CloseResults()
			local firstVisible
			for _, tab in ipairs(self.Tabs) do
				local visible = self:CanShowTab(tab)
				tab._btn.Visible = visible
				if tab._pill then tab._pill.Visible = visible end
				if visible and not firstVisible then firstVisible = tab end
			end
			for _, group in ipairs(self.TabGroups or {}) do group:RefreshMode() end
			if self.ActiveTab and not self:CanShowTab(self.ActiveTab) then
				self.ActiveTab:_SetActive(false)
				self.ActiveTab = nil
				TabHighlight.Visible = false
				HL.Btn = nil
			end
			if not self.ActiveTab and firstVisible then
				if firstVisible.Group then firstVisible.Group:SetOpen(true) end
				firstVisible:Select()
			end
		end

		-- ===== profile popup (click the avatar card) =====
		local overlay = Create("TextButton", {
			Name = "ProfileOverlay", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
			Visible = false, ZIndex = 90, Parent = Root,
		})
		local panel = Create("Frame", {
			Name = "ProfileMenu", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Active = true, ZIndex = 91, Parent = overlay,
		}, { Corner(12), Stroke(Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.35), Padding(10, 8, 10, 8), List(2) })
		local popScale = Create("UIScale", { Scale = 1, Parent = panel })
		local function CloseMode() overlay.Visible = false end

		local function profileText() return "CrackHub" end

		local order = 0
		local function nextOrder() order += 1; return order end

		-- header: avatar, nick
		local head = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = nextOrder(), ZIndex = 92, Parent = panel,
		})
		local headAvatar = Create("ImageLabel", {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 6), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
			Image = Avatar.Image, ZIndex = 93, Parent = head,
		}, { Corner(22) })
		Avatar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"):Connect(function() headAvatar.Image = Avatar.Image end)
		local headName = Label({ Text = LocalPlayer.DisplayName, FontFace = Fonts.Bold, TextSize = 14,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 8), Size = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0, 18), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 93, Parent = head })
		local headSub = Label({ Text = profileText(), TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 27), Size = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0, 14), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 93, Parent = head })
		local headUser = Label({ Text = "@" .. LocalPlayer.Name, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.Accent,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 41), Size = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0, 14), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 93, Parent = head })

		local dividers = {}
		local function divider()
			local d = Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Stroke, BorderSizePixel = 0,
				LayoutOrder = nextOrder(), ZIndex = 92, Parent = panel })
			table.insert(dividers, d)
		end

		local rows = {}
		local function row(icon, text, value, chevron, onClick)
			local b = Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, LayoutOrder = nextOrder(), ZIndex = 92, Parent = panel,
			}, { Corner(8) })
			local ic = Create("ImageLabel", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(17, 17), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ImageColor3 = Theme.SubText, ZIndex = 93, Parent = b })
			ApplyIcon(ic, icon)
			local title = Label({ Text = text, FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 13, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 0),
				Size = UDim2.new(0.55, -36, 1, 0), ZIndex = 93, Parent = b })
			local val = Label({ Text = value or "", TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, chevron and -28 or -10, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 1, 0),
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 93, Parent = b })
			local arrow
			if chevron then
				arrow = Create("ImageLabel", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ImageColor3 = Theme.SubText, Rotation = -90,
					ZIndex = 93, Parent = b })
				ApplyIcon(arrow, "chevron-down")
			end
			b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.88 }, 0.12) end)
			b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.12) end)
			if onClick then b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onClick) end
			local r = { Button = b, Icon = ic, Title = title, Value = val, Arrow = arrow }
			table.insert(rows, r)
			return r
		end

		-- UI Mode row + expandable choice list
		local modeRow
		local modeList = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true,
			Visible = true, ZIndex = 92, Parent = panel,
		}, { List(2), Padding(0, 0, 0, 22) })
		local modeOptions = {}
		local function PaintMode()
			modeRow.Value.Text = Window.UIMode
			for mode, opt in pairs(modeOptions) do
				local selected = mode == Window.UIMode
				opt.Check.ImageTransparency = selected and 0 or 1
				opt.Label.TextColor3 = selected and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText
				opt.Button.BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0.85 or 1
			end
		end
		local modeOpen = false
		modeRow = row("shield-check", "UI Mode", Window.UIMode, true, function()
			modeOpen = not modeOpen
			Tween(modeList, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, modeOpen and 64 or 0) }, 0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
			Tween(modeRow.Arrow, { Rotation = modeOpen and 0 or -90 }, 0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
		end)
		modeList.LayoutOrder = nextOrder()
		local descriptions = { ["Safe Mode"] = "Only visual tabs", ["Rage Mode"] = "All tabs" }
		for _, mode in ipairs({ "Safe Mode", "Rage Mode" }) do
			local b = Create("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 93, Parent = modeList }, { Corner(7) })
			local check = Create("ImageLabel", { AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, 0),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ImageColor3 = Theme.Accent, ZIndex = 94, Parent = b })
			ApplyIcon(check, "check")
			local lbl = Label({ Text = mode, FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 12, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 0),
				Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 94, Parent = b })
			Label({ Text = descriptions[mode], TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
				ZIndex = 94, Parent = b })
			modeOptions[mode] = { Button = b, Check = check, Label = lbl }
			b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				Window:SetUIMode(mode)
				PaintMode()
			end)
		end

		-- Menu key row: click, then press a key
		local capturing = false
		local keyRow
		keyRow = row("keyboard", "Menu Key", toggleKey and toggleKey.Name or "-", false, function()
			if capturing then return end
			capturing = true
			keyRow.Value.Text = "press a key..."
			local conn
			conn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
				conn:Disconnect()
				capturing = false
				if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Escape then pcall(function() Window:SetToggleKey(input.KeyCode) end) end
				keyRow.Value.Text = toggleKey and toggleKey.Name or "-"
			end)
		end)

		local function Repaint()
			panel.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background
			panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke").Color = Theme.Stroke
			headName.TextColor3, headSub.TextColor3, headUser.TextColor3 = Theme.Text, Theme.SubText, Theme.Accent
			for _, d in ipairs(dividers) do d.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Stroke end
			for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
				r.Title.TextColor3, r.Value.TextColor3, r.Icon.ImageColor3 = Theme.Text, Theme.SubText, Theme.SubText
				if r.Arrow then r.Arrow.ImageColor3 = Theme.SubText end
			end
			PaintMode()
		end

		local function OpenMode()
			CloseResults()
			headSub.Text = profileText()
			keyRow.Value.Text = toggleKey and toggleKey.Name or "-"
			Repaint()
			local sc = math.max(Window.ScaleObj.Scale, 0.05)
			local rel = (UserCard.AbsolutePosition - Root.AbsolutePosition) / sc
			panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(rel.X, rel.Y - 6)
			overlay.Visible = true
			popScale.Scale = 0.92
			Tween(popScale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
		end
		overlay.Activated:Connect(CloseMode)
		local profileHit = Create("TextButton", {
			Name = "ProfileModeHit", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 4, Parent = UserCard,
		})
		profileHit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if overlay.Visible then CloseMode() else OpenMode() end end)
		profileHit.MouseButton2Click:Connect(OpenMode)
		UserCard.Gui3D.MouseButton2Click:Connect(OpenMode)
		local brandIcon = Brand:FindFirstChild("CrackHubIcon")
		if brandIcon then
			brandIcon.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then OpenMode() end
			end)
		end
	end

	local function PlayIntro()
		local Splash = Create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Name = "CrackHubSplash",
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 124),
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Parent = Gui,
		}, { Corner(14) })
		local sStroke = Stroke(Theme.Accent, 1.5, 1)
		sStroke.Parent = Splash
		local sScale = Create("UIScale", { Scale = 0.9, Parent = Splash })
		local sLogo = Create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 42),
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Parent = Splash,
		}, { Corner(12), AccentGradient(45) })
		sLogo:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient").Enabled = false
		local sLetter = Create("ImageLabel", {
			Name = "CrackHubIcon",
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Image = "rbxassetid://84919983720903",
			ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
			ImageTransparency = 1,
			Parent = sLogo,
		})
		local sTitle = Label({
			Text = title,
			FontFace = Fonts.Bold,
			TextSize = 15,
			TextTransparency = 1,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 70),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18),
			Parent = Splash,
		})
		local track = Create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 100),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 3),
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Parent = Splash,
		}, { Corner(2) })
		local bar = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			Parent = track,
		}, { Corner(2), AccentGradient(0) })

		Tween(Splash, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, 0.4)
		Tween(sStroke, { Transparency = 0.4 }, 0.4)
		Tween(sScale, { Scale = 1 }, 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		Tween(sLetter, { ImageTransparency = 0 }, 0.4)
		Tween(sTitle, { TextTransparency = 0 }, 0.4)
		Tween(track, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, 0.4)
		task.wait(0.3)
		-- loading bar: fills up to 85% and waits until every tab and function is built, then completes
		Tween(bar, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 1) }, 1.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
		task.wait(1.2)
		local waitStart = os.clock()
		while not CrackHub.Loaded and os.clock() - waitStart < 60 do
			local p = 0.85 + 0.12 * math.min(1, (os.clock() - waitStart) / 20)
			bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(p, 1)
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		Tween(bar, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
		task.wait(0.35)

		for _, obj in ipairs({ Splash, sLogo, track, bar }) do
			Tween(obj, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.3)
		end
		Tween(sLetter, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.3)
		Tween(sTitle, { TextTransparency = 1 }, 0.3)
		Tween(sStroke, { Transparency = 1 }, 0.3)
		Tween(sScale, { Scale = 1.08 }, 0.3)
		task.wait(0.3)
		Splash:Destroy()
	end


	Root.Visible = false
	introThread = task.spawn(function()

		if opts.Intro ~= false then
			local ok, err = pcall(PlayIntro)
			if not ok then
				warn("[CrackHub] Intro skipped: " .. tostring(err))
				local leftover = Gui:FindFirstChild("CrackHubSplash")
				if leftover then leftover:Destroy() end
			end
		end
		if Window.Destroyed then return end

		if Window.Visible then
			Window:SetVisible(true)
		else
			Root.Visible = false
		end
	end)

	return Window
end





local function ElementBase(container, height, name, desc)
	local inGroup = container._group
	if container._isTab then container._cols = nil end
	local children = { Corner(8) }
	if not inGroup then
		table.insert(children, Stroke(Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.35))
		table.insert(children, Create("UIGradient", {
			Rotation = 90,
			Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(226, 226, 232)),
		}))
	end
	local f = Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
		BackgroundTransparency = inGroup and 1 or 0,
		LayoutOrder = NextOrder(),
		Parent = container.Holder,
	}, children)
	f:SetAttribute("CrackHubName", name or "")
	f:SetAttribute("InGroup", inGroup and true or false)
	if container._reg then
		table.insert(container._reg, { f, Lower(name or "") })
	end

	local title = Label({
		Text = name or "",
		FontFace = Fonts.Medium,
		TextSize = 13,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, desc and 9 or 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, inGroup and -70 or -170, 0, desc and 18 or height),
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Parent = f,
	})
	if desc then
		Label({
			Text = desc,
			TextSize = 12,
			TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 28),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, inGroup and -70 or -170, 0, 15),
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			Parent = f,
		})
	end
	return f, title
end

local function ClickArea(parent, height)
	return Create("TextButton", {
		Size = height and UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height) or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "",
		Parent = parent,
	})
end

local function RegisterFlag(o, obj)
	if o.Flag then CrackHub.Flags[o.Flag] = obj end
end


function Container:AddDivider()
	Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Stroke,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		LayoutOrder = NextOrder(),
		Parent = self.Holder,
	})
end


function Container:AddProgress(o)
	o = o or {}
	local P = { Value = o.Default or 0 }
	local f = ElementBase(self, 46, o.Name)
	f:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel").Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 28)
	local pct = Label({
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 28),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
		Parent = f,
	})
	local bar = Create("Frame", {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -14),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 6),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
		Parent = f,
	}, { Corner(3) })
	local fill = Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Parent = bar,
	}, { Corner(3), AccentGradient(0) })
	function P:Set(v)
		v = math.clamp(v, 0, 1)
		self.Value = v
		Tween(fill, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(v, 1) }, 0.4)
		pct.Text = math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5) .. "%"
	end
	P:Set(P.Value)
	RegisterFlag(o, P)
	return P
end







local function CollapsibleBody(window, outer, collapsedH, gap, holderProps, bodyChildren)
	outer.ClipsDescendants = true

	local cfg = {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	}
	for k, v in pairs(holderProps or {}) do cfg[k] = v end
	local holder = Create("Frame", cfg)
	local body = Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = holder,
	}, bodyChildren)

	local ctl = { Collapsed = false }
	local token = 0


	local function unscale(px)
		local sc = window and window.ScaleObj and window.ScaleObj.Scale or 1
		return px / math.max(sc, 0.01)
	end

	function ctl:Set(collapsed)
		if collapsed == self.Collapsed then return end
		self.Collapsed = collapsed
		token += 1
		local my = token

		outer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, unscale(outer.AbsoluteSize.Y))
		outer.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
		local target = collapsed and collapsedH or (collapsedH + gap + unscale(body.AbsoluteSize.Y))

		local tw = Tween(outer, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, target) }, collapsed and 0.28 or 0.34, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
		tw.Completed:Connect(function()
			if my ~= token or collapsed then return end
			outer.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
			outer.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		end)
	end

	return holder, body, ctl
end




function Container:AddSection(name, fullWidth)
	if self._isTab and self.Window.Cards ~= false then
		return self:AddGroup(name, fullWidth)
	end
	return self:AddPlainSection(name)
end

function Container:AddPlainSection(name)
	if self._isTab then self._cols = nil end
	local sec = Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = NextOrder(),
		Parent = self.Holder,
	}, { List(6), Padding(6, 0, 0, 0) })

	local head = Create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Text = "",
		LayoutOrder = 0,
		Parent = sec,
	})
	Create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Parent = head,
	}, { Corner(3), AccentGradient(45) })
	Label({
		Text = string.upper(name),
		FontFace = Fonts.Bold,
		TextSize = 11,
		TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0),
		Parent = head,
	})
	local chevron = Icon("chevron", head, Theme.SubText, 14)
	chevron.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	chevron.Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0.5, 0)
	local _, body, ctl = CollapsibleBody(self.Window, sec, 28, 6, { LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = sec }, { List(6) })
	head.MouseEnter:Connect(function() IconColor(chevron, Theme.Text) end)
	head.MouseLeave:Connect(function() IconColor(chevron, Theme.SubText) end)
	head.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ctl:Set(not ctl.Collapsed)
		Tween(chevron, { Rotation = ctl.Collapsed and -90 or 0 }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end)

	return setmetatable({ Holder = body, Window = self.Window, _reg = self._reg }, Container)
end



function Container:AddColumns(n)
	n = n or 2
	local gap = 12
	local row = Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = NextOrder(),
		Parent = self.Holder,
	}, {
		Create("UIListLayout", {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, gap),
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
		}),
	})
	local cols = {}
	for i = 1, n do
		local col = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1 / n, -gap * (n - 1) / n, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = i,
			Parent = row,
		}, { List(10) })
		cols[i] = setmetatable({ Holder = col, Window = self.Window, _reg = self._reg }, Container)
	end
	return table.unpack(cols)
end



function Container:AddGroup(name, fullWidth)

	local parentHolder = self.Holder
	if self._isTab and not fullWidth then
		if not self._cols then
			local a, b = self:AddColumns(2)
			self._cols = { a, b }
			self._colN = 0
		end
		self._colN += 1
		parentHolder = self._cols[(self._colN - 1) % 2 + 1].Holder
	elseif self._isTab then
		self._cols = nil
	end

	local card = Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Card or Theme.Element,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
		LayoutOrder = NextOrder(),
		Parent = parentHolder,
	}, {
		Corner(12),
		Stroke(Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.3),
		Create("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(205, 200, 220)) }),
	})
	if self._isTab then
		self._groups = self._groups or {}
		table.insert(self._groups, { card, name })
	end

	local head = Create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Text = "",
		Parent = card,
	})
	local badge = Create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = head,
	})
	local badgeIcon = Create("ImageLabel", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 15),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ImageColor3 = Theme.Accent,
		Parent = badge,
	})
	ApplyIcon(badgeIcon, GROUP_ICONS[name] or TAB_ICONS[name] or "layers")
	Create("Frame", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 39),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Stroke,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Parent = card,
	})
	Label({
		Text = name,
		FontFace = Fonts.Bold,
		TextSize = 13,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 1, 0),
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Parent = head,
	})
	local chevron = Icon("chevron", head, Theme.SubText, 14)
	chevron.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	chevron.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0.5, 0)

	local _, body, ctl = CollapsibleBody(
		self.Window,
		card, 40, 0,
		{ Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 40), Parent = card },
		{ List(2), Padding(6, 12, 12, 12) }
	)
	local cardStroke = card:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
	head.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		IconColor(chevron, Theme.Text)
		Tween(cardStroke, { Color = Theme.Accent, Transparency = 0.55 }, 0.2)
	end)
	head.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		IconColor(chevron, Theme.SubText)
		Tween(cardStroke, { Color = Theme.Stroke, Transparency = 0.3 }, 0.2)
	end)
	head.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ctl:Set(not ctl.Collapsed)
		Tween(chevron, { Rotation = ctl.Collapsed and -90 or 0 }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end)

	return setmetatable({ Holder = body, Window = self.Window, _group = true, _reg = self._reg, _gname = tostring(name or ""), _tname = self._tname or self.Name }, Container)
end


function Container:AddLabel(text)
	local f = Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
		LayoutOrder = NextOrder(),
		Parent = self.Holder,
	}, { Corner(8), Padding(10, 14, 10, 14) })
	if self._group then f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
	local l = Label({
		Text = text or "",
		TextSize = 13,
		TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
		TextWrapped = true,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		Parent = f,
	})
	local obj = {}
	function obj:Set(t) l.Text = t end
	return obj
end

function Container:AddParagraph(o)
	local f = Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
		LayoutOrder = NextOrder(),
		Parent = self.Holder,
	}, { Corner(8), Stroke(Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.35), List(4), Padding(12, 14, 12, 14) })
	if self._group then
		f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		local st = f:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
		if st then st.Enabled = false end
	end
	local t = Label({ Text = o.Title or "", FontFace = Fonts.Bold, TextSize = 14, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), LayoutOrder = 1, Parent = f })
	local c = Label({
		Text = o.Content or "",
		TextSize = 13,
		TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
		TextWrapped = true,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		LayoutOrder = 2,
		Parent = f,
	})
	local obj = {}
	function obj:Set(title, content)
		if title then t.Text = title end
		if content then c.Text = content end
	end
	return obj
end


function Container:AddButton(o)
	o = o or {}
	local f, titleLbl = ElementBase(self, o.Description and 52 or 40, o.Name, o.Description)
	f.ClipsDescendants = true
	local s = Create("UIScale", { Parent = f })


	local primary = o.Style == "Primary"
	if primary then
		f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		AccentGradient(0).Parent = f
		for _, d in ipairs(f:GetChildren()) do
			if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
				d.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				d.FontFace = Fonts.Bold
			end
		end
	end

	local arrow = Create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.85,
		Parent = f,
	}, { Corner(7) })
	Label({
		Text = "›",
		FontFace = Fonts.Bold,
		TextSize = 20,
		TextColor3 = Theme.Accent,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -2),
		Parent = arrow,
	})

	local btn = ClickArea(f)
	if primary then
		Hover(btn, f, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 230))
	else
		Hover(btn, f)
	end
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() Tween(s, { Scale = 0.97 }, 0.12) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() Tween(s, { Scale = 1 }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Tween(s, { Scale = 1 }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Ripple(f)
		Tween(arrow, { Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0) }, 0.12).Completed:Connect(function()
			Tween(arrow, { Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0) }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		end)
		SafeCall(o.Callback)
	end)

	local Btn = { Type = "Button" }
	if o.Bind == nil then o.Bind = true end
	if titleLbl then MakeBind(self, o, Btn, f, titleLbl, o.Description and 17 or 20, function() SafeCall(o.Callback) end) end
	RegisterFlag(o, Btn)
	return Btn
end




function Container:AddToggle(o, default, callback)
	if type(o) ~= "table" then
		o = { Name = o, Default = default, Callback = callback }
	end
	local Toggle = { Value = o.Default and true or false, Type = "Toggle" }
	if o.Bind == nil then o.Bind = true end
	local f, titleLbl = ElementBase(self, o.Description and 52 or (Mac and 40 or 36), o.Name, o.Description)
	local setVisual

	if Mac then
		local off = Theme.Stroke
		local sw = Create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 22),
			BackgroundColor3 = off,
			Parent = f,
		}, { Corner(11) })
		local onFill = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Parent = sw,
		}, { Corner(11), AccentGradient(0) })
		local knob = Create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 200, 225),
			ZIndex = 2,
			Parent = sw,
		}, { Corner(9) })
		Create("ImageLabel", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 1),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 8, 1, 8),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Image = "rbxassetid://5554236805",
			ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			ImageTransparency = 0.55,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
			SliceCenter = Rect.new(23, 23, 277, 277),
			ZIndex = 1,
			Parent = knob,
		})
		setVisual = function(on, animate)
			Tween(onFill, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1 }, 0.25)
			Tween(knob, { BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(205, 200, 225) }, 0.25)
			if animate then
				knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(23, 18)
				Tween(knob, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18) }, 0.35)
			end
			Tween(knob, {
				Position = on and UDim2.new(1, -20, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0),
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
			}, 0.3)
		end
	else


	local box = Create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
		Parent = f,
	}, { Corner(5), Stroke(Theme.Stroke, 1, 0) })
	local fill = Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = box,
	}, { Corner(5), AccentGradient(45) })
	local check = Icon("check", box, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 18)
	check.ZIndex = 2
	IconAlpha(check, 1, 0)
	local pop = Create("UIScale", { Parent = box })
	setVisual = function(on, animate)
		Tween(fill, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1 }, 0.15)
		IconAlpha(check, on and 0 or 1, 0.15)
		if animate then
			pop.Scale = 0.75
			Tween(pop, { Scale = 1 }, 0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		end
	end
	end

	function Toggle:Set(v, silent)
		self.Value = v and true or false
		setVisual(self.Value, not silent)
		if not silent then SafeCall(o.Callback, self.Value) end
	end

	local btn = ClickArea(f)
	Hover(btn, f)
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		Toggle:Set(not Toggle.Value)
	end)


	if WantsBind(self.Window, o) then
		local x = Mac and -60 or -38
		titleLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(self._group and 140 or 240), titleLbl.Size.Y.Scale, titleLbl.Size.Y.Offset)
		Toggle.BindChip = AddBindChip(f, self.Window.Connections, x, o.Bind ~= true and o.Bind or nil, {
			OnChange = function(b)
				Toggle.BindValue = b
				SafeCall(o.BindChanged, b)
			end,
			OnPress = function() Toggle:Set(not Toggle.Value) end,
		})
		Toggle.BindValue = Toggle.BindChip:Get()
		Toggle.BindChip.Owner = Toggle
	end

	Toggle:Set(Toggle.Value, true)
	RegisterFlag(o, Toggle)
	return Toggle
end


function Container:AddSlider(o)
	o = o or {}
	local min, max = o.Min or 0, o.Max or 100
	local inc = o.Increment or 1
	local suffix = o.Suffix or ""
	local Slider = { Value = o.Default or min, Type = "Slider" }

	local f, titleLbl = ElementBase(self, 56, o.Name)
	f:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel").Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 34)

	local valueBox = Create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 8),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
		Parent = f,
	}, { Corner(6), Padding(0, 8, 0, 8) })
	local valueLabel = Label({
		FontFace = Fonts.Medium,
		TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		Parent = valueBox,
	})

	local bar = Create("Frame", {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -16),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 5),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Stroke,
		Parent = f,
	}, { Corner(3) })
	local fill = Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Parent = bar,
	}, { Corner(3), AccentGradient(0) })
	local knob = Create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		ZIndex = 2,
		Parent = bar,
	}, { Corner(7), Stroke(Theme.Accent, 3, 0.45) })

	local function fmt(v)
		if o.Format then return o.Format(v) end
		if inc % 1 == 0 then return tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5)) end
		local s = string.format("%.3f", v)
		s = s:gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", "")
		return s
	end

	function Slider:Set(v, silent)
		v = math.clamp(math.floor((v - min) / inc + 0.5) * inc + min, min, max)
		local changed = v ~= self.Value
		self.Value = v
		local pct = (max == min) and 0 or (v - min) / (max - min)
		Tween(fill, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(pct, 1) }, 0.12)
		Tween(knob, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(pct, 0.5) }, 0.12)
		valueLabel.Text = fmt(v) .. suffix
		if changed and not silent then SafeCall(o.Callback, v) end
	end

	local hit = Create("TextButton", {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -28),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = "",
		Parent = f,
	})
	Hover(hit, f)

	OnDrag(hit, self.Window.Connections, function(pos)
		Tween(knob, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18) }, 0.2)
		local pct = math.clamp((pos.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		Slider:Set(min + (max - min) * pct)
	end, function()
		Tween(knob, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14) }, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	end)

	Slider.Value = nil
	Slider:Set(o.Default or min, true)

	MakeBind(self, o, Slider, f, titleLbl, 17, function()
		if o.BindCallback then
			SafeCall(o.BindCallback, Slider.Value)
		else
			Slider:Set(o.Default or min)
		end
	end)
	RegisterFlag(o, Slider)
	return Slider
end


function Container:AddDropdown(o)
	o = o or {}
	local multi = o.Multi == true
	local DD = { Options = o.Options or {}, Open = false, Type = "Dropdown" }
	if multi then
		DD.Value = {}
		if type(o.Default) == "table" then
			for _, v in ipairs(o.Default) do table.insert(DD.Value, v) end
		end
	else
		DD.Value = o.Default
	end

	local f, titleLbl = ElementBase(self, 40, o.Name)
	f.ClipsDescendants = true

	local valueLabel = Label({
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -30, 0, 40),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Parent = f,
	})
	local arrow = Icon("chevron", f, Theme.Accent, 14)
	arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 13)

	local header = ClickArea(f, 40)
	Hover(header, f)

	local list = Create("ScrollingFrame", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 44),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ScrollBarThickness = 2,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Accent,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		Parent = f,
	}, { List(4) })

	local optionViews = {}

	local function isSelected(opt)
		if multi then return table.find(DD.Value, opt) ~= nil end
		return DD.Value == opt
	end

	local function updateDisplay()
		if multi then
			local names = {}
			for _, v in ipairs(DD.Value) do table.insert(names, tostring(v)) end
			valueLabel.Text = #names > 0 and table.concat(names, ", ") or "None"
		else
			valueLabel.Text = DD.Value ~= nil and tostring(DD.Value) or "None"
		end
		for opt, view in pairs(optionViews) do
			local sel = isSelected(opt)
			Tween(view.Label, { TextColor3 = sel and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText }, 0.2)
			Tween(view.Bar, { BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0 or 1 }, 0.2)
			Tween(view.Button, { BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0 or 0.4 }, 0.2)
		end
	end

	local function listHeight()
		local n = math.min(#DD.Options, 5)
		return n * 30 + math.max(n - 1, 0) * 4
	end

	function DD:SetOpen(state)
		self.Open = state
		local h = listHeight()
		Tween(f, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, state and (40 + 4 + h + 8) or 40) }, 0.35)
		Tween(list, { Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, state and h or 0) }, 0.35)
		Tween(arrow, { Rotation = state and 180 or 0 }, 0.35)
	end

	local function build()
		for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
		end
		table.clear(optionViews)

		for i, opt in ipairs(DD.Options) do
			local ob = Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 30),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Text = "",
				LayoutOrder = i,
				Parent = list,
			}, { Corner(6) })
			local bar = Create("Frame", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, 0),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 14),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Parent = ob,
			}, { Corner(2), AccentGradient(90) })
			local l = Label({
				Text = tostring(opt),
				TextSize = 12,
				TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 0),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0),
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
				Parent = ob,
			})
			optionViews[opt] = { Button = ob, Label = l, Bar = bar }

			ob.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				if not isSelected(opt) then Tween(l, { TextColor3 = Theme.Text }, 0.15) end
			end)
			ob.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
				if not isSelected(opt) then Tween(l, { TextColor3 = Theme.SubText }, 0.15) end
			end)
			ob.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				if multi then
					local idx = table.find(DD.Value, opt)
					if idx then table.remove(DD.Value, idx) else table.insert(DD.Value, opt) end
					updateDisplay()
					SafeCall(o.Callback, DD.Value)
				else
					DD.Value = opt
					updateDisplay()
					DD:SetOpen(false)
					SafeCall(o.Callback, opt)
				end
			end)
		end
		updateDisplay()
	end

	function DD:Set(v, silent)
		if v == string.char(80, 117, 108, 115, 101) then v = "Rhythm" end
		if multi then
			self.Value = type(v) == "table" and v or { v }
		else
			self.Value = v
		end
		updateDisplay()
		if not silent then SafeCall(o.Callback, self.Value) end
	end

	function DD:Refresh(options, keepValue)
		self.Options = options or {}
		if not keepValue then self.Value = multi and {} or nil end
		build()
		if self.Open then self:SetOpen(true) end
	end

	header.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		DD:SetOpen(not DD.Open)
	end)

	build()

	if not multi or o.BindCallback then
		MakeBind(self, o, DD, f, titleLbl, 20, function()
			if o.BindCallback then
				SafeCall(o.BindCallback, DD.Value)
				return
			end
			local idx = table.find(DD.Options, DD.Value) or 0
			DD:Set(DD.Options[idx % #DD.Options + 1])
		end)
	end
	RegisterFlag(o, DD)
	return DD
end


function Container:AddTextbox(o)
	o = o or {}
	local TB = { Value = o.Default or "", Type = "Textbox" }
	local f, titleLbl = ElementBase(self, o.Description and 52 or 40, o.Name, o.Description)

	local box = Create("TextBox", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 26),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
		Text = TB.Value,
		PlaceholderText = o.Placeholder or "Enter text...",
		PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.SubText,
		TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
		FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
		TextSize = 12,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		ClearTextOnFocus = o.ClearOnFocus or false,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		Parent = f,
	}, { Corner(6), Padding(0, 8, 0, 8) })
	local st = Stroke(Theme.Stroke, 1, 0)
	st.Parent = box

	if o.Numeric then
		box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
			local clean = box.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")
			if clean ~= box.Text then box.Text = clean end
		end)
	end

	box.Focused:Connect(function()
		Tween(st, { Color = Theme.Accent }, 0.2)
		Tween(box, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 26) }, 0.25)
	end)
	box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
		Tween(st, { Color = Theme.Stroke }, 0.2)
		Tween(box, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 26) }, 0.25)
		TB.Value = box.Text
		SafeCall(o.Callback, box.Text, enter)
	end)

	TB.Box = box
	function TB:Set(text)
		box.Text = tostring(text)
		self.Value = box.Text
	end

	RegisterFlag(o, TB)
	return TB
end


function Container:AddKeybind(o)
	o = o or {}
	local KB = { Value = o.Default, Binding = false, Type = "Keybind" }
	local f = ElementBase(self, o.Description and 52 or 40, o.Name, o.Description)

	local box = Create("TextButton", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 24),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Text = "",
		FontFace = Fonts.Medium,
		TextSize = 12,
		TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
		Parent = f,
	}, { Corner(6), Padding(0, 10, 0, 10) })
	local st = Stroke(Theme.Stroke, 1, 0)
	st.Parent = box

	local function display()
		box.Text = KB.Binding and "..." or (KB.Value and KB.Value.Name or "—")
		Tween(st, { Color = KB.Binding and Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke }, 0.2)
	end

	local savedKey
	box.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		savedKey=KB.Value; KB.Binding=true
		BindCapture:Begin(KB,function(input)
			local clear=input and input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape
			KB.Binding=false
			if clear then KB.Value=nil else KB.Value=savedKey end
			display()
			if clear and savedKey then SafeCall(o.ChangedCallback,nil) end
		end)
		display()
	end)

	table.insert(self.Window.Connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if KB.Binding then
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
					BindCapture:Cancel(input)
					return
				end
				if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
					KB.Value = nil
				else
					KB.Value = input.KeyCode
				end
				BindCapture:Finish(KB,input)
				KB.Binding = false
				display()
				SafeCall(o.ChangedCallback, KB.Value)
			end
			return
		end
		if not gp and not BindCapture:Blocked(input) and KB.Value and input.KeyCode == KB.Value then
			SafeCall(o.Callback)
		end
	end))

	function KB:Set(key)
		if key==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then return end
		if BindCapture.Active and BindCapture.Active.Owner==self then BindCapture:Cancel() end
		self.Value = key
		display()
		SafeCall(o.ChangedCallback, self.Value)
	end

	display()
	KB.Frame = f
	CrackHub.KeybindRegistry = CrackHub.KeybindRegistry or {}
	table.insert(CrackHub.KeybindRegistry, KB)
	RegisterFlag(o, KB)
	return KB
end


function Container:AddColorPicker(o)
	o = o or {}
	local CP = { Value = o.Default or Color3.fromRGB(140, 90, 255), Open = false, Type = "ColorPicker" }
	local h, s, v = CP.Value:ToHSV()

	local f, titleLbl = ElementBase(self, 40, o.Name)
	f.ClipsDescendants = true

	local swatch = Create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 10),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 20),
		BackgroundColor3 = CP.Value,
		Parent = f,
	}, { Corner(6), Stroke(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 1, 0.8) })

	local paletteStyle = o.VisualPalette == true
	local hexBadge
	if paletteStyle then
		swatch.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 24)
		swatch.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 8)
		hexBadge = Label({
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -62, 0, 20),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 20), TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Parent = f,
		})
		f:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
			hexBadge.Visible = f.AbsoluteSize.X > 230
		end)
		hexBadge.Visible = f.AbsoluteSize.X > 230
	end
	local header = ClickArea(f, 40)
	Hover(header, f)

	local area = Create("Frame", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 48),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 120),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = f,
	})

	local sv = Create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1),
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Text = "",
		Parent = area,
	}, { Corner(6) })
	Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		Parent = sv,
	}, { Corner(6), Create("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1) }) })
	Create("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		Parent = sv,
	}, { Corner(6), Create("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0) }) })
	local svCursor = Create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		ZIndex = 3,
		Parent = sv,
	}, { Corner(6), Stroke(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 2, 0) })

	local rainbow = {}
	for i = 0, 6 do
		table.insert(rainbow, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 6, Color3.fromHSV((i / 6) % 1, 1, 1)))
	end
	local hue = Create("TextButton", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Text = "",
		Parent = area,
	}, { Corner(6), Create("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(rainbow) }) })
	local hueCursor = Create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 6, 0, 6),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		ZIndex = 3,
		Parent = hue,
	}, { Corner(3), Stroke(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 1, 0.5) })

	local info = Label({
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 176),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 18),
		TextSize = 12,
		FontFace = Fonts.Medium,
		TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
		Parent = f,
	})

	local hexBox, preview
	local original = CP.Value
	if paletteStyle then
		sv.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		hue.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero
		hue.Position = UDim2.new(0, 43, 1, 16)
		hue.Size = UDim2.new(1, -43, 0, 10)
		hue:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient").Rotation = 0
		hueCursor.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 13)
		preview = Create("Frame", {
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 6), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32),
			BackgroundColor3 = CP.Value, Parent = area,
		}, { Corner(7), Stroke(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 1, 0.7) })
		info.Visible = false
		hexBox = Create("TextBox", {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 213), Size = UDim2.new(1, -65, 0, 28),
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Card or Theme.Background, TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
			TextSize = 12, FontFace = Fonts.Medium, ClearTextOnFocus = false, Parent = f,
		}, { Corner(6) })
	end
	local function update(silent)
		CP.Value = Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v)
		sv.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h, 1, 1)
		swatch.BackgroundColor3 = CP.Value
		svCursor.Position = UDim2.fromScale(s, 1 - v)
		hueCursor.Position = paletteStyle and UDim2.fromScale(h, 0.5) or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, h)
		if paletteStyle then
			local hex = "#" .. CP.Value:ToHex():upper()
			hexBadge.Text = hex
			if not hexBox:IsFocused() then hexBox.Text = hex end
			preview.BackgroundColor3 = CP.Value
		end
		info.Text = string.format("#%s   ·   RGB %d, %d, %d",
			CP.Value:ToHex():upper(),
			math.floor(CP.Value.R * 255 + 0.5),
			math.floor(CP.Value.G * 255 + 0.5),
			math.floor(CP.Value.B * 255 + 0.5))
		if not silent then SafeCall(o.Callback, CP.Value) end
	end

	local conns = self.Window.Connections
	OnDrag(sv, conns, function(pos)
		s = math.clamp((pos.X - sv.AbsolutePosition.X) / sv.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		v = 1 - math.clamp((pos.Y - sv.AbsolutePosition.Y) / sv.AbsoluteSize.Y, 0, 1)
		update()
	end)
	OnDrag(hue, conns, function(pos)
		local ratio = paletteStyle and (pos.X - hue.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(hue.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
			or (pos.Y - hue.AbsolutePosition.Y) / math.max(hue.AbsoluteSize.Y, 1)
		h = math.clamp(ratio, 0, 0.999)
		update()
	end)

	function CP:SetOpen(state)
		self.Open = state
		Tween(f, { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, state and (paletteStyle and 252 or 204) or 40) }, 0.35)
	end

	function CP:Set(color, silent)
		h, s, v = color:ToHSV()
		update(silent)
	end

	if paletteStyle then
		hexBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local hex = hexBox.Text:match("^%s*#?(%x%x%x%x%x%x)%s*$")
			local red, green, blue = hexBox.Text:match("^%s*(%d+)%s*,%s*(%d+)%s*,%s*(%d+)%s*$")
			if hex then
				CP:Set(Color3.fromHex(hex))
			elseif red then
				CP:Set(Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(tonumber(red), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(green), 0, 255), math.clamp(tonumber(blue), 0, 255)))
			else
				update(true)
			end
		end)
		local reset = Create("TextButton", {
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -43, 0, 213), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(29, 28),
			Text = "↶", TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 15, AutoButtonColor = false,
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Card or Theme.Background, Parent = f,
		}, { Corner(6) })
		reset.Activated:Connect(function() CP:Set(original) end)
	end
	header.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if not CP.Open then original = CP.Value end
		CP:SetOpen(not CP.Open)
	end)

	update(true)

	MakeBind(self, o, CP, f, titleLbl, 20, function() CP:SetOpen(not CP.Open) end)
	RegisterFlag(o, CP)
	return CP
end







local B64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local B64Index = {}
for i = 1, 64 do B64Index[B64:sub(i, i)] = i - 1 end

local function Base64Encode(str: string): string
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #str, 3 do
		local a, b, c = str:byte(i, i + 2)
		local n = a * 65536 + (b or 0) * 256 + (c or 0)
		local c1 = math.floor(n / 262144) % 64
		local c2 = math.floor(n / 4096) % 64
		local c3 = math.floor(n / 64) % 64
		local c4 = n % 64
		table.insert(out, B64:sub(c1 + 1, c1 + 1) .. B64:sub(c2 + 1, c2 + 1)
			.. (b and B64:sub(c3 + 1, c3 + 1) or "=")
			.. (c and B64:sub(c4 + 1, c4 + 1) or "="))
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function Base64Decode(str: string): string
	str = str:gsub("[^%w%+/]", "")
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #str, 4 do
		local chunk = str:sub(i, i + 3)
		local n, count = 0, #chunk
		for j = 1, 4 do
			n = n * 64 + (B64Index[chunk:sub(j, j)] or 0)
		end
		local a = math.floor(n / 65536) % 256
		local b = math.floor(n / 256) % 256
		local c = n % 256
		if count >= 2 then table.insert(out, string.char(a)) end
		if count >= 3 then table.insert(out, string.char(b)) end
		if count >= 4 then table.insert(out, string.char(c)) end
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local CONFIG_PREFIX = "CH1:"

local function EncodeBind(b)
	if not b then return "" end
	if b.Key then return "K:" .. b.Key.Name end
	return "M:" .. b.Mouse.Name
end

local function DecodeBind(str)
	if type(str) ~= "string" or str == "" then return nil end
	local kind, name = str:match("^(%a):(%w+)$")
	if not kind then return nil end
	local ok, item = pcall(function()
		return kind == "K" and Enum.KeyCode[name] or Enum.UserInputType[name]
	end)
	return ok and item or nil
end


CrackHub.AllToggles, CrackHub.AllButtons = CrackHub.AllToggles or {}, CrackHub.AllButtons or {}
do
	local addToggle, addButton = Container.AddToggle, Container.AddButton
	local addSlider, addDropdown = Container.AddSlider, Container.AddDropdown
	local autoCount = {}
	local function autoFlag(o, kind, owner)
		if type(o) ~= "table" or o.Flag or not o.Name then return end
		local where = ""
		-- (same names as before v82 so saved configs keep matching)
		local base = "AUTO_" .. kind .. "_" .. where .. tostring(o.Name)
		autoCount[base] = (autoCount[base] or 0) + 1
		o.Flag = autoCount[base] > 1 and (base .. "_" .. autoCount[base]) or base
	end
	local function pending(o, obj)
		local p = CrackHub.PendingConfig
		if obj and type(o) == "table" and o.Flag and p and p[o.Flag] ~= nil and not tostring(o.Flag):find("^AUTO_") then
			local v = p[o.Flag]; p[o.Flag] = nil
			task.defer(function() pcall(function() obj:Set(v) end) end)
		end
		return obj
	end
	function Container:AddSlider(o, ...) autoFlag(o, "S", self); return pending(o, addSlider(self, o, ...)) end
	function Container:AddDropdown(o, ...) autoFlag(o, "D", self); return pending(o, addDropdown(self, o, ...)) end
	function Container:AddToggle(o, ...)
		autoFlag(o, "T", self)
		local t = pending(o, addToggle(self, o, ...))
		local name = type(o) == "table" and o.Name or o
		if t and name then table.insert(CrackHub.AllToggles, {name = tostring(name), toggle = t}) end
		return t
	end
	function Container:AddButton(o, ...)
		local b = addButton(self, o, ...)
		if type(o) == "table" and o.Name and type(o.Callback) == "function" then table.insert(CrackHub.AllButtons, {name = tostring(o.Name), callback = o.Callback}) end
		return b
	end
end

function CrackHub:SnapshotConfig(saveBinds)
	local values, binds = {}, {}
	for flag, obj in pairs(self.Flags) do
		local t, v = obj.Type, obj.Value
		if t == "ColorPicker" and typeof(v) == "Color3" then
			values[flag] = { c = v:ToHex() }
		elseif t == "Keybind" then
			values[flag] = { k = v and v.Name or "" }
		elseif t == "Toggle" or t == "Slider" or t == "Textbox" or t == "Dropdown" then
			if v ~= nil then values[flag] = v end
		end
		if saveBinds ~= false and obj.BindChip then
			binds[flag] = EncodeBind(obj.BindChip:Get())
		end
	end
	return values, binds
end


function CrackHub:ApplyConfig(cfg)
	local applied = 0
	self.PendingConfig = self.PendingConfig or {}
	for flag, v in pairs(cfg.Values or {}) do
		local obj = self.Flags[flag]
		if not obj then self.PendingConfig[flag] = v end
		if obj and obj.Set then
			local t = obj.Type
			local ok = pcall(function()
				if t == "Toggle" and type(v) == "boolean" then
					obj:Set(v)
				elseif t == "Slider" and type(v) == "number" then
					obj:Set(v)
				elseif t == "Textbox" and type(v) == "string" then
					obj:Set(v)
				elseif t == "Dropdown" and (type(v) == "string" or type(v) == "table") then
					obj:Set(v)
				elseif t == "ColorPicker" and type(v) == "table" and type(v.c) == "string" then
					obj:Set(Color3.fromHex(v.c))
				elseif t == "Keybind" and type(v) == "table" then
					obj:Set(DecodeBind("K:" .. tostring(v.k)))
				else
					return
				end
				applied += 1
			end)
			if not ok then warn("[CrackHub] failed to apply", flag) end
		end
	end
	for flag, b in pairs(cfg.Binds or {}) do
		local obj = self.Flags[flag]
		if obj and obj.BindChip then obj.BindChip:Set(DecodeBind(b)) end
	end
	return applied
end

function CrackHub:EncodeConfig(cfg)
	local json = HttpService:JSONEncode({
		v = 1, n = cfg.Name, a = cfg.Author, f = cfg.Values, b = cfg.Binds,
	})
	return CONFIG_PREFIX .. Base64Encode(json)
end


local function ExtractConfigCode(text: string): string?
	local start = text:upper():find(CONFIG_PREFIX, 1, true)
	if not start then return nil end
	local rest = text:sub(start + #CONFIG_PREFIX)
	local body = {}
	for ch in rest:gmatch(".") do
		if ch:match("[%w%+/=]") then
			table.insert(body, ch)
		elseif not ch:match("%s") then
			break
		end
	end
	if #body < 8 then return nil end
	return table.concat(body)
end
CrackHub.ExtractConfigCode = ExtractConfigCode

function CrackHub:DecodeConfig(code)
	if type(code) ~= "string" or code:gsub("%s", "") == "" then return nil, "field is empty" end
	local body = ExtractConfigCode(code)
	if not body then
		if code:find("http", 1, true) or code:find("loadstring", 1, true) then
			return nil, "this is a link/loadstring. Open the link and copy the text itself: " .. CONFIG_PREFIX .. "..."
		end
		return nil, "code not found: " .. CONFIG_PREFIX .. "... — copy all of it"
	end
	local ok, data = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(Base64Decode(body))
	end)
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.f) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "code is corrupted"
	end
	local name = type(data.n) == "string" and data.n:sub(1, 40) or "Untitled"
	if name:gsub("%s", "") == "" then name = "Untitled" end
	return {
		Name = name,
		Author = type(data.a) == "string" and data.a:sub(1, 30) or "?",
		Values = data.f,
		Binds = type(data.b) == "table" and data.b or {},
	}
end

local function ConfigURL(input)
	local text = input:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if text:match("^https?://") then return text end
	local quote, url, tail = text:match([[^loadstring%s*%(%s*game%s*:%s*HttpGet%s*%(%s*(['"])(.-)%1%s*(.-)%)%s*%)%s*%(%s*%)%s*;?$]])
	if not quote then return nil end
	tail = tail:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if tail ~= "" and not tail:match("^,%s*true$") and not tail:match("^,%s*false$") then
		return nil
	end
	return url
end

function CrackHub:ResolveConfigInput(input)
	if type(input) ~= "string" then return nil, "Paste a config code or link" end
	local text = input:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if ExtractConfigCode(text) then return text end
	local url = ConfigURL(text)
	if not url or not url:match("^https?://[^/%s]+") or url:find([=[[%s"'<>\]]=]) then
		return nil, "Paste CH1:..., a raw link or loadstring(game:HttpGet(\"URL\", true))()"
	end
	local ok, body
	if type(self.FetchConfig) == "function" then

		ok, body = pcall(self.FetchConfig, url)
	else
		ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url, true) end)
		if not ok then
			ok, body = pcall(function() return HttpService:GetAsync(url, true) end)
		end
	end
	if not ok then
		return nil, "Failed to download the config. Check the raw link and HTTP access."
	end
	if type(body) ~= "string" or #body == 0 then return nil, "The provider returned an empty response" end
	if #body > 1024 * 1024 then return nil, "Config file is too large (max 1 MB)" end

	if body:sub(1, 3) == "\239\187\191" then body = body:sub(4) end
	body = body:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if body:sub(1, #CONFIG_PREFIX) ~= CONFIG_PREFIX then
		return nil, "The link must contain the CH1:... code from the “Code” field, not an HTML page or script"
	end
	return body
end

local function CreateFileConfigStorage()
	if type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
		return nil, "File saving unavailable: readfile, writefile and isfile are required. Configs will only last until restart."
	end
	local oldFileName = "CrackHub_Configs_" .. tostring(game.GameId) .. "_" .. tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId) .. ".json"
	-- one file per PC (= per HWID): every Roblox account on this computer sees the same configs
	local fileName = "CrackHub_Configs_" .. tostring(game.GameId) .. "_device.json"
	return {
		Load = function()
			if not isfile(fileName) then
				if isfile(oldFileName) then pcall(function() writefile(fileName, readfile(oldFileName)) end) end
				if not isfile(fileName) then return {} end
			end
			local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(fileName))
			if type(data) ~= "table" or data.Version ~= 1 or type(data.Configs) ~= "table" then
				error("Invalid config file format")
			end
			local list = {}
			for _, encoded in ipairs(data.Configs) do
				local cfg, err = CrackHub:DecodeConfig(encoded)
				if not cfg then error(err or "Corrupted config") end
				table.insert(list, cfg)
			end
			return list
		end,
		Save = function(list)
			local encoded = {}
			for _, cfg in ipairs(list) do
				table.insert(encoded, CrackHub:EncodeConfig(cfg))
			end
			writefile(fileName, HttpService:JSONEncode({ Version = 1, Configs = encoded }))
		end,
	}, fileName
end

function CrackHub._BuildConfigTab(window, o)
	local storage = o.Storage
	local storageInfo
	if not storage then storage, storageInfo = CreateFileConfigStorage() end
	local saveBinds = o.SaveBinds ~= false
	local configs = {}
	local loadFailed = false
	if storage and storage.Load then
		local ok, list = pcall(storage.Load)
		if ok and type(list) == "table" then
			configs = list
		else
			loadFailed = true
			storageInfo = "Failed to read configs. The original file was kept; saving is disabled until it is fixed."
			warn("[CrackHub] Config read error:", list)
		end
	end

	local function find(name)
		for i, c in ipairs(configs) do
			if c.Name == name then return i, c end
		end
		return nil, nil
	end
	local function uniqueName(name)
		if not find(name) then return name end
		local i = 2
		while find(name .. " (" .. i .. ")") do i += 1 end
		return name .. " (" .. i .. ")"
	end
	local function persist()
		if loadFailed or not storage or type(storage.Save) ~= "function" then return false end

		local ok, result = pcall(storage.Save, configs)
		if not ok or result == false then
			CrackHub:Notify({ Title = "Write error", Content = "The config is in memory, but the file could not be saved.", Type = "Error", Duration = 6 })
			warn("[CrackHub] Config write error:", result)
			return false
		end
		return true
	end
	local function notify(title, text, kind)
		CrackHub:Notify({ Title = title, Content = text, Type = kind, Duration = 3 })
	end

	local Tab = window:CreateTab(o.Name or "Configs", o.Icon)
	local NB = false


	local Create_ = Tab:AddGroup("Save")
	if loadFailed or not storage then
		Create_:AddLabel(storageInfo or "Persistent storage unavailable")
	elseif storageInfo then
		Create_:AddLabel("Autosave: " .. storageInfo)
	end
	local NameBox = Create_:AddTextbox({ Name = "Name", Placeholder = "My config", Bind = NB })
	local AuthorBox = Create_:AddTextbox({ Name = "Author", Default = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Name or "", Bind = NB })
	local CodeBox

	local List, Info, refreshList

	local function showCode(cfg)
		local code = CrackHub:EncodeConfig(cfg)
		CodeBox.Code = code
		CodeBox:Set(code)
		return code
	end

	Create_:AddButton({
		Name = "Save",
		Description = "Creates a config and a shareable code",
		Style = "Primary",
		Bind = NB,
		Callback = function()
			local name = NameBox.Box.Text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
			if name == "" then name = "Config " .. (#configs + 1) end
			local values, binds = CrackHub:SnapshotConfig(saveBinds)
			local cfg = { Name = name:sub(1, 40), Author = AuthorBox.Box.Text:sub(1, 30), Values = values, Binds = binds }
			local i = find(cfg.Name)
			if i then configs[i] = cfg else table.insert(configs, cfg) end
			persist()
			refreshList(cfg.Name)
			showCode(cfg)
			notify("Saved", "«" .. cfg.Name .. "” — code is in the “Code” field, copy with Ctrl+C", "Success")
		end,
	})


	local CodeGroup = Tab:AddGroup("Config code")
	CodeBox = CodeGroup:AddTextbox({
		Name = "Code",
		Description = "Click, Ctrl+A → Ctrl+C",
		Placeholder = "Save a config first",
		Bind = NB,
	})

	CodeBox.Box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		if CodeBox.Code and CodeBox.Box.Text ~= CodeBox.Code then
			CodeBox.Box.Text = CodeBox.Code
		end
	end)
	CodeBox.Box.Focused:Connect(function()
		task.defer(function()
			CodeBox.Box.SelectionStart = 1
			CodeBox.Box.CursorPosition = #CodeBox.Box.Text + 1
		end)
	end)
	CodeGroup:AddLabel("Upload the code to GitHub / Pastebin and share it. Others paste it into “Import”.")


	local Mine = Tab:AddGroup("My configs")
	List = Mine:AddDropdown({
		Name = "Config",
		Options = {},
		Bind = NB,
		Callback = function(name)
			local _, c = find(name)
			Info:Set(c and ("Author: " .. (c.Author ~= "" and c.Author or "?")) or "No configs yet")
		end,
	})
	Info = Mine:AddLabel("No configs yet")

	refreshList = function(select)
		local names = {}
		for _, c in ipairs(configs) do table.insert(names, c.Name) end
		List:Refresh(names)
		if select and find(select) then
			List:Set(select)
		elseif names[1] then
			List:Set(names[1])
		else
			Info:Set("No configs yet")
		end
	end

	local function selected()
		local _, c = find(List.Value)
		if not c then notify("Config", "Select a config first", "Warning") end
		return c
	end

	Mine:AddButton({
		Name = "Load",
		Style = "Primary",
		Bind = NB,
		Callback = function()
			local c = selected()
			if not c then return end
			local n = CrackHub:ApplyConfig(c)
			notify("Loaded", "«" .. c.Name .. "” · settings applied: " .. n, "Success")
		end,
	})
	Mine:AddButton({
		Name = "Show code",
		Bind = NB,
		Callback = function()
			local c = selected()
			if c then showCode(c); notify("Code", "Code “" .. c.Name .. "” is in the “Code” field") end
		end,
	})
	Mine:AddButton({
		Name = "Delete",
		Bind = NB,
		Callback = function()
			local c = selected()
			if not c then return end
			table.remove(configs, (find(c.Name)))
			persist()
			refreshList()
			notify("Deleted", "«" .. c.Name .. "»", "Error")
		end,
	})


	local Import = Tab:AddGroup("Import")
	local ImportBox = Import:AddTextbox({ Name = "Code / link", Placeholder = "CH1:... / https://... / loadstring(...)", Bind = NB })
	local lastCode, busy = nil, false
	local function doImport(text, quiet)
		if busy then return end
		text = (text or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
		if text == "" then
			if not quiet then notify("Import", "Paste code " .. CONFIG_PREFIX .. "...", "Warning") end
			return
		end
		busy = true
		local fetchOK, resolved, fetchError = pcall(CrackHub.ResolveConfigInput, CrackHub, text)
		if not fetchOK or not resolved then
			busy = false
			if not quiet then notify("Import error", fetchOK and fetchError or "Failed to get the config", "Error") end
			return
		end
		text = resolved
		local cfg, err = CrackHub:DecodeConfig(text)
		if not cfg then
			busy = false
			if not quiet then notify("Import error", err, "Error") end
			return
		end
		busy = true
		lastCode = ExtractConfigCode(text)
		cfg.Name = uniqueName(cfg.Name)
		table.insert(configs, cfg)
		persist()
		refreshList(cfg.Name)
		ImportBox:Set("")
		local ok, n = pcall(CrackHub.ApplyConfig, CrackHub, cfg)
		if not ok then warn("[CrackHub] ApplyConfig:", n) end
		notify("Imported", "«" .. cfg.Name .. "” by " .. cfg.Author .. " · loaded", "Success")
		busy = false
	end

	ImportBox.Box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
		if enter and ImportBox.Box.Text:gsub("%s", "") ~= "" then doImport(ImportBox.Box.Text) end
	end)

	Import:AddButton({
		Name = "Import",
		Description = "Appears in “My configs” and loads",
		Style = "Primary",
		Bind = NB,
		Callback = function() doImport(ImportBox.Box.Text) end,
	})

	refreshList()
	Tab.Configs = configs
	CrackHub.ConfigApi = {List = function() return configs end, Import = function(code) doImport(code, false) end}
	return Tab
end
