local function CrackHubCreateCombatModules()
local EspBox = {}
function EspBox.quantize(value)
	return math.floor(value * 200 + 0.5) / 200
end

local FovSettings = {}

function FovSettings.initialize(configuration)
	local settings = configuration.sheriff.fov
	if type(settings) ~= "table" then
		settings = {}
		configuration.sheriff.fov = settings
	end

	settings.on = settings.on or false
	settings.size = settings.size or 220
	settings.r, settings.g, settings.b = settings.r or 120, settings.g or 220, settings.b or 255
	settings.lr, settings.lg, settings.lb = settings.lr or 255, settings.lg or 255, settings.lb or 255
	settings.style, settings.tr, settings.fa = settings.style or "Glow", settings.tr or 20, settings.fa or 12
	if settings.fill == nil then settings.fill = false end
	if settings.anim == nil then settings.anim = true end

	return settings
end

function FovSettings.changeSize(context, value)
	context.settings.size = context.environment.math.floor(value)
end

function FovSettings.changeFillStrength(context, value)
	context.settings.fa = context.environment.math.floor(value)
	context.redraw()
end

function FovSettings.changeTransparency(context, value)
	context.settings.tr = context.environment.math.floor(value)
	context.redraw()

	if not context.picker or not context.picker.SetAlpha then
		return
	end

	context.picker.SetAlpha(1 - context.settings.tr / 100)
end

function FovSettings.changeAnimation(context, isEnabled)
	context.settings.anim = not not isEnabled
end

function FovSettings.changeLockColor(context, color)
	local floor = context.environment.math.floor
	context.settings.lr = floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5)
	context.settings.lg = floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5)
	context.settings.lb = floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)

	context.redraw()
end

function FovSettings.changeFilled(context, isEnabled)
	local isFilled = true

	if not isEnabled then
		isFilled = context.disabledValue()
	end

	context.settings.fill = isFilled
	context.redraw()
end

function FovSettings.formatSize(environment, value)
	local numeric = environment.tonumber(value)

	if numeric and numeric >= 1500 then
		return "в€ћ"
	end

	numeric = environment.tonumber(value) or 0
	return environment.tostring(environment.math.floor(numeric))
end

function FovSettings.changeColor(context, selection)
	local color = selection.color
	local floor = context.environment.math.floor
	context.settings.r = floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5)
	context.settings.g = floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5)
	context.settings.b = floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)

	FovSettings._syncTransparency(context, selection.alpha)
	context.redraw()
end

function FovSettings._syncTransparency(context, alpha)
	if not context.environment.tonumber(alpha) then
		return
	end

	local transparency = context.environment.math.floor((1 - alpha) * 100 + 0.5)

	if transparency == context.settings.tr then
		return
	end

	context.settings.tr = transparency

	if not context.slider or not context.slider.Set then
		return
	end

	context.slider.Set(transparency)
end

local FovRenderer = {}

function FovRenderer.create(environment, create)
	local context = {environment = environment, create = create}

	return {
		make = function(parent) return FovRenderer.make(environment, create, parent) end,
		render = function(...) return FovRenderer.render(context, ...) end,
	}
end

function FovRenderer.render(context, item, radius, color, lockColor, locked, filled, fillStrength, style, animated, delta, opacity, rotation)
	local environment = context.environment
	local math = environment.math
	radius = math.max(2, radius)
	local smoothing = 1 - math.exp(-delta * 16)
	item.radius = item.radius or radius
	item.radius += (radius - item.radius) * smoothing
	radius = item.radius
	local target = locked and 1 or 0
	item.lock += (target - item.lock) * smoothing

	if rotation ~= nil then
		item.spin = rotation
	end

	if rotation == nil and animated then
		item.spin = (item.spin + delta * 75) % 360
	end

	local currentColor = color:Lerp(lockColor, item.lock * 0.42)
	local diameter = radius * 2
	local coreThickness = 1.6 + item.lock * 0.77
	local gradient = style == "Gradient"
	local glow = style == "Glow" or gradient
	local dashed = style == "Dashed"
	local classic = style == "Classic"
	local white = environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local black = environment.Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

	item.fill.Visible = filled and true or false
	if filled then
		local strength = math.clamp((environment.tonumber(fillStrength) or 10) / 100 * (1 + item.lock * 0.35), 0, 0.9)
		local keypoint = environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
		item.fill.Size = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter)
		item.fill.BackgroundColor3 = currentColor
		item.fill.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		item.fillGradient.Rotation = 90
		item.fillGradient.Transparency = environment.NumberSequence.new({
			keypoint(0, 1 - strength * 0.55), keypoint(0.5, 1 - strength), keypoint(1, 1 - strength * 0.55),
		})
	end

	item.base.Visible = style ~= "Glow"
	item.base.Size = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(diameter, diameter)
	item.baseStroke.Color = currentColor
	item.baseStroke.Thickness = classic and 1.5 or 1
	item.baseStroke.Transparency = 1 - opacity * (classic and 1 or (dashed and 0.18 or 0.3))

	item.shade.Visible = not (classic or dashed)
	item.shade.Size = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(2, diameter - coreThickness - 2), math.max(2, diameter - coreThickness - 2))
	item.shadeStroke.Color = black
	item.shadeStroke.Thickness = coreThickness + 2
	item.shadeStroke.Transparency = 1 - opacity * (gradient and 0.14 or 0.26)

	item.core.Visible = not (classic or dashed)
	item.core.Size = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(2, diameter - coreThickness), math.max(2, diameter - coreThickness))
	item.coreStroke.Color = white
	item.coreStroke.Thickness = coreThickness
	item.coreStroke.Transparency = 1 - opacity
	local colorPoint = environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new
	local middleColor = gradient and environment.Color3.new(0.12, 0.55, 1) or currentColor:Lerp(white, 0.55)
	item.coreGradient.Color = environment.ColorSequence.new({colorPoint(0, currentColor), colorPoint(0.5, middleColor), colorPoint(1, currentColor)})
	item.coreGradient.Rotation = item.spin
	if gradient then
		local numberPoint = environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
		item.coreGradient.Transparency = environment.NumberSequence.new({numberPoint(0, 0), numberPoint(0.5, 0.92), numberPoint(1, 0)})
	else
		item.coreGradient.Transparency = environment.NumberSequence.new(0)
	end

	FovRenderer._renderGlow(context, item, diameter, currentColor, opacity, glow, gradient)
	FovRenderer._renderDashes(context, item, radius, currentColor, opacity, dashed)
end

function FovRenderer._renderGlow(context, item, diameter, color, opacity, visible, gradient)
	local environment = context.environment
	local intensity = opacity * (gradient and 0.55 or 1) * (1 + item.lock * 0.63)

	for _, layer in ipairs(item.glow) do
		layer.frame.Visible = visible

		if not visible then
			continue
		end

		local size = environment.math.max(2, diameter + layer.inset * 2)
		layer.frame.Size = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
		layer.stroke.Color = color
		layer.stroke.Thickness = layer.thickness * (1 + item.lock * 0.42)
		layer.stroke.Transparency = environment.math.clamp(1 - (1 - layer.alpha) * intensity, 0, 1)
	end
end

function FovRenderer._renderDashes(context, item, radius, color, opacity, visible)
	local environment = context.environment
	local math = environment.math
	local count = visible and math.clamp(math.floor(2 * math.pi * radius / 16), 12, 72) or 0

	while #item.dashes < count do
		local dash = context.create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = environment.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4,
		}, item.holder)
		context.create("UICorner", {CornerRadius = environment.UDim.new(1, 0)}, dash)
		table.insert(item.dashes, dash)
	end

	for index, dash in ipairs(item.dashes) do
		dash.Visible = index <= count

		if index > count then
			continue
		end

		local angle = (index - 1) * math.pi * 2 / count + math.rad(item.spin * 0.35)
		dash.Size = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(3, math.pi * radius / count), 2 + item.lock * 0.77)
		dash.Position = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(math.cos(angle) * radius, math.sin(angle) * radius)
		dash.Rotation = math.deg(angle) + 90
		dash.BackgroundColor3 = color
		dash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - opacity * 0.96
	end
end

function FovRenderer.make(environment, create, parent)
	local center = environment.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	local position = environment.UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	local holder = create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = center, Position = position, Size = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, parent)
	local fill = create("Frame", {AnchorPoint = center, Position = position, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1}, holder)
	create("UICorner", {CornerRadius = environment.UDim.new(1, 0)}, fill)
	local fillGradient = create("UIGradient", {}, fill)
	local glow = {}

	for _, settings in ipairs({{3, 0.72, 0}, {7, 0.87, 0}, {13, 0.945, 0}, {3, 0.8, -3}, {8, 0.925, -8}}) do
		local frame, stroke = FovRenderer._circle(environment, create, holder, 2)
		table.insert(glow, {frame = frame, stroke = stroke, thickness = settings[1], alpha = settings[2], inset = settings[3]})
	end

	local shade, shadeStroke = FovRenderer._circle(environment, create, holder, 3)
	local base, baseStroke = FovRenderer._circle(environment, create, holder, 3)
	local core, coreStroke = FovRenderer._circle(environment, create, holder, 4)
	local coreGradient = create("UIGradient", {}, coreStroke)

	return {holder = holder, fill = fill, fillGradient = fillGradient, glow = glow,
		base = base, baseStroke = baseStroke, shade = shade, shadeStroke = shadeStroke,
		core = core, coreStroke = coreStroke, coreGradient = coreGradient, dashes = {}, spin = 0, lock = 0}
end

function FovRenderer._circle(environment, create, parent, zIndex)
	local frame = create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = environment.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = environment.UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = zIndex,
	}, parent)
	create("UICorner", {CornerRadius = environment.UDim.new(1, 0)}, frame)
	local stroke = create("UIStroke", {
		ApplyStrokeMode = environment.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, LineJoinMode = environment.Enum.LineJoinMode.Round,
	}, frame)

	return frame, stroke
end

local InputBindings = {}

function InputBindings.install(environment, inputService)
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	local enum = environment.Enum
	local mouse = {
		MouseButton1 = enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,
		MouseButton2 = enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,
		MouseButton3 = enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3,
	}
	globals.__crackhubBindMouse = mouse
	globals.__crackhubBindCapture = false

	globals.__crackhubBindFromName = function(name)
		if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return nil end
		if mouse[name] then return mouse[name] end

		local ok, key = pcall(function() return enum.KeyCode[name] end)
		if ok and environment.typeof(key) == "EnumItem" then return key end
		return nil
	end

	globals.__crackhubBindReady = function()
		return not globals.__crackhubBindCapture and not inputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
	end

	globals.__crackhubBindHit = function(input, binding)
		if environment.typeof(binding) ~= "EnumItem" then return false end
		if binding.EnumType == enum.UserInputType then return input.UserInputType == binding end
		return binding.EnumType == enum.KeyCode and input.UserInputType == enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
			and input.KeyCode == binding
	end
end

local FovSection = {}

function FovSection.install(context)
	local section = context.section
	section:Header("AimBot FOV")

	return section:Toggle({
		Text = "Show FOV Circle", Default = context.defaultOn,
		Callback = function(enabled) context.controller:setEnabled(enabled) end,
		Settings = function() FovSection.create(context) end,
	})
end

function FovSection.create(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local parent = context.section:Container()
	local container = context.create("Frame", {
		Size = environment.UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 84),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	}, parent)

	context.create("UIListLayout", {
		FillDirection = environment.Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
		Padding = environment.UDim.new(0, 6),
		SortOrder = environment.Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	}, container)

	local cards = {}
	local function repaint()
		for _, card in environment.ipairs(cards) do
			FovSection._paintCard(context, card)
		end
	end

	local function redraw()
		local settings = context.settings
		local color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(settings.r, settings.g, settings.b)
		local lockColor = environment.Color3.fromRGB(settings.lr, settings.lg, settings.lb)
		local alpha = 1 - environment.math.clamp((environment.tonumber(settings.tr) or 20) / 100, 0, 1)

		for _, card in environment.ipairs(cards) do
			environment.pcall(context.renderer.render, card.item, 11, color, lockColor, false,
				settings.fill == true, settings.fa, card.name, context.disabledValue(), 0, alpha, 40)
		end
	end

	context.setRedraw(redraw)

	for index, styleName in environment.ipairs(context.styles) do
		FovSection._createCard(context, {
			index = index, name = styleName, parent = container, cards = cards, repaint = repaint,
		})
	end

	repaint()
	redraw()

	environment.getgenv().__crackhubFovPaint = function()
		repaint()
		context.redraw()
	end

	local settingsContext = {
		environment = environment, settings = context.settings, section = context.section,
		configuration = context.configuration, redraw = context.redraw,
		disabledValue = context.disabledValue, alphaEnabled = context.alphaEnabled,
	}

	FovSection._createControls(settingsContext)
end

function FovSection._createCard(context, option)
	local environment = context.environment
	local nova = context.nova
	local button = context.create("TextButton", {
		Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = environment.UDim2.new(0.25, -4.5, 1, 0), LayoutOrder = option.index,
	}, option.parent)

	context.round(button, 10)
	nova.Theme.bind(button, "BackgroundColor3", "Surface2")

	local stroke = context.create("UIStroke", {
		Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.86,
		ApplyStrokeMode = environment.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
	}, button)
	nova.Theme.bind(stroke, "Color", "Glass")

	local frame = context.create("Frame", {
		Position = environment.UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1),
		Size = environment.UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 58),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true,
	}, button)
	local preview = context.renderer.make(frame)
	preview.holder.Position = environment.UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)

	local label = nova.label({
		Parent = button, Text = context.translation.tr(option.name), Font = nova.Font.Semi(), Size = 11,
		Pos = environment.UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -22), Box = environment.UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18),
		AlignX = environment.Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Color = "Muted",
	})

	environment.pcall(function()
		context.translation.bind(label, option.name)
	end)

	local card = {button = button, stroke = stroke, label = label, item = preview, name = option.name, hover = false}
	table.insert(option.cards, card)

	context.connect(button.MouseButton1Click, function()
		environment.pcall(function() nova.Sound.play("tick") end)
		context.settings.style = option.name
		option.repaint()
	end)

	context.connect(button.MouseEnter, function()
		card.hover = true
		option.repaint()
	end)

	nova.U.leave(button, function()
		card.hover = false
		option.repaint()
	end)
end

function FovSection._paintCard(context, card)
	local nova = context.nova
	local isSelected = context.settings.style == card.name
	local backgroundColor = isSelected and "Accent" or "Surface2"
	local strokeColor = (isSelected or card.hover) and "Accent" or "Glass"
	local textColor = (isSelected or card.hover) and "Text" or "Muted"
	local transparency = isSelected and 0.15 or (card.hover and 0.55 or 0.86)

	nova.paint(card.button, "BackgroundColor3", backgroundColor, "Quick")
	nova.Motion.tween(card.button, "Quick", {BackgroundTransparency = isSelected and 0.82 or 0})
	nova.paint(card.stroke, "Color", strokeColor, "Quick")
	nova.Motion.tween(card.stroke, "Quick", {Transparency = transparency})
	nova.paint(card.label, "TextColor3", textColor, "Quick")
end

function FovSection._createControls(context)
	local section = context.section
	local settings = context.settings
	local environment = context.environment

	section:Slider({
		Text = "FOV Size", Min = 40, Max = 1500, Default = context.configuration.sheriff.fov.size,
		Decimals = 0, Display = function(value) return FovSettings.formatSize(environment, value) end,
		Callback = function(value) FovSettings.changeSize(context, value) end,
	})

	context.slider = section:Slider({
		Text = "FOV Transparency", Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = environment.tonumber(settings.tr) or 20,
		Decimals = 0, Suffix = "%", Callback = function(value) FovSettings.changeTransparency(context, value) end,
	})

	context.picker = section:Colorpicker({
		Text = "FOV Color", Default = environment.Color3.fromRGB(settings.r or 120, settings.g or 220, settings.b or 255),
		Alpha = context.alphaEnabled(), DefaultAlpha = 1 - (environment.tonumber(settings.tr) or 20) / 100,
		Callback = function(color, alpha) FovSettings.changeColor(context, {color = color, alpha = alpha}) end,
	})

	section:Toggle({
		Text = "Animation", Default = settings.anim ~= false,
		Callback = function(value) FovSettings.changeAnimation(context, value) end,
	})
	section:Colorpicker({
		Text = "Lock Color", Default = environment.Color3.fromRGB(settings.lr, settings.lg, settings.lb),
		Callback = function(color) FovSettings.changeLockColor(context, color) end,
	})
	section:Toggle({
		Text = "Filled", Default = settings.fill == true,
		Callback = function(value) FovSettings.changeFilled(context, value) end,
	})
	section:Slider({
		Text = "Fill Strength", Min = 1, Max = 60, Default = environment.tonumber(settings.fa) or 12,
		Decimals = 0, Callback = function(value) FovSettings.changeFillStrength(context, value) end,
	})
end

local SheriffSection = {}

function SheriffSection.create(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	local settings = context.configuration.sheriff

	SheriffSection._createGeneralControls(context)
	SheriffSection._createTiming(context)
	context.section:Header("AimBot")
    context.section:Toggle({
        Text = "Auto Fire", Default = context.defaults.sheriff.autoShoot,
        Flag = "Combat_Sheriff_Auto_Shoot_Murder",
        Callback = function(enabled) settings.autoShoot = not not enabled end,
    })
	settings.aimVer = "V4"

	environment.pcall(function()
		globals.__crackhubAim = globals.__crackhubAim or {}
		local enabled = settings.silentAim or settings.aimType == "Flick Shot"
		globals.__crackhubAim.on = not not enabled

		if enabled and globals.__crackhubAim.installHook then
			environment.pcall(globals.__crackhubAim.installHook)
		end
	end)

	SheriffSection._createResolver(context)
	SheriffSection._createAimControls(context)
	SheriffSection._createFlickControls(context)
	SheriffSection._createPrediction(context)
	SheriffSection._createKeybind(context)
end

function SheriffSection._createGeneralControls(context)
	local settings = context.configuration.sheriff
	local defaults = context.defaults.sheriff

	context.section:Toggle({
		Text = "Wallbang", Default = defaults.wallbang,
		Callback = function(value) settings.wallbang = value end,
	})
end

function SheriffSection._createTiming(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local settings = context.configuration.sheriff

	environment.pcall(function()
		local labels = {
			["Shot Timing"] = {"Р’СЂРµРјСЏ РІС‹СЃС‚СЂРµР»Р°", "Р§Р°СЃ РїРѕСЃС‚СЂС–Р»Сѓ"},
			Accurate = {"РўРѕС‡РЅРѕ", "РўРѕС‡РЅРѕ"},
			Instant = {"РњРіРЅРѕРІРµРЅРЅРѕ", "РњРёС‚С‚С”РІРѕ"},
		}

		for label, values in environment.pairs(labels) do
			if context.translation.data.ru and context.translation.data.ru[label] == nil then
				context.translation.data.ru[label] = values[1]
			end

			if context.translation.data.uk and context.translation.data.uk[label] == nil then
				context.translation.data.uk[label] = values[2]
			end
		end
	end)

	context.section:Dropdown({
		Text = "Shot Timing",
		Options = {{code = "Accurate", label = "Accurate"}, {code = "Instant", label = "Instant"}},
		Default = settings.shotTiming == "Instant" and "Instant" or "Accurate",
		Callback = function(value)
			if value ~= "Instant" and value ~= "Accurate" then
				return
			end

			settings.shotTiming = value
			local aim = environment.rawget(environment.getgenv(), "__crackhubAimX")

			if environment.type(aim) == "table" and aim.alive and aim.applyTiming then
				environment.pcall(aim.applyTiming)
			end
		end,
	})
end

function SheriffSection._createResolver(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local settings = context.configuration.sheriff
	local resolver = context.section:Toggle({
		Text = "Resolver", Default = context.defaults.sheriff.resolver,
		Callback = function(value)
			if settings.aimVer ~= "V3" then
				settings.resolver = not not value
				return
			end

			settings.resolver = true

			if not value and context.resolver and context.resolver.Set then
				environment.task.defer(function()
					environment.pcall(context.resolver.Set, context.resolverEnabled())
				end)
			end
		end,
	})
	context.resolver = resolver

	environment.getgenv().__crackhubForceResolver = function()
		if settings.aimVer ~= "V3" then
			return
		end

		settings.resolver = true

		if context.resolver and context.resolver.Set then
			environment.pcall(context.resolver.Set, true)
		end
	end

	environment.task.defer(function()
		environment.pcall(environment.getgenv().__crackhubForceResolver)
	end)
end

	local environment = context.environment
	local settings = context.configuration.sheriff

	context.section:Dropdown({

		Options = {
			{code = "Classic", label = "Classic"}, {code = "Universal", label = "Universal (Cam Lock)"},
			{code = "Flick Shot", label = "Flick Shot"},
		},
		Callback = function(value)
			settings.aimType = value
			local globals = environment.getgenv()
			globals.__crackhubAim = globals.__crackhubAim or {}

			if value == "Flick Shot" then
				globals.__crackhubAim.on = true

				if globals.__crackhubAim.installHook then
					environment.pcall(globals.__crackhubAim.installHook)
				end

				return
			end

			globals.__crackhubAim.on = not not settings.silentAim
		end,
	})
end

local FovLifecycle = {}

function FovLifecycle.ensure(context)
	local state = context.state
	local screen = state.screen
	local renderer = state.renderer

	if screen and screen.Parent and renderer and renderer.holder.Parent then
		return
	end

	if screen then
		context.environment.pcall(function()
			screen:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	state.screen = context.create("ScreenGui", {
		Name = "CrackHubAimFOV", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
		DisplayOrder = 4, ZIndexBehavior = context.environment.Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
	})

	local attached = context.environment.pcall(function()
		state.screen.Parent = context.coreGui
	end)

	if not attached or not state.screen.Parent then
		context.environment.pcall(function()
			state.screen.Parent = context.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
		end)
	end

	state.renderer = context.renderers.make(state.screen)
end

local RoleData = {}

RoleData.infer = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(player)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return nil end
    local role = player:GetAttribute("Role") or character:GetAttribute("Role")
    if role == "Murderer" or role == "Sheriff" or role == "Hero" then return role end
    for _, container in ipairs({character, player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")}) do
        for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
            if not tool:IsA("Tool") then continue end
            local name = string.lower(tool.Name)
            if name:find("knife", 1, true) then return "Murderer" end
            if name:find("gun", 1, true) or name == "revolver" then return "Sheriff" end
        end
    end
end)

function RoleData.source(context)
	local state = context.state
	if state.source then return state.source end

	local storage = context.storage
	local function fromFolder(folder)
		return RoleData._load(context.environment, folder and folder:FindFirstChild("CurrentRoundClient"))
	end

	state.source = fromFolder(storage:FindFirstChild("Modules"))
		or RoleData._load(context.environment, storage:FindFirstChild("CurrentRoundClient"))
		or fromFolder(storage:FindFirstChild("Client"))

	if state.source then return state.source end

	local modules = storage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
	local client = modules and modules:FindFirstChild("Client")
	state.source = fromFolder(client)

	return state.source
end

function RoleData.refresh(context)
	local state = context.state
	local source = RoleData.source(context)

	if source then
		local ok, roles = context.environment.pcall(function() return source.GetLatestPlayerData() end)
		if ok and type(roles) == "table" then
			roles = table.clone(roles)
			for _, player in ipairs(context.players:GetPlayers()) do
				if roles[player.Name] == nil then
					local inferred = RoleData.infer(player)
					if inferred then roles[player.Name] = {Role = inferred, Dead = false, Killed = false} end
				end
			end
			state.roles = roles
			return
		end
	end

	local roles = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(context.players:GetPlayers()) do
		local role = RoleData.infer(player)
		if not role then
			continue
		end

		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local dead = humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 or false
		roles[player.Name] = {Role = role, Dead = dead, Killed = false}
	end

	state.roles = roles
end

function RoleData._load(environment, module)
	if not module or not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then return end

	local ok, source = environment.pcall(environment.require, module)
	if not ok or type(source) ~= "table" or type(source.GetLatestPlayerData) ~= "function" then return end

	return source
end

local RoleCache = {}

function RoleCache.create(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local state = context.state
	state.refreshing = false
	state.lastRefresh = 0

	return function()
		if not state.refreshing and environment.os.clock() - state.lastRefresh >= 0.25 then
			state.refreshing = true
			environment.task.spawn(function()
				environment.pcall(context.refresh)
				state.lastRefresh = environment.os.clock()
				state.refreshing = false
			end)
		end

		return state.roles
	end
end

function RoleData.create(context)
	local state = {roles = {}}
	local data = {environment = context.environment, storage = context.storage, players = context.players, state = state}
	local getRoles = RoleCache.create({
		environment = context.environment, state = state,
		refresh = function() RoleData.refresh(data) end,
	})

	return getRoles, state
end

local FovTarget = {}

FovTarget.isInside = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(context, character)
	local settings = context.configuration.sheriff.fov
	if not settings or not settings.on then return true end
	if tonumber(settings.size) and tonumber(settings.size) >= 1500 then return character ~= nil end

	local part = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Head"))
	if not part then return false end

	local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return true end

	local ok, inside = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local point, visible = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
		if not visible or point.Z <= 0 then return false end

		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
		local x, y = point.X - viewport.X * 0.5, point.Y - viewport.Y * 0.5
		local radius = tonumber(settings.size) or 220
		return x * x + y * y <= radius * radius
	end))

	return ok and inside or false
end)

function FovTarget.hasMurderer(context)
	local roles = context.roles()

	for _, player in ipairs(context.players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player == context.localPlayer then
			continue
		end

		local role = roles[player.Name]
		if not role or role.Role ~= "Murderer" or role.Dead == true or role.Killed == true then
			continue
		end

		local character = player.Character
		if not character then
			continue
		end

		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			continue
		end

		if character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

local FovController = {}
FovController.__index = FovController

function FovController.create(context)
	return setmetatable({
		context = context, environment = context.environment, state = context.state, settings = context.settings,
		renderers = context.renderers, isLocked = context.isLocked,
		lastFrame = context.environment.os.clock(), nextLockCheck = 0, locked = false,
	}, FovController)
end

function FovController.setEnabled(controller, enabled)
	controller.settings.on = not not enabled
	controller:refresh()
end

function FovController.refresh(controller)
	local state = controller.state

	if not controller.settings.on then
		if state.screen then state.screen.Enabled = false end
		return
	end

	controller.context.ensure()
	if state.screen then state.screen.Enabled = true end
	if controller.context.redraw then controller.context.redraw() end
end

function FovController.step(controller)
	local environment = controller.environment
	local settings = controller.settings
	local state = controller.state
	local now = environment.os.clock()
	local delta = environment.math.clamp(now - controller.lastFrame, 0, 0.1)
	controller.lastFrame = now

	if not settings.on or not state.screen or not state.renderer or not state.renderer.holder.Parent then
		return
	end

	if now >= controller.nextLockCheck then
		controller.nextLockCheck = now + 0.1
		local ok, locked = environment.pcall(controller.isLocked)
		controller.locked = ok and locked or false
	end

	local color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(settings.r, settings.g, settings.b)
	local lockColor = environment.Color3.fromRGB(settings.lr, settings.lg, settings.lb)
	local opacity = 1 - environment.math.clamp((environment.tonumber(settings.tr) or 20) / 100, 0, 1)
	controller.renderers.render(state.renderer, environment.tonumber(settings.size) or 220, color, lockColor,
		controller.locked, settings.fill == true, settings.fa, settings.style, settings.anim ~= false, delta, opacity)
end

local GunFeature = {}

function GunFeature.installEsp(context)
	-- Gun ESP: the dropped gun glows yellow (through walls) with a "GUN" tag and distance.
	-- Finds the drop whatever shape it has (Part / MeshPart / Model / Tool) and wherever it lies in the map.
	local environment = context.environment
	local workspace, player = context.workspace, context.player
	local drops = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local watching, checkedAt, current, adornee = false, 0, nil, nil
	local billboard, label, highlight, onDrop
	local COLOR = environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 60)

	local owned; owned = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(object)
		local model = object:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		while model do
			if context.players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then return true end
			model = model:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		end
		return false
	end)
	local isDrop; isDrop = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(object)
		if object.Name == "GunDrop" then return true end
		return object:IsA("Tool") and (object.Name == "Gun" or object:FindFirstChild("Shoot") ~= nil)
	end)
	-- the thing to highlight and the part to hang the tag on
	local partOf; partOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(object)
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then return object end
		local handle = object:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then return handle end
		if object:IsA("Model") and object.PrimaryPart then return object.PrimaryPart end
		return object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end)
	local remember; remember = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(object)
		if not isDrop(object) then return end
		drops[object] = true
		if onDrop and object.Name == "GunDrop" and object:IsA("BasePart") then environment.task.spawn(onDrop, object) end
	end)
	local startWatching; startWatching = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		if watching then return end
		watching = true
		context.connect(workspace.DescendantAdded, remember)
		for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do remember(object) end
	end)
	local function findDrop()
		startWatching()
		for object in pairs(drops) do
			if object.Parent and object.Name == "GunDrop" and object:IsA("BasePart") and object:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return object end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local refresh; refresh = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local now = environment.os.clock()
		if now - checkedAt < 0.1 then return end
		checkedAt, current, adornee = now, nil, nil
		startWatching()
		local fallback, fallbackPart
		for object in pairs(drops) do
			if not object.Parent or not object:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				drops[object] = nil
			elseif not owned(object) then
				local part = partOf(object)
				if part then
					if object.Name == "GunDrop" then current, adornee = object, part; return end
					fallback, fallbackPart = object, part
				end
			end
		end
		current, adornee = fallback, fallbackPart
	end)
	local clear; clear = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		if billboard then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() billboard:Destroy() end)); billboard, label = nil, nil end
		if highlight then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() highlight:Destroy() end)); highlight = nil end
	end)
	local protectedParent; protectedParent = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(instance, inside)
		-- try the hidden UI first; if this executor does not render it there, fall back to the object itself
		local ok = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() instance.Parent = context.coreGui end))
		if not ok or instance.Parent ~= context.coreGui then
			if not pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() instance.Parent = inside end)) then
				pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() instance.Parent = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end))
			end
		end
	end)
	context.connect(context.runService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		if not context.configuration.sheriff.gunEsp then
			clear()
			return
		end
		refresh()
		if not current or not adornee or not adornee.Parent then
			clear()
			return
		end
		if not billboard or not billboard.Parent then
			billboard = environment.Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			billboard.Name, billboard.Size = "CrackHubGunESP", environment.UDim2.fromOffset(140, 30)
			billboard.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = environment.Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0)
			billboard.AlwaysOnTop, billboard.LightInfluence, billboard.MaxDistance = true, 0, 100000
			label = environment.Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.BackgroundTransparency, label.Size = 1, environment.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			label.Font, label.TextSize, label.Text = environment.Enum.Font.GothamBold, 14, "GUN"
			label.TextColor3, label.TextStrokeTransparency, label.TextStrokeColor3 = COLOR, 0.3, environment.Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			label.Parent = billboard
			protectedParent(billboard, adornee)
			pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() environment.getgenv().__crackhubBBMirror.add(billboard) end))
		end
		if billboard.Adornee ~= adornee then billboard.Adornee = adornee end
		-- the Highlight lives inside the gun itself: that always renders, on every executor
		if not highlight or not highlight.Parent or highlight.Parent ~= current then
			if highlight then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() highlight:Destroy() end)) end
			highlight = environment.Instance.new("Highlight")
			highlight.Name, highlight.DepthMode = "CrackHubGunHL", environment.Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			highlight.FillColor, highlight.OutlineColor = COLOR, COLOR
			highlight.FillTransparency, highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0.35, 0
			highlight.Adornee = current
			if not pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() highlight.Parent = current end)) then protectedParent(highlight, adornee) end
		end
		if highlight.Adornee ~= current then highlight.Adornee = current end
		-- soft pulse so it reads as glowing, plus distance on the tag
		local pulse = (math.sin(environment.os.clock() * 4) + 1) * 0.5
		highlight.FillTransparency = 0.25 + pulse * 0.3
		local own = player.Character
		local root = own and own:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if label then
			local text = root and string.format("GUN · %dm", math.floor((root.Position - adornee.Position).Magnitude + 0.5)) or "GUN"
			if label.Text ~= text then label.Text = text end
		end
	end))
	context.section:Toggle({Text = "Gun ESP", Default = context.defaults.sheriff.gunEsp,
		Callback = function(enabled) context.configuration.sheriff.gunEsp = enabled end})
	return clear, {
		findDrop = findDrop,
		find = function()
			local drop = findDrop()
			if drop then return drop, drop end
			checkedAt = 0
			refresh()
			if current and adornee and adornee.Parent then return current, adornee end
			return nil, nil
		end,
		onDrop = function(callback) onDrop = callback end,
	}
end

function GunFeature.installAuto(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local globals, player = environment.getgenv(), context.player
	local settings = context.configuration.sheriff
	local state = {drop = nil, t0 = 0, n = 0, fullT = 0, log = {}}
	local picking = false
	globals.__crackhubAutoGun = state

	local log; log = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(message)
		table.insert(state.log, string.format("%.2f %s", environment.os.clock(), message))
		if #state.log > 30 then table.remove(state.log, 1) end
	end)
	local gun; gun = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local character = player.Character
		local held = character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
		if held then return held end
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
		return backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun")
	end)
	local root; root = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local character = player.Character
		return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end)
	local allowed; allowed = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(force)
		if not force and not settings.autoGun or gun() then return false end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
		local ok, roles = pcall(context.roles)
		local info = ok and type(roles) == "table" and roles[player.Name]
		if type(info) == "table" then
			if info.Dead == true or info.Killed == true then return false end
			local role = info.Role and tostring(info.Role):lower() or ""
			return role ~= "murderer" and role ~= "sheriff"
		end
		if ok and type(roles) == "table" and next(roles) ~= nil then return false end
		if character:FindFirstChild("Knife") then return false end
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		return not (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife"))
	end)
	local touch; touch = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(object, part, full)
		local ownRoot = root()
		if not ownRoot or not part or not part.Parent or not environment.firetouchinterest then return false end
		local fire; fire = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(first, second)
			environment.firetouchinterest(first, second, 0)
			environment.firetouchinterest(first, second, 1)
		end)
		pcall(fire, ownRoot, part)
		if full then
			local character = player.Character
			if character then
				for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("BasePart") and child ~= ownRoot then pcall(fire, child, part) end
				end
			end
			if object and object ~= part then
				for _, child in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
					if child:IsA("BasePart") and child ~= part then pcall(fire, ownRoot, child) end
				end
			end
		end
		return true
	end)
	local pauseInvisibility; pauseInvisibility = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(drop)
		local invisible = globals.__crackhubInvis
		if not invisible or not invisible.active then return end
		local now = environment.os.clock()
		if globals.__crackhubInvisPauseDrop ~= drop then
			globals.__crackhubInvisPauseDrop, globals.__crackhubInvisPauseN = drop, 0
		end
		if (tonumber(globals.__crackhubInvisPause) or 0) < now and (globals.__crackhubInvisPauseN or 0) < 4 then
			globals.__crackhubInvisPauseN = (globals.__crackhubInvisPauseN or 0) + 1
			globals.__crackhubInvisPause = now + 0.6
		end
	end)
	local attempt; attempt = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(force)
		if not allowed(force) then return false end
		local object, part = context.drops.find()
		if not part then return false end
		local ownRoot = root()
		if not force and (tonumber(settings.agDist) or 1000) < 1000 and ownRoot
			and (ownRoot.Position - part.Position).Magnitude > (tonumber(settings.agDist) or 1000) then return false end
		local now = environment.os.clock()
		if state.drop ~= part then
			state.drop, state.t0, state.n, state.fullT, state.goneT = part, now, 0, 0, nil
			local distance = ownRoot and math.floor((ownRoot.Position - part.Position).Magnitude) or -1
			log("DROP d=" .. distance)
		end
		pauseInvisibility(object)
		local full = now - state.fullT > 0.12
		if full then state.fullT = now end
		if touch(object, part, full) then state.n += 1 end
		return true
	end)
	globals.__crackhubPickUpGun = function()
		if picking or gun() then return false end
		picking = true
		environment.task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			local started, found = environment.os.clock(), false
			log("BIND")
			while context.isAlive() and environment.os.clock() - started < 2 and not gun() do
				local ok, success = pcall(attempt, true)
				if ok and success then
					found = true
				end
				if not found and environment.os.clock() - started > 0.25 then
					break
				end
				context.runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
			picking = false
		end))
		return true
	end
	context.drops.onDrop(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(part)
		if not settings.autoGun then return end
		local started = environment.os.clock()
		while part.Parent and environment.os.clock() - started < 0.6 and not part:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter") do
			context.runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end
		if part.Parent then pcall(attempt) end
	end))
	environment.task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		pcall(context.drops.findDrop)
		local hadGun = false
		while context.isAlive() do
			context.runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			local hasGun, drop = gun() ~= nil, state.drop
			if drop then
				local now = environment.os.clock()
				if hasGun and not hadGun then
					log("GOT n=" .. state.n .. " dt=" .. string.format("%.2f", now - state.t0))
					state.drop = nil
				end
				if not (hasGun and not hadGun) and not drop.Parent then
					state.goneT = state.goneT or now
					if hasGun or now - state.goneT > 0.6 then
						log((hasGun and "GOT" or "GONE") .. " n=" .. state.n .. " dt=" .. string.format("%.2f", state.goneT - state.t0))
						state.drop, state.goneT = nil, nil
					end
				end
			end
			if settings.autoGun then pcall(attempt) end
			hadGun = hasGun
		end
	end))
	context.section:Toggle({Text = "Auto Pickup Gun", Default = context.defaults.sheriff.autoGun,
		Callback = function(enabled) settings.autoGun = enabled end, Settings = function()
			context.section:Slider({Text = "Pickup Distance", Min = 10, Max = 1000,
				Default = tonumber(settings.agDist) or 1000, Decimals = 0,
				Display = function(value)
					value = tonumber(value) or 0
					return value >= 1000 and "в€ћ" or tostring(math.floor(value))
				end,
				Callback = function(value) settings.agDist = value end})
		end})
	local key = globals.__crackhubBindFromName(settings.grabKey)
	context.section:Keybind({Text = "Pick Up Gun", Default = key, Callback = function(value)
		key = value
		settings.grabKey = value and value.Name or ""
	end})
	context.connect(context.inputService.InputBegan, function(input)
		if not globals.__crackhubBindReady() or not globals.__crackhubBindHit(input, key) then return end
		if globals.__crackhubPickUpGun then pcall(globals.__crackhubPickUpGun) end
	end)
end

local AimCalibration = {}

function AimCalibration.create()
	local state = {alive = true, conns = {}, D = 0.18, J = 0.12, L = 0.15, Lsd = 0.045, Lnr = 0.14, Lnrsd = 0.05,
		pingCal = 0.05, echo = 0.07, k = 1, cooldown = 3.2, cdFloor = 2.6, hist = {}, others = {},
		err = {md = 0.6, cv = 1.2, mdE = 0.8, mdL = 0.8, fly = 1.4, mdv = 1.4, arc = 1.4, stop = 2,
			half = 1.5, res = 0.25, arc3 = 0.8, airStop = 0.6, airRev = 0.6},
		log = {}, stats = {fired = 0, hit = 0, miss = 0}, file = "CrackHub/aimx_state.json",
		lastAccepted = 0, minAuto = 0.9, minManual = 0.2, pca3 = true, lagRef = 0.12, lagDB = {}, lagPool = {},
		shift = 0, useLagJ = true, useLagL = false, airV2 = true, colFirst = true, airLag = true, airT = 0.07,
		tauGridMin = -0.05, tauGridStep = 0.01, tauGridN = 51}
	state.shiftJ = function() return state.useLagJ and state.shift or 0 end
	state.shiftL = function() return state.useLagL and state.shift or 0 end
	return state
end

function AimCalibration.load(context, state)
	pcall(function()
		local environment = context.environment
		if not environment.isfile or not environment.isfile(state.file) then return end
		local saved = context.http:JSONDecode(environment.readfile(state.file))
		if type(saved) ~= "table" then return end
		local calibrated = tonumber(saved.pingCal) ~= nil
		if calibrated and tonumber(saved.L) then state.L = math.clamp(tonumber(saved.L), -0.1, 0.45) end
		if calibrated and tonumber(saved.Lsd) then state.Lsd = math.clamp(tonumber(saved.Lsd), 0.035, 0.12) end
		if tonumber(saved.D) then state.D = math.clamp(tonumber(saved.D), 0.06, 0.32) end
		if tonumber(saved.vsLock) == 1 or tonumber(saved.vsLock) == -1 then state.vsLock = tonumber(saved.vsLock) end
		if tonumber(saved.cooldown) then state.cooldown = math.min(math.clamp(tonumber(saved.cooldown), state.cdFloor, 6), 3.2) end
		if calibrated and tonumber(saved.hits) then state.calib = tonumber(saved.hits) end
		if tonumber(saved.Lnr) then state.Lnr = math.clamp(tonumber(saved.Lnr), 0, 0.5) end
		if tonumber(saved.Lnrsd) then state.Lnrsd = math.clamp(tonumber(saved.Lnrsd), 0.03, 0.12) end
		if tonumber(saved.nrHits) then state.nrCalib = tonumber(saved.nrHits) end
		if type(saved.skipT) == "boolean" then state.skipTransparent = saved.skipT end
		if type(saved.backpack) == "boolean" then state.backpackOk = saved.backpack end
		if tonumber(saved.pingCal) then state.pingCal = math.clamp(tonumber(saved.pingCal), 0, 1) end
		if tonumber(saved.lag) then state.lagPrior = math.clamp(tonumber(saved.lag), 0.04, 0.45) end
		if calibrated and type(saved.tauLog) == "table" and #saved.tauLog == state.tauGridN then
			state.tauLog = {}
			for index, value in saved.tauLog do state.tauLog[index] = (tonumber(value) or 0) * 0.5 end
			state.tauShots = tonumber(saved.tauShots) or 0
		end
	end)
end

AimCalibration.save = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(context, state)
	pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local environment = context.environment
		if not environment.writefile then return end
		if environment.isfolder and environment.makefolder and not environment.isfolder("CrackHub") then environment.makefolder("CrackHub") end
		local data = {vsLock = state.vsLock, L = state.L, Lsd = state.Lsd, D = state.D, cooldown = state.cooldown,
			hits = state.calib or 0, skipT = state.skipTransparent, backpack = state.backpackOk, Lnr = state.Lnr,
			Lnrsd = state.Lnrsd, nrHits = state.nrCalib or 0, pingCal = state.pingCal, lag = state.lagPrior,
			tauLog = state.tauLog, tauShots = state.tauShots}
		environment.writefile(state.file, context.http:JSONEncode(data))
	end))
end)

AimCalibration.median = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(values)
	if #values == 0 then return nil end
	local sorted = table.clone(values)
	table.sort(sorted)
	local count = #sorted
	if count % 2 == 1 then return sorted[(count + 1) / 2] end
	return (sorted[count / 2] + sorted[count / 2 + 1]) * 0.5
end)

AimCalibration.watchLag = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(context, state, options)
	local player, character, root, humanoid, now = options.player, options.character, options.root, options.humanoid, options.time
	local entry = state.lagDB[player.UserId] or {js = {}}
	state.lagDB[player.UserId] = entry
	if entry.c ~= character then entry.c, entry.py, entry.ev = character, nil, nil end
	local status, height = humanoid:GetState(), root.Position.Y
	if entry.py then
		local event = entry.ev
		if event then
			if height <= event.ymin + 0.05 then
				if height < event.ymin then event.ymin = height end
				event.tmin = now
			end
			if height > event.ymin + 0.3 and height - entry.py > 0.25 then
				local lag = event.tmin - event.t0 + 0.008
				if lag > 0.04 and lag < 0.5 then
					table.insert(entry.js, lag)
					if #entry.js > 7 then table.remove(entry.js, 1) end
					table.insert(state.lagPool, lag)
					if #state.lagPool > 40 then table.remove(state.lagPool, 1) end
					state.lagVer, state.lagCount = (state.lagVer or 0) + 1, (state.lagCount or 0) + 1
					if state.lagCount % 8 == 0 and #state.lagPool >= 8 then
						state.lagPrior = AimCalibration.median(state.lagPool)
						AimCalibration.save(context, state)
					end
				end
				entry.ev = nil
			end
			if entry.ev and now - event.t0 > 0.6 then entry.ev = nil end
		end
		if not event and status == context.environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
			and entry.pst ~= context.environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
			entry.ev = {t0 = now, ymin = height, tmin = now}
		end
	end
	entry.py, entry.pst = height, status
end)

AimCalibration.lagOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(context, state, character)
	local player
	if character then
		local cached = state.lagCP
		if cached and state.lagCC == character and cached.Character == character and cached.Parent then player = cached end
		if not player then
			player = context.players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
			state.lagCC, state.lagCP = character, player
		end
	end
	local entry, version = player and state.lagDB[player.UserId], state.lagVer or 0
	local median
	if entry and #entry.js > 0 then
		if entry.medVer ~= version or entry.medN ~= #entry.js then
			entry.medVer, entry.medN, entry.med = version, #entry.js, AimCalibration.median(entry.js)
		end
		median = entry.med
	end
	local poolMedian
	if #state.lagPool >= 4 then
		if state.poolMedVer ~= version or state.poolMedN ~= #state.lagPool or state.poolMedT ~= state.lagPool then
			state.poolMedVer, state.poolMedN, state.poolMedT = version, #state.lagPool, state.lagPool
			state.poolMed = AimCalibration.median(state.lagPool)
		end
		poolMedian = state.poolMed
	end
	poolMedian = poolMedian or state.lagPrior
	local result
	if median and poolMedian then result = (median * #entry.js + poolMedian * 3) / (#entry.js + 3) end
	if not result then result = poolMedian or median and #entry.js >= 2 and median or nil end
	if not result then return 0 end
	return math.clamp(result - state.lagRef, -0.07, 0.25)
end)

AimCalibration.pingShift = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(context, state)
	if not state.pingCal then return 0 end
	local ok, ping = pcall(context.player.GetNetworkPing, context.player)
	if not ok or type(ping) ~= "number" then return 0 end
	return math.clamp(ping - state.pingCal, -0.06, 0.25)
end)

AimCalibration.taus = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(context, state, mode, airborne, scale)
	local mean, deviation = state.L, state.Lsd
	if mode == "nr" then mean, deviation = state.Lnr, state.Lnrsd end
	mean += AimCalibration.pingShift(context, state) + (state.useLagL and state.shift or 0)
	deviation *= scale or (airborne and (state.tauSdKAir or 2.5) or (state.tauSdK or 4))
	local count, step, samples, total = state.tauN or 3, state.tauStep or 0.75, {}, 0
	for index = -count, count do
		local time = mean + index * deviation * step
		if state.tauClamp == true and time <= -0.15 then time = -0.149 + (index + count) * 0.001 end
		if time <= -0.15 then continue end
		local weight = math.exp(-0.5 * (index * step) ^ 2)
		table.insert(samples, {tau = time, w = weight})
		if index == 0 then samples.mid = #samples end
		total += weight
	end
	for _, sample in ipairs(samples) do sample.w /= total end
	return samples
end)

function AimCalibration.shotTrajectory(shot)
	local samples = {}
	for _, sample in shot.pre or {} do table.insert(samples, sample) end
	local last = samples[#samples] and samples[#samples].t or -math.huge
	for _, sample in shot.post or {} do
		if sample.t <= last then continue end
		table.insert(samples, sample)
		last = sample.t
	end
	return samples
end

function AimCalibration.tauInit(state)
	if type(state.tauLog) == "table" and #state.tauLog == state.tauGridN then return end
	state.tauLog = {}
	local mean, deviation = state.L, math.max(state.Lsd * 1.5, 0.05)
	for index = 1, state.tauGridN do
		local tau = state.tauGridMin + (index - 1) * state.tauGridStep
		state.tauLog[index] = -0.5 * ((tau - mean) / deviation) ^ 2
	end
end

function AimCalibration.tauApply(state)
	local prior, weighted, maximum = 0.12 + (state.pingCal or 0.05), {}, -math.huge
	for index, value in state.tauLog do
		local tau = state.tauGridMin + (index - 1) * state.tauGridStep
		weighted[index] = value - 0.5 * ((tau - prior) / 0.05) ^ 2
		maximum = math.max(maximum, weighted[index])
	end
	local probabilities, total = {}, 0
	for index, value in weighted do
		probabilities[index] = math.exp(value - maximum)
		total += probabilities[index]
	end
	local mean, cumulative, median = 0, 0, nil
	for index = 1, state.tauGridN do
		local tau = state.tauGridMin + (index - 1) * state.tauGridStep
		mean += tau * probabilities[index] / total
		cumulative += probabilities[index] / total
		if not median and cumulative >= 0.5 then median = tau end
	end
	local variance = 0
	for index = 1, state.tauGridN do
		local tau = state.tauGridMin + (index - 1) * state.tauGridStep
		variance += (tau - mean) ^ 2 * probabilities[index] / total
	end
	state.L = math.clamp(median or mean, -0.05, 0.45)
	state.Lsd = math.clamp(math.sqrt(variance), 0.035, 0.09)
end

function AimCalibration.tauEvidence(context, state, shot, hit, endpoint)
	if shot.mode == "nr" or not shot.body or shot.offLine then return nil end
	local trajectory = AimCalibration.shotTrajectory(shot)
	if #trajectory < 6 then return nil end
	AimCalibration.tauInit(state)
	local path = shot.e - shot.o
	local direction, rayLength, limit = path.Unit, path.Magnitude + 400, math.huge
	if not hit and context.environment.typeof(endpoint) == "Vector3" then limit = (endpoint - shot.o).Magnitude + 0.5 end
	local first, last = trajectory[1].t, trajectory[#trajectory].t
	local shift = (shot.pingS or 0) + (shot.shift or 0)
	local low, high
	for index = 1, state.tauGridN do
		local tau = state.tauGridMin + (index - 1) * state.tauGridStep
		local time, probability = shot.t + tau + shift, nil
		if time < first or time > last then probability = hit and 0.6 or 1 end
		if time >= first and time <= last then
			local position = state.posAt(trajectory, time)
			local collision, core = state.hitsBody(shot.body, position, shot.o, direction, rayLength)
			local beforeLimit = collision ~= nil and collision < limit
			if hit then probability = beforeLimit and 1 or 0.1 end
			if not hit then probability = core and core < limit and (state.missCoreLike or 0.3) or (beforeLimit and (state.missLike or 0.7) or 1) end
			if beforeLimit then low, high = low or tau, tau end
		end
		state.tauLog[index] = state.tauLog[index] * 0.97 + math.log(probability)
	end
	AimCalibration.tauApply(state)
	state.tauShots = (state.tauShots or 0) + 1
	return low, high
end

local AimGeometry = {}
local AIM_AXES = {"X", "Y", "Z"}

AimGeometry.at = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(samples, time)
	local count = #samples
	if count == 0 then return nil end
	if time >= samples[count].t then return samples[count], count end
	if time <= samples[1].t then return samples[1], 1 end
	local low, high = 1, count
	while low < high do
		local middle = math.floor((low + high + 1) / 2)
		if samples[middle].t <= time then low = middle end
		if samples[middle].t > time then high = middle - 1 end
	end
	return samples[low], low
end)

AimGeometry.posAt = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(samples, time)
	local sample, index = AimGeometry.at(samples, time)
	if not sample then return nil end
	local nextSample = samples[index + 1]
	if not nextSample or time <= sample.t then return sample.p end
	local alpha = math.clamp((time - sample.t) / math.max(0.0001, nextSample.t - sample.t), 0, 1)
	return sample.p:Lerp(nextSample.p, alpha)
end)

AimGeometry.kinVelocity = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, samples, time, period)
	period = period or 0.1
	if #samples < 2 or time - period < samples[1].t then return nil end
	local current, previous = AimGeometry.posAt(samples, time), AimGeometry.posAt(samples, time - period)
	if not current or not previous then return nil end
	local average = (current - previous) / period
	local midpoint = AimGeometry.posAt(samples, time - period * 0.5)
	local recent = midpoint and (current - midpoint) / (period * 0.5) or average
	if (average - recent).Magnitude < 0.35 * math.max(average.Magnitude, recent.Magnitude) + 3 then
		return recent.Magnitude < 400 and recent or environment.Vector3.zero
	end
	local point = AimGeometry.posAt(samples, time - 0.025)
	local velocity = point and (current - point) / 0.025 or environment.Vector3.zero
	if velocity.Magnitude > 300 then return environment.Vector3.zero end
	return velocity
end)

AimGeometry.slab = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(options)
	local near, far = -math.huge, options.distance
	local origin, direction, half = options.origin, options.direction, options.half
	for _, axis in AIM_AXES do
		local position, velocity, radius = origin[axis], direction[axis], half[axis]
		if math.abs(velocity) < 1e-9 then
			if math.abs(position) > radius then return nil end
			continue
		end
		local first, last = (-radius - position) / velocity, (radius - position) / velocity
		if first > last then first, last = last, first end
		near, far = math.max(near, first), math.min(far, last)
		if near > far then return nil end
	end
	if near <= 0 then return nil end
	return near
end)

AimGeometry.rayBox = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(options)
	return AimGeometry.slab({origin = options.frame:PointToObjectSpace(options.origin),
		direction = options.frame:VectorToObjectSpace(options.direction), half = options.half, distance = options.distance})
end)

AimGeometry.bodyModel = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, character, fullSize)
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return nil end
	local candidates = {}
	for _, child in character:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(candidates, child); continue end
		if not (child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("Tool")) then continue end
		local handle = child:FindFirstChild("Handle")
		if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") and handle.Size.Magnitude < 7 then table.insert(candidates, handle) end
	end
	local vector, frame = environment.Vector3, environment.CFrame
	local parts, detached, radius = {}, {}, 0
	local low = vector.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	local high = vector.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
	for _, part in candidates do
		if not part.CanQuery then continue end
		local relative = root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
		local core = part == root or part.Name == "UpperTorso" or part.Name == "LowerTorso" or part.Name == "Torso" or part.Name == "Head"
		local half = part.Size * ((core or fullSize) and 0.5 or 0.43)
		if relative.Position.Magnitude > 7 then
			table.insert(detached, {cf = part.CFrame, half = half})
			continue
		end
		table.insert(parts, {rel = relative, half = half, core = core})
		for _, x in {-1, 1} do
			for _, y in {-1, 1} do
				for _, z in {-1, 1} do
					local point = relative * vector.new(half.X * x, half.Y * y, half.Z * z)
					low = vector.new(math.min(low.X, point.X), math.min(low.Y, point.Y), math.min(low.Z, point.Z))
					high = vector.new(math.max(high.X, point.X), math.max(high.Y, point.Y), math.max(high.Z, point.Z))
					radius = math.max(radius, point.Magnitude)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if #parts == 0 and #detached == 0 then return nil end
	table.sort(parts, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(first, second) return first.core and not second.core end))
	local coreCount = 0
	for _, part in parts do if part.core then coreCount += 1 end end
	local body = {parts = parts, detached = detached, rot = root.CFrame - root.CFrame.Position, rad = radius + 0.05, nCore = coreCount}
	if #parts > 0 then body.bcf, body.bhalf = frame.new((low + high) * 0.5), (high - low) * 0.5 end
	return body
end)

AimGeometry.hitsBody = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, options)
	local body, position, origin, direction, distance = options.body, options.position, options.origin, options.direction, options.distance
	local parts = body.parts
	if #parts == 0 then return nil end
	local dx, dy, dz = origin.X - position.X, origin.Y - position.Y, origin.Z - position.Z
	if body.rad then
		local along = -(dx * direction.X + dy * direction.Y + dz * direction.Z)
		if along < -body.rad or along > distance + body.rad then return nil end
		if dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz - along * along > body.rad * body.rad then return nil end
	end
	if body.cd ~= direction then
		body.cd = direction
		body.cld = body.rot:VectorToObjectSpace(direction)
		for _, part in parts do part.ld = part.rel:VectorToObjectSpace(body.cld) end
	end
	local localOrigin = body.rot:VectorToObjectSpace(environment.Vector3.new(dx, dy, dz))
	if body.bcf then
		local center, half = body.bcf.Position, body.bhalf
		local relative = environment.Vector3.new(localOrigin.X - center.X, localOrigin.Y - center.Y, localOrigin.Z - center.Z)
		local padded = environment.Vector3.new(half.X + 0.01, half.Y + 0.01, half.Z + 0.01)
		local hit = AimGeometry.slab({origin = relative, direction = body.cld, half = padded, distance = distance})
		if not hit and (math.abs(relative.X) > half.X or math.abs(relative.Y) > half.Y or math.abs(relative.Z) > half.Z) then return nil end
	end
	local coreHit, nearest
	for index, part in parts do
		if index == (body.nCore or 0) + 1 and coreHit then return coreHit, coreHit end
		local point = part.rel:PointToObjectSpace(localOrigin)
		local hit = AimGeometry.slab({origin = point, direction = part.ld, half = part.half, distance = distance})
		if hit then
			nearest = nearest and math.min(nearest, hit) or hit
			if part.core then coreHit = coreHit and math.min(coreHit, hit) or hit end
		end
	end
	return nearest, coreHit
end)

AimGeometry.hitsDetached = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(body, origin, direction, distance)
	local nearest
	for _, part in body.detached do
		local hit = AimGeometry.rayBox({frame = part.cf, half = part.half, origin = origin, direction = direction, distance = distance})
		if hit then nearest = nearest and math.min(nearest, hit) or hit end
	end
	return nearest
end)

local AimMotion = {}

AimMotion.velocityFit = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, state, samples, time)
	local cache = state.vfCache
	if cache and cache.h == samples and cache.t == time and cache.n == #samples then return cache.deg, cache.mag end
	local lag, window = state.velLagFit or 0.16, state.velFitWin or 0.6
	local angles, speeds = {}, {}
	for index = #samples, 2, -2 do
		local sample = samples[index]
		if time - sample.t > window then break end
		if sample.t > time + 1e-6 or environment.typeof(sample.v) ~= "Vector3" then continue end
		local x, z = sample.v.X, sample.v.Z
		local speed = math.sqrt(x * x + z * z)
		if speed <= (state.velFitMinV or 30) or speed >= 400 then continue end
		local previous = AimGeometry.at(samples, sample.t - lag)
		local direction = previous and previous.md
		if not direction or direction.X * direction.X + direction.Z * direction.Z <= 0.25 then continue end
		local angle = (math.atan2(z, x) - math.atan2(direction.Z, direction.X) + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
		table.insert(angles, math.abs(angle))
		table.insert(speeds, speed / math.max(1, previous.ws or 16))
	end
	local degrees, magnitude
	if #angles >= (state.velFitNeed or 8) then
		degrees, magnitude = math.deg(AimCalibration.median(angles)), AimCalibration.median(speeds)
	end
	state.vfCache = {h = samples, t = time, n = #samples, deg = degrees, mag = magnitude}
	return degrees, magnitude
end)

AimMotion.speedFactor = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, state, samples)
	if #samples < 10 then return 1 end
	local time, ratios = samples[#samples].t, {}
	for index = #samples, 2, -3 do
		local sample = samples[index]
		if time - sample.t >= 1.5 then break end
		local past = sample.t - 0.2 >= samples[1].t and AimGeometry.posAt(samples, sample.t - 0.2) or nil
		local direction = AimGeometry.at(samples, sample.t - state.D)
		local previous = AimGeometry.at(samples, sample.t - state.D - 0.2)
		if not past or not direction or not previous or sample.air then continue end
		if direction.md.Magnitude <= 0.9 or previous.md.Magnitude <= 0.9 or direction.md:Dot(previous.md) <= 0.95 then continue end
		local velocity = (sample.p - past) / 0.2
		local speed = math.sqrt(velocity.X * velocity.X + velocity.Z * velocity.Z)
		local expected = direction.ws * direction.md.Magnitude
		if expected > 4 and speed > 2 then table.insert(ratios, speed / expected) end
	end
	local factor = #ratios >= 5 and math.clamp(AimCalibration.median(ratios), 0.4, 8) or 1
	if state.kFit == true then
		local degrees, magnitude = AimMotion.velocityFit(environment, state, samples, time)
		if degrees and magnitude and degrees < (state.velFitDeg or 25) and magnitude > math.max(state.kFitMin or 1.6, factor * 1.4) then
			factor = math.clamp(magnitude, 0.4, 8)
		end
	end
	return factor
end)

AimMotion.currentFactor = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, samples, time, factor)
	local weight = state.kLocW or 0
	if weight <= 0 then return factor end
	local window = state.kLocWin or 0.25
	local current, previous = AimGeometry.posAt(samples, time), AimGeometry.posAt(samples, time - window)
	if not current or not previous then return factor end
	local x, z = 0, 0
	for index = 0, 4 do
		local sample = AimGeometry.at(samples, time - window + (index + 0.5) * window / 5 - state.D)
		if not sample or sample.air then return factor end
		x += sample.md.X * sample.ws * window / 5
		z += sample.md.Z * sample.ws * window / 5
	end
	local expected = math.sqrt(x * x + z * z)
	if expected < (state.kLocMin or 1.5) then return factor end
	local actual = current - previous
	local ratio = math.sqrt(actual.X * actual.X + actual.Z * actual.Z) / expected
	if ratio >= factor * (state.kLocThr or 0.6) then return factor end
	return factor + (math.max(ratio, 0.15) - factor) * weight
end)

AimMotion.jumpTime = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, state, samples, time)
	local types, lead = environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType, state.jFlagLead or 0
	local flagged
	for index = #samples, 2, -1 do
		local sample, previous = samples[index], samples[index - 1]
		if time - sample.t >= 0.4 + state.shiftJ() then break end
		if flagged and flagged - sample.t > (state.jFlagWin or 0.15) then break end
		if sample.t > time then continue end
		if sample.jump and not previous.jump and not flagged then
			if lead <= 0 then return sample.t + state.J + state.shiftJ() - time end
			flagged = sample.t
		end
		if sample.st == types.Jumping and previous.st ~= types.Jumping and not previous.air then
			return sample.t + state.J + state.shiftJ() - time
		end
		if sample.st == types.Freefall and sample.jump and not previous.air
			and previous.st ~= types.Jumping and previous.st ~= types.Freefall then
			return sample.t + state.J + state.shiftJ() - time
		end
		if state.ffJump == true and sample.st == types.Freefall and not sample.air and not previous.air
			and (previous.st == types.Running or previous.st == types.RunningNoPhysics or previous.st == types.Landed) then
			return sample.t + state.J + state.shiftJ() - time
		end
	end
	if flagged then return flagged + state.J + state.shiftJ() - lead - time end
	return nil
end)

AimMotion.averageDirection = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, samples, time, window)
	local x, z, count = 0, 0, 0
	for index = #samples, 1, -1 do
		local sample = samples[index]
		if sample.t > time then continue end
		if time - sample.t > window then break end
		x, z, count = x + sample.md.X, z + sample.md.Z, count + 1
	end
	if count == 0 then return nil end
	return environment.Vector3.new(x / count, 0, z / count)
end)

AimMotion.directionTrust = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, state, samples, time)
	local total, count = 0, 0
	local vector, types = environment.Vector3, environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType
	for index = #samples, 2, -3 do
		local sample = samples[index]
		if time - sample.t > 0.6 then break end
		local before, after = AimGeometry.posAt(samples, sample.t - 0.3), AimGeometry.posAt(samples, sample.t)
		local expected = AimGeometry.at(samples, sample.t - state.D)
		if not before or not after or not expected or sample.t - 0.3 < samples[1].t then continue end
		local velocity = (after - before) / 0.3
		local actual = vector.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
		local direction = vector.new(expected.md.X, 0, expected.md.Z)
		local speed, magnitude, score = actual.Magnitude, direction.Magnitude, nil
		if speed > 6 and magnitude > 0.5 then score = actual.Unit:Dot(direction.Unit) end
		if speed > 6 and magnitude <= 0.1 and not sample.air then score = -0.3 end
		if speed > 6 and magnitude <= 0.1 and sample.air and (sample.st == types.PlatformStanding or sample.st == types.Physics) then score = -0.5 end
		if speed < 1 and magnitude > 0.5 and not sample.air then score = -0.3 end
		if speed < 1 and magnitude <= 0.5 then score = 1 end
		if score then total, count = total + score, count + 1 end
	end
	if count < 6 then return 1 end
	return math.clamp((total / count - 0.15) / 0.6, 0, 1)
end)

AimMotion.estimateDelay = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, state, samples, time)
	if #samples < 30 or time - samples[1].t < 1.5 then return nil end
	local vector = environment.Vector3
	local velocities, times, moving = {}, {}, 0
	local cursor = math.max(samples[1].t + 0.45, time - 2)
	while cursor <= time - 0.05 do
		local before, after = AimGeometry.posAt(samples, cursor - 0.05), AimGeometry.posAt(samples, cursor + 0.05)
		if before and after then
			local velocity = (after - before) / 0.1
			velocity = vector.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
			table.insert(velocities, velocity)
			table.insert(times, cursor)
			if velocity.Magnitude > 3 then moving += 1 end
		end
		cursor += 0.05
	end
	if moving < 6 then return nil end
	local factor, current = state.k or 1, state.D
	local best, bestError, currentError
	for index = 0, 17 do
		local delay, error = 0.05 + index * 0.02, 0
		for sampleIndex, at in times do
			local sample = AimGeometry.at(samples, at - delay)
			if not sample then continue end
			local expected = vector.new(sample.md.X, 0, sample.md.Z) * (sample.ws * factor)
			error += math.min((velocities[sampleIndex] - expected).Magnitude, 20) ^ 2
		end
		if not bestError or error < bestError then best, bestError = delay, error end
		if math.abs(delay - current) < 0.011 then currentError = error end
	end
	return best, bestError, currentError
end)

AimMotion.clusters = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, state, samples, time)
	local positions = {}
	for index = #samples, 1, -1 do
		if time - samples[index].t > 0.6 then break end
		table.insert(positions, samples[index].p)
	end
	if #positions < 8 then return nil end
	local jumps, reversals, previous = 0, 0, nil
	for index = 2, #positions do
		local delta = positions[index] - positions[index - 1]
		if delta.Magnitude <= 8 then continue end
		jumps += 1
		if previous and delta:Dot(previous) < -0.3 * delta.Magnitude * previous.Magnitude then reversals += 1 end
		previous = delta
	end
	if jumps < 3 or state.clusterRev and reversals < state.clusterRev then return nil end
	local first, second = positions[1], positions[1]
	for _, position in positions do
		if (position - first).Magnitude > (second - first).Magnitude then second = position end
	end
	for _ = 1, 6 do
		local sumFirst, countFirst, sumSecond, countSecond = environment.Vector3.zero, 0, environment.Vector3.zero, 0
		for _, position in positions do
			if (position - first).Magnitude <= (position - second).Magnitude then
				sumFirst, countFirst = sumFirst + position, countFirst + 1
				continue
			end
			sumSecond, countSecond = sumSecond + position, countSecond + 1
		end
		if countFirst > 0 then first = sumFirst / countFirst end
		if countSecond > 0 then second = sumSecond / countSecond end
		state.clusterW = {countFirst / #positions, countSecond / #positions}
	end
	return {{p = first, w = state.clusterW[1]}, {p = second, w = state.clusterW[2]}}
end)

AimMotion.oscillation = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, state, samples, time)
	local positions = {}
	for index = #samples, 1, -1 do
		local sample = samples[index]
		if sample.t > time then continue end
		if time - sample.t > 0.45 then break end
		table.insert(positions, sample.p)
	end
	if #positions < 8 then return nil end
	local vector, horizontal = environment.Vector3, state.oscXZ ~= false
	local length, low, high = 0, positions[1], positions[1]
	for index = 2, #positions do
		local delta, position = positions[index] - positions[index - 1], positions[index]
		if horizontal then delta = vector.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z) end
		length += delta.Magnitude
		low = vector.new(math.min(low.X, position.X), math.min(low.Y, position.Y), math.min(low.Z, position.Z))
		high = vector.new(math.max(high.X, position.X), math.max(high.Y, position.Y), math.max(high.Z, position.Z))
	end
	local displacement, range = positions[1] - positions[#positions], high - low
	if horizontal then displacement, range = vector.new(displacement.X, 0, displacement.Z), vector.new(range.X, 0, range.Z) end
	if length <= displacement.Magnitude * 3 + 6 or range.Magnitude <= 2.5 or range.Magnitude >= 12 then return nil end
	if state.oscMinRev then
		local segment, previous, reversals = state.oscSeg or 3, nil, 0
		for index = 1, #positions - segment, segment do
			local delta = positions[index] - positions[index + segment]
			if horizontal then delta = vector.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z) end
			if delta.Magnitude <= 0.3 then continue end
			if previous and delta:Dot(previous) < -0.3 * delta.Magnitude * previous.Magnitude then reversals += 1 end
			previous = delta
		end
		if reversals < state.oscMinRev then return nil end
	end
	local result = {}
	for index = 1, #positions, math.max(1, math.floor(#positions / 8)) do table.insert(result, positions[index]) end
	return result
end)

AimMotion.repeatTrajectory = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(samples, time, period, duration)
	local current, previous = AimGeometry.posAt(samples, time), AimGeometry.posAt(samples, time - period)
	if not current or not previous or time - period < samples[1].t then return nil end
	local offset, trajectory, count = current - previous, {}, math.max(2, math.ceil(duration * 60))
	for index = 0, count do
		local elapsed = duration * index / count
		local at = time + elapsed - period
		while at > time do at -= period end
		table.insert(trajectory, {tau = elapsed, p = AimGeometry.posAt(samples, at) + offset})
	end
	return trajectory
end)

function AimMotion.findRepeat(environment, state, samples, time)
	if #samples < 30 then return nil end
	local window, minimum = state.repWin or 1, state.repTMin or 0.25
	local maximum = math.min(state.repTMax or 1.6, time - samples[1].t - window)
	if maximum < minimum + 0.05 then return nil end
	local positions, mean = {}, environment.Vector3.zero
	for index = 0, 15 do
		positions[index] = AimGeometry.posAt(samples, time - index * window / 16)
		mean += positions[index]
	end
	mean /= 16
	local variance = 0
	for index = 0, 15 do
		local delta = positions[index] - mean
		variance += delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z
	end
	local amplitude = math.sqrt(variance / 16)
	if amplitude < (state.repAmp or 1.5) then return nil end
	local function errorFor(period)
		local error = 0
		for index = 0, 15 do
			local delta = positions[index] - AimGeometry.posAt(samples, time - index * window / 16 - period)
			error += delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z + delta.Y * delta.Y * 0.2
		end
		return math.sqrt(error / 16)
	end
	local periods, cursor = {}, minimum
	while cursor <= maximum do table.insert(periods, cursor); cursor += 1 / 30 end
	local best, bestError
	for _, period in periods do
		local error = errorFor(period)
		if not bestError or error < bestError then best, bestError = period, error end
	end
	for _, offset in {-1 / 60, 1 / 60} do
		local period = best + offset
		if period < minimum or period > maximum then continue end
		local error = errorFor(period)
		if error < bestError then best, bestError = period, error end
	end
	return best, bestError, amplitude
end

AimMotion.accelerationFit = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, state, samples, time, window)
	local sums = {{0, 0, 0}, {0, 0, 0}, {0, 0, 0}}
	local count, sumT, sumHalfT2, sumT2, sumT3, sumT4 = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	for index = #samples, 1, -1 do
		local sample = samples[index]
		if sample.t > time then continue end
		local t = sample.t - time
		if t < -window then break end
		local halfT2 = 0.5 * t * t
		count, sumT, sumHalfT2 = count + 1, sumT + t, sumHalfT2 + halfT2
		sumT2, sumT3, sumT4 = sumT2 + t * t, sumT3 + t * halfT2, sumT4 + halfT2 * halfT2
		for axis, value in {sample.p.X, sample.p.Y, sample.p.Z} do
			sums[axis][1] += value
			sums[axis][2] += value * t
			sums[axis][3] += value * halfT2
		end
	end
	if count < (state.caMinN or 6) then return nil end
	local determinant = count * (sumT2 * sumT4 - sumT3 * sumT3)
		- sumT * (sumT * sumT4 - sumT3 * sumHalfT2) + sumHalfT2 * (sumT * sumT3 - sumT2 * sumHalfT2)
	if math.abs(determinant) < 1e-12 then return nil end
	local solve; solve = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(values)
		local a, b, c = values[1], values[2], values[3]
		local position = a * (sumT2 * sumT4 - sumT3 * sumT3) - sumT * (b * sumT4 - sumT3 * c)
			+ sumHalfT2 * (b * sumT3 - sumT2 * c)
		local velocity = count * (b * sumT4 - sumT3 * c) - a * (sumT * sumT4 - sumT3 * sumHalfT2)
			+ sumHalfT2 * (sumT * c - b * sumHalfT2)
		local acceleration = count * (sumT2 * c - b * sumT3) - sumT * (sumT * c - b * sumHalfT2)
			+ a * (sumT * sumT3 - sumT2 * sumHalfT2)
		return position / determinant, velocity / determinant, acceleration / determinant
	end)
	local px, vx, ax = solve(sums[1])
	local py, vy, ay = solve(sums[2])
	local pz, vz, az = solve(sums[3])
	local vector = environment.Vector3
	local acceleration = vector.new(ax, ay, az)
	if acceleration.Magnitude > (state.caAmax or 900) then acceleration = acceleration.Unit * (state.caAmax or 900) end
	return vector.new(px, py, pz), vector.new(vx, vy, vz), acceleration
end)

AimMotion.accelerationTrajectory = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(context, state, samples, time, duration)
	local position, velocity, acceleration = AimMotion.accelerationFit(context.environment, state, samples, time, state.caWin or 0.17)
	if not position then return nil end
	local trajectory, elapsed = {{tau = 0, p = position}}, 0
	while elapsed < duration do
		elapsed += 1 / 60
		table.insert(trajectory, {tau = elapsed, p = position + velocity * elapsed + acceleration * (0.5 * elapsed * elapsed)})
	end
	return trajectory
end)

AimMotion.arcTrajectory = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, samples, time, duration)
	local current, previous = AimGeometry.kinVelocity(environment, samples, time, 0.06), AimGeometry.kinVelocity(environment, samples, time - 0.07, 0.06)
	if not current or not previous or current.Magnitude < 8 or previous.Magnitude < 8 then return nil end
	local cross = previous:Cross(current)
	local sine = cross.Magnitude / (previous.Magnitude * current.Magnitude)
	local cosine = previous.Unit:Dot(current.Unit)
	local turn = math.clamp(math.atan2(sine, cosine) / 0.07, -8, 8)
