			if not weapons then return end
			local saved = globals.__crackhubAimWS
			if saved and weapons.GetTargetPosition == saved.tgt and weapons.GetMouseTargetCFrame == saved.mouse then pointInstalled = true; return end
			local oldMouse, oldTarget = weapons.GetMouseTargetCFrame, weapons.GetTargetPosition
			local function position()
				if globals.__crackhubAim and globals.__crackhubAim.bypass then return nil end
				if not settings.silentAim and settings.aimType ~= "Flick Shot" then return nil end
				local own = context.player.Character
				if not own or not own:FindFirstChild("Gun") then return nil end
				local part = targetPart()
				if not part or globals.__crackhubFovOK and not globals.__crackhubFovOK(part.Parent) then return nil end
				return part.Position
			end
			local function mouse(self, ...)
				local point = position()
				if point then return environment.CFrame.new(point) end
				return oldMouse(self, ...)
			end
			local function target(self, ...)
				local point = position()
				if point then return environment.CFrame.new(point) end
				return oldTarget(self, ...)
			end
			weapons.GetMouseTargetCFrame, weapons.GetTargetPosition = mouse, target
			if weapons.GetMouseTargetCFrame == mouse and weapons.GetTargetPosition == target then
				globals.__crackhubAimWS, pointInstalled = {mouse = mouse, tgt = target, origMouse = oldMouse, origTarget = oldTarget}, true
			end
		end)
		return pointInstalled
	end
	aim.installAimPointHook = installPointHook
	globals.__crackhubAimGen = (globals.__crackhubAimGen or 0) + 1
	local generation, hooked, notifiedLimited, notifiedMissing = globals.__crackhubAimGen, false, false, false
	globals.__crackhubHookCapOK = function()
		if type(environment.newcclosure) ~= "function" then return false end
		local original = function(value) return value end
		local ok, wrapper = pcall(environment.newcclosure, original)
		if not ok or type(wrapper) ~= "function" or wrapper == original then return false end
		local success, slow = pcall(function()
			local started = environment.os.clock()
			for index = 1, 3000 do wrapper(index) end
			return environment.os.clock() - started > 0.15
		end)
		return not (success and slow)
	end
	local function installNamecall()
		if hooked then return true end
		if type(environment.hookmetamethod) ~= "function" or type(environment.getnamecallmethod) ~= "function"
			or type(environment.newcclosure) ~= "function" or not globals.__crackhubHookCapOK() then return false end
		local original
		local intercept; intercept = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(remote, ...)
			local ok, method = pcall(environment.getnamecallmethod)
			local current = globals.__crackhubAim
			if not ok or method ~= "FireServer" or not current or not current.on or current.bypass or globals.__crackhubAimGen ~= generation then
				return original(remote, ...)
			end
			if environment.checkcaller then
				local success, caller = pcall(environment.checkcaller)
				if success and caller then return original(remote, ...) end
			end
			local handled = false
			pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
				if remote.Name == "Shoot" and remote.Parent and remote.Parent.Name == "Gun" and current.fire then handled = current.fire(remote) end
			end))
			if handled then return end
			return original(remote, ...)
		end)
		local ok = pcall(function() original = environment.hookmetamethod(environment.__hostGame or environment.game, "__namecall", environment.newcclosure(intercept)) end)
		hooked = hooked or ok
		return hooked
	end
	local function notify(message)
		pcall(function() environment.game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "CrackHub", Text = message, Duration = 7}) end)
	end
	aim.installHook = function()
		if installNamecall() then return true end
		if installPointHook() then
			if not notifiedLimited then notifiedLimited = true; notify("Silent Aim: limited mode (V2 only, no Wallbang)") end
			return true
		end
		if not notifiedMissing then notifiedMissing = true; notify("Silent Aim: executor has no hooks. Use Auto Shoot.") end
		return false
	end
	if settings.silentAim then aim.installHook() end
end

function SheriffRuntime.install(context)
	local environment, settings = context.environment, context.configuration.sheriff
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	local allowed; allowed = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(character) if context.singleShot and context.singleShot.target == character then return true end; return FovTarget.isInside({configuration = context.configuration, workspace = context.workspace}, character) end)
    local shoot; shoot = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(character, manual)
        if not character or not allowed(character) then return end
        if context.singleShot and context.singleShot.target == character then
            local private = table.clone(context)
            private.configuration = table.clone(context.configuration)
            private.configuration.sheriff = table.clone(settings)
            private.configuration.sheriff.wallbang = true
            private.oneShotBypassMuzzle = true
            local original = context.aim
            local shot = setmetatable({}, {__index = original, __newindex = original})
            rawset(shot, "plan", function(target, sight) return AimPlan.plan(private, original, target, sight) end)
            rawset(shot, "send", function(plan, target, reason, time) return AimEngine.send(private, original, plan, target, reason, time) end)
            return AimEngine.fireFor(private, shot, character, false, false)
        end
        if settings.aimType == "Flick Shot" then environment.task.spawn(SheriffRuntime.flick, context, character, manual); return end
        return context.aim.fireFor(character, manual, not settings.wallbang)
    end)

    -- Shot Murder (bind): standalone, you never move. Equips the gun and kills the murderer.
    -- While the bind shot runs, your Wallbang is on for it (silently, the Wallbang toggle itself is not changed).
    -- It does not go through Auto Shoot / FOV / score gates and turns nothing else on.
    local privateConfig; privateConfig = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local private = table.clone(context)
        private.configuration = table.clone(context.configuration)
        private.configuration.sheriff = table.clone(settings)
        private.configuration.sheriff.wallbang = true -- Wallbang on for the bind shot only, no notification
        private.oneShotBypassMuzzle = true
        return private
    end)
    local function pingOf()
        local ping = 0.1
        pcall(function() ping = math.clamp(context.player:GetNetworkPing(), 0.02, 0.5) end)
        return ping
    end
    local function alive(character)
        local hum = character and character.Parent and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
    end
    local say; say = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(text, kind)
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() CrackHub:Notify({Title = "Shot Murder", Content = text, Type = kind or "Info", Duration = 3}) end))
    end)

    local lastCall = 0
    globals.__crackhubShotMurder = function(lockedCharacter, returnTool, hideWeapon)
        local aim = context.aim
        if context.bindShot then return false end
        local callAt = environment.os.clock()
        if callAt - lastCall < 0.25 then return false end -- one key press = one call
        lastCall = callAt
        if not aim or not aim.alive or not context.isAlive() then say("Sheriff module is not running", "Error"); return false end
        local own = context.player.Character
        local backpack = context.player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        local humanoid = own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local ownRoot = own and own:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not own or not humanoid or not ownRoot or humanoid.Health <= 0 then say("You are not alive", "Warning"); return false end
        if not (own:FindFirstChild("Gun") or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun"))) then
            say("You need the gun (Sheriff or Hero)", "Warning")
            return false
        end
        local target
        if lockedCharacter then
            local player = context.players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(lockedCharacter)
            local role = player and context.roles()[player.Name]
            local roleName = player and (type(role) == "table" and role.Role or RoleData.infer(player))
            if not player or player.Character ~= lockedCharacter
                or not tostring(roleName):lower():find("murder", 1, true)
                or (type(role) == "table" and (role.Dead or role.Killed)) then return false end
            target = lockedCharacter
        else
            local _, murdererCharacter = SheriffRuntime.target(context)
            target = murdererCharacter
        end
        if not target or not alive(target) then say("No living murderer found", "Warning"); return false end
        local wasEquipped = own:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil
        context.bindShot = true
        environment.task.spawn(function()
            local clock = environment.os.clock
            local shots, accepted = 0, 0
            local restoreVisibility
            local ok, problem = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                if not wasEquipped then
                    local gun = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun")
                    if gun then
                        if hideWeapon then restoreVisibility = hideWeapon(gun, own) end
                        humanoid:EquipTool(gun)
                    end
                    local started = clock()
                    while not own:FindFirstChild("Gun") and clock() - started <= 1 do
                        environment.task.wait()
                    end
                    if not own:FindFirstChild("Gun") then say("Could not take the gun out", "Warning"); return end
                    if not lockedCharacter then environment.task.wait(0.1) end
                end
                local private = privateConfig()
                shots, accepted = AimEngine.runBind(private, aim, target, function()
                    return alive(target) and context.player.Character == own and own.Parent ~= nil
                        and humanoid.Health > 0 and own:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil
                end)
            end))
            if aim.forced == target then aim.forced = nil end
            context.singleShot = nil
            if not wasEquipped and own.Parent and own:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
                pcall(function()
                    humanoid:UnequipTools()
                    if returnTool and backpack and returnTool.Parent == backpack
                        and context.player.Character == own and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                        humanoid:EquipTool(returnTool)
                    end
                end)
            end
            if restoreVisibility then restoreVisibility() end
            context.bindShot = nil
            if not ok then
                warn("[CrackHub Shot Murder] " .. tostring(problem))
                say("Error: " .. tostring(problem):sub(1, 120), "Error")
            elseif not alive(target) then
                say("Murderer killed", "Success")
            elseif shots == 0 then
                say("No reliable firing window: waiting for stable target data", "Warning")
            elseif accepted == 0 then
                say("The server ignored the shots (" .. shots .. " sent)", "Warning")
            else
                say("Murderer survived " .. accepted .. " shot(s)", "Warning")
            end
        end)
        return true
    end

    -- direct key listener as a backup, so the key works even if the keybind row did not pass the press on
    context.connect(context.inputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
        if processed or context.bindShot then return end
        local name = settings.shootKey
        if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return end
        if context.inputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if input.KeyCode.Name == name or input.UserInputType.Name == name then
            environment.task.defer(function()
                if not context.bindShot then pcall(globals.__crackhubShotMurder) end
            end)
        end
    end)
	context.connect(context.runService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local own = context.player.Character
		if context.bindShot or settings.aimType ~= "Universal" or not own or not own:FindFirstChild("Gun") then return end
		local _, character = SheriffRuntime.target(context)
		local target = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Head"))
		local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
		if target and camera then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame:Lerp(environment.CFrame.lookAt(camera.CFrame.Position, target.Position), 0.65) end)) end
	end))
    local lastAuto, lastEquip = 0, 0
    context.autoFireStep = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if context.bindShot then return end
        local aim, now = context.aim, environment.os.clock()
        local request = context.singleShot
        if request then
            if aim.stats.fired > request.fired or not request.target.Parent then
                context.singleShot, request = nil, nil
            elseif now >= request.expires then
                context.singleShot, request = nil, nil
                CrackHub:Notify({Title = "Shot Murder", Content = "Shot could not be made: check the target, FOV and gun reload", Type = "Warning", Duration = 4})
            end
        end
		if context.bindShot then return end
		if request then
			local targetHumanoid = request.target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not targetHumanoid or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then context.singleShot, request = nil, nil end
		end
		if request and request.readyAt and now < request.readyAt then return end
		local rapid = aim.alive and (aim.dsHot(aim.target) or aim.spHot(aim.target) or aim.spActive(aim.target))
		local interval = request and 0.12 or (rapid and (aim.dsGap or 0.04) or 0.2)
		if not (settings.autoShoot or request) or now - lastAuto <= interval or not SheriffRuntime.gun(context) then return end
		local player, character
		if request then
			-- the bind shot goes to the murderer it was requested for, no FOV / target re-pick
			player, character = true, request.target
		else
			player, character = SheriffRuntime.target(context)
		end
		if not player or not character then return end
		pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			if not allowed(character) then return end
			local own = context.player.Character
			local humanoid = own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not humanoid or not (humanoid.Health > 0) then return end
			if not own:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
				if now - lastEquip < 1 then return end
				if not settings.wallbang and not request then
					local head, root = own:FindFirstChild("Head"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if not head or not root then return end
					local parameters = environment.RaycastParams.new()
					parameters.FilterType, parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, {own, character}
					local hit = context.workspace:Raycast(head.Position, root.Position - head.Position, parameters)
					if hit and hit.Instance.Transparency < 0.9 then return end
				end
				local backpack = context.player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
				local gun = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun")
				if not gun then return end
				lastEquip = environment.os.clock()
				humanoid:EquipTool(gun)
				return
			end
			shoot(character, false)
		end))
		lastAuto = now
	end)
	context.connect(context.runService.Heartbeat, context.autoFireStep)
	SheriffRuntime.installHooks(context)
end
