local EspColor = {}
local ESP_ROLE_COLORS = {Murderer = "murdererColour", Sheriff = "sheriffColour", Hero = "heroColour", Innocent = "innocentColour"}

function EspColor.create(environment, settings)
	return {environment = environment, settings = settings, white = environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		black = environment.Color3.new(0, 0, 0)}
end

function EspColor.key(color)
	return math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5) * 65536 + math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5) * 256 + math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)
end

function EspColor.tone(state, color)
	local settings = state.settings
	local brightness, saturation = (settings.brightness or 100) / 100, (settings.saturation or 100) / 100
	if brightness == 1 and saturation == 1 then return color end
	if not state.tones or state.brightness ~= brightness or state.saturation ~= saturation then
		state.tones, state.brightness, state.saturation, state.count = {}, brightness, saturation, 0
	end

	local cache, key = state.tones, EspColor.key(color)
	if cache[key] then return cache[key] end
	local hue, sat, value = color:ToHSV()
	local adjusted = value * brightness
	local result = state.environment.Color3.fromHSV(hue, math.clamp(sat * saturation, 0, 1), math.clamp(adjusted, 0, 1))
	if adjusted > 1 then result = result:Lerp(state.white, math.clamp((adjusted - 1) * 0.6, 0, 0.6)) end
	state.count += 1
	if state.count > 4096 then state.tones = nil end
	cache[key] = result
	return result
end

function EspColor.ink(state, source, custom, color)
	if source == "Custom" then return EspColor.tone(state, custom or state.white) end
	if source == "White" then return EspColor.tone(state, state.white) end
	if source == "Light" then return color:Lerp(state.white, 0.45) end
	if source == "Dark" then return color:Lerp(state.black, 0.5) end
	return color
end

function EspColor.roleBase(state, role)
	return state.settings[ESP_ROLE_COLORS[role] or "noRoleColour"]
end

function EspColor.role(state, role)
	return EspColor.tone(state, EspColor.roleBase(state, role))
end

function EspColor.select(state, role, isVisible, distance)
	local settings, environment = state.settings, state.environment
	local color = EspColor.roleBase(state, role)
	if settings.colorMode == "Rainbow" then
		local hue = environment.os.clock() * 0.09 * (settings.rainbowSpeed or 1) % 1
		color = environment.Color3.fromHSV(hue, math.clamp((settings.rainbowSat or 65) / 100, 0, 1), 1)
	end
	if settings.colorMode == "Custom" then color = settings.customColour end
	if settings.colorMode == "Distance" then
		color = settings.nearColour:Lerp(settings.farColour, math.clamp((distance or 0) / math.max(settings.maxDist, 1), 0, 1))
	end
	if settings.colorMode == "Visibility" then color = isVisible and settings.seenColour or settings.hiddenColour end
	if settings.visCheck and settings.dimHidden and not isVisible and settings.hiddenStyle == "Grey" then color = settings.hiddenColour end
	return EspColor.tone(state, color)
end

function EspColor.cham(state, color)
	local brightness = (state.settings.chamsBright or 100) / 100
	if brightness > 1 then return color:Lerp(state.white, math.clamp((brightness - 1) * 0.6, 0, 0.6)) end
	if brightness < 1 then return color:Lerp(state.black, math.clamp(1 - brightness, 0, 0.85)) end
	return color
end

function EspColor.health(state, ratio)
	return state.settings.healthLow:Lerp(state.settings.healthHigh, math.clamp(ratio, 0, 1))
end

local EspChams = {}

function EspChams.materials(environment)
	local material = environment.Enum.Material
	return {
		Shaded = {material.SmoothPlastic, 1.02, 0.95, 0}, Glow = {material.Neon, 1.02, 0.7, 0},
		["Glow Outline"] = {material.Neon, 1.05, 0.3, 0}, Iridescent = {material.ForceField, 1.03, 0.9, 0},
		["Water Flow"] = {material.ForceField, 1.03, 0.9, 0}, Glossy = {material.SmoothPlastic, 1.02, 0.95, 0.65},
		Glass = {material.Glass, 1.03, 0.8, 0.25}, ForceField = {material.ForceField, 1.03, 0.95, 0},
		Gradient = {material.SmoothPlastic, 1.02, 0.85, 0}, Ghost = {material.SmoothPlastic, 1.03, 0.4, 0.15},
		Metallic = {material.Foil, 1.02, 0.95, 0.3}, Metal = {material.Metal, 1.02, 0.95, 0.15},
		Chrome = {material.SmoothPlastic, 1.02, 0.95, 0.55}, Crystal = {material.Glass, 1.04, 0.7, 0.5},
		Ice = {material.Ice, 1.03, 0.85, 0.25}, Lava = {material.CrackedLava, 1.02, 0.95, 0},
		Wireframe = {material.SmoothPlastic, 1.01, 1, 0},
	}
end

function EspChams.close(color, target)
	if math.abs(color.R - target.R) + math.abs(color.G - target.G) + math.abs(color.B - target.B) < 0.004 then return target end
	return color
end

function EspChams.targets(state, options)
	local settings = state.settings
	local role = EspColor.role(state.colors, options.role)
	local darkness = math.clamp((tonumber(settings.chamsHiddenDark) or 30) / 100, 0, 0.9)
	local fill = settings.chamsColour
	if not options.seen then fill = settings.chamsHidden end
	if settings.chamsRole then
		fill = role
		if not options.seen then fill = role:Lerp(state.colors.black, darkness) end
	end
	local edge = options.seen and settings.chamsEdge or settings.chamsEdgeHidden
	if settings.chamsRole and settings.chamsEdgeRole ~= false then
		edge = role:Lerp(state.colors.white, 0.25)
		if not options.seen then edge = role:Lerp(state.colors.black, darkness * 0.6) end
	end
	return fill, edge
end

function EspChams.animate(state, options, previous)
	local settings = state.settings
	local now = state.context.environment.os.clock()
	local fill, edge = EspChams.targets(state, options)
	local saved = previous or {fill = fill, edge = edge, seen = options.seen, flash = 0, born = now, at = now}
	local elapsed = math.clamp(now - saved.at, 0, 0.1)
	saved.at = now
	local blend = 1 - math.exp(-10 * elapsed)
	saved.fill = EspChams.close(saved.fill:Lerp(fill, blend), fill)
	saved.edge = EspChams.close(saved.edge:Lerp(edge, blend), edge)
	if options.seen and not saved.seen and settings.chamsFlash then saved.flash = 1 end
	saved.seen = options.seen
	saved.flash = math.max(0, saved.flash - elapsed * 2.2)

	local phase = settings.chamsAnim ~= "None" and 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(now * settings.chamsSpeed * math.pi * 2 + options.player.UserId % 89 * 0.41) or 0
	local fillFactor, edgeFactor, color = 1, 1, saved.fill
	if settings.chamsAnim == "Rhythm" then fillFactor = 0.45 + 0.55 * phase end
	if settings.chamsAnim == "Breathe" then edgeFactor = 0.3 + 0.7 * phase end
	if settings.chamsAnim == "Flow" then color = color:Lerp(settings.chamsFlow, phase) end
	if saved.flash > 0 then color = color:Lerp(state.colors.white, saved.flash * 0.55) end
	color = EspColor.cham(state.colors, color)
	return saved, {fill = color, edge = saved.edge, fillFactor = fillFactor, edgeFactor = edgeFactor,
		born = math.clamp((now - saved.born) / 0.35, 0, 1), now = now}
end

function EspChams.material(state, role)
	local settings = state.settings
	local name = settings.chamsMaterial
	if role == "Murderer" and settings.murdMat and settings.murdMat ~= "Same" then name = settings.murdMat end
	if (role == "Sheriff" or role == "Hero") and settings.sheriffMat and settings.sheriffMat ~= "Same" then name = settings.sheriffMat end
	local specification = state.chamsMaterials[name]
	if settings.chamsStyle == "Glow" then
		name = "Core"
		specification = {state.context.environment.Enum.Material.Neon, 1.02, 0.85, 0}
	end
	if not specification then return nil, nil, nil end
	local scale = math.clamp((settings.chamsShell or 100) / 100, 1, 1.4)
	if scale ~= 1 then
		return name .. "@" .. tostring(math.floor(scale * 100 + 0.5)),
			{specification[1], specification[2] * scale, specification[3], specification[4]}, name
	end
	return name, specification, name
end

function EspChams.plan(state, options, saved)
	local settings, environment = state.settings, state.context.environment
	local through = settings.chamsThrough
	if through and (settings.chamsRange or 60) < 300 then
		local root = options.character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		through = root ~= nil and (root.Position - options.cameraPosition).Magnitude <= (settings.chamsRange or 60)
	end
	local animation
	saved, animation = EspChams.animate(state, options, saved)
	local opacity = math.clamp(settings.chamsAlpha / 100, 0, 1)
	if settings.chamsStyle == "Outline" then opacity = 0 end
	if settings.chamsStyle == "Soft" then opacity *= 0.65 end
	local material, spec, kind = EspChams.material(state, options.role)
	local isGlow = settings.chamsStyle == "Glow"
	local showModel = (options.seen or through) and options.inView ~= false
	local modelColor = animation.fill
	if isGlow then modelColor = modelColor:Lerp(state.colors.white, 0.08) end
	if not isGlow and (kind == "Glow" or kind == "Glow Outline") then modelColor = modelColor:Lerp(state.colors.black, 0.42) end
	local modelAlpha = options.alpha * animation.born * animation.fillFactor
	if isGlow then modelAlpha *= math.clamp((settings.glowCore or 85) / 100, 0, 1) end

	local edge = animation.edge
	local edgeTransparency = settings.chamsOutline and 1 - options.alpha * animation.born * settings.chamsEdgeAlpha / 100 * animation.edgeFactor or 1
	if kind == "Glow Outline" then edge, edgeTransparency = animation.fill, 1 - options.alpha * animation.born * animation.edgeFactor end
	if isGlow then
		edge = animation.fill:Lerp(state.colors.white, 0.45)
		edgeTransparency = 1 - options.alpha * animation.born * 0.55 * animation.edgeFactor
	end
	local fillTransparency = material and 1 or EspBox.quantize(1 - math.clamp(opacity * animation.fillFactor + saved.flash * 0.35, 0, 1) * options.alpha * animation.born)
	edgeTransparency = EspBox.quantize(edgeTransparency)
	local haloStrength = math.clamp(settings.glowHalo / 100, 0, 1)
	local haloRhythm = 0.8 + 0.2 * math.sin(animation.now * 2.2 + options.player.UserId % 89 * 0.41)
	return saved, {
		through = through, fill = animation.fill, edge = edge, fillTransparency = fillTransparency,
		edgeTransparency = edgeTransparency, enabled = options.inView ~= false and not (fillTransparency >= 0.995 and edgeTransparency >= 0.995),
		material = material, specification = spec, showModel = showModel, modelColor = modelColor, modelAlpha = modelAlpha,
		showHalo = (isGlow or settings.chamsOverlay) and showModel and haloStrength * 0.44 >= 0.07 and (haloStrength >= 0.28 or (options.distance or 0) <= 110),
		haloAlpha = options.alpha * animation.born * haloStrength * haloRhythm * 2.2,
	}
end

local EspChamModel = {}

function EspChamModel.root(state)
	local environment, camera = state.context.environment, state.context.workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return nil end
	if state.modelFolder and state.modelFolder.Parent == camera then return state.modelFolder end
	if state.modelFolder then pcall(function() state.modelFolder:Destroy() end) end
	for _, object in camera:GetChildren() do
		if object.Name == "CrackHubESPModels" then pcall(function() object:Destroy() end) end
	end
	local folder = environment.Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name, folder.Parent = "CrackHubESPModels", camera
	state.modelFolder = folder
	return folder
end

function EspChamModel.pool(state, store, player)
	state.modelPool = state.modelPool or setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	state.modelPool[store] = state.modelPool[store] or {}
	local group = state.modelPool[store]
	group[player] = group[player] or {at = state.context.environment.os.clock(), items = {}}
	return group[player]
end

function EspChamModel.poolKey(part)
	local size = part.Size
	local key = part.Name .. "|" .. part.ClassName .. "|" .. string.format("%.3f,%.3f,%.3f", size.X, size.Y, size.Z)
	if part.ClassName == "MeshPart" then return key .. "|" .. tostring(part.MeshId) end
	local mesh = part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
	if not mesh then return key end
	local scale = mesh.Scale
	return key .. "|" .. tostring(mesh.MeshId) .. "|" .. mesh.MeshType.Name .. "|" .. string.format("%.3f,%.3f,%.3f", scale.X, scale.Y, scale.Z)
end

function EspChamModel.purge(state, player)
	for _, group in state.modelPool or {} do
		for owner, pool in group do
			if player and owner ~= player then continue end
			for _, items in pool.items do
				for _, item in items do pcall(function() item:Destroy() end) end
			end
			group[owner] = nil
		end
	end
end

function EspChamModel.sweep(state)
	local now = state.context.environment.os.clock()
	for _, group in state.modelPool or {} do
		for player, pool in group do
			if not (type(player) ~= "table" and player.Parent == nil or now - pool.at > 45) then continue end
			for _, items in pool.items do
				for _, item in items do pcall(function() item:Destroy() end) end
			end
			group[player] = nil
		end
	end
end

function EspChamModel.drop(state, store, player)
	local model = store[player]
	if not model then return end
	for _, connection in model.connections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
	local pool = model.kind ~= "Wireframe" and model.keys and EspChamModel.pool(state, store, player) or nil
	for index, clone in model.clones do
		local key = pool and model.keys[index]
		if not key or not clone.Parent then pcall(function() clone:Destroy() end); continue end
		pcall(function() clone.Transparency = 1 end)
		pool.items[key] = pool.items[key] or {}
		table.insert(pool.items[key], clone)
	end
	if pool then pool.at = state.context.environment.os.clock() end
	store[player] = nil
end

function EspChamModel.cloneable(part)
	if not part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then return false end
	if part.Transparency >= 0.95 or part.LocalTransparencyModifier >= 0.95 then return false end
	if part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer") then return false end
	local accessory = part:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accessory")
	if accessory and accessory:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer", true) then return false end
	return true
end

function EspChamModel.clone(state, source, specification, folder, pool)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local key = pool and EspChamModel.poolKey(source)
	local items = key and pool.items[key]
	local clone = items and table.remove(items)
	while clone and clone.Parent ~= folder do
		pcall(function() clone:Destroy() end)
		clone = table.remove(items)
	end
	local mesh, meshScale
	if clone then
		mesh = clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
		if mesh then
			local sourceMesh = source:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
			meshScale = sourceMesh and sourceMesh.Scale or mesh.Scale
		end
	end
	if not clone then
		local archivable = source.Archivable
		source.Archivable = true
		local ok, result = pcall(function() return source:Clone() end)
		source.Archivable = archivable
		if not ok or not result then return nil end
		clone = result
		if clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh") then
			for _, child in clone:GetChildren() do
				if child:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
					child.TextureId = ""
					mesh = child
					continue
				end
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		if not mesh then clone:ClearAllChildren() end
		if mesh then meshScale = mesh.Scale end
		if clone:IsA("MeshPart") then pcall(function() clone.TextureID = "" end) end
		clone.Name = "M"
	end

	local scale, size
	if mesh and mesh.MeshType == environment.Enum.MeshType.FileMesh then
		scale = meshScale * specification[2]
		mesh.Scale = scale
	end
	if not scale then
		size = source.Size * specification[2]
		clone.Size = size
	end
	clone.Anchored, clone.CanCollide, clone.CanQuery, clone.CanTouch, clone.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
	clone.Material, clone.Reflectance, clone.Transparency = specification[1], specification[4], 1
	if clone.Parent ~= folder then clone.Parent = folder end
	return {clone = clone, mesh = mesh and scale and mesh or nil, scale = scale, size = size, key = key}
end

function EspChamModel.build(state, character, material, specification, folder, pool)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local kind = tostring(material):match("^[^@]+")
	local model = {material = material, kind = kind, specification = specification, character = character,
		root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso"),
		sources = {}, clones = {}, sizes = {}, meshes = {}, scales = {}, cframes = {}, boxes = {}, keys = {}, scale = 1, connections = {}}
	if kind == "Wireframe" then pool = nil end
	for _, source in character:GetDescendants() do
		if not EspChamModel.cloneable(source) then continue end
		local result = EspChamModel.clone(state, source, specification, folder, pool)
		if not result then continue end
		local index = #model.clones + 1
		model.sources[index], model.clones[index], model.keys[index] = source, result.clone, result.key
		model.sizes[index], model.meshes[index], model.scales[index] = result.size, result.mesh, result.scale
		if kind == "Wireframe" and source.Parent == character and source.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			local outline = environment.Instance.new("SelectionBox")
			outline.Adornee, outline.LineThickness, outline.SurfaceTransparency, outline.Transparency = result.clone, 0.02, 1, 1
			outline.Parent, model.boxes[index] = result.clone, outline
		end
	end
	local function dirty(object)
		if (object:IsA("BasePart") or object:IsA("Accessory") or object:IsA("WrapLayer") or object:IsA("SpecialMesh")) and not model.dirty then
			model.dirty = environment.os.clock()
		end
	end
	table.insert(model.connections, character.DescendantAdded:Connect(dirty))
	table.insert(model.connections, character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(dirty))
	return model
end

EspChamModel.resize = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(model, scale)
	model.scale = scale
	for index, clone in model.clones do
		local mesh = model.meshes[index]
		if mesh then mesh.Scale = model.scales[index] * scale end
		if not mesh then clone.Size = model.sizes[index] * scale end
	end
	for _, box in model.boxes do box.LineThickness = 0.02 * scale end
end)

function EspChamModel.paint(state, model, color, transparency, now)
	local settings, environment = state.settings, state.context.environment
	local rootY = model.root and model.root.Parent and model.root.Position.Y or 0
	local top, bottom
	if model.kind == "Gradient" then
		top = EspColor.cham(state.colors, EspColor.tone(state.colors, settings.chamsGradA))
		bottom = EspColor.cham(state.colors, EspColor.tone(state.colors, settings.chamsGradB))
	end
	for index, clone in model.clones do
		local tint = color
		if model.kind == "Iridescent" then tint = environment.Color3.fromHSV((now * 0.12 * (settings.chamsSpeed or 1) + index * 0.012) % 1, 0.38, 1) end
		if model.kind == "Gradient" then
			local source = model.sources[index]
			local fraction = source and source.Parent and math.clamp((source.Position.Y - (rootY - 3)) / 5.6, 0, 1) or 0.5
			if settings.chamsGradScroll then fraction = math.abs((fraction + now * 0.2 * (settings.chamsSpeed or 1)) % 1 * 2 - 1) end
			tint = bottom:Lerp(top, fraction)
		end
		clone.Color, clone.Transparency = tint, transparency
	end
end

function EspChamModel.show(state, model, visible, color, alpha)
	if not visible then
		if model.shown == false then return end
		for _, clone in model.clones do clone.Transparency = 1 end
		for _, box in model.boxes do box.Transparency = 1 end
		model.shown = false
		return
	end
	local now, wasShown = state.context.environment.os.clock(), model.shown == true
	if wasShown and now - (model.propertiesAt or 0) < 1 / 30 then return end
	model.propertiesAt = now
	local transparency = 1 - math.clamp(model.specification[3] * alpha, 0, 1)
	if model.kind == "Wireframe" then
		model.shown = true
		if not wasShown or model.lastTint ~= color or math.abs((model.lastTransparency or -1) - transparency) >= 0.01 then
			model.lastTint, model.lastTransparency = color, transparency
			for _, box in model.boxes do box.Color3, box.Transparency = color, transparency end
		end
		return
	end
	if model.kind == "Iridescent" or model.kind == "Gradient" then
		model.shown, model.lastTint, model.lastTransparency = true, nil, nil
		EspChamModel.paint(state, model, color, transparency, now)
		return
	end
	local colorChanged = not wasShown or model.lastTint ~= color
	local transparencyChanged = not wasShown or math.abs((model.lastTransparency or -1) - transparency) >= 0.01
	if not colorChanged and not transparencyChanged then return end
	model.shown = true
	if colorChanged then
		model.lastTint = color
		for _, clone in model.clones do clone.Color = color end
	end
	if transparencyChanged then
		model.lastTransparency = transparency
		for _, clone in model.clones do clone.Transparency = transparency end
	end
end

function EspChamModel.step(state, options)
	local store, player = options.store, options.player
	local model, now = store[player], state.context.environment.os.clock()
	local stale = not model or model.character ~= options.character or model.material ~= options.material or not model.character.Parent
		or model.dirty ~= nil and now - model.dirty > 0.35
	if stale then
		if not options.visible then EspChamModel.drop(state, store, player); return end
		if (state.modelBudget or 0) <= 0 then
			if model and model.character == options.character then
				model.view = options.inView
				EspChamModel.show(state, model, options.visible, options.color, options.alpha)
			end
			return
		end
		state.modelBudget -= 1
		EspChamModel.drop(state, store, player)
		local folder = EspChamModel.root(state)
		if not folder or not options.material or not options.specification then return end
		model = EspChamModel.build(state, options.character, options.material, options.specification, folder, EspChamModel.pool(state, store, player))
		store[player] = model
		EspChamModel.bind(state)
	end
	model.view = options.inView
	EspChamModel.show(state, model, options.visible, options.color, options.alpha)
end

EspChamModel.placeStore = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, store, camera)
	local environment, workspace = state.context.environment, state.context.workspace
	local position, viewport = camera.CFrame.Position, camera.ViewportSize
	for _, model in store do
		local root = model.root
		local parked = not (root and root.Parent)
		if model.shown and not parked then
			if model.view ~= nil then parked = model.view == false end
			if model.view == nil and (root.Position - position).Magnitude > 12 then
				local point = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
				local marginX, marginY = viewport.X * 0.35, viewport.Y * 0.35
				parked = point.Z < -6 or point.X < -marginX or point.X > viewport.X + marginX or point.Y < -marginY or point.Y > viewport.Y + marginY
			end
		end
		if model.shown and parked and not model.parked then
			model.parked = true
			local frames, frame = {}, environment.CFrame.new(0, 30000, 0)
			for index = 1, #model.clones do frames[index] = frame end
			pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() workspace:BulkMoveTo(model.clones, frames, environment.Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged) end))
		end
		if not model.shown or parked then continue end
		model.parked = nil
		if state.settings.chamsThrough and root and root.Parent then
			local distance = math.max((root.Position - position).Magnitude, 0.01)
			local scale = math.min(1, 2.5 / distance)
			if scale >= 1 and model.scale < 1 then EspChamModel.resize(model, 1) end
			if scale < 1 and (model.scale >= 1 or distance * model.scale < 1.9 or distance * model.scale > 3.25) then EspChamModel.resize(model, scale) end
		end
		if not state.settings.chamsThrough and model.scale ~= 1 then EspChamModel.resize(model, 1) end
		for index, source in model.sources do
			local frame = source.CFrame
			if model.scale < 1 then frame = frame.Rotation + (frame.Position * model.scale + position * (1 - model.scale)) end
			model.cframes[index] = frame
		end
		pcall(workspace.BulkMoveTo, workspace, model.clones, model.cframes, environment.Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
	end
end)

function EspChamModel.bind(state)
	if state.modelsBound then return end
	local runService, environment = state.context.runService, state.context.environment
	local name = "CrackHubESP2ModelPlace"
	state.modelsBound = name
	pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(name) end)
	runService:BindToRenderStep(name, environment.Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			local camera = state.context.workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not camera then return end
			EspChamModel.placeStore(state, state.models, camera)
			EspChamModel.placeStore(state, state.halos, camera)
		end))
	end))
end

function EspChamModel.unbind(state)
	if not state.modelsBound then return end
	pcall(function() state.context.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(state.modelsBound) end)
	state.modelsBound = nil
end

function EspChams.drop(state, player)
	local highlight = state.highlights[player]
	if highlight then pcall(function() highlight:Destroy() end) end
	state.highlights[player], state.chamStates[player] = nil, nil
	EspChamModel.drop(state, state.models, player)
	EspChamModel.drop(state, state.halos, player)
end

function EspChams.clear(state)
	for player in state.highlights do EspChams.drop(state, player) end
	for player in state.models do EspChamModel.drop(state, state.models, player) end
	for player in state.halos do EspChamModel.drop(state, state.halos, player) end
end

function EspChams.apply(state, options)
	if not state.settings.chams then EspChams.drop(state, options.player); return end
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local remote = environment.getgenv().__crackhubRemoteSkin
	local replacement = remote and remote.list[options.player] and remote.list[options.player].model
	if replacement and replacement.Parent then options.character = replacement end
	local highlight = state.highlights[options.player]
	if not highlight or not highlight.Parent then
		highlight = environment.Instance.new("Highlight")
		highlight.Name, highlight.Enabled = "CrackHubESP2Cham", false
		local holder = context.coreGui
		if not holder or not holder.Parent then holder = context.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end
		highlight.Parent = holder or options.character
		state.highlights[options.player], state.chamStates[options.player] = highlight, nil
	end
	local previous = state.chamStates[options.player]
	if options.inView == false and previous and previous.adorned == nil then
		local model, halo = state.models[options.player], state.halos[options.player]
		if not (model and model.shown or halo and halo.shown) then return end
	end
	local saved, plan = EspChams.plan(state, options, previous)
	state.chamStates[options.player] = saved
	if plan.material then
		EspChamModel.step(state, {store = state.models, player = options.player, character = options.character,
			visible = plan.showModel, color = plan.modelColor, alpha = plan.modelAlpha, material = plan.material,
			specification = plan.specification, inView = options.inView})
	end
	if not plan.material and state.models[options.player] then EspChamModel.drop(state, state.models, options.player) end
	if state.settings.chamsStyle == "Glow" or state.settings.chamsOverlay then
		EspChamModel.step(state, {store = state.halos, player = options.player, character = options.character,
			visible = plan.showHalo, color = plan.fill, alpha = plan.haloAlpha, material = "Halo",
			specification = {environment.Enum.Material.Neon, 1.16, 0.2, 0}, inView = options.inView})
	end
	if state.settings.chamsStyle ~= "Glow" and not state.settings.chamsOverlay and state.halos[options.player] then
		EspChamModel.drop(state, state.halos, options.player)
	end
	if not plan.enabled then
		if saved.adorned ~= nil then highlight.Adornee, saved.adorned = nil, nil end
		highlight.Enabled = false
		return
	end
	if saved.adorned ~= options.character then highlight.Adornee, saved.adorned = options.character, options.character end
	highlight.FillColor, highlight.OutlineColor = plan.fill, plan.edge
	highlight.FillTransparency, highlight.OutlineTransparency = plan.fillTransparency, plan.edgeTransparency
	highlight.DepthMode = plan.through and environment.Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop or environment.Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
	highlight.Enabled = true
end

local MurderFeature = {}
local KNIFE_TARGET_PARTS = {"HumanoidRootPart", "UpperTorso", "Torso", "LowerTorso", "Head"}

function MurderFeature.install(context)
	local state = {context = context, killAll = false, killGun = false, aura = false, radius = 20}
	local globals = context.environment.getgenv()
	globals.__crackhubSetKillAll = function(enabled) state.killAll = not not enabled end
	globals.__crackhubGetKillAll = function() return state.killAll end
	globals.__crackhubKillPass = function() return MurderFeature.killPass(state) end

	local section = context.section
	section:Group({Title = "Murder", Side = "Right"})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Kill Aura", Default = false, Callback = function(enabled)
		state.aura = not not enabled
		globals.__crackhubKillAuraOn = state.aura
	end, Settings = function()
		section:Slider({Text = "Aura Radius", Min = 5, Max = 200, Default = 20, Decimals = 0, Suffix = " studs",
			Callback = function(value) state.radius = value end})
	end})
	section:ToggleKey({Text = "Kill All", Default = false, Callback = function(enabled) state.killAll = not not enabled end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Kill Gun Players", Default = false, Callback = function(enabled) state.killGun = not not enabled end})
	section:Header("Kill Player")
	section:PlayerList({ExcludeLocal = true, Momentary = true, ActionIcon = "skull", OnSelect = function(player)
		if player then MurderFeature.killPlayer(state, player) end
	end})

	context.environment.task.spawn(function()
		while context.isAlive() do
			local delay = MurderFeature.step(state)
			context.environment.task.wait(delay)
		end
	end)
	return state
end

MurderFeature.findKnife = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, container)
	if not container then return nil end
	local knife = container:FindFirstChild("Knife")
	if knife then return knife end

	for _, tool in container:GetChildren() do
		if tool:IsA("Tool") and state.context.collection:HasTag(tool, "Weapon_Knife") then return tool end
	end
	return nil
end)

MurderFeature.isMurderer = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, roles)
	local context, globals = state.context, state.context.environment.getgenv()
	local duel = globals.__crackhubDuel
	if duel and duel.on then
		return MurderFeature.findKnife(state, context.player.Character) ~= nil
			or MurderFeature.findKnife(state, context.player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")) ~= nil
	end

	local role = roles[context.player.Name]
	return role ~= nil and role.Role ~= nil and tostring(role.Role):lower():find("murder") ~= nil
end)

function MurderFeature.ready(state, roles)
	local context = state.context
	local character = context.player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not MurderFeature.isMurderer(state, roles) or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	if MurderFeature.findKnife(state, character) then return true end

	local knife = MurderFeature.findKnife(state, context.player:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
	if knife and knife:IsA("Tool") then
		knife.Parent = character
		return true
	end
	return MurderFeature.findKnife(state, character) ~= nil
end

function MurderFeature.validTarget(state, player, roles)
	local context = state.context
	if player == context.player then return false end

	local duel = context.environment.getgenv().__crackhubDuel
	if duel and duel.on then
		return duel.foes[player.Name] and duel.alive(player) ~= nil or false
	end

	local role = roles[player.Name]
	if not role or role.Dead == true or role.Killed == true then return false end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end

function MurderFeature.hasGun(player)
	local character, backpack = player.Character, player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	return character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil or backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil or false
end

function MurderFeature.hit(state, root)
	if not root or not root.Parent then return end
	local character = state.context.player.Character
	local knife = MurderFeature.findKnife(state, character)
	if not knife then return end

	local handle = knife:FindFirstChild("Handle") or knife:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
	local touch = state.context.environment.firetouchinterest
	if handle and touch then
		for _, name in KNIFE_TARGET_PARTS do
			local part = root.Parent:FindFirstChild(name)
			if not part then continue end
			pcall(function()
				touch(handle, part, 0)
				touch(handle, part, 1)
				touch(part, handle, 0)
				touch(part, handle, 1)
			end)
		end
	end
	pcall(function() knife:Activate() end)
end

function MurderFeature.killPlayer(state, player)
	local context, roles = state.context, state.context.roles()
	if not MurderFeature.ready(state, roles) then return end
	player = context.players:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if not player or not MurderFeature.validTarget(state, player, roles) then return end
	local character = player.Character

	context.environment.task.spawn(function()
		for _ = 1, 6 do
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local localCharacter = context.player.Character
			if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not localCharacter or not localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then break end
			MurderFeature.hit(state, root)
		end
	end)
end

function MurderFeature.killPass(state)
	local context, roles = state.context, state.context.roles()
	if not MurderFeature.ready(state, roles) then return false end

	local armed, others = {}, {}
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if not MurderFeature.validTarget(state, player, roles) then continue end
		local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then continue end
		local targets = MurderFeature.hasGun(player) and armed or others
		table.insert(targets, root)
	end
	for _, root in armed do MurderFeature.hit(state, root) end
	for _, root in others do MurderFeature.hit(state, root) end
	return #armed + #others > 0
end

function MurderFeature.step(state)
	if not (state.killAll or state.killGun or state.aura) then return 0.2 end
	local context, roles = state.context, state.context.roles()
	if not MurderFeature.ready(state, roles) then return 0.2 end

	local character = context.player.Character
	local localRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local targets = {}
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if not MurderFeature.validTarget(state, player, roles) then continue end
		local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then continue end
		local role = roles[player.Name]
		local armed = MurderFeature.hasGun(player) or type(role) == "table" and tostring(role.Role) == "Sheriff"
		local inside = state.aura and localRoot and (root.Position - localRoot.Position).Magnitude <= state.radius
		if state.killAll or state.killGun and armed or inside then targets[root] = true end
	end
	for root in targets do MurderFeature.hit(state, root) end
	return nil
end

local KnifeAim = {}

function KnifeAim.create(context, murder)
	return {
		context = context, murder = murder, on = false, mode = "Smart", fov = 360, maxDist = 250,
		wall = true, predict = true, lead = 100, sticky = true, show = true, auto = false, autoRange = 70,
		autoMin = 55, speed = 96, throws = 0, speedN = 0, lastMs = 0, curScore = 0, lastThrow = 0,
		hist = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), hcache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
	}
end

function KnifeAim.origin(state)
	local character = state.context.player.Character
	local knife = MurderFeature.findKnife(state.murder, character)
	local handle = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	if handle then return handle.Position end

	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return root and root.Position or nil
end

function KnifeAim.blocked(state, origin, position)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local params = environment.RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType, params.RespectCanCollide, params.IgnoreWater = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true, true
	local characters = {}
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if player.Character then table.insert(characters, player.Character) end
	end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = characters

	local ok, result = pcall(function() return context.workspace:Raycast(origin, position - origin, params) end)
	return ok and result ~= nil
end

function KnifeAim.candidates(state, origin, roles)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
	local direction = camera and camera.CFrame.LookVector or environment.Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	local candidates = {}

	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if not MurderFeature.validTarget(state.murder, player, roles) then continue end
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then continue end

		local delta = root.Position - origin
		local distance = delta.Magnitude
		if distance > state.maxDist or distance <= 0.5 then continue end

		local angle = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(direction:Dot(delta.Unit), -1, 1)))
		if state.fov < 360 and angle > state.fov * 0.5 then continue end

		local role = roles[player.Name]
		local name = role and role.Role and tostring(role.Role):lower() or ""
		local armed = name:find("sheriff") ~= nil or name:find("hero") ~= nil
		local score = -angle - distance * 0.12 + (armed and 14 or 0)
		if state.mode == "Crosshair" then score = -angle end
		if state.mode == "Nearest" then score = -distance end
		if state.mode == "Sheriff" then score = (armed and 1000 or 0) - angle - distance * 0.05 end
		if state.sticky and state.cur == character then score += state.mode == "Nearest" and 12 or 8 end
		table.insert(candidates, {c = character, plr = player, hrp = root, dist = distance, score = score})
	end

	table.sort(candidates, function(first, second) return first.score > second.score end)
	return candidates
end

KnifeAim.sample = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, character)
	local context = state.context
	local aim = context.aim
	if aim and aim.alive then return AimTarget.sample(context, aim, character) end

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid then return nil end

	return {t = context.environment.os.clock(), p = root.Position, cf = root.CFrame, md = humanoid.MoveDirection,
		ws = humanoid.WalkSpeed, st = humanoid:GetState(), air = humanoid.FloorMaterial == context.environment.Enum.Material.Air,
		jump = humanoid.Jump, hh = humanoid.HipHeight, jp = 50}
end)

function KnifeAim.ping(context)
	local ok, value = pcall(function() return context.stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
	if ok and type(value) == "number" and value == value then return math.clamp(value / 1000, 0, 1) end
	return 0.08
end

KnifeAim.record = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state)
	local context = state.context
	if not (state.on or state.auto) then return end
	if not MurderFeature.isMurderer(state.murder, context.roles()) then return end

	local own = context.player.Character
	local root = own and own:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end

	local now = context.environment.os.clock()
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if player == context.player then continue end
		local character = player.Character
		local targetRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not targetRoot or (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > state.maxDist + 80 then continue end

		local history = state.hist[character]
		if not history then history = {}; state.hist[character] = history end
		local last = history[#history]
		if last and now - last.t > 0.4 then table.clear(history); last = nil end
		if last and now - last.t < 1 / 240 then continue end

		local sample = KnifeAim.sample(state, character)
		if not sample then continue end
		table.insert(history, sample)
		while #history > 2 and sample.t - history[1].t > 3 do table.remove(history, 1) end
	end
end)

function KnifeAim.body(environment, character)
	local original = AimGeometry.bodyModel(environment, character, true)
	if not original then return nil end

	local padding = environment.Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	local body = {parts = {}, detached = {}, rot = original.rot, nCore = original.nCore, rad = original.rad + 0.55}
	for _, part in original.parts do
		table.insert(body.parts, {rel = part.rel, half = part.half + padding, core = part.core})
	end
	if original.bcf then body.bcf, body.bhalf = original.bcf, original.bhalf + padding end
	return body
end

function KnifeAim.hypotheses(state, character, history, horizon, force)
	local context, aim = state.context, state.context.aim
	local environment = context.environment
	local now, cached = environment.os.clock(), state.hcache[character]
	if cached and not force and now - cached.at < 0.22 and cached.horizon >= horizon - 0.05 then return cached end

	local factor, shift = aim.k, aim.shift
	aim.k = AimMotion.speedFactor(environment, aim, history)
	aim.shift = AimCalibration.lagOf(context, aim, character)
	local time = history[#history].t
	local ok, models = pcall(AimMotion.hypotheses, context, aim, history,
		{time = time, duration = horizon, parameters = AimTarget.moveParams(context)})

	if ok and type(models) == "table" and #models > 0 then
		pcall(function()
			local trust = AimMotion.directionTrust(environment, aim, history, time)
			local affected = {md = true, mdE = true, mdL = true, mdNJ = true, mdv = true, mdJe = true, mdJl = true}
			if trust < 0.98 then
				for _, model in models do if affected[model.kind] then model.w *= math.max(trust, 0.03) end end
			end

			local velocity = AimGeometry.kinVelocity(environment, history, time, 0.08) or environment.Vector3.zero
			if horizon < 1 and (AimMotion.mode(environment, history) == "nr" or velocity.Magnitude > 28) then
				local trajectory = AimMotion.arcTrajectory(environment, history, time, horizon)
				if trajectory then
					local maximum = 0
					for _, model in models do maximum = math.max(maximum, model.w) end
					table.insert(models, {kind = "arc3", w = math.max(maximum * 0.8, 0.15), traj = trajectory})
				end
			end

			local anomaly = AimMotion.anomaly(aim, history, time)
			if anomaly then
				local previous = aim.lastTrust
				aim.lastTrust = trust
				models = AimPlan.resolve(environment, aim, history, {time = time, duration = horizon, hypotheses = models, anomaly = anomaly})
				aim.lastTrust = previous
			end

			local total = 0
			for _, model in models do total += model.w end
			if total > 0 then for _, model in models do model.w /= total end end
		end)
	end
	aim.k, aim.shift = factor, shift
	if not ok or type(models) ~= "table" or #models == 0 then return nil end

	table.sort(models, function(first, second) return first.w > second.w end)
	local result = {at = now, tNow = time, hyps = models, horizon = horizon, body = KnifeAim.body(environment, character)}
	state.hcache[character] = result
	return result
end

function KnifeAim.predict(state, character, origin, detail)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return nil end

	local position, speed = root.Position, state.speed
	local history, aim = state.hist[character], context.aim
	if aim and not aim.alive then aim = nil end
	local lead = math.clamp(state.lead / 100, 0, 3)
	local function result(point, score)
		if state.wall and KnifeAim.blocked(state, origin, point) then return nil end
		return point, score, (point - origin).Magnitude / speed
	end

	if not state.predict then return result(position, 0.6) end
	if not (aim and aim.alive and history and #history >= 8) then
		local sample = history and history[#history] or KnifeAim.sample(state, character)
		if not sample then return nil end
		local movement = environment.Vector3.new(sample.md.X, 0, sample.md.Z) * sample.ws
		local latency = (aim and (aim.L or 0.15) or KnifeAim.ping(context) + 0.1) * lead
		local predicted = sample.p
		for _ = 1, 5 do predicted = sample.p + movement * (latency + (predicted - origin).Magnitude / speed) end
		return result(predicted, 0.35)
	end

	local horizon = math.clamp((position - origin).Magnitude / speed + 0.6, 0.7, 2.2)
	local cache = KnifeAim.hypotheses(state, character, history, horizon, detail >= 1)
	if not cache then return result(position, 0.3) end

	local elapsed = math.clamp(environment.os.clock() - cache.tNow, 0, 0.5)
	local mode = AimMotion.mode(environment, history)
	local taus = AimCalibration.taus(context, aim, mode, nil, 1)
	if detail < 1 and #taus >= 5 then taus = {taus[2], taus[math.ceil(#taus / 2)], taus[#taus - 1]} end
	local totalTau = 0
	for index = 1, #taus do totalTau += taus[index].w end
	if totalTau <= 0 then return result(position, 0.3) end

	local paths, total = {}, 0
	for index, hypothesis in cache.hyps do
		if index > (detail >= 1 and 8 or 4) then break end
		for index = 1, #taus do
			local tau = taus[index]
			local weight = hypothesis.w * tau.w / totalTau
			table.insert(paths, {w = weight, traj = hypothesis.traj, latency = tau.tau + elapsed})
			total += weight
		end
	end
	if total <= 0 then return result(position, 0.3) end

	local candidates, mean = {}, environment.Vector3.zero
	local function add(point, weight)
		for _, candidate in candidates do
			if (candidate.p - point).Magnitude < 0.7 then candidate.w += weight; return end
		end
		table.insert(candidates, {p = point, w = weight})
	end
	for _, path in paths do
		local point = AimMotion.trajectoryAt(path.traj, path.latency)
		for _ = 1, 4 do point = AimMotion.trajectoryAt(path.traj, path.latency + (point - origin).Magnitude / speed) end
		add(point, path.w)
		mean += point * path.w
	end
	table.sort(candidates, function(first, second) return first.w > second.w end)
	while #candidates > (detail >= 1 and 6 or 3) do table.remove(candidates) end
	add(mean / total, 0.001)

	local function score(point)
		local direction = point - origin
		local distance = direction.Magnitude
		if distance < 0.5 then return 0 end
		direction /= distance
		local hits = 0
		for _, path in paths do
			local time = distance / speed
			local target = AimMotion.trajectoryAt(path.traj, path.latency + time)
			for _ = 1, 2 do
				time = math.max(0, (target - origin):Dot(direction) / speed)
				target = AimMotion.trajectoryAt(path.traj, path.latency + time)
			end
			local hit
			if cache.body then
				hit = AimGeometry.hitsBody(environment, {body = cache.body, position = target, origin = origin,
					direction = direction, distance = (target - origin).Magnitude + 3}) ~= nil
			end
			if not cache.body then
				local offset = target - origin
				hit = (offset - direction * math.max(0, offset:Dot(direction))).Magnitude < 1.9
			end
			if hit then hits += path.w end
		end
		return hits / total
	end

	for _, candidate in candidates do candidate.s = score(candidate.p) end
	table.sort(candidates, function(first, second)
		if math.abs(first.s - second.s) > 0.02 then return first.s > second.s end
		return first.w > second.w
	end)
	local best
	for _, candidate in candidates do
		if not state.wall or not KnifeAim.blocked(state, origin, candidate.p) then best = candidate; break end
	end
	if not best then return nil end

	if detail >= 1 and best.s < 0.9 then
		local direction = best.p - origin
		if direction.Magnitude > 1 then
			direction = direction.Unit
			local side = direction:Cross(environment.Vector3.yAxis)
			side = side.Magnitude > 0.001 and side.Unit or environment.Vector3.xAxis
			local up = side:Cross(direction)
			for _, offset in {side * 0.7, -side * 0.7, up * 0.7, -up * 0.7} do
				local point = best.p + offset
				local chance = score(point)
				if chance > best.s + 0.03 and (not state.wall or not KnifeAim.blocked(state, origin, point)) then
					best = {p = point, s = chance, w = best.w}
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local point = lead ~= 1 and position + (best.p - position) * lead or best.p
	return point, best.s, (point - origin).Magnitude / speed
end

function KnifeAim.aim(state)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local character = context.player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not state.on or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not MurderFeature.isMurderer(state.murder, context.roles()) then return nil end

	local now = environment.os.clock()
	if state.cache and now - (state.cacheT or 0) < 0.035 then return state.cache end
	local origin = KnifeAim.origin(state)
	if not origin then return nil end

	local candidates, started = KnifeAim.candidates(state, origin, context.roles()), environment.os.clock()
	for index = 1, math.min(#candidates, 4) do
		local candidate = candidates[index]
		local point, score = KnifeAim.predict(state, candidate.c, origin, 1)
		if not point then continue end

		state.cur, state.curScore, state.curPoint = candidate.c, score, point
		state.cache, state.cacheT = point, now
		state.lastAim = {t = now, O = origin, P = point, c = candidate.c, sc = score}
		state.lastMs = (environment.os.clock() - started) * 1000
		return point
	end
	state.cur = nil
	return nil
end

function KnifeAim.marker(state, character, text)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local root = state.show and character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		if state.marker then state.marker.Enabled = false end
		return
	end

	if not state.marker or not state.marker.Parent then
		local marker = environment.Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		marker.Name, marker.Size = "CrackHubKnifeTarget", environment.UDim2.fromOffset(90, 26)
		marker.StudsOffsetWorldSpace, marker.AlwaysOnTop, marker.ResetOnSpawn = environment.Vector3.new(0, 3.6, 0), true, false
		local label = environment.Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name, label.BackgroundTransparency, label.Size = "L", 1, environment.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		label.Font, label.TextSize, label.TextColor3 = environment.Enum.Font.GothamBold, 15, environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 70)
		label.TextStrokeTransparency, label.Parent = 0.35, marker
		pcall(function() marker.Parent = context.coreGui end)
		if marker.Parent ~= context.coreGui then pcall(function() marker.Parent = context.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end) end
		pcall(function() environment.getgenv().__crackhubBBMirror.add(marker) end)
		state.marker = marker
	end

	state.marker.Adornee, state.marker.Enabled = root, true
	local label = state.marker:FindFirstChild("L")
	if label then label.Text = text end
end

function KnifeAim.throw(state, point)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local knife = MurderFeature.findKnife(state.murder, context.player.Character)
	local events = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Events")
	local remote = events and events:FindFirstChild("KnifeThrown")
	local handle = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Handle")
	if not remote or not handle then return false end

	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local antiAim = rawget(globals, "__crackhubAntiAim")
		if not antiAim or not antiAim.desyncAt or environment.os.clock() - antiAim.desyncAt >= 0.2 then return end
		globals.__crackhubShotHold = math.max(tonumber(globals.__crackhubShotHold) or 0, environment.os.clock() + 0.45)
		local started = environment.os.clock()
		while environment.os.clock() - started < (antiAim.fireDelay or 0.05) do context.runService.Heartbeat:Wait() end
	end))

	state.lastThrow, state.throws = environment.os.clock(), state.throws + 1
	globals.__crackhubKnifeBypass = true
	pcall(function() remote:FireServer(handle.CFrame, environment.CFrame.new(point)) end)
	return true
end

function KnifeAim.step(state)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local character = context.player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (state.on or state.auto) or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0
		or not MurderFeature.isMurderer(state.murder, context.roles()) then
		state.cur = nil
		KnifeAim.marker(state, nil)
		return
	end

	local origin = KnifeAim.origin(state)
	if not origin then return end
	local candidates = KnifeAim.candidates(state, origin, context.roles())
	local selected, point, score
	for index = 1, math.min(#candidates, 2) do
		local candidate = candidates[index]
		point, score = KnifeAim.predict(state, candidate.c, origin, 0.5)
		if point then selected = candidate; break end
	end
	if not selected then
		state.cur = nil
		KnifeAim.marker(state, nil)
		return
	end

	state.cur, state.curScore, state.curPoint = selected.c, score, point
	KnifeAim.marker(state, selected.c, math.floor(score * 100 + 0.5) .. "%")
	if not state.auto then return end

	local knife = MurderFeature.findKnife(state.murder, character)
	local throwSpeed = knife and tonumber(knife:GetAttribute("ThrowSpeed")) or 0.7
	local cooldown = math.max(1.45, throwSpeed * 2 + 0.08)
	if environment.os.clock() - state.lastThrow < cooldown or selected.dist > state.autoRange or score < state.autoMin / 100 then return end
	if not knife then MurderFeature.ready(state.murder, context.roles()); return end

	local precise, chance = KnifeAim.predict(state, selected.c, origin, 1)
	if not precise or chance < state.autoMin / 100 then return end
	state.lastAim = {t = environment.os.clock(), O = origin, P = precise, c = selected.c, sc = chance}
	KnifeAim.throw(state, precise)
end

function KnifeAim.installHook(state)
	if state.hooked then return end
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	pcall(function()
		local services = context.storage:FindFirstChild("ClientServices")
		local module = services and services:FindFirstChild("WeaponService")
		local weapons = module and environment.require(module)
		if not weapons then return end

		local previous = globals.__crackhubThrowWS
		local oldMouse = previous and previous.origMouse or weapons.GetMouseTargetCFrame
		local oldTarget = previous and previous.origTarget or weapons.GetTargetPosition
		local function mouse(self, ...)
			local ok, point = pcall(KnifeAim.aim, state)
			if ok and point then return environment.CFrame.new(point) end
			return oldMouse(self, ...)
		end
		local function target(self, ...)
			local ok, point = pcall(KnifeAim.aim, state)
			if ok and point then return environment.CFrame.new(point) end
			return oldTarget(self, ...)
		end
		weapons.GetMouseTargetCFrame, weapons.GetTargetPosition = mouse, target
		if weapons.GetMouseTargetCFrame == mouse and weapons.GetTargetPosition == target then
			globals.__crackhubThrowWS = {mouse = mouse, tgt = target, origMouse = oldMouse, origTarget = oldTarget}
			state.hooked = true
		end
	end)
end

function KnifeAim.controls(state)
	local section = state.context.section
	section:Header("Knife Throw")
	section:Toggle({Text = "Knife Throw Aimbot", Default = false, Callback = function(value)
		state.on, state.cache = not not value, nil
		if state.on then KnifeAim.installHook(state) end
	end, Settings = function()
		section:Dropdown({Text = "Target Mode", Default = "Smart", Options = {
			{code = "Smart", label = "Smart"}, {code = "Crosshair", label = "Crosshair"},
			{code = "Nearest", label = "Nearest"}, {code = "Sheriff", label = "Sheriff First"},
		}, Callback = function(value) state.mode = value end})
		section:Slider({Text = "Max Distance", Min = 30, Max = 400, Default = 250, Decimals = 0, Suffix = " st",
			Callback = function(value) state.maxDist = value end})
		section:Slider({Text = "Aim FOV", Min = 10, Max = 360, Default = 360, Decimals = 0, Suffix = "В°",
			Callback = function(value) state.fov = value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Wall Check", Default = true, Callback = function(value) state.wall, state.cache = not not value, nil end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Predict Movement", Default = true, Callback = function(value) state.predict, state.cache = not not value, nil end})
		section:Slider({Text = "Lead %", Min = 0, Max = 150, Default = 100, Decimals = 0,
			Callback = function(value) state.lead, state.cache = value, nil end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Sticky Target", Default = true, Callback = function(value) state.sticky = not not value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Target Marker", Default = true, Callback = function(value) state.show = not not value end})
	end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Auto Throw", Default = false, Callback = function(value) state.auto = not not value end,
		Settings = function()
			section:Slider({Text = "Auto Min Chance %", Min = 20, Max = 95, Default = 55, Decimals = 0,
				Callback = function(value) state.autoMin = value end})
			section:Slider({Text = "Auto Range", Min = 20, Max = 200, Default = 70, Decimals = 0, Suffix = " st",
				Callback = function(value) state.autoRange = value end})
		end})
end

function KnifeAim.install(context, murder)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	local state = KnifeAim.create(context, murder)
	globals.__crackhubKnifeAim, globals.__crackhubKnifeBypass = state, true
	state.aim = function() return KnifeAim.aim(state) end
	state.solve = function(character, origin, detail) return KnifeAim.predict(state, character, origin, detail) end
	state.pick = function(origin, roles) return KnifeAim.candidates(state, origin, roles) end
	state.origin = function() return KnifeAim.origin(state) end

	local lastManual = 0
	globals.__crackhubThrowKnife = function()
		if environment.os.clock() - lastManual < 0.2 or not MurderFeature.ready(murder, context.roles()) then return false end
		local enabled = state.on
		state.on, state.cache = true, nil
		local ok, point = pcall(KnifeAim.aim, state)
		state.on = enabled
		if not ok or not point then return false end
		lastManual = environment.os.clock()
		return KnifeAim.throw(state, point)
	end

	pcall(function()
		if environment.isfile("CrackHub/mm2_knife.json") then
			local saved = context.http:JSONDecode(environment.readfile("CrackHub/mm2_knife.json"))
			if type(saved) == "table" and tonumber(saved.speed) then state.speed = math.clamp(tonumber(saved.speed), 85, 108) end
		end
	end)
	context.connect(context.runService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() pcall(KnifeAim.record, state) end))
	context.connect(context.workspace.DescendantAdded, function(part)
		if part.Name ~= "BladePosition" or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
		environment.task.spawn(function()
			local samples = {}
			for _ = 1, 30 do
				context.runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				if not part.Parent then break end
				table.insert(samples, {environment.os.clock(), part.Position})
			end
			if #samples < 12 then return end
			local moving = {}
			for index = 2, #samples do
				if (samples[index][2] - samples[index - 1][2]).Magnitude > 0.02 then table.insert(moving, index) end
			end
			if #moving < 5 then return end
			local first, last = samples[moving[2]], samples[moving[#moving]]
			local elapsed = last[1] - first[1]
			if elapsed < 0.15 then return end
			local speed = (last[2] - first[2]).Magnitude / elapsed
			if speed <= 85 or speed >= 108 then return end
			state.speed, state.speedN = state.speed * 0.9 + speed * 0.1, state.speedN + 1
			if state.speedN % 5 ~= 0 then return end
			pcall(function()
				if not environment.isfolder("CrackHub") then environment.makefolder("CrackHub") end
				environment.writefile("CrackHub/mm2_knife.json", context.http:JSONEncode({speed = state.speed}))
			end)
		end)
	end)
	KnifeAim.controls(state)
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		while context.isAlive() do
			environment.task.wait(0.12)
			pcall(KnifeAim.step, state)
		end
	end)
	return state, function()
		state.on, state.auto = false, false
		if state.marker then pcall(function() state.marker:Destroy() end) end
	end
end

local MuzzleGuard = {}

MuzzleGuard.parts = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state)
	local character = state.context.player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local muzzle = root and root:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("Gun") or not root or not head or not muzzle or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil end
	return character, root, head, muzzle, humanoid
end)

MuzzleGuard.lineClear = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, origin, finish)
	local context = state.context
	local delta = finish - origin
	local distance = delta.Magnitude
	if distance < 0.001 then return true end

	local hit = context.workspace:Raycast(origin, delta * ((distance + (state.ext or 0.6)) / distance), state.rayParams)
	if not hit then return true end
	local model = hit.Instance and hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	local aim = rawget(context.environment.getgenv(), "__crackhubAimX")
	return model ~= nil and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= nil and aim ~= nil and aim.target == model
end)

MuzzleGuard.nearby = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, root)
	local context, vector = state.context, state.context.environment.Vector3
	table.clear(state.nearby)
	if state.nearOff then return end
	local aim = rawget(context.environment.getgenv(), "__crackhubAimX")
	local target = aim and aim.target
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if player == context.player then continue end
		local character = player.Character
		if not character or character == target then continue end
		local other = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not other or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or (other.Position - root.Position).Magnitude >= 12 then continue end
		local velocity = other.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		table.insert(state.nearby, other.Position)
		table.insert(state.nearby, other.Position + vector.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z) * (state.nearLead or 0.25))
	end
	state.nearN = #state.nearby / 2
end)

MuzzleGuard.nearClear = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, origin, finish)
	local delta, vector = finish - origin, state.context.environment.Vector3
	local denominator = math.max(delta:Dot(delta), 1e-6)
	for _, position in state.nearby do
		for _, height in {1.5, 0, -1.5} do
			local point = position + vector.new(0, height, 0)
			local closest = origin + delta * math.clamp((point - origin):Dot(delta) / denominator, 0, 1)
			if (closest - point).Magnitude < (state.nearR or 2) then return false end
		end
	end
	return true
end)

MuzzleGuard.clearPose = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, frame, head, muzzle, thorough)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local finish, origin = (frame * muzzle).Position, frame * head
	if not MuzzleGuard.lineClear(state, origin, finish) then return false end
	if not thorough then return true end

	local vector = environment.Vector3
	for _, offset in {vector.new(0.2, 0, 0), vector.new(-0.2, 0, 0), vector.new(0, 0.2, 0), vector.new(0, -0.2, 0)} do
		if not MuzzleGuard.lineClear(state, frame * (head + offset), finish) then return false end
	end
	if not MuzzleGuard.nearClear(state, origin, finish) then return false end
	if state.yawTol == false then return true end

	for _, angle in {math.rad(25), math.rad(-25)} do
		local rotated = frame * environment.CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0)
		local from, to = rotated * head, (rotated * muzzle).Position
		if not MuzzleGuard.lineClear(state, from, to) or not MuzzleGuard.nearClear(state, from, to) then return false end
	end
	return true
end)

MuzzleGuard.findPose = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, current, head, muzzle)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local frame, vector = environment.CFrame, environment.Vector3
	local look = vector.new(current.LookVector.X, 0, current.LookVector.Z)
	if look.Magnitude < 0.05 then look = vector.new(0, 0, -1) end
	local yaw, position = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z), current.Position
	if state.lastYaw then
		local candidate = frame.new(position) * frame.Angles(0, yaw + state.lastYaw, 0)
		if MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, candidate, head, muzzle, true) then return candidate end
	end

	for index = 1, 23 do
		local offset = math.ceil(index / 2) * (index % 2 == 1 and 1 or -1) * math.pi / 12
		local candidate = frame.new(position) * frame.Angles(0, yaw + offset, 0)
		if not MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, candidate, head, muzzle, false) then continue end
		if MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, candidate, head, muzzle, true) then state.lastYaw = offset; return candidate end
	end

	for _, radius in {1, 2, 3} do
		for index = 0, 7 do
			local angle = index * math.pi / 4
			local point = position + vector.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * radius
			if context.workspace:Raycast(position, point - position, state.rayParams) then continue end
			if #context.workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(frame.new(point), vector.new(1.6, 4.2, 1.6), state.overlapParams) > 0 then continue end
			for rotation = 0, 11 do
				local candidate = frame.new(point) * frame.Angles(0, yaw + rotation * math.pi / 6, 0)
				if not MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, candidate, head, muzzle, false) then continue end
				if MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, candidate, head, muzzle, true) then return candidate end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end)

MuzzleGuard.reset = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state)
	local hold = state.hold
	if hold.cf and hold.humanoid and hold.humanoid.Parent and hold.autoRotate ~= nil then
		pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() hold.humanoid.AutoRotate = hold.autoRotate end))
	end
	hold.cf, hold.fixedPosition, hold.autoRotate, hold.humanoid, hold.root = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
end)

MuzzleGuard.hold = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state)
	local hold = state.hold
	if not hold.cf then return end
	local root = hold.root
	if not root or not root.Parent then MuzzleGuard.reset(state); return end

	local environment = state.context.environment
	local position = hold.fixedPosition or root.Position
	root.CFrame = environment.CFrame.new(position) * hold.cf.Rotation
	if hold.fixedPosition then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = environment.Vector3.new(0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0) end
end)

function MuzzleGuard.poseClear(state, frame)
	local character, root, head, muzzle = MuzzleGuard.parts(state)
	if not character or state.character ~= character then return true end
	local headPosition = root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(head.Position)
	local pose = state.context.environment.CFrame.new(root.Position) * frame.Rotation
	return MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, pose, headPosition, muzzle.CFrame, true)
end

MuzzleGuard.step = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	local character, root, head, muzzle, humanoid = MuzzleGuard.parts(state)
	if not character or globals.__crackhubManualFling or globals.__crackhubTouchFlinging or globals.__crackhubFlingTargetChar
		or globals.__crackhubInvis and globals.__crackhubInvis.active == true or globals.__crackhubMuzzleOff then
		if state.hold.cf then MuzzleGuard.reset(state) end
		state.at, state.guarding = nil, false
		return
	end

	local now = environment.os.clock()
	if state.character ~= character then
		state.character = character
		state.rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances, state.overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}, {character}
		state.at = nil
		MuzzleGuard.reset(state)
	end
	local current = root.CFrame
	local headPosition, muzzleFrame = current:PointToObjectSpace(head.Position), muzzle.CFrame
	state.frames += 1
	MuzzleGuard.nearby(state, root)
	local clear = MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, current, headPosition, muzzleFrame, true)
	if not clear and not MuzzleGuard.lineClear(state, current * headPosition, (current * muzzleFrame).Position) then state.hardAt = now end

	if (state.wantUntil or 0) > now then
		if not clear and now >= (state.nextFind or 0) then
			local candidate = MuzzleGuard.findPose(state, current, headPosition, muzzleFrame)
			if not candidate then state.nextFind = now + (state.findGap or 0.1) end
			if candidate then
				local hold = state.hold
				if not hold.cf then hold.autoRotate, hold.humanoid = humanoid.AutoRotate, humanoid end
				humanoid.AutoRotate = false
				hold.cf, hold.root = candidate, root
				local delta = candidate.Position - current.Position
				hold.fixedPosition = environment.Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude > 0.3 and candidate.Position or nil
				root.CFrame = candidate
				state.guardFrames, clear = state.guardFrames + 1, true
			end
		end
		globals.__crackhubShotHold = math.max(tonumber(globals.__crackhubShotHold) or 0, now + 0.2)
	end
	if (state.wantUntil or 0) <= now and state.hold.cf then MuzzleGuard.reset(state) end
	state.guarding = state.hold.cf ~= nil

	local antiAim = state.aaWait ~= false and rawget(globals, "__crackhubAntiAim")
	local spoofRecent = antiAim and antiAim.sideAt and now - antiAim.sideAt < 0.03
	if spoofRecent and clear and environment.typeof(antiAim.fakeCF) == "CFrame" and state.aaCheck ~= false then
		local pose = environment.CFrame.new(current.Position) * antiAim.fakeCF.Rotation
		if MuzzleGuard.clearPose(state, pose, headPosition, muzzleFrame, true) then spoofRecent = false end
	end
	state.spoofRecent = not not spoofRecent
	if clear then
		if state.blocked or not state.at or spoofRecent then state.clearSince = now end
		state.blocked = false
	end
	if not clear then
		if not state.blocked then state.blockedAt = now end
		state.blocked, state.blockedFrames = true, state.blockedFrames + 1
	end
	state.at = now
end)

function MuzzleGuard.install(context)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	local state = {context = context, alive = true, clearSince = 0, blocked = false, guarding = false,
		frames = 0, guardFrames = 0, blockedFrames = 0, nearby = {}, hold = {}}
	state.rayParams = environment.RaycastParams.new()
	state.rayParams.FilterType = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	state.overlapParams = environment.OverlapParams.new()
	state.overlapParams.FilterType, state.overlapParams.RespectCanCollide = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude, true
	state.request = function(duration) state.wantUntil = math.max(state.wantUntil or 0, environment.os.clock() + (duration or 0.5)) end
	state.poseClear = function(frame) return MuzzleGuard.poseClear(state, frame) end
	globals.__crackhubMuzzle = state

	context.connect(context.runService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() pcall(MuzzleGuard.hold, state) end))
	context.connect(context.runService.PreSimulation, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		pcall(MuzzleGuard.hold, state)
		if not pcall(MuzzleGuard.step, state) then state.at = nil end
	end))
	pcall(function() context.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CrackHubMuzzleHold") end)
	pcall(function() context.runService:BindToRenderStep("CrackHubMuzzleHold", environment.Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1,
		LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() pcall(MuzzleGuard.hold, state) end)) end)
	return state, function()
		pcall(MuzzleGuard.reset, state)
		state.alive = false
		pcall(function() context.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CrackHubMuzzleHold") end)
	end
end
