function GameEffects.Kill.smoke(state, position, color, count, speed, size)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local anchor = GameEffects.Kill.anchor(state, environment.CFrame.new(position), environment.Vector3.new(2, 0.5, 2))
	GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.smokeFB, FlipbookLayout = environment.Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4,
		FlipbookMode = environment.Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot, Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(color, color),
		Size = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, (size or 2) * 0.6, 1, (size or 2) * 1.6),
		Transparency = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, 0.2, 0.7, 0.45, 1, 1), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.3),
		Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(speed * 0.4, speed), SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(85, 85), Drag = 3,
		Rotation = environment.NumberRange.new(0, 360), Shape = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box, LightEmission = 0, LightInfluence = 1, Brightness = 1}, count)
	GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, anchor, 2.5)
	return anchor
end

function GameEffects.Kill.frostBite(state, effect)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local color, white = environment.Color3.fromRGB(160, 225, 255), environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local body = GameEffects.Kill.staticBody(state, effect)
	GameEffects.Kill.hideEffectBody(state, effect.char)
	GameEffects.Kill.arc(state, effect.chest, 30, 3.4, 1.05, color, 0.8, 0.07, 0.08, -10)
	GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, 0.08, function() GameEffects.Kill.arc(state, effect.chest, 150, 3.4, 1.05, color, 0.8, 0.07, 0.08, 10) end)
	local ice = GameEffects.Kill.transmute(state, body, environment.Enum.Material.Ice, color, 0.25, 0.25)
	local spikes = {}
	GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, 0.2, function()
		for _ = 1, 10 do
			local part = ice[math.random(1, math.max(1, #ice))]
			if not part then continue end
			local direction = environment.Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() * 0.8, math.random() - 0.5).Unit
			local pieces = GameEffects.Kill.spike(state, part.Position, part.Position + direction * (0.9 + math.random() * 0.8), 0.14, 0.2,
				white:Lerp(color, 0.5), environment.Enum.Material.Glass)
			for _, piece in pieces do piece.Transparency = 0.2; table.insert(spikes, piece) end
		end
	end)
	local anchor = GameEffects.Kill.anchor(state, environment.CFrame.new(effect.chest), environment.Vector3.new(2.6, 5, 2))
	local emitter = GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.soft, Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(white, white),
		Size = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, 0.25, 1, 0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.3),
		Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.5), Acceleration = environment.Vector3.new(0, -3, 0),
		Shape = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box, LightEmission = 0.3, Brightness = 2}, 0)
	emitter.Rate, emitter.Enabled = 40, true
	GameEffects.Kill.smoke(state, effect.root - environment.Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), environment.Color3.fromRGB(220, 235, 255), 8, 3, 2.5)
	GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, 0.95, function()
		emitter.Enabled = false
		for _, group in {ice, body, spikes} do for _, part in group do pcall(function() part:Destroy() end) end end
		GameEffects.Kill.fragments(state, effect.chest, 28, color, environment.Enum.Material.Ice, 0.4, 16, 1.8)
		local _, attachment = GameEffects.Kill.effectAttachment(state, effect.chest)
		GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = state.textures.soft, Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(white, white),
			Size = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, 1.2, 1, 3.5), Transparency = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, 0.3, 1, 1),
			Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.6, 1), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(6, 12), SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(180, 180),
			Drag = 3, LightEmission = 0.3, Brightness = 2}, 20)
		GameEffects.Kill.flash(state, effect.chest, color, 10, 4)
		GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.iceShatter, 1, 1.1)
		GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.iceCrack, 0.7, 1.3, nil, 1.5)
		GameEffects.Kill.shakeCamera(state, effect.chest, 0.7, 0.25)
	end)
	GameEffects.Kill.light(state, anchor, color, 4, 14, 1.2)
	GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, anchor, 2.4)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.whooshQuick, 0.9, 1.2)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.iceCrack, 1, 1, nil, 1.5)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.rainbow(state, effect)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local colors = {environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 70), environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 40),
		environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 60), environment.Color3.fromRGB(80, 230, 100),
		environment.Color3.fromRGB(70, 150, 255), environment.Color3.fromRGB(170, 90, 255)}
	local white = environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local sequence = function(...) return GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, ...) end
	local colorSequence = function(first, second) return environment.ColorSequence.new(first, second or first) end
	local direction = GameEffects.Kill.direction(state, effect)
	local body = GameEffects.Kill.body(state, effect, direction * 26 + environment.Vector3.new(0, 60, 0), GameEffects.Kill.randomVector(state, 4), 3.2)
	GameEffects.Kill.hideEffectBody(state, effect.char)
	if body and body.torso then
		local anchor = GameEffects.Kill.anchor(state, environment.CFrame.new(body.torso.Position), environment.Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2))
		local trails = {}
		for index, color in colors do
			local first, second = environment.Instance.new("Attachment"), environment.Instance.new("Attachment")
			first.Position, first.Parent = environment.Vector3.new(0, (3.5 - index) * 0.36 + 0.18, 0), anchor
			second.Position, second.Parent = environment.Vector3.new(0, (3.5 - index) * 0.36 - 0.18, 0), anchor
			local trail = environment.Instance.new("Trail")
			trail.Attachment0, trail.Attachment1 = first, second
			trail.Color, trail.Transparency = colorSequence(color), sequence(0, 0.1, 1, 1)
			trail.Lifetime, trail.LightEmission, trail.FaceCamera, trail.Parent = 1.1, 0.6, true, anchor
			table.insert(trails, trail)
		end
		local emitter = GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.star, Color = colorSequence(white, colors[3]),
			Size = sequence(0, 0.5, 1, 0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(1, 3),
			SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(180, 180), Brightness = 4}, 0)
		emitter.Rate, emitter.Enabled = 30, true
		GameEffects.Kill.animate(state, 1.7, function()
			if body.torso.Parent then anchor.CFrame = environment.CFrame.new(body.torso.Position) end
		end, function()
			emitter.Enabled = false
			for _, trail in trails do trail.Enabled = false end
			local _, attachment = GameEffects.Kill.effectAttachment(state, anchor.Position)
			GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = state.textures.star4, Color = colorSequence(white, colors[3]),
				Size = sequence(0, 0, 0.3, 2, 1, 0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.5), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(6, 12),
				SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(180, 180), Drag = 3, Brightness = 6}, 14)
			GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, anchor, 1.3)
			GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.chimes, 0.6, 1.5)
		end)
	end
	local anchor = GameEffects.Kill.anchor(state, environment.CFrame.new(effect.root), environment.Vector3.new(2, 1, 2))
	GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.soft, Color = colorSequence(white), Size = sequence(0, 1.5, 1, 4),
		Transparency = sequence(0, 0.1, 1, 1), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.6, 1), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(6, 12),
		SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(85, 85), Drag = 4, Shape = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box,
		LightEmission = 0, LightInfluence = 0.8, Brightness = 1.3}, 16)
	GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, anchor, 1.5)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.slideWhistle, 0.6, 1.2)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.partyHorn2, 0.6, 1.1)
	for index = 0, 2 do
		GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, 0.25 + index * 0.09, function() GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.chimes, 0.4, 1.2 + index * 0.25) end)
	end
end

function GameEffects.Kill.inferno(state, effect)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
	local ground = GameEffects.Kill.ground(state, effect.root, effect.ignore)
	local height = ground and ground.Y or effect.root.Y - 3
	local parts = GameEffects.Kill.ghost(state, effect.char, {material = environment.Enum.Material.Neon,
		color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 60), transparency = 0})
	GameEffects.Kill.hideEffectBody(state, effect.char)
	for _, part in parts do
		GameEffects.Kill.tween(state, part, 0.9, {Color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(28, 14, 8)}, environment.Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
	end
	GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, 1, function()
		for _, part in parts do
			if not part.Parent then continue end
			local offset = math.max(0, part.Position.Y - (height + 0.3)) * 0.85
			GameEffects.Kill.tween(state, part, 0.55, {CFrame = part.CFrame - environment.Vector3.new(0, offset, 0), Size = part.Size * 0.55,
				Transparency = 1}, environment.Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, environment.Enum.EasingDirection.In)
			GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, part, 0.6)
		end
	end)

	local sequence = function(...) return GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, ...) end
	local colors = function(first, second) return environment.ColorSequence.new(first, second or first) end
	local anchor = GameEffects.Kill.anchor(state, environment.CFrame.new(effect.chest - environment.Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)), environment.Vector3.new(2.4, 4.4, 1.6))
	local flame = GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.flame,
		Color = environment.ColorSequence.new({environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 170)),
			environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 30)),
			environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, environment.Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 10))}),
		Size = sequence(0, 0.8, 0.3, 1.8, 1, 0.2), Transparency = sequence(0, 0.6, 0.15, 0.05, 0.8, 0.4, 1, 1),
		Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.45, 0.8), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(2, 5), Acceleration = environment.Vector3.new(0, 9, 0),
		SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(15, 15), Rotation = environment.NumberRange.new(-15, 15), Shape = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box,
		ShapeStyle = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume, Brightness = 3, ZOffset = 1}, 30)
	flame.Rate, flame.Enabled = 110, true
	GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, 1.25, function() if flame.Parent then flame.Enabled = false end end)
	GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.fsparks, Color = colors(environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 120), color),
		Size = sequence(0, 0.35, 1, 0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(2, 6),
		Acceleration = environment.Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(50, 50), Shape = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box,
		Brightness = 4}, 30, 0.3)
	GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.square, Color = colors(environment.Color3.fromRGB(80, 75, 70), environment.Color3.fromRGB(30, 28, 26)),
		Size = sequence(0, 0.2, 1, 0.08), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(1, 1.6), Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(0.5, 2),
		Acceleration = environment.Vector3.new(0, -4, 0), Drag = 1, Rotation = environment.NumberRange.new(0, 360), RotSpeed = environment.NumberRange.new(-200, 200),
		Shape = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box, LightEmission = 0, LightInfluence = 1, Brightness = 1}, 50, 1)
	local attachment = environment.Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = anchor
	GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = state.textures.core, Color = colors(environment.Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 160), color),
		Size = sequence(0, 2, 1, 7), Transparency = sequence(0, 0, 1, 1), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.35),
		Rotation = environment.NumberRange.new(0, 360), Brightness = 4}, 2)
	local floor = GameEffects.Kill.anchor(state, environment.CFrame.new(effect.root.X, height + 0.1, effect.root.Z), environment.Vector3.new(1, 0.2, 1))
	GameEffects.Kill.groundRing(state, floor, state.textures.ringEdge, color, 2, 11, 0.55, 3)
	local light = environment.Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color, light.Range, light.Shadows, light.Brightness, light.Parent = color, 16, false, 0, anchor
	GameEffects.Kill.animate(state, 1.7, function(progress) light.Brightness = (1 - progress) * (4 + math.noise(progress * 22, 0.37) * 4) end)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.fireball, 0.45, 0.55, anchor)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.fireWhoosh, 0.6, 0.5, anchor)
	GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, anchor, 3)
	GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, floor, 1.5)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.highlight(state, model, color, outline, transparency, outlineTransparency)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local highlight = environment.Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.FillColor, highlight.OutlineColor = color, outline or color
	highlight.FillTransparency, highlight.OutlineTransparency = transparency or 0.5, outlineTransparency or 0
	highlight.DepthMode = environment.Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
	highlight.Adornee, highlight.Parent = model, model
	return highlight
end

function GameEffects.Kill.crystalPrison(state, effect)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local color, white = environment.Color3.fromRGB(170, 90, 255), environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local ground = GameEffects.Kill.ground(state, effect.root, effect.ignore)
	local height = ground and ground.Y or effect.root.Y - 3
	local body, model = GameEffects.Kill.staticBody(state, effect)
	GameEffects.Kill.hideEffectBody(state, effect.char)
	if model then GameEffects.Kill.highlight(state, model, color, environment.Color3.fromRGB(230, 200, 255), 0.45, 0) end

	local crystals = {}
	local top = effect.head + environment.Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)
	for index = 1, 9 do
		local angle, radius = index / 9 * 6.283 + math.random() * 0.3, 2.2 + math.random() * 0.6
		local start = environment.Vector3.new(effect.root.X + math.cos(angle) * radius, height - 0.2, effect.root.Z + math.sin(angle) * radius)
		local finish = top + environment.Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 0.4, math.random() * 0.8, math.sin(angle) * 0.4)
		local parts, direction, length = GameEffects.Kill.spike(state, start, finish, 0.45, 0.6 + math.random() * 0.25,
			color:Lerp(white, math.random() * 0.3), environment.Enum.Material.Glass)
		for _, part in parts do
			part.Transparency, part.Reflectance = 0.2, 0.3
			local frame = part.CFrame
			part.CFrame = frame - direction * (length + 0.3)
			GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, index * 0.035, function()
				if part.Parent then GameEffects.Kill.tween(state, part, 0.3, {CFrame = frame}, environment.Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end
			end)
			table.insert(crystals, part)
		end
	end

	local anchor = GameEffects.Kill.anchor(state, environment.CFrame.new(effect.chest), environment.Vector3.new(4, 5, 4))
	local emitter = GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, anchor, {Texture = state.textures.star4, Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(white, color),
		Size = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, 0, 0.5, 0.9, 1, 0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5),
		Rotation = environment.NumberRange.new(0, 90), Shape = environment.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box, Brightness = 5, ZOffset = 1}, 0)
	emitter.Rate, emitter.Enabled = 14, true
	GameEffects.Kill.light(state, anchor, color, 5, 16, 1.4)
	GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, anchor, 3)
	GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, 1.15, function()
		emitter.Enabled = false
		for _, part in crystals do pcall(function() part:Destroy() end) end
		for _, part in body do pcall(function() part:Destroy() end) end
		GameEffects.Kill.fragments(state, effect.chest, 26, color, environment.Enum.Material.Glass, 0.45, 18, 1.6)
		GameEffects.Kill.flash(state, effect.chest, color, 12, 5)
		GameEffects.Kill.sparks(state, effect.chest, color, 30, 30, state.textures.shards)
		GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.glassSmash2, 1, 0.8)
		GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.iceFreeze, 0.6, 0.7, nil, 1.6)
		GameEffects.Kill.shakeCamera(state, effect.chest, 0.9, 0.3)
	end)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.iceFreeze, 0.8, 0.6, nil, 1.6)
	GameEffects.Kill.sound(state, GameEffects.Kill.soundIds.synthSpark, 0.4, 1.6)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.spike(state, start, finish, width, depth, color, material)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local offset = finish - start
	local length, direction = offset.Magnitude, offset.Unit
	local reference = math.abs(direction.Z) < 0.9 and environment.Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) or environment.Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
	local frame = environment.CFrame.fromMatrix(start, direction:Cross(reference).Unit, direction)
	local parts = {}
	for index = 0, 3 do
		local part = environment.Instance.new("WedgePart")
		part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
		part.Material, part.Color, part.Reflectance = material, color, 0.15
		part.Size = environment.Vector3.new(width, length, depth)
		part.CFrame = frame * environment.CFrame.Angles(0, index * math.pi / 2, 0) * environment.CFrame.new(0, length / 2, -depth / 2)
		part.Parent = GameEffects.Kill.folder(state)
		table.insert(parts, part)
	end
	return parts, direction, length
end

function GameEffects.Kill.fragments(state, position, count, color, material, size, speed, lifetime)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local parts = {}
	for _ = 1, count do
		local part = environment.Instance.new("Part")
		local scale = size * (0.5 + math.random())
		part.Size = environment.Vector3.new(scale, scale * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.6), scale * (0.7 + math.random() * 0.5))
		part.Material, part.Color = material or environment.Enum.Material.Slate, color
		part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch = false, false
		pcall(function() part.CollisionGroup = "Ragdolls" end)
		local offset = environment.Vector3.new((math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5, math.random() * 0.8, (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5)
		part.CFrame = environment.CFrame.new(position + offset) * environment.CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6, math.random() * 6)
		part.Parent = GameEffects.Kill.bodiesFolder(state)
		table.insert(parts, part)
		local duration = (lifetime or 2) + math.random() * 0.6
		GameEffects.Kill.delay(state, duration, function()
			if part.Parent then GameEffects.Kill.tween(state, part, 0.4, {Size = part.Size * 0.2, Transparency = 1}) end
		end)
		GameEffects.Kill.destroyLater(state, part, duration + 0.5)
	end

	local function launch()
		for _, part in parts do
			if not part.Parent then continue end
			local direction = environment.Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, 0, math.random() - 0.5)
			direction = direction.Magnitude > 0.05 and direction.Unit or environment.Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
			part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = direction * speed * (0.4 + math.random() * 0.6) + environment.Vector3.new(0, speed * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.6), 0)
			part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = GameEffects.Kill.randomVector(state, 8)
		end
	end
	launch()
	local connection
	connection = context.runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() connection:Disconnect(); launch() end)
	return parts
end

function GameEffects.Kill.flash(state, position, color, size, brightness)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local anchor, attachment = GameEffects.Kill.effectAttachment(state, position)
	local white = environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = state.textures.core, Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(white, color),
		Size = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, size * 0.2, 1, size), Transparency = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, 0, 1, 1),
		Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.35), Rotation = environment.NumberRange.new(0, 360), Brightness = brightness or 5, ZOffset = 1}, 2)
	GameEffects.Kill.light(state, anchor, color, 10, math.min(60, size * 3), 0.5)
	return anchor, attachment
end

function GameEffects.Kill.sparks(state, position, color, count, speed, texture)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local anchor, attachment = GameEffects.Kill.effectAttachment(state, position)
	local white = environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	GameEffects.Kill.particle(state, attachment, {Texture = texture or state.textures.fsparks, Color = environment.ColorSequence.new(white, color),
		Size = GameEffects.Kill.numberSequence(state, 0, 0.5, 1, 0), Lifetime = environment.NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.7),
		Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(speed * 0.5, speed), SpreadAngle = environment.Vector2.new(180, 180), Drag = 3,
		Acceleration = environment.Vector3.new(0, -25, 0), Orientation = environment.Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel, Brightness = 5}, count)
	return anchor, attachment
end

function GameEffects.Kill.track(state, signal, callback)
	local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
	table.insert(state.connections, connection)
	return connection
end

function GameEffects.Kill.observeCharacter(state, player, character)
	if state.hooked[character] then return end
	state.hooked[character] = true

	state.context.environment.task.spawn(function()
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 8)
		if not humanoid or not state.alive then return end

		local handled, connections = false, {}
		local function onDeath()
			if handled then return end
			handled = true
			GameEffects.Kill.onDeath(state, player, character)
		end

		table.insert(connections, humanoid.Died:Connect(onDeath))
		table.insert(connections, humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
			if health <= 0 then onDeath() end
		end))
		table.insert(connections, character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
			if parent then return end
			for _, connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
			state.characterConnections[character], state.hooked[character] = nil, nil
		end))
		state.characterConnections[character] = connections
	end)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.observePlayer(state, player)
	if player == state.context.player then return end
	if player.Character then GameEffects.Kill.observeCharacter(state, player, player.Character) end
	GameEffects.Kill.track(state, player.CharacterAdded, function(character)
		GameEffects.Kill.observeCharacter(state, player, character)
	end)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.observeBlade(state, blade)
	if blade.Name ~= "ThrowingKnife" then return end
	local environment = state.context.environment

	environment.task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local part = blade:FindFirstChild("BladePosition") or blade:WaitForChild("BladePosition", 1)
		if not part and blade:IsA("BasePart") then part = blade end

		local started = environment.os.clock()
		while part and part.Parent and blade.Parent and state.alive and environment.os.clock() - started < 6 do
			GameEffects.Kill.recordBlade(state, part.Position)
			environment.task.wait(0.03)
		end
	end))
end

function GameEffects.Kill.observe(state)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do GameEffects.Kill.observePlayer(state, player) end

	GameEffects.Kill.track(state, context.players.PlayerAdded, function(player) GameEffects.Kill.observePlayer(state, player) end)
	GameEffects.Kill.track(state, context.workspace.DescendantAdded, function(model) GameEffects.Kill.recordRagdoll(state, model) end)
	GameEffects.Kill.track(state, context.workspace.ChildAdded, function(blade) GameEffects.Kill.observeBlade(state, blade) end)

	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local services = context.storage:WaitForChild("ClientServices", 30)
		local weapons = services and services:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 30)
		local fired = weapons and weapons:WaitForChild("GunFired", 30)
		if not state.alive or not fired or not fired:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return end

		GameEffects.Kill.track(state, fired.OnClientEvent, function(shooter, _, position, hit)
			GameEffects.Kill.recordShot(state, shooter, position, hit)
		end)
	end)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.stop(state)
	state.alive = false
	state.showing = false
	GameEffects.Kill.resetShake(state)

	for _, connection in state.connections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
	for _, connections in state.characterConnections do
		for _, connection in connections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
	end

	table.clear(state.connections)
	table.clear(state.characterConnections)
	if state.folder then pcall(function() state.folder:Destroy() end); state.folder = nil end
end

function GameEffects.Kill.preview(state, name, options, title, generation)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return end

		if not state.dummyDescription then
			pcall(function() state.dummyDescription = context.players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(context.player.UserId) end)
		end
		if not state.dummyDescription then return end

		local ok, model = pcall(function()
			return context.players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(state.dummyDescription, environment.Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
		end)
		if not ok or not model then return end

		model.Name = "RhythmKillPreview"
		local frame = camera.CFrame
		local direction = environment.Vector3.new(frame.LookVector.X, 0, frame.LookVector.Z)
		direction = direction.Magnitude > 0.01 and direction.Unit or environment.Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		local character = context.player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local position = (root and root.Position or frame.Position) + direction * 9
		local localHumanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local ground
		if root then ground = root.Position.Y - root.Size.Y / 2 - (localHumanoid and localHumanoid.HipHeight or 2) end
		if not ground then
			local hit = GameEffects.Kill.ground(state, position, {a = character, b = camera})
			ground = hit and hit.Y or position.Y - 3
		end

		local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local previewRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		previewRoot.Anchored = true
		for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch = false, false, false end
		end
		if humanoid then humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = environment.Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None end

		local center = environment.Vector3.new(position.X, ground + (humanoid and humanoid.HipHeight or 2) + previewRoot.Size.Y / 2, position.Z)
		model:PivotTo(environment.CFrame.lookAt(center, environment.Vector3.new(frame.Position.X, center.Y, frame.Position.Z)))
		model.Parent = GameEffects.Kill.folder(state)
		if title and context.window then
			pcall(function() context.window:Notify({Title = context.translation.tr(title), Text = context.translation.tr(name), Kind = "info", Duration = 2}) end)
		end

		environment.task.wait(0.45)
		if generation and (state.showGen ~= generation or not state.showing) then pcall(function() model:Destroy() end); return end

		character = context.player.Character
		local killer = character and (character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
		GameEffects.Kill.play(state, name, options, model, killer)
		environment.task.wait(2.6 / state.speed)
		pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
	end)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.clearShow(state)
	for _, folder in {state.folder, state.bodies} do
		if not folder then continue end
		for _, child in folder:GetChildren() do pcall(function() child:Destroy() end) end
	end
	pcall(GameEffects.Kill.resetShake, state)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.showLabel(state, showing)
	local button, environment = state.showButton, state.context.environment
	if environment.typeof(button) ~= "Instance" then return end

	local start = state.context.translation.tr("Show All Effects")
	local stop = state.context.translation.tr("Stop Showing")
	local text = showing and stop or start
	local objects = button:GetDescendants()
	table.insert(objects, button)
	for _, object in objects do
		if not object:IsA("TextLabel") and not object:IsA("TextButton") then continue end
		if object.Text == start or object.Text == stop then object.Text = text end
	end
end

function GameEffects.Kill.previewAll(state)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	state.showGen += 1
	local generation = state.showGen
	if state.showing then
		state.showing = false
		GameEffects.Kill.clearShow(state)
		environment.task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1, 16 do
				environment.task.wait(0.2)
				if state.showing or state.showGen ~= generation then break end
				GameEffects.Kill.clearShow(state)
			end
		end)
		GameEffects.Kill.showLabel(state, false)
		return
	end

	state.showing = true
	GameEffects.Kill.showLabel(state, true)
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local function active() return state.alive and state.showing and state.showGen == generation end
		for _, group in {{GameEffects.Kill.knifeEffects, "Knife Kill"}, {GameEffects.Kill.gunEffects, "Gun Kill"}} do
			for _, name in group[1] do
				if not active() then break end
				GameEffects.Kill.preview(state, name, group[1], group[2], generation)
				local started = environment.os.clock()
				while active() and environment.os.clock() - started < 3.2 / state.speed do environment.task.wait(0.05) end
			end
		end
		if state.showGen == generation then
			state.showing = false
			GameEffects.Kill.showLabel(state, false)
		end
	end)
end

function GameEffects.Kill.options(names)
	local options = {}
	for _, name in names do
		table.insert(options, {code = name, label = name:gsub("(%l)(%u)", "%1 %2")})
	end
	table.insert(options, {code = "Random", label = "Random"})
	return options
end

function GameEffects.Kill.install(context)
	local environment, section = context.environment, context.section
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	if type(globals.__crackhubKillFXStop) == "function" then pcall(globals.__crackhubKillFXStop) end

	local state = GameEffects.Kill.create(context)
	state.showGen = 0
	state.stop = function() GameEffects.Kill.stop(state) end
	globals.__crackhubKillFX, globals.__crackhubKillFXStop = state, state.stop
	GameEffects.Kill.observe(state)

	section:Group({Title = "Kill Effects", Side = "Right"})
	section._curSub = "KillFX"
	section:Toggle({Text = "Kill Effects", Default = false, Callback = function(value) state.on = value == true end})
	section:Dropdown({Text = "Knife Kill", Default = "Slash", Options = GameEffects.Kill.options(GameEffects.Kill.knifeEffects), Callback = function(value)
		if value then state.knife = value end
	end})
	section:Dropdown({Text = "Gun Kill", Default = "Headshot", Options = GameEffects.Kill.options(GameEffects.Kill.gunEffects), Callback = function(value)
		if value then state.gun = value end
	end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Screen Shake", Default = true, Callback = function(value)
		state.shake = value == true
		if not state.shake then GameEffects.Kill.resetShake(state) end
	end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Only My Kills", Default = false, Callback = function(value) state.mine = value == true end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Kill Sounds", Default = true, Callback = function(value) state.sound = value == true end, Settings = function()
		section:Slider({Text = "Kill Volume", Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = 60, Decimals = 0, Suffix = "%", Callback = function(value) state.volume = value end})
	end})
	section:Button({Text = "Preview Knife Kill", Callback = function() GameEffects.Kill.preview(state, state.knife, GameEffects.Kill.knifeEffects, "Knife Kill") end})
	section:Button({Text = "Preview Gun Kill", Callback = function() GameEffects.Kill.preview(state, state.gun, GameEffects.Kill.gunEffects, "Gun Kill") end})
	state.showButton = section:Button({Text = "Show All Effects", Callback = function() GameEffects.Kill.previewAll(state) end})
	return state.stop
end

local SELF_CHAM_STYLES = {
	ForceField = {material = "ForceField"}, Hologram = {material = "ForceField", clean = true, edge = true},
	Flat = {material = "SmoothPlastic", clean = true}, Neon = {material = "Neon", clean = true},
	Glow = {material = "Neon", clean = true, edge = true}, Glass = {material = "Glass", clean = true, reflectance = 0.25, transparency = 0.35},
	Crystal = {material = "Glass", clean = true, reflectance = 0.5, transparency = 0.55, edge = true},
	Chrome = {material = "SmoothPlastic", clean = true, reflectance = 0.6}, Metallic = {material = "Foil", clean = true, reflectance = 0.3},
	Ice = {material = "Ice", clean = true, reflectance = 0.2, transparency = 0.15}, Lava = {material = "CrackedLava", clean = true},
	Ghost = {material = "SmoothPlastic", clean = true, reflectance = 0.1, transparency = 0.6, edge = true},
	Wireframe = {material = "ForceField", clean = true, transparency = 0.85, wire = true},
	Silhouette = {fill = 0, edge = true}, Tint = {fill = 0.5}, Outline = {edge = true},
}
local SELF_CHAM_ORDER = {"ForceField", "Hologram", "Flat", "Neon", "Glow", "Glass", "Crystal", "Chrome", "Metallic", "Ice", "Lava", "Ghost", "Wireframe", "Silhouette", "Tint", "Outline"}
local SELF_CHAM_ANIMATIONS = {"None", "Rhythm", "Breathe", "Fade", "Flash", "Rainbow", "Wave", "Gradient"}
local SelfChams = {}

function SelfChams.color(environment, value, fallback)
	if type(value) == "table" and tonumber(value.r) and tonumber(value.g) and tonumber(value.b) then
		return environment.Color3.fromRGB(value.r, value.g, value.b)
	end
	return fallback
end

function SelfChams.saveColor(color)
	return {r = math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5), g = math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5), b = math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)}
end

function SelfChams.settings(context)
	local configuration, environment = context.configuration, context.environment
	configuration.chamsCfg = type(configuration.chamsCfg) == "table" and configuration.chamsCfg or {}
	local fallback = SelfChams.color(environment, configuration.chamsCol, environment.Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255))
	local settings = {}
	for _, kind in {"self", "tool"} do
		local saved = type(configuration.chamsCfg[kind]) == "table" and configuration.chamsCfg[kind] or {}
		configuration.chamsCfg[kind] = saved
		settings[kind] = {on = false, col = SelfChams.color(environment, saved.c, fallback), col2 = SelfChams.color(environment, saved.c2, environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
			style = SELF_CHAM_STYLES[tostring(saved.style)] and saved.style or "ForceField",
			anim = table.find(SELF_CHAM_ANIMATIONS, tostring(saved.anim)) and saved.anim or "None",
			speed = math.clamp(tonumber(saved.speed) or 100, 10, 300), alpha = math.clamp(tonumber(saved.alpha) or 0, 0, 90), saved = saved}
	end
	return settings
end

function SelfChams.save(state, kind)
	local settings = state.settings[kind]
	local saved = settings.saved
	saved.c, saved.c2 = SelfChams.saveColor(settings.col), SelfChams.saveColor(settings.col2)
	saved.style, saved.anim, saved.speed, saved.alpha = settings.style, settings.anim, settings.speed, settings.alpha
	if kind == "self" then state.context.configuration.chamsCol = SelfChams.saveColor(settings.col) end
end

SelfChams.same = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(environment, first, second)
	if environment.typeof(first) == "Color3" and environment.typeof(second) == "Color3" then
		return math.abs(first.R - second.R) < 0.004 and math.abs(first.G - second.G) < 0.004 and math.abs(first.B - second.B) < 0.004
	end
	if type(first) == "number" and type(second) == "number" then return math.abs(first - second) < 0.002 end
	return first == second
end)

SelfChams.write = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, object, record, property, desired)
	local current, previous = object[property], record.written[property]
	if previous == nil or not SelfChams.same(state.context.environment, current, previous) then record.original[property] = current end
	if type(desired) == "function" then desired = desired(record.original[property]) end
	if desired == nil then record.written[property] = nil; return end
	if not SelfChams.same(state.context.environment, current, desired) then object[property] = desired end
	record.written[property] = desired
end)

SelfChams.restore = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, object, record)
	if record.clothing then
		if not object.Parent and record.parent and record.parent.Parent then object.Parent = record.parent end
		return
	end
	if not object.Parent then return end
	for property, original in record.original do
		local written = record.written[property]
		if written ~= nil then
			pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() if SelfChams.same(state.context.environment, object[property], written) then object[property] = original end end))
		end
	end
end)

SelfChams.animated = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, settings, time, height)
	local color, second, animation = settings.col, settings.col2, settings.anim
	local phase = time * settings.speed / 100
	if animation == "Rhythm" then
		local hue, saturation, value = color:ToHSV()
		return state.context.environment.Color3.fromHSV(hue, saturation, value * (0.35 + 0.65 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(phase * 4)))), 0
	end
	if animation == "Breathe" then return color, 0.7 * (0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(phase * 3)) end
	if animation == "Fade" then return color:Lerp(second, 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(phase * 2.5)), 0 end
	if animation == "Flash" then return math.floor(phase * 5) % 2 == 0 and color or second, 0 end
	if animation == "Rainbow" or animation == "Wave" then
		local _, saturation, value = color:ToHSV()
		local hue = animation == "Wave" and phase * 0.35 - height * 0.08 or phase * 0.25
		return state.context.environment.Color3.fromHSV(hue % 1, math.max(saturation, 0.55), math.max(value, 0.8)), 0
	end
	if animation == "Gradient" then return second:Lerp(color, 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(phase * 2.2 - height * 0.8)), 0 end
	return color, 0
end)

SelfChams.transparency = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(original, style, settings, animation)
	return 1 - (1 - original) * (1 - (style or 0)) * (1 - settings.alpha / 100) * (1 - animation)
end)

SelfChams.folder = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state)
	local camera = state.context.workspace.CurrentCamera
	if state.folder and state.folder.Parent == camera then return state.folder end
	if state.folder then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() state.folder:Destroy() end)) end
	local folder = state.context.environment.Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name, folder.Parent, state.folder = "RhythmSelfChams", camera, folder
	return folder
end)

SelfChams.appearance = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state)
	local camera = state.context.workspace.CurrentCamera
	local model = camera and camera:FindFirstChild("ImportedSkin")
	return model and model:IsA("Model") and model or nil
end)

SelfChams.displays = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, character)
	local result = {}
	for _, kind in {"Knife", "Gun"} do
		local reference = character:FindFirstChild("DisplayRef" .. kind)
		local display = reference and reference:IsA("ObjectValue") and reference.Value
		if display and display.Parent then table.insert(result, display) end
	end
	local folder = state.context.workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays")
	for _, display in folder and folder:GetChildren() or {} do
		if display.Name:sub(1, 9) == "ImportedSkin" then table.insert(result, display) end
	end
	return result
end)

SelfChams.visible = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(object)
	return not object:IsA("BasePart") or object.Transparency < 0.99 and object.LocalTransparencyModifier < 0.99
end)

SelfChams.collect = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, root, kind, style, clothing, wanted, boxes)
	local add; add = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(object)
		if object:GetAttribute("RhythmVFX") then return end
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then
			if object.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then return end
			if style.material and (state.saved[object] or object.Transparency < 0.99) then wanted[object] = kind end
			if style.wire and object.Transparency < 0.99 then boxes[object] = kind end
			return
		end
		if not style.clean then return end
		if object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("SpecialMesh") or clothing and (object:IsA("Clothing") or object:IsA("ShirtGraphic")) then wanted[object] = kind end
	end)
	add(root)
	for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do add(object) end
end)

SelfChams.targets = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state)
	local wanted, highlights, boxes = {}, {}, {}
	local character = state.context.player.Character
	if not character then return wanted, highlights, boxes end
	local own, tool = state.settings.self, state.settings.tool
	if own.on then
		local style, appearance = SELF_CHAM_STYLES[own.style], SelfChams.appearance(state)
		for _, child in character:GetChildren() do if not child:IsA("Tool") then SelfChams.collect(state, child, "self", style, true, wanted, boxes) end end
		if appearance then SelfChams.collect(state, appearance, "self", style, true, wanted, boxes) end
		if style.fill ~= nil or style.edge then
			highlights[appearance or character] = "self"
			if not appearance then for _, child in character:GetChildren() do if child:IsA("Tool") then highlights[child] = "block" end end end
		end
	end
	if tool.on then
		local style = SELF_CHAM_STYLES[tool.style]
		local targets = SelfChams.displays(state, character)
		for _, child in character:GetChildren() do if child:IsA("Tool") then table.insert(targets, child) end end
		for _, target in targets do
			if not SelfChams.visible(target) then continue end
			SelfChams.collect(state, target, "tool", style, false, wanted, boxes)
			if style.fill ~= nil or style.edge then highlights[target] = "tool" end
		end
	end
	return wanted, highlights, boxes
end)

SelfChams.reconcile = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, wanted, highlights, boxes)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	for object, record in state.saved do
		local keep = wanted[object] == record.kind
		if not keep and record.clothing then
			local settings = state.settings[record.kind]
			keep = settings.on and SELF_CHAM_STYLES[settings.style].clean == true and record.parent and record.parent.Parent ~= nil
		end
		if not keep then state.saved[object] = nil; pcall(SelfChams.restore, state, object, record) end
	end
	for object, kind in wanted do
		if state.saved[object] then continue end
		local record = {kind = kind, original = {}, written = {}}
		if object:IsA("Clothing") or object:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
			record.clothing, record.parent = true, object.Parent
			pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() object.Parent = nil end))
		else
			record.part, record.meshPart, record.decal, record.mesh = object:IsA("BasePart"), object:IsA("MeshPart"), object:IsA("Decal"), object:IsA("SpecialMesh")
		end
		state.saved[object] = record
		state.added = (state.added or 0) + 1
	end
	for object, record in state.highlights do
		if highlights[object] ~= record.kind or not object.Parent then state.highlights[object] = nil; pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() record.object:Destroy() end)) end
	end
	for object, kind in highlights do
		if state.highlights[object] then continue end
		local highlight = environment.Instance.new("Highlight")
		highlight.Name, highlight.DepthMode, highlight.FillTransparency, highlight.OutlineTransparency = "RhythmChamsHL", environment.Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded, 1, 1
		highlight.Adornee, highlight.Parent = object, SelfChams.folder(state)
		state.highlights[object] = {object = highlight, kind = kind}
	end
	for object, record in state.boxes do
		if boxes[object] ~= record.kind or not object.Parent then state.boxes[object] = nil; pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() record.object:Destroy() end)) end
	end
	for object, kind in boxes do
		if state.boxes[object] then continue end
		local box = environment.Instance.new("SelectionBox")
		box.Name, box.LineThickness, box.SurfaceTransparency, box.Transparency = "RhythmChamsWire", 0.025, 1, 1
		box.Adornee, box.Parent = object, SelfChams.folder(state)
		state.boxes[object] = {object = box, kind = kind}
	end
end)

SelfChams.paint = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, full)
	local environment, character = state.context.environment, state.context.player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local origin = root and root.Position.Y
	local appearance = SelfChams.appearance(state)
	local time = environment.os.clock() - state.started
	for object, record in state.saved do
		local settings = state.settings[record.kind]
		local style = SELF_CHAM_STYLES[settings.style]
		if record.part and object.Parent and style.material and (full or settings.anim ~= "None") then
			pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
				local color, animation = SelfChams.animated(state, settings, time, origin and object.Position.Y - origin or 0)
				if full or not state.phone then
					SelfChams.write(state, object, record, "Material", environment.Enum.Material[style.material])
					SelfChams.write(state, object, record, "Reflectance", style.reflectance or 0)
				end
				SelfChams.write(state, object, record, "Color", color)
				if full and style.clean and record.meshPart then SelfChams.write(state, object, record, "TextureID", "") end
				local transparency = style.transparency or 0
				if transparency > 0 or settings.alpha > 0 or animation > 0 or record.written.Transparency ~= nil then
					SelfChams.write(state, object, record, "Transparency", function(original)
						if original >= 0.99 then return nil end
						return SelfChams.transparency(original, transparency, settings, animation)
					end)
				end
			end))
			continue
		end
		if full and object.Parent and record.decal then pcall(SelfChams.write, state, object, record, "Transparency", 1) end
		if full and object.Parent and record.mesh then pcall(SelfChams.write, state, object, record, "TextureId", "") end
	end
	for object, record in state.highlights do
		pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			local highlight = record.object
			if record.kind == "block" then highlight.FillTransparency, highlight.OutlineTransparency, highlight.Enabled = 1, 1, true; return end
			local settings, style = state.settings[record.kind], SELF_CHAM_STYLES[state.settings[record.kind].style]
			local color, animation = SelfChams.animated(state, settings, time, 0)
			local hidden = 0
			if object == character or object == appearance then
				local head = object:FindFirstChild("Head")
				if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then hidden = head.LocalTransparencyModifier end
			end
			highlight.FillColor = color
			highlight.OutlineColor = style.fill == 0 and color:Lerp(environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.4) or color
			highlight.FillTransparency = style.fill ~= nil and 1 - (1 - SelfChams.transparency(0, style.fill, settings, animation)) * (1 - hidden) or 1
			highlight.OutlineTransparency = style.edge and 1 - (1 - SelfChams.transparency(0, 0, settings, animation)) * (1 - hidden) or 1
			highlight.Enabled = hidden < 0.95 and SelfChams.visible(object)
		end))
	end
	for object, record in state.boxes do
		pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			local settings = state.settings[record.kind]
			local color, animation = SelfChams.animated(state, settings, time, origin and object.Position.Y - origin or 0)
			local hidden = object.LocalTransparencyModifier
			record.object.Color3 = color
			record.object.Transparency = 1 - (1 - SelfChams.transparency(0, 0, settings, animation)) * (1 - hidden)
			record.object.Visible = hidden < 0.95 and object.Transparency < 0.99
		end))
	end
end)

SelfChams.refresh = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, scan)
	local wanted, highlights, boxes = SelfChams.targets(state)
	state.added = 0
	SelfChams.reconcile(state, wanted, highlights, boxes)
	-- periodic scans repaint everything only when something new showed up (respawn, new accessory, tool)
	if not scan or state.added > 0 or not state.phone then SelfChams.paint(state, true) end
	-- the game can reset a part: cheap re-check of the static look every 6 s
	if scan and os.clock() - (state.fullAt or 0) > 6 then state.fullAt = os.clock(); SelfChams.paint(state, true) end
end)

function SelfChams.clearKind(state, kind)
	for object, record in state.saved do
		if record.kind == kind then state.saved[object] = nil; pcall(SelfChams.restore, state, object, record) end
	end
	for object, record in state.highlights do
		if record.kind == kind or kind == "self" and record.kind == "block" then state.highlights[object] = nil; pcall(function() record.object:Destroy() end) end
	end
	for object, record in state.boxes do
		if record.kind == kind then state.boxes[object] = nil; pcall(function() record.object:Destroy() end) end
	end
end

function SelfChams.synchronize(state)
	local restored = SelfChams.settings(state.context)
	for _, kind in {"self", "tool"} do
		local current, values = state.settings[kind], restored[kind]
		for _, key in {"col", "col2", "style", "anim", "speed", "alpha", "saved"} do current[key] = values[key] end
		for key, handle in state.controls[kind] do pcall(handle.SetSilent, current[key]) end
		SelfChams.clearKind(state, kind)
	end
	pcall(SelfChams.refresh, state)
	local tint = state.context.environment.getgenv().__crackhubVFXTint
	if tint then pcall(tint) end
end

function SelfChams.install(context)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	local state = {context = context, settings = SelfChams.settings(context), saved = {}, highlights = {}, boxes = {},
		controls = {self = {}, tool = {}}, started = environment.os.clock(), scanAt = 0, paintAt = 0}
	local function options(values)
		local result = {}
		for _, value in values do table.insert(result, {code = value, label = value}) end
		return result
	end
	local function tint()
		if globals.__crackhubVFXTint then pcall(globals.__crackhubVFXTint) end
	end
	local function refresh() pcall(SelfChams.refresh, state) end
	local function controls(kind)
		return function()
			local settings = state.settings[kind]
			state.controls[kind].col = context.section:Colorpicker({Text = "Chams Color", NoSave = true, Default = settings.col, Callback = function(color)
				if environment.typeof(color) ~= "Color3" then return end
				settings.col = color; SelfChams.save(state, kind); pcall(SelfChams.paint, state, true); if kind == "self" then tint() end
			end})
			state.controls[kind].style = context.section:Dropdown({Text = "Chams Style", NoSave = true, Default = settings.style, Options = options(SELF_CHAM_ORDER), Callback = function(value)
				if not SELF_CHAM_STYLES[value] or value == settings.style then return end
				settings.style = value; SelfChams.save(state, kind); SelfChams.clearKind(state, kind); refresh()
			end})
			state.controls[kind].anim = context.section:Dropdown({Text = "Animation", NoSave = true, Default = settings.anim, Options = options(SELF_CHAM_ANIMATIONS), Callback = function(value)
				if not table.find(SELF_CHAM_ANIMATIONS, value) then return end
				settings.anim = value; SelfChams.save(state, kind); refresh()
			end})
			state.controls[kind].speed = context.section:Slider({Text = "Animation Speed", NoSave = true, Min = 10, Max = 300, Default = settings.speed, Decimals = 0, Suffix = "%", Callback = function(value)
				settings.speed = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 100, 10, 300); SelfChams.save(state, kind)
			end})
			state.controls[kind].col2 = context.section:Colorpicker({Text = "Second Color", NoSave = true, Default = settings.col2, Callback = function(color)
				if environment.typeof(color) ~= "Color3" then return end
				settings.col2 = color; SelfChams.save(state, kind); pcall(SelfChams.paint, state, true)
			end})
			state.controls[kind].alpha = context.section:Slider({Text = "Chams Transparency", NoSave = true, Min = 0, Max = 90, Default = settings.alpha, Decimals = 0, Suffix = "%", Callback = function(value)
				settings.alpha = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 0, 0, 90); SelfChams.save(state, kind); pcall(SelfChams.paint, state, true)
			end})
		end
	end
	for _, kind in {"self", "tool"} do
		context.section:Toggle({Text = kind == "self" and "Self Chams" or "Tool Chams", Default = false, Callback = function(value)
			state.settings[kind].on = not not value; refresh()
		end, Settings = controls(kind)})
	end
	context.section:Toggle({Text = "Tint Auras / VFX", Default = false, Callback = function(value) globals.__crackhubFxTintOn = not not value; tint() end})
	if context.applyHooks then table.insert(context.applyHooks, function() SelfChams.synchronize(state) end) end
	local mine = function()
		local own, tool = state.settings.self, state.settings.tool
		if not own.on and not tool.on then return nil end
		local color, style = own.on and own.col or tool.col, own.on and own.style or tool.style
		local result = {s = own.on and 1 or nil, t = tool.on and 1 or nil, c = math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5) * 65536 + math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5) * 256 + math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)}
		if style ~= "ForceField" and SELF_CHAM_STYLES[style].material then result.y = style end
		return result
	end
	local material = function(style)
		local spec = SELF_CHAM_STYLES[tostring(style)]
		return spec and spec.material and environment.Enum.Material[spec.material] or nil
	end
	local color = function() return state.settings.self.col end
	globals.__crackhubChamsMine, globals.__crackhubChamsMat, globals.__crackhubSelfChams, globals.__crackhubFxColor = mine, material, state, color
	state.K, state.hls, state.apply = state.settings, state.highlights, refresh
	context.connect(context.runService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local now = environment.os.clock()
		local phone = state.phone
		if phone == nil then phone = context.inputService and context.inputService.TouchEnabled and not context.inputService.KeyboardEnabled or false; state.phone = phone end
		if now - state.scanAt >= (phone and 2 or 0.4) and (state.settings.self.on or state.settings.tool.on or next(state.saved) or next(state.highlights) or next(state.boxes)) then
			state.scanAt = now; pcall(SelfChams.refresh, state, true)
		end
		if now - state.paintAt < (phone and 1 / 12 or 1 / 30) then return end
		if state.settings.self.anim == "None" and state.settings.tool.anim == "None" and not next(state.highlights) and not next(state.boxes) then return end
		state.paintAt = now
		pcall(SelfChams.paint, state, false)
	end))
	return state, function()
		state.settings.self.on, state.settings.tool.on = false, false
		SelfChams.clearKind(state, "self"); SelfChams.clearKind(state, "tool")
		if state.folder then pcall(function() state.folder:Destroy() end) end
		if globals.__crackhubChamsMine == mine then globals.__crackhubChamsMine = nil end
		if globals.__crackhubChamsMat == material then globals.__crackhubChamsMat = nil end
		if globals.__crackhubSelfChams == state then globals.__crackhubSelfChams = nil end
		if globals.__crackhubFxColor == color then globals.__crackhubFxColor = nil end
	end
end

local AuraEngine = {}
function AuraEngine.recolor(environment, sequence, tint)
	if environment.typeof(sequence) ~= "ColorSequence" then return environment.ColorSequence.new(tint) end
	local points = {}
	for _, point in sequence.Keypoints do
		local original = point.Value
		local high, low = math.max(original.R, original.G, original.B), math.min(original.R, original.G, original.B)
		local brightness = 0.3 + 0.7 * high
		local color = environment.Color3.new(tint.R * brightness, tint.G * brightness, tint.B * brightness)
		if low > 0.72 then color = color:Lerp(environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), (low - 0.72) / 0.28 * 0.75) end
		table.insert(points, environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(point.Time, color))
	end
	return environment.ColorSequence.new(points)
end

local AuraTint = {}

function AuraTint.roots(state, character)
	local roots = {}
	if not character then return roots end
	table.insert(roots, character)
	local context, globals = state.context, state.context.environment.getgenv()
	local model
	if character == context.player.Character then
		if type(globals.__crackhubSkinModel) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(globals.__crackhubSkinModel)
			if ok then model = result end
		end
	else
		local player = context.players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		local remote = rawget(globals, "__crackhubRemoteSkin")
		if player and type(remote) == "table" and type(remote.liveModel) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(remote.liveModel, player)
			if ok then model = result end
		end
	end
	if model then table.insert(roots, model) end
	return roots
end

function AuraTint.applyObject(state, object, color, glow, remote)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local sequence = object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Trail")
	local light = object:IsA("PointLight") or object:IsA("SpotLight") or object:IsA("SurfaceLight")
	if sequence then
		if state.colors[object] == nil then state.colors[object] = object.Color end
		if state.emission[object] == nil then state.emission[object] = object.LightEmission end
		object.Color = color and AuraEngine.recolor(environment, state.colors[object], color) or state.colors[object]
		object.LightEmission = color and state.emission[object] * glow or state.emission[object]
		return
	end
	if light then
		if state.colors[object] == nil then state.colors[object] = object.Color end
		if state.secondary[object] == nil then state.secondary[object] = object.Brightness end
		object.Color, object.Brightness = color or state.colors[object], color and state.secondary[object] * glow or state.secondary[object]
		return
	end
	if remote then return end
	if object:IsA("BasePart") and object.Name ~= "RhythmAuraHost" or object:IsA("Fire") then
		if state.colors[object] == nil then state.colors[object] = object.Color end
		object.Color = color or state.colors[object]
		return
	end
	if object:IsA("Highlight") then
		if state.colors[object] == nil then state.colors[object] = object.OutlineColor end
		if state.secondary[object] == nil then state.secondary[object] = object.FillColor end
		object.OutlineColor, object.FillColor = color or state.colors[object], color or state.secondary[object]
		return
	end
	if object:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
		local material = object.Parent and object.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and object.Parent.Material
		if material == environment.Enum.Material.ForceField then return end
		if state.colors[object] == nil then state.colors[object] = object.VertexColor end
		object.VertexColor = color and environment.Vector3.new(color.R, color.G, color.B) * (material == environment.Enum.Material.Neon and 1 or 1.6) or state.colors[object]
	end
end

function AuraTint.apply(state, character, remoteOptions)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	character = character or context.player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local remote = remoteOptions ~= nil
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	local common = not remote and globals.__crackhubFxTintOn and globals.__crackhubFxColor and globals.__crackhubFxColor() or nil
	local options = context.configuration.vfxCol or {}
	for _, root in AuraTint.roots(state, character) do
		for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do
			if not object:GetAttribute("RhythmVFX") then continue end
			pcall(function()
				local key = object:GetAttribute("RhythmVFXKey")
				local color, glow = common, 1
				if remote then
					local packed = remoteOptions[key]
					if type(packed) == "number" and packed > 1 then
						local brightness, rgb = math.floor(packed / 16777216), packed % 16777216
						color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(rgb / 65536) % 256, math.floor(rgb / 256) % 256, rgb % 256)
						if brightness > 0 then glow = brightness / 100 end
					end
				else
					local custom = key and options[key]
					if custom and custom.custom then
						color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(custom.r, custom.g, custom.b)
						glow = custom.glow and custom.glow / 100 or 1
					end
				end
				AuraTint.applyObject(state, object, color, glow, remote)
				for _, child in object:GetDescendants() do AuraTint.applyObject(state, child, color, glow, remote) end
			end)
		end
	end
end

function AuraTint.install(context)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	local state = {context = context, colors = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), emission = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), secondary = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})}
	local apply = function() AuraTint.apply(state) end
	local applyFor = function(character, options) if character and type(options) == "table" then AuraTint.apply(state, character, options) end end
	globals.__crackhubVFXTint, globals.__crackhubVFXTintFor = apply, applyFor
	context.connect(context.player.CharacterAdded, function()
		environment.task.wait(0.8)
		pcall(apply)
	end)
	return state, function()
		for object in state.colors do pcall(AuraTint.applyObject, state, object, nil, 1, false) end
		if globals.__crackhubVFXTint == apply then globals.__crackhubVFXTint = nil end
		if globals.__crackhubVFXTintFor == applyFor then globals.__crackhubVFXTintFor = nil end
	end
end

local SkyFx = {}
local SKY_FX_ORDER = {"stars", "meteors", "comets", "net", "runes", "dust"}
local SKY_FX_TEXTURES = {dot = "rbxassetid://16512006463", soft = "rbxassetid://1075864321", spark = "rbxassetid://14590086212",
	sharp = "rbxassetid://17391818367", runes = "rbxassetid://11910560348", glyphs = "rbxassetid://10713705343",
	const1 = "rbxassetid://14101033134", const2 = "rbxassetid://14101036795", beam = "rbxassetid://12781750620", rays = "rbxassetid://4553095322"}

function SkyFx.defaults(env)
	local rgb = env.Color3.fromRGB
	return {general = {bright = 100}, stars = {on = false, density = 60, size = 100, twinkle = 60, tint = "Natural"},
		meteors = {on = false, rate = 45, length = 100, color = rgb(190, 225, 255)},
		comets = {on = false, rate = 40, size = 100, color = rgb(120, 210, 255)},
		net = {on = false, nodes = 80, reach = 50, speed = 40, place = "Sky", color = rgb(150, 205, 255), figures = true, rhythms = true, rainbow = false, cursor = true},
		runes = {on = false, amount = 50, size = 100, set = "Runes", color = rgb(130, 220, 255)},
		dust = {on = false, amount = 50, palette = "Gold"}}
end

function SkyFx.palettes(env)
	local rgb = env.Color3.fromRGB
	return {stars = {Natural = {rgb(232, 240, 255), rgb(170, 200, 255), rgb(255, 226, 190)},
		Cold = {rgb(205, 225, 255), rgb(140, 185, 255), rgb(190, 240, 255)},
		Warm = {rgb(255, 238, 214), rgb(255, 205, 150), rgb(255, 180, 140)},
		Pastel = {rgb(255, 205, 236), rgb(195, 255, 232), rgb(214, 196, 255)}},
		dust = {Gold = {rgb(255, 220, 130), rgb(255, 190, 90)}, Silver = {rgb(235, 242, 255), rgb(190, 210, 255)},
		Pink = {rgb(255, 170, 220), rgb(255, 120, 190)}, Aqua = {rgb(140, 255, 235), rgb(110, 200, 255)}}}
end

SkyFx.create = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, class, parent, properties)
	local object = state.context.environment.Instance.new(class)
	for key, value in pairs(properties or {}) do object[key] = value end
	object.Parent = parent
	return object
end)

SkyFx.part = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, parent, name)
	local env = state.context.environment
	return SkyFx.create(state, "Part", parent, {Name = name, Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanTouch = false,
		CanQuery = false, CastShadow = false, Transparency = 1, Locked = true, Size = env.Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)})
end)

SkyFx.emitter = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, parent, texture, life, speed, brightness, locked)
	local env = state.context.environment
	return SkyFx.create(state, "ParticleEmitter", parent, {Enabled = false, Rate = 0, Texture = texture,
		LightEmission = 1, LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = brightness, Lifetime = env.NumberRange.new(life[1], life[2] or life[1]),
		Speed = env.NumberRange.new(speed and speed[1] or 0, speed and (speed[2] or speed[1]) or 0),
		LockedToPart = locked == true, Orientation = env.Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera})
end)

SkyFx.sequence = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, points)
	local env, result = state.context.environment, {}
	for _, point in ipairs(points) do table.insert(result, env.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], point[2], point[3] or 0)) end
	return env.NumberSequence.new(result)
end)

SkyFx.rainbow = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, offset)
	local env, result = state.context.environment, {}
	for index = 0, 6 do table.insert(result, env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(index / 6, env.Color3.fromHSV((offset + index / 6) % 1, 0.55, 1))) end
	return env.ColorSequence.new(result)
end)

SkyFx.particle = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, parent, texture, life, speed, brightness, locked, sphere)
	local emitter = SkyFx.emitter(state, parent, texture, life, speed, brightness, locked)
	local env = state.context.environment
	emitter.Shape = sphere and env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Sphere or env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
	emitter.ShapeStyle = sphere and env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Surface or env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
	if sphere then
		emitter.ShapeInOut, emitter.EmissionDirection = env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Outward, env.Enum.NormalId.Top
		pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() emitter.ShapePartial = 0.5 end))
	end
	return emitter
end)

SkyFx.buildParticles = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, folder)
	local env, texture = state.context.environment, SKY_FX_TEXTURES
	local part = SkyFx.part(state, folder, name)
	local fx = {folder = folder, part = part, dirty = true, filled = false}
	if name == "stars" then
		fx.small = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.dot, {4, 9}, nil, 2.6, true, true)
		fx.tint = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.dot, {4, 8}, nil, 2.8, true, true)
		fx.big = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.spark, {5, 10}, nil, 3, true, true)
		return fx
	end
	if name == "runes" then
		part.Size = env.Vector3.new(80, 22, 80)
		fx.main = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.runes, {6, 10}, {0.5, 1.5}, 2.6)
		fx.main.Drag, fx.main.EmissionDirection, fx.main.SpreadAngle = 0.3, env.Enum.NormalId.Top, env.Vector2.new(25, 25)
		fx.main.FlipbookLayout, fx.main.FlipbookMode = env.Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4, env.Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
		fx.main.FlipbookFramerate, fx.main.FlipbookStartRandom = env.NumberRange.new(0, 0), true
		fx.glow = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.dot, {3, 6}, {0.3, 1}, 2)
		fx.glow.EmissionDirection = env.Enum.NormalId.Top
		return fx
	end
	part.Size = env.Vector3.new(90, 30, 90)
	fx.main = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.spark, {4, 8}, {0.1, 0.5}, 2.6)
	fx.glow = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.dot, {3, 7}, {0.1, 0.4}, 2.2)
	fx.main.SpreadAngle, fx.glow.SpreadAngle = env.Vector2.new(180, 180), env.Vector2.new(180, 180)
	fx.main.Acceleration, fx.glow.Acceleration = env.Vector3.new(0, -0.15, 0), env.Vector3.new(0, -0.1, 0)
	return fx
end)

SkyFx.applyStars = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx)
	local env, cfg, radius = state.context.environment, state.cfg.stars, state.radius
	local brightness, size = state.cfg.general.bright / 100, cfg.size / 100
	fx.part.Size = env.Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * math.min(radius * 2, 2040)
	local twinkle = 0.08 + 0.62 * cfg.twinkle / 100
	local transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.1, 0.04}, {0.22, twinkle}, {0.34, 0.04}, {0.46, twinkle * 0.8},
		{0.58, 0.04}, {0.7, twinkle}, {0.82, 0.08}, {1, 1}})
	fx.small.Transparency, fx.tint.Transparency = transparency, transparency
	fx.small.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, radius * 0.03 * size, radius * 0.012 * size}, {1, radius * 0.03 * size, radius * 0.012 * size}})
	fx.tint.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, radius * 0.036 * size, radius * 0.012 * size}, {1, radius * 0.036 * size, radius * 0.012 * size}})
	local large = radius * 0.055 * size
	fx.big.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0}, {0.14, large}, {0.3, large * 0.55}, {0.46, large}, {0.62, large * 0.6}, {0.8, large}, {1, 0}})
	fx.big.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.12, 0.05}, {0.88, 0.1}, {1, 1}})
	fx.small.Brightness, fx.tint.Brightness, fx.big.Brightness = 2.6 * brightness, 2.8 * brightness, 3 * brightness
	fx.small.Rate, fx.tint.Rate, fx.big.Rate = cfg.density * 1.25, cfg.density * 0.36, cfg.density * 0.07
	fx.small.Enabled, fx.tint.Enabled, fx.big.Enabled = cfg.density > 0, cfg.density > 0, cfg.density > 0
	if cfg.tint == "Rainbow" then
		fx.small.Color, fx.tint.Color, fx.big.Color = SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0), SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0.5), SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0.25)
	else
		local colors = state.palettes.stars[cfg.tint] or state.palettes.stars.Natural
		fx.small.Color, fx.tint.Color, fx.big.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(colors[1]), env.ColorSequence.new(colors[2], colors[3]), env.ColorSequence.new(colors[1])
	end
	if not fx.filled and cfg.density > 0 then
		fx.filled = true
		fx.small:Emit(math.floor(cfg.density * 3.6))
		fx.tint:Emit(math.floor(cfg.density))
		fx.big:Emit(math.floor(cfg.density * 0.2))
	end
end)

SkyFx.applyRunes = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.runes
	local size, brightness = cfg.size / 100, state.cfg.general.bright / 100
	fx.main.Texture = cfg.set == "Glyphs" and SKY_FX_TEXTURES.glyphs or SKY_FX_TEXTURES.runes
	fx.main.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1.02 * size}, {0.15, 1.7 * size}, {0.85, 1.7 * size}, {1, 1.36 * size}})
	fx.main.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.15, 0.05}, {0.75, 0.15}, {1, 1}})
	fx.glow.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.5 * size}, {1, 0}})
	fx.glow.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.3}, {1, 1}})
	fx.main.Color, fx.glow.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color), env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color)
	fx.main.Brightness, fx.glow.Brightness = 2.6 * brightness, 2 * brightness
	fx.main.Rate, fx.glow.Rate = cfg.amount * 0.32, cfg.amount * 0.3
	fx.main.Enabled, fx.glow.Enabled = cfg.amount > 0, cfg.amount > 0
	if not fx.filled and cfg.amount > 0 then fx.filled = true; fx.main:Emit(math.floor(cfg.amount * 1.6)) end
end)

SkyFx.applyDust = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.dust
	fx.main.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0}, {0.15, 0.75}, {0.3, 0.2625}, {0.45, 0.75}, {0.6, 0.3}, {0.78, 0.75}, {1, 0}})
	fx.main.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.12, 0}, {0.85, 0.1}, {1, 1}})
	fx.glow.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.38}, {1, 0.14}})
	fx.glow.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.15, 0.1}, {0.5, 0.5}, {0.75, 0.1}, {1, 1}})
	if cfg.palette == "Rainbow" then fx.main.Color, fx.glow.Color = SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0), SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0.4)
	else
		local colors = state.palettes.dust[cfg.palette] or state.palettes.dust.Gold
		fx.main.Color, fx.glow.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(colors[1]), env.ColorSequence.new(colors[2])
	end
	local brightness = state.cfg.general.bright / 100
	fx.main.Brightness, fx.glow.Brightness = 3.2 * brightness, 2.6 * brightness
	fx.main.Rate, fx.glow.Rate = cfg.amount * 0.9, cfg.amount * 1.1
	fx.main.Enabled, fx.glow.Enabled = cfg.amount > 0, cfg.amount > 0
	if not fx.filled and cfg.amount > 0 then
		fx.filled = true
		fx.main:Emit(math.floor(cfg.amount * 3))
		fx.glow:Emit(math.floor(cfg.amount * 3))
	end
end)

SkyFx.beam = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, parent, first, second, brightness)
	local env = state.context.environment
	return SkyFx.create(state, "Beam", parent, {Attachment0 = first, Attachment1 = second, FaceCamera = true, LightEmission = 1,
		LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = brightness, Segments = 1, Width0 = 0, Width1 = 1,
		Texture = SKY_FX_TEXTURES.beam, TextureMode = env.Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, Enabled = false})
end)

SkyFx.buildTrails = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, folder)
	local env = state.context.environment
	local anchor = SkyFx.part(state, folder, name .. "Anchor")
	anchor.CFrame = env.CFrame.new()
	local fx = {folder = folder, anchor = anchor, pool = {}, dirty = true, nextSpawn = state.time + (name == "meteors" and 0.5 or 1.2)}
	local count = name == "meteors" and 7 or 2
	for _ = 1, count do
		local first, second = SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", anchor), SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", anchor)
		local trail = {first = first, second = second, beams = {}, active = false}
		if name == "comets" then trail.ion = SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", anchor) end
		local beamCount = name == "meteors" and 2 or 5
		for index = 1, beamCount do
			local beam = SkyFx.beam(state, anchor, first, index > 3 and trail.ion or second, index == 1 and 3.2 or 1.4)
			if name == "comets" then beam.Segments = index <= 3 and 24 or 12 end
			table.insert(trail.beams, beam)
		end
		trail.head = SkyFx.part(state, folder, name .. "Head")
		trail.head.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
		trail.glow = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.soft, {name == "meteors" and 30 or 60}, nil, 1.4, true)
		trail.star = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, name == "meteors" and SKY_FX_TEXTURES.spark or SKY_FX_TEXTURES.dot,
			{name == "meteors" and 30 or 60}, nil, 3, true)
		trail.dust = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.dot, {0.3, 0.8}, {0.2, 1}, 2.2)
		trail.dust.SpreadAngle = env.Vector2.new(180, 180)
		if name == "comets" then
			trail.flare = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.spark, {1.6, 2.4}, nil, 2.4, true)
			trail.dust2 = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.dot, {2, 4}, {0.2, 1.5}, 2)
			trail.dust2.SpreadAngle = env.Vector2.new(180, 180)
		end
		table.insert(fx.pool, trail)
	end
	return fx
end)

SkyFx.applyTrails = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, fx)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg[name]
	local scale = name == "comets" and cfg.size / 100 or 1
	for _, trail in ipairs(fx.pool) do
		for _, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do beam.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color) end
		local white = env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		if name == "meteors" then
			trail.beams[1].Color = env.ColorSequence.new({env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, cfg.color),
				env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, cfg.color:Lerp(white, 0.5)), env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, white)})
		else
			trail.beams[1].Color = env.ColorSequence.new({env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, white),
				env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.12, cfg.color:Lerp(white, 0.35)), env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, cfg.color)})
			trail.beams[2].Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color:Lerp(white, 0.3), cfg.color)
			trail.beams[4].Color = env.ColorSequence.new(white, env.Color3.fromRGB(120, 175, 255))
			trail.beams[5].Color = env.ColorSequence.new(env.Color3.fromRGB(120, 175, 255))
		end
		trail.glow.Color, trail.dust.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color), env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color)
		trail.glow.Size, trail.star.Size = env.NumberSequence.new(state.radius * 0.032 * scale), env.NumberSequence.new(state.radius * 0.03 * scale)
		trail.dust.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, state.radius * 0.007 * scale}, {1, 0}})
		trail.dust.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.1}, {1, 1}})
		if name == "comets" then
			trail.flare.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, state.radius * 0.042 * scale}, {0.5, state.radius * 0.07 * scale}, {1, state.radius * 0.042 * scale}})
			trail.flare.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.3, 0.2}, {0.7, 0.2}, {1, 1}})
			trail.dust2.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, state.radius * 0.006 * scale}, {1, 0}})
			trail.dust2.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.2}, {1, 1}})
			trail.dust2.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color)
		end
	end
end)

SkyFx.direction = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, azimuth, elevation)
	local cos = math.cos(elevation)
	return state.context.environment.Vector3.new(cos * math.cos(azimuth), math.sin(elevation), cos * math.sin(azimuth))
end)

SkyFx.arc = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(first, second, t)
	local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(first:Dot(second), -1, 1))
	if angle < 0.0001 then return first end
	local sine = math.sin(angle)
	return first * (math.sin((1 - t) * angle) / sine) + second * (math.sin(t * angle) / sine)
end)

SkyFx.spawnTrail = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, fx, look)
	local trail
	for _, candidate in ipairs(fx.pool) do if not candidate.active then trail = candidate; break end end
	if not trail then return end
	local comet = name == "comets"
	local azimuth = math.atan2(look.Z, look.X) + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * (comet and 0.96 or 1.05)
	if not comet and math.random() >= 0.8 then azimuth = math.random() * math.pi * 2 end
	local elevation = math.rad(comet and 26 + math.random() * 26 or 30 + math.random() * 42)
	local direction = math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1
	trail.start = SkyFx.direction(state, azimuth, elevation)
	trail.finish = SkyFx.direction(state, azimuth + direction * math.rad(comet and 26 + math.random() * 18 or 16 + math.random() * 24),
		elevation + math.rad(comet and -12 + math.random() * 20 or -14 - math.random() * 14))
	trail.started, trail.duration, trail.active = state.time, comet and 18 + math.random() * 10 or 0.6 + math.random() * 0.7, true
	trail.tail = comet and 0.3 or 0.3 * state.cfg.meteors.length / 100 * (0.8 + math.random() * 0.45)
	for _, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do beam.Enabled = true end
	trail.glow:Emit(1)
	trail.star:Emit(1)
	trail.dust.Rate, trail.dust.Enabled = comet and 26 or 80, true
	if comet then
		trail.flare.Rate, trail.flare.Enabled = 1.4, true
		trail.dust2.Rate, trail.dust2.Enabled = 34, true
	end
end)

SkyFx.stepTrails = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, fx, position, look)
	local cfg = state.cfg[name]
	local comet = name == "comets"
	if state.time >= fx.nextSpawn then
		SkyFx.spawnTrail(state, name, fx, look)
		local delay = comet and 6 + 70 * (1 - cfg.rate / 100) ^ 2 or 0.3 + 9 * (1 - cfg.rate / 100) ^ 2
		fx.nextSpawn = state.time + delay * (comet and 0.5 + math.random() or 0.35 + 1.3 * math.random())
	end
	local brightness = state.cfg.general.bright / 100
	for _, trail in ipairs(fx.pool) do
		if not trail.active then continue end
		local progress = (state.time - trail.started) / trail.duration
		if progress >= 1 + (comet and 0 or trail.tail) then
			trail.active, trail.dust.Enabled = false, false
			if comet then trail.flare.Enabled, trail.dust2.Enabled = false, false end
			for _, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do beam.Enabled = false end
			trail.glow:Clear()
			trail.star:Clear()
			trail.head.CFrame = state.context.environment.CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
			continue
		end
		local direction = SkyFx.arc(trail.start, trail.finish, math.min(progress, 1))
		local head = position + direction * state.radius
		local fade
		if comet then
			local ahead = SkyFx.arc(trail.start, trail.finish, math.min(progress + 0.01, 1)) - direction
			local tangent = ahead.Magnitude > 1e-6 and ahead.Unit or state.context.environment.Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
			local side = tangent:Cross(direction).Unit
			local size = cfg.size / 100
			local dust = (direction - tangent * 0.3 * size + side * 0.04 * size).Unit
			local ion = (direction - tangent * 0.42 * size - side * 0.02 * size).Unit
			trail.first.CFrame = state.context.environment.CFrame.fromMatrix(head, side, direction)
			trail.second.CFrame = state.context.environment.CFrame.fromMatrix(position + dust * state.radius, side, dust)
			trail.ion.Position = position + ion * state.radius
			fade = math.clamp(math.min(progress * trail.duration / 2.5, (1 - progress) * trail.duration / 3), 0, 1)
			local widths = {{0.022, 0.08}, {0.04, 0.15}, {0.065, 0.24}, {0.012, 0.03}, {0.026, 0.07}}
			local alphas = {0.75, 0.45, 0.25, 0.7, 0.3}
			local levels = {1.4, 0.9, 0.6, 1.8, 0.8}
			for index, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do
				beam.Width0, beam.Width1 = state.radius * size * widths[index][1], state.radius * size * widths[index][2]
				beam.CurveSize0, beam.CurveSize1 = index <= 3 and state.radius * 0.05 * size or 0, 0
				beam.Brightness = levels[index] * brightness
