				beam.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1 - alphas[index] * fade}, {1, 1}})
			end
			trail.flare.Brightness, trail.dust2.Brightness = 2.4 * brightness * fade, 2 * brightness * fade
		else
			local tail = position + SkyFx.arc(trail.start, trail.finish, math.clamp(progress - trail.tail, 0, 1)) * state.radius
			trail.first.Position, trail.second.Position = tail, head
			fade = math.clamp(math.min(progress / 0.12, (1 + trail.tail - progress) / (trail.tail + 0.2)), 0, 1)
			for index, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do
				beam.Width0, beam.Width1 = 0, state.radius * (index == 1 and 0.016 or 0.055)
				beam.Brightness = (index == 1 and 3.2 or 1.4) * brightness
				beam.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {1, 1 - fade * (index == 1 and 1 or 0.4)}})
			end
		end
		trail.head.CFrame = state.context.environment.CFrame.new(head)
		trail.glow.Brightness, trail.star.Brightness = 1.4 * brightness * fade, 3 * brightness * fade
		if progress > 0.95 and not comet then trail.dust.Enabled = false end
	end
end)

SkyFx.buildNet = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, folder)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.net
	local fx = {folder = folder, nodes = {}, links = {}, dirty = true, count = math.clamp(math.floor(cfg.nodes), 8, 140), place = cfg.place, linkClock = 1}
	local look = state.camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local forward = math.atan2(look.Z, look.X)
	for index = 1, fx.count do
		local part = SkyFx.part(state, folder, "Node")
		local attachment = SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", part)
		local emitter = SkyFx.emitter(state, part, index % 6 == 0 and SKY_FX_TEXTURES.spark or SKY_FX_TEXTURES.dot, {12}, nil, 2.8, true)
		local node = {part = part, attachment = attachment, emitter = emitter, big = index % 6 == 0,
			azimuth = math.random() < 0.75 and forward + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 1.25 or math.random() * math.pi * 2,
			elevation = math.rad(14 + math.random() * 58),
			drift = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.022, vertical = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.014,
			relative = env.Vector3.new((math.random() * 2 - 1) * 44, -10 + math.random() * 24, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 44),
			velocity = env.Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.4, math.random() * 2 - 1),
			nextEmit = state.time + math.random() * 6, hue = math.random()}
		table.insert(fx.nodes, node)
	end
	fx.cursorAnchor = SkyFx.part(state, folder, "CursorAnchor")
	fx.cursorAnchor.CFrame = env.CFrame.new()
	fx.cursor = SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", fx.cursorAnchor)
	for _ = 1, fx.count * 2 + 6 do
		local beam = SkyFx.beam(state, folder, nil, nil, 1.8)
		local rhythm = SkyFx.beam(state, folder, nil, nil, 3)
		rhythm.Texture, rhythm.TextureMode = SKY_FX_TEXTURES.rays, env.Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
		table.insert(fx.links, {beam = beam, rhythm = rhythm})
	end
	fx.shell = SkyFx.part(state, folder, "Constellations")
	fx.figures = {SkyFx.particle(state, fx.shell, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.const1, {9, 13}, nil, 1.8, true, true),
		SkyFx.particle(state, fx.shell, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.const2, {9, 13}, nil, 1.8, true, true)}
	return fx
end)

SkyFx.applyNet = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.net
	local sky, brightness = cfg.place ~= "Around me", state.cfg.general.bright / 100
	for _, node in ipairs(fx.nodes) do
		local size = sky and state.radius * (node.big and 0.06 or 0.036) or (node.big and 1.7 or 1)
		node.emitter.Size = env.NumberSequence.new(size)
		node.emitter.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color:Lerp(env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.45))
		node.emitter.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.15, 0}, {0.85, 0}, {1, 1}})
		node.emitter.Brightness = 2.8 * brightness
		if not node.seeded then node.seeded = true; node.emitter:Emit(1) end
	end
	for _, link in ipairs(fx.links) do
		local width = sky and state.radius * 0.0075 or 0.16
		link.beam.Width0, link.beam.Width1 = width, width
		link.rhythm.Width0, link.rhythm.Width1 = width * 1.9, width * 1.9
		link.rhythm.TextureLength, link.rhythm.TextureSpeed = sky and state.radius * 0.2 or 7, 0.35 + 0.6 * cfg.speed / 100
		link.beam.Color, link.rhythm.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color), env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color)
		link.beam.Brightness, link.rhythm.Brightness = 1.8 * brightness, 5 * brightness
	end
	fx.shell.Size = env.Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * math.min(state.radius * 1.9, 2040)
	for _, emitter in ipairs(fx.figures) do
		emitter.Size, emitter.Color = env.NumberSequence.new(state.radius * 0.2), env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color:Lerp(env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.4))
		emitter.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.25, 0.3}, {0.75, 0.3}, {1, 1}})
		emitter.Brightness, emitter.Rate, emitter.Enabled = 1.8 * brightness, 0.06, sky and cfg.figures
	end
	fx.linkClock = 1
end)

SkyFx.linkNet = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.net
	local sky = cfg.place ~= "Around me"
	local maxDistance = sky and 2 * state.radius * 0.92 * math.sin(math.rad(5 + 20 * cfg.reach / 100) / 2) or 10 + 24 * cfg.reach / 100
	local used, degrees = 0, {}
	local connect; connect = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(firstNode, attachment)
		if used >= #fx.links then return end
		used += 1
		local link = fx.links[used]
		link.beam.Attachment0, link.beam.Attachment1 = firstNode.attachment, attachment
		link.rhythm.Attachment0, link.rhythm.Attachment1 = firstNode.attachment, attachment
		link.beam.Enabled, link.rhythm.Enabled = true, cfg.rhythms
		local color = cfg.rainbow and env.Color3.fromHSV((firstNode.hue + state.time * 0.05) % 1, 0.6, 1) or cfg.color
		link.beam.Color, link.rhythm.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(color), env.ColorSequence.new(color)
	end)
	for first = 1, #fx.nodes do
		for second = first + 1, #fx.nodes do
			if (degrees[first] or 0) >= 4 then break end
			if (degrees[second] or 0) >= 4 then continue end
			local firstNode, secondNode = fx.nodes[first], fx.nodes[second]
			if (firstNode.position - secondNode.position).Magnitude > maxDistance then continue end
			degrees[first], degrees[second] = (degrees[first] or 0) + 1, (degrees[second] or 0) + 1
			connect(firstNode, secondNode.attachment)
		end
	end
	if fx.cursorPosition then
		local nearest = {}
		for _, node in ipairs(fx.nodes) do
			local distance = (node.position - fx.cursorPosition).Magnitude
			if distance <= maxDistance * 1.3 then table.insert(nearest, {node = node, distance = distance}) end
		end
		table.sort(nearest, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a, b) return a.distance < b.distance end))
		for index = 1, math.min(6, #nearest) do connect(nearest[index].node, fx.cursor) end
	end
	for index = used + 1, #fx.links do fx.links[index].beam.Enabled, fx.links[index].rhythm.Enabled = false, false end
end)

SkyFx.cursor = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx, position)
	if not state.cfg.net.cursor then return nil end
	local camera, input = state.camera, state.context.inputService
	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	local x, y = viewport.X / 2, viewport.Y / 2
	if input and input.MouseEnabled then
		local mouse = input:GetMouseLocation()
		x, y = mouse.X, mouse.Y
	end
	local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(x, y)
	if state.cfg.net.place == "Around me" then return ray.Origin + ray.Direction.Unit * 26 end
	if ray.Direction.Y <= -0.05 then return nil end
	return position + ray.Direction.Unit * state.radius * 0.92
end)

SkyFx.stepNet = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx, position, playerPosition, delta)
	local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.net
	local sky, speed = cfg.place ~= "Around me", cfg.speed / 100
	fx.shell.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(position)
	fx.cursorPosition = SkyFx.cursor(state, fx, position)
	if fx.cursorPosition then fx.cursor.Position = fx.cursorPosition end
	for _, node in ipairs(fx.nodes) do
		if sky then
			node.azimuth += node.drift * delta * speed
			node.elevation += node.vertical * delta * speed
			if node.elevation < math.rad(12) then node.vertical = math.abs(node.vertical) end
			if node.elevation > math.rad(74) then node.vertical = -math.abs(node.vertical) end
			node.position = position + SkyFx.direction(state, node.azimuth, node.elevation) * state.radius * 0.92
		else
			node.relative += node.velocity * delta * speed * 2.5
			local relative, velocity = node.relative, node.velocity
			if math.abs(relative.X) > 44 then velocity = env.Vector3.new(-math.sign(relative.X) * math.abs(velocity.X), velocity.Y, velocity.Z) end
			if relative.Y < -10 or relative.Y > 14 then velocity = env.Vector3.new(velocity.X, (relative.Y < 0 and 1 or -1) * math.abs(velocity.Y), velocity.Z) end
			if math.abs(relative.Z) > 44 then velocity = env.Vector3.new(velocity.X, velocity.Y, -math.sign(relative.Z) * math.abs(velocity.Z)) end
			node.velocity = velocity
			node.position = playerPosition + env.Vector3.new(0, 12, 0) + node.relative
		end
		node.part.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(node.position)
		if state.time >= node.nextEmit then node.emitter:Emit(1); node.nextEmit = state.time + 5 + math.random() * 3 end
	end
	fx.linkClock += delta
	if fx.linkClock >= 0.05 then fx.linkClock = 0; SkyFx.linkNet(state, fx) end
end)

SkyFx.drop = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name)
	local effect = state.effects[name]
	state.effects[name] = nil
	if effect and effect.folder then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() effect.folder:Destroy() end)) end
end)

SkyFx.clear = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state)
	for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do SkyFx.drop(state, name) end
	if state.folder then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() state.folder:Destroy() end)) end
	state.folder, state.camera = nil, nil
end)

SkyFx.dirty = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name)
	if name == "general" then
		for _, effect in pairs(state.effects) do effect.dirty = true end
		return
	end
	if state.effects[name] then state.effects[name].dirty = true end
end)

function SkyFx.set(state, name, key, value)
	local settings = state.cfg[name]
	if not settings then return end
	settings[key] = value
	SkyFx.dirty(state, name)
end

function SkyFx.setOn(state, name, enabled)
	local handle = state.controls[name]
	if handle and handle.Set then handle.Set(enabled); return end
	SkyFx.set(state, name, "on", enabled)
end

function SkyFx.scene(state, names)
	if not state.sceneSaved then
		state.sceneSaved = {}
		for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do state.sceneSaved[name] = state.cfg[name].on end
	end
	local selected = {}
	for _, name in ipairs(names or {}) do selected[name] = true end
	for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do SkyFx.setOn(state, name, selected[name] == true) end
	if state.paint then state.paint() end
end

function SkyFx.sceneEnd(state)
	local saved = state.sceneSaved
	state.sceneSaved = nil
	if not saved then return end
	for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do SkyFx.setOn(state, name, saved[name] == true) end
	if state.paint then state.paint() end
end

SkyFx.build = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name)
	local folder = SkyFx.create(state, "Folder", state.folder, {Name = name})
	local ok, effect = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		if name == "stars" or name == "runes" or name == "dust" then return SkyFx.buildParticles(state, name, folder) end
		if name == "net" then return SkyFx.buildNet(state, folder) end
		return SkyFx.buildTrails(state, name, folder)
	end))
	if ok then return effect end
	folder:Destroy()
	error(effect, 0)
end)

SkyFx.apply = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, effect)
	if name == "stars" then return SkyFx.applyStars(state, effect) end
	if name == "runes" then return SkyFx.applyRunes(state, effect) end
	if name == "dust" then return SkyFx.applyDust(state, effect) end
	if name == "net" then return SkyFx.applyNet(state, effect) end
	return SkyFx.applyTrails(state, name, effect)
end)

SkyFx.applySquash = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, effect)
	local env = state.context.environment
	local squash = env.NumberSequence.new(state.squash)
	for _, object in ipairs(effect.folder:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() object.Squash = squash end)) end
	end
	local rotated = state.squash <= 0.05
	if name == "stars" then
		effect.big.Rotation = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(-20, 20) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0)
		effect.big.RotSpeed = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(-12, 12) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	end
	if name == "runes" then effect.main.Rotation = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(-10, 10) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0) end
	if name == "dust" then
		effect.main.Rotation = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(0, 45) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0)
		effect.main.RotSpeed = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(-30, 30) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0)
	end
end)

SkyFx.stepEffect = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, effect, position, look, playerPosition, delta)
	local env = state.context.environment
	if name == "stars" then effect.part.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(position); return end
	if name == "runes" then effect.part.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(playerPosition + env.Vector3.new(0, 9, 0)); return end
	if name == "dust" then effect.part.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(playerPosition + env.Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)); return end
	if name == "net" then return SkyFx.stepNet(state, effect, position, playerPosition, delta) end
	return SkyFx.stepTrails(state, name, effect, position, look)
end)

SkyFx.step = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, delta)
	local context = state.context
	if not context.isAlive() then SkyFx.clear(state); return end
	local active = false
	for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do if state.cfg[name].on then active = true; break end end
	local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not active or not camera then if state.folder then SkyFx.clear(state) end; return end
	if not state.folder or state.camera ~= camera or state.folder.Parent ~= camera then
		SkyFx.clear(state)
		state.folder = SkyFx.create(state, "Folder", camera, {Name = "RhythmSkyFX"})
		state.camera = camera
	end
	delta = math.clamp(tonumber(delta) or 1 / 60, 0, 0.1)
	state.time += delta
	state.environmentClock += delta
	if state.environmentClock >= 0.5 then
		state.environmentClock = 0
		local atmosphere = context.lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
		local radius = math.clamp(atmosphere and 72 / math.max(atmosphere.Density, 0.04) or context.lighting.FogEnd * 0.5, 110, 520)
		if math.abs(radius - state.radius) / state.radius > 0.08 then state.radius = radius; SkyFx.dirty(state, "general") end
		local stretch = context.configuration.ui and tonumber(context.configuration.ui.stretch) or 0
		local squash = stretch > 0 and math.floor(-math.log(math.max(0.1, 1 - stretch / 100 * 0.6), 2) * 100 + 0.5) / 100 or 0
		if math.abs(squash - state.squash) > 0.02 then state.squash = squash; SkyFx.dirty(state, "general") end
	end
	local frame, character = camera.CFrame, context.player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local playerPosition = root and root.Position or frame.Position
	for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do
		local cfg, effect = state.cfg[name], state.effects[name]
		if not cfg.on then if effect then SkyFx.drop(state, name) end; continue end
		if name == "net" and effect and (effect.count ~= math.clamp(math.floor(cfg.nodes), 8, 140) or effect.place ~= cfg.place) then
			SkyFx.drop(state, name)
			effect = nil
		end
		if not effect and state.time >= (state.failures[name] or 0) then
			local ok, result = pcall(SkyFx.build, state, name)
			if ok then effect = result; state.effects[name] = effect
			else state.failures[name] = state.time + 5; context.environment.warn("[CrackHub] sky fx " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(result)) end
		end
		if not effect then continue end
		if effect.dirty then
			effect.dirty = false
			local ok, message = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
				SkyFx.apply(state, name, effect)
				SkyFx.applySquash(state, name, effect)
			end))
			if not ok then context.environment.warn("[CrackHub] sky fx " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(message)) end
		end
		local ok, message = pcall(SkyFx.stepEffect, state, name, effect, frame.Position, frame.LookVector, playerPosition, delta)
		if not ok then
			state.failures[name] = state.time + 5
			SkyFx.drop(state, name)
			context.environment.warn("[CrackHub] sky fx " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(message))
		end
	end
end)

function SkyFx.gallery(state)
	local context, env = state.context, state.context.environment
	local container = context.section:Container()
	if not container then return end
	local create = context.create
	local frame = create("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = env.UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = env.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y}, container)
	create("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = env.UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 76), CellPadding = env.UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
		SortOrder = env.Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, frame)
	local labels = {"Stars", "Shooting Stars", "Comets", "Constellations", "Runes", "Stardust"}
	local colors = {{{70, 90, 150}, {12, 16, 40}}, {{150, 200, 255}, {14, 20, 46}}, {{110, 210, 255}, {16, 22, 50}},
		{{150, 205, 255}, {14, 18, 44}}, {{130, 220, 255}, {18, 30, 54}}, {{255, 214, 120}, {40, 28, 20}}}
	local ok, atlas = pcall(CrackHubEffectAsset, env, "sky_fx_v6.jpg")
	if not ok then atlas = nil end
	local tiles = {}
	for index, key in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do
		local button = create("TextButton", {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = index,
			BackgroundColor3 = env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}, frame)
		context.corner(button, 12)
		create("UIGradient", {Color = env.ColorSequence.new(env.Color3.fromRGB(table.unpack(colors[index][1])),
			env.Color3.fromRGB(table.unpack(colors[index][2]))), Rotation = 35}, button)
		local picture = create("ImageLabel", {Name = "Photo", Size = env.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			ScaleType = env.Enum.ScaleType.Stretch, Visible = atlas ~= nil, Image = atlas or "", ZIndex = 2}, button)
		context.corner(picture, 12)
		picture.ImageRectOffset = env.Vector2.new((index - 1) % 4 * 256, math.floor((index - 1) / 4) * 128)
		picture.ImageRectSize = env.Vector2.new(256, 128)
		local shade = create("Frame", {AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = env.UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -5),
			Size = env.UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 20), BackgroundColor3 = env.Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3}, button)
		context.corner(shade, 7)
		local label = context.nova.label({Parent = shade, Text = context.translation.tr(labels[index]), Font = context.nova.Font.Semi(), Size = 12,
			Pos = env.UDim2.fromOffset(7, 0), Box = env.UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0), Truncate = true, Color = "Text", Z = 4})
		context.translation.bind(label, labels[index])
		local stroke = create("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.8, ApplyStrokeMode = env.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, button)
		context.nova.Theme.bind(stroke, "Color", "Glass")
		local tile = {key = key, stroke = stroke, hover = false}
		table.insert(tiles, tile)
		context.connect(button.MouseButton1Click, function() SkyFx.setOn(state, key, not state.cfg[key].on); state.paint() end)
		context.connect(button.MouseEnter, function() tile.hover = true; state.paint() end)
		context.connect(button.MouseLeave, function() tile.hover = false; state.paint() end)
	end
	state.paint = function()
		for _, tile in ipairs(tiles) do
			local selected = state.cfg[tile.key].on
			context.nova.paint(tile.stroke, "Color", (selected or tile.hover) and "Accent" or "Glass", "Quick")
			tile.stroke.Transparency, tile.stroke.Thickness = selected and 0 or (tile.hover and 0.35 or 0.8), selected and 2 or 1
		end
	end
	state.paint()
end

function SkyFx.install(context)
	local env, section = context.environment, context.section
	local state = {context = context, cfg = SkyFx.defaults(env), palettes = SkyFx.palettes(env), controls = {}, effects = {}, failures = {},
		time = 0, environmentClock = 1, radius = 160, squash = 0}
	local function slider(text, group, key, min, max, suffix)
		section:Slider({Text = text, Min = min, Max = max, Decimals = 0, Suffix = suffix, Default = state.cfg[group][key],
			Callback = function(value) SkyFx.set(state, group, key, value) end})
	end
	local function dropdown(text, group, key, values)
		local options = {}
		for _, value in ipairs(values) do table.insert(options, {code = value, label = value}) end
		section:Dropdown({Text = text, Default = state.cfg[group][key], Options = options, Callback = function(value)
			if value then SkyFx.set(state, group, key, value) end
		end})
	end
	local function color(text, group, key)
		section:Colorpicker({Text = text, Default = state.cfg[group][key], Callback = function(value)
			if env.typeof(value) == "Color3" then SkyFx.set(state, group, key, value) end
		end})
	end
	local function toggle(text, key, children)
		state.controls[key] = section:Toggle({Text = text, Default = false, Settings = children, Callback = function(value)
			SkyFx.set(state, key, "on", value == true)
			if state.paint then state.paint() end
		end})
	end
	section:Sub("SkyFX")
	section:Columns()
	section:Group({Title = "Sky Effects", Side = "Left", Pin = true})
	pcall(SkyFx.gallery, state)
	section:Group({Title = "Sky Settings", Side = "Left", Pin = true})
	slider("Effect brightness", "general", "bright", 30, 200, "%")
	section:Button({Text = "Turn all off", Callback = function()
		for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do SkyFx.setOn(state, name, false) end
		if state.paint then state.paint() end
	end})
	section:Group({Title = "Night Sky", Side = "Right", Pin = true})
	toggle("Stars", "stars", function()
		slider("Star density", "stars", "density", 10, 100, "%")
		slider("Star size", "stars", "size", 50, 200, "%")
		slider("Twinkle", "stars", "twinkle", 0, 100, "%")
		dropdown("Star color", "stars", "tint", {"Natural", "Cold", "Warm", "Pastel", "Rainbow"})
	end)
	toggle("Shooting Stars", "meteors", function()
		slider("Meteor frequency", "meteors", "rate", 5, 100, "%")
		slider("Tail length", "meteors", "length", 40, 200, "%")
		color("Meteor color", "meteors", "color")
	end)
	toggle("Comets", "comets", function()
		slider("Comet frequency", "comets", "rate", 5, 100, "%")
		slider("Comet size", "comets", "size", 50, 200, "%")
		color("Comet color", "comets", "color")
	end)
	section:Group({Title = "Magic", Side = "Right", Pin = true})
	toggle("Constellations", "net", function()
		dropdown("Placement", "net", "place", {"Sky", "Around me"})
		slider("Node count", "net", "nodes", 20, 140)
		slider("Link distance", "net", "reach", 0, 100, "%")
		slider("Drift speed", "net", "speed", 0, 100, "%")
		color("Line color", "net", "color")
		for _, entry in ipairs({{"Energy rhythms", "rhythms", true}, {"Follow cursor", "cursor", true},
			{"Rainbow lines", "rainbow", false}, {"Star figures", "figures", true}}) do
			section:Toggle({Text = entry[1], Default = entry[3], Callback = function(value) SkyFx.set(state, "net", entry[2], value == true) end})
		end
	end)
	toggle("Runes", "runes", function()
		slider("Rune amount", "runes", "amount", 10, 100, "%")
		slider("Rune size", "runes", "size", 50, 200, "%")
		dropdown("Rune set", "runes", "set", {"Runes", "Glyphs"})
		color("Rune color", "runes", "color")
	end)
	toggle("Stardust", "dust", function()
		slider("Dust amount", "dust", "amount", 10, 100, "%")
		dropdown("Dust color", "dust", "palette", {"Gold", "Silver", "Pink", "Aqua", "Rainbow"})
	end)
	local api = {cfg = state.cfg, scene = function(names) SkyFx.scene(state, names) end, sceneEnd = function() SkyFx.sceneEnd(state) end,
		set = function(group, key, value) SkyFx.set(state, group, key, value) end}
	env.getgenv().__crackhubSkyFx = api
	if state.paint then state.paint() end
	if context.runService.RenderStepped then context.connect(context.runService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(delta)
		local ok, message = pcall(SkyFx.step, state, delta)
		if not ok then env.warn("[CrackHub] sky fx step: " .. tostring(message)) end
	end)) end
	return state, function()
		SkyFx.clear(state)
		if env.getgenv().__crackhubSkyFx == api then env.getgenv().__crackhubSkyFx = nil end
	end
end


local CustomCursor = {}
local CURSOR_SHAPES = {{"Dot", "Dot"}, {"Ring", "Ring"}, {"Crosshair", "Cross"}, {"Gap", "Gap Cross"}, {"GapDot", "Gap Dot"},
	{"RingDot", "Ring Dot"}, {"Diag", "Diagonal"}, {"Brackets", "Brackets"}, {"Tri", "Tri"}, {"Diamond", "Diamond"},
	{"Square", "Square"}, {"Heart", "Heart"}, {"PP", "PP"}}
local CURSOR_ASSETS = {11719595104, 11810229301, 12233185690, 12275825245, 6239163275, 11830989304, 11747999946, 11723817205,
	11988231127, 8390115370, 5143056985, 3259050989, 51838212, 8360620314, 11867337948, 11915656516, 11867351018, 12232793816,
	11747026230, 10696045527, 7051824015, 11718192673, 11121461899, 11756692076, 11756696859}


function CustomCursor.images()
	local result = {}
	for _, id in ipairs(CURSOR_ASSETS) do table.insert(result, "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)) end

	return result
end

function CustomCursor.initialize(settings, env)
	local defaults = {cursor = "Off", cursorSize = 100, cursorFade = 0, cursorOutline = true, cursorTint = false,
		cursorRainbow = false, cursorRainbowSpd = 3, cursorRhythm = false, cursorRhythmSpd = 3, cursorRhythmAmt = 20,
		cursorSpin = false, cursorSpinSpd = 180, cursorSpinRev = false, cursorClick = false, cursorClickAmt = 30}
	for key, value in pairs(defaults) do if settings[key] == nil then settings[key] = value end end
	if not tonumber(settings.cursorR) then
		local color = env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		if settings.cursor ~= "Off" and tonumber(settings.cursorHue) then
			local brightness = tonumber(settings.cursorBright) or 100
			color = env.Color3.fromHSV(tonumber(settings.cursorHue) % 360 / 360, brightness <= 2 and 0 or 0.85, brightness / 100)
		end
		settings.cursorR, settings.cursorG, settings.cursorB = math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)
	end
end

function CustomCursor.valid(state, name)
	if name == "Off" then return true end
	for _, shape in ipairs(CURSOR_SHAPES) do if shape[1] == name then return true end end
	if type(name) ~= "string" then return false end
	local index = tonumber(name:match("^I(%d+)$") or "")
	return index ~= nil and state.images[index] ~= nil
end

CustomCursor.color = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, now)
	local env, settings = state.context.environment, state.settings
	if settings.cursorRainbow then return env.Color3.fromHSV(now * (tonumber(settings.cursorRainbowSpd) or 3) * 0.06 % 1, 0.8, 1) end
	return env.Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(settings.cursorR) or 255, tonumber(settings.cursorG) or 255, tonumber(settings.cursorB) or 255)
end)

CustomCursor.scale = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, now, clicked, base)
	local settings, value = state.settings, base
	if settings.cursorRhythm then
		local speed = (tonumber(settings.cursorRhythmSpd) or 3) * 0.35
		value *= 1 + math.clamp((tonumber(settings.cursorRhythmAmt) or 20) / 100, 0, 1) * math.sin(now * speed * math.pi * 2)
	end
	local elapsed = now - clicked
	if settings.cursorClick and elapsed >= 0 and elapsed < 0.24 then
		value *= 1 - math.clamp((tonumber(settings.cursorClickAmt) or 30) / 100, 0, 0.9) * math.sin(elapsed / 0.24 * math.pi)
	end
	return math.max(value, 0.05)
end)

function CustomCursor.element(state, parent, x, y, width, height, rotation, rounded, zIndex)
	local env = state.context.environment
	local frame = env.Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.BorderSizePixel, frame.AnchorPoint = 0, env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.Position, frame.Size = env.UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0.5, y), env.UDim2.fromOffset(width, height)
	frame.Rotation, frame.ZIndex = rotation or 0, zIndex or 3
	if rounded then
		local corner = env.Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius, corner.Parent = env.UDim.new(rounded, 0), frame
	end
	frame.Parent = parent
	return frame
end

function CustomCursor.draw(state, parent, shape)
	local env = state.context.environment
	for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do if not child:IsA("UIScale") then child:Destroy() end end
	local parts = {}
	local function fill(x, y, width, height, rotation, rounded, noOutline)
		local outline
		if not noOutline then
			outline = CustomCursor.element(state, parent, x, y, width + 2, height + 2, rotation, rounded, 2)
			outline.BackgroundColor3 = env.Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		end
		local frame = CustomCursor.element(state, parent, x, y, width, height, rotation, rounded, 3)
		table.insert(parts, {kind = "fill", frame = frame, outline = outline})
	end
	local function ring(x, y, size, thickness, rotation, square)
		local rounded = not square and 0.5 or nil
		local outline = CustomCursor.element(state, parent, x, y, size - 2, size - 2, rotation, rounded, 2)
		outline.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		local outerStroke = env.Instance.new("UIStroke")
		outerStroke.Color, outerStroke.Thickness, outerStroke.Parent = env.Color3.new(0, 0, 0), thickness + 2, outline
		local frame = CustomCursor.element(state, parent, x, y, size, size, rotation, rounded, 3)
		frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		local stroke = env.Instance.new("UIStroke")
		stroke.Thickness, stroke.Parent = thickness, frame
		table.insert(parts, {kind = "ring", frame = frame, stroke = stroke, outline = outline, outerStroke = outerStroke})
	end
	if shape == "Dot" then fill(0, 0, 6, 6, 0, 0.5) end
	if shape == "Ring" then ring(0, 0, 14, 2) end
	if shape == "Crosshair" then fill(0, 0, 18, 2); fill(0, 0, 2, 18) end
	if shape == "Gap" or shape == "GapDot" then
		fill(7, 0, 8, 2); fill(-7, 0, 8, 2); fill(0, 7, 2, 8); fill(0, -7, 2, 8)
		if shape == "GapDot" then fill(0, 0, 2, 2) end
	end
	if shape == "RingDot" then ring(0, 0, 16, 2); fill(0, 0, 4, 4, 0, 0.5) end
	if shape == "Diag" then fill(5, 5, 8, 2, 45); fill(-5, -5, 8, 2, 45); fill(5, -5, 8, 2, -45); fill(-5, 5, 8, 2, -45) end
	if shape == "Brackets" then
		for _, x in ipairs({-1, 1}) do for _, y in ipairs({-1, 1}) do fill(x * 7, y * 9, 6, 2); fill(x * 9, y * 7, 2, 6) end end
		fill(0, 0, 2, 2)
	end
	if shape == "Tri" then fill(0, -8, 8, 2, 90); fill(7, 4, 8, 2, 30); fill(-7, 4, 8, 2, 150) end
	if shape == "Diamond" then ring(0, 0, 12, 2, 45, true) end
	if shape == "Square" then ring(0, 0, 14, 2, 0, true); fill(0, 0, 2, 2) end
	if shape == "Heart" then fill(-4, -3, 10, 10, 0, 0.5, true); fill(4, -3, 10, 10, 0, 0.5, true); fill(0, 2, 12, 12, 45, nil, true) end
	if shape == "PP" then
		fill(0, -2, 8, 22, 0, 1, true); fill(0, -14, 10, 10, 0, 1, true)
		fill(-5, 10, 8, 8, 0, 1, true); fill(5, 10, 8, 8, 0, 1, true)
	end
	local index = type(shape) == "string" and tonumber(shape:match("^I(%d+)$") or "") or nil
	if index and state.images[index] then
		local image = env.Instance.new("ImageLabel")
		image.BackgroundTransparency, image.AnchorPoint, image.Position = 1, env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), env.UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		image.Size, image.ScaleType, image.ZIndex, image.Image = env.UDim2.fromOffset(32, 32), env.Enum.ScaleType.Fit, 3, state.images[index]
		image.Parent = parent
		table.insert(parts, {kind = "image", frame = image})
	end
	return parts
end

CustomCursor.paint = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, parts, color, preview)
	local settings, env = state.settings, state.context.environment
	local fade = preview and 0 or math.clamp((tonumber(settings.cursorFade) or 0) / 100, 0, 0.95)
	local showOutline = preview or settings.cursorOutline ~= false
	local outlineFade = 1 - (1 - fade) * 0.6
	for _, part in ipairs(parts or {}) do
		if part.kind == "fill" then
			part.frame.BackgroundColor3, part.frame.BackgroundTransparency = color, fade
			if part.outline then part.outline.Visible, part.outline.BackgroundTransparency = showOutline, outlineFade end
			continue
		end
		if part.kind == "ring" then
			part.stroke.Color, part.stroke.Transparency = color, fade
			part.outline.Visible, part.outerStroke.Transparency = showOutline, outlineFade
			continue
		end
		part.frame.ImageColor3 = settings.cursorTint and not preview and color or env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		part.frame.ImageTransparency = fade
	end
end)

CustomCursor.native = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, hidden)
	local input = state.context.inputService
	if hidden then
		if not state.hidden or input.MouseIconEnabled then state.hidden = true; pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() input.MouseIconEnabled = false end)) end
		return
	end
	if state.hidden then state.hidden = false; pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() input.MouseIconEnabled = true end)) end
end)

function CustomCursor.ensure(state)
	if state.gui and state.gui.Parent then return end
	local env, context = state.context.environment, state.context
	local gui = env.Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.DisplayOrder = "RhythmCursor", false, 2147483000
	gui.ZIndexBehavior, gui.IgnoreGuiInset = env.Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, true
	pcall(function() gui.Parent = context.coreGui end)
	if not gui.Parent then pcall(function() gui.Parent = context.player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end) end
	local frame = env.Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name, frame.BackgroundTransparency, frame.AnchorPoint = "K", 1, env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	frame.Size, frame.Visible, frame.Parent = env.UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64), false, gui
	local scale = env.Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Parent = frame
	state.gui, state.frame, state.scaleObject = gui, frame, scale
end

function CustomCursor.repaint(state)
	local color = CustomCursor.color(state, os.clock())
	CustomCursor.paint(state, state.parts, color, false)
	CustomCursor.paint(state, state.previewParts, color, false)
	if state.paintPreview then state.paintPreview() end
end

function CustomCursor.build(state)
	CustomCursor.ensure(state)
	state.parts = CustomCursor.draw(state, state.frame, state.settings.cursor)
	if state.preview then state.previewParts = CustomCursor.draw(state, state.preview, state.settings.cursor) end
	CustomCursor.repaint(state)
end

function CustomCursor.select(state, shape)
	if not CustomCursor.valid(state, shape) then shape = "Off" end
	state.settings.cursor = shape
	CustomCursor.build(state)
	if state.paintCells then state.paintCells() end
end

CustomCursor.step = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, delta, now)
	local context, settings, env = state.context, state.settings, state.context.environment
	if settings.cursorSpin then
		state.rotation = (state.rotation + delta * (tonumber(settings.cursorSpinSpd) or 180) * (settings.cursorSpinRev and -1 or 1)) % 360
	else state.rotation = 0 end
	local color = settings.cursorRainbow and CustomCursor.color(state, now) or nil
	if state.preview and settings.cursor ~= "Off" and (not context.window or context.window.Visible ~= false) then
		state.preview.Rotation = state.rotation
		state.previewScale.Scale = math.min(CustomCursor.scale(state, now, state.previewClickAt, math.clamp((tonumber(settings.cursorSize) or 100) / 100, 0.4, 3)), 2.1)
		if color then CustomCursor.paint(state, state.previewParts, color, false) end
	end
	if settings.cursor == "Off" or not state.frame then
		if state.frame then state.frame.Visible = false end
		CustomCursor.native(state, false)
		return
	end
	local mouse = context.inputService.MouseEnabled
	CustomCursor.native(state, mouse)
	state.frame.Visible = mouse
	if not mouse then return end
	local location = context.inputService:GetMouseLocation()
	state.frame.Position, state.frame.Rotation = env.UDim2.fromOffset(location.X, location.Y), state.rotation
	state.scaleObject.Scale = CustomCursor.scale(state, now, state.clickAt, math.clamp((tonumber(settings.cursorSize) or 100) / 100, 0.2, 4))
	if color then CustomCursor.paint(state, state.parts, color, false) end
end)

function CustomCursor.gallery(state)
	local context, env = state.context, state.context.environment
	local section, create = context.section, context.create
	local hero = create("Frame", {Name = "CursorHero", Size = env.UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 92), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, section:Container())
	local previewButton = create("TextButton", {Position = env.UDim2.fromOffset(0, 4), Size = env.UDim2.fromOffset(84, 84),
		BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", ClipsDescendants = true}, hero)
	context.corner(previewButton, 14)
	context.nova.Theme.bind(previewButton, "BackgroundColor3", "Surface2")
	local outline = create("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.86, ApplyStrokeMode = env.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, previewButton)
	context.nova.Theme.bind(outline, "Color", "Glass")
	state.preview = create("Frame", {AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = env.UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = env.UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2}, previewButton)
	state.previewScale = create("UIScale", {}, state.preview)
	local placeholder = context.nova.icon({Parent = previewButton, Icon = "mouse-pointer-2", Size = 24, Pos = env.UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Anchor = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Color = "Faint", Z = 2})
	local title = context.nova.label({Parent = hero, Text = "", Font = context.nova.Font.Bold(), Size = 15, Pos = env.UDim2.fromOffset(98, 12),
		Box = env.UDim2.new(1, -98, 0, 20), Truncate = true, Color = "Text"})
	local detail = context.nova.label({Parent = hero, Text = "", Font = context.nova.Font.Medium(), Size = 12, Pos = env.UDim2.fromOffset(98, 34),
		Box = env.UDim2.new(1, -98, 0, 16), Truncate = true, Color = "Muted"})
	local off = create("TextButton", {Position = env.UDim2.fromOffset(98, 58), Size = env.UDim2.fromOffset(75, 24), BorderSizePixel = 0,
		AutoButtonColor = false, Text = context.translation.tr("Turn off")}, hero)
	context.corner(off, 8)
	context.nova.Theme.bind(off, "BackgroundColor3", "Elevated")
	context.nova.Theme.bind(off, "TextColor3", "Text")
	state.paintPreview = function()
		local shape, settings = state.settings.cursor, state.settings
		local name = "Off"
		for _, item in ipairs(CURSOR_SHAPES) do if item[1] == shape then name = item[2]; break end end
		local index = type(shape) == "string" and shape:match("^I(%d+)$")
		if index then name = context.translation.tr("Image") .. " #" .. index else name = context.translation.tr(name) end
		title.Text, placeholder.ImageTransparency, off.Visible = name, shape == "Off" and 0 or 1, shape ~= "Off"
		local details = {context.translation.tr("Size") .. " " .. tostring(math.floor((tonumber(settings.cursorSize) or 100) + 0.5)) .. "%"}
		for _, item in ipairs({{"cursorSpin", "Spin"}, {"cursorRhythm", "Rhythm"}, {"cursorRainbow", "Rainbow"}, {"cursorClick", "Bounce"}}) do
			if settings[item[1]] then table.insert(details, context.translation.tr(item[2])) end
		end
		detail.Text = table.concat(details, " В· ")
		context.nova.paint(outline, "Color", shape ~= "Off" and "Accent" or "Glass", "Quick")
		outline.Transparency = shape ~= "Off" and 0.45 or 0.86
	end
	context.connect(previewButton.MouseButton1Click, function() state.previewClickAt = os.clock() end)
	context.connect(off.MouseButton1Click, function() CustomCursor.select(state, "Off") end)
	local tabs = create("Frame", {Name = "CursorCategories", Size = env.UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, section:Container())
	local grids, buttons = {}, {}
	for index, category in ipairs({"Shapes", "Crosshairs"}) do
		local button = create("TextButton", {Position = env.UDim2.new((index - 1) * 0.5, 0, 0, 0), Size = env.UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, 0),
			Text = context.translation.tr(category), AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0}, tabs)
		context.corner(button, 8)
		context.nova.Theme.bind(button, "BackgroundColor3", "Surface2")
		context.nova.Theme.bind(button, "TextColor3", "Text")
		context.translation.bind(button, category)
		buttons[category] = button
		local frame = create("Frame", {Name = "Cursor" .. category, Size = env.UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = env.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false}, section:Container())
		local layout = create("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = env.UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46), CellPadding = env.UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), SortOrder = env.Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, frame)
		grids[category] = {frame = frame, layout = layout, built = false}
	end
	state.cells = {}
	state.paintCells = function()
		for key, cell in pairs(state.cells) do
			local selected = key == state.settings.cursor
			context.nova.paint(cell.button, "BackgroundColor3", selected and "Accent" or "Surface2", "Quick")
			context.nova.paint(cell.stroke, "Color", (selected or cell.hover) and "Accent" or "Glass", "Quick")
			cell.button.BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0.82 or 0
			cell.stroke.Transparency, cell.stroke.Thickness = selected and 0.15 or (cell.hover and 0.5 or 0.86), selected and 1.5 or 1
			cell.check.Visible = selected
		end
	end
	local function addCell(parent, order, key)
		local previewScale
		local button = create("TextButton", {Name = "C" .. key, LayoutOrder = order, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "",
			BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true}, parent)
		context.corner(button, 10)
		context.nova.Theme.bind(button, "BackgroundColor3", "Surface2")
		local stroke = create("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.86, ApplyStrokeMode = env.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, button)
		context.nova.Theme.bind(stroke, "Color", "Glass")
		if key == "Off" then
			context.nova.icon({Parent = button, Icon = "ban", Size = 18, Pos = env.UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
				Anchor = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Color = "Muted", Z = 2})
		else
			local imageIndex = tonumber(key:match("^I(%d+)$") or "")
			if imageIndex then
				create("ImageLabel", {AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = env.UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Size = env.UDim2.fromScale(0.68, 0.68), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ScaleType = env.Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
					Image = state.images[imageIndex], ZIndex = 2}, button)
			else
				local preview = create("Frame", {AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = env.UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
					Size = env.UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2}, button)
				previewScale = create("UIScale", {Scale = 0.65}, preview)
				CustomCursor.paint(state, CustomCursor.draw(state, preview, key), env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), true)
			end
		end
		local check = create("Frame", {AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = env.UDim2.new(1, -3, 0, 3),
			Size = env.UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 4}, button)
		context.corner(check, 7)
		context.nova.Theme.bind(check, "BackgroundColor3", "Accent")
		context.nova.icon({Parent = check, Icon = "check", Size = 10, Pos = env.UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Anchor = env.Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Color = "OnAccent", Z = 5})
		local cell = {button = button, stroke = stroke, check = check, previewScale = previewScale, hover = false}
		state.cells[key] = cell
		context.connect(button.MouseButton1Click, function() CustomCursor.select(state, key) end)
		context.connect(button.MouseEnter, function() cell.hover = true; state.paintCells() end)
		context.connect(button.MouseLeave, function() cell.hover = false; state.paintCells() end)
	end
	local function resize()
		local grid = grids[state.category or "Shapes"]
		local scale = context.window and context.window.Scale and context.window.Scale.Scale or 1
		local width = grid.frame.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(scale, 0.1)
		if width < 60 then return end
		local columns = math.max(4, math.floor((width + 8) / 54))
		local cellSize = math.floor((width - 8 * (columns - 1)) / columns)
		for _, item in pairs(grids) do item.layout.CellSize = env.UDim2.fromOffset(cellSize, cellSize) end
		for _, item in pairs(state.cells) do
			if item.previewScale then item.previewScale.Scale = math.clamp(cellSize / 64 * 0.9, 0.3, 1.2) end
		end
	end
	for _, grid in pairs(grids) do pcall(function()
		context.connect(grid.frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), resize)
	end) end
	local function show(category)
		state.category = category
		local grid = grids[category]
		if not grid.built then
			grid.built = true
			if category == "Shapes" then
				addCell(grid.frame, 0, "Off")
				for index, item in ipairs(CURSOR_SHAPES) do addCell(grid.frame, index, item[1]) end
			else
				for index in ipairs(state.images) do addCell(grid.frame, index, "I" .. index) end
			end
		end
		for name, value in pairs(grids) do
			value.frame.Visible = name == category
			context.nova.paint(buttons[name], "BackgroundColor3", name == category and "Accent" or "Surface2", "Quick")
		end
		state.paintCells()
		pcall(resize)
	end
	for category, button in pairs(buttons) do context.connect(button.MouseButton1Click, function() show(category) end) end
	show(state.settings.cursor:match("^I%d+$") and "Crosshairs" or "Shapes")
	state.paintPreview()
end

function CustomCursor.install(context)
	local env, section = context.environment, context.section
	local settings = context.configuration.optim
	CustomCursor.initialize(settings, env)
	local state = {context = context, settings = settings, images = CustomCursor.images(), parts = {}, previewParts = {},
		rotation = 0, clickAt = -9, previewClickAt = -9, hidden = false}
	if not CustomCursor.valid(state, settings.cursor) then settings.cursor = "Off" end
	section:Header("Custom Cursor")
	local galleryReady, galleryError = pcall(CustomCursor.gallery, state)
    if not galleryReady then
        warn("[CrackHub] Custom Cursor gallery: " .. tostring(galleryError))
        state.preview, state.previewScale, state.paintPreview, state.paintCells = nil, nil, nil, nil
        section:Note({Text="Cursor preview could not load: " .. tostring(galleryError)})
    end
	local function slider(text, key, min, max, suffix)
		section:Slider({Text = text, Min = min, Max = max, Decimals = 0, Suffix = suffix, Default = settings[key], Callback = function(value)
			settings[key] = value
			CustomCursor.repaint(state)
		end})
	end
	local function toggle(text, key, children)
		section:Toggle({Text = text, Default = settings[key] == true, Settings = children, Callback = function(value)
			settings[key] = value == true
			CustomCursor.repaint(state)
		end})
	end
	slider("Cursor Size", "cursorSize", 40, 300, "%")
	slider("Cursor Transparency", "cursorFade", 0, 90, "%")
	section:Colorpicker({Text = "Cursor Color", Default = env.Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(settings.cursorR) or 255, tonumber(settings.cursorG) or 255, tonumber(settings.cursorB) or 255), Callback = function(color)
		if env.typeof(color) ~= "Color3" then return end
		settings.cursorR, settings.cursorG, settings.cursorB = math.floor(color.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(color.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(color.B * 255 + 0.5)
		CustomCursor.repaint(state)
	end})
	toggle("Cursor Outline", "cursorOutline")
	toggle("Recolor Images", "cursorTint")
	toggle("Rainbow Cursor", "cursorRainbow", function() slider("Rainbow Speed", "cursorRainbowSpd", 1, 10) end)
	toggle("Cursor Pulse", "cursorRhythm", function() slider("Pulse Speed", "cursorRhythmSpd", 1, 10); slider("Pulse Size", "cursorRhythmAmt", 5, 80, "%") end)
	toggle("Cursor Spin", "cursorSpin", function() slider("Spin Speed", "cursorSpinSpd", 10, 1080, "В°"); toggle("Reverse Spin", "cursorSpinRev") end)
	toggle("Click Bounce", "cursorClick", function() slider("Bounce Size", "cursorClickAmt", 5, 80, "%") end)
	if context.inputService.InputBegan then context.connect(context.inputService.InputBegan, function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == env.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then state.clickAt = os.clock() end
	end) end
	if context.runService.RenderStepped then context.connect(context.runService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(delta)
		CustomCursor.step(state, delta, os.clock())
	end)) end
	table.insert(context.applyHooks, function()
		if not CustomCursor.valid(state, settings.cursor) then settings.cursor = "Off" end
		pcall(CustomCursor.build, state)
		if state.paintCells then state.paintCells() end
	end)
	env.task.defer(function() if context.isAlive() then pcall(CustomCursor.build, state) end end)
	return state, function()
		CustomCursor.native(state, false)
		if state.gui then pcall(function() state.gui:Destroy() end) end
	end
end


local function tridentOutcome(attackerRole, targetRole)
    if attackerRole == "murderer" then return "knife" end
    if (attackerRole == "sheriff" or attackerRole == "hero") and targetRole == "murderer" then
        return "gun"
    end
    return "fling"
end

local function InstallBodyguard(window, tab, combat)
    -- Angel and Demon companions, plus the locally rendered trident.
    local connections, companions = {}, {}
    local catalogModels, catalogStatus = {}, {}
    local alive = true
    local cfg = { Size = 3.8, Angel = { Show = true, Effects = true, HeadHeight = -1.2, AutoDodge = true }, Demon = { Show = false, Effects = true, HeadHeight = -1.2 } }
    local ANGEL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 92)
    local DEMON_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(235, 48, 64)
    local C, A = CFrame.new, CFrame.Angles

    local worldFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    worldFolder.Name = "CrackHub_Companions"
    worldFolder.Parent = workspace

    local function connect(signal, callback)
        local c = signal:Connect(callback)
        table.insert(connections, c)
        return c
    end

    local statusLabels = {}
    local function updateStatus()
        for kind, label in pairs(statusLabels) do
            label.Text = catalogStatus[kind] or "Loading catalog outfit..."
        end
    end

    local removeCompanion; removeCompanion = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(kind)
        local c = companions[kind]
        if c then c.model:Destroy(); companions[kind] = nil end
    end)
    local function reloadCompanions(kind)
        removeCompanion(kind)
        updateStatus()
    end

    -- Accessory types verified against the Roblox asset catalog for these IDs.
    local outfits = {
        Angel = {
            faceId = 18484685060,
            skin = Color3.fromRGB(255, 224, 200),
            items = {
                {14785298623, Enum.AccessoryType.Face},
                {106360041707596, Enum.AccessoryType.Hat},
                {124536429873831, Enum.AccessoryType.Back},
                {116550066609621, Enum.AccessoryType.DressSkirt, true},
                {18484685060, Enum.AccessoryType.Hat},
            },
        },
        Demon = {
            faceId = 73921799523027,
            skin = Color3.fromRGB(240, 205, 200),
            items = {
                {111764085772755, Enum.AccessoryType.Hat},
                {18181093613, Enum.AccessoryType.Hat},
                {72470443560312, Enum.AccessoryType.Back},
                {132526951704680, Enum.AccessoryType.Waist},
                {70417317803915, Enum.AccessoryType.Back},
                {115048656839885, Enum.AccessoryType.DressSkirt, true},
                {73921799523027, Enum.AccessoryType.Face},
            },
        },
    }

    local ACCESSORY_TYPES = {
        [8] = "Hat", [41] = "Hair", [42] = "Face", [43] = "Neck", [44] = "Shoulder",
        [45] = "Front", [46] = "Back", [47] = "Waist",
        [64] = "TShirt", [65] = "Shirt", [66] = "Pants", [67] = "Jacket", [68] = "Sweater",
        [69] = "Shorts", [70] = "LeftShoe", [71] = "RightShoe", [72] = "DressSkirt",
    }
    local function resolveTypes(outfit)
        if outfit.resolved then return end
        outfit.resolved = true
        local market = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
        for _, item in ipairs(outfit.items) do
            local ok, info = pcall(market.GetProductInfo, market, item[1], Enum.InfoType.Asset)
            local typeName = ok and type(info) == "table" and ACCESSORY_TYPES[info.AssetTypeId]
            if typeName then
                item[2] = Enum.AccessoryType[typeName]
                item[3] = info.AssetTypeId >= 64
            end
        end
    end

    local function assembleCatalogOutfit(outfit, isActive, publish)
        resolveTypes(outfit)
        local function createModel(items, chibi)
            local description = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
            local skin = outfit.skin
            description.HeadColor, description.TorsoColor = skin, skin
            description.LeftArmColor, description.RightArmColor = skin, skin
            description.LeftLegColor, description.RightLegColor = skin, skin
            if chibi then
                description.Torso = 16736937262
                description.LeftArm = 16736936680
                description.RightArm = 16736936762
                description.LeftLeg = 16736936765
                description.RightLeg = 16736936881
                description.BodyTypeScale = 1
            else
                description.HeightScale, description.WidthScale, description.DepthScale = 0.9, 0.75, 0.8
            end
            local ok, model = pcall(function()
                description:SetAccessories(items, true)
                return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync(description, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
            end)
            description:Destroy()
            if not ok then return nil end
            if model and isActive() and model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") then return model end
            if model then model:Destroy() end
            return nil
        end

        local function attachPiece(source, target, assetId)
            local piece = source:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory")
            local handle = piece and piece:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
            if assetId == outfit.faceId then piece:SetAttribute("MMG_HeadCover", true) end

            -- Both models have the same R15 body. Keep the engine-created fit and remap its weld.
            local weld = handle:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")
            if weld and weld:IsA("Weld") and weld.Part0 == handle and weld.Part1 then
                local sourcePart = weld.Part1
                local targetPart = target:FindFirstChild(sourcePart.Name)
                if targetPart and targetPart:IsA("BasePart") then
                    handle.CFrame = targetPart.CFrame * weld.C1 * weld.C0:Inverse()
                    weld.Part1 = targetPart
                    piece.Parent = target
                    return true
                end
            end
            for _, attachment in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
                if not attachment:IsA("Attachment") then continue end
                for _, targetPart in ipairs(target:GetChildren()) do
                    if not targetPart:IsA("BasePart") then continue end
                    local socket = targetPart:FindFirstChild(attachment.Name)
                    if socket and socket:IsA("Attachment") then
                        if weld then weld:Destroy() end
                        handle.CFrame = socket.WorldCFrame * attachment.CFrame:Inverse()
                        local accessoryWeld = Instance.new("Weld")
                        accessoryWeld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
                        accessoryWeld.Part0, accessoryWeld.Part1 = handle, targetPart
                        accessoryWeld.C0, accessoryWeld.C1 = attachment.CFrame, socket.CFrame
                        accessoryWeld.Parent = handle
                        piece.Parent = target
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        -- Loads an accessory straight from the asset id (works client-side in executors).
        local function fetchAccessory(assetId)
            local ok, objects = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId)) end)
            if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" then return nil end
            local accessory
            for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
                if object:IsA("Accessory") then
                    accessory = object
                else
                    accessory = accessory or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accessory", true)
                end
            end
            if not accessory then
                for _, object in ipairs(objects) do object:Destroy() end
                return nil
            end
            local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
                handle.Anchored = false
                handle.CanCollide = false
                for _, weld in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
                    if weld:IsA("JointInstance") or weld:IsA("WeldConstraint") then weld:Destroy() end
                end
            end
            local wrapper = Instance.new("Model")
            accessory.Parent = wrapper
            return wrapper
        end

        local items, bodyItems = {}, {}
        local faceItem
        for order, item in ipairs(outfit.items) do
            items[order] = {
                AssetId = item[1], AccessoryType = item[2],
                IsLayered = item[3] == true, Order = item[3] == true and order or nil,
            }
            if item[1] == outfit.faceId then
                faceItem = items[order]
            else
                table.insert(bodyItems, items[order])
            end
        end

        local function buildWithFace(chibi)
            local model = createModel(bodyItems, chibi)
            if not model then return nil end
            local faceModel = createModel({ faceItem }, chibi)
            if faceModel then
                attachPiece(faceModel, model, outfit.faceId)
                faceModel:Destroy()
            end
            return model
        end

        local bestScore, bestCount, preferredBody = -1, 0, false
        local function offer(model, chibi)
            if not model then return false end
            local count, layered = 0, false
            for _, piece in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
                local handle = piece:IsA("Accessory") and piece:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
                    count += 1
                    if piece:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer", true) then layered = true end
                end
            end
            local score = count * 4 + (layered and 2 or 0) + (chibi and 1 or 0)
            if count > 0 and score > bestScore and isActive() then
                bestScore, bestCount, preferredBody = score, count, chibi
                model:SetAttribute("MMG_OutfitBody", chibi and 331401 or 0)
                model:SetAttribute("MMG_AccessoryCount", count)
                model:SetAttribute("MMG_AccessoryTotal", #items)
                publish(model, count, #items)
            else
                model:Destroy()
            end
            return count >= #items
        end

        if offer(buildWithFace(true), true) or not isActive() then return bestCount end
        if offer(buildWithFace(false), false) or not isActive() then return bestCount end

        -- A failed item must not discard the rest of the outfit. Rebuild on one shared body.
        local repaired = createModel({}, preferredBody)
        if not repaired then return bestCount end
        local missing = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(items) do
            if not isActive() then
                repaired:Destroy()
                return bestCount
            end
            local single = createModel({ item }, preferredBody)
            local attached = single and attachPiece(single, repaired, item.AssetId)
            if single then single:Destroy() end
            if not attached then
                -- Fallback: download the accessory directly by id.
                local wrapper = fetchAccessory(item.AssetId)
                if wrapper then
                    attached = attachPiece(wrapper, repaired, item.AssetId)
                    wrapper:Destroy()
                end
            end
            if not attached then
                table.insert(missing, tostring(item.AssetId))
            end
        end
        offer(repaired, preferredBody)
        return bestCount, missing
    end

    local function loadCatalogModel(kind)
        if catalogStatus[kind] then return end
        catalogStatus[kind] = "Loading catalog outfit..."
        updateStatus()
        local function isActive() return alive and not window.Destroyed end

        local count, missing = assembleCatalogOutfit(outfits[kind], isActive, function(model, loaded, total)
            local previous = catalogModels[kind]
            model.Name = kind .. "Chibi"
            catalogModels[kind] = model
            catalogStatus[kind] = string.format("Catalog outfit: %d/%d items loaded.", loaded, total)
            reloadCompanions(kind)
            if previous then previous:Destroy() end
        end)
        if not isActive() then return end
        if count == 0 then
            catalogStatus[kind] = "Roblox could not load the catalog outfit."
        elseif count < #outfits[kind].items and missing and #missing > 0 then
            catalogStatus[kind] ..= "\nNot loaded: " .. table.concat(missing, ", ")
            warn("[CrackHub Bodyguard] " .. kind .. " items not recovered: " .. table.concat(missing, ", "))
        end
        updateStatus()
    end

    -- Turns a catalog avatar into a floating, animatable companion (root anchored, limbs on Motor6Ds).
    local buildCompanion; buildCompanion = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(kind)
        local template = catalogModels[kind]
        if not template then return nil end
        local model = template:Clone()
        local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then model:Destroy(); return nil end
        for _, object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if object:IsA("BaseScript") or object:IsA("ModuleScript") or object:IsA("Sound") or object:IsA("Animator") then
                object:Destroy()
            elseif object:IsA("Humanoid") then
                object.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                object.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
                object.NameDisplayDistance = 0
                object.PlatformStand = true
                object.EvaluateStateMachine = false
                pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() object.AutomaticScalingEnabled = false end))
                pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() object.BreakJointsOnDeath = false end))
            elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
                object.Anchored = object == root
                object.CanCollide, object.CanQuery, object.CanTouch = false, false, false
                object.CastShadow = false
                object.Massless = true
            end
        end
        local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local headWeld
        if head then
            for _, accessory in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
                if accessory:IsA("Accessory") and accessory:GetAttribute("MMG_HeadCover") == true then
                    local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                    if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
                        for _, joint in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
                            if joint:IsA("JointInstance") or joint:IsA("WeldConstraint") then joint:Destroy() end
                        end
                        -- head mesh centred on the real head (fine-tuned live by the Head Height slider)
                        local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
                        weld.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
                        weld.Part0, weld.Part1 = handle, head
                        weld.Parent = handle
                        headWeld = weld
                    end
                    head.Transparency = 1
                    for _, image in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
                        if image:IsA("Decal") or image:IsA("Texture") then image.Transparency = 1 end
                    end
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        -- Seat the head on the body: the chibi body's neck socket sits too high for this head,
        -- which leaves a gap. Put the bottom of the head right on top of the torso.
        local upperTorso = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        local neck = head and head:FindFirstChild("Neck")
        if upperTorso and neck and neck:IsA("Motor6D") then
            neck.C0 = CFrame.new(0, upperTorso.Size.Y * 0.5, 0)
            neck.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -head.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.1, 0)
        end

        -- Scale to chibi size. Fixed factor: a standard R15 avatar is ~5 studs tall.
        -- (Measuring parts of a model that is not in workspace gives wrong numbers.)
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() model:ScaleTo(cfg.Size / 5) end))
        model.PrimaryPart = root
        model.Name = "Bodyguard" .. kind

        -- joints for animation
        local joints = {}
        for _, motor in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if motor:IsA("Motor6D") then joints[motor.Name] = motor end
        end
        -- Find the animated accessories (same animations as the original chibi rig: halo, wings, tail).
        local parts = { wings = {}, halo = nil, tail = nil }
        local weldOf; weldOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(accessory)
            local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            local weld = handle and (handle:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld") or handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Weld"))
            if weld and weld:IsA("Weld") then return weld, handle end
            return nil
        end)
        for _, accessory in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
            if not accessory:IsA("Accessory") or accessory:GetAttribute("MMG_HeadCover") == true then continue end
            local weld, handle = weldOf(accessory)
            if not weld then continue end
            local entry = { weld = weld, c1 = weld.C1 }
            local name = accessory.Name:lower()
            local socket = handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Attachment")
            local socketName = socket and socket.Name or ""
            if name:find("wing") or socketName == "BodyBackAttachment" then
                entry.width = handle.Size.X
                table.insert(parts.wings, entry)
            elseif name:find("tail") or socketName == "WaistBackAttachment" then
                parts.tail = entry
            elseif name:find("halo") or (kind == "Angel" and socketName == "HatAttachment") then
                parts.halo = entry
            end
        end
        -- Demon also wears a trident on the back: only the widest back item is the wings.
        if #parts.wings > 1 then
            table.sort(parts.wings, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a, b) return a.width > b.width end))
            parts.wings = { parts.wings[1] }
        end

        -- effects (same settings as the original companions)
        local torso = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root
        local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
        local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        emitter.LightEmission = 1
        if kind == "Angel" then
            light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness = ANGEL_COLOR, 7, 1.2
            emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
            emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 170))
            emitter.Rate = 6
            emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4)
            emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.4, 1.2)
            emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
            emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.18), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
            emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
        else
            light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness = Color3.fromRGB(255, 45, 55), 7, 1.4
            emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
            emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 40), Color3.fromRGB(90, 0, 10))
            emitter.Rate = 9
            emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.9)
            emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.4)
            emitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
            emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(35, 35)
            emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
            emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.3), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
        end
        light.Parent = torso
        emitter.Parent = torso

        model.Parent = worldFolder
        local allParts = {}
        for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(allParts, d) end
        end
        return { kind = kind, model = model, root = root, joints = joints, parts = parts, allParts = allParts,
            neck = neck and neck:IsA("Motor6D") and neck or nil, neckC1 = neck and neck.C1, neckC0 = neck and neck.C0,
            light = light, emitter = emitter, phase = math.random() * 10, lean = 0 }
    end)

    -- Procedural floating idle: bob, sway, arms drifting, legs dangling, head looking around, wings flapping.
    local animate; animate = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(c, t, speed)
        local j = c.joints
        local s = math.sin
        c.lean += ((math.clamp(speed / 16, 0, 1) * 0.35) - c.lean) * 0.1
        local set; set = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(name, cf) local m = j[name]; if m then m.Transform = cf end end)
        set("Root", C(0, s(t * 2.2) * 0.08, 0) * A(-c.lean + s(t * 1.3) * 0.05, 0, s(t * 1.1) * 0.04))
        set("Waist", A(s(t * 2.2 + 0.6) * 0.05, s(t * 0.9) * 0.1, 0))
        set("Neck", A(s(t * 1.7) * 0.1, s(t * 0.7) * 0.35, s(t * 1.3) * 0.08))
        set("RightShoulder", A(s(t * 2.2) * 0.25, 0, 0.35 + s(t * 2.2 + 1) * 0.12))
        set("LeftShoulder", A(s(t * 2.2 + 3.1) * 0.25, 0, -0.35 - s(t * 2.2 + 1) * 0.12))
        set("RightElbow", A(0.25 + s(t * 2.2) * 0.12, 0, 0))
        set("LeftElbow", A(0.25 + s(t * 2.2 + 3.1) * 0.12, 0, 0))
        set("RightHip", A(s(t * 1.8) * 0.18 + c.lean * 0.5, 0, 0.06))
        set("LeftHip", A(s(t * 1.8 + 2.4) * 0.18 + c.lean * 0.5, 0, -0.06))
        set("RightKnee", A(-0.12 + s(t * 1.8 + 0.5) * 0.1, 0, 0))
        set("LeftKnee", A(-0.12 + s(t * 1.8 + 2.9) * 0.1, 0, 0))
        -- accessory animations ported from the original rig.groups
        local p = c.parts
        if p.halo then -- halo: bob + slow spin
            p.halo.weld.C1 = p.halo.c1 * C(0, s(t * 3) * 0.04, 0) * A(0, t * 0.8, 0)
        end
        for _, w in ipairs(p.wings) do -- wings: flap (angel fast & soft, demon slower & wider)
            local flap = c.kind == "Angel" and (0.35 + s(t * 9) * 0.35) or (0.3 + s(t * 6) * 0.45)
            w.weld.C1 = w.c1 * A(-(flap - 0.35) * 0.5, 0, 0)
        end
        if p.tail then -- tail: swing side to side
            p.tail.weld.C1 = p.tail.c1 * A(s(t * 2.2) * 0.12, s(t * 3) * 0.4, 0)
        end
    end)

    local render; render = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(kind, root, dt, now)
        if not (root and cfg[kind].Show) then removeCompanion(kind); return end
        local c = companions[kind]
        if not c then
            c = buildCompanion(kind)
            if not c then return end
            companions[kind] = c
        end
        -- first person: companion glow/fire off, and the companion fades out when it flies past your face
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local head = root.Parent and root.Parent:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local fp = camera and head and (camera.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude < 1.5
        -- the Demon's red fire/glow is removed completely (it flickered in front of the camera)
        local effects = cfg[kind].Effects and not fp and kind ~= "Demon"
        c.light.Enabled = effects
        c.emitter.Enabled = effects
        local near = fp and c.pos and (camera.CFrame.Position - c.pos).Magnitude < 4.5
        if near ~= c.hidden then
            c.hidden = near
            for _, p in ipairs(c.allParts) do p.LocalTransparencyModifier = near and 1 or 0 end
        end
        local t = now + c.phase
        local side = kind == "Angel" and 1 or -1
        -- Free flight: the companion trails behind you with inertia instead of being glued to you.
        local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
        look = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        if look.Magnitude < 0.01 then look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
        look = look.Unit
        local right = look:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
        local spot = root.Position
            + right * side * (1.8 + cfg.Size * 0.35)
            - look * (1.6 + cfg.Size * 0.25)
            + Vector3.new(0, 0.8 + cfg.Size * 0.2 + math.sin(t * 2.2) * 0.25, 0)
        if not c.pos or (c.pos - spot).Magnitude > 60 then
            c.pos, c.vel, c.yaw = spot, Vector3.zero, math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
        end
        -- spring-damper: smooth acceleration, catches up when you run, drifts when you stop
        local stiffness, damping = 18, 7
        local accel = (spot - c.pos) * stiffness - c.vel * damping
        c.vel += accel * math.min(dt, 0.05)
        c.pos += c.vel * math.min(dt, 0.05)
        -- face where it is flying when moving fast, otherwise face the same way as you
        local flat = Vector3.new(c.vel.X, 0, c.vel.Z)
        local dir = flat.Magnitude > 2 and flat.Unit or look
        local wantYaw = math.atan2(-dir.X, -dir.Z)
        local diff = (wantYaw - c.yaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
        c.yaw += diff * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 5))
        local bank = math.clamp(-diff * 0.4, -0.5, 0.5)
        c.root.CFrame = CFrame.new(c.pos) * A(0, c.yaw, 0) * A(0, 0, bank + math.sin(t * 1.6) * 0.06)
        animate(c, t, flat.Magnitude)
        if c.neck then -- moves the whole head (face, hair, halo) together
            c.neck.C0 = c.neckC0
            c.neck.C1 = c.neckC1 * CFrame.new(0, -cfg[kind].HeadHeight * cfg.Size / 5, 0)
        end
    end)


    -- ========================================================================
    -- DEMON TRIDENT: aim to mark a player, then release to throw at the locked target.
    --  Want a Toolbox model instead? Put its asset id here (scripts inside are removed).
    -- ========================================================================
    local TRIDENT_ASSET_ID = 76983529562803 -- "Sea God's Trident" (textured mesh) from the Creator Store; 0 = built-in trident
    local TRIDENT_LENGTH = 4.2                -- total length in hand, studs (a normal sword is ~4)
    local TRIDENT_POINT = 90                  -- tilt in hand: 90 = prongs forward like a spear (if they point back, use -90)
    local TRIDENT_RAISE = 0.8                 -- how much higher it sits in the hand, studs (more = higher on screen)
    local TRIDENT_FORWARD = 0.5               -- how far it sticks out in front, studs
    local tridentTool
    local activeFlight
    local markedPlayer, markedCharacter
    local tridentHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    tridentHighlight.Name = "CrackHubTridentTarget"
    tridentHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    tridentHighlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65)
    tridentHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.72
    tridentHighlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 78, 78)
    tridentHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
    tridentHighlight.Enabled = false
    tridentHighlight.Parent = worldFolder

    local aimParams = RaycastParams.new()
    aimParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local livingRoot; livingRoot = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(player, character)
        if not player or player.Parent ~= Players or not character or player.Character ~= character then return nil end
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
        return nil
    end)

    local clearTridentMark; clearTridentMark = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        markedPlayer, markedCharacter = nil, nil
        tridentHighlight.Adornee = nil
        tridentHighlight.Enabled = false
    end)

    local updateTridentMark; updateTridentMark = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local own = LocalPlayer.Character
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if activeFlight then return end
        if not tridentTool or not own or tridentTool.Parent ~= own or not camera or not livingRoot(LocalPlayer, own) then
            clearTridentMark()
            return
        end
        local point = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
        if UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter or not UserInputService.MouseEnabled then
            point = camera.ViewportSize * 0.5
        end
        local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(point.X, point.Y)
        aimParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {own, worldFolder}
        local result = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 240, aimParams)
        local part = result and result.Instance
        local player, character
        while part and part ~= workspace do
            if part:IsA("Model") then
                player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(part)
                if player then character = part; break end
            end
            part = part.Parent
        end
        if player == LocalPlayer or not livingRoot(player, character) then
            clearTridentMark()
            return
        end
        markedPlayer, markedCharacter = player, character
        tridentHighlight.Adornee = character
        tridentHighlight.Enabled = true
    end)

    local function launchTrident(tool, player, character)
        if activeFlight or not livingRoot(player, character) then return false end
        local own = LocalPlayer.Character
        local ownRoot = livingRoot(LocalPlayer, own)
        local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if not ownRoot or tool.Parent ~= own or not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then return false end

        local projectile = Instance.new("Model")
        projectile.Name = "CrackHubThrownTrident"
        local parts, offsets = {}, {}
        for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
            if not part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Transparency >= 1 then continue end
            local copy = part:Clone()
            if not copy then continue end
            for _, child in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
                if child:IsA("BasePart") or child:IsA("JointInstance") or child:IsA("Constraint")
                    or child:IsA("BaseScript") or child:IsA("ModuleScript")
                    or child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or child:IsA("Trail") or child:IsA("Beam") then
                    child:Destroy()
                end
            end
            copy.Anchored, copy.CanCollide, copy.CanQuery, copy.CanTouch = true, false, false, false
            copy.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
            copy.Parent = projectile
            table.insert(parts, copy)
            table.insert(offsets, handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame))
        end
        if #parts == 0 then projectile:Destroy(); return false end

        local position = ownRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
        local frames = table.create(#parts)
        local draw; draw = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(direction)
            local pose = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + direction) * CFrame.Angles(-math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
            for index, offset in ipairs(offsets) do frames[index] = pose * offset end
            if projectile.Parent then
                workspace:BulkMoveTo(parts, frames, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
            else
                for index, part in ipairs(parts) do part.CFrame = frames[index] end
                projectile.Parent = worldFolder
            end
        end)
        draw(ownRoot.CFrame.LookVector)

        local targetRoot = livingRoot(player, character)
        if not targetRoot then projectile:Destroy(); return false end
        local flight = {
            model = projectile, outcome = combat.Outcome(player),
            destination = targetRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0),
        }
        activeFlight = flight
        local started = os.clock()
        local finish; finish = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(hit)
