            if activeFlight ~= flight then return end
            activeFlight = nil
            flight.connection:Disconnect()
            clearTridentMark()
            if hit and alive and not window.Destroyed then
                task.delay(0.08, function() projectile:Destroy() end)
                if flight.outcome == "fling" and livingRoot(player, character) then
                    combat.Hit(player, character, tool, "fling")
                end
            else
                projectile:Destroy()
            end
        end)
        flight.connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            local root = livingRoot(player, character)
            if not alive or not tool.Parent or not livingRoot(LocalPlayer, own) or os.clock() - started > 6
                or (flight.outcome == "fling" and not root) then
                finish(false)
                return
            end
            if root then flight.destination = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0) end
            local destination = flight.destination
            local delta = destination - position
            local distance = delta.Magnitude
            local step = 165 * math.min(dt, 0.1)
            if distance <= math.max(1.4, step) then
                position = destination
                draw(distance > 0.01 and delta.Unit or ownRoot.CFrame.LookVector)
                finish(true)
                return
            end
            position += delta.Unit * step
            draw(delta.Unit)
        end))
        if flight.outcome ~= "fling" then
            combat.Hit(player, character, tool, flight.outcome)
        end
        return true
    end

    local function installAngelDodge()
        local tags = game:GetService("CollectionService")
        local blades = {}
        local readyAt, lastScan = 0, 0
        local ownCharacter
        local dangerRadius, safeMin, safeMax = 11, 18, 36
        local floorRay = RaycastParams.new()
        floorRay.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        floorRay.RespectCanCollide = true
        local clearance = OverlapParams.new()
        clearance.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        clearance.RespectCanCollide = true
        clearance.MaxParts = 1

        local filters; filters = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local ignore = {worldFolder}
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player.Character then table.insert(ignore, player.Character) end
            end
            floorRay.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
            clearance.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
        end)

        local distanceToSegment; distanceToSegment = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(point, startPosition, endPosition)
            local segment = endPosition - startPosition
            local squared = segment:Dot(segment)
            if squared < 0.001 then return (point - startPosition).Magnitude end
            local ratio = math.clamp((point - startPosition):Dot(segment) / squared, 0, 1)
            return (point - startPosition - segment * ratio).Magnitude
        end)

        local bladeSideScore; bladeSideScore = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(position, origin, bladePosition, bladeSide)
            local movement = position - origin
            local horizontal = Vector3.new(movement.X, 0, movement.Z).Magnitude
            if horizontal < 0.01 then return nil end
            local sideways = math.abs(movement:Dot(bladeSide))
            local clearance = math.abs((position - bladePosition):Dot(bladeSide))
            if clearance < 8 or sideways < horizontal * 0.65 then return nil end
            return sideways / horizontal * 45 + math.min(clearance, 25) - horizontal * 0.22
        end)

        local safeGround; safeGround = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(part)
            while part and part ~= workspace do
                local name = part.Name:lower()
                if tags:HasTag(part, "NoTeleport") or name:find("lava", 1, true)
                    or name:find("killbrick", 1, true) or name:find("killpart", 1, true) then return false end
                part = part.Parent
            end
            return true
        end)

        local exposedToGun; exposedToGun = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(origin, torso, head)
            local toTorso = torso - origin
            if toTorso.Magnitude < 0.1 or not workspace:Raycast(origin, toTorso, floorRay) then return true end
            local toHead = head - origin
            return toHead.Magnitude < 0.1 or workspace:Raycast(origin, toHead, floorRay) == nil
        end)

        local landing; landing = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(root, threatPosition, preferCover, bladePosition, bladeVelocity)
            filters()
            local origin = root.Position
            local floor = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -10, 0), floorRay)
            if not floor then return nil end
            local mapBounds, mapSize
            local ancestor = floor.Instance.Parent
            while ancestor and ancestor ~= workspace do
                if ancestor:IsA("Model") and (ancestor.Name == "Map"
                    or ancestor:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer", true) or ancestor:FindFirstChild("Spawns", true)) then
                    mapBounds, mapSize = ancestor:GetBoundingBox()
                    break
                end
                ancestor = ancestor.Parent
            end
            local away = origin - threatPosition
            local retreat = Vector3.new(away.X, 0, away.Z)
            if retreat.Magnitude < 0.01 then
                local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
                retreat = Vector3.new(-look.X, 0, -look.Z)
            end
            if retreat.Magnitude < 0.01 then retreat = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
            retreat = retreat.Unit
            local lateral = Vector3.new(-retreat.Z, 0, retreat.X)
            local baseAngle = math.atan2(retreat.Z, retreat.X)
            local bladeSide
            if bladePosition and bladeVelocity then
                local flatVelocity = Vector3.new(bladeVelocity.X, 0, bladeVelocity.Z)
                if flatVelocity.Magnitude > 0.1 then
                    local forward = flatVelocity.Unit
                    bladeSide = Vector3.new(-forward.Z, 0, forward.X)
                    baseAngle = math.atan2(bladeSide.Z, bladeSide.X)
                end
            end
            local distances = bladeSide and {10, 14, safeMin, 24, safeMax} or {safeMin, (safeMin + safeMax) * 0.5, safeMax}
            local best, bestScore = nil, -math.huge
            local bestCover, bestCoverScore = nil, -math.huge
            for _, distance in ipairs(distances) do
                for direction = 0, 11 do
                    local angle = baseAngle + direction * math.pi / 6
                    local probe = origin + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * distance, 6, math.sin(angle) * distance)
                    local hit = workspace:Raycast(probe, Vector3.new(0, -18, 0), floorRay)
                    if not hit or hit.Normal.Y < 0.75 or hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water or not safeGround(hit.Instance) then continue end
                    if math.abs(hit.Position.Y - floor.Position.Y) > 7 then continue end
                    if mapBounds then
                        local rel = mapBounds:PointToObjectSpace(hit.Position)
                        if math.abs(rel.X) > mapSize.X / 2 or math.abs(rel.Z) > mapSize.Z / 2 then continue end
                    end
                    local position = hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, math.max(2.8, origin.Y - floor.Position.Y), 0)
                    local movement = Vector3.new(position.X - origin.X, 0, position.Z - origin.Z)
                    local travel = movement.Magnitude
                    -- Every landing moves both sideways and away from the threat.
                    -- If neither diagonal is safe, retain the existing retry path.
                    if travel < 0.01 or movement:Dot(retreat) < travel * 0.2
                        or math.abs(movement:Dot(lateral)) < travel * 0.35 then continue end
                    local separation = (position - threatPosition).Magnitude
                    local sideScore
                    if bladeSide then
                        sideScore = bladeSideScore(position, origin, bladePosition, bladeSide)
                        if not sideScore then continue end
                        if separation < dangerRadius then continue end
                    elseif separation < dangerRadius + 5 then
                        continue
                    end
                    local bounds = CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0))
                    if #workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(bounds, Vector3.new(2.8, 5.2, 2.8), clearance) > 0 then continue end
                    local covered = preferCover
                        and not exposedToGun(threatPosition, position, position + Vector3.new(0, 1.65, 0))
                    if covered then
                        local score = separation - distance * 0.25
                        if score > bestCoverScore then bestCover, bestCoverScore = position, score end
                    elseif preferCover or bladeSide or separation >= away.Magnitude - 1 then
                        local score = sideScore or separation
                        if score > bestScore then best, bestScore = position, score end
                    end
                end
            end
            return bestCover or best
        end)

        local canDodge; canDodge = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(onGunEquip)
            return alive and not window.Destroyed and cfg.Angel.Show and cfg.Angel.AutoDodge
                and (onGunEquip or os.clock() >= readyAt)
        end)

        local dodge; dodge = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(threatPosition, preferCover, bladePosition, bladeVelocity, onGunEquip)
            if not canDodge(onGunEquip) then return false end
            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            local root = livingRoot(LocalPlayer, character)
            if not root then return false end
            local position = landing(root, threatPosition, preferCover, bladePosition, bladeVelocity)
            if not position then
                readyAt = os.clock() + 0.5
                return false
            end
            readyAt = os.clock() + 8
            character:PivotTo(character:GetPivot() + (position - root.Position))
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            window:Notify({Title = "Angel", Content = "Angel saved you!", Type = "Success", Duration = 3})
            return true
        end)

        local function trackBlade(blade)
            if blade.Name ~= "ThrowingKnife" and not tags:HasTag(blade, "Projectile") then return end
            if not blades[blade] then blades[blade] = {expires = os.clock() + 6} end
        end
        connect(workspace.ChildAdded, trackBlade)
        connect(tags:GetInstanceAddedSignal("Projectile"), trackBlade)
        for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == "ThrowingKnife" then trackBlade(child) end
        end
        for _, blade in ipairs(tags:GetTagged("Projectile")) do trackBlade(blade) end

        local equippedKnife; equippedKnife = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(character)
            for _, tool in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                if tool:IsA("Tool") and (tool.Name:lower() == "knife" or tags:HasTag(tool, "Weapon_Knife")) then return tool end
            end
            return nil
        end)

        local gunOrigin; gunOrigin = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(gun, character, root)
            local tip = gun and (gun:FindFirstChild("Muzzle", true) or gun:FindFirstChild("MuzzleAttachment", true))
                or root:FindFirstChild("GunRaycastAttachment")
            if tip and tip:IsA("Attachment") then return tip.WorldPosition end
            if tip and tip:IsA("BasePart") then return tip.Position end
            local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            return head and head.Position or root.Position
        end)

        local isHeldGun; isHeldGun = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(tool, character, role)
            if not tool:IsA("Tool") or tool.Parent ~= character then return false end
            local name = tool.Name:lower()
            local tagged = tags:HasTag(tool, "Weapon_Gun")
            if not tagged and name ~= "gun" and name ~= "revolver" then return false end
            if tagged or role == "sheriff" or role == "hero" then return true end
            -- The role cache can lag behind Hero picking up the real gun.
            local shoot = tool:FindFirstChild("Shoot")
            return shoot ~= nil and shoot:IsA("RemoteEvent")
        end)

        local heldGun; heldGun = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(character, role)
            for _, tool in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                if isHeldGun(tool, character, role) then return tool end
            end
            return nil
        end)

        local ownerId; ownerId = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(blade, part)
            local owner = blade:GetAttribute("Owner") or part:GetAttribute("Owner")
            if type(owner) == "number" then return owner end
            if type(owner) == "string" then
                local player = Players:FindFirstChild(owner)
                if player and player:IsA("Player") then return player.UserId end
                return tonumber(owner)
            end
            local creator = blade:FindFirstChild("creator") or part:FindFirstChild("creator")
            if creator and creator:IsA("ObjectValue") and creator.Value and creator.Value:IsA("Player") then
                return creator.Value.UserId
            end
            return nil
        end)

        connect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            local now = os.clock()
            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            if character ~= ownCharacter then
                ownCharacter = character
                readyAt = 0
            end
            local root = livingRoot(LocalPlayer, character)
            local available = root and canDodge()
            local roles
            for blade, tracked in pairs(blades) do
                if not blade:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or tracked.expires <= now then
                    blades[blade] = nil
                    continue
                end
                local part = tracked.part or blade:FindFirstChild("BladePosition", true)
                if not part and blade:IsA("BasePart") then part = blade end
                if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") or not part.Parent then continue end
                tracked.part = part
                local position = part.Position
                local previous = tracked.position
                tracked.position = position
                if not available then continue end
                roles = roles or combat.GetRoles()
                local id = ownerId(blade, part)
                if id == LocalPlayer.UserId or (not id and combat.RoleOf(LocalPlayer, roles) == "murderer") then continue end
                local velocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                if previous and velocity.Magnitude < 1 then velocity = (position - previous) / math.max(dt, 1 / 240) end
                if velocity.Magnitude < 8 then continue end
                local from = previous or position
                local to = position + velocity * 0.25
                if distanceToSegment(root.Position, from, to) <= 4.5 then
                    local attacker = id and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(id)
                    local attackerRoot = attacker and livingRoot(attacker, attacker.Character)
                    if dodge(attackerRoot and attackerRoot.Position or from, false, position, velocity) then return end
                    available = false
                end
            end
            if not available or now - lastScan < 0.035 then return end
            lastScan = now
            roles = roles or combat.GetRoles()
            filters()
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player == LocalPlayer then continue end
                local enemyCharacter = player.Character
                local enemyRoot = livingRoot(player, enemyCharacter)
                if not enemyRoot then continue end
                local offset = root.Position - enemyRoot.Position
                local role = combat.RoleOf(player, roles)
                if role == "murderer" and offset.Magnitude <= dangerRadius and equippedKnife(enemyCharacter) then
                    if not workspace:Raycast(enemyRoot.Position, offset, floorRay) and dodge(enemyRoot.Position, false) then return end
                end
                if not canDodge() then return end
                local gun = heldGun(enemyCharacter, role)
                if gun and dodge(gunOrigin(gun, enemyCharacter, enemyRoot), true) then return end
            end
        end))

        local function onGunEquipped(player, character, tool)
            local root = livingRoot(player, character)
            if not root or not canDodge(true) then return end
            local role = combat.RoleOf(player, combat.GetRoles())
            if isHeldGun(tool, character, role) then
                dodge(gunOrigin(tool, character, root), true, nil, nil, true)
            end
        end

        local watchers = {}
        local function unwatch(player)
            local watch = watchers[player]
            if not watch then return end
            watch.character:Disconnect()
            if watch.equip then watch.equip:Disconnect() end
            watchers[player] = nil
        end

        local function watchPlayer(player)
            if player == LocalPlayer or watchers[player] then return end
            local watch = {}
            local function watchCharacter(character)
                if watch.equip then watch.equip:Disconnect() end
                watch.equip = character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(tool)
                    onGunEquipped(player, character, tool)
                end)
            end
            watch.character = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchCharacter)
            watchers[player] = watch
            if player.Character then watchCharacter(player.Character) end
        end

        connect(Players.PlayerAdded, watchPlayer)
        connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, unwatch)
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchPlayer(player) end
        return function()
            for player in pairs(watchers) do unwatch(player) end
        end
    end

    -- Uniformly scales a Tool (parts, meshes, welds, attachments, grip) so its longest side = length.
    local function fitTool(tool, length)
        local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if not (handle and handle:IsA("BasePart")) then return end
        local origin = handle.CFrame
        local lo, hi = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge), -Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        for _, p in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                local rel = origin:PointToObjectSpace(p.Position)
                local half = p.Size.Magnitude * 0.5
                lo = lo:Min(rel - Vector3.new(half, half, half))
                hi = hi:Max(rel + Vector3.new(half, half, half))
            end
        end
        local extent = hi - lo
        local longest = math.max(extent.X, extent.Y, extent.Z)
        if longest <= 0 then return end
        local k = length / longest
        if math.abs(k - 1) < 0.02 then return end
        local constraints = {}
        for _, d in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("WeldConstraint") and d.Enabled then d.Enabled = false; table.insert(constraints, d) end
        end
        for _, d in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                local rel = origin:ToObjectSpace(d.CFrame)
                d.Size *= k
                d.CFrame = origin * (CFrame.new(rel.Position * k) * rel.Rotation)
            elseif d:IsA("SpecialMesh") or d:IsA("BlockMesh") or d:IsA("CylinderMesh") then
                if d:IsA("SpecialMesh") and d.MeshType ~= Enum.MeshType.FileMesh then
                    -- brick-shaped special meshes follow the part size already
                else
                    d.Scale *= k
                end
                d.Offset *= k
            elseif d:IsA("Attachment") then
                d.Position *= k
            elseif d:IsA("JointInstance") then
                d.C0 = CFrame.new(d.C0.Position * k) * d.C0.Rotation
                d.C1 = CFrame.new(d.C1.Position * k) * d.C1.Rotation
            elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
                local kps = {}
                for _, kp in ipairs(d.Size.Keypoints) do
                    table.insert(kps, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, kp.Value * k, kp.Envelope * k))
                end
                d.Size = NumberSequence.new(kps)
            elseif d:IsA("PointLight") then
                d.Range = math.max(4, d.Range * k)
            end
        end
        for _, c in ipairs(constraints) do c.Enabled = true end
        tool.Grip = CFrame.new(tool.Grip.Position * k) * tool.Grip.Rotation
    end

    -- Minecraft-style trident moves: hold = charge over the shoulder, release = Riptide
    -- (spinning launch forward with red whirlpool rings + trail). Quick click = thrust.
    local RIPTIDE_SPEED, RIPTIDE_TIME, RIPTIDE_COOLDOWN = 75, 0.35, 1.2
    local function installTridentMoves(tool)
        local busy, chargeStart, lastRiptide = false, nil, 0
        local baseGrip
        local RED, DARK = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 55), Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 15)

        -- first person = camera is (almost) inside your head: no red flight effects then
        local firstPerson; firstPerson = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            return head ~= nil and camera ~= nil and (camera.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude < 1.5
        end)

        local function ring(cf, size, life)
            if firstPerson() then return end
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
            p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            p.Color = RED
            p.Transparency = 0.35
            p.Size = Vector3.new(0.15, size, size)
            p.CFrame = cf
            local inner = p:Clone()
            inner.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
            inner.Color = DARK
            inner.Transparency = 0
            inner.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, size * 0.75, size * 0.75)
            inner.Parent = worldFolder
            p.Parent = worldFolder
            local t0 = os.clock()
            local conn
            conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                local a = (os.clock() - t0) / life
                if a >= 1 or not p.Parent then
                    conn:Disconnect(); p:Destroy(); inner:Destroy(); return
                end
                local grow = 1 + a * 0.9
                p.Size = Vector3.new(0.15, size * grow, size * grow)
                inner.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, size * 0.75 * grow, size * 0.75 * grow)
                local spin = cf * CFrame.Angles(a * 6, 0, 0)
                p.CFrame, inner.CFrame = spin, spin
                p.Transparency = 0.35 + a * 0.65
                inner.Transparency = a
            end))
        end

        local function riptide()
            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
            local dir = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
            if dir.Magnitude < 0.01 then dir = root.CFrame.LookVector end
            dir = dir.Unit
            -- trail
            local a0, a1 = Instance.new("Attachment"), Instance.new("Attachment")
            a0.Position, a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1.2, 0)
            a0.Parent, a1.Parent = root, root
            local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
            trail.Attachment0, trail.Attachment1 = a0, a1
            trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(RED, DARK)
            trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.2, 1)
            trail.LightEmission = 1
            trail.Lifetime = 0.35
            trail.Enabled = not firstPerson()
            trail.Parent = root
            local swirl = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
            swirl.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
            swirl.Color = ColorSequence.new(RED, DARK)
            swirl.LightEmission = 1
            swirl.Size = NumberSequence.new(1.2, 0)
            swirl.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25, 0.45)
            swirl.Rate = 80
            swirl.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
            swirl.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
            swirl.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-360, 360)
            swirl.Enabled = not firstPerson()
            swirl.Parent = a0

            -- stay on your feet: dash mostly horizontally, keep the body upright
            local flatDir = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
            if flatDir.Magnitude < 0.2 then flatDir = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z) end
            flatDir = flatDir.Unit
            dir = (flatDir + Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(dir.Y, -0.15, 0.35), 0)).Unit
            humanoid.AutoRotate = false
            local t0 = os.clock()
            local conn
            conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
                local elapsed = os.clock() - t0
                if elapsed >= RIPTIDE_TIME or not root.Parent then
                    conn:Disconnect()
                    humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                    swirl.Enabled = false
                    if root.Parent then
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = flatDir * 16
                    end
                    task.delay(0.5, function() trail:Destroy(); swirl:Destroy(); a0:Destroy(); a1:Destroy() end)
                    return
                end
                local fp = firstPerson()
                swirl.Enabled = not fp
                trail.Enabled = not fp
                -- upright, facing the dash direction (no knock-down, no spinning)
                root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + flatDir)
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * RIPTIDE_SPEED
            end))
        end

        local function lerpGrip(from, to, frames)
            for i = 1, frames do tool.Grip = from:Lerp(to, i / frames); task.wait() end
        end

        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- First-person view model: in first person the trident is pinned to the camera
        -- (bottom-right, prongs forward) so it stays on screen wherever you look.
        -- The real one in your hand is hidden locally while you are in first person.
        -- ---------------------------------------------------------------
        local VM_OFFSET = CFrame.new(1.1, -1.0, -1.7)   -- right, down, forward from the camera
        local vm, vmParts, vmRel, vmConn = nil, {}, {}, nil
        local vmPose, vmTarget = 0, 0                     -- >0 pulled back, <0 pushed forward
        local realParts, realEmitters = {}, {}
        local function clearVM()
            if vmConn then vmConn:Disconnect(); vmConn = nil end
            if vm then vm:Destroy(); vm = nil end
            table.clear(vmParts); table.clear(vmRel)
            for _, p in ipairs(realParts) do if p.Parent then p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0 end end
            for e, was in pairs(realEmitters) do if e.Parent then e.Enabled = was end end
            table.clear(realParts); table.clear(realEmitters)
        end
        local function buildVM()
            clearVM()
            local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if not handle then return end
            vm = Instance.new("Model")
            vm.Name = "TridentViewModel"
            for _, p in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then
                    table.insert(realParts, p)
                    local copy = p:Clone()
                    for _, d in ipairs(copy:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("WeldConstraint") or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                            or d:IsA("Highlight") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Light") then d:Destroy() end
                    end
                    copy.Anchored, copy.CanCollide, copy.CanQuery, copy.CanTouch, copy.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
                    copy.Parent = vm
                    table.insert(vmParts, copy)
                    table.insert(vmRel, handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame))
                elseif p:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
                    realEmitters[p] = p.Enabled
                end
            end
            local cfs = table.create(#vmParts)
            vmConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
                local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                local fp = firstPerson()
                for _, p in ipairs(realParts) do p.LocalTransparencyModifier = fp and 1 or 0 end
                for e, was in pairs(realEmitters) do e.Enabled = was and not fp end
                if not fp or not camera then
                    vm.Parent = nil
                    return
                end
                vm.Parent = camera
                vmPose += (vmTarget - vmPose) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 18))
                local t = os.clock()
                local bob = CFrame.new(math.sin(t * 1.6) * 0.02, math.sin(t * 3.2) * 0.025, 0)
                local base = camera.CFrame * VM_OFFSET * bob * CFrame.new(0, 0, vmPose)
                    * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(4), 0) * CFrame.Angles(-math.pi / 2, 0, 0) -- handle Y -> camera forward
                for i, rel in ipairs(vmRel) do cfs[i] = base * rel end
                workspace:BulkMoveTo(vmParts, cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
            end))
        end
        tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
            task.wait() -- let the welds settle in your hand first
            if tool.Parent and tool.Parent:IsA("Model") then buildVM() end
        end)
        tool.Unequipped:Connect(clearVM)
        tool.Destroying:Connect(clearVM)

        tool.Activated:Connect(function()
            if busy or activeFlight then return end
            vmTarget = 0.6
            baseGrip = baseGrip or tool.Grip
            chargeStart = os.clock()
            -- raise it over the shoulder, point first (charging pose)
            local charged = baseGrip * CFrame.new(0, 0.9, 0) -- pulled back, tip still forward
            task.spawn(lerpGrip, baseGrip, charged, 8)
        end)
        tool.Deactivated:Connect(function()
            if busy or not chargeStart or not baseGrip then return end
            local held = os.clock() - chargeStart
            chargeStart = nil
            busy = true
            updateTridentMark()
            if markedPlayer and launchTrident(tool, markedPlayer, markedCharacter) then
                vmTarget = -0.9
                lerpGrip(tool.Grip, baseGrip * CFrame.new(0, -0.7, 0), 4)
                lerpGrip(tool.Grip, baseGrip, 6)
            elseif held >= 0.35 and os.clock() - lastRiptide >= RIPTIDE_COOLDOWN then
                lastRiptide = os.clock()
                tool.Grip = baseGrip * CFrame.new(0, -0.6, 0) -- tip forward, pushed out ahead while flying
                vmTarget = -0.7
                riptide()
                task.wait(RIPTIDE_TIME)
                vmTarget = 0
                lerpGrip(tool.Grip, baseGrip, 8)
            else
                -- quick thrust
                local forward = baseGrip * CFrame.new(0, -1.1, 0) -- straight jab forward along the tip
                vmTarget = -1.2
                lerpGrip(tool.Grip, forward, 5)
                task.wait(0.08)
                vmTarget = 0
                lerpGrip(forward, baseGrip, 8)
            end
            tool.Grip = baseGrip
            vmTarget = 0
            busy = false
        end)
        tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
            chargeStart = nil
            vmTarget = 0
            if baseGrip and not busy then tool.Grip = baseGrip end
        end)
    end

    local function buildTrident()
        if TRIDENT_ASSET_ID ~= 0 then
            local ok, objects = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. TRIDENT_ASSET_ID) end)
            local root = ok and type(objects) == "table" and objects[1]
            if root then
                for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("BaseScript") or d:IsA("ModuleScript") or d:IsA("RemoteEvent") or d:IsA("RemoteFunction")
                        or d:IsA("BindableEvent") or d:IsA("Sound") then d:Destroy() end
                end
                local tool = root:IsA("Tool") and root or root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool", true)
                if not tool then
                    -- a plain model / mesh: the biggest part becomes the handle, the rest is welded on
                    local parts = {}
                    if root:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, root) end
                    for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, d) end end
                    table.sort(parts, function(a, b) return a.Size.Magnitude > b.Size.Magnitude end)
                    local handle = parts[1]
                    if handle then
                        tool = Instance.new("Tool")
                        tool.RequiresHandle = true
                        -- point the long axis up (tools hold the Handle along its Y axis)
                        local size = handle.Size
                        local turn = CFrame.identity
                        if size.X >= size.Y and size.X >= size.Z then turn = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
                        elseif size.Z >= size.Y and size.Z >= size.X then turn = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0) end
                        local base = handle.CFrame
                        for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
                            local rel = base:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)
                            p.CFrame = turn * rel
                            p.Parent = tool
                            if p ~= handle then
                                local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                                w.Part0, w.Part1 = handle, p
                                w.Parent = p
                            end
                        end
                        -- re-make the handle as an upright part holding the mesh, so the grip axis is right
                        local holder = Instance.new("Part")
                        holder.Name = "Handle"
                        holder.Transparency = 1
                        holder.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
                        holder.CFrame = CFrame.new(handle.Position)
                        holder.Parent = tool
                        local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                        w.Part0, w.Part1 = holder, handle
                        w.Parent = handle
                        if handle.Name == "Handle" then handle.Name = "TridentMesh" end
                        tool.Grip = CFrame.new(0, -handle.Size.Y * 0.25, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(TRIDENT_POINT), 0, 0)
                        if root ~= tool then pcall(function() root:Destroy() end) end
                    end
                end
                if tool then
                    tool.CanBeDropped = false
                    tool.Name = "Demon Trident"
                    -- Demon colouring: Poseidon's shape, but dark blood-red metal instead of the original texture.
                    local DEMON_METAL = Color3.fromRGB(78, 10, 18)
                    for _, d in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                            d.Anchored, d.CanCollide, d.CanTouch, d.CanQuery, d.Massless = false, false, false, false, true
                            if d.Transparency < 1 then
                                d.Color = DEMON_METAL
                                d.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
                                d.Reflectance = 0.05
                                if d:IsA("MeshPart") then pcall(function() d.TextureID = "" end) end
                            end
                        elseif d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") or d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
                            d:Destroy()
                        elseif d:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                            d.TextureId = ""
                            d.VertexColor = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
                        end
                    end
                    -- demon effects on top of the model: glow + fire + sparks at the head
                    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                    local mesh = tool:FindFirstChild("TridentMesh") or handle
                    if mesh then
                        local top = Instance.new("Attachment")
                        top.Name = "TipAttachment"
                        top.Position = Vector3.new(0, mesh.Size.Y * 0.4, 0)
                        top.Parent = mesh
                        local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
                        light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness = Color3.fromRGB(255, 45, 55), 10, 2
                        light.Parent = top
                        local fire = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                        fire.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
                        fire.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 40), Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 10))
                        fire.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, mesh.Size.Y * 0.06), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
                        fire.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
                        fire.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.7)
                        fire.Rate = 20
                        fire.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.5)
                        fire.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25)
                        fire.LightEmission = 1
                        fire.Parent = top
                        local sparks = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                        sparks.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
                        sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 70))
                        sparks.LightEmission = 1
                        sparks.Size = NumberSequence.new(mesh.Size.Y * 0.03, 0)
                        sparks.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8)
                        sparks.Rate = 12
                        sparks.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.3, 1)
                        sparks.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
                        sparks.Parent = mesh
                    end
                    return tool
                end
            end
        end

        local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(212, 160, 60)
        local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 30)
        local STEEL = Color3.fromRGB(120, 24, 34)
        local GLOW = Color3.fromRGB(255, 45, 55)

        local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
        tool.Name = "Demon Trident"
        tool.ToolTip = "Poseidon's trident"
        tool.CanBeDropped = false
        tool.RequiresHandle = true
        tool.Grip = CFrame.new(0, -1.6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(TRIDENT_POINT), 0, 0)

        local function newPart(size, cf, color, material, shape, transparency)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch = false, false, false, false
            p.Massless, p.CastShadow = true, false
            p.Size, p.CFrame, p.Color = size, cf, color
            p.Material = material or Enum.Material.Metal
            p.Transparency = transparency or 0
            if shape then p.Shape = shape end
            return p
        end
        local handle = newPart(Vector3.new(0.28, 7, 0.28), CFrame.new(), DARK, Enum.Material.Metal)
        handle.Name = "Handle"
        handle.Parent = tool
        local function add(...)
            local p = newPart(...)
            local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            w.Part0, w.Part1 = handle, p
            w.Parent = p
            p.Parent = tool
            return p
        end
        local CYL, BALL, WEDGE = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Enum.PartType.Ball, Enum.PartType.Wedge
        local UP = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)) -- cylinder axis -> vertical
        local rad = math.rad

        -- shaft: glowing veins, gold rings, wrapped grip, spiked pommel
        for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
            add(Vector3.new(0.06, 6.4, 0.06), CFrame.new(s * 0.12, 0, -0.08), GLOW, Enum.Material.Neon)
        end
        for _, y in ipairs({ -2.6, -0.4, 1.4, 2.9 }) do
            add(Vector3.new(0.14, 0.42, 0.42), CFrame.new(0, y, 0) * UP, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal, CYL)
        end
        for i = 0, 5 do
            add(Vector3.new(0.1, 0.36, 0.36), CFrame.new(0, -1.0 - i * 0.2, 0) * UP * CFrame.Angles(rad(i * 30), 0, 0),
                STEEL, Enum.Material.Fabric, CYL)
        end
        add(Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, 0.45), CFrame.new(0, -3.55, 0), GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal, BALL)
        add(Vector3.new(0.18, 0.7, 0.18), CFrame.new(0, -4.0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(rad(180), 0, 0), GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal, WEDGE)

        -- head base: ornate gold collar + crescent crossbar
        add(Vector3.new(0.5, 0.62, 0.62), CFrame.new(0, 3.4, 0) * UP, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal, CYL)
        for i = -3, 3 do
            local a = rad(i * 13)
            add(Vector3.new(0.42, 0.3, 0.3), CFrame.new(math.sin(a) * 1.3, 3.75 - math.cos(a) * 0.35 + 0.35, 0)
                * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -a), STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal)
        end
        add(Vector3.new(2.9, 0.12, 0.34), CFrame.new(0, 3.62, 0), GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
        local core = add(Vector3.new(0.62, 0.62, 0.62), CFrame.new(0, 3.85, -0.05), GLOW, Enum.Material.Neon, BALL)
        add(Vector3.new(0.9, 0.9, 0.9), CFrame.new(0, 3.85, -0.05), GLOW, Enum.Material.ForceField, BALL, 0.2)

        -- prongs: long center, curved side prongs, barbed tips
        local function prong(x, baseY, length, lean)
            local top = baseY + length
            add(Vector3.new(0.22, length, 0.22), CFrame.new(x, baseY + length / 2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, lean), STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal)
            add(Vector3.new(0.08, length * 0.9, 0.08), CFrame.new(x, baseY + length / 2, -0.12) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, lean), GLOW, Enum.Material.Neon)
            local tipX = x - math.sin(lean) * length / 2
            -- arrow tip
            add(Vector3.new(0.12, 0.8, 0.5), CFrame.new(tipX, top + 0.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(90), 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0), STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal, WEDGE)
            add(Vector3.new(0.12, 0.8, 0.5), CFrame.new(tipX, top + 0.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(-90), 0), STEEL, Enum.Material.Metal, WEDGE)
            add(Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), CFrame.new(tipX, top + 0.75, 0), GLOW, Enum.Material.Neon, BALL)
            -- barbs
            for _, s in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                add(Vector3.new(0.08, 0.45, 0.22), CFrame.new(tipX + s * 0.2, top - 0.15, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, s * rad(35)), GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal, WEDGE)
            end
        end
        prong(0, 3.8, 2.6, 0)
        prong(-1.25, 3.7, 1.8, rad(-8))
        prong(1.25, 3.7, 1.8, rad(8))

        local tip = Instance.new("Attachment")
        tip.Name = "TipAttachment"
        tip.Position = Vector3.new(0, 7.2, 0)
        tip.Parent = handle

        local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
        light.Color, light.Range, light.Brightness = GLOW, 10, 2
        light.Parent = core
        local fire = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        fire.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
        fire.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 40), Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 10))
        fire.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.45), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
        fire.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
        fire.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.7)
        fire.Rate = 18
        fire.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.5)
        fire.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25)
        fire.LightEmission = 1
        fire.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
        fire.Parent = core
        local sparks = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        sparks.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
        sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(GLOW)
        sparks.LightEmission = 1
        sparks.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.15, 0)
        sparks.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.6)
        sparks.Rate = 10
        sparks.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.6)
        sparks.Parent = tip

        return tool
    end

    local function syncTrident()
        if not alive then return end
        local want = cfg.Demon.Show
        if want then
            if tridentTool and tridentTool.Parent and (tridentTool.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character
                or tridentTool.Parent == LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")) then return end
            local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
            if not backpack then return end
            if tridentTool then tridentTool:Destroy() end
            tridentTool = buildTrident()
            tridentTool:SetAttribute("CrackHubTrident", true)
            pcall(fitTool, tridentTool, TRIDENT_LENGTH)
            -- hold it higher and a bit further out so it stays in view in first person
            tridentTool.Grip = CFrame.new(0, -TRIDENT_FORWARD, -TRIDENT_RAISE) * tridentTool.Grip
            installTridentMoves(tridentTool)
            tridentTool.Parent = backpack
        elseif tridentTool then
            tridentTool:Destroy()
            tridentTool = nil
        end
    end
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
        tridentTool = nil
        task.wait(1)
        syncTrident()
    end)

    -- UI
    for _, kind in ipairs({ "Angel", "Demon" }) do
        local group = tab:AddGroup(kind, true)
        statusLabels[kind] = Label({
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44), LayoutOrder = NextOrder(), TextWrapped = true,
            TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText, Parent = group.Holder,
        })
        group:AddToggle({ Name = "Show " .. kind, Default = cfg[kind].Show, Bind = false,
            Callback = function(v) cfg[kind].Show = v; if kind == "Demon" then syncTrident() end end })
        group:AddToggle({ Name = "Effects", Default = cfg[kind].Effects, Bind = false,
            Callback = function(v) cfg[kind].Effects = v end })
        if kind == "Angel" then
            group:AddToggle({ Name = "Auto Dodge", Default = cfg.Angel.AutoDodge, Bind = false,
                Callback = function(enabled) cfg.Angel.AutoDodge = enabled end })
        end
        group:AddSlider({ Name = "Head Height", Min = -3, Max = 1, Default = cfg[kind].HeadHeight,
            Increment = 0.05, Suffix = "", Bind = false,
            Callback = function(v) cfg[kind].HeadHeight = v end })
    end
    tab:AddGroup("Companion Size", true):AddSlider({ Name = "Size", Min = 2, Max = 6, Default = cfg.Size,
        Increment = 0.1, Suffix = " st", Bind = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            cfg.Size = v
            removeCompanion("Angel"); removeCompanion("Demon") -- rebuilt at the new size next frame
        end })
    updateStatus()

    local stopAngelDodge = installAngelDodge()
    task.spawn(syncTrident)
    task.spawn(loadCatalogModel, "Angel")
    task.spawn(loadCatalogModel, "Demon")

    connect(RunService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local now = os.clock()
        render("Angel", root, dt, now)
        render("Demon", root, dt, now)
        updateTridentMark()
    end))

    return function()
        alive = false
        stopAngelDodge()
        if activeFlight then
            activeFlight.connection:Disconnect()
            activeFlight.model:Destroy()
            activeFlight = nil
        end
        for _, c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end
        for kind in pairs(companions) do removeCompanion(kind) end
        for _, m in pairs(catalogModels) do m:Destroy() end
        worldFolder:Destroy()
        if tridentTool then tridentTool:Destroy() end
    end
end

local Bridge = {}

function Bridge.install(window)
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local alive, connections, stops = true, {}, {}
    local globals = {}
    local base = getfenv()
    local environment = setmetatable({getgenv = function() return globals end}, {
        __index = function(_, key)
            local value = CrackHubEnvironment[key]
            if value ~= nil then return value end
            return base[key]
        end,
    })
    local function connect(signal, callback)
        local connection = signal:Connect(function(...)
            if alive and not window.Destroyed then return callback(...) end
        end)
        table.insert(connections, connection)
        return connection
    end
    local isAlive; isAlive = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return alive and not window.Destroyed end)
    local function create(className, properties, parent)
        local object = Create(className, properties)
        if parent then object.Parent = parent end
        return object
    end
    local group = window:CreateTabGroup("Combat", "shield-check")
    local sheriffTab = group:CreateTab("Sheriff", "badge-check")
    local murderTab = group:CreateTab("Murderer", "sword")
    local playerTab = group:CreateTab("Player", "users")
    local bodyguardTab = group:CreateTab("Bodyguard", "shield-check")
    local function flagName(prefix, text) return prefix .. "_" .. text:gsub("[^%w]", "_") end
    local function wrap(control)
        return {Set = function(value, silent) control:Set(value, silent) end,
            Get = function() return control.Value end, Native = control}
    end
    local function section(tab, prefix)
        local adapter = {tab = tab, prefix = prefix}
        function adapter:Group(options)
            self.current = self.tab:AddGroup(options.Title or options.Text or "General")
            return self.current
        end
        function adapter:Header(text) return self:Group({Title = text}) end
        function adapter:holder()
            if not self.current then self:Header("General") end
            return self.current
        end
        function adapter:withSettings(options)
            if type(options.Settings) ~= "function" then return end
            local previous = self.current
            self.current = self.tab:AddGroup((options.Text or "Options") .. " Settings")
            options.Settings()
            self.current = previous
        end
        function adapter:Toggle(options)
            local control = self:holder():AddToggle({Name = options.Text, Default = options.Default,
                Flag = options.Flag or flagName(self.prefix, options.Text), Callback = options.Callback})
            self:withSettings(options)
            return wrap(control)
        end
        function adapter:ToggleKey(options)
            local control = self:holder():AddToggle({Name = options.Text, Default = options.Default,
                Bind = options.Bind or true, BindChanged = options.OnBind,
                Flag = flagName(self.prefix, options.Text), Callback = options.Callback})
            self:withSettings(options)
            return wrap(control)
        end
        function adapter:Slider(options)
            return wrap(self:holder():AddSlider({Name = options.Text, Min = options.Min, Max = options.Max,
                Default = options.Default, Increment = 10 ^ -(options.Decimals or 0), Suffix = options.Suffix,
                Flag = flagName(self.prefix, options.Text), Callback = options.Callback}))
        end
        function adapter:Dropdown(options)
            local labels, toCode, toLabel = {}, {}, {}
            local function rebuild(items)
                labels, toCode, toLabel = {}, {}, {}
                for _, option in ipairs(items or {}) do
                    local code = type(option) == "table" and option.code or option
                    local label = type(option) == "table" and option.label or option
                    table.insert(labels, label); toCode[label], toLabel[code] = code, label
                end
            end
            local function display(value)
                if not options.Multi then return toLabel[value] or value end
                local selected = {}
                for _, code in ipairs(type(value) == "table" and value or {}) do table.insert(selected, toLabel[code] or code) end
                return selected
            end
            rebuild(options.Options)
            local control = self:holder():AddDropdown({Name = options.Text, Options = labels, Multi = options.Multi,
                Default = display(options.Default), Flag = flagName(self.prefix, options.Text),
                Callback = function(value)
                    if not options.Callback then return end
                    if options.Multi then
                        local selected = {}
                        for _, label in ipairs(value) do table.insert(selected, toCode[label] or label) end
                        options.Callback(selected)
                    else options.Callback(toCode[value] or value) end
                end})
            return {Set = function(value) control:Set(display(value)) end,
                SetOptions = function(items) rebuild(items); control:Refresh(labels, true) end, Native = control}
        end

        function adapter:Colorpicker(options)
            local control = self:holder():AddColorPicker({Name = options.Text, Default = options.Default,
                Flag = flagName(self.prefix, options.Text), Callback = function(color)
                    if options.Callback then options.Callback(color) end
                end})
            return wrap(control)
        end
        function adapter:Keybind(options)
            local control = self:holder():AddKeybind({Name = options.Text, Default = options.Default,
                Flag = flagName(self.prefix, options.Text), ChangedCallback = options.Callback})
            if options.OnPress then
                connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input)
                    if control.Binding or BindCapture:Blocked(input) or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
                    local key = control.Value
                    if key and (input.KeyCode == key or input.UserInputType == key) then options.OnPress() end
                end)
            end
            return wrap(control)
        end
        function adapter:Button(options)
            return self:holder():AddButton({Name = options.Text, Callback = options.Callback})
        end
        function adapter:Note(options)
            local holder = self:holder()
            local label = Create("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
                FontFace = Fonts.Regular, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
                Text = options.Text or "", TextWrapped = true, LayoutOrder = NextOrder(), Parent = holder.Holder})
            return label
        end
        function adapter:PlayerList(options)
            local roster = self:holder():AddSection("Players")
            local rows = {}
            local function remove(player)
                local entry = rows[player]
                if not entry then return end
                for _, connection in ipairs(entry.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
                entry.frame:Destroy()
                rows[player] = nil
            end
            local function add(player)
                if not isAlive() or rows[player] or options.ExcludeLocal and player == LocalPlayer then return end
                local row = Create("TextButton", {Name = "Player_" .. player.UserId, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element, BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = NextOrder(), Parent = roster.Holder}, {Corner(9)})
                local image = Create("ImageLabel", {Name = "Avatar", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. player.UserId .. "&w=150&h=150",
                    ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, Parent = row}, {Corner(99)})
                local name = Label({Text = player.DisplayName, FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 13,
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 9), Size = UDim2.new(1, -88, 0, 19),
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = row})
                Label({Text = "@" .. player.Name, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 30), Size = UDim2.new(1, -88, 0, 17),
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = row})
                local icon = Create("ImageLabel", {Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.5, -7), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, ImageColor3 = Theme.Accent, Parent = row})
                ApplyIcon(icon, options.ActionIcon or "user-round")
                local entry = {frame = row, connections = {}}
                rows[player] = entry
                table.insert(entry.connections, connect(row.Activated, function()
                    if player.Parent == Players and options.OnSelect then options.OnSelect(player) end
                end))
                table.insert(entry.connections, connect(row.MouseEnter, function() Tween(row, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.1}, 0.12) end))
                table.insert(entry.connections, connect(row.MouseLeave, function() Tween(row, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.4}, 0.12) end))
                table.insert(entry.connections, connect(player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("DisplayName"), function() name.Text = player.DisplayName end))
                task.spawn(function()
                    local ok, url, ready = pcall(function()
                        return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(player.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
                    end)
                    if ok and ready and isAlive() and rows[player] == entry and type(url) == "string" and url ~= "" then image.Image = url end
                end)
            end
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do add(player) end
            connect(Players.PlayerAdded, add)
            connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, remove)
            return roster
        end

        return adapter
    end

    local sheriff, murderer = section(sheriffTab, "Combat_Sheriff"), section(murderTab, "Combat_Murderer")
    local playerSection = section(playerTab, "Combat_Player")
    local gunSection = section(playerTab, "Combat_Sheriff")
    gunSection:Header("Gun")
    sheriff:Header("Sheriff")
    local settings = {autoFlingSheriff = false, autoFlingMurderer = false, sheriff = {autoKill = false, wallbang = false, predEx = 0,
        autoShoot = false, shotTiming = "Accurate", aimVer = "V4", aimType = "Classic", gunEsp = false,
        silentAim = false, pblank = false, resolver = false, predict = 0.13, autoGun = false,
        flickMouse = true, flickSpeed = 6, flickReturn = 100, fov = {on = false, size = 220, r = 120, g = 220, b = 255}}}
    local defaults = {autoFlingSheriff = false, sheriff = table.clone(settings.sheriff)}
    local translation = {data = {ru = {}, uk = {}}, tr = function(text) return text end}
    local roles = RoleData.create({environment = environment, storage = ReplicatedStorage, players = Players})
    InputBindings.install(environment, UserInputService)
    local bindReady = globals.__crackhubBindReady
    globals.__crackhubBindReady = function()
        return bindReady() and not BindCapture.Active
    end
    local context = {environment = environment, configuration = settings, defaults = defaults, section = sheriff,
        workspace = workspace, players = Players, player = LocalPlayer, roles = roles,
        runService = RunService, inputService = UserInputService, http = HttpService,
        storage = ReplicatedStorage, collection = game:GetService("CollectionService"),
        guiService = game:GetService("GuiService"), connect = connect, isAlive = isAlive,
        coreGui = window.Gui.Parent, stats = game:GetService("Stats"), translation = translation}
    local function copyContext(changes)
        local copied = table.clone(context)
        for key, value in pairs(changes or {}) do copied[key] = value end
        return copied
    end
    local api = {Settings = settings, Environment = environment, Globals = globals, Roles = roles,
        SheriffTab = sheriffTab, MurdererTab = murderTab, PlayerTab = playerTab, Context = context}
    local function install(label, callback)
        local ok, result = xpcall(callback, function(errorText) return debug.traceback(tostring(errorText), 2) end)
        if not ok then
            warn("[CrackHub " .. label .. "] " .. tostring(result))
            CrackHub:Notify({Title = label, Content = tostring(result):sub(1, 220), Type = "Error", Duration = 8})
        end
        return ok, result
    end
    local flingControls = {}
    local function autoFlingControl(targetSection, text, key, flag)
        local peers = flingControls[key] or {}
        flingControls[key] = peers
        local control = targetSection:Toggle({Text = text, Default = settings[key], Flag = flag,
            Callback = function(enabled)
                settings[key] = not not enabled
                for _, peer in ipairs(peers) do peer.Set(settings[key], true) end
            end})
        table.insert(peers, control)
        return control
    end
    install("Sheriff", function()
        local gunContext = copyContext({section = gunSection})
        local stopDrops, drops = GunFeature.installEsp(gunContext)
        table.insert(stops, stopDrops)
        context.drops, gunContext.drops = drops, drops
        GunFeature.installAuto(gunContext)
        local _, stopGuard = MuzzleGuard.install(context)
        table.insert(stops, stopGuard)
        local aim = AimEngine.install(context)
        context.aim = aim
        table.insert(stops, aim.stop)
        SheriffRuntime.install(context)
        SheriffSection.create(copyContext({resolverEnabled = function() return true end}))
        -- The donor exposes Silent Aim in its runtime, but omitted its visible control.
        sheriff:Toggle({Text = "Silent Aim", Default = false, Callback = function(enabled)
            settings.sheriff.silentAim = enabled
            local hook = globals.__crackhubAim
            if hook then
                hook.on = enabled or settings.sheriff.aimType == "Flick Shot"
                if hook.on and hook.installHook then hook.installHook() end
            end
        end})
        local fov = FovSettings.initialize(settings)
        local renderer = FovRenderer.create(environment, create)
        local state = {}
        local controller = FovController.create({environment = environment, settings = fov, state = state,
            renderers = renderer, isLocked = function() return FovTarget.hasMurderer({roles = roles,
                players = Players, localPlayer = LocalPlayer}) end,
            ensure = function() FovLifecycle.ensure({environment = environment, create = create,
                coreGui = window.Gui.Parent, player = LocalPlayer, renderers = renderer, state = state}) end})
        connect(RunService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() controller:step() end))
        table.insert(stops, function() if state.screen then state.screen:Destroy() end end)
        sheriff:Header("AimBot FOV")
        sheriff:Toggle({Text = "Show FOV Circle", Default = false,
            Callback = function(value) controller:setEnabled(value) end})
        sheriff:Dropdown({Text = "FOV Style", Default = fov.style, Options = {"Glow", "Gradient", "Dashed", "Classic"},
            Callback = function(value) fov.style = value end})
        local fovOptions = {environment = environment, settings = fov, configuration = settings,
            section = sheriff, redraw = function() controller:refresh() end, alphaEnabled = function() return false end}
        FovSection._createControls(fovOptions)
        local flingContext = copyContext({})
        local flingState = {busy = false, active = false, token = 0}
        api.FlingState = flingState
        globals.__crackhubFlingDown = function(target, duration, options)
            return FlingFeature.down(flingContext, flingState, target, duration, options)
        end
        sheriff:Header("Fling Murderer")
        autoFlingControl(sheriff, "Auto Fling Murderer", "autoFlingMurderer", "Combat_Sheriff_Auto_Fling_Murderer")
        function api:FlingRole(roleName)
            local roleData = roles()
            for _, target in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local role = roleData[target.Name]
                if target ~= LocalPlayer and type(role) == "table" and not role.Dead and not role.Killed
                    and tostring(role.Role):lower():find(roleName, 1, true) then
                    task.spawn(FlingFeature.player, flingContext, flingState, target)
                    return
                end
            end
        end
        sheriff:Button({Text = "Fling Murderer", Callback = function() api:FlingRole("murder") end})
        Bridge.autoFling(flingContext, flingState)
        table.insert(stops, function() flingState.token += 1 end)
    end)
    local tridentMurder
    install("Murderer", function()
        murderer:Header("Murderer")
        autoFlingControl(murderer, "Auto Fling Sheriff", "autoFlingSheriff", "Combat_Sheriff_Auto_Fling_Sheriff")
        murderer:Button({Text = "Fling Sheriff", Callback = function()
            if api.FlingRole then api:FlingRole("sheriff") end
        end})
        local murderContext = copyContext({section = murderer})
        local murder = MurderFeature.install(murderContext)
        tridentMurder = murder
        local _, stopKnife = KnifeAim.install(murderContext, murder)
        table.insert(stops, stopKnife)
        table.insert(stops, function() murder.killAll, murder.killGun, murder.aura = false, false, false end)
    end)

    install("Player", function()
        playerSection:Header("Fling Roles")
        autoFlingControl(playerSection, "Auto Fling Murderer", "autoFlingMurderer", "Combat_Player_Auto_Fling_Murderer")
        playerSection:Button({Text = "Fling Murderer", Callback = function()
            if api.FlingRole then api:FlingRole("murder") end
        end})
        autoFlingControl(playerSection, "Auto Fling Sheriff", "autoFlingSheriff", "Combat_Player_Auto_Fling_Sheriff")
        playerSection:Button({Text = "Fling Sheriff", Callback = function()
            if api.FlingRole then api:FlingRole("sheriff") end
        end})
    end)

    local trollTab = window:CreateTab("Troll", "rbxassetid://138828515077300")
    api.TrollTab = trollTab
    local fun = section(trollTab, "Troll")
    local trollContext = copyContext({section = fun, touchSection = fun,
        tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService"), debris = game:GetService("Debris")})
    local function keep(stop)
        if type(stop) ~= "function" then return end
        if not isAlive() then pcall(stop) else table.insert(stops, stop) end
    end
    local function guardianRole(player, data)
        local record = data[player.Name]
        local name = type(record) == "table" and record.Role or RoleData.infer(player)
        name = tostring(name or ""):lower()
        if name:find("murder", 1, true) then return "murderer" end
        return name
    end

    local function guardianOutcome(target)
        local data = roles()
        return tridentOutcome(guardianRole(LocalPlayer, data), guardianRole(target, data))
    end

    local hiddenTridentWeapons = {}
    local function hideTridentWeapon(tool, character)
        local prior = hiddenTridentWeapons[tool]
        if prior then prior() end
        local properties = {}
        local frameConnection, addedConnection, cursorConnection, guiConnection
        local stopped = false
        local hideSight = tool.Name == "Gun"
        local previousMouseIcon = hideSight and UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled
        local playerGui = hideSight and LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        local suppressCursor; suppressCursor = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled then UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false end
        end)
        local function hideSightObject(object)
            if properties[object] or object == window.Gui or object:IsDescendantOf(window.Gui) then return end
            local name = object.Name:lower():gsub("[^%w]", "")
            if not name:find("crosshair", 1, true) and not name:find("reticle", 1, true)
                and name ~= "guncursor" and name ~= "weaponcursor" and name ~= "gunaim" then return end
            local property
            if object:IsA("ScreenGui") then property = "Enabled"
            elseif object:IsA("GuiObject") then property = "Visible" end
            if not property then return end
            properties[object] = {property, object[property], false}
            object[property] = false
        end

        local function hide(object)
            local property, value
            if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                property, value = "LocalTransparencyModifier", 1
            elseif object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") then
                property, value = "Transparency", 1
            elseif object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Trail") or object:IsA("Light") then
                property, value = "Enabled", false
            end
            if not property or properties[object] then return end
            properties[object] = {property, object[property], value}
            object[property] = value
        end

        local restore; restore = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if stopped then return end
            stopped = true
            if frameConnection then frameConnection:Disconnect() end
            if addedConnection then addedConnection:Disconnect() end
            if cursorConnection then cursorConnection:Disconnect() end
            if guiConnection then guiConnection:Disconnect() end
            if hideSight then UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = previousMouseIcon end
            for object, property in pairs(properties) do
                if object.Parent then object[property[1]] = property[2] end
            end
            hiddenTridentWeapons[tool] = nil
        end)

        hiddenTridentWeapons[tool] = restore
        if hideSight then
            suppressCursor()
            cursorConnection = UserInputService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MouseIconEnabled"):Connect(suppressCursor)
            if playerGui then
                for _, object in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do hideSightObject(object) end
                guiConnection = playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(hideSightObject)
            end
        end
        for _, object in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do hide(object) end
        addedConnection = tool.DescendantAdded:Connect(hide)
        frameConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not isAlive() or LocalPlayer.Character ~= character or not tool.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                restore()
                return
            end
            if hideSight then suppressCursor() end
            for object, property in pairs(properties) do
                if object.Parent and object[property[1]] ~= property[3] then object[property[1]] = property[3] end
            end
        end))
        return restore
    end
    keep(function()
        for _, restore in pairs(hiddenTridentWeapons) do restore() end
    end)

    local function onTridentHit(player, character, trident, result)
        if not isAlive() or player.Character ~= character or guardianOutcome(player) ~= result then return end
        local data = roles()
        local own = LocalPlayer.Character
        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        local humanoid = own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
        if result == "knife" then
            if not tridentMurder or not MurderFeature.validTarget(tridentMurder, player, data) then return end
            local knife = MurderFeature.findKnife(tridentMurder, own) or MurderFeature.findKnife(tridentMurder, backpack)
            if not knife then return end
            local restoreTrident = trident.Parent == own
            local restoreVisibility = restoreTrident and hideTridentWeapon(knife, own)
            if restoreTrident then
                humanoid:UnequipTools()
                task.delay(0.15, function()
                    if isAlive() and backpack and trident.Parent == backpack and LocalPlayer.Character == own
                        and humanoid.Health > 0 and MurderFeature.findKnife(tridentMurder, own) then
                        pcall(humanoid.EquipTool, humanoid, trident)
                    end
                    restoreVisibility()
                end)
            end
            MurderFeature.killPlayer(tridentMurder, player)
        elseif result == "gun" then
            local shoot = globals.__crackhubShotMurder
            if shoot then
                local returnTool = trident.Parent == own and trident or nil
                shoot(character, returnTool, returnTool and hideTridentWeapon or nil)
            end
        else
            local fling = globals.__crackhubFlingPlayer
            if fling then fling(player) end
        end
    end

    function api:RockImpact(player, character, tool)
        if not isAlive() or not player or player == LocalPlayer or player.Parent ~= Players
            or not character or player.Character ~= character or not tool or not tool.Parent
            or tool:GetAttribute("CrackHubRockProjectile") ~= true then return end
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
        onTridentHit(player, character, tool, guardianOutcome(player))
    end

    install("Bodyguard", function()
        keep(InstallBodyguard(window, bodyguardTab, {
            GetRoles = roles, RoleOf = guardianRole, Outcome = guardianOutcome, Hit = onTridentHit,
        }))
    end)
    local playerFlingContext = copyContext({section = playerSection, touchSection = playerSection,
        tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService"), debris = game:GetService("Debris")})
    install("Player Fling", function()
            playerSection:Header("Troll")
            keep(FlingFeature.installTool(playerFlingContext))
            local state = api.FlingState or {busy = false, active = false, token = 0}
            globals.__crackhubFlingDown = function(target, duration, options)
                return FlingFeature.down(playerFlingContext, state, target, duration, options)
            end
            globals.__crackhubFlingChar = function(target, duration)
                if target then return FlingFeature.down(playerFlingContext, state, target, duration or 0.8) end
            end
            globals.__crackhubFlingPlayer = function(player) return FlingFeature.player(playerFlingContext, state, player) end
            globals.__crackhubFlingPersist = function(player, options) return FlingFeature.persist(playerFlingContext, state, player, options) end
            globals.__crackhubFlingCancel = function() state.token += 1 end
            FlingFeature.installTouch(playerFlingContext)
            keep(FlingFeature.installClick(playerFlingContext))
            playerSection:Header("Fling Players")
            playerSection:PlayerList({ExcludeLocal = true, Momentary = true, ActionIcon = "zap", OnSelect = function(player)
                if state.target == player then state.token += 1; return end
                task.spawn(FlingFeature.persist, playerFlingContext, state, player, {time = 10})
            end})
            keep(function() state.token += 1 end)
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        if not isAlive() then return end
        install("Troll", function()
            fun:Header("Fake Items")
            keep(Appearance.installFakeItems(trollContext))
            local _, stopTools = Appearance.FunTools.install(trollContext)
            keep(stopTools)
        end)
    end)


    function api:InstallEffects(tab)
        if self.EffectsInstalled then return end
        self.EffectsInstalled = true
        local effects = section(tab, "Imported_Effects")
        function effects:withSettings(options)
            if type(options.Settings) ~= "function" then return end
            local parent, previousPrefix = self:holder(), self.prefix
            self.prefix = previousPrefix .. "_" .. (options.Text or "Options")
            self.current = parent:AddPlainSection((options.Text or "Options") .. " Settings")
            local ok, errorText = xpcall(options.Settings, function(message) return debug.traceback(tostring(message),2) end)
            self.current, self.prefix = parent, previousPrefix
            if not ok then error(errorText) end
        end
        function effects:Sub() end
        function effects:Columns() end
        function effects:Container() return self:holder().Holder end
        local nova = {
            Font = {Semi = function() return Fonts.Medium or Fonts.Regular end,
                Bold = function() return Fonts.Bold or Fonts.Regular end,
                Medium = function() return Fonts.Medium or Fonts.Regular end},
            Theme = {bind = function(object, property, key)
                object[property] = key == "Glass" and Theme.Stroke or key == "Accent" and Theme.Accent
                    or key == "Text" and Theme.Text or key == "Muted" and Theme.SubText or Theme.Element
            end},
            paint = function(object, property, key)
                object[property] = key == "Accent" and Theme.Accent or key == "Glass" and Theme.Stroke or Theme.Element
            end,
            label = function(options)
                return Create("TextLabel", {Parent = options.Parent, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
