                    Text = options.Text, FontFace = options.Font, TextSize = options.Size,
                    Position = options.Pos, Size = options.Box, ZIndex = options.Z or 1,
                    TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd})
            end,
        }
        nova.icon = function(options)
            local icon = Create("ImageLabel", {Parent=options.Parent, BackgroundTransparency=1,
                Size=UDim2.fromOffset(options.Size or 18, options.Size or 18), Position=options.Pos,
                AnchorPoint=options.Anchor or Vector2.zero, ZIndex=options.Z or 1,
                ImageColor3=options.Color=="OnAccent" and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Theme.SubText})
            ApplyIcon(icon, options.Icon)
            return icon
        end
        settings.optim = type(settings.optim)=="table" and settings.optim or {}
        local ctx = copyContext({section = effects, window = window, nova = nova, applyHooks = {},
            translation = {tr=function(text) return text end,bind=function(object,text) object.Text=text end},
            tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService"), lighting = game:GetService("Lighting"),
            create = function(class, properties, parent)
                properties = table.clone(properties or {})
                properties.Parent = parent or properties.Parent
                local object = Create(class, properties)
                if object:IsA("GuiObject") and properties.LayoutOrder == nil then object.LayoutOrder = NextOrder() end
                return object
            end,
            corner = function(object, radius) Corner(radius).Parent = object end})
        local function keep(stop) if type(stop) == "function" then table.insert(stops, stop) end end
        effects:Header("Knife Effects")
        effects:Toggle({Text="Unlock All Effects (game menu)",Default=true,Callback=function(value)
            window.CrackHubInventoryEffectsEnabled=value==true
            local inventory=window.CrackHubGameInventory
            if inventory then inventory:SetEffectsEnabled(value==true) end
        end})
        install("Kill Effects", function() keep(GameEffects.Kill.install(ctx)) end)
        effects:Header("Character Effects")
        install("Self Chams", function() local _, stop = SelfChams.install(ctx); keep(stop) end)
        install("Aura Tint", function() local _, stop = AuraTint.install(ctx); keep(stop) end)
        install("Custom Cursor", function()
            local state, stop=CustomCursor.install(ctx)
            api.CursorState=state
            keep(stop)
        end)

    end


    function api:Stop()
        if not alive then return end
        alive = false
        settings.sheriff.silentAim, settings.sheriff.autoShoot = false, false
        settings.sheriff.aimType, settings.sheriff.autoGun = "Classic", false
        settings.autoFlingSheriff, settings.autoFlingMurderer = false, false
        if globals.__crackhubAim then globals.__crackhubAim.on = false end
        if globals.__crackhubKnifeAim then globals.__crackhubKnifeAim.on, globals.__crackhubKnifeAim.auto = false, false end
        for index = #stops, 1, -1 do pcall(stops[index]) end
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
        if self.ChamState then
            EspChams.clear(self.ChamState)
            EspChamModel.unbind(self.ChamState)
            EspChamModel.purge(self.ChamState)
            if self.ChamState.modelFolder then self.ChamState.modelFolder:Destroy() end
        end
    end
    window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(function() api:Stop() end)
    return setmetatable(api, {__index = Bridge})
end

function Bridge:BindChams(tab, receiver, refreshPreview)
    local settings = EspSettings.create(self.Environment, {})
    settings.chams, settings.chamsThrough = receiver.Chams, receiver.ChamsWalls
    settings.chamsVisibleOnly = not settings.chamsThrough
    settings.chamsRange = 300
    settings.chamsColour, settings.chamsEdge = receiver.ChamsFill, receiver.ChamsOutline
    settings.chamsAlpha, settings.chamsEdgeAlpha = (1 - receiver.ChamsFillT) * 100, (1 - receiver.ChamsOutlineT) * 100
    local state = {context = self.Context, settings = settings, highlights = {}, chamStates = {}, models = {}, halos = {},
        modelBudget = 2, colors = EspColor.create(self.Environment, settings), chamsMaterials = EspChams.materials(self.Environment)}
    self.ChamState, self.ChamOwners, self.ReceiverESP = state, {}, receiver
    EspChamModel.bind(state)
    local legacyTransparency, toggleControls = {}, {}
    local function sync()
        receiver.Chams, receiver.ChamsWalls = settings.chams, settings.chamsThrough
        receiver.ChamsFill, receiver.ChamsOutline = settings.chamsColour, settings.chamsEdge
        receiver.ChamsFillT, receiver.ChamsOutlineT = 1 - settings.chamsAlpha / 100, 1 - settings.chamsEdgeAlpha / 100
        if legacyTransparency.fill then legacyTransparency.fill.Value = receiver.ChamsFillT * 100 end
        if legacyTransparency.edge then legacyTransparency.edge.Value = receiver.ChamsOutlineT * 100 end
        for _, field in ipairs({"chamsVisibleOnly", "chamsThrough"}) do
            local control = toggleControls[field]
            if control and control.Value ~= settings[field] then control:Set(settings[field], true) end
        end
        if refreshPreview then refreshPreview() end
    end
    local section = {current = nil}
    function section:Group(options) self.current = tab:AddGroup(options.Title) end
    local feature = {settings = settings, context = {section = section}}
    local aliases = {chams = "ESP_Chams", chamsThrough = "ESP_ChamsWalls", chamsColour = "ESP_ChamsFill",
        chamsEdge = "ESP_ChamsOutline"}
    local function changed(field, value)
        settings[field] = value
        if field == "chamsVisibleOnly" then settings.chamsThrough = not value end
        if field == "chamsThrough" then settings.chamsVisibleOnly = not value end
        if field == "chams" or field == "chamsMaterial" or field == "chamsStyle" or field == "chamsShell"
            or field == "murdMat" or field == "sheriffMat" or field == "chamsVisibleOnly" or field == "chamsThrough" then EspChams.clear(state) end
        sync()
    end
    local controls = {}
    local sliderControls = {}
    function controls.toggle(_, field, text, nested)
        toggleControls[field] = section.current:AddToggle({Name = text, Default = settings[field], Flag = aliases[field] or "ESP_Chams_" .. field,
            Callback = function(value) changed(field, value) end})
        if nested then nested() end
    end
    function controls.slider(_, options)
        sliderControls[options.field] = section.current:AddSlider({Name = options.text, Min = options.min, Max = options.max,
            Default = settings[options.field], Increment = 10 ^ -(options.decimals or 0), Suffix = options.suffix,
            Flag = "ESP_Chams_" .. options.field, Callback = function(value) changed(options.field, value) end})
    end
    function controls.dropdown(_, field, text, options)
        section.current:AddDropdown({Name = text, Options = options, Default = settings[field],
            Flag = "ESP_Chams_" .. field, Callback = function(value) changed(field, value) end})
    end
    function controls.colorpicker(_, field, text)
        section.current:AddColorPicker({Name = text, Default = settings[field], Flag = aliases[field] or "ESP_Chams_" .. field,
            Callback = function(value) changed(field, value) end})
    end
    Bridge.chamsControls(feature, controls)
    controls.slider(feature, {field = "chamsMaxDist", text = "Chams Max Distance (0 = unlimited)", min = 0, max = 5000, suffix = " st"})
    for _, entry in ipairs({{"fill", "ESP_ChamsFillT", "chamsAlpha"}, {"edge", "ESP_ChamsOutlineT", "chamsEdgeAlpha"}}) do
        local field = entry[3]
        local legacy = {Type = "Slider", Value = 100 - settings[field]}
        function legacy:Set(value)
            sliderControls[field]:Set(100 - math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 0, 0, 100))
        end
        legacyTransparency[entry[1]], CrackHub.Flags[entry[2]] = legacy, legacy
    end
    sync()
end

function Bridge:BeginESPFrame()
    local state = self.ChamState
    if not state then return end
    state.modelBudget = 2
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (state.lastPoolSweep or 0) > 2 then
        state.lastPoolSweep = now
        EspChamModel.sweep(state)
    end
end

function Bridge:ApplyChams(model, player, camera, role, distance, visible)
    local state = self.ChamState
    if not state or not player then return end
    local settings, receiver = state.settings, self.ReceiverESP
    settings.murdererColour, settings.sheriffColour, settings.heroColour = receiver.MurdererColor, receiver.SheriffColor, receiver.HeroColor
    settings.noRoleColour = settings.chamsColour
    self.ChamOwners[model] = player
    if settings.chamsVisibleOnly and not visible then EspChams.drop(state, player); return end
    if settings.chamsMaxDist > 0 and distance > settings.chamsMaxDist then EspChams.drop(state, player); return end
    local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
    local _, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
    EspChams.apply(state, {player = player, character = model, role = role, seen = visible,
        cameraPosition = camera.CFrame.Position, alpha = 1, inView = onScreen, distance = distance})
end

function Bridge:DropChams(model)
    local owner = self.ChamOwners and self.ChamOwners[model]
    if owner and self.ChamState then EspChams.drop(self.ChamState, owner); self.ChamOwners[model] = nil end
end

function Bridge:PaintPreview(clone)
    local state = self.ChamState
    if not state then return end
    local settings = state.settings
    local _, specification, kind = EspChams.material(state)
    for _, part in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
        if not part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Transparency >= 1 then continue end
        part.Material = specification and specification[1] or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        part.Reflectance = specification and specification[4] or 0
        local color = settings.chamsColour
        if kind == "Gradient" then
            local root = clone:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            color = settings.chamsGradB:Lerp(settings.chamsGradA, math.clamp((part.Position.Y - (root and root.Position.Y or 0) + 3) / 6, 0, 1))
        end
        part.Color = EspColor.cham(state.colors, color)
        part.Transparency = math.max(part.Transparency, 1 - settings.chamsAlpha / 100)
    end
end

		EspFeature.dropdown(state, "sheriffMat", "Sheriff Material", overrides)
	end)
	EspFeature.dropdown(state, "chamsStyle", "Chams Style", {"Soft", "Outline", "Solid", "Glow"})
	EspFeature.dropdown(state, "chamsMaterial", "Material", materials)
	EspFeature.toggle(state, "chamsOutline", "Chams Outline", function()
		EspFeature.slider(state, {field = "chamsEdgeAlpha", text = "Edge Strength", min = 0, max = 100, suffix = "%"})
		EspFeature.toggle(state, "chamsEdgeRole", "Role Edge")
		EspFeature.colorpicker(state, "chamsEdge", "Visible Edge")
		EspFeature.colorpicker(state, "chamsEdgeHidden", "Hidden Edge")
	end)
	EspFeature.toggle(state, "chamsRole", "Role Colors", function()
		EspFeature.colorpicker(state, "chamsColour", "Visible Fill")
		EspFeature.colorpicker(state, "chamsHidden", "Hidden Fill")
	end)
	EspFeature.toggle(state, "chamsOverlay", "Glow Overlay")
	EspFeature.dropdown(state, "chamsAnim", "Animation", {"None", "Rhythm", "Breathe", "Flow"})
	EspFeature.toggle(state, "chamsFlash", "Flash On Sight")
end

function Bridge.autoFling(context, state)
	local environment = context.environment
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local origins, characters, finished, attempts = {}, {}, {}, {}
		local round, roundAt = false, 0
		while context.isAlive() do
			local roles = context.roles()
			local active = false
			for _, role in roles do
				if type(role) ~= "table" or not role.Role then continue end
				local name = tostring(role.Role):lower()
				if name:find("murder") or name:find("sheriff") then active = true; break end
			end
			if active and not round then roundAt = environment.tick() end
			round = active
			local own = context.player.Character
			local humanoid = own and own:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local ownRoot = own and own:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local canFling = (context.configuration.autoFlingSheriff or context.configuration.autoFlingMurderer) and active and humanoid and ownRoot and humanoid.Health > 0
				and environment.tick() - roundAt >= 2 and not state.active
			if canFling then
				for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
					local role = roles[player.Name]
					if player == context.player or type(role) ~= "table" or role.Dead == true or role.Killed == true
						or not role.Role then continue end
					local roleName = tostring(role.Role):lower()
					if not (context.configuration.autoFlingSheriff and roleName:find("sheriff", 1, true)
						or context.configuration.autoFlingMurderer and roleName:find("murder", 1, true)) then continue end
					local character = player.Character
					local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if not root then break end
					local id = player.UserId
					if characters[id] ~= character then characters[id], origins[id], finished[id], attempts[id] = character, root.Position, nil, 0 end
					if (root.Position - (origins[id] or root.Position)).Magnitude >= 5000 then finished[id] = true end
					if finished[id] then continue end
					if root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 60 then
						if (attempts[id] or 0) >= 3 then finished[id] = true end
						if not finished[id] then attempts[id] = (attempts[id] or 0) + 1; pcall(FlingFeature.player, context, state, player) end
					end
					break
				end
			end
			if not context.configuration.autoFlingSheriff and not context.configuration.autoFlingMurderer and next(origins) then origins, characters, finished, attempts = {}, {}, {}, {} end
			environment.task.wait(0.3)
		end
	end)
end

return Bridge

end

local function CrackHubCreateBuiltInAuras()
local AuraEngine = {}
local AURA_CLASSES = {P = "ParticleEmitter", B = "Beam", T = "Trail", L = "PointLight", S = "SpotLight", U = "SurfaceLight", A = "Attachment",
	FI = "Fire", SM = "Smoke", SP = "Sparkles", F = "Folder", PT = "Part", SH = "SpecialMesh", HL = "Highlight", MD = "Model"}
local AURA_HAT_EFFECTS = {P = true, B = true, T = true, L = true, S = true, U = true}

function AuraEngine.decode(environment, value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	local kind = value[1]
	if kind == 1 then return environment.Color3.new(value[2], value[3], value[4]) end
	if kind == 2 then return environment.Vector3.new(value[2], value[3], value[4]) end
	if kind == 3 then return environment.Vector2.new(value[2], value[3]) end
	if kind == 4 then return environment.NumberRange.new(value[2], value[3]) end
	if kind == 5 then
		local points = {}
		for index = 2, #value, 3 do table.insert(points, environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(value[index], value[index + 1], value[index + 2])) end
		return environment.NumberSequence.new(points)
	end
	if kind == 6 then
		local points = {}
		for index = 2, #value, 4 do
			table.insert(points, environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(value[index], environment.Color3.new(value[index + 1], value[index + 2], value[index + 3])))
		end
		return environment.ColorSequence.new(points)
	end
	if kind == 7 then return environment.CFrame.new(table.unpack(value, 2, 13)) end
	if kind == 8 then
		local name = tostring(value[2]):gsub("^Enum%.", "")
		local ok, item = pcall(function() return environment.Enum[name][value[3]] end)
		return ok and item or nil
	end
	return nil
end

function AuraEngine.sequence(environment, sequence, scale, fade)
	local points = {}
	for _, point in sequence.Keypoints do
		local value = fade and 1 - (1 - point.Value) * scale or point.Value * scale
		table.insert(points, environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point.Time, value, point.Envelope * scale))
	end
	return environment.NumberSequence.new(points)
end

function AuraEngine.recolor(environment, sequence, tint)
	if environment.typeof(sequence) ~= "ColorSequence" then return environment.ColorSequence.new(tint) end
	local points = {}
	for _, point in sequence.Keypoints do
		local original = point.Value
		local high, low = math.max(original.R, original.G, original.B), math.min(original.R, original.G, original.B)
		local brightness = 0.3 + 0.7 * high
		local color = environment.Color3.new(tint.R * brightness, tint.G * brightness, tint.B * brightness)
		if low > 0.72 then color = color:Lerp(environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), (low - 0.72) / 0.28 * 0.75) end
		table.insert(points, environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(point.Time, color))
	end
	return environment.ColorSequence.new(points)
end

function AuraEngine.tune(environment, object, options)
	local size, density, bright, alpha = options.size or 1, options.density or 1, options.bright or 1, options.alpha or 1
	pcall(function()
		if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			if size ~= 1 then
				object.Size = AuraEngine.sequence(environment, object.Size, size, false)
				object.Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(object.Speed.Min * size, object.Speed.Max * size)
				object.Acceleration *= size
			end
			if density ~= 1 then object.Rate *= density end
			if bright ~= 1 then object.Brightness *= bright end
			if alpha ~= 1 then object.Transparency = AuraEngine.sequence(environment, object.Transparency, alpha, true) end
			return
		end
		if object:IsA("Beam") then
			if size ~= 1 then
				object.Width0, object.Width1 = object.Width0 * size, object.Width1 * size
				object.CurveSize0, object.CurveSize1 = object.CurveSize0 * size, object.CurveSize1 * size
			end
			if bright ~= 1 then object.Brightness *= bright end
			if alpha ~= 1 then object.Transparency = AuraEngine.sequence(environment, object.Transparency, alpha, true) end
			return
		end
		if object:IsA("Trail") then
			if bright ~= 1 then object.Brightness *= bright end
			if alpha ~= 1 then object.Transparency = AuraEngine.sequence(environment, object.Transparency, alpha, true) end
			return
		end
		if object:IsA("Light") then
			if size ~= 1 then object.Range *= size end
			if bright ~= 1 then object.Brightness *= bright end
		end
	end)
end

function AuraEngine.build(environment, data, parent, build)
	if data.g and build.off[data.g] then return nil end
	local class = AURA_CLASSES[data.c]
	if not class then return nil end
	local object = environment.Instance.new(class)
	object.Name = data.n or class
	for property, value in data.p or {} do pcall(function() object[property] = AuraEngine.decode(environment, value) end) end
	if data.c == "A" then
		local position = object.Position
		if build.hatHost then
			object.Position = position * ((build.hatK or 1) * build.size)
		else
			local fit = build.fit
			if build.mapA then
				object.Position = build.mapA(position)
			else
				if fit then position = environment.Vector3.new(position.X * fit.x, fit.f + (position.Y + 3) * fit.y, position.Z * fit.z) end
				object.Position = position * build.size + build.liftV
			end
		end
	end
	if data.c == "PT" then
		object.Anchored, object.CanCollide, object.CanQuery, object.CanTouch, object.Massless, object.CastShadow = false, false, false, false, true, false
		local scale = (build.hatK or 1) * build.size
		object.Size *= scale
		local frame = AuraEngine.decode(environment, data.r) or environment.CFrame.new()
		frame = environment.CFrame.new((frame.Position - environment.Vector3.new(0, build.hatCrown or 0, 0)) * scale) * frame.Rotation
		if build.hatHost then
			object.CFrame = build.hatHost.CFrame * frame
			local weld = environment.Instance.new("Weld")
			weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.C0, weld.Parent = build.hatHost, object, frame, object
		end
		local alpha = build.options.alpha or 1
		if alpha ~= 1 then object.Transparency = 1 - (1 - object.Transparency) * alpha end
	end
	if data.c == "SH" then
		local scale = (build.hatK or 1) * build.size
		object.Scale, object.Offset = object.Scale * scale, object.Offset * scale
	end
	if data.c == "HL" then
		local alpha, bright = build.options.alpha or 1, build.options.bright or 1
		object.FillTransparency = 1 - math.clamp((1 - object.FillTransparency) * alpha * bright, 0, 1)
		object.OutlineTransparency = 1 - math.clamp((1 - object.OutlineTransparency) * alpha, 0, 1)
	end
	if data.c == "FI" and build.hatHost then object.Size = math.clamp(object.Size * (build.hatK or 1) * build.size, 2, 30) end
	if data.c == "P" then object.LockedToPart = true end
	if data.c == "T" then object.Lifetime = math.min(object.Lifetime, 0.3) end
	if data.i then build.ids[data.i] = object end
	if data.a or data.b then table.insert(build.links, {object, data.a, data.b}) end
	if data.g then AuraEngine.tune(environment, object, build.options) end
	if not data.g and build.hatTune and AURA_HAT_EFFECTS[data.c] then AuraEngine.tune(environment, object, build.hatTune) end
	object:SetAttribute("CrackHubImportedAura", true)
	object:SetAttribute("CrackHubImportedAuraKey", build.key)
	for _, child in data.k or {} do AuraEngine.build(environment, child, object, build) end
	object.Parent = parent
	return object
end

function AuraEngine.link(build)
	for _, link in build.links do
		pcall(function()
			if link[2] and build.ids[link[2]] then link[1].Attachment0 = build.ids[link[2]] end
			if link[3] and build.ids[link[3]] then link[1].Attachment1 = build.ids[link[3]] end
		end)
	end
end

local AURA_R15 = {HumanoidRootPart = true, Head = true, UpperTorso = true, LowerTorso = true, LeftUpperArm = true, LeftLowerArm = true, LeftHand = true,
	RightUpperArm = true, RightLowerArm = true, RightHand = true, LeftUpperLeg = true, LeftLowerLeg = true, LeftFoot = true, RightUpperLeg = true, RightLowerLeg = true, RightFoot = true}
local AURA_R6 = {HumanoidRootPart = true, Head = true, Torso = true, ["Left Arm"] = true, ["Right Arm"] = true, ["Left Leg"] = true, ["Right Leg"] = true}
local AURA_LIMBS = {["Left Arm"] = "LeftUpperArm", ["Right Arm"] = "RightUpperArm", ["Left Leg"] = "LeftUpperLeg", ["Right Leg"] = "RightUpperLeg"}

function AuraEngine.fit(environment, character, root)
	local head, foot, torso = character:FindFirstChild("Head"), character:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot"), character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	if not head or not foot or not torso or not head:IsA("BasePart") or not foot:IsA("BasePart") or not torso:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
	local rest, links = {[root] = environment.CFrame.new()}, {}
	for _, joint in character:GetDescendants() do
		if joint:IsA("Motor6D") and joint.Part0 and joint.Part1 then
			table.insert(links, {joint.Part0, joint.Part1, joint.C0, joint.C1})
			continue
		end
		if not joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint") or not joint.Attachment0 or not joint.Attachment1 then continue end
		local first, second = joint.Attachment0, joint.Attachment1
		if first.Parent and second.Parent and first.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and second.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(links, {first.Parent, second.Parent, first.CFrame, second.CFrame})
		end
	end
	local changed = true
	while changed do
		changed = false
		for _, link in links do
			if not rest[link[1]] or rest[link[2]] then continue end
			rest[link[2]] = rest[link[1]] * link[3] * link[4]:Inverse()
			changed = true
		end
	end
	if not rest[head] or not rest[foot] then return nil end
	local floor = rest[foot].Position.Y - foot.Size.Y / 2
	local height = (rest[head].Position.Y - floor) / 4.5
	if floor > -1 or height < 0.4 or height > 2 then return nil end
	return {x = math.clamp(torso.Size.X / 2, 0.45, 1.8), y = height, z = math.clamp(torso.Size.Z, 0.45, 1.8), f = floor, rest = rest}
end

function AuraEngine.put(state, character, root, key, options)
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local data = state.data[key]
	if not data then return end
	options = options or {}
	if data.hat then return AuraEngine.putHat(state, character, data, key, options) end
	local scale, lift = options.size or 1, options.lift or 0
	local isR15 = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") ~= nil
	local fit = isR15 and AuraEngine.fit(environment, character, root) or nil
	local build = {key = key, options = options, off = options.off or {}, size = scale, ids = {}, links = {}, liftV = environment.Vector3.zero}
	local rigScale, mapPosition
	if data.rig and fit then
		local torso, head = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local torsoRest, headRest = torso and fit.rest[torso], head and fit.rest[head]
		if torsoRest and headRest and headRest.Position.Y > torsoRest.Position.Y + 0.2 then
			local rig = data.rig
			local y = (headRest.Position.Y - torsoRest.Position.Y) / (rig.hy - rig.ty)
			local x, z = math.clamp(torso.Size.X / rig.tx, 0.3, 2.5), math.clamp(torso.Size.Z / rig.tz, 0.3, 2.5)
			local originY = torsoRest.Position.Y
			rigScale = environment.Vector3.new(x, y, z)
			mapPosition = function(position) return environment.Vector3.new(position.X * x, originY + (position.Y - rig.ty) * y, position.Z * z) end
		end
	end
	for _, hostData in data.h or {} do
		build.mapA = nil
		local part = character:FindFirstChild(hostData.n)
		local allowed = isR15 and AURA_R15[hostData.n] or not isR15 and AURA_R6[hostData.n]
		local host
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and allowed then
			build.liftV = part.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(environment.Vector3.new(0, lift, 0))
			build.fit = part == root and fit or nil
			if mapPosition then
				local localLift = build.liftV
				if part == root then
					build.mapA = function(position) return mapPosition(position) * scale + localLift end
				else
					local reference = AuraEngine.decode(environment, hostData.s) or part.Size
					local ratios = environment.Vector3.new(part.Size.X / math.max(reference.X, 0.01), part.Size.Y / math.max(reference.Y, 0.01), part.Size.Z / math.max(reference.Z, 0.01))
					build.mapA = function(position) return environment.Vector3.new(position.X * ratios.X, position.Y * ratios.Y, position.Z * ratios.Z) * scale + localLift end
				end
			end
			host = part
		else
			build.liftV, build.fit = environment.Vector3.zero, nil
			local original = AuraEngine.decode(environment, hostData.cf) or environment.CFrame.new()
			local position = original.Position
			if mapPosition then position = mapPosition(position) end
			if not mapPosition and fit then position = environment.Vector3.new(position.X * fit.x, fit.f + (position.Y + 3) * fit.y, position.Z * fit.z) end
			local frame = environment.CFrame.new(position * scale + environment.Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)) * original.Rotation
			if mapPosition then
				build.mapA = function(localPosition)
					return frame:PointToObjectSpace(mapPosition(original:PointToWorldSpace(localPosition)) * scale + environment.Vector3.new(0, lift, 0))
				end
			end
			host = environment.Instance.new("Part")
			host.Name = "CrackHubAuraHost"
			host.Size = (AuraEngine.decode(environment, hostData.s) or environment.Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)) * scale
			if rigScale then host.Size = environment.Vector3.new(host.Size.X * rigScale.X, host.Size.Y * rigScale.Y, host.Size.Z * rigScale.Z) end
			host.Transparency, host.CanCollide, host.CanQuery, host.CanTouch, host.CastShadow, host.Massless = 1, false, false, false, false, true
			local limb = fit and AURA_LIMBS[hostData.n] and character:FindFirstChild(AURA_LIMBS[hostData.n])
			local anchor, offset = root, frame
			if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") and fit.rest[limb] then anchor, offset = limb, fit.rest[limb]:Inverse() * frame end
			host.CFrame = anchor.CFrame * offset
			local weld = environment.Instance.new("Weld")
			weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.C0, weld.Parent = anchor, host, offset, host
			host:SetAttribute("CrackHubImportedAura", true)
			host:SetAttribute("CrackHubImportedAuraKey", key)
			host.Parent = character
		end
		for _, child in hostData.k or {} do AuraEngine.build(environment, child, host, build) end
	end
	AuraEngine.link(build)
end

    local cached
    local currentCharacter
    local environment = getfenv()
    local function data()
        if not cached then cached = createAuraData() end
        return cached
    end
    local api = {Catalog = AURA_CATALOG}
    function api:Clear()
        if currentCharacter then
            for _, object in ipairs(currentCharacter:GetDescendants()) do
                if object.Parent and object:GetAttribute("CrackHubImportedAura") then object:Destroy() end
            end
        end
        currentCharacter = nil
    end
    function api:Apply(character, key)
        self:Clear()
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return {} end
        local definitions = data()
        if not definitions[key] then error("Aura data missing: " .. tostring(key)) end
        currentCharacter = character
        AuraEngine.put({context = {environment = environment}, data = definitions}, character, root, key, {mine = true})
        local objects = {}
        for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if object:GetAttribute("CrackHubImportedAura") then table.insert(objects, object) end
        end
        return objects
    end
    return api
end

local function CrackHubInstallTeleport(window, getRoles)
    local stopped, elapsed = false, 0
    local connections, entries, thumbnails, loading = {}, {}, {}, {}
    local tab = window:CreateTab("Teleport", "rbxassetid://137091405832737")
    local destinations = tab:AddGroup("TP Role")
    local roster = tab:AddGroup("TP Player")
    local rows = Create("Frame", {Name = "TeleportPlayerRows", BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        LayoutOrder = NextOrder(), Parent = roster.Holder}, {List(5)})
    local api = {Tab = tab, Entries = entries, RoleRows = {}}
    local function alive() return not stopped and not window.Destroyed end
    local function connect(signal, callback)
        local connection = signal:Connect(function(...) if alive() then return callback(...) end end)
        table.insert(connections, connection)
        return connection
    end
    local function notify(message)
        if alive() then CrackHub:Notify({Title = "Teleport", Content = message, Type = "Warning", Duration = 3}) end
    end
    local function move(target)
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not alive() or not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then notify("Your character is not ready"); return false end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            root.CFrame = target
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
        end)
        if not ok then notify("Could not teleport") end
        return ok
    end
    local function teleportPlayer(player)
        if not player or player == LocalPlayer or player.Parent ~= Players then notify("Player is unavailable"); return false end
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then notify("Player has no living character"); return false end
        return move(root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 5))
    end
    local function inferredRole(player)
        local character = player.Character
        if not character then return nil end
        local role = player:GetAttribute("Role") or character:GetAttribute("Role")
        if role then return tostring(role):lower() end
        for _, container in ipairs({character, player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")}) do
            for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if not tool:IsA("Tool") then continue end
                local name = tool.Name:lower()
                if name:find("knife", 1, true) then return "murderer" end
                if name:find("gun", 1, true) or name == "revolver" then return "sheriff" end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function findRole(wanted)
        local ok, roles = pcall(getRoles)
        if not ok or type(roles) ~= "table" then roles = {} end
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player == LocalPlayer then continue end
            local info = roles[player.Name]
            local role = info and info.Role and tostring(info.Role):lower() or inferredRole(player)
            local character = player.Character
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if role and role:find(wanted, 1, true) and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
                and (not info or not info.Dead and not info.Killed) then return player end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function lobby()
        local model = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby") or workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
        local spawns = model and model:FindFirstChild("Spawns", true)
        local spawn = spawns and spawns:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            or model and model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
            or workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
        if not spawn then notify("Lobby spawn was not found"); return false end
        return move(spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
    end
    local function map()
        local current
        for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if model:IsA("Model") and not model.Name:lower():find("lobby", 1, true)
                and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
                and (model:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer", true) or model:FindFirstChild("Spawns", true)) then
                current = model; break
            end
        end
        if not current then notify("No map loaded"); return false end
        local points = {}
        local spawns = current:FindFirstChild("Spawns", true)
        if spawns then
            for _, object in ipairs(spawns:GetDescendants()) do
                if object:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(points, object) end
            end
        end
        if #points > 0 then return move(points[math.random(1, #points)].CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)) end
        local coins = current:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer", true)
        local part = coins and coins:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        if part then return move(CFrame.new(part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))) end
        return move(current:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0))
    end
    local function loadAvatar(image, player)
        local id = player and player.UserId
        image:SetAttribute("AvatarUserId", id)
        image.Image = id and (thumbnails[id] or "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. tostring(id) .. "&w=150&h=150") or ""
        if not id or thumbnails[id] or loading[id] then return end
        loading[id] = true
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, url, ready = pcall(function()
                return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(id, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
            end)
            loading[id] = nil
            if not alive() or not ok or not ready or type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then return end
            thumbnails[id] = url
            for _, entry in pairs(entries) do
                if entry.Avatar:GetAttribute("AvatarUserId") == id then entry.Avatar.Image = url end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function makeRow(parent, title, subtitle, callback)
        local row = Create("TextButton", {Name = "TeleportPlayer", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58),
            Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = NextOrder(), Parent = parent}, {Corner(9)})
        local portrait = Create("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = row}, {Corner(99)})
        local image = Create("ImageLabel", {Name = "Avatar", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Image = "", ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, Parent = portrait}, {Corner(99)})
        local name = Label({Text = title, FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 13,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 9), Size = UDim2.new(1, -88, 0, 19),
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = row})
        local sub = Label({Text = subtitle, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 30), Size = UDim2.new(1, -88, 0, 17),
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = row})
        local icon = Create("ImageLabel", {Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.5, -7), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = "rbxassetid://137091405832737", ImageColor3 = Theme.Accent, Parent = row})
        connect(row.Activated, callback)
        connect(row.MouseEnter, function() Tween(row, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.08}, 0.12) end)
        connect(row.MouseLeave, function() Tween(row, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.35}, 0.12) end)
        return {Frame = row, Avatar = image, Title = name, Subtitle = sub, Icon = icon}
    end
    destinations:AddButton({Name = "Tp Lobby", Callback = lobby})
    destinations:AddButton({Name = "Tp Map", Callback = map})
    for _, definition in ipairs({{key = "murderer", label = "Tp Murderer"}, {key = "sheriff", label = "Tp Sheriff"}}) do
        destinations:AddButton({Name = definition.label, Callback = function()
            local player = findRole(definition.key == "murderer" and "murder" or "sheriff")
            if not player and definition.key == "sheriff" then player = findRole("hero") end
            if player then teleportPlayer(player) else notify("No living " .. definition.key .. " found") end
        end})
    end
    local function remove(player)
        local entry = entries[player]
        if not entry then return end
        entry.Frame:Destroy()
        for _, connection in ipairs(entry.Connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        entries[player] = nil
    end
    local function add(player)
        if not alive() or player == LocalPlayer or entries[player] then return end
        local entry = makeRow(rows, player.DisplayName, "@" .. player.Name, function() teleportPlayer(player) end)
        entry.Connections = {}
        entries[player] = entry
        loadAvatar(entry.Avatar, player)
        table.insert(entry.Connections, connect(player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("DisplayName"), function()
            entry.Title.Text = player.DisplayName
        end))
    end
    connect(Players.PlayerAdded, add)
    connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, remove)
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do add(player) end
    function api:Stop()
        if stopped then return end
        stopped = true
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        table.clear(connections)
        table.clear(entries)
        table.clear(thumbnails)
    end
    window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(function() api:Stop() end)
    api.TeleportPlayer, api.TeleportLobby, api.TeleportMap = teleportPlayer, lobby, map
    return api
end

local function CrackHubCreateInventoryAssets()
local SkinModel = {}

function SkinModel.decode(environment, value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	local kind = value[1]
	if kind == "V" then return environment.Vector3.new(value[2], value[3], value[4]) end
	if kind == "C" then return environment.Color3.new(value[2], value[3], value[4]) end
	if kind == "F" then return environment.CFrame.new(table.unpack(value, 2, 13)) end
	if kind == "NR" then return environment.NumberRange.new(value[2], value[3]) end
	if kind == "E" then
		local ok, item = pcall(function() return environment.Enum[value[2]][value[3]] end)
		return ok and item or nil
	end
	if kind == "CS" then
		local points = {}
		for index = 2, #value do
			local point = value[index]
			table.insert(points, environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], environment.Color3.new(point[2], point[3], point[4])))
		end
		local ok, sequence = pcall(environment.ColorSequence.new, points)
		return ok and sequence or nil
	end
	if kind == "NS" then
		local points = {}
		for index = 2, #value do
			local point = value[index]
			table.insert(points, environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], point[2], point[3] or 0))
		end
		local ok, sequence = pcall(environment.NumberSequence.new, points)
		return ok and sequence or nil
	end
	return nil
end

function SkinModel.frame(environment, values)
	return environment.CFrame.new(table.unpack(values, 1, 12))
end

SkinModel.mesh = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, meshId)
	if state.meshes[meshId] then return state.meshes[meshId]:Clone() end
	while state.loading[meshId] do state.context.environment.task.wait() end
	if state.meshes[meshId] then return state.meshes[meshId]:Clone() end

	state.loading[meshId] = true
	local environment = state.context.environment
	local ok, result = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		return state.context.insertService:CreateMeshPartAsync(meshId, environment.Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box, environment.Enum.RenderFidelity.Automatic)
	end))
	state.loading[meshId] = nil
	if not ok or not result then return nil end
	state.meshes[meshId] = result
	return result:Clone()
end)

function SkinModel.node(state, data, root, references, unresolved, options)
	if options and options.skip and options.skip(data) then return nil end
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local object
	if data.c == "MeshPart" then
		object = SkinModel.mesh(state, data.p.MeshId or "")
		if not object then object = environment.Instance.new("Part"); object.Transparency = 1 end
	end
	if not object then
		local ok, created = pcall(environment.Instance.new, data.c)
		if not ok or not created then return nil end
		object = created
	end
	object.Name = data.n
	for property, value in data.p or {} do
		if property == "MeshId" and data.c == "MeshPart" then continue end
		if type(value) == "table" and value[1] == "R" then
			table.insert(unresolved, {object, property, value[2]})
			continue
		end
		local decoded = SkinModel.decode(environment, value)
		if decoded ~= nil then pcall(function() object[property] = decoded end) end
	end
	if data.i then references[data.i] = object end
	if object:IsA("BasePart") then
		object.Anchored, object.CanCollide, object.CanQuery, object.CanTouch, object.Massless = false, false, false, false, true
		pcall(function() object.AudioCanCollide = false end)
		if root and data.r then
			local weld = environment.Instance.new("Weld")
			weld.Name, weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.C0, weld.Parent = "PW", root, object, SkinModel.frame(environment, data.r), object
		end
	end
	for key, value in data.a or {} do pcall(object.SetAttribute, object, key, SkinModel.decode(environment, value)) end
	for _, tag in data.t or {} do pcall(context.collection.AddTag, context.collection, object, tag) end
	local parentRoot = root or object
	for _, child in data.k or {} do
		local built = SkinModel.node(state, child, parentRoot, references, unresolved, options)
		if built then built.Parent = object end
	end
	return object
end

function SkinModel.build(state, data, options)
	local references, unresolved = {}, {}
	local root = SkinModel.node(state, data, nil, references, unresolved, options)
	if not root then return nil end
	for _, reference in unresolved do
		local target = references[reference[3]]
		if target then pcall(function() reference[1][reference[2]] = target end) end
	end
	return root
end

function SkinModel.hasChroma(data)
	for _, tag in data.t or {} do
		if tag == "ChromaPart" or tag == "ChromaDecal" or tag == "ChromaFire" then return true end
	end
	for _, child in data.k or {} do if SkinModel.hasChroma(child) then return true end end
	return false
end

function SkinModel.applyChroma(state, skin, model)
	if not skin.ch or SkinModel.hasChroma(skin.d) then return end
	for _, object in model:GetDescendants() do
		if object:IsA("Decal") and object.Name:lower():find("chroma") then pcall(state.context.collection.AddTag, state.context.collection, object, "ChromaDecal") end
		if object:IsA("Fire") then pcall(state.context.collection.AddTag, state.context.collection, object, "ChromaFire") end
	end
end

-- Build a template Folder from embedded part data (mesh parts load in parallel).
CrackHub.BuildEmbeddedModel = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(list)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	local insert = game:GetService("InsertService")
	local assets = game:GetService("AssetService")
	local pending = #list
	local meshCache = {}
	local meshPart; meshPart = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(id)
		if meshCache[id] ~= nil then
			while meshCache[id] == true do task.wait() end
			return meshCache[id] and meshCache[id]:Clone() or nil
		end
		meshCache[id] = true
		local ok, part = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return insert:CreateMeshPartAsync(id, Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box, Enum.RenderFidelity.Automatic) end))
		if not ok or not part then ok, part = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return assets:CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromUri(id)) end)) end
		meshCache[id] = (ok and part) or false
		return meshCache[id] and meshCache[id]:Clone() or nil
	end)
	for _, e in ipairs(list) do
		task.spawn(function()
			pcall(function()
				local part
				if e.c == "MeshPart" and e.m then part = meshPart(e.m) end
				if not part then part = Instance.new("Part") end
				part.Size = Vector3.new(e.s[1], e.s[2], e.s[3])
				part.CFrame = CFrame.new(table.unpack(e.f, 1, 12))
				part.Color = Color3.new(e.col[1], e.col[2], e.col[3])
				pcall(function() part.Material = Enum.Material[e.mat] end)
				part.Transparency, part.Reflectance = e.tr or 0, e.rf or 0
				part.Anchored, part.CanCollide = true, false
				if e.t and part:IsA("MeshPart") then pcall(function() part.TextureID = e.t end) end
				if e.sm then
					local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
					pcall(function() mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType[e.sm[1]] end)
					mesh.MeshId, mesh.TextureId = e.sm[2], e.sm[3]
					mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(table.unpack(e.sm[4]))
					mesh.Offset = Vector3.new(table.unpack(e.sm[5]))
					mesh.Parent = part
				end
				part.Parent = folder
			end)
			pending -= 1
		end)
	end
	local deadline = os.clock() + 15
	while pending > 0 and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait() end
	for _, cached in pairs(meshCache) do if typeof(cached) == "Instance" then cached:Destroy() end end
	return #folder:GetChildren() > 0 and folder or nil
end)

local IMPORTED_EFFECTS = {"ParticleEmitter", "Fire", "Smoke", "Sparkles", "Light", "Beam", "Trail", "Highlight"}
local IMPORTED_REMOVED = {"LuaSourceContainer", "Sound", "LayerCollector", "Camera", "Animation", "RemoteEvent", "RemoteFunction", "BindableEvent", "ValueBase", "ClickDetector", "ProximityPrompt", "TouchTransmitter", "Humanoid", "SoundEffect", "Configuration"}

ImportedSkin.isAny = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(object, classes)
	for _, class in classes do if object:IsA(class) then return true end end
	return false
end)


ImportedSkin.template = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, asset)
	if state.templates[asset] ~= nil then return state.templates[asset] or nil end
	local environment = state.context.environment
	while state.loading[asset] do environment.task.wait() end
	if state.templates[asset] ~= nil then return state.templates[asset] or nil end
	state.loading[asset] = true
	local result
	local embedded = CrackHub.EmbeddedModels and CrackHub.EmbeddedModels[asset]
	local ok, objects
	if embedded then local folder = CrackHub.BuildEmbeddedModel(embedded); ok, objects = folder ~= nil, folder and {folder} or {} end
	if not ok then ok, objects = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return environment.game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. asset) end)) end
	if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" or #objects == 0 then local g = getobjects; if type(g) == "function" then ok, objects = pcall(g, "rbxassetid://" .. asset) end end
	if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" or #objects == 0 then warn("[CrackHub Skin] could not download model " .. tostring(asset) .. ": " .. tostring(objects) .. " (the model must be public / distributed on the Creator Store)") end
	if ok and type(objects) == "table" and #objects > 0 then
		result = environment.Instance.new("Folder")
		for _, root in objects do
			for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do
				if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() object.Disabled = true end)) end
			end
			for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do
				if ImportedSkin.isAny(object, IMPORTED_REMOVED) then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() object:Destroy() end)) end
			end
			if root:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then root:Destroy() else root.Parent = result end
		end
	end
	state.templates[asset], state.loading[asset] = result or false, nil
	return result
end)


function ImportedSkin.scaleSequence(environment, sequence, scale)
	local points = {}
	for _, point in sequence.Keypoints do table.insert(points, environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point.Time, point.Value * scale, point.Envelope * scale)) end
	return environment.NumberSequence.new(points)
end


function ImportedSkin.scaleEffect(environment, object, scale)
	pcall(function()
		if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			object.Size = ImportedSkin.scaleSequence(environment, object.Size, scale)
			object.Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(object.Speed.Min * scale, object.Speed.Max * scale)
			object.Acceleration *= scale
			return
		end
		if object:IsA("Beam") then
			object.Width0, object.Width1 = object.Width0 * scale, object.Width1 * scale
			object.CurveSize0, object.CurveSize1 = object.CurveSize0 * scale, object.CurveSize1 * scale
			return
		end
		if object:IsA("Trail") then object.WidthScale = ImportedSkin.scaleSequence(environment, object.WidthScale, 1); return end
		if object:IsA("Light") then object.Range *= math.max(scale, 0.5); return end
		if object:IsA("Fire") then object.Size *= scale end
	end)
end


-- Auto-fit for models without hand-measured numbers: barrel = longest axis (X, Y or Z),
-- barrel side = away from the heavy (grip) end, length normalised to spec.len studs.
function ImportedSkin.autoFit(environment, template)
	local V3 = environment.Vector3
	local minV, maxV, sum, mass = nil, nil, V3.zero, 0
	for _, part in template:GetDescendants() do
		if not part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Transparency >= 0.999 then continue end
		local name = part.Name:lower()
		if name:find("hitbox") or name:find("collision") then continue end
		local half = part.Size / 2
		for _, sx in {-1, 1} do for _, sy in {-1, 1} do for _, sz in {-1, 1} do
			local p = (part.CFrame * environment.CFrame.new(half.X * sx, half.Y * sy, half.Z * sz)).Position
			minV = minV and V3.new(math.min(minV.X, p.X), math.min(minV.Y, p.Y), math.min(minV.Z, p.Z)) or p
			maxV = maxV and V3.new(math.max(maxV.X, p.X), math.max(maxV.Y, p.Y), math.max(maxV.Z, p.Z)) or p
		end end end
		local volume = math.max(part.Size.X * part.Size.Y * part.Size.Z, 0.001)
		sum += part.Position * volume
		mass += volume
	end
	if not minV or mass <= 0 then return nil end
	local center, extent, centroid = (minV + maxV) / 2, maxV - minV, sum / mass
	local axis, length = V3.xAxis, extent.X
	if extent.Y > length then axis, length = V3.yAxis, extent.Y end
	if extent.Z > length then axis, length = V3.zAxis, extent.Z end
	local offset = (centroid - center):Dot(axis)
	local look = offset > 0 and -axis or axis
	local up = math.abs(look.Y) > 0.9 and V3.zAxis or V3.yAxis
	pcall(function() warn(string.format("[CrackHub Gun] fit size=(%.2f, %.2f, %.2f) axis=%s length=%.2f", extent.X, extent.Y, extent.Z, tostring(look), length)) end)
	return {origin = environment.CFrame.lookAt(center, center + look, up), length = length}
end


function ImportedSkin.build(state, skin)
	local spec = skin.cx
	local template = spec and ImportedSkin.template(state, spec.asset)
	if not template then return nil end
	local environment, scale = state.context.environment, spec.k
	local origin = SkinModel.frame(environment, spec.X)
	if spec.auto then local fit = ImportedSkin.autoFit(environment, template); if fit then origin, scale = fit.origin, (spec.len or 2.1) / math.max(fit.length, 0.05) end end
	local root = environment.Instance.new("Part")
	root.Name, root.Size, root.Transparency = "RhythmCX", environment.Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), 1
	root.CanCollide, root.CanQuery, root.CanTouch, root.Massless, root.CastShadow = false, false, false, true, false
	local mesh = environment.Instance.new("BlockMesh")
	mesh.Scale, mesh.Parent = environment.Vector3.zero, root
	local copy = template:Clone()
	local parts = {}
	for _, object in copy:GetDescendants() do if object:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, object) end end
	for _, part in parts do
		local visible = part.Transparency < 0.999 and (spec.auto or math.max(part.Size.X, part.Size.Y, part.Size.Z) <= 30)
		for _, child in part:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("DataModelMesh") and not (child:IsA("SpecialMesh") and child.MeshType == environment.Enum.MeshType.FileMesh) then
				local size = child.Scale
				if not spec.auto and math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) > 20 then visible = false end
			end
		end
		if not visible then
			for _, object in part:GetDescendants() do if ImportedSkin.isAny(object, IMPORTED_EFFECTS) then visible = true; break end end
		end
		if not visible then continue end
		local relative = origin:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
		for _, child in part:GetChildren() do
			if ImportedSkin.isAny(child, {"JointInstance", "WeldConstraint", "NoCollisionConstraint", "RigidConstraint"}) then child:Destroy(); continue end
			if child:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
				if child.MeshType == environment.Enum.MeshType.FileMesh then child.Scale *= scale end
				child.Offset *= scale
				continue
			end
			if child:IsA("BlockMesh") or child:IsA("CylinderMesh") then child.Offset *= scale; continue end
			if child:IsA("Attachment") then child.Position *= scale end
		end
		part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Massless, part.CastShadow = false, false, false, false, true, false
		pcall(function() part.AudioCanCollide = false end)
		part.Size *= scale
		local weld = environment.Instance.new("Weld")
		weld.Name, weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.C0, weld.Parent = "PW", root, part, environment.CFrame.new(relative.Position * scale) * relative.Rotation, part
		part.Parent = root
	end
	copy:Destroy()
	if spec.auto and #root:GetChildren() <= 1 then warn("[CrackHub Gun] model has no visible parts after fit"); root:Destroy(); return nil end
	for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do
		if ImportedSkin.isAny(object, IMPORTED_EFFECTS) then ImportedSkin.scaleEffect(environment, object, scale) end
		if spec.glowOnly and ImportedSkin.isAny(object, {"ParticleEmitter", "Fire", "Smoke", "Sparkles"}) then object:Destroy(); continue end
		if spec.burst and object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			for _, name in spec.burst do
				if object.Name:find(name) then object:SetAttribute("RhythmBurst", object.Rate); object.Enabled = false; break end
			end
		end
	end
	root:SetAttribute("RhythmCX", true)
	return root
end

local CUSTOM_PICTURES = CrackHubEnvironment.__CrackHubJSONAsset("custom_pictures.json")
local function customPicture(spec)
    if spec.img then return spec.img end
    local fallback = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. spec.asset .. "&w=150&h=150"
    local env = CrackHubEnvironment
    if type(env.writefile) ~= "function" or type(env.getcustomasset) ~= "function" then return fallback end
    local name = "pskin_" .. spec.icon .. "_v1.png"
    if not CUSTOM_PICTURES[name] then return fallback end
    local ok, image = pcall(function()
        if type(env.isfolder) == "function" and not env.isfolder("CrackHub") then env.makefolder("CrackHub") end
        local path = "CrackHub/" .. name
        if type(env.isfile) ~= "function" or not env.isfile(path) then env.writefile(path, Base64Decode(CUSTOM_PICTURES[name])) end
        return env.getcustomasset(path)
    end)
    return ok and image or fallback
end

    local definitions
    local customState = {context = {environment = setmetatable({game=game,Instance=Instance,Enum=Enum,Vector3=Vector3,Color3=Color3,CFrame=CFrame,NumberRange=NumberRange,NumberSequence=NumberSequence,NumberSequenceKeypoint=NumberSequenceKeypoint,ColorSequence=ColorSequence,ColorSequenceKeypoint=ColorSequenceKeypoint,task=task}, {__index=getfenv()})}, templates = {}, loading = {}}
    local modelState = {context = {environment = setmetatable({game=game,Instance=Instance,Enum=Enum,Vector3=Vector3,Color3=Color3,CFrame=CFrame,NumberRange=NumberRange,NumberSequence=NumberSequence,NumberSequenceKeypoint=NumberSequenceKeypoint,ColorSequence=ColorSequence,ColorSequenceKeypoint=ColorSequenceKeypoint,task=task}, {__index=getfenv()}), insertService = game:GetService("InsertService"),
        collection = game:GetService("CollectionService")}, meshes = {}, loading = {}}
    local custom = {}
    for _, spec in ipairs(CUSTOM_SKINS) do custom[spec.key] = spec end
    local api = {Effects = EFFECT_KEYS, Custom = custom}
    CrackHub.FableKeys = {CrackHub_Gun = true}
    task.spawn(function() for _, spec in ipairs(CUSTOM_SKINS) do if spec.auto then pcall(ImportedSkin.template, customState, spec.asset) end end end)
    local function getDefinitions()
        if not definitions then definitions = CrackHubEnvironment.__CrackHubJSONAsset("skin_data.json") end
        return definitions
    end
    function api:Extend(items)
        local known = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(items) do known[item.id] = item end
        local function add(key, name, kind, rarity, image)
            if known[key] then known[key].Imported = key; return end
            if kind ~= "Knife" and kind ~= "Gun" then return end
            local item = {id = key, name = name or key, kind = kind, rarity = rarity or "Common", image = image or "",
                mesh = "", texture = "", scale = {1,1,1}, size = {1,1,1}, color = {255,255,255},
                material = "Plastic", meshpart = false, Imported = key}
            table.insert(items, item); known[key] = item
        end
        for key, info in pairs(getDefinitions()) do
            add(key, info.nm, info.t, info.r, info.img)
            known[key].Chroma = info.ch == true
            known[key].DonorRarity = info.r
            known[key].DonorName = info.nm or key
        end
        for key, spec in pairs(custom) do
            add(key, spec.nm, spec.t, "Custom", customPicture(spec))
        end
        local rank = {Custom=0,Ancient=1,Unique=2,Godly=3,Classic=4,Legendary=5,Rare=6}
        table.sort(items, function(a,b)
            if not not a.Imported ~= not not b.Imported then return a.Imported ~= nil end
            local ar=(rank[a.DonorRarity or a.rarity] or 9)+(a.Chroma and .5 or 0)
            local br=(rank[b.DonorRarity or b.rarity] or 9)+(b.Chroma and .5 or 0)
            if ar~=br then return ar<br end
            if a.kind~=b.kind then return a.kind<b.kind end
            local an,bn=string.lower(a.DonorName or a.name),string.lower(b.DonorName or b.name)
            if an~=bn then return an<bn end
            return a.id<b.id
        end)
        for index,item in ipairs(items) do item.CatalogOrder=index end
        return known
    end
    function api:Template(item)
        local spec = custom[item.id]
        local root
        if spec then root = ImportedSkin.build(customState, {cx = spec})
        else
            local skin = getDefinitions()[item.id]
            if not skin or not skin.d then return nil end
            root = SkinModel.build(modelState, skin.d)
        end
        if root then
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new()
            for _, joint in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                if joint:IsA("Weld") and joint.Part0 and joint.Part1 then
                    joint.Part1.CFrame = joint.Part0.CFrame * joint.C0 * joint.C1:Inverse()
                end
            end
        end
        return root
    end
    function api:EffectData()
        if not self.FX then self.FX = createInventoryEffectData() end
        return self.FX
    end
    function api:Stop()
        for _, object in pairs(customState.templates) do if typeof(object) == "Instance" then object:Destroy() end end
        for _, object in pairs(modelState.meshes) do if typeof(object) == "Instance" then object:Destroy() end end
    end
    return api
end

local function CrackHubAttachNativeChanger(window, controller, items, callbacks)
    local registry=CrackHubEnvironment
    local previous=registry.CrackHubNativeChangerStop
    if type(previous)=="function" then pcall(previous) end
    local environment = setmetatable({game=game,Instance=Instance,Enum=Enum,Vector2=Vector2,Vector3=Vector3,
        UDim2=UDim2,Color3=Color3,ColorSequence=ColorSequence,ColorSequenceKeypoint=ColorSequenceKeypoint,
        task=task,os=os,require=require}, {__index=CrackHubEnvironment})
    local connections={}
    local state={alive=true,enabled=true,DB={},weapons=controller.Sync.Weapons,list={},realName={},realOwned={},
        context={environment=environment,storage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"),runService=RunService,
            collection=game:GetService("CollectionService")}}
    state.context.connect=function(signal,callback)
        local connection=signal:Connect(function(...) if state.alive then return callback(...) end end)
        table.insert(connections,connection)
        return connection
    end
    for kind,key in pairs(controller.Profile.Weapons.Equipped) do state.realName[kind]=key end
    for _,item in ipairs(items) do
        state.DB[item.id]={img=item.image}
        if item.Imported then table.insert(state.list,{key=item.id,type=item.kind}) end
    end
    state.active=function(kind) return state.selected and state.selected[kind] end
    state.equipped=function(kind) return controller.Profile.Weapons.Equipped[kind] end
    local WeaponSkins={}
    function WeaponSkins.equip(_,key)
        for _,item in ipairs(items) do
            if item.id==key then
                state.selected=state.selected or {};state.selected[item.kind]=key
                callbacks.Select(item)
                return
            end
        end
    end
    function WeaponSkins.resetSlot(_,kind)
        local key=state.realName[kind]
        if state.selected then state.selected[kind]=nil end
        if callbacks.Reset then callbacks.Reset(kind,key) end
    end
local InventoryChanger = {}

function InventoryChanger.connect(changer, signal, callback)
	if not signal then return end
	local connection = changer.state.context.connect(signal, callback)
	table.insert(changer.connections, connection)
end

function InventoryChanger.drop(changer)
	for _, connection in changer.connections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
	for object, saved in changer.shifted do
		pcall(function()
			if type(saved) == "table" then object.Position, object.Size = saved[1], saved[2]; return end
			object.LayoutOrder = saved
		end)
	end
	if changer.page then changer.page:Destroy() end
	if changer.button then changer.button:Destroy() end
	changer.page, changer.button, changer.built, changer.building = nil, nil, false, false
	changer.frames, changer.connections, changer.shifted = {}, {}, {}
	changer.gradients, changer.gradientConnection = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), nil
end

function InventoryChanger.tag(changer, frame, visible, active, overlay, key)
	local environment = changer.state.context.environment
	local tagsName = overlay and "CrackHubTags" or "Tags"
	local tags = frame:FindFirstChild(tagsName)
	if not tags and visible then
		local template = frame:FindFirstChild("Tags") or changer.template:FindFirstChild("Tags")
		if not template then return end
		tags = template:Clone()
		for _, child in tags:GetChildren() do if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end end
		tags.Name, tags.Parent = tagsName, frame
		if overlay and changer.tags then changer.tags[tags] = true end
		if overlay then tags.ZIndex = 6 end
	end
	if not tags then return end
	local tag = tags:FindFirstChild("CrackHubChanger")
	if not tag and visible then
		local templateTags = changer.template:FindFirstChild("Tags")
		local source = templateTags and templateTags:FindFirstChild("Chroma")
		if not source then return end
		tag = source:Clone()
		tag.Name, tag.LayoutOrder = "CrackHubChanger", -1
		for _, child in tag:GetDescendants() do if child:IsA("UIGradient") then child:Destroy() end end
		local collection = changer.state.context.collection
		for _, name in collection:GetTags(tag) do collection:RemoveTag(tag, name) end
		local background = tag:FindFirstChild("BG")
		if background then background:Destroy() end
		local label = tag:FindFirstChild("TagName")
		if label then label.Text = "Changer" end
		if overlay then
			tag.ZIndex = 6
			for _, child in tag:GetDescendants() do if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child.ZIndex = 7 end end
		end
		tag.Parent = tags
		if changer.tags then changer.tags[tag] = true end
	end
	if tag then local label = tag:FindFirstChild("TagName"); if label then label.Text = (key and CrackHub.FableKeys and CrackHub.FableKeys[key]) and "Fable" or "Changer" end end
	if tag then tag.Visible, tag.BackgroundColor3 = visible, active and environment.Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 110) or environment.Color3.fromRGB(150, 90, 255) end
end

function InventoryChanger.clearImg(frame)
	for _, object in frame:GetDescendants() do if object:GetAttribute("CrackHubImg") then object:SetAttribute("CrackHubImg", nil) end end
end

function InventoryChanger.decorate(changer, frame, key)
    local state, environment = changer.state, changer.state.context.environment
    local entry = state.DB[key]
    local image = entry and entry.img
    if type(image)=="number" then image="rbxassetid://"..tostring(image) end
    if type(image)=="string" and image:match("^%d+$") then image="rbxassetid://"..image end
    local container = frame:FindFirstChild("Container")
    local icon = container and (container:FindFirstChild("Icon") or container:FindFirstChild("Image"))
    if not icon then icon=frame:FindFirstChild("Icon",true) end
    if icon and (icon:IsA("ImageLabel") or icon:IsA("ImageButton")) then
        -- the wanted image lives in an attribute, so a slot that switches to another item stops being forced
        if type(image)=="string" and image~="" then
            icon:SetAttribute("CrackHubImg",image)
            icon.Image,icon.ImageTransparency,icon.Visible=image,0,true
            icon.ScaleType=environment.Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        else
            icon:SetAttribute("CrackHubImg",nil)
        end
        changer.imageBindings=changer.imageBindings or setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
        if not changer.imageBindings[icon] then
            changer.imageBindings[icon]=true
            InventoryChanger.connect(changer,icon:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"),function()
                local want=icon:GetAttribute("CrackHubImg")
                if want and icon.Parent and icon.Image~=want then icon.Image=want end
            end)
        end
    end
    local spec = state.crackhub and state.crackhub.byKey[key]
    if not spec then return end
	pcall(function()
		local container = frame:FindFirstChild("Container")
		local icon = container and container:FindFirstChild("Icon")
		if icon then icon.Image = spec.img end
		local name = frame:FindFirstChild("ItemName")
		if not name or name:FindFirstChild("CrackHubGrad") then return end
		name.BackgroundColor3 = environment.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local gradient = environment.Instance.new("UIGradient")
		gradient.Name = "CrackHubGrad"
		local first, second = environment.Color3.fromRGB(46, 242, 255), environment.Color3.fromRGB(150, 92, 255)
		gradient.Color = environment.ColorSequence.new({environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, first), environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, second), environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, first)})
		gradient.Parent = name
		changer.gradients[gradient] = true
		if changer.gradientConnection or not state.context.runService then return end
		changer.gradientConnection = state.context.connect(state.context.runService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			if not (changer.page and changer.page.Visible) and not changer.mobile then return end
			local now = environment.os.clock(); if now - (changer.gradAt or 0) < 1 / 30 then return end; changer.gradAt = now
			local offset = now * 0.35 % 2 - 1
			for item in changer.gradients do if item.Parent then item.Offset = environment.Vector2.new(offset, 0) end end
		end))
		table.insert(changer.connections, changer.gradientConnection)
	end)
end

function InventoryChanger.positionMobile(changer, nav, source, button)
	local environment = changer.state.context.environment
	local groups, byPosition = {}, {}
	for _, object in nav:GetChildren() do
		if not object:IsA("GuiObject") then continue end
		changer.shifted[object] = {object.Position, object.Size}
		local position = object.Position
		local key = string.format("%.3f|%.3f", position.Y.Scale, position.X.Scale)
		if not byPosition[key] then
			byPosition[key] = {y = position.Y.Scale, x = position.X.Scale, items = {}}
			table.insert(groups, byPosition[key])
		end
		table.insert(byPosition[key].items, object)
	end
	table.sort(groups, function(a, b) if math.abs(a.y - b.y) > 0.01 then return a.y < b.y end return a.x < b.x end)
	local rows = {}
	for _, group in groups do
		table.insert(rows, group.items)
		if table.find(group.items, source) then table.insert(rows, {button}) end
	end
	local columns = math.max(4, math.ceil(#rows / 2))
	for index, row in rows do
		local column, line = (index - 1) % columns, math.floor((index - 1) / columns)
		for _, object in row do
			object.Position = environment.UDim2.new(column / columns, 0, line * 0.5, 0)
			object.Size = environment.UDim2.new(1 / columns, 0, 0.5, 0)
		end
	end
end

function InventoryChanger.paint(changer)
	local state, page = changer.state, changer.page
	if not page then return end
	local knife, gun = state.active("Knife"), state.active("Gun")
	for key, frame in changer.frames do
		if frame.Parent then pcall(InventoryChanger.tag, changer, frame, true, key == knife or key == gun, nil, key); InventoryChanger.decorate(changer, frame, key) end
	end
	local equipped = page:FindFirstChild("Equipped")
	local container = equipped and equipped:FindFirstChild("Container")
	if not container then return end
	for _, kind in {"Knife", "Gun"} do
		local slot = container:FindFirstChild(kind)
		local frame = slot and slot:FindFirstChild("Container")
		local key = state.equipped(kind)
		if not frame or not key or not state.weapons[key] then continue end
		InventoryChanger.clearImg(frame); pcall(changer.item.DisplayItem, frame, state.weapons[key])
		InventoryChanger.decorate(changer, frame, key)
		frame.Visible = true
		local active = state.enabled and state.active(kind) ~= nil
		pcall(InventoryChanger.tag, changer, frame, active, active, true, key)
	end
end

function InventoryChanger.filter(changer)
	local query = changer.query:lower()
	for key, frame in changer.frames do
		if not frame.Parent then continue end
		local item = changer.state.weapons[key]
		frame.Visible = query == "" or tostring(item and item.ItemName or key):lower():find(query, 1, true) ~= nil
	end
end

function InventoryChanger.selectTab(changer, kind)
	changer.tab = kind
	local page = changer.page
	if not page then return end
	local items = page:FindFirstChild("Items")
	local title = page:FindFirstChild("TitleBar")
	local tabs = items and items:FindFirstChild("Tabs") or title and title:FindFirstChild("Container")
	for _, tab in tabs and tabs:GetChildren() or {} do
		local view, border = tab:FindFirstChild("View"), tab:FindFirstChild("ViewBorder")
		if view and border then border.Visible, tab.BackgroundTransparency = tab.Name == kind, tab.Name == kind and 0.8 or 0.9 end
	end
	local container = items and items:FindFirstChild("Container")
	for _, section in container and container:GetChildren() or {} do
		if section:IsA("GuiObject") then section.Visible = section.Name == kind end
	end
end

function InventoryChanger.selectItem(changer, key)
	local state = changer.state
	local item = state.weapons[key]
	if not state.enabled or not item or item.ItemType ~= "Knife" and item.ItemType ~= "Gun" then return end
	if state.active(item.ItemType) == key then WeaponSkins.resetSlot(state, item.ItemType) else WeaponSkins.equip(state, key) end
	InventoryChanger.paint(changer)
end

function InventoryChanger.populate(changer)
	local state, page = changer.state, changer.page
	if changer.built or changer.building or not page then return end
	changer.building = true
	local items = page:FindFirstChild("Items")
	local sections = items and items:FindFirstChild("Container")
	for index, skin in state.list do
		if (changer.only and not changer.only[skin.key]) or (changer.exclude and changer.exclude[skin.key]) then continue end
		if not state.alive or changer.page ~= page or not page.Parent then break end
		local section = sections and sections:FindFirstChild(skin.type)
		local target = section and section:FindFirstChild("Container")
		if not target or not state.weapons[skin.key] or changer.frames[skin.key] then continue end
		local ok, data = pcall(changer.inventory.CreateNewItemData, skin.key, 1, "Weapons")
		if not ok or not data then continue end
		local frame = changer.template:Clone()
		local displayed = pcall(changer.item.DisplayItem, frame, data, nil, true)
		if not displayed then frame:Destroy(); continue end
		frame.LayoutOrder, frame.Parent = index, target
		changer.frames[skin.key] = frame
        InventoryChanger.decorate(changer,frame,skin.key)
		local container = frame:FindFirstChild("Container")
		local amount = container and container:FindFirstChild("Amount")
		if amount then amount.Text = "" end
		local button = container and container:FindFirstChild("ActionButton")
		if button then InventoryChanger.connect(changer, button.MouseButton1Click, function() InventoryChanger.selectItem(changer, skin.key) end) end
		if index % 25 == 0 then state.context.environment.task.wait() end
	end
	changer.built, changer.building = changer.page == page and page.Parent ~= nil, false
	InventoryChanger.filter(changer)
	InventoryChanger.paint(changer)
end

function InventoryChanger.preparePage(changer, source, mobile)
	local environment = changer.state.context.environment
	local page = source:Clone()
	page.Name = changer.name or "Changer"
	if mobile then page.Position = environment.UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0) else page.Visible = false end
	for _, object in page:GetDescendants() do if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then object:Destroy() end end
	for _, name in mobile and {"EvoMenu", "Actions"} or {"EvoMenu"} do
		local object = page:FindFirstChild(name)
		if object then object:Destroy() end
	end
	local items = page:FindFirstChild("Items")
	local sections = items and items:FindFirstChild("Container")
	local current = sections and (sections:FindFirstChild("Current") or sections:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame"))
	local container = current and current:FindFirstChild("Container")
	if not container then page:Destroy(); return nil end
	for _, object in sections:GetChildren() do if object ~= current and object:IsA("GuiObject") then object:Destroy() end end
	local grid
	for _, object in container:GetChildren() do
		if object:IsA("UIGridLayout") and not grid then grid = object; continue end
		object:Destroy()
	end
	current.CanvasPosition = environment.Vector2.zero
	local gun = current:Clone()
	current.Name, gun.Name, gun.Parent = "Knife", "Gun", sections
	for _, section in {current, gun} do
		local inner = section:FindFirstChild("Container")
		local layout = inner and inner:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIGridLayout")
		if not layout then continue end
		local function resize() section.CanvasSize = environment.UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 5) end
		InventoryChanger.connect(changer, layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"), resize)
		resize()
	end
	local title = page:FindFirstChild("TitleBar")
	local tabs = mobile and title and title:FindFirstChild("Container") or items:FindFirstChild("Tabs")
	if tabs then
		local holiday = tabs:FindFirstChild("Holiday")
		if holiday then holiday:Destroy() end
		for index, pair in {{"Current", "Knife"}, {"Classic", "Gun"}} do
			local tab = tabs:FindFirstChild(pair[1])
			if not tab then continue end
			tab.Name, tab.LayoutOrder = pair[2], index
			for _, label in tab:GetDescendants() do if label:IsA("TextLabel") and (mobile or label.Name == "TabName") then label.Text = pair[2] end end
			local button = tab:FindFirstChild("View")
			if button then InventoryChanger.connect(changer, button.MouseButton1Click, function() InventoryChanger.selectTab(changer, pair[2]) end) end
		end
		local search = tabs:FindFirstChild("Search")
		local searchContainer = search and search:FindFirstChild("Container")
		local input = searchContainer and searchContainer:FindFirstChild("SearchText")
		if input then
			input.Text = ""
			InventoryChanger.connect(changer, input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function() changer.query = input.Text; InventoryChanger.filter(changer) end)
		end
	end
	local equipped = page:FindFirstChild("Equipped")
	local equippedContainer = equipped and equipped:FindFirstChild("Container")
	for _, kind in {"Knife", "Gun"} do
		local slot = equippedContainer and equippedContainer:FindFirstChild(kind)
		local frame = slot and slot:FindFirstChild("Container")
		local inner = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("Container")
		local button = inner and inner:FindFirstChild("Button")
		if button then InventoryChanger.connect(changer, button.MouseButton1Click, function()
			if changer.state.enabled and changer.state.active(kind) then WeaponSkins.resetSlot(changer.state, kind); environment.task.defer(function() InventoryChanger.paint(changer) end) end
		end) end
	end
	return page
end

function InventoryChanger.build(changer)
	local state, inventory = changer.state, changer.inventory
	local gui = inventory.GUI and inventory.GUI.MyInventory
	local main = gui and gui.Main
	local root = main and main.Parent
	local nav = root and root:FindFirstChild("Nav")
	local source = main and main:FindFirstChild("Weapons")
	local desktopButton = nav and nav:FindFirstChild("Weapons")
	local mobileNav = nav and nav:FindFirstChild("Main")
	local mobileButton = mobileNav and mobileNav:FindFirstChild("Weapons")
	local mobile = desktopButton == nil and mobileButton ~= nil
	local navParent, sourceButton = mobile and mobileNav or nav, desktopButton or mobileButton
	if not main or not nav or not source or not sourceButton or not source:FindFirstChild("Items") then return end
    -- Remove leftover pages and navigation buttons from earlier injections.
    local function removeDuplicates(parent, keep)
        for _,object in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
            if object~=keep and object.Name==(changer.name or "Changer") and object:IsA("GuiObject") then object:Destroy() end
        end
    end
    removeDuplicates(main,changer.page)
    removeDuplicates(navParent,changer.button)
    if mobileNav and mobileNav~=navParent then removeDuplicates(mobileNav,nil) end
    if nav~=navParent then removeDuplicates(nav,nil) end
	if changer.page and changer.page.Parent == main and changer.button and changer.button.Parent == navParent then return end
	InventoryChanger.drop(changer)
	changer.mobile = mobile
