	local page = InventoryChanger.preparePage(changer, source, mobile)
	if not page then return end
	page.Parent, changer.page = main, page
	local button = sourceButton:Clone()
	button.Name = changer.name or "Changer"
	for _, object in button:GetDescendants() do
		if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then object:Destroy(); continue end
		if object:IsA("TextLabel") and (object.Name == "TabName" or object.Name == "FramName") then object.Text = changer.name or "Changer" end
	end
	local icon = button:FindFirstChild("Icon")
	if icon and changer.icon then icon.Image = changer.icon elseif icon and state.DB.CrackHub_Oni then icon.Image = state.DB.CrackHub_Oni.img end
	if mobile then InventoryChanger.positionMobile(changer, navParent, sourceButton, button) end
	if not mobile then
		for _, other in navParent:GetChildren() do
			if other:IsA("GuiButton") and other.LayoutOrder > sourceButton.LayoutOrder then
				changer.shifted[other], other.LayoutOrder = other.LayoutOrder, other.LayoutOrder + 1
			end
		end
		button.LayoutOrder = sourceButton.LayoutOrder + 1
	end
	button.Parent, changer.button = navParent, button
	InventoryChanger.connect(changer, button.MouseButton1Click, function()
		if mobile then
			pcall(function() nav:TweenPosition(state.context.environment.UDim2.new(-1, 0, 0, 0), "Out", "Quad", 0.2, true) end)
			pcall(function() page:TweenPosition(state.context.environment.UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), "Out", "Quad", 0.2, true) end)
		end
		if not mobile then
			for _, item in nav:GetChildren() do if item:IsA("TextButton") then pcall(function() item.Style = item == button and state.context.environment.Enum.ButtonStyle.RobloxRoundDefaultButton or state.context.environment.Enum.ButtonStyle.RobloxRoundButton end) end end
			for _, child in main:GetChildren() do if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child.Visible = child == page end end
		end
		InventoryChanger.selectTab(changer, changer.tab)
		InventoryChanger.paint(changer)
		state.context.environment.task.spawn(function() InventoryChanger.populate(changer) end)
	end)
	if not mobile then
		for _, other in nav:GetChildren() do
			if other:IsA("TextButton") and other ~= button then
				InventoryChanger.connect(changer, other.MouseButton1Click, function()
					pcall(function() button.Style = state.context.environment.Enum.ButtonStyle.RobloxRoundButton end)
				end)
			end
		end
	end
	if mobile then
		local title = page:FindFirstChild("TitleBar")
		local titleContainer = title and title:FindFirstChild("Container")
		local back = titleContainer and titleContainer:FindFirstChild("Back") or title and title:FindFirstChild("Back") or page:FindFirstChild("Back")
		if back then InventoryChanger.connect(changer, back.MouseButton1Click, function()
			pcall(function() nav:TweenPosition(state.context.environment.UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0), "Out", "Quad", 0.2, true) end)
			pcall(function() page:TweenPosition(state.context.environment.UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), "Out", "Quad", 0.2, true) end)
		end) end
	end
	InventoryChanger.selectTab(changer, changer.tab)
end

function InventoryChanger.isFake(changer, key)
	local state = changer.state
	return state.DB[key] ~= nil and state.realOwned ~= nil and not state.realOwned[key]
end

function InventoryChanger.bindInventoryItem(changer, key, entry)
	local frame = entry and entry.Frame
	if not frame or not frame.Parent then return end
	local container = frame:FindFirstChild("Container")
	local button = container and container:FindFirstChild("ActionButton")
	if not button then return end
	local state = changer.state
	if InventoryChanger.isFake(changer, key) then
		if entry.CrackHubConn == button then return end
		if entry.EquipConnection then pcall(function() entry.EquipConnection:Disconnect() end) end
		local connection = state.context.connect(button.MouseButton1Click, function() InventoryChanger.selectItem(changer, key) end)
		entry.EquipConnection, entry.CrackHubConn = connection, button
		changer.inventoryItems[entry] = connection
		table.insert(changer.inventoryConnections, connection)
		return
	end
	if entry.CrackHubReal == button then return end
	local connection = state.context.connect(button.MouseButton1Click, function()
		local item = state.weapons[key]
		if not item or item.EvoBaseID or item.ItemType ~= "Knife" and item.ItemType ~= "Gun" then return end
		if state.realOwned and state.realOwned[key] then state.realName[item.ItemType] = key end
	end)
	entry.CrackHubReal = button
	changer.inventoryItems[entry] = changer.inventoryItems[entry] or false
	table.insert(changer.inventoryConnections, connection)
end

function InventoryChanger.bindInventory(changer)
	local inventory = changer.inventory.MyInventory
	local groups = inventory and inventory.Data and inventory.Data.Weapons
	if type(groups) ~= "table" then return end
	for _, group in groups do
		if type(group) ~= "table" then continue end
		for key, entry in group do InventoryChanger.bindInventoryItem(changer, key, entry) end
	end
end

function InventoryChanger.paintInventory(changer)
	local state, inventory = changer.state, changer.inventory
	local current = inventory.MyInventory
	local groups = current and current.Data and current.Data.Weapons
	if type(groups) == "table" then
		local knife, gun = state.active("Knife"), state.active("Gun")
		for _, group in groups do
			if type(group) ~= "table" then continue end
			for key, entry in group do
				local frame = entry and entry.Frame
				if not frame or not frame.Parent then continue end
				local fake = state.enabled and InventoryChanger.isFake(changer, key)
				pcall(InventoryChanger.tag, changer, frame, fake, fake and (key == knife or key == gun), nil, key)
			end
		end
	end
	local gui = inventory.GUI and inventory.GUI.MyInventory
	local main = gui and gui.Main
	local weapons = main and main:FindFirstChild("Weapons")
	local equipped = weapons and weapons:FindFirstChild("Equipped")
	local container = equipped and equipped:FindFirstChild("Container")
	if not container then return end
	for _, kind in {"Knife", "Gun"} do
		local slot = container:FindFirstChild(kind)
		local frame = slot and slot:FindFirstChild("Container")
		local key = state.equipped(kind)
		if not frame or not key or not state.weapons[key] then continue end
		InventoryChanger.clearImg(frame); pcall(changer.item.DisplayItem, frame, state.weapons[key])
		InventoryChanger.decorate(changer, frame, key)
		frame.Visible = true
		local active = state.enabled and state.active(kind) ~= nil
		pcall(InventoryChanger.tag, changer, frame, active, active, true, key)
		local inner = frame:FindFirstChild("Container")
		local button = inner and inner:FindFirstChild("Button")
		if not button or changer.inventoryPanels[button] then continue end
		local connection = state.context.connect(button.MouseButton1Click, function()
			if not state.enabled or not state.active(kind) then return end
			WeaponSkins.resetSlot(state, kind)
			state.context.environment.task.defer(function() pcall(InventoryChanger.paintInventory, changer) end)
		end)
		changer.inventoryPanels[button] = connection
		table.insert(changer.inventoryConnections, connection)
	end
end

function InventoryChanger.stopInventory(changer)
	for _, connection in changer.inventoryConnections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
	for entry, connection in changer.inventoryItems do
		if entry.EquipConnection == connection then entry.EquipConnection = nil end
		entry.CrackHubConn, entry.CrackHubReal = nil, nil
	end
	for tag in changer.tags do pcall(function() tag:Destroy() end) end
	changer.inventoryConnections, changer.inventoryItems, changer.inventoryPanels, changer.tags = {}, {}, {}, {}
end


    local changer
    local fable
    task.spawn(function()
        while state.alive and controller.Alive and not window.Destroyed do
            local ok,err=pcall(function()
                if not changer then
                    local modules=state.context.storage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
                    local inventoryModule=modules and modules:FindFirstChild("InventoryModule")
                    local itemModule=modules and modules:FindFirstChild("ItemModule")
                    local template=inventoryModule and inventoryModule:FindFirstChild("NewItem")
                    if not inventoryModule or not itemModule or not template then return end
                    local inventory,item=require(inventoryModule),require(itemModule)
                    changer={state=state,inventory=inventory,item=item,template=template,frames={},connections={},shifted={},
                        gradients=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"}),inventoryConnections={},inventoryItems={},inventoryPanels={},tags={},tab="Knife",query=""}
                    controller.NativeChanger=changer
                    fable={state=state,inventory=inventory,item=item,template=template,frames={},connections={},shifted={},
                        gradients=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"}),inventoryConnections={},inventoryItems={},inventoryPanels={},tags={},tab="Gun",query="",
                        name="Fable 5.2",icon="rbxassetid://92929408045875",only={CrackHub_Gun=true}}
                    changer.exclude={CrackHub_Gun=true}
                end
                InventoryChanger.build(changer)
                if fable then InventoryChanger.build(fable) end
            end)
            if not ok and err~=state.lastError then state.lastError=err;warn("[CrackHub Changer] "..tostring(err)) end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)
    local stopped=false
    local function stop()
        if stopped then return end
        stopped=true
        state.alive=false
        if changer then InventoryChanger.drop(changer) end
        if fable then InventoryChanger.drop(fable) end
        for _,connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        if registry.CrackHubNativeChangerStop==stop then registry.CrackHubNativeChangerStop=nil end
    end
    registry.CrackHubNativeChangerStop=stop
    return stop
end

local function CrackHubStartGameInventory(window, items, assets, callbacks)
    local storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local state = {Alive = true, WeaponsEnabled = true, Profile = nil, Sync = nil, Connections = {},
        Weapons = {}, Effects = {}, Bindings = {}, EffectObjects = {}, PreviousEffect = nil}
    state.EffectsEnabled=window.CrackHubInventoryEffectsEnabled~=false
    window.CrackHubGameInventory=state
    local byId = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do byId[item.id] = item end
    local alive; alive = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return state.Alive and not window.Destroyed end)
    local readModule; readModule = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(folder, name)
        local module = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(name)
        if not module or not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        local ok, value = pcall(require, module)
        return ok and type(value) == "table" and value or nil
    end)
    local fireChanged; fireChanged = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(category)
        local remotes = storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local inventory = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
        for _, name in ipairs({"InventoryDataChanged", "ProfileDataChanged"}) do
            local signal = inventory and inventory:FindFirstChild(name)
            if signal and signal:IsA("BindableEvent") then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() signal:Fire(category) end)) end
        end
    end)
    local clearEffects; clearEffects = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        for _, object in ipairs(state.EffectObjects) do pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() object:Destroy() end)) end
        table.clear(state.EffectObjects)
    end)
    local applyEffect; applyEffect = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(key)
        clearEffects()
        if not key or key == "" then return end
        if state.EffectsEnabled==false or not state.Effects[key] then return end
        local data = assets:EffectData()[key]
        if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then return end
        local knife = character:FindFirstChild("Knife")
        local target = knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        local targets = {}
        if target then table.insert(targets, target:FindFirstChild("CrackHubSkinVisual") or target) end
        local ref = character:FindFirstChild("DisplayRefKnife")
        if ref and ref:IsA("ObjectValue") and ref.Value then table.insert(targets, ref.Value) end
        local allowed = {ParticleEmitter=true,Beam=true,Trail=true,Fire=true,Smoke=true,Sparkles=true,PointLight=true,SpotLight=true,SurfaceLight=true}
        local ignored = {cls=true,nm=true,par=true,attCF=true,a0CF=true,a1CF=true}
        for _, host in ipairs(targets) do
            for _, spec in ipairs(data) do
                if not allowed[spec.cls] then continue end
                pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                    local effect = Instance.new(spec.cls)
                    table.insert(state.EffectObjects, effect)
                    effect.Name = "CrackHubGameEffect"
                    for property, value in pairs(spec) do
                        if ignored[property] then continue end
                        if type(value) == "string" then
                            local group, name = value:match("^Enum%.([%w_]+)%.([%w_]+)$")
                            if group then value = Enum[group][name] end
                        end
                        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() effect[property] = value end))
                    end
                    if spec.cls == "Beam" or spec.cls == "Trail" then
                        local first, second = Instance.new("Attachment"), Instance.new("Attachment")
                        table.insert(state.EffectObjects, first); table.insert(state.EffectObjects, second)
                        first.CFrame, second.CFrame = spec.a0CF or CFrame.new(0,0,.4), spec.a1CF or CFrame.new(0,0,-.4)
                        first.Parent, second.Parent = host, host
                        effect.Attachment0, effect.Attachment1 = first, second
                    end
                    if spec.attCF then
                        local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
                        table.insert(state.EffectObjects, attachment)
                        attachment.CFrame, attachment.Parent, effect.Parent = spec.attCF, host, attachment
                    else effect.Parent = host end
                end))
            end
        end
    end)
    local function setEffect(key)
        local profile = state.Profile
        if not profile or not profile.Effects then return end
        local equipped = profile.Effects.Equipped
        if type(equipped) ~= "table" then equipped = {}; profile.Effects.Equipped = equipped end
        if state.PreviousEffect == nil then state.PreviousEffect = {Value = equipped[1], Owned = equipped} end
        equipped[1] = key
        state.LastEffect, state.PreviousEffect.Last = key, key
        applyEffect(key)
        fireChanged("Effects")
    end
    local bindEntries; bindEntries = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local modules = storage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
        local inventory = readModule(modules, "InventoryModule")
        local root = inventory and inventory.MyInventory and inventory.MyInventory.Data
        if type(root) ~= "table" then return end
        local visit; visit = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(node, category, depth)
            if type(node) ~= "table" or depth > 4 then return end
            for key, entry in pairs(node) do
                if type(entry) ~= "table" then continue end
                local frame = entry.Frame
                local group = category == "Weapons" and state.Weapons or state.Effects
                local id = tostring(key)
                if frame and frame.Parent and byId[id] and byId[id].CatalogOrder then frame.LayoutOrder=byId[id].CatalogOrder end
                if frame and frame.Parent and group[id] then
                    local container = frame:FindFirstChild("Container")
                    local button = container and container:FindFirstChild("ActionButton")
                    if button and not state.Bindings[button] then
                        if entry.EquipConnection then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() entry.EquipConnection:Disconnect() end)) end
                        local connection = button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                            if not alive() then return end
                            if category == "Effects" then setEffect(id)
                            elseif byId[id] then
                                callbacks.Select(byId[id])
                                local equip = readModule(storage:FindFirstChild("ClientServices"), "EquipService")
                                if equip and equip.EquippedChanged then
                                    pcall(function() equip.EquippedChanged:Fire(byId[id].kind, id) end)
                                end
                                fireChanged("Weapons")
                            end
                        end)
                        entry.EquipConnection = connection
                        state.Bindings[button] = {Connection = connection, Entry = entry}
                    end
                elseif not frame then visit(entry, category, depth+1) end
            end
        end)
        visit(root.Weapons, "Weapons", 0)
        visit(root.Effects, "Effects", 0)
    end)
    state.Grant = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(self)
        if self.Fished then return false end
        local profile, sync = self.Profile, self.Sync
        if not profile or not sync then return false end
        sync.Weapons = type(sync.Weapons) == "table" and sync.Weapons or {}
        sync.Effects = type(sync.Effects) == "table" and sync.Effects or {}
        local owned = profile.Weapons.Owned
        if self.WeaponsEnabled then
            for id, item in pairs(byId) do
                if sync.Weapons[id] == nil then
                    local spec = assets.Custom[id]
                    sync.Weapons[id] = {ItemName=item.name,ItemType=item.kind,Rarity=item.rarity=="Custom"and"Godly"or item.rarity,
                        Image=item.image,ItemID=spec and spec.asset or id,Year=2026}
                end
            end
            for _, item in ipairs(items) do
                local id=item.id
                local metadata=sync.Weapons[id]
                if type(metadata)=="table" then
                    if metadata.ItemType==nil then metadata.ItemType=item.kind end
                    if metadata.ItemName==nil then metadata.ItemName=item.name end
                    if metadata.Image==nil or metadata.Image=="" then metadata.Image=item.image end
                    if metadata.Rarity==nil then metadata.Rarity=item.rarity=="Custom" and "Godly" or item.rarity end
                end
                if owned[id]==nil then
                    if callbacks.Remember then callbacks.Remember(id,owned) end
                    owned[id]=1
                    self.Weapons[id]={Owned=owned,Value=nil,Last=1}
                end
            end
            for key, info in pairs(sync.Weapons) do
                if type(info) ~= "table" or info.ItemType ~= "Knife" and info.ItemType ~= "Gun" then continue end
                local id = tostring(key)
                if not byId[id] then
                    local item={id=id,name=info.ItemName or id,kind=info.ItemType,rarity=info.Rarity or "Common",image=info.Image or "",
                        mesh="",texture="",meshpart=false,scale={1,1,1},size={1,1,1},color={255,255,255},material="Plastic"}
                    byId[id]=item;table.insert(items,item)
                end
                if owned[id] == nil then
                    if callbacks.Remember then callbacks.Remember(id, owned) end
                    owned[id] = 1
                    self.Weapons[id] = {Owned = owned, Value = nil, Last = 1}
                end
            end
        end
        profile.Effects = type(profile.Effects) == "table" and profile.Effects or {Owned = {}, Equipped = {}}
        profile.Effects.Owned = type(profile.Effects.Owned) == "table" and profile.Effects.Owned or {}
        local effects = profile.Effects.Owned
        local seen, array = {}, true
        for key, value in pairs(effects) do
            if type(key) == "number" then seen[tostring(value)] = true else array=false;seen[tostring(key)]=true end
        end
        local keys = {}
        for key in pairs(sync.Effects) do keys[tostring(key)] = true end
        for _, key in ipairs(assets.Effects) do
            keys[key] = true
            if sync.Effects[key] == nil then sync.Effects[key] = {Name=key,ItemName=key,ItemType="Effect",Image="",Rarity="Common"} end
        end
        for key in pairs(keys) do
            if self.EffectsEnabled~=false and not seen[key] then
                if array then table.insert(effects,key) else effects[key]=true end
                self.Effects[key] = {Owned=effects,Array=array}
            end
        end
        fireChanged("Weapons");fireChanged("Effects")
        bindEntries()
        if callbacks.Changed then callbacks.Changed() end
        return true
    end)
    function state:SetEffectsEnabled(enabled)
        self.EffectsEnabled=enabled
        if enabled then self:Grant(); return end
        clearEffects()
        for id, record in pairs(self.Effects) do
            if record.Array then
                for index=#record.Owned,1,-1 do if record.Owned[index]==id then table.remove(record.Owned,index) end end
            elseif record.Owned[id]==true then record.Owned[id]=nil end
        end
        table.clear(self.Effects)
        fireChanged("Effects")
    end
    function state:Stop()
        if not self.Alive then return end
        self.Alive=false
        if self.StopNativeChanger then self.StopNativeChanger() end
        for _, connection in ipairs(self.Connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
        for _, entry in pairs(self.Bindings) do entry.Connection:Disconnect();entry.Entry.EquipConnection=nil end
        clearEffects()
        for id, record in pairs(self.Weapons) do if record.Owned[id]==record.Last then record.Owned[id]=record.Value end end
        for id, record in pairs(self.Effects) do
            if record.Array then
                for index=#record.Owned,1,-1 do if record.Owned[index]==id then table.remove(record.Owned,index) end end
            elseif record.Owned[id]==true then record.Owned[id]=nil end
        end
        local old=self.PreviousEffect
        if old and old.Owned[1]==old.Last then old.Owned[1]=old.Value end
        assets:Stop()
        fireChanged("Weapons");fireChanged("Effects")
        local modules=storage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
        local inventory=readModule(modules,"InventoryModule")
        if inventory and type(inventory.ConnectEquipButtons)=="function" then pcall(inventory.ConnectEquipButtons) end
    end
    function state:FishOff()
        if self.Fished then return end
        self.Fished=true
        self.WeaponsEnabled=false
        self.SavedEffectsEnabled=self.EffectsEnabled
        self.EffectsEnabled=false
        if self.StopNativeChanger then pcall(self.StopNativeChanger); self.StopNativeChanger=nil end
        clearEffects()
        for id, record in pairs(self.Weapons) do if record.Owned[id]==record.Last then record.Owned[id]=record.Value end end
        table.clear(self.Weapons)
        for id, record in pairs(self.Effects) do
            if record.Array then
                for index=#record.Owned,1,-1 do if record.Owned[index]==id then table.remove(record.Owned,index) end end
            elseif record.Owned[id]==true then record.Owned[id]=nil end
        end
        table.clear(self.Effects)
        local old=self.PreviousEffect
        if old and old.Owned[1]==old.Last then old.Owned[1]=old.Value end
        fireChanged("Weapons");fireChanged("Effects")
        local inventory=readModule(storage:FindFirstChild("Modules"),"InventoryModule")
        if inventory and type(inventory.ConnectEquipButtons)=="function" then pcall(inventory.ConnectEquipButtons) end
    end
    function state:FishOn()
        if not self.Fished then return end
        self.Fished=false
        self.WeaponsEnabled=true
        self.EffectsEnabled=self.SavedEffectsEnabled
        pcall(function() self:Grant() end)
        if alive() and not self.StopNativeChanger then
            local ok,stop=pcall(CrackHubAttachNativeChanger,window,self,items,callbacks)
            if ok then self.StopNativeChanger=stop end
        end
    end
    table.insert(state.Connections, window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(function() state:Stop() end))
    local elapsed, lastEquipped, lastCharacter, lastOwned = 0, nil, nil, nil
    local lastHandle, lastDisplay
    table.insert(state.Connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(delta)
        if not alive() then return end
        elapsed+=delta
        if elapsed<.5 then return end
        elapsed=0
        if not state.Profile then return end
        if state.Profile.Weapons.Owned~=lastOwned then
            lastOwned=state.Profile.Weapons.Owned
            pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()state:Grant()end))
        end
        bindEntries()
        local equipped=state.Profile.Effects and state.Profile.Effects.Equipped
        local current=type(equipped)=="table"and equipped[1]or nil
        local character=LocalPlayer.Character
        local knife=character and character:FindFirstChild("Knife")
        local handle=knife and knife:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if handle then handle=handle:FindFirstChild("CrackHubSkinVisual") or handle end
        local reference=character and character:FindFirstChild("DisplayRefKnife")
        local display=reference and reference.Value
        if current~=lastEquipped or character~=lastCharacter or handle~=lastHandle or display~=lastDisplay then
            lastEquipped,lastCharacter=current,character
            lastHandle,lastDisplay=handle,display
            applyEffect(current)
        end
    end)))
    task.spawn(function()
        local deadline=os.clock()+30
        while alive() and os.clock()<deadline do
            local profile=callbacks.Profile()
            local sync=readModule(storage:FindFirstChild("Database"),"Sync")
            if profile and sync then
                state.Profile,state.Sync=profile,sync
                lastOwned=profile.Weapons.Owned
                local ok,err=pcall(function()state:Grant()end)
                if not ok then warn("[CrackHub Inventory] "..tostring(err)) end
                if alive() then state.StopNativeChanger=CrackHubAttachNativeChanger(window,state,items,callbacks) end
                return
            end
            task.wait(.25)
        end
        if alive() then warn("[CrackHub Inventory] Game inventory modules are not available") end
    end)
    return state
end

local CrackHubMusicGlyph
do
    -- Lucide sprites (same sheets the rest of the UI already loads)
    local SPRITES={
        ["play"]={16898613699,918,257},["pause"]={16898613699,0,771},
        ["skip-forward"]={16898613777,98,820},["skip-back"]={16898613777,147,771},
        ["repeat"]={16898613699,820,710},["list"]={16898613509,771,857},
        ["trash"]={16898613869,257,918},["plus"]={16898613699,257,918},
        ["chevron-down"]={16898612819,196,918},["chevron-up"]={16898612819,710,918},
        ["close"]={16898613869,869,906},["minus"]={16898613613,771,196},["circle-play"]={16898613044,514,820},
    }
    local SINGLE={["shuffle"]="rbxassetid://103735725549548"}
    local function vectorShuffle(host,color)
        local function bar(x,y,w,h,r)
            Create("Frame",{Name="GlyphPart",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromScale(w,h),Rotation=r or 0,
                BorderSizePixel=0,BackgroundColor3=color,ZIndex=host.ZIndex,Parent=host},{Create("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)})})
        end
        bar(.5,.5,.86,.11,30);bar(.5,.5,.86,.11,-30);bar(.86,.27,.24,.11);bar(.86,.73,.24,.11)
    end
    CrackHubMusicGlyph=function(parent,name,color)
        local hex=color:ToHex()
        local image=parent:FindFirstChild("MusicIcon")
        if parent:GetAttribute("MusicGlyph")==name and parent:GetAttribute("MusicGlyphColor")==hex then return end
        parent:SetAttribute("MusicGlyphColor",hex)
        if parent:IsA("ImageLabel")or parent:IsA("ImageButton")then parent.ImageTransparency=1 end
        if not image then
            image=Create("ImageLabel",{Name="MusicIcon",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                ZIndex=(parent.ZIndex or 1)+1,Parent=parent})
        end
        image.ImageColor3=color
        local fallback=parent:FindFirstChild("VectorIcon")
        if fallback then for _,p in ipairs(fallback:GetChildren())do p.BackgroundColor3=color end end
        if parent:GetAttribute("MusicGlyph")==name then return end
        parent:SetAttribute("MusicGlyph",name)
        if fallback then fallback:Destroy()end
        image.Visible=true
        local sprite=SPRITES[name]
        if sprite then
            image.Image="rbxassetid://"..sprite[1]
            image.ImageRectOffset=Vector2.new(sprite[2],sprite[3])
            image.ImageRectSize=Vector2.new(48,48)
        else
            image.Image=SINGLE[name]or""
            image.ImageRectOffset=Vector2.zero
            image.ImageRectSize=Vector2.zero
            if name=="shuffle"then
                -- if the custom asset never loads, draw a clean vector version instead
                task.delay(4,function()
                    if image.Parent and parent:GetAttribute("MusicGlyph")=="shuffle" and not image.IsLoaded and not parent:FindFirstChild("VectorIcon")then
                        image.Visible=false
                        local host=Create("Frame",{Name="VectorIcon",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=image.ZIndex,Parent=parent})
                        vectorShuffle(host,image.ImageColor3)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function CrackHubInstallMusicWidget(window, api)
    local CrackHubFormatTime; CrackHubFormatTime = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(seconds)
        seconds=math.max(0,math.floor(tonumber(seconds)or 0))
        return string.format("%d:%02d",seconds//60,seconds%60)
    end)
    local function IsClick(input)
        return input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end
    local function IsMove(input)
        return input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end
    local Fonts={
        Regular=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Regular),
        Medium=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Medium),
        Bold=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold),
    }
    local COLLAPSED,ROW,MAX_ROWS=88,40,5
    local cfg={Enabled=true,Opacity=40,Artwork=85,Width=300,Expanded=false}
    local file="CrackHub/music_widget_v2.json"
    pcall(function()
        if isfile and readfile and isfile(file)then
            local saved=HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(file))
            if type(saved)=="table"then
                if type(saved.Enabled)=="boolean"then cfg.Enabled=saved.Enabled end
                if type(saved.Expanded)=="boolean"then cfg.Expanded=saved.Expanded end
                for key,limits in pairs({Opacity={0,85},Artwork={0,100},Width={260,460}})do
                    if tonumber(saved[key])then cfg[key]=math.clamp(saved[key],limits[1],limits[2])end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    local connections,alive={},true
    local function connect(signal,fn)local c=signal:Connect(function(...)if alive then return fn(...)end end);table.insert(connections,c);return c end
    local saveQueued=false
    local function save()
        if saveQueued then return end
        saveQueued=true
        task.delay(.4,function()
            saveQueued=false
            pcall(function()
                if makefolder and isfolder and not isfolder("CrackHub")then makefolder("CrackHub")end
                if writefile then writefile(file,HttpService:JSONEncode(cfg))end
            end)
        end)
    end

    local frame=Create("Frame",{Name="MusicListWidget",Position=UDim2.new(0,20,1,-(COLLAPSED+20)),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(cfg.Width,COLLAPSED),
        BackgroundColor3=Theme.Background,BackgroundTransparency=.04,BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true,ZIndex=15,Parent=window.Gui},
        {Corner(14),Stroke(Theme.Stroke,1,.35)})
    -- artwork covers the whole card (also the opened playlist), not just the top strip
    local backdrop=Create("ImageLabel",{Name="Artwork",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop,ZIndex=15,Parent=frame},{Corner(14)})
    local shade=Create("Frame",{Name="Shade",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(.03,.03,.045),BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=16,Parent=frame},{
        Corner(14),
        -- darker behind the text on the left, the picture stays clearly visible on the right
        Create("UIGradient",{Rotation=0,Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.5,.45),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.85)})}),
    })
    local portrait=Create("ImageLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,12),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(46,46),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,
        ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop,ZIndex=17,Parent=frame},{Corner(999)})
    local title=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(68,13),Size=UDim2.new(1,-112,0,18),BackgroundTransparency=1,FontFace=Fonts.Bold,
        TextSize=14,TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=17,Parent=frame})
    local artist=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(68,31),Size=UDim2.new(1,-112,0,15),BackgroundTransparency=1,FontFace=Fonts.Regular,
        TextSize=12,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(200,200,214),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=17,Parent=frame})
    local handle=Create("TextButton",{Name="Drag",Size=UDim2.new(1,-44,0,50),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",Active=true,AutoButtonColor=false,ZIndex=18,Parent=frame})
    MakeDraggable(handle,frame,connections)

    local icons={}
    local function button(name,x,y,size,fn,filled)
        local b=Create("TextButton",{Name=name,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size),AutoButtonColor=false,
            BackgroundColor3=filled and Theme.Accent or Color3.new(1,1,1),BackgroundTransparency=filled and 0 or 1,BorderSizePixel=0,Text="",ZIndex=18,Parent=frame},{Corner(999)})
        local inset=math.floor(size*(filled and .3 or .24))
        local icon=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(inset,inset),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size-inset*2,size-inset*2),BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=19,Parent=b})
        local scale=Create("UIScale",{Parent=b})
        connect(b.MouseEnter,function()if not filled then Tween(b,{BackgroundTransparency=.9},.12)end;Tween(scale,{Scale=1.08},.12)end)
        connect(b.MouseLeave,function()if not filled then Tween(b,{BackgroundTransparency=1},.12)end;Tween(scale,{Scale=1},.12)end)
        connect(b.MouseButton1Down,function()Tween(scale,{Scale=.9},.08)end)
        connect(b.MouseButton1Up,function()Tween(scale,{Scale=1},.15,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)end)
        connect(b.Activated,fn)
        icons[name]={Button=b,Icon=icon,Filled=filled}
        return b,icon
    end
    local list
    local function setExpanded(state,instant) end
    button("list",-1,12,28,function()setExpanded(not cfg.Expanded)end)
    icons.list.Button.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0);icons.list.Button.Position=UDim2.new(1,-10,0,12)

    -- controls row
    button("skip-back",64,52,24,function()api.Step(-1)end)
    button("play",92,50,28,function()api.Toggle()end,true)
    button("skip-forward",124,52,24,function()api.Step(1)end)
    local time=Create("TextLabel",{Name="Elapsed",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.new(1,-14,0,56),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(90,16),BackgroundTransparency=1,
        FontFace=Fonts.Medium,TextSize=11,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(205,205,218),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,Text="0:00 / --:--",ZIndex=17,Parent=frame})

    -- seekable progress line
    local seekArea=Create("TextButton",{Name="Seek",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,COLLAPSED-12),Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,12),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",
        AutoButtonColor=false,Active=true,ZIndex=18,Parent=frame})
    local progress=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,.5),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,3),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),
        BackgroundTransparency=.82,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=18,Parent=seekArea},{Corner(2)})
    local fill=Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=19,Parent=progress},{Corner(2)})
    -- equalizer bars for "Show Beat" (fed by the Music tab)
    local WBARS=30
    local eq=Create("Frame",{Name="Equalizer",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,1),Position=UDim2.new(0,10,1,-3),Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,14),
        BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=false,ZIndex=18,Parent=frame})
    local eqBars={}
    for i=1,WBARS do
        eqBars[i]=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,1),Position=UDim2.fromScale((i-.5)/WBARS,1),Size=UDim2.new(.6/WBARS,0,0,2),
            BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),BackgroundTransparency=.7,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=19,Parent=eq},{Corner(1)})
    end
    local seekDrag=false
    local function seekAt(x)
        local w=progress.AbsoluteSize.X
        if w>0 and api.Seek then api.Seek((x-progress.AbsolutePosition.X)/w)end
    end
    connect(seekArea.InputBegan,function(input)
        if IsClick(input)then seekDrag=true;Tween(progress,{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,5)},.12);seekAt(input.Position.X)end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputChanged,function(input)if seekDrag and IsMove(input)then seekAt(input.Position.X)end end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded,function(input)
        if seekDrag and IsClick(input)then seekDrag=false;Tween(progress,{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,3)},.15)end
    end)

    -- scrollable playlist (expands below)
    list=Create("ScrollingFrame",{Name="Playlist",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,COLLAPSED+4),Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,ROW*MAX_ROWS),BackgroundTransparency=1,
        BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=3,ScrollBarImageColor3=Theme.Accent,ScrollBarImageTransparency=.3,ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
        ElasticBehavior=Enum.ElasticBehavior.WhenScrollable,CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,ZIndex=18,Parent=frame},
        {Create("UIListLayout",{Padding=UDim.new(0,2),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}),Create("UIPadding",{PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,6),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,4)})})
    local divider=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,COLLAPSED),Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,1),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),BackgroundTransparency=.9,
        BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=18,Parent=frame})
    local listRows={}
    local function listHeight()
        return math.min(#api.Tracks,MAX_ROWS)*(ROW+2)+8
    end
    local sizeTween
    setExpanded=function(state,instant)
        cfg.Expanded=state
        local height=state and COLLAPSED+listHeight() or COLLAPSED
        local target=UDim2.fromOffset(cfg.Width,height)
        -- keep the bottom edge in place so the card grows upward from the screen corner
        local pos=frame.Position
        local delta=height-frame.Size.Y.Offset
        local targetPos=UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale,pos.X.Offset,pos.Y.Scale,pos.Y.Offset-delta)
        if sizeTween then sizeTween:Cancel()end
        if instant then frame.Size,frame.Position=target,targetPos
        else
            sizeTween=TweenService:Create(frame,TweenInfo.new(.32,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Size=target,Position=targetPos})
            sizeTween:Play()
        end
        CrackHubMusicGlyph(icons.list.Icon,state and"chevron-down"or"list",Color3.new(1,1,1))
        if state then
            local index=table.find(api.Tracks,api.Current())or 1
            list.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.max(0,(index-2)*(ROW+2)))
        end
        save()
    end
    local function paintRows()
        local current=api.Current()
        local accent=Theme.Accent
        for _,row in ipairs(listRows)do
            local active=row.Track==current
            row.Frame.BackgroundColor3=active and accent or Color3.new(1,1,1)
            if not row.Hover then row.Frame.BackgroundTransparency=active and .78 or 1 end
            row.Title.TextColor3=active and Color3.new(1,1,1)or Color3.fromRGB(225,225,235)
            row.Title.FontFace=active and Fonts.Bold or Fonts.Medium
        end
    end
    local function buildRows()
        for _,row in ipairs(listRows)do row.Frame:Destroy()end
        table.clear(listRows)
        for index,track in ipairs(api.Tracks)do
            local rowFrame=Create("TextButton",{Name="Track",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,ROW),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,
                AutoButtonColor=false,Text="",BorderSizePixel=0,LayoutOrder=index,ZIndex=19,Parent=list},{Corner(9)})
            Create("ImageLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(28,28),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
                Image=api.Artwork(track),ZIndex=20,Parent=rowFrame},{Corner(6)})
            local rowTitle=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(42,5),Size=UDim2.new(1,-90,0,16),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=track.title,
                FontFace=Fonts.Medium,TextSize=12,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(225,225,235),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=20,Parent=rowFrame})
            Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(42,21),Size=UDim2.new(1,-90,0,14),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=track.artist~=""and track.artist or"Roblox Audio",
                FontFace=Fonts.Regular,TextSize=11,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(165,165,182),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=20,Parent=rowFrame})
            Create("TextLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-8,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(40,14),BackgroundTransparency=1,
                Text=track.duration and CrackHubFormatTime(track.duration)or"",FontFace=Fonts.Regular,TextSize=11,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(150,150,168),
                TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,ZIndex=20,Parent=rowFrame})
            local row={Track=track,Frame=rowFrame,Title=rowTitle}
            rowFrame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()row.Hover=true;if track~=api.Current()then Tween(rowFrame,{BackgroundTransparency=.92},.12)end end)
            rowFrame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()row.Hover=false;if track~=api.Current()then Tween(rowFrame,{BackgroundTransparency=1},.12)end end)
            rowFrame.Activated:Connect(function()if alive then api.Play(track)end end)
            table.insert(listRows,row)
        end
        paintRows()
        if cfg.Expanded then setExpanded(true)end
    end

    local lastImage
    local function paint()
        if not alive then return end
        local track=api.Current()
        local image=api.Artwork(track)
        if lastImage~=image then lastImage=image;portrait.Image=image;backdrop.Image=image end
        title.Text=track and track.title or "Music"
        artist.Text=track and (track.unavailable and"Unavailable"or(track.artist~=""and track.artist or"Roblox Audio"))or""
        local accent=Theme.Accent
        for name,data in pairs(icons)do
            if data.Filled then data.Button.BackgroundColor3=accent end
            if name=="play"then CrackHubMusicGlyph(data.Icon,api.Sound.IsPlaying and"pause"or"play",Color3.new(1,1,1))
            elseif name~="list"then CrackHubMusicGlyph(data.Icon,name,Color3.new(1,1,1))end
        end
        fill.BackgroundColor3=accent
        list.ScrollBarImageColor3=accent
        frame.BackgroundColor3=Theme.Background
        paintRows()
    end
    local lastTime
    local tick; tick = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local length=api.Duration()
        local position=api.Position()
        fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(length>0 and math.clamp(position/length,0,1)or 0,1)
        local text=CrackHubFormatTime(position).." / "..(length>0 and CrackHubFormatTime(length)or"--:--")
        if text~=lastTime then lastTime=text;time.Text=text end
        if eq.Visible then
            local fraction=length>0 and math.clamp(position/length,0,1)or 0
            for i=1,WBARS do
                local played=(i-.5)/WBARS<=fraction
                eqBars[i].BackgroundColor3=played and Theme.Accent or Color3.new(1,1,1)
                eqBars[i].BackgroundTransparency=played and 0 or .7
            end
        end
    end)
    local function appearance()
        frame.Visible=cfg.Enabled
        shade.BackgroundTransparency=1-cfg.Opacity/100
        backdrop.ImageTransparency=1-cfg.Artwork/100
        setExpanded(cfg.Expanded,true)
    end

    -- settings popup (opened from the watermark menu), macOS-style window
    local POPUP_W,POPUP_H,POPUP_TALL,HEADER=310,300,420,40
    local popupHeight,popupMin=POPUP_H,false
    local popup=Create("Frame",{Name="WatermarkElements",Size=UDim2.fromOffset(POPUP_W,POPUP_H),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(30,80),Visible=false,
        BackgroundColor3=Theme.Background,BackgroundTransparency=.04,BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true,ZIndex=60,Parent=window.Gui},{Corner(12),Stroke(Theme.Stroke,1,.2)})
    local popupScale=Create("UIScale",{Parent=popup})
    local header=Create("TextButton",{Name="Header",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,HEADER),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,Active=true,ZIndex=61,Parent=popup})
    MakeDraggable(header,popup,connections)
    Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,HEADER-1),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,1),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Stroke,BackgroundTransparency=.4,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=61,Parent=popup})
    Create("TextLabel",{Name="Title",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,HEADER),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="Music List",
        FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=13,TextColor3=Theme.Text,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,ZIndex=62,Parent=popup})
    local function resizePopup()
        Tween(popup,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(POPUP_W,popupMin and HEADER or popupHeight)},.28,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
    end
    local function closePopup()
        Tween(popupScale,{Scale=.94},.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In)
        task.delay(.12,function()if alive then popup.Visible=false end end)
    end
    local lights=Create("Frame",{Name="TrafficLights",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,(HEADER-14)/2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(58,14),BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=62,Parent=popup})
    local symbols={}
    for index,info in ipairs({
        {"Close",Color3.fromRGB(255,95,87),"close",closePopup},
        {"Minimize",Color3.fromRGB(254,188,46),"minus",function()popupMin=not popupMin;resizePopup()end},
        {"Zoom",Color3.fromRGB(40,200,64),"plus",function()popupMin=false;popupHeight=popupHeight==POPUP_H and POPUP_TALL or POPUP_H;resizePopup()end},
    })do
        local dot=Create("TextButton",{Name=info[1],Position=UDim2.fromOffset((index-1)*20,1),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(12,12),BackgroundColor3=info[2],
            Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=63,Parent=lights},{Corner(999),Stroke(Color3.new(0,0,0),1,.8)})
        local symbol=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=false,ZIndex=64,Parent=dot})
        CrackHubMusicGlyph(symbol,info[3],Color3.fromRGB(90,30,20))
        table.insert(symbols,symbol)
        connect(dot.MouseButton1Down,function()Tween(dot,{BackgroundColor3=info[2]:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0),.25)},.06)end)
        connect(dot.MouseButton1Up,function()Tween(dot,{BackgroundColor3=info[2]},.12)end)
        connect(dot.Activated,info[4])
    end
    -- like macOS: symbols appear when the cursor is over the group
    connect(lights.MouseEnter,function()for _,s in ipairs(symbols)do s.Visible=true end end)
    connect(lights.MouseLeave,function()for _,s in ipairs(symbols)do s.Visible=false end end)
    local holder=Create("ScrollingFrame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,HEADER+6),Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-(HEADER+14)),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
        ScrollBarThickness=3,CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,ZIndex=62,Parent=popup},{List(5)})
    local controls=setmetatable({Holder=holder,Window=window},Container)
    local function setter(key)return function(value)cfg[key]=value;appearance();paint();save()end end
    controls:AddToggle({Name="Music List",Default=cfg.Enabled,Flag="MusicWidget_Enabled",Bind=false,Callback=setter("Enabled")})
    controls:AddSlider({Name="Darken",Min=0,Max=85,Default=cfg.Opacity,Increment=1,Suffix="%",Flag="MusicWidget_Darken",Callback=setter("Opacity")})
    controls:AddSlider({Name="Artwork strength",Min=0,Max=100,Default=cfg.Artwork,Increment=1,Suffix="%",Flag="MusicWidget_Artwork",Callback=setter("Artwork")})
    controls:AddSlider({Name="Width",Min=260,Max=460,Default=cfg.Width,Increment=10,Flag="MusicWidget_Width",Callback=setter("Width")})
    for _,object in ipairs(holder:GetDescendants())do if object:IsA("GuiObject")then object.ZIndex=63 end end
    local open=function(at)
        if at then
            local size=workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720)
            popup.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(at.X,4,math.max(4,size.X-314)),math.clamp(at.Y,4,math.max(4,size.Y-popupHeight-4)))
        end
        popupScale.Scale=.94
        popupMin=false
        popup.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(POPUP_W,popupHeight)
        popup.Visible=true
        Tween(popupScale,{Scale=1},.22,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
    end
    window.OpenMusicWidgetSettings=open

    -- progress updates only while the card is on screen and the track is actually playing
    local elapsed=0
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(delta)
        elapsed+=delta
        if elapsed<.2 then return end
        elapsed=0
        if frame.Visible and (api.Sound.IsPlaying or seekDrag)then tick()end
    end))
    api.OnChanged(function()paint();tick()end)
    api.OnBeat(function(levels,on)
        if eq.Visible~=on then eq.Visible=on;progress.Visible=not on end
        if not on or not frame.Visible then return end
        local fraction=fill.Size.X.Scale
        local accent=Theme.Accent
        local count=#levels
        for i=1,WBARS do
            local level=levels[math.clamp(math.ceil(i*count/WBARS),1,count)]or 0
            local bar=eqBars[i]
            bar.Size=UDim2.new(.6/WBARS,0,0,2+level*12)
            local played=(i-.5)/WBARS<=fraction
            bar.BackgroundColor3=played and accent or Color3.new(1,1,1)
            bar.BackgroundTransparency=played and 0 or .7
        end
    end)
    api.OnTracksChanged(buildRows)
    buildRows();appearance();paint();tick()

    local controller={Frame=frame,Settings=cfg,Popup=popup,Open=open,Refresh=function()paint();tick()end,SetExpanded=setExpanded}
    function controller:Stop()
        if not alive then return end
        alive=false
        for _,connection in ipairs(connections)do connection:Disconnect()end
        frame:Destroy();popup:Destroy()
        if window.OpenMusicWidgetSettings==open then window.OpenMusicWidgetSettings=nil end
    end
    return controller
end

local function CrackHubInstallMusic(window, tab)
    local Fonts={
        Regular=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Regular),
        Medium=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Medium),
        Bold=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold),
    }
    local tracks = {{id="104795305072330",title="Кошмары",artist="Dabbackwood",start=0,duration=84.12},{id="114927337348047",title="Хроники 1",artist="Dabbackwood",start=5.53,duration=110.14},{id="88011825786653",title="Распять",artist="madk1d",start=31.9,duration=112.14},{id="71655018556268",title="Так похуй",artist="madk1d",start=3.0,duration=114.42},{id="76968950248241",title="Маршрутка",artist="CUPSIZE",start=23.85,duration=177.51},{id="113046329605558",title="Ты любишь танцевать",artist="CUPSIZE",start=8.0,duration=95.25}}
    local covers = setmetatable({}, {__index = function(_, id) return "@covers/" .. tostring(id) .. ".jpg" end})
    local audioData = setmetatable({}, {__index = function(_, id) return "@music/" .. tostring(id) .. ".ogg" end})
    local musicIcon = "rbxassetid://132132095360900"
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.Name, sound.Volume, sound.Looped = "CrackHubMusicPlayer", .5, false
    sound.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
    local alive, current, shuffle, generation = true, tracks[1], false, 0
    local connections, rows = {}, {}
    local localSource, desiredVolume, waitingStart = false, .5, false
    local advance
    local widget
    local endAction="Next Track"
    local changeListeners,trackListeners,beatListeners={},{},{}
    local playingIntent,endedGeneration,lastStart=false,-1,0
    local drawBarsRef
    local beatEnabled,beatLevel,beatPulse,beatAverage=false,0,0,0
    local function emit(list)for _,fn in ipairs(list)do task.spawn(pcall,fn)end end
    local playerGroup = tab:AddGroup("Music Player", true)
    local function connect(signal, fn)
        local c=signal:Connect(function(...) if alive then return fn(...) end end)
        table.insert(connections,c)
        return c
    end
    local function notify(text)
        if alive then window:Notify({Title="Music",Content=text,Type="Warning",Duration=4}) end
    end
    local function make(class,props,parent,children)
        props.Parent=parent
        return Create(class,props,children)
    end
    local function picture(track)
        if track.picture then return track.picture end
        local encoded=covers[track.id]
        local env=CrackHubEnvironment
        if encoded and type(env.writefile)=="function" and type(env.getcustomasset)=="function" then
            local ok,result=pcall(function()
                if type(env.isfolder)=="function" and not env.isfolder("CrackHub") then env.makefolder("CrackHub") end
                local path="CrackHub/music_cover_"..track.id..".jpg"
                if type(env.isfile)~="function" or not env.isfile(path) then env.writefile(path,(encoded:sub(1,1)=="@" and assert(((getgenv and getgenv()) or _G).__CrackHubAsset(encoded:sub(2)),"asset download failed") or Base64Decode(encoded))) end
                return env.getcustomasset(path)
            end)
            if ok and type(result)=="string" then track.picture=result;covers[track.id]=nil;return result end
        end
        track.picture=musicIcon
        return musicIcon
    end
    local function soundSource(track)
        if track.cachedAudio then return track.cachedAudio,true end
        local encoded=audioData[track.id]
        local env=CrackHubEnvironment
        if encoded and type(env.writefile)=="function" and type(env.getcustomasset)=="function"then
            local ok,uri=pcall(function()
                if type(env.isfolder)=="function"and not env.isfolder("CrackHub")then env.makefolder("CrackHub")end
                local path="CrackHub/music_clean_v17_"..track.id..".ogg"
                if type(env.isfile)~="function"or not env.isfile(path)then env.writefile(path,(encoded:sub(1,1)=="@" and assert(((getgenv and getgenv()) or _G).__CrackHubAsset(encoded:sub(2)),"asset download failed") or Base64Decode(encoded)))end
                return env.getcustomasset(path)
            end)
            if ok and type(uri)=="string"and uri~=""then track.cachedAudio=uri;audioData[track.id]=nil;return uri,true end
        end
        return "rbxassetid://"..track.id,false
    end
    local startOffset; startOffset = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        return not localSource and current and (tonumber(current.start)or 0)or 0
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ now playing card
    local hero=make("Frame",{Name="MusicTransport",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,166),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Background,BackgroundTransparency=.35,
        BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true,LayoutOrder=NextOrder()},playerGroup.Holder,{Corner(12),Stroke(Theme.Stroke,1,.5)})
    local heroBackdrop=make("ImageLabel",{Name="Backdrop",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
        ImageTransparency=.82,Image=picture(current)},hero,{Corner(12)})
    make("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Background,BorderSizePixel=0},hero,{
        Corner(12),Create("UIGradient",{Rotation=0,Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.55),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.05)})})})
    local cover=make("ImageLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,14),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(104,104),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,
        ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop,Image=picture(current)},hero,{Corner(12),Stroke(Color3.new(1,1,1),1,.85)})
    local nowLabel=make("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(134,16),Size=UDim2.new(1,-148,0,14),BackgroundTransparency=1,
        FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=10,TextColor3=Theme.Accent,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Text="NOW PLAYING"},hero)
    local title=make("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(134,32),Size=UDim2.new(1,-148,0,26),BackgroundTransparency=1,
        FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=20,TextColor3=Theme.Text,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,Text=current.title},hero)
    local subtitle=make("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(134,58),Size=UDim2.new(1,-148,0,18),BackgroundTransparency=1,
        FontFace=Fonts.Regular,TextSize=13,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,Text=current.artist},hero)

    local transportButtons={}
    local function transport(name,x,accent)
        local size=accent and 40 or 32
        local button=make("TextButton",{Name=name,AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,.5),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,100),
            Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size),BackgroundColor3=accent and Theme.Accent or Theme.Text,Text="",BorderSizePixel=0,
            BackgroundTransparency=accent and 0 or 1,AutoButtonColor=false},hero,{Corner(999)})
        local scale=Create("UIScale",{Parent=button})
        local inset=accent and 12 or 9
        local glyph=make("Frame",{Name="Glyph",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(inset,inset),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size-inset*2,size-inset*2),BackgroundTransparency=1},button)
        connect(button.MouseEnter,function()if not accent then Tween(button,{BackgroundTransparency=.92},.12)end;Tween(scale,{Scale=1.06},.12)end)
        connect(button.MouseLeave,function()if not accent then Tween(button,{BackgroundTransparency=1},.12)end;Tween(scale,{Scale=1},.12)end)
        connect(button.MouseButton1Down,function()Tween(scale,{Scale=.9},.08)end)
        connect(button.MouseButton1Up,function()Tween(scale,{Scale=1},.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)end)
        transportButtons[name]={Button=button,Glyph=glyph,Accent=accent}
        return button,glyph
    end
    local shuffleButton,shuffleGlyph=transport("shuffle",134,false)
    local previousButton,previousGlyph=transport("skip-back",170,false)
    local playButton,playGlyph=transport("play",206,true)
    local nextButton,nextGlyph=transport("skip-forward",250,false)
    local repeatButton,repeatGlyph=transport("repeat",286,false)

    local elapsedLabel=make("TextLabel",{Name="Elapsed",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,134),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(40,18),Text="0:00",BackgroundTransparency=1,
        FontFace=Fonts.Medium,TextSize=11,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left},hero)
    local timeLabel=make("TextLabel",{Name="Time",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.new(1,-14,0,134),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(40,18),
        Text="--:--",BackgroundTransparency=1,FontFace=Fonts.Medium,TextSize=11,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right},hero)
    local seekArea=make("TextButton",{Name="Seek",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(58,130),Size=UDim2.new(1,-116,0,26),
        BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,Active=true},hero)
    local seekTrack=make("Frame",{Name="Track",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,.5),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,4),
        BackgroundColor3=Theme.Stroke,BorderSizePixel=0},seekArea,{Corner(2)})
    local seekFill=make("Frame",{Name="Progress",Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,BorderSizePixel=0},seekTrack,{Corner(2)})
    local seekKnob=make("Frame",{Name="Handle",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,.5),
        Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),BorderSizePixel=0},seekTrack,{Corner(999)})
    local dragging,dragInput,seekHover=false,nil,false
    local function knob()
        local show=dragging or seekHover
        Tween(seekKnob,{Size=show and UDim2.fromOffset(12,12)or UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)},.12)
        if not beatEnabled then Tween(seekTrack,{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,show and 6 or 4)},.12)end
    end
    connect(seekArea.MouseEnter,function()seekHover=true;knob()end)
    connect(seekArea.MouseLeave,function()seekHover=false;knob()end)

    local formatTime; formatTime = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(seconds)
        seconds=math.max(0,math.floor(tonumber(seconds)or 0))
        return string.format("%d:%02d",seconds//60,seconds%60)
    end)
    local duration; duration = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if not current or sound.SoundId~=(current.cachedAudio or "rbxassetid://"..current.id) or not sound.IsLoaded then return 0 end
        local length=math.max(0,(tonumber(sound.TimeLength)or 0)-startOffset())
        if current.duration then length=math.min(length,current.duration)end
        return length==length and length<math.huge and math.max(0,length)or 0
    end)
    local lastElapsed,lastTotal
    local refreshTime; refreshTime = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local length=duration()
        local position=math.clamp((tonumber(sound.TimePosition)or 0)-startOffset(),0,length>0 and length or 0)
        local fraction=length>0 and position/length or 0
        seekFill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(fraction,1)
        seekKnob.Position=UDim2.fromScale(fraction,.5)
        if beatEnabled and drawBarsRef then drawBarsRef(fraction)end
        local e,t=formatTime(position),length>0 and formatTime(length)or "--:--"
        if e~=lastElapsed then lastElapsed=e;elapsedLabel.Text=e end
        if t~=lastTotal then lastTotal=t;timeLabel.Text=t end
    end)
    local function seek(fraction)
        local length=duration()
        if length<=0 then return false end
        sound.TimePosition=startOffset()+math.clamp(fraction,0,1)*length
        refreshTime()
        if widget then widget.Refresh()end
        return true
    end
    local function seekAt(x)
        local width=seekTrack.AbsoluteSize.X
        if width<=0 then return end
        seek((x-seekTrack.AbsolutePosition.X)/width)
    end
    connect(seekArea.InputBegan,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            if duration()<=0 then return end
            dragging,dragInput=true,input
            knob()
            seekAt(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputChanged,function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input==dragInput) then seekAt(input.Position.X)end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded,function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input==dragInput)then
            seekAt(input.Position.X);dragging,dragInput=false,nil;knob()
        end
    end)
    -- the track is over: handled exactly once per started track, then the next action runs on the next frame
    local trackFinished; trackFinished = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if not alive or not playingIntent or endedGeneration==generation then return end
        endedGeneration=generation
        task.defer(function()if alive and advance then advance(1)end end)
    end)
    -- one cheap timer: end-of-track check always, UI refresh only when the Music tab is actually on screen
    local timer,uiTimer=0,0
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(delta)
        timer+=delta
        if timer<.1 then return end
        uiTimer+=timer
        timer=0
        if not playingIntent or waitingStart then return end
        local length=duration()
        if not sound.IsPlaying then
            -- Roblox sometimes stops a sound at the end without firing Ended
            if sound.IsLoaded and os.clock()-lastStart>1 then trackFinished()end
            return
        end
        if length>0 and sound.TimePosition-startOffset()>=length-.08 then trackFinished();return end
        if uiTimer<.25 then return end
        uiTimer=0
        if window.Visible~=false and hero.AbsoluteSize.X>0 then
            local p=hero.Parent
            local shown=true
            while p and p~=window.Gui do if p:IsA("GuiObject")and not p.Visible then shown=false;break end;p=p.Parent end
            if shown then refreshTime()end
        end
    end))
    local function finishLoading()
        if not current or not sound.IsLoaded then return end
        if waitingStart then
            sound.TimePosition=startOffset()
            waitingStart=false
            lastStart=os.clock()
            sound.Volume=desiredVolume
        end
        current.unavailable=false
        refreshTime()
    end
    connect(sound.Loaded,finishLoading)

    local function paint()
        local accent=Theme.Accent
        title.Text=current and current.title or "Music"
        subtitle.Text=current and (current.artist~=""and current.artist or"Roblox Audio") or ""
        local image=current and picture(current) or musicIcon
        if cover.Image~=image then cover.Image=image;heroBackdrop.Image=image end
        nowLabel.TextColor3=accent
        nowLabel.Text=sound.IsPlaying and "NOW PLAYING" or "PAUSED"
        playButton.BackgroundColor3=accent
        seekFill.BackgroundColor3=accent
        CrackHubMusicGlyph(playGlyph,sound.IsPlaying and "pause" or "play",Color3.new(1,1,1))
        CrackHubMusicGlyph(previousGlyph,"skip-back",Theme.Text)
        CrackHubMusicGlyph(nextGlyph,"skip-forward",Theme.Text)
        CrackHubMusicGlyph(shuffleGlyph,"shuffle",shuffle and accent or Theme.SubText)
        CrackHubMusicGlyph(repeatGlyph,"repeat",endAction=="Repeat Track" and accent or Theme.SubText)
        refreshTime()
        for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
            local active=row.track==current
            row.frame.BackgroundColor3=active and accent or Theme.ElementHover
            if not row.hover then row.frame.BackgroundTransparency=active and .86 or 1 end
            row.mark.Visible=active
            row.mark.BackgroundColor3=accent
            row.titleLabel.TextColor3=active and accent or Theme.Text
            row.number.Visible=not active
            row.playing.Visible=active
            CrackHubMusicGlyph(row.playing,sound.IsPlaying and active and "pause" or "play",accent)
            row.artistLabel.Text=row.track.unavailable and "Unavailable" or (row.track.artist~=""and row.track.artist or"Roblox Audio")
        end
        emit(changeListeners)
    end
    local function play(track)
        if not alive or not track then return end
        generation+=1
        local token=generation
        current=track
        dragging,dragInput=false,nil
        playingIntent=true
        lastStart=os.clock()
        sound:Stop()
        current.unavailable=false
        waitingStart=true
        sound.Volume=0
        local uri,isLocal=soundSource(track)
        localSource=isLocal
        sound.SoundId=uri
        sound.TimePosition=startOffset()
        sound:Play()
        if sound.IsLoaded then finishLoading()end
        paint()
        task.delay(12,function()
            if alive and token==generation and not sound.IsLoaded then
                track.unavailable=true
                waitingStart=false
                endedGeneration=generation
                sound:Stop()
                paint()
                notify("Could not load "..track.title..". Skipping track.")
                if advance then advance(1)end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function step(direction)
        if #tracks==0 then return end
        local index=table.find(tracks,current) or 1
        if shuffle and #tracks>1 then
            local pick=math.random(1,#tracks-1)
            if pick>=index then pick+=1 end
            index=pick
        else index=(index-1+direction)%#tracks+1 end
        local checked=0
        while tracks[index].unavailable and checked<#tracks do index=index%#tracks+1;checked+=1 end
        if checked>=#tracks then playingIntent=false;sound:Stop();paint();return end
        play(tracks[index])
    end
    advance=function(direction)
        if endAction=="Repeat Track" and current and not current.unavailable then play(current)else step(direction)end
    end
    local function toggle()
        if not current then return end
        if sound.IsPlaying then playingIntent=false;sound:Pause();generation+=1;paint()
        elseif sound.SoundId==(current.cachedAudio or "rbxassetid://"..current.id) and sound.TimePosition>0 then playingIntent=true;lastStart=os.clock();sound:Resume();paint()
        else play(current) end
    end
    local endDropdown
    connect(playButton.Activated,toggle)
    connect(previousButton.Activated,function()step(-1)end)
    connect(nextButton.Activated,function()step(1)end)
    connect(shuffleButton.Activated,function()shuffle=not shuffle;paint()end)
    connect(repeatButton.Activated,function()
        endAction=endAction=="Repeat Track" and "Next Track" or "Repeat Track"
        if endDropdown and endDropdown.Set then pcall(endDropdown.Set,endDropdown,endAction,true)end
        paint()
    end)
    connect(sound.Ended,trackFinished)
    endDropdown=playerGroup:AddDropdown({Name="When song ends",Options={"Repeat Track","Next Track"},Default="Next Track",Bind=false,
        Flag="Music_EndAction",Callback=function(value)endAction=value=="Repeat Track"and"Repeat Track"or"Next Track";paint()end})
    -- "Show Beat": the seek line turns into jumping equalizer bars.
    -- Roblox only exposes overall loudness, so every band gets its own motion
    -- on top of the real loudness, and all bands jump together on each kick.
    local BANDS=40
    local bands,bandKick,bandSeed={}, {}, {}
    for i=1,BANDS do bands[i]=0;bandKick[i]=0;bandSeed[i]=math.random()*6 end
    local beatClock=0
    local barHolder=make("Frame",{Name="Equalizer",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=false},seekArea)
    local bars={}
    for i=1,BANDS do
        local bar=make("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale((i-.5)/BANDS,.5),Size=UDim2.new(.62/BANDS,0,0,3),
            BackgroundColor3=Theme.Stroke,BorderSizePixel=0},barHolder,{Corner(2)})
        bars[i]={Frame=bar,Played=nil}
    end
    local BAR_MAX=22
    local drawBars; drawBars = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(fraction)
        local accent=Theme.Accent
        for i=1,BANDS do
            local bar=bars[i]
            bar.Frame.Size=UDim2.new(.62/BANDS,0,0,3+bands[i]*BAR_MAX)
            local played=(i-.5)/BANDS<=fraction
            if bar.Played~=played or bar.Color~=accent then
                bar.Played,bar.Color=played,accent
                bar.Frame.BackgroundColor3=played and accent or Theme.Stroke
                bar.Frame.BackgroundTransparency=played and 0 or .15
            end
        end
    end)
    drawBarsRef=drawBars
    local function setBeatMode(on)
        barHolder.Visible=on
        seekTrack.Visible=not on
        for i=1,BANDS do bands[i]=0 end
        if on then drawBars(seekFill.Size.X.Scale)end
        for _,fn in ipairs(beatListeners)do fn(bands,on)end
    end
    connect(RunService.RenderStepped,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        if not beatEnabled then return end
        local playing=sound.IsPlaying and not waitingStart
        local loud=playing and (tonumber(sound.PlaybackLoudness)or 0) or 0
        beatAverage+=(loud-beatAverage)*math.min(1,dt*2.5)
        if loud>60 and loud>beatAverage*1.22 and beatPulse<.5 then
            beatPulse=1
            for i=1,BANDS do bandKick[i]=.45+math.random()*.55 end
        end
        beatPulse=math.max(0,beatPulse-dt*3.5)
        beatClock+=dt
        local energy=math.clamp(loud/420,0,1)
        local moving=false
        for i=1,BANDS do
            local seed=bandSeed[i]
            local wobble=.5+.5*math.sin(beatClock*(4+seed)+seed*5)
            local target=playing and math.clamp(energy*(.18+.55*wobble)+beatPulse*bandKick[i]*.75,0,1) or 0
            local current=bands[i]
            -- fast attack, slower fall: that's what makes it "jump"
            current+=(target-current)*math.min(1,dt*(target>current and 28 or 9))
            bands[i]=current
            if current>.005 then moving=true end
        end
        if not moving and beatLevel==0 then return end
        beatLevel=moving and 1 or 0
        if window.Visible~=false and hero.AbsoluteSize.X>0 then drawBars(seekFill.Size.X.Scale)end
        for _,fn in ipairs(beatListeners)do fn(bands,true)end
    end))
    playerGroup:AddToggle({Name="Show Beat",Default=false,Flag="Music_ShowBeat",Bind=false,Callback=function(value)
        beatEnabled=value==true
        beatPulse,beatAverage,beatLevel=0,0,0
        setBeatMode(beatEnabled)
        knob()
    end})
    local volumeControl=playerGroup:AddSlider({Name="Volume",Min=0,Max=100,Default=50,Increment=1,Suffix="%",Flag="Music_Volume",
        Callback=function(value)desiredVolume=math.clamp(value/100,0,1);if not waitingStart then sound.Volume=desiredVolume end end})

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ playlist
    local songs=tab:AddGroup("My Songs",true)
    local entryRow=make("Frame",{Name="AddTrack",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,40),BackgroundTransparency=1,LayoutOrder=-2},songs.Holder)
    local function entry(name,placeholder,position,size)
        local box=make("TextBox",{Name=name,Position=position,Size=size,Text="",PlaceholderText=placeholder,
            ClearTextOnFocus=false,BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,BackgroundTransparency=.15,BorderSizePixel=0,
            FontFace=Fonts.Regular,TextSize=12,TextColor3=Theme.Text,PlaceholderColor3=Theme.SubText,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left},entryRow,{Corner(9),Create("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,12),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,8)})})
        local stroke=Stroke(Theme.Stroke,1,.4);stroke.Parent=box
        connect(box.Focused,function()Tween(stroke,{Color=Theme.Accent,Transparency=.2},.15)end)
        connect(box.FocusLost,function()Tween(stroke,{Color=Theme.Stroke,Transparency=.4},.15)end)
        return {Box=box,Set=function(_,value)box.Text=value end}
    end
    local idBox=entry("SoundID","Roblox Sound ID",UDim2.fromOffset(0,2),UDim2.new(.5,-26,0,36))
    local nameBox=entry("TrackName","Name (optional)",UDim2.new(.5,-20,0,2),UDim2.new(.5,-26,0,36))
    local addButton=make("TextButton",{Name="AddSong",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.new(1,0,0,2),
        Size=UDim2.fromOffset(36,36),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,BorderSizePixel=0,Text="",AutoButtonColor=true},entryRow,{Corner(10)})
    local addGlyph=make("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,10),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16),BackgroundTransparency=1},addButton)
    CrackHubMusicGlyph(addGlyph,"plus",Color3.new(1,1,1))
    local countLabel=make("TextLabel",{Name="Count",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,22),BackgroundTransparency=1,LayoutOrder=-1,FontFace=Fonts.Medium,
        TextSize=11,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Text=""},songs.Holder,{Create("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,4)})})
    local render
    local function add()
        local id=idBox.Box.Text:match("^%s*(%d+)%s*$")
        if not id or id:match("^0+$") then notify("Enter a numeric Sound ID.");return false end
        for _,track in ipairs(tracks)do if track.id==id then notify("This Sound ID is already in My Songs.");return false end end
        local name=nameBox.Box.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        table.insert(tracks,{id=id,title=name~="" and name or "Sound "..id,artist=""})
        idBox:Set("");nameBox:Set("");render()
        return true
    end
    connect(addButton.Activated,add)
    connect(idBox.Box.FocusLost,function(enter)if enter and idBox.Box.Text~=""then add()end end)
    connect(nameBox.Box.FocusLost,function(enter)if enter and idBox.Box.Text~=""then add()end end)
    render=function()
        for _,row in ipairs(rows)do
            for _,c in ipairs(row.connections)do c:Disconnect()end
            row.frame:Destroy()
        end
        table.clear(rows)
        countLabel.Text=#tracks..(#tracks==1 and" track"or" tracks")
        for index,track in ipairs(tracks)do
            local frame=make("Frame",{Name="Song_"..track.id,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,52),BackgroundColor3=Theme.ElementHover,
                BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,LayoutOrder=index},songs.Holder,{Corner(10)})
            local number=make("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(4,0),Size=UDim2.new(0,22,1,0),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=tostring(index),
                FontFace=Fonts.Medium,TextSize=12,TextColor3=Theme.SubText},frame)
            local playing=make("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.new(0,15,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(12,12),BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=false},frame)
            make("ImageLabel",{Name="Artwork",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(32,7),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(38,38),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,
                ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop,Image=picture(track)},frame,{Corner(8)})
            local titleLabel=make("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(80,8),Size=UDim2.new(1,-170,0,19),Text=track.title,BackgroundTransparency=1,
                FontFace=Fonts.Medium,TextSize=13,TextColor3=Theme.Text,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd},frame)
            local artistLabel=make("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(80,27),Size=UDim2.new(1,-170,0,16),Text=track.artist,BackgroundTransparency=1,
                FontFace=Fonts.Regular,TextSize=11,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd},frame)
            make("TextLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-46,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(44,16),BackgroundTransparency=1,
                Text=track.duration and formatTime(track.duration)or"",FontFace=Fonts.Regular,TextSize=11,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,
                TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right},frame)
            local choose=make("TextButton",{Name="Select",Size=UDim2.new(1,-44,1,0),Text="",BackgroundTransparency=1,AutoButtonColor=false},frame)
            local remove=make("TextButton",{Name="Remove",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-8,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(30,30),
                Text="",BackgroundColor3=Theme.Danger,BackgroundTransparency=1,AutoButtonColor=false},frame,{Corner(8)})
