            local removeGlyph=make("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(14,14),BackgroundTransparency=1},remove)
            CrackHubMusicGlyph(removeGlyph,"trash",Theme.SubText)
            local mark=make("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(0,3,1,-22),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,11),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,BorderSizePixel=0,Visible=false},frame,{Corner(2)})
            local row={track=track,frame=frame,mark=mark,artistLabel=artistLabel,titleLabel=titleLabel,number=number,playing=playing,connections={}}
            local function hover(state)
                row.hover=state
                if track~=current then Tween(frame,{BackgroundTransparency=state and .55 or 1},.12)end
            end
            table.insert(row.connections,choose.MouseEnter:Connect(function()hover(true)end))
            table.insert(row.connections,choose.MouseLeave:Connect(function()hover(false)end))
            table.insert(row.connections,choose.Activated:Connect(function()
                if not alive then return end
                if track==current then toggle()else play(track)end
            end))
            table.insert(row.connections,remove.MouseEnter:Connect(function()Tween(remove,{BackgroundTransparency=.82},.12);CrackHubMusicGlyph(removeGlyph,"trash",Theme.Danger)end))
            table.insert(row.connections,remove.MouseLeave:Connect(function()Tween(remove,{BackgroundTransparency=1},.12);CrackHubMusicGlyph(removeGlyph,"trash",Theme.SubText)end))
            table.insert(row.connections,remove.Activated:Connect(function()
                if not alive then return end
                local position=table.find(tracks,track)
                if position then table.remove(tracks,position)end
                if current==track then generation+=1;playingIntent=false;sound:Stop();current=tracks[math.min(position or 1,#tracks)]end
                render()
            end))
            table.insert(rows,row)
        end
        paint()
        emit(trackListeners)
    end
    local function stop()
        if not alive then return end
        alive=false;generation+=1;dragging,dragInput=false,nil
        if widget then widget:Stop()end
        for _,row in ipairs(rows)do for _,c in ipairs(row.connections)do c:Disconnect()end end
        for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end
        sound:Stop();sound:Destroy()
    end
    connect(window.Gui.Destroying,stop)
    -- keep the play/pause icon in sync if something else pauses/resumes the sound
    connect(sound.Paused,function()paint()end)
    connect(sound.Resumed,function()paint()end)
    local api={Tracks=tracks,Sound=sound,Rows=rows,Play=play,Step=step,Add=add,ID=idBox,Name=nameBox,
        Seek=seek,RefreshTime=refreshTime,TimeLabel=timeLabel,SeekArea=seekArea,SeekTrack=seekTrack,
        Controls={Play=playButton,Next=nextButton,Previous=previousButton,Shuffle=shuffleButton,Repeat=repeatButton},Stop=stop}
    api.Toggle=toggle
    api.Current=function()return current end
    api.Artwork=function(track)return track and picture(track)or musicIcon end
    api.Duration=duration
    api.Position=function()return math.clamp((tonumber(sound.TimePosition)or 0)-startOffset(),0,duration())end
    api.StopPlayback=function()generation+=1;playingIntent=false;waitingStart=false;sound:Stop();sound.TimePosition=startOffset();paint()end
    api.GetVolume=function()return desiredVolume end
    api.SetVolume=function(value)volumeControl:Set(math.clamp(tonumber(value)or 0,0,1)*100)end
    api.Shuffle=function()shuffle=not shuffle;paint()end
    api.IsShuffling=function()return shuffle end
    api.OnChanged=function(fn)table.insert(changeListeners,fn)end
    api.OnTracksChanged=function(fn)table.insert(trackListeners,fn)end
    api.OnBeat=function(fn)table.insert(beatListeners,fn)end
    render()
    window.MusicPlayer=api
    widget=CrackHubInstallMusicWidget(window,api)
    api.Widget=widget
    return api
end

    -- Put your own uploaded image IDs here to replace the icons (leave "" to use the game's own icons / Lucide)

        Bold=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Bold),
    }

    local SPRITES={
        ["skull"]={16898613777,49,869},["coins"]={16898613044,869,612},["hourglass"]={16898613509,49,918},
        ["map"]={16898613613,306,771},["zap"]={16898613869,918,906},["trophy"]={16898613869,820,147},
        ["shield"]={16898613777,869,0},["badge-check"]={16898612629,967,147},["activity"]={16898612629,514,771},
        ["map-pin"]={16898613613,820,257},["gamepad"]={16898613353,967,759},["footprints"]={16898613353,918,710},
        ["crosshair"]={16898613044,453,869},["sword"]={16898613777,710,967},["clock"]={16898613044,771,661},
        ["heart"]={16898613509,661,771},["globe"]={16898613509,771,563},["sparkles"]={16898613777,918,49},
        ["package"]={16898613613,918,196},["users"]={16898613869,967,98},["wifi"]={16898613869,869,808},

        local sprite=SPRITES[name]
        if sprite then
            image.Image="rbxassetid://"..sprite[1]
            image.ImageRectOffset=Vector2.new(sprite[2],sprite[3])
            image.ImageRectSize=Vector2.new(48,48)
        else
            ApplyIcon(image,name)
        end
    end)

    local Players=game:GetService("Players")
    local LocalPlayer=Players.LocalPlayer
    local alive=true
    local connections={}
    local connect; connect = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(signal,fn)
        local c=signal:Connect(function(...)if alive then return fn(...)end end)
        table.insert(connections,c)
        return c
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ saved statistics
    local env=CrackHubEnvironment
    local file="CrackHub/player_stats_"..tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId)..".json"
    local stats={Studs=0,Kills=0,Deaths=0,Rounds=0,Murderer=0,Sheriff=0,Hero=0,Innocent=0,Coins=0,Candy=0,Other=0,
        ScriptTime=0,GameTimeBase=0,GameJob="",GameJobTime=0,FirstSeen=0,Servers=0}
    pcall(function()
        if type(env.isfile)=="function" and env.isfile(file) then
            local saved=HttpService:JSONDecode(env.readfile(file))
            if type(saved)=="table" then
                for key,value in pairs(saved)do
                    if type(stats[key])==type(value)then stats[key]=value end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    -- time in MM2: finished servers are folded into the base, the current server counts live
    if stats.FirstSeen<=0 then stats.FirstSeen=os.time()end
    if stats.GameJob~=game.JobId then
        stats.GameTimeBase+=stats.GameJobTime
        stats.GameJob,stats.GameJobTime=game.JobId,0
        stats.Servers+=1
    end
    local session={Studs=0,Kills=0,Deaths=0,Rounds=0,Murderer=0,Sheriff=0,Hero=0,Innocent=0,Coins=0,Candy=0,Other=0,ScriptTime=0}
    local add; add = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(key,amount)
        stats[key]+=amount
        session[key]+=amount
    end)
    local save; save = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if type(env.writefile)~="function"then return end
            if type(env.isfolder)=="function" and not env.isfolder("CrackHub") then env.makefolder("CrackHub") end
            stats.GameJobTime=time()
            env.writefile(file,HttpService:JSONEncode(stats))
        end))
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
    local comma; comma = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(n)
        local s=tostring(math.floor(n+.5))
        local formatted=s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse()
        return (formatted:gsub("^,",""))
    end)
    local duration; duration = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(seconds)
        seconds=math.max(0,math.floor(seconds))
        local h,m,s=seconds//3600,seconds%3600//60,seconds%60
        if h>0 then return string.format("%dh %02dm",h,m)end
        if m>0 then return string.format("%dm %02ds",m,s)end
        return s.."s"
    end)

    local VALUES_SOURCE="mm2values.com · Nov 2026"
    local values={}
    do
        local category
        for line in VALUE_DATA:gmatch("[^\n]+")do
            local header=line:match("^#(%w+)")
            if header then category=header;values[category]={}
            elseif category then
                for key,value in line:gmatch("([%w]+)=([%d%.]+)")do values[category][key]=tonumber(value)end
            end
        end
    end
    local RARITY={godly="Godly",ancient="Ancient",unique="Unique",vintage="Vintage",legendary="Legendary",legend="Legendary",
        rare="Rare",uncommon="Uncommon",common="Common",classic="Common",pet="Pet"}
    local norm; norm = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(text)return (tostring(text or ""):lower():gsub("[^a-z0-9]",""))end)
    local requireModule; requireModule = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(parent,name)
        local module=parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name)
        if not module or not module:IsA("ModuleScript")then return nil end
        local ok,result=pcall(require,module)
        return ok and type(result)=="table" and result or nil
    end)
    local priceOf; priceOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(id,entry,isPet)
        local name=tostring(entry and (entry.ItemName or entry.Name) or id)
        local itemType=tostring(entry and entry.ItemType or "")
        local rarity=tostring(entry and entry.Rarity or ""):lower()
        local chroma=(entry and entry.Chroma==true) or name:lower():find("^chroma")~=nil or tostring(id):lower():find("chroma",1,true)~=nil
        local base=norm((name:gsub("^[Cc]hroma%s*","")))
        local category=chroma and "Chroma" or isPet and "Pet" or RARITY[rarity]
        local look; look = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(cat)
            local list=values[cat]
            if not list then return nil end
            return list[base] or list[base..norm(itemType)] or list[norm(id)]
        end)
        local value=category and look(category)
        if not value and not category then
            for _,cat in ipairs({"Godly","Ancient","Vintage","Legendary","Rare","Uncommon","Common"})do
                value=look(cat);if value then category=cat;break end
            end
        end
        return value or 0,category or (rarity~="" and rarity) or "?",name
    end)
    local countOf; countOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(raw)
        if type(raw)=="number"then return raw end
        if type(raw)=="table"then return tonumber(raw.Count or raw.Amount or raw.Quantity)or 1 end
        return raw and 1 or 0
    end)
    local inventorySummary={Total=0,Items=0,Godly=0,Chroma=0,Ancient=0,Top={},Source="",Ready=false}
    local computeInventory; computeInventory = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local storage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local sync=requireModule(storage:FindFirstChild("Database"),"Sync")
        local profile=requireModule(storage:FindFirstChild("Modules"),"ProfileData")
        local snapshot=env["CrackHubRealInventory_"..tostring(game.JobId)]
        local weapons,pets,source
        if type(snapshot)=="table" and type(snapshot.Weapons)=="table" then
            weapons,pets,source=snapshot.Weapons,snapshot.Pets,"real inventory"
        elseif profile and type(profile.Weapons)=="table" then
            weapons=profile.Weapons.Owned
            pets=type(profile.Pets)=="table" and profile.Pets.Owned or nil
            source="live inventory"
        end
        if type(weapons)~="table" then return false end
        local summary={Total=0,Items=0,Godly=0,Chroma=0,Ancient=0,Top={},Source=source,Ready=true}
        local visit; visit = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(list,database,isPet)
            if type(list)~="table" then return end
            for id,raw in pairs(list)do
                local count=countOf(raw)
                if count>0 then
                    local entry=type(database)=="table" and database[id] or nil
                    local value,category,name=priceOf(id,entry,isPet)
                    summary.Items+=count
                    summary.Total+=value*count
                    if category=="Godly" then summary.Godly+=count
                    elseif category=="Chroma" then summary.Chroma+=count
                    elseif category=="Ancient" then summary.Ancient+=count end
                    if value>0 then
                        table.insert(summary.Top,{Name=(category=="Chroma" and not name:lower():find("^chroma")) and "Chroma "..name or name,
                            Value=value,Count=count,Category=category,Image=entry and entry.Image})
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        visit(weapons,sync and sync.Weapons,false)
        visit(pets,sync and sync.Pets,true)
        table.sort(summary.Top,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a,b)return a.Value>b.Value end))
        inventorySummary=summary
        return true
    end)

    local valueGroup=tab:AddGroup("Inventory Value",true)
    local valueGrid=grid(valueGroup,3,78)

    local topRows={}
    for i=1,5 do
        local row=Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,44),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,BackgroundTransparency=.35,LayoutOrder=i,Visible=false,Parent=topList},
            {Corner(10)})

        local name=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(80,4),Size=UDim2.new(1,-200,0,20),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",
            FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=13,TextColor3=Theme.Text,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,Parent=row})
        local category=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(80,23),Size=UDim2.new(1,-200,0,16),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",
            FontFace=Fonts.Regular,TextSize=11,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Parent=row})
        local value=Create("TextLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-12,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(110,20),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",
            FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=14,TextColor3=Theme.Text,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,Parent=row})
        topRows[i]={Frame=row,Rank=rank,Picture=picture,Name=name,Category=category,Value=value}
    end
    local drawnSummary
    local drawInventory; drawInventory = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local s=inventorySummary
        if s==drawnSummary then return end
        if s.Ready then drawnSummary=s end
        if not s.Ready then
            setTile("InvTotal","...","Waiting for MM2 inventory")
            return
        end
        setTile("InvTotal",comma(s.Total),"Values: "..VALUES_SOURCE)
        local best=s.Top[1]
        setTile("InvBest",best and best.Name or "None",best and ("Worth "..comma(best.Value)) or "")
        setTile("InvItems",comma(s.Items),"From your "..s.Source)
        setTile("InvGodly",comma(s.Godly))
        setTile("InvChroma",comma(s.Chroma))
        setTile("InvAncient",comma(s.Ancient))
        for i,row in ipairs(topRows)do
            local item=s.Top[i]
            row.Frame.Visible=item~=nil
            if item then
                row.Rank.TextColor3=Theme.Accent
                row.Name.Text=item.Name..(item.Count>1 and ("  x"..item.Count) or "")
                row.Category.Text=item.Category
                row.Value.Text=comma(item.Value*item.Count)
                local image=item.Image
                if type(image)=="number" or (type(image)=="string" and image:match("^%d+$")) then image="rbxassetid://"..image end
                row.Picture.Image=type(image)=="string" and image or ""
            end
        end
    end)
    valueGroup:AddButton({Name="Recalculate inventory value",Callback=function()
        pcall(computeInventory)
        drawInventory()
    end})

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ all-time numbers that MM2 itself keeps for your account
    local LIFETIME_WORDS={"level","xp","exp","prestige","kill","win","death","coin","candy","murder","sheriff","hero","surviv",
        "round","streak","played","token","gem","elite","rank","time","hour","minute","second","play","join","day","session","match","game"}
    local LIFETIME_ICONS={{"level","trophy"},{"prestige","badge-check"},{"xp","activity"},{"exp","activity"},{"kill","crosshair"},
        {"death","skull"},{"win","trophy"},{"coin","coins"},{"candy","sparkles"},{"murder","sword"},{"sheriff","shield"},{"hero","badge-check"},
        {"surviv","heart"},{"round","gamepad"},{"streak","zap"},{"time","clock"},{"hour","clock"},{"minute","clock"},{"second","clock"},{"play","hourglass"},{"day","calendar"}}
    local SKIP_TABLES={Weapons=true,Pets=true,Effects=true,Emotes=true,Radios=true,Perks=true,Toys=true,Inventory=true}
    local lifetimeOrder=0
    local pretty; pretty = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(text)
        text=tostring(text):gsub("_"," "):gsub("(%l)(%u)","%1 %2")
        return (text:gsub("^%l",string.upper))
    end)
    local lifetimeIcon; lifetimeIcon = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(key)
        key=key:lower()
        for _,pair in ipairs(LIFETIME_ICONS)do if key:find(pair[1],1,true)then return pair[2]end end
        return "activity"
    end)
    local readLifetime; readLifetime = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local found={}
        local consider; consider = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(label,key,value)
            if type(value)~="number" or value~=value or value==math.huge then return end
            -- dates (unix timestamps / ticks) are not statistics
            if value>1e9 then return end
            found[label]={Key=tostring(key),Value=value}
        end)
        local storage=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local profile=requireModule(storage:FindFirstChild("Modules"),"ProfileData")
        if profile then
            for key,value in pairs(profile)do
                if type(key)~="string" then continue end
                if type(value)=="number" then consider(pretty(key),key,value)
                elseif type(value)=="table" and not SKIP_TABLES[key] then
                    local seen=0
                    for innerKey,innerValue in pairs(value)do
                        seen+=1
                        if seen>80 then break end
                        if type(innerKey)=="string" then consider(pretty(key).." · "..pretty(innerKey),innerKey,innerValue)end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local leaderstats=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
        if leaderstats then
            for _,object in ipairs(leaderstats:GetChildren())do
                if object:IsA("ValueBase") and tonumber(object.Value)then found[pretty(object.Name)]={Key=object.Name,Value=tonumber(object.Value)}end
            end
        end
        return found
    end)
    local drawLifetime; drawLifetime = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local found=readLifetime()
        local count=0
        local labels={}
        for label in pairs(found)do table.insert(labels,label)end
        -- known stat words first, the rest alphabetically
        local weight; weight = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(label)
            local lower=label:lower()
            for index,word in ipairs(LIFETIME_WORDS)do if lower:find(word,1,true)then return index end end
            return 999
        end)
        table.sort(labels,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a,b)
            local wa,wb=weight(a),weight(b)
            if wa~=wb then return wa<wb end
            return a<b
        end))
        for _,label in ipairs(labels)do
            count+=1
            if count>36 then break end
            local key="LT_"..label
            if not tiles[key]then
                lifetimeOrder+=1
                tile(lifetimeGrid,key,"MM2 · "..label,lifetimeIcon(found[label].Key),100+lifetimeOrder)
            end
            local value=found[label].Value
            local raw=found[label].Key:lower()
            local text
            -- time fields: MM2 usually stores seconds; minutes/hours keep their unit
            if raw:find("hour",1,true)then text=duration(value*3600)
            elseif raw:find("minute",1,true)then text=duration(value*60)
            elseif (raw:find("time",1,true) or raw:find("second",1,true) or raw:find("played",1,true)) and value>=60 then text=duration(value)
            else text=value%1==0 and comma(value) or string.format("%.2f",value)end
            setTile(key,text,"Stored by MM2 for your whole account")
        end
        lifetimeNote.Text=count>0 and ("Everything CrackHub has counted since your first run, plus "..count.." numbers your MM2 account stores (marked MM2).")
            or "Everything CrackHub has counted since your first run. MM2 does not share extra account counters with the client."
    end)

    tile(timeGrid,"GameTime","Played in Murder Mystery 2","trophy",2)

    resetGroup:AddButton({Name="Reset statistics",Callback=function()

        for key in pairs(session)do session[key]=0 end
        stats.GameJob,stats.GameTimeBase=game.JobId,-time()
        stats.FirstSeen,stats.Servers=os.time(),1

    end})

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ studs walked (counted every frame, UI or not)
    local lastPosition
    local rootPart; rootPart = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local character=LocalPlayer.Character
        return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end)
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        stats.ScriptTime+=dt
        session.ScriptTime+=dt
        local part=rootPart()
        if not part then lastPosition=nil;return end
        local position=part.Position
        if lastPosition then
            local distance=(position-lastPosition).Magnitude
            -- ignore teleports / respawns, count real movement only
            if distance>0.01 and distance<math.max(6,dt*120) then add("Studs",distance)end
        end
        lastPosition=position
    end))

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ deaths & kills
    local roles; roles = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local ok,result=pcall(getRoles)
        return ok and type(result)=="table" and result or {}
    end)
    local myRole; myRole = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local entry=roles()[LocalPlayer.Name]
        return type(entry)=="table" and entry.Role or nil
    end)
    local watched={}
    local function watchCharacter(player,character)
        local humanoid=character:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10)
        if not humanoid or not alive then return end
        local c=humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            if not alive then return end
            if player==LocalPlayer then add("Deaths",1);return end
            local all=roles()
            local mine=all[LocalPlayer.Name]
            local victim=all[player.Name]
            local role=type(mine)=="table" and mine.Role
            local me=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not me or me.Health<=0 then return end
            if role=="Murderer" then add("Kills",1)
            elseif (role=="Sheriff" or role=="Hero") and type(victim)=="table" and victim.Role=="Murderer" then add("Kills",1)end
        end)
        table.insert(connections,c)
    end
    local function watchPlayer(player)
        if watched[player] then return end
        watched[player]=true
        if player.Character then task.spawn(watchCharacter,player,player.Character)end
        connect(player.CharacterAdded,function(character)watchCharacter(player,character)end)
    end
    for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do watchPlayer(player)end
    connect(Players.PlayerAdded,watchPlayer)
    connect(Players.PlayerRemoving,function(player)watched[player]=nil end)

    local currentMap; currentMap = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        for _,model in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren())do
            if model:IsA("Model") and not model.Name:lower():find("lobby",1,true) and model:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer",true)
                and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then return model end

    local inRound,roundRole,mapName=false,nil,"Lobby"

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ coins / candy / event items (read from MM2's own coin bag UI)
    local counters={}
    local guiFound=false
    local kindOf; kindOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(name)
        name=name:lower()
        if name:find("candy",1,true) then return "Candy" end
        if name:find("coin",1,true) then return "Coins" end
        return "Other"
    end)
    local number; number = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(text)
        local digits=tostring(text or ""):gsub(",",""):match("%d+")
        return tonumber(digits)
    end)
    local hookCounter; hookCounter = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(label,kind)
        if counters[label] then return end
        counters[label]={Kind=kind,Last=number(label.Text)or 0}
        guiFound=true
        connect(label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"),function()
            local info=counters[label]
            local value=number(label.Text)
            if not info or not value then return end
            -- only count increases; a lower number means a new round started
            if value>info.Last and value-info.Last<=50 then add(info.Kind,value-info.Last)end
            info.Last=value
        end)
    end)
    local bagsFound,bagsChecked,bagScanTimer=nil,{},0
    local scanBags; scanBags = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local gui=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not gui then return end
        -- look for MM2's coin bag UI only every 5 s until it exists, then only inside it
        if not bagsFound or not bagsFound.Parent then
            bagScanTimer+=1
            if bagScanTimer<5 then return end
            bagScanTimer=0
            bagsFound=gui:FindFirstChild("CoinBags",true)
            if not bagsFound then return end
            bagsChecked={}
        end
        local count=#bagsFound:GetDescendants()
        if bagsChecked.Count==count then return end
        bagsChecked.Count=count
        for _,bags in ipairs({bagsFound})do
            if bags.Name=="CoinBags" then
                for _,object in ipairs(bags:GetDescendants())do
                    if object:IsA("TextLabel") and number(object.Text)~=nil then
                        -- the currency type is the first named frame under the bag container
                        local node,kindName=object,nil
                        while node and node~=bags do
                            if node.Parent and node.Parent.Name=="Container" then kindName=node.Name;break end
                            node=node.Parent
                        end
                        if kindName then hookCounter(object,kindOf(kindName))end
                    elseif object:IsA("ImageLabel") and object.Image~="" then
                        local node,kindName=object,nil
                        while node and node~=bags do
                            if node.Parent and node.Parent.Name=="Container" then kindName=node.Name;break end
                            node=node.Parent
                        end
                        local kind=kindName and kindOf(kindName)
                        -- use MM2's real coin / candy picture unless you set your own ID above
                        if kind and CUSTOM_ICONS[kind]=="" and not (tiles[kind] and tiles[kind].Picture) and object.Name:lower():find("icon",1,true) then
                            usePicture(kind,object.Image)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    -- fallback when the bag UI is not found: count coins that vanish right next to you
    local watchedContainers={}
    local watchContainer; watchContainer = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(container)
        if watchedContainers[container] then return end
        watchedContainers[container]=true
        connect(container.ChildRemoved,function(coin)
            if guiFound then return end
            local part=rootPart()
            local coinPart=coin:IsA("BasePart") and coin or coin:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
            if part and coinPart and (coinPart.Position-part.Position).Magnitude<10 then
                add(kindOf(tostring(coin:GetAttribute("CoinID") or coin.Name)),1)
            end
        end)
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ slow loop (1s): rounds, coin UI, saving
    local saveTimer,slow=0,0
    local slowUpdate; slowUpdate = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local map=currentMap()
        mapName=map and map.Name or "Lobby"
        local role=myRole()
        local nowInRound=map~=nil and role~=nil
        if nowInRound and not inRound then
            add("Rounds",1)
            if role=="Murderer" or role=="Sheriff" or role=="Innocent" or role=="Hero" then add(role,1)end
            roundRole=role
        elseif nowInRound and role=="Hero" and roundRole~="Hero" then
            add("Hero",1)
            roundRole=role
        end
        inRound=nowInRound
        if not inRound then roundRole=nil end
        if map then
            local container=map:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer",true)
            if container then watchContainer(container)end
        end
        scanBags()
        inventoryTimer=(inventoryTimer or 0)+1
        if not inventorySummary.Ready or inventoryTimer>=30 then inventoryTimer=0;pcall(computeInventory)end
        lifetimeTimer+=1
        if lifetimeTimer>=10 then lifetimeTimer=0;pcall(drawLifetime)end
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ drawing (only while the tab is on screen)
    local frames,fpsTimer,fps=0,0,60
    local onScreen; onScreen = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if window.Visible==false or profile.AbsoluteSize.X<=0 then return false end
        local node=profile
        while node and node~=window.Gui do
            if node:IsA("GuiObject") and not node.Visible then return false end
            node=node.Parent
        end
        return true
    end)
    local plus; plus = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(key,format)
        local value=session[key]
        if value<=0 then return "" end
        return "+"..(format and format(value) or comma(value)).." this session"
    end)
    local paintedAccent,paintedCount
    local draw; draw = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local accent=Theme.Accent
        local count=0
        for _ in pairs(tiles)do count+=1 end
        if paintedAccent~=accent or paintedCount~=count then
            paintedAccent,paintedCount=accent,count
            for _,entry in pairs(tiles)do
                entry.Badge.BackgroundColor3=accent
                entry.Sub.TextColor3=accent
                if not entry.Picture then entry.Image.ImageColor3=accent end
            end
        end
        sessionLabel.Text=duration(session.ScriptTime)
        local role=myRole()
        roleLabel.Text=inRound and role and ("Playing as "..role) or "In lobby"
        setTile("Players",#Players:GetPlayers().." / "..Players.MaxPlayers)
        setTile("Ping",math.floor(LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing()*1000+.5).." ms")
        setTile("FPS",tostring(fps))
        setTile("Map",mapName)
        setTile("ServerAge",duration(workspace.DistributedGameTime))
        setTile("InServer",duration(time()))
        setTile("PlaceId",tostring(game.PlaceId))
        setTile("Role",inRound and role or "None")
        setTile("Studs",comma(stats.Studs),plus("Studs"))
        setTile("Kills",comma(stats.Kills),plus("Kills"))
        setTile("Deaths",comma(stats.Deaths),plus("Deaths"))
        setTile("Rounds",comma(stats.Rounds),plus("Rounds"))
        setTile("Murderer",comma(stats.Murderer),plus("Murderer"))
        setTile("Sheriff",comma(stats.Sheriff),plus("Sheriff"))
        setTile("Hero",comma(stats.Hero),plus("Hero"))
        setTile("Innocent",comma(stats.Innocent),plus("Innocent"))
        setTile("Survival",string.format("%.2f",stats.Kills/math.max(1,stats.Deaths)),
            session.Kills+session.Deaths>0 and string.format("%.2f this session",session.Kills/math.max(1,session.Deaths)) or "")
        setTile("Coins",comma(stats.Coins),plus("Coins"))
        setTile("Candy",comma(stats.Candy),plus("Candy"))
        setTile("Other",comma(stats.Other),plus("Other"))
        setTile("ScriptTime",duration(stats.ScriptTime),"This session: "..duration(session.ScriptTime))
        setTile("GameTime",duration(stats.GameTimeBase+time()),"This server: "..duration(time()))
        local days=math.max(1,math.floor((os.time()-stats.FirstSeen)/86400)+1)
        setTile("AT_Value",inventorySummary.Ready and comma(inventorySummary.Total) or "...",inventorySummary.Ready and (comma(inventorySummary.Items).." items") or "Reading inventory")
        setTile("AT_Coins",comma(stats.Coins),plus("Coins"))
        setTile("AT_Candy",comma(stats.Candy),plus("Candy"))
        setTile("AT_Other",comma(stats.Other),plus("Other"))
        setTile("AT_Kills",comma(stats.Kills),plus("Kills"))
        setTile("AT_Deaths",comma(stats.Deaths),plus("Deaths"))
        setTile("AT_KD",string.format("%.2f",stats.Kills/math.max(1,stats.Deaths)))
        setTile("AT_Rounds",comma(stats.Rounds),plus("Rounds"))
        setTile("AT_Murderer",comma(stats.Murderer),plus("Murderer"))
        setTile("AT_Sheriff",comma(stats.Sheriff),plus("Sheriff"))
        setTile("AT_Hero",comma(stats.Hero),plus("Hero"))
        setTile("AT_Innocent",comma(stats.Innocent),plus("Innocent"))
        setTile("AT_Studs",comma(stats.Studs),plus("Studs"))
        setTile("AT_GameTime",duration(stats.GameTimeBase+time()),"This server: "..duration(time()))
        setTile("AT_ScriptTime",duration(stats.ScriptTime),"This session: "..duration(session.ScriptTime))
        setTile("AT_Servers",comma(stats.Servers))
        setTile("AT_Since",os.date("%d.%m.%Y",stats.FirstSeen),days==1 and "Today" or (days.." days"))
        setTile("Since",os.date("%d.%m.%Y",stats.FirstSeen),days==1 and "Today" or (days.." days of statistics"))
        setTile("Servers",comma(stats.Servers),"Average "..duration((stats.GameTimeBase+time())/math.max(1,stats.Servers)).." per server")
        drawInventory()
    end)

    local drawTimer=0
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        frames+=1;fpsTimer+=dt
        if fpsTimer>=.5 then fps=math.floor(frames/fpsTimer+.5);frames,fpsTimer=0,0 end
        slow+=dt
        if slow>=1 then slow=0;pcall(slowUpdate)end
        saveTimer+=dt
        if saveTimer>=15 then saveTimer=0;save()end
        drawTimer+=dt
        -- 10 times a second while visible, so the studs counter visibly runs while you walk
        if drawTimer>=.25 then
            drawTimer=0
            if onScreen()then draw()end
        end
    end))
    pcall(slowUpdate)
    draw()

    local function stop()
        if not alive then return end
        save()
        alive=false
        for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end
    end
    connect(window.Gui.Destroying,stop)
    connect(Players.PlayerRemoving,function(player)if player==LocalPlayer then save()end end)
    return {Tab=tab,Stats=stats,Session=session,Save=save,Stop=stop}
end

CrackHub.InstallScripts = function(window, combat)
    local Fonts={
        Regular=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Regular),
        Medium=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Medium),
        Bold=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Bold),
    }
    local MONO=Enum.Font.RobotoMono
    local SPRITES={
        ["play"]={16898613699,918,257},["trash"]={16898613869,257,918},["plus"]={16898613699,257,918},["zap"]={16898613869,918,906},
        ["save"]={16898613699,918,453},["code"]={16898613044,355,869},["eye"]={16898613353,771,563},["folder"]={16898613353,404,967},
        ["sword"]={16898613777,710,967},["users"]={16898613869,967,98},["x"]={16898613869,869,906},["map-pin"]={16898613613,820,257},
        ["coins"]={16898613044,869,612},["pencil-line"]={16898613699,49,771},["terminal-square"]={16898613869,0,820},
        ["eraser"]={16898613353,820,257},["rocket"]={16898613699,918,147},["power"]={16898613699,820,147},
        ["file-code"]={16898613353,869,49},["file-code-2"]={16898613353,918,0},["clipboard-paste"]={16898613044,514,869},
        ["bug"]={16898612819,257,967},["circle-check"]={16898612819,869,955},["alert-triangle"]={16898612629,771,98},
        ["cpu"]={16898613044,196,869},["folder-open"]={16898613353,820,759},["scroll-text"]={16898613699,967,759},
        ["check-circle-2"]={16898612819,918,661},["text-cursor-input"]={16898613869,771,563},["shield"]={16898613777,869,0},
        ["badge-check"]={16898612629,967,147},["layers"]={16898613509,98,967},
    }
    local function setIcon(image,name)
        local sprite=SPRITES[name]
        if sprite then
            image.Image="rbxassetid://"..sprite[1]
            image.ImageRectOffset=Vector2.new(sprite[2],sprite[3])
            image.ImageRectSize=Vector2.new(48,48)
        else ApplyIcon(image,name)end
    end
    local function icon(parent,name,size,color,position)
        local image=Create("ImageLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=position or UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size),
            BackgroundTransparency=1,ImageColor3=color or Theme.Text,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,ZIndex=(parent.ZIndex or 1)+1,Parent=parent})
        setIcon(image,name)
        return image
    end

    local env=CrackHubEnvironment
    local alive=true
    local connections={}
    local function connect(signal,fn)
        local c=signal:Connect(function(...)if alive then return fn(...)end end)
        table.insert(connections,c)
        return c
    end
    local WARNING=Color3.fromRGB(255,184,77)
    local SUCCESS=Color3.fromRGB(88,214,141)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ what kind of script is it?
    local RULES={
        {Category="Sheriff",TabIcon="badge-check",Tab="Sheriff",Icon="badge-check",Words={"sheriff","gun","shoot","silent aim","silentaim","aimbot","gundrop","grab gun","getgun"}},
        {Category="Murderer",TabIcon="sword",Tab="Murderer",Icon="sword",Words={"murderer","knife","stab","kill all","killall","throw","slash"}},
        {Category="Visuals",TabIcon="eye",Tab="ESP",Icon="eye",Words={"esp","highlight","billboardgui","drawing.new","chams","tracer","boxhandleadornment","nametag"}},
        {Category="Movement",TabIcon="users",Tab="Player",Icon="users",Words={"walkspeed","jumppower","jumpheight","fly","noclip","infinite jump","infjump","gravity","speed"}},
        {Category="Teleport",TabIcon="layers",Tab="Teleport",Icon="map-pin",Words={"teleport","pivotto","moveto","tween to","goto"}},
        {Category="Farm",Tab=nil,Icon="coins",TabIcon="boxes",Words={"coin","candy","autofarm","auto farm","coincontainer","beachball","collect"}},
        {Category="Loader",Tab=nil,Icon="rocket",TabIcon="code",Words={"loadstring(game:httpget","loadstring(game:httpgetasync","loadstring(request","raw.githubusercontent","pastebin.com"}},
    }
    local MISC={Category="Misc",Tab=nil,Icon="file-code",TabIcon="folder"}
    local function detect(code)
        local lower=tostring(code or ""):lower()
        local best,bestScore=MISC,0
        for _,rule in ipairs(RULES)do
            local score=0
            for _,word in ipairs(rule.Words)do
                local start=1
                while true do
                    local a,b=lower:find(word,start,true)
                    if not a then break end
                    score+=1;start=b+1
                    if score>40 then break end
                end
            end
            if score>bestScore then best,bestScore=rule,score end
        end
        return best
    end
    local function ruleFor(category)
        for _,rule in ipairs(RULES)do if rule.Category==category then return rule end end
        return MISC
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ Lua syntax colours (Roblox Studio dark theme)
    local COLORS={
        Text="#CCCCCC",Keyword="#F86D7C",Builtin="#84D6F7",String="#ADF195",Number="#FFC600",
        Comment="#666666",Call="#FDFBAC",Property="#61A1F1",Operator="#CCCCCC",
    }
    local KEYWORDS={}
    for word in ("and break continue do else elseif end for function if in local not or repeat return then until while export type"):gmatch("%S+")do KEYWORDS[word]=true end
    local LITERALS={["true"]=true,["false"]=true,["nil"]=true,["self"]=true}
    local BUILTINS={}
    for word in ("game workspace script print warn error pcall xpcall require loadstring getgenv getrenv task wait spawn delay tick time typeof type "
        .."pairs ipairs next select tostring tonumber setmetatable getmetatable rawget rawset rawequal table string math os coroutine debug utf8 bit32 "
        .."Instance Vector2 Vector3 CFrame Color3 UDim UDim2 Enum TweenInfo BrickColor Ray Rect NumberSequence ColorSequence NumberRange Region3 Random "
        .."Drawing syn http request hookfunction hookmetamethod getconnections firesignal fireclickdetector firetouchinterest getnamecallmethod "
        .."setclipboard writefile readfile isfile makefolder isfolder getcustomasset _G shared"):gmatch("%S+")do BUILTINS[word]=true end
    local function escape(text)
        return (text:gsub("&","&amp;"):gsub("<","&lt;"):gsub(">","&gt;"):gsub('"',"&quot;"))
    end
    local function paint(color,text)
        if color==COLORS.Text then return escape(text)end
        return '<font color="'..color..'">'..escape(text)..'</font>'
    end
    local function highlight(source)
        local out,i,n=table.create and table.create(256) or {},1,#source
        local last=""
        while i<=n do
            local char=source:sub(i,i)
            if char=="-" and source:sub(i+1,i+1)=="-" then
                local equals=source:match("^%-%-%[(=*)%[",i)
                local stop
                if equals then
                    local close="]"..equals.."]"
                    local found=source:find(close,i+4,true)
                    stop=found and found+#close-1 or n
                else
                    stop=(source:find("\n",i,true) or n+1)-1
                end
                table.insert(out,paint(COLORS.Comment,source:sub(i,stop)));i=stop+1
            elseif char=='"' or char=="'" then
                local j=i+1
                while j<=n do
                    local d=source:sub(j,j)
                    if d=="\\" then j+=2
                    elseif d==char or d=="\n" then break
                    else j+=1 end
                end
                j=math.min(j,n)
                table.insert(out,paint(COLORS.String,source:sub(i,j)));i=j+1;last=char
            elseif char=="[" and source:match("^%[=*%[",i)then
                local equals=source:match("^%[(=*)%[",i)
                local close="]"..equals.."]"
                local found=source:find(close,i+2,true)
                local stop=found and found+#close-1 or n
                table.insert(out,paint(COLORS.String,source:sub(i,stop)));i=stop+1;last="]"
            elseif char:match("%d") or (char=="." and source:sub(i+1,i+1):match("%d"))then
                local number=source:match("^0[xX][%x_]+",i) or source:match("^0[bB][01_]+",i) or source:match("^[%d_]*%.?[%d_]+[eE][%+%-]?%d+",i)
                    or source:match("^[%d_]*%.?[%d_]+",i) or char
                table.insert(out,paint(COLORS.Number,number));i+=#number;last="0"
            elseif char:match("[%a_]")then
                local word=source:match("^[%w_]+",i)
                local after=source:match("^%s*(.)",i+#word)
                local color=COLORS.Text
                if KEYWORDS[word] then color=COLORS.Keyword
                elseif LITERALS[word] then color=COLORS.Number
                elseif last=="." or last==":" then color=(after=="(" or after=="\"" or after=="{") and COLORS.Call or COLORS.Property
                elseif BUILTINS[word] then color=COLORS.Builtin
                elseif after=="(" or after=="\"" or after=="{" then color=COLORS.Call end
                table.insert(out,paint(color,word));i+=#word;last="a"
            else
                local run=source:match("^[^%w_\"'%-%[%.]+",i) or char
                table.insert(out,paint(COLORS.Operator,run));i+=#run
                local significant=run:match("(%S)%s*$")
                if significant then last=significant end
            end
        end
        return table.concat(out)
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ settings found in the code
    -- top-level   local Speed = 32          getgenv().AutoFarm = true       _G.Name = "x"
    -- and simple config tables:   getgenv().Settings = {  Enabled = true,  Range = 15,  }
    local function literal(text)
        local value,rest=text:match("^(true)(.*)$")
        if value then return true,"bool",rest end
        value,rest=text:match("^(false)(.*)$")
        if value then return false,"bool",rest end
        value,rest=text:match("^(%-?%d+%.?%d*)(.*)$")
        if value and not rest:match("^[%w_%.]")then return tonumber(value),"number",rest end
        value,rest=text:match('^"([^"\\]*)"(.*)$')
        if value then return value,"string",rest end
        value,rest=text:match("^'([^'\\]*)'(.*)$")
        if value then return value,"string",rest end
        return nil
    end
    local function cleanTail(rest)
        return rest:match("^%s*,?%s*$")~=nil or rest:match("^%s*,?%s*%-%-")~=nil
    end
    local function parseSettings(code)
        local found={}
        local lines=string.split(code,"\n")
        local block
        for index,line in ipairs(lines)do
            if #found>=24 then break end
            line=line:gsub("\r$","")
            if block then
                if line:match("^[%}%)]")then block=nil
                else
                    local prefix,key,rest=line:match("^(%s+([%a_][%w_]*)%s*=%s*)(.*)$")
                    if prefix then
                        local value,kind,tail=literal(rest)
                        if kind and cleanTail(tail)then
                            table.insert(found,{Id=block.Name.."."..key,Label=block.Name.." · "..key,Kind=kind,Default=value,Line=index,
                                Prefix=prefix,Suffix=tail,Root=block.Root,Name=block.Name,Key=key})
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                local prefix,root,name,rest
                prefix,name,rest=line:match("^(local%s+([%a_][%w_]*)%s*=%s*)(.*)$")
                if not prefix then
                    prefix,root,name,rest=line:match("^((getgenv%(%))%.([%a_][%w_]*)%s*=%s*)(.*)$")
                    if not prefix then prefix,root,name,rest=line:match("^((_G)%.([%a_][%w_]*)%s*=%s*)(.*)$")end
                    if not prefix then prefix,root,name,rest=line:match("^((shared)%.([%a_][%w_]*)%s*=%s*)(.*)$")end
                end
                if prefix then
                    if rest:match("^{%s*$") or rest:match("^{%s*%-%-")then
                        block={Name=name,Root=root}
                    else
                        local value,kind,tail=literal(rest)
                        if kind and cleanTail(tail)then
                            table.insert(found,{Id=name,Label=name,Kind=kind,Default=value,Line=index,Prefix=prefix,Suffix=tail,Root=root,Name=name})
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return found
    end
    local function serialize(value)
        if type(value)=="string" then return string.format("%q",value)end
        if type(value)=="number" then
            if value%1==0 then return string.format("%d",value)end
            return tostring(math.floor(value*1000+.5)/1000)
        end
        return tostring(value)
    end
    local function codeWithSettings(entry)
        local list=parseSettings(entry.Code)
        if #list==0 or type(entry.Settings)~="table" then return entry.Code end
        local lines=string.split(entry.Code,"\n")
        for _,setting in ipairs(list)do
            local value=entry.Settings[setting.Id]
            if value~=nil and type(value)==type(setting.Default)then
                local cr=lines[setting.Line]:match("\r$") and "\r" or ""
                lines[setting.Line]=setting.Prefix..serialize(value)..setting.Suffix..cr
            end
        end
        return table.concat(lines,"\n")
    end
    local function liveUpdate(setting,value)
        -- scripts that read getgenv()/ _G / shared settings see the change right away
        local root=setting.Root=="getgenv()" and env or setting.Root=="_G" and _G or setting.Root=="shared" and shared or nil
        if not root then return end
        pcall(function()
            if setting.Key then
                if type(root[setting.Name])=="table" then root[setting.Name][setting.Key]=value end
            else root[setting.Name]=value end
        end)
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ storage
    local file="CrackHub/my_scripts.json"
    local entries={}
    local nextId=0
    local function writeSaved()
        pcall(function()
            if type(env.writefile)~="function"then return end
            if type(env.isfolder)=="function" and not env.isfolder("CrackHub")then env.makefolder("CrackHub")end
            local list={}
            for _,entry in ipairs(entries)do
                if entry.Saved then table.insert(list,{Name=entry.Name,Code=entry.Code,Category=entry.Category,AutoRun=entry.AutoRun,
                    Settings=entry.Settings,Key=entry.Key})end
            end
            env.writefile(file,HttpService:JSONEncode(list))
        end)
    end
    pcall(function()
        if type(env.isfile)=="function" and env.isfile(file)then
            local list=HttpService:JSONDecode(env.readfile(file))
            if type(list)=="table"then
                for _,item in ipairs(list)do
                    if type(item)=="table" and type(item.Code)=="string"then
                        nextId+=1
                        table.insert(entries,{Id=nextId,Name=tostring(item.Name or ("Script "..nextId)),Code=item.Code,
                            Category=ruleFor(item.Category).Category,AutoRun=item.AutoRun==true,Saved=true,
                            Settings=type(item.Settings)=="table" and item.Settings or {},Key=type(item.Key)=="string" and item.Key or nil})
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    local saveQueued=false
    local function queueSave()
        if saveQueued then return end
        saveQueued=true
        task.delay(.5,function()saveQueued=false;writeSaved()end)
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ tabs
    local group=window:CreateTabGroup("Scripts","code")
    local executorTab=group:CreateTab("Executor","code")
    local myTab=group:CreateTab("My","folder")

    -- output console (created first so everything can log into it)
    local logLines={}
    local outputGroup
    local outputList
    local function log(kind,text)
        if not outputList then return end
        local color=kind=="error" and Theme.Danger or kind=="ok" and SUCCESS or kind=="warn" and WARNING or Theme.SubText
        local line=Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1,LayoutOrder=#logLines+1,Parent=outputList})
        Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6),BackgroundColor3=color,Parent=line},{Corner(999)})
        Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,0),Size=UDim2.new(1,-14,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Text=os.date("%H:%M:%S").."  "..tostring(text),TextWrapped=true,Font=MONO,TextSize=12,TextColor3=kind=="info" and Theme.SubText or color,
            TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Parent=line})
        table.insert(logLines,line)
        if #logLines>60 then table.remove(logLines,1):Destroy()end
        task.defer(function()
            if outputList and outputList.Parent then outputList.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.huge)end
        end)
    end

    local function run(name,code)
        local loader=env.loadstring or loadstring
        if type(loader)~="function"then log("error","Your executor has no loadstring, scripts can't run.");return false end
        local ok,fn,err=pcall(loader,code,"=My: "..name)
        if not ok or type(fn)~="function"then
            log("error","Syntax error in "..name..": "..tostring(ok and err or fn))
            window:Notify({Title="Scripts",Content=name.." has a syntax error.",Type="Error",Duration=4})
            return false
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local success,problem=pcall(fn)
            if not success then
                log("error",name..": "..tostring(problem))
                window:Notify({Title="Scripts",Content=name.." stopped with an error. See Output.",Type="Error",Duration=4})
            end
        end)
        log("ok","Ran "..name)
        return true
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ "My · ..." cards inside the matching tabs
    -- every kind of script gets its own sub-tab inside Scripts (created only when the first one arrives)
    local subTabs={}
    local function hostTab(rule,peek)
        local tab=subTabs[rule.Category]
        if tab then return tab,"Scripts → "..rule.Category,false end
        if peek then return nil,"Scripts → "..rule.Category,false end
        local ok,result=pcall(function()return group:CreateTab(rule.Category,rule.TabIcon or "folder")end)
        if not ok or not result then return nil,"Scripts → My",false end
        subTabs[rule.Category]=result
        return result,"Scripts → "..rule.Category,true
    end
    -- the tab breaks into accent-coloured particles, then folds away
    local function burst(object)
        local gui=window.Gui
        if not gui or not object or not object.Parent then return end
        local position,size=object.AbsolutePosition,object.AbsoluteSize
        if size.X<=0 or size.Y<=0 then return end
        local accent=Theme.Accent
        for _=1,22 do
            local radius=math.random(3,6)
            local particle=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),
                Position=UDim2.fromOffset(position.X+math.random()*size.X,position.Y+math.random()*size.Y),
                Size=UDim2.fromOffset(radius,radius),BackgroundColor3=accent:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),math.random()*.35),
                BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=500,Parent=gui},{Corner(999)})
            local angle=math.random()*math.pi*2
            local distance=18+math.random()*42
            local life=.45+math.random()*.4
            TweenService:Create(particle,TweenInfo.new(life,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{
                Position=particle.Position+UDim2.fromOffset(math.cos(angle)*distance,math.sin(angle)*distance-14),
                Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),BackgroundTransparency=1,
            }):Play()
            task.delay(life+.05,function()particle:Destroy()end)
        end
    end
    local function fadeOut(object,duration)
        if not object then return end
        for _,item in ipairs(object:GetDescendants())do
            if item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") or item:IsA("TextBox")then Tween(item,{TextTransparency=1},duration)end
            if item:IsA("ImageLabel") or item:IsA("ImageButton")then Tween(item,{ImageTransparency=1},duration)end
            if item:IsA("UIStroke")then Tween(item,{Transparency=1},duration)end
            if item:IsA("GuiObject")then Tween(item,{BackgroundTransparency=1},duration)end
        end
        if object:IsA("GuiObject")then Tween(object,{BackgroundTransparency=1},duration)end
    end
    local function removeSubTab(category)
        local tab=subTabs[category]
        if not tab then return end
        subTabs[category]=nil
        local button,pill,page=tab._btn,tab._pill,tab.Holder
        local wasActive=tab.Active
        pcall(burst,(pill and pill.Visible and pill.AbsoluteSize.X>0) and pill or button)
        pcall(fadeOut,button,.35);pcall(fadeOut,pill,.35)
        if button then Tween(button,{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)},.4,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)end
        if pill then Tween(pill,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,26)},.4,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)end
        if wasActive and myTab and myTab.Select then pcall(function()myTab:Select()end)end
        task.delay(.45,function()
            local list=group.Tabs or {}
            local index=table.find(list,tab);if index then table.remove(list,index)end
            index=table.find(window.Tabs or {},tab);if index then table.remove(window.Tabs,index)end
            if group.Current==tab then group.Current=myTab end
            if button then button:Destroy()end
            if pill then pill:Destroy()end
            if page then page:Destroy()end
            if group.SetOpen then pcall(function()group:SetOpen(group.Open)end)end
        end)
        window:Notify({Title="Tab removed: "..category,Content="No scripts left in Scripts → "..category..".",Type="Info",Duration=3})
        log("info","Removed empty tab Scripts → "..category)
    end
    local function whereOf(entry)
        local _,where=hostTab(ruleFor(entry.Category),true)
        return where or "Scripts → My"
    end
    local runEntry
    local function removeHost(entry)
        if entry.HostCard then entry.HostCard:Destroy();entry.HostCard=nil end
    end
    local function addHost(entry)
        removeHost(entry)
        local rule=ruleFor(entry.Category)
        local tab,_,created=hostTab(rule)
        if not tab or not tab.Holder then return false end
        local before={}
        for _,child in ipairs(tab.Holder:GetChildren())do before[child]=true end
        local ok,card=pcall(function()return tab:AddGroup(entry.Name.." · My",true)end)
        if not ok or not card then return false end
        for _,child in ipairs(tab.Holder:GetChildren())do
            if not before[child] and child:IsA("GuiObject")then entry.HostCard=child end
        end
        entry.Settings=type(entry.Settings)=="table" and entry.Settings or {}
        card:AddButton({Name="Run "..entry.Name.." (My)",Bind=false,Description=entry.Saved and "My function" or "My function · not saved yet",Style="Primary",
            Callback=function()if alive then runEntry(entry)end end})
        -- every setting found in the code becomes a control
        for _,setting in ipairs(parseSettings(entry.Code))do
            local current=entry.Settings[setting.Id]
            if type(current)~=type(setting.Default)then current=setting.Default end
            local function changed(value)
                if not alive then return end
                entry.Settings[setting.Id]=value
                liveUpdate(setting,value)
                if entry.Saved then queueSave()end
            end
            if setting.Kind=="bool" then
                card:AddToggle({Name=setting.Label,Default=current,Callback=changed})
            elseif setting.Kind=="number" and setting.Default>=0 and setting.Default<=100000 then
                local whole=setting.Default%1==0
                local top=math.max(10,setting.Default*4)
                top=whole and math.ceil(top) or top
                card:AddSlider({Name=setting.Label,Min=0,Max=math.max(top,current),Default=current,Increment=whole and 1 or .1,Callback=changed})
            elseif setting.Kind=="number" then
                card:AddTextbox({Name=setting.Label,Default=tostring(current),Numeric=true,Placeholder="Number",
                    Callback=function(text)local number=tonumber(text);if number then changed(number)end end})
            else
                card:AddTextbox({Name=setting.Label,Default=tostring(current),Placeholder="Text",Callback=function(text)changed(text)end})
            end
        end
        local key=nil
        if entry.Key then pcall(function()key=Enum.KeyCode[entry.Key]end)end
        card:AddKeybind({Name="Keybind (My)",Default=key,Callback=function()if alive then runEntry(entry)end end,
            ChangedCallback=function(newKey)
                entry.Key=typeof(newKey)=="EnumItem" and newKey.Name or nil
                if entry.Saved then queueSave()end
            end})
        return created
    end

        Text="-- Paste or type your Lua script here",Font=MONO,TextSize=14,LineHeight=1,

    local MAX_HIGHLIGHT=15000
    local pending=false
    local function layoutEditor()
        local bounds=codeBox.TextBounds
        local view=scroll.AbsoluteSize
        local width=math.max(view.X-20,bounds.X+40)
        local height=math.max(view.Y-20,bounds.Y+LINE*3)
        codeBox.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,height)
        colored.Size=codeBox.Size
        scroll.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(width+20,height+20)
    end
    local function refreshEditor()
        pending=false
        local text=codeBox.Text
        placeholder.Visible=text==""
        local lines=1
        for _ in text:gmatch("\n")do lines+=1 end
        local parts=table.create and table.create(lines) or {}
        for index=1,lines do parts[index]=tostring(index)end
        numbers.Text=table.concat(parts,"\n")
        numbers.Size=UDim2.new(1,-10,0,lines*LINE+LINE)
        if #text<=MAX_HIGHLIGHT then
            local ok,result=pcall(highlight,text)
            colored.Text=ok and result or escape(text)
        else
            colored.Text=escape(text) -- huge scripts: plain text keeps typing smooth
        end
        local rule=detect(text)
        if text==""then
            detectText.Text="Paste code below";setIcon(detectIcon,"file-code")
        else
            local settings=#parseSettings(text)
            local _,where=hostTab(rule,true)
            detectText.Text='<font color="#'..Theme.Text:ToHex()..'"><b>'..rule.Category..'</b></font>  ·  goes to '..(where or "Scripts → My")
                ..(subTabs[rule.Category] and "" or " (new tab)")
                ..(settings>0 and ("  ·  "..settings..(settings==1 and " setting" or " settings")) or "")
            setIcon(detectIcon,rule.Icon)
        end
        layoutEditor()
    end
    connect(codeBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"),function()
        if codeBox.Text:find("\t",1,true)then
            local cursor=codeBox.CursorPosition
            codeBox.Text=codeBox.Text:gsub("\t","    ")
            if cursor>0 then codeBox.CursorPosition=cursor+3 end
            return
        end
        if pending then return end
        pending=true
        task.delay(.06,function()if alive then refreshEditor()end end)
    end)
    connect(codeBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextBounds"),layoutEditor)
    connect(scroll:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"),layoutEditor)
    connect(scroll:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"),function()
        numbers.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,10-scroll.CanvasPosition.Y)
    end)
    connect(codeBox.Focused,function()Tween(editor:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"),{Color=Theme.Accent,Transparency=.25},.15)end)
    connect(codeBox.FocusLost,function()Tween(editor:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke"),{Color=Theme.Stroke,Transparency=.35},.15)end)

    local render
    local function iconButton(parent,iconName,tip,x,callback,color)
        local button=Create("TextButton",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,x,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(32,32),
            BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,BackgroundTransparency=.1,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,Parent=parent},{Corner(9)})
        local stroke=Stroke(Theme.Stroke,1,.45);stroke.Parent=button
        local glyph=icon(button,iconName,15,color or Theme.Text)
        local tipLabel=Create("TextLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,1),Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,-4),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,18),
            AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X,BackgroundColor3=Theme.Background,Text=tip,FontFace=Fonts.Medium,TextSize=11,
            TextColor3=Theme.Text,Visible=false,ZIndex=20,Parent=button},{Corner(5),Create("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,6),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,6)})})
        button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()tipLabel.Visible=true;Tween(button,{BackgroundTransparency=0},.12);Tween(stroke,{Color=Theme.Accent},.12)end)
        button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()tipLabel.Visible=false;Tween(button,{BackgroundTransparency=.1},.12);Tween(stroke,{Color=Theme.Stroke},.12)end)
        button.Activated:Connect(function()if alive then callback(button,glyph,tipLabel)end end)
        return button,glyph,tipLabel
    end
    local function switch(parent,x,state,callback)
        local track=Create("TextButton",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,x,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(38,20),
            BackgroundColor3=state and Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,Parent=parent},{Corner(999)})
        local knob=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,.5),Position=state and UDim2.new(1,-18,.5,0) or UDim2.new(0,2,.5,0),
            Size=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),Parent=track},{Corner(999)})
        track.Activated:Connect(function()
            if not alive then return end
            state=not state
            Tween(track,{BackgroundColor3=state and Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke},.18)
            Tween(knob,{Position=state and UDim2.new(1,-18,.5,0) or UDim2.new(0,2,.5,0)},.2,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
            callback(state)
        end)
        return track
    end

    local rows={}
    render=function()
        for _,row in ipairs(rows)do row:Destroy()end
        table.clear(rows)
        local saved,auto=0,0
        for _,entry in ipairs(entries)do
            if entry.Saved then saved+=1 end
            if entry.AutoRun then auto+=1 end
        end
        summary.Text=#entries.." scripts  ·  "..saved.." saved  ·  "..auto.." run on load"
        empty.Visible=#entries==0
        -- grouped by category
        local order={}
        for index,rule in ipairs(RULES)do order[rule.Category]=index end
        order.Misc=#RULES+1
        local sorted=table.clone(entries)
        table.sort(sorted,function(a,b)
            local oa,ob=order[a.Category] or 99,order[b.Category] or 99
            if oa~=ob then return oa<ob end
            return a.Id<b.Id
        end)
        local lastCategory
        for position,entry in ipairs(sorted)do
            local rule=ruleFor(entry.Category)
            if entry.Category~=lastCategory then
                lastCategory=entry.Category
                local header=Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,26),BackgroundTransparency=1,LayoutOrder=position*2-1,Parent=listGroup.Holder})
                icon(header,rule.Icon,13,Theme.Accent,UDim2.new(0,10,.5,0))
                Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(22,0),Size=UDim2.new(1,-22,1,0),BackgroundTransparency=1,
                    Text=string.upper(rule.Category).."  ·  "..whereOf(entry),FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=11,
                    TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Parent=header})
                table.insert(rows,header)
            end
            local row=Create("Frame",{Name="Script_"..entry.Id,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,62),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,BackgroundTransparency=.25,
                LayoutOrder=position*2,Parent=listGroup.Holder},{Corner(12),Stroke(entry.Saved and Theme.Stroke or WARNING,1,entry.Saved and .45 or .55)})
            table.insert(rows,row)
            local badge=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,12),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(38,38),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency=.85,Parent=row},{Corner(10)})
            icon(badge,rule.Icon,18,Theme.Accent)
            local pill=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(62,12),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(28,18),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,Parent=row},{Corner(6)})
            Create("TextLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="MY",FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=10,
                TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),Parent=pill})
            local nameLabel=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(96,10),Size=UDim2.new(1,-366,0,22),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=entry.Name,
                FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=14,TextColor3=Theme.Text,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,Parent=row})
            local lines=1
            for _ in entry.Code:gmatch("\n")do lines+=1 end
            Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(62,34),Size=UDim2.new(1,-332,0,16),BackgroundTransparency=1,
                Text=entry.Category.."  ·  "..lines..(lines==1 and " line" or " lines").."  ·  "..(entry.Saved and "Saved" or "Not saved, lost after rejoin"),
                FontFace=Fonts.Regular,TextSize=11,TextColor3=entry.Saved and Theme.SubText or WARNING,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,Parent=row})

            -- buttons (right to left): delete, rename, save, run, auto-run switch
            local armed=false
            iconButton(row,"trash","Delete",-12,function(button,glyph,tip)
                if not armed then
                    armed=true
                    tip.Text="Click again to delete"
                    Tween(button,{BackgroundColor3=Theme.Danger},.12);glyph.ImageColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
                    task.delay(2.5,function()
                        if armed and button.Parent then armed=false;tip.Text="Delete";Tween(button,{BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element},.15);glyph.ImageColor3=Theme.Danger end
                    end)
                    return
                end
                local index=table.find(entries,entry)
                if index then table.remove(entries,index)end
                removeHost(entry)
                if entry.Saved then writeSaved()end
                log("info","Deleted "..entry.Name)
                render()
                local left=false
                for _,other in ipairs(entries)do if other.Category==entry.Category then left=true;break end end
                if not left then removeSubTab(entry.Category)end
            end,Theme.Danger)
            iconButton(row,"pencil-line","Rename",-50,function()
                nameLabel.Visible=false
                local box=Create("TextBox",{Position=nameLabel.Position,Size=nameLabel.Size,BackgroundColor3=Theme.Background,Text=entry.Name,
                    ClearTextOnFocus=false,FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=14,TextColor3=Theme.Text,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Parent=row},
                    {Corner(6),Stroke(Theme.Accent,1,.2),Create("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,6)})})
                box:CaptureFocus()
                box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                    local name=box.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
                    if name~="" and name~=entry.Name then
                        log("info","Renamed "..entry.Name.." → "..name)
                        entry.Name=name
                        addHost(entry)
                        if entry.Saved then writeSaved()end
                    end
                    render()
                end)
            end)
            iconButton(row,entry.Saved and "circle-check" or "save",entry.Saved and "Saved" or "Save (keeps it after rejoin)",-88,function()
                if entry.Saved then return end
                entry.Saved=true
                writeSaved()
                addHost(entry)
                log("ok","Saved "..entry.Name.." · "..whereOf(entry))
                window:Notify({Title="Scripts",Content=entry.Name.." saved. It stays after rejoin.",Type="Success",Duration=3})
                render()
            end,entry.Saved and SUCCESS or WARNING)
            local runButton=Create("TextButton",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-126,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(74,32),
                BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,Text="",AutoButtonColor=true,Parent=row},{Corner(9)})
            icon(runButton,"play",13,Color3.new(1,1,1),UDim2.new(0,18,.5,0))
            Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(28,0),Size=UDim2.new(1,-32,1,0),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="Run",FontFace=Fonts.Bold,
                TextSize=13,TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Parent=runButton})
            runButton.Activated:Connect(function()if alive then runEntry(entry)end end)
            Create("TextLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.new(1,-208,0,8),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(60,12),BackgroundTransparency=1,
                Text="AUTO RUN",FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=9,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,Parent=row})
            local auto=switch(row,-219,entry.AutoRun,function(state)
                entry.AutoRun=state
                if state and not entry.Saved then
                    entry.Saved=true
                    log("ok","Saved "..entry.Name.." (auto run needs it saved)")
                end
                writeSaved()
                log("info",entry.Name..(state and " will run when CrackHub starts" or " won't run on start"))
                task.defer(render)
            end)
            auto.Position=UDim2.new(1,-219,.5,6)
        end
    end

    runEntry=function(entry)
        return run(entry.Name,codeWithSettings(entry))
    end
    local function addEntry(code,name,ranAlready)
        code=tostring(code or "")
        if code:match("^%s*$")then log("warn","Nothing to add, the editor is empty.");return end
        for _,entry in ipairs(entries)do
            if entry.Code==code then
                window:Notify({Title="Scripts",Content=entry.Name.." is already in "..whereOf(entry)..".",Type="Info",Duration=3})
                return entry
            end
        end
        local rule=detect(code)
        nextId+=1
        name=tostring(name or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if name=="" then
            local count=0
            for _,entry in ipairs(entries)do if entry.Category==rule.Category then count+=1 end end
            name=rule.Category.." script "..(count+1)
        end
        local entry={Id=nextId,Name=name,Code=code,Category=rule.Category,AutoRun=false,Saved=false,Settings={}}
        table.insert(entries,entry)
        local created=addHost(entry)
        local where=whereOf(entry)
        local settings=#parseSettings(code)
        local extra=settings>0 and (" with "..settings..(settings==1 and " setting" or " settings")) or ""
        log("info",(created and ("New tab "..where.." · ") or "")..name.." added"..extra.." · not saved yet")
        window:Notify({
            Title=created and ("New tab: "..rule.Category) or ("Added to "..rule.Category),
            Content=name.." (My) is in "..where..extra..". Save it in Scripts → My to keep it.",
            Type="Success",Duration=5})
        render()
        return entry
    end

    editorGroup:AddButton({Name="Execute",Description="Run it and add it to its tab",Style="Primary",Callback=function()
        if not alive then return end
        local code=codeBox.Text
        if code:match("^%s*$")then log("warn","Nothing to run, the editor is empty.");return end
        local name=nameBox.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if run(name~="" and name or "Editor",code)then addEntry(code,nameBox.Text,true)end
    end})
    editorGroup:AddButton({Name="Add without running",Description="Only add it to its tab and to My",Callback=function()
        if alive then addEntry(codeBox.Text,nameBox.Text,false)end
    end})
    if type(env.getclipboard)=="function"then
        editorGroup:AddButton({Name="Paste from clipboard",Callback=function()
            local ok,text=pcall(env.getclipboard)
            if ok and type(text)=="string"then codeBox.Text=text end
        end})
    end
    editorGroup:AddButton({Name="Clear editor",Callback=function()codeBox.Text="";nameInput:Set("");log("info","Editor cleared")end})

    outputGroup=executorTab:AddGroup("Output",true)
    outputList=Create("ScrollingFrame",{Name="Console",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,130),BackgroundColor3=EDITOR_BG,BackgroundTransparency=.15,BorderSizePixel=0,
        ScrollBarThickness=4,ScrollBarImageColor3=Theme.Accent,CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        LayoutOrder=NextOrder(),Parent=outputGroup.Holder},{Corner(8),Stroke(Theme.Stroke,1,.3),
        Create("UIListLayout",{Padding=UDim.new(0,4),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}),
        Create("UIPadding",{PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,8),PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,8),PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,10),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,10)})})
    log("info","Ready. Paste a script, then Execute or Add to My.")

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ start up
    for _,entry in ipairs(entries)do addHost(entry)end
    render()
    refreshEditor()
    task.delay(1.5,function()
        if not alive then return end
        for _,entry in ipairs(entries)do
            if entry.AutoRun then log("info","Auto run: "..entry.Name);runEntry(entry)end
        end
    end)

    connect(window.Gui.Destroying,function()
        alive=false
        for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end
    end)
    return {Entries=entries,Run=run,Add=addEntry,Detect=detect}
end

CrackHub.InstallWearables = function(window)
    local Fonts={
        Medium=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Medium),
        Bold=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Bold),
    }
    local Players=game:GetService("Players")
    local LocalPlayer=Players.LocalPlayer
    local env=CrackHubEnvironment

    -- Roblox catalog items. Image="" uses the official Roblox thumbnail;
    -- paste your own uploaded image ID there (Image="1234567890") to replace it.
    local CATALOG={
        Tails={
            {Id=12899708317,Name="Kemono Fox Tail",Tag="Furry · Kemono",Image=""},
            {Id=122974036629534,Name="Kemono Orange Fox Tail",Tag="Furry · Kemono",Image=""},
            {Id=97895763616052,Name="Kemono Blue Fox Tail",Tag="Furry · Kemono",Image=""},
            {Id=123013521442665,Name="Kemono Kitsune Tail",Tag="Furry · Kemono kitsune",Image=""},
            {Id=105406999260283,Name="Kemono White Blossom Tail",Tag="Furry · Kemono",Image=""},
            {Id=7540618277,Name="Mega Fluffy Fox Tail",Tag="Furry · extra fluffy",Image=""},
            {Id=79873565154827,Name="Kemono Gray Demon Tail",Tag="Furry · Kemono demon",Image=""},
            {Id=89752122859042,Name="Kemono Inverted Black Tail",Tag="Furry · Kemono",Image=""},
            {Id=6594651927,Name="Fluffy Fox Tail",Tag="Furry · Willowthedumb",Image=""},
            {Id=6838619271,Name="Fluffy Fox Tail [Black]",Tag="Furry · Fennecpaw",Image=""},
            {Id=6202284497,Name="Mint Fox Tail",Tag="Furry · JohnDrinkin",Image=""},
            {Id=140309235737101,Name="Fox Tail",Tag="Furry · Krazy Kreatures",Image=""},
            {Id=9363116149,Name="White Fluffy Cat Tail",Tag="Furry · cat",Image=""},
            {Id=9363113744,Name="Black Fluffy Cat Tail",Tag="Furry · cat",Image=""},
            {Id=6532373980,Name="Black Fluffy Rounded Tail",Tag="Furry · cat",Image=""},
        },
        Stockings={
            {Id=11667702804,Name="Fluffy Paw Socks White",Tag="Furry · pink paw beans",Image=""},
            {Id=12189471540,Name="Fluffy Paw Socks Black",Tag="Furry · pink paw beans",Image=""},
            {Id=10791341100,Name="White Fur Leg Warmers",Tag="Furry · fur warmers",Image=""},
            {Id=16259340394,Name="Leopard Fur Leg Warmers",Tag="Furry · leopard fur",Image=""},
            {Id=100526897753863,Name="Cat Paw Thigh Highs",Tag="Furry · hot pink paws",Image=""},
        },
        Paws={
            {Id=100729390670866,Name="Big Fluffy Kitten Paws",Tag="Furry · pink gloves",Image=""},
            {Id=17680953402,Name="Kawaii Black Cat Paws",Tag="Furry · 3.0 body",Image=""},
