            {Id=17680973405,Name="Kawaii White Cat Paws",Tag="Furry · 3.0 body",Image=""},
            {Id=17680969860,Name="Kawaii Brown Cat Paws",Tag="Furry · 3.0 body",Image=""},
            {Id=17681398321,Name="Kawaii Black Cat Paws 1.0",Tag="Furry · blocky body",Image=""},
            {Id=17681416212,Name="Kawaii White Cat Paws 1.0",Tag="Furry · blocky body",Image=""},
            {Id=17899540026,Name="White Cat Paws",Tag="Furry · with claws",Image=""},
            {Id=17899627446,Name="Black Cat Paws",Tag="Furry · white claws",Image=""},
        },
    }
    -- card pictures, built into the script (cut from your sheet, transparent PNG 200x200)
    local PICTURES=CrackHubEnvironment.__CrackHubJSONAsset("pictures.json")
    for prefix,category in pairs({t="Tails",s="Stockings",p="Paws"})do
        for index,item in ipairs(CATALOG[category])do item.Key=prefix..string.format("%02d",index)end
    end
    local pictureCache={}
    local function picture(item)
        if item.Image and item.Image~="" then
            return tostring(item.Image):match("^%d+$") and "rbxassetid://"..item.Image or item.Image
        end
        local key=item.Key
        if key and pictureCache[key] then return pictureCache[key] end
        local encoded=key and PICTURES[key]
        if encoded and type(env.writefile)=="function" and type(env.getcustomasset)=="function" then
            local ok,uri=pcall(function()
                if type(env.isfolder)=="function" and not env.isfolder("CrackHub")then env.makefolder("CrackHub")end
                local path="CrackHub/wear_"..key..".png"
                if type(env.isfile)~="function" or not env.isfile(path)then env.writefile(path,(encoded:sub(1,1)=="@" and assert(((getgenv and getgenv()) or _G).__CrackHubAsset(encoded:sub(2)),"asset download failed") or Base64Decode(encoded)))end
                return env.getcustomasset(path)
            end)
            if ok and type(uri)=="string" and uri~="" then pictureCache[key]=uri;PICTURES[key]=nil;return uri end
        end
        return "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id="..item.Id.."&w=150&h=150"
    end
    local GREEN,RED=Color3.fromRGB(48,209,88),Color3.fromRGB(255,69,58)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ saved choice
    local file="CrackHub/wearables.json"
    local state={Tails=nil,Stockings=nil,Paws=nil,Sway=true,SwaySpeed=4,SwayAmount=18,Keep=true}
    pcall(function()
        if type(env.isfile)=="function" and env.isfile(file)then
            local saved=HttpService:JSONDecode(env.readfile(file))
            if type(saved)=="table"then for k,v in pairs(saved)do if state[k]==nil or type(state[k])==type(v)then state[k]=v end end end
        end
    end)
    local saveQueued=false
    local function save()
        if saveQueued then return end
        saveQueued=true
        task.delay(.5,function()
            saveQueued=false
            pcall(function()
                if type(env.writefile)~="function"then return end
                if type(env.isfolder)=="function" and not env.isfolder("CrackHub")then env.makefolder("CrackHub")end
                env.writefile(file,HttpService:JSONEncode(state))
            end)
        end)
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ loading + wearing
    local cache={}
    local loading={}
    local meshFile="CrackHub/wearables_mesh.json"
    local meshInfo={}
    pcall(function()
        if type(env.isfile)=="function" and env.isfile(meshFile)then
            local saved=HttpService:JSONDecode(env.readfile(meshFile))
            if type(saved)=="table"then meshInfo=saved end
        end
    end)
    local saveMeshInfo; saveMeshInfo = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if type(env.writefile)~="function"then return end
            if type(env.isfolder)=="function" and not env.isfolder("CrackHub")then env.makefolder("CrackHub")end
            env.writefile(meshFile,HttpService:JSONEncode(meshInfo))
        end))
    end)
    local vec; vec = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(v)return {v.X,v.Y,v.Z}end)
    -- remember what an item is made of, so next time it is built locally in a few milliseconds
    local remember; remember = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(id,template)
        local info
        local pants=template:IsA("Pants") and template or template:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Pants",true)
        local accessory=template:IsA("Accessory") and template or template:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accessory",true)
        if pants and not accessory then
            info={Kind="pants",Template=pants.PantsTemplate}
        elseif accessory and not accessory:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer",true) and not accessory:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceAppearance",true)then
            local handle=accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            local attachment=handle and handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Attachment")
            if handle and attachment then
                local mesh,texture,scale
                if handle:IsA("MeshPart")then
                    local size,native=handle.Size,handle.MeshSize
                    if native.X>0 and native.Y>0 and native.Z>0 then
                        mesh,texture,scale=handle.MeshId,handle.TextureID,Vector3.new(size.X/native.X,size.Y/native.Y,size.Z/native.Z)
                    end
                else
                    local special=handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
                    if special then mesh,texture,scale=special.MeshId,special.TextureId,special.Scale end
                end
                if mesh and mesh~="" then
                    info={Kind="mesh",Mesh=mesh,Texture=texture or "",Scale=vec(scale),Size=vec(handle.Size),
                        Color=vec(handle.Color),Attach=attachment.Name,CFrame={attachment.CFrame:GetComponents()}}
                end
            end
        end
        if info then meshInfo[tostring(id)]=info;saveMeshInfo()end
    end)
    local build; build = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(id)
        local info=meshInfo[tostring(id)]
        if type(info)~="table" then return nil end
        local ok,result=pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if info.Kind=="pants" then
                local pants=Instance.new("Pants")
                pants.PantsTemplate=info.Template
                return pants
            end
            local accessory=Instance.new("Accessory")
            local handle=Instance.new("Part")
            handle.Name="Handle"
            handle.Size=Vector3.new(table.unpack(info.Size))
            handle.Color=Color3.new(table.unpack(info.Color))
            handle.CanCollide,handle.CanTouch,handle.CanQuery,handle.Massless=false,false,false,true
            local mesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
            mesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            mesh.MeshId=info.Mesh
            mesh.TextureId=info.Texture
            mesh.Scale=Vector3.new(table.unpack(info.Scale))
            mesh.Parent=handle
            local attachment=Instance.new("Attachment")
            attachment.Name=info.Attach
            attachment.CFrame=CFrame.new(table.unpack(info.CFrame))
            attachment.Parent=handle
            handle.Parent=accessory
            return accessory
        end))
        return ok and result or nil
    end)
    local prepare; prepare = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(model)
        for _,part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
            if part:IsA("BasePart")then part.CanCollide=false;part.CanTouch=false;part.CanQuery=false;part.Massless=true;part.Anchored=false end
            if part:IsA("Script") or part:IsA("LocalScript") or part:IsA("ModuleScript")then part:Destroy()end
        end
    end)
    local loadAsset; loadAsset = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(id)
        if cache[id]~=nil then return cache[id] or nil end
        local quick=build(id)
        if quick then cache[id]=quick;return quick end
        if loading[id]then
            while loading[id]do task.wait()end
            return cache[id] or nil
        end
        loading[id]=true
        local attempts={
            function()return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..id)end,
            function()return game:GetObjects("https://www.roblox.com/asset/?id="..id)end,
            function()return {game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadLocalAsset("rbxassetid://"..id)}end,
        }
        for _,attempt in ipairs(attempts)do
            local ok,result=pcall(attempt)
            if ok and type(result)=="table" and typeof(result[1])=="Instance"then
                local template=result[1]
                prepare(template)
                -- preload meshes/textures so wearing it later shows up instantly
                local content={}
                for _,object in ipairs(template:GetDescendants())do
                    if object:IsA("MeshPart") or object:IsA("SpecialMesh") or object:IsA("Pants") or object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")then
                        table.insert(content,object)
                    end
                end
                if template:IsA("Pants")then table.insert(content,template)end
                task.spawn(pcall,function()game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(content)end)
                pcall(remember,id,template)
                cache[id]=template
                loading[id]=nil
                return template
            end
            task.wait()
        end
        cache[id]=false
        loading[id]=nil
        return nil
    end)
    local function itemOf(category,id)
        for _,item in ipairs(CATALOG[category])do if item.Id==id then return item end end
    end
    local character; character = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return char,humanoid
    end)
    -- weld an accessory exactly where Roblox would put it (matching attachments)
    local function attach(char,humanoid,accessory)
        local handle=accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if not handle then return nil end
        pcall(function()humanoid:AddAccessory(accessory)end)
        if accessory.Parent~=char then accessory.Parent=char end
        local weld=handle:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")
        if weld then return weld end
        local own=handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Attachment")
        local target=own and char:FindFirstChild(own.Name,true)
        if not (own and target and target:IsA("Attachment"))then
            target=char:FindFirstChild("WaistBackAttachment",true)
            own=own or Instance.new("Attachment",handle)
        end
        if not target then return nil end
        weld=Instance.new("Weld")
        weld.Name="AccessoryWeld"
        weld.Part0=target.Parent
        weld.Part1=handle
        weld.C0=target.CFrame
        weld.C1=own.CFrame
        weld.Parent=handle
        return weld
    end

    local worn={Tails=nil,Stockings=nil,Paws=nil}
    local tailWeld,tailBase
    local hiddenPants={}
    local function takeOff(category)
        local current=worn[category]
        if current then pcall(function()current:Destroy()end)end
        worn[category]=nil
        if category=="Tails"then tailWeld,tailBase=nil,nil end
        if category=="Stockings"then
            for _,pants in ipairs(hiddenPants)do
                local char=LocalPlayer.Character
                if char and pants and pants.Parent==nil then pcall(function()pants.Parent=char end)end
            end
            table.clear(hiddenPants)
        end
    end
    local function putOn(category,id)
        local char,humanoid=character()
        if not char or not humanoid then return false,"Your character is not loaded." end
        local asset=loadAsset(id)
        if not asset then return false,"Roblox did not give this item to the client." end
        takeOff(category)
        local pants=asset:IsA("Pants") and asset or asset:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Pants",true)
        local accessory=asset:IsA("Accessory") and asset or asset:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accessory",true)
        if category=="Stockings" and pants then
            -- classic stockings: swap the pants texture, keep the originals to put back later
            for _,old in ipairs(char:GetChildren())do
                if old:IsA("Pants") and old.Name~="CrackHubStockings" then table.insert(hiddenPants,old);old.Parent=nil end
            end
            local copy=pants:Clone()
            copy.Name="CrackHubStockings"
            copy.Parent=char
            worn.Stockings=copy
            return true
        end
        if accessory then
            local copy=accessory:Clone()
            copy.Name="CrackHub"..category
            local weld=attach(char,humanoid,copy)
            if not weld then copy:Destroy();return false,"Could not attach it to your character." end
            worn[category]=copy
            if category=="Tails"then tailWeld,tailBase=weld,weld.C0 end
            return true
        end
        return false,"This item has no wearable part."
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ tail sway (the tail moves, faster while you walk)
    local clock=0
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        if not tailWeld or not tailWeld.Parent then return end
        if not state.Sway then
            if tailWeld.C0~=tailBase then tailWeld.C0=tailBase end
            return
        end
        local _,humanoid=character()
        local moving=humanoid and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude>.1
        clock+=dt*state.SwaySpeed*(moving and 1.8 or 1)
        local amount=math.rad(state.SwayAmount)*(moving and 1.25 or 1)
        tailWeld.C0=tailBase*CFrame.Angles(math.sin(clock*.5+1)*amount*.25,math.sin(clock)*amount,math.sin(clock*.7)*amount*.15)
    end))

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ UI (same cards as the rest of Cosmetics)
    local function cosmeticsGroup()
        for _=1,60 do
            for _,group in ipairs(window.TabGroups or {})do
                if group.Name=="Cosmetics" and group.CreateTab then return group end
            end
            task.wait(.5)
        end
    end
    local paints={Tails={},Stockings={},Paws={}}
    local function repaint(category)for _,paint in pairs(paints[category])do paint()end end
    local busy=false
    local function equip(category,item)
        if busy then return end
        if state[category]==item.Id and worn[category] then
            takeOff(category)
            state[category]=nil
            save();repaint(category)
            window:Notify({Title=({Tails="Tail removed",Stockings="Stockings removed",Paws="Paws removed"})[category],Content=item.Name.." is off.",Type="Info",Duration=3})
            return
        end
        state[category]=item.Id
        if cache[item.Id] then
            local ok,problem=putOn(category,item.Id)
            if not ok then
                state[category]=nil
                window:Notify({Title="Could not equip",Content=item.Name..": "..tostring(problem),Type="Error",Duration=4})
            end
            save();repaint(category)
            return
        end
        busy=true
        repaint(category)
        task.spawn(function()
            loadAsset(item.Id)
            local ok,problem=putOn(category,item.Id)
            busy=false
            if not ok then
                state[category]=nil
                window:Notify({Title="Could not equip",Content=item.Name..": "..tostring(problem),Type="Error",Duration=4})
            end
            save();repaint(category)
        end)
    end
    local function card(parent,category,item)
        local frame=Create("Frame",{BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,Parent=parent},{Corner(12),Create("UIStroke",{Color=Theme.Stroke,Thickness=1,Transparency=.3})})
        local scale=Create("UIScale",{Parent=frame})
        local box=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,1,-84),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Background,Parent=frame},{Corner(9)})
        Create("ImageLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),Size=UDim2.fromScale(.86,.86),BackgroundTransparency=1,
            ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,Image=picture(item),Parent=box})
        Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.new(0,12,1,-72),Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,18),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=item.Name,FontFace=Fonts.Bold,
            TextSize=14,TextColor3=Theme.Text,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,Parent=frame})
        Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.new(0,12,1,-53),Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,14),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=item.Tag,FontFace=Fonts.Medium,
            TextSize=11,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,Parent=frame})
        local button=Create("TextButton",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,1),Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-8),Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,28),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,
            AutoButtonColor=false,Text="Equip",FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=13,TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),Parent=frame},{Corner(8)})
        local hovering=false
        local function paint()
            local selected=state[category]==item.Id
            local on=selected and worn[category]~=nil
            button.Text=(selected and busy) and "Loading..." or (on and (hovering and "Unequip" or "Equipped") or "Equip")
            Tween(button,{BackgroundColor3=on and (hovering and RED or GREEN) or Theme.Accent},.18)
        end
        paints[category][item.Id]=paint
        paint()
        button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            hovering=true;paint()
            if cache[item.Id]==nil and not loading[item.Id]then task.spawn(loadAsset,item.Id)end -- head start before the click
        end)
        button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()hovering=false;paint()end)
        button.Activated:Connect(function()equip(category,item)end)
        frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function()Tween(scale,{Scale=1.02},.15)end)
        frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function()Tween(scale,{Scale=1},.15)end)
    end
    local function grid(tab,category)
        local holder=Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundTransparency=1,LayoutOrder=1000000,Parent=tab.Holder},{
            Create("UIGridLayout",{CellSize=UDim2.new(.5,-6,0,210),FillDirectionMaxCells=2,CellPadding=UDim2.fromOffset(12,12),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}),
        })
        for _,item in ipairs(CATALOG[category])do card(holder,category,item)end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local group=cosmeticsGroup()
        if not group then warn("[CrackHub] Cosmetics tab not found, Tails/Stockings skipped");return end

        local tailsTab=group:CreateTab("Tails","sparkles")
        local tailSettings=tailsTab:AddGroup("Tail",true)
        tailSettings:AddToggle({Name="Tail sway",Description="Your tail moves, faster while walking",Default=state.Sway,
            Callback=function(value)state.Sway=value==true;save()end})
        tailSettings:AddSlider({Name="Sway speed",Min=1,Max=12,Default=state.SwaySpeed,Increment=.5,Callback=function(value)state.SwaySpeed=value;save()end})
        tailSettings:AddSlider({Name="Sway amount",Min=0,Max=45,Default=state.SwayAmount,Increment=1,Suffix="°",Callback=function(value)state.SwayAmount=value;save()end})
        tailSettings:AddButton({Name="Remove tail",Callback=function()
            takeOff("Tails");state.Tails=nil;save();repaint("Tails")
        end})
        grid(tailsTab,"Tails")

        local stockingsTab=group:CreateTab("Stockings","layers")
        local stockingSettings=stockingsTab:AddGroup("Stockings",true)
        stockingSettings:AddToggle({Name="Keep after respawn",Description="Puts your tail, stockings and paws back on after you die",Default=state.Keep,
            Callback=function(value)state.Keep=value==true;save()end})
        stockingSettings:AddButton({Name="Remove stockings",Callback=function()
            takeOff("Stockings");state.Stockings=nil;save();repaint("Stockings")
        end})
        grid(stockingsTab,"Stockings")

        local pawsTab=group:CreateTab("Paws","heart")
        local pawSettings=pawsTab:AddGroup("Paws",true)
        pawSettings:AddParagraph({Title="Tip",Content="3.0 paws fit the newer bodies, 1.0 paws fit the classic blocky body."})
        pawSettings:AddButton({Name="Remove paws",Callback=function()
            takeOff("Paws");state.Paws=nil;save();repaint("Paws")
        end})
        grid(pawsTab,"Paws")

        -- put the saved choice back on (now and after every respawn)
        local function restore()
            for _,category in ipairs({"Tails","Stockings","Paws"})do
                local id=state[category]
                if id and itemOf(category,id)then
                    local ok=putOn(category,id)
                    if not ok then state[category]=nil end
                end
                repaint(category)
            end
        end
        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            worn.Tails,worn.Stockings,worn.Paws,tailWeld,tailBase=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil
            table.clear(hiddenPants)
            if not state.Keep then state.Tails,state.Stockings,state.Paws=nil,nil,nil;save();repaint("Tails");repaint("Stockings");repaint("Paws");return end
            char:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10)
            task.wait(1.2) -- let Roblox finish loading the normal avatar first
            restore()
        end)
        if LocalPlayer.Character then task.delay(1,restore)end

        -- only what you wore last time is fetched in the background (one item, no stutter)
        task.delay(2,function()
            for _,category in ipairs({"Tails","Stockings","Paws"})do
                local id=state[category]
                if id and cache[id]==nil then task.spawn(loadAsset,id);task.wait(1)end
            end
        end)
    end)
end

CrackHub.InstallKeybinds = function(window)
    local Fonts={
        Regular=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Regular),
        Medium=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Medium),
        Bold=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Bold),
        Heavy=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold),
    }
    local env=CrackHubEnvironment
    local HEADER,WIDTH=52,250
    local alive=true
    local connections={}
    local function connect(signal,fn)
        local c=signal:Connect(function(...)if alive then return fn(...)end end)
        table.insert(connections,c)
        return c
    end
    local writeJson; writeJson = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(path,data)
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if type(env.writefile)~="function"then return end
            if type(env.isfolder)=="function" and not env.isfolder("CrackHub")then env.makefolder("CrackHub")end
            env.writefile(path,HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
        end))
    end)
    local function readJson(path)
        local ok,data=pcall(function()
            if type(env.isfile)=="function" and env.isfile(path)then return HttpService:JSONDecode(env.readfile(path))end
        end)
        return ok and type(data)=="table" and data or nil
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ settings
    local file="CrackHub/keybinds_widget.json"
    local cfg={Enabled=true,OnlyActive=false,ShowTab=true,Opacity=6,Scale=(UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled) and 60 or 100,X=-1,Y=-1,HideEmpty=false}
    for k,v in pairs(readJson(file) or {})do if type(cfg[k])==type(v)then cfg[k]=v end end
    local saveQueued=false
    local function save()
        if saveQueued then return end
        saveQueued=true
        task.delay(.5,function()saveQueued=false;writeJson(file,cfg)end)
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers to read what a bind belongs to
    local titleOf; titleOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(frame)
        if not frame then return nil end
        local best
        for _,child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren())do
            if child:IsA("TextLabel") and child.Text~="" and child.Visible then
                if not best or child.AbsolutePosition.Y<best.AbsolutePosition.Y then best=child end
            end
        end
        return best and best.Text or nil
    end)
    local tabCache=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
    local tabOf; tabOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(object)
        if tabCache[object]~=nil then return tabCache[object] or nil end
        local holders={}
        for _,tab in ipairs(window.Tabs or {})do if tab.Holder then holders[tab.Holder]=tab end end
        local node=object
        while node do
            local tab=holders[node]
            if tab then
                local name=tab.Group and tab.Group.Name and (tab.Group.Name.." · "..tab.Name) or tab.Name
                tabCache[object]=name
                return name
            end
            node=node.Parent
        end
        tabCache[object]=false
        return nil
    end)
    local scriptName; scriptName = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(frame)
        local node=frame and frame.Parent
        for _=1,5 do
            if not node then break end
            for _,child in ipairs(node:GetChildren())do
                if child:IsA("GuiObject")then
                    for _,label in ipairs(child:GetChildren())do
                        if label:IsA("TextLabel") and label.Text:find(" · My",1,true)then return label.Text end
                    end
                end
            end
            node=node.Parent
        end
    end)
    local nameOf; nameOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(chip)
        local frame=chip.Frame or chip
        local name=titleOf(frame.Parent) or "Bind"
        if name=="Keybind (My)" then name=scriptName(frame) or "My script" end
        return name
    end)
    local keyOf; keyOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(chip)
        local frame=chip.Frame
        return (tabOf(frame) or "?").."/"..nameOf(chip)
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ bind modes: Toggle / Hold / Always (saved per function)
    local modesFile="CrackHub/bind_modes.json"
    local savedModes=readJson(modesFile) or {}
    local MODES={
        {Id="Toggle",Title="Toggle",Text="Press the key to switch on / off"},
        {Id="Hold",Title="Hold",Text="On only while the key is held"},
        {Id="Always",Title="Always",Text="Always on, the key is ignored"},
    }
    CrackHub.BindModeSuffix=function(chipFrame)
        local mode=chipFrame:GetAttribute("BindMode")
        if mode=="Hold" then return " · hold" elseif mode=="Always" then return " · always" end
        return ""
    end
    local setMode; setMode = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(chip,mode,store)
        chip.Frame:SetAttribute("BindMode",mode~="Toggle" and mode or nil)
        if chip.Refresh then pcall(chip.Refresh,chip)end
        local owner=chip.Owner
        if owner and owner.Type=="Toggle" then
            if mode=="Always" and not owner.Value then owner:Set(true)end
            if mode=="Hold" and owner.Value then owner:Set(false)end
        end
        if store then
            savedModes[keyOf(chip)]=mode~="Toggle" and mode or nil
            writeJson(modesFile,savedModes)
        end
    end)
    -- put saved modes back on (also on binds created later, e.g. new scripts)
    local applied=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
    local applyModes; applyModes = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        for _,chip in ipairs(CrackHub.BindRegistry or {})do
            if not applied[chip] and chip.Frame and chip.Frame.Parent and chip.Frame:IsDescendantOf(game)then
                applied[chip]=true
                local mode=savedModes[keyOf(chip)]
                if mode then setMode(chip,mode,false)end
            end
        end
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ right-click menu on any bind chip
    local menuLayer
    local function closeMenu()
        if menuLayer then
            local layer=menuLayer;menuLayer=nil
            local panel=layer:FindFirstChild("Panel")
            if panel then
                Tween(panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"),{Scale=.92},.1)
                Tween(panel,{BackgroundTransparency=1},.1)
            end
            task.delay(.1,function()layer:Destroy()end)
        end
    end
    CrackHub.OpenBindMenu=function(chip)
        closeMenu()
        local owner=chip.Owner
        local isToggle=owner and owner.Type=="Toggle"
        local current=chip.Frame:GetAttribute("BindMode") or "Toggle"
        local layer=Create("TextButton",{Name="BindMenu",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,ZIndex=300,Parent=window.Gui})
        menuLayer=layer
        layer.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeMenu)
        layer.MouseButton2Click:Connect(closeMenu)
        local width=228
        local panel=Create("Frame",{Name="Panel",Size=UDim2.fromOffset(width,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,BackgroundColor3=Theme.Background,
            ZIndex=301,Parent=layer},{Corner(12),Stroke(Theme.Stroke,1,.15),List(2),
            Create("UIPadding",{PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,8),PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,8),PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,8),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,8)})})
        local scale=Create("UIScale",{Scale=.92,Parent=panel})
        local function label(text,size,color,font,order,height)
            return Create("TextLabel",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,height or 18),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=text,FontFace=font or Fonts.Medium,TextSize=size,
                TextColor3=color,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,LayoutOrder=order,ZIndex=302,Parent=panel},
                {Create("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,6)})})
        end
        label(nameOf(chip),13,Theme.Text,Fonts.Bold,1,20)
        label(chip:Get() and ("Key: "..BindName(chip:Get())) or "No key yet — pick a mode, then click the chip and press a key",11,Theme.SubText,Fonts.Medium,2,16)
        local order=3
        local function option(title,text,selected,color,callback)
            order+=1
            local button=Create("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,text and 40 or 30),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,BackgroundTransparency=selected and .82 or 1,
                Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,LayoutOrder=order,ZIndex=302,Parent=panel},{Corner(8)})
            Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,text and 4 or 0),Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,text and 18 or 30),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=title,
                FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=13,TextColor3=color or Theme.Text,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,ZIndex=303,Parent=button})
            if text then
                Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,21),Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,14),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=text,FontFace=Fonts.Regular,
                    TextSize=11,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=303,Parent=button})
            end
            if selected then
                local mark=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-12,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,
                    ZIndex=303,Parent=button},{Corner(999)})
            end
            button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()if not selected then Tween(button,{BackgroundTransparency=.92},.12)end end)
            button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()if not selected then Tween(button,{BackgroundTransparency=1},.12)end end)
            button.Activated:Connect(function()callback();closeMenu()end)
        end
        do
            if isToggle then
                for _,mode in ipairs(MODES)do
                    option(mode.Title,mode.Text,current==mode.Id,nil,function()setMode(chip,mode.Id,true)end)
                end
            else
                option("Press","Runs the function each time you press the key",true,nil,function()end)
            end
            if chip:Get() then
                order+=1
                Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,1),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Stroke,BackgroundTransparency=.3,BorderSizePixel=0,LayoutOrder=order,ZIndex=302,Parent=panel})
                option("Clear bind",nil,false,Theme.Danger,function()setMode(chip,"Toggle",true);chip:Set(nil)end)
            end
        end
        -- open next to the mouse, kept on screen
        task.defer(function()
            local mouse=UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()-GuiService:GetGuiInset()
            local view=workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720)
            local size=panel.AbsoluteSize
            panel.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(mouse.X+6,4,view.X-size.X-4),math.clamp(mouse.Y+6,4,view.Y-size.Y-40))
            Tween(scale,{Scale=1},.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        end)
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ collecting binds
    local collect; collect = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local list={}
        for _,chip in ipairs(CrackHub.BindRegistry or {})do
            local frame=chip.Frame
            local bind=chip.Get and chip:Get()
            if bind and frame and frame.Parent and frame:IsDescendantOf(game)then
                local owner=chip.Owner
                local isToggle=owner and owner.Type=="Toggle"
                table.insert(list,{Id=chip,Bind=bind,Name=nameOf(chip),Tab=tabOf(frame),Toggle=isToggle,
                    On=isToggle and owner.Value==true or false,Mode=frame:GetAttribute("BindMode") or (isToggle and "Toggle" or "Press")})
            end
        end
        for _,kb in ipairs(CrackHub.KeybindRegistry or {})do
            if kb.Value and kb.Frame and kb.Frame.Parent and kb.Frame:IsDescendantOf(game)then
                local name=titleOf(kb.Frame) or "Keybind"
                if name=="Keybind (My)" then name=scriptName(kb.Frame) or "My script" end
                table.insert(list,{Id=kb,Bind={Key=kb.Value},Name=name,Tab=tabOf(kb.Frame),Toggle=false,On=false,Mode="Press"})
            end
        end
        local used={}
        for _,item in ipairs(list)do
            local name=BindName(item.Bind)
            used[name]=(used[name] or 0)+1
        end
        for _,item in ipairs(list)do item.Conflict=used[BindName(item.Bind)]>1 end
        table.sort(list,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a,b)
            if a.On~=b.On then return a.On end
            if (a.Tab or "")~=(b.Tab or "")then return (a.Tab or "")<(b.Tab or "")end
            return a.Name<b.Name
        end))
        return list
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ the on-screen card
    -- the card itself is invisible; its look comes from two full-size layers with the same rounded corners
    -- (fill + border), so no square piece can ever stick out of the rounding
    local frame=Create("Frame",{Name="KeybindsWidget",Size=UDim2.fromOffset(WIDTH,HEADER+10),BackgroundTransparency=1,
        BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=false,ZIndex=14,Parent=window.Gui})
    local scale=Create("UIScale",{Scale=cfg.Scale/100,Parent=frame})
    local fill=Create("Frame",{Name="Fill",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),BackgroundTransparency=cfg.Opacity/100,
        BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=14,Parent=frame},{Corner(14)})
    local tint=Create("UIGradient",{Rotation=90,Parent=fill})
    local border=Create("Frame",{Name="Border",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=14,Parent=frame},{Corner(14)})
    local frameStroke=Stroke(Theme.Stroke,1,.3);frameStroke.Parent=border
    local paintTint; paintTint = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        tint.Color=ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Theme.Background:Lerp(Theme.Accent,.16)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.22,Theme.Background:Lerp(Theme.Accent,.05)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Theme.Background),
        })
    end)
    paintTint()
    -- content is clipped by an inner holder that stays inside the rounded edge
    local inner=Create("Frame",{Name="Inner",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,ClipsDescendants=true,ZIndex=15,Parent=frame})
    local header=Create("TextButton",{Name="Header",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,HEADER),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,Active=true,ZIndex=15,Parent=frame})
    local badge=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,11),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(30,30),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,ZIndex=16,Parent=frame},{Corner(9),
        Create("UIGradient",{Rotation=135,Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1),Color3.fromRGB(175,175,190))})})
    local badgeGlow=Stroke(Theme.Accent,2,.7);badgeGlow.Parent=badge
    local icon=Create("ImageLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16),BackgroundTransparency=1,
        ImageColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),ZIndex=17,Parent=badge})
    ApplyIcon(icon,"keyboard")
    local titleLabel=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(54,10),Size=UDim2.new(1,-120,0,18),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="Keybinds",FontFace=Fonts.Heavy,
        TextSize=15,TextColor3=Theme.Text,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,ZIndex=16,Parent=frame})
    local subtitle=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(54,28),Size=UDim2.new(1,-120,0,14),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",FontFace=Fonts.Medium,
        TextSize=11,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,ZIndex=16,Parent=frame})
    local countPill=Create("TextLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-14,0,HEADER/2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,22),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
        BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,BackgroundTransparency=.82,Text="0",FontFace=Fonts.Heavy,TextSize=12,TextColor3=Theme.Accent,ZIndex=16,Parent=frame},
        {Corner(999),Create("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,9),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,9)})})
    local divider=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,HEADER-1),Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,1),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Stroke,BackgroundTransparency=.35,
        BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=15,Parent=frame},{Create("UIGradient",{Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.15,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.85,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})})})
    local list=Create("Frame",{Name="List",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,HEADER+6),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0),BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=15,Parent=inner})
    local empty=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,HEADER+4),Size=UDim2.new(1,-28,0,34),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",TextWrapped=true,
        FontFace=Fonts.Regular,TextSize=11,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
        Visible=false,ZIndex=15,Parent=inner})

    local function place()
        if cfg.X>=0 and cfg.Y>=0 then frame.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(cfg.X,cfg.Y)
        else frame.Position=UDim2.new(1,-(WIDTH+20),0,90)end
    end
    place()
    MakeDraggable(header,frame,connections)
    connect(header.InputEnded,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            task.delay(.05,function()cfg.X,cfg.Y=math.floor(frame.AbsolutePosition.X),math.floor(frame.AbsolutePosition.Y);save()end)
        end
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ rows
    local rows={}
    local rowHeight; rowHeight = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()return cfg.ShowTab and 38 or 30 end)
    local makeRow; makeRow = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(item)
        local h=rowHeight()
        local row=Create("Frame",{Name="Bind",Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,h-4),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,0),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,
            BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=15,Parent=list},{Corner(9)})
        local group=Create("CanvasGroup",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,GroupTransparency=1,ZIndex=15,Parent=row})
        local bar=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,.5),Position=UDim2.new(0,0,.5,0),Size=UDim2.new(0,3,0,0),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,
            BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=16,Parent=group},{Corner(2)})
        local dot=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(15,cfg.ShowTab and 12 or (h-4)/2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(6,6),
            BackgroundColor3=Theme.SubText,BackgroundTransparency=.4,ZIndex=17,Parent=group},{Corner(999)})
        local dotStroke=Stroke(Theme.Accent,2,1);dotStroke.Parent=dot
        local name=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(25,cfg.ShowTab and 4 or 0),Size=UDim2.new(1,-128,0,cfg.ShowTab and 17 or h-4),
            BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=item.Name,FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=12,TextColor3=Theme.Text,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=16,Parent=group})
        local tab=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(25,20),Size=UDim2.new(1,-128,0,13),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=item.Tab or "",
            FontFace=Fonts.Regular,TextSize=10,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            Visible=cfg.ShowTab,ZIndex=16,Parent=group})
        local right=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-4,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,20),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=16,Parent=group},{Create("UIListLayout",{FillDirection=Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
            HorizontalAlignment=Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right,VerticalAlignment=Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,Padding=UDim.new(0,5),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder})})
        local mode=Create("TextLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,16),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X,BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,Text="",
            FontFace=Fonts.Heavy,TextSize=9,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,LayoutOrder=1,ZIndex=17,Parent=right},
            {Corner(999),Create("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,6),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,6)})})
        local key=Create("TextLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,20),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X,BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,Text="",
            FontFace=Fonts.Heavy,TextSize=11,TextColor3=Theme.Text,LayoutOrder=2,ZIndex=17,Parent=right},
            {Corner(6),Create("UIPadding",{PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,8),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,8)}),Create("UISizeConstraint",{MinSize=Vector2.new(26,20)})})
        local keyStroke=Stroke(Theme.Stroke,1,.35);keyStroke.Parent=key
        -- keycap shading: a touch lighter on top, darker at the bottom
        Create("UIGradient",{Rotation=90,Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1),Color3.fromRGB(200,200,210)),Parent=key})
        local keyScale=Create("UIScale",{Parent=key})
        Tween(group,{GroupTransparency=0},.25)
        return {Row=row,Group=group,Bar=bar,Dot=dot,DotStroke=dotStroke,Name=name,Tab=tab,Mode=mode,Key=key,KeyStroke=keyStroke,KeyScale=keyScale,Item=item}
    end)
    local paintRow; paintRow = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(entry,item)
        entry.Item=item
        if entry.NameText~=item.Name then entry.NameText=item.Name;entry.Name.Text=item.Name end
        local tabText=item.Conflict and "Same key as another function" or (item.Tab or "")
        if entry.TabText~=tabText then entry.TabText=tabText;entry.Tab.Text=tabText end
        local keyText=BindName(item.Bind)
        if entry.KeyText~=keyText then entry.KeyText=keyText;entry.Key.Text=keyText end
        local modeText=item.Mode=="Hold" and "HOLD" or item.Mode=="Always" and "ALWAYS" or item.Mode=="Press" and "PRESS" or ""
        if entry.ModeText~=modeText then entry.ModeText=modeText;entry.Mode.Text=modeText;entry.Mode.Visible=modeText~=""end
        local accent=Theme.Accent
        local state=item.Toggle and (item.On and "on" or "off") or "press"
        if entry.Conflict~=item.Conflict then
            entry.Conflict=item.Conflict
            entry.Accent=nil
            entry.Tab.Text=item.Conflict and "Same key as another function" or (item.Tab or "")
            entry.TabText=entry.Tab.Text
            entry.Tab.TextColor3=item.Conflict and Theme.Danger or Theme.SubText
            entry.Tab.Visible=cfg.ShowTab
        end
        if entry.State~=state or entry.Accent~=accent then
            entry.State,entry.Accent=state,accent
            local on=state=="on"
            Tween(entry.Bar,{Size=UDim2.new(0,3,0,on and 18 or 0),BackgroundColor3=accent},.25,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
            Tween(entry.Row,{BackgroundTransparency=on and .86 or 1,BackgroundColor3=accent},.2)
            Tween(entry.Name,{TextColor3=state=="off" and Theme.SubText or Theme.Text},.2)
            if state=="press" then
                Tween(entry.Dot,{BackgroundTransparency=1},.2)
                entry.DotStroke.Color,entry.DotStroke.Thickness=Theme.SubText,1
                Tween(entry.DotStroke,{Transparency=.3},.2)
            else
                entry.DotStroke.Color,entry.DotStroke.Thickness=accent,3
                Tween(entry.Dot,{BackgroundColor3=on and accent or Theme.SubText,BackgroundTransparency=on and 0 or .45},.2)
                Tween(entry.DotStroke,{Transparency=on and .65 or 1},.25)
            end
            Tween(entry.Key,{BackgroundColor3=on and accent or Theme.Element,TextColor3=on and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Theme.Text},.2)
            Tween(entry.KeyStroke,{Transparency=on and 1 or (entry.Conflict and 0 or .35),Color=entry.Conflict and Theme.Danger or Theme.Stroke},.2)
            Tween(entry.Mode,{BackgroundColor3=on and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Theme.Element,TextColor3=on and accent or Theme.SubText,
                BackgroundTransparency=on and .15 or 0},.2)
        end
    end)
    local removeRow; removeRow = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(entry)
        Tween(entry.Group,{GroupTransparency=1},.2)
        Tween(entry.Row,{BackgroundTransparency=1},.2)
        task.delay(.22,function()entry.Row:Destroy()end)
    end)
    local function rebuildAll()
        for id,entry in pairs(rows)do entry.Row:Destroy();rows[id]=nil end
    end

    local lastHeight
    local refresh; refresh = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local items=collect()
        local shown={}
        for _,item in ipairs(items)do
            if not cfg.OnlyActive or item.On or not item.Toggle then table.insert(shown,item)end
        end
        local h=rowHeight()
        local seen={}
        for index,item in ipairs(shown)do
            local entry=rows[item.Id]
            if not entry then entry=makeRow(item);rows[item.Id]=entry end
            seen[item.Id]=true
            paintRow(entry,item)
            local y=(index-1)*h
            if entry.Y~=y then
                if entry.Y==nil then entry.Row.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,y)
                else Tween(entry.Row,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,y)},.3,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)end
                entry.Y=y
            end
        end
        for id,entry in pairs(rows)do if not seen[id]then rows[id]=nil;removeRow(entry)end end
        local active=0
        for _,item in ipairs(items)do if item.On then active+=1 end end
        countPill.Text=tostring(active>0 and active or #items)
        subtitle.Text=#items==0 and "Nothing bound yet" or (active>0 and (active.." active · "..#items.." bound") or (#items.." bound"))
        empty.Visible=#shown==0
        empty.Text=#items==0 and "Click the key chip next to any function to bind it. Right-click the chip for Hold / Toggle / Always."
            or "Nothing is on right now."
        local height=HEADER+14+(#shown>0 and #shown*h or 38)
        if height~=lastHeight then
            lastHeight=height
            Tween(frame,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(WIDTH,height)},.3,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            list.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,#shown*h)
        end
        local want=cfg.Enabled and not (cfg.HideEmpty and #shown==0)
        if want and not frame.Visible then
            -- small pop when the card appears
            scale.Scale=cfg.Scale/100*.94
            frame.Visible=true
            Tween(scale,{Scale=cfg.Scale/100},.25,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        elseif not want and frame.Visible then
            frame.Visible=false
        end
    end)
    local recolor; recolor = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        paintTint()
        titleLabel.TextColor3=Theme.Text
        subtitle.TextColor3=Theme.SubText
        empty.TextColor3=Theme.SubText
        divider.BackgroundColor3=Theme.Stroke
        badgeGlow.Color=Theme.Accent
        badge.BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent
        countPill.BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent
        countPill.TextColor3=Theme.Accent
        frameStroke.Color=Theme.Stroke
        for _,entry in pairs(rows)do entry.Accent=nil end
    end)

    -- pressing a bound key makes its row flash
    connect(UserInputService.InputBegan,function(input,processed)
        if processed or not frame.Visible then return end
        for _,entry in pairs(rows)do
            if entry.Item and BindMatches(entry.Item.Bind,input)then
                entry.Row.BackgroundTransparency=.55
                Tween(entry.Row,{BackgroundTransparency=entry.State=="on" and .86 or 1},.5)
                entry.KeyScale.Scale=1.18
                Tween(entry.KeyScale,{Scale=1},.35,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                if entry.State=="press" then
                    entry.Dot.BackgroundColor3,entry.Dot.BackgroundTransparency=Theme.Accent,0
                    Tween(entry.Dot,{BackgroundTransparency=1},.5)
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    local timer,modeTimer,lastAccent=0,0,nil
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        timer+=dt;modeTimer+=dt
        if modeTimer>=1 then modeTimer=0;pcall(applyModes)end
        if timer<.2 then return end
        timer=0
        if not cfg.Enabled then frame.Visible=false;return end
        if lastAccent~=Theme.Accent then lastAccent=Theme.Accent;recolor()end
        local ok,err=pcall(refresh)
        if not ok then warn("[CrackHub Keybinds] "..tostring(err))end
    end))

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ settings window (macOS style)
    local POPUP_W,POPUP_H,TOP=300,340,40
    local popup=Create("Frame",{Name="KeybindsSettings",Size=UDim2.fromOffset(POPUP_W,POPUP_H),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(40,100),Visible=false,
        BackgroundColor3=Theme.Background,BackgroundTransparency=.04,BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true,ZIndex=60,Parent=window.Gui},
        {Corner(12),Stroke(Theme.Stroke,1,.2)})
    local popupScale=Create("UIScale",{Parent=popup})
    local popupHeader=Create("TextButton",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,TOP),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,Active=true,ZIndex=61,Parent=popup})
    MakeDraggable(popupHeader,popup,connections)
    Create("TextLabel",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,TOP),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="Keybinds",FontFace=Fonts.Bold,TextSize=13,TextColor3=Theme.Text,ZIndex=62,Parent=popup})
    Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,TOP-1),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,1),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Stroke,BackgroundTransparency=.4,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=61,Parent=popup})
    local minimized=false
    local function closePopup()
        Tween(popupScale,{Scale=.94},.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In)
        task.delay(.12,function()popup.Visible=false end)
    end
    local lights=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,(TOP-14)/2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(58,14),BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=62,Parent=popup})
    local symbols={}
    for index,info in ipairs({
        {Color3.fromRGB(255,95,87),"x",closePopup},
        {Color3.fromRGB(254,188,46),"minus",function()minimized=not minimized;Tween(popup,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(POPUP_W,minimized and TOP or POPUP_H)},.28,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)end},
        {Color3.fromRGB(40,200,64),"plus",function()minimized=false;Tween(popup,{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(POPUP_W,POPUP_H)},.28,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)end},
    })do
        local dot=Create("TextButton",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset((index-1)*20,1),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(12,12),BackgroundColor3=info[1],Text="",
            AutoButtonColor=false,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=63,Parent=lights},{Corner(999),Stroke(Color3.new(0,0,0),1,.8)})
        local symbol=Create("ImageLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(2,2),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),BackgroundTransparency=1,ImageColor3=Color3.fromRGB(90,30,20),
            Visible=false,ZIndex=64,Parent=dot})
        if info[2]=="plus" then
            symbol.Image="rbxassetid://16898613699";symbol.ImageRectOffset=Vector2.new(257,918);symbol.ImageRectSize=Vector2.new(48,48)
        else ApplyIcon(symbol,info[2])end
        table.insert(symbols,symbol)
        connect(dot.Activated,info[3])
    end
    connect(lights.MouseEnter,function()for _,s in ipairs(symbols)do s.Visible=true end end)
    connect(lights.MouseLeave,function()for _,s in ipairs(symbols)do s.Visible=false end end)
    local holder=Create("ScrollingFrame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,TOP+6),Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-(TOP+14)),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,
        ScrollBarThickness=3,CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,ZIndex=62,Parent=popup},{List(5)})
    local controls=setmetatable({Holder=holder,Window=window},Container)
    local function set(key,apply)return function(value)cfg[key]=value;if apply then apply(value)end;save();lastHeight=nil end end
    controls:AddToggle({Name="Keybinds list",Default=cfg.Enabled,Bind=false,Callback=set("Enabled")})
    controls:AddToggle({Name="Only active",Default=cfg.OnlyActive,Bind=false,Callback=set("OnlyActive")})
    controls:AddToggle({Name="Show tab names",Default=cfg.ShowTab,Bind=false,Callback=set("ShowTab",rebuildAll)})
    controls:AddToggle({Name="Hide when empty",Default=cfg.HideEmpty,Bind=false,Callback=set("HideEmpty")})
    controls:AddSlider({Name="Transparency",Min=0,Max=70,Default=cfg.Opacity,Increment=1,Suffix="%",Bind=false,Callback=set("Opacity",function(v)fill.BackgroundTransparency=v/100 end)})
    controls:AddSlider({Name="Size",Min=70,Max=140,Default=cfg.Scale,Increment=5,Suffix="%",Bind=false,Callback=set("Scale",function(v)scale.Scale=v/100 end)})
    controls:AddButton({Name="Reset position",Bind=false,Callback=function()cfg.X,cfg.Y=-1,-1;save();place()end})
    for _,object in ipairs(holder:GetDescendants())do if object:IsA("GuiObject")then object.ZIndex=math.max(object.ZIndex,63)end end
    local function open(at)
        if at then
            local view=workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720)
            popup.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(at.X,4,math.max(4,view.X-POPUP_W-4)),math.clamp(at.Y,4,math.max(4,view.Y-POPUP_H-4)))
        end
        minimized=false
        popup.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(POPUP_W,POPUP_H)
        popupScale.Scale=.94
        popup.Visible=true
        Tween(popupScale,{Scale=1},.22,Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
    end
    window.OpenKeybindsSettings=open
    connect(header.MouseButton2Click,function()open(UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()-GuiService:GetGuiInset())end)

    recolor()
    pcall(applyModes)
    pcall(refresh)
    connect(window.Gui.Destroying,function()
        alive=false
        for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end
    end)
    return {Frame=frame,Open=open,Settings=cfg}
end

CrackHub.RockInspect = function(ctx)
    -- Rock · F inspects.
    -- First person: a pair of view-model arms in front of the camera (like a shooter), so both hands are always on screen.
    -- Third person: your real arms are posed every frame by a two-bone IK written into Motor6D.Transform, so the hands
    -- really close on the bat handle. Everything is local (only you see it) and nothing here ever touches another player.
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local LocalPlayer = ctx.Player
    local part, play, folder = ctx.Part, ctx.Play, ctx.Folder
    local GRAVITY = workspace.Gravity
    local V3 = Vector3.new
    local BIND = "CrackHubRockInspect"
    local api = {TimeScale = 1}

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- small math
    local smooth; smooth = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(x) x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1) return x*x*(3 - 2*x) end)
    local function easeIn(x) x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1) return x*x*x end
    local function easeOut(x) x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1) return 1 - (1 - x)^3 end
    local function linear(x) return math.clamp(x, 0, 1) end
    local bump; bump = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(t, c, w)
        local d = math.abs(t - c)
        if d >= w then return 0 end
        return .5 + .5*math.cos(d/w*math.pi)
    end)
    local ramp; ramp = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(t, a, b, c, d)
        if t <= a or t >= d then return 0 end
        if t < b then return smooth((t - a)/(b - a)) end
        if t > c then return 1 - smooth((t - c)/(d - c)) end
        return 1
    end)
    -- the rotation that turns unit vector a onto unit vector b the short way
    local function arc(a, b)
        local d = a:Dot(b)
        if d > .99999 then return CFrame.identity end
        if d < -.99999 then
            local axis = a:Cross(Vector3.xAxis)
            if axis.Magnitude < .01 then axis = a:Cross(Vector3.zAxis) end
            return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis.Unit, math.pi)
        end
        return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(a:Cross(b).Unit, math.acos(d))
    end
    local slerp; slerp = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a, b, t)
        local d = math.clamp(a:Dot(b), -1, 1)
        if d > .9995 or d < -.9995 then
            local m = a:Lerp(b, t)
            return m.Magnitude > 1e-3 and m.Unit or a
        end
        local th = math.acos(d)
        return (a*math.sin((1 - t)*th) + b*math.sin(t*th))/math.sin(th)
    end)
    local same; same = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a, b)
        return (a.Position - b.Position).Magnitude < 1e-4 and a.LookVector:Dot(b.LookVector) > .99999 and a.UpVector:Dot(b.UpVector) > .99999
    end)
    local scaled; scaled = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(cf, k) return CFrame.new(cf.Position*k)*cf.Rotation end)
    local U3; U3 = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(x, y, z) return V3(x, y, z).Unit end)

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- two-bone IK
    -- shoulder S, target T, bone lengths a/b, pole = where the elbow should point; returns the elbow and the reachable target
    local function solve(S, T, a, b, pole)
        local v = T - S
        local d = v.Magnitude
        local dir = d > 1e-4 and v/d or V3(0, -1, 0)
        d = math.clamp(d, math.abs(a - b) + .02, a + b - .005)
        local cosA = math.clamp((a*a + d*d - b*b)/(2*a*d), -1, 1)
        local p = pole - dir*pole:Dot(dir)
        if p.Magnitude < 1e-3 then p = V3(0, -1, 0) + dir*dir.Y end
        if p.Magnitude < 1e-3 then p = V3(1, 0, 0) - dir*dir.X end
        p = p.Unit
        return S + dir*(a*cosA) + p*(a*math.sqrt(1 - cosA*cosA)), S + dir*d
    end
    -- one arm read from the character's joints (R15: shoulder/elbow/wrist, R6: one shoulder); k scales it (view-model arms)
    local chainOf; chainOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(char, side, k)
        k = k or 1
        local up = char:FindFirstChild(side.."UpperArm")
        if up then
            local lo, ha = char:FindFirstChild(side.."LowerArm"), char:FindFirstChild(side.."Hand")
            local sh = up:FindFirstChild(side.."Shoulder")
            local el = lo and lo:FindFirstChild(side.."Elbow")
            local wr = ha and ha:FindFirstChild(side.."Wrist")
            if not (lo and ha and sh and el) then return nil end
            if not (sh:IsA("Motor6D") and el:IsA("Motor6D")) then return nil end
            if wr and not wr:IsA("Motor6D") then wr = nil end
            local grip = ha:FindFirstChild(side.."GripAttachment")
            local c = {R15 = true, sh = sh, el = el, wr = wr, Parts = {up, lo, ha}}
            c.elC0, c.elC1 = scaled(el.C0, k), scaled(el.C1, k)
            if wr then
                c.wrC0, c.wrC1 = scaled(wr.C0, k), scaled(wr.C1, k)
            else
                c.wrC0, c.wrC1 = scaled(lo.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(ha.CFrame), k), CFrame.identity
            end
            c.pS, c.pEu, c.pEl = sh.C1.Position*k, c.elC0.Position, c.elC1.Position
            c.pG = (grip and grip:IsA("Attachment") and grip.Position or V3(0, -ha.Size.Y*.5, 0))*k
            local g = (c.wrC0*c.wrC1:Inverse())*c.pG
            c.a, c.b = (c.pEu - c.pS).Magnitude, (g - c.pEl).Magnitude
            if c.a < .05 or c.b < .05 then return nil end
            c.boneU, c.boneL = (c.pEu - c.pS).Unit, (g - c.pEl).Unit
            c.Thick = math.min(ha.Size.X, ha.Size.Z)*k
            return c
        end
        local arm, torso = char:FindFirstChild(side.." Arm"), char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        local sh = torso and torso:FindFirstChild(side.." Shoulder")
        if not (arm and sh and sh:IsA("Motor6D")) then return nil end
        local grip = arm:FindFirstChild(side.."GripAttachment")
        local c = {R15 = false, sh = sh, Parts = {arm}}
        c.pS = sh.C1.Position*k
        c.pH = (grip and grip:IsA("Attachment") and grip.Position or V3(0, -arm.Size.Y*.5, 0))*k
        c.len = (c.pH - c.pS).Magnitude
        if c.len < .05 then return nil end
        c.bone = (c.pH - c.pS).Unit
        c.Thick = math.min(arm.Size.X, arm.Size.Z)*k
        return c
    end)
    -- the arm's parts so its grip reaches T from the shoulder S; rest = the upper arm's resting rotation in this space
    local function poseArm(c, rest, S, T, pole, roll)
        if c.R15 then
            local E, Tc = solve(S, T, c.a, c.b, pole)
            local R = arc(rest:VectorToWorldSpace(c.boneU), (E - S).Unit)*rest
            local U = CFrame.new(S)*R*CFrame.new(-c.pS)
            local L0 = U*c.elC0*c.elC1:Inverse()
            local Ep = U*c.pEu
            local R2 = arc(L0:VectorToWorldSpace(c.boneL), (Tc - Ep).Unit)*L0.Rotation
            local L = CFrame.new(Ep)*R2*CFrame.new(-c.pEl)
            local H = L*c.wrC0*CFrame.Angles(0, roll or 0, 0)*c.wrC1:Inverse()
            return {U, L, H}, H*c.pG
        end
        local v = T - S
        local dir = v.Magnitude > 1e-4 and v.Unit or V3(0, 0, -1)
        local R = arc(rest:VectorToWorldSpace(c.bone), dir)*rest
        if roll and roll ~= 0 then R = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(dir, roll)*R end
        local A = CFrame.new(S)*R*CFrame.new(-c.pS)
        return {A}, A*c.pH
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- your real character (third person)
    local written, seen = {}, {}
    -- what the game's animation put on this joint this frame (ignores the value we wrote ourselves last frame)
    local animValue; animValue = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(m)
        local cur = m.Transform
        local w = written[m]
        if w and same(cur, w) then return seen[m] or CFrame.identity end
        seen[m] = cur
        return cur
    end)
    local write; write = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(m, cf)
        m.Transform = cf
        written[m] = m.Transform
    end)
    local releaseAll; releaseAll = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        for m in pairs(written) do pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() m.Transform = seen[m] or CFrame.identity end)) end
        table.clear(written)
        table.clear(seen)
    end)
    -- the Transform that turns a joint's Part1 by `angle` around its Part0's vertical axis
    local yawT; yawT = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(m, angle)
        if math.abs(angle) < 1e-5 then return CFrame.identity end
        return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(m.C0.Rotation:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.yAxis), angle)
    end)
    local rigOf; rigOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(char)
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return nil, "no HumanoidRootPart" end
        local rig = {char = char, root = root}
        local ut = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        if ut then
            local lt = char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
            rig.R15 = true
            rig.torso = ut
            local rj = lt and lt:FindFirstChild("Root")
            local wa = ut:FindFirstChild("Waist")
            if rj and wa and rj:IsA("Motor6D") and wa:IsA("Motor6D") then rig.rootJ, rig.waist = rj, wa end
        else
            local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            if not torso then return nil, "no Torso" end
            rig.torso = torso
            local rj = root:FindFirstChild("RootJoint") or root:FindFirstChild("Root Hip")
            if rj and rj:IsA("Motor6D") and rj.Part1 == torso then
                rig.rootJ = rj
                rig.hips = {torso:FindFirstChild("Right Hip"), torso:FindFirstChild("Left Hip")}
            end
        end
        rig.R, rig.L = chainOf(char, "Right"), chainOf(char, "Left")
        if not rig.R then return nil, "right arm joints not found" end
        if not rig.L then return nil, "left arm joints not found" end
        return rig
    end)

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- shared: hands, bat and rock from one pose
    -- the bat frame: origin at the knob, -Z toward the barrel (same as newBat). Right hand on top, left hand under it.
    local GRIP_R, GRIP_L, SWEET = CFrame.new(0, 0, -.62), CFrame.new(0, 0, -.28), CFrame.new(0, 0, -2.35)
    local batFrame; batFrame = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(H, D)
        local origin = H - D*.45
        return CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + D, math.abs(D.Y) > .97 and Vector3.zAxis or Vector3.yAxis)
    end)
    -- st is in "chest space" (third-person numbers); map turns it into the space we pose in. arm(side,T,pole,roll) -> grip
    -- fit (R6 only): moves the bat so both straight arms can reach the handle exactly
    local resolve; resolve = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(st, arm, map, fit)
        local bat, rock
        if st.bat then
            bat = map.CF(st.bat)
            local tR = (bat*GRIP_R).Position
            if fit and (st.freeL or 0) < 1 then
                local nR = tR:Lerp(fit(tR, (bat*GRIP_L).Position), 1 - (st.freeL or 0))
                bat = bat + (nR - tR)
                tR = nR
            end
            local gR = arm("R", tR, map.V(st.poleR or V3(1, -.6, .6)), st.rollR)
            bat = bat + (gR - tR)
            local tL = (bat*GRIP_L).Position
            if st.freeL and st.freeL > 0 and st.L then tL = tL:Lerp(map.P(st.L), st.freeL) end
            arm("L", tL, map.V(st.poleL or V3(-1, -.6, .6)), st.rollL)
        else
            local gR = st.R and arm("R", map.P(st.R), map.V(st.poleR or V3(1, -.6, .6)), st.rollR)
            local gL = st.L and arm("L", map.P(st.L), map.V(st.poleL or V3(-1, -.6, .6)), st.rollL)
            local lift = V3(0, map.RockLift + (st.lift or 0)*map.S, 0)
            local rot = st.rockRot or CFrame.identity
            if st.rockOn then
                local g = st.rockOn == "R" and gR or gL
                if g then rock = CFrame.new(g + lift)*rot end
            elseif st.fly then
                local g0, g1 = gR, gL
                if st.fly.from == "L" then g0, g1 = gL, gR end
                if g0 and g1 then
                    local a = st.fly.a
                    rock = CFrame.new(g0:Lerp(g1, a) + lift + V3(0, math.sin(a*math.pi)*st.fly.h*map.S, 0))*rot
                end
            end
        end
        return bat, rock
    end)

    -- third person: pose the real joints (shoulder/elbow/wrist + a waist twist), remember where the bat and rock go
    local tp = {}
    local solveTP; solveTP = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(rig, st, map)
        local w = st.w or 0
        local rj = rig.rootJ
        local twist = (st.twist or 0)*w
        local torso0, torso1
        if not rj then
            torso0 = rig.root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(rig.torso.CFrame)
            torso1 = torso0
        elseif rig.R15 then
            local rootT = animValue(rj)
            local wa = rig.waist
            local wT = animValue(wa)
            local LT = rj.C0*rootT*rj.C1:Inverse()
            torso0 = LT*wa.C0*wT*wa.C1:Inverse()
            local tw = yawT(wa, twist)*wT
            torso1 = LT*wa.C0*tw*wa.C1:Inverse()
            write(wa, tw)
        else
            -- R6 turns the whole upper body on the root joint, the legs turn back so the feet stay put
            local rootT = animValue(rj)
            torso0 = rj.C0*rootT*rj.C1:Inverse()
            local tw = yawT(rj, twist)*rootT
            torso1 = rj.C0*tw*rj.C1:Inverse()
            write(rj, tw)
            for i = 1, 2 do
                local hip = rig.hips[i]
                if hip and hip:IsA("Motor6D") then
                    local back = yawT(hip, -twist)
                    write(hip, back*animValue(hip))
                end
            end
        end
        local sR = torso0*rig.R.sh.C0.Position
        local sL = torso0*rig.L.sh.C0.Position
        local chest = CFrame.new((sR + sL)*.5)
        tp.Chest = chest
        local inv = torso1:Inverse()
        local function arm(side, target, pole, roll)
            local c = rig[side]
            local S = torso1*c.sh.C0.Position
            local rest = (torso1*c.sh.C0*c.sh.C1:Inverse()).Rotation
            local parts = poseArm(c, rest, S, chest*target, pole, roll)
            local G
            if c.R15 then
                local U, L, H = inv*parts[1], inv*parts[2], inv*parts[3]
                local tS = animValue(c.sh):Lerp(c.sh.C0:Inverse()*U*c.sh.C1, w)
                local tE = animValue(c.el):Lerp(c.el.C0:Inverse()*U:Inverse()*L*c.el.C1, w)
                write(c.sh, tS)
                write(c.el, tE)
                local tW = CFrame.identity
                if c.wr then
                    tW = animValue(c.wr):Lerp(c.wr.C0:Inverse()*L:Inverse()*H*c.wr.C1, w)
                    write(c.wr, tW)
                end
                -- where the hand really is (also while blending in/out of the game's animation)
                local U2 = c.sh.C0*tS*c.sh.C1:Inverse()
                local L2 = U2*c.el.C0*tE*c.el.C1:Inverse()
                G = torso1*((L2*c.wrC0*tW*c.wrC1:Inverse())*c.pG)
            else
                local tS = animValue(c.sh):Lerp(c.sh.C0:Inverse()*(inv*parts[1])*c.sh.C1, w)
                write(c.sh, tS)
                G = torso1*((c.sh.C0*tS*c.sh.C1:Inverse())*c.pH)
            end
            return chest:PointToObjectSpace(G)
        end
        -- R6: the right grip has to sit on the sphere the right arm can reach AND keep the left grip on the left arm's sphere
        local fit
        if not rig.R15 then
            local SR, SL = chest:PointToObjectSpace(torso1*rig.R.sh.C0.Position), chest:PointToObjectSpace(torso1*rig.L.sh.C0.Position)
            local r1, r2 = rig.R.len, rig.L.len
            fit = function(tR, tL)
                local c2 = SL - (tL - tR)
                local d = c2 - SR
                local dist = d.Magnitude
                if dist < 1e-3 or dist > r1 + r2 or dist < math.abs(r1 - r2) then return tR end
                local n = d/dist
                local a = (r1*r1 - r2*r2 + dist*dist)/(2*dist)
                local m = SR + n*a
                local q = tR - n*(tR - m):Dot(n) - m
                if q.Magnitude < 1e-4 then return tR end
                return m + q.Unit*math.sqrt(math.max(0, r1*r1 - a*a))
            end
        end
        tp.Bat, tp.Rock = resolve(st, arm, map, fit)
    end)

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- first person: view-model arms
    local ANCHOR = {R = V3(1.2, -1.55, .35), L = V3(-1.2, -1.55, .35)}
    local buildView; buildView = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(char)
        local probe = char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm") or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
        if not probe then return nil end
        local k = math.clamp(.5/math.max(.2, math.min(probe.Size.X, probe.Size.Z)), .35, .8)
        local model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name = "CrackHubViewArms"
        -- a humanoid + your shirt so the sleeves look like yours
        local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid")
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            hum.AutomaticScalingEnabled = false
            hum.RequiresNeck = false
            hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
            hum.EvaluateStateMachine = false
            hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
            hum.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
            hum.RigType = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") and Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 or Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6
        end))
        hum.Parent = model
        local shirt = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
        if shirt then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() shirt.Archivable = true local s = shirt:Clone() s.Parent = model end)) end
        local vm = {Model = model, K = k, All = {}}
        for _, side in ipairs({"R", "L"}) do
            local c = chainOf(char, side == "R" and "Right" or "Left", k)
            if not c then model:Destroy() return nil end
            c.Rest = (c.sh.C0*c.sh.C1:Inverse()).Rotation
            local clones = {}
            for i, src in ipairs(c.Parts) do
                local ok, cl = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() src.Archivable = true return src:Clone() end))
                if not ok or not cl then model:Destroy() return nil end
                for _, d in ipairs(cl:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("Constraint") or d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("Sound") or d:IsA("ValueBase") or d:IsA("WrapTarget") or d:IsA("WrapLayer") then
                        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() d:Destroy() end))
                    end
                end
                cl.Anchored, cl.CanCollide, cl.CanQuery, cl.CanTouch, cl.CastShadow, cl.Massless = true, false, false, false, false, true
                cl.Size = src.Size*k
                cl.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                cl.Parent = model
                clones[i] = cl
                table.insert(vm.All, cl)
            end
            c.Parts = clones
            vm[side] = c
        end
        model.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
        return vm
    end)
    -- arm(side, T, pole, roll) for the view-model: the shoulder hides off-screen in a bottom corner, the hand lands on T
    local viewArm; viewArm = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(vm, eye, w)
        local drop = V3(0, -1.5, .6)*(1 - w)
        return function(side, T, pole, roll)
            local c = vm[side]
            T = T + drop
            local toA = ANCHOR[side] - T
            local S = T + (toA.Magnitude > 1e-3 and toA.Unit or V3(0, -1, 0))*(c.R15 and (c.a + c.b)*.94 or c.len)
            local parts, G = poseArm(c, c.Rest, S, T, pole, roll)
            for i, p in ipairs(c.Parts) do
                p.CFrame = eye*parts[i]
                p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
            end
            return G
        end
    end)
    local firstPerson; firstPerson = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(char)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not (cam and head) then return false end
        return (cam.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude < 1.4 or head.LocalTransparencyModifier > .9
    end)

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- the three animations (chest space, in studs; -Z = forward)
    local A1, A2 = 2.7, 3.25
    local FLIPS = {.8, 1.7}
    local sample1; sample1 = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(t, st)
        -- 1: the stone spins on your palm, you flip it up twice
        st.w = ramp(t, 0, .25, A1 - .3, A1)
        local lift, dip = 0, 0
        for _, f in ipairs(FLIPS) do
            local u = (t - f)/.55
            if u > 0 and u < 1 then lift = math.max(lift, math.sin(u*math.pi)) end
            dip += .09*bump(t, f - .05, .1) + .1*bump(t, f + .6, .12)
        end
        st.R = V3(.55, -.22 + math.sin(t*2.6)*.03 - dip, -.92)
        st.poleR = V3(1, -.7, .5)
        st.rollR = math.sin(t*2.1)*.35
        st.rockOn = "R"
        st.lift = lift*1.05
        st.rockRot = CFrame.Angles(t*2.3 + lift*7, t*4.4 + lift*11, math.sin(t*1.7)*.45)
    end)
    local TOSS = {{.4, .9, "R", "L"}, {1.02, 1.52, "L", "R"}, {1.64, 2.14, "R", "L"}, {2.26, 2.78, "L", "R"}}
    local sample2; sample2 = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(t, st)
        -- 2: hand to hand, both hands in front of you
        st.w = ramp(t, 0, .25, A2 - .3, A2)
        local yR, yL, spin = 0, 0, 0
        st.rockOn = "R"
        for i, f in ipairs(TOSS) do
            local t0, t1, from = f[1], f[2], f[3]
            local a = (t - t0)/(t1 - t0)
            if a >= 0 and a <= 1 then
                st.rockOn = nil
                st.fly = {from = from, a = a, h = 1.25}
                spin = i + a
            elseif t > t1 then
                st.rockOn = f[4]
                spin = i + 1
            end
            local throwY = -.1*bump(t, t0 - .07, .09) + .13*bump(t, t0 + .03, .08)
            local catchY = .04*bump(t, t1 - .06, .07) - .13*bump(t, t1 + .07, .12)
            if from == "R" then
                yR += throwY
                yL += catchY
            else
                yL += throwY
                yR += catchY
            end
        end
        st.R = V3(.5, -.25 + yR, -.95)
        st.L = V3(-.5, -.25 + yL, -.95)
        st.poleR, st.poleL = V3(1, -.8, .4), V3(-1, -.8, .4)
        st.rockRot = CFrame.Angles(spin*3.4, spin*2.1, spin*.7)
    end)
    -- 3: keyframes {time, hands (middle of the grip), bat direction knob->barrel, body twist, easing}
    local keys3; keys3 = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(tc)

    local keys3R6; keys3R6 = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(tc)

            {.32, V3(.25, -.5, -1.12), U3(.15, .95, -.25), 0, smooth},

    local track; track = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(keys, t)
        if t <= keys[1][1] then
            local k = keys[1]
            return k[2], k[3], k[4]
        end
        for i = 1, #keys - 1 do
            local k0, k1 = keys[i], keys[i + 1]
            if t <= k1[1] then
                local a = (k1[5] or smooth)((t - k0[1])/math.max(1e-4, k1[1] - k0[1]))
                return k0[2]:Lerp(k1[2], a), slerp(k0[3], k1[3], a), k0[4] + (k1[4] - k0[4])*a
            end
        end
        local k = keys[#keys]
        return k[2], k[3], k[4]
    end)
    local sample3; sample3 = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(t, st, run, mode)
        local r6 = mode == "tp" and run.R6
        local H, D, twist = track(r6 and run.KeysR6 or run.Keys, t)
        -- a little waggle while you wait for the rock
        local wag = ramp(t, .72, .9, run.Tc - .5, run.Tc - .42)
        if wag > 0 then D = (D + V3(math.sin(t*5.5)*.06, 0, math.cos(t*4.3)*.05)*wag).Unit end
        local w = run.W
        local turn = r6 and CFrame.Angles(0, twist*w, 0) or nil
        if turn then H = turn*H end
        st.bat = batFrame(H, D)
        st.twist = twist
        st.w = w
        st.L = turn and turn*V3(-.55, -.6, -.9) or (mode == "fp" and V3(-.5, -.3, -.8) or V3(-.55, -.55, -.75))
        st.freeL = 1 - smooth((t - .3)/.32)   -- the left hand comes over and closes on the handle
        st.poleR, st.poleL = V3(1, -.6, .6), V3(-1, -.7, .5)
    end)

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- effects: flash, glint, tracer, shards that run down walls
    local bits = {}
    local fadeOut; fadeOut = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(p, time)
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(time), {Transparency = 1}):Play() end))
        task.delay(time + .05, function() pcall(function() p:Destroy() end) end)
    end)
    local segment; segment = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a, b, color)
