        return part({Name = "Tracer", Size = V3(.08, .08, math.max(.05, (b - a).Magnitude)), Color = color, Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
            Transparency = .1, CastShadow = false, CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(a:Lerp(b, .5), b), Parent = folder})
    end)
    local flash; flash = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(at, size)
        local f = part({Name = "Flash", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = V3(size, size, size)*.4, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 210),
            Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Transparency = .05, CastShadow = false, CFrame = CFrame.new(at), Parent = folder})
        local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
        light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 170)
        light.Range = 14
        light.Brightness = 4
        light.Parent = f
        table.insert(bits, {Part = f, Static = true, Grow = 4, Fade = .05, Life = .3, Age = 0})
    end)
    local glint; glint = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(at, size)
        local g = part({Name = "Glint", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = V3(.3, .3, .3)*size, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 250, 225),
            Material = Enum.Material.Neon, Transparency = .1, CastShadow = false, CFrame = CFrame.new(at), Parent = folder})
        table.insert(bits, {Part = g, Static = true, Grow = 3, Fade = .1, Life = .35, Age = 0})
        for i = 1, 2 do
            local ray = part({Name = "GlintRay", Size = V3(.05, .05, 1.6)*size, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 200), Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
                Transparency = .2, CastShadow = false, CFrame = CFrame.new(at)*CFrame.Angles(0, 0, i*math.pi/2)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2, 0, 0), Parent = folder})
            table.insert(bits, {Part = ray, Static = true, Fade = .2, Life = .35, Age = 0})
        end
    end)
    local crackMark; crackMark = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(at, n)
        local base = CFrame.lookAt(at + n*.03, at + n*2)
        local disc = part({Name = "Mark", Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Size = V3(.04, 1.3, 1.3), Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 56, 52),
            Material = Enum.Material.Slate, Transparency = .35, CastShadow = false, CFrame = base*CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), Parent = folder})
        table.insert(bits, {Part = disc, Static = true, Fade = .35, Life = 3, Age = 0})
        for i = 1, 6 do
            local a = i/6*math.pi*2 + math.random()*.6
            local len = .6 + math.random()*.7
            local dir = base:VectorToWorldSpace(V3(math.cos(a), math.sin(a), 0))
            local crack = part({Name = "Crack", Size = V3(.05, .03, len), Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 32, 30), Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
                CastShadow = false, CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(at + n*.05 + dir*len*.5, at + n*.05 + dir*len, n), Parent = folder})
            table.insert(bits, {Part = crack, Static = true, Fade = 0, Life = 3, Age = 0})
        end
    end)
    -- the rock bursts: chips bounce off and rain down, grit sticks to the wall and runs down it, everything melts away
    local shatterOn; shatterOn = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(at, normal, vel)
        local n = normal or V3(0, 1, 0)
        local v = vel.Magnitude > .1 and vel.Unit or -n
        local refl = v - 2*v:Dot(n)*n
        refl = refl.Magnitude > .01 and refl.Unit or n
        local floor = ctx.WorldRay(at + n*.3, V3(0, -40, 0))
        local floorY = floor and floor.Position.Y or at.Y - 30
        flash(at, 1.6)
        if normal then crackMark(at, n) end
        for i = 1, 26 do
            local s = .07 + math.random()*.2
            local chip = part({Name = "Shard", Size = V3(s, s*.7, s*1.25), Color = Color3.fromRGB(110 + math.random(-20, 20), 104 + math.random(-15, 15), 97 + math.random(-15, 15)),
                Material = Enum.Material.Slate, CFrame = CFrame.new(at + n*.2)*CFrame.Angles(math.random()*6, math.random()*6, math.random()*6), Parent = folder})
            local dir = refl*.7 + n*.6 + V3(math.random() - .5, math.random() - .5, math.random() - .5)*1.6
            dir = dir.Magnitude > .01 and dir.Unit or n
            table.insert(bits, {Part = chip, Vel = dir*(5 + math.random()*10), Life = 2.4 + math.random()*.8, Age = 0, Size = chip.Size,
                Spin = V3(math.random(), math.random(), math.random())*14, Floor = floorY + s*.35})
        end
        if normal and math.abs(n.Y) < .6 then
            local right = n:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit
            local upW = right:Cross(n).Unit
            for i = 1, 16 do
                local s = .05 + math.random()*.09
                local r, a = math.random()*.7, math.random()*math.pi*2
                local pos = at + right*math.cos(a)*r + upW*math.sin(a)*r + n*s*.4
                local grit = part({Name = "Grit", Size = V3(s, s, s*.6), Color = Color3.fromRGB(100 + math.random(-15, 15), 95 + math.random(-10, 10), 90),
                    Material = Enum.Material.Slate, CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + n)*CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.random()*6), Parent = folder})
                table.insert(bits, {Part = grit, Vel = -upW*(.2 + math.random()*.4), Slide = -upW*(.35 + math.random()*.5), Stuck = true,
                    Life = 1.8 + math.random()*1.2, Age = 0, Size = grit.Size, Floor = floorY + s*.3})
            end
        end
        for i = 1, 7 do
            local s = .5 + math.random()*.6
            local dust = part({Name = "Dust", Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball, Size = V3(s, s, s), Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 140, 128), Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
                Transparency = .45, CastShadow = false, CFrame = CFrame.new(at + n*.3), Parent = folder})
            table.insert(bits, {Part = dust, Vel = n*2 + refl + V3(math.random() - .5, math.random()*.5, math.random() - .5)*2, Life = 1.2, Age = 0,
                Grow = 1.6, Fade = .45, Drag = 2.5, NoGravity = true, Size = dust.Size})
        end
    end)
    local hb = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        if #bits == 0 then return end
        local sdt = dt*api.TimeScale
        for i = #bits, 1, -1 do
            local b = bits[i]
            local p = b.Part
            b.Age += sdt
            if b.Age >= b.Life or not p.Parent then
                pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() p:Destroy() end))
                table.remove(bits, i)
            else
                local life = b.Age/b.Life
                if b.Static then
                    if b.Grow then p.Size = p.Size*(1 + b.Grow*sdt) end
                    p.Transparency = b.Fade + (1 - b.Fade)*life
                else
                    if b.Stuck then
                        b.Vel = b.Vel:Lerp(b.Slide, math.min(1, sdt*2))
                    elseif not b.NoGravity then
                        b.Vel -= V3(0, GRAVITY*.35*sdt, 0)
                    end
                    if b.Drag then b.Vel *= math.max(0, 1 - b.Drag*sdt) end
                    local pos = p.Position + b.Vel*sdt
                    if b.Floor and pos.Y < b.Floor then
                        pos = V3(pos.X, b.Floor, pos.Z)
                        if b.Stuck then
                            b.Vel, b.Slide = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
                        else
                            b.Vel = V3(b.Vel.X*.45, math.abs(b.Vel.Y)*.25, b.Vel.Z*.45)
                            if b.Vel.Magnitude < .6 then
                                b.Vel = Vector3.zero
                                b.Spin = nil
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local rot = b.Spin and CFrame.Angles(b.Spin.X*sdt, b.Spin.Y*sdt, b.Spin.Z*sdt) or CFrame.identity
                    p.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)*(p.CFrame - p.Position)*rot
                    if b.Grow then p.Size = p.Size*(1 + b.Grow*sdt) end
                    if b.Fade then
                        p.Transparency = b.Fade + (1 - b.Fade)*life
                    elseif life > .55 then
                        local m = (life - .55)/.45
                        p.Transparency = m
                        p.Size = b.Size*(1 - .7*m)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end))
    -- a ray that only stops on solid things you can see (skips invisible walls and decorations you walk through)
    local solidRay; solidRay = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(from, dir)
        local origin, rest = from, dir
        for _ = 1, 6 do
            local hit, player, character = ctx.CombatRay(origin, rest)
            if not hit then return nil end
            if player then return hit, player, character end
            local inst = hit.Instance
            if inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst.Transparency < .9 and inst.CanCollide then return hit end
            local used = (hit.Position - origin).Magnitude + .05
            local total = rest.Magnitude
            if used >= total then return nil end
            origin = hit.Position + rest.Unit*.05
            rest = rest.Unit*(total - used)
        end
        return nil
    end)

    local IDENT = {P = function(v) return v end, V = function(v) return v end, CF = function(cf) return cf end, S = 1, RockLift = .75}
    local FPMAP = {
        P = function(v) return V3(v.X*.9, v.Y*.9 - .45, v.Z*.9 - .6) end,
        V = function(v) return v*.9 end,
        CF = function(cf) local p = cf.Position return CFrame.new(p.X*.9, p.Y*.9 - .45, p.Z*.9 - .6)*cf.Rotation end,
        S = .9, RockLift = .5,
    }
    -- anim 3 timing: the rock shows up, falls along its line, meets the bat at TC
    local T_APPEAR, T_LAUNCH, FLIGHT, TC = .5, .72, 1.05, 1.77

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- run one inspect (blocks until it ends)
    local notify; notify = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(text)
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "CrackHub · Rock", Text = text, Duration = 6})
        end))
    end)
    api.Notify = notify
    api.Run = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(which, me, stillOk)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root or not cam then
            notify("No character yet")
            return
        end
        -- if your arms cannot be posed (unusual rig) the animation still plays: rock / bat move on their own
        local okRig, rig, why = pcall(rigOf, char)
        if not okRig then rig, why = nil, rig end
        if not rig and not api.Told then
            api.Told = true
            notify("Arms: "..tostring(why or "unknown rig").." — playing without them")
        end
        local which3 = which == 3
        local run = {Clock = 0, W = 0, R6 = rig ~= nil and not rig.R15, BatAlpha = 0, Tc = TC}
        local props, tracers, fired = {}, {}, {}
        local st = {}
        local done, aborted = false, false
        local okView, vm = pcall(buildView, char)
        if not okView then
            warn("[CrackHub Rock] view arms: "..tostring(vm))
            vm = nil
        end
        -- how high the stone sits above the hand: depends on how thick your hand is
        local tpMap = table.clone(IDENT)
        tpMap.RockLift = rig and rig.R.Thick*.5 + .33 or .75
        local fpMap = table.clone(FPMAP)
        if vm then fpMap.RockLift = vm.R.Thick*.5 + .22 end
        if which3 then
            props.Bat = ctx.NewBat()
            props.Bat.Alpha(0)
            run.Keys, run.KeysR6 = keys3(TC), keys3R6(TC)
        else
            props.RockTP = ctx.NewRock(.75, folder)
            props.RockFP = ctx.NewRock(.5, folder)
            props.RockTP.Hide(true)
            props.RockFP.Hide(true)
        end
        if not root.Parent then
            for _, obj in pairs(props) do pcall(obj.Destroy) end
            if vm then vm.Model:Destroy() end
            return
        end
        local sampleAt; sampleAt = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(t, mode)
            table.clear(st)
            if which == 1 then sample1(t, st) elseif which == 2 then sample2(t, st) else sample3(t, st, run, mode) end
            return st
        end)
        tp.Chest, tp.Bat, tp.Rock = nil, nil, nil

        -- camera for anim 3: first person keeps your eyes (no mouse turning while it plays), third person goes over the shoulder
        local saved = {Type = cam.CameraType, FOV = cam.FieldOfView, Offset = root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(cam.CFrame)}
        local fp3 = which3 and vm ~= nil and firstPerson(char)
        local eyeOff, eyeRot
        if which3 then
            if fp3 then
                eyeOff = root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(cam.CFrame.Position)
                local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
                local flat = V3(look.X, 0, look.Z)
                flat = flat.Magnitude > .1 and flat.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector
                local pitch = math.clamp(math.asin(math.clamp(look.Y, -1, 1)), -.2, .1)
                eyeRot = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, flat)*CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
            end
            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        end
        local camCF = cam.CFrame
        local eye; eye = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return CFrame.new(root.CFrame*eyeOff)*eyeRot end)
        local chestWorld; chestWorld = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return root.CFrame*(tp.Chest or CFrame.new(0, run.R6 and .5 or 1.5, 0)) end)
        local poseWorld; poseWorld = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() if fp3 then return eye() end return chestWorld() end)
        local contactLocal
        if which3 then
            local k = run.Keys[6]
            if fp3 then
                contactLocal = FPMAP.CF(batFrame(k[2], k[3]))*SWEET
            elseif run.R6 then
                local k6 = run.KeysR6[6]
                contactLocal = batFrame(CFrame.Angles(0, k6[4], 0)*k6[2], k6[3])*SWEET
            else
                contactLocal = batFrame(k[2], k[3])*SWEET
            end
        end

        local phase, real, shake = "pose", 0, 0
        local inRock, inStart, fly, lastBat
        local stepConn
        local finish; finish = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if done then return end
            done = true
            pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND) end))
            if stepConn then stepConn:Disconnect() end
            releaseAll()
            api.TimeScale = 1
            if vm then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() vm.Model:Destroy() end)) end
            for _, obj in pairs(props) do pcall(obj.Destroy) end
            if inRock then pcall(inRock.Destroy) inRock = nil end
            for _, s in ipairs(tracers) do fadeOut(s, .5) end
            if which3 then
                pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                    if aborted and root.Parent then cam.CFrame = fp3 and eye() or root.CFrame*saved.Offset end
                    cam.FieldOfView = saved.FOV
                    cam.CameraType = saved.Type
                end))
            end
        end)
        local fire; fire = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(key, cond, fn)
            if cond and not fired[key] then
                fired[key] = true
                fn()
            end
        end)
        local impact; impact = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            -- bat meets rock: flash, TOK!, a short freeze, then the camera jumps behind the rock
            phase = "hitstop"
            run.HitReal = real
            local P = lastBat and (lastBat*SWEET).Position or (poseWorld()*contactLocal).Position
            if inRock then inRock.Place(CFrame.new(P)) end
            play("tok", 1, .7)
            play("tok", .8, 1.05)
            flash(P, 1.3)
            ctx.TokText(P, .6)
            shake = 1
            fly = {Pos = P, Vel = poseWorld():VectorToWorldSpace(U3(-.12, .2, -1))*120, T = 0}
            run.Last = P
            for _, s in ipairs(tracers) do fadeOut(s, .8) end
            tracers = {}
        end)
        local land; land = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(hit)
            -- The camera watches the stone shatter on impact.
            phase = "linger"
            run.LingerReal = 0
            local P = fly.Pos
            if inRock then inRock.Destroy() inRock = nil end
            shatterOn(P, hit and hit.Normal, fly.Vel)
            ctx.TokText(P + (hit and hit.Normal*.6 or Vector3.zero), .5)
            play("tok", 1, .55)
            play("tok", .9, .8)
            shake = .7
            run.Focus = P
            run.HoldFrom = camCF
            api.TimeScale = .3
            for _, s in ipairs(tracers) do fadeOut(s, 1.2) end
            tracers = {}
        end)
        local frame3; frame3 = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt, t)
            if phase == "pose" then
                if t >= T_APPEAR and not inRock then
                    inRock = ctx.NewRock(.75, folder)
                    inStart = (poseWorld()*CFrame.new(fp3 and 2 or 2.4, fp3 and 12 or 15, fp3 and -24 or -26)).Position
                    inRock.Place(CFrame.new(inStart))
                    glint(inStart, 2.2)
                    play("throw", .45, .6)
                    run.Last = inStart
                end
                if inRock then
                    -- it falls from high in front along a curve, a glowing line drawing itself behind it
                    local Pc = (poseWorld()*contactLocal).Position
                    local u = math.clamp((t - T_LAUNCH)/FLIGHT, 0, 1)^1.15
                    local mid = inStart:Lerp(Pc, .5) + V3(0, 4, 0)
                    local pos = inStart:Lerp(mid, u):Lerp(mid:Lerp(Pc, u), u)
                    inRock.Place(CFrame.new(pos)*CFrame.Angles(t*9, t*6, t*2))
                    if (pos - run.Last).Magnitude > .45 then
                        table.insert(tracers, segment(run.Last, pos, Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 140)))
                        run.Last = pos
                    end
                    run.RockPos = pos
                end
                fire("swing", t >= TC - .2, function() play("throw", .95, .72) end)
                if fp3 then
                    camCF = eye()
                else
                    local cw = chestWorld()
                    local aim = (cw*CFrame.new(.7, 1.2, -8)).Position
                    if run.RockPos then aim = aim:Lerp(run.RockPos, .3) end
                    camCF = camCF:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt((cw*CFrame.new(-2.3, 1.3, 6.8)).Position, aim), 1 - math.exp(-6*dt))
                end
                if t >= TC then impact() end
            elseif phase == "hitstop" then
                if real - run.HitReal >= .08 then
                    phase = "fly"
                    run.SwoopFrom = camCF
                    run.FlyReal = 0
                    play("throw", .6, .55)
                end
            elseif phase == "fly" then
                -- rock camera: super slow at first while the camera swoops behind it, then it speeds up
                run.FlyReal += dt
                local fr = run.FlyReal
                local ts = fr < .3 and .07 or math.min(.6, .07 + (fr - .3)*1.1)
                api.TimeScale = ts
                local sdt = dt*ts
                local nextVel = fly.Vel - V3(0, GRAVITY*.4*sdt, 0)
                local move = (fly.Vel + nextVel)*.5*sdt
                local hit, player, character = solidRay(fly.Pos, move)
                if hit then
                    fly.Pos = hit.Position
                    land(hit)
                    if player then ctx.HitPlayer(player, character) end
                else
                    fly.Pos += move
                    fly.Vel = nextVel
                    fly.T += sdt
                    if fly.T > 2.4 then land(nil) end
                end
                if inRock then inRock.Place(CFrame.new(fly.Pos)*CFrame.Angles(real*22, real*15, real*6)) end
                if (fly.Pos - run.Last).Magnitude > .6 then
                    table.insert(tracers, segment(run.Last, fly.Pos, Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 200)))
                    run.Last = fly.Pos
                end
                if phase == "fly" then
                    local v = fly.Vel.Unit
                    local side = v:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
                    side = side.Magnitude > .05 and side.Unit or Vector3.xAxis
                    local up = side:Cross(v).Unit
                    local want = CFrame.lookAt(fly.Pos - v*3.6 + up*.85, fly.Pos + v*6, up)
                    camCF = fr < .32 and run.SwoopFrom:Lerp(want, smooth(fr/.32)) or want
                    cam.FieldOfView = saved.FOV + 16*smooth((fr - .15)/.6)
                end
            elseif phase == "linger" then
                -- watch the pieces fall and run down, the camera slowly drifts back and around
                run.LingerReal += dt
                local lr = run.LingerReal
                api.TimeScale = lr < .35 and .3 or math.min(1, .3 + (lr - .35)*1.6)
                local P = run.Focus
                local from = run.HoldFrom.Position
                local dist = (from - P).Magnitude
                local away = dist > .1 and (from - P)/dist or V3(0, 0, 1)
                local k = smooth(lr/1.8)
                local pos = P + CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis, .25*k)*(away*(dist + 1.2*k)) + V3(0, .6*k, 0)
                camCF = CFrame.lookAt(pos, P)
                cam.FieldOfView = saved.FOV + 16*(1 - smooth(lr/.5))
                if lr >= 1.8 then
                    phase = "return"
                    run.RetReal = 0
                    run.RetFrom = camCF
                    run.ExitT = t + .35
                    api.TimeScale = 1
                end
            elseif phase == "return" then
                -- back to you (you see the follow-through, then the bat fades and the arms go down)
                run.RetReal += dt
                local target = fp3 and eye() or root.CFrame*saved.Offset
                camCF = run.RetFrom:Lerp(target, smooth(run.RetReal/.8))
                cam.FieldOfView = saved.FOV
                if run.RetReal >= .8 and t >= run.ExitT + .45 then
                    cam.CFrame = target
                    finish()
                    return true
                end
            end
            if shake > 0 then shake = math.max(0, shake - dt*2.5) end
            local s = shake*shake
            cam.CFrame = camCF*CFrame.Angles(math.noise(real*28, 1)*s*.05, math.noise(real*28, 2)*s*.05, math.noise(real*28, 3)*s*.03)
            return false
        end)
        local frame; frame = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            dt = math.min(dt, 1/20)
            real += dt
            if me.Stop or not root.Parent or not stillOk() then
                aborted = true
                finish()
                return
            end
            if phase ~= "hitstop" then run.Clock += dt end
            local t = run.Clock
            if which3 then
                local exitK = run.ExitT and smooth((t - run.ExitT)/.45) or 0
                run.W = smooth(t/.25)*(1 - exitK)
                run.BatAlpha = smooth((t - .05)/.3)*(1 - exitK)
            end
            -- place the arms (first person) or take what the joints did (third person), then the bat / the stone
            local fpNow = (which3 and fp3) or (not which3 and vm ~= nil and firstPerson(char))
            if vm then for _, p in ipairs(vm.All) do p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end end
            local batCF, rockCF
            if fpNow then
                local e = which3 and eye() or cam.CFrame
                local s = sampleAt(t, "fp")
                local b, r = resolve(s, viewArm(vm, e, s.w or 0), fpMap)
                batCF = b and e*b
                rockCF = r and e*r
            else
                local base = tp.Chest and root.CFrame*tp.Chest
                batCF = base and tp.Bat and base*tp.Bat
                rockCF = base and tp.Rock and base*tp.Rock
            end
            if props.Bat then
                if batCF then
                    props.Bat.Place(batCF)
                    lastBat = batCF
                    fire("batGlint", t > .12, function() glint((batCF*CFrame.new(0, 0, -1.7)).Position, .9) end)
                end
                props.Bat.Alpha(batCF and run.BatAlpha or 0)
            end
            if props.RockTP then
                local show, hide = props.RockTP, props.RockFP
                if fpNow then show, hide = props.RockFP, props.RockTP end
                hide.Hide(true)
                if rockCF then
                    show.Hide(false)
                    show.Place(rockCF)
                else
                    show.Hide(true)
                end
            end
            if which == 1 then
                for i, f in ipairs(FLIPS) do
                    fire("up"..i, t >= f, function() play("throw", .14, 1.9) end)
                    fire("dn"..i, t >= f + .55, function() play("tok", .18, 1.9) end)
                end
                if t >= A1 then finish() end
            elseif which == 2 then
                for i, f in ipairs(TOSS) do
                    fire("up"..i, t >= f[1], function() play("throw", .14, 1.7) end)
                    fire("dn"..i, t >= f[2], function() play("tok", .2, 1.8 + i*.05) end)
                end
                if t >= A2 then finish() end
            else
                frame3(dt, t)
            end
        end)
        -- third person: the joints are written right after the game's animation step, every frame
        stepConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if done or not root.Parent then return end
            local ok, err = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                local s = sampleAt(run.Clock, "tp")
                if rig then
                    solveTP(rig, s, tpMap)
                else
                    tp.Chest = CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                    tp.Bat, tp.Rock = resolve(s, function(_, T) return T end, tpMap)
                end
            end))
            if not ok then
                -- the arm posing broke: keep playing without it
                if not run.Warned then
                    run.Warned = true
                    warn("[CrackHub Rock] pose: "..tostring(err))
                end
                rig = nil
                releaseAll()
            end
        end))
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND) end))
        RunService:BindToRenderStep(BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if done then return end
            local ok, err = pcall(frame, dt)
            if not ok then
                warn("[CrackHub Rock inspect] "..tostring(err))
                notify("Inspect error: "..tostring(err):sub(1, 120))
                aborted = true
                finish()
            end
        end))
        local started = os.clock()
        while not done and os.clock() - started < 20 do task.wait() end
        if not done then
            aborted = true
            finish()
        end
    end)

    function api.Destroy()
        pcall(function() hb:Disconnect() end)
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(BIND) end)
        for _, b in ipairs(bits) do pcall(function() b.Part:Destroy() end) end
        table.clear(bits)
        releaseAll()
    end
    return api
end

CrackHub.InstallRock = function(window, tab, combat)
    -- Visuals · Fun · Rock: ballistic throws with player and world impacts.
    -- Rock camera, slow motion, aim prediction, tracer, and the original impact effects.
    local env=CrackHubEnvironment
    local Players=game:GetService("Players")
    local SoundService=game:GetService("SoundService")
    local UserInputService=game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local LocalPlayer=Players.LocalPlayer
    local alive=true
    local connections={}
    local function connect(signal,fn)
        local c=signal:Connect(function(...)if alive then return fn(...)end end)
        table.insert(connections,c)
        return c
    end
    local settings={Enabled=false,Power=90,Slow=100,RockCam=false,Predict=true,Tracer=true}

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ sounds
    local SOUND_DATA={tok="",throw=""}
    local sounds={}
    for name,data in pairs(SOUND_DATA)do
        pcall(function()
            if type(env.writefile)~="function" or type(env.getcustomasset)~="function" then return end
            if type(env.isfolder)=="function" and not env.isfolder("CrackHub")then env.makefolder("CrackHub")end
            local path="CrackHub/rock_"..name..".ogg"
            if type(env.isfile)~="function" or not env.isfile(path)then env.writefile(path,Base64Decode(data))end
            local sound=Instance.new("Sound")
            sound.Name="CrackHubRock_"..name
            sound.SoundId=env.getcustomasset(path)
            sound.Parent=SoundService
            sounds[name]=sound
        end)
    end
    local play; play = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(name,volume,speed)
        local sound=sounds[name]
        if not sound then return end
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()sound.Volume=volume or .7;sound.PlaybackSpeed=speed or 1;SoundService:PlayLocalSound(sound)end))
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
    local folder=Instance.new("Folder");folder.Name="CrackHubRock";folder.Parent=workspace
    local part; part = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(props)
        local p=Instance.new("Part")
        p.Anchored,p.CanCollide,p.CanQuery,p.CanTouch,p.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,true
        p.TopSurface,p.BottomSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        for k,v in pairs(props)do p[k]=v end
        return p
    end)
    local character; character = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        return char,char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end)
    local targetHighlight
    local aimedPlayer, aimedCharacter
    local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

    local displayCharacter; displayCharacter = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(player, character)
        local remoteSkins = combat and combat.Globals and combat.Globals.__crackhubRemoteSkin
        local entry = remoteSkins and remoteSkins.list and remoteSkins.list[player]
        local displayed = entry and entry.model
        return displayed and displayed.Parent and displayed or character
    end)

    local livingTarget; livingTarget = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(player, character)
        if not player or player == LocalPlayer or player.Parent ~= Players
            or not character or not character.Parent or player.Character ~= character then return nil end
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil end
        return character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    end)

    local markTarget; markTarget = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(player, character)
        if not livingTarget(player, character) then
            aimedPlayer, aimedCharacter = nil, nil
            if targetHighlight then
                targetHighlight:Destroy()
                targetHighlight = nil
            end
            return
        end
        aimedPlayer, aimedCharacter = player, character
        local displayed = displayCharacter(player, character)
        if not targetHighlight or not targetHighlight.Parent then
            local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
            highlight.Name = "CrackHubRockTarget"
            highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
            highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 110)
            highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
            targetHighlight = highlight
        end
        if targetHighlight.Adornee ~= displayed then
            targetHighlight.Adornee = displayed
            targetHighlight.Parent = displayed
        end
        targetHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.42 + 0.32 * math.abs(0.5 - tick() % 1)
        targetHighlight.Enabled = true
    end)

    local hitCharacter; hitCharacter = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(part)
        while part and part ~= workspace do
            if part:IsA("Model") then
                local humanoid = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if humanoid then
                    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(part)
                    if player and player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character == part and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                        return part, player
                    end
                    return part, nil
                end
            end
            part = part.Parent
        end
        return nil, nil
    end)

    local worldRay; worldRay = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(from, direction, includePlayers, radius)
        if direction.Magnitude < 0.001 then return nil end
        local ignored = {folder}
        if includePlayers then
            if LocalPlayer.Character then table.insert(ignored, LocalPlayer.Character) end
        else
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player.Character then table.insert(ignored, player.Character) end
            end
        end
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.IgnoreWater = false
        for _ = 1, 5 do
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
            local hit
            if radius then
                hit = workspace:Spherecast(from, radius, direction, params)
                    or workspace:Raycast(from, direction, params)
            else
                hit = workspace:Raycast(from, direction, params)
            end
            if not hit then return nil end
            local character, player = hitCharacter(hit.Instance)
            if includePlayers and player then return hit, player, character end
            if not character then return hit end
            table.insert(ignored, character)
        end
        return nil
    end)

    local combatRay; combatRay = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(from, direction)
        return worldRay(from, direction, true, 0.32)
    end)

    -- rock model: "Realistic Rock" from the Creator Store (free, no scripts); two more as backups, a hand-made one if none loads
    local ROCK_IDS={1192366796,8442632450,4038061999}
    local template
    local function loadTemplate()
        if template~=nil then return template end
        template=false
        for _,id in ipairs(ROCK_IDS)do
            local ok,objects=pcall(function()return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..id)end)
            local root=ok and type(objects)=="table" and objects[1]
            if root then
                local model=Instance.new("Model")
                for _,child in ipairs(root:IsA("Model") and root:GetChildren() or {root})do child.Parent=model end
                for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
                    if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("Sound") or d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("WeldConstraint") then pcall(function()d:Destroy()end)
                    elseif d:IsA("DataModelMesh") and d.Parent and d.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and d.Offset.Magnitude>.001 then
                        d.Parent.CFrame=d.Parent.CFrame*CFrame.new(d.Offset);d.Offset=Vector3.zero
                    end
                end
                local parts={}
                for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") then if d.Transparency>=.9 then d:Destroy() else table.insert(parts,d)end end
                end
                if #parts>0 then
                    local cf,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
                    local big=math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z)
                    local list={}
                    for _,p in ipairs(parts)do
                        local meshes={}
                        for _,m in ipairs(p:GetChildren())do if m:IsA("SpecialMesh") or m:IsA("BlockMesh") or m:IsA("CylinderMesh") then table.insert(meshes,{Mesh=m,Scale=m.Scale})end end
                        p.Archivable=true
                        for _,m in ipairs(p:GetDescendants())do m.Archivable=true end
                        table.insert(list,{Part=p,Offset=cf:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame),Size=p.Size,Meshes=meshes})
                    end
                    template={List=list,Big=big}
                    return template
                end
            end
        end
        return template
    end
    task.spawn(loadTemplate)
    -- builds one rock of the given size; returns an object you can move, hide and destroy
    local function newRock(size,parent)
        local tpl=loadTemplate()
        local obj={Parts={}}
        local core=part({Name="RockCore",Size=Vector3.new(.1,.1,.1),Transparency=1,CastShadow=false,Parent=parent})
        obj.Core=core
        if tpl then
            local k=size/tpl.Big
            for _,e in ipairs(tpl.List)do
                local p=e.Part:Clone()
                for _,m in ipairs(p:GetChildren())do if m:IsA("DataModelMesh") then m:Destroy()end end
                for _,m in ipairs(e.Meshes)do local c=m.Mesh:Clone();c.Scale=m.Scale*k;c.Parent=p end
                p.Size=e.Size*k
                p.Anchored,p.CanCollide,p.CanQuery,p.CanTouch=true,false,false,false
                p.Parent=parent
                table.insert(obj.Parts,{Part=p,Offset=CFrame.new(e.Offset.Position*k)*(e.Offset-e.Offset.Position),Base=p.Transparency})
            end
        else
            local rock=part({Name="Rock",Size=Vector3.new(size,size*.82,size*.92),Color=Color3.fromRGB(120,116,110),Material=Enum.Material.Slate,Parent=parent})
            local mesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");mesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere;mesh.Parent=rock
            local bump=part({Name="Bump",Size=Vector3.new(size*.62,size*.5,size*.6),Color=Color3.fromRGB(105,100,95),Material=Enum.Material.Slate,Parent=parent})
            local bm=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");bm.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere;bm.Parent=bump
            table.insert(obj.Parts,{Part=rock,Offset=CFrame.new(),Base=0})
            table.insert(obj.Parts,{Part=bump,Offset=CFrame.new(size*.22,size*.14,-size*.1),Base=0})
        end
        function obj.Place(cf)
            core.CFrame=cf
            for _,e in ipairs(obj.Parts)do e.Part.CFrame=cf*e.Offset end
        end
        function obj.Hide(hidden)
            for _,e in ipairs(obj.Parts)do e.Part.Transparency=hidden and 1 or e.Base end
        end
        function obj.Fade(time)
            for _,e in ipairs(obj.Parts)do TweenService:Create(e.Part,TweenInfo.new(time),{Transparency=1}):Play()end
        end
        function obj.Destroy()
            core:Destroy()
            for _,e in ipairs(obj.Parts)do e.Part:Destroy()end
        end
        -- welds everything to the core so it can hang on a hand
        function obj.Weld()
            obj.Place(core.CFrame)
            for _,e in ipairs(obj.Parts)do
                e.Part.Anchored=false;e.Part.Massless=true
                local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");w.Part0,w.Part1=core,e.Part;w.Parent=e.Part
            end
            core.Anchored=false;core.Massless=true
        end
        return obj
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ the rock in your hand
    local tool,held
    local throwPose=0
    local handOf; handOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(char)
        return char:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
    end)
    local function removeHeld()
        if held then held.Destroy();held=nil end
    end
    local function makeHeld()
        removeHeld()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local hand=char and handOf(char)
        if not hand then return end
        held=newRock(.75,tool or char)
        held.Place(hand.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,-hand.Size.Y/2-.2,0))
        held.Weld()
        local w=Instance.new("Weld");w.Part0,w.Part1=hand,held.Core;w.C0=CFrame.new(0,-hand.Size.Y/2-.2,0);w.Parent=held.Core
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ aiming
    local GRAVITY=workspace.Gravity
    local axes = { "X", "Y", "Z" }
    local distanceToPart; distanceToPart = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(ray, part, limit)
        local origin = part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(ray.Origin)
        local direction = part.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(ray.Direction)
        local half = part.Size * 0.5
        local entry, exit = 0, limit
        for _, axis in ipairs(axes) do
            local value, slope, extent = origin[axis], direction[axis], half[axis] + 0.12
            if math.abs(slope) < 0.0001 then
                if math.abs(value) > extent then return nil end
            else
                local near, far = (-extent - value) / slope, (extent - value) / slope
                entry = math.max(entry, math.min(near, far))
                exit = math.min(exit, math.max(near, far))
                if entry > exit then return nil end
            end
        end
        return entry
    end)

    local playerUnderRay; playerUnderRay = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(ray, limit)
        local bestPlayer, bestCharacter, bestDistance
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            local character = player.Character
            if not livingTarget(player, character) then continue end
            local displayed = displayCharacter(player, character)
            for _, part in ipairs(displayed:GetChildren()) do
                if not part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or part.Transparency >= 0.98 then continue end
                local distance = distanceToPart(ray, part, bestDistance or limit)
                if distance and (not bestDistance or distance < bestDistance) then
                    bestPlayer, bestCharacter, bestDistance = player, character, distance
                end
            end
        end
        return bestPlayer, bestCharacter, bestDistance
    end)

    -- phones: aim where the finger last tapped the world (not the screen centre), soft aim assist, movement lead
    local isTouch = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled
    local lastTouch, lastTouchAt = nil, 0
    connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and not processed then
            lastTouch, lastTouchAt = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y), os.clock()
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input, processed)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and not processed and lastTouch and os.clock() - lastTouchAt < 0.6 then
            lastTouch, lastTouchAt = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y), os.clock()
        end
    end)
    local assistTarget; assistTarget = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(ray, maxAngle)
        local best, bestPlayer, bestCharacter, bestAngle
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            local character = player.Character
            local part = livingTarget(player, character)
            if part and player ~= LocalPlayer then
                local to = part.Position - ray.Origin
                local dist = to.Magnitude
                if dist > 2 and dist < 400 then
                    local angle = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(to.Unit:Dot(ray.Direction.Unit), -1, 1)))
                    if angle < maxAngle and (not bestAngle or angle < bestAngle) then
                        best, bestPlayer, bestCharacter, bestAngle = part, player, character, angle
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best, bestPlayer, bestCharacter
    end)
    local lead; lead = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(point, character)
        local part = character and (character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
        if not part then return point end
        local v = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local flat = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
        if flat.Magnitude > 60 then flat = flat.Unit * 60 end
        local from = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local dist = from and (point - from.Position).Magnitude or 30
        local flight = dist / math.max(settings.Power, 1)
        local ping = 0.08
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() ping = math.clamp(LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing(), 0, 0.3) end))
        return point + flat * (flight + ping)
    end)
    local rawAimPoint; rawAimPoint = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return nil end
        local ray
        if UserInputService.MouseEnabled and UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
            local character, player = hitCharacter(mouse.Target)
            if player and livingTarget(player, character) then return mouse.Hit.Position, player, character end
            ray = mouse.UnitRay
        elseif isTouch and lastTouch and os.clock() - lastTouchAt < 4 then
            ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(lastTouch.X, lastTouch.Y)
        else
            local center = camera.ViewportSize * 0.5
            ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(center.X, center.Y)
        end
        local hit, player, character = worldRay(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 600, true)
        if player then return hit.Position, player, character end
        local limit = hit and math.min(600, (hit.Position - ray.Origin).Magnitude + 0.15) or 600
        local bodyPlayer, bodyCharacter, distance = playerUnderRay(ray, limit)
        if bodyPlayer then return ray.Origin + ray.Direction * distance, bodyPlayer, bodyCharacter end
        if isTouch then
            local part, p2, c2 = assistTarget(ray, 9)
            if part then return part.Position, p2, c2 end
        end
        return hit and hit.Position or (ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 250), nil, nil
    end)
    local aimPoint; aimPoint = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local point, player, character = rawAimPoint()
        if point and player and isTouch then point = lead(point, character) end
        return point, player, character
    end)
    local launchFrom; launchFrom = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local char,root=character()
        local hand=char and handOf(char)
        if hand then return hand.Position+Vector3.new(0,.6,0)end
        return root and root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.5,0)
    end)
    -- speed along the aim + the lift gravity will eat on the way, so it lands where you point
    local launchVelocity; launchVelocity = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(from,target)
        local delta=target-from
        local dist=delta.Magnitude
        if dist<.1 then return Vector3.new(0,settings.Power,0)end
        local speed=settings.Power
        local time=dist/speed
        return delta.Unit*speed+Vector3.new(0,GRAVITY*time*.5,0)
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ prediction arc (3D beads + a landing ring)
    local beads={}
    for i=1,36 do
        beads[i]=part({Name="Aim",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.14,.14,.14),Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,235,150),Material=Enum.Material.Glass,
            Reflectance=.3,Transparency=1,CastShadow=false,Parent=folder})
    end
    local ring={}
    for i=1,14 do
        ring[i]=part({Name="AimRing",Size=Vector3.new(.08,.04,.32),Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,215,110),Material=Enum.Material.Glass,Reflectance=.3,
            Transparency=1,CastShadow=false,Parent=folder})
    end
    local hideAim; hideAim = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        for _,b in ipairs(beads)do b.Transparency=1 end
        for _,r in ipairs(ring)do r.Transparency=1 end
    end)
    local simulate; simulate = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(from,vel,steps,dt,onPoint)
        local pos=from
        for i=1,steps do
            local nextVel=vel-Vector3.new(0,GRAVITY*dt,0)
            local move=(vel+nextVel)*.5*dt
            local hit=combatRay(pos,move)
            if hit then onPoint(i,hit.Position,true,hit.Normal);return hit end
            pos+=move
            vel=nextVel
            if not onPoint(i,pos,false)then return nil end
        end
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ impact: dust, chips, "TOK!"
    local PRETTY=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/LuckiestGuy.json")
    local tokText; tokText = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(at,slow)
        local holder=part({Name="TokAnchor",Size=Vector3.new(.2,.2,.2),Transparency=1,CFrame=CFrame.new(at+Vector3.new(0,1.2,0)),Parent=folder})
        local gui=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        gui.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(220,90)
        gui.AlwaysOnTop=true
        gui.LightInfluence=0
        gui.Adornee=holder
        gui.Parent=holder
        local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
        label.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5)
        label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
        label.BackgroundTransparency=1
        label.Text=({"TOK!","TUK!","BONK!","TOK!"})[math.random(1,4)]
        label.FontFace=PRETTY
        label.TextScaled=true
        label.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
        label.Rotation=math.random(-12,12)
        label.Parent=gui
        local stroke=Instance.new("UIStroke");stroke.Thickness=4;stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(70,40,15);stroke.Parent=label
        local grad=Instance.new("UIGradient");grad.Rotation=90
        grad.Color=ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.fromRGB(255,250,210)),ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.5,Color3.fromRGB(255,205,90)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(240,120,40))})
        grad.Parent=label
        local scale=Instance.new("UIScale");scale.Scale=.2;scale.Parent=label
        local k=1/math.max(slow,.1)
        TweenService:Create(scale,TweenInfo.new(.28*k,Enum.EasingStyle.Back),{Scale=1}):Play()
        task.delay(.5*k,function()
            TweenService:Create(holder,TweenInfo.new(.6*k),{CFrame=holder.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,1.6,0)}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(label,TweenInfo.new(.6*k),{TextTransparency=1}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(stroke,TweenInfo.new(.6*k),{Transparency=1}):Play()
        end)
        task.delay(1.2*k,function()holder:Destroy()end)
    end)
    local debris={}
    local chips; chips = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(at,normal,slow)
        for i=1,8 do
            local s=.1+math.random()*.16
            local chip=part({Name="Chip",Size=Vector3.new(s,s*.7,s),Color=Color3.fromRGB(115+math.random(-15,15),110,104),Material=Enum.Material.Slate,
                CFrame=CFrame.new(at)*CFrame.Angles(math.random()*6,math.random()*6,math.random()*6),Parent=folder})
            local dir=(normal+Vector3.new(math.random()-.5,math.random()*.6,math.random()-.5)).Unit
            table.insert(debris,{Part=chip,Vel=dir*(5+math.random()*6),Life=1.2,Age=0,Spin=Vector3.new(math.random(),math.random(),math.random())*10,Floor=at.Y})
        end
        for i=1,4 do
            local s=.5+math.random()*.4
            local dust=part({Name="Dust",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(s,s,s),Color=Color3.fromRGB(150,138,125),Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
                Transparency=.5,CastShadow=false,CFrame=CFrame.new(at+normal*.2),Parent=folder})
            table.insert(debris,{Part=dust,Vel=(normal*1.5+Vector3.new(math.random()-.5,0,math.random()-.5)*2),Life=.9,Age=0,Grow=1.6,Gravity=0,Fade=true})
        end
    end)
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        local slow=settings.Slow/100
        for i=#debris,1,-1 do
            local d=debris[i]
            local sdt=dt*slow
            d.Age+=sdt
            if d.Age>=d.Life or not d.Part.Parent then
                d.Part:Destroy();table.remove(debris,i)
            else
                d.Vel-=Vector3.new(0,(d.Gravity or GRAVITY*.25)*sdt,0)
                local pos=d.Part.Position+d.Vel*sdt
                if d.Floor and pos.Y<d.Floor then pos=Vector3.new(pos.X,d.Floor,pos.Z);d.Vel*=Vector3.new(.5,-.3,.5)end
                local rot=d.Spin and CFrame.Angles(d.Spin.X*sdt,d.Spin.Y*sdt,d.Spin.Z*sdt) or CFrame.new()
                d.Part.CFrame=CFrame.new(pos)*(d.Part.CFrame-d.Part.Position)*rot
                if d.Grow then d.Part.Size=d.Part.Size*(1+d.Grow*sdt)end
                if d.Fade then d.Part.Transparency=.5+.5*(d.Age/d.Life)end
                if d.Melt and d.Age>d.Life*.45 then
                    local m=(d.Age-d.Life*.45)/(d.Life*.55)
                    d.Part.Transparency=m
                    d.Part.Size=d.Part.Size*(1-sdt*.6)
                    d.Part.CFrame=d.Part.CFrame-Vector3.new(0,sdt*.25,0)
                end
            end
        end
    end))

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ throwing
    local flying=0
    local camRock=nil
    local savedCamType
    -- rock camera: orbits the rock; hold right mouse to turn it, mouse wheel to zoom
    local orbit={Yaw=0,Pitch=-.2,Dist=6,Turning=false}
    connect(UserInputService.InputBegan,function(input)
        if camRock and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
            orbit.Turning=true
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior=Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and orbit.Turning then
            orbit.Turning=false
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior=Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputChanged,function(input)
        if not camRock then return end
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and orbit.Turning then
            orbit.Yaw-=input.Delta.X*.008
            orbit.Pitch=math.clamp(orbit.Pitch-input.Delta.Y*.008,-1.35,1.2)
        elseif input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
            orbit.Dist=math.clamp(orbit.Dist-input.Position.Z*1.2,2.5,24)
        elseif input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            orbit.Yaw-=input.Delta.X*.008
            orbit.Pitch=math.clamp(orbit.Pitch-input.Delta.Y*.008,-1.35,1.2)
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        RunService:BindToRenderStep("CrackHubRockCam",Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+2,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not camRock then return end
            local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
            local pos=camRock.Pos
            local rot=CFrame.Angles(0,orbit.Yaw,0)*CFrame.Angles(orbit.Pitch,0,0)
            local want=CFrame.lookAt(pos+rot:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0,0,orbit.Dist)),pos)
            cam.CFrame=cam.CFrame:Lerp(want,.4)
        end))
    end)
    local function startRockCam(state)
        local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        savedCamType=savedCamType or cam.CameraType
        cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        -- start right behind the rock, looking where it flies
        local v=state.Vel*Vector3.new(1,0,1)
        orbit.Yaw=v.Magnitude>.1 and math.atan2(-v.X,-v.Z) or 0
        orbit.Pitch,orbit.Dist=-.2,6
        camRock=state
    end
    local function stopRockCam()
        camRock=nil
        if orbit.Turning then orbit.Turning=false;UserInputService.MouseBehavior=Enum.MouseBehavior.Default end
        local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam and savedCamType then pcall(function()cam.CameraType=savedCamType end)end
        savedCamType=nil
    end
    local inspecting
    local inspectIndex=0
    local hitPlayer; hitPlayer = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(player, character, attackTool)
        if not combat or not attackTool or not attackTool.Parent then return end
        if inspecting then inspecting.PlayerImpact = true end
        local ok, problem = pcall(combat.RockImpact, combat, player, character, attackTool)
        if not ok then warn("[CrackHub Rock] " .. tostring(problem)) end
    end)
    local shoulder,shoulderBase
    local lastThrow=0
    local stepLockedRock; stepLockedRock = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(position, target, dt, speed)
        local delta = target - position
        local distance = delta.Magnitude
        local direction = distance > 0.01 and delta.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
        local step = speed * dt
        if distance <= math.max(0.5, step) then return target, direction, true end
        return position + direction * step, direction, false
    end)

    local function throw()
        if not tool or tool.Parent~=LocalPlayer.Character then return end
        if os.clock()-lastThrow<.45 or inspecting then return end
        lastThrow=os.clock()
        local from=launchFrom()
        if not from then return end
        local lockedPlayer, lockedCharacter = aimedPlayer, aimedCharacter
        local lockedPart = livingTarget(lockedPlayer, lockedCharacter)
        local target
        if lockedPart then
            target = lockedPart.Position
        else
            target, lockedPlayer, lockedCharacter = aimPoint()
            lockedPart = livingTarget(lockedPlayer, lockedCharacter)
        end
        if not target then return end
        if not lockedPart then lockedPlayer, lockedCharacter = nil, nil end
        local attackTool = tool
        local vel=launchVelocity(from,target)
        local slow=settings.Slow/100
        -- arm: quick wind-up and release
        throwPose=1
        play("throw",.6,math.max(.4,slow))
        hideAim()
        local size=.75
        local rock=newRock(size,folder)
        local spin=CFrame.Angles(math.random()*6,math.random()*6,math.random()*6)
        local state={Pos=from,Vel=vel}
        rock.Place(CFrame.new(from)*spin)
        if held then held.Hide(true)end
        flying+=1
        if settings.RockCam then startRockCam(state)end
        task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local tracerLast=from
            local tracer={}
            local bounces=0
            local resting=false
            local t0=os.clock()
            while alive and rock.Core.Parent and os.clock()-t0<12 do
                local frameTime = math.min(task.wait(), 0.05)
                if resting then break end
                local dt = frameTime * slow
                local nextVel, move, hit, player, hitModel
                if lockedPlayer then
                    local targetPart = livingTarget(lockedPlayer, lockedCharacter)
                    if not targetPart then break end
                    local distance = (targetPart.Position - state.Pos).Magnitude
                    local speed = math.max(settings.Power * slow, 120, distance * 0.9,
                        targetPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude + 45)
                    local position, direction, arrived = stepLockedRock(state.Pos, targetPart.Position, frameTime, speed)
                    state.Pos = position
                    state.Vel = direction * speed
                    if arrived then
                        hit = { Position = position, Normal = -direction }
                        player, hitModel = lockedPlayer, lockedCharacter
                    end
                else
                    nextVel = state.Vel - Vector3.new(0, GRAVITY * dt, 0)
                    move = (state.Vel + nextVel) * 0.5 * dt
                    hit, player, hitModel = combatRay(state.Pos, move)
                end
                if hit then
                    state.Pos = lockedPlayer and hit.Position or hit.Position + hit.Normal * size * 0.4
                    local speed=state.Vel.Magnitude
                    if bounces==0 or speed>40 then
                        play("tok",math.clamp(speed/80,.35,1),math.max(.35,slow)*(.9+math.random()*.2))
                        chips(hit.Position,hit.Normal,slow)
                        if bounces==0 then tokText(hit.Position,slow)end
                    end
                    bounces+=1
                    local reflected=state.Vel-2*state.Vel:Dot(hit.Normal)*hit.Normal
                    state.Vel=reflected*.38
                    if player then
                        resting = true
                        hitPlayer(player, hitModel, attackTool)
                    elseif state.Vel.Magnitude < 6 or bounces >= 4 then
                        resting = true
                    end
                elseif not lockedPlayer then
                    state.Pos+=move
                    state.Vel=nextVel
                end
                spin=spin*CFrame.Angles(dt*14,dt*9,0)
                rock.Place(CFrame.new(state.Pos)*spin)
                -- tracer draws itself right behind the rock
                if settings.Tracer and (state.Pos-tracerLast).Magnitude>.6 then
                    local a,b=tracerLast,state.Pos
                    local seg=part({Name="Tracer",Size=Vector3.new(.07,.07,(b-a).Magnitude),Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,225,140),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,
                        Transparency=.15,CastShadow=false,CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(a:Lerp(b,.5),b),Parent=folder})
                    table.insert(tracer,seg)
                    tracerLast=b
                end
            end
            if camRock==state then task.delay(.8,stopRockCam)end
            flying-=1
            if held and flying<=0 then held.Hide(false)end
            -- the tracer fades out, the rock rests a moment and fades away
            task.delay(1.6,function()
                for _,seg in ipairs(tracer)do TweenService:Create(seg,TweenInfo.new(.6),{Transparency=1}):Play()end
                task.delay(.65,function()for _,seg in ipairs(tracer)do seg:Destroy()end end)
            end)
            task.delay(3,function()
                rock.Fade(.5)
                task.delay(.55,rock.Destroy)
            end)
        end))
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ F: three inspect animations in a row (1 twirl · 2 juggle · 3 bat), Escape cancels
    -- the bat: "Bat" from the Creator Store (free, no scripts), backups after it, a hand-made wooden bat if none loads
    local BAT_IDS={16428159315,875224506,118976189629040,3517077912,15008420462,12550781805}
    local batTemplate
    local batLoading=false
    local loadBatFrom
    local loadBat; loadBat = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if batTemplate~=nil then return batTemplate end
        if batLoading then
            local waited=os.clock()
            while batLoading and os.clock()-waited<6 do task.wait()end
            return batTemplate or false
        end
        batLoading=true
        for _,id in ipairs(BAT_IDS)do
            local ok,result=pcall(loadBatFrom,id)
            if ok and result then batTemplate=result;break end
            if not ok then warn("[CrackHub Rock] bat "..id..": "..tostring(result))end
        end
        if batTemplate==nil then batTemplate=false;warn("[CrackHub Rock] no bat model loaded, using the hand-made bat")end
        batLoading=false
        return batTemplate
    end)
    loadBatFrom=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(id)
        do
            local ok,objects=pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..id)end))
            local root=ok and type(objects)=="table" and objects[1]
            if root then
                local model=Instance.new("Model")
                for _,child in ipairs(root:IsA("Model") and root:GetChildren() or {root})do child.Parent=model end
                for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
                    if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("Sound") or d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("WeldConstraint") then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()d:Destroy()end))
                    elseif d:IsA("DataModelMesh") and d.Parent and d.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and d.Offset.Magnitude>.001 then
                        d.Parent.CFrame=d.Parent.CFrame*CFrame.new(d.Offset);d.Offset=Vector3.zero
                    end
                end
                local parts={}
                for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
                    if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                        if d.Transparency>=.9 then d:Destroy() else d.Anchored=true;d.CanCollide=false;d.CanQuery=true;table.insert(parts,d)end
                    end
                end
                if #parts>0 then
                    -- measure it far away from everything, sized to 3.2 studs
                    model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,4000,0))
                    model.Parent=workspace
                    local cf,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
                    local long=math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z)
                    if long>0 then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale()*3.2/long)end))end
                    cf,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
                    local axis,len,side
                    if size.X>=size.Y and size.X>=size.Z then axis,len,side=cf.RightVector,size.X,cf.UpVector
                    elseif size.Y>=size.Z then axis,len,side=cf.UpVector,size.Y,cf.RightVector
                    else axis,len,side=cf.LookVector,size.Z,cf.UpVector end
                    local endA,endB=cf.Position+axis*len/2,cf.Position-axis*len/2
                    -- which end is the handle? shoot rays at the bat near each end: the thinner end is the handle
                    local params=RaycastParams.new()
                    params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
                    params.FilterDescendantsInstances={model}
                    local thickness; thickness = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(at)
                        local total,hits=0,0
                        local other=axis:Cross(side)
                        for i=0,7 do
                            local a=i/8*math.pi*2
                            local dir=side*math.cos(a)+other*math.sin(a)
                            local start=at+dir*3
                            local hit=workspace:Raycast(start,-dir*3,params)
                            if hit then total+=(3-(hit.Position-start).Magnitude);hits+=1 end
                        end
                        return hits>0 and total/hits or nil
                    end)
                    local ta=thickness(cf.Position+axis*len*.36)
                    local tb=thickness(cf.Position-axis*len*.36)
                    local handleEnd,tipEnd=endB,endA
                    if ta and tb then
                        if ta<tb then handleEnd,tipEnd=endA,endB end
                    else
                        -- several pieces: the side with less volume is the handle
                        local balance=0
                        for _,p in ipairs(parts)do balance+=p.Size.X*p.Size.Y*p.Size.Z*(p.Position-cf.Position):Dot(axis)end
                        if balance<0 then handleEnd,tipEnd=endA,endB end
                    end
                    local frame=CFrame.lookAt(handleEnd,tipEnd)
                    local list={}
                    for _,p in ipairs(parts)do
                        local meshes={}
                        for _,m in ipairs(p:GetChildren())do if m:IsA("DataModelMesh") then table.insert(meshes,m)end end
                        p.Archivable=true
                        for _,m in ipairs(p:GetDescendants())do m.Archivable=true end
                        table.insert(list,{Part=p:Clone(),Offset=frame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)})
                    end
                    model:Destroy()
                    return {List=list,Length=len}
                end
                model:Destroy()
            end
        end
        return nil
    end)
    task.spawn(loadBat)
    -- a bat object: Place(gripCFrame) puts the handle in the hands, -Z of the frame pointing to the barrel
    local function newBat()
        local tpl=loadBat()
        local obj={Parts={}}
        if tpl then
            for _,e in ipairs(tpl.List)do
                local p=e.Part:Clone()
                p.Anchored,p.CanCollide,p.CanQuery,p.CanTouch=true,false,false,false
                p.Parent=folder
                table.insert(obj.Parts,{Part=p,Offset=e.Offset,Base=p.Transparency})
            end
        else
            -- hand-made wooden bat: tapered barrel, grip tape and a knob
            local wood=Color3.fromRGB(196,150,98)
            local pieces={
                {Size=Vector3.new(.17,.17,1.1),Off=CFrame.new(0,0,-.55),Color=Color3.fromRGB(35,35,40),Mat=Enum.Material.Fabric},
                {Size=Vector3.new(.24,.24,.8),Off=CFrame.new(0,0,-1.45),Color=wood,Mat=Enum.Material.Wood},
                {Size=Vector3.new(.32,.32,.8),Off=CFrame.new(0,0,-2.2),Color=wood,Mat=Enum.Material.Wood},
                {Size=Vector3.new(.36,.36,.55),Off=CFrame.new(0,0,-2.85),Color=wood,Mat=Enum.Material.Wood},
            }
            for _,d in ipairs(pieces)do
                local p=part({Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(d.Size.Z,d.Size.X,d.Size.Y),Color=d.Color,Material=d.Mat,Parent=folder})
                table.insert(obj.Parts,{Part=p,Offset=d.Off*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(90),0),Base=0})
            end
            local knob=part({Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.26,.26,.26),Color=wood,Material=Enum.Material.Wood,Parent=folder})
            table.insert(obj.Parts,{Part=knob,Offset=CFrame.new(0,0,.02),Base=0})
            local cap=part({Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.36,.36,.36),Color=wood,Material=Enum.Material.Wood,Parent=folder})
            table.insert(obj.Parts,{Part=cap,Offset=CFrame.new(0,0,-3.12),Base=0})
        end
        function obj.Place(cf)for _,e in ipairs(obj.Parts)do e.Part.CFrame=cf*e.Offset end end
        function obj.Alpha(a)for _,e in ipairs(obj.Parts)do e.Part.Transparency=e.Base+(1-e.Base)*(1-a)end end
        function obj.Destroy()for _,e in ipairs(obj.Parts)do e.Part:Destroy()end end
        return obj
    end

    -- F inspects: view-model arms in first person, real arms (IK) in third person — see CrackHub.RockInspect
    local inspector=CrackHub.RockInspect({
        Player=LocalPlayer, Folder=folder, Part=part, Play=play, NewRock=newRock, NewBat=newBat,
        WorldRay=worldRay, CombatRay=combatRay, TokText=tokText,
        HitPlayer=function(player, character) hitPlayer(player, character, tool) end,
    })
    local function inspect()
        if not held or flying>0 or inspecting then return end
        inspectIndex=inspectIndex%3+1
        local which=inspectIndex
        local me={Stop=false,Started=os.clock()}
        inspecting=me
        throwPose=0
        if shoulder and shoulderBase then pcall(function()shoulder.C0=shoulderBase end)end
        hideAim()
        held.Hide(true)
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok,err=pcall(inspector.Run,which,me,function()
                return alive and tool ~= nil and (tool.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character or me.PlayerImpact)
            end)
            if not ok then
                warn("[CrackHub Rock inspect] "..tostring(err))
                pcall(inspector.Notify,"Inspect error: "..tostring(err):sub(1,120))
            end
            if held and flying<=0 then held.Hide(false)end
            if inspecting==me then inspecting=nil end
        end)
    end
    -- same as pressing F with the rock (used by the mobile Inspect button)
    CrackHub.RockHeld=function() return settings.Enabled and tool~=nil and tool.Parent==LocalPlayer.Character end
    CrackHub.InspectRock=function()
        if not settings.Enabled then return false end
        if not (tool and tool.Parent==LocalPlayer.Character) then return false end
        if inspecting and os.clock()-(inspecting.Started or 0)>25 then inspecting=nil end
        if inspecting then return true end
        if not held then makeHeld()end
        if not held then pcall(inspector.Notify,"Rock is not in your hand yet");return true end
        if flying>0 then pcall(inspector.Notify,"Wait until the rock lands");return true end
        inspect()
        return true
    end
    connect(UserInputService.InputBegan,function(input,processed)
        if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
            if inspecting then inspecting.Stop=true end
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode~=Enum.KeyCode.F then return end
        if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if not settings.Enabled then return end
        if tool and tool.Parent==LocalPlayer.Character then
            if inspecting and os.clock()-(inspecting.Started or 0)>25 then inspecting=nil end
            if inspecting then return end
            if not held then makeHeld()end
            if not held then pcall(inspector.Notify,"Rock is not in your hand yet");return end
            if flying>0 then pcall(inspector.Notify,"Wait until the rock lands");return end
            inspect()
        else
            pcall(inspector.Notify,"Take the rock (slot 3), then press F")
        end
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ every frame: the throwing arm and the prediction arc
    connect(RunService.RenderStepped,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local equipped=tool and char and tool.Parent==char
        local point, player, targetCharacter
        if equipped and not inspecting then point, player, targetCharacter = aimPoint() end
        markTarget(player, targetCharacter)
        -- arm swing: back, then fast forward
        if equipped and inspecting then
            -- the inspect poses drive the arms now
        elseif equipped then
            local motor=char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm") and char.RightUpperArm:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder") or (char:FindFirstChild("Torso") and char.Torso:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder"))
            if motor~=shoulder then
                if shoulder and shoulderBase then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()shoulder.C0=shoulderBase end))end
                shoulder,shoulderBase=motor,motor and motor.C0
            end
            if shoulder and shoulderBase then
                throwPose=math.max(0,throwPose-dt*3.2)
                local swing=throwPose>.7 and (1-throwPose)/.3*-1 or throwPose/.7*1.4
                shoulder.C0=CFrame.new(shoulderBase.Position)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(70*swing),0,0)*shoulderBase.Rotation
            end
        elseif shoulder and shoulderBase then
            pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()shoulder.C0=shoulderBase end))
            shoulder,shoulderBase=nil,nil
        end
        if not point or not settings.Predict or flying > 0 then hideAim(); return end
        local from=launchFrom()
        if not from then hideAim();return end
        local vel=launchVelocity(from,point)
        local count=0
        local t=os.clock()
        simulate(from,vel,140,1/90,function(i,pos,isHit,normal)
            if i%4==0 and not isHit then
                count+=1
                local b=beads[count]
                if not b then return false end
                b.CFrame=CFrame.new(pos)
                b.Transparency=.15+.6*(count/#beads)
                b.Size=Vector3.new(.15,.15,.15)*(1+.25*math.sin(t*8-count*.5))
            end
            if isHit then
                local up=normal or Vector3.yAxis
                local base=CFrame.lookAt(pos,pos+up)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90),0,0)
                for j,r in ipairs(ring)do
                    local a=(j/#ring)*math.pi*2+t*2
                    local rr=.7+.08*math.sin(t*6)
                    r.CFrame=base*CFrame.new(math.cos(a)*rr,.03,math.sin(a)*rr)*CFrame.Angles(0,-a,0)
                    r.Transparency=.2
                end
            end
            return true
        end)
        for i=count+1,#beads do beads[i].Transparency=1 end
    end))

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ tool
    local function removeTool()
        removeHeld()
        hideAim()
        markTarget(nil, nil)
        if tool then tool:Destroy();tool=nil end
    end
    local function giveTool()
        if tool and tool.Parent then return end
        local backpack=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if not backpack then return end
        tool=Instance.new("Tool")
        tool.Name="Rock"
        tool:SetAttribute("CrackHubRockProjectile", true)
        tool.ToolTip="Click to throw"
        tool.CanBeDropped=false
        tool.RequiresHandle=true
        local handle=Instance.new("Part")
        handle.Name="Handle";handle.Size=Vector3.new(.2,.2,.2);handle.Transparency=1;handle.CanCollide=false;handle.Massless=true
        handle.Parent=tool
        tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
            if not alive then return end
            makeHeld()
            if inspecting and held then held.Hide(true) end
        end)
        tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
            if inspecting and not inspecting.PlayerImpact then inspecting.Stop=true end
            markTarget(nil, nil)
            removeHeld();hideAim()
        end)
        tool.Activated:Connect(throw)
        tool.Parent=backpack
    end
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded,function()
        tool=nil
        held=nil
        if settings.Enabled then task.delay(1.2,function()if settings.Enabled then giveTool()end end)end
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ UI
    local group=tab:AddGroup("Rock",true)
    local result={Group=group}
    group:AddToggle({Name="Rock",Description="A stone in your hotbar · F: inspect (3 animations in a row) · Esc: cancel · hits players and walls",Default=false,Callback=function(v)
        settings.Enabled=v
        if v then giveTool() else removeTool()end
    end})
    group:AddSlider({Name="Throw Power",Min=30,Max=220,Default=90,Increment=5,Callback=function(v)settings.Power=v end})
    group:AddSlider({Name="Slow Motion",Min=5,Max=100,Default=100,Increment=5,Suffix="%",Callback=function(v)settings.Slow=v end})
    group:AddToggle({Name="Rock Camera",Description="Follow the rock in flight · hold right mouse to turn, wheel to zoom",Default=false,Bind=false,Callback=function(v)settings.RockCam=v end})
    group:AddToggle({Name="Aim Prediction",Default=true,Bind=false,Callback=function(v)settings.Predict=v;if not v then hideAim()end end})
    group:AddToggle({Name="Tracer",Default=true,Bind=false,Callback=function(v)settings.Tracer=v end})

    connect(window.Gui.Destroying,function()
        alive=false
        pcall(removeTool)
        pcall(stopRockCam)
        pcall(function()RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CrackHubRockCam")end)
        pcall(inspector.Destroy)
        if targetHighlight then targetHighlight:Destroy(); targetHighlight = nil end
        if shoulder and shoulderBase then pcall(function()shoulder.C0=shoulderBase end)end
        pcall(function()folder:Destroy()end)
        for _,s in pairs(sounds)do pcall(function()s:Destroy()end)end
        for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end
    end)
    return result
end

CrackHub.InstallFlyBrain = function(window, tab)
    -- Visuals · Fun · Fly Brain: a simplified fly brain (200 spiking neurons wired like a fly's: eyes -> compass + memory ->
    -- descending neurons). It flies YOUR PETS (the Fish pet and the Cosmetics pets) — each pet gets its own brain —
    -- or drives your own character. Pets can stay tied to you or be let loose. The watermark shows the neurons live.
    -- Everything is local; it only reads where things are.
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    local V3 = Vector3.new
    local alive = true
    local connections = {}
    local function connect(signal, fn)
        local c = signal:Connect(function(...) if alive then return fn(...) end end)
        table.insert(connections, c)
        return c
    end
    local settings = {Enabled = false, Control = "Pets", Leash = "Tied", Range = 20, Watermark = true}
