    ---------------------------------------------------------------- senses shared by every brain
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local function look(origin, dir)
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, params)
        return hit and (1 - (hit.Position - origin).Magnitude/dir.Magnitude) or 0
    end
    local controls
    local function getControls()
        if controls == nil then
            controls = false
            pcall(function() controls = require(LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("PlayerModule", 3)):GetControls() end)
        end
        return controls or nil
    end
    local function freeControls(on)
        local c = getControls()
        if c then pcall(function() if on then c:Enable() else c:Disable() end end) end
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- the brain (one per body)
    local newBrain; newBrain = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        -- groups (name, count, colour on the watermark)
        local GROUPS = {
            {"eyeL", 12, Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255)}, {"eyeR", 12, Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255)},
            {"thrL", 4, Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)}, {"thrR", 4, Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)},
            {"ring", 16, Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 90)}, {"pflL", 8, Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 60)}, {"pflR", 8, Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 60)},
            {"kc", 100, Color3.fromRGB(190, 140, 255)}, {"mbA", 4, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 160)}, {"mbV", 4, Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 200)},
            {"walk", 6, Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 140)}, {"tL", 6, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)}, {"tR", 6, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)},
            {"gf", 2, Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)}, {"groom", 4, Color3.fromRGB(160, 220, 255)}, {"fly", 4, Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 255)},
        }
        local N = {}          -- neurons: {g=group, v=potential, r=rate 0..1, s=spiked, x,y on the panel, ext=input}
        local G = {}          -- group name -> list of neuron indices
        for _, def in ipairs(GROUPS) do
            G[def[1]] = {}
            for _ = 1, def[2] do
                table.insert(N, {g = def[1], c = def[3], v = math.random()*.5, r = 0, s = false, ext = 0})
                table.insert(G[def[1]], #N)
            end
        end
        local syn = {}        -- syn[pre] = {{post, weight}, ...}
        for i = 1, #N do syn[i] = {} end
        local rng = Random.new(1337)   -- same wiring every time
        local wire; wire = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a, b, w, p)
            for _, i in ipairs(G[a]) do
                for _, j in ipairs(G[b]) do
                    if i ~= j and rng:NextNumber() < (p or 1) then table.insert(syn[i], {j, w*(.8 + rng:NextNumber()*.4)}) end
                end
            end
        end)
        -- eyes: something close on the left -> turn right, on the right -> turn left; looming on both -> giant fibre
        wire("eyeL", "tR", .22, .5) wire("eyeR", "tL", .22, .5)
        wire("eyeL", "gf", .05, .6) wire("eyeR", "gf", .05, .6)
        wire("eyeL", "walk", -.05, .4) wire("eyeR", "walk", -.05, .4)
        -- someone close: escape (giant fibre), turn away, take off
        wire("thrL", "tR", .35, .8) wire("thrR", "tL", .35, .8)
        wire("thrL", "gf", .3) wire("thrR", "gf", .3)
        wire("thrL", "mbV", .25) wire("thrR", "mbV", .25)
        -- compass ring: neighbours excite, the far side inhibits (a bump that follows your heading)
        local ring = G.ring
        for a = 1, 16 do
            for b = 1, 16 do
                local d = math.min((a - b)%16, (b - a)%16)
                if d == 1 then table.insert(syn[ring[a]], {ring[b], .35}) elseif d >= 6 then table.insert(syn[ring[a]], {ring[b], -.12}) end
            end
        end
        wire("pflL", "tL", .3, .6) wire("pflR", "tR", .3, .6)
        -- mushroom body: sparse random memory cells -> approach / avoid output neurons
        for _, k in ipairs(G.kc) do
            for _ = 1, 4 do
                local srcs = {"eyeL", "eyeR", "thrL", "thrR"}
                local g = G[srcs[rng:NextInteger(1, 4)]]
                table.insert(syn[g[rng:NextInteger(1, #g)]], {k, .45})
            end
        end
        wire("kc", "mbA", .06, .3) wire("kc", "mbV", .05, .25)
        wire("mbA", "walk", .25) wire("mbV", "tL", .12, .5) wire("mbV", "tR", .12, .5) wire("mbV", "fly", .2)
        -- motor: turning sides fight, escape stops walking, walking stops grooming
        wire("tL", "tR", -.3) wire("tR", "tL", -.3)
        wire("gf", "fly", .6) wire("gf", "walk", -.6) wire("gf", "groom", -1)
        wire("walk", "groom", -.25) wire("fly", "groom", -.5) wire("thrL", "groom", -.5) wire("thrR", "groom", -.5)

        local spikesPerSec, spikeCount, spikeClock = 0, 0, 0
        local function groupRate(name)
            local s = 0
            for _, i in ipairs(G[name]) do s += N[i].r end
            return s/#G[name]
        end
        local function setExt(name, value) for _, i in ipairs(G[name]) do N[i].ext = value end end
        local function step(dt)
            local inbox = {}
            for i, n in ipairs(N) do
                if n.s then
                    for _, e in ipairs(syn[i]) do inbox[e[1]] = (inbox[e[1]] or 0) + e[2] end
                end
            end
            local decay = math.exp(-dt/.1)
            for i, n in ipairs(N) do
                n.v = n.v*decay + n.ext*dt*46 + (inbox[i] or 0) + (math.random() - .5)*.08
                if n.v > 1 then
                    n.s = true
                    n.v = 0
                    spikeCount += 1
                else
                    n.s = false
                    if n.v < -1 then n.v = -1 end
                end
                n.r += ((n.s and 1 or 0) - n.r)*.18
            end
        end

        local wander, goalYaw, brainTime = 0, 0, 0
        local state, stateText = {}, "IDLE"
        local lastYaw
        local function think(dt, body, yaw, isYou, ignore)
            lastYaw = yaw
            -- eyes: 12 rays per side, from the front round to the side
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
            local range = isYou and 14 or 9
            local up = V3(0, isYou and 0 or .1, 0)
            for side, name in pairs({[-1] = "eyeL", [1] = "eyeR"}) do
                for k, i in ipairs(G[name]) do
                    local a = yaw - side*(k - 1)/11*math.pi*.5 - side*.05
                    N[i].ext = .05 + look(body + up, V3(-math.sin(a), 0, -math.cos(a))*range)*.9
                end
            end
            -- other players close by (only distance and side are read)
            local tl, tr = 0, 0
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                local hrp = p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then
                    local d = hrp.Position - body
                    local dist = d.Magnitude
                    if dist < 16 then
                        local right = d:Dot(V3(math.cos(yaw), 0, -math.sin(yaw)))
                        local k = (1 - dist/16)*1.2
                        if right < 0 then tl = math.max(tl, k) else tr = math.max(tr, k) end
                    end
                end
            end
            -- a pet sees YOU as a big thing too
            if not isYou then
                local me = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if me and (me.Position - body).Magnitude < 4 then
                    local right = (me.Position - body):Dot(V3(math.cos(yaw), 0, -math.sin(yaw)))
                    if right < 0 then tl = math.max(tl, .5) else tr = math.max(tr, .5) end
                end
            end
            setExt("thrL", tl) setExt("thrR", tr)
            -- compass: a bump on the ring at the current heading
            for k, i in ipairs(G.ring) do
                local a = (k - 1)/16*math.pi*2
                local d = math.atan2(math.sin(yaw - a), math.cos(yaw - a))
                N[i].ext = math.exp(-d*d*6)*.5
            end
            -- goal: wander freely, or come back when tied and too far
            wander += (math.random() - .5)*dt*1.4
            goalYaw = yaw + wander*.6
            local pull = 0
            if not isYou and settings.Leash == "Tied" then
                local me = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if me then
                    local d = me.Position - body
                    local dist = V3(d.X, 0, d.Z).Magnitude
                    pull = math.clamp((dist - settings.Range*.5)/(settings.Range*.5), 0, 1)
                    if pull > 0 then goalYaw = math.atan2(-d.X, -d.Z) end
                end
            end
            local err = math.atan2(math.sin(goalYaw - yaw), math.cos(goalYaw - yaw))
            setExt("pflL", math.max(0, err)*.9) setExt("pflR", math.max(0, -err)*.9)
            -- moods drift slowly: sometimes it wants to take off, sometimes to stop and clean itself
            brainTime += dt
            local t = brainTime
            local urgeFly = math.max(0, math.sin(t*.37) + math.sin(t*.13)*.6 - .3)
            local urgeGroom = math.max(0, math.sin(t*.23 + 2) + math.sin(t*.07)*.5 - .55)
            setExt("walk", .28) setExt("groom", .12 + urgeGroom*.6)
            setExt("fly", isYou and 0 or (.12 + urgeFly*.7 + pull*.5)) setExt("tL", .03) setExt("tR", .03) setExt("gf", 0)
            setExt("kc", .07) setExt("mbA", .06) setExt("mbV", .02)
            for _ = 1, 3 do step(dt/3) end
            state.walk, state.tl, state.tr = groupRate("walk"), groupRate("tL"), groupRate("tR")
            state.gf, state.groom, state.fly = groupRate("gf"), groupRate("groom"), groupRate("fly")
            state.pull = pull
            if state.gf > .25 then stateText = "ESCAPE"
            elseif state.groom > state.walk and state.groom > .2 then stateText = "GROOM"
            elseif state.fly > .25 and not isYou then stateText = "FLY"
            elseif math.abs(state.tl - state.tr) > .12 then stateText = state.tl > state.tr and "TURN L" or "TURN R"
            elseif state.walk > .1 then stateText = "WALK" else stateText = "IDLE" end
        end

        return {N = N, G = G, Think = think, State = state, Rate = groupRate,
            Text = function() return stateText end, Yaw = function() return lastYaw end,
            Spikes = function() return spikesPerSec end,
            Tick = function(dt)
                spikeClock += dt
                if spikeClock >= 1 then
                    spikesPerSec = spikeCount
                    spikeCount, spikeClock = 0, 0
                end
            end}
    end)
    local LAYOUT = newBrain()

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- watermark
    -- fonts / icons / colours of the menu itself
    local FB = (Fonts and Fonts.Bold) or Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold)
    local FM = (Fonts and Fonts.Medium) or Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Medium)
    local ACCENT = (Theme and Theme.Accent) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 255)
    local DIM = Color3.fromRGB(150, 142, 178)
    local function icon(parent, name, x, y, size, color)
        local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
        img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
        img.ImageColor3 = color or DIM
        pcall(ApplyIcon, img, name)
        img.Parent = parent
        return img
    end
    local function text(parent, str, x, y, w, size, font, color, align)
        local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
        l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, size + 4)
        l.FontFace = font or FM
        l.TextSize = size
        l.TextColor3 = color or DIM
        l.TextXAlignment = align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        l.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        l.Text = str
        l.Parent = parent
        return l
    end
    local function dot(parent, x, y, color, size)
        local d = Instance.new("Frame")
        d.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
        d.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
        d.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size or 5, size or 5)
        d.BorderSizePixel = 0
        d.BackgroundColor3 = color
        d.BackgroundTransparency = .85
        Instance.new("UICorner", d).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        d.Parent = parent
        return d
    end
    local MOTOR = {{"walk", "Walk", "footprints", Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 140)}, {"tL", "Turn left", "navigation", Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)},
        {"tR", "Turn right", "navigation", Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)}, {"gf", "Escape", "flame", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)},
        {"groom", "Groom", "sparkle", Color3.fromRGB(160, 220, 255)}, {"fly", "Fly", "wind", Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 255)}}
    local STATE = {WALK = {"Walking", "footprints", Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 140)}, FLY = {"Flying", "wind", Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 255)},
        ESCAPE = {"Escaping!", "flame", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)}, GROOM = {"Cleaning itself", "sparkle", Color3.fromRGB(160, 220, 255)},
        ["TURN L"] = {"Turning left", "navigation", Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)}, ["TURN R"] = {"Turning right", "navigation", Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245)},
        IDLE = {"Resting", "clock", DIM}, FLY = {"Flying", "wind", Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 255)}}
    local panel, dots, ui
    local function buildPanel()
        if panel then panel:Destroy() end
        ui = {}
        panel = Instance.new("Frame")
        panel.Name = "FlyBrainWatermark"
        panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(330, 214)
        panel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 70)
        panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 14, 24)
        panel.BackgroundTransparency = .08
        panel.Active = true
        panel.Parent = window.Gui
        Instance.new("UICorner", panel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
        ui.Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", panel)
        ui.Stroke.Color = ACCENT
        ui.Stroke.Transparency = .5
        -- header
        icon(panel, "scan-eye", 12, 10, 16, ACCENT)
        text(panel, "Fly Brain", 34, 8, 100, 14, FB, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
        text(panel, #LAYOUT.N .. " neurons", 108, 9, 90, 11, FM, DIM)
        ui.Rate = text(panel, "", 200, 9, 118, 11, FM, DIM, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
        local line = Instance.new("Frame")
        line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 32)
        line.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 1)
        line.BorderSizePixel = 0
        line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 52, 86)
        line.Parent = panel
        -- section titles
        local function section(name, ic, x, y)
            icon(panel, ic, x, y + 1, 11, DIM)
            text(panel, name, x + 15, y, 80, 10, FB, DIM)
        end
        section("EYES", "eye", 12, 40)
        section("MEMORY", "layers", 96, 40)
        section("COMPASS", "navigation", 96, 104)
        section("MOTOR", "footprints", 214, 40)
        -- neuron positions
        local pos = {}
        local function place(name, fn) for k, i in ipairs(LAYOUT.G[name]) do pos[i] = {fn(k, #LAYOUT.G[name])} end end
        place("eyeL", function(k) local a = math.rad(110 + k*10) return 46 + math.cos(a)*30, 96 - math.sin(a)*30 end)
        place("eyeR", function(k) local a = math.rad(70 - k*10) return 46 + math.cos(a)*30, 96 - math.sin(a)*30 end)
        place("thrL", function(k) return 26 + (k - 1)*5, 130 end)
        place("thrR", function(k) return 50 + (k - 1)*5, 130 end)
        place("kc", function(k) return 100 + (k - 1)%20*5.4, 60 + math.floor((k - 1)/20)*5.4 end)
        place("mbA", function(k) return 104 + (k - 1)*7, 92 end)
        place("mbV", function(k) return 182 + (k - 1)*7, 92 end)
        place("ring", function(k) local a = (k - 1)/16*math.pi*2 - math.pi/2 return 152 + math.cos(a)*24, 150 + math.sin(a)*24 end)
        place("pflL", function(k) return 104 + (k - 1)%2*6, 132 + math.floor((k - 1)/2)*8 end)
        place("pflR", function(k) return 196 + (k - 1)%2*6, 132 + math.floor((k - 1)/2)*8 end)
        ui.Bars = {}
        for row, m in ipairs(MOTOR) do
            local y = 58 + (row - 1)*21
            local ic = icon(panel, m[3], 214, y - 1, 11, m[4])
            if m[1] == "tL" then ic.Rotation = -90 elseif m[1] == "tR" then ic.Rotation = 90 end
            text(panel, m[2], 229, y - 2, 60, 10, FM, Color3.fromRGB(200, 194, 220))
            place(m[1], function(k) return 296 + (k - 1)%3*6, y + 2 + math.floor((k - 1)/3)*5 - (#LAYOUT.G[m[1]] > 3 and 2 or 0) end)
            local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
            bg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(214, y + 11)
            bg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 3)
            bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
            bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(42, 38, 60)
            Instance.new("UICorner", bg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            bg.Parent = panel
            local fill = bg:Clone()
            fill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
            fill.BackgroundColor3 = m[4]
            fill.Parent = bg
            ui.Bars[row] = {m[1], fill}
        end
        dots = {}
        for i, n in ipairs(LAYOUT.N) do dots[i] = dot(panel, pos[i][1], pos[i][2], n.c, 4) end
        -- compass needle
        ui.Needle = Instance.new("Frame")
        ui.Needle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, 1)
        ui.Needle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(152, 150)
        ui.Needle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 17)
        ui.Needle.BorderSizePixel = 0
        ui.Needle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 110)
        ui.Needle.Parent = panel
        dot(panel, 152, 150, Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 110), 5).BackgroundTransparency = 0
        -- footer: what it is doing
        local chip = Instance.new("Frame")
        chip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 180)
        chip.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 24)
        chip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 26, 44)
        chip.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", chip).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
        chip.Parent = panel
        ui.StateIcon = icon(chip, "footprints", 8, 5, 14, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
        ui.State = text(chip, "", 28, 2, 150, 13, FB, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
        ui.DriveIcon = icon(chip, "paw-print", 196, 6, 12, DIM)
        ui.Drive = text(chip, "", 212, 3, 100, 11, FM, DIM)
        -- drag
        local dragging, start, startPos
        panel.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging, start, startPos = true, input.Position, panel.Position
                input.Changed:Connect(function() if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end end)
            end
        end)
        connect(game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged, function(input)
            if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                local d = input.Position - start
                panel.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            end
        end)
    end
    local drawPanel; drawPanel = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(b, driving)
        if not panel then return end
        panel.Visible = settings.Enabled and settings.Watermark
        if not panel.Visible then return end
        if not b then
            for _, d in ipairs(dots) do d.BackgroundTransparency = .85 end
            ui.State.Text = "No pet out yet"
            ui.State.TextColor3 = DIM
            ui.Drive.Text = "Fish or Cosmetics"
            return
        end
        for i, n in ipairs(b.N) do
            local d = dots[i]
            d.BackgroundTransparency = n.s and 0 or (.82 - math.min(.72, n.r*2.4))
            d.Size = n.s and UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6) or UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4)
        end
        local txt = b.Text()
        local info = STATE[txt] or STATE.IDLE
        ui.State.Text = info[1]
        ui.State.TextColor3 = info[3]
        ui.StateIcon.ImageColor3 = info[3]
        pcall(ApplyIcon, ui.StateIcon, info[2])
        ui.StateIcon.Rotation = txt == "TURN L" and -90 or txt == "TURN R" and 90 or 0
        ui.Drive.Text = driving
        pcall(ApplyIcon, ui.DriveIcon, settings.Control == "You" and "user" or "paw-print")
        ui.Rate.Text = b.Spikes() .. " spikes / s"
        if b.Yaw() then ui.Needle.Rotation = -math.deg(b.Yaw()) end
        if b.State.walk then
            for _, bar in ipairs(ui.Bars) do bar[2].Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(b.Rate(bar[1])*2.4, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0) end
        end
        ui.Stroke.Transparency = .7 - math.min(.5, b.Spikes()/500)
    end)

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- your pets
    -- the Fish pet and the Cosmetics pets (shoulder ghost / girl, recorded pets): found by name, previews are skipped
    local petModels; petModels = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local found = {}
        for _, c in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            local n = c.Name
            if c:IsA("Model") and (n:find("^CrackHubRecordedPet_") or n == "CrackHubFishPet") then
                table.insert(found, c)
            elseif c:IsA("Folder") and n:find("^CrackHubShoulder") then
                for _, m in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do if m:IsA("Model") then table.insert(found, m) end end
            end
        end
        local fish = workspace:FindFirstChild("CrackHubFishPet", true)
        if fish and fish:IsA("Model") and not table.find(found, fish) and not fish:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ViewportFrame") then table.insert(found, fish) end
        return found
    end)
    local pets, order = {}, {}
    local myRoot; myRoot = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end)
    local yawOf; yawOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(cf) local lv = cf.LookVector return math.atan2(-lv.X, -lv.Z) end)
    local refreshPets; refreshPets = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local list = petModels()
        local keep = {}
        for _, m in ipairs(list) do
            keep[m] = true
            -- every part of the pet, and its biggest part as the handle we steer it by
            local parts, ref, big = {}, nil, 0
            for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                    table.insert(parts, d)
                    local v = d.Size.X*d.Size.Y*d.Size.Z
                    if v > big and d.Transparency < 1 then big, ref = v, d end
                end
            end
            ref = ref or parts[1]
            if ref then
                local p = pets[m]
                if not p then
                    p = {Model = m, Brain = newBrain(), Pos = ref.Position, Yaw = yawOf(ref.CFrame), Alt = 3, Speed = 0, Roll = 0, Clock = math.random()*10}
                    pets[m] = p
                end
                p.Parts, p.Ref = parts, ref
            end
        end
        for m in pairs(pets) do if not keep[m] or not m.Parent then pets[m] = nil end end
        table.clear(order)
        for _, m in ipairs(list) do if pets[m] then table.insert(order, pets[m]) end end
    end)
    local ignoreList; ignoreList = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local list = {LocalPlayer.Character}
        for _, p in ipairs(order) do table.insert(list, p.Model) end
        return list
    end)

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- driving you
    local youBrain = newBrain()
    local youYaw, youMove
    local MOVE_BIND, PET_BIND = "CrackHubFlyBrainMove", "CrackHubFlyBrainPets"
    local function bindMove(on)
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(MOVE_BIND) end)
        youYaw, youMove = nil, nil
        if not on then return end
        -- right after Roblox's own controls (they reset the move to zero every frame)
        RunService:BindToRenderStep(MOVE_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Input.Value + 5, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not (alive and settings.Enabled and settings.Control == "You" and youMove) then return end
            local _, hum = myRoot()
            if hum then hum:Move(youMove, false) end
        end))
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- pets: the brain moves them, last thing every frame
    local function bindPets(on)
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(PET_BIND) end)
        if not on then return end
        RunService:BindToRenderStep(PET_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not (alive and settings.Enabled and settings.Control == "Pets") then return end
            local root = myRoot()
            local charYaw = root and CFrame.Angles(0, yawOf(root.CFrame), 0) or CFrame.identity
            for _, p in ipairs(order) do
                if p.Model.Parent and p.Ref and p.Ref.Parent then
                    pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                        -- keep the pet's own look (its sway, bob, wings, outfit): only where it is and where it faces change.
                        -- the pet's own code already placed it this frame, we move all its parts together from there
                        local mine = p.Ref.CFrame
                        local rel = charYaw:Inverse()*mine.Rotation
                        local bob = math.sin(p.Clock*3.1)*.25
                        local want = CFrame.new(p.Pos + V3(0, bob, 0))*CFrame.Angles(0, p.Yaw, 0)*CFrame.Angles(0, 0, p.Roll)*rel
                        local delta = want*mine:Inverse()
                        for _, part in ipairs(p.Parts) do
                            if part.Parent then part.CFrame = delta*part.CFrame end
                        end
                    end))
                end
            end
        end))
    end

    local function stopAll()
        bindMove(false)
        bindPets(false)
        freeControls(true)
        local _, hum = myRoot()
        if hum then pcall(function() hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false) end) end
        table.clear(pets)
        table.clear(order)
    end
    local function apply()
        stopAll()
        if not settings.Enabled then
            if panel then panel.Visible = false end
            return
        end
        if not panel then buildPanel() end
        if settings.Control == "You" then
            freeControls(false)
            bindMove(true)
        else
            refreshPets()
            bindPets(true)
        end
    end

    local tickAcc, refreshAcc = 0, 0
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        if not settings.Enabled then return end
        local root, hum = myRoot()
        local thinkDt = 1/20
        tickAcc += dt
        local thinkNow = tickAcc >= thinkDt
        if thinkNow then tickAcc = 0 end
        if settings.Control == "You" then
            youBrain.Tick(dt)
            if not (root and hum) then return end
            if thinkNow then
                youBrain.Think(thinkDt, root.Position, yawOf(root.CFrame), true, {LocalPlayer.Character})
                drawPanel(youBrain, "driving you")
            end
            local st = youBrain.State
            if not st.walk then return end
            youYaw = youYaw or yawOf(root.CFrame)
            youYaw -= (st.tr - st.tl)*5*dt*1.8
            local go = youBrain.Text() == "GROOM" and 0 or math.clamp(.35 + st.walk*2.5 + st.gf*2, 0, 1)
            youMove = V3(-math.sin(youYaw), 0, -math.cos(youYaw))*go
            if st.gf > .25 then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() hum.Jump = true end)) end
            return
        end
        -- pets
        refreshAcc += dt
        if refreshAcc > 1 then
            refreshAcc = 0
            refreshPets()
        end
        local ignore = thinkNow and ignoreList()
        for _, p in ipairs(order) do
            local b = p.Brain
            b.Tick(dt)
            p.Clock += dt
            if thinkNow then b.Think(thinkDt, p.Pos, p.Yaw, false, ignore) end
            local st = b.State
            if st.walk then
                -- pets fly: cruising, darting away, hovering while they "clean" themselves
                local yawRate = (st.tr - st.tl)*5*1.4
                p.Yaw -= yawRate*dt
                p.Roll += (math.clamp(-yawRate*.15, -.5, .5) - p.Roll)*math.min(1, dt*6)
                local txt = b.Text()
                local speed = txt == "GROOM" and 0 or (3 + st.walk*9 + st.fly*8 + st.gf*24 + st.pull*12)
                p.Speed += (speed - p.Speed)*math.min(1, dt*4)
                local fwd = V3(-math.sin(p.Yaw), 0, -math.cos(p.Yaw))
                params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore or ignoreList()
                if workspace:Raycast(p.Pos, fwd*2, params) then
                    p.Yaw += math.pi*.6*(math.random() < .5 and 1 or -1)
                    fwd = V3(-math.sin(p.Yaw), 0, -math.cos(p.Yaw))
                end
                local pos = p.Pos + fwd*p.Speed*dt
                local ground = workspace:Raycast(pos + V3(0, 4, 0), V3(0, -80, 0), params)
                local floorY = ground and ground.Position.Y or (p.Pos.Y - p.Alt)
                local wantAlt = 2.2 + st.fly*4 + st.gf*3 + math.sin(p.Clock*.7)*.6
                p.Alt += (wantAlt - p.Alt)*math.min(1, dt*2.5)
                pos = V3(pos.X, floorY + p.Alt, pos.Z)
                if settings.Leash == "Tied" and root then
                    local d = pos - root.Position
                    local flat = V3(d.X, 0, d.Z)
                    if flat.Magnitude > settings.Range then pos = root.Position + flat.Unit*settings.Range + V3(0, pos.Y - root.Position.Y, 0) end
                end
                p.Pos = pos
            end
        end
        if thinkNow then
            local first = order[1]
            drawPanel(first and first.Brain, #order == 1 and "driving 1 pet" or ("driving " .. #order .. " pets"))
        end
    end))

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- menu
    local group = tab:AddGroup("Fly Brain", true)
    group:AddToggle({Name = "Fly Brain", Description = "200 spiking neurons fly your pets (Fish + Cosmetics) or you · only you see it", Default = false, Callback = function(v)
        settings.Enabled = v
        apply()
    end})
    group:AddDropdown({Name = "Brain controls", Options = {"My pets", "Me"}, Default = "My pets", Callback = function(v)
        if type(v) == "table" then v = v[1] end
        settings.Control = v == "Me" and "You" or "Pets"
        if settings.Enabled then apply() end
    end})
    group:AddDropdown({Name = "Pets", Options = {"Tied to me", "Let loose (on their own)"}, Default = "Tied to me", Callback = function(v)
        if type(v) == "table" then v = v[1] end
        settings.Leash = v == "Tied to me" and "Tied" or "Free"
    end})
    group:AddSlider({Name = "Leash length", Min = 6, Max = 60, Default = 20, Increment = 1, Callback = function(v) settings.Range = v end})
    group:AddToggle({Name = "Brain watermark", Description = "Neurons firing live on screen", Default = true, Bind = false, Callback = function(v)
        settings.Watermark = v
        if panel then panel.Visible = settings.Enabled and v end
    end})
    group:AddButton({Name = "Call pets back", Bind = false, Callback = function()
        local root = myRoot()
        if not root then return end
        for i, p in ipairs(order) do p.Pos = root.Position + V3(math.cos(i*2.1)*3, 2.5, math.sin(i*2.1)*3) end
    end})

    connect(window.Gui.Destroying, function()
        pcall(stopAll)
        alive = false
        if panel then pcall(function() panel:Destroy() end) end
        for _, c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end
    end)
    return {Group = group}
end

CrackHub.Toggle3DGui = function(window)
    -- Profile card (avatar / nick) · 3D GUI: the whole menu moves onto a panel inside the game world.
    -- Top bar: drag to move it, pin = it follows you / stays where it is, ✕ = back to the screen.
    -- Drag the left / right / bottom edges or the corner to make it wider or taller. Only you see it.
    local st = window.__Gui3D
    if st and st.On then
        st.Exit()
        return
    end
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    local root = window.Root
    if not root then return end
    local V3 = Vector3.new
    local Q = 1.6                   -- the menu is drawn 1.6x bigger on the panel so text stays sharp up close
    local PPS = 110*Q               -- canvas pixels per stud
    local M, BAR = 18, 38           -- edge handle margin and top bar height (menu pixels)
    local ACCENT = (Theme and Theme.Accent) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 255)
    st = {On = true}
    window.__Gui3D = st
    local saved = {Parent = root.Parent, Anchor = root.AnchorPoint, Pos = root.Position, Size = root.Size, Scale = window.ScaleObj and window.ScaleObj.Scale}
    local W = math.max(560, root.Size.X.Offset > 0 and root.Size.X.Offset or root.AbsoluteSize.X)
    local H = math.max(360, root.Size.Y.Offset > 0 and root.Size.Y.Offset or root.AbsoluteSize.Y)
    local follow = true
    local conns = {}

    -- the panel in the world
    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "CrackHub3DGui"
    folder.Parent = workspace
    local panel = Instance.new("Part")
    panel.Name = "Panel"
    panel.Anchored, panel.CanCollide, panel.CanQuery, panel.CanTouch, panel.CastShadow = true, false, true, false, false
    panel.Transparency = 1
    panel.Parent = folder
    local function piece(name, material, color, transparency)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = name
        p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
        p.Material = material
        p.Color = color
        p.Transparency = transparency
        p.Parent = folder
        return p
    end
    local slab = piece("Glass", Enum.Material.Glass, Color3.fromRGB(14, 12, 22), .25)
    local back = piece("Back", Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color3.fromRGB(22, 20, 34), 0)
    local rims = {}
    for i = 1, 4 do rims[i] = piece("Rim", Enum.Material.Neon, ACCENT, .15) end
    local corners = {}
    for i = 1, 4 do
        corners[i] = piece("Corner", Enum.Material.Neon, ACCENT, .05)
        corners[i].Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    end
    local halo = piece("Halo", Enum.Material.Neon, ACCENT, .93)
    local beam = piece("HoloBeam", Enum.Material.Neon, ACCENT, .88)
    beam.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
    emitter.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
    emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), ACCENT)
    emitter.LightEmission = 1
    emitter.LightInfluence = 0
    emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .12), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
    emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
    emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(.8, 1.6)
    emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(.6, 1.6)
    emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(25, 25)
    emitter.Rate = 14
    emitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Right
    emitter.Parent = beam
    local light = Instance.new("SurfaceLight")
    light.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
    light.Color = ACCENT
    light.Brightness = .8
    light.Range = 10
    light.Angle = 120
    light.Parent = panel
    local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
    sg.Name = "CrackHub3D"
    sg.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
    sg.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
    sg.PixelsPerStud = PPS
    sg.Brightness = 1.15
    sg.LightInfluence = 0
    sg.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
    sg.MaxDistance = 2000
    sg.Adornee = panel
    -- clicks only reach a world GUI from PlayerGui
    sg.Parent = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5) or window.Gui.Parent

    -- no screen effects of the menu while it lives in the world (blur / depth of field / its glass pane)
    window.__No2DFx = true
    pcall(function() if window.__StopBlur then window.__StopBlur() end end)
    local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    local killScreenFx; killScreenFx = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        for _, name in ipairs({"CrackHubBlur", "CrackHubDOF"}) do
            local fx = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
            if fx then fx.Enabled = false end
        end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local glass = cam and cam:FindFirstChild("CrackHubGlass")
        if glass then glass.Parent = nil end
    end)
    killScreenFx()

    -- top bar + edge handles (they live around the menu on the same panel)
    local function frame(props)
        local f = Instance.new(props.Class or "Frame")
        for k, v in pairs(props) do if k ~= "Class" and k ~= "Parent" then f[k] = v end end
        f.Parent = props.Parent
        return f
    end
    local backdrop = frame({BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 20), BackgroundTransparency = .05, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 0, Parent = sg})
    Instance.new("UICorner", backdrop).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 22*Q)
    local bg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    bg.Rotation = 90
    bg.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(34, 28, 56), Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 18))
    bg.Parent = backdrop
    local glowStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    glowStroke.Color = ACCENT
    glowStroke.Thickness = 3*Q
    glowStroke.Transparency = .25
    glowStroke.Parent = backdrop
    local sheen = frame({BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = .93, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 0, Parent = backdrop,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, .22, 0)})
    Instance.new("UICorner", sheen).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 22*Q)
    local sg2 = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    sg2.Rotation = 90
    sg2.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
    sg2.Parent = sheen
    local bar = frame({Class = "TextButton", Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 22, 40), BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2, Parent = sg})
    Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local barStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    barStroke.Color = ACCENT
    barStroke.Transparency = .55
    barStroke.Thickness = 1.5*Q
    barStroke.Parent = bar
    local barGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    barGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(190, 180, 225))
    barGrad.Rotation = 90
    barGrad.Parent = bar
    local gripIcon = frame({Class = "ImageLabel", BackgroundTransparency = 1, ImageColor3 = ACCENT, ZIndex = 3, Parent = bar,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, .5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12*Q, .5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16*Q, 16*Q)})
    pcall(ApplyIcon, gripIcon, "move-diagonal")
    local grip = frame({Class = "TextLabel", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(36*Q, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -120*Q, 1, 0), ZIndex = 3,
        Text = "", TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 198, 235), TextSize = 13*Q, Parent = bar})
    pcall(function() grip.FontFace = Fonts.Medium end)
    local function barButton(icon, x, tip)
        local b = frame({Class = "ImageButton", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(44, 38, 66), BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3,
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, .5), Position = UDim2.new(1, x*Q, .5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28*Q, 26*Q), ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Parent = bar})
        Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
        pad.PaddingLeft, pad.PaddingRight, pad.PaddingTop, pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6*Q), UDim.new(0, 6*Q), UDim.new(0, 5*Q), UDim.new(0, 5*Q)
        pad.Parent = b
        pcall(ApplyIcon, b, icon)
        b.Name = tip
        local hoverColor = icon == "x" and Color3.fromRGB(220, 70, 90) or ACCENT
        b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if not (icon ~= "x" and follow) then b.BackgroundColor3 = hoverColor end end)
        b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if icon == "x" or not follow then b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(44, 38, 66) end end)
        return b
    end
    local closeB = barButton("x", -7, "Back to screen")
    local pinB = barButton("navigation", -41, "Follow me")
    local function paintPin()
        pinB.BackgroundColor3 = follow and ACCENT or Color3.fromRGB(44, 38, 66)
        grip.Text = follow and "Follows you  ·  drag to move  ·  pull the edges to resize" or "Stays here  ·  drag to move  ·  pull the edges to resize"
    end
    paintPin()
    local handles = {}
    local function handle(kind)
        local h = frame({Class = "TextButton", Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT, BackgroundTransparency = .55, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4, Parent = sg})
        Instance.new("UICorner", h).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local hs = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        hs.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        hs.Transparency = .75
        hs.Thickness = 1*Q
        hs.Parent = h
        handles[kind] = h
        h.MouseEnter:Connect(function() h.BackgroundTransparency = .05 hs.Transparency = .2 end)
        h.MouseLeave:Connect(function() h.BackgroundTransparency = .55 hs.Transparency = .75 end)
        return h
    end
    handle("left") handle("right") handle("bottom") handle("corner")

    -- layout of the canvas (pixels) and the panel (studs)
    local function layout()
        local cw, ch = (W + M*2)*Q, (H + M*2 + BAR)*Q
        panel.Size = V3(cw/PPS, ch/PPS, .05)
        backdrop.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(M*.45*Q, M*.45*Q)
        backdrop.Size = UDim2.fromOffset((W + M*1.1)*Q, (H + BAR + M*1.1)*Q)
        bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(M*Q, 6*Q)
        bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W*Q, (BAR - 10)*Q)
        handles.left.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3*Q, (M + BAR + H*.3)*Q)
        handles.left.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7*Q, H*.4*Q)
        handles.right.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((M + W + 8)*Q, (M + BAR + H*.3)*Q)
        handles.right.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7*Q, H*.4*Q)
        handles.bottom.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((M + W*.3)*Q, (M + BAR + H + 8)*Q)
        handles.bottom.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W*.4*Q, 7*Q)
        handles.corner.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((M + W + 3)*Q, (M + BAR + H + 3)*Q)
        handles.corner.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14*Q, 14*Q)
        root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero
        root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(M*Q, (M + BAR)*Q)
        root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
    end
    -- the glass, rim, corners, halo and holo beam follow the panel
    local dress; dress = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(cf, t)
        local sx, sy = panel.Size.X, panel.Size.Y
        local w, h = sx - .1, sy - .1
        slab.Size = V3(w, h, .14)
        slab.CFrame = cf*CFrame.new(0, 0, .09)
        back.Size = V3(w - .02, h - .02, .04)
        back.CFrame = cf*CFrame.new(0, 0, .18)
        rims[1].Size, rims[1].CFrame = V3(w, .05, .05), cf*CFrame.new(0, h/2, .05)
        rims[2].Size, rims[2].CFrame = V3(w, .05, .05), cf*CFrame.new(0, -h/2, .05)
        rims[3].Size, rims[3].CFrame = V3(.05, h, .05), cf*CFrame.new(w/2, 0, .05)
        rims[4].Size, rims[4].CFrame = V3(.05, h, .05), cf*CFrame.new(-w/2, 0, .05)
        local k = 0
        for _, sx2 in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
            for _, sy2 in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
                k += 1
                corners[k].Size = V3(.12, .12, .12)
                corners[k].CFrame = cf*CFrame.new(sx2*w/2, sy2*h/2, .05)
            end
        end
        local pulse = .9 + math.sin(t*2)*.03
        halo.Size = V3(w + .7, h + .7, .02)
        halo.CFrame = cf*CFrame.new(0, 0, .26)
        halo.Transparency = pulse
        for _, r in ipairs(rims) do r.Transparency = .1 + math.sin(t*2)*.08 end
        -- a soft holo beam from under the panel to the floor
        local base = (cf*CFrame.new(0, -h/2 - .05, .1)).Position
        local len = 2.6
        beam.Size = V3(len, .5, .5)
        beam.CFrame = CFrame.new(base - V3(0, len/2, 0))*CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi/2)
        beam.Transparency = .86 + math.sin(t*3)*.03
    end)
    -- where the panel is: relative to you (follow) or fixed in the world
    local charRoot; charRoot = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end)
    local worldCF
    do
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local r = charRoot()
        local base = r and r.Position + V3(0, 1.5, 0) or cam.CFrame.Position + cam.CFrame.LookVector*10
        local flat = V3(cam.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, cam.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
        flat = flat.Magnitude > .1 and flat.Unit or V3(0, 0, -1)
        local pos = base + flat*7
        worldCF = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos - flat)   -- the front (the menu) looks back at you
    end
    local relCF
    local function captureRel()
        local r = charRoot()
        if r then
            local yaw = CFrame.new(r.Position)*CFrame.Angles(0, math.atan2(-r.CFrame.LookVector.X, -r.CFrame.LookVector.Z), 0)
            relCF = yaw:ToObjectSpace(worldCF)
        end
    end
    captureRel()
    local currentCF; currentCF = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if follow and relCF then
            local r = charRoot()
            if r then
                local yaw = CFrame.new(r.Position)*CFrame.Angles(0, math.atan2(-r.CFrame.LookVector.X, -r.CFrame.LookVector.Z), 0)
                worldCF = yaw*relCF
            end
        end
        return worldCF
    end)

    -- mouse on the panel plane -> canvas pixels
    local function planeHit(cf, screenPos)
        local ray = workspace.CurrentCamera:ViewportPointToRay(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
        local n = cf.LookVector
        local denom = ray.Direction:Dot(n)
        if math.abs(denom) < 1e-4 then return nil end
        local t = (cf.Position - ray.Origin):Dot(n)/denom
        if t < 0 then return nil end
        return ray.Origin + ray.Direction*t
    end
    local drag
    local function begin(kind, input)
        local cf = currentCF()
        local hit = planeHit(cf, UserInputService:GetMouseLocation())
        if not hit then return end
        drag = {Kind = kind, Hit = hit, CF = cf, W = W, H = H}
        local c
        c = input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                drag = nil
                captureRel()
                c:Disconnect()
            end
        end)
    end
    local function onDown(kind)
        return function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then begin(kind, input) end
        end
    end
    bar.InputBegan:Connect(onDown("move"))
    for kind, h in pairs(handles) do h.InputBegan:Connect(onDown(kind)) end
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not drag then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        local hit = planeHit(drag.CF, UserInputService:GetMouseLocation())
        if not hit then return end
        local cf = drag.CF
        local d = hit - drag.Hit
        -- on the front face the menu's "right" is the panel's -X and "down" is its -Y
        local right, down = -cf.RightVector, -cf.UpVector
        local dx, dy = d:Dot(right)*PPS/Q, d:Dot(down)*PPS/Q
        if drag.Kind == "move" then
            worldCF = cf + d
        else
            local cw0, ch0 = (drag.W + M*2)*Q/PPS, (drag.H + M*2 + BAR)*Q/PPS
            local topLeft = cf.Position - right*cw0/2 - down*ch0/2
            local topRight = cf.Position + right*cw0/2 - down*ch0/2
            local nw, nh = drag.W, drag.H
            if drag.Kind == "right" or drag.Kind == "corner" then nw = drag.W + dx end
            if drag.Kind == "left" then nw = drag.W - dx end
            if drag.Kind == "bottom" or drag.Kind == "corner" then nh = drag.H + dy end
            nw, nh = math.clamp(nw, 520, 1700), math.clamp(nh, 330, 1100)
            W, H = math.floor(nw), math.floor(nh)
            local cw, ch = (W + M*2)*Q/PPS, (H + M*2 + BAR)*Q/PPS
            local center
            if drag.Kind == "left" then center = topRight - right*cw/2 + down*ch/2 else center = topLeft + right*cw/2 + down*ch/2 end
            worldCF = CFrame.fromMatrix(center, cf.RightVector, cf.UpVector)
            layout()
        end
        if follow then captureRel() end
    end))
    pinB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        follow = not follow
        if follow then captureRel() end
        paintPin()
    end)

    local openedAt = os.clock()
    -- move the real menu onto the panel
    root.Parent = sg
    layout()
    table.insert(conns, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if not st.On then return end
        -- the menu keeps trying to put itself back where it was on the screen: hold it on the panel
        if root.Parent ~= sg then root.Parent = sg end
        killScreenFx()
        if root.Position ~= UDim2.fromOffset(M*Q, (M + BAR)*Q) then root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(M*Q, (M + BAR)*Q) end
        if root.AnchorPoint ~= Vector2.zero then root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero end
        if root.Size ~= UDim2.fromOffset(W, H) then root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H) end
        if window.ScaleObj and window.ScaleObj.Scale ~= Q then window.ScaleObj.Scale = Q end
        local shown = root.Visible
        sg.Enabled = shown
        light.Enabled = shown
        emitter.Enabled = shown
        local t = os.clock()
        -- grows in when it opens, then floats gently
        local grow = math.clamp((t - openedAt)/.45, 0, 1)
        grow = 1 - (1 - grow)^3
        local cf = currentCF()*CFrame.new(0, drag and 0 or math.sin(t*1.4)*.06, 0)
        panel.CFrame = cf
        dress(cf, t)
        for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p ~= panel then
                if not shown then p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 else p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 - grow end
            end
        end
        sg.Brightness = 1.15*grow
    end)))

    function st.Exit()
        st.On = false
        window.__No2DFx = false
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end
        root.Parent = saved.Parent
        root.AnchorPoint = saved.Anchor
        root.Position = saved.Pos
        root.Size = saved.Size
        if window.ScaleObj and saved.Scale then window.ScaleObj.Scale = saved.Scale end
        pcall(function() sg:Destroy() end)
        pcall(function() folder:Destroy() end)
        -- back on the screen: the menu's own blur comes back if it is open
        pcall(function() if window.__ApplyBlur and root.Visible then window.__ApplyBlur(true, .25) end end)
    end
    closeB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(st.Exit)
    table.insert(conns, window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(function() pcall(st.Exit) end))
    pcall(function() CrackHub:Notify({Title = "3D GUI", Content = "The menu is in the world now · X on its bar or the cube on your profile brings it back", Type = "Info", Duration = 4}) end)
end

CrackHub.InstallLyrics3D = function(window, tab)
    -- Music · Lyrics in the world: while a song plays, its words fly into the game like Minecraft text —
    -- they fade in, bounce off the floor, walls and each other, then fade away. Lyrics with timings come from LRCLIB
    -- (lrclib.net, a free open lyrics database) by the track's title and artist. Only you see the words.
    local music = window.MusicPlayer
    if not music then return end
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    local V3 = Vector3.new
    local alive = true
    local conns = {}
    local settings = {Enabled = false, Font = "Minecraft", Color = "Rainbow", Spawn = "Before my eyes", Collide = true, HitMe = false,
        Size = 2, Life = 7, Gravity = 25, Power = 45, Max = 60, Offset = 0, Fall = 14, Distance = 14,
        Style = "World", WDist = 9, WSize = 1, Scatter = .7, Roadside = true, WGlow = true, WGlowStrength = .9, WShadow = true, InWatermark = true,
        Palette = "Ice", GlowSize = 1, GlowPulse = true, Stay = 3, Vanish = "With the music", Glow = 70, Trails = true, Sparks = true, Pulse = true, Lights = true}
    local FONTS = {Minecraft = Enum.Font.Arcade, Bold = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Comic = Enum.Font.FredokaOne, Cartoon = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy}
    local function notify(text, kind)
        pcall(function() CrackHub:Notify({Title = "3D Lyrics", Content = text, Type = kind or "Info", Duration = 4}) end)
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- lyrics
    local env = CrackHubEnvironment or {}
    local function httpGet(url)
        local req = env.request or env.http_request or (type(request) == "function" and request) or (type(http_request) == "function" and http_request)
            or (type(syn) == "table" and syn.request)
        if req then
            local ok, res = pcall(req, {Url = url, Method = "GET", Headers = {["User-Agent"] = "CrackHub (Roblox)"}})
            if ok and type(res) == "table" and (res.StatusCode == 200 or res.Success) then return res.Body end
        end
        local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
        if ok and type(body) == "string" then return body end
        return nil
    end
    local function decode(body)
        if not body then return nil end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
        return ok and data or nil
    end
    local function parseLrc(text)
        local lines = {}
        for raw in tostring(text):gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
            local times = {}
            local rest = raw:gsub("%[(%d+):(%d+%.?%d*)%]", function(m, s)
                table.insert(times, tonumber(m)*60 + tonumber(s))
                return ""
            end)
            rest = rest:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            if rest ~= "" then for _, t in ipairs(times) do table.insert(lines, {T = t, Text = rest}) end end
        end
        table.sort(lines, function(a, b) return a.T < b.T end)
        return lines
    end
    local cache = {}
    local function clean(s)
        s = tostring(s or "")
        s = s:gsub("%b()", ""):gsub("%b[]", ""):gsub("[Ff]eat%.?.*$", ""):gsub("%s+", " ")
        return (s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
    end
    local function lyricsFor(track)
        local title, artist = clean(track.title), clean(track.artist)
        if artist == "Roblox Audio" then artist = "" end
        -- titles like "Artist - Song"
        if artist == "" and title:find(" %- ") then artist, title = title:match("^(.-) %- (.+)$") end
        local key = title .. "|" .. artist
        if cache[key] ~= nil then return cache[key] end
        local enc = function(s) return HttpService:UrlEncode(s) end
        local found
        if artist ~= "" then
            local d = decode(httpGet("https://lrclib.net/api/get?track_name=" .. enc(title) .. "&artist_name=" .. enc(artist)))
            if type(d) == "table" and (d.syncedLyrics or d.plainLyrics) then found = d end
        end
        if not found then
            local list = decode(httpGet("https://lrclib.net/api/search?q=" .. enc((title .. " " .. artist):gsub("%s+$", ""))))
            if type(list) == "table" then
                for _, d in ipairs(list) do if type(d) == "table" and d.syncedLyrics then found = d break end end
                if not found and type(list[1]) == "table" then found = list[1] end
            end
        end
        local lines = {}
        if found and type(found.syncedLyrics) == "string" and found.syncedLyrics ~= "" then
            lines = parseLrc(found.syncedLyrics)
        elseif found and type(found.plainLyrics) == "string" then
            -- no timings: spread the lines evenly over the song
            local plain = {}
            for l in found.plainLyrics:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do if l:match("%S") then table.insert(plain, l) end end
            local len = (music.Duration and music.Duration()) or 120
            for i, l in ipairs(plain) do table.insert(lines, {T = len*(.05 + .9*(i - 1)/math.max(1, #plain)), Text = l}) end
        end
        cache[key] = lines
        return lines
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- words in the world
    local clearWorld
    local lines, nextLine, lastPos, trackKey, loading = {}, 1, 0, nil, false
    local folder
    local words = {}
    local hue = 0
    local colorFor; colorFor = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(i)
        if settings.Color == "White" then return Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
        if settings.Color == "Gold" then return Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 80) end
        if settings.Color == "Menu accent" then return (Theme and Theme.Accent) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 255) end
        hue = (hue + .07)%1
        return Color3.fromHSV(hue, .65, 1)
    end)
    local fadeAndRemove; fadeAndRemove = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(w, time)
        if w.Gone then return end
        w.Gone = true
        local info = TweenInfo.new(time, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
        for _, l in ipairs(w.Labels) do pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() TweenService:Create(l, info, {TextTransparency = 1, TextStrokeTransparency = 1}):Play() end)) end
        for _, k in ipairs(w.Strokes) do pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() TweenService:Create(k, info, {Transparency = 1}):Play() end)) end
        for _, sc in ipairs(w.Scales) do pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() TweenService:Create(sc, info, {Scale = .55}):Play() end)) end
        if w.Light then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() TweenService:Create(w.Light, info, {Brightness = 0}):Play() end)) end
        if w.Trail then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() w.Trail.Enabled = false end)) end
        task.delay(time + .05, function() pcall(function() w.Part:Destroy() end) end)
    end)
    local charParts; charParts = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local list = {}
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        if c then for _, p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do if p:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(list, p) end end end
        return list
    end)
    local spawnWord; spawnWord = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(text, index, count, color, place)
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not root or not cam then return end
        if not folder or not folder.Parent then
            folder = Instance.new("Folder")
            folder.Name = "CrackHubLyrics"
            folder.Parent = workspace
        end
        local size = settings.Size
        local width = (#text*.62 + .5)*size
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = "Word"
        p.Size = V3(width, size, math.max(.25, size*.3))
        p.Transparency = 1
        p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = false, false, false
        p.CanCollide = settings.Collide
        p.Anchored = not settings.Collide
        p.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(.4, .5, .45, 1, 1)
        -- where it appears
        local flat = V3(cam.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, cam.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
        flat = flat.Magnitude > .1 and flat.Unit or V3(0, 0, -1)
        local side = flat:Cross(V3(0, 1, 0))
        local spread = (index - (count + 1)/2)
        local pos, out
        local fall = V3(0, -settings.Fall, 0)
        if settings.Spawn == "Before my eyes" or settings.Spawn == "From the sky" then
            -- straight in front of the camera, a bit away from the eyes, coming in from above the screen
            local x, y, dist
            if place then
                x, y, dist = place.X, place.Y, place.Dist
            else
                dist = settings.Distance
                local halfH = math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView)/2)*dist
                x, y = 0, halfH + size*1.2
            end
            pos = (place and place.Cam or cam.CFrame)*CFrame.new(x, y, -dist)
            pos = pos.Position
            out = V3((math.random() - .5)*.3, 0, (math.random() - .5)*.3)
        elseif settings.Spawn == "Above me" then
            pos = root.Position + side*spread*size*1.6 + V3(0, 9 + math.random()*2, 0) + flat*2
            out = V3(0, -.2, 0)
        elseif settings.Spawn == "Around me" then
            local a = math.random()*math.pi*2
            out = V3(math.cos(a), 0, math.sin(a))
            pos = root.Position + out*(6 + math.random()*2) + V3(0, 2 + math.random()*3, 0)
        else
            pos = root.Position + flat*(7 + math.random()) + side*spread*size*1.25 + V3(0, 3 + math.abs(spread)*.25*size, 0)
            out = (flat + side*spread*.18).Unit
        end

        local head = root.Position + V3(0, 1.5, 0)
        if falling and place then
            -- the whole line is one flat row facing the camera
            local c = place.Cam
            p.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(pos, -c.RightVector, c.UpVector)
        else
            local faceAt = falling and cam.CFrame.Position or V3(head.X, pos.Y, head.Z)
            p.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, V3(faceAt.X, pos.Y, faceAt.Z))*CFrame.Angles(0, 0, (math.random() - .5)*.25)
        end
        local delay = place and place.Delay or 0
        -- the text on both sides: a soft neon halo, a dark drop shadow (Minecraft style), bright letters with a moving shine
        local labels, strokes, scales, grads = {}, {}, {}, {}
        local glow = settings.Glow/100
        local light = Color3.new(math.min(1, color.R*.45 + .55), math.min(1, color.G*.45 + .55), math.min(1, color.B*.45 + .55))
        local font = FONTS[settings.Font] or Enum.Font.Arcade
        local layer; layer = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(parent, z, col, offset, trans)
            local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
            l.Position = UDim2.new(.5, offset, .5, offset)
            l.Size = UDim2.fromScale(.92, .86)
            l.Font = font
            l.TextScaled = true
            l.Text = text
            l.TextColor3 = col
            l.TextTransparency = 1
            l.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
            l.ZIndex = z
            l.Parent = parent
            table.insert(labels, l)
            l:SetAttribute("Target", trans)
            return l
        end)
        for _, face in ipairs({Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back}) do
            local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
            sg.Face = face
            sg.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
            sg.PixelsPerStud = 50
            sg.LightInfluence = 0
            sg.Brightness = 1 + glow*2.2
            sg.ClipsDescendants = false
            sg.Parent = p
            local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
            holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            holder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            holder.Parent = sg
            local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
            scale.Scale = .25
            scale.Parent = holder
            table.insert(scales, scale)
            -- halo: two wide soft outlines in the word's colour
            if glow > 0 then
                for k, thick in ipairs({size*9*glow + 4, size*4.5*glow + 2}) do
                    local h = layer(holder, k, color, 0, .55 + k*.1)
                    local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                    st.Color = color
                    st.Thickness = thick
                    st.Transparency = 1
                    st.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
                    st.Parent = h
                    st:SetAttribute("Target", k == 1 and .82 - glow*.12 or .6 - glow*.15)
                    table.insert(strokes, st)
                end
            end
            layer(holder, 3, Color3.new(color.R*.18, color.G*.18, color.B*.18), math.max(2, size*3), .1)
            local main = layer(holder, 4, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0, 0)
            local edge = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            edge.Color = Color3.new(color.R*.35, color.G*.35, color.B*.35)
            edge.Thickness = math.max(1, size*.9)
            edge.Transparency = 1
            edge.Parent = main
            edge:SetAttribute("Target", .2)
            table.insert(strokes, edge)
            local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, color), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.45, color),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.5, light), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.55, color), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, color)})
            grad.Rotation = 20
            grad.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
            grad.Parent = main
            table.insert(grads, grad)
        end
        -- pop in (overshoot), fade in
        -- in a line the words light up one after another
        for _, sc in ipairs(scales) do TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, delay), {Scale = 1}):Play() end
        for _, l in ipairs(labels) do TweenService:Create(l, TweenInfo.new(.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, delay), {TextTransparency = l:GetAttribute("Target") or 0}):Play() end
        for _, st in ipairs(strokes) do TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, delay), {Transparency = st:GetAttribute("Target") or .5}):Play() end
        -- the word lights up what is around it
        local pl
        if settings.Lights then
            local lit = 0
            for _, x in ipairs(words) do if x.Light and not x.Gone then lit += 1 end end
            if lit < 14 then
                pl = Instance.new("PointLight")
                pl.Color = color
                pl.Range = 4 + size*2.5
                pl.Brightness = 0
                pl.Shadows = false
                pl.Parent = p
                TweenService:Create(pl, TweenInfo.new(.3), {Brightness = .6 + glow*1.4}):Play()
            end
        end
        -- spark burst when it appears
        if settings.Sparks then
            local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
            pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
            pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(light, color)
            pe.LightEmission = 1
            pe.LightInfluence = 0
            pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, size*.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
            pe.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
            pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(.35, .7)
            pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6 + size)
            pe.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
            pe.Drag = 4
            pe.Rate = 0
            pe.Parent = p
            task.delay(delay, function() pcall(function() pe:Emit(10 + math.floor(#text*1.5)) end) end)
        end
        -- glowing streaks while it flies
        local trail
        if settings.Trails and settings.Collide then
            local a0, a1 = Instance.new("Attachment"), Instance.new("Attachment")
            a0.Position = V3(0, size*.35, 0)
            a1.Position = V3(0, -size*.35, 0)
            a0.Parent, a1.Parent = p, p
            trail = Instance.new("Trail")
            trail.Attachment0, trail.Attachment1 = a0, a1
            trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
            trail.LightEmission = 1
            trail.LightInfluence = 0
            trail.FaceCamera = true
            trail.Lifetime = .3
            trail.MinLength = .05
            trail.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
            trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .45), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
            trail.Parent = p
        end
        p.Parent = folder
        local drift = falling and (place and fall or (fall + V3((math.random() - .5)*1.2, 0, (math.random() - .5)*1.2)))
            or V3((math.random() - .5)*.6, .5 + math.random()*.5, (math.random() - .5)*.6)
        local w = {Part = p, Labels = labels, Strokes = strokes, Scales = scales, Grads = grads, Light = pl, Trail = trail, Color = color,
            Born = os.clock() + delay, Shine = math.random()*3, Drift = drift, Spin = place and 0 or (math.random() - .5)*(falling and 1.2 or 0)}
        if settings.Collide then
            -- physics: launched out, lighter gravity, bounces off the world and the other words
            if not settings.HitMe then
                for _, cp in ipairs(charParts()) do
                    local nc = Instance.new("NoCollisionConstraint")
                    nc.Part0, nc.Part1 = p, cp
                    nc.Parent = p
                end
            end
            local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
            att.Parent = p
            local lift = Instance.new("VectorForce")
            lift.Attachment0 = att
            lift.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
            lift.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
            lift.Force = V3(0, p.AssemblyMass*workspace.Gravity*(1 - settings.Gravity/100), 0)
            lift.Parent = p
            local power = settings.Power/100
            if falling then
                p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = fall
            else
                p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = out*(4 + power*22) + V3(0, 5 + power*14, 0) + V3((math.random() - .5)*3, 0, (math.random() - .5)*3)
            end
            p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = V3((math.random() - .5)*3, (math.random() - .5)*3, (math.random() - .5)*3)
        end
        table.insert(words, w)
        -- too many: the oldest fade first
        local live = 0
        for _, x in ipairs(words) do if not x.Gone then live += 1 end end
        for _, x in ipairs(words) do
            if live <= settings.Max then break end
            if not x.Gone then
                fadeAndRemove(x, .4)
                live -= 1
            end
        end
    end)
    local spawnLine; spawnLine = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(text)
        local list = {}
        for word in text:gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(list, word) end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam and #list > 0 and (settings.Spawn == "Before my eyes" or settings.Spawn == "From the sky") then
            local size = settings.Size
            local dist = settings.Distance
            local halfH = math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView)/2)*dist
            local halfW = halfH*(cam.ViewportSize.X/math.max(1, cam.ViewportSize.Y))
            local gap = size*.45
            local rows, row, rowW = {}, {}, 0
            for _, word in ipairs(list) do
                local w = (#word*.62 + .5)*size
                if #row > 0 and rowW + gap + w > halfW*1.8 then
                    table.insert(rows, {Words = row, W = rowW})
                    row, rowW = {}, 0
                end
                table.insert(row, {Text = word, W = w})
                rowW += (#row > 1 and gap or 0) + w
            end
            table.insert(rows, {Words = row, W = rowW})
            local top = settings.Spawn == "From the sky" and (halfH + 20) or (halfH + size*1.3)
            local camCF = cam.CFrame
            local n = 0
            for r, rw in ipairs(rows) do
                local x = -rw.W/2
                local y = top + (#rows - r)*size*1.35
                for _, wd in ipairs(rw.Words) do
                    n += 1
                    local place = {X = x + wd.W/2, Y = y, Dist = dist, Cam = camCF, Delay = (n - 1)*.14}
                    pcall(spawnWord, wd.Text, n, #list, colorFor(n), place)
                    x += wd.W + gap
                end
            end
            return
        end
        for i, word in ipairs(list) do
            task.delay((i - 1)*.08, function()
                if alive and settings.Enabled then pcall(spawnWord, word, i, #list, colorFor(i)) end
            end)
        end
    end)
    local function clearWords()
        for _, w in ipairs(words) do fadeAndRemove(w, .3) end
        table.clear(words)
        if clearWorld then clearWorld() end
    end


    ---------------------------------------------------------------- World style (lines hang around you, words rise in on the beat, then crumble)
    local MONTSERRAT = (function()
        local ok, f = pcall(function() return Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/Montserrat.json", Enum.FontWeight.ExtraBold) end)
        return ok and f or nil
    end)()
    -- colour presets: letters go from Top to Bottom, the halo is Glow
    local PALETTES = {
        Ice = {Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(196, 222, 255), Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255)},
        ["Neon Purple"] = {Color3.fromRGB(250, 235, 255), Color3.fromRGB(196, 140, 255), Color3.fromRGB(160, 90, 255)},
        Sunset = {Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 200), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 90), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 70)},
        Mint = {Color3.fromRGB(235, 255, 245), Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 200), Color3.fromRGB(60, 230, 170)},
        Rose = {Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 244), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 190), Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 150)},
        Gold = {Color3.fromRGB(255, 250, 220), Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 90), Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 40)},
        Blood = {Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 220), Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 80), Color3.fromRGB(220, 20, 40)},
        Rainbow = "rainbow",
        ["Menu accent"] = "accent",
    }
    local PALETTE_NAMES = {"Ice", "Neon Purple", "Sunset", "Mint", "Rose", "Gold", "Blood", "Rainbow", "Menu accent"}
    local rainbowHue = 0
    local lighten; lighten = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(c, k) return Color3.new(c.R + (1 - c.R)*k, c.G + (1 - c.G)*k, c.B + (1 - c.B)*k) end)
    local paletteForLine; paletteForLine = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local p = PALETTES[settings.Palette] or PALETTES.Ice
        if p == "rainbow" then
            rainbowHue = (rainbowHue + .13)%1
            local c = Color3.fromHSV(rainbowHue, .7, 1)
            return {lighten(c, .7), c, c}
        elseif p == "accent" then
            local c = (Theme and Theme.Accent) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 255)
            return {lighten(c, .8), lighten(c, .35), c}
        end
        return p
    end)
    local worldLines, pixels = {}, {}
    local roadSide = 1
    local wordPart; wordPart = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(text, h, pal)
        local TOP, BOTTOM, GLOWC = pal[1], pal[2], pal[3]
        local w = (utf8.len(text) or #text)*.56*h + .2*h
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = "LyricWord"
        p.Size = V3(w, h*1.25, .05)
        p.Transparency = 1
        p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
        local sg = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
        sg.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
        sg.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
        sg.PixelsPerStud = 70
        sg.LightInfluence = 0
        sg.Brightness = 1.6
        sg.ClipsDescendants = false
        sg.AlwaysOnTop = false
        sg.Parent = p
        local labels, strokes = {}, {}
        local layer; layer = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(z, color, ox, oy, target)
            local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
            l.Position = UDim2.new(.5, ox, .5, oy)
            l.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, .9)
            if MONTSERRAT then l.FontFace = MONTSERRAT else l.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack end

            l.Text = text
            l.TextColor3 = color
            l.TextTransparency = 1
            l.ZIndex = z
            l:SetAttribute("Target", target)
            l.Parent = sg
            table.insert(labels, l)
            return l
        end)
        local gs = settings.WGlowStrength
        local spread = settings.GlowSize
        if settings.WGlow and gs > 0 then
            for k, th in ipairs({(14*gs + 4)*spread, (6*gs + 2)*spread}) do
                local g = layer(k, GLOWC, 0, 0, k == 1 and .82 or .7)
                local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                st.Color = GLOWC
                st.Thickness = th
                st.Transparency = 1
                st.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
                st:SetAttribute("Target", k == 1 and (.9 - gs*.12) or (.72 - gs*.2))
                st.Parent = g
                table.insert(strokes, st)
            end
        end
        if settings.WShadow then layer(3, Color3.fromRGB(10, 14, 30), 4, 5, .45) end
        local main = layer(4, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0, 0, 0)
        local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        grad.Rotation = 90
        grad.Color = ColorSequence.new(TOP, BOTTOM)
        grad.Parent = main
        return p, labels, strokes, w
    end)
    local TOP, BOTTOM = PALETTES.Ice[1], PALETTES.Ice[2]
    local crumble; crumble = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(word)
        -- the word breaks into little glowing pixels that drift away
        if word.Gone then return end
        word.Gone = true
        for _, l in ipairs(word.Labels) do pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() TweenService:Create(l, TweenInfo.new(.45), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play() end)) end
        for _, st in ipairs(word.Strokes) do pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(.45), {Transparency = 1}):Play() end)) end
        task.delay(.5, function() pcall(function() word.Part:Destroy() end) end)
        local cf, size = word.Part.CFrame, word.Part.Size
        local count = math.clamp(math.floor(size.X*6), 8, 34)
        for _ = 1, count do
            local px = Instance.new("Part")
            px.Name = "LyricPixel"
            local k = .05 + math.random()*.09
            px.Size = V3(k, k, .02)
            px.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            px.Color = math.random() < .5 and (word.Pal and word.Pal[1] or TOP) or (word.Pal and word.Pal[2] or BOTTOM)
            px.Anchored, px.CanCollide, px.CanQuery, px.CanTouch, px.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
            px.CFrame = cf*CFrame.new((math.random() - .5)*size.X*.9, (math.random() - .5)*size.Y*.6, 0)
            px.Parent = folder
            local drift = cf:VectorToWorldSpace(V3(-(.6 + math.random()*1.6), .4 + math.random()*1.2, -(math.random()*.8)))
            table.insert(pixels, {Part = px, Vel = drift, Age = 0, Life = .7 + math.random()*.6, Spin = (math.random() - .5)*8})
        end
    end)
    local dropLine; dropLine = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(line)
        if line.Dropped then return end
        line.Dropped = true
        for i, w in ipairs(line.Words) do task.delay((i - 1)*.05, function() if w.Shown then crumble(w) else pcall(function() w.Part:Destroy() end) end end) end
    end)
    local spawnWorldLine; spawnWorldLine = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(index)
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local entry = lines[index]
        if not cam or not entry then return end
        if not folder or not folder.Parent then
            folder = Instance.new("Folder")
            folder.Name = "CrackHubLyrics"
            folder.Parent = workspace
        end

        for word in entry.Text:gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(list, word) end
        if #list == 0 then return end
