        local span = math.clamp(nextT - entry.T, .6, 8)
        -- where the line hangs: in front of you, scattered (or along the sides of your view)
        local h = 1.4*settings.WSize*(.85 + math.random()*.4)
        local dist = settings.WDist*(.85 + math.random()*.35)
        local camCF = cam.CFrame
        local flat = V3(camCF.LookVector.X, 0, camCF.LookVector.Z)
        flat = flat.Magnitude > .1 and flat.Unit or V3(0, 0, -1)
        local right = flat:Cross(V3(0, 1, 0))
        local sc = settings.Scatter
        local ox, oy
        if settings.Roadside then
            roadSide = -roadSide
            ox = roadSide*dist*(.28 + math.random()*.22*sc)
            oy = (math.random() - .25)*dist*.22*sc + h*.6
        else
            ox = (math.random()*2 - 1)*dist*.42*sc
            oy = (math.random() - .3)*dist*.3*sc + h*.5
        end
        local center = camCF.Position + flat*dist + right*ox + V3(0, oy, 0)
        local face = CFrame.lookAt(center, V3(camCF.Position.X, center.Y, camCF.Position.Z))
            *CFrame.Angles((math.random() - .5)*.12, (math.random() - .5)*.5, (math.random() - .5)*.1)
        -- the words left to right (on the panel, "right" for the viewer is -X), two rows when long
        local made, widths, total = {}, {}, 0
        local pal = paletteForLine()
        for i, word in ipairs(list) do
            local p, labels, strokes, w = wordPart(word, h, pal)
            made[i] = {Part = p, Labels = labels, Strokes = strokes, W = w, Pal = pal}
            widths[i] = w
            total += w
        end
        local gap = h*.32
        local rows, row, rowW = {}, {}, 0
        local maxW = math.max(h*10, total/2 + gap*3)
        for i, w in ipairs(widths) do
            if #row > 0 and rowW + gap + w > maxW then
                table.insert(rows, {Items = row, W = rowW})
                row, rowW = {}, 0
            end
            table.insert(row, i)
            rowW += (#row > 1 and gap or 0) + w
        end
        table.insert(rows, {Items = row, W = rowW})
        local line = {Words = {}, Start = entry.T, End = nextT, LastWord = entry.T + span*.82}
        local chars, acc = 0, 0
        for _, w in ipairs(list) do chars += utf8.len(w) or #w end
        local n = 0
        for r, rw in ipairs(rows) do
            local x = -rw.W/2
            for _, i in ipairs(rw.Items) do
                n += 1
                local m = made[i]
                local cf = face*CFrame.new(-(x + m.W/2), -(r - 1)*h*1.35 + (#rows - 1)*h*.6, 0)
                m.Home = cf
                m.Part.CFrame = cf*CFrame.new(0, -h*.35, 0)
                m.Part.Parent = folder
                -- each word comes in when it is sung (spread over the line by word length)
                m.At = entry.T + span*.82*(acc/math.max(1, chars))
                acc += utf8.len(list[i]) or #list[i]
                m.H = h
                table.insert(line.Words, m)
                x += m.W + gap
            end
        end
        -- with the music: each word lives until the next one is sung, the last one a moment longer
        for i, w in ipairs(line.Words) do
            local nxt = line.Words[i + 1]
            if nxt then
                w.DieAt = math.max(w.At + .45, nxt.At + .3)
            else
                w.DieAt = math.max(w.At + .6, math.min(line.End - .05, w.At + 1.1))
            end
        end
        local prev = worldLines[#worldLines]
        if prev then prev.NextLastWord = line.LastWord + .4 end
        table.insert(worldLines, line)
        -- safety net only: far more lines than ever fit on screen
        while #worldLines > 8 do dropLine(table.remove(worldLines, 1)) end
    end)
    local updateWorld; updateWorld = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt, pos)
        for li = #worldLines, 1, -1 do
            local line = worldLines[li]
            for _, w in ipairs(line.Words) do
                if not w.Shown and not w.Gone and pos >= w.At then
                    w.Shown, w.ShownAt = true, os.clock()
                    for _, l in ipairs(w.Labels) do TweenService:Create(l, TweenInfo.new(.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {TextTransparency = l:GetAttribute("Target") or 0}):Play() end
                    for _, st in ipairs(w.Strokes) do TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Transparency = st:GetAttribute("Target") or .6}):Play() end
                end
                if w.Shown and not w.Gone and w.Part.Parent then
                    -- "Rise": slides up into place while it fades in
                    local k = math.clamp((os.clock() - w.ShownAt)/.4, 0, 1)
                    k = 1 - (1 - k)^3
                    w.Part.CFrame = w.Home*CFrame.new(0, -w.H*.35*(1 - k) + math.sin(os.clock()*1.3 + w.W)*.03, 0)
                end
            end
            local removeAt
            if settings.Vanish == "With the music" then
                for _, w in ipairs(line.Words) do
                    if w.Shown and not w.Gone and pos >= w.DieAt then crumble(w) end
                end
                removeAt = line.LastWord + 1.6
            elseif settings.Vanish == "Custom time" then
                removeAt = line.LastWord + settings.Stay
            else
                -- Auto: stay until the next line has fully come in (and at least 1.5 s after the last word)
                removeAt = math.max(line.LastWord + 1.5, (line.NextLastWord or line.End + 1.2))
            end
            if pos > removeAt or pos < line.Start - 1 then
                dropLine(line)
                table.remove(worldLines, li)
            end
        end
        for i = #pixels, 1, -1 do
            local px = pixels[i]
            px.Age += dt
            if px.Age >= px.Life or not px.Part.Parent then
                pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() px.Part:Destroy() end))
                table.remove(pixels, i)
            else
                local life = px.Age/px.Life
                px.Vel *= (1 - math.min(1, dt*1.2))
                px.Part.CFrame = (px.Part.CFrame + px.Vel*dt)*CFrame.Angles(0, 0, px.Spin*dt)
                px.Part.Transparency = life
            end
        end
    end)
    clearWorld = function()
        for _, line in ipairs(worldLines) do dropLine(line) end
        table.clear(worldLines)
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- the current line in the watermark (karaoke)
    local pill
    local escape; escape = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(t) return (t:gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")) end)
    local buildPill; buildPill = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if pill or not window.Gui then return end
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.Name = "LyricsPill"
        f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, 0)
        f.Position = UDim2.new(.5, 0, 0, 56)
        f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(380, 36)
        f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 12, 22)
        f.BackgroundTransparency = .12
        f.Parent = window.Gui
        Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        st.Color = (Theme and Theme.Accent) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 255)
        st.Transparency = .55
        st.Parent = f
        local cover = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        cover.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 36, 58)
        cover.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 5)
        cover.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26)
        cover.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
        cover.Parent = f
        Instance.new("UICorner", cover).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        text.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 0)
        text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -78, 1, 0)
        text.RichText = true
        text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        text.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        text.TextSize = 13
        text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() text.FontFace = Fonts.Bold end))
        text.Parent = f
        local bars = {}
        for i = 1, 4 do
            local b = Instance.new("Frame")
            b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, .5)
            b.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30 + (i - 1)*5, .5, 0)
            b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 8)
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.BackgroundColor3 = st.Color
            b.Parent = f
            Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            bars[i] = b
        end
        pill = {Frame = f, Cover = cover, Text = text, Bars = bars, Accent = st.Color}
    end)
    local updatePill; updatePill = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(pos, playing)
        if not pill then return end
        local show = settings.Enabled and settings.InWatermark and #lines > 0
        pill.Frame.Visible = show
        if not show then return end
        local idx = 0
        for i = 1, #lines do if lines[i].T <= pos then idx = i else break end end
        local entry = lines[math.max(1, idx)]
        local track = music.Current and music.Current()
        if idx > 0 then
            -- gone right after the line is sung (no long hang during the instrumental)
            local nextT = lines[idx + 1] and lines[idx + 1].T or (entry.T + 4)
            local lastWord = entry.T + math.clamp(nextT - entry.T, .6, 8)*.82
            if pos > lastWord + .8 then
                pill.Frame.Visible = false
                return
            end
        end
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() if track and music.Artwork then pill.Cover.Image = music.Artwork(track) end end))
        if idx == 0 then
            pill.Text.Text = escape(tostring(track and track.title or ""))
        else
            -- the word being sung is lit, the rest is dim
            local nextT = lines[idx + 1] and lines[idx + 1].T or (entry.T + 4)
            local frac = math.clamp((pos - entry.T)/math.max(.3, (nextT - entry.T)*.82), 0, 1)
            local list, chars = {}, 0
            for w in entry.Text:gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(list, w) chars += utf8.len(w) or #w end
            local at, acc, out = frac*chars, 0, {}
            local hex = string.format("#%02x%02x%02x", math.floor(pill.Accent.R*255), math.floor(pill.Accent.G*255), math.floor(pill.Accent.B*255))
            for _, w in ipairs(list) do
                local len = utf8.len(w) or #w
                if acc <= at and at < acc + len then table.insert(out, '<font color="' .. hex .. '">' .. escape(w) .. '</font>')
                elseif acc + len <= at then table.insert(out, escape(w))
                else table.insert(out, '<font transparency="0.55">' .. escape(w) .. '</font>') end
                acc += len
            end
            pill.Text.Text = table.concat(out, " ")
        end
        local t = os.clock()
        for i, b in ipairs(pill.Bars) do b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, playing and (5 + math.abs(math.sin(t*6 + i*1.3))*12) or 4) end
    end)

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- follow the song
    local load; load = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(force)
        local track = music.Current and music.Current()
        if not track then lines = {} return end
        local key = tostring(track.title) .. "|" .. tostring(track.artist)
        if key == trackKey and not force then return end
        trackKey, lines, nextLine, loading = key, {}, 1, true
        if force then for k in pairs(cache) do cache[k] = nil end end
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, got = pcall(lyricsFor, track)
            loading = false
            if trackKey ~= key then return end
            lines = ok and got or {}
            nextLine = 1
            if settings.Enabled then
                if #lines > 0 then notify("Lyrics found: " .. tostring(track.title), "Success")
                else notify("No lyrics found for " .. tostring(track.title)) end
            end
        end)
    end)
    table.insert(conns, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        if not (alive and settings.Enabled) then return end
        dt = math.min(dt or 1/60, .1)
        load(false)
        -- physics-free words just drift up slowly
        local now = os.clock()
        for i = #words, 1, -1 do
            local w = words[i]
            if not w.Part.Parent then
                table.remove(words, i)
            else
                if not w.Gone and now - w.Born > settings.Life then fadeAndRemove(w, .8) end
                if w.Part.Anchored and not w.Gone then
                    w.Part.CFrame = (w.Part.CFrame + w.Drift*dt)*CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin((now - w.Born)*2 + w.Shine)*w.Spin*dt)
                end
                -- a shine sweeps over the letters every couple of seconds
                local ph = ((now - w.Born + w.Shine)%2.4)/2.4
                local off = Vector2.new(-1 + ph*2.6, 0)
                for _, g in ipairs(w.Grads) do g.Offset = off end
            end
        end
        local sound = music.Sound
        local playing = sound and sound.IsPlaying
        local pos = (music.Position and music.Position() or 0) + settings.Offset
        buildPill()
        updatePill(pos, playing)
        updateWorld(dt, pos)
        if not playing or #lines == 0 then return end
        if pos < lastPos - .5 or pos > lastPos + 3 then
            -- seeked: jump to the right line without dumping every word in between
            nextLine = 1
            while lines[nextLine] and lines[nextLine].T < pos do nextLine += 1 end
        end
        lastPos = pos
        local spawned = 0
        while lines[nextLine] and lines[nextLine].T <= pos and spawned < 2 do
            if settings.Style == "World" then spawnWorldLine(nextLine) else spawnLine(lines[nextLine].Text) end
            nextLine += 1
            spawned += 1
        end
    end)))

    -- every beat of the song the words flare up
    pcall(function()
        if music.OnBeat then
            music.OnBeat(function()
                if not (alive and settings.Enabled) then return end
                if settings.GlowPulse then
                    for _, line in ipairs(worldLines) do
                        for _, w in ipairs(line.Words) do
                            if w.Shown and not w.Gone then
                                for _, st in ipairs(w.Strokes) do
                                    local target = st:GetAttribute("Target") or .6
                                    st.Transparency = math.max(0, target - .28)
                                    TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(.35), {Transparency = target}):Play()
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not settings.Pulse then return end
                for _, w in ipairs(words) do
                    if not w.Gone then
                        for _, st in ipairs(w.Strokes) do
                            local target = st:GetAttribute("Target") or .5
                            st.Transparency = math.max(0, target - .3)
                            TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(.35), {Transparency = target}):Play()
                        end
                        for _, sc in ipairs(w.Scales) do
                            sc.Scale = 1.12
                            TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {Scale = 1}):Play()
                        end
                        if w.Light then
                            local b = .6 + settings.Glow/100*1.4
                            w.Light.Brightness = b*2
                            TweenService:Create(w.Light, TweenInfo.new(.35), {Brightness = b}):Play()
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- menu
    local g = tab:AddGroup("Lyrics in the world", true)
    g:AddToggle({Name = "3D Lyrics", Description = "The song's lines hang in the world around you, word by word on the beat, then crumble · only you see them", Default = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            settings.Enabled = v
            if v then
                trackKey = nil
                load(true)
            else
                clearWords()
            end
        end})
    local function pick(v) if type(v) == "table" then v = v[1] end return v end
    g:AddDropdown({Name = "Color", Options = PALETTE_NAMES, Default = "Ice", Callback = function(v) settings.Palette = pick(v) or settings.Palette end})
    g:AddSlider({Name = "Distance", Min = 4, Max = 30, Default = 9, Increment = .5, Callback = function(v) settings.WDist = v end})
    g:AddSlider({Name = "Size", Min = .4, Max = 3, Default = 1, Increment = .1, Callback = function(v) settings.WSize = v end})
    g:AddSlider({Name = "Scatter", Min = 0, Max = 1, Default = .7, Increment = .05, Callback = function(v) settings.Scatter = v end})
    g:AddToggle({Name = "Roadside", Description = "Lines hang at the sides so they never cover the middle", Default = true, Bind = false, Callback = function(v) settings.Roadside = v end})
    g:AddToggle({Name = "Glow", Default = true, Bind = false, Callback = function(v) settings.WGlow = v end})
    g:AddSlider({Name = "Glow strength", Min = 0, Max = 1, Default = .9, Increment = .05, Callback = function(v) settings.WGlowStrength = v end})
    g:AddSlider({Name = "Glow size", Min = .4, Max = 2.5, Default = 1, Increment = .1, Callback = function(v) settings.GlowSize = v end})
    g:AddToggle({Name = "Glow pulse to the beat", Default = true, Bind = false, Callback = function(v) settings.GlowPulse = v end})
    g:AddToggle({Name = "Shadow", Default = true, Bind = false, Callback = function(v) settings.WShadow = v end})
    g:AddDropdown({Name = "Words disappear", Options = {"With the music", "When the next line is out", "Custom time"}, Default = "With the music",
        Callback = function(v) settings.Vanish = pick(v) or settings.Vanish end})
    g:AddSlider({Name = "Custom time", Min = .5, Max = 15, Default = 3, Increment = .5, Suffix = "s", Callback = function(v) settings.Stay = v end})
    g:AddSlider({Name = "Sync offset", Min = -3, Max = 3, Default = 0, Increment = .1, Suffix = "s", Callback = function(v) settings.Offset = v end})
    g:AddToggle({Name = "Lyrics in watermark", Description = "The line being sung under the watermark, word by word", Default = true, Bind = false, Callback = function(v) settings.InWatermark = v end})
    g:AddButton({Name = "Reload lyrics", Bind = false, Callback = function() load(true) end})
    g:AddButton({Name = "Clear words", Bind = false, Callback = clearWords})

    table.insert(conns, window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
        alive = false
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end
        pcall(function() if folder then folder:Destroy() end end)
        pcall(function() if pill then pill.Frame:Destroy() end end)
    end))
end

CrackHub.FoxStyle = function(model, window)
    -- The talking fox NPC: a slimmer body (narrow legs and waist, thinner arms), idle life (rocks heel-to-toe,
    -- breathes, swings its arms, looks at you, wags its tail, waves now and then) and a thought cloud with three
    -- bouncing dots above its head that hides while you talk to it. Only you see it.
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    local V3 = Vector3.new
    local ACCENT = (Theme and Theme.Accent) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 255)

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- slimmer body
    local SLIM = {
        UpperTorso = V3(.8, 1, .82), LowerTorso = V3(.6, 1, .78),
        LeftUpperLeg = V3(.62, 1, .66), RightUpperLeg = V3(.62, 1, .66),
        LeftLowerLeg = V3(.55, 1, .6), RightLowerLeg = V3(.55, 1, .6),
        LeftFoot = V3(.62, 1, .76), RightFoot = V3(.62, 1, .76),
        LeftUpperArm = V3(.6, 1, .62), RightUpperArm = V3(.6, 1, .62),
        LeftLowerArm = V3(.55, 1, .58), RightLowerArm = V3(.55, 1, .58),
        LeftHand = V3(.6, 1, .66), RightHand = V3(.6, 1, .66),
    }
    local function factor(part) return part and SLIM[part.Name] or V3(1, 1, 1) end
    local function scaledCF(cf, f) return CFrame.new(cf.Position*f)*cf.Rotation end
    if not model:GetAttribute("CrackHubSlim") then
        model:SetAttribute("CrackHubSlim", true)
        local joints, attachments = {}, {}
        for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("JointInstance") then table.insert(joints, d) elseif d:IsA("Attachment") then table.insert(attachments, d) end
        end
        for _, j in ipairs(joints) do
            pcall(function()
                j.C0 = scaledCF(j.C0, factor(j.Part0))
                j.C1 = scaledCF(j.C1, factor(j.Part1))
            end)
        end
        for _, a in ipairs(attachments) do
            local f = factor(a.Parent)
            if f ~= V3(1, 1, 1) then pcall(function() a.CFrame = scaledCF(a.CFrame, f) end) end
        end
        for name, f in pairs(SLIM) do
            local p = model:FindFirstChild(name)
            if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(function() p.Size = p.Size*f end) end
        end
    end

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- idle life
    local function motor(partName, jointName)
        local p = model:FindFirstChild(partName)
        local m = p and p:FindFirstChild(jointName)
        return m and m:IsA("Motor6D") and m or nil
    end
    local rootJ, waist, neck = motor("LowerTorso", "Root"), motor("UpperTorso", "Waist"), motor("Head", "Neck")
    local lSh, rSh, rEl = motor("LeftUpperArm", "LeftShoulder"), motor("RightUpperArm", "RightShoulder"), motor("RightLowerArm", "RightElbow")
    local hrp = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local head = model:FindFirstChild("FoxHead") or model:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local tailWeld
    for _, acc in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
        if acc:IsA("Accessory") then
            local h = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            local w = h and h:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")
            if w and acc.AccessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Back then tailWeld = w end
        end
    end
    local tailRest = tailWeld and tailWeld.C0
    -- rock from the feet, not from the hips
    local footPivot = V3(0, -2.4, 0)
    pcall(function()
        local foot = model:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot")
        local jointWorld = hrp.CFrame*rootJ.C0
        footPivot = V3(0, (foot.Position.Y - foot.Size.Y/2) - jointWorld.Y, 0)
    end)
    local aroundFeet; aroundFeet = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(rot) return CFrame.new(footPivot)*rot*CFrame.new(-footPivot) end)

    local lEl = motor("LeftLowerArm", "LeftElbow")
    local lHip, rHip = motor("LeftUpperLeg", "LeftHip"), motor("RightUpperLeg", "RightHip")
    local lKnee, rKnee = motor("LeftLowerLeg", "LeftKnee"), motor("RightLowerLeg", "RightKnee")
    local lAnk, rAnk = motor("LeftFoot", "LeftAnkle"), motor("RightFoot", "RightAnkle")
    local A = CFrame.Angles
    local LEGS = {}
    for key, m in pairs({lHip = lHip, rHip = rHip, lKnee = lKnee, rKnee = rKnee, lAnk = lAnk, rAnk = rAnk}) do table.insert(LEGS, {m, key}) end
    local function bell(x) x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1) return math.sin(x*math.pi) end
    local function ease(x) x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1) return x*x*(3 - 2*x) end
    -- a crouch: hips back, knees bent, feet flat; d = 0..1, the body goes down by the leg bend
    local function crouch(o, d)
        o.lHip, o.rHip = A(.55*d, 0, 0), A(.55*d, 0, 0)
        o.lKnee, o.rKnee = A(-1.0*d, 0, 0), A(-1.0*d, 0, 0)
        o.lAnk, o.rAnk = A(.45*d, 0, 0), A(.45*d, 0, 0)
        return -.42*d
    end
    -- every action: how long it lasts, what the thought cloud shows, and the pose at time t (0..dur)
    local ACTIONS = {
        Wave = {Dur = 2.3, Cloud = "!", Pose = function(t, o)
            local raise = ease(t/.35)*(1 - ease((t - 1.9)/.4))
            o.rSh = A(0, 0, 1.6*raise)
            o.rEl = A(0, 0, (1.3 + ((t > .35 and t < 1.9) and math.sin((t - .35)*12)*.4 or 0))*raise)
            o.neck = A(0, 0, -.12*raise)
            o.tail = 1.8
        end},
        Stretch = {Dur = 2.8, Cloud = "dots", Pose = function(t, o)
            local k = ease(t/.8)*(1 - ease((t - 2.1)/.7))
            o.rSh, o.lSh = A(2.9*k, 0, .25*k), A(2.9*k, 0, -.25*k)
            o.rEl, o.lEl = A(.3*k, 0, 0), A(.3*k, 0, 0)
            o.waist = A(-.16*k, 0, 0)
            o.neck = A(-.3*k, 0, 0)
            o.up = .1*k
        end},
        LookAround = {Dur = 3.4, Cloud = "?", Pose = function(t, o)
            local k = ease(t/.4)*(1 - ease((t - 3)/.4))
            local yaw = (t < 1.2 and -.85*ease(t/1) or (t < 2.4 and -.85 + 1.7*ease((t - 1.2)/1) or .85*(1 - ease((t - 2.4)/.6))))
            o.neck = A(.05, yaw*k, 0)
            o.waist = A(0, yaw*.3*k, 0)
            o.rSh = A(.2*k, 0, .12*k)
        end},
        Think = {Dur = 3.6, Cloud = "dots", Fast = true, Pose = function(t, o)
            local k = ease(t/.5)*(1 - ease((t - 3.1)/.5))
            o.rSh = A(1.25*k, 0, -.35*k)
            o.rEl = A(1.75*k + math.sin(t*3)*.06*k, 0, 0)
            o.lSh = A(.55*k, 0, .2*k)
            o.lEl = A(1.25*k, 0, 0)
            o.neck = A(.12*k, .1*k, .18*k)
            o.waist = A(.04*k, 0, 0)
        end},
        Hop = {Dur = 1.5, Cloud = "!", Pose = function(t, o)
            local squat = bell(t/.35)*(t < .35 and 1 or 0) + bell((t - .85)/.3)*(t > .85 and t < 1.15 and .6 or 0)
            local air = (t > .35 and t < .85) and bell((t - .35)/.5) or 0
            o.down = crouch(o, squat)
            o.up = air*1.1
            o.rSh, o.lSh = A(0, 0, 2.2*air + .3*squat), A(0, 0, -2.2*air - .3*squat)
            o.neck = A(-.15*air, 0, 0)
            o.tail = 2.5
        end},
        Dance = {Dur = 4.4, Cloud = "dots", Fast = true, Pose = function(t, o)
            local k = ease(t/.4)*(1 - ease((t - 4)/.4))
            local b = t*math.pi*2*1.6
            o.rockRoll = math.sin(b*.5)*.1*k
            o.down = crouch(o, (.25 + .25*math.abs(math.sin(b)))*k)
            o.rSh = A(0, 0, (1.1 + math.sin(b*.5)*.9)*k)
            o.lSh = A(0, 0, -(1.1 - math.sin(b*.5)*.9)*k)
            o.rEl, o.lEl = A(.8*k, 0, 0), A(.8*k, 0, 0)
            o.neck = A(math.sin(b)*.12*k, 0, math.sin(b*.5)*.15*k)
            o.waist = A(0, math.sin(b*.5)*.25*k, 0)
            o.tail = 2.8
        end},
        Scratch = {Dur = 2.6, Cloud = "?", Pose = function(t, o)
            local k = ease(t/.45)*(1 - ease((t - 2.15)/.45))
            o.rSh = A(.7*k, 0, 2.3*k)
            o.rEl = A((1.9 + math.sin(t*16)*.25)*k, 0, 0)
            o.neck = A(.08*k, 0, -.22*k)
            o.waist = A(0, 0, .05*k)
        end},
        Yawn = {Dur = 2.4, Cloud = "Zz", Pose = function(t, o)
            local k = ease(t/.7)*(1 - ease((t - 1.7)/.7))
            o.rSh, o.lSh = A(.4*k, 0, 1.3*k), A(.4*k, 0, -1.3*k)
            o.rEl, o.lEl = A(1.2*k, 0, 0), A(1.2*k, 0, 0)
            o.neck = A(-.38*k, 0, 0)
            o.waist = A(-.1*k, 0, 0)
            o.up = .05*k
        end},
        LookAtPaw = {Dur = 2.8, Cloud = "?", Pose = function(t, o)
            local k = ease(t/.5)*(1 - ease((t - 2.3)/.5))
            o.lSh = A(1.15*k, 0, .15*k)
            o.lEl = A(1.05*k, 0, 0)
            o.neck = A(.35*k, .35*k, 0)
            o.waist = A(.05*k, .12*k, 0)
        end},
    }
    local ORDER = {"Stretch", "LookAround", "Think", "Hop", "Dance", "Scratch", "Yawn", "LookAtPaw", "Wave"}
    local action, actionT, queue, lastName = nil, 0, {}, nil
    local nextAction = os.clock() + 3 + math.random()*3
    local play; play = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(name)
        action, actionT = ACTIONS[name], 0
        lastName = name
    end)
    local greeted = false
    local cloudMode, cloudFast = "dots", false

    local dist = math.huge
    local lastT = os.clock()
    local conn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if not model.Parent then return end
        local t = os.clock()
        local dt = math.min(.1, t - lastT)
        lastT = t
        local me = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        dist = (me and hrp) and (me.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
        local talking = dist < 13
        -- choose what to do next
        if talking then
            action, queue = nil, {}
        else
            if dist < 18 and not greeted then
                greeted = true
                play("Hop")
                queue = {"Wave"}
            elseif dist > 24 then
                greeted = false
            end
            if action then
                actionT += dt
                if actionT >= action.Dur then
                    action = nil
                    if #queue > 0 then play(table.remove(queue, 1)) else nextAction = t + 1.5 + math.random()*3 end
                end
            elseif t > nextAction then
                local name
                repeat name = ORDER[math.random(1, #ORDER)] until name ~= lastName
                play(name)
            end
        end
        -- the idle base pose (always on), the action on top
        local o = {}
        if action then pcall(action.Pose, actionT, o) end
        cloudMode = action and action.Cloud or "dots"
        cloudFast = action and action.Fast or false
        local roll = (o.rockRoll or 0) + math.sin(t*.62)*.018
        local lift = (o.up or 0) + (o.down or 0)
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if rootJ then rootJ.Transform = CFrame.new(0, lift, 0)*aroundFeet(A(math.sin(t*1.25)*.045*(action and .4 or 1), 0, roll)) end
            if waist then waist.Transform = A(math.sin(t*2.1)*.025 - math.sin(t*1.25)*.02, math.sin(t*.5)*.05, 0)*(o.waist or CFrame.identity) end
            for _, leg in ipairs(LEGS) do leg[1].Transform = o[leg[2]] or CFrame.identity end
            if lSh then lSh.Transform = A(math.sin(t*1.25 + .6)*.07, 0, -.04 - math.sin(t*2.1)*.02)*(o.lSh or CFrame.identity) end
            if lEl then lEl.Transform = o.lEl or A(.08, 0, 0) end
            if tailWeld and tailRest and not talking then
                local wag = o.tail or 1
                tailWeld.C0 = tailRest*A(0, math.sin(t*2.6*wag)*.22*math.min(1.6, wag), math.sin(t*1.3)*.05)
            end
        end))
        -- the right arm and the head belong to the dialogue while you talk
        if not talking then
            pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                if rSh then rSh.Transform = A(math.sin(t*1.25 + 2.2)*.07, 0, .04 + math.sin(t*2.1)*.02)*(o.rSh or CFrame.identity) end
                if rEl then rEl.Transform = o.rEl or A(.08, 0, 0) end
                if neck then
                    local yaw = 0
                    if me and hrp and dist < 24 and not o.neck then
                        local rel = hrp.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(me.Position)
                        yaw = math.clamp(math.atan2(-rel.X, -rel.Z), -.7, .7)
                    end
                    local want = A(math.sin(t*.9)*.04, yaw, math.sin(t*.7)*.05)*(o.neck or CFrame.identity)
                    neck.Transform = neck.Transform:Lerp(want, .15)
                end
            end))
        end
    end))

    ---------------------------------------------------------------- thought cloud with three dots
    local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bb.Name = "CrackHubThought"
    bb.Size = UDim2.new(3.2, 0, 2.3, 0)
    bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = V3(.9, 2.2, 0)
    bb.LightInfluence = 0
    bb.MaxDistance = 70
    bb.ResetOnSpawn = false
    bb.Adornee = head
    bb.Parent = head
    local group = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
    group.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    group.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    group.Parent = bb
    local CLOUD = Color3.fromRGB(250, 248, 255)
    local function blob(x, y, w, h, color, trans, z, parent)
        local f = Instance.new("Frame")
        f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
        f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
        f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h)
        f.BackgroundColor3 = color
        f.BackgroundTransparency = trans
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.ZIndex = z
        Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        f.Parent = parent or group
        return f
    end
    -- the cloud: a soft shadow, then the body (a pill + bumps on top), then the little trail of bubbles to the head
    local SHAPES = {{.5, .4, .9, .42}, {.32, .26, .36, .4}, {.56, .2, .44, .5}, {.76, .3, .3, .34}}
    for _, s in ipairs(SHAPES) do blob(s[1] + .015, s[2] + .03, s[3], s[4], Color3.fromRGB(30, 20, 60), .78, 1) end
    for _, s in ipairs(SHAPES) do
        local b = blob(s[1], s[2], s[3], s[4], CLOUD, 0, 2)
        local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        g.Rotation = 90
        g.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(226, 220, 248))
        g.Parent = b
    end
    local tail1 = blob(.3, .74, .15, .15, CLOUD, 0, 2)
    local tail2 = blob(.2, .9, .085, .085, CLOUD, 0, 2)
    blob(.3 + .012, .74 + .02, .15, .15, Color3.fromRGB(30, 20, 60), .78, 1)
    blob(.2 + .01, .9 + .015, .085, .085, Color3.fromRGB(30, 20, 60), .78, 1)
    for _, b in ipairs({tail1, tail2}) do
        local a = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
        a.AspectRatio = 1
        a.Parent = b
    end
    -- three dots
    local dots = {}
    for i = 1, 3 do
        local d = blob(.34 + (i - 1)*.16, .38, .11, .11, ACCENT, 0, 4)
        local a = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
        a.AspectRatio = 1
        a.Parent = d
        local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        g.Rotation = 90
        g.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(math.min(1, ACCENT.R + .25), math.min(1, ACCENT.G + .25), math.min(1, ACCENT.B + .25)), ACCENT)
        g.Parent = d
        local shine = blob(.35, .3, .32, .32, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), .35, 5, d)
        shine.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
        dots[i] = d
    end
    local symbol = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    symbol.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    symbol.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
    symbol.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.52, .36)
    symbol.Size = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .42)
    symbol.TextScaled = true
    symbol.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    symbol.TextColor3 = ACCENT
    symbol.TextTransparency = 1
    symbol.ZIndex = 6
    symbol.Text = ""
    symbol.Parent = group
    local symbolShown = ""
    local shown = true
    local anim = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if not model.Parent then return end
        local t = os.clock()
        bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = V3(.9, 2.2 + math.sin(t*1.6)*.08, 0)
        -- what it is thinking about: dots, "?", "!" or "Zz"
        local want = cloudMode == "dots" and "" or cloudMode
        if want ~= symbolShown then
            symbolShown = want
            if want ~= "" then symbol.Text = want end
            TweenService:Create(symbol, TweenInfo.new(.25), {TextTransparency = want == "" and 1 or 0}):Play()
            for _, d in ipairs(dots) do d.Visible = want == "" end
        end
        if symbolShown ~= "" then
            symbol.Rotation = math.sin(t*3)*8
            symbol.Size = UDim2.fromScale(.5 + math.sin(t*5)*.03, .42 + math.sin(t*5)*.03)
        end
        local speed = cloudFast and 7.5 or 4.2
        for i, d in ipairs(dots) do
            -- a wave runs through the dots: each one hops and brightens in turn
            local ph = math.max(0, math.sin(t*speed - i*.75))
            d.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.34 + (i - 1)*.16, .38 - ph*.09)
            d.BackgroundTransparency = .35 - ph*.35
            d.Size = UDim2.fromScale(.11 + ph*.02, .11 + ph*.02)
        end
        tail1.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.3, .74 + math.sin(t*1.6 + .6)*.01)
        tail2.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.2, .9 + math.sin(t*1.6 + 1.2)*.012)
        -- hide while you talk to it
        local visible = dist >= 13
        if visible ~= shown then
            shown = visible
            TweenService:Create(group, TweenInfo.new(.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {GroupTransparency = visible and 0 or 1}):Play()
        end
    end))

    local function cleanup()
        conn:Disconnect()
        anim:Disconnect()
        pcall(function() bb:Destroy() end)
    end
    model.Destroying:Connect(cleanup)
    if window and window.Gui then window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(cleanup) end
end

    -- Save: type a name -> Save -> the menu closes -> click your build -> the whole build is saved.
    local env = CrackHubEnvironment

    local buildTab
    local buildPageSelected; buildPageSelected = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()

    end)
    local connections = {}
    local function connect(signal, fn)

        table.insert(connections, c)

    do
        local previous = env.CrackHubBuildABoat

        local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("CrackHub_Builds")

    for _, b in ipairs(BLOCKS) do BLOCK_BY_NAME[b.Name] = b; table.insert(BLOCK_NAMES, b.Name) end
    local COLORS = {
        Default = false,
        White = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240), Black = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35), Red = Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 50),
        Orange = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 40), Yellow = Color3.fromRGB(250, 210, 60), Green = Color3.fromRGB(70, 190, 80),
        Blue = Color3.fromRGB(60, 120, 230), Purple = Color3.fromRGB(150, 80, 230), Pink = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 190),
        Brown = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 45), Cyan = Color3.fromRGB(60, 210, 230), Lime = Color3.fromRGB(160, 240, 60),
        Gray = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 135), Navy = Color3.fromRGB(30, 45, 110), Maroon = Color3.fromRGB(110, 25, 35),
    }
    local COLOR_NAMES = { "Default", "White", "Black", "Gray", "Red", "Maroon", "Orange", "Yellow", "Lime", "Green",
        "Cyan", "Blue", "Navy", "Purple", "Pink", "Brown" }

    -- hotbar (keys 1-9) - press E in build mode to open the inventory and put any block into a slot
    local hotbar = { "Wood", "Metal", "Glass", "Wedge", "Seat", "Motor", "Jet Turbine", "Balloon", "Ignition" }
    local enginesOn = false -- motors only run after you start them with the Ignition item (or G)
    local hotSlot = 1

    local settings = {
        BuildMode = false, AllowBlocks = true, Block = hotbar[1], Color = "Default", Size = 2, Grid = 1,
        Collide = true, Power = 60, Turn = 1.6, Hover = true, Name = "", SitLaunch = false,
    }

    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "CrackHub_Builds"
    folder.Parent = workspace

    local isBlock; isBlock = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(part)
        return typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Parent == folder and part:GetAttribute("BAB_Type") ~= nil
    end)

    local blockSize; blockSize = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(def, s)
        return (def.Dim or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)) * s
    end)

    local newShape; newShape = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(def, size)
        local shape = def.Shape
        local part
        if shape == "Wedge" then
            part = Instance.new("WedgePart")
        elseif shape == "Corner" then
            part = Instance.new("CornerWedgePart")
        elseif shape == "Truss" then
            part = Instance.new("TrussPart")
            size = Vector3.new(2, math.max(2, math.floor(size.Y / 2 + 0.5) * 2), 2)
        else
            part = Instance.new("Part")
            if shape == "Cylinder" then
                part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            elseif shape == "Ball" then
                part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            end
        end
        part.Size = size
        part.TopSurface, part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        part.Material = def.Material
        part.Color = def.Color
        part.Transparency = def.Transparency or 0
        return part
    end)

    local function arrowOn(part, face, color)
        local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
        gui.Face = face
        gui.CanvasSize = Vector2.new(100, 100)
        gui.LightInfluence = 0
        local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        arrow.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        arrow.Text = "▲"
        arrow.TextScaled = true
        arrow.TextColor3 = color
        arrow.Parent = gui
        gui.Parent = part
    end

    local function flameOn(part, big)
        local fire = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        fire.Name = "Flame"
        fire.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
        fire.Color = big and ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(140, 200, 255), Color3.fromRGB(60, 90, 255))
            or ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80), Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 20))
        fire.LightEmission = 1
        fire.Size = NumberSequence.new(math.min(part.Size.X, part.Size.Y) * (big and 0.5 or 0.35), 0)
        fire.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.15, big and 0.45 or 0.3)
        fire.Speed = NumberRange.new(big and 14 or 8, big and 20 or 12)
        fire.Rate = big and 90 or 60
        fire.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Back
        fire.Enabled = false
        fire.Parent = part
    end

    -- extra look for seats; the pieces are children of the seat, welded to it and never hit by the mouse
    local function seatDecor(part, style, def)
        local sx, sy, sz = part.Size.X, part.Size.Y, part.Size.Z
        local function piece(size, offset, color, material, shape)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = "SeatDecor"
            p.Size = size
            p.CFrame = part.CFrame * offset
            p.Color = color or part.Color
            p.Material = material or part.Material
            if shape then p.Shape = shape end
            p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.Massless, p.CastShadow = false, false, false, false, true, false
            p.TopSurface, p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            w.Part0, w.Part1 = part, p
            w.Parent = p
            p.Parent = part
            return p
        end
        local dark = part.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.35)
        if style == "Chair" or style == "Driver" or style == "Pilot" or style == "Throne" or style == "Bench" or style == "Sofa" then
            local backH = (style == "Throne" and 2.6 or style == "Pilot" and 2 or style == "Bench" and 1 or 1.3) * sz
            local backT = math.max(0.15, sz * 0.18)
            piece(Vector3.new(sx, backH, backT), CFrame.new(0, sy / 2 + backH / 2, sz / 2 - backT / 2),
                style == "Throne" and Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 50) or dark)
            if style == "Pilot" or style == "Throne" or style == "Sofa" then
                local armH = sz * 0.45
                for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                    piece(Vector3.new(sx * 0.12, armH, sz * 0.9), CFrame.new(side * (sx / 2 - sx * 0.06), sy / 2 + armH / 2, 0), dark)
                end
            end
            if style == "Throne" then
                for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                    piece(Vector3.new(sz * 0.22, sz * 0.22, sz * 0.22), CFrame.new(side * sx * 0.42, sy / 2 + backH + sz * 0.1, sz / 2 - backT / 2),
                        Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 90), Enum.Material.Neon, Enum.PartType.Ball)
                end
            end
            if style == "Driver" then
                -- steering wheel + column in front
                piece(Vector3.new(0.12, sz * 0.7, sz * 0.7), CFrame.new(0, sy / 2 + sz * 0.75, -sz * 0.55) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), math.rad(-25)),
                    Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 28), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
                piece(Vector3.new(0.1, sz * 0.6, 0.1), CFrame.new(0, sy / 2 + sz * 0.45, -sz * 0.62) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-25), 0, 0),
                    Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 65), Enum.Material.Metal)
            end
            if style == "Pilot" then
                -- control stick
                piece(Vector3.new(0.12, sz * 0.5, 0.12), CFrame.new(0, sy / 2 + sz * 0.25, -sz * 0.45), Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35), Enum.Material.Metal)
                piece(Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), CFrame.new(0, sy / 2 + sz * 0.5, -sz * 0.45), Color3.fromRGB(220, 40, 40), Enum.Material.Neon, Enum.PartType.Ball)
            end
        elseif style == "Stool" then
            piece(Vector3.new(sx * 0.2, sz * 0.9, sx * 0.2), CFrame.new(0, -sy / 2 - sz * 0.45, 0), dark, Enum.Material.Metal)
        end
    end

    local function decorate(part, kind)
        if kind == "Motor" then
            -- front face shows the push direction; fire comes out of the back while it runs
            arrowOn(part, Enum.NormalId.Front, Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 60))
            flameOn(part, false)
        elseif kind == "Jet" then
            arrowOn(part, Enum.NormalId.Front, Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255))
            flameOn(part, true)
        elseif kind == "Lift" then
            arrowOn(part, Enum.NormalId.Top, Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255))
            local fire = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
            fire.Name = "Flame"
            fire.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
            fire.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(140, 200, 255), Color3.fromRGB(60, 90, 255))
            fire.LightEmission = 1
            fire.Size = NumberSequence.new(part.Size.X * 0.35, 0)
            fire.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.15, 0.3)
            fire.Speed = NumberRange.new(8, 12)
            fire.Rate = 60
            fire.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
            fire.Enabled = false
            fire.Parent = part
        elseif kind == "Light" then
            local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
            light.Color = part.Color
            light.Range = 14
            light.Brightness = 1.6
            light.Parent = part
        end
    end

    local onSeatTouched -- set further down (needs launch / sitOn)
    local function makeBlock(kind, size, cf, color)
        local def = BLOCK_BY_NAME[kind] or BLOCKS[1]
        local part = newShape(def, size)
        part.Name = def.Name
        part.CFrame = cf
        part.Anchored = true
        part.CanCollide = settings.Collide
        if color then part.Color = color end
        part:SetAttribute("BAB_Type", def.Name)
        if def.Special then part:SetAttribute("BAB_Special", def.Special) end
        decorate(part, def.Special)
        if def.Decor then seatDecor(part, def.Decor, def) end
        if def.Special == "Seat" then
            -- walk / jump onto a seat to sit down (like a real Roblox seat)
            part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
                local character = LocalPlayer.Character
                if character and hit:IsDescendantOf(character) and onSeatTouched then onSeatTouched(part) end
            end)
        end
        if def.Special == "Bounce" then
            local last = 0
            part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
                local character = LocalPlayer.Character
                if not (character and hit:IsDescendantOf(character)) or os.clock() - last < 0.4 then return end
                last = os.clock()
                local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then
                    local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(v.X, 90, v.Z)
                end
            end)
        end
        part.Parent = folder
        return part
    end

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ placing
    local mouseRay = RaycastParams.new()
    mouseRay.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local ghost = Instance.new("Part")
    local ghostKey = nil
    -- clean outline for the preview block (Highlight instead of thick selection boxes)
    local ghostBox = Instance.new("Highlight")
    ghostBox.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(90, 200, 255)
    ghostBox.FillTransparency = 0.7
    ghostBox.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(235, 250, 255)
    ghostBox.OutlineTransparency = 0.15
    ghostBox.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
    local refreshGhost; refreshGhost = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local def = BLOCK_BY_NAME[settings.Block] or BLOCKS[1]
        local key = def.Name .. "|" .. settings.Size
        if key == ghostKey then return end
        ghostKey = key
        local parent = ghost.Parent
        ghost:Destroy()
        ghost = newShape(def, blockSize(def, settings.Size))
        ghost.Name = "BAB_Ghost"
        ghost.Anchored, ghost.CanCollide, ghost.CanQuery, ghost.CanTouch, ghost.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
        ghost.Transparency = 0.55
        ghostBox.Adornee = ghost
        ghostBox.Parent = ghost
        ghost.Parent = parent
    end)
    local hoverBox = Instance.new("Highlight")
    hoverBox.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    hoverBox.FillTransparency = 0.88
    hoverBox.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 90)
    hoverBox.OutlineTransparency = 0.1
    hoverBox.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
    hoverBox.Parent = folder
    local rotation = CFrame.identity
    local pickMode = false
    local pickBoxes = {}

    local snap; snap = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(v, grid)
        return math.floor(v / grid + 0.5) * grid
    end)

    local castMouse; castMouse = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(screenPos)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return nil end
        local ray
        if screenPos then
            ray = camera:ScreenPointToRay(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) -- touch position
        else
            local pos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(pos.X, pos.Y)
        end
        local ignore = { ghost }
        if LocalPlayer.Character then table.insert(ignore, LocalPlayer.Character) end
        mouseRay.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
        return workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 400, mouseRay)
    end)

    local placementCFrame; placementCFrame = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(screenPos)
        local hit = castMouse(screenPos)
        if not hit then return nil end
        local def = BLOCK_BY_NAME[settings.Block] or BLOCKS[1]
        local size = ghost.Size -- the real size of the chosen block (trusses round theirs)
        local world = rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(size)
        local ext = Vector3.new(math.abs(world.X), math.abs(world.Y), math.abs(world.Z)) / 2 -- half extents in world
        local grid = settings.Grid
        local n = hit.Normal
        local ax = Vector3.new(math.abs(n.X) > 0.5 and 1 or 0, math.abs(n.Y) > 0.5 and 1 or 0, math.abs(n.Z) > 0.5 and 1 or 0)
        local pos
        if isBlock(hit.Instance) then
            -- stick to the face of the block you point at
            local b = hit.Instance
            local bw = b.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(b.Size)
            local bext = Vector3.new(math.abs(bw.X), math.abs(bw.Y), math.abs(bw.Z)) / 2
            local center = b.Position + n * ((bext * ax).Magnitude + (ext * ax).Magnitude)
            pos = Vector3.new(
                ax.X == 1 and center.X or snap(hit.Position.X, grid),
                ax.Y == 1 and center.Y or snap(hit.Position.Y, grid),
                ax.Z == 1 and center.Z or snap(hit.Position.Z, grid))
        else
            local p = hit.Position + n * (ext * ax).Magnitude
            pos = Vector3.new(
                ax.X == 1 and p.X or snap(p.X, grid),
                ax.Y == 1 and p.Y or snap(p.Y, grid),
                ax.Z == 1 and p.Z or snap(p.Z, grid))
        end
        return CFrame.new(pos) * rotation, def
    end)

    local currentColor; currentColor = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local c = COLORS[settings.Color]
        return c or nil
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ builds (connected groups)
    local touching; touching = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a, b)
        -- axis-aligned check in a's space with a small tolerance (blocks only rotate in 90° steps)
        local rel = a.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(b.Position)
        local bs = a.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(b.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(b.Size))
        bs = Vector3.new(math.abs(bs.X), math.abs(bs.Y), math.abs(bs.Z))
        local lim = (a.Size + bs) / 2 + Vector3.new(0.06, 0.06, 0.06)
        return math.abs(rel.X) <= lim.X and math.abs(rel.Y) <= lim.Y and math.abs(rel.Z) <= lim.Z
    end)
    local buildOf; buildOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(start)
        local all = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if isBlock(p) then table.insert(all, p) end end
        local seen, queue, out = { [start] = true }, { start }, {}
        while #queue > 0 do
            local cur = table.remove(queue)
            table.insert(out, cur)
            for _, other in ipairs(all) do
                if not seen[other] and touching(cur, other) then
                    seen[other] = true
                    table.insert(queue, other)
                end
            end
        end
        return out
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ vehicle (launch / fly)
    local vehicle = nil -- { parts, root, motors, seat, force, gyro, weld }
    local lastUnsit = 0
    local sitState = nil -- { weld, conn, seat } - you can sit on any seat, flying or not
    local unsit; unsit = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if sitState then
            if sitState.conn then sitState.conn:Disconnect() end
            if sitState.weld then sitState.weld:Destroy() end
            sitState = nil
            lastUnsit = os.clock()
        end
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false; hum.Sit = false end
    end)
    local function sitOn(seat)
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not (hum and hrp and seat and seat.Parent) then return end
        if sitState and sitState.seat == seat then return end
        unsit()
        local lift = hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 and math.max(1.2, hum.HipHeight * 0.75) or 1.5
        local w = Instance.new("Weld")
        w.Name = "BAB_SitWeld"
        w.Part0 = seat
        w.Part1 = hrp
        w.C0 = CFrame.new(0, seat.Size.Y / 2, 0)
        w.C1 = CFrame.new(0, -lift, 0)
        w.Parent = seat
        hum.Sit = true -- sitting pose
        sitState = { weld = w, seat = seat }
        -- jumping (or the game standing you up) leaves the seat
        sitState.conn = hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Sit"):Connect(function()
            if not hum.Sit then task.defer(unsit) end
        end)
    end
    local seatedIn; seatedIn = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(parts)
        return sitState ~= nil and sitState.weld.Parent ~= nil and table.find(parts, sitState.seat) ~= nil
    end)
    local function freeze()
        if not vehicle then return end
        for _, obj in ipairs(vehicle.extras) do obj:Destroy() end
        for _, p in ipairs(vehicle.parts) do
            if p.Parent then
                for _, w in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do if w.Name == "BAB_Weld" then w:Destroy() end end
                p.Anchored = true
                p.AssemblyLinearVelocity, p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
                local flame = p:FindFirstChild("Flame")
                if flame then flame.Enabled = false end
            end
        end
        vehicle = nil
    end
    local function launch(target)
        freeze()
        local parts = buildOf(target)
        if #parts == 0 then return end
        local seat, motors, balloons, wheels = nil, {}, 0, 0
        for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
            local sp = p:GetAttribute("BAB_Special")
            if sp == "Seat" and not seat then seat = p end
            if sp == "Motor" or sp == "Jet" or sp == "Lift" then table.insert(motors, p) end
            if sp == "Balloon" then balloons += 1 end
            if sp == "Wheel" then wheels += 1 end
        end
        if sitState and table.find(parts, sitState.seat) then seat = sitState.seat end
        local root = seat or parts[1]
        vehicle = { parts = parts, root = root, motors = motors, seat = seat, extras = {}, balloons = balloons, wheels = wheels }
        for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
            p.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.35, 0.3, 0.2)
            if p ~= root then
                local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                w.Name = "BAB_Weld"
                w.Part0, w.Part1 = root, p
                w.Parent = p
            end
        end
        local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
        att.Name = "BAB_Root"
        att.Parent = root
        local force = Instance.new("VectorForce")
        force.Attachment0 = att
        force.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
        force.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
        force.Force = Vector3.zero
        force.Parent = root
        -- flying: the build moves where the camera looks (LinearVelocity) and turns to face it (AlignOrientation)
        local lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
        lv.Attachment0 = att
        lv.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
        lv.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
        lv.MaxForce = 0
        lv.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
        lv.Parent = root
        local align = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
        align.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
        align.Attachment0 = att
        align.MaxTorque = math.huge
        align.Responsiveness = 20
        align.CFrame = root.CFrame.Rotation
        align.Enabled = false
        align.Parent = root
        vehicle.force, vehicle.lv, vehicle.align, vehicle.speed = force, lv, align, 0
        local weight = 0
        for _, m in ipairs(motors) do weight += (m:GetAttribute("BAB_Special") == "Jet") and 2.5 or 1 end
        vehicle.weight = weight
        table.insert(vehicle.extras, att); table.insert(vehicle.extras, force)
        table.insert(vehicle.extras, lv); table.insert(vehicle.extras, align)
        for _, p in ipairs(parts) do p.Anchored = false end
        if sitState and table.find(parts, sitState.seat) then
            vehicle.seat = sitState.seat -- you already sit in it: drive from that seat
        elseif seat then
            sitOn(seat)
        end
        if #motors == 0 then
            notify("This build has no Motor / Jet / Up Thruster - it can't fly. Add a Motor from the inventory (E)", "Warning")
        else
            notify(("Launched: %d blocks, %d motors. Look where to fly, W = gas, S = back, G = motors on/off, Jump = leave the seat"):format(#parts, #motors), "Success")
        end
    end

    onSeatTouched = function(seat)
        if os.clock() - lastUnsit < 1.5 or sitState then return end
        sitOn(seat)
        if settings.SitLaunch and not (vehicle and table.find(vehicle.parts, seat)) then
            launch(seat)
        end
    end
    local keyDown; keyDown = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(k) return UserInputService:IsKeyDown(k) end)
    local mobileVert = 0 -- phone Gas (+1) / Back (-1) buttons
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        if sitState and (not sitState.seat.Parent or not sitState.weld.Parent) then unsit() end
        if not vehicle then return end
        local root = vehicle.root
        if not root.Parent then vehicle = nil; return end
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local seated = seatedIn(vehicle.parts)
        -- with a seat you drive it from the seat; a build without a seat is driven standing on / next to it
        local controlling = seated or (vehicle.seat == nil and hrp ~= nil and (hrp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude < 40)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local look = camera and camera.CFrame.LookVector or root.CFrame.LookVector

        local throttle = 0
        if controlling then
            if not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                if keyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) or keyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Up) then throttle += 1 end
                if keyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) or keyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Down) then throttle -= 1 end
            end
            throttle += mobileVert -- phone: Gas / Back buttons
            if hum and UserInputService.TouchEnabled and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.2 and camera then
                -- phone joystick pushed forward = gas
                local flatCam = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
                if flatCam.Magnitude > 0.01 then throttle += math.clamp(hum.MoveDirection:Dot(flatCam.Unit), -1, 1) end
            end
            throttle = math.clamp(throttle, -1, 1)
        end

        local mass = root.AssemblyMass
        local g = workspace.Gravity
        local total = Vector3.zero
        local motorsOn = #vehicle.motors > 0 and enginesOn
        for _, m in ipairs(vehicle.motors) do
            local flame = m.Parent and m:FindFirstChild("Flame")
            if flame then flame.Enabled = motorsOn and throttle ~= 0 end
        end

        if motorsOn then
            -- fly where you look: up = climb, down = dive, turn the camera = turn. No input = hover in place.
            local top = settings.Power * 0.5 * math.min(1 + 0.25 * (vehicle.weight - 1), 4)
            vehicle.speed += (throttle * top - vehicle.speed) * math.min(1, dt * 2.5)
            vehicle.lv.MaxForce = mass * (g + 300)
            vehicle.lv.VectorVelocity = look * vehicle.speed
            if controlling then
                local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
                local pitch = math.clamp(math.asin(math.clamp(look.Y, -1, 1)), math.rad(-60), math.rad(60))
                vehicle.align.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
                vehicle.align.Responsiveness = 6 + settings.Turn * 8
                vehicle.align.Enabled = true
            else
                vehicle.align.Enabled = false
            end
        else
            vehicle.speed = 0
            vehicle.lv.MaxForce = 0
            vehicle.align.Enabled = false
            -- wheels: drive on the ground with W / S, steer with the camera
            if vehicle.wheels > 0 and controlling then
                local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
                if flat.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                    flat = flat.Unit
                    total += flat * throttle * settings.Power * 0.8 * mass
                    vehicle.align.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, flat)
                    vehicle.align.Responsiveness = 4 + settings.Turn * 4
                    vehicle.align.Enabled = true
                end
                local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                total -= Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z) * mass * 0.6
            end
        end
        -- balloons: each one carries a part of the weight (4 balloons = it floats on its own)
        if vehicle.balloons > 0 and not motorsOn then
            total += Vector3.new(0, mass * g * math.min(vehicle.balloons * 0.26, 1.15), 0)
        end
        vehicle.force.Force = total
    end))

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ saving
    local saves = {}
    local SAVE_DIR = "CrackHub/Builds"
    local function canFiles()
        return type(env.writefile) == "function" and type(env.readfile) == "function"
    end
    local function ensureDir()
        pcall(function()
            if type(env.isfolder) == "function" and type(env.makefolder) == "function" then
                if not env.isfolder("CrackHub") then env.makefolder("CrackHub") end
                if not env.isfolder(SAVE_DIR) then env.makefolder(SAVE_DIR) end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function cleanName(name)
        name = tostring(name or ""):gsub("[^%w%s%-_]", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        return name
    end
    local function loadSaveList()
        local names = {}
        for name in pairs(saves) do names[name] = true end
        if canFiles() and type(env.listfiles) == "function" then
            ensureDir()
            pcall(function()
                for _, path in ipairs(env.listfiles(SAVE_DIR)) do
                    local name = tostring(path):match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
                    if name then names[name] = true end
                end
            end)
        end
        local list = {}
        for name in pairs(names) do table.insert(list, name) end
        table.sort(list)
        return list
    end
    local function serialize(parts, origin)
        local data = { Version = 1, Blocks = {} }
        for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
            local rel = origin:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)
            local rx, ry, rz = rel:ToOrientation()
            local c = p.Color
            table.insert(data.Blocks, {
                t = p:GetAttribute("BAB_Type"),
                s = { p.Size.X, p.Size.Y, p.Size.Z },
                p = { rel.X, rel.Y, rel.Z },
                r = { math.deg(rx), math.deg(ry), math.deg(rz) },
                c = { math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5) },
            })
        end
        return data
    end
    local function saveBuild(name, parts)
        local origin = CFrame.new(parts[1].Position)
        local data = serialize(parts, origin)
        saves[name] = data
        if canFiles() then
            ensureDir()
            local ok = pcall(function() env.writefile(SAVE_DIR .. "/" .. name .. ".json", HttpService:JSONEncode(data)) end)
            if not ok then notify("Couldn't write the file, the build is saved until you leave", "Warning") end
        end
    end
    local function readBuild(name)
        if saves[name] then return saves[name] end
        if canFiles() then
            local ok, data = pcall(function()
                return HttpService:JSONDecode(env.readfile(SAVE_DIR .. "/" .. name .. ".json"))
            end)
            if ok and type(data) == "table" then saves[name] = data; return data end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function spawnBuild(data)
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return 0 end
        local look = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
        local flat = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        flat = flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and flat.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
        -- lowest block sits on the ground in front of you
        local lowest = math.huge
        for _, b in ipairs(data.Blocks or {}) do lowest = math.min(lowest, b.p[2] - b.s[2] / 2) end
        if lowest == math.huge then return 0 end
        local base = hrp.Position + flat * 14
        local ground = workspace:Raycast(base + Vector3.new(0, 20, 0), Vector3.new(0, -200, 0), mouseRay)
        local y = ground and ground.Position.Y or (hrp.Position.Y - 3)
        local origin = CFrame.new(base.X, y - lowest, base.Z)
        local made = 0
        for _, b in ipairs(data.Blocks) do
            local cf = origin * CFrame.new(b.p[1], b.p[2], b.p[3])
                * CFrame.fromOrientation(math.rad(b.r[1]), math.rad(b.r[2]), math.rad(b.r[3]))
            makeBlock(b.t, Vector3.new(b.s[1], b.s[2], b.s[3]), cf, Color3.fromRGB(b.c[1], b.c[2], b.c[3]))
            made += 1
        end
        return made
    end

        end
    end)

    local function nearestBlock(maxDist)
        local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local best, bestDist = nil, maxDist or math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if isBlock(p) then
                local d = (p.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = p, d end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    -- Ignition: starts the build you are near (launches it first if needed) / stops the motors
    local function toggleIgnition()
        if sitState and not (vehicle and table.find(vehicle.parts, sitState.seat)) then
            launch(sitState.seat) -- start the build you are sitting in
            setEngines(true)
            return
        end
        if not vehicle then
            local target = nearestBlock(80)
            if not target then notify("No build near you", "Warning"); return end
            launch(target)
            setEngines(true)
            return
        end
        setEngines(not enginesOn)
    end
    -- pressing gas while sitting starts everything by itself (no need to press Ignition first)
    local function gasPressed()
        if not sitState then return end
        if not (vehicle and table.find(vehicle.parts, sitState.seat)) then
            launch(sitState.seat)
            if vehicle and #vehicle.motors > 0 then setEngines(true) end
        elseif not enginesOn and #vehicle.motors > 0 then
            setEngines(true)
        end
    end
    local function undo()
        while #placedStack > 0 do
            local p = table.remove(placedStack)
            if p.Parent then
                if vehicle and table.find(vehicle.parts, p) then freeze() end
                p:Destroy()
                return
            end
        end
        notify("Nothing to undo")
    end
    local function removeBlock(p)
        if not p then return end
        if vehicle and table.find(vehicle.parts, p) then freeze() end
        p:Destroy()
    end

    -- what a click / tap does with the selected slot
    local function primaryAction(screenPos)
        local def = BLOCK_BY_NAME[settings.Block]
        if def and def.Item then
            local hit = castMouse(screenPos)
            local target = hit and isBlock(hit.Instance) and hit.Instance or nil
            local sp = def.Special
            if sp == "Ignition" then
                toggleIgnition()
            elseif sp == "Launcher" then
                if vehicle then freeze(); notify("Build frozen")
                elseif target then launch(target)
                else notify("Click a build to launch it", "Warning") end
            elseif sp == "Hammer" then
                removeBlock(target)
            elseif sp == "Paint" then
                local c = currentColor()
                if not c then notify("Pick a colour in the inventory (E) first", "Warning")
                elseif target then target.Color = c end
            elseif sp == "Picker" then
                if target then
                    local kind = target:GetAttribute("BAB_Type")
                    hotbar[hotSlot] = kind
                    fillSlot(hotSlot)
                    selectSlot(hotSlot)
                    notify("Picked " .. tostring(kind))
                end
            elseif sp == "Rotate" then
                if target and not (vehicle and table.find(vehicle.parts, target)) then
                    target.CFrame = target.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
                end
            end
            return
        end
        if not settings.AllowBlocks then notify("Placing blocks is turned off (Allow Blocks)", "Warning"); return end
        refreshGhost()
        local cf = placementCFrame(screenPos)
        if cf then
            local p = makeBlock(settings.Block, ghost.Size, cf, currentColor())
            table.insert(placedStack, p)
            if #placedStack > 300 then table.remove(placedStack, 1) end
        end
    end
