    -- colour palette
    local swatches = {}
    local function refreshSwatches()
        for name, sw in pairs(swatches) do
            local st = sw:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            if st then st.Transparency = name == settings.Color and 0 or 0.8; st.Thickness = name == settings.Color and 2 or 1 end
        end
    end
    for i, name in ipairs(COLOR_NAMES) do
        local sw = Instance.new("TextButton")
        sw.Text = name == "Default" and "∅" or ""
        sw.TextSize = 14
        sw.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
        sw.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS[name] or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 72)
        sw.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((i - 1) * 32, 36)
        sw.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26)
        sw.Parent = tools
        corner(sw, 13)
        stroke(sw, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 1, 0.8)
        swatches[name] = sw
        sw.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() settings.Color = name; refreshSwatches() end)
    end
    refreshSwatches()
    -- actions
    local collideBtn
    smallButton(tools, "Undo (Z)", 80, 0, 72, nil, undo)
    smallButton(tools, "Launch", 70, 86, 72, Color3.fromRGB(40, 90, 160), function()
        local target = nearestBlock(); if target then launch(target) else notify("Build something first", "Warning") end
    end)
    smallButton(tools, "Ignition (G)", 92, 162, 72, Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 60), toggleIgnition)
    smallButton(tools, "Freeze", 64, 260, 72, nil, function() freeze(); notify("Build frozen") end)
    collideBtn = smallButton(tools, "Collisions: ON", 112, 330, 72, nil, function()
        settings.Collide = not settings.Collide
        for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if isBlock(p) then p.CanCollide = settings.Collide end end
        collideBtn.Text = settings.Collide and "Collisions: ON" or "Collisions: OFF"
    end)
    smallButton(tools, "Reset Rotation", 106, 448, 72, nil, function() rotation = CFrame.identity end)
    smallButton(tools, "Clear All", 76, 560, 72, Color3.fromRGB(140, 45, 45), function()
        freeze()
        for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if isBlock(p) then p:Destroy() end end
        table.clear(placedStack)
    end)
    -- name every cell so search can find it
    for _, grid in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
        for _, cell in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do
            if cell:IsA("TextButton") then
                local label = cell:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
                if label then cell:SetAttribute("BlockName", label.Text) end
            end
        end
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while alive do
            local n = 0
            for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if isBlock(p) then n += 1 end end
            countLabel.Text = ("%d blocks · %s"):format(n, enginesOn and "engines ON" or "engines OFF")
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)

    -- ---- always-visible buttons (phone + PC): hide UI, inventory, flight controls
    mobileGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    mobileGui.Name = "CrackHub_BuildABoatButtons"
    mobileGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    mobileGui.DisplayOrder = 61
    mobileGui.Enabled = false
    pcall(function() mobileGui.Parent = gui.Parent end)
    local col = Instance.new("Frame")
    col.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    col.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
    col.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.45, 0)
    col.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 320)
    col.Parent = mobileGui
    local colList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    colList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    colList.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
    colList.Parent = col
    local function sideButton(label, color)
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.Text = label
        b.TextSize = 13
        b.FontFace = UI_FONT
        b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = color or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)
        b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
        b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(104, 38)
        b.Parent = col
        corner(b, 10)
        stroke(b, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 1, 0.85)
        return b
    end
    local buildBtn = sideButton("Build: OFF (B)", Color3.fromRGB(120, 70, 20))
    local hideBtn = sideButton("Hide UI (F10)")
    local invBtn = sideButton("Blocks (E)")
    local ignBtn = sideButton("Ignition (G)", Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 60))
    local upBtn = sideButton("▲ Gas", Color3.fromRGB(40, 70, 130))
    local downBtn = sideButton("▼ Back", Color3.fromRGB(40, 70, 130))
    local function setHidden(h)
        uiHidden = h
        if h then setInventory(false) end
        hideBtn.Text = h and "Show UI (F10)" or "Hide UI (F10)"
        refreshVisibility()
    end
    hideBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setHidden(not uiHidden) end)
    -- one switch for the menu toggle, the B key and the screen button
    setBuildMode = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(on, fromMenu)
        on = not not on
        if on and ((fromMenu and not buildPageSelected()) or not buildOverlayAllowed()) then
            if buildToggle then buildToggle:Set(settings.BuildMode, true) end
            return
        end
        settings.BuildMode = on
        setBuildUI(on)
        buildBtn.Text = on and "Build: ON (B)" or "Build: OFF (B)"
        buildBtn.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(40, 130, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 70, 20)
        if not fromMenu and buildToggle then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() buildToggle:Set(on, true) end)) end
    end)
    buildBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setBuildMode(not settings.BuildMode) end)
    invBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if uiHidden then setHidden(false) end
        setInventory(not inventoryOpen)
    end)
    ignBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleIgnition)
    upBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() mobileVert = 1; gasPressed() end)
    upBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() mobileVert = 0 end)
    upBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if mobileVert == 1 then mobileVert = 0 end end)
    downBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() mobileVert = -1 end)
    downBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() mobileVert = 0 end)
    downBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if mobileVert == -1 then mobileVert = 0 end end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while alive do
            local flying = vehicle ~= nil or sitState ~= nil
            upBtn.Visible, downBtn.Visible = flying, flying
            invBtn.Visible = settings.BuildMode
            hideBtn.Visible = settings.BuildMode
            refreshVisibility()
            task.wait(0.25)
        end
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ input
    local hovered = nil
    local lastPickTarget = nil
    connect(RunService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if not buildOverlayAllowed() then
            if settings.BuildMode then setBuildMode(false) end
            pickMode = false
            ghost.Parent, hoverBox.Adornee = nil, nil
            clearPickBoxes()
            refreshVisibility()
            return
        end
        refreshVisibility()
        -- save mode: highlight the build under the mouse
        if pickMode then
            ghost.Parent = nil
            hoverBox.Adornee = nil
            local hit = castMouse()
            local target = hit and isBlock(hit.Instance) and hit.Instance or nil
            if target ~= lastPickTarget then
                lastPickTarget = target
                if target then showPick(buildOf(target)) else clearPickBoxes() end
            end
            return
        end
        local selectedDef = BLOCK_BY_NAME[settings.Block]
        if not settings.BuildMode or inventoryOpen then
            ghost.Parent = nil
            hoverBox.Adornee = nil
            return
        end
        local hit = castMouse()
        hovered = hit and isBlock(hit.Instance) and hit.Instance or nil
        hoverBox.Adornee = hovered
        -- tools (Hammer, Paint, ...) only outline the block you point at
        hoverBox.OutlineColor = (selectedDef and selectedDef.Special == "Hammer") and Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
            or Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 90)
        if selectedDef and selectedDef.Item then
            ghost.Parent = nil
            return
        end
        refreshGhost()
        local cf, def = nil, nil
        if settings.AllowBlocks then cf, def = placementCFrame() end
        if cf then
            ghost.CFrame = cf
            ghost.Color = currentColor() or def.Color
            ghost.Parent = workspace
        else
            ghost.Parent = nil
        end
    end))

    connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
        if processed or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if BindCapture and BindCapture:Blocked(input) then return end
        if not buildOverlayAllowed() then return end
        local t = input.UserInputType
        if pickMode then
            if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                local hit = castMouse()
                if hit and isBlock(hit.Instance) then
                    local parts = buildOf(hit.Instance)
                    saveBuild(settings.Name, parts)
                    pickMode = false
                    lastPickTarget = nil
                    clearPickBoxes()
                    notify(("Saved \"%s\" (%d blocks)"):format(settings.Name, #parts), "Success")
                    if window._babRefresh then window._babRefresh() end
                else
                    notify("Click one of your blocks to save that build", "Warning")
                end
            elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
                pickMode = false
                lastPickTarget = nil
                clearPickBoxes()
                notify("Saving cancelled", "Warning")
            end
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.G then
            if not settings.BuildMode and not vehicle and not sitState then return end
            toggleIgnition()
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.B then
            if not settings.BuildMode and not buildPageSelected() then return end
            setBuildMode(not settings.BuildMode)
            return
        end
        if (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up) and sitState then
            gasPressed() -- doesn't return: W keeps working as gas
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F10 and settings.BuildMode then
            setHidden(not uiHidden)
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace and sitState then
            unsit()
            return
        end
        if not settings.BuildMode then return end
        if NUMBER_KEYS[input.KeyCode] then selectSlot(NUMBER_KEYS[input.KeyCode]); return end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
            if uiHidden then setHidden(false) end
            setInventory(not inventoryOpen)
            return
        end
        if inventoryOpen then return end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then undo(); return end
        if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            primaryAction(nil)
        elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            primaryAction(Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y))
        elseif t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.X then
            if hovered then
                removeBlock(hovered)
                hovered = nil
            end
        elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then
            rotation = rotation * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
        elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
            rotation = rotation * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
        elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F and hovered then
            launch(hovered)
        end
    end)

    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
        sitState = nil
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ tab: Visuals · Build A Board
    task.spawn(function()
        local visuals
        for _ = 1, 80 do
            for _, group in ipairs(window.TabGroups or {}) do
                if group.Name == "Visuals" and group.CreateTab then visuals = group end
            end
            if visuals or not alive then break end
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
        if not alive then return end
        local tab = visuals and visuals:CreateTab("Build A Board") or window:CreateTab("Build A Board")
        buildTab = tab

        local build = tab:AddGroup("Build", true)
        buildToggle = build:AddToggle({ Name = "Build Mode", Default = false, Bind = false, Flag = "BuildABoard_BuildMode",
            Description = "Hotbar 1-9 · E = inventory with all blocks · LMB place · RMB / X remove · R turn · T tilt · F launch",
            Callback = function(v) setBuildMode(v, true) end })
        build:AddToggle({ Name = "Allow Blocks", Default = true,
            Description = "Off = you can't place new blocks (removing still works)",
            Callback = function(v) settings.AllowBlocks = v end })
        build:AddDropdown({ Name = "Block (selected slot)", Options = BLOCK_NAMES, Default = settings.Block, Callback = function(v)
            if type(v) == "table" then v = v[1] end
            if v and BLOCK_BY_NAME[v] then
                hotbar[hotSlot] = v
                fillSlot(hotSlot)
                selectSlot(hotSlot)
            end
        end })
        build:AddDropdown({ Name = "Color", Options = COLOR_NAMES, Default = settings.Color, Callback = function(v)
            if type(v) == "table" then v = v[1] end
            if v then settings.Color = v end
        end })
        build:AddSlider({ Name = "Block Size", Min = 1, Max = 8, Default = settings.Size, Increment = 0.5, Suffix = " st",
            Callback = function(v) settings.Size = v end })
        build:AddSlider({ Name = "Grid", Min = 0.5, Max = 4, Default = settings.Grid, Increment = 0.5, Suffix = " st",
            Callback = function(v) settings.Grid = v end })
        build:AddToggle({ Name = "Block Collisions", Default = true, Callback = function(v)
            settings.Collide = v
            for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if isBlock(p) then p.CanCollide = v end end
        end })
        build:AddButton({ Name = "Clear All Blocks", Callback = function()
            freeze()
            for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if isBlock(p) then p:Destroy() end end
            notify("All blocks removed")
        end })

        local fly = tab:AddGroup("Motors & Flying", true)
        fly:AddParagraph({ Title = "How to fly",
            Content = "Put a Seat and at least one Motor / Jet on your build. Sit on the seat (walk onto it), start the motors with "
                .. "Ignition (slot 9) or G. Then just look where you want to fly: camera up = climb, down = dive, turn = turn. "
                .. "W = gas, S = back, no gas = hover. Jump = leave the seat. Phone: Gas / Back buttons + drag the camera." })
        fly:AddButton({ Name = "Launch Nearest Build", Callback = function()
            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
            for _, p in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                if isBlock(p) and hrp then
                    local d = (p.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = p, d end
                end
            end
            if best then launch(best) else notify("Build something first", "Warning") end
        end })
        fly:AddButton({ Name = "Stop & Freeze", Callback = function() freeze(); notify("Build frozen") end })
        fly:AddSlider({ Name = "Motor Power", Min = 10, Max = 200, Default = settings.Power, Increment = 5,
            Callback = function(v) settings.Power = v end })
        fly:AddSlider({ Name = "Turn Speed", Min = 0.4, Max = 4, Default = settings.Turn, Increment = 0.1,
            Callback = function(v) settings.Turn = v end })
        fly:AddToggle({ Name = "Sitting Starts The Build", Default = false,
            Description = "Off = you just sit on seats (like Build A Board); on = sitting down also launches the build",
            Callback = function(v) settings.SitLaunch = v end })
        fly:AddToggle({ Name = "Hover Assist", Default = true,
            Description = "Motors hold the build in the air (off = it falls unless up-motors push it)",
            Callback = function(v) settings.Hover = v end })

        local save = tab:AddGroup("Save / Load", true)
        save:AddTextbox({ Name = "Build Name", Placeholder = "My boat", Callback = function(text)
            settings.Name = cleanName(text)
        end })
        save:AddButton({ Name = "Save", Description = "Then the menu closes - click your build to save all of it",
            Callback = function()
                if settings.Name == "" then notify("Type a build name first", "Warning"); return end
                pickMode = true
                lastPickTarget = nil
                pcall(function() window:SetVisible(false) end)
                notify("Click your build to save it (Esc / Q - cancel)")
            end })
        local savesDD
        local selected = nil
        savesDD = save:AddDropdown({ Name = "Saved Builds", Options = loadSaveList(), Callback = function(v)
            if type(v) == "table" then v = v[1] end
            selected = v
        end })
        window._babRefresh = function()
            pcall(function() savesDD:Refresh(loadSaveList(), true) end)
        end
        save:AddButton({ Name = "Load", Callback = function()
            if not selected then notify("Pick a saved build", "Warning"); return end
            local data = readBuild(selected)
            if not data then notify("Couldn't read that save", "Warning"); return end
            notify(("Loaded \"%s\" (%d blocks)"):format(selected, spawnBuild(data)), "Success")
        end })
        save:AddButton({ Name = "Delete Save", Callback = function()
            if not selected then return end
            saves[selected] = nil
            if type(env.delfile) == "function" then
                pcall(function() env.delfile(SAVE_DIR .. "/" .. selected .. ".json") end)
            end
            notify(("Deleted \"%s\""):format(selected))
            selected = nil
            window._babRefresh()
        end })
    end)

    local function stop()
        if not alive then return end
        alive = false
        pcall(freeze)
        for _, c in ipairs(connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        pcall(clearPickBoxes)
        pcall(function() ghost:Destroy() end)
        pcall(function() folder:Destroy() end)
        pcall(setBuildUI, false)
        pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
        pcall(function() mobileGui:Destroy() end)
        if env.CrackHubBuildABoat and env.CrackHubBuildABoat.Stop == stop then env.CrackHubBuildABoat = nil end
    end
    env.CrackHubBuildABoat = { Stop = stop }
    -- the hub has no unload hook for modules: watch the window and clean everything when it is closed
    task.spawn(function()
        while alive do
            if window.Destroyed then stop(); break end
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)
    return stop
end

CrackHub.InstallFishing = function(window, combat)
    -- Visuals · Fishing: a client-side fishing mini-game, only you see it.
    -- Animated rod skins, real (local) terrain water, character poses for cast / wait / fight / catch,
    -- timing hook, reel fight with dashes, fish with rarities and a saved catch log.
    local env=CrackHubEnvironment
    local Players=game:GetService("Players")
    local SoundService=game:GetService("SoundService")
    local UserInputService=game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local HttpService=game:GetService("HttpService")
    local LocalPlayer=Players.LocalPlayer
    local alive=true
    local connections={}
    local function connect(signal,fn)
        local c=signal:Connect(function(...)if alive then return fn(...)end end)
        table.insert(connections,c)
        return c
    end
    local UI_B=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Bold)
    local UI_H=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Heavy)
    local UI_R=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/BuilderSans.json",Enum.FontWeight.Regular)
    local SPARK="rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
    local FIRE="rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds"
    local SMOKE="rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds"

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ sounds
    local SOUND_DATA=CrackHubEnvironment.__CrackHubJSONAsset("sound_data.json")
    local sounds={}
    for name,data in pairs(SOUND_DATA)do
        pcall(function()
            if type(env.writefile)~="function" or type(env.getcustomasset)~="function" then return end
            if type(env.isfolder)=="function" and not env.isfolder("CrackHub")then env.makefolder("CrackHub")end
            local path="CrackHub/fish2_"..name..".ogg"
            if type(env.isfile)~="function" or not env.isfile(path)then env.writefile(path,Base64Decode(data))end
            local sound=Instance.new("Sound")
            sound.Name="CrackHubFishing_"..name
            sound.SoundId=env.getcustomasset(path)
            sound.Parent=SoundService
            sounds[name]=sound
        end)
    end
    local play; play = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(name,volume,speed)
        local sound=sounds[name]
        if not sound then return end
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            sound.Volume=volume or .6
            sound.PlaybackSpeed=speed or 1
            SoundService:PlayLocalSound(sound)
        end))
    end)
    -- looping reel whirr (its speed follows how fast the reel spins)
    local reelLoop=sounds.reel
    if reelLoop then reelLoop.Looped=true;reelLoop.Volume=0 end
    local reelSound; reelSound = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(volume,speed)
        if not reelLoop then return end
        if volume>0 and not reelLoop.IsPlaying then reelLoop:Play()end
        reelLoop.Volume=volume
        reelLoop.PlaybackSpeed=speed or 1
        if volume<=0 and reelLoop.IsPlaying then reelLoop:Stop()end
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ fish
    local RARITIES={
        {Name="Common",Color=Color3.fromRGB(185,190,200),Weight=60,Boost=0,Speed=.8,Jitter=.6,Zone=96,Dash=0,Hint="A small tug..."},
        {Name="Uncommon",Color=Color3.fromRGB(90,215,125),Weight=25,Boost=.3,Speed=1,Jitter=.8,Zone=88,Dash=.08,Hint="Something is biting!"},
        {Name="Rare",Color=Color3.fromRGB(70,150,255),Weight=10,Boost=.6,Speed=1.2,Jitter=1,Zone=80,Dash=.14,Hint="It's pulling hard!"},
        {Name="Epic",Color=Color3.fromRGB(175,95,255),Weight=4,Boost=1,Speed=1.45,Jitter=1.2,Zone=72,Dash=.2,Hint="A strong one!"},
        {Name="Legendary",Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,190,45),Weight=.9,Boost=1.6,Speed=1.7,Jitter=1.4,Zone=66,Dash=.28,Hint="It's HUGE!"},
        {Name="Mythic",Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,60,150),Weight=.1,Boost=2.4,Speed=1.95,Jitter=1.6,Zone=60,Dash=.36,Hint="The water is shaking..."},
    }
    local RARITY={}
    for index,r in ipairs(RARITIES)do r.Index=index;RARITY[r.Name]=r end
    local SPECIES={
        {Name="Bluegill",Rarity="Common",Body=Color3.fromRGB(90,130,170),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(230,190,90),Kg={.2,.8},Size=.8},
        {Name="Carp",Rarity="Common",Body=Color3.fromRGB(150,120,70),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(210,190,140),Kg={1,6},Size=1.1},
        {Name="Perch",Rarity="Common",Body=Color3.fromRGB(120,150,70),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(230,220,170),Kg={.3,1.5},Size=.9,Stripes=true},
        {Name="Sardine",Rarity="Common",Body=Color3.fromRGB(150,170,190),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(235,240,245),Kg={.05,.2},Size=.6},
        {Name="Salmon",Rarity="Uncommon",Body=Color3.fromRGB(170,110,110),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(240,170,140),Kg={2,9},Size=1.2},
        {Name="Rainbow Trout",Rarity="Uncommon",Body=Color3.fromRGB(110,140,110),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(240,150,170),Kg={1,5},Size=1},
        {Name="Catfish",Rarity="Uncommon",Body=Color3.fromRGB(80,75,70),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(190,180,160),Kg={2,14},Size=1.3,Whiskers=true},
        {Name="Pufferfish",Rarity="Rare",Body=Color3.fromRGB(220,190,90),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(245,240,220),Kg={.5,2},Size=.9,Round=true},
        {Name="Clownfish",Rarity="Rare",Body=Color3.fromRGB(255,120,30),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),Kg={.1,.4},Size=.7,Stripes=true},
        {Name="Koi",Rarity="Rare",Body=Color3.fromRGB(245,245,240),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(230,70,40),Kg={2,10},Size=1.2},
        {Name="Swordfish",Rarity="Epic",Body=Color3.fromRGB(60,80,130),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(200,210,230),Kg={40,180},Size=1.8,Sword=true},
        {Name="Anglerfish",Rarity="Epic",Body=Color3.fromRGB(50,45,60),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(90,80,100),Kg={3,20},Size=1.2,Lure=true},
        {Name="Golden Koi",Rarity="Legendary",Body=Color3.fromRGB(255,200,50),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(255,240,180),Kg={5,15},Size=1.4,Glow=true},
        {Name="Crystal Bass",Rarity="Legendary",Body=Color3.fromRGB(150,230,255),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(230,250,255),Kg={4,12},Size=1.3,Glow=true,Glass=true},
        {Name="Void Leviathan",Rarity="Mythic",Body=Color3.fromRGB(70,20,110),Belly=Color3.fromRGB(255,60,170),Kg={200,999},Size=2.2,Glow=true},
    }

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ saved log
    local LOG_FILE="CrackHub/fishing.json"
    local log={Total=0,Rarity={},Species={},Best=nil,Perfect=0}
    pcall(function()
        if type(env.isfile)=="function" and env.isfile(LOG_FILE)then
            local saved=HttpService:JSONDecode(env.readfile(LOG_FILE))
            if type(saved)=="table" then
                log.Total=tonumber(saved.Total) or 0
                log.Perfect=tonumber(saved.Perfect) or 0
                log.Rarity=type(saved.Rarity)=="table" and saved.Rarity or {}
                log.Species=type(saved.Species)=="table" and saved.Species or {}
                log.Best=type(saved.Best)=="table" and saved.Best or nil
            end
        end
    end)
    local saveLog; saveLog = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()if type(env.writefile)=="function" then env.writefile(LOG_FILE,HttpService:JSONEncode(log))end end))
    end)

    local settings={Enabled=false,Luck=1,Skin="Classic",Shake=true,Aura=true,Model="Fantasy Rod",Pond="Lily Pond",AuraStyle="Built-in Glow",Cinematic=true,CatchStyle="Random",UnlockCount=4}

    local idOf; idOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(list,name)for _,e in ipairs(list)do if e.Name==name then return e.Id end end end)
    -- some store meshes are drawn shifted away from their part (Mesh.Offset): move the part instead, so what you see is where it is
    local bakeMeshOffsets; bakeMeshOffsets = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(root)
        for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
            if d:IsA("DataModelMesh") then
                local holder=d.Parent
                local ok,offset=pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()return d.Offset end))
                if ok and holder and holder:IsA("BasePart") and offset.Magnitude>.001 then
                    holder.CFrame=holder.CFrame*CFrame.new(offset)
                    pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()d.Offset=Vector3.zero end))
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    local assetCache={}
    local loadAsset; loadAsset = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(id)
        if not id then return nil end
        if assetCache[id]==nil then
            local ok,objects=pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..tostring(id))end))
            local root=ok and type(objects)=="table" and objects[1] or nil
            if root then
                for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
                    if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("Sound") then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()d:Destroy()end))end
                end
            end
            assetCache[id]=root or false
        end
        local cached=assetCache[id]
        return cached and cached:Clone() or nil
    end)
    -- loads in the background so equipping never freezes
    task.spawn(function()
        loadAsset(idOf(ROD_MODELS,settings.Model))
        loadAsset(idOf(POND_MODELS,settings.Pond))
    end)
    local function auraEntry()for _,e in ipairs(AURAS)do if e.Name==settings.AuraStyle then return e end end return AURAS[1]end
    local function scaleSeq(sequence,k)
        local points={}
        for _,p in ipairs(sequence.Keypoints)do table.insert(points,NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(p.Time,p.Value*k,p.Envelope*k))end
        return NumberSequence.new(points)
    end
    -- copies the particles of a store aura onto the rod (smaller and lighter so it never lags)
    local function applyStoreAura(segments,tip)
        local entry=auraEntry()
        if not settings.Aura or not entry.Id then return false end
        local asset=loadAsset(entry.Id)
        if not asset then return false end
        local holders={}
        for _,child in ipairs(asset:GetChildren())do
            local has=child:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
            if not has then for _,d in ipairs(child:GetDescendants())do if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then has=true break end end end
            if has then table.insert(holders,child)end
        end
        local source=holders[entry.Pick or 1] or holders[1] or asset
        local list={}
        local function take(d)if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("PointLight") then table.insert(list,d)end end
        take(source)
        for _,d in ipairs(source:GetDescendants())do take(d)end
        local spots={segments[2],segments[math.floor(#segments/2)+1],segments[#segments],tip}
        local count=0
        for _,src in ipairs(list)do
            if src:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
                for _,spot in ipairs(spots)do
                    if spot and count<14 then
                        local ok=pcall(function()
                            local e=src:Clone()
                            e.Size=scaleSeq(src.Size,.3)
                            e.Rate=math.min(src.Rate*.35,22)
                            e.Speed=NumberRange.new(src.Speed.Min*.35,src.Speed.Max*.35)
                            e.Acceleration=src.Acceleration*.35
                            e.Enabled=true
                            e.Parent=spot
                        end)
                        if ok then count+=1 end
                    end
                end
            elseif src:IsA("PointLight") then
                pcall(function()local l=src:Clone();l.Range=math.min(l.Range,8);l.Parent=spots[2] or tip end)
            end
        end
        asset:Destroy()
        return count>0
    end
    local function rollFish()
        local total,weights=0,{}
        for _,r in ipairs(RARITIES)do
            local w=r.Weight*(1+(settings.Luck-1)*r.Boost)
            weights[r.Name]=w
            total+=w
        end
        local pick=math.random()*total
        local rarity="Common"
        for _,r in ipairs(RARITIES)do
            pick-=weights[r.Name]
            if pick<=0 then rarity=r.Name break end
        end
        local pool={}
        for _,s in ipairs(SPECIES)do if s.Rarity==rarity then table.insert(pool,s)end end
        local species=pool[math.random(1,#pool)]
        local roll=math.random()^1.8
        local kg=species.Kg[1]+(species.Kg[2]-species.Kg[1])*roll
        return species,RARITY[rarity],math.floor(kg*100+.5)/100,roll
    end

        p.TopSurface,p.BottomSurface=Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth

    end)

    local ease; ease = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(t)return 1-(1-t)^3 end)
    local emitter; emitter = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(parent,props)
