    local seq; seq = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a,b)return NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,a),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,b)})end)
    ------------------------------------------------------------------ real 3D effects (no flat sprites): every bit is a lit 3D part with its own physics
    local FX={List={}}
    FX.Folder=Instance.new("Folder")
    FX.Folder.Name="CrackHubFX3D"
    FX.Folder.Parent=workspace
    FX.spawn = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(o)
        if #FX.List>420 then return end
        local p=part({Name="FX",Shape=o.Shape or Enum.PartType.Block,Size=o.Size,Color=o.Color,Material=o.Material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
            Transparency=o.Transparency or 0,Reflectance=o.Reflectance or 0,
            CFrame=CFrame.new(o.Pos)*CFrame.Angles(math.random()*6.28,math.random()*6.28,math.random()*6.28),Parent=FX.Folder})
        if o.Light then local l=Instance.new("PointLight");l.Color=o.Color;l.Range=o.Light;l.Brightness=1.5;l.Parent=p end
        table.insert(FX.List,{Part=p,Vel=o.Vel or Vector3.zero,G=o.Gravity or 0,Drag=o.Drag or 0,Spin=o.Spin or Vector3.new(math.random()-.5,math.random()-.5,math.random()-.5)*12,
            Life=o.Life or 1,Age=0,Size0=o.Size,Grow=o.Grow or -0.8,T0=o.Transparency or 0,Floor=o.Floor})
        return p
    end)
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        local list=FX.List
        for i=#list,1,-1 do
            local f=list[i]
            f.Age+=dt
            local k=f.Age/f.Life
            if k>=1 or not f.Part.Parent then
                f.Part:Destroy()
                table.remove(list,i)
            else
                f.Vel=f.Vel*(1-math.min(1,f.Drag*dt))-Vector3.new(0,f.G*dt,0)
                local pos=f.Part.Position+f.Vel*dt
                if f.Floor and pos.Y<f.Floor then pos=Vector3.new(pos.X,f.Floor,pos.Z);f.Vel=Vector3.new(f.Vel.X*.4,-f.Vel.Y*.25,f.Vel.Z*.4)end
                f.Part.CFrame=CFrame.new(pos)*(f.Part.CFrame-f.Part.Position)*CFrame.Angles(f.Spin.X*dt,f.Spin.Y*dt,f.Spin.Z*dt)
                f.Part.Size=f.Size0*math.max(.05,1+f.Grow*k)
                f.Part.Transparency=f.T0+(1-f.T0)*k*k
            end
        end
    end))
    -- glass water droplets thrown up and falling back, plus a crown of streaks
    FX.droplets = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(at,count,power,color)
        power=power or 1
        for _=1,count do
            local a=math.random()*6.28
            local out=(2+math.random()*4)*power
            local s=(.14+math.random()*.22)*math.min(1.6,power)
            FX.spawn({Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(s,s,s),Color=color or Color3.fromRGB(175,215,250),Material=Enum.Material.Glass,
                Transparency=.2,Reflectance=.3,Pos=at+Vector3.new(0,.1,0),Vel=Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*out,(8+math.random()*9)*power,math.sin(a)*out),
                Gravity=55,Life=.7+math.random()*.5,Grow=-.6,Floor=at.Y})
        end
        for i=1,math.floor(count/3)do
            local a=(i/math.floor(count/3))*6.28
            FX.spawn({Size=Vector3.new(.09,.5*power,.09),Color=Color3.fromRGB(215,238,255),Material=Enum.Material.Glass,Transparency=.3,Reflectance=.3,
                Pos=at+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*.5,.2,math.sin(a)*.5),Vel=Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*3*power,6*power,math.sin(a)*3*power),Gravity=40,
                Spin=Vector3.zero,Life=.45,Grow=-.7})
        end
    end)
    -- faceted neon crystals that tumble outward (used instead of sparkle sprites)
    FX.shards = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(at,count,color,speed,gravity)
        for _=1,count do
            local dir=Vector3.new(math.random()-.5,math.random()-.3,math.random()-.5)
            dir=dir.Magnitude>0 and dir.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
            local s=.12+math.random()*.16
            local c=typeof(color)=="table" and color[math.random(1,#color)] or color
            FX.spawn({Size=Vector3.new(s,s*1.6,s),Color=c,Material=Enum.Material.Glass,Reflectance=.35,Transparency=.05,Pos=at,
                Vel=dir*(speed or 12)*(.5+math.random()*.7),Gravity=gravity or 6,Drag=2.2,Life=.7+math.random()*.6,Grow=-.9,Light=math.random()<.12 and 4 or nil})
        end
    end)
    -- chunks of ground flung out of a crack, with a puff of 3D dust balls
    function FX.rocks(at,count)
        for _=1,count do
            local a=math.random()*6.28
            local s=.18+math.random()*.3
            FX.spawn({Size=Vector3.new(s,s*.7,s*1.1),Color=Color3.fromRGB(95+math.random(-15,15),88+math.random(-15,15),82+math.random(-15,15)),Material=Enum.Material.Slate,
                Pos=at+Vector3.new(0,.2,0),Vel=Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*3,6+math.random()*6,math.sin(a)*3),Gravity=45,Life=1.1,Grow=-.3,Floor=at.Y})
        end
        for _=1,3 do
            local s=.8+math.random()*.6
            FX.spawn({Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(s,s,s),Color=Color3.fromRGB(140,125,115),Transparency=.55,Pos=at+Vector3.new(0,.4,0),
                Vel=Vector3.new(math.random()-.5,1.5,math.random()-.5)*2,Life=.9,Grow=1.4,Spin=Vector3.zero})
        end
    end
    -- an expanding glowing sphere (3D flash)
    FX.sphere = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(at,size,color,life)
        FX.spawn({Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(1,1,1)*size*.2,Color=color,Material=Enum.Material.ForceField,Transparency=.05,Pos=at,
            Life=life or .5,Grow=4,Spin=Vector3.zero})
    end)
    -- life around the pond: real glowing fireflies and glints on the water
    FX.pondLife = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(model,center,radius,surfaceY)
        local flies={}
        for i=1,6 do
            local fly=part({Name="Firefly",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.14,.14,.14),Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,240,140),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,Parent=model})
            local l=Instance.new("PointLight");l.Color=fly.Color;l.Range=3.5;l.Brightness=1;l.Parent=fly
            flies[i]={Part=fly,Light=l,Phase=math.random()*6.28,R=radius*(.4+math.random()*.7),H=1+math.random()*2.5,S=.2+math.random()*.3}
        end
        local glints={}
        for i=1,9 do
            glints[i]=part({Name="Glint",Size=Vector3.new(.35,.02,.08),Color=Color3.fromRGB(240,250,255),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,Transparency=1,Parent=model})
        end
        task.defer(function()
            while alive and model.Parent do
                local t=os.clock()
                for _,f in ipairs(flies)do
                    local a=f.Phase+t*f.S
                    f.Part.CFrame=CFrame.new(center.X+math.cos(a)*f.R+math.sin(t*1.3+f.Phase)*.6,surfaceY+f.H+math.sin(t*2+f.Phase)*.4,center.Z+math.sin(a)*f.R)
                    local blink=(math.sin(t*3+f.Phase*3)+1)*.5
                    f.Part.Transparency=.1+blink*.7
                    f.Light.Brightness=1.2*(1-blink)
                end
                for i,g in ipairs(glints)do
                    local cycle=(t*.6+i*.37)%1
                    if cycle<.02 then
                        local a,d=math.random()*6.28,math.random()*radius*.8
                        g.CFrame=CFrame.new(center.X+math.cos(a)*d,surfaceY+.03,center.Z+math.sin(a)*d)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.random()*6.28,0)
                    end
                    g.Transparency=1-math.sin(cycle*math.pi)*.75
                end
                task.wait(1/30)
            end
        end)
    end)


    ------------------------------------------------------------------ the pond: real terrain water (local only) with a stone bank
    local pond
    -- an expanding ring on the water, made of small glowing pieces
    local ripple; ripple = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(position,size,strength)
        if not pond then return end
        local pieces={}
        local count=16
        local alpha=math.clamp(.75-.25*(strength or 1),.15,.9)
        for i=1,count do
            pieces[i]=part({Size=Vector3.new(.07,.03,.3),Color=Color3.fromRGB(225,242,255),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,Transparency=alpha,Parent=pond.Model})
        end
        local life=1.2
        local t0=os.clock()
        task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            while os.clock()-t0<life and alive do
                local k=(os.clock()-t0)/life
                local r=.2+(size/2-.2)*ease(k)
                local seg=2*math.pi*r/count*1.05
                for i,p in ipairs(pieces)do
                    local a=(i/count)*math.pi*2
                    p.Size=Vector3.new(.07,.03,seg)
                    p.CFrame=CFrame.new(position+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*r,.03,math.sin(a)*r))*CFrame.Angles(0,-a,0)
                    p.Transparency=alpha+(1-alpha)*k
                end
                task.wait()
            end
            for _,p in ipairs(pieces)do p:Destroy()end
        end))
    end)
    local splash; splash = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(position,amount,color,power)
        if not pond then return end
        FX.droplets(position,math.clamp(math.floor((amount or 24)*.6),4,40),power or 1,color)
    end)
    local removePond; removePond = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if not pond then return end
        local p=pond
        pond=nil
        for _,d in ipairs(p.Model:GetDescendants())do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then TweenService:Create(d,TweenInfo.new(.4),{Transparency=1}):Play()end
        end
        -- give the ground back exactly as it was
        if p.Saved then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()workspace.Terrain:WriteVoxels(p.Region,4,p.Saved[1],p.Saved[2])end))end
        task.delay(.45,function()p.Model:Destroy()end)
    end)
    local makeBuiltinPond
    local makePond; makePond = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local id=idOf(POND_MODELS,settings.Pond)
        local asset=id and loadAsset(id)
        if not asset then return makeBuiltinPond()end
        removePond()
        local _,root=character()
        if not root then asset:Destroy();return end
        local params=RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances={LocalPlayer.Character}
        local look=root.CFrame.LookVector*Vector3.new(1,0,1)
        if look.Magnitude<.1 then look=Vector3.new(0,0,-1)end
        look=look.Unit
        local model=Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name="CrackHubPond"
        for _,child in ipairs(asset:IsA("Model") and asset:GetChildren() or {asset})do child.Parent=model end
        if asset.Parent==nil and asset~=model then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()asset:Destroy()end))end
        bakeMeshOffsets(model)
        for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Anchored,d.CanCollide,d.CanQuery,d.CanTouch=true,false,false,false end
        end
        model.Parent=workspace
        -- size it to about 15 studs across and stand it on the ground in front of you
        local okBox,cf,size=pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()return model:GetBoundingBox()end))
        if not okBox then model:Destroy();return makeBuiltinPond()end
        local across=math.max(size.X,size.Z)
        if across>0 then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale()*15/across)end))end
        cf,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
        across=math.max(size.X,size.Z)
        local spot=root.Position+look*(across/2+4)
        local hit=workspace:Raycast(spot+Vector3.new(0,8,0),Vector3.new(0,-40,0),params)
        local ground=hit and hit.Position or (root.Position-Vector3.new(0,3,0)+look*(across/2+4))
        local bottom=cf.Position-Vector3.new(0,size.Y/2,0)
        model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot()+(Vector3.new(ground.X,ground.Y-.05,ground.Z)-bottom))
        -- find the water surface in the model (or lay our own water if it has none)
        local water,best=nil,0
        for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                local name=d.Name:lower()
                local isWater=name:find("water") or d.Material==Enum.Material.Glass or d.Material==Enum.Material.ForceField or d.Material==Enum.Material.Water
                    or (d.Color.B>d.Color.R*1.4 and d.Color.B>.45 and d.Size.Y<1.5)
                local area=d.Size.X*d.Size.Z
                if isWater and area>best and area>4 then water,best=d,area end
            end
        end
        local center,surfaceY,radius
        if water then
            center=Vector3.new(water.Position.X,0,water.Position.Z)
            surfaceY=water.Position.Y+water.Size.Y/2
            radius=math.max(2,math.min(water.Size.X,water.Size.Z)/2*.75)
            -- moving shimmer on top of their water
            part({Name="Shimmer",Size=Vector3.new(water.Size.X*.96,.02,water.Size.Z*.96),Color=Color3.fromRGB(150,235,255),Material=Enum.Material.ForceField,
                Transparency=.3,CFrame=water.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,water.Size.Y/2+.01,0),Parent=model})
        else
            local box=model:GetBoundingBox()
            center=Vector3.new(box.Position.X,0,box.Position.Z)
            surfaceY=ground.Y+.3
            radius=math.max(3,across/2*.55)
            local flat=CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(90))
            part({Name="Water",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.2,radius*2.4,radius*2.4),Color=Color3.fromRGB(38,120,175),Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
                Transparency=.18,Reflectance=.28,CFrame=CFrame.new(center.X,ground.Y+.2,center.Z)*flat,Parent=model})
            part({Name="Shimmer",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.02,radius*2.3,radius*2.3),Color=Color3.fromRGB(140,235,255),Material=Enum.Material.ForceField,
                Transparency=.25,CFrame=CFrame.new(center.X,surfaceY+.01,center.Z)*flat,Parent=model})
        end
        -- fireflies + water glints
        FX.pondLife(model,center,radius,surfaceY)
        -- grow in
        for _,p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency<1 then
                local target=p.Transparency
                p.Transparency=1
                TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(.5+math.random()*.3),{Transparency=target}):Play()
            end
        end
        pond={Model=model,Center=Vector3.new(center.X,surfaceY,center.Z),Radius=radius}
        play("splash",.4,.8)
        task.delay(.35,function()if pond then ripple(pond.Center,radius*1.6,1.2);splash(pond.Center,14,nil,.7)end end)
        task.spawn(function()
            local mine=pond
            while alive and pond==mine do
                task.wait(1.4+math.random()*2.2)
                if pond~=mine then break end
                local a,d=math.random()*math.pi*2,math.random()*(radius-1)
                local at=mine.Center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*d,0,math.sin(a)*d)
                ripple(at,1.6+math.random()*1.2,.7)
                if math.random()<.18 then splash(at,8,nil,.5);play("tick",.12,.5)end
            end
        end)
    end)
    makeBuiltinPond=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        removePond()
        local _,root=character()
        if not root then return end
        local params=RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances={LocalPlayer.Character}
        params.IgnoreWater=true
        local look=root.CFrame.LookVector*Vector3.new(1,0,1)
        if look.Magnitude<.1 then look=Vector3.new(0,0,-1)end
        look=look.Unit
        local R=6
        local center=root.Position+look*(R+4)
        local hit=workspace:Raycast(center+Vector3.new(0,6,0),Vector3.new(0,-40,0),params)
        local ground=hit and hit.Position or (root.Position-Vector3.new(0,3,0)+look*(R+4))
        local model=Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name="CrackHubPond"
        local base=CFrame.new(ground)
        local flat=CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(90))
        local surfaceY=ground.Y+.32
        local saved,region
        -- water built from parts (always visible): deep colour, a glossy surface and a moving shimmer on top
        part({Name="Water",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.22,R*2,R*2),Color=Color3.fromRGB(38,120,175),Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
            Transparency=.18,Reflectance=.28,CFrame=CFrame.new(ground.X,ground.Y+.2,ground.Z)*flat,Parent=model})
        part({Name="Gloss",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.02,R*2-.3,R*2-.3),Color=Color3.fromRGB(150,215,245),Material=Enum.Material.Glass,
            Transparency=.55,Reflectance=.4,CFrame=CFrame.new(ground.X,surfaceY-.005,ground.Z)*flat,Parent=model})
        part({Name="Shimmer",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.02,R*2-.4,R*2-.4),Color=Color3.fromRGB(140,235,255),Material=Enum.Material.ForceField,
            Transparency=.25,CFrame=CFrame.new(ground.X,surfaceY+.01,ground.Z)*flat,Parent=model})
        -- soft foam line along the shore
        for i=1,28 do
            local a=(i/28)*math.pi*2
            part({Name="Foam",Size=Vector3.new(.12,.03,2*math.pi*(R-.15)/28*1.05),Color=Color3.fromRGB(235,248,255),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,Transparency=.7,
                CFrame=CFrame.new(ground.X+math.cos(a)*(R-.15),surfaceY+.02,ground.Z+math.sin(a)*(R-.15))*CFrame.Angles(0,-a,0),Parent=model})
        end
        -- light patches drifting over the water
        local caustics={}
        for i=1,4 do
            caustics[i]=part({Name="Caustic",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.015,1.6+math.random()*1.4,1.2+math.random()),
                Color=Color3.fromRGB(200,245,255),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,Transparency=.88,
                CFrame=CFrame.new(ground.X,surfaceY+.015,ground.Z)*flat,Parent=model})
        end
        -- dark bed under the water
        part({Name="Bed",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.08,R*2-.5,R*2-.5),Color=Color3.fromRGB(26,48,46),Material=Enum.Material.Mud,
            CFrame=base*CFrame.new(0,.04,0)*flat,Parent=model})
        -- sand + stone bank all round
        part({Name="Sand",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.06,R*2+3,R*2+3),Color=Color3.fromRGB(190,165,115),Material=Enum.Material.Sand,
            CFrame=base*CFrame.new(0,.02,0)*flat,Parent=model})
        local count=22
        for i=1,count do
            local a=(i/count)*math.pi*2+math.random()*.15
            local s=.7+math.random()*.8
            part({Name="Stone",Size=Vector3.new(s*1.3,s*.75,s),Color=Color3.fromRGB(105+math.random(-18,18),108+math.random(-18,18),112+math.random(-18,18)),
                Material=Enum.Material.Slate,CFrame=base*CFrame.new(math.cos(a)*(R+.5),s*.3,math.sin(a)*(R+.5))*CFrame.Angles(math.random()*.3,-a+math.random(),math.random()*.3),
                Parent=model})
            if math.random()<.35 then
                part({Name="Moss",Size=Vector3.new(s*.9,.12,s*.7),Color=Color3.fromRGB(80,130,60),Material=Enum.Material.Grass,
                    CFrame=base*CFrame.new(math.cos(a)*(R+.5),s*.68,math.sin(a)*(R+.5))*CFrame.Angles(0,-a,0),Parent=model})
            end
        end
        -- reeds, cattails, lily pads with a flower, a little wooden dock post
        for i=1,9 do
            local a=math.rad(150+i*11+math.random(-5,5))
            local h=2+math.random()*2
            local reed=part({Name="Reed",Size=Vector3.new(.09,h,.09),Color=Color3.fromRGB(70+math.random(-10,10),125,50),Material=Enum.Material.Grass,
                CFrame=base*CFrame.new(math.cos(a)*(R+.9),h/2,math.sin(a)*(R+.9))*CFrame.Angles(math.random()*.24-.12,0,math.random()*.24-.12),Parent=model})
            if i%2==0 then
                part({Name="Cattail",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.55,.2,.2),Color=Color3.fromRGB(105,70,40),Material=Enum.Material.Fabric,
                    CFrame=reed.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,h/2-.25,0)*flat,Parent=model})
            end
        end
        for i=1,4 do
            local a=math.random()*math.pi*2
            local d=1.8+math.random()*(R-2.6)
            local size=1+math.random()*.5
            part({Name="LilyPad",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.05,size,size),Color=Color3.fromRGB(70,150,60),
                Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,CFrame=CFrame.new(ground.X+math.cos(a)*d,surfaceY+.03,ground.Z+math.sin(a)*d)*flat,Parent=model})
            if i<=2 then
                part({Name="Flower",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.32,.3,.32),Color=i==1 and Color3.fromRGB(255,170,210) or Color3.fromRGB(255,245,250),
                    Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,CFrame=CFrame.new(ground.X+math.cos(a)*d,surfaceY+.17,ground.Z+math.sin(a)*d),Parent=model})
            end
        end
        local postAngle=math.atan2(-look.Z,-look.X)
        part({Name="Post",Size=Vector3.new(.35,2.4,.35),Color=Color3.fromRGB(110,78,48),Material=Enum.Material.Wood,
            CFrame=base*CFrame.new(math.cos(postAngle+.5)*(R+.3),1.1,math.sin(postAngle+.5)*(R+.3)),Parent=model})
        -- fireflies + glints on the water
        FX.pondLife(model,Vector3.new(ground.X,0,ground.Z),R,surfaceY)
        model.Parent=workspace
        for _,p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency<1 then
                local target,size=p.Transparency,p.Size
                p.Transparency=1
                p.Size=size*.5
                TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(.5+math.random()*.25,Enum.EasingStyle.Back),{Transparency=target,Size=size}):Play()
            end
        end
        pond={Model=model,Center=Vector3.new(ground.X,surfaceY,ground.Z),Radius=R,Saved=saved,Region=region}
        task.spawn(function()
            local mine=pond
            local seeds={}
            for i=1,#caustics do seeds[i]=math.random()*10 end
            while alive and pond==mine do
                local t=os.clock()
                for i,c in ipairs(caustics)do
                    if c.Parent then
                        local r=(R-1.6)*(.4+.6*math.abs(math.sin(t*.13+seeds[i])))
                        local a=t*.18*(i%2==0 and 1 or -1)+seeds[i]
                        c.CFrame=CFrame.new(ground.X+math.cos(a)*r,surfaceY+.015,ground.Z+math.sin(a)*r)*CFrame.Angles(0,a,0)*flat
                    end
                end
                task.wait(1/30)
            end
        end)
        play("splash",.4,.8)
        task.delay(.35,function()if pond then ripple(pond.Center,R*1.6,1.2);splash(pond.Center,14,nil,.7)end end)
        -- calm ripples and jumping little fish now and then
        task.spawn(function()
            local mine=pond
            while alive and pond==mine do
                task.wait(1.4+math.random()*2.2)
                if pond~=mine then break end
                local a,d=math.random()*math.pi*2,math.random()*(R-1.5)
                local at=mine.Center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*d,0,math.sin(a)*d)
                ripple(at,1.6+math.random()*1.2,.7)
                if math.random()<.18 then splash(at,8,nil,.5);play("tick",.12,.5)end
            end
        end)
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ character poses (only you see them: joint offsets on your own client)
    local pose={Active=false}
    local POSES={
        -- angles in degrees in the parent's own space.
        -- arms: X+ swings the arm forward/up, Y- turns a forward arm toward the middle (left arm), Z- lifts the left arm out
        -- elbow: X+ bends the forearm up. waist: X+ leans back, X- leans forward, Y- twists to the right
        Idle={RS={0,0,0},LS={0,0,0},LE={0,0,0},W={0,0,0}},
        Windup={RS={50,-6,6},LS={20,0,-8},LE={20,0,0},W={5,-16,0}},
        Whip={RS={-22,6,0},LS={-6,0,0},LE={0,0,0},W={-6,10,0}},
        Wait={RS={5,0,0},LS={38,-18,0},LE={42,0,0},W={0,4,0}},
        Hook={RS={38,0,0},LS={40,-15,0},LE={30,0,0},W={7,-5,0}},
        Fight={RS={24,0,0},LS={44,-16,0},LE={36,0,0},W={6,0,0}},
        Catch={RS={22,0,12},LS={105,0,-12},LE={12,0,0},W={4,0,0}},
    }
    local anglesOf; anglesOf = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(list)return CFrame.Angles(math.rad(list[1]),math.rad(list[2]),math.rad(list[3]))end)
    local function joints(char)
        local list={}
        local function add(key,motor)if motor and motor:IsA("Motor6D") then list[key]={Motor=motor,Base=motor.C0}end end
        if char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") then
            add("RS",char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm") and char.RightUpperArm:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder"))
            add("LS",char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm") and char.LeftUpperArm:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder"))
            add("LE",char:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerArm") and char.LeftLowerArm:FindFirstChild("LeftElbow"))
            add("W",char.UpperTorso:FindFirstChild("Waist"))
        else
            local torso=char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            if torso then
                add("RS",torso:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder"))
                add("LS",torso:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder"))
            end
            local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            add("W",root and root:FindFirstChild("RootJoint"))
        end
        return list
    end
    local current={RS=CFrame.new(),LS=CFrame.new(),LE=CFrame.new(),W=CFrame.new()}
    local target={RS=CFrame.new(),LS=CFrame.new(),LE=CFrame.new(),W=CFrame.new()}
    local poseSpeed=10
    local extra={RS=CFrame.new(),LS=CFrame.new(),LE=CFrame.new(),W=CFrame.new()}
    local setPose; setPose = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(name,speed)
        local p=POSES[name] or POSES.Idle
        for key,list in pairs(p)do target[key]=anglesOf(list)end
        poseSpeed=speed or 10
    end)
    local function startPose()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        pose.Joints=joints(char)
        pose.Active=true
        for key in pairs(current)do current[key]=CFrame.new();extra[key]=CFrame.new()end
        setPose("Idle")
    end
    local function stopPose()
        if pose.Joints then
            for _,j in pairs(pose.Joints)do pcall(function()j.Motor.C0=j.Base end)end
        end
        pose.Active=false
        pose.Joints=nil
    end
    connect(RunService.RenderStepped,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        if not pose.Active or not pose.Joints then return end
        local k=1-math.exp(-poseSpeed*dt)
        for key,j in pairs(pose.Joints)do
            current[key]=current[key]:Lerp(target[key],k)
            local base=j.Base
            -- rotate around the joint in the parent's space, keeping the joint's own orientation
            local ok=pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()j.Motor.C0=CFrame.new(base.Position)*current[key]*extra[key]*base.Rotation end))
            if not ok then pose.Active=false end
        end
    end))

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ rod skins (animated)
    local SKINS={"Classic","Neon Pulse","Galaxy","Inferno","Frost","Golden"}
    local SKIN={
        Classic={Shaft=Color3.fromRGB(28,30,36),ShaftMat=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,Grip=Color3.fromRGB(196,154,104),Reel=Color3.fromRGB(205,205,215),
            Spool=Color3.fromRGB(220,60,60),Tip=Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80),Line=Color3.fromRGB(235,235,240)},
        ["Neon Pulse"]={Shaft=Color3.fromRGB(20,20,26),ShaftMat=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,Grip=Color3.fromRGB(30,30,36),Reel=Color3.fromRGB(40,40,48),
            Spool=Color3.fromRGB(0,255,200),Tip=Color3.fromRGB(0,255,200),Line=Color3.fromRGB(120,255,230),Rainbow=true,Stripes=true},
        Galaxy={Shaft=Color3.fromRGB(45,20,80),ShaftMat=Enum.Material.Glass,Grip=Color3.fromRGB(25,15,45),Reel=Color3.fromRGB(70,40,120),
            Spool=Color3.fromRGB(190,120,255),Tip=Color3.fromRGB(220,170,255),Line=Color3.fromRGB(210,180,255),Stars=true,Stripes=true},
        Inferno={Shaft=Color3.fromRGB(45,15,10),ShaftMat=Enum.Material.Basalt,Grip=Color3.fromRGB(30,20,18),Reel=Color3.fromRGB(70,30,20),
            Spool=Color3.fromRGB(255,120,30),Tip=Color3.fromRGB(255,150,40),Line=Color3.fromRGB(255,170,90),Fire=true,Stripes=true},
        Frost={Shaft=Color3.fromRGB(170,220,245),ShaftMat=Enum.Material.Ice,Grip=Color3.fromRGB(230,240,250),Reel=Color3.fromRGB(240,248,255),
            Spool=Color3.fromRGB(120,200,255),Tip=Color3.fromRGB(180,235,255),Line=Color3.fromRGB(220,245,255),Snow=true},
        Golden={Shaft=Color3.fromRGB(230,180,60),ShaftMat=Enum.Material.Metal,Grip=Color3.fromRGB(60,30,20),Reel=Color3.fromRGB(255,215,100),
            Spool=Color3.fromRGB(255,240,180),Tip=Color3.fromRGB(255,230,140),Line=Color3.fromRGB(255,235,170),Shine=true},
    }

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ the rod: tapered bending shaft, spinning reel, guides, glowing tip
    local SEGMENTS,ROD_LEN=8,6.4
    local rod
    local tool
    local rodState={Tilt=35,Bend=0,Spin=0,SpinSpeed=0,Shake=0}
    local function handOf(char)
        local hand=char:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
        if hand then return hand,Vector3.new(0,-.2,0)end
        local arm=char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
        if arm then return arm,Vector3.new(0,-.9,0)end
    end
    local function removeRod()
        if rod then rod.Model:Destroy();rod=nil end
    end
    local buildBuiltinRod
    local function buildRod()
        removeRod()
        local id=idOf(ROD_MODELS,settings.Model)
        local asset=id and loadAsset(id)
        if not asset then return buildBuiltinRod()end
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then asset:Destroy();return end
        local hand,origin=handOf(char)
        if not hand then asset:Destroy();return end
        local skin=SKIN[settings.Skin] or SKIN.Classic
        local model=Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name="CrackHubFishingRod"
        local handlePart=asset:IsA("Tool") and asset:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        for _,child in ipairs(asset:GetChildren())do child.Parent=model end
        pcall(function()asset:Destroy()end)
        local parts={}
        for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                d.Anchored,d.CanCollide,d.CanQuery,d.CanTouch,d.Massless,d.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,true,false
                table.insert(parts,d)
            elseif d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("WeldConstraint") or d:IsA("Constraint") then
                pcall(function()d:Destroy()end)
            end
        end
        bakeMeshOffsets(model)
        -- drop invisible helper boxes (they wreck the size and direction)
        for i=#parts,1,-1 do
            if parts[i].Transparency>=.9 then pcall(function()parts[i]:Destroy()end);table.remove(parts,i)end
        end
        if #parts==0 then model:Destroy();return buildBuiltinRod()end
        model.Parent=workspace
        -- the rod's direction comes from its longest piece (the shaft), not from the whole model's box
        local function shaftOf()
            local best,bestLen=nil,0
            for _,p in ipairs(parts)do
                local l=math.max(p.Size.X,p.Size.Y,p.Size.Z)
                if l>bestLen then best,bestLen=p,l end
            end
            return best,bestLen
        end
        local shaft,shaftLen=shaftOf()
        if shaftLen>0 then pcall(function()model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale()*6.5/shaftLen)end)end
        shaft,shaftLen=shaftOf()
        local sz=shaft.Size
        local axis
        if sz.X>=sz.Y and sz.X>=sz.Z then axis=shaft.CFrame.RightVector
        elseif sz.Y>=sz.Z then axis=shaft.CFrame.UpVector
        else axis=shaft.CFrame.LookVector end
        local len=shaftLen
        local cf=shaft.CFrame
        local endA,endB=cf.Position+axis*len/2,cf.Position-axis*len/2
        local heavy
        if handlePart and handlePart.Parent and handlePart~=shaft then heavy=handlePart.Position
        else
            -- the handle end is where the other pieces (reel, grip) sit; for a single mesh: the thicker end is unknown, keep the lower end
            local sum,total=Vector3.zero,0
            for _,p in ipairs(parts)do
                if p~=shaft then local v=p.Size.X*p.Size.Y*p.Size.Z;sum+=p.Position*v;total+=v end
            end
            heavy=total>0 and sum/total or (endA.Y<endB.Y and endA or endB)
        end
        local handleEnd,tipEnd=endA,endB
        if (heavy-endB).Magnitude<(heavy-endA).Magnitude then handleEnd,tipEnd=endB,endA end
        local dir=(tipEnd-handleEnd).Unit
        -- base = grip point, -Z toward the tip; everything welded to it
        local base=part({Name="Base",Size=Vector3.new(.1,.1,.1),Transparency=1,Anchored=true,Massless=true,
            CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(handleEnd+dir*math.min(1.1,len*.15),tipEnd),Parent=model})
        for _,p in ipairs(parts)do
            local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");w.Part0,w.Part1=base,p;w.Parent=p
        end
        local tip=part({Name="Tip",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.14,.14,.14),Color=skin.Tip,Material=Enum.Material.Neon,
            CFrame=CFrame.new(tipEnd),Parent=model})
        local wt=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");wt.Part0,wt.Part1=base,tip;wt.Parent=tip
        local tipAttachment=Instance.new("Attachment");tipAttachment.Parent=tip
        local tipLight=Instance.new("PointLight");tipLight.Color=skin.Tip;tipLight.Range=5;tipLight.Brightness=1.2;tipLight.Parent=tip
        -- invisible anchors along the rod for aura effects
        local segments={}
        for i=1,SEGMENTS do
            local at=handleEnd+dir*len*(i/(SEGMENTS+1))
            local seg=part({Name="Anchor"..i,Size=Vector3.new(.05,.05,.05),Transparency=1,CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(at,at+dir)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(90),0),Parent=model})
            local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");w.Part0,w.Part1=base,seg;w.Parent=seg
            segments[i]=seg
        end
        local a0=Instance.new("Attachment");a0.Position=Vector3.new(0,.06,0);a0.Parent=tip
        local a1=Instance.new("Attachment");a1.Position=Vector3.new(0,-.06,0);a1.Parent=tip
        local trail=Instance.new("Trail")
        trail.Attachment0,trail.Attachment1=a0,a1
        trail.Color=ColorSequence.new(skin.Tip)
        trail.LightEmission=1
        trail.Lifetime=.25
        trail.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.2),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
        trail.WidthScale=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)})
        trail.Enabled=false
        trail.Parent=tip
        -- unanchor and hang it on the hand
        for _,p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Anchored=false end end
        local handWeld=Instance.new("Weld")
        handWeld.Part0,handWeld.Part1=hand,base
        handWeld.Parent=base
        -- skin effects + aura (same as the built-in rod)
        if skin.Fire then
            emitter(tip,{Texture=FIRE,Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,200,80),Color3.fromRGB(255,60,20)),LightEmission=.9,
                Size=seq(.35,0),Transparency=seq(.2,1),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.25,.45),Speed=NumberRange.new(1,2),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(25,25),Rate=40,
                EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Top})
        end
        if skin.Stars then
            for i=2,SEGMENTS,2 do
                emitter(segments[i],{Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),Color3.fromRGB(200,150,255)),Size=NumberSequence.new({
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.5,.14),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)}),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.6,1.1),
                    Speed=NumberRange.new(.1,.5),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180),Rate=4})
            end
        end
        if skin.Snow then
            for i=2,SEGMENTS,3 do
                emitter(segments[i],{Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(235,250,255)),LightEmission=.4,Size=seq(.1,0),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.8,1.4),
                    Speed=NumberRange.new(.2,.6),Acceleration=Vector3.new(0,-2,0),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180),Rate=5})
            end
        end
        local aura=Instance.new("Highlight")
        aura.Adornee=model
        aura.FillColor,aura.OutlineColor=skin.Tip,skin.Tip
        aura.FillTransparency,aura.OutlineTransparency=1,.45
        aura.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
        aura.Enabled=settings.Aura
        aura.Parent=model
        if not applyStoreAura(segments,tip) then
            for i=2,SEGMENTS,2 do
                emitter(segments[i],{Color=ColorSequence.new(skin.Tip,skin.Spool),Size=seq(.14,0),Transparency=seq(.2,1),
                    Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.5,.9),Speed=NumberRange.new(.2,.7),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180),Rate=7,Enabled=settings.Aura})
            end
        end
        local auraLight=Instance.new("PointLight");auraLight.Color=skin.Tip;auraLight.Range=7;auraLight.Brightness=.9;auraLight.Enabled=settings.Aura
        auraLight.Parent=segments[math.floor(SEGMENTS/2)]
        local orbiters={}
        for i=1,3 do
            orbiters[i]=part({Name="Orbiter",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.09,.09,.09),Color=skin.Tip,Material=Enum.Material.Neon,
                Transparency=settings.Aura and 0 or 1,Parent=model})
            local o0=Instance.new("Attachment");o0.Position=Vector3.new(0,.04,0);o0.Parent=orbiters[i]
            local o1=Instance.new("Attachment");o1.Position=Vector3.new(0,-.04,0);o1.Parent=orbiters[i]
            local tr=Instance.new("Trail");tr.Attachment0,tr.Attachment1=o0,o1;tr.Color=ColorSequence.new(skin.Tip);tr.LightEmission=1
            tr.Lifetime=.18;tr.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(.3,1);tr.Enabled=settings.Aura;tr.Parent=orbiters[i]
        end
        model.Parent=(tool and tool.Parent==char) and tool or char
        rod={Model=model,Aura=aura,AuraLight=auraLight,Orbiters=orbiters,Parts={},Tip=tip,TipAttachment=tipAttachment,Base=base,HandWeld=handWeld,
            Origin=origin,Links={},Segments=segments,Bands={},Trail=trail,TipLight=tipLight,Skin=skin}
        for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Name~="Orbiter" then table.insert(rod.Parts,d)end
        end
        play("equip",.5,1)
        return rod
    end
    buildBuiltinRod=function()
        removeRod()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hand,origin=handOf(char)
        if not hand then return end
        local skin=SKIN[settings.Skin] or SKIN.Classic
        local model=Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name="CrackHubFishingRod"
        local function loose(props)
            local p=part(props)
            p.Anchored=false
            p.Massless=true
            p.Parent=model
            return p
        end
        local function weld(a,b,c0)
            local w=Instance.new("Weld")
            w.Part0,w.Part1,w.C0=a,b,c0 or CFrame.new()
            w.Parent=b
            return w
        end
        -- base sits in the hand; its -Z points along the rod
        local base=loose({Name="Base",Size=Vector3.new(.1,.1,.1),Transparency=1})
        local handWeld=weld(hand,base)
        -- handle: butt cap, cork grip with rings, reel seat
        local Z90=CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(90),0)
        local butt=loose({Name="Butt",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.3,.3,.3),Color=skin.Reel,Material=Enum.Material.Metal})
        weld(base,butt,CFrame.new(0,0,.62))
        local grip=loose({Name="Grip",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(1.15,.25,.25),Color=skin.Grip,Material=Enum.Material.Fabric})
        weld(base,grip,CFrame.new(0,0,.02)*Z90)
        for i=0,2 do
            local ring=loose({Name="GripRing",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.05,.27,.27),Color=skin.Spool,Material=Enum.Material.Metal})
            weld(base,ring,CFrame.new(0,0,.5-i*.48)*Z90)
        end
        local seat=loose({Name="Seat",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.45,.2,.2),Color=skin.Reel,Material=Enum.Material.Metal,Reflectance=.15})
        weld(base,seat,CFrame.new(0,0,-.75)*Z90)
        -- reel: body + coloured spool + handle that really spins
        local reelBody=loose({Name="Reel",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.24,.56,.56),Color=skin.Reel,Material=Enum.Material.Metal,Reflectance=.2})
        weld(base,reelBody,CFrame.new(0,-.38,-.6))
        local spool=loose({Name="Spool",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.26,.36,.36),Color=skin.Spool,
            Material=skin.Rainbow and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic})
        weld(base,spool,CFrame.new(0,-.38,-.6))
        local stem=loose({Name="ReelStem",Size=Vector3.new(.08,.3,.08),Color=skin.Reel,Material=Enum.Material.Metal})
        weld(base,stem,CFrame.new(0,-.18,-.6))
        local crank=loose({Name="Crank",Size=Vector3.new(.06,.05,.34),Color=Color3.fromRGB(35,35,40),Material=Enum.Material.Metal})
        local crankWeld=weld(reelBody,crank,CFrame.new(.17,0,0))
        local knob=loose({Name="Knob",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.16,.12,.12),Color=skin.Spool,Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic})
        weld(crank,knob,CFrame.new(.08,0,.15))
        local spoolAttachment=Instance.new("Attachment");spoolAttachment.Position=Vector3.new(0,.15,0);spoolAttachment.Parent=spool
        -- shaft: tapered segments chained with welds; bending = turning every link a little
        local links,segments={},{}
        local prev,prevLen=base,0
        local segLen=ROD_LEN/SEGMENTS
        for i=1,SEGMENTS do
            local thick=.12-(.075*(i-1)/(SEGMENTS-1))
            local seg=loose({Name="Shaft"..i,Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(segLen+.02,thick,thick),Color=skin.Shaft,Material=skin.ShaftMat,
                Reflectance=skin.Shine and .25 or 0,Transparency=skin.ShaftMat==Enum.Material.Glass and .15 or 0})
            local c0
            if i==1 then c0=CFrame.new(0,0,-.95)*Z90*CFrame.new(segLen/2,0,0)
            else c0=CFrame.new(prevLen/2,0,0)*CFrame.new(segLen/2,0,0)end
            local link=weld(prev,seg,c0)
            table.insert(links,{Weld=link,Base=c0,Half=(i==1) and 0 or prevLen/2})
            table.insert(segments,seg)
            -- line guide ring at the start of every other segment
            if i%2==0 or i==SEGMENTS then
                local guide=loose({Name="Guide",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.03,thick+.12,thick+.12),Color=skin.Reel,Material=Enum.Material.Metal})
                weld(seg,guide,CFrame.new(-segLen/2+.05,-.03,0))
            end
            if skin.Stripes and i%2==1 then
                local band=loose({Name="Band",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.08,thick+.015,thick+.015),Color=skin.Spool,Material=Enum.Material.Neon})
                weld(seg,band,CFrame.new(0,0,0))
            end
            prev,prevLen=seg,segLen
        end
        local tipSeg=segments[#segments]
        local tip=loose({Name="Tip",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.13,.13,.13),Color=skin.Tip,Material=Enum.Material.Neon})
        weld(tipSeg,tip,CFrame.new(segLen/2,0,0))
        local tipAttachment=Instance.new("Attachment");tipAttachment.Parent=tip
        local tipLight=Instance.new("PointLight");tipLight.Color=skin.Tip;tipLight.Range=5;tipLight.Brightness=1.2;tipLight.Parent=tip
        -- line running along the rod (reel -> tip)
        local rodLine=Instance.new("Beam")
        rodLine.Attachment0,rodLine.Attachment1=spoolAttachment,tipAttachment
        rodLine.Width0,rodLine.Width1=.025,.02
        rodLine.Color=ColorSequence.new(skin.Line)
        rodLine.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(.25)
        rodLine.FaceCamera=true
        rodLine.Segments=10
        rodLine.Parent=tip
        -- trail from the tip (shows on the cast whip)
        local a0=Instance.new("Attachment");a0.Position=Vector3.new(0,.06,0);a0.Parent=tip
        local a1=Instance.new("Attachment");a1.Position=Vector3.new(0,-.06,0);a1.Parent=tip
        local trail=Instance.new("Trail")
        trail.Attachment0,trail.Attachment1=a0,a1
        trail.Color=ColorSequence.new(skin.Tip)
        trail.LightEmission=1
        trail.Lifetime=.25
        trail.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.2),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
        trail.WidthScale=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)})
        trail.Enabled=false
        trail.Parent=tip
        -- skin effects
        local fx={}
        if skin.Stars then
            for i=2,SEGMENTS,2 do
                table.insert(fx,emitter(segments[i],{Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),Color3.fromRGB(200,150,255)),
                    Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.5,.14),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)}),
                    Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.6,1.1),Speed=NumberRange.new(.1,.5),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180),Rate=4}))
            end
        end
        if skin.Fire then
            table.insert(fx,emitter(tip,{Texture=FIRE,Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,200,80),Color3.fromRGB(255,60,20)),LightEmission=.9,
                Size=seq(.35,0),Transparency=seq(.2,1),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.25,.45),Speed=NumberRange.new(1,2),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(25,25),Rate=40,
                EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Top}))
            for i=3,SEGMENTS,3 do
                table.insert(fx,emitter(segments[i],{Texture=FIRE,Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,170,60),Color3.fromRGB(200,40,10)),LightEmission=.8,
                    Size=seq(.18,0),Transparency=seq(.35,1),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.2,.35),Speed=NumberRange.new(.5,1.2),Rate=12,EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Top}))
            end
        end
        if skin.Snow then
            for i=2,SEGMENTS,3 do
                table.insert(fx,emitter(segments[i],{Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(235,250,255)),LightEmission=.4,Size=seq(.1,0),
                    Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.8,1.4),Speed=NumberRange.new(.2,.6),Acceleration=Vector3.new(0,-2,0),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180),Rate=5}))
            end
        end
        if skin.Shine then
            table.insert(fx,emitter(tipSeg,{Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,240,180)),Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.5,.2),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)}),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.4,.7),Speed=NumberRange.new(0,.3),Rate=6}))
        end
        -- aura: a glowing outline, light wisps along the shaft, sparks orbiting the rod and a soft light
        local aura=Instance.new("Highlight")
        aura.Adornee=model
        aura.FillColor,aura.OutlineColor=skin.Tip,skin.Tip
        aura.FillTransparency,aura.OutlineTransparency=1,.45
        aura.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
        aura.Enabled=settings.Aura
        aura.Parent=model
        local auraFx={}
        for i=2,(applyStoreAura(segments,tip) and 0 or SEGMENTS),2 do
            table.insert(auraFx,emitter(segments[i],{Color=ColorSequence.new(skin.Tip,skin.Spool),Size=seq(.14,0),Transparency=seq(.2,1),
                Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.5,.9),Speed=NumberRange.new(.2,.7),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180),Rate=7,Enabled=settings.Aura}))
        end
        local auraLight=Instance.new("PointLight");auraLight.Color=skin.Tip;auraLight.Range=7;auraLight.Brightness=.9;auraLight.Enabled=settings.Aura
        auraLight.Parent=segments[math.floor(SEGMENTS/2)]
        local orbiters={}
        for i=1,3 do
            orbiters[i]=part({Name="Orbiter",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.09,.09,.09),Color=skin.Tip,Material=Enum.Material.Neon,
                Transparency=settings.Aura and 0 or 1,Parent=model})
            local a0=Instance.new("Attachment");a0.Position=Vector3.new(0,.04,0);a0.Parent=orbiters[i]
            local a1=Instance.new("Attachment");a1.Position=Vector3.new(0,-.04,0);a1.Parent=orbiters[i]
            local tr=Instance.new("Trail");tr.Attachment0,tr.Attachment1=a0,a1;tr.Color=ColorSequence.new(skin.Tip);tr.LightEmission=1
            tr.Lifetime=.18;tr.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(.3,1);tr.Enabled=settings.Aura;tr.Parent=orbiters[i]
        end
        model.Parent=(tool and tool.Parent==char) and tool or char
        rod={Model=model,Aura=aura,AuraFx=auraFx,AuraLight=auraLight,Orbiters=orbiters,Parts={},Tip=tip,TipAttachment=tipAttachment,Base=base,HandWeld=handWeld,Origin=origin,Links=links,Segments=segments,
            CrankWeld=crankWeld,Spool=spool,Bands={},Trail=trail,TipLight=tipLight,RodLine=rodLine,Skin=skin}
        for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
            if d.Name=="Band" then table.insert(rod.Bands,d)end
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(rod.Parts,d)end
        end
        -- pop in: every piece fades in from the hand outwards
        for index,p in ipairs(model:GetChildren())do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") and p~=base then
                local t=p.Transparency
                p.Transparency=1
                task.delay(index*.012,function()if p.Parent then TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(.25),{Transparency=t}):Play()end end)
            end
        end
        play("equip",.5,1)
        return rod
    end
    -- every frame: aim the rod, bend it, spin the reel, animate the skin
    local hue=0
    connect(RunService.RenderStepped,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        if not rod or not rod.Base.Parent then return end
        local s=rodState
        local shake=s.Shake>0 and (math.noise(os.clock()*18,1)*s.Shake) or 0
        local a=math.rad(s.Tilt+shake*8)
        local dir=Vector3.new(math.noise(os.clock()*14,2)*s.Shake*.15,-math.cos(a),-math.sin(a)).Unit
        rod.HandWeld.C0=CFrame.lookAt(rod.Origin,rod.Origin+dir)
        -- bend grows toward the tip
        local n=#rod.Links
        for i,link in ipairs(rod.Links)do
            if i>1 then
                local k=(i-1)/(n-1)
                local bend=-math.rad(s.Bend)*(.35+k*1.3)/n*2
                link.Weld.C0=CFrame.new(link.Half,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,bend)*CFrame.new(link.Half,0,0)
            end
        end
        -- keep the rod visible in first person
        for _,p in ipairs(rod.Parts)do if p.LocalTransparencyModifier~=0 then p.LocalTransparencyModifier=0 end end
        if settings.Aura then
            local t=os.clock()
            local segs=rod.Segments
            for i,o in ipairs(rod.Orbiters)do
                local seg=segs[math.clamp(math.floor(#segs*(.35+.2*i)),1,#segs)]
                o.CFrame=seg.CFrame*CFrame.new(math.sin(t*1.3+i)*.3,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(t*5+i*2.1,0,0)*CFrame.new(0,.24+.05*math.sin(t*3+i),0)
            end
            rod.Aura.FillTransparency=1
            rod.Aura.OutlineTransparency=.4+.25*(math.sin(t*3)+1)*.5
        end
        s.Spin+=s.SpinSpeed*dt
        if rod.CrankWeld then rod.CrankWeld.C0=CFrame.Angles(s.Spin,0,0)*CFrame.new(.17,0,0)end
        if rod.Skin.Rainbow then
            hue=(hue+dt*.25)%1
            local c=Color3.fromHSV(hue,.85,1)
            if rod.Spool then rod.Spool.Color=c end
            rod.Tip.Color=c
            rod.TipLight.Color=c
            rod.Trail.Color=ColorSequence.new(c)
            for i,band in ipairs(rod.Bands)do band.Color=Color3.fromHSV((hue+i*.08)%1,.85,1)end
        elseif #rod.Bands>0 then
            local pulse=(math.sin(os.clock()*3)+1)*.5
            for i,band in ipairs(rod.Bands)do band.Transparency=.1+.5*((math.sin(os.clock()*3-i*.8)+1)*.5)end
            rod.TipLight.Brightness=.8+pulse
        end
    end))
    local tween; tween = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(field,value,time,style)
        local holder=rodState
        local start,t0=holder[field],os.clock()
        local mine={}
        holder["_"..field]=mine
        task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            while holder["_"..field]==mine do
                local a=math.clamp((os.clock()-t0)/time,0,1)
                local e=(style=="back") and (1+2.70158*(a-1)^3+1.70158*(a-1)^2) or (style=="in" and a*a or ease(a))
                holder[field]=start+(value-start)*e
                if a>=1 then break end
                task.wait()
            end
        end))
    end)

    screen.Name="CrackHubFishingUI"
    screen.ResetOnSpawn=false
    screen.IgnoreGuiInset=true
    screen.DisplayOrder=50
    screen.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    screen.Parent=window.Gui.Parent

    -- reel fight panel
    local PANEL_W=400
    local panel=Create("CanvasGroup",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,1),Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-110),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(PANEL_W,118),
        BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(14,16,22),BackgroundTransparency=.06,GroupTransparency=1,Visible=false,Parent=screen},{Corner(16)})
    local panelStroke=Stroke(Color3.new(1,1,1),1.5,.7);panelStroke.Parent=panel
    local panelTitle=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,12),Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,20),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",
        FontFace=UI_H,TextSize=17,TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Parent=panel})
    local panelHint=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,12),Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,20),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="hold click / space",
        FontFace=UI_R,TextSize=12,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(150,156,172),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,Parent=panel})
    local TRACK_W=PANEL_W-36
    local track=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,42),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(TRACK_W,36),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),
        BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true,Parent=panel},{Corner(10),Create("UIGradient",{Rotation=90,Color=ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.fromRGB(70,160,220)),ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(18,55,105))})})})
    -- bubbles drifting in the track
    local bubbles={}
    for i=1,9 do
