        bubbles[i]={Frame=b,X=math.random()*TRACK_W,Y=math.random()*36,Speed=8+math.random()*14,Size=2+math.random()*4}
    end
    local zone=Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(90,36),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(120,235,150),BackgroundTransparency=.35,BorderSizePixel=0,Parent=track},
        {Corner(9)})
    local zoneStroke=Stroke(Color3.fromRGB(200,255,210),2,.15);zoneStroke.Parent=zone
    -- fish icon drawn from frames (body + tail + eye)
    local fishIcon=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.new(0,0,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(34,20),BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=3,Parent=track})
    local fishBody=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(.42,.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(24,15),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),
        BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=4,Parent=fishIcon},{Corner(999)})
    local fishTail=Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(.9,.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(10,10),Rotation=45,
        BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=3,Parent=fishIcon},{Corner(2)})
    Create("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(.24,.4),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(4,4),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0),
        BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=5,Parent=fishIcon},{Corner(999)})
    local fishScale=Create("UIScale",{Parent=fishIcon})
    local progressBack=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,88),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(TRACK_W-54,10),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,44,54),
        BorderSizePixel=0,Parent=panel},{Corner(5)})
    local progress=Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(.3,1),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),BorderSizePixel=0,Parent=progressBack},{Corner(5)})
    local progressGrad=Create("UIGradient",{Parent=progress})
    local percent=Create("TextLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.new(1,-18,0,82),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(48,20),BackgroundTransparency=1,
        Text="30%",FontFace=UI_H,TextSize=15,TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,Parent=panel})
    local panelScale=Create("UIScale",{Parent=panel})

    -- catch card
    local card=Create("CanvasGroup",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,0),Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,90),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(360,100),
        BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(14,16,22),GroupTransparency=1,Visible=false,Parent=screen},{Corner(18)})
    local cardStroke=Stroke(Color3.new(1,1,1),2,.15);cardStroke.Parent=card
    local cardGlow=Create("UIGradient",{Rotation=90,Parent=card})
    local cardShine=Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(0,60,1,0),Position=UDim2.new(-.3,0,0,0),Rotation=15,BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),
        BackgroundTransparency=.85,BorderSizePixel=0,Parent=card})
    local cardRarity=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,14),Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,16),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",FontFace=UI_H,
        TextSize=13,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Parent=card})
    local cardNew=Create("TextLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,12),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(56,20),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80),
        Text="NEW!",FontFace=UI_H,TextSize=12,TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),Visible=false,Parent=card},{Corner(999)})
    local cardName=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,32),Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,32),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",FontFace=UI_H,
        TextSize=28,TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Parent=card})
    local cardInfo=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(20,68),Size=UDim2.new(1,-40,0,16),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",FontFace=UI_R,
        TextSize=13,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(190,195,210),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,RichText=true,Parent=card})
    local flash=Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=0,Parent=screen})

    local cardToken=0
    local showCard; showCard = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(species,rarity,kg,isNew,isBest,perfect)
        cardToken+=1
        local mine=cardToken
        cardRarity.Text=string.upper(rarity.Name)..(isBest and "  ·  NEW RECORD" or "")
        cardRarity.TextColor3=rarity.Color
        cardName.Text=species.Name
        cardInfo.Text=string.format("%.2f kg  ·  caught #%d",kg,(log.Species[species.Name] or 1))..(perfect and '  ·  <font color="#FFD84A"><b>PERFECT HOOK</b></font>' or "")
        cardNew.Visible=isNew
        cardStroke.Color=rarity.Color
        cardGlow.Color=ColorSequence.new(rarity.Color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(14,16,22),.5),Color3.fromRGB(14,16,22))
        card.Visible=true
        card.GroupTransparency=1
        card.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,55)
        card.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(320,88)
        TweenService:Create(card,TweenInfo.new(.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Back),{GroupTransparency=0,Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,90),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(360,100)}):Play()
        cardShine.Position=UDim2.new(-.3,0,-.2,0)
        TweenService:Create(cardShine,TweenInfo.new(.9,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,.25),{Position=UDim2.new(1.2,0,-.2,0)}):Play()
        if rarity.Index>=4 then
            flash.BackgroundColor3=rarity.Color
            flash.BackgroundTransparency=rarity.Index>=5 and .45 or .7
            TweenService:Create(flash,TweenInfo.new(.9),{BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
        end
        task.delay(3.8,function()
            if cardToken~=mine then return end
            TweenService:Create(card,TweenInfo.new(.35),{GroupTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,70)}):Play()
            task.delay(.36,function()if cardToken==mine then card.Visible=false end end)
        end)
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ camera shake (small, optional)
    local shakeAmount=0
    pcall(function()
        RunService:BindToRenderStep("CrackHubFishingShake",Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+1,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if shakeAmount<=.001 or not settings.Shake then return end
            local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
            local t=os.clock()*30
            cam.CFrame=cam.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(math.noise(t,1)*shakeAmount*.02,math.noise(t,2)*shakeAmount*.02,math.noise(t,3)*shakeAmount*.01)
        end))
    end)
    local kick; kick = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(amount)
        shakeAmount=math.max(shakeAmount,amount)
        task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            while shakeAmount>.001 and alive do
                shakeAmount*=.88
                task.wait()
            end
            shakeAmount=0
        end))
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ fish model
    local buildFish; buildFish = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(species,rarity,scale)
        local model=Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name="CrackHubFish"
        local s=species.Size*scale
        local mat=species.Glass and Enum.Material.Glass or (species.Glow and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        local body=part({Name="Body",Size=Vector3.new(.8*s,(species.Round and .85 or .58)*s,1.6*s),Color=species.Body,Material=mat,
            Transparency=species.Glass and .25 or 0,Parent=model})
        local mesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");mesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere;mesh.Parent=body
        local belly=part({Name="Belly",Size=Vector3.new(.64*s,.34*s,1.3*s),Color=species.Belly,Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,Parent=model})
        local m2=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");m2.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere;m2.Parent=belly
        local tail=part({Name="Tail",Size=Vector3.new(.1*s,.75*s,.6*s),Color=species.Body:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0),.15),Material=mat,Parent=model})
        local fin=part({Name="Fin",Size=Vector3.new(.06*s,.38*s,.55*s),Color=species.Body:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0),.2),Material=mat,Parent=model})
        local finL=part({Name="FinL",Size=Vector3.new(.3*s,.04*s,.25*s),Color=species.Body:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.15),Parent=model})
        local finR=part({Name="FinR",Size=Vector3.new(.3*s,.04*s,.25*s),Color=species.Body:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.15),Parent=model})
        local layout={
            {belly,CFrame.new(0,-.13*s,0)},
            {tail,CFrame.new(0,0,.98*s)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(10),0,0),true},
            {fin,CFrame.new(0,.35*s,.05*s)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-20),0,0)},
            {finL,CFrame.new(-.42*s,-.12*s,-.15*s)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-25)),"L"},
            {finR,CFrame.new(.42*s,-.12*s,-.15*s)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(25)),"R"},
        }
        for _,side in ipairs({-1,1})do
            local eye=part({Name="Eye",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.17*s,.17*s,.17*s),Color=Color3.new(1,1,1),Parent=model})
            local pupil=part({Name="Pupil",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.1*s,.1*s,.1*s),Color=Color3.new(0,0,0),Parent=model})
            table.insert(layout,{eye,CFrame.new(side*.3*s,.09*s,-.5*s)})
            table.insert(layout,{pupil,CFrame.new(side*.37*s,.09*s,-.55*s)})
        end
        if species.Stripes then
            for i=-1,1 do
                local stripe=part({Name="Stripe",Size=Vector3.new(.82*s,.6*s,.08*s),Color=Color3.new(1,1,1),Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,Parent=model})
                local sm=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");sm.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere;sm.Parent=stripe
                stripe.Color=species.Name=="Clownfish" and Color3.new(1,1,1) or species.Body:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0),.35)
                table.insert(layout,{stripe,CFrame.new(0,0,i*.42*s)})
            end
        end
        if species.Whiskers then
            for _,side in ipairs({-1,1})do
                table.insert(layout,{part({Name="Whisker",Size=Vector3.new(.03*s,.03*s,.6*s),Color=Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40),Parent=model}),
                    CFrame.new(side*.22*s,-.05*s,-.95*s)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(15),math.rad(side*25),0)})
            end
        end
        if species.Sword then
            table.insert(layout,{part({Name="Sword",Size=Vector3.new(.07*s,.07*s,1.15*s),Color=Color3.fromRGB(40,50,80),Parent=model}),CFrame.new(0,.02*s,-1.3*s)})
        end
        if species.Lure then
            local lure=part({Name="Lure",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.18*s,.18*s,.18*s),Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,240,140),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,Parent=model})
            local light=Instance.new("PointLight");light.Color=lure.Color;light.Range=6;light.Brightness=2;light.Parent=lure
            table.insert(layout,{lure,CFrame.new(0,.64*s,-.97*s)})
            table.insert(layout,{part({Name="Stalk",Size=Vector3.new(.03*s,.03*s,.6*s),Color=species.Body,Parent=model}),CFrame.new(0,.5*s,-.72*s)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-35),0,0)})
        end
        if species.Glow or rarity.Index>=4 then
            local light=Instance.new("PointLight");light.Color=rarity.Color;light.Range=8+rarity.Index;light.Brightness=1.6;light.Parent=body
            emitter(body,{Color=ColorSequence.new(rarity.Color,Color3.new(1,1,1)),Size=seq(.3,0),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.5,.9),Speed=NumberRange.new(1,3),
                SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180),Rate=10+rarity.Index*8})
        end
        -- water dripping off it
        emitter(body,{Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(190,225,255)),LightEmission=.3,Size=seq(.12,0),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.4,.6),
            Speed=NumberRange.new(0,.5),Acceleration=Vector3.new(0,-25,0),Rate=12})
        local function place(cf,wiggle)
            body.CFrame=cf
            for _,entry in ipairs(layout)do
                local offset=entry[2]
                if entry[3]==true then offset=offset*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(wiggle or 0),0)
                elseif entry[3]=="L" then offset=offset*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad((wiggle or 0)*.5))
                elseif entry[3]=="R" then offset=offset*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-(wiggle or 0)*.5))end
                entry[1].CFrame=cf*offset
            end
        end
        model.Parent=workspace
        return model,place,body
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ fishing state machine
    local state="idle" -- idle / casting / waiting / tapping / landing
    local hideTap
    local cineStopRef
    local bobber,line,bobberAttachment,biteGui
    local token=0
    local holding=false
    local perfectHook=false
    local clearLine; clearLine = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if bobber then bobber:Destroy();bobber=nil end
        line=nil
    end)
    local makeBobber; makeBobber = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(at)
        local skin=rod and rod.Skin or SKIN.Classic
        bobber=part({Name="CrackHubBobber",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.38,.38,.38),Color=Color3.fromRGB(230,45,45),
            Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,CFrame=CFrame.new(at),Parent=pond and pond.Model or workspace})
        local top=part({Name="Top",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.27,.27,.27),Color=Color3.new(1,1,1),Anchored=false,Massless=true,
            CFrame=CFrame.new(at+Vector3.new(0,.09,0)),Parent=bobber})
        local stick=part({Name="Stick",Size=Vector3.new(.05,.28,.05),Color=skin.Tip,Material=Enum.Material.Neon,Anchored=false,Massless=true,
            CFrame=CFrame.new(at+Vector3.new(0,.3,0)),Parent=bobber})
        for _,p in ipairs({top,stick})do local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");w.Part0,w.Part1=bobber,p;w.Parent=p end
        bobberAttachment=Instance.new("Attachment");bobberAttachment.Position=Vector3.new(0,.42,0);bobberAttachment.Parent=bobber
        line=Instance.new("Beam")
        line.Attachment0,line.Attachment1=rod.TipAttachment,bobberAttachment
        line.Width0,line.Width1=.03,.03
        line.Color=ColorSequence.new(skin.Line)
        line.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(.1)
        line.LightEmission=skin.Rainbow and 1 or .3
        line.Segments=30
        line.FaceCamera=true
        line.Parent=bobber
    end)
    local setSlack; setSlack = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(amount)
        if line then line.CurveSize0=0;line.CurveSize1=-amount end
    end)
    local reset; reset = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        token+=1
        state="idle"
        holding=false
        reelSound(0)
        rodState.Shake=0
        rodState.SpinSpeed=0
        tween("Tilt",35,.45)
        tween("Bend",0,.4)
        if rod then rod.Trail.Enabled=false end
        if biteGui then biteGui:Destroy();biteGui=nil end
        if hideTap then hideTap()end
        if cineStopRef then cineStopRef()end
        TweenService:Create(panel,TweenInfo.new(.2),{GroupTransparency=1}):Play()
        task.delay(.2,function()if state~="reeling" then panel.Visible=false end end)
        clearLine()
        if pose.Active then setPose("Idle",8)end
    end)

    local landFish; landFish = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(species,rarity,kg,roll)
        state="landing"
        local from=bobber and bobber.Position or (pond and pond.Center) or Vector3.zero
        clearLine()
        reelSound(0)
        rodState.Shake=0
        local _,root=character()
        if not root then reset();return end
        splash(from,40,rarity.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.5),1.3)
        ripple(from,5,1.6)
        play("splash",.75,1)
        play("whoosh",.5,1)
        kick(rarity.Index*.6+1)
        setPose("Catch",9)
        tween("Tilt",70,.4,"back")
        tween("Bend",0,.3)
        local fish,place,body=buildFish(species,rarity,.75+roll*.6)
        -- leaps out of the water and lands in front of you, spinning
        local t0,flight=os.clock(),.9
        local spin=0
        while os.clock()-t0<flight do
            local a=(os.clock()-t0)/flight
            local target=root.Position+root.CFrame.LookVector*2.4+Vector3.new(0,2.8,0)
            local pos=from:Lerp(target,ease(a))+Vector3.new(0,math.sin(a*math.pi)*6,0)
            spin+=14
            place(CFrame.new(pos)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(spin),math.rad(spin*.6),0),math.sin(os.clock()*30)*35)
            task.wait()
        end
        play("catch",.6,1+(rarity.Index-1)*.04)
        if rarity.Index>=4 then
            local burst=part({Size=Vector3.new(.2,.2,.2),Transparency=1,CFrame=body.CFrame,Parent=workspace})
            local e=emitter(burst,{Color=ColorSequence.new(rarity.Color,Color3.new(1,1,1)),Size=seq(.5,0),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.6,1.1),
                Speed=NumberRange.new(8,16),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180),Drag=3})
            e:Emit(30+rarity.Index*10)
            task.delay(1.5,function()burst:Destroy()end)
        end
        -- log it
        local isNew=(log.Species[species.Name] or 0)==0
        log.Total+=1
        if perfectHook then log.Perfect=(log.Perfect or 0)+1 end
        log.Rarity[rarity.Name]=(log.Rarity[rarity.Name] or 0)+1
        log.Species[species.Name]=(log.Species[species.Name] or 0)+1
        local isBest=false
        local best=log.Best
        if not best or (RARITY[best.Rarity] and (rarity.Index>RARITY[best.Rarity].Index or (rarity.Index==RARITY[best.Rarity].Index and kg>(best.Kg or 0)))) then
            log.Best={Name=species.Name,Rarity=rarity.Name,Kg=kg}
            isBest=best~=nil
        end
        saveLog()
        showCard(species,rarity,kg,isNew,isBest,perfectHook)
        if CrackHub.FishingRefresh then pcall(CrackHub.FishingRefresh)end
        -- name tag
        local tag=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        tag.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(220,50)
        tag.StudsOffsetWorldSpace=Vector3.new(0,1.7,0)
        tag.AlwaysOnTop=true
        tag.Adornee=body
        tag.Parent=screen
        local tagName=Create("TextLabel",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,26),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=species.Name,FontFace=UI_H,TextSize=21,
            TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),TextStrokeTransparency=.3,Parent=tag})
        local tagInfo=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,26),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,18),BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Text=rarity.Name.."  ·  "..string.format("%.2f kg",kg),FontFace=UI_B,TextSize=14,TextColor3=rarity.Color,TextStrokeTransparency=.3,Parent=tag})
        -- you hold it up by the tail in your raised left hand: it flops, then shrinks away
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local leftHand=char and (char:FindFirstChild("LeftHand") or char:FindFirstChild("Left Arm"))
        local hold=2.4
        t0=os.clock()
        local held=body.Position
        while os.clock()-t0<hold do
            local a=os.clock()-t0
            local flop=math.sin(a*18)*math.max(0,1-a*.6)*.7
            local want
            if leftHand and leftHand.Parent then
                want=leftHand.Position+Vector3.new(0,-.3,0)+root.CFrame.LookVector*.4
            else
                want=root.Position+root.CFrame.LookVector*2.4+Vector3.new(0,2.8,0)
            end
            held=held:Lerp(want,math.min(1,(1/60)*14))
            -- head down, tail up in the hand, swinging
            local face=CFrame.lookAt(held,held+root.CFrame.RightVector)
            place(face*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-80)+flop*.3,flop,0)*CFrame.new(0,0,.6*species.Size),math.sin(a*20)*35*math.max(.25,1-a*.4))
            task.wait()
        end
        for _,p in ipairs(fish:GetDescendants())do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(.35),{Transparency=1,Size=p.Size*.2}):Play()end
        end
        TweenService:Create(tagName,TweenInfo.new(.3),{TextTransparency=1,TextStrokeTransparency=1}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(tagInfo,TweenInfo.new(.3),{TextTransparency=1,TextStrokeTransparency=1}):Play()
        task.wait(.38)
        fish:Destroy()
        tag:Destroy()
        reset()
    end)

    local reelGame; reelGame = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(species,rarity,kg,roll)
        state="reeling"
        if biteGui then biteGui:Destroy();biteGui=nil end
        setPose("Fight",8)
        panel.Visible=true
        panel.GroupTransparency=1
        panelScale.Scale=.85
        TweenService:Create(panel,TweenInfo.new(.3),{GroupTransparency=0}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(panelScale,TweenInfo.new(.35,Enum.EasingStyle.Back),{Scale=1}):Play()
        panelTitle.Text=rarity.Hint
        panelTitle.TextColor3=rarity.Index>=3 and rarity.Color or Color3.new(1,1,1)
        panelStroke.Color=rarity.Index>=3 and rarity.Color or Color3.new(1,1,1)
        fishBody.BackgroundColor3=rarity.Index>=3 and rarity.Color or Color3.fromRGB(235,240,250)
        fishTail.BackgroundColor3=fishBody.BackgroundColor3
        local zoneW=rarity.Zone
        zone.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(zoneW,36)
        local zoneX,zoneV=TRACK_W/2-zoneW/2,0
        local fishX,fishTarget,fishTimer,facing=TRACK_W/2,TRACK_W/2,0,1
        local dashing=0
        local value=perfectHook and .55 or .3
        local mine=token
        local start=os.clock()
        -- the fish is visible as a dark shape fighting just under the surface
        local shadow
        if pond then
            local sz=species.Size*(.8+roll*.5)
            shadow=part({Name="FishShadow",Size=Vector3.new(.7*sz,.05,1.7*sz),Color=Color3.fromRGB(8,28,40),Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
                Transparency=.45,CFrame=CFrame.new(pond.Center),Parent=pond.Model})
            local sm=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");sm.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere;sm.Parent=shadow
            if rarity.Index>=4 then
                local glow=Instance.new("PointLight");glow.Color=rarity.Color;glow.Range=6;glow.Brightness=1.2;glow.Parent=shadow
            end
        end
        local shadowPos,shadowLook=pond and pond.Center or Vector3.zero,Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
        local dropShadow; dropShadow = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()if shadow then shadow:Destroy();shadow=nil end end)
        while alive and token==mine and state=="reeling" do
            local dt=task.wait()
            -- your catch zone: hold to push right, release and it drifts left (with a little bounce at the edges)
            zoneV+=(holding and 600 or -520)*dt
            zoneV=math.clamp(zoneV,-300,300)
            zoneX+=zoneV*dt
            if zoneX<=0 then zoneX,zoneV=0,math.max(0,-zoneV*.35)end
            if zoneX>=TRACK_W-zoneW then zoneX,zoneV=TRACK_W-zoneW,math.min(0,-zoneV*.35)end
            -- the fish: darts around; rarer = faster, and sometimes it DASHES
            fishTimer-=dt
            if fishTimer<=0 then
                fishTimer=(.35+math.random()*.9)/rarity.Jitter
                local jump=(math.random()*2-1)*TRACK_W*.55*rarity.Jitter
                if math.random()<rarity.Dash then
                    dashing=.45
                    jump=(math.random()<.5 and -1 or 1)*TRACK_W*.7
                    play("tick",.5,.5)
                    kick(.8)
                end
                fishTarget=math.clamp(fishX+jump,14,TRACK_W-14)
            end
            dashing=math.max(0,dashing-dt)
            local speed=2.4*rarity.Speed*(dashing>0 and 2.6 or 1)
            local before=fishX
            fishX+=(fishTarget-fishX)*math.min(1,dt*speed)
            if math.abs(fishX-before)>.3 then facing=fishX>before and -1 or 1 end
            local inside=fishX>=zoneX and fishX<=zoneX+zoneW
            value=math.clamp(value+(inside and .3 or -.22*(.85+rarity.Speed*.15))*dt,0,1)
            -- draw
            zone.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(zoneX,0)
            zone.BackgroundColor3=inside and Color3.fromRGB(120,235,150) or Color3.fromRGB(240,175,90)
            zoneStroke.Color=inside and Color3.fromRGB(200,255,210) or Color3.fromRGB(255,215,160)
            fishIcon.Position=UDim2.new(0,fishX,.5,math.sin(os.clock()*(dashing>0 and 40 or 18))*3)
            fishIcon.Rotation=math.sin(os.clock()*12)*8
            fishScale.Scale=dashing>0 and 1.25 or 1
            fishBody.Position=UDim2.fromScale(facing==1 and .42 or .58,.5)
            fishTail.Position=UDim2.fromScale(facing==1 and .9 or .1,.5)
            for _,b in ipairs(bubbles)do
                b.X-=b.Speed*dt
                b.Y-=b.Speed*.25*dt
                if b.X<-6 or b.Y<-6 then b.X,b.Y=TRACK_W+math.random()*20,10+math.random()*30 end
                b.Frame.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(b.X,b.Y)
                b.Frame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(b.Size,b.Size)
            end
            progress.Size=UDim2.fromScale(value,1)
            local barColor=Color3.fromRGB(235,85,75):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(120,235,150),value)
            progressGrad.Color=ColorSequence.new(barColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.25),barColor)
            percent.Text=math.floor(value*100+.5).."%"
            -- rod, reel, line, body all react
            rodState.Bend=inside and 18+math.sin(os.clock()*10)*3 or 32+math.sin(os.clock()*16)*6
            rodState.Shake=dashing>0 and 1 or (inside and .25 or .55)
            rodState.Tilt=50+(inside and 8 or 0)
            rodState.SpinSpeed=holding and (inside and 22 or 12) or 2
            reelSound(holding and .35 or .08,holding and (inside and 1.25 or .9) or .7)
            extra.W=CFrame.Angles(math.rad(4+(dashing>0 and 6 or 0)),math.rad(math.sin(os.clock()*3)*4),0)
            extra.LE=CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.sin(os.clock()*(holding and 18 or 4))*(holding and 25 or 5)),0,0) -- cranking the reel
            if bobber and pond then
                local off=(fishX/TRACK_W-.5)*pond.Radius*1.3
                local around=Vector3.new(math.cos(os.clock()*.7),0,math.sin(os.clock()*.7))*off
                bobber.CFrame=CFrame.new(pond.Center+around+Vector3.new(0,-.15+math.sin(os.clock()*22)*.06,0))
                setSlack(0)
                if math.random()<dt*(inside and 2 or 5) then ripple(bobber.Position,1.4,.9)end
                if dashing>0 and math.random()<dt*20 then splash(bobber.Position,6,nil,.6)end
                if shadow then
                    local want=bobber.Position+Vector3.new(0,-.13,0)
                    local move=want-shadowPos
                    if move.Magnitude>.02 then shadowLook=shadowLook:Lerp(move.Unit,math.min(1,dt*6))end
                    shadowPos=shadowPos:Lerp(want,math.min(1,dt*8))
                    local look=Vector3.new(shadowLook.X,0,shadowLook.Z)
                    if look.Magnitude<.01 then look=Vector3.new(0,0,-1)end
                    shadow.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(shadowPos.X,pond.Center.Y+.03,shadowPos.Z),Vector3.new(shadowPos.X,pond.Center.Y+.03,shadowPos.Z)+look)
                        *CFrame.Angles(0,math.sin(os.clock()*(dashing>0 and 30 or 14))*.25,0)
                end
            end
            if value>=1 then
                dropShadow()
                extra.W,extra.LE=CFrame.new(),CFrame.new()
                TweenService:Create(panel,TweenInfo.new(.2),{GroupTransparency=1}):Play()
                task.delay(.2,function()panel.Visible=false end)
                play("perfect",.4,1.2)
                landFish(species,rarity,kg,roll)
                return
            elseif value<=0 then
                if shadow then TweenService:Create(shadow,TweenInfo.new(.6),{Transparency=1}):Play();task.delay(.6,dropShadow)end
                extra.W,extra.LE=CFrame.new(),CFrame.new()
                panelTitle.Text="It got away..."
                panelTitle.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,110,100)
                play("fail",.5,1)
                reelSound(0)
                rodState.Bend=0
                if bobber then splash(bobber.Position,14,nil,.8);ripple(bobber.Position,3,1.2)end
                tween("Tilt",20,.25)
                task.wait(.8)
                reset()
                return
            end
            if os.clock()-start>45 then dropShadow();reset();return end
        end
        dropShadow()
        extra.W,extra.LE=CFrame.new(),CFrame.new()
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ store fish models (free Creator Store models, scripts removed)
    local STORE_FISH={
        {Name="Realistic Fish",Rarity="Common",Id=8174284465,Len=2.4,Kg={.4,2}},

        {Name="Blowfish",Rarity="Common",Id=119855290473720,Len=2,Kg={.5,2}},
        {Name="Parrot Fish",Rarity="Common",Id=1019175788,Len=2.4,Kg={1,4}},
        {Name="Rainbow Trout",Rarity="Uncommon",Id=89878920919450,Len=2.8,Kg={1,5}},
        {Name="King Salmon",Rarity="Uncommon",Id=10182558289,Len=3.2,Kg={4,14}},
        {Name="Clownfish",Rarity="Uncommon",Id=95805863191778,Len=1.8,Kg={.1,.4}},
        {Name="Tancho Koi",Rarity="Rare",Id=3947281012,Len=3,Kg={3,10}},
        {Name="Goshiki Koi",Rarity="Rare",Id=3947286941,Len=3,Kg={3,10}},
        {Name="Largemouth Bass",Rarity="Rare",Id=8993892628,Len=3,Kg={2,7}},
        {Name="Sockeye Salmon",Rarity="Epic",Id=75290018513458,Len=3.4,Kg={3,9}},
        {Name="Royal Blowfish",Rarity="Epic",Id=97838290440571,Len=2.6,Kg={1,4}},
        {Name="Anglerfish",Rarity="Epic",Id=5439350551,Len=3,Kg={5,30}},
        {Name="Hammerhead Shark",Rarity="Legendary",Id=12914591949,Len=6,Kg={200,500}},
        {Name="Great White Shark",Rarity="Legendary",Id=9301542905,Len=6.5,Kg={600,1500}},
        {Name="Elemental Fish",Rarity="Mythic",Id=6147541136,Len=4,Kg={50,120}},
        {Name="Whale Shark",Rarity="Mythic",Id=15805726600,Len=8,Kg={9000,20000}},
    }
    local rollStoreFish; rollStoreFish = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local total,weights=0,{}
        for _,r in ipairs(RARITIES)do weights[r.Name]=r.Weight;total+=r.Weight end
        local pick,rarity=math.random()*total,"Common"
        for _,r in ipairs(RARITIES)do pick-=weights[r.Name];if pick<=0 then rarity=r.Name break end end
        local pool={}
        for _,f in ipairs(STORE_FISH)do if f.Rarity==rarity then table.insert(pool,f)end end
        local fish=pool[math.random(1,#pool)]
        local roll=math.random()^1.8
        return fish,RARITY[rarity],math.floor((fish.Kg[1]+(fish.Kg[2]-fish.Kg[1])*roll)*100+.5)/100
    end)
    task.spawn(function()for _,f in ipairs(STORE_FISH)do if not alive then break end loadAsset(f.Id);task.wait(.15)end end)

    -- builds the fish model so it can be moved every frame; returns place(cf), size info and the parts
    local buildStoreFish; buildStoreFish = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(entry,rarity)
        local asset=loadAsset(entry.Id)
        if not asset then
            local species={Name=entry.Name,Body=rarity.Color,Belly=Color3.new(1,1,1),Size=entry.Len/2,Glow=rarity.Index>=5}
            local model,place,body=buildFish(species,rarity,1)
            return model,function(cf)place(cf,0)end,{L=entry.Len,H=entry.Len*.35,W=entry.Len*.3},body
        end
        local model=Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name="CrackHubCaughtFish"
        for _,child in ipairs(asset:IsA("Model") and asset:GetChildren() or {asset})do child.Parent=model end
        pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()if asset.Parent==nil then asset:Destroy()end end))
        bakeMeshOffsets(model)
        -- store models often come with a name sign, a stand or invisible boxes: keep only the fish itself
        for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
            if (d:IsA("SurfaceGui") or d:IsA("BillboardGui") or d:IsA("TextLabel")) then
                local holder=d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
                if holder then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()holder:Destroy()end))end
            end
        end
        local JUNK={"sign","board","text","stand","base","podium","plate","label","tag","display","info","pedestal","hitbox","root","collision","box","platform"}
        local candidates={}
        for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then
                local lower=d.Name:lower()
                local junk=d.Transparency>=.9
                for _,word in ipairs(JUNK)do if lower:find(word,1,true) then junk=true break end end
                if junk then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()d:Destroy()end)) else table.insert(candidates,d)end
            elseif d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("Constraint") or d:IsA("WeldConstraint") then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()d:Destroy()end))end
        end
        local main,mainV=nil,0
        for _,p in ipairs(candidates)do local v=p.Size.X*p.Size.Y*p.Size.Z;if v>mainV then main,mainV=p,v end end
        local parts={}
        for _,p in ipairs(candidates)do
            if p.Parent and main and (p.Position-main.Position).Magnitude<=math.max(main.Size.X,main.Size.Y,main.Size.Z)*1.5+1 then
                p.Anchored,p.CanCollide,p.CanQuery,p.CanTouch,p.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false
                table.insert(parts,p)
            elseif p.Parent then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()p:Destroy()end))end
        end
        if #parts==0 then
            model:Destroy()
            local species={Name=entry.Name,Body=rarity.Color,Belly=Color3.new(1,1,1),Size=entry.Len/2,Glow=rarity.Index>=5}
            local m2,place2,body2=buildFish(species,rarity,1)
            return m2,function(cf)place2(cf,0)end,{L=entry.Len,H=entry.Len*.35,W=entry.Len*.3},body2
        end
        model.Parent=workspace
        local cf,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
        local long=math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z)
        if long>0 then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale()*entry.Len/long)end))end
        cf,size=model:GetBoundingBox()
        -- a core frame whose -Z runs along the fish's length
        local axis
        if size.X>=size.Y and size.X>=size.Z then axis=cf.RightVector elseif size.Z>=size.Y then axis=cf.LookVector else axis=cf.UpVector end
        -- which end is the head? the heavier half (head + body) vs the thin tail;
        -- for a single mesh, trust the mesh's own "forward" (LookVector) if it lies along the fish
        local balance,mainPart,mainVolume=0,nil,0
        for _,p in ipairs(parts)do
            local v=p.Size.X*p.Size.Y*p.Size.Z
            balance+=v*(p.Position-cf.Position):Dot(axis)
            if v>mainVolume then mainPart,mainVolume=p,v end
        end
        local totalVolume=0
        for _,p in ipairs(parts)do totalVolume+=p.Size.X*p.Size.Y*p.Size.Z end
        if #parts>1 and math.abs(balance)>totalVolume*entry.Len*.02 then
            if balance<0 then axis=-axis end
        elseif mainPart then
            local look=mainPart.CFrame.LookVector
            local rightV=mainPart.CFrame.RightVector
            if math.abs(look:Dot(axis))>.7 then axis=look
            elseif math.abs(rightV:Dot(axis))>.7 then axis=-rightV end
        end
        if entry.Flip then axis=-axis end
        local up=math.abs(axis:Dot(Vector3.yAxis))>.9 and cf.LookVector or Vector3.yAxis
        local core=CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position,cf.Position+axis,up)
        local offsets={}
        for _,p in ipairs(parts)do offsets[p]=core:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)end
        local dims={L=entry.Len,H=math.min(size.Y,entry.Len*.6),W=math.min(size.X,size.Z)}
        local body=part({Name="Core",Size=Vector3.new(.2,.2,.2),Transparency=1,CFrame=core,Parent=model})
        if rarity.Index>=3 then
            local light=Instance.new("PointLight");light.Color=rarity.Color;light.Range=10+rarity.Index*2;light.Brightness=2;light.Parent=body
        end
        local function place(at)
            body.CFrame=at
            for p,offset in pairs(offsets)do if p.Parent then p.CFrame=at*offset end end
        end
        return model,place,dims,body
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ angel wings, halo and a top hat for the catch
    local buildHalo; buildHalo = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(parent,dims,rarity)
        local s=math.clamp(dims.L/3,.6,2.6)
        local pieces={Wings={},Halo={},Hat={}}
        for _,side in ipairs({-1,1})do
            for i=1,6 do
                local len=(2.1-i*.22)*s
                local feather=part({Name="Feather",Size=Vector3.new(len,.07*s,.32*s),Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
                    Transparency=1,Parent=parent})
                local fm=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");fm.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere;fm.Scale=Vector3.new(1,2.2,1);fm.Parent=feather
                local tipGlow=part({Name="FeatherTip",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.16,.16,.16)*s,Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,245,210),Material=Enum.Material.Glass,Reflectance=.4,
                    Transparency=1,Parent=parent})
                table.insert(pieces.Wings,{Part=feather,Tip=tipGlow,Side=side,Index=i,Len=len})
            end
        end
        for i=1,14 do
            table.insert(pieces.Halo,part({Name="Halo",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.17,.17,.17)*s,Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,210,90),
                Material=Enum.Material.Metal,Reflectance=.45,Transparency=1,Parent=parent}))
        end
        local haloLight=Instance.new("PointLight");haloLight.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,220,120);haloLight.Range=8;haloLight.Brightness=0;haloLight.Parent=pieces.Halo[1]
        pieces.Hat.Crown=part({Name="HatCrown",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.7*s,.55*s,.55*s),Color=Color3.fromRGB(22,22,26),Transparency=1,Parent=parent})
        pieces.Hat.Brim=part({Name="HatBrim",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.06*s,.95*s,.95*s),Color=Color3.fromRGB(22,22,26),Transparency=1,Parent=parent})
        pieces.Hat.Band=part({Name="HatBand",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.13*s,.57*s,.57*s),Color=rarity.Color,Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,Transparency=1,Parent=parent})
        local lastSpark=0
        local grow=0
        local function place(cf,t)
            local flap=math.sin(t*7)*22
            local vertical=CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(90)) -- cylinders stand up
            for _,w in ipairs(pieces.Wings)do
                -- shoulder of the wing on the fish's back; feathers fan out from long (front) to short (back)
                local shoulder=cf*CFrame.new(w.Side*dims.W*.18,dims.H*.42,-dims.L*.05)
                local raise=math.rad(18+flap+(w.Index-1)*7)
                local sweep=math.rad(-8-(w.Index-1)*13)
                local fcf=shoulder*CFrame.Angles(0,w.Side*-sweep,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,w.Side*raise)*CFrame.new(w.Side*w.Len*grow/2,0,0)
                w.Part.Size=Vector3.new(math.max(.05,w.Len*grow),.1*s,(.55-.04*w.Index)*s)
                w.Part.CFrame=fcf
                w.Tip.CFrame=fcf
                w.Part.Transparency=1-grow*.97
                w.Tip.Transparency=1
                -- soft pearly white with a faint shimmer
                w.Part.Color=Color3.new(1,1,1):Lerp(Color3.fromHSV((t*.08+w.Index*.05)%1,.35,1),.18)
            end
            local top=cf*CFrame.new(0,dims.H/2+.55*s,-dims.L*.22)
            for i,h in ipairs(pieces.Halo)do
                local a=(i/#pieces.Halo)*math.pi*2+t*1.5
                h.CFrame=top*CFrame.new(math.cos(a)*.45*s*grow,.75*s,math.sin(a)*.45*s*grow)
                h.Transparency=1-grow
                h.Color=Color3.fromHSV((.12+.04*math.sin(t*3+i*.6))%1,.6,1)
            end
            haloLight.Brightness=2*grow
            local hatBase=cf*CFrame.new(0,dims.H/2,-dims.L*.22)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-12))
            pieces.Hat.Brim.CFrame=hatBase*CFrame.new(0,.03*s,0)*vertical
            pieces.Hat.Crown.CFrame=hatBase*CFrame.new(0,.38*s,0)*vertical
            pieces.Hat.Band.CFrame=hatBase*CFrame.new(0,.14*s,0)*vertical
            for _,p in pairs(pieces.Hat)do p.Transparency=1-grow end
            -- glitter falling off the wings (3D crystals) and water dripping from the fish
            if os.clock()-lastSpark>.05 then
                lastSpark=os.clock()
                if grow>.2 then
                    local w=pieces.Wings[math.random(1,#pieces.Wings)]
                    FX.shards(w.Tip.Position,1,{Color3.new(1,1,1),Color3.fromRGB(255,225,140),rarity.Color},2.5,4)
                end
                if math.random()<.5 then
                    FX.spawn({Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.12,.12,.12),Color=Color3.fromRGB(180,220,255),Material=Enum.Material.Glass,Transparency=.2,
                        Reflectance=.3,Pos=(cf*CFrame.new((math.random()-.5)*dims.W,-dims.H*.3,(math.random()-.5)*dims.L)).Position,Vel=Vector3.new(0,-2,0),Gravity=50,Life=.7})
                end
                if rarity.Index>=3 and math.random()<.6 then
                    FX.shards((cf*CFrame.new((math.random()-.5)*dims.W*2,(math.random()-.5)*dims.H*2,(math.random()-.5)*dims.L)).Position,1,
                        {rarity.Color,Color3.new(1,1,1)},2,0)
                end
            end
        end
        return place,function(v)grow=v end,pieces
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ the purple hurricane
    local hurricane; hurricane = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(center,height)
        local model=Instance.new("Model");model.Name="CrackHubHurricane";model.Parent=workspace
        -- wind ribbons: small invisible carriers with trails, spiralling up the funnel
        local ribbons={}
        for i=1,20 do
            local carrier=part({Name="Wind",Size=Vector3.new(.1,.1,.1),Transparency=1,Parent=model})
            local a0=Instance.new("Attachment");a0.Position=Vector3.new(0,.35,0);a0.Parent=carrier
            local a1=Instance.new("Attachment");a1.Position=Vector3.new(0,-.35,0);a1.Parent=carrier

            trail.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.5),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.6,.8),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
            trail.WidthScale=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.2)})
            trail.LightEmission=.25
            trail.Lifetime=.45
            trail.FaceCamera=true
            trail.Parent=carrier
            ribbons[i]={Part=carrier,Trail=trail,Phase=math.random()*6.28,Lift=math.random(),Speed=6+math.random()*5,Width=.25+math.random()*.35}
        end
        -- rocks and water pulled into the storm
        local debris={}
        for i=1,18 do
            local s=.25+math.random()*.45
            local rock=part({Name="Debris",Size=Vector3.new(s,s*.8,s*1.1),Color=Color3.fromRGB(90+math.random(-20,20),85+math.random(-20,20),95+math.random(-20,20)),
                Material=Enum.Material.Slate,Transparency=1,Parent=model})
            debris[i]={Part=rock,Phase=math.random()*6.28,Lift=math.random(),Speed=3+math.random()*3,Spin=Vector3.new(math.random(),math.random(),math.random())*6}
        end
        local core=part({Name="Eye",Size=Vector3.new(3,height,3),Transparency=1,CFrame=CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(0,height/2,0)),Parent=model})
        -- volumetric cloud: big soft 3D balls swirling up the funnel (dark at the bottom, glowing at the top)
        local clouds={}
        for i=1,22 do
            local s=1.4+math.random()*1.8
            clouds[i]={Part=part({Name="Cloud",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(s,s,s),Color=Color3.fromRGB(35,15,60):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(110,70,160),math.random()),
                Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,Transparency=1,CastShadow=false,Parent=model}),Phase=math.random()*6.28,Lift=math.random(),Speed=2.5+math.random()*2.5,Size=s}
        end
        -- glowing inner core of the funnel
        local spine=part({Name="Spine",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(height,1.2,1.2),Color=Color3.fromRGB(160,120,220),Material=Enum.Material.ForceField,
            Transparency=1,CFrame=CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(0,height/2,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(90)),Parent=model})
        local light=Instance.new("PointLight");light.Color=Color3.fromRGB(170,80,255);light.Range=45;light.Brightness=0;light.Parent=core
        -- shockwave on the ground
        local wave=part({Name="Shockwave",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.15,2,2),Color=Color3.fromRGB(200,140,255),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,
            Transparency=.2,CFrame=CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(0,.1,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(90)),Parent=model})
        TweenService:Create(wave,TweenInfo.new(.9,Enum.EasingStyle.Quart),{Size=Vector3.new(.05,44,44),Transparency=1}):Play()
        local strength,target,done=0,1,false
        local bolt; bolt = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local y0=math.random()*height*.8
            local a=math.random()*6.28
            local points={center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*1.5,y0,math.sin(a)*1.5)}
            for _=1,4 do
                a+=math.random()*.9-.2
                local last=points[#points]
                table.insert(points,center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*(2+math.random()*3),last.Y-center.Y+1+math.random()*2.5,math.sin(a)*(2+math.random()*3)))
            end
            for i=1,#points-1 do
                local p0,p1=points[i],points[i+1]
                local seg=part({Name="Bolt",Size=Vector3.new(.14,.14,(p1-p0).Magnitude),Color=Color3.fromRGB(245,225,255),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,
                    CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(p0:Lerp(p1,.5),p1),Parent=model})
                TweenService:Create(seg,TweenInfo.new(.14),{Transparency=1}):Play()
                task.delay(.15,function()seg:Destroy()end)
            end
            light.Brightness=9
        end)
        task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local last=os.clock()
            local born=last
            while alive and not done do
                local now=os.clock();local dt=now-last;last=now
                strength+=(target-strength)*math.min(1,dt*3.5)
                local grow=math.min(1,(now-born)/.8)
                spine.Transparency=1-strength*(.12+.06*math.sin(now*9))
                spine.Size=Vector3.new(height*grow,1+math.sin(now*7)*.3,1+math.sin(now*7)*.3)
                spine.CFrame=CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(0,height*grow/2,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(90))
                for _,c in ipairs(clouds)do
                    c.Lift=(c.Lift+dt*.14)%1
                    local y=c.Lift*height*grow
                    local radius=(1.6+(y/height)*7)*(.5+.5*strength)
                    local a=c.Phase+now*c.Speed
                    c.Part.CFrame=CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*radius,y,math.sin(a)*radius))
                    local pulse=1+.15*math.sin(now*4+c.Phase)
                    c.Part.Size=Vector3.new(c.Size,c.Size,c.Size)*(.6+.6*(y/height))*pulse
                    local edge=math.min(1,c.Lift*6,(1-c.Lift)*4)
                    c.Part.Transparency=1-strength*edge*.3
                end
                if strength>.3 and math.random()<dt*14 then
                    local a=math.random()*6.28
                    FX.droplets(center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*3,.3,math.sin(a)*3),2,1.4)
                end
                light.Brightness+=(2*strength-light.Brightness)*math.min(1,dt*8)
                local top=height*grow
                for _,r in ipairs(ribbons)do
                    r.Lift=(r.Lift+dt*.32)%1
                    local y=r.Lift*top
                    local radius=(1.2+(y/height)*6.5)*(.5+.5*strength)
                    local a=r.Phase+now*r.Speed
                    r.Part.CFrame=CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*radius,y,math.sin(a)*radius))
                    r.Trail.WidthScale=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,r.Width*strength),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.05)})
                    local h=.75+.08*math.sin(now*2+r.Phase)
                    r.Trail.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHSV(h%1,.15,.95),Color3.fromHSV((h+.06)%1,.55,.7))
                end
                for _,d in ipairs(debris)do
                    d.Lift=(d.Lift+dt*.18)%1
                    local y=d.Lift*top
                    local radius=(2+(y/height)*5.5)*(.5+.5*strength)
                    local a=d.Phase+now*d.Speed
                    d.Part.CFrame=CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*radius,y,math.sin(a)*radius))*CFrame.Angles(now*d.Spin.X,now*d.Spin.Y,now*d.Spin.Z)
                    d.Part.Transparency=1-strength
                end
                if strength>.5 and math.random()<dt*5 then bolt()end
                task.wait()
            end
        end))
        return {
            Burst=function()FX.shards(center+Vector3.new(0,height,0),40,{Color3.fromRGB(230,190,255),Color3.new(1,1,1),Color3.fromRGB(170,90,255)},20,2);bolt();bolt()end,
            Fade=function(time)
                target=0
                task.delay(time or 1.4,function()done=true;model:Destroy()end)
            end,
        }
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ cracks running across the ground
    local cracks; cracks = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(center,startRadius)
        local model=Instance.new("Model");model.Name="CrackHubCracks";model.Parent=workspace
        local params=RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances={LocalPlayer.Character,model,pond and pond.Model or nil}
        local function groundAt(p)
            local hit=workspace:Raycast(p+Vector3.new(0,6,0),Vector3.new(0,-20,0),params)
            return hit and hit.Position or nil
        end
        local crackLine; crackLine = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(origin,angle,segments,width,delay)
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(delay)
                local at=origin
                for i=1,segments do
                    if not alive or not model.Parent then return end
                    angle+=math.rad(math.random(-28,28))
                    local len=1+math.random()*1.4
                    local nextAt=at+Vector3.new(math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle))*len
                    local g0,g1=groundAt(at),groundAt(nextAt)
                    if not g0 or not g1 or math.abs(g1.Y-g0.Y)>2 then return end
                    local mid=g0:Lerp(g1,.5)+Vector3.new(0,.03,0)
                    local w=width*(1-i/(segments+2))
                    local dark=part({Name="Crack",Size=Vector3.new(w,.06,.05),Color=Color3.fromRGB(22,16,30),Material=Enum.Material.Slate,
                        CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(mid,g1+Vector3.new(0,.03,0)),Parent=model})
                    local glow=part({Name="CrackGlow",Size=Vector3.new(w*.4,.07,.05),Color=Color3.fromRGB(190,90,255),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,
                        CFrame=dark.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,.01,0),Parent=model})
                    local full=(g1-g0).Magnitude
                    TweenService:Create(dark,TweenInfo.new(.07),{Size=Vector3.new(w,.06,full)}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(glow,TweenInfo.new(.07),{Size=Vector3.new(w*.4,.07,full)}):Play()
                    if i%2==0 then
                        FX.rocks(g1,3)
                        FX.shards(g1+Vector3.new(0,.2,0),3,Color3.fromRGB(200,120,255),7,20)
                    end
                    if i==3 and math.random()<.7 then crackLine(g1,angle+math.rad(math.random()<.5 and -50 or 50),math.max(2,segments-4),w*.7,0)end
                    at=nextAt
                    task.wait(.06)
                end
            end)
        end)
        local count=8
        for i=1,count do
            local a=(i/count)*math.pi*2+math.random()*.4
            crackLine(center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*startRadius,0,math.sin(a)*startRadius),a,7+math.random(0,4),.4,math.random()*.25)
        end
        -- the glow cools down, then everything fades away
        task.delay(4,function()
            for _,p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name=="CrackGlow" then TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(1.5),{Color=Color3.fromRGB(60,30,80)}):Play()end
            end
        end)
        task.delay(7,function()
            for _,p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do if p:IsA("BasePart") then TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(1.2),{Transparency=1}):Play()end end
            task.delay(1.3,function()model:Destroy()end)
        end)
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ tap to reel: just click fast, you always pull it out
    local tapPanel=Create("CanvasGroup",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,1),Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-110),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(360,96),
        BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(14,16,22),BackgroundTransparency=.06,GroupTransparency=1,Visible=false,Parent=screen},{Corner(16)})
    local tapStroke=Stroke(Color3.new(1,1,1),1.5,.6);tapStroke.Parent=tapPanel
    local tapTitle=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,12),Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,22),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="TAP TAP TAP!",FontFace=UI_H,
        TextSize=20,TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Parent=tapPanel})
    local tapCombo=Create("TextLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.new(1,-18,0,12),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(120,22),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="",
        FontFace=UI_H,TextSize=18,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,215,60),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,Parent=tapPanel})

    local tapHint=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,36),Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,16),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text="click as fast as you can",FontFace=UI_R,
        TextSize=12,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(150,156,172),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Parent=tapPanel})
    local tapBack=Create("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,62),Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,16),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,44,54),BorderSizePixel=0,Parent=tapPanel},{Corner(8)})
    local tapFill=Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),BorderSizePixel=0,Parent=tapBack},{Corner(8)})
    local tapGrad=Create("UIGradient",{Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(170,90,255),Color3.fromRGB(255,120,220)),Parent=tapFill})
    local tapShine=Create("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(0,30,1,0),BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),BackgroundTransparency=.6,BorderSizePixel=0,Parent=tapFill},{Corner(8)})
    local tapScale=Create("UIScale",{Parent=tapPanel})
    hideTap=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()tapPanel.Visible=false end)
    local tapState={Value=0,Combo=0,Last=0}
    local function tap()
        if state~="tapping" then return end
        tapState.Combo+=1
        tapState.Last=os.clock()
        tapState.Value=math.min(1,tapState.Value+tapState.Step)
        play("tap",.45,.9+math.min(tapState.Combo,30)*.02)
        tapCombo.Text="x"..tapState.Combo
        tapComboScale.Scale=1.35
        TweenService:Create(tapComboScale,TweenInfo.new(.2,Enum.EasingStyle.Back),{Scale=1}):Play()
        tapScale.Scale=1.04
        TweenService:Create(tapScale,TweenInfo.new(.15),{Scale=1}):Play()
        rodState.Bend=34
        rodState.SpinSpeed=30
        kick(.35)
        if bobber then
            splash(bobber.Position,6,nil,.6)
            if math.random()<.4 then ripple(bobber.Position,1.6,.9)end
        end
    end
    connect(UserInputService.InputBegan,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Space then tap()end
    end)

    local epicCatch
    local tapReel; tapReel = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(entry,rarity,kg)
        state="tapping"
        if biteGui then biteGui:Destroy();biteGui=nil end
        setPose("Fight",8)
        tapState.Value,tapState.Combo,tapState.Last=0,0,os.clock()
        -- rarer fish need a few more clicks, but you always win
        tapState.Step=math.clamp(.11-rarity.Index*.012,.04,.1)
        tapStroke.Color=rarity.Index>=3 and rarity.Color or Color3.new(1,1,1)
        tapHint.Text=rarity.Hint
        tapCombo.Text=""
        tapPanel.Visible=true
        tapPanel.GroupTransparency=1
        tapScale.Scale=.85
        TweenService:Create(tapPanel,TweenInfo.new(.25),{GroupTransparency=0}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(tapScale,TweenInfo.new(.3,Enum.EasingStyle.Back),{Scale=1}):Play()
        local mine=token
        local landing=bobber and bobber.Position or pond.Center
        while alive and token==mine and state=="tapping" do
            local dt=task.wait()
            -- slowly slips back if you stop, but never all the way
            if os.clock()-tapState.Last>.35 then tapState.Value=math.max(.05,tapState.Value-dt*.12)end
            tapFill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(tapState.Value,1)
            tapShine.Position=UDim2.new((os.clock()*1.4)%1.4-.2,0,0,0)
            rodState.Bend+=(14-rodState.Bend)*math.min(1,dt*6)
            rodState.SpinSpeed+=(0-rodState.SpinSpeed)*math.min(1,dt*4)
            rodState.Tilt=50+tapState.Value*15
            rodState.Shake=.3+tapState.Value*.5
            reelSound(rodState.SpinSpeed>4 and .35 or 0,1+tapState.Value*.5)
            extra.LE=CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.sin(os.clock()*20)*20),0,0)
            if bobber then
                local t=os.clock()
                local toward=(pond.Center-landing)*tapState.Value*.5
                bobber.CFrame=CFrame.new(landing+toward+Vector3.new(math.sin(t*9)*.25,-.2+math.sin(t*25)*.06,math.cos(t*7)*.25))
                setSlack(0)
            end
            if tapState.Value>=1 then
                extra.LE=CFrame.new()
                TweenService:Create(tapPanel,TweenInfo.new(.2),{GroupTransparency=1}):Play()
                task.delay(.2,function()tapPanel.Visible=false end)
                reelSound(0)
                epicCatch(entry,rarity,kg)
                return
            end
        end
        extra.LE=CFrame.new()
        tapPanel.Visible=false
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ cinematic camera for the catch
    local cine={On=false,From=Vector3.zero,Focus=Vector3.zero,Smooth=6,Saved=nil}
    local cineStart; cineStart = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if not settings.Cinematic then return end
        local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return end
        cine.Saved={Type=cam.CameraType}
        cine.Pos=cam.CFrame.Position
        cine.Look=cam.CFrame.Position+cam.CFrame.LookVector*10
        cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        cine.On=true
        cineStopRef=function()
            cine.On=false
            if cam and cine.Saved then pcall(function()cam.CameraType=cine.Saved.Type end)end
        end
    end)
    local cineStop; cineStop = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        cineStopRef=nil
        if not cine.On then return end
        cine.On=false
        local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam and cine.Saved then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()cam.CameraType=cine.Saved.Type end))end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        RunService:BindToRenderStep("CrackHubFishingCine",Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value,LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if not cine.On then return end
            local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
            local k=1-math.exp(-cine.Smooth*dt)
            cine.Pos=cine.Pos:Lerp(cine.From,k)
            cine.Look=cine.Look:Lerp(cine.Focus,math.min(1,k*1.6))
            cam.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(cine.Pos,cine.Look)
        end))
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ THE CATCH: hurricane, cracks, angel wings, flies to you
    -- shimmering colour around a base colour (iridescent look)
    local shimmer; shimmer = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(base,t,spread)
        local h,s,v=base:ToHSV()
        return Color3.fromHSV((h+math.sin(t)*(spread or .08))%1,math.clamp(s*.85,0,1),math.clamp(v*1.1,0,1))
    end)
    local smooth; smooth = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(k)return k*k*(3-2*k)end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ 3D trophy plaque: a real glass slab in a gold frame floating in the world
    local PLAQUE_FONT=Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/LuckiestGuy.json")
    local plaque; plaque = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(name,rarity,kg,isNew,isBest)

        end)

        Stroke(Color3.fromRGB(50,25,5),3,0).Parent=caught
        local title=label({Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,62),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,96),Text=string.upper(name),FontFace=PLAQUE_FONT,TextSize=78,TextScaled=false,
            TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)})
        local titleStroke=Stroke(rarity.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0),.7),5,0);titleStroke.Parent=title
        local grad=Create("UIGradient",{Rotation=90,Color=ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,rarity.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.6)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.45,rarity.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.15)),ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.5,Color3.new(1,1,1)),

            FontFace=UI_H,TextSize=42,TextColor3=rarity.Color:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255,225,120),.5)})

        Stroke(Color3.fromRGB(20,10,30),3,0).Parent=info

        if isNew or isBest then
            badge=label({AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.new(1,-18,0,14),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(isBest and 200 or 110,40),

            badge.BackgroundTransparency=0

            badge.Rotation=8
            badge.Visible=false
        end
        -- pop-in, then the stars and weight fill in
        local born=os.clock()
        task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            task.wait(.35)
            for i=1,6 do
                if not model.Parent then return end
                stars.MaxVisibleGraphemes=i
                if i<=rarity.Index then play("tick",.4,1+i*.12)end
                task.wait(.08)
            end
            local t0=os.clock()
            while os.clock()-t0<.7 and model.Parent do
                local k=1-(1-(os.clock()-t0)/.7)^3
                info.Text=string.upper(rarity.Name).."  ·  "..string.format("%.2f KG",kg*k)
                task.wait()
            end
            info.Text=string.upper(rarity.Name).."  ·  "..string.format("%.2f KG",kg)
            if badge then badge.Visible=true;play("perfect",.5,1.2)end
        end))
        local pos,vel=nil,Vector3.zero
        local api={}
        -- follows a point, swings like it hangs on springs, always turned toward the camera
        function api.update(anchor,dt)
            if not pos then pos=anchor-Vector3.new(0,1.5,0)end
            local force=(anchor-pos)*60-vel*9
            vel+=force*dt
            pos+=vel*dt
            local age=os.clock()-born
            local pop=age<.45 and (1+2.70158*((age/.45)-1)^3+1.70158*((age/.45)-1)^2) or 1
            local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
            local face=cam and (cam.CFrame.Position-pos)*Vector3.new(1,0,1) or Vector3.new(0,0,1)
            local cf=CFrame.lookAt(pos,pos+(face.Magnitude>.1 and face.Unit or Vector3.new(0,0,1)))
                *CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-vel.Y*3),math.rad(math.sin(age*1.3)*6),math.rad(-vel.X*2+math.sin(age*1.7)*2))
            local s=math.max(.05,pop)
            slab.Size=Vector3.new(W,H,.28)*s
            slab.CFrame=cf
            for _,f in ipairs(frame)do
                f.Part.Size=f.Size*s
                f.Part.CFrame=cf*CFrame.new(f.Offset.Position*s)
            end
            grad.Offset=Vector2.new(0,math.sin(age*2.2)*.4)
            light.Brightness=1.2+.6*math.sin(age*3)
        end
        function api.destroy()
            for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") then TweenService:Create(d,TweenInfo.new(.3),{Transparency=1}):Play()end
            end
            TweenService:Create(gui,TweenInfo.new(.3),{Brightness=0}):Play()
            for _,l in ipairs(gui:GetChildren())do
                if l:IsA("TextLabel") then TweenService:Create(l,TweenInfo.new(.3),{TextTransparency=1,BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()end
            end
            task.delay(.35,function()model:Destroy()end)
        end
        return api
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ cosmic portal (second catch animation)
    local portal; portal = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(at,radius,color)
        local model=Instance.new("Model");model.Name="CrackHubPortal";model.Parent=workspace

                Reflectance=.5,Transparency=1,Parent=model}),A=math.random()*6.28,R=math.random(),S=.6+math.random()*1.2}
        end

        local center=at
        task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()

            while alive and not done do

                open+=(target-open)*math.min(1,dt*3)
                local r=radius*open

                for _,s in ipairs(stars)do

                    s.Part.CFrame=CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*r*s.R*1.3,-.2,math.sin(a)*r*s.R*1.3))

                end
                task.wait()
            end
        end))
        return {
            Move=function(to)center=to end,
            Close=function(time)target=0;task.delay(time or .8,function()done=true;model:Destroy()end)end,

        }
    end)
