    ------------------------------------------------------------------ the very first catch animation (kept as "Classic Storm")
    local hurricaneClassic; hurricaneClassic = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(center,height)
        local model=Instance.new("Model");model.Name="CrackHubHurricane";model.Parent=workspace
        local rings={}
        local LAYERS,PER=6,20
        for layer=1,LAYERS do
            local ring={Pieces={},Height=(layer-1)/(LAYERS-1)*height,Radius=1.6+layer*1.15,Speed=(5+layer*.6)*(layer%2==0 and 1 or -1),Angle=math.random()*6}
            for i=1,PER do
                ring.Pieces[i]=part({Name="Wind",Size=Vector3.new(.18,.18,1),Color=Color3.fromRGB(170,80,255):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(240,190,255),math.random()*.5),
                    Material=Enum.Material.Neon,Transparency=1,Parent=model})
            end
            rings[layer]=ring
        end
        local core=part({Name="Eye",Size=Vector3.new(2,height,2),Transparency=1,CFrame=CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(0,height/2,0)),Parent=model})
        local swirl=emitter(core,{Texture=SMOKE,Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(150,60,255),Color3.fromRGB(60,10,120)),LightEmission=.6,
            Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,2),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,7)}),Transparency=seq(.45,1),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(1,1.8),
            Speed=NumberRange.new(4,9),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(30,30),EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Top,RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-200,200),Rate=0})
        local sparks=emitter(core,{Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(220,170,255)),Size=seq(.4,0),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.4,.8),Speed=NumberRange.new(10,20),
            SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180),Rate=0})
        local light=Instance.new("PointLight");light.Color=Color3.fromRGB(170,80,255);light.Range=40;light.Brightness=0;light.Parent=core
        local strength,target,done=0,1,false
        task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local last=os.clock()
            while alive and not done do
                local now=os.clock();local dt=now-last;last=now
                strength+=(target-strength)*math.min(1,dt*4)
                swirl.Rate=60*strength
                sparks.Rate=30*strength
                light.Brightness=4*strength
                for _,ring in ipairs(rings)do
                    ring.Angle+=ring.Speed*dt
                    local r=ring.Radius*(.4+.6*strength)
                    local arc=2*math.pi*r/PER*.75
                    for i,p in ipairs(ring.Pieces)do
                        local a=ring.Angle+(i/PER)*math.pi*2
                        local y=ring.Height+math.sin(a*2+now*3)*.6
                        p.Size=Vector3.new(.16,.16,arc)
                        p.CFrame=CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*r,y,math.sin(a)*r))*CFrame.Angles(0,-a,0)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(12),0,0)
                        p.Transparency=1-strength*(.55+.35*math.noise(i,now*3))
                    end
                end
                -- lightning flickers inside the funnel
                if strength>.5 and math.random()<dt*6 then
                    local y0=math.random()*height
                    local a0,a1=math.random()*6.28,math.random()*6.28
                    local p0=center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a0)*2,y0,math.sin(a0)*2)
                    local p1=center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a1)*4,y0+3+math.random()*4,math.sin(a1)*4)
                    local bolt=part({Name="Bolt",Size=Vector3.new(.12,.12,(p1-p0).Magnitude),Color=Color3.fromRGB(240,220,255),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,
                        CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(p0:Lerp(p1,.5),p1),Parent=model})
                    task.delay(.08,function()bolt:Destroy()end)
                end
                task.wait()
            end
        end))
        return {
            Burst=function()sparks:Emit(60);swirl:Emit(30)end,
            Fade=function(time)
                target=0
                task.delay(time or 1.2,function()done=true;model:Destroy()end)
            end,
        }
    end)

    local classicCatch; classicCatch = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(entry,rarity,kg)
        state="landing"
        local mine=token
        local _,root=character()
        if not root or not pond then reset();return end
        local from=bobber and bobber.Position or pond.Center
        local center=pond.Center
        clearLine()
        rodState.Shake,rodState.Bend,rodState.SpinSpeed=0,0,0
        tween("Tilt",75,.3,"back")
        setPose("Hook",14)
        -- 1) the water explodes, the ground cracks, a purple hurricane rises
        play("splash",.9,.8)
        play("crack",.9,1)
        play("storm",.8,1)
        kick(4)
        splash(from,70,Color3.fromRGB(200,150,255),2)
        ripple(center,pond.Radius*3,2)
        flash.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(150,70,255)
        flash.BackgroundTransparency=.5
        TweenService:Create(flash,TweenInfo.new(.8),{BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
        cracks(center,pond.Radius+.6)
        local apexHeight=22
        local storm=hurricaneClassic(center,apexHeight)
        -- 2) the fish is lifted up through the eye of the storm
        local fish,place,dims,body=buildStoreFish(entry,rarity)
        local halo,setGrow=buildHalo(fish,dims,rarity)
        local apex=center+Vector3.new(0,apexHeight,0)
        local t0,rise=os.clock(),1.9
        while os.clock()-t0<rise and alive do
            local k=(os.clock()-t0)/rise
            local e=1-(1-k)^2.4
            local pos=from:Lerp(apex,e)+Vector3.new(math.sin(k*14)*(1-k)*1.5,0,math.cos(k*14)*(1-k)*1.5)
            local cf=CFrame.new(pos)*CFrame.Angles(0,k*math.pi*6,math.sin(k*20)*.4)
            place(cf)
            halo(cf,os.clock())
            task.wait()
        end
        -- 3) at the top: a flash of light, angel wings unfold, halo and hat appear
        storm.Burst()
        play("angel",.7,1)
        kick(1.5)
        flash.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
        flash.BackgroundTransparency=.35
        TweenService:Create(flash,TweenInfo.new(1),{BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
        local burst=part({Size=Vector3.new(.2,.2,.2),Transparency=1,CFrame=CFrame.new(apex),Parent=workspace})
        emitter(burst,{Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1),rarity.Color),Size=seq(.8,0),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.6,1.2),Speed=NumberRange.new(14,26),
            SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180),Drag=3}):Emit(80)
        local beam=part({Name="LightBeam",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(apexHeight+6,3,3),Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,240,200),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,
            Transparency=.6,CFrame=CFrame.new(center+Vector3.new(0,(apexHeight+6)/2,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(90)),Parent=workspace})
        TweenService:Create(beam,TweenInfo.new(1.4),{Transparency=1,Size=Vector3.new(apexHeight+6,.3,.3)}):Play()
        task.delay(1.5,function()burst:Destroy();beam:Destroy()end)
        t0=os.clock()
        local hover=1.4
        while os.clock()-t0<hover and alive do
            local k=(os.clock()-t0)/hover
            setGrow(math.min(1,k*1.6))
            local face=(root.Position-apex)*Vector3.new(1,0,1)
            local cf=CFrame.lookAt(apex+Vector3.new(0,math.sin(k*6)*.4,0),apex+(face.Magnitude>.1 and face.Unit or Vector3.new(0,0,-1)))
            place(cf)
            halo(cf,os.clock())
            task.wait()
        end
        setGrow(1)
        -- 4) the storm calms down and it flies down to you, wings flapping
        storm.Fade(1.4)
        play("whoosh",.6,.8)
        t0=os.clock()
        local fly=1.7
        local start=apex
        while os.clock()-t0<fly and alive do
            local k=(os.clock()-t0)/fly
            local e=k<.5 and 2*k*k or 1-(-2*k+2)^2/2
            local hold=root.Position+root.CFrame.LookVector*3+Vector3.new(0,3.2,0)
            local mid=start:Lerp(hold,.5)+Vector3.new(0,7,0)
            local pos=start:Lerp(mid,e):Lerp(mid:Lerp(hold,e),e)
            local ahead=start:Lerp(mid,math.min(1,e+.05)):Lerp(mid:Lerp(hold,math.min(1,e+.05)),math.min(1,e+.05))
            local dir=ahead-pos
            local cf=CFrame.lookAt(pos,pos+(dir.Magnitude>.01 and dir.Unit or root.CFrame.LookVector))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.sin(k*10)*.2)
            place(cf)
            halo(cf,os.clock())
            task.wait()
        end
        -- 5) you've got it: it hovers in front of you
        setPose("Catch",9)
        play("catch",.7,1+(rarity.Index-1)*.04)
        local isNew=(log.Species[entry.Name] or 0)==0
        log.Total+=1
        log.Rarity[rarity.Name]=(log.Rarity[rarity.Name] or 0)+1
        log.Species[entry.Name]=(log.Species[entry.Name] or 0)+1
        local isBest=false
        local best=log.Best
        if not best or (RARITY[best.Rarity] and (rarity.Index>RARITY[best.Rarity].Index or (rarity.Index==RARITY[best.Rarity].Index and kg>(best.Kg or 0)))) then
            log.Best={Name=entry.Name,Rarity=rarity.Name,Kg=kg}
            isBest=best~=nil
        end
        saveLog()
        if CrackHub.FishCaught then task.spawn(pcall,CrackHub.FishCaught,entry,rarity,kg,isBest)end
        showCard({Name=entry.Name},rarity,kg,isNew,isBest,false)
        local tag=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        tag.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(240,52)
        tag.StudsOffsetWorldSpace=Vector3.new(0,dims.H/2+2.4,0)
        tag.AlwaysOnTop=true
        tag.Adornee=body
        tag.Parent=screen
        local tagName=Create("TextLabel",{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,26),BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=entry.Name,FontFace=UI_H,TextSize=22,
            TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),TextStrokeTransparency=.3,Parent=tag})
        local tagInfo=Create("TextLabel",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,26),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,18),BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Text=rarity.Name.."  ·  "..string.format("%.2f kg",kg),FontFace=UI_B,TextSize=14,TextColor3=rarity.Color,TextStrokeTransparency=.3,Parent=tag})
        t0=os.clock()
        local holdTime=2.6
        while os.clock()-t0<holdTime and alive do
            local a=os.clock()-t0
            local hold=root.Position+root.CFrame.LookVector*3+Vector3.new(0,3.2+math.sin(a*3)*.2,0)
            local cf=CFrame.lookAt(hold,hold+root.CFrame.RightVector)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.sin(a*2)*.5,math.sin(a*5)*.08)
            place(cf)
            halo(cf,os.clock())
            task.wait()
        end
        -- 6) it vanishes in a shower of sparkles
        local poof=part({Size=Vector3.new(.2,.2,.2),Transparency=1,CFrame=body.CFrame,Parent=workspace})
        emitter(poof,{Color=ColorSequence.new(rarity.Color,Color3.new(1,1,1)),Size=seq(.5,0),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.5,1),Speed=NumberRange.new(6,12),
            SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180),Drag=2}):Emit(50)
        task.delay(1.2,function()poof:Destroy()end)
        play("perfect",.5,1.1)
        for _,p in ipairs(fish:GetDescendants())do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(.3),{Transparency=1}):Play()end
        end
        TweenService:Create(tagName,TweenInfo.new(.3),{TextTransparency=1,TextStrokeTransparency=1}):Play()
        TweenService:Create(tagInfo,TweenInfo.new(.3),{TextTransparency=1,TextStrokeTransparency=1}):Play()
        task.wait(.35)
        fish:Destroy()
        tag:Destroy()
        if token==mine then reset()end
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ THE CATCH
    epicCatch=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(entry,rarity,kg)
        state="landing"
        local mine=token
        local _,root=character()
        if not root or not pond then reset();return end
        local style=settings.CatchStyle
        if style=="Random" then style=({"Hurricane","Cosmic Portal","Classic Storm"})[math.random(1,3)] end
        if style=="Classic Storm" then return classicCatch(entry,rarity,kg)end
        local from=bobber and bobber.Position or pond.Center
        local center=pond.Center
        local side=(root.Position-center)*Vector3.new(1,0,1)
        side=side.Magnitude>.1 and side.Unit or Vector3.new(0,0,1)
        local right=side:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
        clearLine()
        rodState.Shake,rodState.Bend,rodState.SpinSpeed=0,0,0
        tween("Tilt",70,.3,"back")
        setPose("Hook",10)
        cineStart()
        cine.Smooth=3.5
        cine.From=center+side*15+right*5+Vector3.new(0,5,0)
        cine.Focus=center+Vector3.new(0,3,0)
        local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
        local fov0=cam and cam.FieldOfView or 70
        local punch; punch = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(amount,time)
            if not cam then return end
            cam.FieldOfView=fov0+amount
            TweenService:Create(cam,TweenInfo.new(time or .6,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad),{FieldOfView=fov0}):Play()
        end)
        -- the fish: real model, a thin glowing outline only (no flat fill), shimmering trail, wings/halo/hat
        local fish,place,dims,body=buildStoreFish(entry,rarity)
        local outline=Instance.new("Highlight")
        outline.Adornee=fish
        outline.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
        outline.FillTransparency=1
        outline.OutlineTransparency=.35
        outline.Parent=fish
        local ta0=Instance.new("Attachment");ta0.Position=Vector3.new(0,dims.H*.25,0);ta0.Parent=body
        local ta1=Instance.new("Attachment");ta1.Position=Vector3.new(0,-dims.H*.25,0);ta1.Parent=body
        local fishTrail=Instance.new("Trail")
        fishTrail.Attachment0,fishTrail.Attachment1=ta0,ta1
        fishTrail.LightEmission=.6
        fishTrail.Lifetime=.35
        fishTrail.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.45),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
        fishTrail.WidthScale=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)})
        fishTrail.Parent=body
        local halo,setGrow=buildHalo(fish,dims,rarity)
        local shine; shine = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(t)
            local c=shimmer(rarity.Color,t*2,.08)
            outline.OutlineColor=c:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.3+.2*math.sin(t*4))
            fishTrail.Color=ColorSequence.new(c:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.4),c)
        end)
        -- a calm, natural swim: gentle tail-beat yaw and a little roll, nothing jittery
        local swim; swim = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(cf,t,amount)
            amount=amount or 1
            return cf*CFrame.Angles(0,math.sin(t*6)*.16*amount,math.sin(t*3)*.05*amount)
        end)
        local show; show = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(cf,t,amount)
            local c=swim(cf,t,amount)
            place(c);halo(c,t);shine(t)
        end)
        -- facing helper: head along a direction, slightly nose-up
        local lastFlat=Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
        local heading; heading = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(pos,dir,pitch)
            local flat=Vector3.new(dir.X,0,dir.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude>.01 then lastFlat=flat.Unit end
            local climb=dir.Magnitude>.01 and math.clamp(math.deg(math.asin(math.clamp(dir.Unit.Y,-1,1))),-22,22) or 0
            return CFrame.lookAt(pos,pos+lastFlat)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(climb+(pitch or 0)),0,0)
        end)
        play("splash",.9,.8)
        kick(3)
        punch(14,.7)
        FX.droplets(from,40,2.2,Color3.fromRGB(200,170,255))
        ripple(center,pond.Radius*3,2)
        local column=part({Name="WaterColumn",Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder,Size=Vector3.new(.5,2.4,2.4),Color=Color3.fromRGB(180,220,255),Material=Enum.Material.Glass,
            Transparency=.35,Reflectance=.25,CFrame=CFrame.new(from)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(90)),Parent=workspace})
        TweenService:Create(column,TweenInfo.new(.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Quart),{Size=Vector3.new(14,1.6,1.6),CFrame=CFrame.new(from+Vector3.new(0,7,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(90))}):Play()
        task.delay(.5,function()TweenService:Create(column,TweenInfo.new(.6),{Transparency=1,Size=Vector3.new(14,.3,.3)}):Play()end)
        task.delay(1.2,function()column:Destroy()end)
        local holdAt=LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()return root.Position+root.CFrame.LookVector*3.5+root.CFrame.RightVector*2.2+Vector3.new(0,2.4,0)end)
        if style=="Cosmic Portal" then
            ---------------------------------------------------------------- COSMIC PORTAL
            play("storm",.45,1.35)
            local top=center+Vector3.new(0,18,0)
            local gate=portal(top,4.2,Color3.fromRGB(110,90,255))
            lightPillar(center,18,Color3.fromRGB(150,170,255),2.6)
            -- whirlpool: the water spirals into the middle
            for i=1,3 do task.delay(i*.18,function()ripple(center,pond.Radius*2-i,1.6)end)end
            local t0,rise=os.clock(),2.1
            while os.clock()-t0<rise and alive do
                local now=os.clock()
                local k=smooth((now-t0)/rise)
                local pos=from:Lerp(top-Vector3.new(0,.5,0),k)+Vector3.new(math.cos(k*9)*(1-k)*1.2,0,math.sin(k*9)*(1-k)*1.2)
                local nextPos=from:Lerp(top,math.min(1,k+.03))
                show(heading(pos,nextPos-pos+Vector3.new(0,.6,0),0),now,1)
                cine.From=center+side*15+right*4+Vector3.new(0,4+(pos.Y-center.Y)*.55,0)
                cine.Focus=pos:Lerp(top,.25)
                if math.random()<.3 then FX.shards(pos,1,{Color3.fromRGB(180,170,255),Color3.new(1,1,1)},3,0)end
                task.wait()
            end
            -- swallowed by the portal
            play("angel",.6,.85)
            punch(10,.8)
            FX.sphere(top,8,Color3.fromRGB(160,150,255),.5)
            FX.shards(top,40,{Color3.fromRGB(180,170,255),Color3.new(1,1,1)},18,0)
            fishTrail.Enabled=false
            place(CFrame.new(0,-500,0))
            halo(CFrame.new(0,-500,0),os.clock())
            task.wait(.35)
            -- the portal glides over to you...
            local over=holdAt()+Vector3.new(0,7,0)
            cine.From=root.Position-root.CFrame.LookVector*8+root.CFrame.RightVector*3+Vector3.new(0,3,0)
            cine.Focus=over
            t0=os.clock()
            local glide=1.1
            while os.clock()-t0<glide and alive do
                local k=smooth((os.clock()-t0)/glide)
                gate.Move(top:Lerp(over,k)+Vector3.new(0,math.sin(k*math.pi)*3,0))
                task.wait()
            end
            gate.Move(over)
            -- ...and the fish floats down out of it with wings
            play("whoosh",.5,.7)
            lightPillar(root.Position-Vector3.new(0,3,0),10.5,Color3.fromRGB(255,230,160),2.6)
            place(CFrame.new(over))
            fishTrail.Enabled=true
            t0=os.clock()
            local drop=2
            while os.clock()-t0<drop and alive do
                local now=os.clock()
                local k=smooth((now-t0)/drop)
                setGrow(math.min(1,k*1.5))
                local pos=over:Lerp(holdAt(),k)
                local cf=CFrame.lookAt(pos,pos+root.CFrame.RightVector)*CFrame.Angles(0,(1-k)*math.pi*2,0)
                show(cf,now,.6)
                cine.Focus=pos
                task.wait()
            end
            gate.Close(.7)
        else
            ---------------------------------------------------------------- HURRICANE
            play("crack",.9,1)
            play("storm",.8,1)
            cracks(center,pond.Radius+.6)
            local apexHeight=20
            local storm=hurricane(center,apexHeight)
            local apex=center+Vector3.new(0,apexHeight,0)
            -- rises in a smooth spiral, head pointing along the path
            local t0,rise=os.clock(),2.1
            local spiral; spiral = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(k)
                local e=1-(1-k)^2.2
                local r=(1-e)*2.2
                return from:Lerp(apex,e)+Vector3.new(math.cos(k*11)*r,0,math.sin(k*11)*r)
            end)
            while os.clock()-t0<rise and alive do
                local now=os.clock()
                local k=(now-t0)/rise
                local pos=spiral(k)
                show(heading(pos,spiral(math.min(1,k+.02))-pos,0),now,1)
                cine.From=center+side*24+right*8+Vector3.new(0,5+(pos.Y-center.Y)*.4,0)
                cine.Focus=pos
                task.wait()
            end
            -- the top: flash, slow-mo, wings unfold
            storm.Burst()
            play("angel",.75,1)
            kick(1.4)
            punch(12,1)
            flash.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
            flash.BackgroundTransparency=.75
            TweenService:Create(flash,TweenInfo.new(.8),{BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
            FX.shards(apex,60,{Color3.new(1,1,1),rarity.Color,Color3.fromRGB(255,230,150)},22,3)
            FX.sphere(apex,9,Color3.fromRGB(255,245,225),.55)
            lightPillar(center,apexHeight+6,Color3.fromRGB(255,240,200),1.8)
            cine.From=center+side*22+right*4+Vector3.new(0,apexHeight*.5,0)
            t0=os.clock()
            local hover=1.7
            local face=(root.Position-apex)*Vector3.new(1,0,1)
            while os.clock()-t0<hover and alive do
                local now=os.clock()
                local k=(now-t0)/hover
                setGrow(smooth(math.min(1,k*1.4)))
                local spin=(1-smooth(k))*math.pi*1.5
                local cf=heading(apex+Vector3.new(0,math.sin(k*4)*.4,0),face,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,spin,0)
                show(cf,now,.5)
                cine.Focus=apex
                task.wait()
            end
            setGrow(1)
            storm.Fade(1.6)
            -- glides down to you along a smooth arc, banking into the turn
            play("whoosh",.65,.8)
            t0=os.clock()
            local fly=1.9
            local start=apex
            local arc; arc = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(x)
                local hold=holdAt()
                local mid=start:Lerp(hold,.5)+Vector3.new(0,6,0)+right*4
                return start:Lerp(mid,x):Lerp(mid:Lerp(hold,x),x)
            end)
            while os.clock()-t0<fly and alive do
                local now=os.clock()
                local k=smooth((now-t0)/fly)
                local pos=arc(k)
                local ahead=arc(math.min(1,k+.03))
                local cf=heading(pos,ahead-pos,0)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.sin(k*math.pi)*.35)
                show(cf,now,.7)
                cine.From=root.Position-root.CFrame.LookVector*7+root.CFrame.RightVector*3+Vector3.new(0,4,0)
                cine.Focus=pos
                task.wait()
            end
        end
        cineStop()
        if cam then cam.FieldOfView=fov0 end
        -- got it: the fish hangs in front of you with the 3D plaque above it
        setPose("Catch",7)
        play("catch",.7,1+(rarity.Index-1)*.04)
        local isNew=(log.Species[entry.Name] or 0)==0
        log.Total+=1
        log.Rarity[rarity.Name]=(log.Rarity[rarity.Name] or 0)+1
        log.Species[entry.Name]=(log.Species[entry.Name] or 0)+1
        local isBest=false
        local best=log.Best
        if not best or (RARITY[best.Rarity] and (rarity.Index>RARITY[best.Rarity].Index or (rarity.Index==RARITY[best.Rarity].Index and kg>(best.Kg or 0)))) then
            log.Best={Name=entry.Name,Rarity=rarity.Name,Kg=kg}
            isBest=best~=nil
        end
        saveLog()
        if CrackHub.FishCaught then task.spawn(pcall,CrackHub.FishCaught,entry,rarity,kg,isBest)end
        local board=plaque(entry.Name,rarity,kg,isNew,isBest)
        for i=1,3 do
            task.delay((i-1)*.12,function()
                if not pond then return end
                local feet=root.Position-Vector3.new(0,2.8,0)
                ripple(feet,6+i*3,2)
                FX.shards(feet+Vector3.new(0,.3,0),10,{rarity.Color,Color3.new(1,1,1)},9,8)
            end)
        end
        local t0=os.clock()
        local last=t0
        local holdTime=3.8
        while os.clock()-t0<holdTime and alive do
            local now=os.clock()
            local dt=now-last;last=now
            local a=now-t0
            local hold=holdAt()+Vector3.new(0,math.sin(a*2.4)*.15,0)
            local cf=CFrame.lookAt(hold,hold+root.CFrame.RightVector)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.sin(a*1.2)*.35,0)
            show(cf,now,.6)
            board.update(hold+Vector3.new(0,dims.H/2+3.2,0),dt)
            task.wait()
        end
        -- gone in a burst of glass crystals
        FX.shards(body.Position,45,{rarity.Color,Color3.new(1,1,1),Color3.fromRGB(255,225,140)},13,6)
        FX.sphere(body.Position,4,rarity.Color,.35)
        play("perfect",.5,1.1)
        board.destroy()
        outline.Enabled=false
        for _,p in ipairs(fish:GetDescendants())do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(.3),{Transparency=1,Size=p.Size*.3}):Play()end
        end
        task.wait(.35)
        fish:Destroy()
        if token==mine then reset()end
    end)

    local cast; cast = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if state~="idle" or not rod then return end
        local _,root=character()
        if not root then return end
        if not pond or (pond.Center-root.Position).Magnitude>34 then makePond();task.wait(.45)end
        if not pond then return end
        token+=1
        local mine=token
        state="casting"
        perfectHook=false
        -- wind up: body twists, rod goes back over the shoulder
        setPose("Windup",9)
        tween("Tilt",95,.32)
        tween("Bend",-10,.32)
        task.wait(.34)
        if token~=mine then return end
        -- whip: fast forward, the tip leaves a trail, line flies out
        play("cast",.65,1)
        rod.Trail.Enabled=true
        setPose("Whip",22)
        tween("Tilt",8,.16,"in")
        tween("Bend",22,.12)
        rodState.SpinSpeed=-40
        reelSound(.25,1.6)
        task.wait(.1)
        local a,d=math.random()*math.pi*2,math.random()*(pond.Radius-2)
        local landing=pond.Center+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*d,0,math.sin(a)*d)
        local from=rod.Tip.Position
        makeBobber(from)
        local t0,flight=os.clock(),.65
        while os.clock()-t0<flight and token==mine do
            local k=(os.clock()-t0)/flight
            local pos=from:Lerp(landing,k)+Vector3.new(0,math.sin(k*math.pi)*4,0)
            if bobber then bobber.CFrame=CFrame.new(pos)end
            setSlack(math.sin(k*math.pi)*2)
            task.wait()
        end
        if token~=mine or not bobber then return end
        rod.Trail.Enabled=false
        rodState.SpinSpeed=0
        reelSound(0)
        bobber.CFrame=CFrame.new(landing)
        tween("Tilt",28,.6)
        tween("Bend",0,.5,"back")
        setPose("Wait",5)
        play("splash",.55,1.2)
        splash(landing,20,nil,.8)
        ripple(landing,3.2,1.3)
        state="waiting"
        -- waiting: the bobber floats; nibbles make it twitch
        local entry,rarity,kg=rollStoreFish()
        local waitFor=2.5+math.random()*4
        local started=os.clock()
        local nextNibble=os.clock()+1+math.random()
        -- the real fish swims in the pond (just under the surface): first it wanders, then it circles in on the bobber
        local preview={}
        task.spawn(function()
            local m,pl,d=buildStoreFish({Name=entry.Name,Id=entry.Id,Len=math.min(entry.Len,2.2),Kg=entry.Kg,Rarity=entry.Rarity,Flip=entry.Flip},rarity)
            if token~=mine or state~="waiting" then m:Destroy();return end
            for _,d2 in ipairs(m:GetDescendants())do
                if d2:IsA("BasePart") and d2.Transparency<1 then
                    local want=math.max(d2.Transparency,.3)
                    d2.Transparency=1
                    TweenService:Create(d2,TweenInfo.new(.8),{Transparency=want}):Play()
                end
            end
            pl(CFrame.new(landing+Vector3.new(0,-.3,0)))
            preview.Model,preview.Place,preview.Dims=m,pl,d
        end)
        local swimAngle=math.random()*6.28
        local swimR=pond.Radius*.6
        local lastBubble=0
        while token==mine and state=="waiting" and os.clock()-started<waitFor do
            local t=os.clock()
            local left=waitFor-(t-started)
            if preview.Place then
                local closing=math.clamp(1-(left-.2)/2.4,0,1)
                local speed=.55+closing*2.6
                swimAngle+=speed/60
                swimR+=((pond.Radius*.6)*(1-closing)^1.4+.45-swimR)*math.min(1,(1/60)*3)
                local at=landing:Lerp(pond.Center,(1-closing)*.6)+Vector3.new(math.cos(swimAngle)*swimR,-preview.Dims.H*.32,math.sin(swimAngle)*swimR)
                local tangent=Vector3.new(-math.sin(swimAngle),0,math.cos(swimAngle))
                local cf=CFrame.lookAt(at,at+tangent)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.sin(t*(7+closing*8))*.22+.25,math.sin(t*3)*.05)
                preview.Place(cf)
                if t-lastBubble>.35 then
                    lastBubble=t
                    local s=.08+math.random()*.08
                    FX.spawn({Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(s,s,s),Color=Color3.fromRGB(220,240,255),Material=Enum.Material.Glass,Transparency=.3,
                        Reflectance=.4,Pos=(cf*CFrame.new(0,preview.Dims.H*.3,-preview.Dims.L*.45)).Position,Vel=Vector3.new(0,1.6,0),Life=.6,Grow=.4})
                    if math.random()<.4 then ripple(Vector3.new(at.X,landing.Y,at.Z),.9,.35)end
                end
            end
            local dip=0
            if t>nextNibble then
                dip=-.13
                ripple(landing,1.2,.7)
                play("tick",.22,.6)
                tween("Bend",6,.08)
                task.delay(.12,function()if state=="waiting" then tween("Bend",0,.3)end end)
                nextNibble=t+.7+math.random()*1.4
            end
            bobber.CFrame=CFrame.new(landing+Vector3.new(0,math.sin(t*2.4)*.07+dip,0))*CFrame.Angles(math.sin(t*1.7)*.12,0,math.cos(t*1.3)*.12)
            setSlack(1.4)
            task.wait()
        end
        if token~=mine or state~="waiting" then
            if preview.Model then preview.Model:Destroy()end
            task.delay(1,function()if preview.Model and preview.Model.Parent then preview.Model:Destroy()end end)
            return
        end
        -- it lunges at the bobber and vanishes under it
        if preview.Model then
            local m,pl,d=preview.Model,preview.Place,preview.Dims
            local startCf=m:FindFirstChild("Core") and m.Core.CFrame or CFrame.new(landing)
            task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                local t0=os.clock()
                while os.clock()-t0<.22 do
                    local k=(os.clock()-t0)/.22
                    local pos=startCf.Position:Lerp(landing+Vector3.new(0,-d.H*.2,0),k*k)
                    local dir=landing-startCf.Position
                    pl(CFrame.lookAt(pos,pos+(Vector3.new(dir.X,0,dir.Z).Magnitude>.01 and Vector3.new(dir.X,0,dir.Z).Unit or Vector3.new(0,0,-1)))*CFrame.Angles(0,math.sin(os.clock()*40)*.3,0))
                    task.wait()
                end
                for _,d2 in ipairs(m:GetDescendants())do
                    if d2:IsA("BasePart") then TweenService:Create(d2,TweenInfo.new(.2),{Transparency=1}):Play()end
                end
                task.delay(.25,function()m:Destroy()end)
            end))
        else
            task.delay(.5,function()if preview.Model then preview.Model:Destroy()end end)
        end

        if token~=mine or state~="waiting" then return end
        -- BITE: the bobber is yanked under, "!" pops, then you just tap
        state="bite"
        play("bite",.8,1)
        ripple(landing,4,1.7)
        splash(landing,22,nil,1)
        kick(1)
        -- a 3D "!" made of glowing pieces, bouncing above the bobber
        biteGui=Instance.new("Model")
        biteGui.Name="CrackHubBiteMark"
        local barPart=part({Name="Bar",Size=Vector3.new(.3,1,.3),Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,215,60),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,Parent=biteGui})
        local barMesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");barMesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Brick;barMesh.Parent=barPart
        local dotPart=part({Name="Dot",Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball,Size=Vector3.new(.36,.36,.36),Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,215,60),Material=Enum.Material.Neon,Parent=biteGui})
        local outline=Instance.new("Highlight");outline.FillTransparency=1;outline.OutlineColor=Color3.fromRGB(90,40,0);outline.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        outline.Parent=biteGui
        local markLight=Instance.new("PointLight");markLight.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,215,60);markLight.Range=8;markLight.Brightness=2;markLight.Parent=barPart
        biteGui.Parent=workspace
        local markBorn=os.clock()
        local mark=biteGui
        task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            while mark.Parent and bobber and bobber.Parent do
                local a=os.clock()-markBorn
                local pop=a<.25 and (1-(1-a/.25)^3)*1.25 or 1+.25*math.exp(-(a-.25)*6)*math.cos((a-.25)*20)
                local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
                local base=bobber.Position+Vector3.new(0,2.2+math.sin(a*8)*.15,0)
                local face=cam and (cam.CFrame.Position-base)*Vector3.new(1,0,1) or Vector3.new(0,0,1)
                local cf=CFrame.lookAt(base,base+(face.Magnitude>.1 and face.Unit or Vector3.new(0,0,1)))*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.sin(a*14)*.15)
                barPart.Size=Vector3.new(.3,1,.3)*pop
                dotPart.Size=Vector3.new(.36,.36,.36)*pop
                barPart.CFrame=cf*CFrame.new(0,.35*pop,0)
                dotPart.CFrame=cf*CFrame.new(0,-.45*pop,0)
                task.wait()
            end
        end))
        FX.shards(landing+Vector3.new(0,2.2,0),10,{Color3.fromRGB(255,215,60),Color3.new(1,1,1)},9,2)
        setPose("Hook",18)
        tween("Tilt",60,.15)
        tween("Bend",26,.15)
        task.wait(.45)
        if token==mine and state=="bite" then tapReel(entry,rarity,kg)end
    end)

    local function onActivated()
        if state=="idle" then
            task.spawn(cast)
        elseif state=="waiting" then
            play("tick",.3,.8)
            reset()
        end
    end
    connect(UserInputService.InputBegan,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Space then
            if state=="reeling" then holding=true end
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Space then
            holding=false
        end
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ the tool in your hotbar
    local function onEquip()
        if not alive then return end
        rodState.Tilt,rodState.Bend=35,0
        buildRod()
        startPose()
        local _,root=character()
        if root and (not pond or (pond.Center-root.Position).Magnitude>34)then task.spawn(makePond)end
    end
    local function onUnequip()
        reset()
        stopPose()
        removeRod()
    end
    local function removeTool()
        onUnequip()
        if tool then tool:Destroy();tool=nil end
    end
    local function giveTool()
        if tool and tool.Parent then return end
        local backpack=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if not backpack then return end
        tool=Instance.new("Tool")
        tool.Name="Fishing Rod"
        tool.ToolTip="Click to cast"
        tool.CanBeDropped=false
        tool.RequiresHandle=true
        local handle=Instance.new("Part")
        handle.Name="Handle"
        handle.Size=Vector3.new(.2,.2,.2)
        handle.Transparency=1
        handle.CanCollide=false
        handle.Massless=true
        handle.Parent=tool
        tool.Equipped:Connect(onEquip)
        tool.Unequipped:Connect(onUnequip)
        tool.Activated:Connect(onActivated)
        tool.Parent=backpack -- given before the round tools, so it takes slot 1
    end
    -- while Fish is on, skin / effect tabs are closed with a "404 · off fish" page and their switches are turned off
    local locked={}
    local function categoryOf(tab)
        local group=tab.Group and tab.Group.Name
        if group=="Cosmetics" then return "Changer" end
        if group=="Visuals" and tab.Name~="ESP" and tab.Name~="Fun" then return "Effects" end
        if tab.Name=="Inventory" then return "Inventory" end
        if group=="Fun" and tab.Name=="Skins" then return "Skins" end
        return nil
    end
    local function lockable(tab)return categoryOf(tab)~=nil end
    local function lockTab(tab)
        local holder=tab.Holder
        if not holder or locked[tab] then return end
        local hidden={}
        local entry={Hidden=hidden}
        local function hide(child)
            if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child~=entry.Page and child.Visible then hidden[child]=true;child.Visible=false end
        end
        for _,child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren())do hide(child)end
        entry.Added=holder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)task.defer(hide,child)end)
        local page=Create("Frame",{Name="OffFish",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,260),BackgroundTransparency=1,LayoutOrder=-100000,Parent=holder})
        entry.Page=page
        local code=Create("TextLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,0),Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,46),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(300,96),BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Text="404",FontFace=UI_H,TextSize=96,TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1),Parent=page},{Create("UIGradient",{Rotation=90,
            Color=ColorSequence.new(Theme.Text,Theme.Accent)})})
        Create("TextLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,0),Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,146),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(300,26),BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Text="off fish",FontFace=UI_H,TextSize=22,TextColor3=Theme.Accent,Parent=page})
        Create("TextLabel",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,0),Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,178),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(320,18),BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Text="Turn off Fish to use this tab",FontFace=UI_R,TextSize=13,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,Parent=page})
        code.TextTransparency=1
        TweenService:Create(code,TweenInfo.new(.4),{TextTransparency=0}):Play()
        locked[tab]=entry
        -- turn off what was switched on in this tab
        for _,chip in ipairs(CrackHub.BindRegistry or {})do
            local owner=chip.Owner
            if owner and owner.Type=="Toggle" and owner.Value==true and chip.Frame and chip.Frame:IsDescendantOf(holder) then
                pcall(function()owner:Set(false)end)
            end
        end
    end
    local function unlockTab(tab)
        local entry=locked[tab]
        if not entry then return end
        locked[tab]=nil
        if entry.Added then entry.Added:Disconnect()end
        if entry.Page then entry.Page:Destroy()end
        for child in pairs(entry.Hidden)do if child.Parent then child.Visible=true end end
    end
    local locksOn=false
    local caughtThisRun=0
    local UNLOCK_ORDER={"Changer","Effects","Inventory","Skins"}
    local unlockedStages={}
    local function setLocks(on)
        caughtThisRun=0
        unlockedStages={}
        for _,tab in ipairs(window.Tabs or {})do
            if lockable(tab) then if on then pcall(lockTab,tab) else pcall(unlockTab,tab) end end
        end
        -- the skin changer inside the game's own inventory: all changer skins and effects go away while Fish is on
        if on and not locksOn then
            if CrackHub.InventoryFishOff then pcall(CrackHub.InventoryFishOff)end
        elseif not on and locksOn then
            if CrackHub.InventoryFishOn then pcall(CrackHub.InventoryFishOn)end
        end
        locksOn=on
    end
    ------------------------------------------------------------------ your best fish becomes a pet that flies after you (wings, halo and hat stay on)
    local pet
    local function removePet()
        if pet then
            local old=pet
            pet=nil
            for _,d in ipairs(old.Model:GetDescendants())do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") then TweenService:Create(d,TweenInfo.new(.3),{Transparency=1}):Play()end
            end
            task.delay(.35,function()pcall(function()old.Model:Destroy()end)end)
        end
    end
    local function spawnPet()
        if not settings.Enabled or not log.Best then removePet();return end
        if pet and pet.Name==log.Best.Name then return end
        removePet()
        local entry
        for _,f in ipairs(STORE_FISH)do if f.Name==log.Best.Name then entry=f end end
        if not entry then return end
        local rarity=RARITY[log.Best.Rarity] or RARITIES[1]
        local small={Name=entry.Name,Id=entry.Id,Len=math.min(entry.Len,2.4),Kg=entry.Kg,Rarity=entry.Rarity,Flip=entry.Flip}
        local model,place,dims,body=buildStoreFish(small,rarity)
        model.Name="CrackHubFishPet"
        local halo,setGrow=buildHalo(model,dims,rarity)
        setGrow(1)
        local light=Instance.new("PointLight");light.Color=rarity.Color;light.Range=8;light.Brightness=1;light.Parent=body
        local me={Model=model,Name=entry.Name}
        pet=me
        task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local pos,vel=nil,Vector3.zero
            local look=Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
            local last=os.clock()
            while alive and pet==me and model.Parent do
                local now=os.clock()
                local dt=math.min(now-last,.1)
                last=now
                local _,root=character()
                if root then
                    -- floats behind your right shoulder, springy, turns where it flies
                    local target=(root.CFrame*CFrame.new(2.6,1.6+math.sin(now*2)*.35,2.4)).Position
                    if not pos or (target-pos).Magnitude>40 then pos=target;vel=Vector3.zero end
                    vel+=((target-pos)*26-vel*7)*dt
                    pos+=vel*dt
                    local move=Vector3.new(vel.X,0,vel.Z)
                    local want=move.Magnitude>.8 and move.Unit or (root.CFrame.LookVector*Vector3.new(1,0,1))
                    if want.Magnitude>.01 then look=look:Lerp(want.Unit,math.min(1,dt*5))end
                    if look.Magnitude<.01 then look=Vector3.new(0,0,-1)end
                    local cf=CFrame.lookAt(pos,pos+look.Unit)*CFrame.Angles(math.clamp(vel.Y*.03,-.3,.3),math.sin(now*5)*.14,math.sin(now*2.5)*.06)
                    place(cf)
                    halo(cf,now)
                end
                task.wait()
            end
        end))
    end
    -- every catch while Fish is on opens the next closed part again: 1 Changer, 2 Effects, 3 Inventory, 4 the rest
    CrackHub.FishCaught=function(entry,rarity,kg,isBest)
        if not settings.Enabled then return end
        caughtThisRun+=1
        -- the 4 parts open evenly over the number of fish set in "Fish to unlock all"
        local total=math.max(1,settings.UnlockCount or 4)
        local opened={}
        for index,stage in ipairs(UNLOCK_ORDER)do
            local need=math.max(1,math.ceil(index*total/#UNLOCK_ORDER))
            if caughtThisRun>=need and not unlockedStages[stage] then
                unlockedStages[stage]=true
                for tab in pairs(locked)do
                    if categoryOf(tab)==stage then pcall(unlockTab,tab)end
                end
                if stage=="Changer" and CrackHub.InventoryFishOn then pcall(CrackHub.InventoryFishOn)end
                table.insert(opened,stage)
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            local content=#opened>0 and (table.concat(opened,", ").." unlocked") or "Keep fishing to unlock more"
            CrackHub:Notify({Title="Fish · "..math.min(caughtThisRun,total).."/"..total,Content=content,Type=#opened>0 and "Success" or "Info",Duration=4})
        end)
        task.delay(4.5,spawnPet)
    end
    local function setEnabled(on)
        settings.Enabled=on
        setLocks(on)
        if on then
            giveTool()
            local _,_,hum=character()
            if hum and tool then pcall(function()hum:EquipTool(tool)end)end
            task.spawn(spawnPet)
        else
            removePet()
            removeTool()
            removePond()
        end
    end
    local function rebuildRod()
        if rod and tool and tool.Parent==LocalPlayer.Character then
            local wasState=state
            if wasState~="idle" then reset()end
            buildRod()
        end
    end
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded,function()
        tool,rod=nil,nil
        reset()
        stopPose()
        removePond()
        if settings.Enabled then task.delay(1.2,function()if settings.Enabled then giveTool()end end)end
    end)

    ------------------------------------------------------------------ tab: Visuals · Fishing
    task.spawn(function()
        local visuals
        for _=1,80 do
            for _,group in ipairs(window.TabGroups or {})do
                if group.Name=="Visuals" and group.CreateTab then visuals=group end
            end
            if visuals or not alive then break end
            task.wait(.5)
        end
        local tab=visuals and visuals:CreateTab("Fun") or window:CreateTab("Fun")
        -- make every sub-tab fit in the Visuals bar: tighter pills + mouse wheel scrolls the bar sideways
        local bar=visuals and visuals.Bar
        if bar then
            local function tighten()
                for _,pill in ipairs(bar:GetChildren())do
                    if pill:IsA("TextButton") then
                        local pad=pill:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
                        if pad then pad.PaddingLeft,pad.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,7),UDim.new(0,7)end
                        local label=pill:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
                        if label then label.TextSize=11 end
                    end
                end
                local list=bar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
                if list then list.Padding=UDim.new(0,2)end
            end
            tighten()
            connect(bar.ChildAdded,function()task.defer(tighten)end)
            connect(bar.InputChanged,function(input)
                if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
                    local max=math.max(0,bar.AbsoluteCanvasSize.X-bar.AbsoluteWindowSize.X)
                    bar.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(math.clamp(bar.CanvasPosition.X-input.Position.Z*40,0,max),0)
                end
            end)
        end
        local main=tab:AddGroup("Fish",true)
        main:AddToggle({Name="Fishing Rod",Description="Rod in slot 1 and a pond in front of you · skins and effects are off while it's on",Default=false,Callback=function(v)setEnabled(v)end})
        local names=function(list)local t={}for _,e in ipairs(list)do table.insert(t,e.Name)end return t end
        main:AddDropdown({Name="Rod Model",Options=names(ROD_MODELS),Default=settings.Model,Callback=function(v)
            if type(v)=="table" then v=v[1]end
            if v and v~=settings.Model then settings.Model=v;task.spawn(function()loadAsset(idOf(ROD_MODELS,v));rebuildRod()end)end
        end})
        main:AddDropdown({Name="Pond",Options=names(POND_MODELS),Default=settings.Pond,Callback=function(v)
            if type(v)=="table" then v=v[1]end
            if v and v~=settings.Pond then settings.Pond=v;if settings.Enabled and pond then task.spawn(makePond)end end
        end})
        main:AddDropdown({Name="Aura Style",Options=names(AURAS),Default=settings.AuraStyle,Callback=function(v)
            if type(v)=="table" then v=v[1]end
            if v and v~=settings.AuraStyle then
                settings.AuraStyle=v
                task.spawn(function()local e=auraEntry();if e.Id then loadAsset(e.Id)end;rebuildRod()end)
            end
        end})
        main:AddDropdown({Name="Rod Skin",Options=SKINS,Default="Classic",Callback=function(v)
            if type(v)=="table" then v=v[1]end
            if SKIN[v] then settings.Skin=v;rebuildRod()end
        end})
        main:AddToggle({Name="Rod Aura",Default=true,Bind=false,Callback=function(v)settings.Aura=v;rebuildRod()end})
        main:AddDropdown({Name="Catch Animation",Options={"Random","Hurricane","Cosmic Portal","Classic Storm"},Default="Random",Callback=function(v)
            if type(v)=="table" then v=v[1]end
            if v then settings.CatchStyle=v end
        end})
        main:AddSlider({Name="Fish to unlock all",Min=1,Max=20,Default=4,Increment=1,Callback=function(v)settings.UnlockCount=v end})
        main:AddToggle({Name="Cinematic Camera",Default=true,Bind=false,Callback=function(v)settings.Cinematic=v end})
        main:AddToggle({Name="Camera Shake",Default=true,Bind=false,Callback=function(v)settings.Shake=v end})
        main:AddButton({Name="Move pond here",Bind=false,Callback=function()if settings.Enabled then task.spawn(makePond)end end})
        local rockResult
        if CrackHub.InstallRock then
            local ok,res=pcall(CrackHub.InstallRock,window,tab,combat)
            if ok then rockResult=res else warn("[CrackHub Rock] "..tostring(res))end
        end
        local brainResult
        if CrackHub.InstallFlyBrain then
            local ok,res=pcall(CrackHub.InstallFlyBrain,window,tab)
            if ok then brainResult=res else warn("[CrackHub Fly Brain] "..tostring(res))end
        end
        -- One Visuals > Fun page; all seven sections share the available width.
        local weaponResult
        if CrackHub.InstallWeapons then
            local ok, res = pcall(CrackHub.InstallWeapons, window, tab)
            if ok then weaponResult = res else
                warn("[CrackHub Weapons] " .. tostring(res))
                CrackHub:Notify({Title="Weapons",Content=tostring(res),Type="Error",Duration=8})
            end
        end
        local function rootOf(group)
            local frame = group and group.Holder
            while frame and frame.Parent and frame.Parent ~= tab.Holder do frame = frame.Parent end
            return frame
        end
        local sections = {
            Fish = {rootOf(main)}, Rock = {rockResult and rootOf(rockResult.Group)},
            ["Fly Brain"] = {brainResult and rootOf(brainResult.Group)},
        }
        for name, group in pairs(weaponResult and weaponResult.Groups or {}) do
            sections[name] = {rootOf(group)}
        end
        local order = {"Fish","Rock","Fly Brain","AK-47","RPG","Drone","Grenade"}
        local bar = Create("Frame", {
            Name="FunSubTabs",Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,78),BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element,
            BackgroundTransparency=.35,LayoutOrder=-100000,Parent=tab.Holder,
        }, {Corner(10),Padding(4,4,4,4),Create("UIGridLayout", {
            CellSize=UDim2.new(.25,-3,0,32),CellPadding=UDim2.fromOffset(4,4),
            FillDirectionMaxCells=4,SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        })})
        local buttons = {}
        local function selectSection(name)
            for key, list in pairs(sections) do
                for _, frame in ipairs(list) do if frame then frame.Visible = key == name end end
            end
            for key, button in pairs(buttons) do
                TweenService:Create(button,TweenInfo.new(.15),{
                    BackgroundTransparency=key==name and .15 or 1,
                    TextColor3=key==name and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Theme.SubText,
                }):Play()
            end
            tab.Holder.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
        end
        for index, name in ipairs(order) do
            local button = Create("TextButton", {
                Name=name,LayoutOrder=index,BackgroundColor3=Theme.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=name,FontFace=UI_B,TextSize=13,
                TextColor3=Theme.SubText,AutoButtonColor=false,Parent=bar,
            }, {Corner(8)})
            connect(button.MouseButton1Click,function()selectSection(name)end)
            buttons[name]=button
        end
        -- No menu viewport competes with the controls for horizontal space.
        tab.Holder.ScrollBarThickness=5
        selectSection("Fish")

    end)

    connect(window.Gui.Destroying,function()
        alive=false
        token+=1
        pcall(removeTool)
        pcall(removePond)
        pcall(setLocks,false)
        pcall(removePet)
        pcall(function()RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CrackHubFishingShake")end)
        pcall(function()RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CrackHubFishingCine")end)
        pcall(function()FX.Folder:Destroy()end)
        if cineStopRef then pcall(cineStopRef)end
        pcall(function()screen:Destroy()end)
        for _,s in pairs(sounds)do pcall(function()s:Destroy()end)end
        for _,c in ipairs(connections)do c:Disconnect()end
    end)
end

local function InstallWorldVisualTabs(window, visualGroup, worldTab)
	local weatherTab = visualGroup:CreateTab("Weather")
	local skyTab = visualGroup:CreateTab("Sky")
	local cleanup, connections = {}, {}
	local alive = true
	local function connect(signal, callback)
		local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
		table.insert(connections, connection)
		return connection
	end
	local function stop()
		if not alive then return end
		alive = false
		for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
		for i = #cleanup, 1, -1 do pcall(cleanup[i]) end
	end
	connect(window.Gui.Destroying, stop)
	connect(window.Gui.AncestryChanged, function(_, parent)
		if not parent then stop() end
	end)

	local function create(class, properties, parent)
		if not parent then return Create(class, properties) end
		local options = table.clone(properties)
		options.Parent = parent
		return Create(class, options)
	end
	local function corner(object, radius)
		local rounding = Corner(radius)
		rounding.Parent = object
	end
	local function palette(name)
		if name == "Accent" then return Theme.Accent end
		if name == "Text" then return Theme.Text end
		if name == "Muted" then return Theme.SubText end
		if name == "Glass" then return Theme.SubText end
		return Theme.Card or Theme.Background
	end
	local function paint(object, property, name)
		object[property] = palette(name)
	end
	local function label(options)
		return create("TextLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = options.Text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold,
			TextSize = options.Size, Position = options.Pos, Size = options.Box,
			TextColor3 = palette(options.Color), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextTruncate = options.Truncate and Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd or Enum.TextTruncate.None,
			ZIndex = options.Z or options.Parent.ZIndex + 1,
		}, options.Parent)
	end
	local nova = {Theme = {bind = paint}, paint = paint, label = label, Font = {Semi = function() return Enum.Font.GothamSemibold end}}
	local translation = {tr = function(text) return text end, bind = function() end}
	local columns = {}
	local pages = {Shaders = worldTab, Weather = weatherTab, WeatherSky = skyTab, SkyFX = skyTab, Sky = skyTab}
	local function wrap(control, toCode, toLabel)
		local function set(value, silent) control:Set(toLabel and (toLabel[value] or value) or value, silent) end
		return {
			Set = set,
			SetSilent = function(value) set(value, true) end,
			Get = function() return toCode and (toCode[control.Value] or control.Value) or control.Value end,
		}
	end
	local section = {}
	function section:Sub(name)
		self.page = assert(pages[name], "Unknown visual tab: " .. name)
		self.group = nil
	end
	function section:Columns()
		if not columns[self.page] then columns[self.page] = {self.page:AddColumns(2)} end
	end
	function section:Group(options)
		self:Columns()
		local column = columns[self.page][options.Side == "Right" and 2 or 1]
		self.groupName = options.Title
		self.group = column:AddGroup(options.Title, true)
		return self.group
	end
	function section:Container() return self.group.Holder end
	local function flag(group, text, name)
		return ("VisualPort_" .. name .. "_" .. group .. "_" .. text):gsub("[^%w_]", "_")
	end
	function section:Toggle(options)
		local group = self.group
		local control = group:AddToggle({Name = options.Text, Default = options.Default,
			Flag = flag(self.groupName or "", options.Text, self.page.Name), Callback = options.Callback})
		if options.Settings then
			self.group = group:AddGroup(options.Text .. " Settings", true)
			local groupName = self.groupName
			self.groupName = (groupName or "") .. "_" .. options.Text
			options.Settings()
			self.groupName = groupName
			self.group = group
		end
		return wrap(control)
	end
	function section:Slider(options)
		return wrap(self.group:AddSlider({Name = options.Text, Min = options.Min, Max = options.Max,
			Default = options.Default, Increment = 10 ^ -(options.Decimals or 0), Suffix = options.Suffix,
			Flag = flag(self.groupName or "", options.Text, self.page.Name), Callback = options.Callback}))
	end
	function section:Dropdown(options)
		local labels, codes, names = {}, {}, {}
		for _, option in ipairs(options.Options) do
			table.insert(labels, option.label)
			codes[option.label], names[option.code] = option.code, option.label
		end
		return wrap(self.group:AddDropdown({Name = options.Text, Options = labels,
			Default = names[options.Default] or options.Default,
			Flag = not options.NoSave and flag(self.groupName or "", options.Text, self.page.Name) or nil,
			Callback = function(value) if value ~= nil then options.Callback(codes[value] or value) end end}), codes, names)
	end
	function section:Colorpicker(options)
		return wrap(self.group:AddColorPicker({Name = options.Text, Default = options.Default, VisualPalette = true,
			Flag = flag(self.groupName or "", options.Text, self.page.Name), Callback = options.Callback}))
	end
	function section:Button(options)
		return self.group:AddButton({Name = options.Text, Callback = options.Callback})
	end

	local assets = {
		["CrackHub/sky_fx_v6.jpg"]=[=[]=],

		["CrackHub/textures/weather/sky_aurora3-13793.jpg"]=[=[]=],

		["CrackHub/textures/weather/sky_fiery-10441.jpg"]=[=[]=],
		["CrackHub/textures/weather/sky_golden-6397.jpg"]=[=[]=],
		["CrackHub/textures/weather/sky_mountains-3763.jpg"]=[=[]=],

	}
	local paths = {}
	local host = getfenv()
	local resolveAsset = host.getcustomasset or host.getsynasset
	local function getPreview(path)
		if paths[path] ~= nil then return paths[path] or nil end
		local encoded = assets[path]
		if not encoded or type(resolveAsset) ~= "function" or type(host.writefile) ~= "function" then return nil end
		local file = "CrackHub/VisualPreviews/" .. path:match("[^/]+$")
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			if type(host.makefolder) == "function" then
				pcall(host.makefolder, "CrackHub")
				pcall(host.makefolder, "CrackHub/VisualPreviews")
			end
			if type(host.isfile) ~= "function" or not host.isfile(file) then host.writefile(file, Base64Decode(encoded)) end
			return resolveAsset(file)
		end)
		paths[path] = ok and type(result) == "string" and result or false
		return paths[path] or nil
	end
	local sharedState = {}
	local environment = setmetatable({getcustomasset = getPreview, getgenv = function() return sharedState end}, {__index = host})
	local players = game:GetService("Players")
	local context = {
		environment = environment, section = section, configuration = {}, applyHooks = {},
		workspace = workspace, lighting = game:GetService("Lighting"), players = players, player = players.LocalPlayer,
		coreGui = window.Gui.Parent, materialService = game:GetService("MaterialService"),
		runService = game:GetService("RunService"), inputService = game:GetService("UserInputService"),
		connect = connect, isAlive = function() return alive and window.Gui.Parent ~= nil end,
		create = create, corner = corner, nova = nova, translation = translation,
	}
