		return SkyFx.create(state, "Part", parent, {Name = name, Anchored = true, CanCollide = false, CanTouch = false,
			CanQuery = false, CastShadow = false, Transparency = 1, Locked = true, Size = env.Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)})
	end)

	SkyFx.emitter = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, parent, texture, life, speed, brightness, locked)
		local env = state.context.environment
		return SkyFx.create(state, "ParticleEmitter", parent, {Enabled = false, Rate = 0, Texture = texture,
			LightEmission = 1, LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = brightness, Lifetime = env.NumberRange.new(life[1], life[2] or life[1]),
			Speed = env.NumberRange.new(speed and speed[1] or 0, speed and (speed[2] or speed[1]) or 0),
			LockedToPart = locked == true, Orientation = env.Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera})
	end)

	SkyFx.sequence = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, points)
		local env, result = state.context.environment, {}
		for _, point in ipairs(points) do table.insert(result, env.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], point[2], point[3] or 0)) end
		return env.NumberSequence.new(result)
	end)

	SkyFx.rainbow = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, offset)
		local env, result = state.context.environment, {}
		for index = 0, 6 do table.insert(result, env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(index / 6, env.Color3.fromHSV((offset + index / 6) % 1, 0.55, 1))) end
		return env.ColorSequence.new(result)
	end)

	SkyFx.particle = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, parent, texture, life, speed, brightness, locked, sphere)
		local emitter = SkyFx.emitter(state, parent, texture, life, speed, brightness, locked)
		local env = state.context.environment
		emitter.Shape = sphere and env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Sphere or env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
		emitter.ShapeStyle = sphere and env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Surface or env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
		if sphere then
			emitter.ShapeInOut, emitter.EmissionDirection = env.Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Outward, env.Enum.NormalId.Top
			pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() emitter.ShapePartial = 0.5 end))
		end
		return emitter
	end)

	SkyFx.buildParticles = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, folder)
		local env, texture = state.context.environment, SKY_FX_TEXTURES
		local part = SkyFx.part(state, folder, name)
		local fx = {folder = folder, part = part, dirty = true, filled = false}
		if name == "stars" then
			fx.small = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.dot, {4, 9}, nil, 2.6, true, true)
			fx.tint = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.dot, {4, 8}, nil, 2.8, true, true)
			fx.big = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.spark, {5, 10}, nil, 3, true, true)
			return fx
		end
		if name == "runes" then
			part.Size = env.Vector3.new(80, 22, 80)
			fx.main = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.runes, {6, 10}, {0.5, 1.5}, 2.6)
			fx.main.Drag, fx.main.EmissionDirection, fx.main.SpreadAngle = 0.3, env.Enum.NormalId.Top, env.Vector2.new(25, 25)
			fx.main.FlipbookLayout, fx.main.FlipbookMode = env.Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4, env.Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
			fx.main.FlipbookFramerate, fx.main.FlipbookStartRandom = env.NumberRange.new(0, 0), true
			fx.glow = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.dot, {3, 6}, {0.3, 1}, 2)
			fx.glow.EmissionDirection = env.Enum.NormalId.Top
			return fx
		end
		part.Size = env.Vector3.new(90, 30, 90)
		fx.main = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.spark, {4, 8}, {0.1, 0.5}, 2.6)
		fx.glow = SkyFx.particle(state, part, texture.dot, {3, 7}, {0.1, 0.4}, 2.2)
		fx.main.SpreadAngle, fx.glow.SpreadAngle = env.Vector2.new(180, 180), env.Vector2.new(180, 180)
		fx.main.Acceleration, fx.glow.Acceleration = env.Vector3.new(0, -0.15, 0), env.Vector3.new(0, -0.1, 0)
		return fx
	end)

	SkyFx.applyStars = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx)
		local env, cfg, radius = state.context.environment, state.cfg.stars, state.radius
		local brightness, size = state.cfg.general.bright / 100, cfg.size / 100
		fx.part.Size = env.Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * math.min(radius * 2, 2040)
		local twinkle = 0.08 + 0.62 * cfg.twinkle / 100
		local transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.1, 0.04}, {0.22, twinkle}, {0.34, 0.04}, {0.46, twinkle * 0.8},
			{0.58, 0.04}, {0.7, twinkle}, {0.82, 0.08}, {1, 1}})
		fx.small.Transparency, fx.tint.Transparency = transparency, transparency
		fx.small.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, radius * 0.03 * size, radius * 0.012 * size}, {1, radius * 0.03 * size, radius * 0.012 * size}})
		fx.tint.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, radius * 0.036 * size, radius * 0.012 * size}, {1, radius * 0.036 * size, radius * 0.012 * size}})
		local large = radius * 0.055 * size
		fx.big.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0}, {0.14, large}, {0.3, large * 0.55}, {0.46, large}, {0.62, large * 0.6}, {0.8, large}, {1, 0}})
		fx.big.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.12, 0.05}, {0.88, 0.1}, {1, 1}})
		fx.small.Brightness, fx.tint.Brightness, fx.big.Brightness = 2.6 * brightness, 2.8 * brightness, 3 * brightness
		fx.small.Rate, fx.tint.Rate, fx.big.Rate = cfg.density * 1.25, cfg.density * 0.36, cfg.density * 0.07
		fx.small.Enabled, fx.tint.Enabled, fx.big.Enabled = cfg.density > 0, cfg.density > 0, cfg.density > 0
		if cfg.tint == "Rainbow" then
			fx.small.Color, fx.tint.Color, fx.big.Color = SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0), SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0.5), SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0.25)
		else
			local colors = state.palettes.stars[cfg.tint] or state.palettes.stars.Natural
			fx.small.Color, fx.tint.Color, fx.big.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(colors[1]), env.ColorSequence.new(colors[2], colors[3]), env.ColorSequence.new(colors[1])
		end
		if not fx.filled and cfg.density > 0 then
			fx.filled = true
			fx.small:Emit(math.floor(cfg.density * 3.6))
			fx.tint:Emit(math.floor(cfg.density))
			fx.big:Emit(math.floor(cfg.density * 0.2))
		end
	end)

	SkyFx.applyRunes = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx)
		local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.runes
		local size, brightness = cfg.size / 100, state.cfg.general.bright / 100
		fx.main.Texture = cfg.set == "Glyphs" and SKY_FX_TEXTURES.glyphs or SKY_FX_TEXTURES.runes
		fx.main.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1.02 * size}, {0.15, 1.7 * size}, {0.85, 1.7 * size}, {1, 1.36 * size}})
		fx.main.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.15, 0.05}, {0.75, 0.15}, {1, 1}})
		fx.glow.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.5 * size}, {1, 0}})
		fx.glow.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.3}, {1, 1}})
		fx.main.Color, fx.glow.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color), env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color)
		fx.main.Brightness, fx.glow.Brightness = 2.6 * brightness, 2 * brightness
		fx.main.Rate, fx.glow.Rate = cfg.amount * 0.32, cfg.amount * 0.3
		fx.main.Enabled, fx.glow.Enabled = cfg.amount > 0, cfg.amount > 0
		if not fx.filled and cfg.amount > 0 then fx.filled = true; fx.main:Emit(math.floor(cfg.amount * 1.6)) end
	end)

	SkyFx.applyDust = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx)
		local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.dust
		fx.main.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0}, {0.15, 0.75}, {0.3, 0.2625}, {0.45, 0.75}, {0.6, 0.3}, {0.78, 0.75}, {1, 0}})
		fx.main.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.12, 0}, {0.85, 0.1}, {1, 1}})
		fx.glow.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.38}, {1, 0.14}})
		fx.glow.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.15, 0.1}, {0.5, 0.5}, {0.75, 0.1}, {1, 1}})
		if cfg.palette == "Rainbow" then fx.main.Color, fx.glow.Color = SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0), SkyFx.rainbow(state, 0.4)
		else
			local colors = state.palettes.dust[cfg.palette] or state.palettes.dust.Gold
			fx.main.Color, fx.glow.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(colors[1]), env.ColorSequence.new(colors[2])
		end
		local brightness = state.cfg.general.bright / 100
		fx.main.Brightness, fx.glow.Brightness = 3.2 * brightness, 2.6 * brightness
		fx.main.Rate, fx.glow.Rate = cfg.amount * 0.9, cfg.amount * 1.1
		fx.main.Enabled, fx.glow.Enabled = cfg.amount > 0, cfg.amount > 0
		if not fx.filled and cfg.amount > 0 then
			fx.filled = true
			fx.main:Emit(math.floor(cfg.amount * 3))
			fx.glow:Emit(math.floor(cfg.amount * 3))
		end
	end)

	SkyFx.beam = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, parent, first, second, brightness)
		local env = state.context.environment
		return SkyFx.create(state, "Beam", parent, {Attachment0 = first, Attachment1 = second, FaceCamera = true, LightEmission = 1,
			LightInfluence = 0, Brightness = brightness, Segments = 1, Width0 = 0, Width1 = 1,
			Texture = SKY_FX_TEXTURES.beam, TextureMode = env.Enum.TextureMode.Stretch, Enabled = false})
	end)

	SkyFx.buildTrails = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, folder)
		local env = state.context.environment
		local anchor = SkyFx.part(state, folder, name .. "Anchor")
		anchor.CFrame = env.CFrame.new()
		local fx = {folder = folder, anchor = anchor, pool = {}, dirty = true, nextSpawn = state.time + (name == "meteors" and 0.5 or 1.2)}
		local count = name == "meteors" and 7 or 2
		for _ = 1, count do
			local first, second = SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", anchor), SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", anchor)
			local trail = {first = first, second = second, beams = {}, active = false}
			if name == "comets" then trail.ion = SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", anchor) end
			local beamCount = name == "meteors" and 2 or 5
			for index = 1, beamCount do
				local beam = SkyFx.beam(state, anchor, first, index > 3 and trail.ion or second, index == 1 and 3.2 or 1.4)
				if name == "comets" then beam.Segments = index <= 3 and 24 or 12 end
				table.insert(trail.beams, beam)
			end
			trail.head = SkyFx.part(state, folder, name .. "Head")
			trail.head.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
			trail.glow = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.soft, {name == "meteors" and 30 or 60}, nil, 1.4, true)
			trail.star = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, name == "meteors" and SKY_FX_TEXTURES.spark or SKY_FX_TEXTURES.dot,
				{name == "meteors" and 30 or 60}, nil, 3, true)
			trail.dust = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.dot, {0.3, 0.8}, {0.2, 1}, 2.2)
			trail.dust.SpreadAngle = env.Vector2.new(180, 180)
			if name == "comets" then
				trail.flare = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.spark, {1.6, 2.4}, nil, 2.4, true)
				trail.dust2 = SkyFx.emitter(state, trail.head, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.dot, {2, 4}, {0.2, 1.5}, 2)
				trail.dust2.SpreadAngle = env.Vector2.new(180, 180)
			end
			table.insert(fx.pool, trail)
		end
		return fx
	end)

	SkyFx.applyTrails = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, fx)
		local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg[name]
		local scale = name == "comets" and cfg.size / 100 or 1
		for _, trail in ipairs(fx.pool) do
			for _, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do beam.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color) end
			local white = env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			if name == "meteors" then
				trail.beams[1].Color = env.ColorSequence.new({env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, cfg.color),
					env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, cfg.color:Lerp(white, 0.5)), env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, white)})
			else
				trail.beams[1].Color = env.ColorSequence.new({env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, white),
					env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.12, cfg.color:Lerp(white, 0.35)), env.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, cfg.color)})
				trail.beams[2].Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color:Lerp(white, 0.3), cfg.color)
				trail.beams[4].Color = env.ColorSequence.new(white, env.Color3.fromRGB(120, 175, 255))
				trail.beams[5].Color = env.ColorSequence.new(env.Color3.fromRGB(120, 175, 255))
			end
			trail.glow.Color, trail.dust.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color), env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color)
			trail.glow.Size, trail.star.Size = env.NumberSequence.new(state.radius * 0.032 * scale), env.NumberSequence.new(state.radius * 0.03 * scale)
			trail.dust.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, state.radius * 0.007 * scale}, {1, 0}})
			trail.dust.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.1}, {1, 1}})
			if name == "comets" then
				trail.flare.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, state.radius * 0.042 * scale}, {0.5, state.radius * 0.07 * scale}, {1, state.radius * 0.042 * scale}})
				trail.flare.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.3, 0.2}, {0.7, 0.2}, {1, 1}})
				trail.dust2.Size = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, state.radius * 0.006 * scale}, {1, 0}})
				trail.dust2.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 0.2}, {1, 1}})
				trail.dust2.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color)
			end
		end
	end)

	SkyFx.direction = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, azimuth, elevation)
		local cos = math.cos(elevation)
		return state.context.environment.Vector3.new(cos * math.cos(azimuth), math.sin(elevation), cos * math.sin(azimuth))
	end)

	SkyFx.arc = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(first, second, t)
		local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(first:Dot(second), -1, 1))
		if angle < 0.0001 then return first end
		local sine = math.sin(angle)
		return first * (math.sin((1 - t) * angle) / sine) + second * (math.sin(t * angle) / sine)
	end)

	SkyFx.spawnTrail = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, fx, look)
		local trail
		for _, candidate in ipairs(fx.pool) do if not candidate.active then trail = candidate; break end end
		if not trail then return end
		local comet = name == "comets"
		local azimuth = math.atan2(look.Z, look.X) + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * (comet and 0.96 or 1.05)
		if not comet and math.random() >= 0.8 then azimuth = math.random() * math.pi * 2 end
		local elevation = math.rad(comet and 26 + math.random() * 26 or 30 + math.random() * 42)
		local direction = math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1
		trail.start = SkyFx.direction(state, azimuth, elevation)
		trail.finish = SkyFx.direction(state, azimuth + direction * math.rad(comet and 26 + math.random() * 18 or 16 + math.random() * 24),
			elevation + math.rad(comet and -12 + math.random() * 20 or -14 - math.random() * 14))
		trail.started, trail.duration, trail.active = state.time, comet and 18 + math.random() * 10 or 0.6 + math.random() * 0.7, true
		trail.tail = comet and 0.3 or 0.3 * state.cfg.meteors.length / 100 * (0.8 + math.random() * 0.45)
		for _, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do beam.Enabled = true end
		trail.glow:Emit(1)
		trail.star:Emit(1)
		trail.dust.Rate, trail.dust.Enabled = comet and 26 or 80, true
		if comet then
			trail.flare.Rate, trail.flare.Enabled = 1.4, true
			trail.dust2.Rate, trail.dust2.Enabled = 34, true
		end
	end)

	SkyFx.stepTrails = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, fx, position, look)
		local cfg = state.cfg[name]
		local comet = name == "comets"
		if state.time >= fx.nextSpawn then
			SkyFx.spawnTrail(state, name, fx, look)
			local delay = comet and 6 + 70 * (1 - cfg.rate / 100) ^ 2 or 0.3 + 9 * (1 - cfg.rate / 100) ^ 2
			fx.nextSpawn = state.time + delay * (comet and 0.5 + math.random() or 0.35 + 1.3 * math.random())
		end
		local brightness = state.cfg.general.bright / 100
		for _, trail in ipairs(fx.pool) do
			if not trail.active then continue end
			local progress = (state.time - trail.started) / trail.duration
			if progress >= 1 + (comet and 0 or trail.tail) then
				trail.active, trail.dust.Enabled = false, false
				if comet then trail.flare.Enabled, trail.dust2.Enabled = false, false end
				for _, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do beam.Enabled = false end
				trail.glow:Clear()
				trail.star:Clear()
				trail.head.CFrame = state.context.environment.CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
				continue
			end
			local direction = SkyFx.arc(trail.start, trail.finish, math.min(progress, 1))
			local head = position + direction * state.radius
			local fade
			if comet then
				local ahead = SkyFx.arc(trail.start, trail.finish, math.min(progress + 0.01, 1)) - direction
				local tangent = ahead.Magnitude > 1e-6 and ahead.Unit or state.context.environment.Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
				local side = tangent:Cross(direction).Unit
				local size = cfg.size / 100
				local dust = (direction - tangent * 0.3 * size + side * 0.04 * size).Unit
				local ion = (direction - tangent * 0.42 * size - side * 0.02 * size).Unit
				trail.first.CFrame = state.context.environment.CFrame.fromMatrix(head, side, direction)
				trail.second.CFrame = state.context.environment.CFrame.fromMatrix(position + dust * state.radius, side, dust)
				trail.ion.Position = position + ion * state.radius
				fade = math.clamp(math.min(progress * trail.duration / 2.5, (1 - progress) * trail.duration / 3), 0, 1)
				local widths = {{0.022, 0.08}, {0.04, 0.15}, {0.065, 0.24}, {0.012, 0.03}, {0.026, 0.07}}
				local alphas = {0.75, 0.45, 0.25, 0.7, 0.3}
				local levels = {1.4, 0.9, 0.6, 1.8, 0.8}
				for index, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do
					beam.Width0, beam.Width1 = state.radius * size * widths[index][1], state.radius * size * widths[index][2]
					beam.CurveSize0, beam.CurveSize1 = index <= 3 and state.radius * 0.05 * size or 0, 0
					beam.Brightness = levels[index] * brightness
					beam.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1 - alphas[index] * fade}, {1, 1}})
				end
				trail.flare.Brightness, trail.dust2.Brightness = 2.4 * brightness * fade, 2 * brightness * fade
			else
				local tail = position + SkyFx.arc(trail.start, trail.finish, math.clamp(progress - trail.tail, 0, 1)) * state.radius
				trail.first.Position, trail.second.Position = tail, head
				fade = math.clamp(math.min(progress / 0.12, (1 + trail.tail - progress) / (trail.tail + 0.2)), 0, 1)
				for index, beam in ipairs(trail.beams) do
					beam.Width0, beam.Width1 = 0, state.radius * (index == 1 and 0.016 or 0.055)
					beam.Brightness = (index == 1 and 3.2 or 1.4) * brightness
					beam.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {1, 1 - fade * (index == 1 and 1 or 0.4)}})
				end
			end
			trail.head.CFrame = state.context.environment.CFrame.new(head)
			trail.glow.Brightness, trail.star.Brightness = 1.4 * brightness * fade, 3 * brightness * fade
			if progress > 0.95 and not comet then trail.dust.Enabled = false end
		end
	end)

	SkyFx.buildNet = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, folder)
		local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.net
		local fx = {folder = folder, nodes = {}, links = {}, dirty = true, count = math.clamp(math.floor(cfg.nodes), 8, 140), place = cfg.place, linkClock = 1}
		local look = state.camera.CFrame.LookVector
		local forward = math.atan2(look.Z, look.X)
		for index = 1, fx.count do
			local part = SkyFx.part(state, folder, "Node")
			local attachment = SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", part)
			local emitter = SkyFx.emitter(state, part, index % 6 == 0 and SKY_FX_TEXTURES.spark or SKY_FX_TEXTURES.dot, {12}, nil, 2.8, true)
			local node = {part = part, attachment = attachment, emitter = emitter, big = index % 6 == 0,
				azimuth = math.random() < 0.75 and forward + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 1.25 or math.random() * math.pi * 2,
				elevation = math.rad(14 + math.random() * 58),
				drift = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.022, vertical = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.014,
				relative = env.Vector3.new((math.random() * 2 - 1) * 44, -10 + math.random() * 24, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 44),
				velocity = env.Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.4, math.random() * 2 - 1),
				nextEmit = state.time + math.random() * 6, hue = math.random()}
			table.insert(fx.nodes, node)
		end
		fx.cursorAnchor = SkyFx.part(state, folder, "CursorAnchor")
		fx.cursorAnchor.CFrame = env.CFrame.new()
		fx.cursor = SkyFx.create(state, "Attachment", fx.cursorAnchor)
		for _ = 1, fx.count * 2 + 6 do
			local beam = SkyFx.beam(state, folder, nil, nil, 1.8)
			local pulse = SkyFx.beam(state, folder, nil, nil, 3)
			pulse.Texture, pulse.TextureMode = SKY_FX_TEXTURES.rays, env.Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
			table.insert(fx.links, {beam = beam, pulse = pulse})
		end
		fx.shell = SkyFx.part(state, folder, "Constellations")
		fx.figures = {SkyFx.particle(state, fx.shell, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.const1, {9, 13}, nil, 1.8, true, true),
			SkyFx.particle(state, fx.shell, SKY_FX_TEXTURES.const2, {9, 13}, nil, 1.8, true, true)}
		return fx
	end)

	SkyFx.applyNet = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx)
		local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.net
		local sky, brightness = cfg.place ~= "Around me", state.cfg.general.bright / 100
		for _, node in ipairs(fx.nodes) do
			local size = sky and state.radius * (node.big and 0.06 or 0.036) or (node.big and 1.7 or 1)
			node.emitter.Size = env.NumberSequence.new(size)
			node.emitter.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color:Lerp(env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.45))
			node.emitter.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.15, 0}, {0.85, 0}, {1, 1}})
			node.emitter.Brightness = 2.8 * brightness
			if not node.seeded then node.seeded = true; node.emitter:Emit(1) end
		end
		for _, link in ipairs(fx.links) do
			local width = sky and state.radius * 0.0075 or 0.16
			link.beam.Width0, link.beam.Width1 = width, width
			link.pulse.Width0, link.pulse.Width1 = width * 1.9, width * 1.9
			link.pulse.TextureLength, link.pulse.TextureSpeed = sky and state.radius * 0.2 or 7, 0.35 + 0.6 * cfg.speed / 100
			link.beam.Color, link.pulse.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color), env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color)
			link.beam.Brightness, link.pulse.Brightness = 1.8 * brightness, 5 * brightness
		end
		fx.shell.Size = env.Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * math.min(state.radius * 1.9, 2040)
		for _, emitter in ipairs(fx.figures) do
			emitter.Size, emitter.Color = env.NumberSequence.new(state.radius * 0.2), env.ColorSequence.new(cfg.color:Lerp(env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.4))
			emitter.Transparency = SkyFx.sequence(state, {{0, 1}, {0.25, 0.3}, {0.75, 0.3}, {1, 1}})
			emitter.Brightness, emitter.Rate, emitter.Enabled = 1.8 * brightness, 0.06, sky and cfg.figures
		end
		fx.linkClock = 1
	end)

	SkyFx.linkNet = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx)
		local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.net
		local sky = cfg.place ~= "Around me"
		local maxDistance = sky and 2 * state.radius * 0.92 * math.sin(math.rad(5 + 20 * cfg.reach / 100) / 2) or 10 + 24 * cfg.reach / 100
		local used, degrees = 0, {}
		local connect; connect = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(firstNode, attachment)
			if used >= #fx.links then return end
			used += 1
			local link = fx.links[used]
			link.beam.Attachment0, link.beam.Attachment1 = firstNode.attachment, attachment
			link.pulse.Attachment0, link.pulse.Attachment1 = firstNode.attachment, attachment
			link.beam.Enabled, link.pulse.Enabled = true, cfg.pulses
			local color = cfg.rainbow and env.Color3.fromHSV((firstNode.hue + state.time * 0.05) % 1, 0.6, 1) or cfg.color
			link.beam.Color, link.pulse.Color = env.ColorSequence.new(color), env.ColorSequence.new(color)
		end)
		for first = 1, #fx.nodes do
			for second = first + 1, #fx.nodes do
				if (degrees[first] or 0) >= 4 then break end
				if (degrees[second] or 0) >= 4 then continue end
				local firstNode, secondNode = fx.nodes[first], fx.nodes[second]
				if (firstNode.position - secondNode.position).Magnitude > maxDistance then continue end
				degrees[first], degrees[second] = (degrees[first] or 0) + 1, (degrees[second] or 0) + 1
				connect(firstNode, secondNode.attachment)
			end
		end
		if fx.cursorPosition then
			local nearest = {}
			for _, node in ipairs(fx.nodes) do
				local distance = (node.position - fx.cursorPosition).Magnitude
				if distance <= maxDistance * 1.3 then table.insert(nearest, {node = node, distance = distance}) end
			end
			table.sort(nearest, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a, b) return a.distance < b.distance end))
			for index = 1, math.min(6, #nearest) do connect(nearest[index].node, fx.cursor) end
		end
		for index = used + 1, #fx.links do fx.links[index].beam.Enabled, fx.links[index].pulse.Enabled = false, false end
	end)

	SkyFx.cursor = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx, position)
		if not state.cfg.net.cursor then return nil end
		local camera, input = state.camera, state.context.inputService
		local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
		local x, y = viewport.X / 2, viewport.Y / 2
		if input and input.MouseEnabled then
			local mouse = input:GetMouseLocation()
			x, y = mouse.X, mouse.Y
		end
		local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(x, y)
		if state.cfg.net.place == "Around me" then return ray.Origin + ray.Direction.Unit * 26 end
		if ray.Direction.Y <= -0.05 then return nil end
		return position + ray.Direction.Unit * state.radius * 0.92
	end)

	SkyFx.stepNet = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, fx, position, playerPosition, delta)
		local env, cfg = state.context.environment, state.cfg.net
		local sky, speed = cfg.place ~= "Around me", cfg.speed / 100
		fx.shell.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(position)
		fx.cursorPosition = SkyFx.cursor(state, fx, position)
		if fx.cursorPosition then fx.cursor.Position = fx.cursorPosition end
		for _, node in ipairs(fx.nodes) do
			if sky then
				node.azimuth += node.drift * delta * speed
				node.elevation += node.vertical * delta * speed
				if node.elevation < math.rad(12) then node.vertical = math.abs(node.vertical) end
				if node.elevation > math.rad(74) then node.vertical = -math.abs(node.vertical) end
				node.position = position + SkyFx.direction(state, node.azimuth, node.elevation) * state.radius * 0.92
			else
				node.relative += node.velocity * delta * speed * 2.5
				local relative, velocity = node.relative, node.velocity
				if math.abs(relative.X) > 44 then velocity = env.Vector3.new(-math.sign(relative.X) * math.abs(velocity.X), velocity.Y, velocity.Z) end
				if relative.Y < -10 or relative.Y > 14 then velocity = env.Vector3.new(velocity.X, (relative.Y < 0 and 1 or -1) * math.abs(velocity.Y), velocity.Z) end
				if math.abs(relative.Z) > 44 then velocity = env.Vector3.new(velocity.X, velocity.Y, -math.sign(relative.Z) * math.abs(velocity.Z)) end
				node.velocity = velocity
				node.position = playerPosition + env.Vector3.new(0, 12, 0) + node.relative
			end
			node.part.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(node.position)
			if state.time >= node.nextEmit then node.emitter:Emit(1); node.nextEmit = state.time + 5 + math.random() * 3 end
		end
		fx.linkClock += delta
		if fx.linkClock >= 0.05 then fx.linkClock = 0; SkyFx.linkNet(state, fx) end
	end)

	SkyFx.drop = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name)
		local effect = state.effects[name]
		state.effects[name] = nil
		if effect and effect.folder then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() effect.folder:Destroy() end)) end
	end)

	SkyFx.clear = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state)
		for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do SkyFx.drop(state, name) end
		if state.folder then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() state.folder:Destroy() end)) end
		state.folder, state.camera = nil, nil
	end)

	SkyFx.dirty = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name)
		if name == "general" then
			for _, effect in pairs(state.effects) do effect.dirty = true end
			return
		end
		if state.effects[name] then state.effects[name].dirty = true end
	end)

	function SkyFx.set(state, name, key, value)
		local settings = state.cfg[name]
		if not settings then return end
		settings[key] = value
		SkyFx.dirty(state, name)
	end

	function SkyFx.setOn(state, name, enabled)
		local handle = state.controls[name]
		if handle and handle.Set then handle.Set(enabled); return end
		SkyFx.set(state, name, "on", enabled)
	end

	function SkyFx.scene(state, names)
		if not state.sceneSaved then
			state.sceneSaved = {}
			for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do state.sceneSaved[name] = state.cfg[name].on end
		end
		local selected = {}
		for _, name in ipairs(names or {}) do selected[name] = true end
		for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do SkyFx.setOn(state, name, selected[name] == true) end
		if state.paint then state.paint() end
	end

	function SkyFx.sceneEnd(state)
		local saved = state.sceneSaved
		state.sceneSaved = nil
		if not saved then return end
		for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do SkyFx.setOn(state, name, saved[name] == true) end
		if state.paint then state.paint() end
	end

	SkyFx.build = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name)
		local folder = SkyFx.create(state, "Folder", state.folder, {Name = name})
		local ok, effect = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			if name == "stars" or name == "runes" or name == "dust" then return SkyFx.buildParticles(state, name, folder) end
			if name == "net" then return SkyFx.buildNet(state, folder) end
			return SkyFx.buildTrails(state, name, folder)
		end))
		if ok then return effect end
		folder:Destroy()
		error(effect, 0)
	end)

	SkyFx.apply = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, effect)
		if name == "stars" then return SkyFx.applyStars(state, effect) end
		if name == "runes" then return SkyFx.applyRunes(state, effect) end
		if name == "dust" then return SkyFx.applyDust(state, effect) end
		if name == "net" then return SkyFx.applyNet(state, effect) end
		return SkyFx.applyTrails(state, name, effect)
	end)

	SkyFx.applySquash = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, effect)
		local env = state.context.environment
		local squash = env.NumberSequence.new(state.squash)
		for _, object in ipairs(effect.folder:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() object.Squash = squash end)) end
		end
		local rotated = state.squash <= 0.05
		if name == "stars" then
			effect.big.Rotation = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(-20, 20) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0)
			effect.big.RotSpeed = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(-12, 12) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0)
		end
		if name == "runes" then effect.main.Rotation = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(-10, 10) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0) end
		if name == "dust" then
			effect.main.Rotation = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(0, 45) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0)
			effect.main.RotSpeed = rotated and env.NumberRange.new(-30, 30) or env.NumberRange.new(0, 0)
		end
	end)

	SkyFx.stepEffect = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, name, effect, position, look, playerPosition, delta)
		local env = state.context.environment
		if name == "stars" then effect.part.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(position); return end
		if name == "runes" then effect.part.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(playerPosition + env.Vector3.new(0, 9, 0)); return end
		if name == "dust" then effect.part.CFrame = env.CFrame.new(playerPosition + env.Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)); return end
		if name == "net" then return SkyFx.stepNet(state, effect, position, playerPosition, delta) end
		return SkyFx.stepTrails(state, name, effect, position, look)
	end)

	SkyFx.step = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state, delta)
		local context = state.context
		if not context.isAlive() then SkyFx.clear(state); return end
		local active = false
		for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do if state.cfg[name].on then active = true; break end end
		local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not active or not camera then if state.folder then SkyFx.clear(state) end; return end
		if not state.folder or state.camera ~= camera or state.folder.Parent ~= camera then
			SkyFx.clear(state)
			state.folder = SkyFx.create(state, "Folder", camera, {Name = "CrackHubSkyFX"})
			state.camera = camera
		end
		delta = math.clamp(tonumber(delta) or 1 / 60, 0, 0.1)
		state.time += delta
		state.environmentClock += delta
		if state.environmentClock >= 0.5 then
			state.environmentClock = 0
			local atmosphere = context.lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
			local radius = math.clamp(atmosphere and 72 / math.max(atmosphere.Density, 0.04) or context.lighting.FogEnd * 0.5, 110, 520)
			if math.abs(radius - state.radius) / state.radius > 0.08 then state.radius = radius; SkyFx.dirty(state, "general") end
			local stretch = context.configuration.ui and tonumber(context.configuration.ui.stretch) or 0
			local squash = stretch > 0 and math.floor(-math.log(math.max(0.1, 1 - stretch / 100 * 0.6), 2) * 100 + 0.5) / 100 or 0
			if math.abs(squash - state.squash) > 0.02 then state.squash = squash; SkyFx.dirty(state, "general") end
		end
		local frame, character = camera.CFrame, context.player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local playerPosition = root and root.Position or frame.Position
		for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do
			local cfg, effect = state.cfg[name], state.effects[name]
			if not cfg.on then if effect then SkyFx.drop(state, name) end; continue end
			if name == "net" and effect and (effect.count ~= math.clamp(math.floor(cfg.nodes), 8, 140) or effect.place ~= cfg.place) then
				SkyFx.drop(state, name)
				effect = nil
			end
			if not effect and state.time >= (state.failures[name] or 0) then
				local ok, result = pcall(SkyFx.build, state, name)
				if ok then effect = result; state.effects[name] = effect
				else state.failures[name] = state.time + 5; context.environment.warn("[CrackHub] sky fx " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(result)) end
			end
			if not effect then continue end
			if effect.dirty then
				effect.dirty = false
				local ok, message = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
					SkyFx.apply(state, name, effect)
					SkyFx.applySquash(state, name, effect)
				end))
				if not ok then context.environment.warn("[CrackHub] sky fx " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(message)) end
			end
			local ok, message = pcall(SkyFx.stepEffect, state, name, effect, frame.Position, frame.LookVector, playerPosition, delta)
			if not ok then
				state.failures[name] = state.time + 5
				SkyFx.drop(state, name)
				context.environment.warn("[CrackHub] sky fx " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(message))
			end
		end
	end)

	function SkyFx.gallery(state)
		local context, env = state.context, state.context.environment
		local container = context.section:Container()
		if not container then return end
		local create = context.create
		local frame = create("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = env.UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = env.Enum.AutomaticSize.Y}, container)
		create("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = env.UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 76), CellPadding = env.UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8),
			SortOrder = env.Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, frame)
		local labels = {"Stars", "Shooting Stars", "Comets", "Constellations", "Runes", "Stardust"}
		local colors = {{{70, 90, 150}, {12, 16, 40}}, {{150, 200, 255}, {14, 20, 46}}, {{110, 210, 255}, {16, 22, 50}},
			{{150, 205, 255}, {14, 18, 44}}, {{130, 220, 255}, {18, 30, 54}}, {{255, 214, 120}, {40, 28, 20}}}
		local ok, atlas = pcall(env.getcustomasset, "CrackHub/sky_fx_v6.jpg")
		if not ok then atlas = nil end
		local tiles = {}
		for index, key in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do
			local button = create("TextButton", {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = index,
				BackgroundColor3 = env.Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}, frame)
			context.corner(button, 12)
			create("UIGradient", {Color = env.ColorSequence.new(env.Color3.fromRGB(table.unpack(colors[index][1])),
				env.Color3.fromRGB(table.unpack(colors[index][2]))), Rotation = 35}, button)
			local picture = create("ImageLabel", {Name = "Photo", Size = env.UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				ScaleType = env.Enum.ScaleType.Stretch, Visible = atlas ~= nil, Image = atlas or "", ZIndex = 2}, button)
			context.corner(picture, 12)
			picture.ImageRectOffset = env.Vector2.new((index - 1) % 4 * 256, math.floor((index - 1) / 4) * 128)
			picture.ImageRectSize = env.Vector2.new(256, 128)
			local shade = create("Frame", {AnchorPoint = env.Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = env.UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -5),
				Size = env.UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 20), BackgroundColor3 = env.Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
				BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3}, button)
			context.corner(shade, 7)
			local label = context.nova.label({Parent = shade, Text = context.translation.tr(labels[index]), Font = context.nova.Font.Semi(), Size = 12,
				Pos = env.UDim2.fromOffset(7, 0), Box = env.UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0), Truncate = true, Color = "Text", Z = 4})
			context.translation.bind(label, labels[index])
			local stroke = create("UIStroke", {Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.8, ApplyStrokeMode = env.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, button)
			context.nova.Theme.bind(stroke, "Color", "Glass")
			local tile = {key = key, stroke = stroke, hover = false}
			table.insert(tiles, tile)
			context.connect(button.MouseButton1Click, function() SkyFx.setOn(state, key, not state.cfg[key].on); state.paint() end)
			context.connect(button.MouseEnter, function() tile.hover = true; state.paint() end)
			context.connect(button.MouseLeave, function() tile.hover = false; state.paint() end)
		end
		state.paint = function()
			for _, tile in ipairs(tiles) do
				local selected = state.cfg[tile.key].on
				context.nova.paint(tile.stroke, "Color", (selected or tile.hover) and "Accent" or "Glass", "Quick")
				tile.stroke.Transparency, tile.stroke.Thickness = selected and 0 or (tile.hover and 0.35 or 0.8), selected and 2 or 1
			end
		end
		state.paint()
	end

	function SkyFx.install(context)
		local env, section = context.environment, context.section
		local state = {context = context, cfg = SkyFx.defaults(env), palettes = SkyFx.palettes(env), controls = {}, effects = {}, failures = {},
			time = 0, environmentClock = 1, radius = 160, squash = 0}
		local function slider(text, group, key, min, max, suffix)
			section:Slider({Text = text, Min = min, Max = max, Decimals = 0, Suffix = suffix, Default = state.cfg[group][key],
				Callback = function(value) SkyFx.set(state, group, key, value) end})
		end
		local function dropdown(text, group, key, values)
			local options = {}
			for _, value in ipairs(values) do table.insert(options, {code = value, label = value}) end
			section:Dropdown({Text = text, Default = state.cfg[group][key], Options = options, Callback = function(value)
				if value then SkyFx.set(state, group, key, value) end
			end})
		end
		local function color(text, group, key)
			section:Colorpicker({Text = text, Default = state.cfg[group][key], Callback = function(value)
				if env.typeof(value) == "Color3" then SkyFx.set(state, group, key, value) end
			end})
		end
		local function toggle(text, key, children)
			state.controls[key] = section:Toggle({Text = text, Default = false, Settings = children, Callback = function(value)
				SkyFx.set(state, key, "on", value == true)
				if state.paint then state.paint() end
			end})
		end
		section:Sub("SkyFX")
		section:Columns()
		section:Group({Title = "Sky Effects", Side = "Left", Pin = true})
		pcall(SkyFx.gallery, state)
		section:Group({Title = "Sky Settings", Side = "Left", Pin = true})
		slider("Effect brightness", "general", "bright", 30, 200, "%")
		section:Button({Text = "Turn all off", Callback = function()
			for _, name in ipairs(SKY_FX_ORDER) do SkyFx.setOn(state, name, false) end
			if state.paint then state.paint() end
		end})
		section:Group({Title = "Night Sky", Side = "Right", Pin = true})
		toggle("Stars", "stars", function()
			slider("Star density", "stars", "density", 10, 100, "%")
			slider("Star size", "stars", "size", 50, 200, "%")
			slider("Twinkle", "stars", "twinkle", 0, 100, "%")
			dropdown("Star color", "stars", "tint", {"Natural", "Cold", "Warm", "Pastel", "Rainbow"})
		end)
		toggle("Shooting Stars", "meteors", function()
			slider("Meteor frequency", "meteors", "rate", 5, 100, "%")
			slider("Tail length", "meteors", "length", 40, 200, "%")
			color("Meteor color", "meteors", "color")
		end)
		toggle("Comets", "comets", function()
			slider("Comet frequency", "comets", "rate", 5, 100, "%")
			slider("Comet size", "comets", "size", 50, 200, "%")
			color("Comet color", "comets", "color")
		end)
		section:Group({Title = "Magic", Side = "Right", Pin = true})
		toggle("Constellations", "net", function()
			dropdown("Placement", "net", "place", {"Sky", "Around me"})
			slider("Node count", "net", "nodes", 20, 140)
			slider("Link distance", "net", "reach", 0, 100, "%")
			slider("Drift speed", "net", "speed", 0, 100, "%")
			color("Line color", "net", "color")
			for _, entry in ipairs({{"Energy pulses", "pulses", true}, {"Follow cursor", "cursor", true},
				{"Rainbow lines", "rainbow", false}, {"Star figures", "figures", true}}) do
				section:Toggle({Text = entry[1], Default = entry[3], Callback = function(value) SkyFx.set(state, "net", entry[2], value == true) end})
			end
		end)
		toggle("Runes", "runes", function()
			slider("Rune amount", "runes", "amount", 10, 100, "%")
			slider("Rune size", "runes", "size", 50, 200, "%")
			dropdown("Rune set", "runes", "set", {"Runes", "Glyphs"})
			color("Rune color", "runes", "color")
		end)
		toggle("Stardust", "dust", function()
			slider("Dust amount", "dust", "amount", 10, 100, "%")
			dropdown("Dust color", "dust", "palette", {"Gold", "Silver", "Pink", "Aqua", "Rainbow"})
		end)
		local api = {cfg = state.cfg, scene = function(names) SkyFx.scene(state, names) end, sceneEnd = function() SkyFx.sceneEnd(state) end,
			set = function(group, key, value) SkyFx.set(state, group, key, value) end}
		env.getgenv().__crackHubVisualSkyFx = api
		if state.paint then state.paint() end
		if context.runService.RenderStepped then context.connect(context.runService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(delta)
			local ok, message = pcall(SkyFx.step, state, delta)
			if not ok then env.warn("[CrackHub] sky fx step: " .. tostring(message)) end
		end)) end
		return state, function()
			SkyFx.clear(state)
			if env.getgenv().__crackHubVisualSkyFx == api then env.getgenv().__crackHubVisualSkyFx = nil end
		end
	end
	local world, stopWorld = VisualWorld.install(context)
	table.insert(cleanup, stopWorld)
	context.visualWorld = world
	section:Sub("Sky")
	local _, stopSky = VisualSky.install(context)
	table.insert(cleanup, stopSky)
	local _, stopWeather = Weather.install(context)
	table.insert(cleanup, stopWeather)
	local _, stopSkyFx = SkyFx.install(context)
	table.insert(cleanup, stopSkyFx)
end

    tbl5.register = function(arg)

            return
        end
        local tbl6 = nil

    tbl5.refresh = function()

        end
    end

    tbl5.restore = function()
        local v7, v8, v9 = pairs(obj)
        local v10 = v9
        local v11 = v7
        local v12 = v8

        while true do
            local v13, v14 = v11(v12, v10)
            if v13 == nil then

local function StartCrackHubContent()
	local ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(150, 95, 255)
	do
		local old=CrackHubEnvironment.CrackHubWindow
		if type(old)=="table" and type(old.Destroy)=="function" then pcall(function() old:Destroy(true) end) end
		local parents={}
		local hidden=gethui or CrackHubEnvironment.gethui
		if type(hidden)=="function" then local ok,p=pcall(hidden); if ok and p then table.insert(parents,p) end end
		pcall(function() table.insert(parents,game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
		local pg=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"); if pg then table.insert(parents,pg) end
		local removed=false
		for _,parent in ipairs(parents) do
			for _,gui in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
				if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and gui.Name=="CrackHub" then gui:Destroy(); removed=true end
			end
		end
		if removed then task.wait() end
		for _,effect in ipairs(game:GetService("Lighting"):GetChildren()) do
			if effect.Name=="CrackHubBlur" or effect.Name=="CrackHubDOF" then effect:Destroy() end
		end
	end

-- ===== CrackHub Movement =====
CrackHub.InstallMovement = function(Window, MovementTab, rolesFn)
local game = game
local baseEnv = CrackHubEnvironment
local environment = setmetatable({getgenv = function() return baseEnv end}, {__index = function(t, k)
	local v = baseEnv[k]
	if v == nil then
		local ok, genv = pcall(getfenv, 0)
		if ok and type(genv) == "table" then v = genv[k] end
	end
	if v == nil then v = _G[k] end
	return v
end})
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local inputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local player = players.LocalPlayer
local dead = false
local connections = {}
local function connect(signal, callback)
	local c = signal:Connect(callback)
	table.insert(connections, c)
	return c
end

local function deepCopy(t)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then return t end
	local r = {}
	for k, v in pairs(t) do r[k] = deepCopy(v) end
	return r
end
local configuration = {
	antiFling = false, bhop = false, bhopKey = "", bhopPower = 5, bhopSound = false, bombJump = false,
	infJump = false, infJumpKey = "",
	invis = {on = false, key = ""}, noclip = {on = false, key = ""}, noclipCam = {on = false, key = ""},
	spin = {on = false, key = "", speed = 10}, fly = {on = false, key = "", speed = 60, method = "Classic"},
}
local defaults = deepCopy(configuration)

-- Crk-style section adapter over CrackHub containers
local current = MovementTab:AddSection("Movement")
local section = {}
local function toKey(b)
	if typeof(b) == "EnumItem" then return b end
	if type(b) == "table" then
		if typeof(b.Key) == "EnumItem" then return b.Key end
		if typeof(b.Value) == "EnumItem" then return b.Value end
	end
	return nil
end
local function handle(t)
	return {
		Row = t and t.Frame, Get = function() return t and t.Value end,
		Set = function(a, b)
			local v = a
			if type(a) == "table" and a == t then v = b end
			if t and t.Set then pcall(t.Set, t, v) end
		end,
	}
end
function section:Header(text) current = MovementTab:AddSection(tostring(text)) end
function section:Note(text) current:AddLabel(tostring(text)) end
function section:Toggle(o)
	local t = current:AddToggle({Name = o.Text, Default = o.Default and true or false, Bind = false,
		Callback = function(v) if o.Callback then o.Callback(v and true or false) end end})
	if o.Settings then o.Settings() end
	return handle(t)
end
function section:ToggleKey(o)
	local t = current:AddToggle({Name = o.Text, Default = o.Default and true or false, Bind = toKey(o.Bind) or true,
		Callback = function(v) if o.Callback then o.Callback(v and true or false) end end,
		BindChanged = function(b) if o.OnBind then pcall(o.OnBind, toKey(b)) end end})
	if o.Settings then o.Settings() end
	return handle(t)
end
function section:Slider(o)
	local dec = tonumber(o.Decimals) or 0
	local t = current:AddSlider({Name = o.Text, Min = o.Min, Max = o.Max, Increment = dec > 0 and 10 ^ -dec or 1,
		Default = o.Default, Callback = function(v) if o.Callback then o.Callback(v) end end})
	return handle(t)
end
function section:Dropdown(o)
	local labels, toCode, toLabel = {}, {}, {}
	for _, opt in ipairs(o.Options or {}) do
		local code, label = opt, opt
		if type(opt) == "table" then code, label = opt.code or opt.label, opt.label or opt.code end
		table.insert(labels, tostring(label))
		toCode[tostring(label)], toLabel[code] = code, tostring(label)
	end
	local t = current:AddDropdown({Name = o.Text, Options = labels, Default = toLabel[o.Default] or o.Default,
		Callback = function(v) if o.Callback then o.Callback(toCode[v] ~= nil and toCode[v] or v) end end})
	return handle(t)
end
function section:Keybind(o)
	local t = current:AddKeybind({Name = o.Text, Default = o.Default,
		ChangedCallback = function(k) if o.Callback then o.Callback(k) end end})
	return handle(t)
end

local renderNames = {}
local function bindRender(name, priority, callback)
	pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(name) end)
	runService:BindToRenderStep(name, priority, callback)
	table.insert(renderNames, name)
end

local KeyBinds = {}

function KeyBinds.setup(environment, inputService)
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	local enum = environment.Enum
	local mouse = {
		MouseButton1 = enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,
		MouseButton2 = enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,
		MouseButton3 = enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3,
	}
	globals.__crkBindMouse = mouse
	globals.__crkBindCapture = false

	globals.__crkBindFromName = function(name)
		if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return nil end
		if mouse[name] then return mouse[name] end

		local ok, key = pcall(function() return enum.KeyCode[name] end)
		if ok and environment.typeof(key) == "EnumItem" then return key end
		return nil
	end

	globals.__crkBindReady = function()
		return not globals.__crkBindCapture and not inputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
	end

	globals.__crkBindHit = function(input, binding)
		if environment.typeof(binding) ~= "EnumItem" then return false end
		if binding.EnumType == enum.UserInputType then return input.UserInputType == binding end
		return binding.EnumType == enum.KeyCode and input.UserInputType == enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
			and input.KeyCode == binding
	end
end

local MoveKit = {}

function MoveKit.setup(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local settings = context.configuration
	local section = context.section

	context.connect(context.inputService.JumpRequest, function()
		if not settings.infJump then return end

		local character = context.player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

		pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end)
	end)

	section:ToggleKey({
		Text = "Infinite Jumps", Default = context.defaults.infJump,
		Bind = environment.getgenv().__crkBindFromName(settings.infJumpKey or ""),
		Callback = function(enabled) settings.infJump = not not enabled end,
		OnBind = function(key) settings.infJumpKey = key and key.Name or "" end,
	})
	section:Toggle({
		Text = "Anti-Fling", Default = context.defaults.antiFling,
		Callback = function(enabled) settings.antiFling = not not enabled end,
	})
end

function MoveKit.setupNoclip(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local settings = context.configuration.noclip
	local saved, parts = {}, {}
	local character, changed, refreshedAt = nil, false, 0
	local listeners = {}

	local collect; collect = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(model)
		local result, seen = {}, {}
		local add; add = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(part)
			if not part or seen[part] then return end
			seen[part] = true
			table.insert(result, part)
		end)
		for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then add(part) end
		end
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then
			local ok, connected = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return root:GetConnectedParts(true) end))
			if ok and type(connected) == "table" then
				for _, part in ipairs(connected) do add(part) end
			end
		end
		for _, name in ipairs({"DisplayRefKnife", "DisplayRefGun"}) do
			local reference = model:FindFirstChild(name)
			local item = reference and reference:IsA("ObjectValue") and reference.Value
			if item and item.Parent then
				if item:IsA("BasePart") then add(item) end
				for _, part in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then add(part) end
				end
			end
		end
		return result
	end)
	local function restore()
		for part, value in pairs(saved) do
			if part.Parent then pcall(function() part.CanCollide = value end) end
			saved[part] = nil
		end
	end
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	globals.__crkNoclipParts = collect
	context.connect(context.runService.Stepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		if not settings.on then return end
		local current = context.player.Character
		if not current then return end

		local now = environment.os.clock()
		if current ~= character or changed or now - refreshedAt > 1 then
			if current ~= character then
				character = current
				for _, listener in ipairs(listeners) do pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() listener:Disconnect() end)) end
				listeners = {
					context.connect(current.DescendantAdded, function() changed = true end),
					context.connect(current.DescendantRemoving, function() changed = true end),
				}
			end
			changed, refreshedAt = false, now
			parts = collect(current)
		end

		for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
			if part.CanCollide then
				if saved[part] == nil then saved[part] = true end
				part.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end))
	local toggle = context.section:ToggleKey({Text = "No Clip", Default = context.defaults.noclip.on,
		Bind = globals.__crkBindFromName(settings.key or ""), Callback = function(enabled)
			settings.on = not not enabled
			if not enabled then restore() end
		end, OnBind = function(key) settings.key = key and key.Name or "" end})
	globals.__crkSetNoclip = function(enabled)
		enabled = not not enabled
		if toggle and toggle.Set then
			pcall(toggle.Set, enabled)
			return
		end
		settings.on = enabled
		if not enabled then restore() end
	end
	globals.__crkGetNoclip = function() return not not settings.on end

	return function()
		settings.on = false
		restore()
	end
end

function MoveKit.setupCameraNoclip(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	local configuration = context.configuration
	if type(configuration.noclipCam) ~= "table" then configuration.noclipCam = {on = false, key = ""} end
	local settings = configuration.noclipCam
	local state = rawget(globals, "__crkNoclipCam")
	if type(state) ~= "table" then
		state = {on = false, hooked = false}
		globals.__crkNoclipCam = state
	end
	local previousMode

	local findPopper; findPopper = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local scripts = context.player:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
		local playerModule = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
		local camera = playerModule and playerModule:FindFirstChild("CameraModule")
		local zoom = camera and camera:FindFirstChild("ZoomController")
		local module = zoom and zoom:FindFirstChild("Popper")
		if not module then return nil end

		if type(environment.getgc) == "function" then
			local source = module:GetFullName()
			for _, callback in ipairs(environment.getgc(false)) do
				if type(callback) ~= "function" or type(environment.islclosure) == "function" and not environment.islclosure(callback) then
					continue
				end

				local ok, path, arguments = pcall(environment.debug.info, callback, "sa")
				if ok and type(path) == "string" and (path == source or path:sub(-#module.Name - 1) == "." .. module.Name)
					and arguments == 3 then
					local name = environment.debug.info(callback, "n")
					if not name or name == "" or string.lower(name) == "popper" then return callback end
				end
			end
		end

		local ok, callback = pcall(environment.require, module)
		if ok and type(callback) == "function" then return callback end
		return nil
	end)
	local function setupHook()
		if state.hooked then return true end
		if type(environment.hookfunction) ~= "function" then return false end
		local popper = findPopper()
		if not popper then return false end

		local original
		local ok = pcall(function()
			original = environment.hookfunction(popper, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(origin, distance, focus)
				local current = rawget(globals, "__crkNoclipCam")
				if current and current.on and current.mode == "hook" and type(distance) == "number" then
					return distance
				end
				return original(origin, distance, focus)
			end))
		end)
		if not ok or not original then return false end
		state.hooked = true
		return true
	end
	local function setEnabled(enabled)
		state.on = not not enabled
		if state.on then
			if setupHook() then
				state.mode = "hook"
				return
			end
			state.mode = "invisicam"
			pcall(function()
				if previousMode == nil then previousMode = context.player.DevCameraOcclusionMode end
				context.player.DevCameraOcclusionMode = environment.Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Invisicam
			end)
			return
		end

		if state.mode == "invisicam" and previousMode ~= nil then
			pcall(function() context.player.DevCameraOcclusionMode = previousMode end)
			previousMode = nil
		end
		state.mode = nil
	end

	context.section:ToggleKey({Text = "No Clip Camera", Default = context.defaults.noclipCam and context.defaults.noclipCam.on,
		Bind = globals.__crkBindFromName(settings.key or ""), Callback = function(enabled)
			settings.on = not not enabled
			setEnabled(settings.on)
		end, OnBind = function(key) settings.key = key and key.Name or "" end})
	return function() setEnabled(false) end
end

function MoveKit.setupAntiCoin(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local globals, workspace = environment.getgenv(), context.workspace
	local info = {n = 0, leaks = 0, strict = false}
	local coins = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local characterParts = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	local enabled = false
	globals.__crkAntiCoinInfo, globals.__crkAntiCoin = info, false

	local function blockCoin(part)
		if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
		if coins[part] == nil then coins[part] = part.CanTouch end
		if part.CanTouch then
			part.CanTouch = false
			info.n += 1
		end
	end
	local function scanCoins()
		for _, map in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
			local container = map:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
			if container then
				for _, part in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do pcall(blockCoin, part) end
			end
		end
	end
	local function blockCharacter()
		local character = context.player.Character
		if not character then return end
		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if characterParts[part] == nil then characterParts[part] = part.CanTouch end
				if part.CanTouch then pcall(function() part.CanTouch = false end) end
			end
		end
	end
	local function restore()
		for part, original in pairs(coins) do
			if part.Parent then pcall(function() part.CanTouch = original end) end
			coins[part] = nil
		end
		for part, original in pairs(characterParts) do
			if part.Parent then pcall(function() part.CanTouch = original end) end
			characterParts[part] = nil
		end
		info.strict = false
	end
	local function setEnabled(value)
		enabled = not not value
		globals.__crkAntiCoin = enabled
		if enabled then pcall(scanCoins) else restore() end
	end
	info.set = setEnabled
	context.connect(workspace.DescendantAdded, function(part)
		if enabled and part.Parent and part.Parent.Name == "CoinContainer" then pcall(blockCoin, part) end
	end)
	context.connect(context.player.CharacterAdded, function()
		if not enabled or not info.strict then return end
		environment.task.wait(0.5)
		pcall(blockCharacter)
	end)
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		local gameplay
		while context.isAlive() and not gameplay do
			local remotes = context.storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
			gameplay = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
			if not gameplay then environment.task.wait(1) end
		end
		local collected = gameplay and gameplay:FindFirstChild("CoinCollected")
		if not collected then return end
		context.connect(collected.OnClientEvent, function()
			if not enabled then return end
			info.leaks += 1
			if info.strict then return end
			info.strict = true
			pcall(blockCharacter)
			pcall(function()
				context.window:Notify({Title = context.translation.tr("Anti Coin"),
					Text = context.translation.tr("Coin leaked, strict mode on"), Kind = "error", Duration = 3})
			end)
		end)
	end)
	environment.task.spawn(function()
		while context.isAlive() do
			environment.task.wait(0.5)
			if enabled then
				pcall(scanCoins)
				if info.strict then pcall(blockCharacter) end
			end
		end
	end)
	context.section:Toggle({Text = "Anti Coin", Default = false, Callback = setEnabled})
	return function() setEnabled(false) end
end

function MoveKit.setupBombJump(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	local settings, player = context.configuration, context.player
	local busy = false

	local function jump()
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

		local power = humanoid.UseJumpPower == false
			and math.sqrt(2 * (context.workspace.Gravity or 196.2) * math.max(humanoid.JumpHeight or 7.2, 1))
			or math.max(humanoid.JumpPower or 50, 50)
		globals.__crkBombJumpUntil = math.max(tonumber(globals.__crkBombJumpUntil) or 0, environment.os.clock() + 1.5)
		local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = environment.Vector3.new(velocity.X, power, velocity.Z)
		pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end)
	end
	local function findBomb()
		local character = player.Character
		local bomb = character and character:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb")
		if bomb then return bomb end
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
		if not backpack then return nil end
		local toys = backpack:FindFirstChild("Toys")
		return toys and toys:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb") or backpack:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb")
	end
	local function equip()
		local character = player.Character
		if not character or not character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return nil end
		local bomb = character:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb") or findBomb()
		if not bomb then return nil end
		pcall(function() bomb.Parent = character end)
		environment.task.wait(0.08)
		bomb = character:FindFirstChild("FakeBomb") or bomb
		pcall(function()
			local handle = bomb:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			local hand = character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
			if not handle or not hand or hand:FindFirstChild("RightGrip") then return end
			handle.Anchored = false
			local weld = environment.Instance.new("Weld")
			weld.Name, weld.Part0, weld.Part1 = "RightGrip", hand, handle
			weld.C0 = hand.Name == "RightHand" and environment.CFrame.new(0, -0.1, 0)
				or environment.CFrame.new(0, -1, 0) * environment.CFrame.Angles(-math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
			weld.C1, weld.Parent = bomb.Grip, hand
		end)
		return bomb.Parent == character and bomb or nil
	end
	local function throw(position)
		local bomb = equip()
		local remote = bomb and bomb:FindFirstChild("Remote")
		if not remote then return false end
		globals.__crkBombJumpUntil = math.max(tonumber(globals.__crkBombJumpUntil) or 0, environment.os.clock() + 2)
		pcall(function() remote:FireServer(environment.CFrame.new(position), 50) end)
		return true
	end
	local function watch(character)
		local function watchTool(tool)
			if tool.Name == "FakeBomb" and tool:IsA("Tool") then
				context.connect(tool.Activated, function() if settings.bombJump then jump() end end)
			end
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do watchTool(child) end
		context.connect(character.ChildAdded, watchTool)
	end
	if player.Character then watch(player.Character) end
	context.connect(player.CharacterAdded, function(character)
		environment.task.wait(0.3)
		watch(character)
	end)
	globals.__crkAutoBombJump = function()
		if busy then return end
		busy = true
		environment.task.spawn(function()
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				equip()
				environment.task.wait(0.1)
				jump()
				environment.task.wait(0.12)
				throw(root.Position - environment.Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
				environment.task.wait(0.22)
				jump()
			end
			busy = false
		end)
	end
	context.section:Toggle({Text = "Bomb Jump", Default = context.defaults.bombJump,
		Callback = function(enabled) settings.bombJump = not not enabled end, Settings = function()
			local key = globals.__crkBindFromName(settings.bombJumpKey)
			context.section:Keybind({Text = "Bomb Jump", Default = key, Active = function() return busy end,
				Callback = function(value)
					key = value
					settings.bombJumpKey = value and value.Name or ""
				end})
			context.connect(context.inputService.InputBegan, function(input)
				if not globals.__crkBindReady() or not globals.__crkBindHit(input, key) then return end
				if globals.__crkAutoBombJump then pcall(globals.__crkAutoBombJump) end
			end)
		end})
end

function MoveKit.setupInvisibility(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local globals, player = environment.getgenv(), context.player
	local runService, workspace = context.runService, context.workspace
	local active, pending, humanoid, root = false, false, nil, nil
	local parts, heartbeat, lastReal, renderReal, ghostPosition = {}, nil, nil, nil, nil
	local groundedOffset, nudging, nudgeUntil, nudgeConnection = false, false, 0, nil
	local raycastParams, raycastCharacter

	local function nudge(duration)
		nudgeUntil = math.max(nudgeUntil, environment.os.clock() + (duration or 0.5))
		if nudgeConnection then return end
		nudgeConnection = context.connect(runService.Stepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			if environment.os.clock() > nudgeUntil or not humanoid or not root or not root.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				if nudgeConnection then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() nudgeConnection:Disconnect() end)) end
				nudgeConnection = nil
				return
			end
			if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01 then return end
			nudging = not nudging
			pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
				root.CFrame = root.CFrame * environment.CFrame.new(0, nudging and 0.03 or -0.03, 0)
					* environment.CFrame.Angles(0, nudging and 0.01 or -0.01, 0)
			end))
		end))
	end
	local function refreshCharacter()
		local character = player.Character
		if not character then
			humanoid, root, parts = nil, nil, {}
			return
		end
		humanoid, root, parts = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), {}
		for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Transparency == 0 then
				local near = part.Name == "Head" or part.Parent ~= nil and part.Parent:IsA("Accessory") or false
				table.insert(parts, {part = part, near = near})
			end
		end
	end
	local function transparency(enabled)
		pcall(function()
			for _, item in ipairs(parts) do
				if item.part and item.part.Parent then item.part.LocalTransparencyModifier = enabled and 0.5 or 0 end
			end
		end)
	end
	local firstPerson; firstPerson = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return false, nil end
		local position = camera.CFrame.Position
		if player.CameraMode == environment.Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then return true, position end
		local character = player.Character
		local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		return head ~= nil and (head.Position - position).Magnitude < 1.5 or false, position
	end)
	local function unbind()
		pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CrkInvisRestore") end)
		pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CrkInvisGhost") end)
	end
	local function stop()
		if not active then return end
		active, pending = false, false
		pcall(function() if globals.__crkInvis then globals.__crkInvis.active, globals.__crkInvis.real = false, nil end end)
		if heartbeat then
			pcall(function() heartbeat:Disconnect() end)
			heartbeat = nil
		end
		unbind()
		transparency(false)
		if root and root.Parent then
			local target = lastReal or root.CFrame
			pcall(function() root.CFrame = target end)
			pcall(function() root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = environment.Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) end)
			pcall(function() root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = environment.Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) end)
			nudge(0.5)
		end
	end
	local function start()
		if active then return end
		refreshCharacter()
		if not humanoid or not root then return end
		active, pending = true, false
		transparency(true)
		heartbeat = context.connect(runService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			if not active then return end
			local valid = humanoid and root and root.Parent
			if not valid or root.Parent ~= player.Character or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				if globals.__crkInvis then globals.__crkInvis.active, globals.__crkInvis.real = false, nil end
				return
			end
			pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
				local revert = rawget(globals, "__crkAfRevert")
				if revert then pcall(revert) end
				local moving = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.01
				if not raycastParams then
					raycastParams = environment.RaycastParams.new()
					raycastParams.FilterType = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				end
				local character = player.Character
				if raycastCharacter ~= character then
					raycastCharacter = character
					raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
				end
				local grounded = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, environment.Vector3.new(0, -5, 0), raycastParams) ~= nil
				local info = globals.__crkInvis or {}
				info.active, info.grounded = true, grounded
				globals.__crkInvis = info
				local real, offset = root.CFrame, -200000
				if grounded and not moving then
					groundedOffset = not groundedOffset
					if groundedOffset then offset = -199999.5 end
				end
				renderReal, lastReal = real, real
				info.real, info.realAt = real, environment.os.clock()
				if (tonumber(globals.__crkInvisPause) or 0) > environment.os.clock() then return end
				root.CFrame = real * environment.CFrame.new(0, offset, 0)
				ghostPosition, pending = root.Position, true
			end))
		end))
		pcall(function()
			context.bindRender("CrkInvisRestore", environment.Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
				if pending and root and root.Parent and renderReal then
					if not ghostPosition or (root.Position - ghostPosition).Magnitude < 2 then
						pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() root.CFrame = renderReal end))
					end
					pending = false
				end
			end))
		end)
		nudge(0.5)
		pcall(function()
			context.bindRender("CrkInvisGhost", environment.Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
				if not active then return end
				local first, cameraPosition = firstPerson()
				pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
					for _, item in ipairs(parts) do
						local part = item.part
						if part and part.Parent then
							local alpha = 0.5
							if first then
								if item.near then
									alpha = 1
								else
									local distance = cameraPosition and (part.Position - cameraPosition).Magnitude or 99
									if distance < 1.2 then alpha = 1 end
									if distance >= 1.2 and distance < 2.4 then alpha = math.max(0.5, 1 - (distance - 1.2) / 1.2) end
								end
							end
							part.LocalTransparencyModifier = alpha
						end
					end
				end))
			end))
		end)
	end
	context.connect(player.CharacterAdded, function()
		local enabled = not not context.configuration.invis.on
		active, pending = false, false
		if heartbeat then
			pcall(function() heartbeat:Disconnect() end)
			heartbeat = nil
		end
		unbind()
		environment.task.spawn(function()
			local character = player.Character
			if character then
				pcall(function() character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 8) end)
				pcall(function() character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 8) end)
			end
			environment.task.wait(0.4)
			refreshCharacter()
			if enabled and context.configuration.invis.on and player.Character then start() end
		end)
	end)
	context.section:ToggleKey({Text = "Invisible", Default = false,
		Bind = globals.__crkBindFromName(context.configuration.invis.key), Callback = function(enabled)
			context.configuration.invis.on = not not enabled
			if enabled then start() else stop() end
		end, OnBind = function(key) context.configuration.invis.key = key and key.Name or "" end})
	globals.__crkSetInvis = function(enabled)
		enabled = not not enabled
		if enabled == not not context.configuration.invis.on then return end
		context.configuration.invis.on = enabled
		if enabled then start() else stop() end
	end
	globals.__crkGetInvis = function() return not not context.configuration.invis.on end
	return stop
end

function MoveKit.setupSpinAndBhop(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local globals, settings = environment.getgenv(), context.configuration
	local modes = {"Smooth", "Jitter", "Backwards", "Helicopter", "Break Dance", "Top Rock", "Air Dance",
		"Hero Flip", "Twirl", "Jacks", "Floss", "Tantrum", "Robot"}
	local animations = {
		Helicopter = {yaw = 2.4, emote = {10714347453, 1}}, ["Break Dance"] = {yaw = 1.8, emote = {10714003221, 1.3}},
		["Top Rock"] = {yaw = 1, emote = {10714336041, 1.4}}, ["Air Dance"] = {yaw = 1.4, emote = {10713957138, 1.5}},
		["Hero Flip"] = {yaw = 1.2, emote = {10714360164, 1.2}}, Twirl = {yaw = 2.2, emote = {10714293450, 1.5}},
		Jacks = {yaw = 1.6, emote = {10714375667, 1.6}}, Floss = {yaw = 1.2, emote = {10714340543, 1.4}},
		Tantrum = {yaw = 1.5, emote = {10714340558, 1.5}}, Robot = {yaw = 0.8, emote = {10714392151, 1.3}},
	}
	local animationState = {tracks = {}}
	globals.__crkSpinAnim = {anim = animations, sa = animationState}
	local spinning, jitterTimer, jitter = false, 0, false
	local speed, landedAt, wasGrounded, reserve, chainUntil = 0, 0, true, 0, 0
	local sounds

	local stopAnimation; stopAnimation = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local track = animationState.track
		animationState.track = nil
		if track then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() track:Stop(0.25) end)) end
	end)
	local animate; animate = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(character, humanoid, animation, spinSpeed)
		if animationState.char ~= character then
			stopAnimation()
			animationState.char, animationState.tracks = character, {}
		end
		local track = animationState.tracks[animation[1]]
		if not track then
			local ok, result = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
				local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or humanoid
				local asset = environment.Instance.new("Animation")
				asset.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. animation[1]
				local loaded = animator:LoadAnimation(asset)
				loaded.Priority, loaded.Looped = environment.Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4, true
				return loaded
			end))
			if not ok or not result then return end
			track = result
			animationState.tracks[animation[1]] = track
		end
		if animationState.track ~= track then
			stopAnimation()
			animationState.track = track
			pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() track:Play(0.25) end))
		end
		local playback = math.clamp(animation[2] * (0.8 + spinSpeed / 50), 0.5, 4)
		pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() if math.abs(track.Speed - playback) > 0.01 then track:AdjustSpeed(playback) end end))
	end)
	local jumpSound; jumpSound = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		if not settings.bhopSound then return end
		if not sounds then
			sounds = {}
			for _, id in ipairs({7338942417, 7338942345, 7338942259, 7338942180}) do
				local ok, sound = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
					local object = environment.Instance.new("Sound")
					object.SoundId, object.Volume, object.Parent = "rbxassetid://" .. id, 2, context.workspace
					return object
				end))
				if ok and sound then table.insert(sounds, sound) end
			end
		end
		if #sounds > 0 then
			local sound = sounds[math.random(1, #sounds)]
			pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() sound:Play() end))
		end
	end)
	local yaw; yaw = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(frame)
		local look = frame.LookVector
		return math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
	end)
	local spinAngle; spinAngle = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(root, delta)
		local mode = settings.spin.mode or "Smooth"
		local spinSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(settings.spin.speed) or 10, 1, 100)
		local current, animation = yaw(root.CFrame), animations[mode]
		if animation then return current + spinSpeed * animation.yaw * delta end
		local camera = context.workspace.CurrentCamera
		local cameraYaw = camera and yaw(camera.CFrame) or 0
		if mode == "Jitter" then
			jitterTimer += delta
			if jitterTimer >= 1 / math.max(spinSpeed * 0.6, 0.5) then jitterTimer, jitter = 0, not jitter end
			return cameraYaw + (jitter and math.rad(75) or -math.rad(75))
		end
		if mode == "Backwards" then return cameraYaw + math.pi end
		return current + spinSpeed * delta
	end)
	context.connect(context.runService.Stepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local animation = settings.spin and settings.spin.on and animations[settings.spin.mode or ""]
		if not animation then
			stopAnimation()
			return
		end
		local character = context.player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or character:FindFirstChild("Gun") then
			stopAnimation()
			return
		end
		animate(character, humanoid, animation.emote, math.clamp(tonumber(settings.spin.speed) or 10, 1, 100))
	end))
	context.connect(context.runService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(delta)
		if not (settings.spin and settings.spin.on) and not settings.bhop and not spinning then
			if globals.__crkBhopChain then
				speed, reserve, chainUntil = 0, 0, 0
				globals.__crkBhopSpeed, globals.__crkBhopChain = 0, false
			end
			return
		end
		local character = context.player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if settings.spin and settings.spin.on then
			if humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				spinning = true
				pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
					humanoid.AutoRotate = false
					if environment.os.clock() < (tonumber(globals.__crkShotHold) or 0) then return end
					root.CFrame = environment.CFrame.new(root.Position) * environment.CFrame.Angles(0, spinAngle(root, delta), 0)
				end))
			end
		end
		if not (settings.spin and settings.spin.on) and spinning then
			spinning = false
			if humanoid and root then
				pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
					humanoid.AutoRotate = true
					root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = environment.Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end))
			end
		end

		local status
		pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() status = humanoid:GetState() end))
		local stateTypes = environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType
		if settings.bhop and humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0 and not globals.__crkTouchFlinging and status ~= stateTypes.Climbing then
			local invisible = globals.__crkInvis
			local grounded = invisible and invisible.active and invisible.grounded
				or (not (invisible and invisible.active) and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= environment.Enum.Material.Air
					and status ~= stateTypes.Freefall and status ~= stateTypes.Jumping)
			local now, velocity = environment.os.clock(), root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local power, walkSpeed = settings.bhopPower or 5, humanoid.WalkSpeed
			if grounded and not wasGrounded then
				landedAt = now
			end
			if not grounded and wasGrounded and velocity.Y > 2 and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then
				speed = speed > 0 and now - landedAt <= 0.25 and speed + 2 + power * 1.2 or math.max(speed, walkSpeed + 2 + power)
				jumpSound()
			end
			if grounded and now - landedAt > 0.3 then speed = 0 end
			local movement = humanoid.MoveDirection
			if speed > 0 and movement.Magnitude > 0.1 then
				speed = math.min(speed, math.max(walkSpeed * (2 + 0.4 * power), 100))
				if not grounded or now - landedAt <= 0.25 then
					local direction = environment.Vector3.new(movement.X, 0, movement.Z).Unit
					local desired = math.max(speed, tonumber(globals.__crkGlitchCur) or 0)
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = environment.Vector3.new(direction.X * desired, velocity.Y, direction.Z * desired)
				end
			end
			wasGrounded = grounded
			if speed > 0 then
				reserve, chainUntil = math.max(reserve, speed + 2 + power * 1.2), now + 0.5
			end
			if not (speed > 0) and now > chainUntil then
				reserve = 0
			end
			globals.__crkBhopSpeed = math.max(speed, reserve, walkSpeed + 2 + power)
			globals.__crkBhopChain = speed > 0 or now <= chainUntil
		else
			wasGrounded, speed = true, 0
			if reserve > 0 and environment.os.clock() <= chainUntil then
				globals.__crkBhopSpeed, globals.__crkBhopChain = reserve, true
			else
				reserve, chainUntil = 0, 0
				globals.__crkBhopSpeed, globals.__crkBhopChain = 0, false
			end
		end
	end))
	if not table.find(modes, settings.spin.mode) then settings.spin.mode = "Smooth" end
	if not table.find(modes, context.defaults.spin.mode) then context.defaults.spin.mode = "Smooth" end
	context.section:ToggleKey({Text = "Spin", Default = context.defaults.spin.on,
		Bind = globals.__crkBindFromName(settings.spin.key), Callback = function(enabled) settings.spin.on = not not enabled end,
		OnBind = function(key) settings.spin.key = key and key.Name or "" end, Settings = function()
			local options = {}
			for _, mode in ipairs(modes) do table.insert(options, {code = mode, label = mode == "Smooth" and "Classic" or mode}) end
