			context.section:Dropdown({Text = "Spin Mode", Options = options, Default = context.defaults.spin.mode, Callback = function(value)
				settings.spin.mode, jitterTimer, jitter = value, 0, false
			end})
			context.section:Slider({Text = "Spin Speed", Min = 1, Max = 100, Default = context.defaults.spin.speed or 10, Decimals = 0,
				Callback = function(value) settings.spin.speed = value end})
		end})
	context.section:ToggleKey({Text = "Bhop", Default = context.defaults.bhop,
		Bind = globals.__crkBindFromName(settings.bhopKey), Callback = function(enabled) settings.bhop = not not enabled end,
		OnBind = function(key) settings.bhopKey = key and key.Name or "" end, Settings = function()
			context.section:Slider({Text = "Bhop Power", Min = 1, Max = 10, Default = context.defaults.bhopPower or 5, Decimals = 0,
				Callback = function(value) settings.bhopPower = value end})
		end})

	return function()
		stopAnimation()
		local character = context.player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if spinning and humanoid and root then
			pcall(function()
				humanoid.AutoRotate = true
				root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = environment.Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			end)
		end
		globals.__crkBhopSpeed, globals.__crkBhopChain = 0, false
	end
end

function MoveKit.setupFly(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local enum, vector, cframe = environment.Enum, environment.Vector3, environment.CFrame
	local states = enum.HumanoidStateType
	local zero, up = vector.new(0, 0, 0), vector.new(0, 1, 0)
	local settings, globals = context.configuration.fly, environment.getgenv()
	local state = {velocity = zero, bank = 0, lastUp = 0}
	local upHeld, downHeld, lastJump = false, false, 0
	local methods = {}

	local destroy; destroy = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(name)
		local object = state[name]
		if object then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() object:Destroy() end)) end
		state[name] = nil
	end)
	local function motors(root)
		if not state.velocityMotor or state.velocityMotor.Parent ~= root then
			destroy("velocityMotor")
			local motor = environment.Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
			motor.MaxForce = vector.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
			motor.Velocity = vector.new(0, 0.1, 0)
			motor:SetAttribute("CrkMine", true)
			motor.Parent = root
			state.velocityMotor = motor
		end
		if not state.gyro or state.gyro.Parent ~= root then
			destroy("gyro")
			local gyro = environment.Instance.new("BodyGyro")
			gyro.P = 90000
			gyro.MaxTorque = vector.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
			gyro.CFrame = root.CFrame
			gyro:SetAttribute("CrkMine", true)
			gyro.Parent = root
			state.gyro, state.gyroFrame = gyro, root.CFrame
		end
	end
	local function changeState(humanoid, target)
		local ok, current = pcall(function() return humanoid:GetState() end)
		if ok and current ~= target then pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(target) end) end
	end
	local function setStates(humanoid, disabled, enabled)
		state.savedStates = state.savedStates or {}
		local function remember(value)
			if state.savedStates[value] ~= nil then return end
			local ok, current = pcall(function() return humanoid:GetStateEnabled(value) end)
			state.savedStates[value] = not (ok and current == false)
		end
		for _, value in ipairs(disabled) do
			remember(value)
			pcall(function() humanoid:SetStateEnabled(value, false) end)
		end
		if enabled then
			remember(enabled)
			pcall(function() humanoid:SetStateEnabled(enabled, true) end)
		end
	end
	local cleanup; cleanup = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local humanoid = state.humanoid
		local character = humanoid and humanoid.Parent
		local savedStates = state.savedStates
		state.savedStates = nil
		if humanoid and savedStates then
			for value, enabled in pairs(savedStates) do pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() humanoid:SetStateEnabled(value, enabled) end)) end
			if humanoid.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() humanoid:ChangeState(states.Freefall) end)) end
		end
		destroy("velocityMotor")
		destroy("gyro")
		destroy("platform")
		if state.stand and humanoid then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() humanoid.PlatformStand = false end)) end
		if state.animationDisabled and character then
			local animate = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
			if animate then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() animate.Disabled = false end)) end
		end
		state.stand, state.animationDisabled = false, false
		state.method, state.humanoid, state.root, state.gyroFrame = nil, nil, nil, nil
		state.level, state.position, state.yaw, state.face = nil, nil, nil, nil
		state.velocity, state.bank, state.lastUp = zero, 0, 0
	end)
	local function stand(character, humanoid)
		if not humanoid.PlatformStand then pcall(function() humanoid.PlatformStand = true end) end
		state.stand = true
		local animate = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
		if animate and not animate.Disabled then
			pcall(function() animate.Disabled = true end)
			state.animationDisabled = true
		end
		local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
		if animator then
			for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end) end
		end
	end
	local function facing(root, movement, velocity, fallback, delta)
		local horizontal = vector.new(movement.X, 0, movement.Z)
		local drift = vector.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
		local direction = horizontal.Magnitude > 0.01 and horizontal.Unit or (drift.Magnitude > 0.5 and drift.Unit or fallback)
		local target = cframe.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + direction)
		state.gyroFrame = state.gyroFrame and state.gyroFrame:Lerp(target, math.min(1, 8 * delta)) or target
		state.gyro.CFrame = state.gyroFrame
	end
	local function height(humanoid, root)
		if humanoid.RigType == enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then return root.Size.Y / 2 + 2 end
		return humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2
	end
	local direction; direction = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(humanoid)
		local camera, move = context.workspace.CurrentCamera, humanoid.MoveDirection
		local forward, result = vector.new(0, 0, -1), zero
		if camera then
			local cameraFrame = camera.CFrame
			local look = cameraFrame.LookVector
			local flat = vector.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
			forward = flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and flat.Unit or forward
			if move.Magnitude > 0 then
				local right = cameraFrame.RightVector
				local flatRight = vector.new(right.X, 0, right.Z)
				flatRight = flatRight.Magnitude > 0.01 and flatRight.Unit or vector.new(1, 0, 0)
				result = look * move:Dot(forward) + flatRight * move:Dot(flatRight)
			end
		end
		local vertical = (upHeld or environment.os.clock() - lastJump < 0.15) and 1 or 0
		if downHeld then vertical -= 1 end
		return result, vertical, forward
	end)

	methods.Classic = {
		start = function(humanoid, root)
			motors(root)
			setStates(humanoid, {states.Freefall})
			pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(states.Running) end)
		end,
		step = function(humanoid, root, character, delta, movement, vertical, forward, speed)
			motors(root)
			stand(character, humanoid)
			local target = movement + up * vertical
			local velocity = target.Magnitude > 0.01 and target.Unit * speed or zero
			state.velocityMotor.Velocity = velocity
			facing(root, movement, velocity, forward, delta)
		end,
	}
	methods.CFrame = {
		start = function(humanoid, root)
			setStates(humanoid, {states.Freefall, states.FallingDown, states.Ragdoll, states.Jumping})
			state.position = root.Position
		end,
		step = function(humanoid, root, _, delta, movement, vertical, forward, speed)
			changeState(humanoid, states.Running)
			local position = root.Position
			if not state.position or (position - state.position).Magnitude > 8 then state.position = position end
			local target = movement + up * vertical
			if target.Magnitude > 0.01 then state.position += target.Unit * speed * delta end
			local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
			local facingNow = vector.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
			facingNow = facingNow.Magnitude > 0.01 and facingNow.Unit or forward
			local desired = vector.new(movement.X, 0, movement.Z)
			desired = desired.Magnitude > 0.01 and desired.Unit or facingNow
			local smoothed = facingNow:Lerp(desired, math.min(1, 10 * delta))
			if smoothed.Magnitude < 0.01 then smoothed = desired end
			root.CFrame = cframe.lookAt(state.position, state.position + smoothed.Unit)
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = zero, zero
		end,
	}
	methods.Swim = {
		start = function(humanoid, root)
			motors(root)
			setStates(humanoid, {states.Freefall, states.Running, states.RunningNoPhysics, states.Landed, states.Jumping,
				states.Climbing, states.FallingDown, states.GettingUp, states.Ragdoll}, states.Swimming)
			changeState(humanoid, states.Swimming)
		end,
		step = function(humanoid, root, _, delta, movement, vertical, forward, speed)
			motors(root)
			changeState(humanoid, states.Swimming)
			local target = movement + up * vertical
			local velocity = target.Magnitude > 0.01 and target.Unit * speed or zero
			state.velocity = state.velocity:Lerp(velocity, math.min(1, 9 * delta))
			state.velocityMotor.Velocity = state.velocity
			facing(root, movement, state.velocity, forward, delta)
		end,
	}
	methods["Air Walk"] = {
		start = function(humanoid, root)
			setStates(humanoid, {states.Jumping, states.Freefall, states.FallingDown, states.Ragdoll})
			state.level = root.Position.Y - height(humanoid, root)
		end,
		step = function(humanoid, root, _, delta, _, vertical, _, speed)
			if not state.platform or not state.platform.Parent then
				local platform = environment.Instance.new("Part")
				platform.Name, platform.Size = "CrkAirWalk", vector.new(10, 1, 10)
				platform.Anchored, platform.CanTouch, platform.CastShadow, platform.Transparency = true, false, false, 1
				platform:SetAttribute("CrkMine", true)
				platform.CFrame = cframe.new(root.Position.X, state.level - 0.5, root.Position.Z)
				platform.Parent = context.workspace
				state.platform = platform
			end
			changeState(humanoid, states.Running)
			local ascent, position = math.clamp(speed, 10, 120), root.Position
			local feet = position.Y - height(humanoid, root)
			if vertical ~= 0 then
				state.level += vertical * ascent * delta
				local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vector.new(velocity.X, vertical * ascent, velocity.Z)
			else
				if state.lastUp ~= 0 then
					local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vector.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
				end
				if humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= enum.Material.Air and feet > state.level + 0.2 then state.level = feet end
			end
			state.lastUp = vertical
			state.platform.CFrame = cframe.new(position.X, state.level - 0.5, position.Z)
		end,
	}
	methods.Glide = {
		start = function(humanoid, root)
			motors(root)
			setStates(humanoid, {states.Freefall})
			pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(states.Running) end)
		end,
		step = function(humanoid, root, character, delta, movement, vertical, forward, speed)
			motors(root)
			stand(character, humanoid)
			local target = movement + up * vertical
			local velocity = target.Magnitude > 0.01 and target.Unit * speed or zero
			local rate = velocity.Magnitude > 0.01 and 2.2 or 1.6
			state.velocity = state.velocity:Lerp(velocity, 1 - math.exp(-rate * delta))
			if velocity.Magnitude < 0.01 and state.velocity.Magnitude < 0.3 then state.velocity = zero end
			state.velocityMotor.Velocity = state.velocity
			local horizontal = vector.new(state.velocity.X, 0, state.velocity.Z)
			local horizontalSpeed = horizontal.Magnitude
			if horizontalSpeed > 1 then state.face = horizontal.Unit end
			local face = state.face or forward
			local ratio = math.clamp(state.velocity.Magnitude / math.max(speed, 1), 0, 1)
			local pitch = math.atan2(state.velocity.Y, math.max(horizontalSpeed, 0.001))
			local angle = math.clamp(ratio * (math.rad(65) - pitch * 0.6), 0, math.rad(115))
			local yaw = math.atan2(-face.X, -face.Z)
			local turn = state.yaw and ((yaw - state.yaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi) / math.max(delta, 1 / 240) or 0
			state.yaw = yaw
			local bank = math.clamp(turn * 0.3, -0.75, 0.75) * ratio
			state.bank += (bank - state.bank) * (1 - math.exp(-6 * delta))
			local targetFrame = cframe.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + face)
				* cframe.Angles(0, 0, state.bank) * cframe.Angles(-angle, 0, 0)
			state.gyroFrame = state.gyroFrame and state.gyroFrame:Lerp(targetFrame, math.min(1, 8 * delta)) or targetFrame
			state.gyro.CFrame = state.gyroFrame
		end,
	}
	context.connect(context.inputService.JumpRequest, function() lastJump = environment.os.clock() end)
	context.connect(context.inputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
		if processed or input.UserInputType ~= enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
		if input.KeyCode == enum.KeyCode.Space then upHeld = true end
		if input.KeyCode == enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then downHeld = true end
	end)
	context.connect(context.inputService.InputEnded, function(input)
		if input.KeyCode == enum.KeyCode.Space then upHeld = false end
		if input.KeyCode == enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then downHeld = false end
	end)
	context.connect(context.runService.Stepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(_, delta)
		if not context.configuration.fly or not settings.on then
			globals.__crkFlyActive = false
			if state.method then cleanup() end
			return
		end

		local speed = tonumber(settings.speed) or 60
		globals.__crkFlyActive, globals.__crkFlySpeed = true, speed
		local character = context.player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			if state.method then cleanup() end
			return
		end
		local method = methods[settings.method] and settings.method or "Classic"
		if state.method ~= method or state.humanoid ~= humanoid or state.root ~= root then
			if state.method then cleanup() end
			state.method, state.humanoid, state.root = method, humanoid, root
			methods[method].start(humanoid, root)
		end
		delta = math.clamp(tonumber(delta) or 1 / 60, 0, 0.1)
		local movement, vertical, forward = direction(humanoid)
		methods[method].step(humanoid, root, character, delta, movement, vertical, forward, speed)
	end))
	context.section:ToggleKey({Text = "Fly", Default = context.defaults.fly.on,
		Bind = globals.__crkBindFromName(settings.key), Callback = function(enabled) settings.on = not not enabled end,
		OnBind = function(key) settings.key = key and key.Name or "" end, Settings = function()
			context.section:Slider({Text = "Fly Speed", Min = 10, Max = 300, Default = context.defaults.fly.speed or 60,
				Decimals = 0, Callback = function(value) settings.speed = value end})
			local options = {}
			for _, method in ipairs({"Classic", "CFrame", "Swim", "Air Walk", "Glide"}) do
				table.insert(options, {code = method, label = method})
			end
			context.section:Dropdown({Text = "Fly Method", Options = options, Default = context.defaults.fly.method or "Classic",
				Callback = function(value) if methods[value] then settings.method = value end end})
		end})

	return function()
		globals.__crkFlyActive = false
		cleanup()
	end
end

function MoveKit.setupSpeed(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local section = context.section
	local state = {on = false, value = 16, method = "WalkSpeed", base = 16, applied = false, elapsed = 0}
	local methods = {"WalkSpeed", "CFrame", "TP Walk", "Velocity", "Mover"}
	local jumpEnabled, jumpPower = false, 50

	local humanoid; humanoid = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local character = context.player.Character
		return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	end)
	local dropMover; dropMover = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		if not state.mover then return end
		pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() state.mover:Destroy() end))
		state.mover = nil
	end)
	local function apply()
		local characterHumanoid = humanoid()
		if not characterHumanoid then return end

		if state.on and state.method == "WalkSpeed" then
			if characterHumanoid.WalkSpeed ~= state.value then characterHumanoid.WalkSpeed = state.value end
			state.applied = true
			return
		end
		if state.applied then
			state.applied = false
			if characterHumanoid.WalkSpeed ~= state.base then characterHumanoid.WalkSpeed = state.base end
		end
	end
	local step; step = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(_, delta)
		if not state.on or state.method == "WalkSpeed" or context.configuration.fly and context.configuration.fly.on then
			dropMover()
			return
		end

		local characterHumanoid = humanoid()
		local character = context.player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not characterHumanoid or not root or characterHumanoid.Health <= 0 or characterHumanoid.Sit then
			dropMover()
			return
		end

		delta = math.clamp(tonumber(delta) or 1 / 60, 0, 0.1)
		local direction = characterHumanoid.MoveDirection
		local movement = environment.Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
		if movement.Magnitude > 1 then movement = movement.Unit end
		local moving = movement.Magnitude > 0.01
		local extra = state.value - characterHumanoid.WalkSpeed

		if state.method == "CFrame" then
			dropMover()
			if moving and extra > 0 then root.CFrame = root.CFrame + movement * extra * delta end
			return
		end
		if state.method == "TP Walk" then
			dropMover()
			state.elapsed += delta
			if state.elapsed >= 0.1 then
				local interval = math.min(state.elapsed, 0.2)
				state.elapsed = 0
				if moving and extra > 0 then root.CFrame = root.CFrame + movement * extra * interval end
			end
			return
		end
		if state.method == "Velocity" then
			dropMover()
			if moving then
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = environment.Vector3.new(movement.X * state.value,
					root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, movement.Z * state.value)
			end
			return
		end
		if state.method == "Mover" then
			if not state.mover or state.mover.Parent ~= root then
				dropMover()
				local mover = environment.Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				mover.Name = "CrkSpeedMover"
				mover.MaxForce = environment.Vector3.new(100000, 0, 100000)
				mover.P = 10000
				mover:SetAttribute("CrkMine", true)
				mover.Velocity = environment.Vector3.zero
				mover.Parent = root
				state.mover = mover
			end
			state.mover.Velocity = movement * state.value
		end
	end)
	local function applyJump()
		local characterHumanoid = humanoid()
		if characterHumanoid and jumpEnabled then
			characterHumanoid.UseJumpPower = true
			characterHumanoid.JumpPower = jumpPower
		end
	end

	context.connect(context.runService.Stepped, step)
	local speed
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	globals.__crkSetSpeed = function(enabled)
		enabled = not not enabled
		if speed and speed.Set then
			pcall(speed.Set, enabled)
			return
		end

		state.on = enabled
		if not enabled then dropMover() end
		apply()
	end
	globals.__crkGetSpeed = function() return not not state.on end
	speed = section:ToggleKey({Text = "Walk Speed", Default = false, Callback = function(enabled)
		state.on = not not enabled
		if not state.on then dropMover() end
		apply()
	end, Settings = function()
		section:Slider({Text = "Walk Speed Value", Min = 16, Max = 100, Default = 16, Decimals = 0,
			Callback = function(value)
				state.value = tonumber(value) or 16
				apply()
			end})
		local options = {}
		for _, method in ipairs(methods) do table.insert(options, {code = method, label = method}) end
		section:Dropdown({Text = "Speed Method", Options = options, Default = "WalkSpeed", Callback = function(value)
			if not table.find(methods, value) then return end
			state.method, state.elapsed = value, 0
			dropMover()
			apply()
		end})
	end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Jump Power", Default = false, Callback = function(enabled)
		jumpEnabled = enabled
		if enabled then
			applyJump()
			return
		end

		local characterHumanoid = humanoid()
		if characterHumanoid then
			characterHumanoid.UseJumpPower = true
			characterHumanoid.JumpPower = 50
		end
	end, Settings = function()
		section:Slider({Text = "Jump Power Value", Min = 50, Max = 200, Default = 50, Decimals = 0,
			Callback = function(value)
				jumpPower = value
				applyJump()
			end})
	end})
	if context.isAlive then
		environment.task.spawn(function()
			while context.isAlive() do
				environment.task.wait(0.5)
				local characterHumanoid = humanoid()
				if characterHumanoid then
					apply()
					if jumpEnabled then
						if not characterHumanoid.UseJumpPower then characterHumanoid.UseJumpPower = true end
						if characterHumanoid.JumpPower ~= jumpPower then characterHumanoid.JumpPower = jumpPower end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	return function()
		state.on = false
		dropMover()
		apply()
	end
end

function MoveKit.setupGlitch(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local globals = environment.getgenv()
	local state = {on = false, max = 120, acceleration = 60, speed = 0, landedAt = 0, airborne = false}
	local humanoidStates = environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType

	local publish; publish = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(speed)
		globals.__crkGlitchCur = speed
		globals.__crkGlitchSpeed = speed > 0 and speed + 6 or 0
	end)
	local reset; reset = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		if state.speed == 0 and not state.airborne then return end
		state.speed, state.airborne = 0, false
		publish(0)
	end)
	local step; step = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(delta)
		if not state.on then
			reset()
			return
		end

		local character = context.player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = humanoid and humanoid.RootPart
		if not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 or globals.__crkFlyActive or globals.__crkTouchFlinging then
			reset()
			return
		end

		local status = humanoid:GetState()
		if status == humanoidStates.Climbing or status == humanoidStates.Swimming
			or status == humanoidStates.Seated or status == humanoidStates.Dead then
			reset()
			return
		end

		delta = math.min(delta or 1 / 60, 0.1)
		local now = environment.os.clock()
		local inAir = status == humanoidStates.Freefall or status == humanoidStates.Jumping
		local direction = humanoid.MoveDirection
		local movement = environment.Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
		local moving = movement.Magnitude > 0.1
		local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local horizontal = environment.Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
		local current = horizontal.Magnitude

		if inAir then
			state.airborne = true
			if moving then
				state.speed = math.max(state.speed, humanoid.WalkSpeed)
				if current > state.speed and current <= state.max then state.speed = current end
				if state.speed < state.max then state.speed = math.min(state.max, state.speed + state.acceleration * delta) end
			end
		else
			if state.airborne then state.airborne, state.landedAt = false, now end
			if now - state.landedAt > 0.3 then state.speed = 0 end
		end

		state.speed = math.min(state.speed, state.max)
		publish(state.speed)
		if state.speed > 0 and moving and (inAir or now - state.landedAt <= 0.25) and current < state.speed + 1 then
			local desired = movement.Unit * state.speed
			if (horizontal - desired).Magnitude > 0.5 then
				root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = environment.Vector3.new(desired.X, velocity.Y, desired.Z)
			end
		end
	end)

	context.connect(context.runService.Heartbeat, step)
	local toggle = context.section:ToggleKey({Text = "Speed Glitch", Default = false, Callback = function(enabled)
		state.on, state.speed, state.airborne = not not enabled, 0, false
		publish(0)
	end, Settings = function()
		context.section:Slider({Text = "Glitch Speed", Min = 30, Max = 300, Default = 120, Decimals = 0,
			Callback = function(value) state.max = tonumber(value) or 120 end})
		context.section:Slider({Text = "Glitch Acceleration", Min = 10, Max = 300, Default = 60, Decimals = 0,
			Callback = function(value) state.acceleration = tonumber(value) or 60 end})
	end})
	globals.__crkSetSGlitch = function(enabled)
		enabled = not not enabled
		if toggle and toggle.Set then
			pcall(toggle.Set, enabled)
			return
		end
		state.on = enabled
	end
	globals.__crkGetSGlitch = function() return not not state.on end

	return function()
		state.on = false
		publish(0)
	end
end

function MoveKit.setupWallHop(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local vector, cframe, enum = environment.Vector3, environment.CFrame, environment.Enum
	local workspace, globals = context.workspace, environment.getgenv()
	local state = {on = false, mode = "Press", angle = 90, camFlick = false, last = 0, press = 0,
		edgeAt = -1, edgeAir = false, used = -2, held = false, filterT = 0}
	globals.__crkWallHop = state
	local rays = environment.RaycastParams.new()
	rays.FilterType = enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	pcall(function() rays.RespectCanCollide = true end)
	local overlaps = environment.OverlapParams.new()
	overlaps.FilterType = enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	pcall(function() overlaps.RespectCanCollide = true end)
	pcall(function() overlaps.MaxParts = 1 end)
	local directions = {}
	for index = 0, 7 do
		local angle = index * math.pi / 4
		table.insert(directions, vector.new(math.sin(angle), 0, -math.cos(angle)))
	end
	local filter; filter = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(character)
		local now = environment.os.clock()
		if state.fchar == character and now - state.filterT < 1 then return end
		state.fchar, state.filterT = character, now
		local ignored = {character}
		for _, player in ipairs(context.players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player.Character and player.Character ~= character then table.insert(ignored, player.Character) end
		end
		local platform = workspace:FindFirstChild("CrkAirWalk")
		if platform then table.insert(ignored, platform) end
		rays.FilterDescendantsInstances, overlaps.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored, ignored
	end)
	local jumpPower; jumpPower = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(humanoid)
		if humanoid.UseJumpPower then return math.max(humanoid.JumpPower, 20) end
		return math.sqrt(2 * workspace.Gravity * math.max(humanoid.JumpHeight, 2))
	end)
	local findWall; findWall = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(character, humanoid, root)
		filter(character)
		local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
		local horizontal = vector.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
		local rotation = cframe.Angles(0, horizontal.Magnitude > 0.01 and math.atan2(-horizontal.X, -horizontal.Z) or 0, 0)
		local distance = root.Size.X / 2 + 0.85
		local height = humanoid.RigType == enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and root.Size.Y / 2 + 2 or humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2
		local position, now = root.Position, environment.os.clock()
		if not state.terrAt or now - state.terrAt > 15 then
			state.terrAt = now
			local ok, cells = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return workspace.Terrain:CountCells() end))
			state.noTerrain = ok and cells == 0
		end
		if state.noTerrain then
			local vertical = math.max(height * 0.6, root.Size.Y * 0.5)
			local ok, nearby = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
				return workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, math.sqrt(distance * distance + vertical * vertical) + 0.25, overlaps)
			end))
			if ok and type(nearby) == "table" and #nearby == 0 then return nil end
		end
		local nearest, nearestDirection, nearestDistance
		local cast; cast = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(direction)
			for _, y in ipairs({-height * 0.6, 0, root.Size.Y * 0.5}) do
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(position + vector.new(0, y, 0), direction * distance, rays)
				if hit and math.abs(hit.Normal.Y) < 0.4 and (not nearestDistance or hit.Distance < nearestDistance) then
					nearest, nearestDirection, nearestDistance = hit, direction, hit.Distance
				end
			end
		end)
		local movement = humanoid.MoveDirection
		movement = vector.new(movement.X, 0, movement.Z)
		if movement.Magnitude > 0.1 then cast(movement.Unit) end
		for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do cast(rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(direction)) end
		return nearest, nearestDirection
	end)
	local rotateCamera; rotateCamera = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(angle, position)
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera then
			pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() camera.CFrame = cframe.new(position) * cframe.Angles(0, angle, 0) * cframe.new(-position) * camera.CFrame end))
		end
	end)
	context.connect(context.inputService.JumpRequest, function() state.press = environment.os.clock() end)
	context.connect(context.runService.Stepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		local character = context.player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
		local now, back = environment.os.clock(), state.back
		if back and now >= back.t then
			state.back = nil
			if back.hrp == root and root.Parent then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() root.CFrame = cframe.new(root.Position) * back.rot end)) end
			if back.cam then rotateCamera(-back.cam, root.Position) end
			if back.ar then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() if back.ar.AutoRotate == false then back.ar.AutoRotate = true end end)) end
		end
		local airborne = humanoid.FloorMaterial == enum.Material.Air
		local pressed = humanoid.Jump or context.inputService:IsKeyDown(enum.KeyCode.Space) or now - state.press < 0.12
		if pressed and not state.held then state.edgeAt, state.edgeAir = now, airborne end
		state.held = pressed
		if not state.on or state.back or globals.__crkFlyActive or not airborne or now - state.last < 0.25 then return end
		local current = humanoid:GetState()
		if current ~= enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and current ~= enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then return end
		local vertical, power = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, jumpPower(humanoid)
		if state.mode == "Hold" and (not pressed or vertical > power * 0.1) then return end
		if state.mode ~= "Hold" and (not state.edgeAir or state.used == state.edgeAt or now - state.edgeAt > 0.15 or vertical > power * 0.7) then return end
		local hit, direction = findWall(character, humanoid, root)
		if not hit then return end
		state.last, state.used = now, state.edgeAt
		local normal = vector.new(hit.Normal.X, 0, hit.Normal.Z)
		normal = normal.Magnitude > 0.01 and normal.Unit or -direction
		local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
		look = vector.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
		local sign = look.Magnitude > 0.01 and look:Cross(-normal).Y < 0 and -1 or 1
		local angle, rotation = math.rad(state.angle) * sign, root.CFrame - root.CFrame.Position
		local autoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate and humanoid or nil
		if autoRotate then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() humanoid.AutoRotate = false end)) end
		pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() root.CFrame = cframe.new(root.Position) * cframe.Angles(0, angle, 0) * rotation end))
		state.back = {t = now + 0.05, rot = rotation, hrp = root, cam = state.camFlick and angle or nil, ar = autoRotate}
		if state.camFlick then rotateCamera(angle, root.Position) end
		pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() humanoid:ChangeState(enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end))
		state.hops = (state.hops or 0) + 1
	end))
	context.section:Header("Wall Hop")
	context.section:ToggleKey({Text = "Wall Hop", Default = false, Callback = function(enabled) state.on = not not enabled end,
		Settings = function()
			context.section:Dropdown({Text = "Hop Mode", Options = {{code = "Press", label = "Press"}, {code = "Hold", label = "Hold"}},
				Default = "Press", Callback = function(value) if value == "Press" or value == "Hold" then state.mode = value end end})
			context.section:Slider({Text = "Flick Angle", Min = 30, Max = 180, Default = 90, Decimals = 0, Suffix = "В°",
				Callback = function(value) state.angle = tonumber(value) or 90 end})
			context.section:Toggle({Text = "Camera Flick", Default = false, Callback = function(value) state.camFlick = not not value end})
		end})
	return function()
		state.on = false
		if state.back and state.back.ar then pcall(function() state.back.ar.AutoRotate = true end) end
	end
end

function MoveKit.setupGravity(context)
	local environment = context.environment
	local section = context.section
	local state = {on = false, value = 196, applied = false, hipOn = false, hip = 4}

	local function applyGravity()
		if state.on then
			if math.abs(context.workspace.Gravity - state.value) > 0.01 then
				context.workspace.Gravity = state.value
			end
			state.applied = true
			return
		end

		if state.applied then
			state.applied = false
			local base = rawget(environment.getgenv(), "__crkWorldBase")
			context.workspace.Gravity = type(base) == "table" and tonumber(base.Gravity) or 196.2
		end
	end
	local function applyHip()
		local character = context.player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if state.hipOn and humanoid then
			if state.humanoid ~= humanoid then
				state.humanoid, state.hipBase = humanoid, humanoid.HipHeight
			end
			if math.abs(humanoid.HipHeight - state.hip) > 0.01 then humanoid.HipHeight = state.hip end
			return
		end
		if not state.hipOn and state.humanoid then
			if state.humanoid == humanoid and state.hipBase then
				pcall(function() humanoid.HipHeight = state.hipBase end)
			end
			state.humanoid, state.hipBase = nil, nil
		end
	end

	section:ToggleKey({Text = "Gravity", Default = false, Callback = function(enabled)
		state.on = not not enabled
		applyGravity()
	end, Settings = function()
		section:Slider({Text = "Gravity Value", Min = 5, Max = 400, Default = 196, Decimals = 0,
			Callback = function(value)
				state.value = tonumber(value) or 196
				applyGravity()
			end})
	end})
	section:Toggle({Text = "Hip Height", Default = false, Callback = function(enabled)
		state.hipOn = not not enabled
		applyHip()
	end, Settings = function()
		section:Slider({Text = "Hip Height Value", Min = 0, Max = 30, Default = 4, Decimals = 1,
			Callback = function(value)
				state.hip = tonumber(value) or 4
				applyHip()
			end})
	end})
	if context.isAlive then
		environment.task.spawn(function()
			while context.isAlive() do
				environment.task.wait(0.5)
				pcall(applyGravity)
				pcall(applyHip)
			end
		end)
	end

	return function()
		state.on, state.hipOn = false, false
		pcall(applyGravity)
		pcall(applyHip)
	end
end


local DesyncKit = {}

function DesyncKit.initialize(configuration)
	if type(configuration.fakepos) ~= "table" then configuration.fakepos = {} end
	local settings = configuration.fakepos
	local version = tonumber(settings.v) or 0
	if tonumber(settings.power) == nil or version < 3 then settings.power = 5 end
	if settings.vel == nil then settings.vel = true end
	if settings.md == nil then settings.md = true end
	if settings.side == nil or version < 4 then settings.side = true end
	if version < 5 then settings.mode, settings.dir, settings.smart, settings.power = "Desync", "Random", true, 10 end
	if settings.mode ~= "Desync" and settings.mode ~= "Prediction" then settings.mode = "Desync" end
	if type(settings.dir) ~= "string" then settings.dir = "Random" end
	if settings.smart == nil then settings.smart = true end
	settings.v, settings.on = 5, false
	return settings
end

function DesyncKit.bindCharacter(state, character)
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	state.character, state.active = character, false
	for _, connection in state.characterConnections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
	state.characterConnections = {}

	if character then
		local function onTool(tool)
			if tool:IsA("Tool") then state.toolAt = environment.os.clock() end
		end
		table.insert(state.characterConnections, context.connect(character.ChildAdded, onTool))
		table.insert(state.characterConnections, context.connect(character.ChildRemoved, onTool))
	end
	state.savedVelocity, state.spoofVelocity, state.savedDirection, state.spoofDirection = nil, nil, nil, nil
	state.savedFrame, state.spoofFrame = nil, nil
	state.root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
	state.humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
end

DesyncKit.restore = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state)
	state.active = false
	local root, humanoid = state.root, state.humanoid
	if state.savedFrame and state.spoofFrame and root and root.Parent then
		local current = root.CFrame
		if (current.Position - state.spoofFrame.Position).Magnitude < 0.01
			and current.LookVector:Dot(state.spoofFrame.LookVector) > 0.9999 then root.CFrame = state.savedFrame end
	end
	if state.spoofVelocity and state.savedVelocity and root and root.Parent then
		local current = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local spoofDistance, originalDistance = (current - state.spoofVelocity).Magnitude, (current - state.savedVelocity).Magnitude
		if spoofDistance < 0.05 then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = state.savedVelocity end
		if spoofDistance >= 0.05 and spoofDistance < originalDistance then
			local vector = state.context.environment.Vector3
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vector.new(state.savedVelocity.X, math.min(current.Y, state.savedVelocity.Y), state.savedVelocity.Z)
			state.leakFix = (state.leakFix or 0) + 1
		end
	end
	if state.spoofDirection and state.savedDirection and humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
		if (humanoid.MoveDirection - state.spoofDirection).Magnitude < 0.05 then humanoid:Move(state.savedDirection, false) end
	end
	state.savedVelocity, state.spoofVelocity, state.savedDirection, state.spoofDirection = nil, nil, nil, nil
	state.savedFrame, state.spoofFrame = nil, nil
	state.restores += 1
end)

DesyncKit.tryRestore = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(state)
	if not state.active then return end
	local ok = pcall(DesyncKit.restore, state)
	if ok then return end
	state.active = false
	state.savedVelocity, state.spoofVelocity, state.savedDirection, state.spoofDirection = nil, nil, nil, nil
	state.savedFrame, state.spoofFrame = nil, nil
end)

function DesyncKit.ownedMover(state)
	local root = state.root
	if not root or not root.Parent then return false end
	for _, child in root:GetChildren() do
		if child.Name == "CrkFarmBV" or child.Name == "CrkFarmBG" or child:GetAttribute("CrkMine") then return true end
	end
	return false
end

function DesyncKit.busy(state, now)
	local globals = state.context.environment.getgenv()
	if now < (tonumber(globals.__crkShotHold) or 0) or now - (state.toolAt or 0) < 0.35 then return true end
	if globals.__crkFlyActive or globals.__crkManualFling or globals.__crkTouchFlinging or globals.__crkFlingTargetChar then return true end
	if state.context.configuration.autoFlingSheriff then return true end
	if globals.__crkInvis and globals.__crkInvis.active then return true end
	if (tonumber(globals.__crkBombJumpUntil) or 0) > now then return true end
	local farm = globals.__crkFarmAPI
	if farm and farm.getEnabled and farm.getEnabled() then return true end
	return state.hasMover
end

function DesyncKit.threat(state, position)
	local context = state.context
	local roles = context.roles()
	if type(roles) ~= "table" then return nil end
	local own = roles[context.player.Name]
	local murderer = own ~= nil and tostring(own.Role) == "Murderer"
	local closest, distance

	for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
		if player == context.player then continue end
		local role = roles[player.Name]
		if not role or role.Dead == true or role.Killed == true then continue end
		local name = tostring(role.Role)
		if murderer and name ~= "Sheriff" and name ~= "Hero" then continue end
		if not murderer and name ~= "Murderer" then continue end
		local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then continue end
		local current = (root.Position - position).Magnitude
		if not distance or current < distance then closest, distance = root, current end
	end
	return closest
end

function DesyncKit.spoofVector(state, now, power)
	local vector, settings = state.context.environment.Vector3, state.cfg
	local function random() return math.random() * 2 - 1 end
	if settings.dir == "Underground" then return vector.new(random() * power * 0.15, -power, random() * power * 0.15) end
	if settings.dir == "Sky" then return vector.new(random() * power * 0.15, power, random() * power * 0.15) end
	if settings.dir == "Spin" then
		state.angle = (state.angle + 0.9 + math.random() * 0.6) % (2 * math.pi)
		return vector.new(math.cos(state.angle) * power, random() * power * 0.35, math.sin(state.angle) * power)
	end
	if settings.dir == "Jitter" then
		if not state.jitterDirection or now >= state.jitterUntil then
			local direction = vector.new(random(), random() * 0.4, random())
			state.jitterDirection = direction.Magnitude > 0.1 and direction.Unit or vector.xAxis
			state.jitterUntil = now + 0.25 + math.random() * 0.25
		end
		state.flip = -state.flip
		return state.jitterDirection * (power * 1.6 * state.flip)
	end
	return vector.new((math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * power, random() * power,
		(math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * power)
end

function DesyncKit.nearCoin(state, position, now)
	local context = state.context
	if now - state.coinAt > 1 or not (state.coinContainer and state.coinContainer.Parent) then
		state.coinAt, state.coinContainer = now, nil
		for _, child in context.workspace:GetChildren() do
			local container = child:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
			if container then state.coinContainer = container; break end
		end
		if state.coinContainer then state.coinParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {state.coinContainer} end
	end
	if not state.coinContainer then return false end
	return #context.workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, state.coinR or 14, state.coinParams) > 0
end

function DesyncKit.shouldPause(state, character, position, now)
	if now - state.pauseAt < 0.08 then return state.pauseValue end
	state.pauseAt = now
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	local knife, gun = character:FindFirstChild("Knife"), character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
	local pause = (knife or gun) and context.inputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(environment.Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) or false
	if knife and not pause then
		local globals = environment.getgenv()
		pause = globals.__crkKillAuraOn or globals.__crkGetKillAll and globals.__crkGetKillAll() or false
		if not pause then
			for _, player in context.players:GetPlayers() do
				if player == context.player then continue end
				local target = player.Character
				local root = target and target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local humanoid = target and target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and (root.Position - position).Magnitude < (state.stabR or 16) then
					pause = true
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if not pause then
		local ok, near = pcall(DesyncKit.nearCoin, state, position, now)
		pause = ok and near or false
	end
	state.pauseValue = pause
	return pause
end

function DesyncKit.desync(state, character, position, now)
	local context, settings = state.context, state.cfg
	local role = context.roles()[context.player.Name]
	if not role or role.Dead == true or role.Killed == true then state.mode = "idle"; return end
	if settings.smart ~= false and DesyncKit.shouldPause(state, character, position, now) then state.mode = "pause"; return end

	local vector = context.environment.Vector3
	local power = 32767 * math.clamp(tonumber(settings.power) or 10, 1, 10) / 10
	local spoof = DesyncKit.spoofVector(state, now, power)
	state.active = true
	state.savedVelocity = state.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	state.spoofVelocity = vector.new(math.clamp(spoof.X, -32767, 32767), math.clamp(spoof.Y, -32767, 32767),
		math.clamp(spoof.Z, -32767, 32767))
	state.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = state.spoofVelocity
	if context.environment.sethiddenproperty then pcall(context.environment.sethiddenproperty, state.root, "NetworkIsSleeping", false) end

	if settings.md ~= false then
		if not state.direction or now >= state.directionUntil then
			local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
			state.direction = vector.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
			state.directionUntil = now + 0.15 + math.random() * 0.3
		end
		state.savedDirection, state.spoofDirection = state.humanoid.MoveDirection, state.direction
		state.humanoid:Move(state.spoofDirection, false)
	end
	state.mode, state.desyncAt, state.frames = "desync", now, state.frames + 1
end

function DesyncKit.predict(state, position, now)
	local context, settings = state.context, state.cfg
	local environment, vector = context.environment, context.environment.Vector3
	state.mode = "prediction"
	if now >= state.threatAt then
		state.threatAt = now + 0.25
		local ok, threat = pcall(DesyncKit.threat, state, position)
		state.threat = ok and threat or nil
		if not state.threat and environment.typeof(state.force) == "Instance" and state.force.Parent then state.threat = state.force end
	end
	if not state.threat or not state.threat.Parent then return end

	local delta = position - state.threat.Position
	delta = vector.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
	if delta.Magnitude < 0.5 then return end
	local direction = delta.Unit
	local side = vector.new(-direction.Z, 0, direction.X)
	local velocity, frame = state.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity, state.root.CFrame
	local horizontal = vector.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
	local lateral = horizontal:Dot(side)
	local facing = frame.LookVector:Dot(side) >= 0 and side or -side
	if math.abs(lateral) > 3 then
		state.side = lateral > 0 and -1 or 1
		state.sideUntil = now + 0.25 + math.random() * 0.35
	end
	if math.abs(lateral) <= 3 and settings.side ~= false and now >= state.sideUntil then state.side = facing:Dot(side) > 0 and 1 or -1 end
	if math.abs(lateral) <= 3 and settings.side == false and now >= state.sideUntil then
		state.side = math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1
		state.sideUntil = now + 0.6 + math.random() * 1.2
	end

	local spoofDirection = side * state.side
	local speed = math.max(10 + math.clamp(tonumber(settings.power) or 5, 1, 10) * 9, horizontal.Magnitude)
	state.active = true
	if settings.vel ~= false then
		state.savedVelocity = velocity
		state.spoofVelocity = vector.new(spoofDirection.X * speed, velocity.Y, spoofDirection.Z * speed)
		state.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = state.spoofVelocity
	end
	if settings.md ~= false then
		state.savedDirection, state.spoofDirection = state.humanoid.MoveDirection, spoofDirection
		state.humanoid:Move(spoofDirection, false)
	end
	if settings.side ~= false then
		local fake = environment.CFrame.lookAt(frame.Position, frame.Position + facing)
		local muzzle = rawget(environment.getgenv(), "__crkMuzzle")
		if muzzle and muzzle.poseClear and not muzzle.poseClear(fake) then
			local opposite = environment.CFrame.lookAt(frame.Position, frame.Position - facing)
			fake = muzzle.poseClear(opposite) and opposite or nil
			state.sideSkips = (state.sideSkips or 0) + (fake and 0 or 1)
		end
		if fake then
			state.savedFrame, state.spoofFrame = frame, fake
			state.root.CFrame = fake
			state.sideFrames, state.sideAt, state.fakeCF = (state.sideFrames or 0) + 1, now, fake
		end
	end
	state.frames += 1
end

function DesyncKit.step(state)
	local context, settings = state.context, state.cfg
	if state.active or not settings.on then return end
	if settings.mode == "Prediction" and settings.vel == false and settings.md == false and settings.side == false then return end

	local character = context.player.Character
	if character ~= state.character then DesyncKit.bindCharacter(state, character) end
	if not (state.root and state.root.Parent) then state.root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil end
	if not (state.humanoid and state.humanoid.Parent) then state.humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil end
	local root, humanoid = state.root, state.humanoid
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Sit or state.invalidStates[humanoid:GetState()] then return end

	local now = context.environment.os.clock()
	if now >= state.moverAt then state.moverAt, state.hasMover = now + 0.1, DesyncKit.ownedMover(state) end
	if DesyncKit.busy(state, now) then state.mode = "busy"; return end
	if settings.mode ~= "Prediction" then DesyncKit.desync(state, character, root.Position, now); return end
	DesyncKit.predict(state, root.Position, now)
end

function DesyncKit.controls(state, section)
	local settings = state.cfg
	section:Header("Anti-Aim")
	section:Toggle({Text = "Anti Aim", Default = false, Callback = function(value) settings.on = not not value end, Settings = function()
		section:Dropdown({Text = "AA Mode", Default = settings.mode, Options = {{code = "Desync", label = "Desync"},
			{code = "Prediction", label = "Prediction"}}, Callback = function(value)
			if value == "Desync" or value == "Prediction" then settings.mode = value end
		end})
		section:Dropdown({Text = "Direction", Default = settings.dir, Options = {{code = "Random", label = "Random"},
			{code = "Jitter", label = "Jitter"}, {code = "Spin", label = "Spin"}, {code = "Underground", label = "Underground"},
			{code = "Sky", label = "Sky"}}, Callback = function(value) if type(value) == "string" then settings.dir = value end end})
		section:Slider({Text = "Spoof Strength", Min = 1, Max = 10, Default = settings.power, Decimals = 0,
			Callback = function(value) settings.power = value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Smart Pause", Default = settings.smart ~= false, Callback = function(value) settings.smart = not not value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Spoof Velocity", Default = settings.vel == true, Callback = function(value) settings.vel = not not value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Spoof Move Direction", Default = settings.md == true, Callback = function(value) settings.md = not not value end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Side Profile", Default = settings.side == true, Callback = function(value) settings.side = not not value end})
	end})
end

function DesyncKit.setup(context)
	local environment, globals = context.environment, context.environment.getgenv()
	local settings = DesyncKit.initialize(context.configuration)
	local invalid = environment.Enum.HumanoidStateType
	local state = {context = context, cfg = settings, frames = 0, restores = 0, side = 1, sideUntil = 0, threatAt = 0,
		angle = 0, flip = 1, jitterUntil = 0, directionUntil = 0, pauseAt = 0, pauseValue = false, coinAt = -10,
		moverAt = 0, hasMover = false, active = false, characterConnections = {}, invalidStates = {}}
	for _, name in {"Dead", "Seated", "Climbing", "Physics", "PlatformStanding", "Ragdoll", "FallingDown", "Swimming", "GettingUp"} do
		state.invalidStates[invalid[name]] = true
	end
	state.coinParams = environment.OverlapParams.new()
	state.coinParams.FilterType = environment.Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	globals.__crkFakePos = {active = false, off = environment.Vector3.zero}
	globals.__crkAntiAim = state
	pcall(function() if tonumber(environment.getfflag("WorldStepMax")) < 0 then environment.setfflag("WorldStepMax", "30") end end)

	context.connect(context.runService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		DesyncKit.tryRestore(state)
		if settings.on then environment.task.defer(function()
			if not pcall(DesyncKit.step, state) then DesyncKit.tryRestore(state) end
		end) end
	end))
	context.connect(context.runService.PreSimulation, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() DesyncKit.tryRestore(state) end))
	pcall(function() context.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CrkFakePos") end)
	pcall(function() context.runService:BindToRenderStep("CrkFakePos", environment.Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() DesyncKit.tryRestore(state) end)) end)
	context.connect(context.player.CharacterAdded, function(character) DesyncKit.bindCharacter(state, character) end)
	if context.player.Character then DesyncKit.bindCharacter(state, context.player.Character) end
	DesyncKit.controls(state, context.section)
	return state, function()
		DesyncKit.tryRestore(state)
		settings.on = false
		for _, connection in state.characterConnections do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
		pcall(function() context.runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CrkFakePos") end)
		globals.__crkFakePos.active, globals.__crkFakePos.off = false, environment.Vector3.zero
	end
end

KeyBinds.setup(environment, inputService)
local isAlive = function() return not dead and not Window.Destroyed end
local stops = {}
local function add(fn) if type(fn) == "function" then table.insert(stops, fn) end end
local function run(name, fn)
	local ok, res = pcall(fn)
	if ok then add(res) else warn("[CrackHub Movement] " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(res)) end
end
local base = {environment = environment, configuration = configuration, defaults = defaults, section = section,
	connect = connect, inputService = inputService, runService = runService, workspace = workspace, player = player}
local function ctx(extra)
	local c = {}
	for k, v in pairs(base) do c[k] = v end
	for k, v in pairs(extra or {}) do c[k] = v end
	return c
end

run("Noclip", function() return MoveKit.setupNoclip(ctx()) end)
run("CameraNoclip", function() return MoveKit.setupCameraNoclip(ctx()) end)
run("Jump", function() return MoveKit.setup(ctx()) end)
run("AntiCoin", function() return MoveKit.setupAntiCoin(ctx({storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), window = Window,
	translation = {tr = function(s) return s end}, isAlive = isAlive})) end)
run("BombJump", function() return MoveKit.setupBombJump(ctx()) end)
run("Fly", function() return MoveKit.setupFly(ctx()) end)
run("SpinBhop", function() return MoveKit.setupSpinAndBhop(ctx()) end)
run("Invisibility", function() return MoveKit.setupInvisibility(ctx({bindRender = bindRender})) end)
section:Header("Speed & Jump")
run("Speed", function() return MoveKit.setupSpeed(ctx({isAlive = isAlive})) end)
run("Glitch", function() return MoveKit.setupGlitch(ctx()) end)
run("Gravity", function() return MoveKit.setupGravity(ctx({isAlive = isAlive})) end)
run("WallHop", function() return MoveKit.setupWallHop(ctx({players = players})) end)

local aaState
run("DesyncKit", function()
	local st, stop = DesyncKit.setup(ctx({players = players, roles = function()
		local ok, r = pcall(rolesFn)
		return ok and type(r) == "table" and r or {}
	end}))
	aaState = st
	return stop
end)

section:Header("Fake Pos")
run("FakePos", function()
	local fp = {on = false, mode = "Orbit", rate = 6, amp = 3, face = true}
	local saved, spoof, root
	local restore; restore = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		if saved and spoof and root and root.Parent then
			local cur = root.CFrame
			if (cur.Position - spoof.Position).Magnitude < 25 then
				local rot = cur.LookVector:Dot(spoof.LookVector) > 0.9999 and saved.Rotation or cur.Rotation
				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(cur.Position - spoof.Position + saved.Position) * rot
			end
		end
		saved, spoof = nil, nil
	end)
	local step; step = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		if not fp.on or (aaState and aaState.active) then return end
		local char = player.Character
		root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or hum.Sit then return end
		local frame = root.CFrame
		local off
		if fp.mode == "Jitter" then
			off = Vector3.new((math.random() * 2 - 1) * fp.amp, 0, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * fp.amp)
		else
			local a = os.clock() * fp.rate
			off = Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * fp.amp, 0, math.sin(a) * fp.amp)
		end
		local pos = frame.Position + off
		local fake = fp.face and CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + frame.LookVector) or (CFrame.new(pos) * frame.Rotation)
		saved, spoof = frame, fake
		root.CFrame = fake
	end)
	connect(runService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() restore(); step() end))
	connect(runService.PreSimulation, restore)
	pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ChFakePos") end)
	pcall(function() runService:BindToRenderStep("ChFakePos", Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value, restore) end)
	section:ToggleKey({Text = "Fake Pos", Default = false, Callback = function(v)
		fp.on = v
		if not v then restore() end
	end, Settings = function()
		section:Dropdown({Text = "Fake Pos Mode", Options = {"Orbit", "Jitter"}, Default = "Orbit", Callback = function(v) fp.mode = v end})
		section:Slider({Text = "Fake Pos Speed", Min = 1, Max = 30, Default = 6, Decimals = 0, Callback = function(v) fp.rate = v end})
		section:Slider({Text = "Fake Pos Radius", Min = 1, Max = 15, Default = 3, Decimals = 0, Callback = function(v) fp.amp = v end})
		section:Toggle({Text = "Face Forward", Default = true, Callback = function(v) fp.face = v end})
	end})
	return function()
		fp.on = false
		restore()
		pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ChFakePos") end)
	end
end)

local function cleanup()
	dead = true
	for _, s in ipairs(stops) do pcall(s) end
	for _, c in ipairs(connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	for _, n in ipairs(renderNames) do pcall(function() runService:UnbindFromRenderStep(n) end) end
end
table.insert(Window.Connections, {Disconnect = cleanup})
return cleanup
end

-- ===== CrackHub Mobile: on-screen buttons for any hub function =====
CrackHub.InstallMobile = function(Window, MobileTab)
	local Players, UIS, TweenService = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("UserInputService"), game:GetService("TweenService")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	local FILE = "CrackHub/mobile_buttons.json"
	local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

	-- every function the hub has: toggles and buttons recorded when they were created (+ special actions)
	local function actions()
		local list, seen = {}, {}
		local function add(name, kind, ref, icon)
			name = tostring(name or "")
			if name == "" or seen[name:lower()] then return end
			seen[name:lower()] = true
			table.insert(list, {name = name, kind = kind, ref = ref, icon = icon})
		end
		add("Shot Murder", "call", function()
			if CrackHub.ShotMurderPress then CrackHub.ShotMurderPress(); return end
			local f = rawget(CrackHubEnvironment, "__crackhubShotMurder")
			if type(f) ~= "function" then pcall(function() f = getgenv().__crackhubShotMurder end) end
			if type(f) == "function" then pcall(f) else pcall(function() CrackHub:Notify({Title = "Shot Murder", Content = "Shot Murder is not loaded", Type = "Warning", Duration = 3}) end) end
		end, "scan-eye")
		add("Inspect Gun", "call", function() if CrackHub.InspectGun then pcall(CrackHub.InspectGun) end end, "box")
		add("Inspect Rock", "call", function() if CrackHub.InspectRock then pcall(CrackHub.InspectRock) end end, "triangle")
		for _, e in ipairs(CrackHub.AllToggles or {}) do add(e.name, "toggle", e.toggle) end
		for _, e in ipairs(CrackHub.AllButtons or {}) do add(e.name, "call", e.callback) end
		return list
	end
	local ICONS = {["shot murder"] = "scan-eye", ["speed glitch"] = "flame", bhop = "layers", ["bomb jump"] = "triangle",
		["kill all"] = "sword", fly = "send", ["inspect gun"] = "box", ["inspect rock"] = "triangle", noclip = "user-x", ["anti aim"] = "shield-check", ["fake pos"] = "users"}
	local function iconFor(a) return a.icon or ICONS[a.name:lower()] or "badge-check" end
	local function find(name)
		for _, a in ipairs(actions()) do if a.name:lower() == name:lower() then return a end end
	end
	local function run(a)
		if not a then return end
		if a.kind == "toggle" then pcall(function() a.ref:Set(not a.ref.Value) end) else pcall(a.ref) end
	end

	-- saved layout
	local saved = {locked = false, buttons = {}}
	pcall(function() if isfile and isfile(FILE) then saved = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(FILE)) end end)
	if type(saved.buttons) ~= "table" or #saved.buttons == 0 and not saved.init then
		saved.buttons, saved.init = {}, true
		for i, n in ipairs({"Shot Murder", "Speed Glitch", "Bhop", "Bomb Jump", "Kill All", "Fly"}) do
			table.insert(saved.buttons, {name = n, size = 48, x = 0.76 + ((i - 1) % 3) * 0.065, y = 0.5 + math.floor((i - 1) / 3) * 0.13})
		end
	end
	local function save() pcall(function() if makefolder and isfolder and not isfolder("CrackHub") then makefolder("CrackHub") end; writefile(FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(saved)) end) end
	-- Inspect button: on the screen only while you hold a weapon / tool (gun, knife, rock...). Delete it in this list to remove it for good.
	-- one-time: older default size 64 -> 48 (smaller buttons)
	if not saved.smallSizes then for _, c in ipairs(saved.buttons) do if tonumber(c.size) == 64 then c.size = 48 end end; saved.smallSizes = true end
	saved.removedAuto = saved.removedAuto or {}
	if saved.inspectRemoved then saved.removedAuto["Inspect Gun"] = true; saved.inspectRemoved = nil end
	for _, auto in ipairs({{"Inspect Gun", 0.62, 0.62}, {"Inspect Rock", 0.62, 0.78}}) do
		if not saved.removedAuto[auto[1]] then
			local has = false
			for _, c in ipairs(saved.buttons) do if c.name == auto[1] then has = true end end
			if not has then table.insert(saved.buttons, {name = auto[1], size = 48, x = auto[2], y = auto[3]}) end
		end
	end
	-- auto buttons: on screen only while the item is in your hand
	local AUTO_SHOW = {
		["Inspect Gun"] = function() local ch = LocalPlayer.Character; return ch ~= nil and ch:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil end,
		["Inspect Rock"] = function() return CrackHub.RockHeld ~= nil and CrackHub.RockHeld() == true end,
	}

	-- ===== on-screen buttons =====
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.IgnoreGuiInset, gui.DisplayOrder = "CrackHubMobile", false, true, 50
	pcall(function() gui.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
	if not gui.Parent then gui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end
	local live = {}
	local moveConns = {}
	local refreshList
	local function build()
		for _, b in ipairs(live) do b:Destroy() end
		table.clear(live)
		for _, c in ipairs(moveConns) do c:Disconnect() end
		table.clear(moveConns)
		for index, cfg in ipairs(saved.buttons) do
			if cfg.hidden then continue end -- hidden = kept in the list, just not on screen
			local a = find(cfg.name)
			local size = math.clamp(tonumber(cfg.size) or 64, 40, 110)
			local b = Create("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(cfg.x or 0.8, cfg.y or 0.5),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, Text = "",
				AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = gui}, {Corner(size / 2), Stroke(Theme.Accent, 2, 0.2)})
			local ic = Create("ImageLabel", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.4), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size * 0.36, size * 0.36),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1, ImageColor3 = Theme.Accent, Parent = b})
			ApplyIcon(ic, a and iconFor(a) or "x")
			Create("TextLabel", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.64), Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 12), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = cfg.name, FontFace = Fonts.Bold, TextSize = math.max(8, math.floor(size / 7)), TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextScaled = false,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = b})
			local scale = Create("UIScale", {Parent = b})
			local function paint()
				local on = a and a.kind == "toggle" and a.ref.Value
				b.BackgroundColor3 = on and Theme.Accent or Theme.Background
				ic.ImageColor3 = on and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Theme.Accent
			end
			paint()
			-- tap = run, drag (when unlocked) = move
			local downAt, startPos, moved
			b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
				downAt, startPos, moved = input.Position, b.Position, false
				Tween(scale, {Scale = 0.88}, 0.08)
				local conn
				conn = input.Changed:Connect(function()
					if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
						conn:Disconnect()
						Tween(scale, {Scale = 1}, 0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
						if moved then
							local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
							cfg.x, cfg.y = b.AbsolutePosition.X / vp.X + b.AbsoluteSize.X / 2 / vp.X, b.AbsolutePosition.Y / vp.Y + b.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2 / vp.Y
							save()
						else
							run(find(cfg.name)); task.defer(paint)
						end
						downAt = nil
					end
				end)
			end)
			table.insert(moveConns, UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
				if not downAt or saved.locked then return end
				if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
				local d = input.Position - downAt
				if d.Magnitude > 22 then moved = true end
				if moved then b.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y) end
			end))
			if a and a.kind == "toggle" then task.spawn(function() while b.Parent do paint(); task.wait(0.3) end end) end
			local showIf = AUTO_SHOW[cfg.name]
			if showIf then
				local function check() local ok, h = pcall(showIf); return ok and h == true end
				b.Visible = check()
				task.spawn(function() while b.Parent do local h = check(); if b.Visible ~= h then b.Visible = h end; task.wait(0.15) end end)
			end
			table.insert(live, b)
		end
	end

	-- ===== tab page =====
	local page = Create("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		LayoutOrder = NextOrder(), Parent = MobileTab.Holder}, {List(8)})
	local top = Create("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = page})
	Create("TextLabel", {Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Mobile buttons", FontFace = Fonts.Bold, TextSize = 18,
		TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = top})
	local lockBtn = Create("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 32),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element, Text = "", FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, Parent = top}, {Corner(8)})
	local addBtn = Create("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 32),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, Text = "+  Add your own", FontFace = Fonts.Bold, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Parent = top}, {Corner(8)})
	local function paintLock() lockBtn.Text = saved.locked and "Positions: locked" or "Positions: drag" end
	paintLock()
	lockBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() saved.locked = not saved.locked; paintLock(); save() end)

	local listFrame = Create("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = page}, {List(6)})
	function refreshList()
		for _, c in ipairs(listFrame:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end end
		for i, cfg in ipairs(saved.buttons) do
			local a = find(cfg.name)
			local r = Create("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = listFrame}, {Corner(10)})
			local ic = Create("ImageLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 11), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ImageColor3 = Theme.Accent, Parent = r})
			ApplyIcon(ic, a and iconFor(a) or "x")
			Create("TextLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = cfg.name .. (a and "" or "  (not found)"),
				FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = r})
			local function sizeBtn(txt, xo, delta)
				local b = Create("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, xo, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 28),
					BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, Text = txt, FontFace = Fonts.Bold, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, Parent = r}, {Corner(7)})
				b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() cfg.size = math.clamp((tonumber(cfg.size) or 64) + delta, 40, 110); save(); build(); refreshList() end)
			end
			Create("TextLabel", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -198, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 28), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = "size " .. tostring(cfg.size or 64), FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText, Parent = r})
			sizeBtn("-", -262, -8); sizeBtn("+", -164, 8)
			-- Hide/Show: takes the button off the screen without deleting it from your list
			local vis = Create("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 28),
				BackgroundColor3 = cfg.hidden and Theme.Accent or Theme.Background, Text = cfg.hidden and "Show" or "Hide", FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 12,
				TextColor3 = cfg.hidden and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Theme.Text, Parent = r}, {Corner(7)})
			vis.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() cfg.hidden = not cfg.hidden; save(); build(); refreshList() end)
			local del = Create("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -82, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 28),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, Text = "Delete", FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 110), Parent = r}, {Corner(7)})
			del.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if AUTO_SHOW[cfg.name] then saved.removedAuto[cfg.name] = true end; table.remove(saved.buttons, i); save(); build(); refreshList() end)
		end
	end

	-- ===== "Add your own" picker: search + grid, 5 per row =====
	local picker
	addBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if picker then picker:Destroy(); picker = nil; return end
		picker = Create("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 380), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, LayoutOrder = -1, Parent = page},
			{Corner(12), Stroke(Theme.Accent, 1, 0.4), Padding(10, 10, 10, 10)})
		local search = Create("TextBox", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element, Text = "", PlaceholderText = "Search function...",
			ClearTextOnFocus = false, FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.SubText,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = picker}, {Corner(8), Padding(0, 12, 0, 12)})
		local grid = Create("ScrollingFrame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 44), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -44), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			ScrollBarThickness = 3, CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Parent = picker})
		Create("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = UDim2.new(0.2, -8, 0, 84), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.Name, Parent = grid})
		local function fill(q)
			for _, c in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("TextButton") then c:Destroy() end end
			for _, a in ipairs(actions()) do
				if q == "" or a.name:lower():find(q:lower(), 1, true) then
					local card = Create("TextButton", {Name = a.name, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = true, Parent = grid}, {Corner(10), Stroke(Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)})
					local ic = Create("ImageLabel", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 12), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
						BackgroundTransparency = 1, ImageColor3 = Theme.Accent, Parent = card})
					ApplyIcon(ic, iconFor(a))
					Create("TextLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 46), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = a.name, TextWrapped = true,
						FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, Parent = card})
					card.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
						if AUTO_SHOW[a.name] then saved.removedAuto[a.name] = nil end; table.insert(saved.buttons, {name = a.name, size = 48, x = 0.5, y = 0.5})
						save(); build(); refreshList()
						pcall(function() CrackHub:Notify({Title = "Mobile", Content = a.name .. " added - drag it where you want", Duration = 3}) end)
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() fill(search.Text) end)
		fill("")
	end)

	task.delay(2, function() build(); refreshList() end) -- wait until every tab registered its functions
	table.insert(Window.Connections, {Disconnect = function() gui:Destroy() end})
end


-- ===== CrackHub Vote Dupe (map vote) + notifications =====
CrackHub.InstallVoteDupe = function(Window, SettingsTab)
local env = setmetatable({getgenv = function() return CrackHubEnvironment end}, {__index = function(_, k)
	local v = CrackHubEnvironment[k]
	if v == nil then local ok, g = pcall(getfenv, 0); if ok and type(g) == "table" then v = g[k] end end
	if v == nil then v = _G[k] end
	return v
end})
local alive = true
local conns = {}
local function connect(signal, fn) local c = signal:Connect(fn); table.insert(conns, c); return c end
local function create(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do pcall(function() o[k] = v end) end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end
local function corner(o, r) local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 8); c.Parent = o; return c end

-- section adapter (Crk-style calls -> CrackHub groups)
local section = {current = nil}
function section:Group(o) self.current = SettingsTab:AddGroup(o.Title or o.Text or "Vote Dupe"); return self.current end
function section:Header(text) return self:Group({Title = text}) end
function section:holder() if not self.current then self:Group({Title = "Vote Dupe"}) end return self.current end
function section:Container() return self:holder().Holder end
function section:Slider(o)
	local c = self:holder():AddSlider({Name = o.Text, Min = o.Min, Max = o.Max, Default = o.Default, Increment = 1, Callback = o.Callback})
	return {Set = function(v) pcall(function() c:Set(v) end) end}
end
function section:Button(o) return self:holder():AddButton({Name = o.Text, Callback = o.Callback}) end
function section:Toggle(o) return self:holder():AddToggle({Name = o.Text, Default = o.Default, Bind = false, Callback = o.Callback}) end
function section:Dropdown(o)
	local labels, toCode, toLabel = {}, {}, {}
	for _, opt in ipairs(o.Options or {}) do
		local code, label = opt, opt
		if type(opt) == "table" then code, label = opt.code, opt.label end
		table.insert(labels, label); toCode[label], toLabel[code] = code, label
	end
	return self:holder():AddDropdown({Name = o.Text, Options = labels, Default = toLabel[o.Default] or o.Default,
		Callback = function(v) if o.Callback then o.Callback(toCode[v] or v) end end})
end
function section:Note(o)
	return create("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), Text = o.Text or "", TextWrapped = true,
		FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		LayoutOrder = NextOrder(), Parent = self:holder().Holder})
end

local context = {
	environment = env, configuration = {vote = {}}, section = section, create = create, corner = corner, connect = connect,
	tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService"), runService = game:GetService("RunService"),
	inputService = game:GetService("UserInputService"), workspace = workspace, players = game:GetService("Players"),
	player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer, window = Window, applyHooks = {},
	translation = {tr = function(s) return s end},
	isAlive = function() return alive and not Window.Destroyed end,
}
local ServerIdentity = {}

ServerIdentity.MapVote = {}

ServerIdentity.MapVote.maps = {
	{key = "bank2", name = "Bank 2", icon = "rbxassetid://3214475169"},
	{key = "biolab", name = "Bio Lab", icon = "rbxassetid://3214475802"},
	{key = "factory", name = "Factory", icon = "rbxassetid://3214476069"},
	{key = "hospital3", name = "Hospital 3", icon = "rbxassetid://3214476562"},
	{key = "hotel2", name = "Hotel 2", icon = "rbxassetid://3214477063"},
	{key = "house2", name = "House 2", icon = "rbxassetid://3214477411"},
	{key = "mansion2", name = "Mansion 2", icon = "rbxassetid://3214477676"},
	{key = "milbase", name = "Mil Base", icon = "rbxassetid://3214477899"},
	{key = "office3", name = "Office 3", icon = "rbxassetid://3214478924"},
	{key = "policestation", name = "Police Station", icon = "rbxassetid://3214479176"},
	{key = "researchfacility", name = "Research Facility", icon = "rbxassetid://4751350477"},
	{key = "workplace", name = "Workplace", icon = "rbxassetid://3214479481"},
}

function ServerIdentity.MapVote.key(name)
	return (string.lower(tostring(name or "")):gsub("[^%w]", ""))
end

function ServerIdentity.MapVote.create(context)
	local vote = context.configuration.vote
	if type(vote) ~= "table" then
		vote = {}
		context.configuration.vote = vote
	end
	if type(vote.count) ~= "number" then vote.count = 10 end
	if vote.panel == nil then vote.panel = true end
	if vote.silent == nil then vote.silent = true end
	if type(vote.icons) ~= "table" then vote.icons = {} end
	if type(vote.extra) ~= "table" then vote.extra = {} end
	if type(vote.off) ~= "table" then vote.off = {} end
	if vote.auto == nil then vote.auto = false end
	if type(vote.fallback) ~= "string" then vote.fallback = "skip" end
	vote.auto = false

	local state = {context = context, cfg = vote, busy = false, stop = false, done = 0, want = 0,
		status = "", sel = 1, log = {}, maps = {}, mapList = {}, iconCandidates = {}}
	for _, map in ServerIdentity.MapVote.maps do
		state.maps[map.key] = map
		table.insert(state.mapList, map)
	end
	for key, extra in vote.extra do
		if type(extra) ~= "table" or state.maps[key] then continue end
		local map = {key = key, name = tostring(extra.n or key), icon = extra.i}
		state.maps[key] = map
		table.insert(state.mapList, map)
	end
	local order, seen = {}, {}
	for _, key in type(vote.order) == "table" and vote.order or {} do
		if not state.maps[key] or seen[key] then continue end
		seen[key] = true
		table.insert(order, key)
	end
	for _, map in state.mapList do
		if seen[map.key] then continue end
		seen[map.key] = true
		table.insert(order, map.key)
	end
	vote.order = order
	for key, icon in vote.icons do
		if state.maps[key] and state.maps[key].icon or type(icon) ~= "string" then
			vote.icons[key] = nil
			continue
		end
		if ServerIdentity.MapVote.keyForIcon(state, icon, key) then vote.icons[key] = nil end
	end
	return state
end

function ServerIdentity.MapVote.icon(state, key)
	local map = state.maps[key]
	local icon = map and map.icon or state.cfg.icons[key]
	return type(icon) == "string" and icon ~= "" and icon or nil
end

function ServerIdentity.MapVote.keyForIcon(state, icon, except)
	for _, map in state.mapList do
		if map.key ~= except and ServerIdentity.MapVote.icon(state, map.key) == icon then return map.key end
	end
	return nil
end

local padCache = {at = -math.huge}
function ServerIdentity.MapVote.pads(workspace)
	local c = padCache
	if c.parent and c.parent.Parent and (not c.folder or c.folder.Parent) then return c.parent, c.folder end
	if os.clock() - c.at < 1 then return nil end
	c.at = os.clock()
	c.parent, c.folder = ServerIdentity.MapVote.scanPads(workspace)
	return c.parent, c.folder
end
function ServerIdentity.MapVote.scanPads(workspace)
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
	local pads = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("VotePads")
	if pads and lobby:FindFirstChild("VotePad1") then return lobby, pads end
	for _, model in workspace:GetChildren() do
		if not model:IsA("Model") then continue end
		local folder = model:FindFirstChild("VotePads")
		if not folder then continue end
		if model:FindFirstChild("VotePad1") then return model, folder end
		if folder:FindFirstChild("VotePad1") then return folder, folder end
	end
	return nil
end

function ServerIdentity.MapVote.readPad(state, index)
	local parent, detectors = ServerIdentity.MapVote.pads(state.context.workspace)
	if not parent then return nil end
	local pad = parent:FindFirstChild("VotePad" .. index)
