	plus = {16898613699, 257, 918}, minus = {16898613613, 771, 196},
}
local function vnew(c, p, parent) local o = Instance.new(c); for k, v in p or {} do o[k] = v end; o.Parent = parent; return o end
local function vround(o, r) return vnew("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r)}, o) end
local function vline(o, col, th, tr) return vnew("UIStroke", {Color = col, Thickness = th or 1, Transparency = tr or 0, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, o) end
local function vgrad(o, a, b, r) return vnew("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(a, b), Rotation = r or 0}, o) end
local function vtw(o, t, p, s, d) local x = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, s or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, d or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), p); x:Play(); return x end
local function vtxt(p, parent)
	local b = {BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextColor3 = VT.Text, FontFace = VMED, TextSize = 12}
	for k, v in p do b[k] = v end
	return vnew("TextLabel", b, parent)
end
local function vicon(parent, name, size, color, props)
	local img = vnew("ImageLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size), ImageColor3 = color or VT.Text}, parent)
	local d = VICONS[name]
	if type(d) == "table" then
		img.Image, img.ImageRectOffset, img.ImageRectSize = "rbxassetid://" .. d[1], Vector2.new(d[2], d[3]), Vector2.new(48, 48)
	else img.Image = d end
	for k, v in props or {} do img[k] = v end
	return img
end
local VOTE_TIME = 15

function ServerIdentity.MapVote.row(state, parent, index)
	local f = vnew("TextButton", {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48), BackgroundColor3 = VT.Row,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.55, LayoutOrder = index}, parent)
	vround(f, 9)
	local st = vline(f, VT.Accent, 1, 1)
	local share = vnew("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = VT.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.86, BorderSizePixel = 0}, f)
	vround(share, 9)
	local pic = vnew("ImageLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 36), BackgroundColor3 = VT.Pill,
		Image = "", ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop}, f)
	vround(pic, 6); vline(pic, VT.Stroke, 1, 0.3)
	local title = vtxt({Text = "Waiting for vote", FontFace = VSEMI, TextSize = 12, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 9), Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 14),
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd}, f)
	local modeRow = vnew("Frame", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 26), Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 12), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, f)
	vicon(modeRow, "users", 11, VT.Sub, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 1)})
	local details = vtxt({Text = "", TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = VT.Sub, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -15, 1, 0)}, modeRow)
	local box = vnew("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 30),
		BackgroundColor3 = VT.Bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2}, f)
	vround(box, 7); vline(box, VT.Stroke, 1, 0.3)
	local votes = vtxt({Text = "0", FontFace = VBOLD, TextSize = 13, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 3),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center}, box)
	vtxt({Text = "VOTES", FontFace = VBOLD, TextSize = 7, TextColor3 = VT.Sub, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 19),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center}, box)
	local check = vnew("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
		BackgroundColor3 = VT.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 1}, f)
	vround(check, 9); vline(check, VT.Accent, 1.4, 0)
	local checkIcon = vicon(check, "check", 4, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ImageTransparency = 1})
	local row = {frame = f, stroke = st, share = share, check = check, checkIcon = checkIcon, votes = votes, image = pic, title = title, details = details, box = box, on = nil}
	f.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if state.sel ~= index then vtw(f, 0.18, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.35}) end
		vtw(pic, 0.25, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 38), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 5)})
	end)
	f.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if state.sel ~= index then vtw(f, 0.18, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.55}) end
		vtw(pic, 0.25, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 36), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6)})
	end)
	-- click = dupe votes on this map
	f.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		state.sel = index
		ServerIdentity.MapVote.start(state, index)
		vtw(box, 0.08, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 34)}).Completed:Connect(function() vtw(box, 0.3, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 30)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
	end)
	return row
end

function ServerIdentity.MapVote.rows(state, parent)
	if not parent then return {} end
	local rows = {}
	for index = 1, 3 do rows[index] = ServerIdentity.MapVote.row(state, parent, index) end
	return rows, parent
end

function ServerIdentity.MapVote.renderRows(state, rows, pads)
	local sum = 0
	for i = 1, 3 do local p = pads[i]; if p and p.active and not p.idle then sum += tonumber(p.votes) or 0 end end
	sum = math.max(sum, 1)
	for index, r in rows do
		local pad = pads[index]
		local visible = pad and pad.active
		r.title.Text = visible and pad.name ~= "" and pad.name or "Waiting for vote"
		r.image.Image = visible and pad.icon or ""
		r.details.Text = visible and (pad.idle and "" or tostring(pad.mode or "")) or ""
		local n = visible and not pad.idle and tonumber(pad.votes) or 0
		r.votes.Text = tostring(n)
		local on = index == state.sel
		if r.on ~= on or r.lastN ~= n then
			r.on, r.lastN = on, n
			vtw(r.share, 0.45, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(n / sum, 1)})
			vtw(r.frame, 0.25, {BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.15 or 0.55})
			vtw(r.stroke, 0.25, {Transparency = on and 0 or 1})
			vtw(r.check, 0.25, {BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1})
			vtw(r.checkIcon, 0.25, {ImageTransparency = on and 0 or 1, Size = on and UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10) or UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
			vtw(r.image, 0.25, {ImageColor3 = on and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 190, 180)})
		end
	end
end

function ServerIdentity.MapVote.panel(state)
	local context = state.context
	local window = context.window
	if not window or not window.Gui then return end
	local holder = vnew("Frame", {Name = "CrkVotePanel", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(310, 0),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Visible = false, ZIndex = 20}, window.Gui)
	local position = state.cfg.pos
	holder.Position = type(position) == "table" and tonumber(position.x) and UDim2.fromOffset(position.x, position.y) or UDim2.fromOffset(80, 70)
	local card = vnew("CanvasGroup", {Name = "Card", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(310, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		BackgroundColor3 = VT.Bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.18, GroupTransparency = 1}, holder)
	vround(card, 12)
	local cardStroke = vline(card, VT.Stroke, 1.5, 0)
	vnew("UIPadding", {PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)}, card)
	vnew("UIListLayout", {SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 0)}, card)

	-- header
	local head = vnew("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = true, LayoutOrder = 1}, card)
	local tile = vnew("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)}, head)
	vround(tile, 8); vgrad(tile, VT.Accent2, VT.Accent, 90)
	vicon(tile, "map", 18, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)})
	vtxt({Text = "Map Vote", FontFace = VBOLD, TextSize = 14, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 2), Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 16)}, head)
	local status = vtxt({Text = "Choose a map", TextColor3 = VT.Sub, TextSize = 11, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 19), Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 13),
		TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd}, head)
	local timer = vnew("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 22),
		BackgroundColor3 = VT.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.8}, head)
	vround(timer, 11)
	local timerIcon = vicon(timer, "timer", 12, VT.Accent2, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, -6)})
	local timerText = vtxt({Text = "", FontFace = VBOLD, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = VT.Accent2, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, 0), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center}, timer)
	local arrow = vnew("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26),
		BackgroundColor3 = VT.Pill, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false}, head)
	vround(arrow, 7)
	local chevron = vicon(arrow, "chevron", 16, VT.Text, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Rotation = 180})
	arrow.MouseEnter:Connect(function() vtw(arrow, 0.15, {BackgroundTransparency = 0}) end)
	arrow.MouseLeave:Connect(function() vtw(arrow, 0.15, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.3}) end)

	-- collapsible content
	local wrap = vnew("Frame", {Name = "Wrap", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ClipsDescendants = true, LayoutOrder = 2}, card)
	local content = vnew("CanvasGroup", {Name = "Content", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1}, wrap)
	vnew("UIPadding", {PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)}, content)
	local contentLayout = vnew("UIListLayout", {SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)}, content)
	local bar = vnew("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3), BackgroundColor3 = VT.Pill, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = 0}, content)
	vround(bar, 2)
	local barFill = vnew("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0}, bar)
	vround(barFill, 2); vgrad(barFill, VT.Accent, VT.Accent2)
	local rows = ServerIdentity.MapVote.rows(state, content)

	-- footer: votes to add [-] N [+]  Stop
	local foot = vnew("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 10}, content)
	vtxt({Text = "Votes to add", TextColor3 = VT.Sub, TextSize = 11, Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0)}, foot)
	local function pill(xOff, width, iconName, text, color, cb)
		local b = vnew("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, xOff, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 26),
			BackgroundColor3 = VT.Pill, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, Text = text or "", FontFace = VBOLD, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = color or VT.Text, AutoButtonColor = false}, foot)
		vround(b, 7)
		if iconName then vicon(b, iconName, 14, color or VT.Text, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)}) end
		b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() vtw(b, 0.15, {BackgroundTransparency = 0}) end)
		b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() vtw(b, 0.15, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.3}) end)
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(cb)
		return b
	end
	local stop = pill(0, 56, nil, "Stop", VT.Danger, function() state.stop = true end)
	local count = vnew("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -94, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 26),
		BackgroundColor3 = VT.Bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2}, foot)
	vround(count, 7); vline(count, VT.Stroke, 1, 0.3)
	local countText = vtxt({Text = tostring(state.cfg.count), FontFace = VBOLD, TextSize = 12, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center}, count)
	pill(-62, 26, "plus", nil, nil, function() ServerIdentity.MapVote.changeCount(state, 1); countText.Text = tostring(state.cfg.count) end)
	pill(-140, 26, "minus", nil, nil, function() ServerIdentity.MapVote.changeCount(state, -1); countText.Text = tostring(state.cfg.count) end)

	-- smooth collapse / expand
	local collapsed = false
	local function applyHeight(animated)
		local sc = card.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and card.AbsoluteSize.X / 310 or 1
		if sc < 0.05 then sc = 1 end
		local h = collapsed and 0 or contentLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y / sc + 10
		if animated then
			vtw(wrap, 0.42, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
			vtw(content, 0.3, {GroupTransparency = collapsed and 1 or 0})
			vtw(chevron, 0.42, {Rotation = collapsed and 0 or 180}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
		else wrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h) end
	end
	contentLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function() if not collapsed then applyHeight(false) end end)
	arrow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() collapsed = not collapsed; applyHeight(true) end)
	task.defer(applyHeight, false)

	-- rotating glow on the border: only while the card is on screen (= while a vote is running)
	local glowGrad = vnew("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, VT.Stroke),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, VT.Accent2), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, VT.Stroke)})}, cardStroke)
	task.spawn(function()
		local t = 0
		while holder.Parent do
			local dt = task.wait(1 / 30)
			if holder.Visible then
				t += dt
				glowGrad.Rotation = (t * 50) % 360
				-- vote timer (15 s round) + progress bar
				local left = state.startT and math.max(0, VOTE_TIME - (os.clock() - state.startT)) or VOTE_TIME
				timerText.Text = tostring(math.ceil(left))
				local warnColor = left <= 5 and VT.Danger or VT.Accent2
				timerText.TextColor3, timerIcon.ImageColor3 = warnColor, warnColor
				barFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(left / VOTE_TIME, 1)
			else
				task.wait(0.25)
			end
		end
	end)

	-- drag (smoothed)
	do
		local drag, origin, start
		head.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
			if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				drag, origin, start = true, i.Position, holder.Position
				i.Changed:Connect(function()
					if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
						drag = false
						state.cfg.pos = {x = holder.Position.X.Offset, y = holder.Position.Y.Offset}
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
		context.connect(game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged, function(i)
			if drag and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				local d = i.Position - origin
				vtw(holder, 0.08, {Position = UDim2.new(start.X.Scale, start.X.Offset + d.X, start.Y.Scale, start.Y.Offset + d.Y)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine)
			end
		end)
	end

	state.panel, state.panelBody, state.panelRows, state.panelStatus, state.panelStop, state.panelCount = holder, card, rows, status, stop, countText
	state.panelShowing = false
end

function ServerIdentity.MapVote.panelVisibility(state, visible)
	if not state.panel or state.panelShowing == visible then return end
	state.panelShowing = visible
	local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
	if visible then state.panel.Visible = true end
	local duration = visible and 0.28 or 0.22
	pcall(function()
		context.tweenService:Create(state.panelBody, environment.TweenInfo.new(duration), {GroupTransparency = visible and 0 or 1}):Play()
	end)
	if visible then return end
	environment.task.delay(0.24, function()
		if not state.panelShowing then pcall(function() state.panel.Visible = false end) end
	end)
end

function ServerIdentity.MapVote.changeCount(state, direction)
	local count = math.floor(tonumber(state.cfg.count) or 10)
	local step = (count > 10 or count == 10 and direction > 0) and 5 or 1
	state.cfg.count = math.clamp(count + direction * step, 1, 100)
	if state.countSlider then state.countSlider.Set(state.cfg.count) end
end

function ServerIdentity.MapVote.controls(state)
	-- no Map Vote section in Settings: everything is done from the floating vote panel
	state.rows = {}
end
function ServerIdentity.MapVote.install(context)
	local vote = ServerIdentity.MapVote
	local state = vote.create(context)
	state.iconFor = function(name) return vote.icon(state, vote.key(name)) end
	state.isKey = function(key) return state.maps[key] ~= nil end
	state.sortFarm = function()
		vote.sortFarm(state, rawget(context.environment.getgenv(), "__crkMapFarm"))
		vote.renderPriority(state)
	end
	context.environment.getgenv().__crkVoteDbg = state
	vote.controls(state)
	pcall(vote.panel, state)
	context.environment.task.spawn(function()
		local lastObservation = -math.huge
		local pads, active = {}, false
		while not state.closed and context.isAlive() do
			pcall(function()
				local now = context.environment.os.clock()
				if now - lastObservation >= 0.25 then
					pads, active = vote.observe(state); if state.onActive then pcall(state.onActive, active) end
					vote.renderPriority(state)
					lastObservation = now
				end
				vote.renderRows(state, state.rows, pads)
				local status = vote.status(state, active)
				if state.statusLabel then state.statusLabel.Text = status end
				if state.panel then
					vote.panelVisibility(state, state.cfg.panel ~= false and (active or state.busy))
					state.panelStatus.Text, state.panelCount.Text = status, tostring(state.cfg.count)
					state.panelStop.Visible = state.busy
					vote.renderRows(state, state.panelRows, pads)
				end
			end)
			context.environment.task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)
	return state, function()
		state.closed, state.stop = true, true
		if state.panel then state.panel:Destroy() end
	end
end

-- ===== notifications: "map vote started" toast + sound (Settings -> Notifications) =====
local NOTIFY_SOUNDS = {
	-- public Creator Store audio (create.roblox.com/store/audio)
	{"Telegram", "rbxassetid://6696469190"},
	{"iPhone", "rbxassetid://72725498450767"},
	{"Windows 10", "rbxassetid://2502368191"},
	{"Steam", "rbxassetid://195868961"},
	{"Samsung", "rbxassetid://6114974207"},
	{"Android", "rbxassetid://7695856187"},
	{"Roblox", "rbxassetid://3023237993"},
	-- built into Roblox (always available)
	{"Ping", "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"},}
local notifyCfg = {on = true, sound = NOTIFY_SOUNDS[1][1], volume = 70}
local function playNotify()
	local id
	for _, s in ipairs(NOTIFY_SOUNDS) do if s[1] == notifyCfg.sound then id = s[2] end end
	if not id then return end
	local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
	snd.SoundId, snd.Volume = id, notifyCfg.volume / 100 * 2
	snd.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
	snd:Play()
	task.delay(4, function() snd:Destroy() end)
end
CrackHub.PlayNotifySound = playNotify

local ng = SettingsTab:AddGroup("Notifications")
ng:AddToggle({Name = "Vote notifications", Default = true, Bind = false, Callback = function(v) notifyCfg.on = v end})
local names = {}
for _, s in ipairs(NOTIFY_SOUNDS) do table.insert(names, s[1]) end
ng:AddDropdown({Name = "Notification sound", Options = names, Default = notifyCfg.sound, Callback = function(v) notifyCfg.sound = v; playNotify() end})
ng:AddSlider({Name = "Notification volume", Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = notifyCfg.volume, Suffix = "%", Callback = function(v) notifyCfg.volume = v end})
ng:AddButton({Name = "Test", Callback = function() playNotify(); pcall(function() CrackHub:Notify({Title = "Map Vote", Content = "Map vote started", Type = "Info", Duration = 3}) end) end})

local state, stop = ServerIdentity.MapVote.install(context)
local wasActive = false
state.onActive = function(active)
	if active and not wasActive and notifyCfg.on then
		playNotify()
		pcall(function() CrackHub:Notify({Title = "Map Vote", Content = "Map vote started - open the vote panel", Type = "Info", Duration = 4}) end)
	end
	wasActive = active
end
table.insert(Window.Connections, {Disconnect = function()
	alive = false
	pcall(stop)
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
end})
end


-- ===== Unlock FPS (Settings) =====
CrackHub.InstallUnlockFPS = function(Window, SettingsTab)
	local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
	local setcap = rawget(genv, "__CrackHubRealSetFps")
	local cfg = {on = false, cap = "Unlimited"}
	local CAPS = {"60", "120", "144", "165", "240", "360", "Unlimited"}
	-- the cap is only touched after you turn Unlock FPS on; turning it off gives back the cap you had before
	local touched, original = false, nil
	-- builds v78-v86 set a 60 FPS cap at start even with Unlock FPS off, and the executor keeps that cap
	-- until Roblox restarts. On PC, clear it once so FPS is back to what it was before.
	do
		local UIS0 = game:GetService("UserInputService")
		if setcap and UIS0.KeyboardEnabled and not rawget(genv, "__CrackHubFpsReset") then
			genv.__CrackHubFpsReset = true
			pcall(setcap, 9999)
		end
	end
	pcall(function() local get = rawget(genv, "getfpscap") or getfpscap; if type(get) == "function" then original = get() end end)
	local function apply()
		if not setcap then return false end
		if cfg.on then
			touched = true
			local value = cfg.cap == "Unlimited" and 9999 or tonumber(cfg.cap)
			return pcall(setcap, value)
		elseif touched then
			touched = false
			return pcall(setcap, tonumber(original) or 9999)
		end
		return true
	end
	local g = SettingsTab:AddGroup("Performance")
	g:AddToggle({Name = "Unlock FPS", Default = false, Bind = false, Flag = "UnlockFPS_On", Callback = function(v)
		cfg.on = v
		if not setcap then
			if v then pcall(function() CrackHub:Notify({Title = "Unlock FPS", Content = "Your executor has no setfpscap, FPS can't be unlocked", Type = "Warning", Duration = 4}) end) end
			return
		end
		apply()
	end})
	-- Performance mode: lighter game graphics (shadows, post effects, decorations). On by default on phones.
	local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	local isPhone = UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled
	local perfSaved
	local function setPerf(on)
		if on and not perfSaved then
			perfSaved = {shadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows, fx = {}, deco = nil, quality = nil}
			pcall(function() Lighting.GlobalShadows = false end)
			for _, e in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
				if (e:IsA("PostEffect") or e:IsA("Atmosphere") or e:IsA("Clouds")) and not tostring(e.Name):find("CrackHub", 1, true) then
					local prop = e:IsA("Atmosphere") and "Density" or "Enabled"
					local ok, v = pcall(function() return e[prop] end)
					if ok then table.insert(perfSaved.fx, {e, prop, v}); pcall(function() if prop == "Density" then e.Density = 0 else e.Enabled = false end end) end
				end
			end
			pcall(function() local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain"); perfSaved.deco = terrain.Decoration; terrain.Decoration = false end)
			pcall(function() perfSaved.quality = settings().Rendering.QualityLevel; settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01 end)
		elseif not on and perfSaved then
			local s = perfSaved; perfSaved = nil
			pcall(function() Lighting.GlobalShadows = s.shadows end)
			for _, item in ipairs(s.fx) do pcall(function() item[1][item[2]] = item[3] end) end
			pcall(function() if s.deco ~= nil then workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain").Decoration = s.deco end end)
			pcall(function() if s.quality then settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = s.quality end end)
		end
	end
	-- Menu size: the system picks it for your screen; turn Auto off to set it yourself (1000 = 100%)
	local dg = SettingsTab:AddGroup("Display")
	local autoNow = math.floor((Window.AutoScale or (Window.ScaleObj and Window.ScaleObj.Scale) or 1) * 1000 + 0.5)
	local sizeSlider
	local lastGood = nil -- last manual size that fit on the screen (nil = auto)
	local toast
	local function closeToast() if toast then toast:Destroy(); toast = nil end end
	local function restore()
		closeToast()
		Window.ManualScale = lastGood
		if not lastGood then pcall(function() CrackHub.Flags.Display_Auto:Set(true) end) end
		if Window.FitToScreen then pcall(Window.FitToScreen) end
		pcall(function() sizeSlider:Set(math.floor((lastGood or Window.AutoScale or 1) * 1000 + 0.5)) end)
	end
	-- too big for the screen: a notice you tap to go back
	local function checkTooBig()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local root = Window.Root
		if not cam or not root then return end
		local vp, size = cam.ViewportSize, root.AbsoluteSize
		local tooBig = size.X > vp.X * 1.02 or size.Y > vp.Y * 1.02
		if not tooBig then lastGood = Window.ManualScale; closeToast(); return end
		if toast then return end
		toast = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		toast.Name, toast.ResetOnSpawn, toast.DisplayOrder, toast.IgnoreGuiInset = "CHToastTooBig", false, 100000, true
		pcall(function() toast.Parent = Window.Gui.Parent end)
		local b = Create("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(340, 64),
			BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 20, 24), AutoButtonColor = true, Text = "", Parent = toast}, {Corner(12), Stroke(Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 110), 1.5, 0)})
		Create("TextLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 8), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 22), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Menu is too big for your screen",
			FontFace = Fonts.Bold, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = b})
		Create("TextLabel", {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 32), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 20), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Tap here to go back to the previous size",
			FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 180), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = b})
		b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(restore)
	end
	dg:AddToggle({Name = "Auto menu size", Default = true, Bind = false, Flag = "Display_Auto", Callback = function(v)
		if v then Window.ManualScale = nil else Window.ManualScale = math.max((sizeSlider and sizeSlider.Value or autoNow) / 1000, 0.05) end
		if Window.FitToScreen then pcall(Window.FitToScreen) end
		task.delay(0.1, checkTooBig)
	end})
	sizeSlider = dg:AddSlider({Name = "Menu size", Min = 0, Max = 10000, Default = autoNow, Increment = 10, Flag = "Display_Size", Callback = function(v)
		if Window.ManualScale ~= nil or (CrackHub.Flags.Display_Auto and CrackHub.Flags.Display_Auto.Value == false) then
			Window.ManualScale = math.max(v / 1000, 0.05)
			if Window.FitToScreen then pcall(Window.FitToScreen) end
			task.delay(0.1, checkTooBig)
		end
	end})
	dg:AddButton({Name = "Reset to system size", Callback = function()
		Window.ManualScale = nil
		lastGood = nil
		closeToast()
		pcall(function() CrackHub.Flags.Display_Auto:Set(true) end)
		if Window.FitToScreen then pcall(Window.FitToScreen) end
		pcall(function() sizeSlider:Set(math.floor((Window.AutoScale or 1) * 1000 + 0.5)) end)
	end})

	-- separate sizes for the floating panels (100 = normal)
	local panelScale = {}
	local PANELS = {{"Keybinds size", "KeybindsWidget"}, {"Music player size", "MusicListWidget"}, {"Watermark size", "Watermark"}, {"Map vote size", "CrkVotePanel"}}
	local function findPanel(name)
		local gui = Window.Gui
		if not gui then return nil end
		return gui:FindFirstChild(name) or gui:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	end
	local function applyPanels()
		for name, s in pairs(panelScale) do
			local o = findPanel(name)
			if o then
				local sc = o:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
				if not sc then sc = Instance.new("UIScale"); sc.Name = "CrackHubFit"; sc.Parent = o end
				if math.abs(sc.Scale - s) > 0.001 then sc.Scale = s end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(PANELS) do
		dg:AddSlider({Name = p[1], Min = 20, Max = 300, Default = 100, Suffix = "%", Flag = "Display_" .. p[2], Callback = function(v)
			if v == 100 and panelScale[p[2]] == nil then return end
			panelScale[p[2]] = v / 100
			applyPanels()
		end})
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		while not Window.Destroyed do
			task.wait(1)
			if next(panelScale) then pcall(applyPanels) end
		end
	end)
	table.insert(Window.Connections, {Disconnect = closeToast})
	g:AddToggle({Name = "Performance mode", Default = isPhone, Bind = false, Flag = "PerfMode_On", Callback = function(v) setPerf(v) end})
	if isPhone then task.defer(setPerf, true) end
	table.insert(Window.Connections, {Disconnect = function() setPerf(false) end})
	g:AddDropdown({Name = "FPS cap", Options = CAPS, Default = cfg.cap, Flag = "UnlockFPS_Cap", Callback = function(v) cfg.cap = v; if cfg.on then apply() end end})
	-- some games reset the cap: keep it applied while on
	task.spawn(function()
		while not Window.Destroyed do
			task.wait(5)
			if cfg.on and setcap then apply() end
		end
	end)
	table.insert(Window.Connections, {Disconnect = function() if touched and setcap then pcall(setcap, tonumber(original) or 9999) end end})
end

-- ===== phones: every floating CrackHub panel (vote card, keybinds, music, watermark, mobile buttons) scales to the screen =====
CrackHub.InstallMobileFit = function(Window)
	local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	if not (UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled) then return end
	local function factor()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 400)
		return math.clamp(math.min(vp.X, vp.Y * 1.6) / 1000, 0.55, 1)
	end
	local scales = {}
	local function fitChild(child)
		if not child:IsA("GuiObject") or child == Window.Root then return end
		if child.Size.X.Scale >= 0.9 and child.Size.Y.Scale >= 0.9 then return end -- full-screen layers (fade, blur, overlays)
		if Window.Root and Window.Root:IsDescendantOf(child) then return end
		if child:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") and not child:FindFirstChild("CrackHubFit") then return end
		local s = child:FindFirstChild("CrackHubFit") or Instance.new("UIScale")
		s.Name, s.Scale = "CrackHubFit", factor()
		s.Parent = child
		scales[s] = true
	end
	local function ours(gui)
		local n = gui.Name:lower()
		return gui == Window.Gui or n:find("crack", 1, true) or n:find("crk", 1, true)
	end
	local function hookGui(gui)
		if not gui:IsA("LayerCollector") or not ours(gui) then return end
		for _, c in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do fitChild(c) end
		table.insert(Window.Connections, gui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c) task.defer(fitChild, c) end))
	end
	local parent = Window.Gui.Parent
	if parent then
		for _, g in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do hookGui(g) end
		table.insert(Window.Connections, parent.ChildAdded:Connect(function(g) task.defer(hookGui, g) end))
	end
	local function refit() local f = factor(); for s in pairs(scales) do if s.Parent then s.Scale = f else scales[s] = nil end end end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if cam then table.insert(Window.Connections, cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(refit)) end
end

-- ===== CrackHub Kill Sounds: separate sound for gun and knife kills =====
CrackHub.InstallKillSounds = function(Window, SettingsTab)
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	-- same sound list Pulse Hub uses (works in MM2)
	local SOUNDS = {
		{"Gamesense (Skeet)", "rbxassetid://4817809188"}, {"CS:GO Headshot", "rbxassetid://133002449941130"},
		{"CS:GO Headshot 2", "rbxassetid://132110078840319"}, {"CS:GO Headshot 3", "rbxassetid://118849595584555"},
		{"MLG Hitmarker", "rbxassetid://121351852050830"}, {"CoD Hitmarker", "rbxassetid://138832207290954"},
		{"Minecraft Hit", "rbxassetid://127091812835195"}, {"Quake Hit", "rbxassetid://1455817260"},
		{"Head Hitmarker", "rbxassetid://17724154662"}, {"Minecraft XP", "rbxassetid://101023147710668"},
		{"Bonk", "rbxassetid://137041944943141"}, {"TF2 Kill", "rbxassetid://124543461907751"},
		{"Vine Boom", "rbxassetid://139557908315922"}, {"Kill Confirmed", "rbxassetid://127053529664678"},
		{"Madness Headshot", "rbxassetid://7849569525"}, {"OOF", "rbxassetid://79348298352567"},
	}
	local names = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(SOUNDS) do table.insert(names, s[1]) end
	local cfg = {on = true, gun = SOUNDS[1][1], knife = SOUNDS[2][1], volume = 60}
	local alive = true
	-- every sound is created and loaded once, so a kill plays it instantly
	local loaded = {}
	for _, s in ipairs(SOUNDS) do
		local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
		snd.Name = "CrackHubKill_" .. s[1]
		snd.SoundId = s[2]
		snd.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
		loaded[s[1]] = snd
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local list = {}
		for _, snd in pairs(loaded) do table.insert(list, snd) end
		pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(list) end)
	end)
	local function play(name)
		local snd = loaded[name]
		if not snd then return end
		snd.Volume = cfg.volume / 100 * 3
		snd.TimePosition = 0
		pcall(function() snd:Play() end)
	end
	local g = SettingsTab:AddGroup("Kill Sounds")
	g:AddToggle({Name = "Kill sounds", Default = true, Bind = false, Flag = "KS_On", Callback = function(v) cfg.on = v end})
	g:AddDropdown({Name = "Gun kill sound", Options = names, Default = cfg.gun, Flag = "KS_Gun", Callback = function(v) cfg.gun = v end})
	g:AddDropdown({Name = "Knife kill sound", Options = names, Default = cfg.knife, Flag = "KS_Knife", Callback = function(v) cfg.knife = v end})
	g:AddSlider({Name = "Kill sound volume", Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = cfg.volume, Suffix = "%", Flag = "KS_Vol", Callback = function(v) cfg.volume = v end})
	g:AddButton({Name = "Test gun sound", Callback = function() play(cfg.gun) end})
	g:AddButton({Name = "Test knife sound", Callback = function() play(cfg.knife) end})

	local function characterOf(inst)
		local c = typeof(inst) == "Instance" and inst or nil
		while c and not (c:IsA("Model") and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) do c = c.Parent end
		return c
	end
	local recentGun = {}
	-- gun: Pulse method, GunFired remote gives the hit part
	task.spawn(function()
		local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
		local services = rs:WaitForChild("ClientServices", 30)
		local weapons = services and services:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 30)
		local fired = weapons and weapons:WaitForChild("GunFired", 30)
		if not fired or not fired:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return end
		local c = fired.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(tool, origin, endpoint, hit)
			if not alive or not cfg.on then return end
			if characterOf(tool) ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
			local victim = characterOf(hit)
			if victim and victim ~= LocalPlayer.Character and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(victim) then
				recentGun[victim] = os.clock()
				play(cfg.gun)
			end
		end)
		table.insert(Window.Connections, c)
	end)
	-- knife: a player near us (or hit by our throw) dies while we hold the knife
	local function hasKnife()
		local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
		return ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Knife") ~= nil
	end
	local function hookVictim(player)
		if player == LocalPlayer then return end
		local function onChar(char)
			local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
			if not hum then return end
			hum.Died:Connect(function()
				if not alive or not cfg.on then return end
				if recentGun[char] and os.clock() - recentGun[char] < 2 then recentGun[char] = nil; return end
				if not hasKnife() then return end
				local me = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local them = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if me and them and (me.Position - them.Position).Magnitude < 60 then play(cfg.knife) end
			end)
		end
		if player.Character then task.spawn(onChar, player.Character) end
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onChar)
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do hookVictim(p) end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookVictim)
	table.insert(Window.Connections, {Disconnect = function() alive = false; for _, snd in pairs(loaded) do pcall(function() snd:Destroy() end) end end})
end


	local Window = CrackHub:CreateWindow({
        Intro = false,
		Title = "CrackHub",
		Subtitle = "Murder Mystery 2",
		Blur = true,
		Style = "macOS",
		Font = "Ubuntu",
		ShowFPS = false,
		ControlColor = Color3.fromRGB(146, 98, 255),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(960, 620),
		ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
		AutoBind = false,
	})
	local Combat = CrackHubCreateCombatModules().install(Window)
	local MovementTab = Window:CreateTab("Movement", "footprints")
	do local okM, errM = pcall(CrackHub.InstallMovement, Window, MovementTab, Combat and Combat.Roles); if not okM then warn("[CrackHub Movement] " .. tostring(errM)) end end
	local MobileTab = Window:CreateTab("Mobile", "keyboard")
	do local okM2, errM2 = pcall(CrackHub.InstallMobile, Window, MobileTab); if not okM2 then warn("[CrackHub Mobile] " .. tostring(errM2)) end end
	local MusicTab=Window:CreateTab("Music", "rbxassetid://132132095360900")
	CrackHubInstallMusic(Window, MusicTab)
	do
		local ok, err = pcall(function() if CrackHub.InstallLyrics3D then CrackHub.InstallLyrics3D(Window, MusicTab) end end)
		if not ok then warn("[CrackHub 3D Lyrics] " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
	CrackHubInstallTeleport(Window, Combat.Roles)
	do
		local ok, err = pcall(CrackHub.InstallPlayerInfo, Window, Combat.Roles)
		if not ok then warn("[CrackHub Player Info] " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
	do
		local ok, err = pcall(CrackHub.InstallScripts, Window, Combat)
		if not ok then warn("[CrackHub Scripts] " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
	do
		local ok, err = pcall(CrackHub.InstallWearables, Window)
		if not ok then warn("[CrackHub Wearables] " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
	do
		local ok, err = pcall(CrackHub.InstallKeybinds, Window)
		if not ok then warn("[CrackHub Keybinds] " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
	do
		local ok, err = pcall(CrackHub.InstallFishing, Window, Combat)
		if not ok then warn("[CrackHub Fishing] " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
	do
		local ok, err = pcall(CrackHub.InstallBuildABoat, Window)
		if not ok then warn("[CrackHub Build A Board] " .. tostring(err)) end
	end

	do
		local previous=CrackHubEnvironment.CrackHubLobbyStatue
		if type(previous)=="table" and type(previous.Stop)=="function" then pcall(previous.Stop) end
		local state={}
		local stopped=false
		local template,replacement,original,originalParent
		local connections={}
		local refreshQueued=false
		local fallback=CFrame.new(546.977661,465.722412,37.8555603,-1.1920929e-07,0,1.00000012,0,1,0,-1.00000012,0,-1.1920929e-07)
		local function connect(signal,fn)
			local c=signal:Connect(fn); table.insert(connections,c); return c
		end
		local function findOriginal()
			local nearest,torso,parent
			local distance=8*8
			local search=workspace
			for scanIndex,part in ipairs(search:GetDescendants()) do if scanIndex%1500==0 then task.wait() end
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and (part.Name=="Torso" or part.Name=="UpperTorso") then
					local p=part.Position-fallback.Position
					local d=p.X*p.X+p.Y*p.Y+p.Z*p.Z
					if d<distance then
						local object=part.Parent
						while object and object~=search and not object:IsA("Model") do object=object.Parent end
						local allowed=object and object~=search and object.Parent~=nil
						local ancestor=object
						while allowed and ancestor and ancestor~=workspace do
							if ancestor.Name:sub(1,8)=="CrackHub" or (ancestor:IsA("Model") and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(ancestor)) then allowed=false end
							ancestor=ancestor.Parent
						end
						if allowed then nearest,torso,parent,distance=object,part,object.Parent,d end
					end
				end
			end
			return nearest,torso,parent
		end

		local function floorY(model)
			local bottom=math.huge
			for _,part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Transparency<0.99 then
					local cf,h=part.CFrame,part.Size*0.5
					local extent=math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y)*h.X+math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)*h.Y+math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)*h.Z
					bottom=math.min(bottom,cf.Position.Y-extent)
				end
			end
			return bottom<math.huge and bottom or nil
		end
		local function place(model,old,torso)
			local target=(torso and torso.CFrame or fallback)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi,0)
			local reference=model:FindFirstChild("Torso",true) or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso",true)
			if not reference or not reference:IsA("BasePart") then reference=model.PrimaryPart end
			local source=reference and reference.CFrame or model:GetPivot()
			model:PivotTo(target*source:Inverse()*model:GetPivot())
			local ground=old and floorY(old) or target.Position.Y-3
			local bottom=floorY(model)
			if ground and bottom then model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,ground-bottom,0)*model:GetPivot()) end
		end
		local hiddenVisuals={}
		local hiddenSignals={}
		local detachedEffects={}
		local detachedRemnants={}
		local watchedVisuals={}
		local function clearEffect(object)
			if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Trail") then pcall(function() object:Clear() end) end
		end
		local function hideVisual(object)
			clearEffect(object)
			if hiddenVisuals[object] then return end
			local props
			if object:IsA("BasePart") then props={"Transparency","LocalTransparencyModifier","CanCollide","CanTouch","CanQuery"}
			elseif object:IsA("Decal") then props={"Transparency"}
			elseif object:IsA("GuiBase3d") then props={"Visible","Transparency"}
			elseif object:IsA("Highlight") then props={"Enabled"}
			elseif object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Trail") or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Fire") or object:IsA("Smoke") or object:IsA("Sparkles") or object:IsA("Light") or object:IsA("BillboardGui") or object:IsA("SurfaceGui") then props={"Enabled"} end
			if not props then return end
			local saved={}
			hiddenVisuals[object]=saved
			for _,prop in ipairs(props) do
				local ok,value=pcall(function() return object[prop] end)
				if ok then
					saved[prop]=value
					local hidden=prop=="Transparency" or prop=="LocalTransparencyModifier"
					local wanted=hidden and 1 or false
					pcall(function() object[prop]=wanted end)
					table.insert(hiddenSignals,object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop):Connect(function()
						if not stopped and object[prop]~=wanted then object[prop]=wanted; clearEffect(object) end
					end))
				end
			end
			if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Trail") or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Fire") or object:IsA("Smoke") or object:IsA("Sparkles") or object:IsA("BillboardGui") or object:IsA("SurfaceGui") or object:IsA("GuiBase3d") or object:IsA("Highlight") then
				detachedEffects[object]={Parent=object.Parent}
				clearEffect(object)
				object.Parent=nil
				table.insert(hiddenSignals,object.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
					if not stopped and object.Parent then clearEffect(object); object.Parent=nil end
				end))
			end
		end
		local exactRemnants={
			["1158007"]=Vector3.new(546.887878,467.702423,37.9129639),
			["121944778"]=Vector3.new(545.008789,468.255951,36.8594666),
		}
		local function exactRemnantPart(object)
			local part=object:IsA("BasePart") and object or (object:IsA("SpecialMesh") and object.Parent)
			if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
			local mesh=part:IsA("MeshPart") and part or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
			if not mesh then return end
			local uri=tostring(mesh.MeshId)
			local id=uri:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)") or uri:match("[?&]id=(%d+)") or uri:match("^%s*(%d+)%s*$")
			local point=exactRemnants[id]
			if not point then return end
			local delta=part.Position-point
			if delta:Dot(delta)>2.25 then return end
			local ancestor=part
			while ancestor and ancestor~=workspace do
				if ancestor.Name:sub(1,8)=="CrackHub" or (ancestor:IsA("Model") and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(ancestor)) then return end
				ancestor=ancestor.Parent
			end
			return part
		end
		local function hideExactPart(part)
			hideVisual(part)
			for _,child in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do hideVisual(child) end
			if not detachedRemnants[part] then
				detachedRemnants[part]={Parent=part.Parent}
				table.insert(hiddenSignals,part.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
					if not stopped and part.Parent then part.Parent=nil end
				end))
			end
			part.Parent=nil
		end
		local watchedPumpkinLights={}
		local function pumpkinLightPosition(light)
			local parent=light.Parent
			if parent and parent:IsA("Attachment") then return parent.WorldPosition end
			while parent and parent~=workspace do
				if parent:IsA("BasePart") then return parent.Position end
				parent=parent.Parent
			end
		end
		local function watchPumpkinLight(light)
			if stopped or not light:IsA("Light") then return end
			local position=pumpkinLightPosition(light)
			if not position then return end
			local delta=position-exactRemnants["1158007"]
			if delta:Dot(delta)>12.25 then return end
			local ancestor=light
			while ancestor and ancestor~=workspace do
				if ancestor.Name:sub(1,8)=="CrackHub" or (ancestor:IsA("Model") and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(ancestor)) then return end
				ancestor=ancestor.Parent
			end
			local function apply()
				if stopped or not replacement or not light.Parent then return end
				local color=light.Color
				if color and color.G>=0.35 and color.G>color.R*1.2 and color.G>color.B*1.15 then hideVisual(light) end
			end
			if not watchedPumpkinLights[light] then
				watchedPumpkinLights[light]=true
				connect(light:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Color"),apply)
			end
			apply()
		end

		local spatialGlowWatched={}
		local function isPumpkinGreen(color)
			return typeof(color)=="Color3" and color.G>=.55 and color.B<color.G*.8 and color.R<=color.G*1.15
		end
		local function glowColor(object)
			for _,p in ipairs({"Color3","Color","ImageColor3"}) do
				local ok,c=pcall(function()return object[p]end)
				if ok then
					if isPumpkinGreen(c) then return true end
					if typeof(c)=="ColorSequence" then for _,k in ipairs(c.Keypoints)do if isPumpkinGreen(k.Value)then return true end end end
				end
			end
			return false
		end
		local function spatialGlowPosition(object)
			if object:IsA("BasePart") then return object.Position end
			if object:IsA("GuiBase3d") then
				local ok,cf=pcall(function()return object.CFrame end)
				if ok and typeof(cf)=="CFrame" then
					local target=object.Adornee
					if target and target:IsA("BasePart")then return (target.CFrame*cf).Position end
					if target and target:IsA("Model")then return (target:GetPivot()*cf).Position end
					return cf.Position
				end
			end
			for _,p in ipairs({"Attachment0","Adornee"}) do
				local ok,t=pcall(function()return object[p]end)
				if ok and t then
					if t:IsA("Attachment")then return t.WorldPosition end
					if t:IsA("BasePart")then return t.Position end
				end
			end
			local p=object.Parent
			while p and p~=game do
				if p:IsA("Attachment")then return p.WorldPosition end
				if p:IsA("BasePart")then return p.Position end
				p=p.Parent
			end
		end
		local function watchSpatialGlow(object)
			if stopped or not replacement then return end
			local candidate=object:IsA("BasePart")or object:IsA("GuiBase3d")or object:IsA("Light")or object:IsA("ParticleEmitter")or object:IsA("Beam")or object:IsA("Trail")
			if not candidate then return end
			local ancestor=object
			while ancestor and ancestor~=game do
				if ancestor.Name:sub(1,8)=="CrackHub"or (ancestor:IsA("Model")and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(ancestor))then return end
				ancestor=ancestor.Parent
			end
			local point=spatialGlowPosition(object)
			if not point then return end
			local delta=point-exactRemnants["1158007"]
			if delta:Dot(delta)>12.25 then return end
			local function apply()
				if stopped or not replacement or not object.Parent then return end
				local point=spatialGlowPosition(object)
				if not point then return end
				local d=point-exactRemnants["1158007"]
				if d:Dot(d)>12.25 or not glowColor(object)then return end
				if object:IsA("BasePart")then
					local sphere=object:IsA("Part")and object.Shape==Enum.PartType.Ball
					if not sphere and object.Material~=Enum.Material.Neon then return end
					hideExactPart(object)
				else hideVisual(object)end
			end
			if not spatialGlowWatched[object]then
				spatialGlowWatched[object]=true
				for _,p in ipairs({"Color3","Color","ImageColor3","CFrame","Adornee","Enabled"})do pcall(function()connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(p),apply)end)end
			end
			apply()
		end

		local function relatedTarget(target)
			if typeof(target)~="Instance" then return false end
			local node=target
			while node and node~=workspace do
				if detachedRemnants[node] or node==original then return true end
				node=node.Parent
			end
			return false
		end
		local function visualCandidate(object)
			return object:IsA("GuiBase3d") or object:IsA("Highlight") or object:IsA("BillboardGui") or object:IsA("SurfaceGui") or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Trail")
		end
		local function watchLinkedVisual(object)
			watchSpatialGlow(object)
			if stopped or not visualCandidate(object) then return end
			local function apply()
				if stopped or not replacement then return end
				local match=relatedTarget(object.Parent)
				for _,prop in ipairs({"Adornee","Attachment0","Attachment1"}) do
					local ok,target=pcall(function() return object[prop] end)
					if ok and relatedTarget(target) then match=true end
				end
				if match then hideVisual(object) end
			end
			if not watchedVisuals[object] then
				watchedVisuals[object]=true
				for _,prop in ipairs({"Adornee","Attachment0","Attachment1"}) do
					pcall(function() connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop),apply) end)
				end
			end
			apply()
		end
		local visualRoots={workspace}
		do
			local pg=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui"); if pg then table.insert(visualRoots,pg) end
			pcall(function() table.insert(visualRoots,game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
			local get=gethui or CrackHubEnvironment.gethui
			if type(get)=="function" then local ok,root=pcall(get); if ok and root then table.insert(visualRoots,root) end end
		end
		local function scanLinkedVisuals()
			local seen={}
			for _,root in ipairs(visualRoots) do
				if not seen[root] then
					seen[root]=true
					local ok,objects=pcall(function() return root:GetDescendants() end)
					if ok then for scanIndex,object in ipairs(objects) do watchLinkedVisual(object); if scanIndex%1500==0 then task.wait() end end end
				end
			end
		end
		do
			local connected={}
			for _,root in ipairs(visualRoots) do
				if not connected[root] then
					connected[root]=true
					connect(root.DescendantAdded,function(object)
						if not stopped and visualCandidate(object) then task.defer(function() if not stopped then watchLinkedVisual(object) end end) end
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		local lastRemnantScan,remnantQueued=0,false
		local hideExactRemnantsNow
		local function hideExactRemnants()
			-- full workspace + GUI scan at most once every 3 seconds
			local left=lastRemnantScan+15-os.clock()
			if left<=0 then lastRemnantScan=os.clock(); return hideExactRemnantsNow() end
			if remnantQueued then return end
			remnantQueued=true
			task.delay(left,function()
				remnantQueued=false
				if stopped then return end
				lastRemnantScan=os.clock()
				hideExactRemnantsNow()
			end)
		end
		function hideExactRemnantsNow()
			for scanIndex,object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do if scanIndex%1500==0 then task.wait() end
				if object:IsA("BasePart") then
					local part=exactRemnantPart(object)
					if part then hideExactPart(part) end
				elseif object:IsA("Light") then watchPumpkinLight(object) end
			end
			scanLinkedVisuals()
		end

		local function restoreVisuals()
			for _,c in ipairs(hiddenSignals) do c:Disconnect() end
			table.clear(hiddenSignals)
			for object,props in pairs(hiddenVisuals) do
				for prop,value in pairs(props) do pcall(function() object[prop]=value end) end
			end
			table.clear(hiddenVisuals)
			for object,saved in pairs(detachedEffects) do pcall(function() object.Parent=saved.Parent end) end
			table.clear(detachedEffects)
			for part,saved in pairs(detachedRemnants) do pcall(function() part.Parent=saved.Parent end) end
			table.clear(detachedRemnants)
			table.clear(watchedVisuals)
		end
		local function hideRemnants(old,torso,parent)
			local related,edges={},{}
			for _,object in ipairs(old:GetDescendants()) do if object:IsA("BasePart") then related[object]=true end end
			local function excluded(object)
				local node=object
				while node and node~=workspace do
					if node.Name:sub(1,8)=="CrackHub" or (node:IsA("Model") and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(node)) then return true end
					node=node.Parent
				end
				return false
			end
			local function edge(a,b)
				if not a or not b or not a:IsA("BasePart") or not b:IsA("BasePart") then return end
				edges[a]=edges[a] or {}; table.insert(edges[a],b)
				edges[b]=edges[b] or {}; table.insert(edges[b],a)
			end
			for scanIndex,object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do if scanIndex%1500==0 then task.wait() end
				if object:IsA("JointInstance") or object:IsA("WeldConstraint") then edge(object.Part0,object.Part1)
				elseif object:IsA("Constraint") then
					pcall(function()
						local a,b=object.Attachment0,object.Attachment1
						edge(a and a:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart"),b and b:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart"))
					end)
				end
			end
			local queue={}
			for part in pairs(related) do table.insert(queue,part) end
			local index=1
			while index<=#queue do
				local part=queue[index]; index+=1
				for _,other in ipairs(edges[part] or {}) do
					local p=other.Position-torso.Position
					if not related[other] and p:Dot(p)<=100 and not excluded(other) then
						related[other]=true; table.insert(queue,other)
					end
				end
			end
			for _,part in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and not related[part] and not excluded(part) then
					local p=part.Position-torso.Position
					if p.X*p.X+p.Z*p.Z<=16 and math.abs(p.Y)<=4.5 then
						local node,cosmetic=part,false
						while node and node~=parent do
							local name=string.lower(node.Name)
							if node:IsA("Accessory") or node:IsA("Tool") or name:find("knife",1,true) or name:find("gun",1,true) or name:find("weapon",1,true) or name:find("sword",1,true) or name:find("scarf",1,true) or name:find("hair",1,true) then cosmetic=true end
							node=node.Parent
						end
						if cosmetic then related[part]=true end
					end
				end
			end
			for part in pairs(related) do
				if not part:IsDescendantOf(old) then
					hideVisual(part)
					for _,child in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do hideVisual(child) end
				end
			end
		end

		local function restoreOriginal()
			if original then
				if originalParent and originalParent:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					pcall(function() original.Parent=originalParent end)
				else pcall(function() original:Destroy() end) end
			end
			original,originalParent=nil,nil
		end
		function state.Stop()
			if stopped then return end
			stopped=true
			for _,c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end
			table.clear(connections)
			if replacement then replacement:Destroy(); replacement=nil end
			if template then template:Destroy(); template=nil end
			restoreVisuals()
			restoreOriginal()
			if CrackHubEnvironment.CrackHubLobbyStatue==state then CrackHubEnvironment.CrackHubLobbyStatue=nil end
		end
		CrackHubEnvironment.CrackHubLobbyStatue=state
		connect(Window.Gui.Destroying,state.Stop)
		local function refresh()
			if stopped or Window.Destroyed or not template then return end
			local old,torso,parent=findOriginal()
			if not old then
				if originalParent and not originalParent:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					if replacement then replacement:Destroy(); replacement=nil end
					restoreOriginal()
				end
				if original and originalParent and originalParent:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
					local torso=original:FindFirstChild("Torso",true) or original:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso",true)
					if torso then hideRemnants(original,torso,originalParent) end
				end
				if not replacement then
					local clone=template:Clone(); clone.Name="CrackHubLobbyStatue"
					place(clone); clone.Parent=workspace; replacement=clone
				end
				hideExactRemnants()
				return
			end
			local clone=template:Clone()
			clone.Name="CrackHubLobbyStatue"
			local ok,err=pcall(function()
				place(clone,old,torso)
				clone.Parent=workspace
			end)
			if not ok then clone:Destroy(); warn("[CrackHub Statue] "..tostring(err)); return end
			if replacement then replacement:Destroy() end
			if original and original~=old then pcall(function() original:Destroy() end) end
			replacement=clone; original=old; originalParent=parent
			hideRemnants(old,torso,parent)
			hideExactRemnants()
			original.Parent=nil
		end
		local lastRefresh=0
		local function scheduleRefresh()
			if stopped or refreshQueued or not template then return end
			refreshQueued=true
			-- at most once every 2 seconds: each refresh scans the whole workspace
			local wait=math.max(0.15,lastRefresh+2-os.clock())
			task.delay(wait,function()
				lastRefresh=os.clock()
				refreshQueued=false
				if stopped then return end
				local ok,err=pcall(refresh)
				if not ok then warn("[CrackHub Statue] "..tostring(err)) end
			end)
		end
		connect(workspace.DescendantAdded,function(object)
			if replacement and not stopped then
				local part=exactRemnantPart(object)
				if part then task.defer(function() if not stopped and replacement then hideExactPart(part) end end) end
				if object:IsA("Light") then task.defer(function() if not stopped then watchPumpkinLight(object) end end) end
				task.defer(function()if not stopped then watchSpatialGlow(object)end end)
			end
			local name=object.Name
			if name=="Lobby" or (originalParent and object:IsDescendantOf(originalParent)) or ((name=="Model" or name=="" or name=="Torso") and object:FindFirstAncestor("Lobby")) then scheduleRefresh() end
		end)
		connect(workspace.DescendantRemoving,function(object)
			if object==originalParent then scheduleRefresh() end
		end)
		local function load()
			local loaded,abandoned=nil,false
			local pending=0
			local errors={}
			local function prepare(objects)
				if typeof(objects)=="Instance" then objects={objects} end
				assert(type(objects)=="table" and #objects>0,"Empty asset response")
				local model=Instance.new("Model"); model.Name="CrackHubLobbyStatueTemplate"
				local ok,err=pcall(function()
					for _,object in ipairs(objects) do object.Archivable=true; object.Parent=model end
					local count=0
					for i,object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
						object.Archivable=true
						if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then object:Destroy()
						elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
							count+=1; object.Anchored=true
							object.CanCollide=false; object.CanTouch=false; object.CanQuery=false
						end
						if i%200==0 then task.wait() end
					end
					assert(count>0,"Asset has no geometry")
				end)
				if not ok then model:Destroy(); error(err) end
				return model
			end
			local get=getobjects or CrackHubEnvironment.getobjects
			local methods={
				function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://125972692083965") end,
				function() assert(type(get)=="function","getobjects unavailable"); return get("rbxassetid://125972692083965") end,
				function() return game:GetService("AssetService"):LoadAssetAsync(125972692083965) end,
				function() return game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(125972692083965) end,
			}
			for i,method in ipairs(methods) do
				if loaded or stopped then break end
				pending+=1
				task.spawn(function()
					local ok,result=pcall(function() return prepare(method()) end)
					if ok then
						if abandoned or stopped or loaded then result:Destroy() else loaded=result end
					else errors[i]=tostring(result) end
					pending-=1
				end)
			end
			local deadline=os.clock()+10
			while pending>0 and not loaded and not stopped and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(0.05) end
			abandoned=true
			if stopped then if loaded then loaded:Destroy() end; return end
			return loaded,errors[1] or errors[3] or "Model loading timed out"
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			for attempt=1,2 do
				if stopped or Window.Destroyed then return end
				local model,err=load()
				if model then
					template=model
					scheduleRefresh()
					for _=1,20 do
						task.wait(1)
						if stopped or original then break end
						scheduleRefresh()
					end
					return
				end
				if attempt==2 and not stopped then
					warn("[CrackHub Statue] 125972692083965: "..tostring(err))
					Window:Notify({Title="Statue",Content="Failed to load model 125972692083965. The old statue was kept.",Duration=5})
				elseif not stopped then task.wait(attempt) end
			end
		end)
	end





	local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local HP_LOW, HP_HIGH = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70), Color3.fromRGB(80, 230, 120)

	local S = {
		Enabled = true,
		TeamCheck = false, TeamColor = false, Self = false,
		EditOnPlayers = true,


		Roles = true, RoleText = true,
		MurdererColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
		SheriffColor = Color3.fromRGB(60, 130, 255),
		HeroColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 50),
		MaxDistance = 2000,
		VisibleCheck = false, VisibleColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 230, 120),

		Chams = true, ChamsWalls = true,
		ChamsFill = ACCENT, ChamsOutline = WHITE,
		ChamsFillT = 0.5, ChamsOutlineT = 0,

		Box = true, BoxType = "Full", BoxFill = false, BoxColor = WHITE,

		Name = true, NameType = "Display",
		Distance = true, Tool = true, HPText = false,
		TextSize = 13, TextColor = WHITE,

		HealthBar = true,


		Pos = { Name = "Top", Role = "Top", HPText = "Left", Tool = "Bottom", Distance = "Bottom", Health = "Left" },

		Tracers = false, TracerFrom = "Bottom", TracerTo = "Feet", TracerThick = 1, TracerColor = ACCENT,
		Arrows = true, ArrowsAlways = true, ArrowStyle = "Arrow 1", ArrowRadius = 170, ArrowSize = 46, ArrowColor = ACCENT,
		ArrowSpread = true, ArrowSpreadAmount = 60, ArrowSpreadSmooth = 50, ArrowSpreadNow = 0,
		Skeleton = false, SkeletonColor = WHITE,
		HeadDot = false, LookLine = false, HeadColor = WHITE,
	}

	local POS_RU = { Top = "Top", Bottom = "Bottom", Left = "Left", Right = "Right" }
	local POS_EN = { ["Top"] = "Top", ["Bottom"] = "Bottom", ["Left"] = "Left", ["Right"] = "Right" }
	local POS_LIST = { "Top", "Bottom", "Left", "Right" }
	local TEXT_KEYS = { "Name", "Role", "HPText", "Tool", "Distance" }
	local HIT_ORDER = { "Name", "Role", "HPText", "Tool", "Distance", "Health" }







	local ROLE_TOOLS = {
		Murderer = { "Knife" },
		Sheriff = { "Gun", "Revolver" },
	}


	local GUN_DROP_NAMES = { "GunDrop" }
	local ROLE_NAMES = { Murderer = "Murderer", Sheriff = "Sheriff", Hero = "Hero" }

	local HasTool; HasTool = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(container, names)
		if not container then return false end
		for _, n in ipairs(names) do
			local t = container:FindFirstChild(n)
			if t and t:IsA("Tool") then return true end
		end
		return false
	end)






	local Heroes = {}
	local dropGoneAt = -100
	local roleConns = {}

	local function IsGunDrop(obj)
		local n = obj.Name
		local match = false
		for _, x in ipairs(GUN_DROP_NAMES) do
			if n == x then match = true break end
		end
		if not match and obj:IsA("Tool") then
			for _, x in ipairs(ROLE_TOOLS.Sheriff) do
				if n == x then match = true break end
			end
		end
		if not match then return false end

		local model = obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		return not (model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model))
	end

	local function WatchDrop(obj)
		if not IsGunDrop(obj) then return end
		local c
		c = obj.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
			local model = parent and (parent:IsA("Model") and parent or parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"))
			local plr = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
			if plr then Heroes[plr] = true end
			dropGoneAt = os.clock()
			if not parent or plr then c:Disconnect() end
		end)
		table.insert(roleConns, c)
	end

	for _, o in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do WatchDrop(o) end
	table.insert(roleConns, workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(WatchDrop))

	local function HookPlayer(p)
		table.insert(roleConns, p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() Heroes[p] = nil end))
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do HookPlayer(p) end
	table.insert(roleConns, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(HookPlayer))
	table.insert(roleConns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) Heroes[p] = nil end))

	local GetRole; GetRole = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(plr)
		if not plr then return nil end
		local attr = plr:GetAttribute("Role")
		if plr.Character and attr == nil then attr = plr.Character:GetAttribute("Role") end
		if attr == "Murderer" or attr == "Sheriff" or attr == "Hero" then return attr end

		local char, bp = plr.Character, plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if HasTool(char, ROLE_TOOLS.Murderer) or HasTool(bp, ROLE_TOOLS.Murderer) then
			return "Murderer"
		end
		if HasTool(char, ROLE_TOOLS.Sheriff) or HasTool(bp, ROLE_TOOLS.Sheriff) then

			if not Heroes[plr] and os.clock() - dropGoneAt < 3 then Heroes[plr] = true end
			return Heroes[plr] and "Hero" or "Sheriff"
		end
		if Heroes[plr] then return "Hero" end
		return nil
	end)

	local RoleColor; RoleColor = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(role)
		if not S.Roles or not role then return nil end
		if role == "Murderer" then return S.MurdererColor end
		if role == "Hero" then return S.HeroColor end
		return S.SheriffColor
	end)




	local ARROW_IMAGE_DIR = 90
	local ARROW_STYLES = {}
	do


		local ids = {
			{ 88863382897057, 1 },
			{ 85660367877801, 1 },
			{ 79432394704184, 1 },
			{ 112760280346836, 1 },
			{ 93881602596620, 1 },
			{ 117450492237795, 1 },
			{ 85694172361109, 1 },
			{ 95540224898085, 1 },
			{ 127595775639385, 4 },
		}
		local used = {}
		for _, e in ipairs(ids) do
			local id, scale = e[1], e[2] or 1
			if not used[id] then
				used[id] = true
				table.insert(ARROW_STYLES, {
					Name = "Arrow " .. (#ARROW_STYLES + 1),
					Id = id,
					Image = "rbxassetid://" .. id,
					Dir = ARROW_IMAGE_DIR,
					Scale = scale,
				})
			end
		end
	end


	do
		local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
		for _, st in ipairs(ARROW_STYLES) do
			task.spawn(function()
				local probe = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
				probe.Image = st.Image
				local ok = false
				pcall(function()
					ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ probe }, function(_, status)
						ok = status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success
					end)
				end)
				probe:Destroy()
				if not ok then
					st.Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. st.Id .. "&w=150&h=150"
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	local ARROW_BY_NAME = {}
	for _, st in ipairs(ARROW_STYLES) do ARROW_BY_NAME[st.Name] = st end
	local ARROW_NAMES = {}
	for _, st in ipairs(ARROW_STYLES) do table.insert(ARROW_NAMES, st.Name) end

	local Preview = {}
	local function RefreshPreview()
		if Preview.Schedule then Preview.Schedule() end
	end




	local MkLine; MkLine = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(parent)
		return Create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Visible = false,
			ZIndex = 3,
			Parent = parent,
		}, { Create("UIStroke", { Color = BLACK, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.6 }) })
	end)

	local MkRect; MkRect = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(parent)
		return Create("Frame", {
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Visible = false,
			ZIndex = 3,
			Parent = parent,
		}, { Create("UIStroke", { Color = BLACK, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.5 }) })
	end)

	local function SetLine(f, a, b, thick, color)
		local d = b - a
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((a.X + b.X) * 0.5, (a.Y + b.Y) * 0.5)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d.Magnitude, thick)
		f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y, d.X))
		f.BackgroundColor3 = color
		f.Visible = true
	end

	local function Place(f, x, y, w, h)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
		f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
		f.Visible = true
	end


	local BOX_SIGNS={-1,1}
	local BoxPoints; BoxPoints = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(hrp, head, hum, out)
		local pos = hrp.Position
		local _, ry = hrp.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
		local yaw = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, ry, 0)
		local legs = (hum and hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6) and 2 or (hum and hum.HipHeight or 2)
		local bottom = -(hrp.Size.Y / 2 + legs)
		local top = head and (head.Position.Y + head.Size.Y / 2 - pos.Y) or 2.5
		local pts = out or {}
		table.clear(pts)
		for _, sx in ipairs(BOX_SIGNS) do
			for _, sz in ipairs(BOX_SIGNS) do
				pts[#pts + 1] = yaw:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(sx * 2, bottom, sz * 0.8))
				pts[#pts + 1] = yaw:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(sx * 2, top, sz * 0.8))
			end
		end
		return pts
	end)


	local GetBonePairs; GetBonePairs = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(model)
		local list = {}
		for _, m in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if m:IsA("Motor6D") and m.Part0 and m.Part1
				and m.Part0.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and m.Part1.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
				table.insert(list, { m.Part0, m.Part1 })
			end
		end
		return list
	end)


	local BOX3D_EDGES = {
		{ 1, 2 }, { 3, 4 }, { 5, 6 }, { 7, 8 },
		{ 1, 3 }, { 3, 7 }, { 7, 5 }, { 5, 1 },
		{ 2, 4 }, { 4, 8 }, { 8, 6 }, { 6, 2 },
	}

	local Drawer = {}
	Drawer.__index = Drawer

	Drawer.new = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(parent)
		local d = setmetatable({ Bones = {}, Texts = {} }, Drawer)
		local r = Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = parent })
		d.Root = r

		d.BoxOut = Create("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, ZIndex = 1, Parent = r },
			{ Create("UIStroke", { Color = BLACK, Thickness = 3, Transparency = 0.45 }) })
		d.Box = Create("Frame", { BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 2, Parent = r })
		d.BoxStroke = Create("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1, Parent = d.Box })
		d.Corners = {}
		for i = 1, 8 do d.Corners[i] = MkRect(r) end
		d.Edges = {}
		for i = 1, 12 do d.Edges[i] = MkLine(r) end
		d.SP = {}

		d.HB = Create("Frame", {
			BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
			BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, ZIndex = 3, Parent = r,
		})
		d.HBFill = Create("Frame", { BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4, Parent = d.HB })

		d.Labels = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(TEXT_KEYS) do
			d.Labels[k] = Create("TextLabel", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
				FontFace = Fonts.Medium,
				TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35,
				Visible = false,
				ZIndex = 5,
				Parent = r,
			})
		end

		d.Dot = Create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Visible = false, ZIndex = 3, Parent = r,
		}, { Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }) })
		d.DotStroke = Create("UIStroke", { Thickness = 1.5, Parent = d.Dot })

		d.Look = MkLine(r)
		d.Tracer = MkLine(r)

		d.Arrow = Create("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Visible = false, ZIndex = 3, Parent = r,
		})
		d.ArrowA = MkLine(d.Arrow)
		d.ArrowB = MkLine(d.Arrow)
		d.ArrowImg = Create("ImageLabel", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
			Rotation = ARROW_IMAGE_DIR,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Image = ARROW_STYLES[1].Image,
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
			ZIndex = 4,
			Parent = d.Arrow,
		})

		d.Hit = {
			Name = d.Labels.Name, Role = d.Labels.Role, HPText = d.Labels.HPText,
			Tool = d.Labels.Tool, Distance = d.Labels.Distance, Health = d.HB,
		}
		return d
	end)

	function Drawer:Hide()
		self.Box.Visible = false
		self.BoxOut.Visible = false
		for _, c in ipairs(self.Corners) do c.Visible = false end
		for _, e in ipairs(self.Edges) do e.Visible = false end
		self.HB.Visible = false
		for _, l in pairs(self.Labels) do l.Visible = false end
		self.Dot.Visible = false
		self.Look.Visible = false
		self.Tracer.Visible = false
		for _, b in ipairs(self.Bones) do b.Visible = false end
		self.Rect = nil
	end

	function Drawer:HideArrow() self.Arrow.Visible = false end
	function Drawer:Destroy() self.Root:Destroy() end

	function Drawer:ShowArrow(center, dir, color, radius)
		local sz = S.ArrowSize
		local pos = center + dir * (radius or S.ArrowRadius)
		local a = self.Arrow
		a.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
		a.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y)
		a.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dir.Y, dir.X))
		local img = self.ArrowImg
		local st = ARROW_BY_NAME[S.ArrowStyle] or ARROW_STYLES[1]
		if img.Image ~= st.Image then img.Image = st.Image end
		img.Rotation = st.Dir
		local k = st.Scale or 1
		img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(k, k)
		img.ImageColor3 = color
		if img.IsLoaded then

			img.Visible = true
			self.ArrowA.Visible = false
			self.ArrowB.Visible = false
		else

			img.Visible = true
			SetLine(self.ArrowA, Vector2.new(0, 0), Vector2.new(sz, sz / 2), 3, color)
			SetLine(self.ArrowB, Vector2.new(0, sz), Vector2.new(sz, sz / 2), 3, color)
		end
		a.Visible = true
	end


	function Drawer:ArrowHit(m)
		local a = self.Arrow
		if not a.Visible then return false end
		local c = a.AbsolutePosition + a.AbsoluteSize / 2
		return (m - c).Magnitude <= math.max(a.AbsoluteSize.X, 16) * 0.75
	end

	function Drawer:HitTest(m)
		for _, key in ipairs(HIT_ORDER) do
			local inst = self.Hit[key]
			if inst.Visible then
				local p, s = inst.AbsolutePosition, inst.AbsoluteSize
				local pad = key == "Health" and 6 or 3
				if m.X >= p.X - pad and m.X <= p.X + s.X + pad and m.Y >= p.Y - pad and m.Y <= p.Y + s.Y + pad then
					return key
				end
			end
		end
		return nil
	end



	function Drawer:Update(t)
		local minX, minY, maxX, maxY = math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
		self.PlayerName = t.PlayerName
		local sp = self.SP
		for i, p in ipairs(t.Points) do
			local s, z = t.Project(p)
			if z <= 0 then
				self:Hide()
				return nil
			end
			sp[i] = s
			if s.X < minX then minX = s.X end
			if s.Y < minY then minY = s.Y end
			if s.X > maxX then maxX = s.X end
			if s.Y > maxY then maxY = s.Y end
		end
		local x, y = math.floor(minX), math.floor(minY)
		local w = math.max(math.floor(maxX - x), 2)
		local h = math.max(math.floor(maxY - y), 2)
		self.Rect = { x, y, w, h }
		local main = t.Color


		local corners = S.Box and S.BoxType == "Corners"
		local box3d = S.Box and S.BoxType == "3D"
		if box3d then

			for i, e in ipairs(BOX3D_EDGES) do
				SetLine(self.Edges[i], sp[e[1]], sp[e[2]], 1, main)
			end
		else
			for _, e in ipairs(self.Edges) do e.Visible = false end
		end
		if S.Box and not corners and not box3d then
			Place(self.BoxOut, x, y, w, h)
			Place(self.Box, x, y, w, h)
			self.Box.BackgroundColor3 = main
			self.Box.BackgroundTransparency = S.BoxFill and 0.82 or 1
			self.BoxStroke.Color = main
		else
			self.Box.Visible = false
			self.BoxOut.Visible = false
		end
		if corners then
			local cl = math.max(math.floor(math.min(w, h) * 0.25), 3)
			local spec = {
				{ x, y, cl, 1 }, { x, y, 1, cl },
				{ x + w - cl, y, cl, 1 }, { x + w - 1, y, 1, cl },
				{ x, y + h - 1, cl, 1 }, { x, y + h - cl, 1, cl },
				{ x + w - cl, y + h - 1, cl, 1 }, { x + w - 1, y + h - cl, 1, cl },
			}
			for i, sp in ipairs(spec) do
				local c = self.Corners[i]
				Place(c, sp[1], sp[2], sp[3], sp[4])
				c.BackgroundColor3 = main
			end
		else
			for _, c in ipairs(self.Corners) do c.Visible = false end
		end


		local shift = { Top = 0, Bottom = 0, Left = 0, Right = 0 }
		local pct = math.clamp(t.Health / math.max(t.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
		if S.HealthBar then
			local hb, fill = self.HB, self.HBFill
			local side = S.Pos.Health
			local vertical = side == "Left" or side == "Right"
			if self.DragKey == "Health" then
				vertical = true
				Place(hb, self.DragPos.X - 2, self.DragPos.Y - h / 2, 5, h + 2)
			elseif side == "Left" then
				Place(hb, x - 9, y - 1, 5, h + 2)
			elseif side == "Right" then
				Place(hb, x + w + 4, y - 1, 5, h + 2)
			elseif side == "Top" then
				Place(hb, x - 1, y - 9, w + 2, 5)
			else
				Place(hb, x - 1, y + h + 4, w + 2, 5)
			end
			if self.DragKey ~= "Health" then shift[side] = 9 end
			if vertical then
				fill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
				fill.Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -1)
				fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, pct, -2 * pct)
			else
				fill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
				fill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)
				fill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, -2 * pct, 1, -2)
			end
			fill.BackgroundColor3 = HP_LOW:Lerp(HP_HIGH, pct)
		else
			self.HB.Visible = false
		end


		local texts = self.Texts
		texts.Name = S.Name and t.NameText or nil
		texts.Role = (S.Roles and S.RoleText and t.Role) and ROLE_NAMES[t.Role] or nil
		texts.HPText = S.HPText and (math.floor(t.Health + 0.5) .. " HP") or nil
		texts.Tool = S.Tool and t.ToolText or nil
		texts.Distance = S.Distance and (math.floor(t.Dist * 0.28 + 0.5) .. "m") or nil

		local lh = S.TextSize + 2
		local cT, cB = y - 4 - shift.Top, y + h + 4 + shift.Bottom
		local cL, cR = y, y
		for _, key in ipairs(TEXT_KEYS) do
			local l, txt = self.Labels[key], texts[key]
			if txt then
				if l.Text~=txt then l.Text=txt end
				if l.TextSize~=S.TextSize then l.TextSize=S.TextSize end
				if key == "HPText" then
					l.TextColor3 = HP_LOW:Lerp(HP_HIGH, pct)
				elseif (key == "Name" or key == "Role") and t.RoleColor then
					l.TextColor3 = t.RoleColor
				else
					l.TextColor3 = S.TextColor
				end
				l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, lh)
				l.Visible = true
				if self.DragKey == key then
					l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
					l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(self.DragPos.X, self.DragPos.Y)
				else
					local side = S.Pos[key]
					if side == "Top" then
						l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
						l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + w / 2, cT)
						cT -= lh
					elseif side == "Bottom" then
						l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
						l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + w / 2, cB)
						cB += lh
					elseif side == "Left" then
						l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
						l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - 5 - shift.Left, cL)
						cL += lh
					else
						l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
						l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + w + 5 + shift.Right, cR)
						cR += lh
					end
				end
			else
				l.Visible = false
			end
		end


		local head = t.Head
		local hs, hz
		if head and (S.HeadDot or S.LookLine) then hs, hz = t.Project(head.Position) end
		if head and S.HeadDot and hz > 0 then
			local es = t.Project(head.Position + t.CamUp * head.Size.Y * 0.5)
			local rad = math.max((es - hs).Magnitude, 2)
			self.Dot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(hs.X, hs.Y)
			self.Dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(rad * 2, rad * 2)
			self.DotStroke.Color = t.Override or S.HeadColor
			self.Dot.Visible = true
		else
			self.Dot.Visible = false
		end
		if head and S.LookLine and hz > 0 then
			local ls, lz = t.Project(head.Position + t.Look * 4)
			if lz > 0 then SetLine(self.Look, hs, ls, 1, t.Override or S.HeadColor) else self.Look.Visible = false end
		else
			self.Look.Visible = false
		end


		local n = 0
		if S.Skeleton and t.Pairs then
			local col = t.Override or S.SkeletonColor
			for _, pr in ipairs(t.Pairs) do
				local a, b = pr[1], pr[2]
				if a.Parent and b.Parent then
					local sa, za = t.Project(a.Position)
					local sb, zb = t.Project(b.Position)
					if za > 0 and zb > 0 then
						n += 1
						local line = self.Bones[n]
						if not line then
							line = MkLine(self.Root)
							self.Bones[n] = line
						end
						SetLine(line, sa, sb, 1, col)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for i = n + 1, #self.Bones do self.Bones[i].Visible = false end


		if S.Tracers and t.TracerFrom then
			local to = Vector2.new(x + w / 2, y + h)
			if S.TracerTo == "Head" and head and hz > 0 then to = hs end
			SetLine(self.Tracer, t.TracerFrom, to, S.TracerThick, t.Override or S.TracerColor)
		else
			self.Tracer.Visible = false
		end

		return self.Rect
	end

	local JC_IMAGES = {

	local V = {

		Style = "Variant 1",
		When = "Jump",
		Size = 6,
		Speed = 5,
		Transparency = 0,
		Spin = true,
		Rainbow = false,
		Color = ACCENT,
