	local JCFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	JCFolder.Name = "CrackHubJumpCircles"
	JCFolder.Parent = workspace

	local jcRay = RaycastParams.new()
	jcRay.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	local function SpawnCircle(hrp)
		if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then return end
		local char = hrp.Parent
		jcRay.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, JCFolder }


		local hit = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), jcRay)
		local pos, normal
		if hit then
			pos, normal = hit.Position, hit.Normal
		else
			local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			pos = hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, hrp.Size.Y / 2 + (hum and hum.HipHeight or 2), 0)
			normal = Vector3.yAxis
		end


		local fwd = Vector3.zAxis - normal * normal:Dot(Vector3.zAxis)
		if fwd.Magnitude < 0.01 then fwd = Vector3.xAxis - normal * normal:Dot(Vector3.xAxis) end
		local base = pos + normal * 0.06
		local cf = CFrame.lookAt(base, base + fwd.Unit, normal)

		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = "JumpCircle"
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CastShadow = false
		part.Transparency = 1
		part.Size = Vector3.new(0.001, 0.001, 0.001)
		part.CFrame = cf
		part.Parent = JCFolder

		local dur = 3 / math.max(V.Speed, 0.1)
		local diameter = V.Size * 2
		local alpha = math.clamp(V.Transparency, 0, 1)
		local sizes, fades = {}, {}
		for i = 0, 10 do
			local t = i / 10
			table.insert(sizes, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, 0.4 + (diameter - 0.4) * (1 - (1 - t) ^ 5)))
			table.insert(fades, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, alpha + (1 - alpha) * t * t))
		end
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Name = "JumpCircleSprite"
		emitter.Enabled = false
		emitter.Rate = 0
		emitter.Texture = JC_IMAGES[V.Style] or JC_IMAGES["Variant 1"]
		emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(V.Rainbow and Color3.fromHSV((os.clock() * 0.25) % 1, 0.8, 1) or V.Color)
		emitter.LightEmission = 1
		emitter.LightInfluence = 0
		emitter.Brightness = 1
		emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(dur)
		emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(sizes)
		emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(fades)
		emitter.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular
		emitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.001)
		emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.zero
		emitter.Acceleration = Vector3.zero
		emitter.Drag = 0
		emitter.VelocityInheritance = 0
		emitter.LockedToPart = true
		emitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0)
		emitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(V.Spin and 180 / dur or 0)
		emitter.Parent = part
		emitter:Emit(1)

		task.delay(dur + 0.05, function() part:Destroy() end)
	end


	local JCState = { Conns = {}, CharConn = nil }
	local function HookJumpCircles(char)
		if JCState.CharConn then JCState.CharConn:Disconnect() end
		local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
		if not hum then return end
		JCState.CharConn = hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, new)
			if not V.JumpCircles then return end
			local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping and V.When ~= "Landing" then
				SpawnCircle(hrp)
			elseif new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed and V.When ~= "Jump" then
				SpawnCircle(hrp)
			end
		end)
	end
	table.insert(JCState.Conns, LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(HookJumpCircles))
	if LocalPlayer.Character then task.spawn(HookJumpCircles, LocalPlayer.Character) end

		-- ---- loading aura models (hats / accessories are skipped) ----
		local modelCache = {}
		local function FetchObjects(id)
			local uri = "rbxassetid://" .. id
			local ok, objs = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects(uri) end)
			if not ok or type(objs) ~= "table" or #objs == 0 then
				local get = getobjects or CrackHubEnvironment.getobjects
				if type(get) == "function" then ok, objs = pcall(get, uri) end
			end
			if not ok or type(objs) ~= "table" or #objs == 0 then
				local okI, c = pcall(function() return game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(id) end)
				if okI and c then ok, objs = true, { c } end
			end
			return ok and type(objs) == "table" and #objs > 0 and objs or nil
		end
		local function LoadAura(aura)
			for _, id in ipairs(aura[2]) do
				if modelCache[id] then return modelCache[id] end
				local objs = FetchObjects(id)
				if objs then
					local m = Instance.new("Model")
					for _, o in ipairs(objs) do pcall(function() o.Parent = m end) end
					for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
						if d.Parent and (d:IsA("Accessory") or d:IsA("Hat") or d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("Sound")
							or d:IsA("Clothing") or d:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or d:IsA("BodyColors") or d:IsA("Humanoid") or d:IsA("AnimationController")) then
							d:Destroy()
						end
					end
					modelCache[id] = m
					return m
				end
			end
		end

		local function ApplyTint()
			for obj, orig in pairs(tinted) do
				if obj.Parent then
					obj.Color = AV.Color and (obj:IsA("Light") and AV.Color or ColorSequence.new(AV.Color)) or orig
				end

		local rigTint = Color3.fromRGB(133, 220, 255)
		local function IsAuraVisual(object)
			return object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Trail") or object:IsA("Light")
		end
		local function AttachRigAura(model, char)
			local clone = model:Clone()
			-- Keep the cloned rig intact until its effects are moved, so beam and trail links survive.
			for _, object in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
				if object.Parent and not object:IsA("Model") and not object:IsA("Folder")
					and not object:IsA("BasePart") and not object:IsA("Attachment") and not IsAuraVisual(object) then
					object:Destroy()
				end
			end
			local transferred = {}
			for _, part in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Parent then
					local limb = CharPart(char, part.Name) or char:FindFirstChild(part.Name)
					if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") then
						for _, effect in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
							if effect:IsA("Attachment") or IsAuraVisual(effect) then
								for _, descendant in ipairs(effect:GetDescendants()) do
									if descendant.Parent and not descendant:IsA("Attachment") and not IsAuraVisual(descendant) then
										descendant:Destroy()
									end
								end
								table.insert(transferred, {effect, limb})
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			for _, transfer in ipairs(transferred) do
				local effect, limb = transfer[1], transfer[2]
				effect.Parent = limb
				table.insert(attached, effect)
				local function remember(object)
					if IsAuraVisual(object) then
						tinted[object] = object:IsA("Light") and rigTint or ColorSequence.new(rigTint)
					end
				end
				remember(effect)
				for _, descendant in ipairs(effect:GetDescendants()) do remember(descendant) end
			end
			clone:Destroy()
			ApplyTint()
		end
		local buildToken = 0
		local function BuildWorld()
			buildToken += 1
			local my = buildToken
			ClearWorld()
			local aura = AV.Enabled and AV.Current and auraByName[AV.Current]
			if not aura then return end
			if aura.BuiltIn then
				local ok, objects = pcall(function() return builtInAuras:Apply(LocalPlayer.Character, aura.BuiltIn) end)
				if not ok then builtInAuras:Clear(); Window:Notify({Title = "Auras", Content = tostring(objects), Type = "Error", Duration = 5}); return end
				for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
					if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Trail") then tinted[object] = object.Color end
				end
				ApplyTint()
				return
			end
			task.spawn(function()
				AV.Loading = true
				local model = LoadAura(aura)
				AV.Loading = false
				if my ~= buildToken then return end
				local char = LocalPlayer.Character
				local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if not model or not hrp then
					if not model then Window:Notify({ Title = "Auras", Content = "Couldn't load “" .. aura[1] .. "”", Duration = 4 }) end
					return
				end
				if aura.RigAura then
					AttachRigAura(model, char)
					return
				end
				local clone = model:Clone()
				-- reference point inside the aura model (its own root / torso)
				local ref
				for _, n in ipairs({ "HumanoidRootPart", "Torso", "UpperTorso" }) do
					ref = ref or clone:FindFirstChild(n, true)
				end
				local refCF = YawOnly((ref and ref:IsA("BasePart")) and ref.CFrame or clone:GetBoundingBox())
				-- ground level of the aura model (its rig stands ~3 studs above the floor)
				local refGround = CFrame.new(refCF.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * refCF.Rotation
				folder = Instance.new("Folder")
				folder.Name = "CrackHubAura"
				local moving, offsets, onGround = {}, {}, {}
				for _, part in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then
						for _, j in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
							if j:IsA("JointInstance") or j:IsA("WeldConstraint") or j:IsA("Constraint") then j:Destroy() end
						end
						part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Massless = false, false, false, true
						local isBody = BODY[part.Name] ~= nil
						if isBody then
							part.Transparency = 1
							for _, v in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
								if v:IsA("Decal") or v:IsA("DataModelMesh") then v:Destroy() end
							end
						end
						local limb = LIMBS[part.Name] and CharPart(char, part.Name)
						if AV.Mode == "Body" and not limb then
							limb = CharPart(char, part.Name)
							if not limb then
								-- loose parts: keep their offset from the aura rig's root
								local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or hrp
								part.Anchored = false
								part.CFrame = YawOnly(hrp.CFrame) * refCF:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
								local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
								w.Part0, w.Part1 = part, hrp
								w.Parent = part
								part.Parent = folder
								torso = torso
								continue
							end
						end
						if limb then
							-- effects on head / hands / legs follow the animated limb
							part.Anchored = false
							part.CFrame = limb.CFrame
							local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
							w.Part0, w.Part1 = part, limb
							w.Parent = part
						else
							-- everything else follows you upright; floor effects stay flat on the ground
							part.Anchored = true
							local rel = refCF:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
							local ground = rel.Position.Y < -2.2
							table.insert(moving, part)
							offsets[part] = ground and refGround:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame) or rel
							onGround[part] = ground
						end
						part.Parent = folder
					end
				end
				if #moving > 0 then
					local rp = RaycastParams.new()
					rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
					rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, folder }
					local cfs = table.create(#moving)
					local lastGround, rayAcc = nil, 1
					followConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
						if not hrp.Parent then return end
						local base = YawOnly(hrp.CFrame)
						rayAcc += dt
						if rayAcc >= 0.05 or not lastGround then
							rayAcc = 0
							local hit = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(0, -12, 0), rp)
							lastGround = hit and hit.Position.Y + 0.05 or (hrp.Position.Y - 3)
						end
						local gbase = CFrame.new(base.X, lastGround, base.Z) * base.Rotation
						for k, part in ipairs(moving) do
							cfs[k] = (onGround[part] and gbase or base) * offsets[part]
						end
						workspace:BulkMoveTo(moving, cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
					end))
				end
				-- performance budget: aura models are often made for showcases, not for gameplay
				local emitters, lights, totalRate = {}, 0, 0
				for _, d in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
					if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
						table.insert(emitters, d)
						totalRate += d.Rate
					elseif d:IsA("Light") then
						lights += 1
						if lights > 2 then d.Enabled = false end
						d.Shadows = false
					end
					if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Trail") then tinted[d] = d.Color end
				end
				local BUDGET = 160
				if totalRate > BUDGET then
					local k = BUDGET / totalRate
					for _, e in ipairs(emitters) do e.Rate = e.Rate * k end
				end
				for idx, e in ipairs(emitters) do
					if idx > 20 then e.Enabled = false end
					e.LightInfluence = 0
				end
				clone:Destroy()
				folder.Parent = workspace
				ApplyTint()
			end)
		end
		table.insert(Window.Connections, LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
			c:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
			task.wait(0.3)
			BuildWorld()
		end))
		Window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			buildToken += 1
			ClearWorld()
		end)

		-- models are fetched in the background the first time the Auras tab is opened
		local preloadStarted = false
		local function Preload()
			if preloadStarted then return end
			preloadStarted = true
			task.spawn(function()
				for _, a in ipairs(AURAS) do
					if Window.Destroyed then return end
					if not a.BuiltIn then
						if not modelCache[a[2][1]] then pcall(LoadAura, a) end
						task.wait(0.5)
					end
				end
			end)
		end

		local AuraTab = VisualsGroup:CreateTab("Auras")
		local cards = {}

		-- ---- settings (kept short) ----
		local cards = cards
		local function Paint()
			for name, card in pairs(cards) do
				local on = AV.Current == name
				card.Stroke.Color = on and Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke
				card.Stroke.Transparency = on and 0 or 0.4
				card.Stroke.Thickness = on and 2 or 1
				card.Label.TextColor3 = on and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText
				card.Frame.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.1 or 0.3
			end
		end
		local SG = AuraTab:AddGroup("Aura settings", true)
		SG:AddToggle({ Name = "Aura", Default = AV.Enabled, Bind = true, Flag = "VIS_Aura",
			Callback = function(v) AV.Enabled = v; BuildWorld() end })
		SG:AddDropdown({ Name = "Attach mode", Options = { "Smooth", "Body" }, Default = "Smooth", Flag = "VIS_AuraMode",
			Callback = function(v) AV.Mode = v or "Smooth"; if AV.Enabled then BuildWorld() end end })
		local useColor, ColorPick = false, nil
		SG:AddToggle({ Name = "Custom color", Default = false, Flag = "VIS_AuraUseColor",
			Callback = function(v)
				useColor = v
				AV.Color = v and ColorPick and ColorPick.Value or nil
				ApplyTint(); Paint()
			end })
		ColorPick = SG:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Color", Default = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 40), Flag = "VIS_AuraColor",
			Callback = function(c) if useColor then AV.Color = c; ApplyTint(); Paint() end end })

		-- ---- aura gallery ----
		local GG = AuraTab:AddGroup("Auras", true)
		local Grid = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = NextOrder(),
			Parent = GG.Holder,
		}, {
			Padding(6, 4, 8, 4),
			Create("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(132, 40), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
		})
		for i, aura in ipairs(AURAS) do
			local name = aura[1]
			local selection = aura.Selection or name
			local frame = Create("TextButton", {
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Text = "",
				LayoutOrder = i,
				ClipsDescendants = true,
				Parent = Grid,
			}, { Corner(10) })
			local st = Create("UIStroke", { Color = Theme.Stroke, Transparency = 0.4, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = frame })
			local lbl = Label({
				Text = name,
				FontFace = Fonts.Bold,
				TextSize = 12,
				TextColor3 = Theme.SubText,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, 0),
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
				Parent = frame,
			})
			cards[selection] = { Frame = frame, Label = lbl, Stroke = st }
			local sc = Create("UIScale", { Parent = frame })
			frame.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Tween(sc, { Scale = 1.05 }, 0.12) end)
			frame.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Tween(sc, { Scale = 1 }, 0.12) end)
			frame.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				if AV.Current == selection then
					AV.Current = nil
				else
					AV.Current = selection
					AV.Enabled = true
					local flag = CrackHub.Flags.VIS_Aura
					if flag and not flag.Value then flag:Set(true, true) end
				end
				Paint()
				BuildWorld()
			end)
		end
		Paint()
	end


	local JCMain = AddVisualPage("Jump Circles")
	JCMain:AddToggle({ Name = "Jump Circles", Default = V.JumpCircles, Bind = true, Flag = "VIS_JumpCircles",
		Callback = function(v) V.JumpCircles = v end })
	JCMain:AddDropdown({ Name = "Ring style", Options = JC_LIST, Default = V.Style, Flag = "VIS_JCStyle",
		Callback = function(v) V.Style = v end })
	JCMain:AddDropdown({ Name = "When", Options = { "Jump", "Landing", "Both" }, Default = V.When, Flag = "VIS_JCWhen",
		Callback = function(v) V.When = v end })
	JCMain:AddSlider({ Name = "Size", Min = 1, Max = 20, Default = V.Size, Increment = 0.5, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_JCSize",
		Callback = function(v) V.Size = v end })
	JCMain:AddSlider({ Name = "Speed", Min = 1, Max = 10, Default = V.Speed, Increment = 0.5, Flag = "VIS_JCSpeed",
		Callback = function(v) V.Speed = v end })
	JCMain:AddSlider({ Name = "Transparency", Min = 0, Max = 90, Default = V.Transparency * 100, Suffix = "%", Flag = "VIS_JCTransparency",
		Callback = function(v) V.Transparency = v / 100 end })

	JCMain:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Ring color", Default = V.Color, Flag = "VIS_JCColor",
		Callback = function(c) V.Color = c end })
	JCMain:AddToggle({ Name = "Rainbow", Default = V.Rainbow, Flag = "VIS_JCRainbow",
		Callback = function(v) V.Rainbow = v end })
	JCMain:AddToggle({ Name = "Spin", Default = V.Spin, Flag = "VIS_JCSpin",
		Callback = function(v) V.Spin = v end })
	JCMain:AddButton({ Name = "Check", Style = "Primary",
		Callback = function()
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			SpawnCircle(char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
		end })

	local PartApi = {}
	do



		local PARTICLE_STYLES = {}
		do
			local ids = {
				71777654323859, 130475994134399, 75506121406813, 73751093522224,
				72572111835432, 97260699403108, 132234348179648,
			}
			local used = {}
			for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
				if not used[id] then
					used[id] = true
					table.insert(PARTICLE_STYLES, {
						Name = "Particle " .. (#PARTICLE_STYLES + 1),
						Id = id,
						Image = "rbxassetid://" .. id,
					})
				end
			end

			local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
			for _, st in ipairs(PARTICLE_STYLES) do
				task.spawn(function()
					local probe = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
					probe.Image = st.Image
					local ok = false
					pcall(function()
						ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ probe }, function(_, status)
							ok = status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success
						end)
					end)
					probe:Destroy()
					if not ok then st.Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. st.Id .. "&w=150&h=150" end
				end)
			end
		end
		local P_BY_NAME = {}
		local P_NAMES = { "Random" }
		for _, st in ipairs(PARTICLE_STYLES) do
			P_BY_NAME[st.Name] = st
			table.insert(P_NAMES, st.Name)
		end

		local PV = {
			Enabled = false,
			Style = "Random",
			Mode = "Cloud",
			Count = 40,
			Speed = 6,
			Size = 0.8,
			SizeRandom = 40,
			Radius = 10,
			Lifetime = 4,
			Collision = true,
			Gravity = false,
			Bounce = 0.85,
			Follow = false,
			Twinkle = true,
			Opacity = 100,
			Color = WHITE,
			Rainbow = false,
			Glow = true,
			Spin = true,
		}
		local P_MODES = { "Cloud", "Orbit", "Vortex", "Snow", "Fireflies", "Floor" }




		local pRay = RaycastParams.new()
		pRay.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

		local Particles = {}
		local lastCenter = nil

		local RandomUnit; RandomUnit = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			local v
			repeat
				v = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1)
			until v.Magnitude > 0.05 and v.Magnitude <= 1
			return v.Unit
		end)

		local PickStyle; PickStyle = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			if PV.Style == "Random" or not P_BY_NAME[PV.Style] then
				return PARTICLE_STYLES[math.random(1, #PARTICLE_STYLES)]
			end
			return P_BY_NAME[PV.Style]
		end)


		local SpawnPoint; SpawnPoint = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(p, center)
			local R = PV.Radius
			local mode = PV.Mode
			if mode == "Floor" then

				local a, r = math.random() * math.pi * 2, math.sqrt(math.random()) * R
				local top = center + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, 3, math.sin(a) * r)
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(top, Vector3.new(0, -15, 0), pRay)
				local y = hit and hit.Position.Y or (center.Y - 3)
				return Vector3.new(top.X, y + PV.Size * 0.5, top.Z)
			elseif mode == "Snow" then
				local a, r = math.random() * math.pi * 2, math.sqrt(math.random()) * R
				return center + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, R * (0.4 + math.random() * 0.4), math.sin(a) * r)
			elseif mode == "Orbit" then
				local a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
				return center + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * p.OrbitR, p.OrbitH, math.sin(a) * p.OrbitR)
			elseif mode == "Vortex" then
				local a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
				return center + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * p.OrbitR * 0.4, -2.5, math.sin(a) * p.OrbitR * 0.4)
			end
			local dir = RandomUnit()
			dir = Vector3.new(dir.X, dir.Y * 0.5, dir.Z)
			return center + dir * (math.random() * R)
		end)


		local Wander; Wander = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(p, t, freq)
			local sd = p.Seed
			return Vector3.new(
				math.noise(sd, t * freq, 0.5),
				math.noise(sd + 17.31, t * freq, 0.5),
				math.noise(sd + 41.77, t * freq, 0.5)
			) * 2
		end)


		local Desired; Desired = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(p, center, t)
			local mode, spd = PV.Mode, PV.Speed
			local off = p.Pos - center
			if mode == "Orbit" or mode == "Vortex" then
				local flat = Vector3.new(off.X, 0, off.Z)
				local r = flat.Magnitude
				if r < 0.05 then flat, r = Vector3.xAxis, 1 end
				local radial = flat / r
				local tangent = Vector3.new(-radial.Z, 0, radial.X) * p.OrbitDir
				local wantR = mode == "Vortex" and (p.OrbitR * (0.3 + 0.7 * math.clamp((off.Y + 2.5) / (PV.Radius * 0.9), 0, 1))) or p.OrbitR
				local v = tangent * spd + radial * math.clamp(wantR - r, -3, 3) * 1.5
				if mode == "Vortex" then
					v += Vector3.new(0, spd * 0.35 * p.RiseK, 0)
				else
					v += Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(p.OrbitH + math.sin(t * 0.8 + p.Phase) * 0.5 - off.Y, -3, 3) * 1.5, 0)
				end
				return v
			elseif mode == "Floor" then

				local w = Wander(p, t, 0.25)
				return Vector3.new(w.X, 0, w.Z) * spd * 0.12 + Vector3.new(0, spd * 0.3 * p.RiseK, 0)
			elseif mode == "Snow" then
				local w = Wander(p, t, 0.3)
				return Vector3.new(w.X, 0, w.Z) * spd * 0.18 + Vector3.new(0, -spd * 0.4 * p.RiseK, 0)
			elseif mode == "Fireflies" then
				return Wander(p, t, 0.22) * spd * 0.35
			end

			local w = Wander(p, t, 0.3)
			w = Vector3.new(w.X, w.Y * 0.6, w.Z)
			if w.Magnitude < 0.05 then return p.Vel end
			return w.Unit * spd * p.RiseK
		end)

		local Respawn; Respawn = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(p, center)
			local st = PickStyle()
			p.Style = st
			p.Img.Image = st.Image
			p.OrbitR = PV.Radius * (0.35 + math.random() * 0.65)
			p.OrbitH = (math.random() * 1.2 - 0.4) * PV.Radius * 0.35
			p.OrbitDir = math.random() < 0.85 and 1 or -1
			p.SizeK = 1 + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * PV.SizeRandom / 100
			local target = SpawnPoint(p, center)

			if PV.Collision then
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(center, target - center, pRay)
				if hit then target = hit.Position + hit.Normal * 0.3 end
			end
			p.Pos = target
			p.Seed = math.random() * 1000
			p.RiseK = 0.75 + math.random() * 0.5
			p.Phase = math.random() * math.pi * 2
			p.Age = 0
			p.Life = PV.Lifetime * (0.7 + math.random() * 0.6)
			p.Spin = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 35
			p.Hue = math.random()
			p.Squash = 0
			p.Landed = false

			p.Vel = Desired(p, center, os.clock())
		end)

		local NewParticle; NewParticle = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
			att.Name = "CrackHubParticle"
			att.Parent = workspace.Terrain
			local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			bb.Adornee = att
			bb.Size = UDim2.fromScale(PV.Size, PV.Size)
			bb.LightInfluence = PV.Glow and 0 or 1
			bb.ResetOnSpawn = false
			bb.Parent = att
			local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			img.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			img.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			img.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			img.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
			img.ImageTransparency = 1
			img.Parent = bb
			return {
				Att = att, BB = bb, Img = img,
				Pos = Vector3.zero, Vel = Vector3.zero,
				Age = 0, Life = 1, Rot = 0, Spin = 0, Hue = 0, Phase = 0,
				OrbitR = 5, OrbitH = 0, OrbitDir = 1, SizeK = 1, Squash = 0,
				LastSize = -1, Landed = false, Seed = 0, RiseK = 1,
			}
		end)

		local KillParticle; KillParticle = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(p)
			p.BB:Destroy()
			p.Att:Destroy()
		end)

		local ClearParticles; ClearParticles = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			for _, p in ipairs(Particles) do pcall(KillParticle, p) end
			table.clear(Particles)
			lastCenter = nil
		end)


		local pRespawnConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			ClearParticles()
		end)

		local pFrame = 0
		local pPhone = game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled and not game:GetService("UserInputService").KeyboardEnabled
		local pConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not PV.Enabled or not hrp or #PARTICLE_STYLES == 0 then
				if #Particles > 0 then ClearParticles() end
				return
			end
			local center = hrp.Position
			pRay.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }


			local first = Particles[1]
			if first and (not first.Att.Parent or not first.BB.Parent) then ClearParticles() end


			local want = math.floor(PV.Count)
			if pPhone then want = math.min(want, 24) end
			while #Particles < want do
				local p = NewParticle()
				table.insert(Particles, p)
				Respawn(p, center)
				p.Age = math.random() * p.Life * 0.5
			end
			while #Particles > want do KillParticle(table.remove(Particles)) end

			dt = math.min(dt, 1 / 20)
			local t = os.clock()

			local moved = lastCenter and (center - lastCenter) or Vector3.zero
			lastCenter = center
			if moved.Magnitude > 20 then moved = Vector3.zero end

			pFrame = (pFrame or 0) + 1
			for pi, p in ipairs(Particles) do
				p.Age += dt
				if p.Age >= p.Life then Respawn(p, center) end

				if PV.Follow then p.Pos += moved * 0.85 end

				if not p.Landed then
					local desired = Desired(p, center, t)
					local k = math.min(dt * 2, 1)
					local gravity = PV.Gravity and PV.Mode ~= "Floor" and PV.Mode ~= "Orbit" and PV.Mode ~= "Vortex"
					if gravity then

						local nv = p.Vel + (desired - p.Vel) * k
						p.Vel = Vector3.new(nv.X, p.Vel.Y - workspace.Gravity * 0.15 * dt, nv.Z)
					else
						p.Vel += (desired - p.Vel) * k
					end
				end


				local off = p.Pos - center
				local dist = off.Magnitude
				if PV.Mode == "Floor" or PV.Mode == "Snow" then
					off = Vector3.new(off.X, 0, off.Z)
					dist = off.Magnitude
				end
				if PV.Follow then

					if dist > PV.Radius * 1.1 and dist > 0.01 and PV.Mode ~= "Snow" and PV.Mode ~= "Floor" then
						p.Vel -= off.Unit * PV.Speed * 3 * dt
					end
					if dist > PV.Radius * 2.5 then Respawn(p, center) end
				else

					if dist > PV.Radius * 1.6 and p.Age < p.Life - 0.4 then
						p.Age = p.Life - 0.4
					end
					if dist > PV.Radius * 4 then Respawn(p, center) end
				end

				local step = p.Vel * dt
				-- collision ray for half of the particles per frame (alternating): half the raycasts, same look
				if PV.Collision and step.Magnitude > 0.0001 and (not pPhone or (pi + pFrame) % 2 == 0 or p.Squash > 0) then

					local radius = PV.Size * p.SizeK * 0.4
					local hit = workspace:Raycast(p.Pos, step + step.Unit * radius, pRay)
					if hit then
						local n = hit.Normal
						p.Pos = hit.Position + n * (radius + 0.02)
						local flow = (PV.Mode == "Snow" or PV.Mode == "Floor" or PV.Mode == "Vortex") and not PV.Gravity
						if flow then


							p.Vel = Vector3.zero
							if not p.Landed then
								p.Landed = true
								p.Age = math.max(p.Age, p.Life - 0.6)
							end
						else

							local into = -p.Vel:Dot(n)
							p.Vel = (p.Vel - 2 * p.Vel:Dot(n) * n) * PV.Bounce
							p.Squash = math.clamp(into / math.max(PV.Speed, 1), 0, 1) * 0.35

							p.Seed = math.random() * 1000
						end
					else
						p.Pos += step
					end
				elseif not p.Landed then
					p.Pos += step
				end

				p.Att.WorldPosition = p.Pos


				local life = p.Age / p.Life
				local fade = math.clamp(math.min(life / 0.15, 1, (1 - life) / 0.25), 0, 1)
				local flick = 1
				if PV.Twinkle then
					flick = PV.Mode == "Fireflies"
						and (0.35 + 0.65 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 3 + p.Phase)) ^ 2)
						or (0.8 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 5 + p.Phase))
				end
				p.Img.ImageTransparency = 1 - fade * flick * (PV.Opacity / 100)

				if PV.Spin then
					p.Rot += p.Spin * dt
					p.Img.Rotation = p.Rot
				elseif p.Img.Rotation ~= 0 then
					p.Rot = 0
					p.Img.Rotation = 0
				end
				p.Img.ImageColor3 = PV.Rainbow and Color3.fromHSV((p.Hue + t * 0.2) % 1, 0.75, 1) or PV.Color


				p.Squash = math.max(p.Squash - dt * 2.5, 0)
				local rhythm = PV.Twinkle and (1 + 0.12 * math.sin(t * 4 + p.Phase)) or 1
				local grow = 0.6 + 0.4 * math.min(life / 0.15, 1)
				local s = PV.Size * p.SizeK * rhythm * grow * (1 + p.Squash)
				if math.abs(s - p.LastSize) > 0.01 then
					p.LastSize = s
					p.BB.Size = UDim2.fromScale(s, s)
				end
				local li = PV.Glow and 0 or 1
				if p.BB.LightInfluence ~= li then p.BB.LightInfluence = li end
			end
		end))

		local function RestyleAll()
			for _, p in ipairs(Particles) do
				local st = PickStyle()
				p.Style = st
				p.Img.Image = st.Image
			end
		end

		local PMain = AddVisualPage("Particles")
		PMain:AddToggle({ Name = "Particles", Default = PV.Enabled, Bind = true, Flag = "VIS_Particles",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Enabled = v end })
		PMain:AddDropdown({ Name = "Style", Options = P_NAMES, Default = PV.Style, Flag = "VIS_PStyle",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Style = v; RestyleAll() end })
		PMain:AddDropdown({ Name = "Mode", Options = P_MODES, Default = PV.Mode, Flag = "VIS_PMode",
			Callback = function(v)
				PV.Mode = v
				local char = LocalPlayer.Character
				local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if hrp then
					for _, p in ipairs(Particles) do
						Respawn(p, hrp.Position)
						p.Age = math.random() * p.Life * 0.5
					end
				end
			end })
		PMain:AddSlider({ Name = "Count", Min = 5, Max = 150, Default = PV.Count, Flag = "VIS_PCount",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Count = v end })
		PMain:AddSlider({ Name = "Speed", Min = 0.5, Max = 30, Default = PV.Speed, Increment = 0.5, Suffix = " st/s", Flag = "VIS_PSpeed",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Speed = v end })
		PMain:AddSlider({ Name = "Size", Min = 0.2, Max = 4, Default = PV.Size, Increment = 0.1, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_PSize",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Size = v end })
		PMain:AddSlider({ Name = "Size variation", Min = 0, Max = 80, Default = PV.SizeRandom, Suffix = "%", Flag = "VIS_PSizeRandom",
			Callback = function(v) PV.SizeRandom = v end })
		PMain:AddSlider({ Name = "Cloud radius", Min = 3, Max = 40, Default = PV.Radius, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_PRadius",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Radius = v end })
		PMain:AddSlider({ Name = "Lifetime", Min = 1, Max = 15, Default = PV.Lifetime, Increment = 0.5, Suffix = " s", Flag = "VIS_PLife",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Lifetime = v end })

		PMain:AddToggle({ Name = "Collision", Default = PV.Collision, Flag = "VIS_PCollision",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Collision = v end })
		PMain:AddSlider({ Name = "Bounciness", Min = 10, Max = 100, Default = PV.Bounce * 100, Suffix = "%", Flag = "VIS_PBounce",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Bounce = v / 100 end })
		PMain:AddToggle({ Name = "Gravity", Default = PV.Gravity, Flag = "VIS_PGravity",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Gravity = v end })
		PMain:AddToggle({ Name = "Follow me", Default = PV.Follow, Flag = "VIS_PFollow",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Follow = v end })

		PMain:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Color", Default = PV.Color, Flag = "VIS_PColor",
			Callback = function(c) PV.Color = c end })
		PMain:AddToggle({ Name = "Rainbow", Default = PV.Rainbow, Flag = "VIS_PRainbow",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Rainbow = v end })
		PMain:AddToggle({ Name = "Twinkle", Default = PV.Twinkle, Flag = "VIS_PTwinkle",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Twinkle = v end })
		PMain:AddToggle({ Name = "Glow", Default = PV.Glow, Flag = "VIS_PGlow",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Glow = v end })
		PMain:AddToggle({ Name = "Spin", Default = PV.Spin, Flag = "VIS_PSpin",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Spin = v end })
		PMain:AddSlider({ Name = "Opacity", Min = 10, Max = 100, Default = PV.Opacity, Suffix = "%", Flag = "VIS_POpacity",
			Callback = function(v) PV.Opacity = v end })
		function PartApi.Destroy()
			pConn:Disconnect()
			ClearParticles()
			pRespawnConn:Disconnect()
		end
	end




	local CubesApi = {}
	do
		local CV = {
			Enabled = false,
			Count = 8,
			Size = 1.2,
			Speed = 3,
			Push = 20,
			Radius = 12,
			Spin = true,
			Collision = true,
			Return = true,
			Outline = true,
			Model = "Crystal",
			Glow = true,
			Material = "Neon",
			Transparency = 20,
			Color = ACCENT,
			Rainbow = false,
		}
		local MATERIALS = { "Neon", "Glass", "ForceField", "SmoothPlastic", "Metal" }
		local MODELS = { "Crystal", "Neon", "Wireframe" }
		local DAMP = 2.2


		local HIT_SOUND_ID = 100809160609628
		local HitSound = { Enabled = true, Volume = 70 }
		local hitSrc = Instance.new("Sound")
		hitSrc.Name = "CrackHubCubeHit"
		hitSrc.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. HIT_SOUND_ID
		hitSrc.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
		task.spawn(function()
			pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({ hitSrc }) end)
		end)
		local function PlayHit(force)
			if not HitSound.Enabled and not force then return end
			local s = hitSrc:Clone()
			s.Volume = HitSound.Volume / 100 * 2

			s.PlaybackSpeed = force and 1 or (0.93 + math.random() * 0.14)
			s.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
			s:Play()
			s.Ended:Connect(function() s:Destroy() end)
			task.delay(6, function() if s.Parent then s:Destroy() end end)
		end

		local Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		Folder.Name = "CrackHubCubes"
		Folder.Parent = workspace

		local ray = RaycastParams.new()
		ray.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

		local Cubes = {}
		local hovered = nil

		local RandomRot; RandomRot = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			return CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 6.28, math.random() * 6.28, math.random() * 6.28)
		end)

		local Place; Place = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(c, center)
			local R = CV.Radius
			local a, r = math.random() * math.pi * 2, (0.3 + math.random() * 0.7) * R
			local target = center + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, (math.random() * 0.7 - 0.1) * R * 0.5, math.sin(a) * r)
			if CV.Collision then
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(center, target - center, ray)
				if hit then target = hit.Position + hit.Normal * CV.Size end
			end
			c.Pos = target
			c.Vel = Vector3.zero
			c.PushVel = Vector3.zero
			c.Fade = 0
			c.Pushed = false
		end)

		local NewCube; NewCube = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(center)
			local part = Instance.new("Part")
			part.Name = "CrackHubCube"
			part.Anchored = true
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanQuery = false
			part.CanTouch = false
			part.CastShadow = false
			part.Size = Vector3.one * CV.Size
			part.Transparency = 1
			part.Parent = Folder
			local sel = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
			sel.Adornee = part
			sel.LineThickness = 0.03
			sel.SurfaceTransparency = 1
			sel.Parent = part

			local core = Instance.new("Part")
			core.Name = "Core"
			core.Anchored = true
			core.CanCollide = false
			core.CanQuery = false
			core.CanTouch = false
			core.CastShadow = false
			core.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			core.Size = Vector3.one * CV.Size * 0.45
			core.Transparency = 1
			core.Parent = part
			local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Shadows = false
			light.Brightness = 0
			light.Parent = part
			local c = {
				Part = part, Sel = sel, Core = core, Light = light,
				CoreRot = RandomRot(),
				Pos = center, Vel = Vector3.zero, PushVel = Vector3.zero,
				Rot = RandomRot(),
				SpinAxis = Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5).Unit,
				SpinSpeed = 0.4 + math.random() * 0.6,
				SpinBoost = 0,
				Seed = math.random() * 1000, Phase = math.random() * 6.28, Hue = math.random(),
				Flash = 0, Punch = 0, Fade = 0, LastSize = -1,
			}
			Place(c, center)
			return c
		end)

		local Kill; Kill = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(c) c.Part:Destroy() end)
		local ClearAll; ClearAll = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			for _, c in ipairs(Cubes) do pcall(Kill, c) end
			table.clear(Cubes)
			hovered = nil
		end)


		local RayBox; RayBox = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(o, d, cf, size)
			local lo = cf:PointToObjectSpace(o)
			local ld = cf:VectorToObjectSpace(d)
			local h = size / 2
			local tmin, tmax = -math.huge, math.huge
			for _, ax in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
				local oa, da, ha = lo[ax], ld[ax], h[ax]
				if math.abs(da) < 1e-6 then
					if math.abs(oa) > ha then return nil end
				else
					local t1, t2 = (-ha - oa) / da, (ha - oa) / da
					if t1 > t2 then t1, t2 = t2, t1 end
					if t1 > tmin then tmin = t1 end
					if t2 < tmax then tmax = t2 end
					if tmin > tmax then return nil end
				end
			end
			if tmax < 0 then return nil end
			return tmin >= 0 and tmin or tmax
		end)

		local CubeUnderMouse; CubeUnderMouse = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(pos)
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not cam then return nil end
			local r = cam:ViewportPointToRay(pos.X, pos.Y)
			local best, bestT = nil, 600
			for _, c in ipairs(Cubes) do
				local t = RayBox(r.Origin, r.Direction, c.Part.CFrame, c.Part.Size * 1.15)
				if t and t < bestT then best, bestT = c, t end
			end
			return best, r.Direction
		end)


		local clickConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
			if gp or not CV.Enabled then return end
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			local pos = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
				and Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) + GuiService:GetGuiInset()
				or UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			local c, dir = CubeUnderMouse(pos)
			if not c then return end

			local d = (dir.Unit + Vector3.new(0, 0.25, 0)).Unit
			c.PushVel += d * CV.Push * DAMP
			c.Flash = 1
			c.Punch = 0.35
			c.SpinBoost = 6
			c.Pushed = true
			PlayHit(false)
		end)

		local t0 = os.clock()
		local stepConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not CV.Enabled or not hrp then
				if #Cubes > 0 then ClearAll() end
				return
			end
			if not Folder.Parent then Folder.Parent = workspace end
			local center = hrp.Position
			ray.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, Folder }

			local want = math.floor(CV.Count)
			while #Cubes < want do table.insert(Cubes, NewCube(center)) end
			while #Cubes > want do Kill(table.remove(Cubes)) end

			dt = math.min(dt, 1 / 20)
			local t = os.clock() - t0


			local hov = CubeUnderMouse(UserInputService:GetMouseLocation())
			hovered = hov

			local mat = Enum.Material[CV.Material] or Enum.Material.Neon
			local baseT = CV.Transparency / 100

			for _, c in ipairs(Cubes) do
				if not c.Part.Parent then
					c.Part.Parent = Folder
				end


				local w = Vector3.new(
					math.noise(c.Seed, t * 0.25, 0.5),
					math.noise(c.Seed + 17.31, t * 0.25, 0.5) * 0.5,
					math.noise(c.Seed + 41.77, t * 0.25, 0.5)
				)
				local desired = w.Magnitude > 0.02 and w.Unit * CV.Speed or Vector3.zero
				desired += Vector3.new(0, math.sin(t * 1.2 + c.Phase) * CV.Speed * 0.15, 0)


				local off = c.Pos - center
				local dist = off.Magnitude
				if dist > CV.Radius and not (c.Pushed and not CV.Return) then
					local k = math.min((dist - CV.Radius) / CV.Radius, 2)
					desired -= off.Unit * CV.Speed * (1 + k * 2)
				end
				c.Vel += (desired - c.Vel) * math.min(dt * 1.5, 1)


				c.PushVel *= math.exp(-DAMP * dt)

				local total = c.Vel + c.PushVel
				local step = total * dt
				if CV.Collision and step.Magnitude > 0.0001 then
					local half = CV.Size * 0.55
					local hit = workspace:Raycast(c.Pos, step + step.Unit * half, ray)
					if hit then
						local n = hit.Normal
						c.Pos = hit.Position + n * (half + 0.02)
						c.Vel = (c.Vel - 2 * c.Vel:Dot(n) * n) * 0.7
						c.PushVel = (c.PushVel - 2 * c.PushVel:Dot(n) * n) * 0.6
						if c.PushVel.Magnitude > 3 then
							c.Punch = math.max(c.Punch, 0.15)
							c.SpinBoost = math.max(c.SpinBoost, 3)
						end
					else
						c.Pos += step
					end
				else
					c.Pos += step
				end


				if dist > CV.Radius * 8 then Place(c, center) end


				c.SpinBoost = math.max(c.SpinBoost - dt * 4, 0)
				if CV.Spin or c.SpinBoost > 0 then
					local sp = (CV.Spin and c.SpinSpeed or 0) + c.SpinBoost
					c.Rot = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(c.SpinAxis, sp * dt) * c.Rot
				end


				c.Fade = math.min(c.Fade + dt * 2, 1)
				c.Flash = math.max(c.Flash - dt * 3, 0)
				c.Punch = math.max(c.Punch - dt * 2.5, 0)

				local s = CV.Size * (1 + c.Punch) * (c == hovered and 1.08 or 1)
				local model = CV.Model
				local coreK = model == "Wireframe" and 0.3 or 0.45
				if math.abs(s - c.LastSize) > 0.005 then
					c.LastSize = s
					c.Part.Size = Vector3.one * s
					c.Core.Size = Vector3.one * s * coreK
				end

				local sp = ((CV.Spin and c.SpinSpeed or 0) + c.SpinBoost) * 1.6
				c.CoreRot = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.new(-c.SpinAxis.Z, c.SpinAxis.X, -c.SpinAxis.Y), sp * dt) * c.CoreRot
				c.Part.CFrame = CFrame.new(c.Pos) * c.Rot
				c.Core.CFrame = CFrame.new(c.Pos) * c.CoreRot

				local col = CV.Rainbow and Color3.fromHSV((c.Hue + t * 0.15) % 1, 0.7, 1) or CV.Color
				local shown = col:Lerp(WHITE, c.Flash * 0.8)
				local rhythm = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 2.5 + c.Phase)
				c.Part.Color = shown
				c.Core.Color = shown:Lerp(WHITE, 0.25 + rhythm * 0.2 + c.Flash * 0.5)

				local shellT, coreVisible, lineW
				if model == "Crystal" then

					if c.Part.Material ~= Enum.Material.Glass then c.Part.Material = Enum.Material.Glass end
					shellT, coreVisible, lineW = math.max(baseT, 0.55), true, 0.035
				elseif model == "Wireframe" then

					shellT, coreVisible, lineW = 1, true, 0.06
				else

					if c.Part.Material ~= mat then c.Part.Material = mat end
					shellT, coreVisible, lineW = baseT, false, 0.03
				end
				c.Part.Transparency = 1 - (1 - shellT) * c.Fade
				c.Core.Transparency = coreVisible and (1 - (1 - (0.05 + (1 - rhythm) * 0.15)) * c.Fade) or 1

				c.Sel.Visible = CV.Outline or model == "Wireframe"
				c.Sel.LineThickness = lineW * math.max(CV.Size, 0.5)
				c.Sel.Color3 = c == hovered and WHITE or shown
				c.Sel.Transparency = (c == hovered and 0 or 0.25) + (1 - c.Fade) * 0.75


				if CV.Glow then
					c.Light.Enabled = true
					c.Light.Color = shown
					c.Light.Range = s * 4
					c.Light.Brightness = (0.8 + rhythm * 0.4 + c.Flash * 3) * c.Fade
				elseif c.Light.Enabled then
					c.Light.Enabled = false
				end
			end
		end))


		local respawnConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
			local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
			if hrp then for _, c in ipairs(Cubes) do Place(c, hrp.Position) end end
		end)

		function CubesApi.Destroy()
			clickConn:Disconnect()
			stepConn:Disconnect()
			respawnConn:Disconnect()
			ClearAll()
			Folder:Destroy()
		end

		local G = AddVisualPage("Floating Cubes")
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Floating Cubes", Default = CV.Enabled, Bind = true, Flag = "VIS_Cubes",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Enabled = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Count", Min = 1, Max = 40, Default = CV.Count, Flag = "VIS_CCount",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Count = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Size", Min = 0.3, Max = 6, Default = CV.Size, Increment = 0.1, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_CSize",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Size = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Flight speed", Min = 0.5, Max = 20, Default = CV.Speed, Increment = 0.5, Suffix = " st/s", Flag = "VIS_CSpeed",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Speed = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Knockback distance", Min = 2, Max = 100, Default = CV.Push, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_CPush",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Push = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Flight radius", Min = 4, Max = 40, Default = CV.Radius, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_CRadius",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Radius = v end })

		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Return", Default = CV.Return, Flag = "VIS_CReturn",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Return = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Collision", Default = CV.Collision, Flag = "VIS_CCollision",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Collision = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Spin", Default = CV.Spin, Flag = "VIS_CSpin",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Spin = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Outline", Default = CV.Outline, Flag = "VIS_COutline",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Outline = v end })
		G:AddDropdown({ Name = "Model", Options = MODELS, Default = CV.Model, Flag = "VIS_CModel",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Model = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Glow", Default = CV.Glow, Flag = "VIS_CGlow",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Glow = v end })
		G:AddDropdown({ Name = "Material (for “Neon”)", Options = MATERIALS, Default = CV.Material, Flag = "VIS_CMaterial",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Material = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Transparency", Min = 0, Max = 90, Default = CV.Transparency, Suffix = "%", Flag = "VIS_CTransparency",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Transparency = v end })
		G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Color", Default = CV.Color, Flag = "VIS_CColor",
			Callback = function(c) CV.Color = c end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Rainbow", Default = CV.Rainbow, Flag = "VIS_CRainbow",
			Callback = function(v) CV.Rainbow = v end })

		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Click sound", Default = HitSound.Enabled, Flag = "VIS_CHitSound",
			Callback = function(v) HitSound.Enabled = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Volume", Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = HitSound.Volume, Suffix = "%", Flag = "VIS_CHitVolume",
			Callback = function(v) HitSound.Volume = v end })
		G:AddButton({ Name = "Preview", Style = "Primary",
			Callback = function() PlayHit(true) end })
	end




	local FogApi = {}
	do
		local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

		local FV = {
			Enabled = false,
			Start = 0,
			Radius = 150,
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 110, 255),
			Rainbow = false,
			RainbowSpeed = 20,
			Blur = true,
			BlurStrength = 60,
		}

		local saved = nil
		local hiddenAtmos = {}
		local dof = nil

		local Save; Save = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			if saved then return end
			saved = {
				FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
				FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
				FogColor = Lighting.FogColor,
			}
			for _, a in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
				if a:IsA("Atmosphere") then
					table.insert(hiddenAtmos, a)
					a.Parent = nil
				end
			end
		end)

		local Restore; Restore = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			if not saved then return end
			Lighting.FogStart = saved.FogStart
			Lighting.FogEnd = saved.FogEnd
			Lighting.FogColor = saved.FogColor
			for _, a in ipairs(hiddenAtmos) do
				pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() a.Parent = Lighting end))
			end
			table.clear(hiddenAtmos)
			saved = nil
			if dof then dof:Destroy() dof = nil end
		end)


		local atmosConn = Lighting.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
			if saved and c:IsA("Atmosphere") then
				task.defer(function()
					if saved and c.Parent == Lighting then
						table.insert(hiddenAtmos, c)
						c.Parent = nil
					end
				end)
			end
		end)

		local t0 = os.clock()
		local SetIfChanged; SetIfChanged = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(obj, prop, value)
			if obj[prop] ~= value then obj[prop] = value end
		end)
		local stepConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			if not FV.Enabled then
				if saved then Restore() end
				return
			end
			Save()

			local col = FV.Rainbow
				and Color3.fromHSV(((os.clock() - t0) * FV.RainbowSpeed / 100) % 1, 0.65, 1)
				or FV.Color
			local fogEnd = math.max(FV.Radius, 5)
			local fogStart = math.clamp(FV.Start, 0, fogEnd - 1)

			SetIfChanged(Lighting, "FogStart", fogStart)
			SetIfChanged(Lighting, "FogEnd", fogEnd)
			SetIfChanged(Lighting, "FogColor", col)

			if FV.Blur and FV.BlurStrength > 0 then
				if not dof or not dof.Parent then
					dof = Instance.new("DepthOfFieldEffect")
					dof.Name = "CrackHubFogBlur"
					dof.NearIntensity = 0
					dof.Parent = Lighting
				end
				SetIfChanged(dof, "Enabled", true)
				SetIfChanged(dof, "FocusDistance", math.max(fogStart, 0))
				SetIfChanged(dof, "InFocusRadius", math.max((fogEnd - fogStart) * 0.25, 2))
				SetIfChanged(dof, "FarIntensity", FV.BlurStrength / 100)
			elseif dof and dof.Enabled then
				dof.Enabled = false
			end
		end))

		function FogApi.Destroy()
			stepConn:Disconnect()
			atmosConn:Disconnect()
			Restore()
		end

		local G = AddVisualPage("Custom Fog")
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Custom Fog", Default = FV.Enabled, Bind = true, Flag = "VIS_Fog",
			Callback = function(v) FV.Enabled = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Fog radius", Min = 10, Max = 2000, Default = FV.Radius, Increment = 5, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_FogRadius",
			Callback = function(v) FV.Radius = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Fog start", Min = 0, Max = 1000, Default = FV.Start, Increment = 5, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_FogStart",
			Callback = function(v) FV.Start = v end })
		G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Fog color", Default = FV.Color, Flag = "VIS_FogColor",
			Callback = function(c) FV.Color = c end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Rainbow", Default = FV.Rainbow, Flag = "VIS_FogRainbow",
			Callback = function(v) FV.Rainbow = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Rainbow speed", Min = 1, Max = 100, Default = FV.RainbowSpeed, Suffix = "%", Flag = "VIS_FogRainbowSpeed",
			Callback = function(v) FV.RainbowSpeed = v end })

		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Fog Blur", Default = FV.Blur, Flag = "VIS_FogBlur",
			Callback = function(v) FV.Blur = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Fog Blur strength", Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = FV.BlurStrength, Suffix = "%", Flag = "VIS_FogBlurStrength",
			Callback = function(v) FV.BlurStrength = v end })
	end




	local TrailApi = {}
	do
		local TRAIL_ID = 135621030926785

		local TV = {
			Enabled = false,
			Delay = 0.12,
			Size = 3,
			Lifetime = 1.5,
			Color = ACCENT,
			Rainbow = false,
			Brightness = 2,
			Angle = 270,
			Mirror = true,
			FixVertical = true,
			OnlyMoving = true,
		}



		local texture = "rbxassetid://" .. TRAIL_ID
		task.spawn(function()
			local probe = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			probe.Image = texture
			local ok = false
			pcall(function()
				game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({ probe }, function(_, status)
					ok = status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success
				end)
			end)
			probe:Destroy()
			if not ok then
				pcall(function()
					CrackHub:Notify({
						Title = "Trail Line",
						Content = "Texture failed to load. This may be a decal ID — use the Image ID instead.",
						Duration = 6,
					})
				end)
			end
		end)

		local Stamps = {}
		local MAX_STAMPS = 250

		local ray = RaycastParams.new()
		ray.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

		local KillStamp; KillStamp = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(st)
			st.Beam:Destroy()
			st.A0:Destroy()
			st.A1:Destroy()
		end)


		local FOOT_OFFSETS = {
			Vector3.zero,
			Vector3.new(0.6, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-0.6, 0, 0),
			Vector3.new(0, 0, 0.6), Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.6),
		}
		local FindGround; FindGround = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(hrp, hum, char)
			ray.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
			local legs = hrp.Size.Y / 2 + math.max(hum.HipHeight, 2)
			local best
			for _, o in ipairs(FOOT_OFFSETS) do
				local hit = workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position + o + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), Vector3.new(0, -(legs + 6), 0), ray)
				if hit and (not best or hit.Position.Y > best.Position.Y) then best = hit end
				if hit and o == Vector3.zero then break end
			end
			if not best then return nil end
			if hrp.Position.Y - best.Position.Y > legs + 1.5 then return nil end
			return best
		end)


		local RotateAround; RotateAround = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(v, axis, deg)
			if deg % 360 == 0 then return v end
			return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, math.rad(deg)):VectorToWorldSpace(v)
		end)

		local SpawnStamp; SpawnStamp = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(pos, n, dir, color)

			local d = dir - n * dir:Dot(n)
			if d.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
			d = RotateAround(d.Unit, n, -TV.Angle)


			local right = d:Cross(n).Unit
			if TV.Mirror then right = -right end
			local half = TV.Size / 2
			local p = pos + n * 0.06

			local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
			local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")

			local cf0, cf1
			if TV.FixVertical then

				cf0 = CFrame.fromMatrix(p - right * half, right, -d)
				cf1 = CFrame.fromMatrix(p + right * half, right, -d)
			else
				cf0 = CFrame.fromMatrix(p - right * half, right, n)
				cf1 = CFrame.fromMatrix(p + right * half, right, n)
			end
			a0.Parent = workspace.Terrain
			a1.Parent = workspace.Terrain
			a0.WorldCFrame = cf0
			a1.WorldCFrame = cf1

			local b = Instance.new("Beam")
			b.Attachment0 = a0
			b.Attachment1 = a1
			b.Texture = texture
			b.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Stretch
			b.TextureLength = 1
			b.TextureSpeed = 0
			b.Width0 = TV.Size
			b.Width1 = TV.Size
			b.CurveSize0 = 0
			b.CurveSize1 = 0
			b.Segments = 1
			b.FaceCamera = false
			b.LightEmission = 1
			b.LightInfluence = 0
			b.Brightness = TV.Brightness
			b.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
			b.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1)
			b.ZOffset = 0.05
			b.Parent = a0

			table.insert(Stamps, { A0 = a0, A1 = a1, Beam = b, Age = 0, Life = TV.Lifetime })
			while #Stamps > MAX_STAMPS do KillStamp(table.remove(Stamps, 1)) end
		end)

		local timer = 0
		local lastDir = nil
		local t0 = os.clock()

		local stepConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)

			for i = #Stamps, 1, -1 do
				local st = Stamps[i]
				st.Age += dt
				local k = st.Age / st.Life
				if k >= 1 or not st.Beam.Parent then
					pcall(KillStamp, st)
					table.remove(Stamps, i)
				else
					local fadeIn = math.min(st.Age / 0.08, 1)
					local fadeOut = k < 0.6 and 1 or (1 - (k - 0.6) / 0.4)
					st.Beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1 - fadeIn * fadeOut)
				end
			end

			if not TV.Enabled then
				timer = 0
				return
			end
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end


			local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local flat = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
			local speed = flat.Magnitude
			if speed < 0.5 and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then
				flat = hum.MoveDirection
				speed = 1
			end
			if flat.Magnitude > 0.05 then
				local target = flat.Unit
				if not lastDir or lastDir:Dot(target) < -0.7 then
					lastDir = target
				else
					local d = lastDir:Lerp(target, math.min(dt * 15, 1))
					lastDir = d.Magnitude > 0.001 and d.Unit or target
				end
			end
			if not lastDir then

				local lv = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
				lastDir = Vector3.new(lv.X, 0, lv.Z).Unit
			end

			timer += dt
			if timer < TV.Delay then return end
			if TV.OnlyMoving and speed < 1 then return end

			local hit = FindGround(hrp, hum, char)
			if not hit then return end
			timer = 0

			local col = TV.Rainbow and Color3.fromHSV(((os.clock() - t0) * 0.25) % 1, 0.7, 1) or TV.Color
			SpawnStamp(hit.Position, hit.Normal, lastDir, col)
		end))

		local respawnConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			lastDir = nil
			timer = 0
		end)

		function TrailApi.Destroy()
			stepConn:Disconnect()
			respawnConn:Disconnect()
			for _, st in ipairs(Stamps) do pcall(KillStamp, st) end
			table.clear(Stamps)
		end

		local G = AddVisualPage("Trail Line")
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Trail Line", Default = TV.Enabled, Bind = true, Flag = "VIS_Trail",
			Callback = function(v) TV.Enabled = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Delay", Min = 0.02, Max = 1, Default = TV.Delay, Increment = 0.01, Suffix = " s", Flag = "VIS_TrailDelay",
			Callback = function(v) TV.Delay = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Size", Min = 0.5, Max = 12, Default = TV.Size, Increment = 0.5, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_TrailSize",
			Callback = function(v) TV.Size = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Lifetime", Min = 0.2, Max = 8, Default = TV.Lifetime, Increment = 0.1, Suffix = " s", Flag = "VIS_TrailLife",
			Callback = function(v) TV.Lifetime = v end })
		G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Color", Default = TV.Color, Flag = "VIS_TrailColor",
			Callback = function(c) TV.Color = c end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Rainbow", Default = TV.Rainbow, Flag = "VIS_TrailRainbow",
			Callback = function(v) TV.Rainbow = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Brightness", Min = 0.5, Max = 10, Default = TV.Brightness, Increment = 0.5, Flag = "VIS_TrailBrightness",
			Callback = function(v) TV.Brightness = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Only while walking", Default = TV.OnlyMoving, Flag = "VIS_TrailMoving",
			Callback = function(v) TV.OnlyMoving = v end })

		G:AddDropdown({ Name = "Image rotation", Options = { "0°", "90°", "180°", "270°" }, Default = tostring(TV.Angle) .. "°", Flag = "VIS_TrailAngleV2",
			Callback = function(v) TV.Angle = tonumber((v:gsub("°", ""))) or 0 end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Mirror", Default = TV.Mirror, Flag = "VIS_TrailMirrorV2",
			Callback = function(v) TV.Mirror = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Lay flat", Default = TV.FixVertical, Flag = "VIS_TrailFixV2",
			Callback = function(v) TV.FixVertical = v end })
	end






	local BlurTexApi = {}
	do
		local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

		local BV = {
			Enabled = false,
			Strength = 8,
			Images = true,
			Materials = true,
		}






		local origImage = {}
		local origMaterial = {}
		local hiddenSA = {}

		local blurred = {}
		local pending = {}
		local queue = {}
		local addQueue = {}
		local editableImages = {}
		local editableOK, editableFails = true, 0
		local scanToken = 0
		local destroyed = false

		local THUMB = { 420, 150 }
		local ThumbUri; ThumbUri = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(id, F)
			local s = F <= 2 and THUMB[1] or THUMB[2]
			return "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. id .. "&w=" .. s .. "&h=" .. s
		end)

		local function AssetIdOf(str)
			if type(str) ~= "string" then return nil end
			return str:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)") or str:match("[?&]id=(%d+)") or str:match("^(%d+)$")
		end

		local function InPlayer(inst)
			local m = inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			while m do
				if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then return true end
				m = m:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			end
			local top = inst
			while top.Parent and top.Parent ~= workspace do top = top.Parent end
			return top.Name:sub(1, 8) == "CrackHub"
		end

		local Alive; Alive = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(token)
			return not destroyed and token == scanToken and BV.Enabled
		end)



		local MakeBlurred; MakeBlurred = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(uri, F, token)
			local okSrc, src = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
				return AssetService:CreateEditableImageAsync(Content.fromUri(uri))
			end))
			if not okSrc or not src then return nil end
			if not Alive(token) then src:Destroy() return nil end

			local size = src.Size
			local sw, sh = size.X, size.Y
			local okRead, buf = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() return src:ReadPixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, size) end))
			src:Destroy()
			if not okRead or not buf then return nil end

			local w = math.max(math.floor(sw / F), 2)
			local h = math.max(math.floor(sh / F), 2)
			local bx, by = sw / w, sh / h
			local steps = math.min(4, math.max(1, math.floor(bx)))
			local n = steps * steps
			local readu8, writeu8 = buffer.readu8, buffer.writeu8
			local out = buffer.create(w * h * 4)

			local cols = table.create(w * steps)
			for x = 0, w - 1 do
				for sx = 0, steps - 1 do
					cols[x * steps + sx + 1] = math.min(math.floor(x * bx + (sx + 0.5) * bx / steps), sw - 1)
				end
			end
			local rows = table.create(steps)

			for y = 0, h - 1 do
				if not Alive(token) then return nil end
				for sy = 0, steps - 1 do
					rows[sy + 1] = math.min(math.floor(y * by + (sy + 0.5) * by / steps), sh - 1) * sw
				end
				for x = 0, w - 1 do
					local r, g, b, a = 0, 0, 0, 0
					local base = x * steps
					for sy = 1, steps do
						local row = rows[sy]
						for sx = 1, steps do
							local i = (row + cols[base + sx]) * 4
							local pa = readu8(buf, i + 3)
							r += readu8(buf, i) * pa
							g += readu8(buf, i + 1) * pa
							b += readu8(buf, i + 2) * pa
							a += pa
						end
					end
					local o = (y * w + x) * 4
					if a > 0 then
						writeu8(out, o, r // a)
						writeu8(out, o + 1, g // a)
						writeu8(out, o + 2, b // a)
					end
					writeu8(out, o + 3, a // n)
				end
				if y % 32 == 31 then task.wait() end
			end

			local okNew, img = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
				return AssetService:CreateEditableImage({ Size = Vector2.new(w, h) })
			end))
			if not okNew or not img then return nil end
			if not Alive(token) then img:Destroy() return nil end
			local okW = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() img:WritePixelsBuffer(Vector2.zero, Vector2.new(w, h), out) end))
			if not okW then img:Destroy() return nil end
			editableImages[img] = true
			return Content.fromObject(img)
		end)

		local ApplyTo; ApplyTo = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(inst, result, token)
			local o = origImage[inst]
			if not o or not inst.Parent or not BV.Images or not Alive(token) then return end
			if typeof(result) == "Content" then
				if o.ContentProp and pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() inst[o.ContentProp] = result end)) then return end
				result = ThumbUri(o.Id, BV.Strength)
			end
			if type(result) == "string" then
				pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() inst[o.LegacyProp] = result end))
			end
		end)

		local function BlurImage(inst)
			if origImage[inst] then return end
			local legacyProp = inst:IsA("MeshPart") and "TextureID" or "Texture"
			local ok, uri = pcall(function() return inst[legacyProp] end)
			local id = ok and AssetIdOf(uri)
			if not id then return end

			local contentProp, content
			local okC, value = pcall(function() return inst.TextureContent end)
			if okC and value ~= nil then contentProp, content = "TextureContent", value end

			origImage[inst] = { LegacyProp = legacyProp, Uri = uri, Id = id, ContentProp = contentProp, Content = content }

			local key = id .. "_" .. BV.Strength
			if blurred[key] then ApplyTo(inst, blurred[key], scanToken) return end
			local job = pending[key]
			if job and job.Token == scanToken then table.insert(job.Targets, inst) return end
			job = { Key = key, Id = id, Uri = "rbxassetid://" .. id, F = BV.Strength, Token = scanToken, Targets = { inst } }
			pending[key] = job
			table.insert(queue, job)
		end

		local function SmoothPart(p)
			if origMaterial[p] then return end
			local m = p.Material
			if m == Enum.Material.Neon or m == Enum.Material.Glass or m == Enum.Material.ForceField then return end
			local ok, variant = pcall(function() return p.MaterialVariant end)
			origMaterial[p] = { Material = m, Variant = variant, HasVariant = ok }
			p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			if ok then pcall(function() p.MaterialVariant = "" end) end
			for _, sa in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
				if sa:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
					table.insert(hiddenSA, { sa, p })
					sa.Parent = nil
				end
			end
		end

		local function Handle(inst, token)
			if not Alive(token) then return end
			local isImage = inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("MeshPart")
			local isPart = BV.Materials and inst:IsA("BasePart")
			if not (isImage and BV.Images) and not isPart then return end
			if InPlayer(inst) then return end
			if isImage and BV.Images then BlurImage(inst) end
			if isPart then SmoothPart(inst) end
		end



		local function RestoreImage(inst, o)
			local ok = false
			if o.ContentProp and o.Content ~= nil then
				ok = pcall(function() inst[o.ContentProp] = o.Content end)
			end
			local okL, cur = pcall(function() return inst[o.LegacyProp] end)
			if not ok or not okL or cur ~= o.Uri then
				ok = pcall(function() inst[o.LegacyProp] = o.Uri end) or ok
			end
			return ok
		end

		local function ReleaseImages()
			table.clear(blurred)
			for img in pairs(editableImages) do pcall(function() img:Destroy() end) end
			table.clear(editableImages)
		end

		local function RestoreAll()
			scanToken += 1
			table.clear(queue)
			table.clear(pending)
			addQueue = {}

			for inst, o in pairs(origImage) do
				if RestoreImage(inst, o) or not inst.Parent then origImage[inst] = nil end
			end
			for p, o in pairs(origMaterial) do
				local ok = pcall(function()
					p.Material = o.Material
					if o.HasVariant then p.MaterialVariant = o.Variant end
				end)
				if ok or not p.Parent then origMaterial[p] = nil end
			end
			local retry = {}
			for _, e in ipairs(hiddenSA) do
				local sa, part = e[1], e[2]
				if part.Parent then
					if not pcall(function() sa.Parent = part end) then table.insert(retry, e) end
				else
					pcall(function() sa:Destroy() end)
				end
			end
			hiddenSA = retry
		end


		local Sweep; Sweep = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			for inst in pairs(origImage) do if not inst.Parent then origImage[inst] = nil end end
			for p in pairs(origMaterial) do if not p.Parent then origMaterial[p] = nil end end
			for i = #hiddenSA, 1, -1 do
				local e = hiddenSA[i]
				if not e[2].Parent then
					pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() e[1]:Destroy() end))
					table.remove(hiddenSA, i)
				end
			end
		end)

		local function ScanAll()
			scanToken += 1
			local my = scanToken
			task.spawn(function()
				local list = workspace:GetDescendants()
				for i, d in ipairs(list) do
					if not Alive(my) then return end
					Handle(d, my)
					if i % 400 == 0 then task.wait() end
				end
			end)
		end


		task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			local lastSweep = os.clock()
			while not destroyed do
				if os.clock() - lastSweep > 10 then
					lastSweep = os.clock()
					Sweep()
				end
				local job = table.remove(queue, 1)
				if not job then
					task.wait(0.1)
				else
					local result
					if editableOK then
						local ok, res = pcall(MakeBlurred, job.Uri, job.F, job.Token)
						if ok and res then
							result = res
							editableFails = 0
						else
							editableFails += 1
							if editableFails >= 3 then editableOK = false end
						end
					end
					if destroyed then break end
					if Alive(job.Token) then
						result = result or ThumbUri(job.Id, job.F)
						blurred[job.Key] = result
						for _, inst in ipairs(job.Targets) do ApplyTo(inst, result, job.Token) end
					end
					if pending[job.Key] == job then pending[job.Key] = nil end
					task.wait()
				end
			end
		end))


		local addConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
			if BV.Enabled then table.insert(addQueue, d) end
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			while not destroyed do
				if #addQueue == 0 then
					task.wait(0.2)
				else
					local token = scanToken
					local list = addQueue
					addQueue = {}
					for i, d in ipairs(list) do
						if not Alive(token) then break end
						if d.Parent then Handle(d, token) end
						if i % 300 == 0 then task.wait() end
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		local function Reapply()
			if destroyed then return end
			RestoreAll()
			ReleaseImages()
			if BV.Enabled then
				ScanAll()
			else

				local token = scanToken
				task.delay(0.3, function()
					if not destroyed and not BV.Enabled and token == scanToken then
						RestoreAll()
						ReleaseImages()
					end
				end)
			end
		end

		function BlurTexApi.Destroy()
			if destroyed then return end
			BV.Enabled = false
			RestoreAll()
			destroyed = true
			addConn:Disconnect()
			ReleaseImages()
		end
		Window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(BlurTexApi.Destroy)

		local G = AddVisualPage("BlurTexture")
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "BlurTexture", Default = BV.Enabled, Bind = true, Flag = "VIS_BlurTex",
			Callback = function(v) BV.Enabled = v; Reapply() end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Blur strength", Min = 2, Max = 32, Default = BV.Strength, Flag = "VIS_BlurTexStrength",
			Callback = function(v)
				BV.Strength = v
				if BV.Enabled then
					local my = os.clock()
					BV._t = my
					task.delay(0.4, function() if BV._t == my then Reapply() end end)
				end
			end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Images and meshes", Default = BV.Images, Flag = "VIS_BlurTexImages",
			Callback = function(v) BV.Images = v; Reapply() end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Materials", Default = BV.Materials, Flag = "VIS_BlurTexMaterials",
			Callback = function(v) BV.Materials = v; Reapply() end })
	end





	local McCamApi = {}
	do
		local MC = {
			Enabled = false,
			View = 1,
			Smooth = false,
			Smoothness = 60,
			Sensitivity = 100,
			Distance = 6,
			FOV = 70,
			Bobbing = true,
		}
		local VIEW_NAMES = { "First Person", "Third Person (Back)", "Third Person (Front)" }

		local yaw, pitch = 0, 0
		local cYaw, cPitch = 0, 0
		local active = false
		local previousCamera, previousMouse, previousHumanoid, previousRotate
		local bobT = 0
		local hiddenParts = {}

		local ray = RaycastParams.new()
		ray.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

		local MenuIsOpen; MenuIsOpen = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			local sc = Window.ScaleObj
			return sc and sc.Scale > 0.5 and sc.Parent and sc.Parent.Visible
		end)

		local SetSelfHidden; SetSelfHidden = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(hide)
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			if hide and char then
				for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
					if d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal") then
						pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
							if hiddenParts[d]==nil then hiddenParts[d]=d.LocalTransparencyModifier end
							d.LocalTransparencyModifier=1
						end))
					end
				end
			else
				for d,value in pairs(hiddenParts) do
					pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() if d.Parent then d.LocalTransparencyModifier=value end end))
				end
				table.clear(hiddenParts)
			end
		end)

		local Start; Start = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not cam then return end
			previousCamera={Camera=cam,Type=cam.CameraType,FOV=cam.FieldOfView}
			previousMouse=UserInputService.MouseBehavior
			previousHumanoid=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			previousRotate=previousHumanoid and previousHumanoid.AutoRotate
			local lv = cam.CFrame.LookVector
			yaw = math.deg(math.atan2(-lv.X, -lv.Z))
			pitch = math.deg(math.asin(math.clamp(lv.Y, -1, 1)))
			cYaw, cPitch = yaw, pitch
			cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
			active = true
		end)

		local Stop; Stop = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			active = false
			SetSelfHidden(false)
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if cam and previousCamera and previousCamera.Camera==cam then
				cam.CameraType=previousCamera.Type
				cam.FieldOfView=previousCamera.FOV
			end
			if previousMouse then UserInputService.MouseBehavior=previousMouse end
			if previousHumanoid and previousHumanoid.Parent then previousHumanoid.AutoRotate=previousRotate end
			previousCamera,previousHumanoid=nil,nil
		end)

		local Step; Step = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
			if not MC.Enabled then
				if active then Stop() end
				return
			end
			if not active then Start() end

			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not (cam and hrp and head and hum) then return end
			if cam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable end


			local menu = MenuIsOpen()
			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = menu and Enum.MouseBehavior.Default or Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
			if not menu then
				local d = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
				local k = 0.25 * MC.Sensitivity / 100
				yaw -= d.X * k
				pitch = math.clamp(pitch - d.Y * k, -89, 89)
			end


			if MC.Smooth then
				local speed = 3 + (1 - MC.Smoothness / 100) * 27
				local a = 1 - math.exp(-speed * dt)
				cYaw += (yaw - cYaw) * a
				cPitch += (pitch - cPitch) * a
			else
				cYaw, cPitch = yaw, pitch
			end

			local rot = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(cYaw), 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(cPitch), 0, 0)
			local eye = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0)


			hum.AutoRotate = MC.View == 3
			if MC.View ~= 3 then
				local p = hrp.Position
				hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(p) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(cYaw), 0)
			end

			local camCF
			if MC.View == 1 then

				local moving = Vector3.new(hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z).Magnitude > 1
					and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
				if MC.Bobbing and moving then bobT += dt * 9 end
				local bob = MC.Bobbing and moving and Vector3.new(math.cos(bobT) * 0.08, math.abs(math.sin(bobT)) * 0.12, 0) or Vector3.zero
				camCF = CFrame.new(eye) * rot * CFrame.new(bob)
				if not next(hiddenParts) then SetSelfHidden(true) end
			else
				if next(hiddenParts) then SetSelfHidden(false) end
				local dir = rot.LookVector
				ray.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
				if MC.View == 2 then

					local want = -dir * MC.Distance
					local hit = workspace:Raycast(eye, want, ray)
					local pos = hit and (hit.Position + dir * 0.3) or (eye + want)
					camCF = CFrame.lookAt(pos, eye)
				else

					local want = dir * MC.Distance
					local hit = workspace:Raycast(eye, want, ray)
					local pos = hit and (hit.Position - dir * 0.3) or (eye + want)
					camCF = CFrame.lookAt(pos, eye)
				end
			end

			cam.CFrame = camCF
			cam.FieldOfView = MC.FOV
		end)

		RunService:BindToRenderStep("CrackHubMinecraftCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, Step)


		local wheelConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, gp)
			if not MC.Enabled or gp or MC.View == 1 then return end
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
				MC.Distance = math.clamp(MC.Distance - input.Position.Z, 2, 25)
			end
		end)

		local respawnConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			if active then Stop() else SetSelfHidden(false) end
		end)

		function McCamApi.Destroy()
			pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CrackHubMinecraftCamera") end)
			wheelConn:Disconnect()
			respawnConn:Disconnect()
			if active then Stop() end
		end

		local function CycleView()
			if not MC.Enabled then return end
			MC.View = MC.View % 3 + 1
			pcall(function()
				CrackHub:Notify({ Title = "Minecraft Camera", Content = VIEW_NAMES[MC.View], Duration = 1.5 })
			end)
		end

		local G = AddVisualPage("Minecraft Camera")
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Minecraft Camera", Default = MC.Enabled, Bind = true, Flag = "VIS_McCam",
			Callback = function(v) MC.Enabled = v end })
		G:AddKeybind({ Name = "View switch key", Default = Enum.KeyCode.F5, Flag = "VIS_McCamKey",
			Callback = CycleView })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Smooth Camera", Default = MC.Smooth, Flag = "VIS_McCamSmooth",
			Callback = function(v) MC.Smooth = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Smoothness", Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = MC.Smoothness, Suffix = "%", Flag = "VIS_McCamSmoothness",
			Callback = function(v) MC.Smoothness = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Turn speed", Min = 10, Max = 300, Default = MC.Sensitivity, Suffix = "%", Flag = "VIS_McCamSens",
			Callback = function(v) MC.Sensitivity = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Distance (back/front view)", Min = 2, Max = 25, Default = MC.Distance, Increment = 0.5, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_McCamDist",
			Callback = function(v) MC.Distance = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "FOV", Min = 40, Max = 120, Default = MC.FOV, Flag = "VIS_McCamFOV",
			Callback = function(v) MC.FOV = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "View bobbing", Default = MC.Bobbing, Flag = "VIS_McCamBob",
			Callback = function(v) MC.Bobbing = v end })
	end

	local HatApi = {}
	do

		local HAT_SHAPES = {
			"Cone", "Halo", "Crown", "Star", "Sombrero", "Pagoda",
			"Witch", "Saturn", "Flower", "Umbrella", "Flat", "Pyramid",
		}
		local HAT_STYLES = {
			"Glass", "Neon", "Rainbow", "Gradient", "Galaxy", "Rhythm",
			"Wireframe", "Crystal", "Classic", "Striped",
		}

		local HV = {
			Enabled = false,
			Shape = "Cone",
			Style = "Glass",
			Color1 = ACCENT,
			Color2 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 160, 255),
			Radius = 2.2,
			Height = 0.9,
			Offset = 0.35,
			Segments = 32,
			Transparency = 35,
			Spin = true,
			SpinSpeed = 40,
			Outline = true,
			Glow = false,
		}

		local Hat = nil
		local spinAngle = 0
		local rebuildAt = nil

		local NewPart; NewPart = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(cls, parent)
			local p = Instance.new(cls)
			p.Anchored = false
			p.CanCollide = false
			p.CanQuery = false
			p.CanTouch = false
			p.CastShadow = false
			p.Massless = true
			p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			p.Parent = parent
			return p
		end)

		local WeldTo; WeldTo = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(root, part, cf)
			local w = Instance.new("Weld")
			w.Part0 = root
			w.Part1 = part
			w.C0 = cf
			w.Parent = part
		end)


		local Triangle; Triangle = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(root, a, b, c, parent)
			local ab, ac, bc = b - a, c - a, c - b
			local abd, acd, bcd = ab:Dot(ab), ac:Dot(ac), bc:Dot(bc)
			if abd > acd and abd > bcd then
				c, a = a, c
			elseif acd > bcd and acd > abd then
				a, b = b, a
			end
			ab, ac, bc = b - a, c - a, c - b
			local cr = ac:Cross(ab)
			if cr.Magnitude < 1e-5 then return nil end
			local right = cr.Unit
			local up = bc:Cross(right).Unit
			local back = bc.Unit
			local height = math.abs(ab:Dot(up))
			local T = 0.03
			local w1 = NewPart("WedgePart", parent)
			w1.Size = Vector3.new(T, math.max(height, 0.01), math.max(math.abs(ab:Dot(back)), 0.01))
			WeldTo(root, w1, CFrame.fromMatrix((a + b) / 2, right, up, back))
			local w2 = NewPart("WedgePart", parent)
			w2.Size = Vector3.new(T, math.max(height, 0.01), math.max(math.abs(ac:Dot(back)), 0.01))
			WeldTo(root, w2, CFrame.fromMatrix((a + c) / 2, -right, up, -back))
			return w1, w2
		end)


		local Line; Line = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(root, a, b, thick, parent)
			local len = (b - a).Magnitude
			if len < 0.01 then return nil end
			local p = NewPart("Part", parent)
			p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
			p.Size = Vector3.new(len, thick, thick)
			WeldTo(root, p, CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0))
			return p
		end)

		local DestroyHat; DestroyHat = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			if Hat and Hat.Model then Hat.Model:Destroy() end
			Hat = nil
		end)







		local Profiles; Profiles = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(shape, R, H)
			local L = {}
			if shape == "Cone" then
				L[1] = { Rings = { { 0, H }, { R, 0 } } }
			elseif shape == "Flat" then
				L[1] = { Rings = { { 0, H * 0.35 }, { R * 1.15, 0 } } }
			elseif shape == "Sombrero" then
				L[1] = { Rings = {
					{ 0, H * 1.5 }, { R * 0.3, H * 1.42 }, { R * 0.38, H * 0.35 },
					{ R * 0.9, H * 0.05 }, { R * 1.35, 0 }, { R * 1.5, H * 0.18 },
				} }
			elseif shape == "Pagoda" then
				L[1] = { Rings = { { R * 0.25, H * 0.42 }, { R, 0 } } }
				L[2] = { Rings = { { R * 0.2, H * 0.85 }, { R * 0.72, H * 0.42 } } }
				L[3] = { Rings = { { 0, H * 1.45 }, { R * 0.45, H * 0.85 } } }
			elseif shape == "Witch" then
				L[1] = { Rings = { { 0, H * 3 }, { R * 0.12, H * 2.6 }, { R * 0.42, 0.05 } } }
				L[2] = { Rings = { { R * 0.42, 0.05 }, { R * 1.2, -0.08 } } }
			elseif shape == "Umbrella" then
