				local rings = {}
				for k = 0, 5 do
					local a = k / 5 * math.pi / 2
					table.insert(rings, { R * math.sin(a), H * 1.1 * math.cos(a) })
				end
				table.insert(rings, { R * 1.08, -H * 0.15 })
				L[1] = { Rings = rings }
			elseif shape == "Star" then
				L[1] = { Rings = { { 0, H }, { R, 0 } }, ForceN = 10,
					RFunc = function(i) return (i % 2 == 0) and 1 or 0.5 end }
			elseif shape == "Flower" then
				L[1] = { Rings = { { 0, H }, { R, 0 } }, ForceN = 48,
					RFunc = function(_, a) return 0.78 + 0.22 * math.cos(a * 6) end }
			elseif shape == "Pyramid" then
				L[1] = { Rings = { { 0, H * 1.3 }, { R, 0 } }, ForceN = 4 }
			elseif shape == "Saturn" then
				L[1] = { Rings = { { 0, H * 0.9 }, { R * 0.55, 0 } } }
				L[2] = { Rings = { { R * 0.75, H * 0.2 }, { R * 1.35, H * 0.05 } } }
			elseif shape == "Crown" then

				L[1] = { Rings = { { R * 0.65, H * 0.55 }, { R * 0.65, 0 } }, Crown = true }
			end
			return L
		end)

		local Build; Build = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			DestroyHat()
			if not HV.Enabled then return end
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if not head then return end

			local model = Instance.new("Model")
			model.Name = "CrackHubChinaHat"
			local root = NewPart("Part", model)
			root.Name = "HatRoot"
			root.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
			root.Transparency = 1
			local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
			weld.Part0 = head
			weld.Part1 = root
			weld.Parent = root

			local h = { Model = model, Root = root, Weld = weld, Tris = {}, Lines = {} }
			local R, H = HV.Radius, HV.Height
			local wire = HV.Style == "Wireframe"
			local baseN = HV.Style == "Crystal" and 6 or math.floor(HV.Segments)
			h.N = baseN

			local addTri; addTri = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a, b, c, i, layer)
				if wire then return end
				local w1, w2 = Triangle(root, a, b, c, model)
				if w1 then table.insert(h.Tris, { w1, w2, i, layer }) end
			end)
			local addLine; addLine = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a, b, i, kind, thick)
				local p = Line(root, a, b, thick, model)
				if p then table.insert(h.Lines, { p, i, kind }) end
			end)

			if HV.Shape == "Halo" then
				local M = math.max(baseN, 24)
				for i = 1, M do
					local a1, a2 = (i - 1) / M * math.pi * 2, i / M * math.pi * 2
					addLine(Vector3.new(math.cos(a1) * R * 0.55, 0.15, math.sin(a1) * R * 0.55),
						Vector3.new(math.cos(a2) * R * 0.55, 0.15, math.sin(a2) * R * 0.55), i, "rim", 0.16)
				end
				h.N = M
			else
				for layer, prof in ipairs(Profiles(HV.Shape, R, H)) do
					local N = prof.ForceN or baseN
					h.N = math.max(h.N, N)
					local rings = prof.Rings
					local P; P = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(ringIdx, i)
						local a = ((i - 1) % N) / N * math.pi * 2
						local r, y = rings[ringIdx][1], rings[ringIdx][2]
						if prof.RFunc and ringIdx == #rings then r *= prof.RFunc(i, a) end
						return Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, y, math.sin(a) * r)
					end)
					for k = 1, #rings - 1 do
						for i = 1, N do
							local a1, a2 = P(k, i), P(k, i + 1)
							local b1, b2 = P(k + 1, i), P(k + 1, i + 1)
							if rings[k][1] < 1e-4 then
								addTri(a1, b1, b2, i, layer)
							else
								addTri(a1, b1, b2, i, layer)
								addTri(a1, b2, a2, i, layer)
							end
							if wire then
								addLine(a1, b1, i, "spoke", 0.05)
								if k > 1 or rings[k][1] > 1e-4 then addLine(a1, a2, i, "ring", 0.05) end
							end
						end
					end

					if HV.Outline or wire then
						local last = #rings
						for i = 1, N do
							addLine(P(last, i), P(last, i + 1), i, "rim", wire and 0.06 or 0.07)
						end
					end

					if prof.Crown then
						local top = rings[1][2]
						local r = rings[1][1]
						local spikes = 8
						for s = 1, spikes do
							local a1 = (s - 1) / spikes * math.pi * 2
							local a2 = (s - 0.5) / spikes * math.pi * 2
							local a3 = s / spikes * math.pi * 2
							local p1 = Vector3.new(math.cos(a1) * r, top, math.sin(a1) * r)
							local p3 = Vector3.new(math.cos(a3) * r, top, math.sin(a3) * r)
							local tip = Vector3.new(math.cos(a2) * r, top + H * 0.6, math.sin(a2) * r)
							addTri(p1, tip, p3, s * 4, layer)
							if HV.Outline or wire then
								addLine(p1, tip, s * 4, "rim", 0.06)
								addLine(tip, p3, s * 4, "rim", 0.06)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			if HV.Glow then
				local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
				l.Range = R * 3
				l.Brightness = 1.5
				l.Shadows = false
				l.Parent = root
				h.Light = l
			end

			model.Parent = char
			Hat = h
		end)

		local function ScheduleBuild()
			rebuildAt = os.clock() + 0.15
		end

		local ColorFor; ColorFor = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(i, N, t, layer)
			local style = HV.Style
			if style == "Rainbow" then
				return Color3.fromHSV(((i / N) + t * 0.15 + (layer - 1) * 0.12) % 1, 0.8, 1)
			elseif style == "Gradient" then
				local k = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin((i / N) * math.pi * 2 + t * 1.2)
				return HV.Color1:Lerp(HV.Color2, k)
			elseif style == "Striped" then
				return ((i + layer) % 2 == 0) and HV.Color1 or HV.Color2
			elseif style == "Galaxy" then
				local k = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(i * 1.7 + t * 2)
				return Color3.fromRGB(40, 10, 80):Lerp(HV.Color1, k * 0.8)
			end

			if layer and layer % 2 == 0 then return HV.Color2 end
			return HV.Color1
		end)

		local Material; Material = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			local s = HV.Style
			if s == "Neon" or s == "Rhythm" or HV.Shape == "Halo" then return Enum.Material.Neon end
			if s == "Glass" or s == "Crystal" then return Enum.Material.Glass end
			if s == "Galaxy" then return Enum.Material.ForceField end
			return Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		end)

		local t0 = os.clock()
		local hatColorAcc = 0
		local stepConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
			if rebuildAt and os.clock() >= rebuildAt then
				rebuildAt = nil
				Build()
			end
			if not HV.Enabled then
				if Hat then DestroyHat() end
				return
			end
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if not head then return end
			if not Hat or not Hat.Model.Parent or Hat.Weld.Part0 ~= head then
				Build()
				if not Hat then return end
			end

			local t = os.clock() - t0
			if HV.Spin then spinAngle += math.rad(HV.SpinSpeed) * dt end
			local bob = HV.Shape == "Halo" and math.sin(t * 2) * 0.06 or 0
			Hat.Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, head.Size.Y / 2 + HV.Offset + bob, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, spinAngle, 0)

			-- colours only need ~20 updates per second, and only changed values are written
			hatColorAcc = (hatColorAcc or 0) + dt
			if hatColorAcc < 0.05 then return end
			hatColorAcc = 0
			local N = Hat.N or 32
			local baseT = HV.Transparency / 100
			local mat = Material()
			local rhythm = HV.Style == "Rhythm" and (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 4)) or 1
			local tr = math.clamp(baseT + (1 - rhythm) * 0.45, 0, 0.95)
			if HV.Style == "Glass" or HV.Style == "Crystal" then tr = math.max(tr, 0.45) end

			for _, e in ipairs(Hat.Tris) do
				local c = ColorFor(e[3], N, t, e[4])
				for k = 1, 2 do
					local p = e[k]
					if p.Color ~= c then p.Color = c end
					if p.Material ~= mat then p.Material = mat end
					if p.Transparency ~= tr then p.Transparency = tr end
				end
			end
			local lineT = HV.Shape == "Halo" and math.clamp(baseT * 0.5 + (1 - rhythm) * 0.3, 0, 0.9) or math.clamp(baseT * 0.4, 0, 0.9)
			for _, e in ipairs(Hat.Lines) do
				local p = e[1]
				local c = ColorFor(e[2], N, t, 1)
				if e[3] == "rim" and HV.Style ~= "Wireframe" and HV.Shape ~= "Halo" then
					c = c:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35)
				end
				if p.Color ~= c then p.Color = c end
				if p.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon then p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon end
				if p.Transparency ~= lineT then p.Transparency = lineT end
			end
			if Hat.Light then Hat.Light.Color = ColorFor(1, N, t, 1) end
		end))

		local respawnConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			DestroyHat()
			ScheduleBuild()
		end)

		function HatApi.Destroy()
			stepConn:Disconnect()
			respawnConn:Disconnect()
			DestroyHat()
		end

		local G = AddVisualPage("China Hat")
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "China Hat", Default = HV.Enabled, Bind = true, Flag = "VIS_Hat",
			Callback = function(v) HV.Enabled = v; ScheduleBuild() end })
		G:AddDropdown({ Name = "Shape", Options = HAT_SHAPES, Default = HV.Shape, Flag = "VIS_HatShape",
			Callback = function(v) HV.Shape = v; ScheduleBuild() end })
		G:AddDropdown({ Name = "Style", Options = HAT_STYLES, Default = HV.Style, Flag = "VIS_HatStyleV3",
			Callback = function(v) HV.Style = v; ScheduleBuild() end })
		G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Color 1", Default = HV.Color1, Flag = "VIS_HatColor1",
			Callback = function(c) HV.Color1 = c end })
		G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Color 2", Default = HV.Color2, Flag = "VIS_HatColor2",
			Callback = function(c) HV.Color2 = c end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Radius", Min = 0.8, Max = 5, Default = HV.Radius, Increment = 0.1, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_HatRadius",
			Callback = function(v) HV.Radius = v; ScheduleBuild() end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Height", Min = 0.2, Max = 3, Default = HV.Height, Increment = 0.05, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_HatHeight",
			Callback = function(v) HV.Height = v; ScheduleBuild() end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Above head", Min = 0, Max = 2, Default = HV.Offset, Increment = 0.05, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_HatOffset",
			Callback = function(v) HV.Offset = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Segments", Min = 6, Max = 48, Default = HV.Segments, Flag = "VIS_HatSegments",
			Callback = function(v) HV.Segments = v; ScheduleBuild() end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Transparency", Min = 0, Max = 90, Default = HV.Transparency, Suffix = "%", Flag = "VIS_HatTransparency",
			Callback = function(v) HV.Transparency = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Spin", Default = HV.Spin, Flag = "VIS_HatSpin",
			Callback = function(v) HV.Spin = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Spin speed", Min = 5, Max = 360, Default = HV.SpinSpeed, Suffix = "°/s", Flag = "VIS_HatSpinSpeed",
			Callback = function(v) HV.SpinSpeed = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Glowing edge", Default = HV.Outline, Flag = "VIS_HatOutline",
			Callback = function(v) HV.Outline = v; ScheduleBuild() end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Light under hat", Default = HV.Glow, Flag = "VIS_HatGlow",
			Callback = function(v) HV.Glow = v; ScheduleBuild() end })
	end





	-- ===== China hat models from the Toolbox (client side: only you see them) =====
	do
		local HAT_MODELS = {
			{ "External China Hat", { 76951071096255, 93743664779495 } },
			{ "Gold Chinese Hat", { 14950924135 } },
			{ "Bamboo Conical Hat", { 14769019514 } },
			{ "Aesthetic Chinese Hat", { 10779719019 } },
			{ "Straw Rice Hat", { 9656144463 } },
			{ "Chinese Straw Hat", { 15617545100 } },
			{ "Classic Chinese Hat", { 15364639844 } },
			{ "Chinese Dress Hat", { 15379125912 } },
			{ "Chinese Hat", { 15002356161 } },
			{ "Yellow Conical Hat", { 14566331013 } },
			{ "Ronin's Rice Hat", { 14921225263, 14921242591 } },
			{ "Black Rice Hat", { 15510104799 } },
			{ "White Rice Hat", { 13058733125 } },
			{ "China Hat", { 14998336472 } },
			{ "Conical Hat", { 73250676627104 } },
			{ "Chinese Hat 2", { 12422948456 } },
			{ "Chinese Hat 3", { 14687881576 } },
			{ "Rice Farmer Hat", { 11480034314 } },
		}
		local byName = {}
		for _, h in ipairs(HAT_MODELS) do byName[h[1]] = h end
		local HM = { Enabled = false, Current = nil, Offset = 0, Effect = "None", EffectColor = Theme.Accent }
		local EFFECTS = { "None", "Glow", "Sparkles", "Fire", "Neon", "Rainbow" }
		local rainbowParts = {}
		local function ApplyEffect(fold, main)
			table.clear(rainbowParts)
			local c = HM.EffectColor
			if HM.Effect == "Glow" then
				local l = Instance.new("PointLight"); l.Color = c; l.Range = 9; l.Brightness = 1.6; l.Shadows = false; l.Parent = main
			elseif HM.Effect == "Sparkles" then
				local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
				e.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
				e.Color = ColorSequence.new(c)
				e.LightEmission = 1; e.LightInfluence = 0
				e.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.35, 0); e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.1)
				e.Rate = 14; e.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.4, 1.2); e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
				e.Parent = main
			elseif HM.Effect == "Fire" then
				local f = Instance.new("Fire"); f.Color = c; f.SecondaryColor = c:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.4); f.Size = 2; f.Heat = 3; f.Parent = main
			elseif HM.Effect == "Neon" or HM.Effect == "Rainbow" then
				for _, p in ipairs(fold:GetDescendants()) do
					if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency < 1 then
						p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
						p.Color = c
						if p:IsA("MeshPart") then pcall(function() p.TextureID = "" end) end
						for _, m in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
							if m:IsA("SpecialMesh") then pcall(function() m.TextureId = "" end) end
							if m:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") or m:IsA("Decal") or m:IsA("Texture") then m:Destroy() end
						end
						if HM.Effect == "Rainbow" then table.insert(rainbowParts, p) end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local rbAcc = 0
		table.insert(Window.Connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
			if #rainbowParts == 0 then return end
			rbAcc += dt
			if rbAcc < 1 / 15 then return end
			rbAcc = 0
			local col = Color3.fromHSV((os.clock() * 0.2) % 1, 0.75, 1)
			for _, p in ipairs(rainbowParts) do if p.Parent then p.Color = col end end
		end)))
		local cache, folder, token = {}, nil, 0

		local function Fetch(id)
			local uri = "rbxassetid://" .. id
			local ok, objs = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects(uri) end)
			if not ok or type(objs) ~= "table" or #objs == 0 then
				local get = getobjects or CrackHubEnvironment.getobjects
				if type(get) == "function" then ok, objs = pcall(get, uri) end
			end
			if not ok or type(objs) ~= "table" or #objs == 0 then
				local okI, c = pcall(function() return game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(id) end)
				if okI and c then ok, objs = true, { c } end
			end
			if not (ok and type(objs) == "table" and #objs > 0) then return nil end
			local m = Instance.new("Model")
			for _, o in ipairs(objs) do pcall(function() o.Parent = m end) end
			for _, d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
				if d.Parent and (d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("Sound") or d:IsA("Humanoid")) then d:Destroy() end
			end
			return m
		end
		local function Clear()
			if folder then folder:Destroy() end
			folder = nil
			table.clear(rainbowParts)
		end
		local function Wear()
			token += 1
			local my = token
			Clear()
			local entry = HM.Enabled and HM.Current and byName[HM.Current]
			if not entry then return end
			task.spawn(function()
				local model = cache[entry[1]]
				if not model then
					for _, id in ipairs(entry[2]) do
						model = Fetch(id)
						if model then break end
					end
					if model then cache[entry[1]] = model end
				end
				if my ~= token then return end
				if not model then
					Window:Notify({ Title = "Hat models", Content = "Couldn't load “" .. entry[1] .. "”", Duration = 4 })
					return
				end
				local char = LocalPlayer.Character
				local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
				if not head then return end
				local clone = model:Clone()
				local parts = {}
				for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
					if d:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, d) end
				end
				local main = clone:FindFirstChild("Handle", true)
				if not (main and main:IsA("BasePart")) then
					main = nil
					for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
						if not main or p.Size.Magnitude > main.Size.Magnitude then main = p end
					end
				end
				if not main or #parts == 0 then clone:Destroy(); return end
				local hatAtt = main:FindFirstChild("HatAttachment")
				local headAtt = head:FindFirstChild("HatAttachment")
				local mainCF
				if hatAtt and headAtt then
					mainCF = headAtt.WorldCFrame * hatAtt.CFrame:Inverse() * CFrame.new(0, HM.Offset, 0)
				else
					mainCF = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, head.Size.Y / 2 + main.Size.Y / 2 - 0.15 + HM.Offset, 0)
				end
				local rel = {}
				for _, p in ipairs(parts) do rel[p] = main.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame) end
				folder = Instance.new("Folder")
				folder.Name = "CrackHubHatModel"
				for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
					for _, j in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
						if j:IsA("JointInstance") or j:IsA("WeldConstraint") then j:Destroy() end
					end
					p.Anchored = false
					p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.Massless = false, false, false, true
					p.CFrame = mainCF * rel[p]
					local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
					w.Part0, w.Part1 = p, head
					w.Parent = p
					p.Parent = folder
				end
				-- same particle budget as auras
				local emitters, total = {}, 0
				for _, d in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
					if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then table.insert(emitters, d); total += d.Rate
					elseif d:IsA("Light") then d.Shadows = false end
				end
				if total > 120 then for _, e in ipairs(emitters) do e.Rate = e.Rate * 120 / total end end
				for i, e in ipairs(emitters) do if i > 16 then e.Enabled = false end end
				clone:Destroy()
				if my ~= token then folder:Destroy(); folder = nil; return end
				ApplyEffect(folder, main)
				folder.Parent = workspace
			end)
		end
		table.insert(Window.Connections, LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
			c:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
			task.wait(0.3)
			Wear()
		end))
		Window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(Clear)

		local G = AddVisualPage("Hat Models")
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Hat model", Default = false, Bind = true, Flag = "VIS_HatModel",
			Callback = function(v) HM.Enabled = v; Wear() end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Height", Min = -1, Max = 2, Default = 0, Increment = 0.05, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_HatModelOffset",
			Callback = function(v) HM.Offset = v; if HM.Enabled then Wear() end end })
		G:AddDropdown({ Name = "Effect", Options = EFFECTS, Default = "None", Flag = "VIS_HatModelFx",
			Callback = function(v) HM.Effect = v or "None"; if HM.Enabled then Wear() end end })
		G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Effect color", Default = Theme.Accent, Flag = "VIS_HatModelFxColor",
			Callback = function(c)
				HM.EffectColor = c
				if not (HM.Enabled and HM.Effect ~= "None" and HM.Effect ~= "Rainbow") then return end
				local my = os.clock()
				HM._t = my
				task.delay(0.35, function() if HM._t == my then Wear() end end)
			end })
		local cards = {}
		local Grid = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = NextOrder(),
			Parent = G.Holder,
		}, {
			Padding(4, 2, 6, 2),
			Create("UIGridLayout", { CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 0, 34), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }),
		})
		local function Paint()
			for name, c in pairs(cards) do
				local on = HM.Current == name
				c.Stroke.Color = on and Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke
				c.Stroke.Transparency = on and 0 or 0.4
				c.Label.TextColor3 = on and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText
			end
		end
		for i, h in ipairs(HAT_MODELS) do
			local name = h[1]
			local b = Create("TextButton", {
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element,
				BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Text = "",
				LayoutOrder = i,
				Parent = Grid,
			}, { Corner(8) })
			local st = Create("UIStroke", { Color = Theme.Stroke, Transparency = 0.4, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, Parent = b })
			local l = Label({ Text = name, FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, 0), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = b })
			cards[name] = { Label = l, Stroke = st }
			b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				if HM.Current == name then
					HM.Current = nil
				else
					HM.Current = name
					HM.Enabled = true
					local flag = CrackHub.Flags.VIS_HatModel
					if flag and not flag.Value then flag:Set(true, true) end
				end
				Paint()
				Wear()
			end)
		end
		Paint()
	end

	local MotionTrailApi = {}
	do

		local TRAIL_STYLES = {
			"Classic", "Feet", "Neon Glow", "Comet", "Helix", "Rainbow",
			"Wings", "Fire", "Sparkle", "Gradient", "Hands", "Smoke",
		}

		local TEX = {
			Fire = "rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds",
			Smoke = "rbxasset://textures/particles/smoke_main.dds",
			Sparkle = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds",
		}

		local MV = {
			Enabled = false,
			Style = "Classic",
			Color1 = ACCENT,
			Color2 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 160, 255),
			Lifetime = 0.6,
			Width = 2,
			Transparency = 20,
			Brightness = 2,
			OnlyMoving = true,
		}

		local Built = nil
		local rebuildAt = nil
		local t0 = os.clock()

		local Part; Part = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(char, ...)
			for _, n in ipairs({ ... }) do
				local p = char:FindFirstChild(n)
				if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p end
			end
			return nil
		end)

		local Att; Att = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(parent, pos, list)
			local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
			a.Name = "CrackHubTrailAtt"
			a.Position = pos
			a.Parent = parent
			table.insert(list, a)
			return a
		end)

		local RainbowSeq; RainbowSeq = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(shift)
			local kps = {}
			for i = 0, 6 do
				local k = i / 6
				table.insert(kps, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(k, Color3.fromHSV((k + shift) % 1, 0.85, 1)))
			end
			return ColorSequence.new(kps)
		end)

		local NewTrail; NewTrail = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a0, a1, list, opt)
			local tr = Instance.new("Trail")
			tr.Name = "CrackHubTrail"
			tr.Attachment0 = a0
			tr.Attachment1 = a1
			tr.Lifetime = MV.Lifetime * (opt.LifeK or 1)
			tr.MinLength = 0.05
			tr.FaceCamera = opt.FaceCamera or false
			tr.LightEmission = opt.Emission or 0.6
			tr.LightInfluence = 0
			tr.Brightness = MV.Brightness
			tr.Texture = opt.Texture or ""
			tr.TextureMode = opt.TextureMode or Enum.TextureMode.Stretch
			tr.TextureLength = opt.TextureLength or 1
			tr.WidthScale = opt.WidthScale or NumberSequence.new(1)
			local base = MV.Transparency / 100
			tr.Transparency = opt.Transparency or NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, base),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
			})
			tr.Color = ColorSequence.new(MV.Color1, MV.Color2)
			tr.Parent = a0.Parent
			table.insert(list, tr)
			return tr
		end)

		local Clear; Clear = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			if Built then
				for _, o in ipairs(Built.Objects) do pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() o:Destroy() end)) end
			end
			Built = nil
		end)

		local Build; Build = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			Clear()
			if not MV.Enabled then return end
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not hrp then return end

			local b = { Objects = {}, Trails = {}, Helix = {}, Style = MV.Style, Char = char }
			local O = b.Objects
			local W = MV.Width / 2
			local s = MV.Style
			local fade = MV.Transparency / 100

			local add; add = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(tr) table.insert(b.Trails, tr) end)

			if s == "Classic" or s == "Rainbow" or s == "Gradient" or s == "Neon Glow" then
				local a0 = Att(hrp, Vector3.new(0, W, 0), O)
				local a1 = Att(hrp, Vector3.new(0, -W, 0), O)
				add(NewTrail(a0, a1, O, { Emission = s == "Neon Glow" and 1 or 0.5 }))
				if s == "Neon Glow" then

					local g0 = Att(hrp, Vector3.new(0, W * 1.6, 0), O)
					local g1 = Att(hrp, Vector3.new(0, -W * 1.6, 0), O)
					add(NewTrail(g0, g1, O, {
						Emission = 1,
						Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, math.max(fade, 0.7)),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
						}),
					}))
				end
			elseif s == "Comet" then
				local a0 = Att(hrp, Vector3.new(0, W * 0.5, 0), O)
				local a1 = Att(hrp, Vector3.new(0, -W * 0.5, 0), O)
				add(NewTrail(a0, a1, O, {
					FaceCamera = true,
					Emission = 1,
					LifeK = 1.4,
					WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 0.6),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
					}),
				}))
			elseif s == "Wings" then

				local a0 = Att(hrp, Vector3.new(-W * 1.2, 0.8, 0.3), O)
				local a1 = Att(hrp, Vector3.new(W * 1.2, 0.8, 0.3), O)
				add(NewTrail(a0, a1, O, {
					Emission = 0.8,
					WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.2),
					}),
				}))
			elseif s == "Feet" or s == "Hands" then
				local names = s == "Feet"
					and { { "LeftFoot", "Left Leg" }, { "RightFoot", "Right Leg" } }
					or { { "LeftHand", "Left Arm" }, { "RightHand", "Right Arm" } }
				for _, pair in ipairs(names) do
					local p = Part(char, pair[1], pair[2])
					if p then
						local y = -p.Size.Y / 2
						local a0 = Att(p, Vector3.new(0, y + 0.15, 0), O)
						local a1 = Att(p, Vector3.new(0, y - 0.15, 0), O)
						add(NewTrail(a0, a1, O, {
							Emission = 1,
							FaceCamera = true,
							WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
								NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
							}),
						}))
					end
				end
			elseif s == "Helix" then

				for k = 1, 2 do
					local a0 = Att(hrp, Vector3.zero, O)
					local a1 = Att(hrp, Vector3.zero, O)
					local tr = NewTrail(a0, a1, O, {
						FaceCamera = true,
						Emission = 1,
						LifeK = 1.6,
						WidthScale = NumberSequence.new({
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
							NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.1),
						}),
					})
					add(tr)
					table.insert(b.Helix, { a0, a1, (k - 1) * math.pi })
				end
			elseif s == "Fire" or s == "Smoke" or s == "Sparkle" then
				local a0 = Att(hrp, Vector3.new(0, W, 0), O)
				local a1 = Att(hrp, Vector3.new(0, -W, 0), O)
				add(NewTrail(a0, a1, O, {
					Texture = TEX[s],
					TextureMode = s == "Sparkle" and Enum.TextureMode.Wrap or Enum.TextureMode.Stretch,
					TextureLength = s == "Sparkle" and 2 or 1,
					Emission = s == "Smoke" and 0 or 1,
					FaceCamera = true,
					LifeK = s == "Smoke" and 2 or 1,
					WidthScale = s == "Smoke" and NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.6),
					}) or NumberSequence.new(1),
				}))
			end
			Built = b
		end)

		local function ScheduleBuild() rebuildAt = os.clock() + 0.15 end

		local stepConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
			if rebuildAt and os.clock() >= rebuildAt then
				rebuildAt = nil
				Build()
			end

			if not MV.Enabled then
				if Built then Clear() end
				return
			end
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not hrp then return end

			local t = os.clock() - t0
			local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local moving = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude > 2 or math.abs(v.Y) > 6

			if not Built or Built.Style ~= MV.Style or Built.Char ~= char then
				Build()
				if not Built then return end
			end


			for _, hx in ipairs(Built.Helix) do
				local a = t * 7 + hx[3]
				local r = MV.Width * 0.8
				local p = Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * r, math.sin(a * 0.5) * 0.4, math.sin(a) * r)
				hx[1].Position = p + Vector3.new(0, 0.12, 0)
				hx[2].Position = p - Vector3.new(0, 0.12, 0)
			end


			local seq
			if MV.Style == "Rainbow" then
				seq = RainbowSeq(t * 0.3)
			elseif MV.Style == "Fire" then
				seq = ColorSequence.new({
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 160)),
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)),
					ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(150, 20, 10)),
				})
			elseif MV.Style == "Smoke" then
				seq = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 215), Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 95))
			elseif MV.Style == "Classic" then
				seq = ColorSequence.new(MV.Color1)
			else
				seq = ColorSequence.new(MV.Color1, MV.Color2)
			end
			for i, tr in ipairs(Built.Trails) do
				if MV.Style == "Helix" then
					tr.Color = ColorSequence.new(i == 1 and MV.Color1 or MV.Color2)
				else
					tr.Color = seq
				end
				tr.Enabled = moving or not MV.OnlyMoving
				tr.Brightness = MV.Brightness
			end
		end))

		local respawnConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			Clear()
			ScheduleBuild()
		end)

		function MotionTrailApi.Destroy()
			stepConn:Disconnect()
			respawnConn:Disconnect()
			Clear()
		end

		local G = AddVisualPage("Trails")
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Trails", Default = MV.Enabled, Bind = true, Flag = "VIS_MTrail",
			Callback = function(v) MV.Enabled = v; ScheduleBuild() end })
		G:AddDropdown({ Name = "Style", Options = TRAIL_STYLES, Default = MV.Style, Flag = "VIS_MTrailStyleV2",
			Callback = function(v) MV.Style = v; ScheduleBuild() end })
		G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Color 1", Default = MV.Color1, Flag = "VIS_MTrailColor1",
			Callback = function(c) MV.Color1 = c end })
		G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Color 2", Default = MV.Color2, Flag = "VIS_MTrailColor2",
			Callback = function(c) MV.Color2 = c end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Length (lifetime)", Min = 0.1, Max = 3, Default = MV.Lifetime, Increment = 0.05, Suffix = " s", Flag = "VIS_MTrailLife",
			Callback = function(v) MV.Lifetime = v; ScheduleBuild() end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Width", Min = 0.3, Max = 6, Default = MV.Width, Increment = 0.1, Suffix = " st", Flag = "VIS_MTrailWidth",
			Callback = function(v) MV.Width = v; ScheduleBuild() end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Transparency", Min = 0, Max = 90, Default = MV.Transparency, Suffix = "%", Flag = "VIS_MTrailTransparency",
			Callback = function(v) MV.Transparency = v; ScheduleBuild() end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Brightness", Min = 0.5, Max = 10, Default = MV.Brightness, Increment = 0.5, Flag = "VIS_MTrailBrightness",
			Callback = function(v) MV.Brightness = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Only while moving", Default = MV.OnlyMoving, Flag = "VIS_MTrailMoving",
			Callback = function(v) MV.OnlyMoving = v end })
	end




	local GhostApi = {}
	do
		local GHOST_STYLES = { "Neon", "Rainbow", "Gradient", "Hologram", "Glass", "Shadow" }

		local GV = {
			Enabled = false,
			Style = "Neon",
			Color1 = ACCENT,
			Color2 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 160, 255),
			Interval = 0.07,
			Lifetime = 0.5,
			StartTransparency = 45,
			Shrink = true,
			Accessories = false,
			OnlyMoving = true,
			MinSpeed = 2,
			HideFirstPerson = true,
		}

		local ghosts = {}
		local timer = 0
		local t0 = os.clock()

		local IsFirstPerson; IsFirstPerson = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(char)
			local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
			if not cam or not head then return false end

			if (cam.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude < 1.6 then return true end
			return head.LocalTransparencyModifier > 0.9
		end)

		local GhostColor; GhostColor = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(t)
			local s = GV.Style
			if s == "Rainbow" then return Color3.fromHSV((t * 0.6) % 1, 0.8, 1) end
			if s == "Gradient" then return GV.Color1:Lerp(GV.Color2, 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 3)) end
			if s == "Shadow" then return Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20) end
			return GV.Color1
		end)

		local GhostMaterial; GhostMaterial = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			local s = GV.Style
			if s == "Hologram" then return Enum.Material.ForceField end
			if s == "Glass" then return Enum.Material.Glass end
			if s == "Shadow" then return Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic end
			return Enum.Material.Neon
		end)

		local CopyPart; CopyPart = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(p, col, mat)
			local g
			local old = p.Archivable
			p.Archivable = true
			pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() g = p:Clone() end))
			p.Archivable = old
			if g then
				for _, ch in ipairs(g:GetChildren()) do
					if not ch:IsA("DataModelMesh") then ch:Destroy() end
				end
				if g:IsA("MeshPart") then pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function() g.TextureID = "" end)) end
				local mesh = g:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
				if mesh then mesh.TextureId = "" end
			else
				g = Instance.new("Part")
				g.Size = p.Size
			end
			g.Anchored = true
			g.CanCollide = false
			g.CanQuery = false
			g.CanTouch = false
			g.CastShadow = false
			g.Massless = true
			g.Material = mat
			g.Color = col
			g.CFrame = p.CFrame
			g.Transparency = GV.StartTransparency / 100
			g.Parent = workspace.Terrain
			return g
		end)

		-- optimized: body part list is cached, ghost copies are reused from a pool instead of Clone/Destroy every time
		local pool, baseScale = {}, {}
		local gPhone = game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled and not game:GetService("UserInputService").KeyboardEnabled
		local cacheChar, cacheAcc, cacheAt, cacheList = nil, nil, 0, {}
		local BodyParts; BodyParts = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(char)
			local now = os.clock()
			if char == cacheChar and cacheAcc == GV.Accessories and now - cacheAt < 2 then return cacheList end
			if char ~= cacheChar then
				for _, list in pairs(pool) do for _, g in ipairs(list) do g:Destroy() end end
				table.clear(pool)
			end
			cacheChar, cacheAcc, cacheAt, cacheList = char, GV.Accessories, now, {}
			for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
					local acc = p:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accessory")
					if p.Parent == char or (acc and GV.Accessories) then table.insert(cacheList, p) end
				end
			end
			return cacheList
		end)
		local Acquire; Acquire = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(p, col, mat)
			local list = gPhone and pool[p] or nil
			local g = list and table.remove(list)
			if not g then
				g = CopyPart(p, col, mat)
				local m = g:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
				if m then baseScale[g] = m.Scale end
				return g
			end
			g.Color, g.Material, g.Transparency = col, mat, GV.StartTransparency / 100
			local m = g:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
			if m and baseScale[g] then m.Scale = baseScale[g] elseif g.Size ~= p.Size then g.Size = p.Size end
			g.CFrame = p.CFrame
			g.Parent = workspace.Terrain
			return g
		end)
		local Release; Release = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(src, g)
			if gPhone and src.Parent and cacheChar and src:IsDescendantOf(cacheChar) then
				pool[src] = pool[src] or {}
				if #pool[src] < 16 then g.Parent = nil; table.insert(pool[src], g); return end
			end
			baseScale[g] = nil
			g:Destroy()
		end)

		local SpawnGhost; SpawnGhost = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(char, t)
			local col, mat = GhostColor(t), GhostMaterial()
			local parts = {}
			for _, p in ipairs(BodyParts(char)) do
				if p.Parent and p.Transparency < 1 then
					local g = Acquire(p, col, mat)
					local mesh = g:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
					table.insert(parts, { g, p.Size, mesh, p.CFrame, mesh and baseScale[g], p })
				end
			end
			if #parts > 0 then
				table.insert(ghosts, { Parts = parts, Age = 0, Life = GV.Lifetime })
			end
		end)

		local stepConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)

			for i = #ghosts, 1, -1 do
				local g = ghosts[i]
				g.Age += dt
				local k = g.Age / g.Life
				if k >= 1 then
					for _, e in ipairs(g.Parts) do Release(e[6], e[1]) end
					table.remove(ghosts, i)
				else
					local start = GV.StartTransparency / 100
					local tr = start + (1 - start) * k
					for _, e in ipairs(g.Parts) do
						local part = e[1]
						part.Transparency = tr
						if GV.Shrink then
							local s = 1 - 0.25 * k
							if e[3] then
								e[3].Scale = e[5] * s
							else
								part.Size = e[2] * s
								part.CFrame = e[4]
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			if not GV.Enabled then return end
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

			timer += dt
			if gPhone and (timer < math.max(GV.Interval, 0.12) or #ghosts > 10) then return end
			if timer < GV.Interval then return end

			local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local speed = v.Magnitude
			if GV.OnlyMoving and speed < GV.MinSpeed then return end
			if GV.HideFirstPerson and IsFirstPerson(char) then return end

			timer = 0
			SpawnGhost(char, os.clock() - t0)
		end))

		function GhostApi.Destroy()
			stepConn:Disconnect()
			for _, g in ipairs(ghosts) do
				for _, e in ipairs(g.Parts) do e[1]:Destroy() end
			end
			table.clear(ghosts)
			for _, list in pairs(pool) do for _, g in ipairs(list) do g:Destroy() end end
			table.clear(pool)
		end

		local G = AddVisualPage("Ghost Trail")
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Ghost Trail", Default = GV.Enabled, Bind = true, Flag = "VIS_Ghost",
			Callback = function(v) GV.Enabled = v end })
		G:AddDropdown({ Name = "Style", Options = GHOST_STYLES, Default = GV.Style, Flag = "VIS_GhostStyle",
			Callback = function(v) GV.Style = v end })
		G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Color 1", Default = GV.Color1, Flag = "VIS_GhostColor1",
			Callback = function(c) GV.Color1 = c end })
		G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Color 2", Default = GV.Color2, Flag = "VIS_GhostColor2",
			Callback = function(c) GV.Color2 = c end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Frequency", Min = 0.02, Max = 0.5, Default = GV.Interval, Increment = 0.01, Suffix = " s", Flag = "VIS_GhostInterval",
			Callback = function(v) GV.Interval = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Fade speed", Min = 0.1, Max = 3, Default = GV.Lifetime, Increment = 0.05, Suffix = " s", Flag = "VIS_GhostLife",
			Callback = function(v) GV.Lifetime = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Transparency", Min = 0, Max = 90, Default = GV.StartTransparency, Suffix = "%", Flag = "VIS_GhostTransparency",
			Callback = function(v) GV.StartTransparency = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Shrink while fading", Default = GV.Shrink, Flag = "VIS_GhostShrink",
			Callback = function(v) GV.Shrink = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "With accessories", Default = GV.Accessories, Flag = "VIS_GhostAcc",
			Callback = function(v) GV.Accessories = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Only while moving", Default = GV.OnlyMoving, Flag = "VIS_GhostMoving",
			Callback = function(v) GV.OnlyMoving = v end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Min speed", Min = 0.5, Max = 30, Default = GV.MinSpeed, Increment = 0.5, Suffix = " st/s", Flag = "VIS_GhostMinSpeed",
			Callback = function(v) GV.MinSpeed = v end })
		G:AddToggle({ Name = "Hide in first person", Default = GV.HideFirstPerson, Flag = "VIS_GhostFP",
			Callback = function(v) GV.HideFirstPerson = v end })
	end

	VisualsGroup:SetOpen(true)

	do
local function CreateCrackHubPetEdits(Window)
	local api={}
	local edits,hidden={},{}
	local records=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
	local stopped=false
	local function isHidden(object,model,id)
		local names=hidden[id]
		if not names then return false end
		while object and object~=model do
			if names[object.Name] then return true end
			object=object.Parent
		end
		return false
	end
	local function apply(model,record)
		if stopped or not model.Parent then return end
		local values=edits[record.Id] or {}
		for part,original in pairs(record.Rest) do
			if part.Parent and part~=model.PrimaryPart and (record.Id~=138822214304148 or values[part.Name]) then part.CFrame=record.Pose*(values[part.Name] or original) end
		end
		for object,original in pairs(record.Visibility) do
			if object.Parent then
				local hide=isHidden(object,model,record.Id)
				if original.Kind=="Part" then
					object.Transparency=hide and 1 or original.Transparency
					object.LocalTransparencyModifier=hide and 1 or original.Local
				elseif original.Kind=="Image" then object.Transparency=hide and 1 or original.Transparency
				else object.Enabled=not hide and original.Enabled end
			end
		end
	end
	function api:Attach(model,id)
		local record={Id=id,Pose=model:GetPivot(),Rest={},Visibility={}}
		for _,object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("BasePart") then
				record.Rest[object]=record.Pose:ToObjectSpace(object.CFrame)
				record.Visibility[object]={Kind="Part",Transparency=object.Transparency,Local=object.LocalTransparencyModifier}
			elseif object:IsA("Decal") then record.Visibility[object]={Kind="Image",Transparency=object.Transparency}
			elseif object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or object:IsA("Light") then record.Visibility[object]={Kind="Effect",Enabled=object.Enabled} end
		end
		records[model]=record
		apply(model,record)
	end
	function api:Detach(model) records[model]=nil end
	function api:Step(model,id)
		local record=records[model]
		if not record then return end
		record.Pose=model:GetPivot()
		if edits[id] and next(edits[id]) then apply(model,record) end
	end
	local function applyAll(id)
		for model,record in pairs(records) do if record.Id==id then apply(model,record) end end
	end
	function api:SetEdit(id,name,cf)
		if stopped then return end
		edits[id]=edits[id] or {}; edits[id][name]=cf; applyAll(id)
	end
	function api:SetHidden(id,name,value)
		if stopped then return end
		hidden[id]=hidden[id] or {}; hidden[id][name]=value and true or nil; applyAll(id)
	end
	function api:ShowAll(id) hidden[id]=nil; applyAll(id) end
	function api:Reset(id,name)
		if edits[id] then edits[id][name]=nil end
		applyAll(id)
	end
	function api:ResetAll()
		table.clear(edits); table.clear(hidden)
		for model,record in pairs(records) do apply(model,record) end
	end
	Window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(function() stopped=true; table.clear(records); table.clear(edits); table.clear(hidden) end)
	return api
end

		local nextMesh, workers, abandoned, failure = 1, 2, false, nil
		for _=1,2 do task.spawn(function()
			local ok,err=pcall(function()
				while not abandoned and not stopped do
					local index=meshRows[nextMesh]; nextMesh+=1
					if not index then break end
					local part=game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromUri(data[index].Props.MeshId))
					if abandoned or stopped then part:Destroy(); break end
					nodes[index]=part
				end
			end)
			if not ok then failure=err end
			workers-=1
		end) end
		local deadline=os.clock()+15
		while workers>0 and not stopped and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(0.05) end
		if stopped or workers>0 or failure then
			abandoned=true
			for _,object in pairs(nodes) do object:Destroy() end
			return nil, tostring(failure or "Pet mesh loading timed out.")
		end
		for i,row in ipairs(data) do
			local object=nodes[i]
			if not object then for _,node in pairs(nodes) do node:Destroy() end; return nil,"Incomplete pet model." end
			object.Name=row.Name
			for prop,value in pairs(row.Props) do
				if prop~="MeshId" and prop~="MeshSize" and prop~="DoubleSided" and not (type(value)=="table" and value.t=="ref") then
					pcall(function() object[prop]=decode(value,nodes) end)
				end
			end
			for name,value in pairs(row.Attributes or {}) do pcall(function() object:SetAttribute(name,value) end) end
		end
		for i,row in ipairs(data) do
			for prop,value in pairs(row.Props) do
				if type(value)=="table" and value.t=="ref" then pcall(function() nodes[i][prop]=decode(value,nodes) end) end
			end
			if row.Parent>0 then nodes[i].Parent=nodes[row.Parent] end
		end
		return nodes[1]
	end
	local function readTemplate()
		if template then return template end
		local finished, abandoned, loaded = false, false, nil
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok,objects=pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://98566233074980") end)
			if not ok then
				local get=getobjects or CrackHubEnvironment.getobjects
				if type(get)=="function" then ok,objects=pcall(get,"rbxassetid://98566233074980") end
			end
			if ok and type(objects)=="table" then
				for _,root in ipairs(objects) do
					local ghost=root.Name=="ShoulderGhost" and root or root:FindFirstChild("ShoulderGhost",true)
					if not abandoned and not stopped and not loaded and ghost and ghost:IsA("Model") then loaded=ghost:Clone() end
					root:Destroy()
				end
			end
			finished=true
		end)
		local deadline=os.clock()+7
		while not finished and not stopped and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(0.05) end
		abandoned=true
		if stopped then if loaded then loaded:Destroy() end; return nil,"Window closed." end
		if not loaded then
			local err
			loaded,err=backup()
			if not loaded then return nil,err end
		end
		for _,object in ipairs(loaded:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
				object:Destroy()
			elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
				object.Anchored=true
				object.CanCollide=false; object.CanTouch=false; object.CanQuery=false
				object.Massless=true
			end
		end
		template=loaded
		return template
	end
	local assetLoading=false
	local function loadTemplate()
		while assetLoading and not stopped do task.wait(0.05) end
		if stopped then return nil,"Window closed." end
		if template then return template end
		assetLoading=true
		local ok,result,err=pcall(readTemplate)
		assetLoading=false
		if not ok then return nil,tostring(result) end
		return result,err
	end
	local function startAnimation(folder,template)
local GAP = 0.02
local HEAD_GAP = 0.12
local BOB = 0.04
local LEAN = math.rad(4)
local MAX_PITCH, MAX_ROLL = LEAN + math.rad(1.5), math.rad(2)
local SPRING = 7
local TURN = 6
local SNAP = 30

local TOP_CORNERS = {Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), Vector3.new(1, 1, -1), Vector3.new(-1, 1, 1), Vector3.new(-1, 1, -1)}
local ALL_CORNERS = {Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), Vector3.new(1, 1, -1), Vector3.new(1, -1, 1), Vector3.new(1, -1, -1),
	Vector3.new(-1, 1, 1), Vector3.new(-1, 1, -1), Vector3.new(-1, -1, 1), Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1)}

local restCF; restCF = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(part, root, depth)
	if part == root or depth > 6 then return CFrame.identity end
	for _, m in ipairs(part.Parent:GetDescendants()) do
		if m:IsA("Motor6D") and m.Part1 == part and m.Part0 then
			return restCF(m.Part0, root, depth + 1) * m.C0 * m.C1:Inverse()
		end
	end
	return root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
end)

local topY; topY = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(cf, size)
	local y = -math.huge
	for _, s in ipairs(TOP_CORNERS) do y = math.max(y, cf:PointToWorldSpace(size / 2 * s).Y) end
	return y
end)


local measure; measure = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(ghost)
	local pivot = ghost:GetPivot()
	local body = ghost:FindFirstChild("Ghost_Body", true)
	local eye = ghost:FindFirstChild("Ghost_EyeBase", true)
	local faceL = pivot:VectorToObjectSpace(((eye.Position - body.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Unit)
	local upL = pivot:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.yAxis)
	local align = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, faceL:Cross(upL).Unit, upL):Inverse()
	local lo, hi = Vector3.one * math.huge, -Vector3.one * math.huge
	for _, p in ipairs(ghost:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency < 1 then
			for _, s in ipairs(ALL_CORNERS) do
				local c = align:PointToWorldSpace(pivot:PointToObjectSpace(p.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(p.Size / 2 * s)))
				lo, hi = lo:Min(c), hi:Max(c)
			end
		end
	end
	return {align = align, lo = lo, hi = hi, seed = math.random() * 10, speed = 0}
end)

local attach; attach = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(character, d)
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local arm = character:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm") or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not (root and arm and head) then return false end
	local armRest = restCF(arm, root, 0)
	local headRest = restCF(head, root, 0)
	local top = armRest.Position
	local halfW = (d.hi.X - d.lo.X) / 2
	local x = math.max(top.X, headRest.Position.X + head.Size.X / 2 + HEAD_GAP + halfW)

	local tiltLift = (d.hi.Z - d.lo.Z) / 2 * math.sin(MAX_PITCH) + (d.hi.X - d.lo.X) / 2 * math.sin(MAX_ROLL)
	d.offset = Vector3.new(x - (d.hi.X + d.lo.X) / 2, topY(armRest, arm.Size) + GAP + tiltLift - d.lo.Y,
		top.Z - (d.hi.Z + d.lo.Z) / 2)
	d.root, d.arm = root, arm
	return true
end)

local cache = {}
local removedConnection=folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(g) cache[g] = nil end)

local DRESS = {Dress_F = 0, Dress_R = math.pi / 2, Dress_B = math.pi, Dress_L = math.pi * 1.5}
local t = 0
local binding="CrackHubShoulderGhost_"..HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
RunService:BindToRenderStep(binding, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
	t += dt
	for _, ghost in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		local link = ghost:FindFirstChild("Character")
		local character = link and link.Value
		if character and character.Parent then
			local d = cache[ghost]
			if not d then

				d = measure(template)
				cache[ghost] = d
			end
			if not d.bones then


				local bones = {}
				for _, b in ipairs(ghost:GetDescendants()) do
					if b:IsA("Bone") then bones[b.Name] = {b, b.CFrame} end
				end
				if bones.Dress_F and bones.Dress_R and bones.Dress_B and bones.Dress_L and bones.Scarf_Tail then
					d.bones = bones
				end
			end
			if (d.offset or attach(character, d)) and d.root.Parent then
				local root, s = d.root, t + d.seed
				local rootCF = root.CFrame
				local yaw = CFrame.lookAt(rootCF.Position, rootCF.Position + rootCF.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1))
				local goal = yaw:PointToWorldSpace(d.offset)


				if not d.pos or (d.pos - goal).Magnitude > SNAP then
					d.pos, d.vel, d.rot = goal, Vector3.zero, yaw.Rotation
				end
				local steps = math.clamp(math.ceil(dt * 240), 1, 8)
				local h = dt / steps
				for _ = 1, steps do
					d.vel += ((goal - d.pos) * SPRING * SPRING - d.vel * 2 * SPRING) * h
					d.pos += d.vel * h
				end

				local rel = yaw:PointToObjectSpace(d.pos)
				if rel.X < d.offset.X then
					d.pos = yaw:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(d.offset.X, rel.Y, rel.Z))
				end
				d.rot = d.rot:Lerp(yaw.Rotation, 1 - math.exp(-TURN * dt))

				local v = d.vel * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
				d.speed += (math.clamp(v.Magnitude / 16, 0, 1) - d.speed) * math.min(1, dt * 2)
				local sp = d.speed


				local pitch = -LEAN * sp + math.rad(1.5) * math.sin(s * 1.1)
				local roll = MAX_ROLL * math.sin(s * 0.9)
				local hem = Vector3.new((d.hi.X + d.lo.X) / 2, d.lo.Y, (d.hi.Z + d.lo.Z) / 2)
				local sway = CFrame.new(hem) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, roll) * CFrame.new(-hem)
				local bob = Vector3.new(0, BOB * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(s * 1.6)), 0)
				ghost:PivotTo(CFrame.new(d.pos) * d.rot * CFrame.new(bob) * sway * d.align)
				PetParts:Step(ghost,98566233074980)



				d.dressPh = (d.dressPh or 0) + dt * (3 + 1.5 * sp)
				d.scarfPh = (d.scarfPh or 0) + dt * (6 + 4 * sp)
				local trail = math.rad(22) * sp
				local bones = d.bones or {}
				for name, ph in pairs(DRESS) do
					local b = bones[name]
					if b then
						local wave = math.sin(d.dressPh - ph)
						b[1].CFrame = b[2] * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(18) * wave + trail, 0, math.rad(12) * math.cos(d.dressPh * 0.8 - ph))
					end
				end

				local sc = bones.Scarf_Tail
				if sc then
					local f = d.scarfPh
					sc[1].CFrame = sc[2] * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(26 + 14 * sp) * math.sin(f), math.rad(18) * math.sin(f * 0.63),
						math.rad(16) * math.sin(f * 0.81) + math.rad(30) * sp)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end))

return function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(binding); removedConnection:Disconnect() end

end

	local function clearActive()
		if animator then animator(); animator=nil end
		if folder then for _,model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do PetParts:Detach(model) end; folder:Destroy(); folder=nil end
	end
	local function spawn(character)
		clearActive()
		if stopped or not api.Equipped or not template or not character then return end
		folder=Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name="CrackHubShoulderPet_"..LocalPlayer.UserId
		local ghost=template:Clone()
		ghost.Name="CuteGhost"
		local link=Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		link.Name="Character"; link.Value=character; link.Parent=ghost
		ghost:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,-500,0))
		ghost.Parent=folder
		folder.Parent=workspace
		PetParts:Attach(ghost,98566233074980)
		animator=startAnimation(folder,template)
	end
	function api:GetTemplate() return loadTemplate() end
	function api:CreatePreview(parent)
		local value,err=loadTemplate()
		if not value then return nil,err end
		local owner=Instance.new("Model"); owner.Name="PreviewOwner"; owner.Parent=parent
		local root=Instance.new("Part"); root.Name="HumanoidRootPart"; root.Size=Vector3.new(2,2,1); root.Anchored=true; root.Transparency=1
		root.CanCollide=false; root.CanTouch=false; root.CanQuery=false; root.Parent=owner
		local function add(name,size,offset)
			local part=Instance.new("Part"); part.Name=name; part.Size=size; part.CFrame=root.CFrame*offset; part.Anchored=true; part.Transparency=1
			part.CanCollide=false; part.CanTouch=false; part.CanQuery=false; part.Parent=owner
			local joint=Instance.new("Motor6D"); joint.Part0=root; joint.Part1=part; joint.C0=offset; joint.Parent=root
		end
		add("Right Arm",Vector3.new(1,2,1),CFrame.new(1.5,0,0))
		add("Head",Vector3.new(2,1,1),CFrame.new(0,1.5,0))
		local holder=Instance.new("Folder"); holder.Name="PreviewPet"; holder.Parent=parent
		local model=value:Clone(); model.Name="PreviewPet"; model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,2,0)); model.Parent=holder
		for _,part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanQuery=part.Transparency<0.99 end end
		local link=Instance.new("ObjectValue"); link.Name="Character"; link.Value=owner; link.Parent=model
		PetParts:Attach(model,98566233074980)
		local ok,stopAnimation=pcall(startAnimation,holder,value)
		if not ok then PetParts:Detach(model); holder:Destroy(); owner:Destroy(); return nil,tostring(stopAnimation) end
		local closed=false
		return {Model=model,Stop=function()
			if closed then return end
			closed=true; stopAnimation(); PetParts:Detach(model); holder:Destroy(); owner:Destroy()
		end}
	end
	function api:Unequip()
		version+=1
		self.Equipped=false
		clearActive()
	end
	function api:Equip()
		if stopped then return false,"Window closed." end
		if self.Loading then return false,"Pet is already loading." end
		if self.Equipped then return true end
		self.Loading=true
		version+=1
		local request=version
		local ok,result,err=pcall(loadTemplate)
		self.Loading=false
		if stopped or request~=version then return false,"Pet loading cancelled." end
		if not ok or not result then return false,tostring(ok and err or result) end
		self.Equipped=true
		local spawned,spawnError=pcall(spawn,LocalPlayer.Character)
		if not spawned then self:Unequip(); return false,tostring(spawnError) end
		return true
	end
	table.insert(connections,LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		if api.Equipped then spawn(character) end
	end))
	table.insert(connections,LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(clearActive))
	table.insert(connections,Window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
		stopped=true
		api:Unequip()
		for _,connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
		if template then template:Destroy(); template=nil end
	end))
	return api
end

local function CreateCrackHubShoulderGirl(Window)
	local api = {Equipped=false, Loading=false}
	local stopped, version, template, folder, animator = false, 0, nil, nil, nil
	local connections = {}
	local function decode(value, nodes)
		if type(value) ~= "table" or not value.t then return value end
		if value.t=="cf" then return CFrame.new(table.unpack(value.v)) end
		if value.t=="v3" then return Vector3.new(table.unpack(value.v)) end
		if value.t=="color" then return Color3.new(table.unpack(value.v)) end
		if value.t=="v2" then return Vector2.new(table.unpack(value.v)) end
		if value.t=="range" then return NumberRange.new(table.unpack(value.v)) end
		if value.t=="ns" then
			local points={}
			for _,p in ipairs(value.v) do table.insert(points,NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(p[1],p[2],p[3])) end
			return NumberSequence.new(points)
		end
		if value.t=="cs" then
			local points={}
			for _,p in ipairs(value.v) do table.insert(points,ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(p[1],Color3.new(p[2],p[3],p[4]))) end
			return ColorSequence.new(points)
		end
		if value.t=="ref" then return nodes[value.v] end
		if value.t=="enum" then local class,name=value.v:match("Enum%.([^.]+)%.(.+)"); return Enum[class][name] end
	end

	local function readTemplate()
		if template then return template end
		local finished, abandoned, loaded = false, false, nil
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok,objects=pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://136053849776543") end)
			if not ok then
				local get=getobjects or CrackHubEnvironment.getobjects
				if type(get)=="function" then ok,objects=pcall(get,"rbxassetid://136053849776543") end
			end
			if ok and type(objects)=="table" then
				for _,root in ipairs(objects) do
					local ghost=root.Name=="ShoulderGirl" and root or root:FindFirstChild("ShoulderGirl",true)
					if not abandoned and not stopped and not loaded and ghost and ghost:IsA("Model") then loaded=ghost:Clone() end
					root:Destroy()
				end
			end
			finished=true
		end)
		local deadline=os.clock()+7
		while not finished and not stopped and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(0.05) end
		abandoned=true
		if stopped then if loaded then loaded:Destroy() end; return nil,"Window closed." end
		if not loaded then
			local err
			loaded,err=backup()
			if not loaded then return nil,err end
		end
		for _,object in ipairs(loaded:GetDescendants()) do
			if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
				object:Destroy()
			elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
				object.Anchored=true
				object.CanCollide=false; object.CanTouch=false; object.CanQuery=false
				object.Massless=true
			end
		end
		template=loaded
		return template
	end
	local assetLoading=false
	local function loadTemplate()
		while assetLoading and not stopped do task.wait(0.05) end
		if stopped then return nil,"Window closed." end
		if template then return template end
		assetLoading=true
		local ok,result,err=pcall(readTemplate)
		assetLoading=false
		if not ok then return nil,tostring(result) end
		return result,err
	end
	local function startAnimation(folder,template)
local GAP = 0.02
local HEAD_GAP = 0.12
local BOB = 0.05
local LEAN = math.rad(8)
local MAX_PITCH, MAX_ROLL = LEAN + math.rad(1.5), math.rad(2)
local SPRING = 7
local TURN = 6
local SNAP = 30
local JET_ON = 0.12

local TOP_CORNERS = {Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), Vector3.new(1, 1, -1), Vector3.new(-1, 1, 1), Vector3.new(-1, 1, -1)}
local ALL_CORNERS = {Vector3.new(1, 1, 1), Vector3.new(1, 1, -1), Vector3.new(1, -1, 1), Vector3.new(1, -1, -1),
	Vector3.new(-1, 1, 1), Vector3.new(-1, 1, -1), Vector3.new(-1, -1, 1), Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1)}

local restCF; restCF = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(part, root, depth)
	if part == root or depth > 6 then return CFrame.identity end
	for _, m in ipairs(part.Parent:GetDescendants()) do
		if m:IsA("Motor6D") and m.Part1 == part and m.Part0 then
			return restCF(m.Part0, root, depth + 1) * m.C0 * m.C1:Inverse()
		end
	end
	return root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
end)

local topY; topY = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(cf, size)
	local y = -math.huge
	for _, s in ipairs(TOP_CORNERS) do y = math.max(y, cf:PointToWorldSpace(size / 2 * s).Y) end
	return y
end)


local measure; measure = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(girl)
	local pivot = girl:GetPivot()
	local body = girl:FindFirstChild("Body")
	local faceL = pivot:VectorToObjectSpace((body.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Unit)
	local upL = pivot:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.yAxis)
	local align = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, faceL:Cross(upL).Unit, upL):Inverse()
	local lo, hi = Vector3.one * math.huge, -Vector3.one * math.huge
	for _, p in ipairs(girl:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency < 1 then
			for _, s in ipairs(ALL_CORNERS) do
				local c = align:PointToWorldSpace(pivot:PointToObjectSpace(p.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(p.Size / 2 * s)))
				lo, hi = lo:Min(c), hi:Max(c)
			end
		end
	end
	return {align = align, lo = lo, hi = hi, seed = math.random() * 10, speed = 0}
end)

local attach; attach = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(character, d)
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local arm = character:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm") or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not (root and arm and head) then return false end
	local armRest = restCF(arm, root, 0)
	local headRest = restCF(head, root, 0)
	local top = armRest.Position
	local halfW = (d.hi.X - d.lo.X) / 2
	local x = math.max(top.X, headRest.Position.X + head.Size.X / 2 + HEAD_GAP + halfW)

	local tiltLift = (d.hi.Z - d.lo.Z) / 2 * math.sin(MAX_PITCH) + (d.hi.X - d.lo.X) / 2 * math.sin(MAX_ROLL)
	d.offset = Vector3.new(x - (d.hi.X + d.lo.X) / 2, topY(armRest, arm.Size) + GAP + tiltLift - d.lo.Y,
		top.Z - (d.hi.Z + d.lo.Z) / 2)
	d.root, d.arm = root, arm
	return true
end)

local cache = {}
local removedConnection=folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(g) cache[g] = nil end)

local t = 0
local binding="CrackHubShoulderGirl_"..HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
RunService:BindToRenderStep(binding, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
	t += dt
	for _, girl in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		local link = girl:FindFirstChild("Character")
		local character = link and link.Value
		if character and character.Parent then
			local d = cache[girl]
			if not d then

				d = measure(template)
				cache[girl] = d
			end
			if not d.jets then

				local jets = {}
				for _, e in ipairs(girl:GetDescendants()) do
					if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or e:IsA("PointLight") then table.insert(jets, e) end
				end
				if #jets >= 6 then d.jets = jets end
			end
			if (d.offset or attach(character, d)) and d.root.Parent then
				local root, s = d.root, t + d.seed
				local rootCF = root.CFrame
				local yaw = CFrame.lookAt(rootCF.Position, rootCF.Position + rootCF.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1))
				local goal = yaw:PointToWorldSpace(d.offset)


				if not d.pos or (d.pos - goal).Magnitude > SNAP then
					d.pos, d.vel, d.rot = goal, Vector3.zero, yaw.Rotation
				end
				local steps = math.clamp(math.ceil(dt * 240), 1, 8)
				local h = dt / steps
				for _ = 1, steps do
					d.vel += ((goal - d.pos) * SPRING * SPRING - d.vel * 2 * SPRING) * h
					d.pos += d.vel * h
				end

				local rel = yaw:PointToObjectSpace(d.pos)
				if rel.X < d.offset.X then
					d.pos = yaw:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(d.offset.X, rel.Y, rel.Z))
				end
				d.rot = d.rot:Lerp(yaw.Rotation, 1 - math.exp(-TURN * dt))

				local v = d.vel * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
				d.speed += (math.clamp(v.Magnitude / 16, 0, 1) - d.speed) * math.min(1, dt * 2)
				local sp = d.speed


				local pitch = -LEAN * sp + math.rad(1.5) * math.sin(s * 1.1)
				local roll = MAX_ROLL * math.sin(s * 0.9)
				local feet = Vector3.new((d.hi.X + d.lo.X) / 2, d.lo.Y, (d.hi.Z + d.lo.Z) / 2)
				local sway = CFrame.new(feet) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, roll) * CFrame.new(-feet)
				local bob = Vector3.new(0, BOB * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(s * 1.6)), 0)
				girl:PivotTo(CFrame.new(d.pos) * d.rot * CFrame.new(bob) * sway * d.align)
				PetParts:Step(girl,136053849776543)


				local jet = math.clamp((sp - JET_ON) / (1 - JET_ON) * 1.5, 0, 1)
				for _, e in ipairs(d.jets or {}) do
					if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
						e.Rate = (e:GetAttribute("MaxRate") or 50) * jet
					else
						e.Brightness = (e:GetAttribute("MaxBrightness") or 2) * jet * (0.8 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 40 + d.seed))
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end))

return function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(binding); removedConnection:Disconnect() end

end

	local function clearActive()
		if animator then animator(); animator=nil end
		if folder then for _,model in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do PetParts:Detach(model) end; folder:Destroy(); folder=nil end
	end
	local function spawn(character)
		clearActive()
		if stopped or not api.Equipped or not template or not character then return end
		folder=Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name="CrackHubShoulderGirl_"..LocalPlayer.UserId
		local ghost=template:Clone()
		ghost.Name="AnimeGirl"
		local link=Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		link.Name="Character"; link.Value=character; link.Parent=ghost
		ghost:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,-500,0))
		ghost.Parent=folder
		folder.Parent=workspace
		PetParts:Attach(ghost,136053849776543)
		animator=startAnimation(folder,template)
	end
	function api:GetTemplate() return loadTemplate() end
	function api:CreatePreview(parent)
		local value,err=loadTemplate()
		if not value then return nil,err end
		local owner=Instance.new("Model"); owner.Name="PreviewOwner"; owner.Parent=parent
		local root=Instance.new("Part"); root.Name="HumanoidRootPart"; root.Size=Vector3.new(2,2,1); root.Anchored=true; root.Transparency=1
		root.CanCollide=false; root.CanTouch=false; root.CanQuery=false; root.Parent=owner
		local function add(name,size,offset)
			local part=Instance.new("Part"); part.Name=name; part.Size=size; part.CFrame=root.CFrame*offset; part.Anchored=true; part.Transparency=1
			part.CanCollide=false; part.CanTouch=false; part.CanQuery=false; part.Parent=owner
			local joint=Instance.new("Motor6D"); joint.Part0=root; joint.Part1=part; joint.C0=offset; joint.Parent=root
		end
		add("Right Arm",Vector3.new(1,2,1),CFrame.new(1.5,0,0))
		add("Head",Vector3.new(2,1,1),CFrame.new(0,1.5,0))
		local holder=Instance.new("Folder"); holder.Name="PreviewPet"; holder.Parent=parent
		local model=value:Clone(); model.Name="PreviewPet"; model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0,2,0)); model.Parent=holder
		for _,part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanQuery=part.Transparency<0.99 end end
		local link=Instance.new("ObjectValue"); link.Name="Character"; link.Value=owner; link.Parent=model
		PetParts:Attach(model,136053849776543)
		local ok,stopAnimation=pcall(startAnimation,holder,value)
		if not ok then PetParts:Detach(model); holder:Destroy(); owner:Destroy(); return nil,tostring(stopAnimation) end
		local closed=false
		return {Model=model,Stop=function()
			if closed then return end
			closed=true; stopAnimation(); PetParts:Detach(model); holder:Destroy(); owner:Destroy()
		end}
	end
	function api:Unequip()
		version+=1
		self.Equipped=false
		clearActive()
	end
	function api:Equip()
		if stopped then return false,"Window closed." end
		if self.Loading then return false,"Pet is already loading." end
		if self.Equipped then return true end
		self.Loading=true
		version+=1
		local request=version
		local ok,result,err=pcall(loadTemplate)
		self.Loading=false
		if stopped or request~=version then return false,"Pet loading cancelled." end
		if not ok or not result then return false,tostring(ok and err or result) end
		self.Equipped=true
		local spawned,spawnError=pcall(spawn,LocalPlayer.Character)
		if not spawned then self:Unequip(); return false,tostring(spawnError) end
		return true
	end
	table.insert(connections,LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		if api.Equipped then spawn(character) end
	end))
	table.insert(connections,LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(clearActive))
	table.insert(connections,Window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
		stopped=true
		api:Unequip()
		for _,connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
		if template then template:Destroy(); template=nil end
	end))
	return api
end

local function CreateCrackHubRecordedPet(Window)
 local ID=138822214304148
 local api={Equipped=false,Loading=false}
 local stopped,version,template,active,player=false,0,nil,nil,nil
 local connections={}
 local Motion=(function()
-- Plays the supplied sampled actions; original controller source was not present.
local HttpService=game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Player={}
Player.__index=Player
local function ease(t)t=math.clamp(t,0,1);return t*t*(3-2*t)end
local function blend(a,b,w)
 local out={}
 for id,row in pairs(a) do
  local nextRow=b[id] or row;local n={}
  for p,v in pairs(row) do
   local nextValue=nextRow[p]
   if nextValue==nil then nextValue=v end
   if typeof(v)=="CFrame" then n[p]=v:Lerp(nextValue,w)
   elseif type(v)=="number" then n[p]=v+(nextValue-v)*w
   else n[p]=w<.5 and v or nextValue end
  end
  out[id]=n
 end
 return out
end
local function sample(clip,t)
 local frames=clip.Frames
 t=math.clamp(t,0,clip.Duration)
 local lo,hi=1,#frames
 while lo<hi do
  local mid=math.floor((lo+hi+1)/2)
  if frames[mid].Time<=t then lo=mid else hi=mid-1 end
 end
 local a,b=frames[lo],frames[math.min(lo+1,#frames)]
 local w=b.Time>a.Time and math.clamp((t-a.Time)/(b.Time-a.Time),0,1) or 0
 return blend(a.Nodes,b.Nodes,w)
end
local function sampleLoop(clip,time)
 local fade=math.min(.40,clip.Duration/4)
 local t=fade+time%(clip.Duration-fade)
 local pose=sample(clip,t)
 if t>clip.Duration-fade then
  pose=blend(pose,sample(clip,t-(clip.Duration-fade)),ease((t-(clip.Duration-fade))/fade))
 end
 return pose
end

function Player.new(model)
 local self=setmetatable({Model=model,Nodes={},Clips={},Jets={},HitIndicators={},Connections={},Elapsed=0,FlightWeight=0,FollowVelocity=Vector3.zero},Player)
 self.Nodes[model:GetAttribute("SnapshotNodeId")]=model
 for _,o in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
  local id=o:GetAttribute("SnapshotNodeId");if id then self.Nodes[id]=o end
  if o:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then table.insert(self.Jets,o) end
  if o:IsA("BillboardGui") then
   local isHit=o:GetAttribute("SnapshotNodeId")==157
   for _,label in ipairs(o:GetDescendants()) do
    if label:IsA("TextLabel") and label.Text:find("💢",1,true) then isHit=true end
   end
   if isHit then o.Enabled=false;table.insert(self.HitIndicators,o) end
  end
 end
 local folders=model:WaitForChild("ActionMotionData")
 for _,name in ipairs({"Idle","Flight","HitReaction"}) do
  local chunks=folders:WaitForChild(name):GetChildren()
  table.sort(chunks,function(a,b)return a.Name<b.Name end)
  local clip={Frames={}}
  for _,chunk in ipairs(chunks) do
   for _,frame in ipairs(HttpService:JSONDecode(chunk.Value)) do
    local f={Time=frame.Time,Nodes={}}
    for _,row in ipairs(frame.Nodes) do
     local n={}
     for p,v in pairs(row) do
      if p~="Id" then n[p]=(p=="CFrame" or p=="Transform") and CFrame.new(table.unpack(v)) or v end
     end
     f.Nodes[row.Id]=n
    end
    table.insert(clip.Frames,f)
   end
  end
  assert(#clip.Frames>1,"Missing action frames: "..name)
  clip.Duration=clip.Frames[#clip.Frames].Time
  self.Clips[name]=clip
 end
 self.Anchor=model:GetPivot()
 return self
end

function Player:RequestHit()
 if self.HitTime then return false end
 self.HitTime=0
 for _,indicator in ipairs(self.HitIndicators) do indicator.Enabled=true end
 self.Model:SetAttribute("RecordedHitCount",(self.Model:GetAttribute("RecordedHitCount") or 0)+1)
 return true
end

function Player:Update(dt)
 if self.Model:GetAttribute("PlaybackEnabled")==false then return end
 local movement=self:UpdateFollow(dt)
 if self.Moving then self.Moving=movement>.45 else self.Moving=movement>1.1 end
 local speed=self.Model:GetAttribute("PlaybackSpeed")
 local delta=dt*math.max(0,type(speed)=="number" and speed or 1)
 self.Elapsed+=delta
 local target=self.Moving and 1 or 0
 self.FlightWeight+= (target-self.FlightWeight)*(1-math.exp(-dt*10))
 local pose=blend(sampleLoop(self.Clips.Idle,self.Elapsed),sampleLoop(self.Clips.Flight,self.Elapsed),self.FlightWeight)
 local action=self.Moving and "Flight" or "Idle"
 if self.HitTime then
  self.HitTime+=delta
  local clip=self.Clips.HitReaction
  if self.HitTime<clip.Duration then
   local w=ease(math.min(self.HitTime/.12,(clip.Duration-self.HitTime)/.25))
   pose=blend(pose,sample(clip,self.HitTime),w);action="HitReaction"
  else
   self.HitTime=nil
   for _,indicator in ipairs(self.HitIndicators) do indicator.Enabled=false end
  end
 end
 if self.Model:GetAttribute("CurrentAction")~=action then self.Model:SetAttribute("CurrentAction",action) end
 for id,row in pairs(pose) do
  local object=self.Nodes[id]
  if object then
   for p,v in pairs(row) do
    if p=="CFrame" then object.CFrame=object:IsA("BasePart") and self.Anchor*v or v
    else object[p]=v end
   end
  end
 end
 -- Emit() calls do not appear in snapshots; supply visible flight emission.
 for _,jet in ipairs(self.Jets) do jet.Rate=math.max(jet.Rate,30*self.FlightWeight) end
end

function Player:Play()
 if self.Connection then return end
 for _,object in pairs(self.Nodes) do
  if object:IsA("BasePart") and object.Transparency<.99 then
   local click=Instance.new("ClickDetector");click.Name="RecordedHitTrigger";click.MaxActivationDistance=20;click.Parent=object
   table.insert(self.Connections,click.MouseClick:Connect(function()self:RequestHit()end))
   table.insert(self.Connections,click)
  end
 end
 table.insert(self.Connections,self.Model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("TriggerHit"):Connect(function()self:RequestHit()end))
 self.Connection=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
  if not self.Model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then self:Stop();return end
  self:Update(dt)
 end))
end

function Player:Stop()
 if self.Connection then self.Connection:Disconnect();self.Connection=nil end
 self.HitTime=nil
 for _,indicator in ipairs(self.HitIndicators) do indicator.Enabled=false end
 for _,c in ipairs(self.Connections) do
  if typeof(c)=="RBXScriptConnection" then c:Disconnect() else c:Destroy() end
 end
 table.clear(self.Connections)
end

function Player:UpdateFollow(dt)
 local movement=0
 if self.Model:GetAttribute("FollowPlayer") then
   local ownerId=self.Model:GetAttribute("FollowUserId")
   local owner=type(ownerId)=="number" and ownerId>0 and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ownerId) or self.Owner
   if not owner or owner.Parent~=Players then
    local distance=math.huge
    for _,candidate in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
     local body=candidate.Character and candidate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
     if body then
      local d=(body.Position-self.Anchor.Position).Magnitude
      if d<distance then owner=candidate;distance=d end
     end
    end
   end
   self.Owner=owner
   local body=owner and owner.Character and owner.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   if body then
    local offset=self.Model:GetAttribute("ShoulderOffset")
    if typeof(offset)~="Vector3" then offset=Vector3.new(2.3,1.5,.35) end
    local clock=os.clock()
    local goal=body.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(offset)
    local position=self.FollowPosition or self.Anchor.Position
    if (goal-position).Magnitude>60 then position=goal;self.FollowVelocity=Vector3.zero end
    local duration=math.min(dt,.1)
    local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil(duration*120))
    local h=duration/steps
    for _=1,steps do
     self.FollowVelocity+=((goal-position)*100-self.FollowVelocity*20)*h
     position+=self.FollowVelocity*h
    end
    self.FollowPosition=position
    local velocity=body.AssemblyLinearVelocity*Vector3.new(1,0,1)
    local direction=velocity.Magnitude>1 and velocity.Unit or body.CFrame.LookVector*Vector3.new(1,0,1)
    if direction.Magnitude<.01 then direction=Vector3.new(0,0,-1) end
    local rotation=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,direction.Unit).Rotation
    self.FlightRotation=(self.FlightRotation or self.Anchor.Rotation):Lerp(rotation,1-math.exp(-9*duration))
    movement=math.max(velocity.Magnitude,self.FollowVelocity.Magnitude)
    local speed=math.clamp(movement/16,0,1)
    local bob=math.sin(clock*2.2)*.10+math.max(0,math.sin(clock*1.1))^8*.12*(1-speed)
    local tilt=CFrame.Angles(-math.rad(12)*speed,math.rad(self.Model:GetAttribute("FacingYawDegrees") or 0),math.rad(1.5)*math.sin(clock*1.5))
    self.Anchor=CFrame.new(position+Vector3.new(0,bob,0))*self.FlightRotation*tilt
    for _,jet in ipairs(self.Jets) do jet.Rate=30*speed end
   end
  end
 return movement
end

Player.SampleLoop=sampleLoop
return Player

 local function backup()

 local snapshot=CrackHubEnvironment.__CrackHubJSONAsset("snapshot.json")
 local captures=CrackHubEnvironment.__CrackHubJSONAsset("anim/captures.json")
 local nodes={}
 local function enum(v)
 local class,name=v:match("^Enum%.([%w_]+)%.([%w_]+)$")
 return class and Enum[class][name]
end
local function decode(x)
 if type(x)~="table" then return x end
 local t,v=x.Type,x.Value
 if t=="Ref" then return nodes[x.Id] end
 if t=="CFrame" then return CFrame.new(table.unpack(v)) end
 if t=="Vector3" then return Vector3.new(table.unpack(v)) end
 if t=="Vector2" then return Vector2.new(table.unpack(v)) end
 if t=="Color3" then return Color3.new(table.unpack(v)) end
 if t=="BrickColor" then return BrickColor.new(v) end
 if t=="UDim" then return UDim.new(table.unpack(v)) end
 if t=="UDim2" then return UDim2.new(table.unpack(v)) end
 if t=="Rect" then return Rect.new(table.unpack(v)) end
 if t=="NumberRange" then return NumberRange.new(table.unpack(v)) end
 if t=="EnumItem" then return enum(v) end
 if t=="Font" then return Font.new(x.Family,enum(x.Weight),enum(x.Style)) end
 if t=="PhysicalProperties" then return PhysicalProperties.new(table.unpack(v)) end
 if t=="NumberSequence" then
  local a={};for _,k in ipairs(v) do table.insert(a,NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(table.unpack(k))) end
  return NumberSequence.new(a)
 end
 if t=="ColorSequence" then
  local a={};for _,k in ipairs(v) do table.insert(a,ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(k[1],Color3.new(k[2],k[3],k[4]))) end
  return ColorSequence.new(a)
 end
 if t=="Content" then return x.Uri and Content.fromUri(x.Uri) or Content.none end
 if t=="Number" then return v=="inf" and math.huge or (v=="-inf" and -math.huge or 0) end
 error("Unsupported value "..tostring(t))
end

  -- StringValue holds < 200000 chars, so animation frames are split into several chunks
  local batch,size,index={},2,0
  local function flush()
   if #batch==0 then return end
   local chunk=Instance.new("StringValue");chunk.Name=string.format("Frames%03d",index);chunk.Value="["..table.concat(batch,",").."]";chunk.Parent=section
   index+=1;batch={};size=2
  end
  for _,frame in ipairs(frames)do

   if size+#encoded+1>=190000 then flush() end
   table.insert(batch,encoded);size+=#encoded+1

 local function prepare(model)
  for _,o in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
   o.Archivable=true
   if o:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then o:Destroy()
   elseif o.Name=="CapturedEnvironmentLights" then o:Destroy()
   elseif o:IsA("BasePart") then o.Anchored=true;o.CanCollide=false;o.CanTouch=false;o.CanQuery=o.Transparency<.99
   elseif o:IsA("Humanoid") then o.AutomaticScalingEnabled=false;o.EvaluateStateMachine=false
   elseif o:IsA("BillboardGui") and o:GetAttribute("SnapshotNodeId")==157 then o.Enabled=false end
  end
  model.PrimaryPart=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart",true)
  assert(model.PrimaryPart and model:FindFirstChild("ActionMotionData"),"Incomplete pet asset")
  model:SetAttribute("FollowPlayer",true);model:SetAttribute("FollowUserId",LocalPlayer.UserId)
  model:SetAttribute("PlaybackEnabled",true);model:SetAttribute("PlaybackSpeed",1)
  model:SetAttribute("ShoulderOffset",Vector3.new(2.3,1.5,.35))
  return model
 end
 local templateBusy=false
