 local function loadTemplate()
  if template then return template end
  while templateBusy and not stopped do task.wait(.05) end
  if template then return template end
  if stopped then return nil,"Window closed" end
  templateBusy=true
  local ok,value,err=pcall(loadTemplateRaw)
  templateBusy=false
  if not ok then return nil,tostring(value) end
  return value,err
 end
 function loadTemplateRaw()
  if template then return template end
  local result,done,abandoned=nil,false,false
  task.spawn(function()
   local ok,objects=pcall(function()return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..ID)end)
   if not ok or type(objects)~="table" or #objects==0 then
    local get=getobjects or CrackHubEnvironment.getobjects
    if type(get)=="function" then ok,objects=pcall(get,"rbxassetid://"..ID) end
   end
   if not ok or type(objects)~="table" or #objects==0 then
    local okInsert,container=pcall(function()return game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(ID)end)
    if okInsert and container then ok,objects=true,{container} end
   end
   if ok and type(objects)=="table" then
    for _,root in ipairs(objects) do
     local data=root:FindFirstChild("ActionMotionData",true)
     if data and data.Parent:IsA("Model") and not result and not stopped and not abandoned then
      local candidate=data.Parent:Clone()
      local valid=pcall(prepare,candidate)
      if valid then result=candidate else candidate:Destroy() end
     end
     root:Destroy()
    end
   end
   done=true
  end)
  local deadline=os.clock()+25
  while not stopped and not done and not result and os.clock()<deadline do task.wait(.05) end
  abandoned=true
  if stopped then if result then result:Destroy() end;return nil,"Window closed" end
  if not result then
   local ok,value=pcall(backup)
   if not ok then return nil,tostring(value) end
   result=prepare(value)
  end
  if stopped then result:Destroy();return nil,"Window closed" end
  template=result
  return result
 end

  if active then PetParts:Detach(active);active:Destroy();active=nil end
 end
 local function spawn(character)
  clear()
  if stopped or not api.Equipped or not character then return end
  local hrp=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",10)

  active=template:Clone();active.Name="CrackHubRecordedPet_"..LocalPlayer.UserId
  active:PivotTo(hrp.CFrame*CFrame.new(2.3,1.5,.35));active.Parent=workspace
  PetParts:Attach(active,ID)
  player=Motion.new(active);player:Play()
  local model,current=active,player
  local oldUpdate=current.Update
  function current:Update(dt)
   oldUpdate(self,dt)
   if model.Parent then PetParts:Step(model,ID) end
  end
 end

 function api:Equip()
  if stopped then return false,"Window closed" end
  self.Loading=true;version+=1;local request=version
  local ok,value,err=pcall(loadTemplate);self.Loading=false
  if stopped or request~=version then return false,"Pet loading cancelled" end

  self.Equipped=true
  local success,message=pcall(spawn,LocalPlayer.Character)
  if not success then self:Unequip();return false,tostring(message) end
  return true
 end

local function CreateCrackHubPetSelection(Window, factories)
	local api = { Current = nil, Loading = false }
	local version, stopped = 0, false
	local runtimes = {}
	function api:GetRuntime(id)
		assert(not stopped and not Window.Destroyed,"Window closed.")
		if not runtimes[id] then
			assert(factories[id],"Pet model is unavailable.")
			runtimes[id]=factories[id](Window)
		end
		return runtimes[id]
	end
	function api:Unequip()
		version += 1
		self.Current, self.Loading = nil, false
		for _, runtime in pairs(runtimes) do runtime:Unequip() end
	end
	function api:Select(item, changed, failed)
		if stopped or Window.Destroyed then return end
		if self.Current == item.Name then
			self:Unequip()
			SafeCall(changed)
			return
		end
		self:Unequip()
		self.Current, self.Loading = item.Name, true
		local request = version
		SafeCall(changed)
		task.spawn(function()
			if request ~= version or stopped or Window.Destroyed then return end
			local runtime = runtimes[item.Model]
			if not runtime then
				local factory = factories[item.Model]
				local ok, value = pcall(function()
					assert(factory, "Pet model is unavailable.")
					return factory(Window)
				end)
				if not ok then
					if request == version and not stopped then
						self.Current, self.Loading = nil, false
						SafeCall(changed)
						SafeCall(failed, tostring(value))
					end
					return
				end
				runtime = value
				runtimes[item.Model] = runtime
			end
			while runtime.Loading and request == version and not stopped do task.wait(0.05) end
			if request ~= version or stopped or Window.Destroyed then return end
			local ok, success, err = pcall(runtime.Equip, runtime)
			if request ~= version or stopped or Window.Destroyed then return end
			self.Loading = false
			if not ok or not success then
				runtime:Unequip()
				self.Current = nil
				SafeCall(changed)
				SafeCall(failed, tostring(ok and err or success))
				return
			end
			SafeCall(changed)
		end)
	end
	Window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
		stopped = true
		api:Unequip()
	end)
	return api
end

		local function Container(model)
			local hasParts = false
			for _, c in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
				if c:IsA("BasePart") then hasParts = true break end
			end
			if not hasParts then
				local inner = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
				if inner then return inner end
			end
			return model
		end

		local function RootOf(model)
			local c = Container(model)
			local root = model.PrimaryPart or c.PrimaryPart or c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then
				local best, vol = nil, -1
				for _, p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
					if p:IsA("BasePart") then
						local v = p.Size.X * p.Size.Y * p.Size.Z
						if v > vol then best, vol = p, v end
					end
				end
				root = best
			end
			return root
		end

		local function BodyOf(model, root)

			local best, vol = nil, -1
			for _, p in ipairs(Container(model):GetChildren()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Transparency < 0.99 then
					local v = p.Size.X * p.Size.Y * p.Size.Z
					if v > vol then best, vol = p, v end
				end
			end
			return best or root
		end

		local function Elements(model)
			local c = Container(model)
			local root = RootOf(model)
			local body = BodyOf(model, root)
			local list, used = {}, {}
			for _, ch in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
				local ok = ch:IsA("Accessory") or ch:IsA("Model") or ch:IsA("BasePart")
				if ok and ch ~= root and ch ~= body then
					if ch:IsA("BasePart") and ch.Transparency >= 0.99 then ok = false end
				end
				if ok and ch ~= root and ch ~= body then
					local name = ch.Name
					local n = 2
					while used[name] do name = ch.Name .. " " .. n; n += 1 end
					used[name] = true
					table.insert(list, { Name = name, Inst = ch })
				end
			end
			return list
		end

		local ElParts; ElParts = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(inst)
			local t = {}
			if inst:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(t, inst) end
			for _, d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(t, d) end

		local ElPivot; ElPivot = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(inst)
			if inst:IsA("BasePart") then return inst.CFrame end
			if inst:IsA("Model") then return inst:GetPivot() end
			local h = inst:FindFirstChild("Handle") or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			return h and h.CFrame or CFrame.new()
		end)


		local MoveElement; MoveElement = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(model, inst, target)
			local parts = ElParts(inst)
			if #parts == 0 then return end
			local set = {}
			for _, p in ipairs(parts) do set[p] = true end
			local joints, wcs = {}, {}
			for _, j in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if j:IsA("JointInstance") and j.Part0 and j.Part1 and (set[j.Part0] ~= set[j.Part1]) then
					table.insert(joints, j)
				elseif j:IsA("WeldConstraint") and j.Part0 and j.Part1 and (set[j.Part0] ~= set[j.Part1]) and j.Enabled then
					j.Enabled = false
					table.insert(wcs, j)
				end
			end
			local delta = target * ElPivot(inst):Inverse()
			for _, p in ipairs(parts) do p.CFrame = delta * p.CFrame end
			for _, j in ipairs(joints) do
				if set[j.Part1] then
					j.C0 = j.Part0.CFrame:Inverse() * j.Part1.CFrame * j.C1
				else
					j.C1 = j.Part1.CFrame:Inverse() * j.Part0.CFrame * j.C0
				end
			end
			for _, w in ipairs(wcs) do w.Enabled = true end
		end)


		local function ApplyEdits(model, petName)
			local all = Elements(model)
			local e = Edits[petName] or {}
			local h = Hidden[petName] or {}
			local root = RootOf(model)
			local visible = {}
			for _, el in ipairs(all) do
				local comps = e[el.Name]
				if comps and root then MoveElement(model, el.Inst, root.CFrame * CFrame.new(table.unpack(comps))) end
			end
			for _, el in ipairs(all) do
				if h[el.Name] then
					el.Inst:Destroy()
				else
					table.insert(visible, el)
				end
			end
			return all, visible
		end




		Remote=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CrackHubCosmetics")
		if Remote and not Remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then Remote=nil end
		local function Item(name)
			for _,entry in ipairs(CATALOG.Pets) do if entry.Name==name then return entry end end
		end
		local function Send(kind,name,element,components)
			local entry=Item(name)
			if kind=="Edit" and entry then PetParts:SetEdit(entry.Model,element,CFrame.new(table.unpack(components)))
			elseif kind=="ResetElement" and entry then PetParts:Reset(entry.Model,element)
			elseif kind=="Hide" and entry then PetParts:SetHidden(entry.Model,element,components)
			elseif kind=="ShowAll" and entry then PetParts:ShowAll(entry.Model)
			elseif kind=="ResetAll" then PetParts:ResetAll()
			elseif Remote then Remote:FireServer(kind,name,element,components) end
		end
		local function SetItemImage(img, uri)
			img.Image = uri
			local id = uri:match("rbxassetid://(%d+)")
			if not id then return end
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok = false
				pcall(function()
					game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({ img }, function(_, status)
						ok = status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success
					end)
				end)
				if not ok then img.Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. id .. "&w=420&h=420" end
			end)
		end

		local function FindTemplate(name)
			if Templates[name] then return Templates[name] end
			local entry=Item(name)
			if entry and not TemplateLoading[name] and not previewDestroyed then
				TemplateLoading[name]=true
				task.spawn(function()
					local ok,template,err=pcall(function() return Pet:GetRuntime(entry.Model):GetTemplate() end)
					TemplateLoading[name]=nil
					if previewDestroyed or Window.Destroyed then return end
					if ok and template then
						Templates[name]=template
						if PetPreview.TemplateReady then PetPreview.TemplateReady(name) end
					else Notify(tostring(ok and err or template)) end
				end)
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function PlayAnimations(model)
			table.clear(animTracks)
			local host = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AnimationController", true) or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid", true)
			if not host then return false end
			local animator = host:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator")
			animator.Parent = host
			local anims = {}
			for _, a in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if a:IsA("Animation") then table.insert(anims, a) end
			end

			table.sort(anims, function(x, y)
				local xi = x.Name:lower():find("idle") and 0 or 1
				local yi = y.Name:lower():find("idle") and 0 or 1
				return xi < yi
			end)
			if anims[1] then
				local ok, tr = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anims[1]) end)
				if ok and tr then
					tr.Looped = true
					tr:Play()
					table.insert(animTracks, tr)
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end

		local function ComputeFrame()
			if not Model then return end
			local box, size = Model:GetBoundingBox()
			Center = box.Position
			local half = math.rad(Camera.FieldOfView / 2)
			local vs = Viewport.AbsoluteSize
			local aspect = (vs.X > 1 and vs.Y > 1) and vs.X / vs.Y or 0.8
			local w = math.max(size.X, size.Z)
			local dV = (size.Y / 2 * 1.35) / math.tan(half)
			local dH = (w / 2 * 1.35) / (math.tan(half) * aspect)
			Distance = math.max(dV, dH) + w / 2
		end

		local function Build()
			for _, tr in ipairs(animTracks) do pcall(function() tr:Stop(0) end) end
			table.clear(animTracks)
			if previewDestroyed then return end
			if Model then Model:Destroy() end
			Model, MRoot, MElements = nil, nil, {}
			selected = nil
			if not current then return end
			local tpl = FindTemplate(current)
			if not tpl then
				StatusLbl.Text = "Loading…"
				StatusLbl.Visible = true
				return
			end
			StatusLbl.Visible = false
			local clone = tpl:Clone()
			for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("Sound") then d:Destroy() end
			end
			local root = RootOf(clone)
			if not root then clone:Destroy() return end
			clone.PrimaryPart = root
			local allEls, visibleEls = ApplyEdits(clone, current)
			MAll = allEls

			clone:PivotTo(root.CFrame:Inverse() * clone:GetPivot())
			local rig = clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Motor6D", true) and (clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AnimationController", true) or clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid", true))
			for _, p in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") then
					p.Anchored = (not rig) or p == root
					p.CanCollide = false
					p.CanTouch=false; p.CanQuery=true
				end
			end
			clone.Parent = World
			Model, MRoot = clone, root
			MElements = visibleEls
			local entry=Item(current)
			if entry and entry.Model==138822214304148 then
				local ok,track=pcall(function()return Pet:GetRuntime(entry.Model):StartPreviewAnimation(clone)end)
				if ok and track then table.insert(animTracks,track)end
			elseif rig then PlayAnimations(clone)end
			ComputeFrame()
			Viewport.ImageTransparency = 0.7
			Tween(Viewport, { ImageTransparency = 0 }, 0.35)
		end

		local function IndexOf(name)
			for i, it in ipairs(CATALOG.Pets) do
				if it.Name == name then return i end
			end
			return 1
		end

		local function PaintSeg()
			local i = IndexOf(current)
			TitleLbl.Text = current or "Pet Preview"
			local n = #CATALOG.Pets
			BackBtn.TextColor3 = n > 1 and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText
			FwdBtn.TextColor3 = n > 1 and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText

			TitleLbl.TextTransparency = 0.6
			Tween(TitleLbl, { TextTransparency = 0 }, 0.25)
			return i
		end

		local function Step(dir)
			local n = #CATALOG.Pets
			if n < 2 then return end
			local i = (IndexOf(current) - 1 + dir) % n + 1
			current = CATALOG.Pets[i].Name
			PaintSeg()
			Build()
		end
		BackBtn.Activated:Connect(function() Step(-1) end)
		FwdBtn.Activated:Connect(function() Step(1) end)
		PaintSeg()

		function PetPreview.Select(name)
			if current ~= name or not Model then
				current = name
				PaintSeg()
				Build()
			end
		end
		function PetPreview.OnEdits(name)
			if name == current then Build() end
		end

		function PetPreview.TemplateReady(name)
			if name==current and not previewDestroyed then Build() end
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			while not previewDestroyed and not Window.Destroyed and not (Window.Visible and Window.ActiveTab == PetsTab) do
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
			Build()
		end)
		-- preload all pet models so the cosmetics preview opens instantly
		task.spawn(function()
			-- pet models load only once you open the Pets tab (they are heavy)
			while not previewDestroyed and not Window.Destroyed and not (Window.Visible and Window.ActiveTab == PetsTab) do
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
			for _, it in ipairs(CATALOG.Pets) do
				if previewDestroyed or Window.Destroyed then return end
				FindTemplate(it.Name)
				local t0 = os.clock()
				while TemplateLoading[it.Name] and not previewDestroyed and os.clock() - t0 < 30 do task.wait(0.1) end
			end
		end)




		local Project; Project = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(p)
			local size = Viewport.AbsoluteSize
			local o = Camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p)
			local z = -o.Z
			if z <= 0.05 then return nil end
			local tanH = math.tan(math.rad(Camera.FieldOfView) / 2)
			local aspect = size.X / math.max(size.Y, 1)
			return Vector2.new((o.X / (z * tanH * aspect) + 1) * 0.5 * size.X, (1 - o.Y / (z * tanH)) * 0.5 * size.Y)
		end)

		local function MouseRay()
			local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset()
			local pos, size = Viewport.AbsolutePosition, Viewport.AbsoluteSize
			local px, py = (m.X - pos.X) / size.X, (m.Y - pos.Y) / size.Y
			local tanH = math.tan(math.rad(Camera.FieldOfView) / 2)
			local aspect = size.X / math.max(size.Y, 1)
			local dir = Vector3.new((px * 2 - 1) * tanH * aspect, (1 - py * 2) * tanH, -1).Unit
			return Camera.CFrame.Position, Camera.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(dir), px, py
		end

		local FindEl; FindEl = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(name)
			for _, e in ipairs(MElements) do
				if e.Name == name then return e end
			end
			return nil
		end)

		local ElBounds; ElBounds = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(inst)
			local parts = ElParts(inst)
			local mn, mx = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge), Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
			for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
				local cf, s = p.CFrame, p.Size / 2
				for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
					for _, sy in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
						for _, sz in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
							local w = cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(sx * s.X, sy * s.Y, sz * s.Z))
							mn = mn:Min(w)
							mx = mx:Max(w)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return mn, mx
		end)

		local function RayHitsEl(inst)
			if not inst then return false end
			local o, d = MouseRay()
			local params = RaycastParams.new()
			params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ElParts(inst)
			return World:Raycast(o, d * 200, params) ~= nil
		end

		local function Row(text, order, on, color, cb)
			local b = Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),

				BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 1,

				TextSize = 13,
				TextColor3 = color or (on and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText),
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
				Parent = b,
			})
			if on then
				Create("TextLabel", {
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
					Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16),
					BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					Text = "✓",
					FontFace = Fonts.Bold,

			end
			b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if not on then Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 }, 0.12) end end)
			b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if not on then Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.12) end end)
			b.Activated:Connect(cb)
		end

		local function SwitchRow(text, order, on, cb)
			local b = Create("TextButton", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),

				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Text = "",

			}, { Corner(6) })
			Create("TextLabel", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0),

				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = text,
				FontFace = Fonts.Medium,
				TextSize = 13,
				TextColor3 = on and Theme.Text or Theme.SubText,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
				Parent = b,
			})
			local sw = Create("Frame", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
				Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),

				Parent = b,
			}, { Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }) })
			Create("Frame", {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
				Position = on and UDim2.new(1, -15, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 13),
				BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
				Parent = sw,
			}, { Create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) }) })
			b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 }, 0.12) end)
			b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.12) end)
			b.Activated:Connect(cb)
		end

		function FillPop()
			for _, c in ipairs(PopList:GetChildren()) do
				if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
			end
			for mode, b in pairs(popSegBtns) do
				b.TextColor3 = mode == popMode and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Theme.SubText
			end
			Tween(PopSegPill, { Position = popMode == "Elements" and UDim2.fromOffset(2, 2) or UDim2.new(0.5, 2, 0, 2) }, 0.25)

			if popMode == "Parts" then
				PopTitle.Text = (current or "Pet") .. " · Parts"

				if #MAll == 0 then
					Row("No removable parts", 1, false, Theme.SubText, function() end)
				end
				local h = Hidden[current] or {}
				for i, e in ipairs(MAll) do
					local on = not h[e.Name]
					SwitchRow(e.Name, i, on, function()
						Hidden[current] = Hidden[current] or {}
						Hidden[current][e.Name] = on and true or nil
						Send("Hide", current, e.Name, on)
						if selected == e.Name then selected = nil end
						Build()
						FillPop()
					end)
				end
				if next(h) then
					Row("Restore all parts", #MAll + 1, false, Theme.Accent, function()
						Hidden[current] = nil
						Send("ShowAll", current)
						Build()
						FillPop()
					end)
				end
				return
			end

			PopTitle.Text = (current or "Pet") .. " · Elements"
			if #MElements == 0 then
				Row("No movable parts", 1, false, Theme.SubText, function() end)
			end
			for i, e in ipairs(MElements) do
				Row(e.Name, i, selected == e.Name, nil, function()
					selected = (selected ~= e.Name) and e.Name or nil
					if selected then spinVel = 0 end
					ClosePop()
				end)
			end
			local n = #MElements
			Row((snapSurface and "◉ " or "○ ") .. "Snap to surface", n + 1, false, Theme.Text, function()
				snapSurface = not snapSurface
				FillPop()
			end)
			if selected then
				Row("Reset “" .. selected .. "”", n + 2, false, Color3.fromRGB(255, 159, 10), function()
					if Edits[current] then Edits[current][selected] = nil end
					Send("ResetElement", current, selected)
					local keep = selected
					Build()
					selected = keep
					ClosePop()
				end)
				Row("Done", n + 3, false, Theme.Accent, function()
					selected = nil
					ClosePop()
				end)
			end
		end

		function PetPreview.OpenElements(at)
			if not Model then
				Notify("Pet is still loading…")
				return
			end
			FillPop()
			local scr = Window.Gui.AbsoluteSize
			local k = math.max(WinScale.Scale, 0.01)
			Pop.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
				math.clamp(at.X + 10, 6, scr.X - 210 * k - 6),
				math.clamp(at.Y + 10, 6, scr.Y - (#MElements * 30 + 140) * k - 6)
			)
			Pop.Visible = true
			popOpen = true
			popAnim.Value = 0
			TweenService:Create(popAnim, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Value = 1 }):Play()
		end






		local elDrag = nil

		local function ElCenter(inst)
			local mn, mx = ElBounds(inst)
			return (mn + mx) / 2, (mx - mn) / 2
		end

		local function PlaneHit(o, d, point, normal)
			local denom = d:Dot(normal)
			if math.abs(denom) < 1e-4 then return nil end
			return o + d * ((point - o):Dot(normal) / denom)
		end

		local function StartDrag(el)
			local o, d = MouseRay()
			local center, half = ElCenter(el.Inst)
			local n = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
			local grab = PlaneHit(o, d, center, n) or center
			elDrag = {
				El = el,
				StartPivot = ElPivot(el.Inst),
				StartCenter = center,
				Half = half,
				PlaneN = n,
				GrabOffset = center - grab,
				Target = ElPivot(el.Inst),
			}
		end

		local function UpdateDragTarget()
			if not elDrag or not Model or not MRoot then return end
			local o, d = MouseRay()
			local p = PlaneHit(o, d, elDrag.StartCenter, elDrag.PlaneN)
			if not p then return end
			local newCenter = p + elDrag.GrabOffset

			if snapSurface then

				local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
				local dir = (newCenter - camPos)
				if dir.Magnitude > 1e-3 then
					dir = dir.Unit
					local params = RaycastParams.new()
					params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
					params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ElParts(elDrag.El.Inst)
					local hit = World:Raycast(camPos, dir * 200, params)
					if hit then
						local h = elDrag.Half
						local ext = math.abs(dir.X) * h.X + math.abs(dir.Y) * h.Y + math.abs(dir.Z) * h.Z
						newCenter = hit.Position - dir * (ext * 0.5)
					end
				end
			end


			local lc = MRoot.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(newCenter)
			local _, size = Model:GetBoundingBox()
			if math.abs(lc.X) < size.X * 0.04 then lc = Vector3.new(0, lc.Y, lc.Z) end
			local maxR = size.Magnitude * 0.75
			if lc.Magnitude > maxR then lc = lc.Unit * maxR end
			newCenter = MRoot.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(lc)

			elDrag.Target = CFrame.new(newCenter - elDrag.StartCenter) * elDrag.StartPivot
		end

		local function FinishDrag()
			if not elDrag then return end
			local e, target = elDrag.El, elDrag.Target
			elDrag = nil
			if not MRoot or not e.Inst.Parent then return end
			MoveElement(Model, e.Inst, target)
			local localCF = MRoot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(ElPivot(e.Inst))
			Edits[current] = Edits[current] or {}
			Edits[current][e.Name] = { localCF:GetComponents() }
			Send("Edit", current, e.Name, { localCF:GetComponents() })
		end




		local AUTO = math.rad(35)
		angle, zoom, spinVel = 0, 1, AUTO
		local rotating, lastX, dragAccum, dragVel = false, 0, 0, 0
		local conns = {}

		table.insert(conns, DragArea.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			local el = selected and FindEl(selected)
			local grab = false
			if el then

				local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset()
				local function inside(g, pad)
					if not g.Visible then return false end
					local p, s = g.AbsolutePosition, g.AbsoluteSize
					return m.X >= p.X - pad and m.X <= p.X + s.X + pad and m.Y >= p.Y - pad and m.Y <= p.Y + s.Y + pad
				end
				grab = RayHitsEl(el.Inst) or inside(SelBox, 6) or inside(SelName, 4)
			end
			if el and grab then
				spinVel = 0
				StartDrag(el)
				return
			end
			rotating = true
			lastX = input.Position.X
			dragAccum, dragVel = 0, 0
		end))
		table.insert(conns, DragArea.MouseButton2Click:Connect(function()
			PetPreview.OpenElements(UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset())
		end))
		table.insert(conns, DragArea.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
				zoom = math.clamp(zoom - input.Position.Z * 0.1, 0.45, 2)
			end
		end))
		table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			if elDrag then
				UpdateDragTarget()
			elseif rotating then
				local d = math.rad((input.Position.X - lastX) * 0.8)
				lastX = input.Position.X
				angle += d
				dragAccum += d
			end
		end))
		table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			if elDrag then
				FinishDrag()
			elseif rotating then
				rotating = false
				local dir = dragVel < 0 and -1 or 1

				spinVel = math.abs(dragVel) > AUTO and math.clamp(dragVel, -AUTO * 12, AUTO * 12) or AUTO * dir
			end
		end))
		table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
				if popOpen then ClosePop() elseif selected then selected = nil end
				return
			end
			if popOpen and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
				local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset()
				local p, s = Pop.AbsolutePosition, Pop.AbsoluteSize
				if m.X < p.X or m.Y < p.Y or m.X > p.X + s.X or m.Y > p.Y + s.Y then ClosePop() end
			end
		end))

		ResetBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Tween(ResetBtn, { TextColor3 = Theme.Text }, 0.15) end)
		ResetBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			if os.clock() > resetArmed then Tween(ResetBtn, { TextColor3 = Theme.SubText }, 0.15) end
		end)
		ResetBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if os.clock() <= resetArmed then

				resetArmed = 0
				table.clear(Edits)
				table.clear(Hidden)
				Send("ResetAll")
				ResetBtn.Text = "Reset All"
				Tween(ResetBtn, { BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText }, 0.2)
				Build()
				Notify("All pet edits were reset.")
			else
				resetArmed = os.clock() + 2.5
				ResetBtn.Text = "Confirm?"
				Tween(ResetBtn, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 69, 58), TextColor3 = WHITE }, 0.2)
				task.delay(2.6, function()
					if not previewDestroyed and os.clock() > resetArmed then
						ResetBtn.Text = "Reset All"
						Tween(ResetBtn, { BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element, TextColor3 = Theme.SubText }, 0.2)
					end
				end)
			end
		end)


		local function SetCollapsed(state)
			collapsed = state
			if state then
				Tween(Viewport, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
				Tween(Divider, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
				Tween(Panel, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, HEADER) }, 0.32)
				task.delay(0.32, function() if collapsed then Body.Visible = false end end)
			else
				Body.Visible = true
				Body.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height - HEADER - 1)
				Tween(Panel, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height) }, 0.36)
				Tween(Divider, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, 0.2)
				task.delay(0.12, function() if not collapsed then Tween(Viewport, { ImageTransparency = 0 }, 0.3) end end)
			end
		end
		Light(Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 87), "×", 1, function()
			closed = true
			Tween(PanelScale, { Scale = 0 }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In).Completed:Connect(function()
				if closed then Panel.Visible = false end
			end)
		end)
		Light(Color3.fromRGB(254, 188, 46), "–", 2, function() SetCollapsed(not collapsed) end)
		Light(Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 64), "+", 3, function()
			if collapsed then return end
			zoomed = not zoomed
			local k = zoomed and 1.25 or 1
			width, height = math.floor(BASE_W * k), math.floor(BASE_H * k)
			Body.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height - HEADER - 1)
			Tween(Panel, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height) }, 0.35)
			task.delay(0.4, ComputeFrame)
		end)




		local currentDist = 10
		local wasShown = false
		table.insert(conns, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)

			local sc = WinScale.Scale
			local shown = (Window.Visible or Window.Transitioning) and not Window.Destroyed and not Window.Minimized and Root.Visible and sc > 0.01 and Window.ActiveTab == PetsTab
			if shown and not wasShown then closed = false end
			wasShown = shown
			if not closed then
				Panel.Visible = shown
				PanelScale.Scale = sc
			end
			if not shown then
				for _,track in ipairs(animTracks) do if track.Speed~=0 then track:AdjustSpeed(0) end end
				Panel.Visible=false; SelBox.Visible=false
				if popOpen then ClosePop() end
				return
			end
			for _,track in ipairs(animTracks) do if track.Speed==0 then track:AdjustSpeed(1) end end
			local p = Root.AbsolutePosition
			Panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X - width * sc - 12 * sc, p.Y)
			if popOpen and not shown then ClosePop() end
			if Pop.Visible then PopScale.Scale = sc * (0.9 + 0.1 * math.clamp(popAnim.Value, 0, 1)) end

			if not Panel.Visible or collapsed or not Model or not MRoot then
				SelBox.Visible = false
				return
			end


			if rotating then
				local v = dragAccum / math.max(dt, 1e-3)
				dragVel += (v - dragVel) * math.min(dt * 15, 1)
				dragAccum = 0
			elseif selected then
				spinVel += (0 - spinVel) * math.min(dt * 6, 1)
				angle += spinVel * dt
			else
				local target = AUTO * (spinVel < 0 and -1 or 1)
				spinVel += (target - spinVel) * math.min(dt * 2.5, 1)
				angle += spinVel * dt
			end
			currentDist += (Distance * zoom - currentDist) * math.min(dt * 12, 1)
			local offset = Vector3.new(math.sin(angle), 0.15, -math.cos(angle)) * currentDist
			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Center + offset, Center)


			if #animTracks == 0 and MRoot.Anchored and not selected and not elDrag then
				local y = math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.12
				Model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0, y, 0) * (MRoot.CFrame:Inverse() * Model:GetPivot()))
			end


			if elDrag and elDrag.Target and elDrag.El.Inst.Parent then
				local cur = ElPivot(elDrag.El.Inst)
				MoveElement(Model, elDrag.El.Inst, cur:Lerp(elDrag.Target, math.min(dt * 30, 1)))
			end


			local el = selected and FindEl(selected)
			if el and el.Inst.Parent then
				local mn, mx = ElBounds(el.Inst)
				local x0, y0, x1, y1 = math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
				local ok = true
				for _, sx in ipairs({ mn.X, mx.X }) do
					for _, sy in ipairs({ mn.Y, mx.Y }) do
						for _, sz in ipairs({ mn.Z, mx.Z }) do
							local s = Project(Vector3.new(sx, sy, sz))
							if not s then ok = false break end
							x0, y0 = math.min(x0, s.X), math.min(y0, s.Y)
							x1, y1 = math.max(x1, s.X), math.max(y1, s.Y)
						end
					end
				end
				if ok then
					local k = math.max(sc, 0.01)
					SelBox.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0 / k - 4, y0 / k - 4)
					SelBox.Size = UDim2.fromOffset((x1 - x0) / k + 8, (y1 - y0) / k + 8)
					SelName.Text = el.Name
					SelBox.Visible = true
				else
					SelBox.Visible = false
				end
				Hint.Text = "Drag “" .. el.Name .. "” to move · Esc — done"
			else
				SelBox.Visible = false
				Hint.Text = "Right-click the pet to edit parts"
			end
		end)))

		local function CleanupPreview()
			if previewDestroyed then return end
			previewDestroyed=true
			for _,track in ipairs(animTracks) do pcall(function() track:Stop(0) end) end
			if Model then Model:Destroy(); Model=nil end
			for _,c in ipairs(conns) do c:Disconnect() end
		end
		Window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(CleanupPreview)
		Window.Gui.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_,parent) if not parent then CleanupPreview() end end)
	end)()

	end

local function BuildCrackHubInventory(Window)
	local items = CrackHubEnvironment.__CrackHubJSONAsset("items.json")
	local importedAssets = CrackHubCreateInventoryAssets()
    local nativeItems = {}
    importedAssets:Extend(nativeItems)
	local autoInventory

	local Inventory = Window:CreateTab("Inventory")
	local controls = Inventory:AddGroup("Skin catalog", true)
	controls:AddLabel("Local cosmetic inventory. Images are shown first in every filter. Click a card to select a skin.")
	local search = controls:AddTextbox({Name = "Search", Placeholder = "Name or item ID", Bind = false})
	local category, rarity, page, query = "All", "All", 1, ""
	local selected, profile, profileOwned, originalOwned, originalEquipped = {}, nil, nil, {}, {}
	local connections, visuals, savedParts, grips, savedDecals, visualGuards = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local stopped, revision = false, 0
	local render, applyAll, scheduleImages
	local status = controls:AddLabel("Skins and effects are added to the local game inventory at startup.")
	local function connect(signal, fn)
		local c = signal:Connect(fn)
		table.insert(connections, c)
		return c
	end
	local function vec(v) return Vector3.new(v[1], v[2], v[3]) end
	local function cleanVisuals()
		for _, c in ipairs(visualGuards) do c:Disconnect() end
		table.clear(visualGuards)
		for _, object in ipairs(visuals) do pcall(function() object:Destroy() end) end
		table.clear(visuals)
		for part, old in pairs(savedParts) do
			pcall(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier = old.Local; part.Transparency = old.Transparency end)
		end
		table.clear(savedParts)
		for decal, old in pairs(savedDecals) do pcall(function() decal.Transparency = old end) end
		table.clear(savedDecals)
		for tool, grip in pairs(grips) do pcall(function() tool.Grip = grip end) end
		table.clear(grips)
	end
	local function getProfile()
		if profile then return profile end
		local storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
		local modules = storage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
		local module = modules and modules:FindFirstChild("ProfileData")
		if not module then return nil, "MM2 ProfileData is not available in this game." end
		local ok, result = pcall(require, module)
		if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.Weapons) ~= "table" or type(result.Weapons.Owned) ~= "table" or type(result.Weapons.Equipped) ~= "table" then
			return nil, "Could not read the local MM2 inventory."
		end
		profile, profileOwned = result, result.Weapons.Owned
		return profile
	end
	local function restore()
		revision += 1
		table.clear(selected)
		cleanVisuals()
		if profile then
			if profile.Weapons.Owned == profileOwned then
				for id, old in pairs(originalOwned) do
					if profileOwned[id] == old.Last then profileOwned[id] = old.Value end
				end
			end
			for kind, old in pairs(originalEquipped) do
				if old.Last == profile.Weapons.Equipped[kind] then
					profile.Weapons.Equipped[kind] = old.Value
				end
			end
		end
		table.clear(originalOwned)
		table.clear(originalEquipped)
	end
	local function findNative(item)
		local storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
		local object = storage:FindFirstChild(item.id, true)
		if not object then return nil end
		if object:IsA("BasePart") then return object end
		if object:IsA("Model") or object:IsA("Tool") then
			return object:FindFirstChild("Handle") or (object:IsA("Model") and object.PrimaryPart) or object:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		end
	end
	local function hidePart(part)
		if savedParts[part] == nil then
			savedParts[part] = {Local=part.LocalTransparencyModifier, Transparency=part.Transparency}
			for _, property in ipairs({"Transparency", "LocalTransparencyModifier"}) do
				table.insert(visualGuards,part:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(function()
					if savedParts[part] and part[property] ~= 1 then part[property] = 1 end
				end))
			end
		end
		part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
		part.Transparency = 1
	end
	local function hideOriginal(root)
		local objects = {root}
		for _, object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do table.insert(objects,object) end
		for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
			if object.Name ~= "CrackHubSkinVisual" and not object:FindFirstAncestor("CrackHubSkinVisual") then
				if object:IsA("BasePart") then
					hidePart(object)
				elseif object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") then
					if savedDecals[object] == nil then
						savedDecals[object] = object.Transparency
						table.insert(visualGuards,object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency"):Connect(function()
							if savedDecals[object] ~= nil and object.Transparency ~= 1 then object.Transparency=1 end
						end))
					end
					object.Transparency=1
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function makeTemplate(item)
		if item.Imported then
			local ok, model = pcall(function() return importedAssets:Template(item) end)
			if ok and model then return model end
		end
		local native = findNative(item)
		if native then
			local ok, copy = pcall(function() return native:Clone() end)
			if ok and copy then return copy end
		end
		if item.mesh == "" then return nil, "The source file has no mesh for this item, and no model was found in the game." end
		local part
		if item.meshpart then
			local done, result = false, nil
			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, created = pcall(function()
					return game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromUri(item.mesh))
				end)
				if done then
					if ok and created then created:Destroy() end
				elseif ok then result = created end
				done = true
			end)
			local deadline = os.clock() + 6
			while not done and not stopped and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait(0.05) end
			done = true
			part = result
			if not part then return nil, "This mesh could not be loaded by the client." end
			part.TextureID = item.texture
		else
			part = Instance.new("Part")
			local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
			mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
			mesh.MeshId = item.mesh
			mesh.TextureId = item.texture
			mesh.Scale = vec(item.scale)
			mesh.Parent = part
		end
		part.Size = vec(item.size)
		part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(item.color[1], item.color[2], item.color[3])
		pcall(function() part.Material = Enum.Material[item.material] end)
		return part
	end
	local function applyPart(host, template, item)
		if not host or not host.Parent then return end
		local root = host
		if host:IsA("Model") or host:IsA("Tool") then
			host = host:FindFirstChild("Handle") or (host:IsA("Model") and host.PrimaryPart) or host:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
		elseif not host:IsA("BasePart") then
			host = host:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
		end
		if not host then return end
		for _, object in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do
			if object.Name == "CrackHubSkinVisual" then return end
		end
		local clone = template:Clone()
		clone.Name = "CrackHubSkinVisual"
		local list, relative = {clone}, {}
		for _, object in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do table.insert(list, object) end
		for _, object in ipairs(list) do
			if object:IsA("BasePart") and object ~= clone then relative[object] = clone.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(object.CFrame) end
		end
		for _, object in ipairs(list) do
			if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or object:IsA("Sound") or object:IsA("Constraint") or object:IsA("JointInstance") then
				object:Destroy()
			elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
				object.Anchored, object.CanCollide, object.CanTouch, object.CanQuery = false, false, false, false
				object.Massless = true
				object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
			end
		end
		local tool = host:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool")
		if tool and item.kind == "Gun" then
			if grips[tool] == nil then grips[tool] = tool.Grip end
			if item.mesh:find("79401392", 1, true) then
				tool.Grip = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(0, -0.7, -0.3), Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.zAxis, -Vector3.yAxis)
			elseif item.mesh:find("6600918074", 1, true) then
				tool.Grip = CFrame.new(1, -0.36, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, -1, 0, 0)
			else
				tool.Grip = CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0.7)
			end
		end
		if tool then
			root = tool
		elseif root == host then
			local model = host:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
			if model and model ~= LocalPlayer.Character then root=model end
		end
		hideOriginal(root)
		clone.CFrame = host.CFrame
		for part, offset in pairs(relative) do
			part.CFrame = host.CFrame * offset
			local join = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			join.Part0, join.Part1 = clone, part
			join.Parent = clone
		end
		clone.Parent = host
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0, weld.Part1 = host, clone
		weld.Parent = clone
		table.insert(visuals, clone)
	end
		-- ===== CrackHub Gun inspect: F (same key as Russian "А") =====
		-- CS2-style look-around (right side, left side, top, muzzle, twirl), then the gun is tossed up,
		-- splits into its parts, hovers, reassembles and drops back into the hand. Press F again to cancel.
		local inspecting, inspectCancel = false, false
		local inspectEase; inspectEase = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(x) x = math.clamp(x, 0, 1); return x * x * (3 - 2 * x) end)
		local INSPECT_KEYS = {
			{0, CFrame.new()},
			{0.9, CFrame.new(0, 0.25, 0.3) * CFrame.Angles(0.25, 0, 0)},
			{2.4, CFrame.new(0, 0.3, 0.3) * CFrame.Angles(0.15, 0.6, 1.2)},
			{3.9, CFrame.new(0, 0.3, 0.3) * CFrame.Angles(0.15, -0.6, -1.2)},
			{5.3, CFrame.new(0, 0.35, 0.2) * CFrame.Angles(0.9, 0, 0)},
			{6.3, CFrame.new(0, 0.2, 0.2) * CFrame.Angles(-0.4, 0, 0)},
			{7.3, CFrame.new()},
		}
		local inspectPose; inspectPose = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(t)
			for i = 1, #INSPECT_KEYS - 1 do
				local a, b = INSPECT_KEYS[i], INSPECT_KEYS[i + 1]
				if t <= b[1] then
					local pose = a[2]:Lerp(b[2], inspectEase((t - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1])))
					if i == #INSPECT_KEYS - 1 then pose = pose * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.pi * 2 * inspectEase((t - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]))) end
					return pose
				end
			end
			return CFrame.new()
		end)
		local function inspectGun()
			if stopped then return end
			if inspecting then inspectCancel = true; return end
			local item = selected and selected.Gun
			if not item or item.id ~= "CrackHub_Gun" then return end
			local character = LocalPlayer.Character
			local tool = character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
			local handle = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			local visual = handle and handle:FindFirstChild("CrackHubSkinVisual")
			if not visual then return end
			local main
			for _, c in ipairs(visual:GetChildren()) do
				if c:IsA("WeldConstraint") and ((c.Part0 == handle and c.Part1 == visual) or (c.Part1 == handle and c.Part0 == visual)) then main = c end
			end
			if not main then return end
			inspecting, inspectCancel = true, false
			local base = handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(visual.CFrame)
			local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
			weld.Name, weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.C0 = "CrackHubInspect", handle, visual, base
			main.Enabled = false
			weld.Parent = visual
			local pivot = Vector3.new(0, 0.4, -0.85)
			local parts = {}
			for _, c in ipairs(visual:GetChildren()) do
				if c:IsA("WeldConstraint") and c ~= main and c.Part0 == visual and c.Part1 and c.Part1:IsA("BasePart") then
					local rel = visual.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(c.Part1.CFrame)
					local dir = rel.Position - pivot
					dir = dir.Magnitude > 0.05 and dir.Unit or Vector3.new(math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5, math.random() - 0.5).Unit
					local target = CFrame.new(rel.Position + dir * (1.2 + math.random() * 1.6))
						* CFrame.Angles((math.random() - 0.5) * 6, (math.random() - 0.5) * 6, (math.random() - 0.5) * 6) * rel.Rotation
					table.insert(parts, {c = c, p = c.Part1, rel = rel, target = target})
				end
			end
			local exploded = false
			local setParts; setParts = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(a)
				if not exploded then
					exploded = true
					for _, e in ipairs(parts) do
						e.c.Enabled = false
						local w = Instance.new("Weld")
						w.Name, w.Part0, w.Part1, w.C0 = "CrackHubInspectPart", visual, e.p, e.rel
						w.Parent = visual
						e.w = w
					end
				end
				for _, e in ipairs(parts) do e.w.C0 = e.rel:Lerp(e.target, a) end
			end)
			local place; place = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(pose, height, yaw)
				local up = base.Rotation:Inverse() * handle.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.yAxis)
				weld.C0 = base * CFrame.new(up * height) * CFrame.new(pivot) * pose * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.new(-pivot)
			end)
			local started = os.clock()
			local ok, err = pcall(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
				while not stopped and not inspectCancel and visual.Parent == handle and handle.Parent and tool.Parent == character do
					local t = os.clock() - started
					if t < 7.3 then
						place(inspectPose(t), 0, 0)
					elseif t < 8.2 then
						local a = inspectEase((t - 7.3) / 0.9)
						place(CFrame.new(), 3 * a, math.pi * 4 * a)
					elseif t < 9.6 then
						place(CFrame.new(), 3, (t - 8.2) * 1.2)
						setParts(inspectEase((t - 8.2) / 1.4))
					elseif t < 10.8 then
						place(CFrame.new(0, math.sin((t - 9.6) * 5) * 0.08, 0), 3, (t - 8.2) * 1.2)
						setParts(1)
					elseif t < 12.2 then
						place(CFrame.new(), 3, (t - 8.2) * 1.2)
						setParts(1 - inspectEase((t - 10.8) / 1.4))
					elseif t < 13.0 then
						local a = inspectEase((t - 12.2) / 0.8)
						place(CFrame.new(), 3 * (1 - a), (12.2 - 8.2) * 1.2 + math.pi * 2 * a)
					else
						break
					end
					RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
				end
			end))
			-- restore exactly, then hand control back to the original constraints
			pcall(function()
				weld.C0 = base
				for _, e in ipairs(parts) do
					if e.w then e.w.C0 = e.rel; e.c.Enabled = true; e.w:Destroy() end
				end
				main.Enabled = true
				weld:Destroy()
			end)
			if not ok then warn("[CrackHub Inspect] " .. tostring(err)) end
			inspecting, inspectCancel = false, false
		end
		CrackHub.InspectGun = function() task.spawn(inspectGun) end
		UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if stopped or input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.F or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
			task.spawn(inspectGun)
		end)
	local templates = {}
	local function getTemplate(item)
		if templates[item.kind] and templates[item.kind].Id == item.id then return templates[item.kind].Part end
		local part, err = makeTemplate(item)
		if not part then return nil, err end
		if stopped then part:Destroy(); return nil, "Inventory closed." end
		if templates[item.kind] then templates[item.kind].Part:Destroy() end
		templates[item.kind] = {Id = item.id, Part = part}
		return part
	end
	local applying, pending = false, false
	applyAll = function()
		if stopped then return end
		pending = true
		if applying then return end
		applying = true
		task.spawn(function()
			local success, failure = pcall(function()
			while pending and not stopped do
				pending = false
				local version = revision
				cleanVisuals()
				for _, kind in ipairs({"Knife", "Gun"}) do
					local item = selected[kind]
					if item then
						local template, err = getTemplate(item)
						if stopped or revision ~= version then pending = not stopped; break end
						if template then
							local char = LocalPlayer.Character
							local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
							for _, container in ipairs({char or false, backpack or false}) do
								if container then
									for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
										if tool:IsA("Tool") and (tool:GetAttribute("ItemType") == kind or tool.Name == kind) then
											applyPart(tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"), template, item)
										end
									end
									if container == char then
										local ref = char:FindFirstChild("DisplayRef" .. kind)
										if ref and ref:IsA("ObjectValue") then applyPart(ref.Value, template, item) end
										for _, name in ipairs({kind .. "Display", "Display" .. kind}) do
											local display = char:FindFirstChild(name)
											if display then applyPart(display, template, item) end
										end
									end
								end
							end
						else
							status:Set(item.name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
						end
					end
				end
			end
			end)
			applying = false
			if not success and not stopped then status:Set("Could not apply skin: " .. tostring(failure):sub(1,160)) end
		end)
	end
	local function rememberOwned(id, owned)
		if originalOwned[id] == nil then originalOwned[id] = {Value = owned[id], Last = owned[id]} end
		return originalOwned[id]
	end
	local function addAllSkins()
		if autoInventory then autoInventory.WeaponsEnabled = true; autoInventory:Grant() end
		local data, err = getProfile()
		if not data then status:Set(err); return end
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local owned = data.Weapons.Owned
			if owned[item.id] == nil then
				rememberOwned(item.id, owned).Last = 1
				owned[item.id] = 1
			end
		end
		status:Set("All " .. #items .. " catalog skins added to the local inventory.")
		if render then render() end
	end
	local function removeAllSkins()
		if autoInventory then autoInventory.WeaponsEnabled = false end
		local data, err = getProfile()
		if not data then status:Set(err); return end
		revision += 1
		table.clear(selected)
		cleanVisuals()
		local owned = data.Weapons.Owned
		for id in pairs(owned) do rememberOwned(id, owned).Last = nil end
		table.clear(owned)
		status:Set("Local inventory cleared. Restore original skins restores your starting inventory.")
		if render then render() end
	end
	local function selectItem(item)
		local data, err = getProfile()
		if not data then status:Set(err); return end
		local owned, equipped = data.Weapons.Owned, data.Weapons.Equipped
		local record = rememberOwned(item.id, owned)
		if owned[item.id] == nil then owned[item.id] = 1; record.Last = 1 end
		if originalEquipped[item.kind] == nil then originalEquipped[item.kind] = {Value = equipped[item.kind]} end
		originalEquipped[item.kind].Last = item.id
		equipped[item.kind] = item.id
		selected[item.kind] = item
		revision += 1
		status:Set("Selected " .. item.kind .. ": " .. item.name .. ". Local cosmetic only.")
		applyAll()
		if render then render() end
	end
	local rarities = {"All"}
	local seen = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do if not seen[item.rarity] then seen[item.rarity] = true; table.insert(rarities, item.rarity) end end
	table.sort(rarities, function(a,b) if a == "All" then return b ~= "All" elseif b == "All" then return false end return a < b end)
	controls:AddDropdown({Name = "Type", Options = {"All", "Knives", "Guns"}, Default = "All", Bind = false,
		Callback = function(v) category, page = v, 1; if render then render() end end})
	controls:AddDropdown({Name = "Rarity", Options = rarities, Default = "All", Bind = false,
		Callback = function(v) rarity, page = v, 1; if render then render() end end})
	controls:AddButton({Name = "Restore original skins", Bind = false, Callback = function()
		if autoInventory then autoInventory.WeaponsEnabled = false end
		restore(); status:Set("Original local inventory and skins restored."); if render then render() end
	end})
	controls:AddButton({Name = "Add all skins", Bind = false, Callback = addAllSkins})
	controls:AddButton({Name = "Remove all skins", Bind = false, Callback = removeAllSkins})
	local imageStatus = controls:AddLabel("Checking item pictures. Available pictures appear first.")
	local navigation = Create("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = NextOrder(), Parent = controls.Holder})
	local prev = Create("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(88,30), Text = "Previous", FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element, Parent = navigation}, {Corner(6)})
	local nextButton = Create("TextButton", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(1,0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(88,30), Text = "Next", FontFace = Fonts.Medium, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Theme.Text, BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Element, Parent = navigation}, {Corner(6)})
	local countLabel = Label({Size = UDim2.new(1,-190,1,0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(95,0), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextSize = 12, Text = "", Parent = navigation})
	local host = Create("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = NextOrder(), Parent = controls.Holder})
	local grid = Create("UIGridLayout", {CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8,8), CellSize = UDim2.new(0.25,-6,0,146), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Parent = host})
	local filtered, cards = {}, {}
	local PAGE_SIZE = 24
	local imageCache, imageQueue, imageQueued, imageTasks, imageProbes = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local scanIndex, imagesFound, imagesChecked, refreshPending = 1, 0, 0, false
	local provider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
	local liveWeapons
	local normalizeImage; normalizeImage = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(value)
		if type(value) == "number" then value = tostring(value) end
		if type(value) ~= "string" then return nil end
		value = value:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
		local id = value:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)") or value:match("^(%d+)$")
		if id then return "rbxassetid://" .. id end
		id = value:match("[?&]assetId=(%d+)") or value:match("[?&]assetid=(%d+)")
		if value:sub(1,11) == "rbxthumb://" then id = value:match("[?&]id=(%d+)") end
		if id then return "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. id .. "&w=150&h=150" end
		id = value:match("[?&]id=(%d+)")
		if id then return "rbxassetid://" .. id end
		if value:sub(1,11) == "rbxasset://" then return value end
	end)
	local imageInfo; imageInfo = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(item)
		local info = imageCache[item.id]
		if not info then info = {state="unknown"}; imageCache[item.id] = info end
		return info
	end)
	local imageSources; imageSources = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(item)
		local sources, seenSources = {}, {}
		local add; add = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(value)
			value = normalizeImage(value)
			if value and not seenSources[value] then seenSources[value]=true; table.insert(sources,value) end
		end)
		local live = liveWeapons and liveWeapons[item.id]
		if type(live) == "table" then add(live.Image); add(live.ImageID); add(live.ImageId) end
		add(item.image)
		if item.itemid and item.itemid ~= "" then add("rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. item.itemid .. "&w=150&h=150") end
		local imageID = tostring(item.image):match("[?&]id=(%d+)")
		if imageID then add("rbxassetid://" .. imageID) end
		return sources
	end)
	local function imageRank(item)
		local info = imageInfo(item)
		if info.state == "loaded" then return 0 end
		if info.state == "failed" then return 2 end
		return (item.image and item.image ~= "") and 1 or 3
	end
	local function picturesFirst(a,b)
        local ar,br=a.CatalogOrder or math.huge,b.CatalogOrder or math.huge
        if ar~=br then return ar<br end
        return a.id<b.id
    end	local requestImageRefresh; requestImageRefresh = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		if stopped or refreshPending then return end
		refreshPending = true
		task.delay(0.5,function()
			refreshPending=false
			if not stopped then
				imageStatus:Set(string.format("Pictures: %d available, %d/%d checked. Pictures appear first in all filters.", imagesFound, imagesChecked, #items))
				if Inventory.Active and Window.Visible and render then render() end
			end
		end)
	end)
	local checkImage; checkImage = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(item)
		local info = imageInfo(item)
		if info.state ~= "unknown" then return end
		info.state = "loading"
		local deadline = os.clock() + 7
		for _, source in ipairs(imageSources(item)) do
			if stopped or os.clock() >= deadline then break end
			local probe = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			probe.Image = source
			imageProbes[probe] = true
			local finished, success = false, false
			local thread = task.spawn(function()
				pcall(function()
					provider:PreloadAsync({probe},function(_,fetchStatus)
						if fetchStatus == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then success = true end
					end)
				end)
				finished=true
			end)
			imageTasks[thread] = true
			local attemptDeadline = math.min(deadline,os.clock()+2.5)
			while not finished and not stopped and os.clock() < attemptDeadline do task.wait(0.05) end
			if not finished then pcall(task.cancel,thread) end
			imageTasks[thread]=nil
			probe:Destroy(); imageProbes[probe]=nil
			if success then info.state="loaded"; info.image=source; imagesFound+=1; break end
		end
		if stopped then return end
		if info.state ~= "loaded" then info.state="failed" end
		imagesChecked+=1
		requestImageRefresh()
	end)
	scheduleImages = function(item)
		if imageInfo(item).state == "unknown" and not imageQueued[item.id] then
			imageQueued[item.id]=true
			table.insert(imageQueue,item)
		end
	end
	local rarityColors = {Common=Color3.fromRGB(180,180,190), Uncommon=Color3.fromRGB(90,195,225), Rare=Color3.fromRGB(85,140,255), Legendary=Color3.fromRGB(190,95,255), Godly=Color3.fromRGB(255,95,175), Ancient=Color3.fromRGB(190,90,240), Unique=Color3.fromRGB(255,165,60), Vintage=Color3.fromRGB(235,195,85)}
	render = function()
		if stopped then return end
		for _, card in ipairs(cards) do card:Destroy() end
		table.clear(cards); table.clear(filtered)
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local typeOK = category == "All" or (category == "Knives" and item.kind == "Knife") or (category == "Guns" and item.kind == "Gun")
			if typeOK and (rarity == "All" or item.rarity == rarity) and (query == "" or string.lower(item.name .. " " .. item.id):find(query,1,true)) then table.insert(filtered,item) end
		end
		table.sort(filtered,picturesFirst)
		local pages = math.max(1, math.ceil(#filtered / PAGE_SIZE))
		page = math.clamp(page,1,pages)
		countLabel.Text = string.format("%d items | %d / %d",#filtered,page,pages)
		prev.Active, nextButton.Active = page > 1, page < pages
		local first = (page-1)*PAGE_SIZE+1
		for index = first, math.min(#filtered, first+PAGE_SIZE-1) do
			local item = filtered[index]
			local active = selected[item.kind] == item
			local info = imageInfo(item)
			scheduleImages(item)
			local card = Create("TextButton", {Text="", AutoButtonColor=true, BackgroundColor3=Theme.Element, BorderSizePixel=0, LayoutOrder=index, Parent=host}, {Corner(8),Stroke(active and Theme.Accent or Theme.Stroke,active and 2 or 1,0.2)})
			local image = Create("ImageLabel", {Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,4), Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,88), BackgroundTransparency=1, Image=info.image or imageSources(item)[1] or "", ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Visible=info.state~="failed", Parent=card})
			if info.state == "failed" then Label({Text=string.upper(item.kind),TextSize=18,TextColor3=Theme.SubText,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(6,4),Size=UDim2.new(1,-12,0,88),Parent=card}) end
			Label({Text=item.name, TextSize=12, TextWrapped=true, TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Position=UDim2.fromOffset(5,92), Size=UDim2.new(1,-10,0,30), Parent=card})
			Label({Text=active and "Selected" or (item.kind .. " | " .. item.rarity), TextSize=10, TextColor3=rarityColors[item.rarity] or Theme.SubText, TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Position=UDim2.fromOffset(3,123), Size=UDim2.new(1,-6,0,18), TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent=card})
			card.Activated:Connect(function() selectItem(item) end)
			table.insert(cards,card)
		end
		host.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,math.ceil(#cards/4)*154)
	end
	connect(prev.Activated,function() if page > 1 then page -= 1; render() end end)
	connect(nextButton.Activated,function() if page*PAGE_SIZE < #filtered then page += 1; render() end end)
	connect(search.Box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"),function() query=string.lower(search.Box.Text); page=1; render() end)
	local watched = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
	local function watchObject(object)
		if watched[object] then return end
		watched[object]=true
		if object:IsA("Tool") then
			connect(object.ChildAdded,function(child) if child.Name == "Handle" then applyAll() end end)
		elseif object:IsA("ObjectValue") and (object.Name == "DisplayRefKnife" or object.Name == "DisplayRefGun") then
			connect(object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"),applyAll)
		end
	end
	local function watchContainer(container)
		if not container or watched[container] then return end
		watched[container]=true
		for _, object in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do watchObject(object) end
		connect(container.ChildAdded,function(object) watchObject(object); if object:IsA("Tool") or object:IsA("ObjectValue") then applyAll() end end)
		applyAll()
	end
	connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded,watchContainer)
	connect(LocalPlayer.ChildAdded,function(child) if child:IsA("Backpack") then watchContainer(child) end end)
	watchContainer(LocalPlayer.Character)
	watchContainer(LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))
	connect(Window.Gui.Destroying,function()
		stopped=true
		for thread in pairs(imageTasks) do pcall(task.cancel,thread) end
		for probe in pairs(imageProbes) do probe:Destroy() end
		restore()
		for _, c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end
		for _, cached in pairs(templates) do cached.Part:Destroy() end
		table.clear(templates)
	end)
	render()
    -- Fish: take every changer skin / effect out of the game inventory, and give them back after
    CrackHub.InventoryFishOff = function()
        if autoInventory then pcall(function() autoInventory:FishOff() end) end
        restore()
        if render then pcall(render) end
    end
    CrackHub.InventoryFishOn = function()
        if autoInventory then pcall(function() autoInventory:FishOn() end) end
        if render then pcall(render) end
    end
    autoInventory = CrackHubStartGameInventory(Window, nativeItems, importedAssets, {
        Profile = getProfile,
        Remember = function(id, owned) rememberOwned(id, owned).Last = 1 end,
        Select = selectItem,
        Reset = function(kind,key)
            selected[kind]=nil
            local data=getProfile()
            if data then data.Weapons.Equipped[kind]=key end
            revision+=1
            cleanVisuals()
            applyAll()
            if render then render() end
        end,
        Changed = function()
            if stopped then return end
            status:Set("Skins and effects are available in the local game inventory.")
            if render then render() end
        end,
    })
	task.spawn(function()
		local database = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Database")
		local sync = database and database:FindFirstChild("Sync")
		if sync then
			local ok, data = pcall(require,sync)
			if ok and type(data) == "table" and type(data.Weapons) == "table" then liveWeapons=data.Weapons end
		end
	end)
	for _ = 1,2 do
		task.spawn(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			while not stopped do
				while not stopped and (not Inventory.Active or not Window.Visible) do task.wait(0.3) end
				if stopped then break end
				local item = table.remove(imageQueue,1)
				if not item and scanIndex <= #items then item=items[scanIndex]; scanIndex+=1 end
				if not item then break end
				imageQueued[item.id]=nil
				checkImage(item)
				task.wait(0.03)
			end
		end))
	end
end

	-- ===================== FUN =====================

		-- loads a catalog asset (animation / emote / body part) once and remembers it
		local assetCache, failedAt = {}, {}
		local function LoadAsset(id)
			if assetCache[id] then return assetCache[id] end
			if failedAt[id] and os.clock() - failedAt[id] < 5 then return nil end
			local InsertService = game:GetService("InsertService")
			local tries = {
				function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. id) end,
				function() return game:GetObjects("https://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=" .. id) end,
				function()
					local get = getobjects or CrackHubEnvironment.getobjects
					if type(get) == "function" then return get("rbxassetid://" .. id) end
				end,
				function() return { InsertService:LoadLocalAsset("rbxassetid://" .. id) } end,
				function() return { InsertService:LoadAsset(id) } end,
			}
			for _, try in ipairs(tries) do
				local ok, objs = pcall(try)
				if ok and type(objs) == "table" and objs[1] then
					local holder = Instance.new("Folder")
					for _, o in ipairs(objs) do pcall(function() o.Parent = holder end) end
					if #holder:GetChildren() > 0 then
						assetCache[id] = holder
						return holder
					end
				end
			end
			failedAt[id] = os.clock()
			return nil
		end
		local function AnimIds(id)
			local list = {}
			if type(id) == "table" then
				for _, x in ipairs(id) do table.insert(list, "rbxassetid://" .. x) end
				return list
			end
			if not id or id == 0 then return list end
			local h = LoadAsset(id)
			if h then
				for _, d in ipairs(h:GetDescendants()) do
					if d:IsA("Animation") and d.AnimationId ~= "" then table.insert(list, d.AnimationId) end
				end
			end
			if #list == 0 then list[1] = "rbxassetid://" .. id end
			return list
		end

					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, 0), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, Parent = b })
				cards[it[1]] = { Button = b, Stroke = st, Label = l }
				b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.1 }, 0.12) end)
				b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() Tween(b, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 }, 0.12) end)
				b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() onClick(it) end)
			end
			return cards, grid
		end

		-- slot -> index in each pack's id list: Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, Fall, Climb, Swim
		local SLOTS = { "Idle", "Walk", "Run", "Jump", "Fall", "Climb", "Swim" }
		local packByName = {}
		local packNames = { "Default" }
		for _, p in ipairs(PACKS) do packByName[p[1]] = p; table.insert(packNames, p[1]) end
		local combo = {}
		for _, s in ipairs(SLOTS) do combo[s] = "Default" end
		local originals = {}
		local ANIMATE_KEYS = {
			Idle = { { "idle", "Animation1" }, { "idle", "Animation2" } },
			Walk = { { "walk", "WalkAnim" } },
			Run = { { "run", "RunAnim" } },
			Jump = { { "jump", "JumpAnim" } },
			Fall = { { "fall", "FallAnim" } },
			Climb = { { "climb", "ClimbAnim" } },
			Swim = { { "swim", "Swim" }, { "swimidle", "SwimIdle" } },
		}
		local applying = false
		local function ApplyCombo(silent)
			if applying then return end
			applying = true
			task.spawn(function()
				local hum, char = Hum()
				local animate = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
				if not hum or not animate then applying = false; return end
				if hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
					if not silent then Window:Notify({ Title = "Animations", Content = "Animation packs need an R15 avatar", Duration = 4 }) end
					applying = false
					return
				end
				for slot, keys in pairs(ANIMATE_KEYS) do
					local pack = packByName[combo[slot]]
					local ids = pack and AnimIds(pack[2][table.find(SLOTS, slot)]) or {}
					for k, key in ipairs(keys) do
						local folder = animate:FindFirstChild(key[1])
						local anim = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(key[2])
						if anim and anim:IsA("Animation") then
							local path = key[1] .. "/" .. key[2]
							if originals[path] == nil then originals[path] = anim.AnimationId end
							anim.AnimationId = ids[k] or ids[1] or originals[path]
						end
					end
				end
				-- restart the Animate script so the new set is used right away
				for _, t in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do t:Stop(0) end
				animate.Disabled = true
				task.wait()
				animate.Disabled = false
				applying = false
			end)
		end
		table.insert(Window.Connections, LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
			table.clear(originals)
			c:WaitForChild("Animate", 10)
			task.wait(0.5)
			for _, s in ipairs(SLOTS) do
				if combo[s] ~= "Default" then ApplyCombo(true); break end
			end
		end))

		local slotDD = {}
		local PG = AnimTab:AddGroup("Animation packs", true)
		local packCards
		packCards = Cards(PG, PACKS, function(p)
			for _, s in ipairs(SLOTS) do
				combo[s] = p[1]
				if slotDD[s] then slotDD[s]:Set(p[1], true) end
			end
			Mark(packCards, p[1])
			ApplyCombo()
		end, 150)
		local CG = AnimTab:AddGroup("Animation combo", true)
		for _, s in ipairs(SLOTS) do
			slotDD[s] = CG:AddDropdown({ Name = s, Options = packNames, Default = "Default", Flag = "FUN_Anim_" .. s,
				Callback = function(v) combo[s] = v or "Default"; Mark(packCards, nil); ApplyCombo() end })
		end
		CG:AddButton({ Name = "Reset to default", Callback = function()
			for _, s in ipairs(SLOTS) do combo[s] = "Default"; slotDD[s]:Set("Default", true) end
			Mark(packCards, nil)
			ApplyCombo()
		end })

		-- ---------- Fake Korblox / Headless (only you see them) ----------
		local AV2 = { Korblox = false, Headless = false }
		local hidden, korblox = {}, nil
		local function Restore()
			for obj, t in pairs(hidden) do if obj.Parent then obj.Transparency = t end end
			table.clear(hidden)
			if korblox then korblox:Destroy(); korblox = nil end
		end
		local function Hide(obj)
			if hidden[obj] == nil then hidden[obj] = obj.Transparency end
			obj.Transparency = 1
		end
		local KORBLOX_LEG = 139607718
		local function ApplyAvatar()
			Restore()
			local hum, char = Hum()
			if not char then return end
			if AV2.Headless then
				local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
				if head then
					Hide(head)
					for _, d in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
						if d:IsA("Decal") then Hide(d) end
					end
				end
			end
			if AV2.Korblox then
				task.spawn(function()
					local h = LoadAsset(KORBLOX_LEG)
					if not h or not AV2.Korblox or char ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
					korblox = Instance.new("Folder")
					korblox.Name = "CrackHubKorblox"
					local src = h:FindFirstChild("R15ArtistIntent", true) or h:FindFirstChild("R15Fixed", true) or h
					local made = false
					for _, n in ipairs({ "RightUpperLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "RightFoot" }) do
						local mine, mesh = char:FindFirstChild(n), src:FindFirstChild(n, true)
						if mine and mesh and mesh:IsA("BasePart") then
							local p = mesh:Clone()
							for _, d in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
								if not (d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") or d:IsA("DataModelMesh")) then d:Destroy() end
							end
							p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.Massless = false, false, false, false, true
							p.CFrame = mine.CFrame
							local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
							w.Part0, w.Part1 = p, mine
							w.Parent = p
							p.Parent = korblox
							Hide(mine)
							made = true
						end
					end
					local leg6 = char:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")
					if not made and leg6 then
						-- R6: thin dark bone leg
						local p = Instance.new("Part")
						p.Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 2, 0.35)
						p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
						p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
						p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.Massless = false, false, false, true
						p.CFrame = leg6.CFrame
						local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
						w.Part0, w.Part1 = p, leg6
						w.Parent = p
						p.Parent = korblox
						Hide(leg6)
					end
					korblox.Parent = workspace
				end)
			end
		end
		table.insert(Window.Connections, LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
			c:WaitForChild("Head", 10)
			task.wait(0.5)
			table.clear(hidden)
			if korblox then korblox:Destroy(); korblox = nil end
			if AV2.Korblox or AV2.Headless then ApplyAvatar() end
		end))
		Window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(Restore)
		local YawOnly; YawOnly = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(cf)
			local look = cf.LookVector
			return CFrame.new(cf.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z), 0)
		end)
