		local skinState = { Kind = nil, Value = nil }   -- "user" + userId, or "fun" + entry
		local removed, added, faceOld = {}, {}, nil
		local morph, morphConn, morphHidden = nil, nil, {}

		local function ClearMorph()
			if morphConn then morphConn:Disconnect(); morphConn = nil end
			if morph then morph:Destroy(); morph = nil end
			for obj, t in pairs(morphHidden) do if obj.Parent then obj.Transparency = t end end
			table.clear(morphHidden)
		end
		local function ClearOutfit()
			for _, o in ipairs(added) do if o.Parent then o:Destroy() end end
			table.clear(added)
			local _, char = Hum()
			for _, e in ipairs(removed) do
				if char and e[2] == char then pcall(function() e[1].Parent = char end) end
			end
			table.clear(removed)
			if faceOld and faceOld[1].Parent then faceOld[1].Texture = faceOld[2] end
			faceOld = nil
		end
		local function ClearSkin()
			ClearMorph()
			ClearOutfit()
		end

		local function AttachAccessory(char, acc)
			local handle = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if not (handle and handle:IsA("BasePart")) then return end
			for _, w in ipairs(handle:GetChildren()) do
				if w:IsA("JointInstance") or w:IsA("WeldConstraint") then w:Destroy() end
			end
			handle.Anchored, handle.CanCollide, handle.CanQuery, handle.CanTouch, handle.Massless = false, false, false, false, true
			local att = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
			local target
			if att then
				for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then
						local a = part:FindFirstChild(att.Name)
						if a and a:IsA("Attachment") then target = a; break end
					end
				end
			end
			acc.Parent = char
			local w = Instance.new("Weld")
			if target then
				w.Part0, w.Part1 = target.Parent, handle
				w.C0, w.C1 = target.CFrame, att.CFrame
			else
				local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
				if not head then return end
				w.Part0, w.Part1 = head, handle
				w.C0 = CFrame.new(0, head.Size.Y / 2 + handle.Size.Y / 2, 0)
			end
			w.Name = "AccessoryWeld"
			w.Parent = handle
		end

		-- someone else's outfit on your character (accessories, clothes, colours, face)
		local function WearUser(userId)
			local hum, char = Hum()
			if not hum then return end
			local ok, app = pcall(function() return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceAsync(userId) end)
			if not ok or not app then
				local okD, desc = pcall(function() return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(userId) end)
				if okD and desc then
					app = Instance.new("Model")
					local function grab(id, cls)
						if not id or id == 0 then return end
						local h = LoadAsset(id)
						local found = h and h:FindFirstChildWhichIsA(cls, true)
						if found then found:Clone().Parent = app end
					end
					for _, a in ipairs(desc:GetAccessories(true)) do grab(a.AssetId, "Accessory") end
					grab(desc.Shirt, "Shirt"); grab(desc.Pants, "Pants"); grab(desc.GraphicTShirt, "ShirtGraphic")
					local face = desc.Face ~= 0 and LoadAsset(desc.Face)
					local fd = face and face:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal", true)
					if fd then local c = fd:Clone(); c.Name = "face"; c.Parent = app end
					local bc = Instance.new("BodyColors")
					bc.HeadColor3, bc.TorsoColor3 = desc.HeadColor, desc.TorsoColor
					bc.LeftArmColor3, bc.RightArmColor3 = desc.LeftArmColor, desc.RightArmColor
					bc.LeftLegColor3, bc.RightLegColor3 = desc.LeftLegColor, desc.RightLegColor
					bc.Parent = app
					ok = true
				end
			end
			if not ok or not app then
				Window:Notify({ Title = "Skins", Content = "Couldn't load that avatar", Duration = 4 })
				return
			end
			if skinState.Kind ~= "user" or skinState.Value ~= userId or char ~= LocalPlayer.Character then app:Destroy(); return end
			ClearSkin()
			for _, d in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
				if d:IsA("Accessory") or d:IsA("Shirt") or d:IsA("Pants") or d:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or d:IsA("BodyColors") or d:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
					table.insert(removed, { d, char })
					d.Parent = nil
				end
			end
			for _, d in ipairs(app:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Accessory") then
					local c = d:Clone()
					table.insert(added, c)
					pcall(AttachAccessory, char, c)
				elseif (d:IsA("Shirt") or d:IsA("Pants") or d:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or d:IsA("BodyColors")) and d.Parent == app then
					local c = d:Clone()
					table.insert(added, c)
					c.Parent = char
				elseif d:IsA("CharacterMesh") and hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
					local c = d:Clone()
					table.insert(added, c)
					c.Parent = char
				elseif d:IsA("Decal") and d.Name == "face" then
					local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
					local myFace = head and head:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal")
					if myFace and not faceOld then
						faceOld = { myFace, myFace.Texture }
						myFace.Texture = d.Texture
					end
				end
			end
			app:Destroy()
		end

		-- an outfit of expensive limiteds on your own body
		local function WearOutfit(entry)
			local hum, char = Hum()
			if not hum then return end
			local items = {}
			for _, id in ipairs(entry[2]) do
				local h = LoadAsset(id)
				local acc = h and h:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accessory", true)
				if acc then table.insert(items, acc) end
			end
			local faceTex
			if entry[3] then
				local h = LoadAsset(entry[3])
				local d = h and h:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal", true)
				faceTex = d and d.Texture
			end
			if skinState.Kind ~= "outfit" or skinState.Value ~= entry or char ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
			if #items == 0 then
				Window:Notify({ Title = "Skins", Content = "Couldn't load “" .. entry[1] .. "”", Duration = 4 })
				return
			end
			ClearSkin()
			for _, d in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
				if d:IsA("Accessory") then
					table.insert(removed, { d, char })
					d.Parent = nil
				end
			end
			for _, acc in ipairs(items) do
				local c = acc:Clone()
				table.insert(added, c)
				pcall(AttachAccessory, char, c)
			end
			if faceTex then
				local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
				local myFace = head and head:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal")
				if myFace then
					faceOld = { myFace, myFace.Texture }
					myFace.Texture = faceTex
				end
			end
		end

		-- Tung Tung Tung Sahur built from parts (no download needed), with its own walk / idle animation
		local function BuildTung()
			local hum, char = Hum()
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not hrp then return end
			ClearSkin()
			local model = Instance.new("Model")
			model.Name = "CrackHubSkin"
			local WOOD, DARK, LIGHT = Color3.fromRGB(150, 104, 62), Color3.fromRGB(70, 44, 26), Color3.fromRGB(196, 154, 104)
			local pieces = {}
			local function P(size, color, mat, shape, base)
				local p = Instance.new("Part")
				p.Size = size
				p.Color = color
				p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Wood
				if shape then p.Shape = shape end
				p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanQuery, p.CanTouch, p.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, true
				p.TopSurface, p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth, Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
				p.Parent = model
				table.insert(pieces, { p, base })
				return p
			end
			local up = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
			-- body: the wooden log (feet at y = 0)
			P(Vector3.new(4.2, 2.2, 2.2), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, CFrame.new(0, 3.7, 0) * up)
			P(Vector3.new(0.12, 2.25, 2.25), DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, CFrame.new(0, 5.82, 0) * up)
			-- face
			for _, x in ipairs({ -0.45, 0.45 }) do
				P(Vector3.new(0.55, 0.55, 0.55), Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball, CFrame.new(x, 4.75, -0.98))
				P(Vector3.new(0.26, 0.26, 0.26), Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Enum.PartType.Ball, CFrame.new(x, 4.75, -1.2))
				P(Vector3.new(0.6, 0.12, 0.12), DARK, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, nil, CFrame.new(x, 5.15, -1.05) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(x < 0 and -18 or 18)))
			end
			P(Vector3.new(0.9, 0.16, 0.12), DARK, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, nil, CFrame.new(0, 4.15, -1.08))
			-- limbs (base pose; animated below)
			local armL = P(Vector3.new(1.8, 0.32, 0.32), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, nil)
			local armR = P(Vector3.new(1.8, 0.32, 0.32), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, nil)
			local legL = P(Vector3.new(1.7, 0.36, 0.36), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, nil)
			local legR = P(Vector3.new(1.7, 0.36, 0.36), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, nil)
			local bat = P(Vector3.new(3.2, 0.42, 0.42), LIGHT, Enum.Material.Wood, Enum.PartType.Cylinder, nil)
			-- hide your own body (locally)
			for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal")) and d.Transparency < 1 then
					morphHidden[d] = d.Transparency
					d.Transparency = 1
				end
			end
			model.Parent = workspace
			morph = model
			local list, cfs = {}, {}
			for i, pc in ipairs(pieces) do list[i] = pc[1] end
			local t, swing = 0, 0
			local limb; limb = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(pivot, angle, len, side)
				-- a cylinder hanging down from a pivot, rotated forward/back by angle
				return pivot * CFrame.Angles(angle, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -len / 2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
			end)
			morphConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
				if not hrp.Parent then return end
				t += dt
				local moving = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1
				local target = moving and 1 or 0
				swing += (target - swing) * math.min(dt * 8, 1)
				local speed = math.max(hum.WalkSpeed / 16, 0.6)
				local phase = math.sin(t * 9 * speed) * swing
				local feet = hrp.Position.Y - hrp.Size.Y / 2 - (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 and hum.HipHeight or 2)
				local look = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
				local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
				local bob = math.abs(math.sin(t * 9 * speed)) * 0.18 * swing + math.sin(t * 2) * 0.04 * (1 - swing)
				local root = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, feet + bob, hrp.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
				local tap = math.sin(t * 3) * 0.15 * (1 - swing)
				for i, pc in ipairs(pieces) do
					local p, base = pc[1], pc[2]
					local cf
					if base then
						cf = root * base
					elseif p == armL then
						cf = root * limb(CFrame.new(-1.2, 4.3, 0), -phase * 0.7, 1.8)
					elseif p == armR then
						cf = root * limb(CFrame.new(1.2, 4.3, 0), math.rad(-55) + phase * 0.4 + tap, 1.8)
					elseif p == legL then
						cf = root * limb(CFrame.new(-0.5, 1.65, 0), phase * 0.8, 1.7)
					elseif p == legR then
						cf = root * limb(CFrame.new(0.5, 1.65, 0), -phase * 0.8, 1.7)
					elseif p == bat then
						local hand = root * CFrame.new(1.2, 4.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-55) + phase * 0.4 + tap, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1.8, 0)
						cf = hand * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-70), 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 1.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
					end
					cfs[i] = cf
				end
				workspace:BulkMoveTo(list, cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
			end))
		end

		-- a fun model that walks in your place
		local R15_ANIMS = { Idle = "rbxassetid://507766666", Walk = "rbxassetid://507777826" }
		local R6_ANIMS = { Idle = "rbxassetid://180435571", Walk = "rbxassetid://180426354" }
		local function WearModel(entry)
			local hum, char = Hum()
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not hrp then return end
			local src
			for _, id in ipairs(entry[2]) do
				src = LoadAsset(id)
				if src then break end
			end
			if skinState.Kind ~= "fun" or skinState.Value ~= entry or char ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
			if not src then
				Window:Notify({ Title = "Skins", Content = "Couldn't load “" .. entry[1] .. "”", Duration = 4 })
				return
			end
			ClearSkin()
			local model = Instance.new("Model")
			model.Name = "CrackHubSkin"
			for _, o in ipairs(src:GetChildren()) do o:Clone().Parent = model end
			local animFolder = {}
			for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or d:IsA("Sound") or d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or d:IsA("ClickDetector") or d:IsA("BillboardGui") then
					d:Destroy()
				elseif d:IsA("Animation") then
					table.insert(animFolder, d)
				end
			end
			local parts = {}
			for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("BasePart") then
					d.CanCollide, d.CanQuery, d.CanTouch, d.Massless = false, false, false, true
					table.insert(parts, d)
				end
			end
			if #parts == 0 then model:Destroy(); return end
			local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart", true)
			if not root then
				for _, p in ipairs(parts) do if not root or p.Size.Magnitude > root.Size.Magnitude then root = p end end
			end
			model.PrimaryPart = root
			-- scale to about the size of a player (only visible parts count)
			local function VisibleSpan()
				local lo, hi = math.huge, -math.huge
				for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
					if p.Transparency < 0.95 then
						local cf, hs = p.CFrame, p.Size / 2
						local ext = math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y) * hs.X + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y) * hs.Y + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y) * hs.Z
						lo = math.min(lo, cf.Position.Y - ext)
						hi = math.max(hi, cf.Position.Y + ext)
					end
				end
				if lo == math.huge then
					local cf, sz = model:GetBoundingBox()
					return cf.Position.Y - sz.Y / 2, cf.Position.Y + sz.Y / 2
				end
				return lo, hi
			end
			local lo0, hi0 = VisibleSpan()
			if hi0 - lo0 > 0.1 then pcall(function() model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * (5.6 / (hi0 - lo0))) end) end
			-- rigged (Motor6D) models animate, others are welded together
			local rigged = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Motor6D", true) ~= nil
			for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
				if p ~= root then
					if rigged then
						p.Anchored = false
					else
						p.Anchored = false
						local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint"); w.Part0, w.Part1 = p, root; w.Parent = p
					end
				end
			end
			root.Anchored = true
			local mHum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local isR15 = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso", true) ~= nil
			local isR6 = model:FindFirstChild("Torso", true) ~= nil and model:FindFirstChild("Left Arm", true) ~= nil
			if mHum then mHum:Destroy() end
			local tracks = {}
			if rigged then
				local ctrl = Instance.new("AnimationController")
				ctrl.Parent = model
				local animator = Instance.new("Animator")
				animator.Parent = ctrl
				local function load(id)
					local a = Instance.new("Animation"); a.AnimationId = id
					local ok, t = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(a) end)
					if ok and t then t.Looped = true; return t end
				end
				for _, a in ipairs(animFolder) do
					local n = a.Name:lower()
					if (n:find("walk") or n:find("run")) and not tracks.Walk then tracks.Walk = load(a.AnimationId)
					elseif n:find("idle") and not tracks.Idle then tracks.Idle = load(a.AnimationId) end
				end
				local set = isR15 and R15_ANIMS or (isR6 and R6_ANIMS) or nil
				if set then
					tracks.Walk = tracks.Walk or load(set.Walk)
					tracks.Idle = tracks.Idle or load(set.Idle)
				end
			end
			-- feet on the ground: offset from the model's bottom to its root
			local lo1 = VisibleSpan()
			local rootFromBottom = root.Position.Y - lo1
			local yawFix = YawOnly(root.CFrame):ToObjectSpace(root.CFrame)
			-- hide your own body (locally)
			for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Decal")) and d.Transparency < 1 then
					morphHidden[d] = d.Transparency
					d.Transparency = 1
				end
			end
			model.Parent = workspace
			morph = model
			local playing, t = nil, 0
			morphConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
				if not hrp.Parent or not root.Parent then return end
				t += dt
				local moving = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1
				local feet = hrp.Position.Y - hrp.Size.Y / 2 - (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 and hum.HipHeight or 2)
				local base = YawOnly(hrp.CFrame)
				local bob = 0
				if not rigged and moving then bob = math.abs(math.sin(t * 9)) * 0.35 end
				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(base.X, feet + rootFromBottom + bob, base.Z) * base.Rotation * yawFix
				if rigged then
					local want = moving and (tracks.Walk or tracks.Idle) or (tracks.Idle or tracks.Walk)
					if want and want ~= playing then
						if playing then playing:Stop(0.2) end
						want:Play(0.2)
						playing = want
					end
					if playing == tracks.Walk and tracks.Walk then tracks.Walk:AdjustSpeed(math.max(hum.WalkSpeed / 16, 0.5)) end
				end
			end))
		end

		local function ApplySkin()
			local kind, value = skinState.Kind, skinState.Value
			if not kind then ClearSkin(); return end
			task.spawn(function()
				if kind == "user" then WearUser(value)
				elseif kind == "outfit" then WearOutfit(value)
				elseif value[2] == "builtin" then BuildTung()
				else WearModel(value) end
			end)
		end
		table.insert(Window.Connections, LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
			ClearMorph()
			table.clear(removed); table.clear(added); faceOld = nil
			c:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
			task.wait(1)
			if skinState.Kind then ApplySkin() end
		end))
		Window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(ClearSkin)

		local Pick = SkinsTab:AddGroup("Skins", true)
		local sections = {}
		local function ShowSection(name)
			for n, g in pairs(sections) do
				local card = g.Holder.Parent and g.Holder.Parent.Parent
				if card then card.Visible = (n == name) end
			end
		end
		Pick:AddDropdown({ Name = "Category", Options = { "Custom", "Creators", "Limiteds", "Fun" }, Default = "Creators",
			Callback = function(v) ShowSection(v or "Creators") end })
		local SG = SkinsTab:AddGroup("Custom skin", true)
		sections.Custom = SG
		local idBox = SG:AddTextbox({ Name = "User ID or username", Placeholder = "e.g. 156 or builderman" })
		local creatorCards, funCards
		local function UseUser(input, label)
			task.spawn(function()
				local id = tonumber(input)
				if not id then
					local ok, res = pcall(function() return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(input) end)
					id = ok and res or nil
				end
				if not id then
					Window:Notify({ Title = "Skins", Content = "Player “" .. tostring(input) .. "” not found", Duration = 4 })
					return
				end
				skinState.Kind, skinState.Value = "user", id
				if creatorCards then Mark(creatorCards, label) end
				if funCards then Mark(funCards, nil) end
				ApplySkin()
			end)
		end
		SG:AddButton({ Name = "Apply skin", Style = "Primary", Callback = function()
			local v = (idBox.Value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
			if v ~= "" then UseUser(v, nil) end
		end })
		SG:AddButton({ Name = "Remove skin", Callback = function()
			skinState.Kind, skinState.Value = nil, nil
			if creatorCards then Mark(creatorCards, nil) end
			if funCards then Mark(funCards, nil) end
			ClearSkin()
		end })

		local richCards
		local CRG = SkinsTab:AddGroup("Creators", true)
		sections.Creators = CRG
		richCards = Cards(CRG, RICH, function(it)
			UseUser(tostring(it[2]), nil)
			Mark(richCards, it[1])
			if creatorCards then Mark(creatorCards, nil) end
		end, 132)
		local LG = SkinsTab:AddGroup("Limiteds", true)
		sections.Limiteds = LG
		creatorCards = Cards(LG, CREATORS, function(it)
			skinState.Kind, skinState.Value = "outfit", it
			Mark(creatorCards, it[1])
			Mark(richCards, nil)
			if funCards then Mark(funCards, nil) end
			ApplySkin()
		end, 170)

		local FG = SkinsTab:AddGroup("Fun", true)
		sections.Fun = FG
		funCards = Cards(FG, FUN_SKINS, function(it)
			skinState.Kind, skinState.Value = "fun", it
			Mark(funCards, it[1])
			Mark(creatorCards, nil)
			ApplySkin()
		end, 170)
		ShowSection("Creators")

		local AG = AvatarTab:AddGroup("Fake items", true)
		AG:AddToggle({ Name = "Korblox leg", Default = false, Flag = "FUN_Korblox",
			Callback = function(v) AV2.Korblox = v; ApplyAvatar() end })
		AG:AddToggle({ Name = "Headless", Default = false, Flag = "FUN_Headless",
			Callback = function(v) AV2.Headless = v; ApplyAvatar() end })
	end

	local SettingsGroup = Window:CreateTabGroup("Settings")
	local Settings = SettingsGroup:CreateTab("General")
	local ThemesTab = SettingsGroup:CreateTab("Themes")
	local Look = Settings:AddGroup("Appearance")
	Look:AddSlider({ Name = "Window transparency", Min = 0, Max = 90, Default = 0, Suffix = "%", Flag = "WinTransparency",
		Callback = function(v) Window:SetTransparency(v / 100) end })
	Look:AddSlider({ Name = "Background blur", Min = 0, Max = 40, Default = 14, Flag = "WinBlur",
		Callback = function(v) Window:SetBlur(v) end })

	-- Themes: presets + your own saved themes (Settings > Themes)
	do
		local HttpSvc = game:GetService("HttpService")
		local THEME_FILE = "CrackHub_Themes.json"
		local KEYS = { "Background", "Sidebar", "Element", "Card", "ElementHover", "Stroke", "Text", "SubText", "Accent", "Accent2", "Danger", "Success", "ToggleOn" }
		local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local function Derive(bg, accent, accent2, text)
			return {
				Background = bg,
				Sidebar = bg:Lerp(WHITE, 0.03),
				Element = bg:Lerp(accent, 0.10):Lerp(WHITE, 0.06),
				Card = bg:Lerp(accent, 0.05):Lerp(WHITE, 0.03),
				ElementHover = bg:Lerp(accent, 0.16):Lerp(WHITE, 0.10),
				Stroke = bg:Lerp(accent, 0.22):Lerp(WHITE, 0.10),
				Text = text,
				SubText = text:Lerp(bg, 0.38),
				Accent = accent,
				Accent2 = accent2,
				Danger = Color3.fromRGB(255, 88, 118),
				Success = accent,
				ToggleOn = accent,
			}
		end
		local base = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(KEYS) do base[k] = Theme[k] or Theme.Accent end
		local RGB = Color3.fromRGB
		local PRESETS = {
			{ "CrackHub", base },
			{ "Halloween", Derive(RGB(14, 9, 6), RGB(255, 122, 20), RGB(160, 70, 255), RGB(255, 238, 220)) },
			{ "Ocean", Derive(RGB(8, 14, 24), RGB(40, 170, 255), RGB(40, 230, 200), RGB(230, 242, 255)) },
			{ "Emerald", Derive(RGB(8, 18, 14), RGB(40, 220, 130), RGB(40, 190, 230), RGB(230, 250, 240)) },
			{ "Sakura", Derive(RGB(22, 12, 18), RGB(255, 110, 180), RGB(255, 180, 120), RGB(255, 238, 246)) },
			{ "Crimson", Derive(RGB(18, 8, 10), RGB(255, 60, 80), RGB(255, 140, 60), RGB(255, 236, 238)) },
			{ "Midnight", Derive(RGB(12, 13, 18), RGB(120, 140, 255), RGB(160, 170, 200), RGB(235, 238, 248)) },
			{ "Sunset", Derive(RGB(20, 11, 14), RGB(255, 120, 70), RGB(255, 70, 150), RGB(255, 240, 232)) },
		}
		local presetByName = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(PRESETS) do presetByName[p[1]] = p[2] end

		-- saved data: { Active = "Name", Custom = { { Name, Bg, Accent, Accent2, Text }, ... } }
		local saved = { Active = "Halloween", Custom = {} }
		local function hex(c) return c:ToHex() end
		local function unhex(h) local ok, c = pcall(Color3.fromHex, h); return ok and c or nil end
		pcall(function()
			if isfile and readfile and isfile(THEME_FILE) then
				local data = HttpSvc:JSONDecode(readfile(THEME_FILE))
				if type(data) == "table" then
					if type(data.Active) == "string" then saved.Active = data.Active end
					if type(data.Custom) == "table" then saved.Custom = data.Custom end
				end
			end
		end)
		local function Save()
			pcall(function() if writefile then writefile(THEME_FILE, HttpSvc:JSONEncode(saved)) end end)
		end
		local function CustomEntry(name)
			for i, c in ipairs(saved.Custom) do if c.Name == name then return c, i end end
		end
		local function PaletteOf(name)
			if presetByName[name] then return presetByName[name] end
			local c = CustomEntry(name)
			if c then
				local bg, a, a2, t = unhex(c.Bg), unhex(c.Accent), unhex(c.Accent2), unhex(c.Text)
				if bg and a and a2 and t then return Derive(bg, a, a2, t) end
			end
		end
		local function Names()
			local list = {}
			for _, p in ipairs(PRESETS) do table.insert(list, p[1]) end
			for _, c in ipairs(saved.Custom) do table.insert(list, c.Name) end
			return list
		end

		-- recolour everything already on screen: old palette colour -> new palette colour
		local floor = math.floor
		local function key(c) return floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5) * 65536 + floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5) * 256 + floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5) end
		local Grid
		local function ApplyPalette(pal)
			local map = {}
			for _, k in ipairs(KEYS) do
				local old, new = Theme[k], pal[k]
				if typeof(old) == "Color3" and typeof(new) == "Color3" and map[key(old)] == nil then map[key(old)] = new end
			end
			for _, d in ipairs(Window.Gui:GetDescendants()) do
				if Grid and d:IsDescendantOf(Grid) then
					-- theme previews keep their own colours
				elseif d:IsA("GuiObject") then
					local n = map[key(d.BackgroundColor3)]
					if n then d.BackgroundColor3 = n end
					if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox") then
						n = map[key(d.TextColor3)]
						if n then d.TextColor3 = n end
						if d:IsA("TextBox") then
							n = map[key(d.PlaceholderColor3)]
							if n then d.PlaceholderColor3 = n end
						end
					elseif d:IsA("ImageLabel") or d:IsA("ImageButton") then
						n = map[key(d.ImageColor3)]
						if n then d.ImageColor3 = n end
					end
					if d:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
						n = map[key(d.ScrollBarImageColor3)]
						if n then d.ScrollBarImageColor3 = n end
					end
				elseif d:IsA("UIStroke") then
					local n = map[key(d.Color)]
					if n then d.Color = n end
				elseif d:IsA("UIGradient") then
					local kps, changed = {}, false
					for _, kp in ipairs(d.Color.Keypoints) do
						local n = map[key(kp.Value)]
						if n then changed = true end
						table.insert(kps, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, n or kp.Value))
					end
					if changed then d.Color = ColorSequence.new(kps) end
				end
			end
			for _, k in ipairs(KEYS) do Theme[k] = pal[k] end
		end

		local G = ThemesTab:AddGroup("Theme", true)
		local AccentCP, Accent2CP, BgCP, TextCP, NameBox
		local suppress = false
		local RebuildGrid
		local function SyncEditor(pal)
			suppress = true
			if AccentCP then AccentCP:Set(pal.Accent, true) end
			if Accent2CP then Accent2CP:Set(pal.Accent2, true) end
			if BgCP then BgCP:Set(pal.Background, true) end
			if TextCP then TextCP:Set(pal.Text, true) end
			suppress = false
		end
		local function Use(name)
			local pal = PaletteOf(name)
			if not pal then return end
			ApplyPalette(pal)
			SyncEditor(pal)
			saved.Active = name
			Save()
			if RebuildGrid then RebuildGrid() end
		end

		Grid = Create("Frame", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			LayoutOrder = 1,
			Parent = G.Holder,
		}, {
			Padding(4, 0, 6, 0),
			Create("UIGridLayout", {
				CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(122, 84),
				CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),
				SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			}),
		})
		-- one theme preview: a tiny window painted in that theme's colours
		local function Swatch(order, name, pal)
			local active = saved.Active == name
			local card = Create("TextButton", {
				BackgroundColor3 = pal.Background,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Text = "",
				LayoutOrder = order,
				ClipsDescendants = true,
				Parent = Grid,
			}, { Corner(10) })
			local st = Create("UIStroke", {
				Color = active and pal.Accent or pal.Stroke,
				Thickness = active and 2 or 1,
				Transparency = active and 0 or 0.2,
				ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
				Parent = card,
			})
			Create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = pal.Sidebar, BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = card })
			for r = 0, 2 do
				Create("Frame", {
					Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 10 + r * 10),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 5),
					BackgroundColor3 = r == 0 and pal.Accent or pal.Element,
					BorderSizePixel = 0,
					Parent = card,
				}, { Corner(2) })
			end
			Create("Frame", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 10),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 6),
				BackgroundColor3 = WHITE,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Parent = card,
			}, { Corner(3), Create("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(pal.Accent, pal.Accent2) }) })
			Create("Frame", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 22),
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 26),
				BackgroundColor3 = pal.Card,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				Parent = card,
			}, {

			})

		function RebuildGrid()
			for _, c in ipairs(Grid:GetChildren()) do
				if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
			end
			local n = 0
			for _, p in ipairs(PRESETS) do n += 1; Swatch(n, p[1], p[2]) end
			for _, c in ipairs(saved.Custom) do
				local pal = PaletteOf(c.Name)
				if pal then n += 1; Swatch(n, c.Name, pal) end
			end
		end

		G = ThemesTab:AddGroup("Custom theme", true)
		local liveQueued, lastLive = false, 0
		local function Live()
			if suppress or not (AccentCP and Accent2CP and BgCP and TextCP) then return end
			if liveQueued then return end
			liveQueued = true
			task.delay(math.max(0.2 - (os.clock() - lastLive), 0.05), function()
				liveQueued = false
				lastLive = os.clock()
				if suppress then return end
				ApplyPalette(Derive(BgCP.Value, AccentCP.Value, Accent2CP.Value, TextCP.Value))
			end)
		end
		AccentCP = G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Accent", Default = Theme.Accent, Callback = Live })
		Accent2CP = G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Accent 2", Default = Theme.Accent2, Callback = Live })
		BgCP = G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Background", Default = Theme.Background, Callback = Live })
		TextCP = G:AddColorPicker({ Name = "Text", Default = Theme.Text, Callback = Live })

			local name = (NameBox.Value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
			if name == "" then name = "Theme " .. (#saved.Custom + 1) end
			if presetByName[name] then
				Window:Notify({ Title = "Themes", Content = "“" .. name .. "” is a built-in theme, pick another name", Duration = 4 })
				return
			end
			local entry = CustomEntry(name)
			if not entry then entry = { Name = name }; table.insert(saved.Custom, entry) end
			entry.Bg, entry.Accent, entry.Accent2, entry.Text = hex(BgCP.Value), hex(AccentCP.Value), hex(Accent2CP.Value), hex(TextCP.Value)
			saved.Active = name
			Save()
			RebuildGrid()
			Window:Notify({ Title = "Themes", Content = "Saved “" .. name .. "”", Duration = 3 })
		end })
		G:AddButton({ Name = "Delete selected theme", Callback = function()
			local name = saved.Active
			local _, idx = CustomEntry(name or "")
			if not idx then
				Window:Notify({ Title = "Themes", Content = "Built-in themes can't be deleted", Duration = 3 })
				return
			end
			table.remove(saved.Custom, idx)
			Use("CrackHub")
			Window:Notify({ Title = "Themes", Content = "Deleted “" .. name .. "”", Duration = 3 })
		end })

			else

				RebuildGrid()
			end
		end)

	do

		do
			local used = {}
			for _, id in ipairs(CLICK_IDS) do
				if not used[id] then
					used[id] = true
					local name = "Sound " .. (#NAMES + 1)
					local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
					snd.Name = "CrackHubClick_" .. id
					snd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. id

					SOUNDS[name] = snd
					table.insert(NAMES, name)
				end
			end

			task.spawn(function()

			end)
		end

		local lastPlay = 0
		local function PlayClick(on)
			if not SV.Enabled then return end

			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastPlay < 0.06 then return end
			lastPlay = now
			local src = SOUNDS[SV.Sound] or SOUNDS[NAMES[1]]
			if not src then return end
			local s = src:Clone()
			s.Volume = SV.Volume / 100 * 2
			s.PlaybackSpeed = SV.Pitch and (on and 1.08 or 0.92) or 1
			s.Parent = SoundService
			s:Play()
			s.Ended:Connect(function() s:Destroy() end)
			task.delay(5, function() if s.Parent then s:Destroy() end end)
		end

			Callback = function(v)

				lastPlay = 0
				PlayClick(true)
			end })
		G:AddSlider({ Name = "Volume", Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = SV.Volume, Suffix = "%", Flag = "SET_ClickVolume",

					obj.Set = function(self, v, silent)

	local EspGui = Create("ScreenGui", {
		Name = "CrackHubESP",
		ResetOnSpawn = false,
		IgnoreGuiInset = true,
		DisplayOrder = 50,
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,

	local Drawers, Highs, seen = {}, {}, {}
	local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
	rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	local CleanTarget; CleanTarget = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(model)
		Combat:DropChams(model)
		if Drawers[model] then Drawers[model]:Destroy(); Drawers[model] = nil end
		if Highs[model] then Highs[model]:Destroy(); Highs[model] = nil end
	end)

	local HandleTarget; HandleTarget = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(model, plr, cam, project, from)
		local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local hrp = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
		if not (hum and hrp) or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
		local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
		local dist = (camPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude
		if dist > S.MaxDistance then return end
		seen[model] = true

		local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local override
		if S.TeamColor and plr and plr.Team then override = plr.TeamColor.Color end
		local chamVisible = true
		if S.VisibleCheck or S.Chams then
			rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { model, LocalPlayer.Character }
			local target = (head or hrp).Position
			chamVisible = workspace:Raycast(camPos, target - camPos, rayParams) == nil
			if S.VisibleCheck and chamVisible then override = S.VisibleColor end
		end

		local role = GetRole(plr)
		local roleColor = S.Roles and RoleColor(role) or nil
		if roleColor then override = roleColor end


		Combat:ApplyChams(model, plr, cam, role, dist, chamVisible)

		local d = Drawers[model]
		if not d then
			d = Drawer.new(EspGui)
			Drawers[model] = d
		end
		if S.Skeleton and (not d.Pairs or os.clock() - (d.PairsAt or 0) > 3) then
			d.Pairs = GetBonePairs(model)
			d.PairsAt = os.clock()
		end

		local tool = S.Tool and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		d.Points=d.Points or {}
		d.FrameData=d.FrameData or {}
		local frame=d.FrameData
		frame.Points=BoxPoints(hrp,head,hum,d.Points)
		frame.Project=project
		frame.HRP=hrp
		frame.Head=head
		frame.Look=hrp.CFrame.LookVector
		frame.CamUp=cam.CFrame.UpVector
		frame.Dist=dist
		frame.NameText=plr and (S.NameType == "Username" and plr.Name or plr.DisplayName) or model.Name
		frame.PlayerName=plr and plr.DisplayName or model.Name
		frame.ToolText=tool and tool.Name or nil
		frame.Health=hum.Health
		frame.MaxHealth=hum.MaxHealth
		frame.Color=override or S.BoxColor
		frame.Override=override
		frame.TracerFrom=from
		frame.Pairs=d.Pairs
		frame.Role=role
		frame.RoleColor=roleColor
		d:Update(frame)

		if S.Arrows then
			local v = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
			local vs = cam.ViewportSize

			if S.ArrowsAlways or v.Z <= 0 or v.X < 0 or v.Y < 0 or v.X > vs.X or v.Y > vs.Y then
				local rel = cam.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(hrp.Position)
				local dir = Vector2.new(rel.X, rel.Z)
				if dir.Magnitude > 0.001 then
					d:ShowArrow(vs / 2, dir.Unit, override or S.ArrowColor, S.ArrowRadius + S.ArrowSpreadNow)
				else
					d:HideArrow()
				end
			else
				d:HideArrow()
			end
		else
			d:HideArrow()
		end
	end)

	local espPhone = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
	local espAcc = 0
	local espConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
		-- phones: ESP redraw at 30 per second instead of every frame
		if espPhone then espAcc += dt; if espAcc < 1 / 20 then return end; espAcc = 0 end
		Combat:BeginESPFrame()
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then return end
		do
			local target = 0
			local myHrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if S.ArrowSpread and myHrp then
				local v = myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				local k = math.clamp(Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude / 16 + math.abs(v.Y) / 60, 0, 1.4)
				target = k * S.ArrowSpreadAmount
			end
			local speed = 2 + (1 - S.ArrowSpreadSmooth / 100) * 18
			S.ArrowSpreadNow += (target - S.ArrowSpreadNow) * math.min(dt * speed, 1)
		end

		table.clear(seen)
		if S.Enabled then
			local vs = cam.ViewportSize
			local project = function(p)
				local v = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(p)
				return Vector2.new(v.X, v.Y), v.Z
			end
			local from
			if S.TracerFrom == "Bottom" then from = Vector2.new(vs.X / 2, vs.Y)
			elseif S.TracerFrom == "Center" then from = vs / 2
			elseif S.TracerFrom == "Top" then from = Vector2.new(vs.X / 2, 0)
			else from = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() end

			for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local char = p.Character
				if char and (p ~= LocalPlayer or S.Self)
					and not (S.TeamCheck and p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Team and p.Team == LocalPlayer.Team) then
					HandleTarget(char, p, cam, project, from)
				end
			end
		end

		for model in pairs(Drawers) do if not seen[model] then CleanTarget(model) end end
		for model in pairs(Highs) do if not seen[model] then CleanTarget(model) end end



	end))




	local function SnapSideOf(rect, p)
		local cx, cy = rect[1] + rect[3] / 2, rect[2] + rect[4] / 2
		local dx = (p.X - cx) / math.max(rect[3], 1)
		local dy = (p.Y - cy) / math.max(rect[4], 1)
		if math.abs(dx) > math.abs(dy) then return dx < 0 and "Left" or "Right" end
		return dy < 0 and "Top" or "Bottom"
	end
	local function ApplySide(key, side)
		local flag = CrackHub.Flags["ESP_Pos_" .. key]
		if flag then flag:Set(POS_RU[side]) else S.Pos[key] = side end
	end

	local MenuOpen; MenuOpen = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()

	end)

		end

	local camRay = RaycastParams.new()
	camRay.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude


	local function PlayerUnderMouse(m)
		local best, bestArea
		for _, d in pairs(Drawers) do
			local r = d.Rect
			if r and m.X >= r[1] - 4 and m.X <= r[1] + r[3] + 4 and m.Y >= r[2] - 4 and m.Y <= r[2] + r[4] + 4 then
				local area = r[3] * r[4]
				if not bestArea or area < bestArea then best, bestArea = d, area end
			end
		end
		if best then return best.PlayerName or "Player" end

		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then return nil end
		local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(m.X, m.Y)
		camRay.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LocalPlayer.Character }
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 1000, camRay)
		local model = hit and hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		local plr = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
		if plr and plr ~= LocalPlayer then return plr.DisplayName end
		return nil
	end

	local rPress = nil
	table.insert(liveConns, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then return end
		if gp or not S.Enabled or not S.EditOnPlayers then return end
		rPress = { Pos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation(), Time = os.clock() }
	end))
	table.insert(liveConns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 or not rPress then return end
		local pr = rPress
		rPress = nil
		local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

		if (m - pr.Pos).Magnitude > 6 or os.clock() - pr.Time > 0.35 then return end
		local at = m - GuiService:GetGuiInset()

		for _, d in pairs(Drawers) do
			if d:ArrowHit(m) then
				if PopApi.Arrow then PopApi.Arrow(at, true, d.PlayerName) end
				return
			end
		end
		local name = PlayerUnderMouse(m)
		if name and PopApi.Box then
			PopApi.Box(at, true, name)
		end
	end))
	table.insert(liveConns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not liveDrag then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			liveDrag.D.DragPos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		end
	end))
	table.insert(liveConns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if not liveDrag then return end
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		local d, key = liveDrag.D, liveDrag.Key
		liveDrag = nil
		d.DragKey = nil

		if d.Root.Parent and d.Rect and d.DragPos then
			ApplySide(key, SnapSideOf(d.Rect, d.DragPos))
		end
	end))


	table.insert(liveConns, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
		if liveDrag and not liveDrag.D.Root.Parent then liveDrag = nil end
		if not CanEdit() then
			LiveHover.Visible = false
			return
		end
		local d, key
		if liveDrag then
			d, key = liveDrag.D, liveDrag.Key
		else
			d, key = LiveHit(UserInputService:GetMouseLocation())
		end
		local inst = d and d.Hit[key]
		if not inst then

			local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
			for _, dd in pairs(Drawers) do
				if dd:ArrowHit(m) then inst = dd.Arrow break end
			end
		end
		if inst and inst.Visible then
			LiveHover.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(inst.AbsolutePosition.X - 3, inst.AbsolutePosition.Y - 2)
			LiveHover.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(inst.AbsoluteSize.X + 6, inst.AbsoluteSize.Y + 4)
			LiveHover.Visible = true
		else
			LiveHover.Visible = false
		end
	end)))

		local symbols = {}

			table.insert(symbols, Create("TextLabel", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -1),
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Text = sym,
				FontFace = Fonts.Bold,
				TextSize = 11,
				TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 25, 15),
				TextTransparency = 1,
				ZIndex = 5,
				Parent = b,
			}))
			local sc = Create("UIScale", { Parent = b })
			b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() Tween(sc, { Scale = 0.85 }, 0.1) end)

		local pModel, pHRP, pHead, pHum, pPairs
		local Center, Distance = Vector3.zero, 10
		local REMOVE = { "LuaSourceContainer", "Sound", "ForceField", "ParticleEmitter", "Trail", "Beam", "Light", "BillboardGui" }

		local function ChamsLook(clone)
			for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("Clothing") or d:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") or d:IsA("Decal") then
					d:Destroy()
				elseif d:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
					d.TextureId = ""
				end
			end
			local k = 1 - S.ChamsFillT * 0.8
			for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.Transparency < 1 then
					if d:IsA("MeshPart") then pcall(function() d.TextureID = "" end) end
					d.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
					d.Color = d.Color:Lerp(S.ChamsFill, k)
				end
			end
			Combat:PaintPreview(clone)
		end

		local function Build()
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not hrp then return end

			local old = char.Archivable
			char.Archivable = true
			local ok, clone = pcall(function() return char:Clone() end)
			char.Archivable = old
			if not ok or not clone then return end

			for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
				local kill = false
				for _, cls in ipairs(REMOVE) do
					if d:IsA(cls) then kill = true break end
				end
				if kill then
					d:Destroy()
				elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
					d.Anchored = true
					d.CanCollide = false
					d.CastShadow = false
				end
			end
			local hum = clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then
				hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
				hum.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
			end
			if S.Enabled and S.Chams then ChamsLook(clone) end

			clone:PivotTo(hrp.CFrame:Inverse() * clone:GetPivot())
			local box, size = clone:GetBoundingBox()
			local half = math.rad(Camera.FieldOfView / 2)
			local aspect = BASE_W / (BASE_H - HEADER - 1)
			local w = math.max(size.X, size.Z)

			local dV = (size.Y / 2 * 1.45) / math.tan(half)
			local dH = (w / 2 * 1.6) / (math.tan(half) * aspect)
			Distance = math.max(dV, dH) + w / 2
			Center = box.Position

			if pModel then pModel:Destroy() end
			pModel = clone
			clone.Parent = World
			pHRP = clone:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			pHead = clone:FindFirstChild("Head")
			pHum = hum
			pPairs = GetBonePairs(clone)

			if not collapsed then
				Viewport.ImageTransparency = 0.7
				Tween(Viewport, { ImageTransparency = 0 }, 0.4)
			end
		end

		local pending = false
		local function Schedule()
			if pending then return end
			pending = true
			task.delay(0.3, function()
				pending = false
				Build()
			end)
		end
		Preview.Schedule = Schedule

		local iconSpin = false
		RefreshBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			Build()
			if iconSpin then return end
			iconSpin = true
			RefreshIcon.Rotation = 0
			Tween(RefreshIcon, { Rotation = 360 }, 0.6).Completed:Connect(function()
				RefreshIcon.Rotation = 0
				iconSpin = false
			end)
		end)


		local function SetCollapsed(state)
			collapsed = state
			if state then
				Overlay.Visible = false
				Tween(Viewport, { ImageTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
				Tween(Divider, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, 0.2)
				Tween(RefreshBtn, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) }, 0.2)
				Tween(Panel, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, HEADER) }, 0.32)
				task.delay(0.32, function() if collapsed then Body.Visible = false end end)
			else
				Body.Visible = true
				Body.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height - HEADER - 1)
				Tween(Panel, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height) }, 0.36)
				Tween(Divider, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, 0.2)
				Tween(RefreshBtn, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26) }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
				task.delay(0.12, function()
					if not collapsed then Tween(Viewport, { ImageTransparency = 0 }, 0.3) end
				end)
			end
		end

		Light(Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 87), "×", 1, function()
			closed = true
			Tween(PanelScale, { Scale = 0 }, 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In).Completed:Connect(function()
				if closed then Panel.Visible = false end
			end)
		end)
		Light(Color3.fromRGB(254, 188, 46), "–", 2, function() SetCollapsed(not collapsed) end)
		Light(Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 64), "+", 3, function()
			if collapsed then return end
			zoomed = not zoomed
			local k = zoomed and 1.25 or 1
			width, height = math.floor(BASE_W * k), math.floor(BASE_H * k)
			Body.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height - HEADER - 1)
			Tween(Panel, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height) }, 0.35)
		end)


		local charConns = {}
		local function IsLook(d)
			return d:IsA("Accessory") or d:IsA("Clothing") or d:IsA("ShirtGraphic")
				or d:IsA("BodyColors") or d:IsA("CharacterMesh") or d:IsA("Decal")
				or d:IsA("SpecialMesh") or d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") or d:IsA("WrapLayer")
				or d:IsA("Tool") or d:IsA("BasePart")
		end
		local function Watch(d)
			if d:IsA("Clothing") or d:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or d:IsA("BodyColors")
				or d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
				table.insert(charConns, d.Changed:Connect(Schedule))
			elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
				for _, prop in ipairs({ "Color", "Material", "Size" }) do
					table.insert(charConns, d:GetPropertyChangedSignal(prop):Connect(Schedule))
				end
			end
		end
		local function OnCharacter(char)
			for _, c in ipairs(charConns) do c:Disconnect() end
			table.clear(charConns)
			for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do Watch(d) end
			table.insert(charConns, char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
				Watch(d)
				if IsLook(d) then Schedule() end
			end))
			table.insert(charConns, char.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(d)
				if IsLook(d) then Schedule() end
			end))
			char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
			Schedule()
		end
		local cAdded = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(OnCharacter)
		local cLoaded = LocalPlayer.CharacterAppearanceLoaded:Connect(Schedule)
		if LocalPlayer.Character then task.spawn(OnCharacter, LocalPlayer.Character) end

		local function SetFlag(name, value, fallback)

		end

			function P.Show(at, fromWorld, who)
				for _, other in ipairs(Pops) do
					if other ~= P then other.Close() end
				end
				P.World = fromWorld == true
				Title.Text = who and (cfg.Title .. " · " .. who) or cfg.Title
				Refresh()
				RefreshSwitch()
				RefreshSwatches()
				local scr = Window.Gui.AbsoluteSize
				local k = math.max(Base(), 0.01)
				local h = (#cfg.Modes * 32 + 120) * k
				Pop.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
					math.clamp(at.X + 10, 6, scr.X - POP_W * k - 6),
					math.clamp(at.Y + 10, 6, scr.Y - h - 6)
				)
				Pop.Visible = true
				P.Open = true
				anim.Value = 0
				TweenService:Create(anim, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Value = 1 }):Play()
			end

			table.insert(Pops, P)
			return P
		end


		local BoxPop = BuildPop({
			Title = "Boxes",
			Modes = {
				{ Name = "Off", Value = "off" },
				{ Name = "Full", Value = "Full" },
				{ Name = "Corners", Value = "Corners" },
				{ Name = "3D", Value = "3D" },
			},
			Current = function() return S.Box and S.BoxType or "off" end,
			Select = function(v)
				if v == "off" then
					SetFlag("ESP_Box", false, function(x) S.Box = x end)
				else
					SetFlag("ESP_Box", true, function(x) S.Box = x end)
					SetFlag("ESP_BoxType", v, function(x) S.BoxType = x end)
				end
			end,
			Switch = {
				Name = "Fill",
				Get = function() return S.BoxFill end,
				Set = function(v) SetFlag("ESP_BoxFill", v, function(x) S.BoxFill = x end) end,
			},
			Color = {
				Get = function() return S.BoxColor end,
				Set = function(c) SetFlag("ESP_BoxColor", c, function(x) S.BoxColor = x end) end,
			},
		})


		local arrowModes = { { Name = "Off", Value = "off" } }
		for _, st in ipairs(ARROW_STYLES) do
			table.insert(arrowModes, { Name = st.Name, Value = st.Name, Image = st.Image, Dir = st.Dir, Scale = st.Scale })
		end
		local ArrowPop = BuildPop({
			Title = "Arrows",
			Modes = arrowModes,
			Current = function() return S.Arrows and S.ArrowStyle or "off" end,
			Select = function(v)
				if v == "off" then
					SetFlag("ESP_Arrows", false, function(x) S.Arrows = x end)
				else
					SetFlag("ESP_Arrows", true, function(x) S.Arrows = x end)
					SetFlag("ESP_ArrowStyle", v, function(x) S.ArrowStyle = x end)
				end
			end,
			Switch = {
				Name = "360° (always)",
				Get = function() return S.ArrowsAlways end,
				Set = function(v) SetFlag("ESP_ArrowsAlways", v, function(x) S.ArrowsAlways = x end) end,
			},
			Color = {
				Get = function() return S.ArrowColor end,
				Set = function(c) SetFlag("ESP_ArrowColor", c, function(x) S.ArrowColor = x end) end,
			},
		})

		PopApi.Box = BoxPop.Show
		PopApi.Arrow = ArrowPop.Show


		table.insert(popConns, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			for _, P in ipairs(Pops) do
				if P.Open then
					if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
						P.Close()
					elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
						or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
						local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset()
						local p, s = P.Frame.AbsolutePosition, P.Frame.AbsoluteSize
						if m.X < p.X or m.Y < p.Y or m.X > p.X + s.X or m.Y > p.Y + s.Y then
							P.Close()
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end))


		local AUTO = math.rad(40)
		local angle, zoom, spinVel = 0, 1, AUTO
		local rotating, lastX, dragAccum, dragVel = false, 0, 0, 0
		local labelDrag = nil
		local press = nil

		local MouseGui; MouseGui = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			return UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() - GuiService:GetGuiInset()
		end)
		local function ToLocal(m)
			return (m - Overlay.AbsolutePosition) / math.max(WinScale.Scale, 0.01)
		end
		local function SnapSide(rect, p)
			local cx, cy = rect[1] + rect[3] / 2, rect[2] + rect[4] / 2
			local dx = (p.X - cx) / math.max(rect[3], 1)
			local dy = (p.Y - cy) / math.max(rect[4], 1)
			if math.abs(dx) > math.abs(dy) then return dx < 0 and "Left" or "Right" end
			return dy < 0 and "Top" or "Bottom"
		end

		local inputConns = {}
		table.insert(inputConns, DragArea.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			local key = S.Enabled and PDrawer:HitTest(MouseGui()) or nil
			if key then
				labelDrag = key
				PDrawer.DragKey = key
				PDrawer.DragPos = ToLocal(MouseGui())
			else
				rotating = true
				lastX = input.Position.X
				dragAccum, dragVel = 0, 0

				local inBox = false
				local r = PDrawer.Rect
				if S.Enabled and r then
					local lp = ToLocal(MouseGui())
					inBox = lp.X >= r[1] - 6 and lp.X <= r[1] + r[3] + 6 and lp.Y >= r[2] - 6 and lp.Y <= r[2] + r[4] + 6
				end

				local inArrow = S.Enabled and S.Arrows and PDrawer:ArrowHit(MouseGui())
				press = { Pos = MouseGui(), Time = os.clock(), InBox = inBox, InArrow = inArrow }
			end
		end))
		table.insert(inputConns, DragArea.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
				zoom = math.clamp(zoom - input.Position.Z * 0.1, 0.5, 2)
			end
		end))
		table.insert(inputConns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
				and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			if labelDrag then
				PDrawer.DragPos = ToLocal(MouseGui())
			elseif rotating then
				local d = math.rad((input.Position.X - lastX) * 0.8)
				lastX = input.Position.X
				angle += d
				dragAccum += d
			end
		end))
		table.insert(inputConns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
			if labelDrag then
				local key = labelDrag
				labelDrag = nil
				PDrawer.DragKey = nil
				if PDrawer.Rect and PDrawer.DragPos then
					local side = SnapSide(PDrawer.Rect, PDrawer.DragPos)
					local flag = CrackHub.Flags["ESP_Pos_" .. key]
					if flag then flag:Set(POS_RU[side]) else S.Pos[key] = side end
				end
			elseif rotating then
				rotating = false
				local pr = press
				press = nil
				local m = MouseGui()
				if pr and (pr.InArrow or pr.InBox) and (m - pr.Pos).Magnitude < 5 and os.clock() - pr.Time < 0.35 then

					if pr.InArrow then PopApi.Arrow(m) else PopApi.Box(m) end
					return
				end
				local dir = dragVel < 0 and -1 or 1
				spinVel = math.abs(dragVel) > AUTO and math.clamp(dragVel, -AUTO * 12, AUTO * 12) or AUTO * dir
			end
		end))

		local MakeProjector; MakeProjector = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(camCF, fov, size)
			local tanH = math.tan(math.rad(fov) / 2)
			local aspect = size.X / size.Y
			return function(p)
				local o = camCF:PointToObjectSpace(p)
				local z = -o.Z
				if z <= 0.05 then return Vector2.zero, -1 end
				return Vector2.new(
					(o.X / (z * tanH * aspect) + 1) * 0.5 * size.X,
					(1 - o.Y / (z * tanH)) * 0.5 * size.Y
				), z
			end
		end)

		local currentDist = 10
		local wasMenuVisible = false
		local previewConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)

			local sc = WinScale.Scale
			local menuVisible = (Window.Visible or Window.Transitioning) and not Window.Destroyed and not Window.Minimized and Root.Visible and sc > 0.01 and Window.ActiveTab == Tab
			if menuVisible and not wasMenuVisible then closed = false end
			wasMenuVisible = menuVisible
			if not closed then
				Panel.Visible = menuVisible
				PanelScale.Scale = sc
			end
			if not menuVisible then
				Panel.Visible=false; HoverBox.Visible=false
				for _,P in ipairs(Pops) do if P.Open and not P.World then P.Close() end end
				return
			end
			local p, s = Root.AbsolutePosition, Root.AbsoluteSize
			Panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.X + s.X + 12 * sc, p.Y)


			for _, P in ipairs(Pops) do
				if P.Open and not P.World and (not Panel.Visible or collapsed or not S.Enabled) then P.Close() end
				if P.Frame.Visible then P.UpdateScale() end
			end

			if not Panel.Visible or collapsed or not Body.Visible or not pModel or not pHRP then
				HoverBox.Visible = false
				return
			end


			if rotating then
				local v = dragAccum / math.max(dt, 1e-3)
				dragVel += (v - dragVel) * math.min(dt * 15, 1)
				dragAccum = 0
			elseif not labelDrag then
				local target = AUTO * (spinVel < 0 and -1 or 1)
				spinVel += (target - spinVel) * math.min(dt * 2.5, 1)
				angle += spinVel * dt
			end
			currentDist += (Distance * zoom - currentDist) * math.min(dt * 12, 1)
			local offset = Vector3.new(math.sin(angle), 0.12, -math.cos(angle)) * currentDist
			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Center + offset, Center)


			if not S.Enabled then
				Overlay.Visible = false
				return
			end
			Overlay.Visible = true
			local size = Vector2.new(width, height - HEADER - 1)
			local override
			if S.TeamColor and LocalPlayer.Team then override = LocalPlayer.TeamColor.Color end
			if S.VisibleCheck then override = S.VisibleColor end
			local myRole = GetRole(LocalPlayer)
			local myRoleColor = RoleColor(myRole)
			if myRoleColor then override = myRoleColor end
			local from
			if S.TracerFrom == "Center" then from = size / 2
			elseif S.TracerFrom == "Top" then from = Vector2.new(size.X / 2, 0)
			else from = Vector2.new(size.X / 2, size.Y) end
			local tool = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")

			PDrawer:Update({
				Points = BoxPoints(pHRP, pHead, pHum),
				Project = MakeProjector(Camera.CFrame, Camera.FieldOfView, size),
				HRP = pHRP, Head = pHead,
				Look = pHRP.CFrame.LookVector, CamUp = Camera.CFrame.UpVector,
				Dist = 30,
				NameText = S.NameType == "Username" and LocalPlayer.Name or LocalPlayer.DisplayName,
				ToolText = tool and tool.Name or "Sword",
				Health = 60 + 40 * math.sin(os.clock() * 0.8), MaxHealth = 100,
				Color = override or S.BoxColor, Override = override,
				TracerFrom = from, Pairs = pPairs,
				Role = myRole, RoleColor = myRoleColor,
			})
			if S.Arrows then
				PDrawer:ShowArrow(size / 2, Vector2.new(-1, 0), override or S.ArrowColor, size.X / 2 - S.ArrowSize)
			else
				PDrawer:HideArrow()
			end


			local key = labelDrag or (not rotating and PDrawer:HitTest(MouseGui()))
			local inst = key and PDrawer.Hit[key]
			if inst and inst.Visible then
				local k = math.max(sc, 0.01)
				local ip = (inst.AbsolutePosition - Overlay.AbsolutePosition) / k
				local is = inst.AbsoluteSize / k
				HoverBox.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ip.X - 3, ip.Y - 2)
				HoverBox.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(is.X + 6, is.Y + 4)
				HoverBox.Visible = true
			else
				HoverBox.Visible = false
			end
		end))


		Window.Gui.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
			if parent then return end
			espConn:Disconnect()
			for _, c in ipairs(roleConns) do c:Disconnect() end
			for _, c in ipairs(JCState.Conns) do c:Disconnect() end
			if JCState.CharConn then JCState.CharConn:Disconnect() end
			JCFolder:Destroy()
			PartApi.Destroy()
			CubesApi.Destroy()
			FogApi.Destroy()
			TrailApi.Destroy()
			BlurTexApi.Destroy()
			McCamApi.Destroy()
			HatApi.Destroy()
			MotionTrailApi.Destroy()
			GhostApi.Destroy()
			previewConn:Disconnect()
			cAdded:Disconnect()
			cLoaded:Disconnect()
			for _, c in ipairs(charConns) do c:Disconnect() end
			for _, c in ipairs(inputConns) do c:Disconnect() end
			for _, c in ipairs(popConns) do c:Disconnect() end
			for _, c in ipairs(liveConns) do c:Disconnect() end
			for model in pairs(Drawers) do CleanTarget(model) end
			for model in pairs(Highs) do CleanTarget(model) end
			EspGui:Destroy()
		end)
	end

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "CrackHubFoxNPC"
	local built, meshes = {}, {}
	local pending, closed = 0, false
	for i, item in ipairs(data) do
		if item.Class == "MeshPart" then
			pending += 1
			task.spawn(function()
				local meshId = item.Props.MeshId
				local ok, part = pcall(function()
					return game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromUri(meshId))
				end)
				if ok and part then
					if closed then part:Destroy() else meshes[i] = part end
				end
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
	end
	local deadline = os.clock() + 8
	while pending > 0 and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait(0.1) end
	closed = true
	for i, item in ipairs(data) do
		local obj
		if item.Class == "MeshPart" then
			obj = meshes[i] or Instance.new("Part")
		else
			local ok, value = pcall(Instance.new, item.Class)
			if ok then obj = value end
		end
		if obj then obj.Name = item.Name; built[i] = obj end
	end
	local function decode(value)
		if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
		if value.t == "ref" then return built[value.v] end
		if value.t == "cf" then return CFrame.new(table.unpack(value.v)) end
		if value.t == "v3" then return Vector3.new(table.unpack(value.v)) end
		if value.t == "color" then return Color3.new(table.unpack(value.v)) end
		if value.t == "enum" then
			local kind, name = value.v:match("^Enum%.([%w_]+)%.([%w_]+)$")
			if kind then return Enum[kind][name] end
		end
	end
	for i, item in ipairs(data) do
		local obj = built[i]
		if obj then
			if obj:IsA("Humanoid") then obj.AutomaticScalingEnabled = false end
			for prop, value in pairs(item.Props) do
				if not (item.Class == "MeshPart" and (prop == "MeshId" or prop == "MeshSize")) then
					pcall(function() obj[prop] = decode(value) end)
				end
			end
			if item.Class == "MeshPart" and not obj:IsA("MeshPart") then
				local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
				mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
				mesh.MeshId = item.Props.MeshId
				mesh.TextureId = item.Props.TextureID or ""
				local size = item.Props.MeshSize and decode(item.Props.MeshSize)
				if size then mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(obj.Size.X / math.max(size.X, 0.001), obj.Size.Y / math.max(size.Y, 0.001), obj.Size.Z / math.max(size.Z, 0.001)) end
				mesh.Parent = obj
			end
			if obj:IsA("BasePart") then obj.Anchored = true; obj.CanCollide = false end
		end
	end
	for i, item in ipairs(data) do
		local obj = built[i]
		if obj then pcall(function() obj.Parent = built[item.Parent] or model end) end
	end
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart", true)
	if not root then model:Destroy(); error("Failed to build the NPC") end
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	return model
end

local function LoadCrackHubFox()
	local localModel = workspace:FindFirstChild("FoxNPC")
	if localModel and localModel:IsA("Model") then
		local ok, clone = pcall(function() return localModel:Clone() end)
		if ok and clone then return clone end
	end
	local completed, abandoned, result = false, false, nil
	task.spawn(function()
		local uri = "rbxassetid://81260816134998"
		local ok, objects = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects(uri) end)
		if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" or #objects == 0 then
			local getAsset = getobjects or CrackHubEnvironment.getobjects
			if type(getAsset) == "function" then ok, objects = pcall(getAsset, uri) end
		end
		if ok and type(objects) == "table" then
			if not abandoned then
				for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
					if object:IsA("Model") and object:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart", true) then
						result = object
						break
					end
					for _, child in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
						if child:IsA("Model") and child:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then result = child; break end
					end
					if result then break end
				end
				if result then result.Parent = nil end
			end
			for _, object in ipairs(objects) do if object ~= result then object:Destroy() end end
		end
		completed = true
	end)
	local deadline = os.clock() + 6
	while not completed and os.clock() < deadline do task.wait(0.1) end
	abandoned = true
	if result then return result end
	return BuildCrackHubFoxBackup()
end

local NPC_NAME = "TalkNPC"

local function getNpc()
	return npcModel

local function getMotor(npc, name)
	return npc and npc:FindFirstChild(name, true)
end


local IDENTITY = CFrame.new()


local waving = false
local function wave()
	if waving then
		return
	end
	local npc = getNpc()
	local shoulder = getMotor(npc, "RightShoulder")
	local elbow = getMotor(npc, "RightElbow")
	if not shoulder then
		return
	end

	local sAngle = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	local eAngle = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	local function apply()
		if shoulder.Parent then
			shoulder.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, sAngle.Value)
		end
		if elbow and elbow.Parent then
			elbow.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, eAngle.Value)
		end
	end
	local c1 = sAngle:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(apply)
	local c2 = eAngle:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(apply)

	local function tweenTo(value, target, time, style)
		local tween = TweenService:Create(value, TweenInfo.new(time, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Value = target })
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Wait()
	end

	waving = true
	task.spawn(function()
		tweenTo(sAngle, 1.6, 0.35)
		tweenTo(eAngle, 1.3, 0.25)
		for _ = 1, 3 do
			tweenTo(eAngle, 0.9, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine)
			tweenTo(eAngle, 1.7, 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine)
		end
		tweenTo(eAngle, 0, 0.25)
		tweenTo(sAngle, 0, 0.35)
		c1:Disconnect()
		c2:Disconnect()
		sAngle:Destroy()
		eAngle:Destroy()

		if shoulder.Parent then
			shoulder.Transform = IDENTITY
		end
		if elbow and elbow.Parent then
			elbow.Transform = IDENTITY
		end
		waving = false
	end)
end


local sway = nil
local tailRest = {}
local function setSway(enabled)
	if sway then
		sway:Disconnect()
		sway = nil
	end
	local npc = getNpc()
	local neck = getMotor(npc, "Neck")
	if not neck then
		return
	end


	local tailWelds = {}
	for _, acc in ipairs(npc:GetChildren()) do
		if acc:IsA("Accessory") and acc.AccessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Back then
			local handle = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			local weld = handle and handle:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")
			if weld and weld:IsA("JointInstance") or (weld and weld:IsA("Weld")) then
				tailRest[weld] = tailRest[weld] or weld.C0
				table.insert(tailWelds, weld)
			end
		end
	end

	if enabled then
		sway = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
			local t = os.clock()
			if neck.Parent then
				neck.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(t * 5) * 0.1, math.sin(t * 7) * 0.05)
			end
			for _, weld in ipairs(tailWelds) do
				if weld.Parent then
					weld.C0 = tailRest[weld] * CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(t * 8) * 0.35, 0)
				end
			end
		end))
	else

		neck.Transform = IDENTITY
		for _, weld in ipairs(tailWelds) do
			if weld.Parent then
				weld.C0 = tailRest[weld]
			end
		end
	end
end



local CAM_BIND = "CrackHubFoxCamera"
local camState = nil

local camStep; camStep = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local st = camState
	if not (camera and st) then
		return
	end
	if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	end
	local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-dt * CAM_SPEED)
	camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame:Lerp(st.Target, alpha)
	camera.FieldOfView += (st.FOV - camera.FieldOfView) * alpha


	if st.Closing and (camera.CFrame.Position - st.Target.Position).Magnitude < 0.1 then
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CAM_BIND)
		camera.FieldOfView = st.SavedFOV
		camera.CameraType = st.SavedType or Enum.CameraType.Custom
		camera.CameraSubject = st.SavedSubject
		camState = nil
	end
end)

local function zoomIn(npc)
	local head = npc:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local root = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not (head and root and camera) then
		return
	end
	local target = head.Position
	local pos = root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * CAM_DISTANCE + root.CFrame.RightVector * CAM_SIDE
	pos = Vector3.new(pos.X, target.Y + 0.3, pos.Z)
	local lookAt = CFrame.lookAt(pos, target - Vector3.new(0, 0.3, 0))

	if camState then

		camState.Target = lookAt
		camState.FOV = CAM_FOV
		camState.Closing = false
		return
	end
	camState = {
		Target = lookAt,
		FOV = CAM_FOV,
		SavedCFrame = camera.CFrame,
		SavedFOV = camera.FieldOfView,
		SavedType = camera.CameraType,
		SavedSubject = camera.CameraSubject,
		Closing = false,
	}
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	RunService:BindToRenderStep(CAM_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, camStep)
end

local function zoomOut()
	if not camState then
		return
	end
	camState.Target = camState.SavedCFrame
	camState.FOV = camState.SavedFOV
	camState.Closing = true
end




local function makeCircle(color, x, parent, glyph)
	local c = Instance.new("TextButton")
	c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
	c.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0.5, 0)
	c.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	c.BackgroundColor3 = color
	c.BorderSizePixel = 0
	c.AutoButtonColor = false
	c.Text = ""
	c.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 30, 20)
	c.TextSize = 11
	c.Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansBold
	c.Parent = parent
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	corner.Parent = c
	c.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		c.Text = glyph
	end)
	c.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		c.Text = ""
	end)
	return c
end

	sound.Parent = gui

	task.spawn(function()
		ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ sound }, function(_, status)
			if status ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
				sound.SoundId = SOUND_FALLBACK_ID
			end
		end)
	end)

	return {
		Gui = gui,
		Frame = frame,
		Scale = scale,
		Text = text,
		Buttons = buttons,
		Sound = sound,
		Close = btnClose,
		Min = btnMin,
		Max = btnMax,
	}
end

local function makeButton(parent, label, order, onClick)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.LayoutOrder = order
	b.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 38)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_BUTTON
	b.AutoButtonColor = false
	b.Text = label
	b.TextColor3 = COLOR_TEXT
	b.TextSize = 18
	b.Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSans
	b.Parent = parent

	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 16)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 16)
	pad.Parent = b

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
	corner.Parent = b

	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		b.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_BUTTON_HOVER
	end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		b.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_BUTTON
	end)
	b.Activated:Connect(onClick)
	return b
end



local function isActive(s)
	return session == s
end


local function say(s, message)
	s.Buttons.Visible = false
	s.Text.Text = ""
	setSway(true)


	local chars = {}
	for _, code in utf8.codes(message) do
		table.insert(chars, utf8.char(code))
	end

	for i, ch in ipairs(chars) do
		if not isActive(s) then
			setSway(false)
			return false
		end
		s.Text.Text = table.concat(chars, "", 1, i)


		if i % 2 == 0 and ch ~= " " then
			s.Sound.PlaybackSpeed = SOUND_SPEED_MIN + math.random() * (SOUND_SPEED_MAX - SOUND_SPEED_MIN)
			s.Sound.TimePosition = 0
			s.Sound:Play()
		end

		task.wait(PUNCTUATION[ch] and PUNCT_DELAY or TYPE_DELAY)
	end

	setSway(false)
	return isActive(s)
end

local function closeWindow(s)
	if session ~= s then
		return
	end
	session = nil
	setSway(false)
	zoomOut()
	local tween = TweenService:Create(s.Scale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = 0 })
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Once(function()
		s.Gui:Destroy()
	end)
end

local showButtons

local function ask(s, q)
	s.Buttons.Visible = false
	wave()
	if say(s, q.A) then
		showButtons(s)
	end
end

showButtons = function(s)
	if not isActive(s) then
		return
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(s.Buttons:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextButton") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	for i, q in ipairs(DIALOG.Questions) do
		makeButton(s.Buttons, q.Q, i, function()
			task.spawn(ask, s, q)
		end)
	end

	makeButton(s.Buttons, "Bye!", #DIALOG.Questions + 1, function()
		task.spawn(function()
			s.Buttons.Visible = false
			wave()
			if say(s, DIALOG.Bye) then
				task.wait(0.6)
				closeWindow(s)
			end
		end)
	end)

	s.Buttons.Visible = true
end

local function openDialog()
	if session then
		return
	end

	local npc = getNpc()
	local torso = npc and npc:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	if not torso then
		return
	end

	local s = createWindow()
	session = s
	zoomIn(npc)

	TweenService:Create(s.Scale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()


	local collapsed, enlarged = false, false
	local function resizeWindow()
		local w = enlarged and 600 or 480
		local h = collapsed and 34 or (enlarged and 270 or 210)
		TweenService:Create(s.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h),
		}):Play()
	end
	s.Close.Activated:Connect(function()
		closeWindow(s)
	end)
	s.Min.Activated:Connect(function()
		collapsed = not collapsed
		resizeWindow()
	end)
	s.Max.Activated:Connect(function()
		enlarged = not enlarged
		collapsed = false
		resizeWindow()
	end)


	task.spawn(function()
		while isActive(s) do
			local char = player.Character
			local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root or not torso.Parent or (root.Position - torso.Position).Magnitude > CLOSE_DISTANCE then
				closeWindow(s)
				break
			end
			task.wait(0.2)
		end
	end)

	wave()
	if say(s, DIALOG.Greeting) then
		showButtons(s)
	end
end

local talkPrompt = torso and torso:FindFirstChild("TalkPrompt")
if not talkPrompt then return function() end end
talkPrompt.Enabled = true
local disposed = false
local promptConnection = talkPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
	if not disposed then openDialog() end
end)
local function cleanup()
	if disposed then return end
	disposed = true
	promptConnection:Disconnect()
	local active = session
	session = nil
	setSway(false)
	RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CAM_BIND)
	if camState then
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera then
			camera.CFrame = camState.SavedCFrame
			camera.FieldOfView = camState.SavedFOV
			camera.CameraType = camState.SavedType or Enum.CameraType.Custom
			camera.CameraSubject = camState.SavedSubject
		end
		camState = nil
	end
	if active then active.Gui:Destroy() end
end
npcModel.Destroying:Connect(cleanup)
return cleanup

do
	local allowed = true
	if allowed then
		local previous = workspace:FindFirstChild("CrackHubFoxNPC")
		if previous then previous:Destroy() end
		local spawned
		local cancelled = false
		Window.Gui.Destroying:Connect(function()
			cancelled = true
			if spawned then spawned:Destroy(); spawned = nil end
		end)
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				local saved = CFrame.new(502.121613, 461.366577, 37.538071, -0.014615, -0.007772, 0.999863, 0.000136, 0.999970, 0.007775, -0.999893, 0.000250, -0.014613)
				local target = saved.Position
				local front = -saved.LookVector
				front = Vector3.new(front.X, 0, front.Z).Unit
				target = saved.Position + front * 4
				local model = LoadCrackHubFox()
				spawned = model
				if cancelled or Window.Destroyed then model:Destroy(); return end
				model.Name = "CrackHubFoxNPC"
				local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart", true)
				for _, child in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
					if child:IsA("BaseScript") then
						child.Enabled = false
					elseif child:IsA("BasePart") then
						child.Anchored = child == root
						child.CanCollide = false
						child.CanTouch = false
						child.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						child.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end
				end
				local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid then humanoid.AutoRotate = false; humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0 end
				local initial = CFrame.lookAt(target, target + front)
				model:PivotTo(initial)
				local existing = workspace:FindFirstChild("CrackHubFoxNPC")
				if existing and existing ~= model then existing:Destroy() end
				model.Parent = workspace
				StartCrackHubFoxDialogue(model)
				if CrackHub.FoxStyle then
					local okStyle, errStyle = pcall(CrackHub.FoxStyle, model, Window)
					if not okStyle then warn("[CrackHub Fox] " .. tostring(errStyle)) end
				end
				task.spawn(function() pcall(function() LocalPlayer:RequestStreamAroundAsync(target, 8) end) end)
				local params = RaycastParams.new()
				params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				params.IgnoreWater = true
				params.RespectCanCollide = true
				local ground
				for _ = 1, 60 do
					if cancelled or Window.Destroyed then model:Destroy(); return end
					local excluded = {model}
					for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
						if p.Character then table.insert(excluded, p.Character) end
					end
					params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
					local hit = workspace:Raycast(target + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), Vector3.new(0, -256, 0), params)
					if hit and hit.Normal.Y >= 0.65 then ground = hit.Position; break end
					task.wait(0.5)
				end
				if not ground then
					CrackHub:Notify({Title = "FoxNPC", Content = "NPC created, but no floor was found under it. Check the coordinates and map loading.", Type = "Warning", Duration = 9})
					return
				end
				model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(target, target + front))
				local bottom
				for _, name in ipairs({"LeftFoot", "RightFoot", "Left Leg", "Right Leg"}) do
					local foot = model:FindFirstChild(name, true)
					if foot and foot:IsA("BasePart") then
						local half = foot.Size / 2
						local cf = foot.CFrame
						local low = cf.Position.Y - math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y) * half.X - math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y) * half.Y - math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y) * half.Z
						bottom = bottom and math.min(bottom, low) or low
					end
				end
				if not bottom then
					local box, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
					bottom = box.Position.Y - size.Y / 2
				end
				model:PivotTo(model:GetPivot() + Vector3.new(0, ground.Y + 0.02 - bottom, 0))
				if cancelled or Window.Destroyed then model:Destroy(); return end
			end)
			if not ok then
				if spawned then spawned:Destroy(); spawned = nil end
				if not cancelled and not Window.Destroyed then
					CrackHub:Notify({Title = "FoxNPC", Content = tostring(err), Type = "Error", Duration = 7})
				end
			end
		end)
	end
